articles.abstract_zh_full: 当前开发新型数据操控方式的研究，旨在实现磁性材料中磁化强度的超快控制，并在抗磁性材料中诱导磁矩。我们证明，在抗磁性量子顺电体KTaO₃中，振幅约为300 kV/cm的圆偏振太赫兹脉冲电场能够通过共振激发其简并软极性声子，诱导瞬态类磁响应。我们利用太赫兹泵浦-光学探测技术，通过时间分辨磁光法拉第效应测量了这种声子介导的响应。我们的探测方案被设置为抵消电光克尔效应的主要部分，因为该效应通常也会对瞬态响应作出显著贡献。随后，通过相减与相反圆偏振太赫兹辐射对应的实验数据，进一步抑制了与克尔效应相关的信号。因此，我们能够明确识别出KTaO₃晶体中具有温度依赖性的类磁行为，该行为表现为提取出的法拉第旋转。我们建立了一个理论模型，能够对测得的瞬态法拉第效应信号曲线进行良好的定量描述。然而，这些曲线的幅度呈现出出乎意料的温度依赖性，这可能是深入理解所观察到的声子磁效应的关键。

articles.title: Giant bulk photovoltaic effect driven by interfacial symmetry breaking in MoS2/Ta2NiSe5 heterostructures
articles.title_zh: MoS₂/Ta₂NiSe₅异质结构中由界面反演对称性破缺驱动的巨型体光伏效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27064v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures offer a versatile platform for engineering unconventional bulk photovoltaic (BPV) effect through interfacial symmetry breaking. However, the coexistence of multiple photophysical mechanisms, driven by structural complexity, spontaneous charge transfer, and strong interlayer coupling, often obscures the microscopic origin of the BPV response and hinders its rational optimization. Here, we demonstrate a pronounced BPV effect localized at the overlap region of a cross-bar MoS2/Ta2NiSe5 vdW heterostructure, where symmetry breaking induced by vertical stacking lifts the inversion center of MoS2. The orthogonal device geometry enables the independent probing of intralayer and interfacial photoresponse pathways, facilitating clear separation of competing mechanisms. Spontaneous interfacial charge transfer between MoS2 and Ta2NiSe5 further establishes a strong interlayer electronic coupling. By modulating the interlayer potential landscape through gate voltage and vertical electric fields, we achieve an optimized zero-bias photocurrent density of 247 A/cm2 and a BPV coefficient of 0.99 V-1. Supported by theoretical modelling, our results illustrate how minimalist device geometry can transform complex heterostructures into experimentally tractable platforms. This strategy paves the way for analyzing and optimizing interface-driven BPV effect, with implications for self-powered optoelectronics, broadband photodetection, and energy-harvesting nanodevices.
articles.abstract_zh: 范德华异质结构为通过界面反演对称性破缺设计非常规体光伏效应提供了灵活平台。本文在交叉条形MoS₂/Ta₂NiSe₅范德华异质结构的重叠区域观察到显著体光伏效应，其中垂直堆叠破坏了MoS₂的反演中心。通过正交器件结构，研究者分离了层内和界面光响应路径，并结合界面自发电荷转移和栅压调控，实现了247 A/cm²的零偏压光电流密度和0.99 V⁻¹的体光伏系数。
authors: Jianwen Ma, Pengliang Leng, Lei Peng, Congming Hao, Xianghao Meng, Jiaqi Liu, Yang Gan, Min Luo, Zifan Zhang, Jiaming Gu, Qinghang Liu, Lidan Duan, Du Xiang, Wu Shi, Peng Wang, Weibin Chu, Xiang Yuan, Weida Hu, Cheng Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德华异质结构为通过界面反演对称性破缺设计非常规体光伏效应提供了灵活平台。然而，由结构复杂性、自发电荷转移和强层间耦合驱动的多种光物理机制经常同时存在，从而掩盖体光伏响应的微观起源，并阻碍其理性优化。在此，我们在交叉条形MoS₂/Ta₂NiSe₅范德华异质结构的重叠区域证明了显著的体光伏效应；在该区域，垂直堆叠诱导的对称性破缺抬升了MoS₂的反演中心。正交器件几何结构能够独立探测层内和界面光响应路径，从而清晰分离相互竞争的机制。MoS₂与Ta₂NiSe₅之间的界面自发电荷转移进一步建立了强烈的层间电子耦合。通过栅极电压和垂直电场调节层间势能景观，我们实现了经优化的零偏压光电流密度247 A/cm²以及体光伏系数0.99 V⁻¹。在理论建模的支持下，我们的结果说明，简化的器件几何结构能够将复杂异质结构转化为便于实验分析的平台。这一策略为分析和优化界面驱动的体光伏效应提供了途径，并对自供电光电子学、宽带光探测和能量采集纳米器件具有意义。

articles.title: Laser induced ultrafast Co 3d and Ho 4f spin dynamics in CoHo ferrimagnetic alloys
articles.title_zh: 激光诱导CoHo亚铁磁合金中的超快Co 3d与Ho 4f自旋动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27083v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The transition metal (TM) / rare-earth (RE) alloys have received renewed interest lately as model systems to decipher the origin of all-optical helicity-independent switching (AO-HIS) by femtosecond laser pulses. Recently, a distinct single-pulse magnetization reversal mechanism, based on domain-wall motion and coalescence, has been reported in CoDy and CoHo alloys, as well as in Co/Gd ultrathin bilayers. It has been claimed that this specific toggle switching is achieved when the Co sublattice is fully demagnetized and the characteristic demagnetization times τRE of the RE (Gd, Dy or Ho) sublattices is longer than that of the Co and the angular momentum transferred to Co is reduced. Element- and time-resolved X-ray spectroscopy studies of CoDy alloys have reported characteristic demagnetization times of τCo = 0.2 ps and τDy = 0.6 ps at room temperature. Similarly, Ho is expected to exhibit a slower response, but its ultrafast 4f spin dynamics remain experimentally unexplored. Here, we report on element- and time-resolved investigations of femtosecond laser induced ultrafast dynamics of the Co 3d and Ho 4f spins in ferrimagnetic Co₈₀Ho₂₀ alloys to verify this prediction. We observed characteristic demagnetization times τCo = 0.22 +/- 0.01 ps and τHo = 0.87 +/- 0.15 ps at room temperature. These results show that Ho demagnetizes substantially more slowly than Co in Co₈₀Ho₂₀, supporting the proposed condition for domain-wall-mediated all-optical toggle switching
articles.abstract_zh: 过渡金属/稀土合金是阐明飞秒激光诱导全光螺旋度无关切换机制的重要模型体系。本文对亚铁磁Co80Ho20合金中的Co 3d和Ho 4f自旋进行了元素分辨和时间分辨研究，测得室温下Co和Ho的特征退磁时间分别为0.22±0.01 ps和0.87±0.15 ps。Ho的退磁明显慢于Co，这支持了由畴壁运动介导的全光翻转切换所需的条件。
authors: Deeksha Gupta, Boonthum Kunyangyuen, Matthias Riepp, Karsten Holldack, Radu-Marius Abrudan, Torsten Kachel, Niko Pontius, Christian Schüßler-Langeheine, Mircea Vomir, Michel Hehn, Nicolas Bergeard
articles.abstract_zh_full: 过渡金属（TM）/稀土（RE）合金近年来重新受到关注，因为它们是阐明飞秒激光脉冲诱导的全光螺旋度无关切换（AO-HIS）起源的模型体系。近期研究在CoDy和CoHo合金以及Co/Gd超薄双层中报道了一种独特的单脉冲磁化反转机制，该机制基于畴壁运动和合并。已有观点认为，当Co亚晶格完全退磁、稀土亚晶格的特征退磁时间τRE（Gd、Dy或Ho）长于Co亚晶格的退磁时间，并且传递给Co的角动量减少时，便可以实现这种特定的翻转切换。对CoDy合金开展的元素分辨和时间分辨X射线光谱研究表明，在室温下其特征退磁时间为τCo=0.2 ps和τDy=0.6 ps。类似地，预计Ho会表现出更慢的响应，但其超快4f自旋动力学此前尚未得到实验研究。在此，我们对亚铁磁Co80Ho20合金中飞秒激光诱导的Co 3d和Ho 4f自旋超快动力学进行了元素分辨和时间分辨研究，以验证这一预测。我们在室温下观测到特征退磁时间τCo=0.22±0.01 ps和τHo=0.87±0.15 ps。这些结果表明，在Co80Ho20中Ho的退磁明显慢于Co，从而支持了由畴壁介导的全光翻转切换所提出的条件。

articles.title: Emergent Skyrmion Hall Effect in d-wave Altermagnets at Finite Temperature
articles.title_zh: d 波反铁磁体中有限温度下涌现的斯格明子霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27107v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with unconventional symmetry-dependent responses, offering a promising platform for spintronic applications. Here, we show that a voltage-controlled magnetic-anisotropy gradient drives altermagnetic (ATM) skyrmions in a nearly rectilinear, Hall-free manner in the absence of thermal fluctuations, owing to their strongly compensated gyrotropic response. Thermal magnons qualitatively modify this behavior by increasing the longitudinal drag through magnon--skyrmion scattering and generating a transverse reaction force through handedness-dependent skew scattering. Owing to the anisotropic altermagnetic magnon band structure, the relative transport weights of the two magnon handednesses are interchanged between propagation along the x and y directions, resulting in transverse skyrmion drifts of opposite sign. By contrast, along the high-symmetry direction, the two magnon handednesses remain degenerate and their transverse contributions cancel, preserving Hall-free motion even at finite temperature. We thus uncover a thermally emergent anisotropic skyrmion Hall effect whose direction-dependent magnitude and sign originate from the intrinsic symmetry-dependent magnon spectrum, making it a generic finite-temperature dynamical feature of ATM skyrmions. Our results establish a low-power route toward electrically controlled and thermally tunable ATM skyrmion transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了电压控制的磁各向异性梯度如何驱动反铁磁斯格明子运动，并揭示了有限温度下涌现的各向异性斯格明子霍尔效应。无热涨落时，斯格明子近似直线、无霍尔偏转传播；而热磁振子散射会引入方向相关的横向漂移，其符号与大小随传播方向而变化。结果表明，这是一种由本征对称性依赖磁振子谱决定的有限温度动力学特征，并为低功耗、可电控的斯格明子输运提供了路径。
authors: Tingting Liu, Bingyu Sun, Fengyue Zhu, Zhihui Zhang, Peiyu Zhang, Yang Liu, Minghui Qin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体将补偿性的磁有序与非常规的、依赖对称性的响应结合起来，为自旋电子学应用提供了一个很有前景的平台。本文表明，电压控制的磁各向异性梯度在缺乏热涨落时驱动 d 波反铁磁（ATM）斯格明子以近乎直线、无霍尔偏转的方式运动，这归因于其强补偿的陀螺动力学响应。热磁振子通过增强磁振子-斯格明子散射导致纵向拖曳增大，并通过依赖手性的偏斜散射产生横向反作用力，从而从定性上改变这一行为。由于反铁磁磁振子带结构具有各向异性，两种手性的磁振子在沿 x 和 y 方向传播时的相对输运权重会互换，导致横向斯格明子漂移的符号相反。相比之下，沿高对称方向时，两种磁振子手性保持简并，其横向贡献相互抵消，即使在有限温度下也能保持无霍尔偏转运动。因此，我们揭示了一种热诱导的各向异性斯格明子霍尔效应，其方向相关的大小与符号源于内禀的、对称性依赖的磁振子谱，使其成为 ATM 斯格明子在有限温度下的一种普适动力学特征。我们的结果为实现电控、热可调的 ATM 斯格明子输运建立了一条低功耗路线。

articles.title: 3D- (H-theta-phi) magnetic phase diagram of antiferromagnetic metal GdB6 with electron and lattice instability
articles.title_zh: 具有电子与晶格不稳定性的反铁磁金属 GdB6 的三维磁相图（H-θ-φ）
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27134v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The origin of charge transport and magnetization anisotropy was studied in GdB6, an antiferromagnetic (AF) metal (Néel temperature TN ~ 15.5 K) with cubic lattice and Gd S-type magnetic ions. Both small static Jahn-Teller distortions and nanoscale electronic instabilities (dynamic charge stripes) were found in precise low temperature X-ray diffraction measurements. The detailed magnetic field (H) vs temperature (T) phase diagrams were constructed with two main magnetic phases AF(I) and AF(II). Using the angular phi-dependences of magnetoresistance and magnetization, impeller-type patterns of the H-phi magnetic phase diagrams in the (110) and (111) planes were found at helium temperatures, which included the AF phases I and II separated from each other by radial and circular boundaries. The results argue in favor of the important role of the spin density wave 5d- component in the magnetic structure of AF(II) state. Charge fluctuations in stripes are proposed to be responsible for the suppression of the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yoshida (RKKY) indirect exchange between the first and second neighboring Gd3+ ions located along the <100> and <110> directions. These dynamic charge stripes and vibrationally coupled Gd-Gd pairs produce unusual anisotropy of charge scattering and the impeller-type diagrams in GdB6 with S-type magnetic ion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了反铁磁金属 GdB6 中电荷输运与磁化各向异性的起源，并结合低温 X 射线衍射、磁输运与角分辨测量构建了三维磁相图。结果显示，体系中存在静态 Jahn-Teller 畸变与纳米尺度电子不稳定性，并可区分出两个主要反铁磁相。作者据此推测，电荷条纹涨落和相关的 Gd-Gd 配对对其异常各向异性具有重要作用。
authors: A. N. Azarevich, A. V. Bogach, T. F. Garipova, V. V. Voronov, M. Rajnak, S. Gabani, K. Flachbart, N. B. Bolotina, O. N. Khrykina, V. M. Gridchina, A. Yu. Tsvetkov, S. Yu. Gavrilkin, N. E. Sluchanko
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在具有立方晶格和 Gd S 型磁离子的反铁磁（AF）金属 GdB6 中，研究了电荷输运和磁化各向异性的起源（Néel 温度 TN ~ 15.5 K）。精确的低温 X 射线衍射测量发现了小的静态 Jahn-Teller 畸变和纳米尺度的电子不稳定性（动态电荷条纹）。通过详细的磁场（H）-温度（T）相图构建，识别出两个主要的磁相 AF(I) 和 AF(II)。利用磁阻和磁化的角度 φ 依赖性，在液氦温度下发现在（110）和（111）平面中的 H-φ 磁相图呈现出类似叶轮的图案，其中 AF 相 I 和 II 由径向和圆形边界彼此分隔。这些结果支持 AF(II) 态磁结构中自旋密度波 5d- 分量发挥重要作用的观点。作者提出，条纹中的电荷涨落可能导致沿 <100> 和 <110> 方向排列的第一、第二近邻 Gd3+ 离子之间的 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yoshida（RKKY）间接交换受到抑制。这些动态电荷条纹以及受振动耦合的 Gd-Gd 对共同导致了异常的电荷散射各向异性和 GdB6 中具有 S 型磁离子的叶轮式图样。

articles.title: Data-efficient crack quantification in lithium-ion cathodes using foundation model transfer
articles.title_zh: 利用基础模型迁移实现锂离子正极裂纹的高数据效率定量分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27162v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Battery lifetime is central to sustainable electrification, yet the particle cracking that drives lithium-ion cathode aging is hard to measure: quantitative microscopy of this degradation is bottlenecked by annotation, because each destructive electron-microscopy cross-section spans hundreds of megapixels and pixel-level expert labelling requires hours per image. We show that a frozen self-supervised vision-transformer encoder, combined with a lightweight trainable decoder and iterative model-assisted annotation, turns this sparse labelling budget into population-scale degradation measurements. Applied to three 120-megapixel NMC cathode cross-sections representing initial, cycled-aged and calendar-aged states, the framework distinguishes intragranular cracks from early- and late-stage intergranular cracks and yields per-particle distributions of crack width, tortuosity and area fraction. Late intergranular crack coverage reaches 4.6% in the cycled sample versus 0.5% in the initial and calendar-aged samples, forming more tortuous, higher-coverage networks, consistent with degradation from repeated electrochemical cycling rather than elevated-temperature storage alone. A single destructive image yields the population-level statistics needed for lifetime-extending design, aging assessment and second-life decisions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对锂离子正极颗粒裂纹难以定量测量的问题，提出了一种结合冻结的自监督视觉 Transformer 编码器、轻量可训练解码器与迭代式人机协同标注的方案。方法在三张超大尺寸 NMC 正极截面图上实现了裂纹类型区分及颗粒级统计分析，并揭示循环老化样品中晚期晶间裂纹显著增多。结果表明，单张破坏性显微图像即可提供用于寿命评估和二次利用决策的群体统计信息。
authors: Thorsten Tegetmeyer-Kleine, Thomas Schmitt, Phillip Aquino, Christiane Rahe, Dirk Uwe Sauer, Weihan Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电池寿命是可持续电气化的核心问题，但驱动锂离子正极老化的颗粒开裂却难以测量：这种退化的定量显微分析受制于标注成本，因为每一张破坏性的电子显微镜横截面图像都包含数亿像素，而像素级专家标注每张图像需要数小时。我们表明，将一个冻结的自监督视觉 Transformer 编码器与轻量级可训练解码器以及迭代式模型辅助标注相结合，可以把稀缺的标注预算转化为群体尺度的退化测量。将该框架应用于三张 1.2 亿像素的 NMC 正极横截面图像，这些图像分别代表初始、循环老化和日历老化状态，结果能够区分晶内裂纹以及早期和晚期晶间裂纹，并得到每个颗粒的裂纹宽度、曲折度和面积分数分布。晚期晶间裂纹覆盖率在循环老化样品中达到 4.6%，而在初始样品和日历老化样品中仅为 0.5%，形成更曲折、覆盖更高的网络，这与重复电化学循环导致的退化而非仅由高温储存引起的退化相一致。单张破坏性图像即可提供用于延长寿命设计、老化评估和二次使用决策所需的群体统计信息。

articles.title: Terahertz anomalous Hall effect in magnetic Weyl semimetal Co₃Sn₂S₂
articles.title_zh: 磁性 Weyl 半金属 Co₃Sn₂S₂ 中的太赫兹反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27195v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-reversal-symmetry-broken Weyl semimetals are known to have at least two nodes in their electronic band structure, separated in momentum space and acting as sources and sinks of Berry curvature. This gives rise to a transverse Hall conductivity, known as the anomalous Hall effect (AHE), which, in the simplest two-node picture, is proportional to the momentum-space separation between the nodes in the zero frequency limit. In the recently discovered Weyl semimetal Co₃Sn₂S₂, a giant AHE has been observed. However, experimental investigations in the low-energy regime, which directly probe quasiparticle excitations near the Weyl nodes, remain limited. Here, we present a systematic study of the intrinsic low-energy gyrotropic optical response of Co₃Sn₂S₂ using terahertz spectroscopy combined with semianalytical calculations based on a physically intuitive effective model. Our results provide a robust and transparent explanation of the observed magnetooptical phenomena in terms of intrinsic gyrotropy arising from momentum-space separation of the Weyl nodes. Furthermore, quantitative comparison between experiment and theory places stringent constraints on the material parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用太赫兹光谱并结合半解析理论，系统研究了磁性 Weyl 半金属 Co₃Sn₂S₂ 的本征低能旋光响应。作者将实验观测到的磁光现象解释为 Weyl 节点在动量空间分离所导致的本征手性响应，并据此对材料参数施加了严格约束。研究为直接探测 Weyl 节点附近准粒子激发提供了低能实验依据。
authors: Ashutosh Singh, Hongjing Xu, Xielin Wang, Kohei Fujiwara, Atsushi Tsukazaki, Shengxi Huang, Andrey Baydin, Junichiro Kono, Alexey Belyanin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 时间反演对称性被破缺的 Weyl 半金属在其电子能带结构中至少具有两个节点，这些节点在动量空间中分离，并充当 Berry 曲率的源与汇。这会产生横向霍尔电导，即反常霍尔效应（AHE）；在最简单的双节点图像中，在零频极限下它与节点在动量空间中的分离成正比。在最近发现的 Weyl 半金属 Co₃Sn₂S₂ 中，已经观察到巨大的 AHE。然而，直接探测 Weyl 节点附近准粒子激发的低能区实验研究仍然有限。本文结合太赫兹光谱和基于物理直观有效模型的半解析计算，对 Co₃Sn₂S₂ 的本征低能旋光光学响应进行了系统研究。我们的结果为所观察到的磁光现象提供了稳健而清晰的解释，即这些现象源于 Weyl 节点在动量空间中的分离所导致的本征旋光性。此外，实验与理论之间的定量比较对材料参数施加了严格约束。

articles.title: Multi-orbital physics in inverse Lieb lattice altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 反 Lieb 晶格反铁磁体中的多轨道物理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The inverse Lieb lattice has recently emerged as a promising platform for altermagnetism, with several materials with this structure proposed as d-wave altermagnetic candidates. Here, we develop a symmetry-based microscopic Hamiltonian for these materials that includes both sublattice and orbital degrees of freedom, going beyond the sublattice-only minimal models that have been extensively used to study such altermagnets. We apply these models to examine multi-orbital electron correlation physics in the vanadium oxychalcogenide family altermagnets, which contain dominant xy and xz/yz orbitals character at the Fermi level in the altermagnetic state. We demonstrate that xy orbitals are crucial to stabilize the altermagnetic state observed within a single V₂O layer, and altermagnetic order in the xz/yz orbitals is induced through Hund's coupling. Additionally, we show that these multi-orbital models reveal topological regimes in which topological edge states are naturally orbital selective.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在反 Lieb 晶格反铁磁体中建立了同时包含子晶格与轨道自由度的对称性微观模型，超越了以往仅考虑子晶格的简化描述。作者将其应用于钒氧硫族化物体系，指出单层 V2O 中的反铁磁稳定性与 xy 轨道密切相关，而 xz/yz 轨道中的反铁磁序则由 Hund 耦合诱导。模型还揭示了轨道选择性的拓扑边缘态区域。
authors: Mercè Roig, Jannik Gondolf, Andreas Kreisel, Brian M. Andersen, Daniel F. Agterberg
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反 Lieb 晶格最近已成为研究 altermagnetism 的一个很有前景的平台，其中已有若干具有该结构的材料被提出作为 d 波 altermagnetic 候选体。本文建立了一个基于对称性的微观哈密顿量，用于描述这些材料，该模型同时包含子晶格和轨道自由度，超越了在研究此类 altermagnets 时被广泛使用的仅含子晶格的最小模型。我们将这些模型用于考察钒氧硫族化物家族 altermagnets 中的多轨道电子关联物理，这些体系在 altermagnetic 态下费米能级附近具有以 xy 和 xz/yz 轨道为主的特征。我们证明，xy 轨道对于稳定在单个 V2O 层内观察到的 altermagnetic 态至关重要，而 xz/yz 轨道中的 altermagnetic 有序则由 Hund 耦合诱导。此外，我们还表明，这些多轨道模型揭示了拓扑区间，在这些区间中，拓扑边缘态天然具有轨道选择性。

articles.title: Crystal Structure Prototype Identification via Element-Mapped Rotation-Invariant Descriptors
articles.title_zh: 基于元素映射旋转不变描述符的晶体结构原型识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27262v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a method for identifying crystal structure prototypes from local atomic environments. A center atom and its neighbors within a distance-normalized cutoff are mapped to anonymous element types (A/B/C/D) by proximity, and a NEP-style descriptor-radial Chebyshev moments plus contracted spherical-harmonic (S-vector) invariants-is computed per type block. The descriptor is rotation-invariant by construction (MLFF-style contraction with analytic normalization constants), so no rotation augmentation is needed. A trainable block-diagonal projection compresses the 316-dimensional raw basis into a 168-dimensional learned descriptor fed to a three-layer MLP. The model classifies each atom into one of 271 AFLOW crystal structure prototypes or the amorphous class (272 classes), reaching 99.38% accuracy on 538,190 per-atom samples. The full pipeline (descriptor extraction + inference) runs on a single CPU core at 3.9 s per 10,000 atoms, making it suitable for website deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了一种基于局域原子环境识别晶体结构原型的方法，通过按邻近关系将原子映射为匿名元素类型并构造旋转不变描述符。模型在 AFLOW 的 271 类晶体原型及非晶类别上取得了很高准确率，同时推理速度足以支持网页部署。研究表明，这类结构化描述符可用于高效、稳健的结构分类任务。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种从局域原子环境识别晶体结构原型的方法。中心原子及其在距离归一化截断半径内的邻居按邻近关系映射为匿名元素类型（A/B/C/D），并针对每个类型块计算一种 NEP 风格的描述符，即径向切比雪夫矩和收缩球谐（S 向量）不变量。该描述符在构造上具有旋转不变性（采用带解析归一化常数的 MLFF 风格收缩），因此无需旋转增强。一个可训练的块对角投影层将 316 维原始基压缩为 168 维学习型描述符，再输入三层 MLP。该模型将每个原子分类为 271 种 AFLOW 晶体结构原型之一或非晶类别（共 272 类），在 538,190 个原子样本上达到了 99.38% 的准确率。完整流程（描述符提取加推理）在单个 CPU 核上对每 10,000 个原子的运行时间为 3.9 秒，适合网页部署。

articles.title: Grain-Boundary Premelting in High-Entropy Transition Metal Carbides
articles.title_zh: 高熵过渡金属碳化物中的晶界预熔化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27273v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain-boundary segregation and thermally induced interfacial disordering were investigated in four high-entropy transition metal carbides using Monte Carlo (MC) sampling and molecular dynamics (MD) with the universal MACE-OMAT-0 machine-learning interatomic potential. MC sampling segregated the group-VI element (Cr, Mo, or W) and Zr to grain boundaries, where the group-VI content reached approximately 45 at.%, consistent with STEM-EDS observations. During MD heating, the grain-boundary Lindemann index, a normalized measure of interatomic distance fluctuations, reached the liquid-like threshold of δ=0.15 near 1390ⁱ̧rcC for the Cr-containing carbides, 1660ⁱ̧rcC for Mo, and 1890ⁱ̧rcC for W, while the grain interiors remained below the threshold. A chemically random (Cr,Hf,Ta,Ti,Zr)C reference crossed about 60ⁱ̧rcC later and showed less boundary-localized disorder, highlighting the role of interfacial chemistry in premelting. Species-resolved displacements showed enhanced grain-boundary mobility, particularly for carbon. Overall, Cr-rich interfaces showed the earliest and most extensive premelting-like response, followed by Mo- and W-containing boundaries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合 Monte Carlo 与分子动力学模拟，考察了高熵过渡金属碳化物中的晶界偏聚和热致界面无序化行为。结果显示，Cr、Mo 或 W 等元素及 Zr 倾向于在晶界富集，并且 Cr 含体系最早出现类似预熔化的响应。研究强调了界面化学在晶界提前无序化和迁移中的关键作用。
authors: Marium M. Mou, Caleb Schenck, Samuel E. Daigle, William G. Fahrenholtz, Bharat Gwalani, Stefano Curtarolo, Donald W. Brenner
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用 Monte Carlo（MC）采样和分子动力学（MD）模拟，并结合通用的 MACE-OMAT-0 机器学习原子间势，对四种高熵过渡金属碳化物中的晶界偏聚和热致界面无序化进行了研究。MC 采样使第 VI 族元素（Cr、Mo 或 W）和 Zr 偏聚到晶界，在那里第 VI 族元素含量达到约 45 at.%，这与 STEM-EDS 观察结果一致。在 MD 升温过程中，晶界的 Lindemann 指数，即原子间距离涨落的归一化度量，在 Cr 含碳化物中于约 1390ⁱ̧rcC、Mo 含体系中于 1660ⁱ̧rcC、W 含体系中于 1890ⁱ̧rcC 附近达到液体样阈值 δ=0.15，而晶内仍低于该阈值。一个化学随机的（Cr,Hf,Ta,Ti,Zr）C 参考体系则晚约 60ⁱ̧rcC 才跨过阈值，并表现出较弱的边界局域无序，凸显了界面化学在预熔化中的作用。按物种分辨的位移显示晶界迁移增强，尤其是碳原子。总体而言，富 Cr 的界面最早且最广泛地表现出类似预熔化的响应，其次是含 Mo 和含 W 的晶界。

articles.title: Benchmarking of Fast and Interpretable UF Machine Learning Potentials
articles.title_zh: 快速且可解释的UF机器学习势的基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27277v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have emerged as a powerful alternative to density functional theory (DFT) for molecular dynamics simulations, offering near-DFT accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost. However, many state-of-the-art MLIPs remain computationally demanding and act as black boxes, limiting physical interpretability. In this work, we evaluate the ultra-fast force field (UF³⁾ potential, which employs linear regression with cubic B-spline basis to represent effective two- and three-body interactions. We show that UF³ displays accuracy comparable to established models such as GAP, MTP, NNP (Behler Parrinello), and qSNAP MLIPs. We further investigate the transferability of UF³ by computing melting points for six elemental systems with potentials fitted without any solid-liquid interface configurations or explicit thermodynamic information about melting. The model reproduces experimental melting points within sim6% for simple metals (Ni, Cu, Li), but substantially underestimates them for Mo and Si and fails to yield a stable potential for Ge, reflecting the limitations of a fixed expansion truncated at the three-body term for systems with strong angular or covalent bonding. We further illustrate how UF³'s spline-based formulation allows direct visualization of the learned interactions, enabling identification of unphysical behavior that black-box approaches often obscure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了超快速力场UF³机器学习势，该模型用三次B样条基的线性回归表示有效二体和三体相互作用。结果表明，UF³在精度上可与GAP、MTP、Behler-Parrinello NNP和qSNAP等模型相当，并在简单金属熔点预测中表现较好。其在Mo、Si和Ge等具有强角向或共价键合特征的体系中存在明显局限，但样条形式使学习到的相互作用可视化并有助于识别非物理行为。
authors: Pawan Prakash, Sam Dong, Richard G. Hennig
articles.focus_summary: 该论文系统评估了超快速且具有可解释性的UF³机器学习原子势，并将其与GAP、MTP、神经网络势和qSNAP等模型进行比较。结果表明，UF³在部分元素体系中可保持接近其他机器学习势的精度并准确预测熔点，但对Mo、Si和Ge等体系的迁移性仍有限。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的机器学习势、分子动力学、材料模拟和主动学习方向直接相关。其低计算成本、线性回归表达和可解释性适合用于大尺度结构演化、相变及缺陷动力学模拟，但需要特别关注复杂化学环境和长程相互作用。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议阅读其势函数基组、训练数据构建和熔点验证方法，并评估其在铁电体、卤化物钙钛矿、二维材料及锂电池材料中的适用性。可进一步结合主动学习、长程库仑项和等变神经网络提升复杂体系的迁移能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）已成为分子动力学模拟中替代密度泛函理论（DFT）的有力方法，能够以小得多的计算成本提供接近DFT的精度。然而，许多最先进的MLIP仍然计算开销较大，并且像黑箱一样运行，限制了物理可解释性。在本工作中，我们评估了超快速力场（UF³）势，该势采用带三次B样条基的线性回归来表示有效的二体和三体相互作用。我们表明，UF³表现出可与GAP、MTP、NNP（Behler-Parrinello）和qSNAP等既有模型相当的精度。我们进一步通过计算六种元素体系的熔点来研究UF³的可迁移性；这些势在拟合时未使用任何固-液界面构型，也未显式使用关于熔化的热力学信息。该模型对简单金属（Ni、Cu、Li）可在约6%以内复现实验熔点，但对Mo和Si的熔点显著低估，并且未能为Ge给出稳定的势，这反映出对于具有强角向键合或共价键合的体系，固定展开并截断到三体项的模型存在局限。我们还说明，UF³基于样条的形式允许直接可视化学习到的相互作用，从而能够识别黑箱方法常常掩盖的非物理行为。

articles.title: 3D Cloud Component Analysis of Atomic Structures
articles.title_zh: 原子结构的三维云组分分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27304v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a method for decomposing atomic structures into physically meaningful components by converting discrete atomic coordinates into continuous three-dimensional density fields. Each element is represented by a Gaussian-smeared density map with values ranging from 0 to 1, computed efficiently through a bin-then-blur approach with periodic boundary conditions. The sum of all element densities, truncated at unity, defines the material region; its complement defines the vacuum. Every voxel is first assigned a chemical formula from the set of elements present above a threshold; the resulting formula map is then cleaned so that only regions with a genuine bulk interior-measured by the Euclidean distance to their own boundary-survive as components. Thin surface terminations (e.g., a Ga monolayer on GaAs) and one-to-two-voxel boundary layers between two crystals are absorbed by the neighboring stable region, so the decomposition contains exactly the bulk-like chemical-formula components and the vacuum, with no surface or interface components. For each component we determine the crystal phase with a neural prototype classifier: one phase if the trusted interior atoms vote unanimously, two phases (e.g., crystalline and amorphous Si) if they split into two confident groups, in which case the component is divided into two. Interfaces and surfaces are then derived as boundaries-material-material and material-vacuum-and every atom is labeled bulk, surface, interface, or vertex, with vertex reserved for geometric corners of a component. Inside crystalline components, inner defects are detected from coordination-number and local-density deviations. We demonstrate the approach on Si/GaAs and Si/SiO2 heterojunctions, crystalline/amorphous silicon junctions, vacancy-containing crystals, and bulk crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种将离散原子坐标转化为连续三维密度场，从而把原子结构分解为具有物理意义组分的方法。方法通过元素密度图、材料/真空区域划分、化学式图清理和神经原型分类器识别体相组分与晶相，并进一步标注体相、表面、界面和顶点原子。作者在Si/GaAs、Si/SiO2、晶态/非晶硅结、含空位晶体和体晶体中展示了该方法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种方法，通过将离散原子坐标转换为连续的三维密度场，将原子结构分解为具有物理意义的组分。每种元素都由一个高斯展宽的密度图表示，其数值范围为0到1，并通过具有周期性边界条件的“先分箱、后模糊”方法高效计算。所有元素密度之和在1处截断后定义材料区域；其补集定义真空。首先根据超过阈值的元素集合为每个体素分配一个化学式；随后清理所得化学式图，使得只有具有真实体相内部的区域能够作为组分保留下来，其中真实体相内部通过到其自身边界的欧氏距离来度量。薄的表面终止层（例如GaAs上的Ga单层）以及两个晶体之间一到两个体素厚的边界层会被相邻稳定区域吸收，因此分解结果只包含类体相的化学式组分和真空，而不包含表面或界面组分。对于每个组分，我们使用神经原型分类器确定晶相：如果可信内部原子投票一致，则为一个相；如果它们分成两个置信度高的群体（例如晶态和非晶Si），则为两个相，在这种情况下该组分会被分为两部分。随后将界面和表面推导为边界，即材料-材料边界和材料-真空边界，并将每个原子标记为体相、表面、界面或顶点，其中顶点专门用于组分的几何角点。在晶体组分内部，通过配位数和局域密度偏差检测内部缺陷。我们在Si/GaAs和Si/SiO2异质结、晶态/非晶硅结、含空位晶体以及体晶体上展示了该方法。

articles.title: Coupled anisotropic weak topological states and Floquet mixed-parity altermagnetism in two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger models
articles.title_zh: 二维Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型中的耦合各向异性弱拓扑态与Floquet混合宇称交替磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) topological systems and altermagnetic (AM) states are two important research areas in condensed matter physics. Realizing the coupled states between the SSH lattices and AM phanse in a single syetem remains challenging. However, the Floquet engineering change it. Our work constructs five two-dimensional-(2D-) SSH models to describe the coupled phases of SSH weak topological state and AM order by tight-binding (TB) method. The evolution of band structures, spin-splitting, and topological phase transitions under the circularly polarized light (CPL) and relative atomic displacement (RAD) in 2D SSH lattices were systematically investigated. The results reveal that the inequality of hopping parameters (t1 and t2) serves as the fundamental origin of SSH topological states and AM order. For the 2D nonmagnetic state, anisotropic weak topological states with Zak phase governed edge states are realized by unit cell selection, similar to the conventional 1D SSH model. The collinear antiferromagnetic state preserves the spin-degenerate band structure and intrinsic weak topological properties. Furthermore, the Floquet engineering introduces the AM phase of odd-parity p-wave while the RAD introduces the AM phase of even-parity d-wave. By combining the two effects, the mixed-parity (non-odd/non-even parity) AM phase could be realized, achieving the simultaneous control of the light field of spin-splitting and topological edge states. The physical mechanisms of Floquet engineering and RAD for the 2D rectangular SSH lattice are also from the inequality of t1 and t2, which can be not only fully understand by the TB methods, but also in good agreement with the first-principle calculations of 2D carbon-based materials. This work establishes an effective theoretical platform for coupling anisotropic SSH weak topological states and AM orders with multi-parities in 2D systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建了五种二维SSH模型，用紧束缚方法描述SSH弱拓扑态与交替磁性有序的耦合相。作者系统研究了圆偏振光和相对原子位移下能带、自旋劈裂与拓扑相变的演化，指出跃迁参数不等是SSH拓扑态和交替磁性的根本来源。Floquet工程可引入奇宇称p波交替磁相，相对原子位移可引入偶宇称d波交替磁相，二者结合可实现混合宇称交替磁性并同时调控自旋劈裂和拓扑边缘态。
authors: Kunyuan Feng, Xibin Liu, Chenchen Liu, Siyuan Liu, Lixiu Guan, Xiaobiao Liu, François M. Peeters, Linyang Li
articles.focus_summary: 论文构建二维Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型，研究弱拓扑态与交替磁性耦合形成的混合奇异相。研究系统分析了相对原子位移和圆偏振光驱动下的能带、自旋劈裂及拓扑相变，并讨论了Floquet工程实现混合宇称交替磁性的可能性。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的交替磁性、拓扑磁性、二维材料、磁性超晶格、紧束缚/有效哈密顿量和光控量子功能材料方向高度直接相关。其对称性分析、拓扑不变量和光驱动磁性设计可与第一性原理哈密顿量构建及Wannier插值结合。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可将模型推广到具体二维材料或范德华异质结构，利用第一性原理验证交替磁性和弱拓扑态的稳定性。进一步研究光场频率、偏振、应变和层间滑移对边界态、自旋输运及磁电响应的调控。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）拓扑系统和交替磁性（AM）态是凝聚态物理中的两个重要研究方向。在单一体系中实现SSH晶格与AM相之间的耦合态仍然具有挑战性。然而，Floquet工程改变了这一点。我们的工作构建了五种二维（2D）SSH模型，并通过紧束缚（TB）方法描述SSH弱拓扑态与AM有序的耦合相。我们系统研究了圆偏振光（CPL）和相对原子位移（RAD）作用下，二维SSH晶格中能带结构、自旋劈裂和拓扑相变的演化。结果表明，跃迁参数（t1和t2）的不等性是SSH拓扑态和AM有序的根本来源。对于二维非磁态，可以通过晶胞选择实现由Zak相支配边缘态的各向异性弱拓扑态，类似于传统的一维SSH模型。共线反铁磁态保持自旋简并能带结构和内禀弱拓扑性质。此外，Floquet工程引入奇宇称p波AM相，而RAD引入偶宇称d波AM相。通过结合这两种效应，可以实现混合宇称（非奇/非偶宇称）AM相，从而实现用光场同时控制自旋劈裂和拓扑边缘态。Floquet工程和RAD在二维矩形SSH晶格中的物理机制同样来自t1和t2的不等性，这不仅可以通过TB方法得到充分理解，而且与二维碳基材料的第一性原理计算结果高度一致。本工作为在二维体系中耦合各向异性SSH弱拓扑态与多宇称AM有序建立了一个有效的理论平台。

articles.title: High-Temperature Superconductivity of the Fe-Se-H compound
articles.title_zh: Fe-Se-H化合物的高温超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using an EPR spectrometer, the dependences of microwave power absorption on magnetic field up to 6000 Oe were measured at temperatures of 3.6-25 K and 295 K in a powdered compound Fe-Se-H, obtained by thermal diffusion of hydrogen into a FeSe single crystal with a critical temperature of 8 K. The shape of the dependences and the analysis of the measurement results confirm the superconductivity of the Fe-Se-H compound at normal pressure, both at temperatures of 3.6-25 K and at 295 K, i.e., at room temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用EPR谱仪测量了粉末状Fe-Se-H化合物在不同温度和最高6000 Oe磁场下的微波功率吸收随磁场变化关系。作者称，曲线形状及测量结果分析支持Fe-Se-H化合物在常压下于3.6至25 K以及295 K均表现出超导性。该结论涉及室温超导主张，需结合原文实验细节与独立复现实验谨慎评估。
authors: S. I. Bondarenko, A. A. Prokhorov, N. N. Galtsov, V. P. Timofeev, V. P. Koverya, I. S. Bondarenko, A. V. Krevsun
articles.abstract_zh_full: 使用EPR谱仪，在3.6-25 K和295 K温度下，对一种粉末状Fe-Se-H化合物测量了其在最高6000 Oe磁场中微波功率吸收随磁场的依赖关系；该化合物通过将氢热扩散进入临界温度为8 K的FeSe单晶而获得。这些依赖关系的形状以及对测量结果的分析确认了Fe-Se-H化合物在常压下的超导性，既包括3.6-25 K温度范围，也包括295 K，即室温。

articles.title: Temperature dependence of the charge density from first principles: application to the (222) forbidden reflection in silicon
articles.title_zh: 第一性原理研究电荷密度的温度依赖性：应用于硅中（222）禁戒反射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Forbidden reflections (FRs) in X-ray diffraction have inherently weak intensity and have long been studied, in particular in semiconductors like silicon. They serve as sensitive probes of symmetry breaking, local strain, impurities, and weak charge redistribution. Despite extensive experimental work, the theory of their temperature dependence has typically relied on simplified models. While atomic Debye-Waller factors work well on allowed reflections, their applicability to the valence charge between atoms, which determines the intensity of FRs such as Si (222), is questionable, and previous agreement between theory and experiment relied on ad-hoc Debye-Waller corrections. We compute the temperature-dependent valence charge density h̊o(r,T) of silicon from first principles, using two methods: (i) perturbation theory, and (ii) averaging over thermally distorted supercells in a non-perturbative approach. The perturbative expression for the charge density is far more demanding than that for electronic energies, since it depends on the wavefunctions themselves and requires an explicit sum over unoccupied bands. We use an acoustic sum rule to express the second derivatives of the potential in terms of first derivatives, making the expression tractable within existing frameworks. The (222) FR then follows directly from the Fourier transform of h̊o(r,T), with no ad-hoc factors. Both methods give similar results, in reasonable agreement with experiment, with thermal expansion noticeably affecting the temperature dependence. The charge density answers a question the measured intensities could not settle: how the valence charge actually redistributes with temperature. Relative to the rigid model, we find more charge in the bonds and less in the core regions, a redistribution that shows up in the intensity as a somewhat weaker temperature dependence of the (222) FR.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究从第一性原理计算硅的温度依赖价电荷密度，并将其用于解释X射线衍射中弱的（222）禁戒反射。作者采用微扰理论和热畸变超胞平均两种方法，避免了以往经验性的Debye-Waller修正，并得到与实验合理一致的结果。研究表明，热膨胀会显著影响温度依赖性，且相对于刚性模型，温度升高相关的电荷重分布表现为键区电荷更多、芯区电荷更少。
authors: Jean Paul Nery, Raveena Gupta, Olle Hellman, Philip B. Allen, Matthieu J. Verstraete
articles.abstract_zh_full: X射线衍射中的禁戒反射（FRs）本身强度很弱，并且长期以来一直受到研究，尤其是在硅等半导体中。它们可作为对称性破缺、局域应变、杂质以及微弱电荷重分布的灵敏探针。尽管已有大量实验工作，对其温度依赖性的理论描述通常依赖简化模型。虽然原子Debye-Waller因子对允许反射适用良好，但其是否适用于原子之间的价电荷仍值得怀疑，而这部分价电荷决定了诸如Si（222）等FR的强度；此前理论与实验之间的一致性依赖于临时引入的Debye-Waller修正。我们使用两种方法从第一性原理计算硅的温度依赖价电荷密度ρ(r,T)：（i）微扰理论；（ii）在一种非微扰方法中对热畸变超胞进行平均。电荷密度的微扰表达式比电子能量的微扰表达式要求高得多，因为它依赖于波函数本身，并需要对未占据能带进行显式求和。我们使用声学求和规则，将势的二阶导数表示为一阶导数，从而使该表达式能够在现有框架内处理。随后，（222）FR可直接由ρ(r,T)的傅里叶变换得到，无需任何临时引入的因子。两种方法给出了相近结果，并与实验合理一致，其中热膨胀对温度依赖性有显著影响。电荷密度回答了测量强度无法解决的问题：价电荷实际上如何随温度重新分布。相对于刚性模型，我们发现键中电荷更多而芯区电荷更少，这种重分布在强度上表现为（222）FR的温度依赖性略弱。

articles.title: Mobility Enhancement in Si/SiGe Quantum Well Enabled by a Buried Si Layer Trapping Oxygen Impurities
articles.title_zh: 通过俘获氧杂质的埋置硅层提升 Si/SiGe 量子阱中的迁移率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27377v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reducing disorder in undoped Si/SiGe field-effect heterostructures remains an important materials challenge for scalable quantum devices, particularly electron spin qubits. Background impurities such as oxygen have been identified as mobility-limiting, yet practical heterostructure-design strategies for suppressing their incorporation remain underexplored, and their influence across different transport regimes is not fully established. Here, we demonstrate a simple route to oxygen reduction and mobility enhancement in Si/SiGe quantum-well heterostructures grown by reduced-pressure chemical vapor deposition (RP-CVD) on 200 mm Si(100) substrates through the introduction of a thin, electrically passive buried Si layer within the lower SiGe barrier. Secondary-ion mass spectrometry shows that the buried Si layer reproducibly reduces the oxygen background in the subsequently grown SiGe by approximately a factor of five, without modifying the active quantum-well region. Density- and temperature-dependent magnetotransport measurements further show that this reduction increases the electron mobility, while leaving the percolation density and density-dependent mobility scaling largely unchanged. Upon cooling to 0.3 K, both high- and low-oxygen devices exhibit similar density-dependent fractional mobility enhancements, indicating that the reduced oxygen background improves momentum relaxation without substantially altering the dominant low-density disorder landscape. These results establish the buried Si layer as a straightforward and process-compatible heterostructure-design element for reducing oxygen incorporation and improving transport in 200 mm CVD-grown Si/SiGe quantum-device materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 在未掺杂 Si/SiGe 场效应异质结构中降低无序，是实现可扩展量子器件，尤其是电子自旋量子比特的重要材料学挑战。研究人员在下部 SiGe 势垒层中引入薄的、 electrically passive 的埋置硅层，使后续生长的 SiGe 中氧背景浓度约降低五倍，并在不改变有源量子阱区域的情况下提升电子迁移率。输运测量表明，氧含量降低主要改善了动量弛豫，而未显著改变渗流密度和低密度下的主导无序景观。
authors: Felix Reichmann, Alberto Mistroni, Fabian Fidorra, Giovanni Capellini, Yuji Yamamoto, Marco Lisker, Marvin H. Zoellner
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在未掺杂 Si/SiGe 场效应异质结构中降低无序，仍然是实现可扩展量子器件，尤其是电子自旋量子比特的一项重要材料学挑战。氧等背景杂质已被确定为限制迁移率的因素，但用于抑制其掺入的实用异质结构设计策略仍研究不足，并且其在不同输运机制中的影响尚未得到充分确立。在此，我们展示了一种简单的降低氧含量并提升迁移率的方法：在 200 mm Si(100) 衬底上，采用减压化学气相沉积法（RP-CVD）生长的 Si/SiGe 量子阱异质结构中，在下部 SiGe 势垒层内引入一层薄的、电学上无源的埋置硅层。二次离子质谱显示，埋置硅层能够以可重复的方式，将随后生长的 SiGe 中的氧背景浓度降低约五倍，同时不改变有源量子阱区域。随载流子密度和温度变化的磁输运测量进一步表明，这种降低会提高电子迁移率，而渗流密度以及迁移率随密度变化的标度关系基本保持不变。冷却至 0.3 K 后，高氧器件和低氧器件都表现出相似的、随密度变化的迁移率相对提升，表明降低氧背景能够改善动量弛豫，但不会显著改变低密度下占主导地位的无序景观。这些结果确立了埋置硅层作为一种直接且工艺兼容的异质结构设计要素，可用于减少氧掺入并改善 200 mm CVD 生长 Si/SiGe 量子器件材料中的输运性能。

articles.title: A continuous confinement-deconfinement transition in a triangular quantum magnet
articles.title_zh: 三角量子磁体中的连续禁闭—解禁闭相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27411v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A continuous transition between phases hosting distinct excitations---bosonic magnons versus fermionic spinons---is a long-sought phenomenon in quantum magnetism, analogous to the confinement--deconfinement transition in quantum chromodynamics. We report evidence for such a transition in the triangular-lattice antiferromagnet TlYbS₂. Antiferromagnetic order develops below T_N approx 0.53,K. A c-axis field suppresses this order, driving the system into a gapless quantum spin liquid with a spinon Fermi surface above μ₀ H_c approx 3,T, evidenced by a finite residual linear term in thermal conductivity, a Pauli-like susceptibility, and a temperature-independent NMR Knight shift. Approaching H_c from above, the scattering rate of itinerant excitations is strongly enhanced while their density of states shows no critical enhancement, atypical of conventional magnetic quantum criticality. These results point to a continuous confinement--deconfinement transition governed by fractionalized excitations beyond the Ginzburg--Landau paradigm.
articles.abstract_zh: 玻色型磁振子与费米型自旋子之间的连续相变，是量子磁性领域长期寻求的现象。研究表明，三角晶格反铁磁体 TlYbS₂ 在约 0.53 K 以下形成反铁磁序，并在沿 c 轴施加约 3 T 的磁场后进入具有自旋子费米面的无能隙量子自旋液体态。临近临界场时，巡游激发的散射率显著增强，但态密度没有临界增强，提示存在超越金兹堡—朗道范式的连续禁闭—解禁闭相变。
authors: Suguru Hosoi, Sejun Park, Michihiro Hirata, Minseong Lee, Adam P Dioguardi, Joe D Thompson, Filip Ronning, Allen O Scheie, Kumpei Imamura, Kenichiro Hashimoto, Takasada Shibauchi, Bishnu P Belbase, Arjun Unnikrishnan, Johannes Knolle, Arnab Banerjee, Yuji Matsuda
articles.abstract_zh_full: 承载不同激发的相之间的连续相变——玻色型磁振子与费米型自旋子之间的相变——是量子磁性领域长期寻求的现象，其类似于量子色动力学中的禁闭—解禁闭相变。我们报告了在三角晶格反铁磁体 TlYbS₂ 中观察到这类相变的证据。反铁磁序在低于 T_N 约 0.53 K 时形成。沿 c 轴的磁场抑制了这种有序，并在 μ₀H_c 约 3 T 以上将体系驱动进入具有自旋子费米面的无能隙量子自旋液体态；有限的热导率残余线性项、类泡利磁化率以及与温度无关的核磁共振奈特位移为此提供了证据。从高于 H_c 的一侧接近 H_c 时，巡游激发的散射率显著增强，而其态密度没有出现临界增强，这与传统磁性量子临界现象不同。这些结果指向一种由分数化激发支配、超越金兹堡—朗道范式的连续禁闭—解禁闭相变。

articles.title: Trapping e/4 quasiparticles in bilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 在双层石墨烯中俘获 e/4 准粒子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27444v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Measuring the charge of the quasiparticles hosted by even-denominator fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states is essential to identify the topology of their ground state. Here, we use a gate-defined antidot in bilayer graphene, with an additional gate to control only the antidot potential, to measure the charge of the quasiparticles trapped around it in even-denominator FQH states. We observe a localized charge of e/4 at ν=-5/2, -1/2, and 3/2, consistent with the minimal excitation expected for leading candidate even-denominator ground states, and e/3 at the hole-conjugate state ν=2/3. We further show that increasing the coupling between the antidot-bound states and extended edge states drives a crossover between two regimes, characterized by the minimal-excitation gate-voltage period and approximately twice that period, respectively. We discuss two possible explanations for this crossover: quasiparticle bunching and a crossover between distinct antidot transport regimes. Our results, together with previous observations of the daughter states, show that the even-denominator FQH states in bilayer graphene are compatible with a non-Abelian ground state, and that their quasiparticles can be localized around a quantum Hall antidot, a necessary ingredient for topological quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究人员利用双层石墨烯中的栅定义反点，并通过额外栅极单独调控反点势能，测量了偶数分母分数量子霍尔态周围被俘获准粒子的电荷。在 ν=-5/2、-1/2 和 3/2 处观察到 e/4 的局域电荷，在空穴共轭态 ν=2/3 处观察到 e/3。结果支持双层石墨烯中的偶数分母分数量子霍尔态与非阿贝尔基态相容，并表明准粒子能够被局域在量子霍尔反点周围。
authors: Mario Di Luca, Emily Hajigeorgiou, Ning Ma, Alexandra Waldherr, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Mitali Banerjee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 测量偶数分母分数量子霍尔（FQH）态所承载准粒子的电荷，对于确定其基态的拓扑性质至关重要。在此，我们使用双层石墨烯中的栅定义反点，并增加一个仅用于控制反点势能的栅极，从而测量偶数分母 FQH 态中被俘获在反点周围的准粒子电荷。我们在 ν=-5/2、-1/2 和 3/2 处观察到 e/4 的局域电荷，这与主要候选偶数分母基态所预期的最小激发相一致；在空穴共轭态 ν=2/3 处观察到 e/3。我们进一步表明，增强反点束缚态与延展边缘态之间的耦合，会在两个区域之间驱动交叉转变：一个区域的特征是最小激发对应的栅极电压周期，另一个区域的周期约为前者的两倍。我们讨论了这一交叉转变的两种可能解释：准粒子成束，以及不同反点输运机制之间的交叉。结合此前对子态的观察结果，我们的研究表明，双层石墨烯中的偶数分母 FQH 态与非阿贝尔基态相容，并且其准粒子能够被局域在量子霍尔反点周围，这是实现拓扑量子计算的必要要素。

articles.title: Distinguishing Quantum Capacitance Signatures of a Topological Majorana Wire from a Normal Wire Segment
articles.title_zh: 区分拓扑马约拉纳线与正常导线段的量子电容特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Majorana zero modes (MZMs) are spatially separated, near-zero-energy excitations expected at the ends of a topological superconducting (TS) wire. A quantum-dot interferometer can be used to probe the quantum capacitance of the TS wire, and the location and magnitude of the capacitance resonances provide information about the MZMs, while their magnetic flux dependence probes coherent coupling to the two Majorana modes. It has been recently shown that, a gapless (i.e., Δ=0) wire segment can also exhibit flux-dependent quantum capacitance oscillations through Aharonov-Bohm interference and, with suitable tuning, can reproduce a Majorana-like response. Here we show that the two mechanisms can be distinguished experimentally. In the gapless normal wire segment, the two parity-dependent signals originate from separate energy resonances corresponding to the lack of generic zero-energy states. By contrast, in the topological wire, the pair of low energy levels with even and odd parity are nearly degenerate in energy, and therefore, the two parity branches remain within the same broader resonance region in the quantum-dot potential, and persist under independent variations of the dot potential and wire chemical potential. Our results show that the experimentally observed quantum capacitance response is distinguished not by a particular flux trace at one optimized point in parameter space, but by its persistence over a finite range of independently controlled parameters, including the quantum-dot potential. This parameter space stability provides a direct means of ruling out the gapless normal wire segment as the origin of the observed Majorana-like response.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子点干涉仪可通过测量量子电容来探测拓扑超导线中的马约拉纳零模。研究表明，无能隙正常导线段也可能因阿哈罗诺夫—玻姆干涉产生类似马约拉纳的磁通依赖响应，但二者可通过参数稳定性加以区分。拓扑导线中的偶宇称和奇宇称低能级近简并，并在量子点势能及导线化学势独立变化时持续位于同一宽共振区域；正常导线则不具备这种稳定性。
authors: Binayyak Bhusan Roy, Jay Deep Sau, Sumanta Tewari
articles.abstract_zh_full: 马约拉纳零模（MZM）是预期存在于拓扑超导线两端、空间上彼此分离的近零能激发。量子点干涉仪可用于探测拓扑超导线的量子电容，而电容共振的位置和幅度能够提供有关马约拉纳零模的信息，其对磁通的依赖性则可探测与两个马约拉纳模的相干耦合。近期研究表明，无能隙，即 Δ=0 的导线段也能够通过阿哈罗诺夫—玻姆干涉产生磁通依赖的量子电容振荡，并且在适当调节下可以再现类似马约拉纳的响应。在此，我们表明这两种机制可以通过实验加以区分。在无能隙正常导线段中，两个依赖宇称的信号源自彼此分离的能量共振，这反映出体系通常不存在零能态。相比之下，在拓扑导线中，具有偶宇称和奇宇称的低能级在能量上近乎简并，因此两个宇称分支会保持在量子点势能对应的同一个较宽共振区域内，并且在独立改变量子点势能和导线化学势时仍然存在。我们的结果表明，实验观测到的量子电容响应，其判别依据并不是参数空间中某个经过优化的单一点处的特定磁通曲线，而是响应能否在包括量子点势能在内的多个独立可控参数的有限范围内持续存在。这种参数空间稳定性提供了一种直接方法，可排除无能隙正常导线段是所观测到的类马约拉纳响应来源的可能性。

articles.title: Metallogenic quantum criticality: Fermi surface nucleation at transitions between gapped phases
articles.title_zh: 成金属量子临界性：有能隙相之间转变中的费米面成核
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Continuous quantum phase transitions in interacting many-body systems exhibit universal phenomena that are largely independent of microscopic details. An organizing principle distilled from canonical examples such as the magnetic transition in Ising models is that the low-energy physics of transitions between gapped phases is governed by scale-invariant quantum field theories with gapless degrees of freedom at isolated points in momentum space. In this paper, we show that this principle can fail in a radical way: an entire gapless Fermi surface can emerge at a quantum critical point separating two fully gapped insulators. These exotic phase transitions are dubbed metallogenic quantum critical points (MGQCP). We construct a controlled family of effective field theories for MGQCPs between distinct fractional Chern insulators and propose a periodically modulated quantum Hall bilayer as a minimal microscopic setting. The critical theory exhibits an unusual mixture of physical signatures: while transport and compressibility follow scaling laws compatible with a conformal field theory, the electron spectral function develops a power-law non-analyticity at the Fermi momentum, characteristic of non-Fermi-liquid metals. We discuss how the concept of MGQCP may shed new light on critical phenomena in moire materials with tunable Chern bands. More generally, our results point to a broader class of quantum critical phenomena in which extended manifolds of gapless excitations emerge in momentum space despite being absent in both neighboring phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种反常的量子临界现象：分隔两个完全有能隙绝缘体的量子临界点上，可能出现完整的无能隙费米面，而非仅在动量空间孤立点上出现无能隙自由度。作者将这类临界点称为成金属量子临界点，并为不同分数陈绝缘体之间的转变构造了受控有效场论。其输运和压缩率遵循类似共形场论的标度规律，而电子谱函数在费米动量处呈现非费米液体特有的幂律非解析性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相互作用多体系统中的连续量子相变表现出在很大程度上独立于微观细节的普适现象。从伊辛模型中的磁性相变等经典实例中提炼出的一个组织原则是：有能隙相之间转变的低能物理由具有尺度不变性的量子场论支配，其无能隙自由度位于动量空间中的孤立点。在本文中，我们表明这一原则可能以一种根本性的方式失效：在分隔两个完全有能隙绝缘体的量子临界点上，整个无能隙费米面都可以出现。这类奇异相变被称为成金属量子临界点（MGQCP）。我们为不同分数陈绝缘体之间的 MGQCP 构造了一族受控的有效场论，并提出一种具有周期调制的量子霍尔双层体系，作为最小的微观实现。该临界理论呈现出不同寻常的物理特征组合：输运和压缩率遵循与共形场论相容的标度定律，而电子谱函数在费米动量处发展出幂律非解析性，这是非费米液体金属的典型特征。我们讨论了 MGQCP 概念如何为具有可调陈能带的莫尔材料中的临界现象提供新的认识。更一般地说，我们的结果指向一类更广泛的量子临界现象：尽管相邻两个相中都不存在动量空间的延展无能隙激发流形，但在临界点却会出现这类流形。

articles.title: Beyond geometric symmetry: Broadband linear relations in wave scattering
articles.title_zh: 超越几何对称性：波散射中的宽带线性关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26562v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The design and control of wave scattering, that is, of the reflection and transmission parameters of a device, is of ubiquitous importance. These parameters generally change with varying frequency, though certain emphfrequency-independent linear relations may exist between them. Reciprocity and geometric symmetry (reflections, rotations, etc.) are classic and well-known examples that are present in many devices and significantly ease their design. In this work, we go beyond these and introduce a new class of relations that cannot be induced by reciprocity or geometric symmetry. Choosing networks of waveguides as our workhorse, we discuss the conditions and consequences of such novel behaviour and showcase suitable example setups. We further experimentally test our predictions using coaxial cables and find excellent agreement in the broad frequency range between 0 and 1 GHz. Our work not only deepens the theoretical understanding of waveguide network dynamics, but also opens new avenues for applications in broadband signal processing, quantum information, and integrated photonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 波散射器件的反射和透射参数通常随频率变化，但其中可能存在与频率无关的线性关系。该研究提出一类不能由互易性或几何对称性诱导的新型关系，并以波导网络为主要研究对象分析其条件和后果。利用同轴电缆进行的实验在 0 至 1 GHz 的宽频范围内与理论预测高度一致，为宽带信号处理、量子信息和集成光子学提供了潜在应用方向。
authors: Malte Röntgen, Sucui Luo, Xuelong Chen, Chenyu Zhang, Ruotao Ye, Tianshu Jiang, Wenlong Gao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 波散射的设计与控制，即对器件反射参数和透射参数的设计与控制，具有普遍的重要性。这些参数通常会随频率变化，不过它们之间可能存在某些与频率无关的线性关系。互易性和几何对称性（反射、旋转等）是经典且广为人知的例子，它们存在于许多器件中，并能显著简化器件设计。在这项工作中，我们超越这些关系，提出一类不能由互易性或几何对称性诱导的新型关系。我们选择波导网络作为主要研究对象，讨论这种新行为出现的条件及其后果，并展示合适的示例装置。随后，我们使用同轴电缆对理论预测进行了实验检验，并在 0 至 1 GHz 的宽频范围内发现了极佳的一致性。我们的工作不仅加深了对波导网络动力学的理论理解，也为宽带信号处理、量子信息和集成光子学中的应用开辟了新的方向。

articles.title: Adiabatic Otto-like quantum thermodynamical cycle in the non-quasi-static regime
articles.title_zh: 非准静态条件下的绝热类奥托量子热力学循环
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26690v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show a finite-time Otto-like quantum thermodynamic cycle that preserves the adiabatic population structure of a time-dependent harmonic oscillator in the non-quasi-static regime. In the conventional energy representation, finite-rate driving induces non-adiabatic population redistribution and leaves residual excitations after the Hamiltonian has returned to its initial value. We show that this difficulty can be avoided by formulating the dynamics in the Lewis-Riesenfeld invariant representation, without modifying the physical Hamiltonian through auxiliary counterdiabatic driving. For a parametric Mathieu protocol, quantum inertia produces a mismatch between the spatial width of the working mode and its transient dressed energy scale. We propose an experimental implementation of this scheme in a trapped-ion Paul trap using stimulated Raman interactions, with independent control of the laser detuning and beam intersection angle. This provides a finite-time implementation in which the invariant population structure is preserved while the physical trap frequency evolves non-quasi-statically. Our results establish a clear distinction between adiabatic operation and quasi-static driving, providing a route toward finite-time quantum thermal cycles that retain the adiabatic energy structure without requiring the quasi-static limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种有限时间的类奥托量子热力学循环，在非准静态条件下仍保持含时谐振子的绝热布居结构。通过在 Lewis–Riesenfeld 不变量表象中描述动力学，可以避免有限速率驱动造成的非绝热布居重分布，而无需引入辅助反事实驱动。作者提出利用囚禁离子 Paul 陷阱和受激拉曼相互作用实现该方案，使激光失谐和光束夹角能够独立控制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们展示了一种有限时间的类奥托量子热力学循环，该循环在非准静态条件下保持含时谐振子的绝热布居结构。在通常的能量表象中，有限速率驱动会诱导非绝热布居重分布，并在哈密顿量恢复其初始值后留下残余激发。我们表明，通过在 Lewis–Riesenfeld 不变量表象中表述动力学，可以避免这一困难，而无需通过辅助反绝热驱动改变物理哈密顿量。对于参数化的 Mathieu 协议，量子惯性会使工作模的空间宽度与其瞬态缀饰能标之间产生不匹配。我们提出在囚禁离子 Paul 陷阱中利用受激拉曼相互作用实现这一方案，其中激光失谐和光束交叉角可以独立控制。这样便可在陷阱频率以非准静态方式演化的同时，实现一种保持不变量布居结构的有限时间过程。我们的结果明确区分了绝热运行与准静态驱动，并为无需准静态极限、却能保留绝热能量结构的有限时间量子热循环提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Isotropic Nanoscale Quantum Sensor at Room-Temperature
articles.title_zh: 室温各向同性纳米尺度量子传感器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26942v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Color-center based quantum sensors provide nanoscale resolution under ambient conditions, yet their applicability remains limited. Because the quantization axes are locked to the host lattice, conventional color centers suffer severe signal loss in off-axis magnetic fields. To address this, we report an isotropic magnetometer enabled by the neutrally charged nitrogen-vacancy center (NV0) in diamond. Here, spin-to-charge dynamics yield an NV0-dark spin pair whose quantization axis dynamically aligns with the external field. Read out through NV charge-state-selective fluorescence, this system exhibits microsecond room-temperature coherence and nanotesla sensitivity for arbitrary field directions. We demonstrate alignment-free mapping of steep field gradients and single paramagnetic micro-targets, alongside isotropic readout from randomly oriented nanodiamonds. Resolving longstanding orientation constraints, this platform unlocks unrestricted nanoscale magnetometry across life sciences and quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统色心量子传感器的量子化轴固定在宿主晶格上，因此在偏离轴向的磁场中会出现严重信号损失。该研究利用金刚石中电中性的氮空位中心 NV0 的自旋—电荷动力学，形成量子化轴可随外部磁场动态对齐的暗自旋对。该系统在室温下具有微秒级相干性和纳特斯拉灵敏度，并实现了任意方向磁场的无须对准测量，包括陡峭磁场梯度、单个顺磁微目标及随机取向纳米金刚石的成像。
authors: Daniel T. Möller, Baha Sakar, Ekrem T. Güldeste, Dhruv Wadhwani, Olt Gashi, Daniel A. García Vaca, Mokessh K. Ciwan, Simone P. Crozier, Christian Laube, Sirswa K. Shree Ram, Matteo Slaviero, Nabeel Aslam
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于色心的量子传感器能够在环境条件下提供纳米尺度分辨率，但其适用性仍受到限制。由于量子化轴被锁定在宿主晶格上，传统色心在偏离轴向的磁场中会遭受严重的信号损失。为解决这一问题，我们报告了一种由金刚石中电中性氮空位中心（NV0）实现的各向同性磁力计。在这里，自旋—电荷动力学产生了一个 NV0 暗自旋对，其量子化轴会动态地与外部磁场对齐。通过 NV 电荷态选择性荧光进行读出，该系统在室温下表现出微秒级相干性，并且对于任意磁场方向都具有纳特斯拉灵敏度。我们展示了无需对准即可绘制陡峭磁场梯度和单个顺磁微目标的磁场图，同时还实现了对随机取向纳米金刚石的各向同性读出。该平台解决了长期存在的取向限制，为生命科学和量子材料中的不受方向约束的纳米尺度磁力测量开辟了道路。

articles.title: A Superconducting Phase Transition Single-Electron Transistor
articles.title_zh: 一种超导相变单电子晶体管
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27045v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum computers require fast and accurate methods for qubit state detection. Phase-transition sensors exploit the abrupt change between two physical states of a material to achieve enhanced sensitivity and have enabled advanced detectors for quantum technologies, such as superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors. However, this sensing principle has not yet been applied to semiconductor spin qubits. Here, we demonstrate a superconducting phase-transition radio-frequency single-electron transistor (PTSET), a charge sensor for semiconductor spin qubits whose response is enhanced by a superconducting-to-normal phase transition. The transition is engineered by linking the sensor current to a low-critical-current, high-kinetic-inductance inductor integrated into the radio-frequency matching network. We demonstrate improvements in sensitivity of one and two orders of magnitude over conventional rfSETs in the large- and small-signal regimes, respectively. Our results establish phase-transition sensing as a route towards ultrasensitive, integrated charge sensors for semiconductor quantum computing and point to broader applications, including cryogenic photon detection for radio astronomy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出并展示了一种用于半导体自旋量子比特电荷探测的超导相变射频单电子晶体管（PTSET）。该传感器将传感器电流与射频匹配网络中的低临界电流、高动能电感器连接起来，利用超导态到正常态的相变增强响应。与传统射频单电子晶体管相比，PTSET 在大信号和小信号工作区域的灵敏度分别提高一个数量级和两个数量级。
authors: Gorka Aizpurua-Iraola, Thomas H. Swift, Felix-Ekkehard von Horstig, Domenic Prete, James Kirkman, Grayson M. Noah, Fabio Olivieri, Alberto Gomez-Saiz, M. Fernando Gonzalez-Zalba
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子计算机需要快速且准确的方法来探测量子比特状态。相变传感器利用材料两种物理状态之间的突变来实现增强灵敏度，并且已经促成了量子技术中的先进探测器，例如超导纳米线单光子探测器。然而，这种传感原理此前尚未应用于半导体自旋量子比特。在此，我们展示了一种超导相变射频单电子晶体管（PTSET），它是一种用于半导体自旋量子比特的电荷传感器，其响应通过超导态到正常态的相变得到增强。该相变是通过将传感器电流连接到集成在射频匹配网络中的低临界电流、高动能电感器来设计实现的。我们证明，与传统射频单电子晶体管相比，PTSET 在大信号和小信号工作区域的灵敏度分别提高了一个数量级和两个数量级。我们的结果确立了相变传感作为实现半导体量子计算超灵敏集成电荷传感器的一条途径，并指出其在更广泛领域中的应用前景，包括用于射电天文学的低温光子探测。

articles.title: Diamond quantum-sensing platform with integrated boron-doped diamond microwave antenna and thermometer
articles.title_zh: 集成硼掺杂金刚石微波天线和温度计的金刚石量子传感平台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27160v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Wide-field nitrogen-vacancy (NV) magnetic imaging at cryogenic temperatures requires microwave excitation and reliable knowledge of the temperature near the sensing region. Here, we report an integrated diamond quantum-sensing platform combining an ensemble of NV centers with a boron-doped diamond (BDD) microwave antenna and thermometer formed on the same diamond substrate. The BDD antenna provides microwave excitation for optically detected magnetic resonance measurements, and the BDD thermometer monitors the thermal environment near the NV sensing region. The BDD thermometer detected laser-induced local heating that was not clearly resolved by a stage-mounted thermometer. Using this platform, we imaged the temperature-dependent Meissner response of multiple cuprate superconductors while recording the temperature. These results demonstrate that the integrated BDD--NV platform provides a practical approach for cryogenic wide-field magnetic imaging with integrated microwave delivery and local thermometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 低温条件下的宽场氮空位中心磁成像需要微波激发，并需要可靠掌握传感区域附近的温度。该研究在同一金刚石衬底上集成氮空位中心阵列、硼掺杂金刚石微波天线和温度计，构建了金刚石量子传感平台。硼掺杂金刚石温度计能够探测到台式温度计未清晰分辨的激光诱导局部升温，并用于记录多个铜酸盐超导体的温度依赖迈斯纳响应。
authors: Masahiro Ohkuma, Ryo Matsumoto, Shintaro Adachi, Shinobu Onoda, Kensei Terashima, Takao Watanabe, Yoshihiko Takano, Keigo Arai
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低温条件下的宽场氮空位中心（NV）磁成像需要微波激发，并且需要可靠地了解传感区域附近的温度。在此，我们报告了一种集成式金刚石量子传感平台，该平台将 NV 中心阵列、硼掺杂金刚石（BDD）微波天线和温度计集成在同一块金刚石衬底上。BDD 天线为光学探测磁共振测量提供微波激发，而 BDD 温度计则监测 NV 传感区域附近的热环境。BDD 温度计探测到了激光诱导的局部升温，而安装在台架上的温度计未能清晰分辨这一升温。利用该平台，我们在记录温度的同时，对多个铜酸盐超导体的温度依赖迈斯纳响应进行了成像。这些结果表明，集成式 BDD—NV 平台为低温宽场磁成像提供了一种实用方案，能够同时实现集成式微波传输和局部测温。

articles.title: ElemCo.jl: A Julia package for electron-correlation methods
articles.title_zh: ElemCo.jl：用于电子相关方法的 Julia 软件包
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27177v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present ElemCo.jl, an open-source Julia package for molecular electronic structure and properties calculations with a particular emphasis on Coupled Cluster and Distinguishable Cluster methods. The package provides a high-level, macro-based user interface which makes routine calculations accessible to users with no prior Julia experience. A newly developed visualizer, JLmol, assists in the graphical preparation of ElemCo.jl input files and displays results such as molecular orbitals. ElemCo.jl offers restricted closed-shell and unrestricted variants of state-of-the-art electron-correlation methods such as FCI, MP2, CCSD(T) as well as EOM-CCSD and the DC methods DCSD and DC-CCSDT. In addition to traditional approaches, ElemCo.jl provides recently developed methods that are currently unique to the package. These include tensor-decomposed implementations of DCSD and DC-CCSDT (SVD-DCSD and SVD-DC-CCSDT) as well as two-determinant and fixed-reference CC and DC methods. For excited-state calculations, ElemCo.jl also offers EOM-DCSD, which is benchmarked in this work against CC3 on the QUEST3 benchmark set, alongside EOM-CCSD. Furthermore, both ground and excited states, including those of multireference character, can be treated using CIPHI - an efficient selected Configuration Interaction (CI) approach employing a CIPSI/Heat-Bath-CI-based algorithm. Users can directly invoke internal functions from the input file, enabling them to test and compose new methods without the need to modify ElemCo.jl's source code. Also, ElemCo.jl can be readily interfaced with external quantum chemistry codes through the Fcidump format, for example as the high-level solver for transcorrelated Hamiltonians, periodic embedded fragments, etc. We provide a detailed overview of ElemCo.jl's methodological repertoire and discuss its technical details and implementation, performance, interfaces, and usage.
articles.abstract_zh: ElemCo.jl 是一个开源 Julia 软件包，用于分子电子结构和性质计算，重点支持耦合簇方法和可区分簇方法。该软件提供基于宏的高级用户界面、用于准备输入文件和显示分子轨道的可视化工具 JLmol，并实现了从 FCI、MP2、CCSD(T) 到 EOM-CCSD、DCSD 和 DC-CCSDT 等多种方法。它还包含张量分解、双行列式、固定参考、CIPHI 选定组态相互作用等方法，并可通过 Fcidump 格式与外部量子化学代码接口。
authors: Daniel Kats, Charlotte Rickert, Thomas Schraivogel, Kristoffer Simula, Denis Usvyat, Fangcheng Wu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们介绍 ElemCo.jl，这是一个用于分子电子结构和性质计算的开源 Julia 软件包，特别强调耦合簇方法和可区分簇方法。该软件包提供基于宏的高级用户界面，使没有 Julia 使用经验的用户也能进行常规计算。新开发的可视化工具 JLmol 可辅助以图形方式准备 ElemCo.jl 输入文件，并显示分子轨道等结果。ElemCo.jl 提供了先进电子相关方法的限制闭壳层和非限制变体，包括 FCI、MP2、CCSD(T)、EOM-CCSD，以及 DCSD 和 DC-CCSDT 等 DC 方法。除传统方法外，ElemCo.jl 还提供近期开发、目前为该软件包所独有的方法，包括 DCSD 和 DC-CCSDT 的张量分解实现（SVD-DCSD 和 SVD-DC-CCSDT），以及双行列式和固定参考的 CC 与 DC 方法。对于激发态计算，ElemCo.jl 还提供 EOM-DCSD；本文在 QUEST3 基准数据集上将其与 CC3 以及 EOM-CCSD 进行了基准比较。此外，基态和激发态，包括具有多参考特征的态，都可以使用 CIPHI 进行处理；CIPHI 是一种高效的选定组态相互作用方法，采用基于 CIPSI/Heat-Bath-CI 的算法。用户可以直接从输入文件调用内部函数，从而无需修改 ElemCo.jl 源代码即可测试和组合新方法。ElemCo.jl 还可以通过 Fcidump 格式方便地与外部量子化学代码连接，例如作为相互作用电子哈密顿量、周期性嵌入片段等问题的高级求解器。我们详细概述了 ElemCo.jl 的方法体系，并讨论其技术细节与实现、性能、接口和使用方式。

articles.title_zh: 来自非均匀 Lieb—Robinson 光锥的 Krylov 崩溃时间

articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论如何确定 m 维 Krylov 截断可以可信使用的时间范围，并指出这一时间由相关 Jacobi 链上的因果传播决定。关键距离不是 Krylov 指标本身，而是由 Lanczos 跃迁系数定义的非均匀输运度量；在小权重极限下，传播在该度量形成的光锥外指数受抑。作者进一步指出，有限 Krylov 近似对返回振幅的误差是往返传播效应，并结合 Lieb—Robinson 界与 Duhamel 公式给出截断动力学误差的下界。所提供的原摘要在定义崩溃时间下界的公式处截断，因而无法据此补译未提供的后续内容。
authors: Shunji Matsuura, Yoji Kawamura, Joseph Salfi, Satoshi Iso

articles.title: Spectral Fingerprints of Gauge Theories on a Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上的规范理论谱指纹
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27457v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Maximally mixed state spectral sampling is an unbiased quantum algorithm that allows for extraction of a finite-resolution spectral distribution from a Hamiltonian over potentially the entire allowed range of energies. We show how it may be focused on any desired area of the spectrum in order to learn about the full fingerprint of the model of interest: from its ground state phenomena such as quantum criticality, obtained from the lowest lying energies, to its thermalization behavior, obtained from the mid-spectrum. We demonstrate this technique specifically on a (1+1)d non-Abelian SO(3) gauge theory, providing a comprehensive analysis of the steps necessary for performing this algorithm, as well as what is possible in the near-term with superconducting quantum hardware, performing simulations with circuits that are 78 two-qubit gates deep. We show how this algorithm is able to take advantage of emerging dynamical circuit capabilities in near-term hardware to roughly halve the number required qubits, as well as how quantum readout error mitigation is trivial for this method. Along the way, we propose a novel strategy for compiling the controlled-time evolutions needed for spectral sampling by means of Pauli-frame optimizations. We illustrate two physical applications of quantum spectral sampling -- disordered many-body transitions, and mid-spectrum densities of states -- and what postprocessing steps they require beyond the Fourier outputs of the algorithm.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究最大混合态谱采样这一无偏量子算法，展示其如何聚焦于能谱的任意区域，以提取模型从基态量子临界性到中部能谱热化行为的完整谱指纹。作者以（1+1）维非阿贝尔 SO(3)规范理论为例，在具有 78 层双量子比特门的超导量子硬件电路上进行模拟。研究还提出基于泡利框架优化的受控时间演化编译策略，并讨论无序多体跃迁和中部能谱态密度等应用。
authors: Graham Van Goffrier, Debasish Banerjee, Bipasha Chakraborty, Emilie Huffman
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最大混合态谱采样是一种无偏量子算法，能够从哈密顿量中提取有限分辨率的谱分布，其能量范围原则上可以覆盖所有允许的能量。我们展示了如何将该方法聚焦于能谱中的任意目标区域，从而了解相关模型的完整指纹：既可以通过最低能量处的谱结构研究量子临界性等基态现象，也可以通过能谱中部研究其热化行为。我们具体将这一技术应用于一个（1+1）维非阿贝尔 SO(3)规范理论，全面分析了实施该算法所需的步骤，以及在近期超导量子硬件上可以实现的内容，并使用深度为 78 个双量子比特门的电路进行了模拟。我们表明，该算法能够利用近期硬件中新兴的动态电路能力，将所需量子比特数量大致减半；同时，对于这一方法而言，量子读出误差缓解也十分简单。在此过程中，我们还提出了一种通过泡利框架优化来编译谱采样所需受控时间演化的新策略。最后，我们展示了量子谱采样的两个物理应用，即无序多体跃迁和能谱中部的态密度，并说明了除算法输出的傅里叶结果之外，这些应用还需要哪些后处理步骤。

articles.title: Emergence of nodal Bogoliubov quasiparticles across the transition from the pseudogap metal to the d-wave superconductor
articles.title_zh: 从赝能隙金属到 d 波超导体的跃迁过程中节点玻戈留博夫准粒子的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2308.03835v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We model the pseudogap state of the hole- and electron-doped cuprates as a metal with hole and/or electron pocket Fermi surfaces. In the absence of long-range antiferromagnetism, such Fermi surfaces violate the Luttinger requirement of enclosing the same area as free electrons at the same density. Using the Ancilla theory of such a pseudogap state, we describe the onset of conventional d-wave superconductivity by the condensation of a charge e Higgs boson transforming as a fundamental under the emergent SU(2) gauge symmetry of a background π-flux spin liquid. In all cases, we find that the d-wave superconductor has gapless Bogoliubov quasiparticles at 4 nodal points on the Brillouin zone diagonals with significant velocity anisotropy, just as in the BCS state. This includes the case of the electron-doped pseudogap metal with only electron pockets centered at wavevectors (π, 0), (0, π), and an electronic gap along the zone diagonals. Remarkably, in this case too, gapless nodal Bogoliubov quasiparticles emerge within the gap at 4 points along the zone diagonals upon the onset of superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将空穴掺杂和电子掺杂铜氧化物中的赝能隙态建模为具有空穴和/或电子口袋费米面的金属，并利用 Ancilla 理论描述常规 d 波超导性的形成。研究发现，在各种情形下，d 波超导体均在布里渊区对角线上出现 4 个无能隙节点玻戈留博夫准粒子，其速度具有显著各向异性。即使电子掺杂赝能隙金属的区对角线存在电子能隙，超导性出现后仍会在该能隙内涌现节点准粒子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将空穴掺杂和电子掺杂铜氧化物中的赝能隙态建模为具有空穴和/或电子口袋费米面的金属。在不存在长程反铁磁性的情况下，这类费米面违反朗道尔要求，即其包围的面积应当与相同电子密度下自由电子所包围的面积相同。利用描述此类赝能隙态的 Ancilla 理论，我们将常规 d 波超导性的出现描述为一种电荷为 e 的希格斯玻色子发生凝聚；该玻色子在背景 π 通量自旋液体所具有的涌现 SU(2)规范对称性下按基本表示变换。在所有情形中，我们发现 d 波超导体在布里渊区对角线上均具有位于 4 个节点处的无能隙玻戈留博夫准粒子，并且具有显著的速度各向异性，这与 BCS 态相同。这一结论也包括仅有电子口袋、且电子口袋中心位于波矢（π，0）和（0，π）的电子掺杂赝能隙金属情形；在该情形中，区对角线方向存在电子能隙。值得注意的是，即使在这一情形下，超导性出现后，无能隙的节点玻戈留博夫准粒子仍会在能隙内部沿区对角线的 4 个点处涌现。

articles.title: Observation of Coherent Ferron Emission and Propagation
articles.title_zh: 相干铁子发射与传播的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.22559v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Excitation of ordered quantum phases gives rise to collective modes and quasiparticles, as exemplified by spin waves and magnons emerging from magnetic order. Extending this paradigm to ferroelectric materials suggests the existence of polarization waves and their fundamental quanta, ferrons. Here, we report the generation and transport of polarization waves, i.e., coherent ferrons, in the van der Waals ferroelectric material NbOI2. Upon excitation by a short laser pulse, the polarization wave emits intense and narrow-band terahertz (THz) radiation at the ferroelectric transverse optical phonon frequency, modulates the ferroelectric order parameter, and propagates uniaxially along the polar axis at hypersonic velocities of ~105 m/s. These long-lived, uniaxial, and dipole-carrying polarization waves may find applications in narrow-band THz emission, ferronic information processing, and coherent electric control.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在范德瓦耳斯铁电材料 NbOI2 中实现并观测了极化波，即相干铁子。短激光脉冲激发后，极化波在铁电横向光学声子频率处发射强而窄带的太赫兹辐射，调制铁电序参量，并以约 10⁵ m/s 的超声速沿极性轴单向传播。这些长寿命、单向且携带偶极矩的极化波有望用于窄带太赫兹发射、铁子信息处理和相干电控。
authors: Jeongheon Choe, Taketo Handa, Chun-Ying Huang, André Koch Liston, Jordan Cox, Jonathan Stensberg, Yongseok Hong, Daniel G. Chica, Ding Xu, Fuyang Tay, Samra Husremovic, Vinicius da Silveira Lanza Avelar, Eric A. Arsenault, Zhuquan Zhang, James McIver, Dmitri N. Basov, Milan Delor, Xavier Roy, X. -Y. Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有序量子相的激发会产生集体模式和准粒子，磁序中出现的自旋波和磁振子就是典型例子。将这一范式拓展到铁电材料，意味着应当存在极化波及其基本量子，即铁子。在此，我们报告了范德瓦耳斯铁电材料 NbOI2 中极化波，也就是相干铁子的产生与输运。受到短激光脉冲激发后，极化波在铁电横向光学声子频率处发射强烈而窄带的太赫兹辐射，调制铁电序参量，并以约 10⁵ m/s 的超声速沿极性轴单向传播。这些长寿命、单向且携带偶极矩的极化波可能应用于窄带太赫兹发射、铁子信息处理和相干电控制。

articles.title: Off-Diagonal dipolar interactions in the mixed Ising--XY magnet LiHoₓEr₁₋ₓF₄
articles.title_zh: 混合 Ising--XY 磁体 LiHoₓEr₁₋ₓF₄ 中的非对角偶极相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.11994v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We theoretically investigate the influence of off-diagonal dipolar interactions in the mixed-anisotropy magnet LiHoₓEr₁₋ₓF₄. Motivated by experimental observations showing an unexpectedly rapid suppression of the ferromagnetic transition temperature T_c upon substitution of Ho by Er ions, we use Monte Carlo simulations incorporating off-diagonal dipolar terms to elucidate the underlying physical mechanism. Our results reveal that, unlike in the diluted magnet LiHoₓY₁₋ₓF₄, where dilution weakens the effect of these interactions, substitution by planar Er ions amplifies it. This leads to a pronounced reduction of T_c, closely matching experimental data, thereby resolving discrepancies with mean-field predictions. The findings underscore the essential role of off-diagonal dipolar interactions in determining the magnetic properties of mixed-anisotropy dipolar systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过理论研究和蒙特卡洛模拟，考察混合各向异性磁体 LiHoₓEr₁₋ₓF₄ 中非对角偶极相互作用的作用。结果表明，与稀释磁体 LiHoₓY₁₋ₓF₄ 不同，平面内 Er 离子的取代会增强这种相互作用，从而显著降低铁磁转变温度 T_c。所得结果与实验数据高度吻合，说明非对角偶极相互作用对于混合各向异性偶极体系的磁性至关重要。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了混合各向异性磁体 LiHoₓEr₁₋ₓF₄ 中非对角偶极相互作用的影响。受实验观测启发，即用 Er 离子取代 Ho 离子后铁磁转变温度 T_c 出现出乎意料的快速抑制，我们采用包含非对角偶极项的蒙特卡洛模拟来阐明其背后的物理机制。我们的结果表明，与稀释磁体 LiHoₓY₁₋ₓF₄ 中稀释会削弱这类相互作用不同，平面内 Er 离子的取代会放大这种作用。这将导致 T_c 显著降低，并且与实验数据高度吻合，从而解决了其与平均场预言之间的矛盾。这些发现凸显了非对角偶极相互作用在决定混合各向异性偶极体系磁性方面所起的关键作用。

articles.title: Nonlinear Hall effect in topological Dirac semimetals in parallel magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 平行磁场下拓扑狄拉克半金属中的非线性霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.20159v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We compute the second-harmonic response of two-dimensional topological Dirac semimetals subjected to an external in-plane magnetic field. The quantum kinetic equation for the Wigner distribution function is derived and then solved to evaluate the second-order electric-field contributions to the current density. Both the Berry curvature dipole and the field-induced terms in the current are analyzed across a broad range of model parameters. We propose that our theory can be tested experimentally by measuring the dependence of the anomalous Hall resistivity on the in-plane magnetic field in the surface states of the topological insulator SnTe, in WTe₂ and WSe₂ monolayers, as well as in the Kondo lattice material Ce₃Bi₄Pd₃ at very low temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文计算了二维拓扑狄拉克半金属在外加面内磁场下的二次谐波响应，并通过求解 Wigner 分布函数的量子动理学方程得到二阶电场诱导电流。作者分析了贝里曲率偶极矩及磁场诱导电流项在广泛模型参数下的行为，并提出可在 SnTe 拓扑绝缘体表面态、WTe₂ 和 WSe₂ 单层以及低温 Ce₃Bi₄Pd₃ 中通过测量反常霍尔电阻率随面内磁场的变化进行检验。
authors: Maxim Dzero, Maxim Khodas, Alex Levchenko, Vladyslav Kozii
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们计算了二维拓扑狄拉克半金属在外部面内磁场作用下的二次谐波响应。我们推导了 Wigner 分布函数所满足的量子动理学方程，并对其进行求解，以评估电流密度中二阶电场贡献。我们在广泛的模型参数范围内分析了贝里曲率偶极矩以及磁场诱导电流中的相关项。我们提出，可以通过测量拓扑绝缘体 SnTe 的表面态、WTe₂ 和 WSe₂ 单层，以及 Kondo 晶格材料 Ce₃Bi₄Pd₃ 在极低温下的反常霍尔电阻率随面内磁场的变化，对我们的理论进行实验检验。

articles.title: Spin triplet pairing by suppressing altermagnetism
articles.title_zh: 通过抑制交错磁性实现自旋三重态配对
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.09959v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay between unconventional superconductivity and altermagnetic order has attracted much attention. In particular, whether spin-triplet superconductivity can be achieved by suppressing altermagnetism remains an open issue. We investigate this issue using a minimal single-orbital Hubbard model on a square lattice with a vacancy superstructure, in which both conventional antiferromagnetic and altermagnetic orders can emerge on an equal footing. We illustrate the existence of a metallic normal phase with altermagnetism even at half-filling due to geometric frustration and Coulomb interaction. Suppressing the altermagnetic long-range order using charge doping can lead to both conventional antiferromagnetic and altermagnetic spin fluctuations. Spin-singlet pairing is always favored when conventional antiferromagnetic spin fluctuations dominate. However, when altermagnetic spin fluctuations dominate, spin-triplet pairing will be induced. Implications of our results for possible material candidates are also briefly discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用具有空位超结构的方格子最小单轨道 Hubbard 模型，研究抑制交错磁性后能否实现自旋三重态超导。结果显示，几何阻挫与库仑相互作用可在半填充下形成具有交错磁性的金属正常相。电荷掺杂抑制交错磁长程有序后，当交错磁自旋涨落占主导时会诱导自旋三重态配对，而常规反铁磁自旋涨落占主导时则始终偏好自旋单重态配对。
authors: Xin Ma, Siqi Wu, Zilong Li, Lunhui Hu, Jianhui Dai, Chao Cao
articles.focus_summary: 该论文利用带有空位超结构的单轨道Hubbard模型，研究抑制交替磁性后自旋三重态超导配对的可能性。结果表明，电荷掺杂抑制交替磁长程序后，若交替磁性自旋涨落占主导，则可能诱导自旋三重态配对。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的交替磁性、超导、磁性结构、强关联体系和自旋相互作用方向相关。虽然研究主要基于模型哈密顿量而非具体材料，但其关于交替磁涨落与非常规超导竞争和协同的结论具有材料设计启发意义。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步寻找具有空位有序或几何阻挫结构的实际交替磁材料，并结合第一性原理构建多轨道低能有效哈密顿量。还可研究自旋-轨道耦合、晶格畸变、应变和载流子掺杂对三重态配对及拓扑超导状态的影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非常规超导性与交错磁序之间的相互作用已经引起广泛关注。尤其是，通过抑制交错磁性是否能够实现自旋三重态超导，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们利用具有空位超结构的方格子最小单轨道 Hubbard 模型研究了这一问题；在该模型中，常规反铁磁序和交错磁序可以在平等的基础上出现。我们说明，由于几何阻挫和库仑相互作用，即使在半填充条件下，也可以存在具有交错磁性的金属正常相。利用电荷掺杂抑制交错磁长程有序，可以产生常规反铁磁自旋涨落和交错磁自旋涨落。当常规反铁磁自旋涨落占主导时，总是偏好自旋单重态配对。然而，当交错磁自旋涨落占主导时，则会诱导自旋三重态配对。我们还简要讨论了这些结果对于可能材料候选体系的意义。

articles.title: Magnetic instabilities in three- and higher-dimensional Hubbard models with different lattice geometries: Impact of nonlocal spatial correlations
articles.title_zh: 具有不同晶格几何的三维及更高维 Hubbard 模型中的磁不稳定性：非局域空间关联的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.14396v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We analyze the impact of the lattice geometry on the thermodynamic transition to magnetically ordered phases in strongly interacting electron systems for various Bravais lattices in three, four and five dimensions, including both local and nonlocal correlation effects. In a first step we use the dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), which takes into account purely local correlations, to calculate the magnetic susceptibilities of the Hubbard model on three- (3d-sc), four- (4d-sc), and five-dimensional (5d-sc) simple cubic/hypercubic, as well as on three-dimensional body- (bcc) and face-centered (fcc) cubic lattices, and determine the transition temperature to the corresponding magnetically ordered state. In a second step, we exploit the dynamical vertex approximation (DΓA), a diagrammatic extension of DMFT, to include the effect of nonlocal correlations which are particularly important in the vicinity of the corresponding phase transition. For the bipartite 3d-sc, 4d-sc, 5d-sc and bcc lattices nonlocal fluctuations lead to a substantial reduction of the DMFT transition temperature consistent to the overall tendency of mean-field approaches to overestimate the stability of ordered phases. As expected, the magnitude of the difference between the DMFT, being exact in the limit of large connectivity/dimensions, and DΓA transition temperatures decreases with increasing coordination number. On a more practical perspective, these results also provide a reasonable guidance to evaluate the expected overestimation of the DMFT ordering temperature for different material geometries. For the fcc lattice, on the other hand, the ordered phase observed in DMFT vanishes completely within DΓA which is consistent with the existence of strong geometric frustration in this lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究三维、四维和五维不同布拉维晶格几何对强相互作用电子体系磁有序热力学转变的影响，并比较局域与非局域关联效应。动力学平均场理论给出磁转变温度，而动力学顶角近似进一步纳入相变附近重要的非局域关联。对于二分晶格，非局域涨落显著降低 DMFT 转变温度；对于具有强几何阻挫的面心立方晶格，DMFT 中的有序相在 DΓA 中完全消失。
authors: Marvin Leusch, Alessandro Toschi, Andreas Hausoel, Giorgio Sangiovanni, Georg Rohringer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们分析了三维、四维和五维中各种布拉维晶格的晶格几何对强相互作用电子体系磁有序相热力学转变的影响，同时考虑局域和非局域关联效应。首先，我们使用只纳入局域关联的动力学平均场理论（DMFT），计算 Hubbard 模型在三维简单立方晶格（3d-sc）、四维简单立方或超立方晶格（4d-sc）、五维简单立方或超立方晶格（5d-sc），以及三维体心立方晶格（bcc）和面心立方晶格（fcc）上的磁化率，并确定相应磁有序态的转变温度。第二步，我们采用动力学顶角近似（DΓA）这一 DMFT 的图示扩展，以纳入非局域关联的影响；在相应相变附近，非局域关联尤为重要。对于二分的 3d-sc、4d-sc、5d-sc 和 bcc 晶格，非局域涨落会显著降低 DMFT 转变温度，这与平均场方法通常高估有序相稳定性的总体趋势一致。正如预期，随着配位数增加，DMFT 与 DΓA 转变温度之间的差异幅度逐渐减小，因为 DMFT 在大配位数或高维极限下是精确的。从更实际的角度看，这些结果也为评估不同材料几何中 DMFT 有序温度预期高估程度提供了合理参考。然而，对于 fcc 晶格，DMFT 中观察到的有序相在 DΓA 中完全消失，这与该晶格中存在强几何阻挫相一致。

articles.title: Learning and retrieval for warm-starting charge-self-consistent DFT+DMFT
articles.title_zh: 用于热启动电荷自洽 DFT+DMFT 的学习与检索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.25061v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Charge-self-consistent (CSC) DFT+DMFT delivers quantitative correlated-electron physics one configuration at a time, making ensemble sampling dependent on reliable warm starts for its expensive fixed-point iteration. Here we compare retrieval from the most similar converged structure with an E(3)-equivariant model that predicts a physics-structured self-energy and Fermi level. Because the full CSC loop refines both initializations, every production result remains a converged DFT+DMFT solution. Across metallic Fe, correlated FeO, and Mott-insulating NiO, learning reduces the typical iterations to sustained convergence from 8 to 3, 8 to 3, and 6 to 1. Retrieval matches this median speed when a dense same-state archive is available, but several poor transplants reveal that structural similarity does not predict transplant quality. In a pre-registered volume window excluded from training and donor pools, learning retains its speed, whereas retrieval starts 3.4× farther from the fixed point and approaches cold-start cost. Either initialization can select a distinct near-degenerate branch on a rugged CSC landscape. Applied end to end, the workflow generates over one thousand correlated energy and force labels for iron at Earth's-core conditions and trains an equivariant interatomic potential. Solid--liquid coexistence with 9216 atoms gives Tₘ = 6225 ± 42,Kₛₜₐₜ at 330~GPa, consistent with recent experiments. A 50-configuration DFT+DMFT audit resolves the potential's energy calibration but does not justify a corrected melting temperature, because four-atom cells cannot realize a liquid. The resulting regime map favors retrieval within dense coverage, amortized learning at and beyond its boundary, and solver refinement throughout.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文比较了两种为电荷自洽 DFT+DMFT 固定点迭代提供热启动的方法：从最相似的已收敛结构中检索，以及利用 E(3) 等变模型预测具有物理结构的自能和费米能级。学习方法将 Fe、FeO 和 NiO 中达到持续收敛所需的典型迭代次数分别从 8、8 和 6 次降至 3、3 和 1 次。端到端流程还生成了铁在地核条件下的相关能量和力标签，并据此训练等变原子间势，得到 330 GPa 下固液共存熔点 6225 ± 42 K。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电荷自洽（CSC）DFT+DMFT 能够逐个构型地给出定量的关联电子物理，因此，系综采样依赖于为其昂贵固定点迭代提供可靠的热启动。在本文中，我们比较了从最相似的已收敛结构中进行检索的方法，以及一种 E(3) 等变模型；后者能够预测具有物理结构的自能和费米能级。由于完整的 CSC 循环会对两种初始化方式都进行进一步优化，因此每一个生产计算结果仍然是收敛的 DFT+DMFT 解。在金属 Fe、关联绝缘体 FeO 和 Mott 绝缘体 NiO 中，学习方法将达到持续收敛所需的典型迭代次数分别从 8 次降至 3 次、从 8 次降至 3 次，以及从 6 次降至 1 次。当存在密集的同态存档时，检索方法能够达到与学习方法相当的中位数加速效果；但若干次较差的移植表明，结构相似性并不能预测移植质量。在一个预先注册、且从训练集和供体池中排除的体积窗口内，学习方法仍保持其速度；而检索方法的初始状态距离固定点远 3.4 倍，并且其计算成本接近冷启动。两种初始化方式都可能在崎岖的 CSC 能量景观上选择不同的近简并分支。将该流程端到端应用后，我们为地核条件下的铁生成了超过一千个关联能量和力标签，并训练出一个等变原子间势。在 330 GPa、包含 9216 个原子的固液共存模拟中，得到熔点 Tₘ = 6225 ± 42 K，这与近期实验结果一致。对 50 个构型进行的 DFT+DMFT 审核解决了该势函数的能量标定问题，但并不能支持修正后的熔点，因为四原子晶胞无法实现液态。所得机制图表明，在数据覆盖密集的区域内应优先采用检索方法，在其边界处及之外采用摊销学习，并在整个过程中使用求解器进行细化。

articles.title: Electric-current control of anomalous Hall effect
articles.title_zh: 电流控制反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.03744v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We demonstrate robust and reversible electric-current control of the anomalous Hall effect (AHE) in a two-dimensional WTe2/Fe3GeTe2 (FGT) stack. Applying a current through Td-WTe2 leads to a giant modulation of the AHE of the adjacent FGT layer, with the relative change of the AHE conductivity exceeding 180%. Control experiments show that i) the observed effect is absent in pure FGT, ii) the modulation weakens in thicker FGT films, confirming its interfacial origin, and iii) the modulation peaks for bilayer WTe2, indicating that the Berry-curvature dipole (BCD) plays the dominant role in the modulation. We propose that the charge current I generates an out-of-plane magnetization Mz via BCD in WTe2 and Mz modifies the exchange splitting of FGT via the inverse magnetic proximity effect, thereby altering its Berry curvature and nontrivially influencing the AHE. The demonstrated method of AHE control offers new possibilities for magnetism control, i.e., for the study of AHE-transistors as well as electric-current control of quantum magnets, especially magnetic insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在二维 WTe2/Fe3GeTe2（FGT）堆叠结构中实现了稳健且可逆的电流控制反常霍尔效应。通过 Td-WTe2 注入电流可使相邻 FGT 层的反常霍尔电导相对变化超过 180%，实验表明该效应源于界面，并且贝里曲率偶极矩起主导作用。作者提出，WTe2 中的电流通过贝里曲率偶极矩产生面外磁化，进而经逆磁近邻效应改变 FGT 的交换劈裂和贝里曲率，实现反常霍尔效应调控。
authors: Jianping Guo, Gusthavo M. S. Brizolla, Peng Rao, Jian Shao, X. H. Huang, Thomas N. G. Meier, Tailai Xu, Peirui Ji, Jonathan Finley, Jaroslav Fabian, Johannes Knolle, Christian Back, Lin Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在二维 WTe2/Fe3GeTe2（FGT）堆叠结构中展示了对反常霍尔效应稳健且可逆的电流控制。通过 Td-WTe2 施加电流，会引起相邻 FGT 层反常霍尔效应的巨大调制，其反常霍尔电导的相对变化超过 180%。对照实验表明：其一，在纯 FGT 中不存在所观察到的效应；其二，随着 FGT 薄膜厚度增加，调制作用减弱，从而证实其来源于界面；其三，当 WTe2 为双层时调制达到峰值，表明贝里曲率偶极矩（BCD）在该调制中起主导作用。我们提出，电荷电流 I 通过 WTe2 中的 BCD 产生面外磁化 Mz，而 Mz 通过逆磁近邻效应改变 FGT 的交换劈裂，进而改变其贝里曲率，并以非平凡方式影响反常霍尔效应。所展示的反常霍尔效应控制方法为磁性控制提供了新的可能性，包括研究反常霍尔效应晶体管，以及利用电流控制量子磁体，尤其是磁性绝缘体。

articles.title: p wave Magnetism and Gate-Tunable Edelstein Response in van der Waals Heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 范德瓦耳斯异质结构中的 p 波磁性与栅极可调艾德尔斯坦响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.11251v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Odd-parity magnetism has attracted significant interest for its unconventional spin splitting. However, a concrete microscopic route for its realization remains elusive. In this work, we propose van der Waals heterostructures of stripe antiferromagnets (sAFMs) as an ideal platform for electrically controllable p-wave magnetism. In the sAFM/metal/sAFM structure, the leading RKKY-type exchange interaction is canceled due to the symmetry of the stacking pattern.
