articles.title: Dynamical signatures of deconfined spinons in dimerized sawtooth chains
articles.title_zh: 二聚化锯齿链中退禁闭自旋子的动力学特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26347v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the ground-state properties and dynamical response of the Heisenberg model on the sawtooth chain in and away from the exactly solvable valence-bond-solid (VBS) point. We employ U(1)-symmetric density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) methods to compute equilibrium diagnostics and the zero-temperature dynamical structure factor (DSF) Szz(q,ømega) across the dimerized phase, a valence-bond-ordered state in which the two symmetry-equivalent apex--base bonds of each triangle develop unequal spin correlations, probing the approach to the continuous lower phase boundary, the exact VBS point, and the approach to the first-order upper boundary. In every regime, the DSF is a broad continuum dominated by a bright band at its lower edge, with the intensity at the one-triplon energy ømega simeq JAB suppressed. We identify the spectrum as a deconfined two-spinon continuum of kink and antikink domain walls between the two degenerate singlet coverings. Closed-form spinon dispersions fix the continuum edges and track the dominant band across the zone in all three regimes, while an explicit finite-separation two-kink calculation in a constrained Hilbert space reproduces the measured intensity distribution. Our results provide a microscopic picture of fractionalized excitations in the dimerized sawtooth chain and are relevant to the recently discovered Ti³⁺ kagome fluorides, where strongly anisotropic exchange interactions can generate sawtooth-chain building blocks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究锯齿链海森堡模型在精确可解的价键固体点及其附近的基态性质和动力学响应。通过具有U(1)对称性的密度矩阵重整化群与含时变分原理计算，作者发现各个二聚化区域的动力学结构因子均表现为宽连续谱，并将其解释为由畴壁构成的退禁闭双自旋子连续谱。闭式自旋子色散关系确定了连续谱边界，并且受限希尔伯特空间中的有限分离双畴壁计算再现了观测到的强度分布。
authors: Nishan Ranabhat, Brandon B. Le, Seung-Hun Lee, Gia-Wei Chern
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了锯齿链上海森堡模型在精确可解的价键固体（VBS）点及其附近的基态性质和动力学响应。我们采用具有U(1)对称性的密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）和含时变分原理（TDVP）方法，计算二聚化相中的平衡诊断量以及零温动力学结构因子Szz(q,ω)。该相为一种价键有序态，其中每个三角形中由对称性等价的两条顶点-底边键发展出不相等的自旋关联；我们考察了接近连续型低相边界、精确VBS点以及接近一级型高边界时的情况。在每个区域中，动力学结构因子都是由其低能边缘上一条明亮谱带主导的宽连续谱，而单三重态激发能量ω≈JAB处的强度受到抑制。我们将该谱识别为退禁闭的双自旋子连续谱，其自旋子是两种简并单态覆盖之间的畴壁，即 kink 和 antikink。闭式自旋子色散关系确定了连续谱边界，并在全部三个区域中追踪跨越整个布里渊区的主导谱带；与此同时，在受限希尔伯特空间中进行的显式有限分离双kink计算再现了测得的强度分布。我们的结果为二聚化锯齿链中的分数量子化激发提供了微观图像，并与近期发现的Ti³⁺笼目氟化物相关；在这些材料中，强烈各向异性的交换相互作用能够产生锯齿链结构单元。

articles.title: When dissipative steady states admit thermodynamic occupation laws
articles.title_zh: 何时耗散稳态具有热力学占据定律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26621v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Non-equilibrium steady states (NESSs) generally lack thermodynamic occupation laws because finite stationary circulation and a globally exact rate-ratio field cannot coexist for the same Markov generator. Here we construct a sector-separated geometry that overcomes this incompatibility without arresting dissipation. Entropy-production exposure-and-separation excludes the entropy-producing state~0 from the conditional occupation manifold while retaining it in the dissipative full graph; physical returns i→0→0^ast become effectively Markovian in the strong-bias/rapid-reset (SR) limit. For a thermodynamically complete conditional manifold, autonomous redistribution (AR) eliminates residual futile circulation, making the rate-ratio one-form exact. Thermodynamic calibration gives Xᵢ₌β(Δμ- mathcal Fᵢcost) and pᵢ₌ₑXᵢ/Z_C, with Z_C=1+sumᵢ eXᵢ. Full-graph probabilities factorize exactly as P_α=(1-P₀₎ₚ_α. In the SR limit, the kinetic factor tends to unity while p_α→ eX_α/Zₘₐₜₕcal C, yielding P_α→ p_α while finite dissipation persists. Near AR, integrability is lost linearly in residual cycle current whereas dissipation begins quadratically. In the binary zero-cycle-rank limit, occupation redistributes autonomously under maintained Δμ bias, yielding the inverted Fermi--Dirac law, which is applied to thermal smearing in quantum-dot lasers. The framework provides constructive acquisition conditions and failure diagnostics for thermodynamic occupation laws in dissipative NESSs.
articles.abstract_zh: 非平衡稳态通常不具备热力学占据定律，因为同一马尔可夫生成元无法同时具有有限稳态环流和全局恰当的速率比场。本文构建分区几何结构，在不停止耗散的条件下规避该不相容性，并在强偏置/快速重置极限下获得热力学校准的条件占据分布。作者还分析了接近自主再分配条件时的可积性丧失和耗散行为，并将二元零循环秩情形得到的反转费米-狄拉克定律用于量子点激光器中的热展宽。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非平衡稳态（NESS）通常缺乏热力学占据定律，因为对于同一个马尔可夫生成元，有限的稳态环流和全局恰当的速率比场不能共存。本文构建了一种分区几何结构，在不阻止耗散的前提下克服这一不相容性。熵产生暴露与分离将产生熵的状态0排除在条件占据流形之外，同时将其保留在耗散的完整图中；在强偏置/快速重置（SR）极限下，物理返回i→0→0*变得有效地马尔可夫化。对于热力学完备的条件流形，自主再分配（AR）消除了残余的无效环流，使速率比一形式成为恰当形式。热力学校准给出Xᵢ＝β(Δμ－ℱᵢ^cost)以及pᵢ＝eXᵢ/Z_C，其中Z_C＝1＋∑ᵢeXᵢ。完整图上的概率可精确分解为P_α＝(1－P₀)p_α。在SR极限下，动力学因子趋于1，同时p_α→eX_α/Z_𝒞，从而在有限耗散仍然存在时P_α→p_α。在AR附近，可积性随残余循环电流线性丧失，而耗散则以二次阶开始出现。在二元零循环秩极限中，占据在维持的Δμ偏置下自主再分配，得到反转的费米-狄拉克定律；该定律被应用于量子点激光器中的热展宽。该框架为耗散NESS中热力学占据定律提供了构造性的获得条件和失效诊断。

articles.title: Interlayer-engineering of Charge Order Wave Vector in Kagome Metals
articles.title_zh: 笼目金属中电荷有序波矢的层间工程调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26751v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Charge orders in the kagome metals AV₃Sb₅ sit at the center of a rich phase diagram that also includes superconductivity, nematicity, and signatures of time-reversal-symmetry breaking. Yet even the basic question of which charge ordering wave vectors are intrinsic, and which are selected by dimensionality and lattice coupling, remains unsettled. Importantly, the microscopic origin of different charge orders and, in particular, the relationship between the robust bulk 2 × 2 charge order and the controversial 4 × 1 modulation, which is primarily resolved by surface probes, remains unresolved. Here, we use first-principles calculations to study the role of interlayer coupling in CsV₃Sb₅ by tuning the interlayer separation from the monolayer limit to the bulk limit. In the monolayer AV₃Sb₅ (A = Rb, Cs), the phonon spectrum exhibits no instability at the M point; instead, the dominant lattice instability occurs at q = (1/4, 0, 0), consistent with a 4 × 1 modulation. As interlayer coupling increases in CsV₃Sb₅, an M-point phonon progressively softens and becomes unstable already near c = 12.24 Å, evolving into the strong 2 × 2 instability characteristic of the bulk. These results identify interlayer coupling as a control parameter at a fixed stoichiometry that links competing 4 × 1 and 2 × 2 tendencies, providing a unified framework for understanding why multiple charge-order wave vectors coexist and compete in kagome metals.
articles.abstract_zh: 笼目金属AV₃Sb₅的电荷有序与超导、向列性及时间反演对称性破缺迹象共存，但其不同电荷有序波矢的起源尚不明确。本文通过第一性原理计算调节CsV₃Sb₅的层间距，发现单层RbV₃Sb₅和CsV₃Sb₅在M点无声子不稳定性，而在q=(1/4,0,0)处具有与4×1调制一致的主导不稳定性。增强层间耦合会使M点声子软化并在约c=12.24 Å时失稳，逐渐演化为体相特征性的强2×2不稳定性。
authors: Muntafa M. Mahi, Quazi D. M. Khosru, M. Zahid Hasan, Mahbub Alam, Md Shafayat Hossain
articles.focus_summary: 该论文利用第一性原理计算调控CsV₃Sb₅的层间距，研究层间耦合对声子不稳定性和电荷序波矢的影响。结果表明，单层体系倾向于形成4×1调制，而增强层间耦合后会诱导M点软模并稳定2×2电荷序。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队关注的kagome金属、电荷密度波、声子耦合、二维材料和层间耦合高度相关。其通过层间工程解释不同电荷序的策略，可借鉴到磁性超晶格、范德华异质结构和电荷序调控研究中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合机器学习势或有效哈密顿量开展有限温度下电荷序相变和畴结构动力学模拟。还可研究应变、载流子掺杂及不同层间堆垛对电荷序和超导性的协同调控。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 笼目金属AV₃Sb₅中的电荷有序处于一个丰富相图的中心，该相图还包括超导、向列性以及时间反演对称性破缺的迹象。然而，究竟哪些电荷有序波矢是内禀的，哪些由维度性和晶格耦合选择，甚至这一基本问题仍未解决。重要的是，不同电荷有序的微观起源，特别是稳健的体相2×2电荷有序与主要由表面探针分辨出的、存在争议的4×1调制之间的关系，仍不清楚。本文利用第一性原理计算，通过将层间距从单层极限调节至体相极限，研究层间耦合在CsV₃Sb₅中的作用。在单层AV₃Sb₅（A＝Rb、Cs）中，声子谱在M点不显示不稳定性；相反，主导晶格不稳定性发生在q＝(1/4,0,0)处，这与4×1调制一致。随着CsV₃Sb₅中层间耦合增强，M点声子逐步软化，并在c约为12.24 Å时已经变得不稳定，进而演化为体相所特有的强2×2不稳定性。这些结果表明，在固定化学计量比下，层间耦合是连接相互竞争的4×1和2×2趋势的控制参数，并为理解为何多种电荷有序波矢会在笼目金属中共存和竞争提供了统一框架。

articles.title: Self-selective growth of GaAs1-xBix on GaAs zinc blende/wurtzite nanowire heterostructures
articles.title_zh: GaAs闪锌矿/纤锌矿纳米线异质结构上GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ的自选择生长
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Site-selective nanostructure growth and material incorporation at the atomic scale offer a promising pathway for engineering quantum materials and nanodevices. Here, GaAs nanowires (NWs) with an axial heterostructure of alternating zinc blende (Zb) and wurtzite (Wz) crystal phases are employed as templates for site-selective Ga and Bi overgrowth. Using X-ray photoemission electron microscopy (XPEEM) with nanoscale spatial resolution, we map elemental distribution and local chemical bonding to reveal the incorporation behavior of Bi atoms in 110 Zb and 11-20 Wz facets. Bi incorporation proceeds through an anion-exchange process, where Bi atoms replace As, forming local Ga-Bi bonds and producing a thin GaAs1-xBix shell. We observe crystal-phase-dependent Bi incorporation, with higher Bi concentration in the Zb segments than in the neighboring Wz segments within the same NW. Furthermore, the Zb segment with higher Bi content exhibits reduced susceptibility to oxidation compared with the Wz segment, resulting in increased Ga-oxide in the Wz surfaces. This study highlights GaAs NW Zb/Wz heterostructures as a template for controlled growth of GaBi and GaAs1-xBix nanostructures with tailored functionalities for quantum applications
articles.abstract_zh: 原子尺度的位点选择性纳米结构生长和材料掺入，为量子材料与纳米器件工程提供了途径。本文以交替闪锌矿和纤锌矿晶相构成轴向异质结构的GaAs纳米线为模板，研究Ga和Bi的选择性过生长；X射线光电子发射电子显微镜显示，Bi通过阴离子交换取代As，形成局域Ga-Bi键及薄GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ壳层。闪锌矿区的Bi含量高于相邻纤锌矿区，且前者更不易氧化，而纤锌矿表面具有更多Ga氧化物。
authors: Rohit Yadav, Sebastian Lehmann, Vidar Flodgren, Evangelos Golias, Alexei Zakharov, Kimberly A. Dick, Anders Mikkelsen, Rainer Timm
articles.abstract_zh_full: 原子尺度上的位点选择性纳米结构生长和材料掺入，为设计量子材料和纳米器件提供了一条很有前景的路径。本文采用具有交替闪锌矿（Zb）和纤锌矿（Wz）晶相轴向异质结构的GaAs纳米线（NW）作为模板，用于Ga和Bi的位点选择性过生长。利用具有纳米尺度空间分辨率的X射线光电子发射电子显微镜（XPEEM），我们绘制了元素分布和局部化学键合图，以揭示Bi原子在110 Zb晶面和11-20 Wz晶面中的掺入行为。Bi的掺入通过阴离子交换过程进行，其中Bi原子取代As，形成局部Ga-Bi键，并产生薄的GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ壳层。我们观察到依赖于晶相的Bi掺入：在同一根纳米线内，Zb区段的Bi浓度高于相邻Wz区段。此外，Bi含量较高的Zb区段相比Wz区段更不易受氧化影响，导致Wz表面形成更多Ga氧化物。本研究突出表明，GaAs纳米线Zb/Wz异质结构可作为模板，用于可控生长具有面向量子应用的定制功能的GaBi和GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ纳米结构。

articles.title: Switchable giant room-temperature nonlinear Hall effect in Bilayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: 双层石墨烯中可切换的巨大室温非线性霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26869v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Utilizing quantum second-order nonlinear transport for practical junction-free devices require materials with large and tunable nonlinearites at room temperature -- a current materials platform challenge. Here, we report the nonlinear Hall effect (NLHE) in double-ionic gated bilayer graphene devices that enable unusually strong inversion breaking. We observe NLHE that are readily switchable (on, off, and sign reversed) with second order nonlinear susceptibilities ḩi⁽²⁾yₓₓ that reaches giant room-temperature values of 3,10⁻³,μm,S/V, comparable to values commonly observed at low temperature in WTe₂ or in graphene-based moiré superlattices, and three-to-four orders of magnitude larger than values reported in material systems recently employed in search of a room-temperature NLHE. Our devices produce corresponding THz voltage responsivities simeq 4,10⁴,V/W, comparable to commercially available Schottky diodes. These are orders of magnitude better than for previously reported room-temperature NLHE devices rendering double-ionic gated bilayer graphene a choice platform for junction-free nonlinear technology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道了双离子栅控双层石墨烯器件中的非线性霍尔效应，器件能够产生异常强的反演对称性破缺。作者在室温下观察到可开启、关闭并反号切换的巨大二阶非线性响应，其强度可与低温 WTe₂ 或石墨烯莫尔超晶格中的典型数值相比。相应太赫兹电压响应率接近商用肖特基二极管水平，表明双离子栅控双层石墨烯是无结非线性器件技术的有前景平台。
authors: Margherita Melegari, Ignacio Gutiérrez-Lezama, Justin C. W. Song, Alberto F. Morpurgo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将量子二阶非线性输运用于实用的无结器件，需要在室温下具有大且可调非线性的材料，而这仍是当前材料平台面临的挑战。本文报道了双离子栅控双层石墨烯器件中的非线性霍尔效应（NLHE），该器件能够实现异常强的反演对称性破缺。我们观察到易于切换（开启、关闭以及符号反转）的 NLHE，其二阶非线性磁化率 ḩi⁽²⁾yₓₓ 达到巨大的室温数值 3×10⁻³ μm S/V，可与通常在低温 WTe₂ 或石墨烯基莫尔超晶格中观察到的数值相比，并且比近期用于寻找室温 NLHE 的材料体系中报道的数值大三到四个数量级。我们的器件产生相应的太赫兹电压响应率约为 4×10⁴ V/W，可与商用肖特基二极管相比。这些性能比先前报道的室温 NLHE 器件高出数个数量级，使双离子栅控双层石墨烯成为无结非线性技术的优选平台。

articles.title: Electronic Structure and Band-Edge Character of Ga-Substituted α-Al₂O₃: A First-Principles Study
articles.title_zh: Ga 取代 α-Al₂O₃ 的电子结构与能带边缘特征：第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26977v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a first-principles density functional theory study of substitutional Ga incorporation in an α-Al₂O₃₋derived host, isolating chemical embedding effects without explicit geometric quantum confinement. Using a 30-atom α-Al₂O₃ supercell with two substituted Ga atoms, we examine three nonequivalent Ga-pair configurations and combine configuration-dependent energetics, local structural analysis, Ga-centered distortion metrics, and electronic-structure calculations.% to establish the relationship between local coordination distortion and band-edge modification. The energetically preferred configuration is governed not solely by Ga--O bond expansion but by the ability of the host lattice to accommodate bond-length and angular distortions around substituted Ga centers. Ga incorporation narrows the band gap relative to pristine α-Al₂O₃ without generating mid-gap states, primarily modifying the conduction-band manifold while preserving the oxygen-dominated valence edge. Band-edge charge densities and charge-density-difference maps show that the electronic response remains localized around the Ga-centered coordination environment. These results establish a chemically resolved baseline for understanding Ga incorporation in ultrawide-band-gap oxides and for future studies of confinement and interface effects in Ga-containing oxide nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用第一性原理密度泛函理论考察 α-Al₂O₃ 衍生宿主中 Ga 替位掺入的化学嵌入效应，而不显式引入几何量子限域。作者比较了三种不等价 Ga 对构型，发现稳定性不仅由 Ga-O 键伸长决定，还受晶格容纳局域键长和键角畸变能力控制。Ga 掺入会缩小带隙但不产生带隙中态，主要影响导带并保持价带边缘以氧为主。
authors: Z. S. Machavariani, R. Ya. Kezerashvili, T. Tchelidze
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一项关于 Ga 在 α-Al₂O₃ 衍生宿主中替位掺入的第一性原理密度泛函理论研究，旨在分离化学嵌入效应，而不显式考虑几何量子限域。使用含 30 个原子的 α-Al₂O₃ 超胞并替换其中两个 Ga 原子，我们考察了三种不等价的 Ga 对构型，并结合构型相关能量学、局域结构分析、以 Ga 为中心的畸变度量以及电子结构计算，以建立局域配位畸变与能带边缘改变之间的关系。能量上优选的构型并非仅由 Ga-O 键扩张支配，而是由宿主晶格容纳取代 Ga 中心周围键长和角度畸变的能力决定。相对于本征 α-Al₂O₃，Ga 掺入缩小了带隙，但不产生带隙中态；它主要改变导带流形，同时保持由氧主导的价带边缘。能带边缘电荷密度和电荷密度差分图显示，电子响应仍局域在以 Ga 为中心的配位环境附近。这些结果为理解超宽带隙氧化物中的 Ga 掺入建立了具有化学分辨率的基线，并为未来研究含 Ga 氧化物纳米结构中的限域和界面效应奠定基础。

articles.title: Crossing the Rotational Sound Barrier in a Quantum Solvent
articles.title_zh: 在量子溶剂中跨越旋转声障
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27030v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecules embedded in superfluids provide an experimentally controllable platform for investigating impurity physics. Here, we investigate a driven molecule rotating in a superfluid environment, including helium and Bose--Einstein condensates, at rotation frequencies similar to the bath dynamics. Within the experimentally relevant platform of an optical centrifuge, we show that the rotor remains localized up to a characteristic harmonic frequency that can realistically exceed the excitation energies of the bath, enabling access to ultrafast rotating impurities. In the co-rotating frame, the bath excitations experience a rotational Doppler shift, generating angular-momentum-resolved resonances absent in equilibrium angulon theory. We identify a dissipative rotational sound barrier at which the molecule resonantly emits bath excitations and undergoes strong angular momentum exchange with the surrounding medium. Overall, we establish the dynamical phase diagram of the driven rotor in a quantum solvent and introduce a generic platform for investigating fast driven rotating impurities in quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了嵌入超流环境中的受驱分子转子，环境包括氦和玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体，转动频率与浴动力学相当。作者表明，在光学离心机平台中，转子可在超过浴激发能的特征谐频前保持局域化，从而进入超快旋转杂质 regime。研究识别出一种耗散性旋转声障，在该点分子共振发射浴激发并与介质发生强角动量交换。
authors: Baptiste Coquinot, Giacomo Bighin, Mikhail Lemeshko, Ragheed Alhyder
articles.abstract_zh_full: 嵌入超流体中的分子为研究杂质物理提供了一个可在实验上控制的平台。本文研究了在超流环境中旋转的受驱分子，环境包括氦和玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体，其旋转频率与浴动力学相近。在实验相关的光学离心机平台内，我们表明转子可保持局域化直到某一特征谐频，而该频率在现实中可超过浴的激发能量，从而能够接近超快旋转杂质。在共旋转参考系中，浴激发经历旋转多普勒频移，产生平衡 angulon 理论中不存在的按角动量分辨的共振。我们识别出一个耗散性旋转声障，在该处分子共振发射浴激发，并与周围介质发生强烈角动量交换。总体而言，我们建立了量子溶剂中受驱转子的动力学相图，并引入了一个用于研究量子多体系统中快速受驱旋转杂质的通用平台。

articles.title: Occupation-Driven Josephson Diode in a Symmetric Junction
articles.title_zh: 对称结中由占据驱动的约瑟夫森二极管
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27213v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a Josephson diode mechanism in which nonreciprocity arises not from a conventional asymmetric Andreev spectrum but from nonequilibrium occupation of the current-carrying states engineered by attached reservoirs. We realize this mechanism in a double-quantum-dot junction, where a phase-textured nonlocal reservoir acts as a quantum Zeno selector: rapid dissipation freezes out the bright state directly coupled to the jump operator L, while preserving an orthogonal dark Andreev channel whose supercurrent remains comparable to that of the lossless junction. In the infinite-gap limit, the steady-state current factorizes as Iₘ̊ ₛₛ=I_A P_γ, so that even when the Andreev current I_A is strictly reciprocal, the phase asymmetry of P_γ alone can produce a Josephson diode effect through reservoir engineering. We further show that local Coulomb repulsion can drive the system toward a nearly ideal diode regime via a dark-pair resonance. Using Keldysh-Lindblad calculations, we demonstrate that our results remain robust for realistic junctions with a finite superconducting gap and dissipation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种约瑟夫森二极管机制，其非互易性并非来自传统的不对称 Andreev 谱，而是来自由外接储库工程化的载流态非平衡占据。作者在双量子点结中实现该机制，其中带相位纹理的非局域储库充当量子 Zeno 选择器，保留暗 Andreev 通道的超电流。计算表明，即使 Andreev 电流本身严格互易，仅占据因子的相位不对称也可产生二极管效应，并且该效应在有限超导能隙和耗散下保持稳健。
authors: Jianxiong Zhai, Zelei Zhang, Jiawei Yan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种约瑟夫森二极管机制，其中非互易性并非来自传统的不对称 Andreev 谱，而是来自由附接储库工程化的载流态非平衡占据。我们在一个双量子点结中实现该机制，在其中具有相位纹理的非局域储库充当量子 Zeno 选择器：快速耗散冻结了与跃迁算符 L 直接耦合的亮态，同时保留一个正交的暗 Andreev 通道，其超电流仍可与无损结的超电流相比。在无限能隙极限中，稳态电流分解为 Iₛₛ=I_A P_γ，因此即使 Andreev 电流 I_A 严格互易，仅 P_γ 的相位不对称也能通过储库工程产生约瑟夫森二极管效应。我们进一步表明，局域库仑排斥可通过暗对共振将系统推向近乎理想的二极管 regime。利用 Keldysh-Lindblad 计算，我们证明在具有有限超导能隙和耗散的真实结中，这些结果仍然稳健。

articles.title: Long-time Dynamics of Many-body Open Quantum Systems using Quantum Generating Functions
articles.title_zh: 利用量子生成函数研究多体开放量子系统的长时动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27237v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between coherent unitary evolution and environment-induced dissipation can give rise to a wide range of non-equilibrium dynamics in open quantum systems, ranging from interesting transport phenomena to dynamical phase transitions. However, accessing such long-time dynamics remains challenging for the existing methods developed for the simulation of many-body open quantum systems. We address this problem by developing a quantum generating function (QGF) formalism for open many-body systems for both ensemble-averaged dynamics governed by a Markovian quantum master equation and trajectory-resolved dynamics described by the quantum trajectory formalism, including quantum jumps, and quantum state diffusion. Our approach computes the dynamics of higher-order moments and fluctuation statistics without explicitly evolving the quantum state, thereby providing an efficient and scalable approach for investigating many-body open quantum systems. We demonstrate the versatility of the formalism by applying it to both the integrable open XXZ chain and the nonintegrable open next-nearest-neighbor XXZ spin chain, where it uncovers distinct initial state dependent long-time transport regimes. Our work establishes quantum generating functions as an efficient and scalable framework for investigating long-time dynamics in open quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对多体开放量子系统长时动力学模拟困难，发展了量子生成函数形式主义。该方法适用于由马尔可夫量子主方程支配的系综平均动力学，也适用于包含量子跃迁和量子态扩散的轨迹分辨动力学。它无需显式演化量子态即可计算高阶矩与涨落统计，并在开放 XXZ 链及含次近邻的非可积开放 XXZ 自旋链中揭示出依赖初态的长时输运 regime。
authors: Katha Ganguly, Dario Poletti, Bijay Kumar Agarwalla
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相干幺正演化与环境诱导耗散之间的相互作用，可在开放量子系统中产生范围广泛的非平衡动力学，从有趣的输运现象到动力学相变。然而，对于现有的多体开放量子系统模拟方法而言，获得这类长时动力学仍然具有挑战性。我们通过为开放多体系统发展量子生成函数（QGF）形式主义来解决这一问题，该形式主义同时适用于由马尔可夫量子主方程支配的系综平均动力学，以及由量子轨迹形式主义描述的轨迹分辨动力学，包括量子跃迁和量子态扩散。我们的方法在不显式演化量子态的情况下计算高阶矩和涨落统计的动力学，从而为研究多体开放量子系统提供了一种高效且可扩展的方法。我们通过将该形式主义应用于可积开放 XXZ 链和非可积开放次近邻 XXZ 自旋链，展示了它的多功能性；在这些系统中，该方法揭示了不同的、依赖初态的长时输运 regime。我们的工作确立了量子生成函数作为研究开放量子多体系统长时动力学的高效且可扩展框架。

articles.title: The heavy Fermi polaron I: the Lithium-Cesium experiment
articles.title_zh: 重费米极化子 I：锂-铯实验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present details of an experimental platform for studying Fermi polarons in a quantum-gas mixture. The system consists of about a thousand bosonic ¹³³Cs impurities immersed in a deeply degenerate Fermi gas (T/T_F sim 0.2) of approximately 2× 10⁵ ⁶Li atoms in a single hyperfine state, with interspecies interactions tunable via a Feshbach resonance. Using optical Raman spectroscopy without relative momentum transfer, we perform injection spectroscopy and thereby create the Fermi polaron. Owing to the large mass imbalance between the two species, the setup provides access to previously unexplored regimes of Fermi polarons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文介绍了一个用于研究量子气体混合物中费米极化子的实验平台。体系由约千个玻色 ¹³³Cs 杂质和约 2×10⁵ 个处于单一超精细态、深度简并的 ⁶Li 费米气体组成，种间相互作用可通过 Feshbach 共振调节。作者使用无相对动量转移的光学 Raman 光谱进行注入谱测量并产生费米极化子，大质量不平衡使平台可探索此前未触及的 regime。
authors: Michael Rautenberg, Tobias Krom, Eleonora Lippi, Lauriane Chomaz, Matthias Weidemüller
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们介绍一个用于研究量子气体混合物中费米极化子的实验平台细节。该系统由约一千个玻色 ¹³³Cs 杂质组成，它们浸入一个深度简并的费米气体（T/T_F 约为 0.2）中，后者包含约 2×10⁵ 个处于单一超精细态的 ⁶Li 原子，且种间相互作用可通过 Feshbach 共振调节。使用没有相对动量转移的光学 Raman 光谱，我们进行注入谱测量，并由此产生费米极化子。由于两个物种之间存在很大的质量不平衡，该装置提供了进入此前未探索的费米极化子 regime 的途径。

articles.title: Nonparametric multiscale modeling of boundary lubrication: hexadecane in highly pressurized gold asperity contacts
articles.title_zh: 边界润滑的非参数多尺度建模：高压金粗糙峰接触中的十六烷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27352v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Boundary lubrication is governed by molecular processes at the sliding interface that are inaccessible to classical continuum descriptions. While molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can resolve these processes in atomistic detail, incorporating their output into engineering-scale models through semi-empirical constitutive laws becomes increasingly difficult as confinement approaches the molecular scale. Here, we apply a nonparametric multiscale framework based on Gaussian process (GP) regression to model boundary lubrication of hexadecane confined between gold surfaces under pressures up to 1 GPa and gap heights down to 1.4 nm. The GP surrogates are trained on nonequilibrium MD simulations of the confined fluid and directly provide stress predictions to a continuum thin-film solver, circumventing the need for fixed-form constitutive laws. The framework naturally captures molecular phenomena such as density layering, viscosity changes, and the strongly nonlinear wall slip that dominates the frictional response at high pressures and small gap heights. Our results reproduce the atomistic benchmark data of Codrignani et al., demonstrating that nonparametric surrogate models offer a flexible and physically transparent route toward predictive continuum modeling of boundary lubrication.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将基于高斯过程回归的非参数多尺度框架用于建模金表面之间受限十六烷的边界润滑。高斯过程替代模型由非平衡分子动力学数据训练，并直接向连续薄膜求解器提供应力预测，避免固定形式本构定律。该框架捕捉密度分层、黏度变化和强非线性壁面滑移等分子现象，并复现了既有原子级基准数据。
authors: Hannes Holey, Michael Moseler, Peter Gumbsch, Lars Pastewka
articles.abstract_zh_full: 边界润滑由滑动界面处的分子过程支配，而这些过程是经典连续介质描述无法触及的。虽然分子动力学（MD）模拟可以以原子级细节解析这些过程，但随着限域接近分子尺度，通过半经验本构定律将其输出纳入工程尺度模型变得越来越困难。本文中，我们应用一种基于高斯过程（GP）回归的非参数多尺度框架，对在最高 1 GPa 压力和低至 1.4 nm 间隙高度下受限于金表面之间的十六烷边界润滑进行建模。GP 替代模型在受限流体的非平衡 MD 模拟上训练，并直接向连续薄膜求解器提供应力预测，从而绕开了对固定形式本构定律的需求。该框架自然捕捉了密度分层、黏度变化以及强非线性壁面滑移等分子现象，其中壁面滑移在高压力和小间隙高度下主导摩擦响应。我们的结果复现了 Codrignani 等人的原子级基准数据，表明非参数替代模型为边界润滑的预测性连续介质建模提供了一条灵活且物理透明的路径。

articles.title: Scalable, Simple, and Versatile Encapsulation of 2D Materials and Devices
articles.title_zh: 二维材料与器件的可扩展、简便且通用的封装方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Air-sensitive 2D materials present a fundamental challenge for device integration. Encapsulation is often required to preserve intrinsic properties, yet conventional protection strategies often fail for thicker layers and complicate fabrication. Here, we demonstrate that electron-beam (e-beam) evaporated aluminum oxide (AlOₓ₎ serves as both an effective encapsulation layer and a platform for direct device fabrication. Unlike transfer-based approaches, this scalable method is compatible with thicker flakes and full device or wafer coverage. It requires no stacking procedures and enables contacts without post-encapsulation etching. Using rare-earth tritellurides (RTe₃, R = La, Er), semimetallic WTe₂, and superconducting FeTeₓSe₁₋ₓ, we show that AlOₓ suppresses oxidation and preserves intrinsic optical and electronic properties. We establish substrate-dependent optimization of encapsulation across a range of flake thicknesses, demonstrate that ultrathin AlOₓ preserves WTe₂'s plasmonic response and maintains superconducting performance in FeTeₓSe₁₋ₓ. Thus we overcome the longstanding tradeoff between encapsulation and straightforward device fabrication in fragile quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出电子束蒸发氧化铝可同时作为空气敏感二维材料的有效封装层和直接器件制备平台。与转移法不同，该方法兼容较厚薄片和整器件或晶圆覆盖，无需堆叠，也无需封装后刻蚀即可形成接触。作者在稀土三碲化物、WTe₂ 和 FeTeₓSe₁₋ₓ 中验证其抑制氧化并保持内禀光学、电子和超导性质的能力。
authors: Gabriel Natale, Uma Chirkova, Flávio Henriques Feres, Ran Jing, Michael Geiwitz, Wenyao Liu, Emma Low, Josh Leeman, Kyung-Mo Kim, Leslie M. Schoop, Mohamed Shehabeldin, Qiong Ma, Michael A. Susner, Pijush Bhattacharya, Genda Gu, Katherine Lee, James Hone, Mengkun Liu, Kenneth S. Burch
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空气敏感二维材料给器件集成带来了根本性挑战。封装通常是保持内禀性质所必需的，但传统保护策略常常对较厚层失效，并使制备复杂化。本文证明，电子束（e-beam）蒸发的氧化铝（AlOₓ）既可作为有效封装层，也可作为直接器件制备平台。不同于基于转移的方法，这种可扩展方法兼容较厚薄片以及整个器件或晶圆覆盖。它不需要堆叠步骤，并能够在无需封装后刻蚀的情况下形成接触。利用稀土三碲化物（RTe₃，R = La、Er）、半金属 WTe₂ 和超导 FeTeₓSe₁₋ₓ，我们显示 AlOₓ 抑制氧化并保持内禀光学和电子性质。我们建立了跨一系列薄片厚度的、依赖衬底的封装优化方案，证明超薄 AlOₓ 保持 WTe₂ 的等离激元响应，并维持 FeTeₓSe₁₋ₓ 的超导性能。因此，我们克服了脆弱量子材料中长期存在的封装与简便器件制备之间的权衡。

articles.title: Band's Geometry Origin of Quantum Spin Transport Phenomena
articles.title_zh: 量子自旋输运现象的能带几何起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27445v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a geometric description of spin-dependent transport based on the local geometric structure of electronic bands and the Fermi surfaces. For quasi-two-dimensional systems, we show that hyperbolic regions of constant-energy surfaces generate a geometrical contribution to the Fermi velocity that couples naturally to electron spin and produces a spin-current response. We further show that, in the presence of time-reversal symmetry, the algebra of spin operators can be related to the exterior algebra of the band's tangent space, providing an additional geometric interpretation of spin in momentum space. This framework motivates a symplectic description of spin-separated transport on Fermi surfaces and its extension to three-dimensional band manifolds through contact geometry. Our results establish a direct connection between Fermi-surface geometry and intrinsic spin transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文基于电子能带和费米面的局域几何结构，发展了自旋依赖输运的几何描述。对于准二维系统，作者指出常能面上的双曲区域会产生费米速度的几何贡献，该贡献自然耦合电子自旋并导致自旋流响应。在时间反演对称存在时，自旋算符代数还可与能带切空间的外代数相关联，从而建立费米面几何与内禀自旋输运之间的直接联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们基于电子能带和费米面的局域几何结构，发展了一种自旋依赖输运的几何描述。对于准二维系统，我们表明常能面上的双曲区域会产生对费米速度的几何贡献，该贡献自然地耦合到电子自旋并产生自旋流响应。我们进一步表明，在存在时间反演对称性的情况下，自旋算符的代数可与能带切空间的外代数相关联，从而为动量空间中的自旋提供额外的几何解释。该框架推动了对费米面上自旋分离输运的辛几何描述，并通过接触几何将其扩展到三维能带流形。我们的结果建立了费米面几何与内禀自旋输运之间的直接联系。

articles.title: Exact Stiffness and Dynamical Responses from Fock-Space Fragmentation
articles.title_zh: 由 Fock 空间碎裂得到的精确刚度与动力学响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exactly solvable quantum many-body models are rare, and even when their spectra are algebraically organized, dynamical responses generally remain difficult to obtain because they probe an extensive number of excited states. Here we show that quantum geometric nesting (QGN) models admit an unusually strong form of solvability rooted in emphFock-space fragmentation: excitations on top of the exact frustration-free ground states decouple into Krylov subspaces with a fixed number of particle and hole operators, and hence remain dynamically invariant. Exploiting this structure, we prove that the stiffness of the spontaneously broken continuous symmetry in QGN models is exactly equal to its variational value in the Gaussian manifold, confirming a conjecture from quantum many-body bootstrap~i̧teGaoHanKhalaf2026. The proof shows that an infinitesimal phase twist couples the ground state only to the one-particle, one-hole fragment, which coincides with the tangent space of the ground state within the variational manifold, thereby making the variational curvature exact. More generally, perturbations whose action remains within a fixed Fock-space fragment have response functions determined exactly by the corresponding few-body sector, enabling exact access to quantities including static susceptibility, optical conductivity, dynamical structure factors, and single-particle Green's functions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，量子几何嵌套模型具有源于 Fock 空间碎裂的强可解性。无挫基态上的激发解耦为具有固定粒子和空穴算符数的 Krylov 子空间，并保持动力学不变。作者利用这一结构证明自发破缺连续对称性的刚度精确等于 Gaussian 流形中的变分值，并指出多类响应函数可由相应少体扇区精确决定。
authors: Jonah Herzog-Arbeitman, Eslam Khalaf, Zhaoyu Han
articles.abstract_zh_full: 精确可解的量子多体模型十分罕见，即使其能谱在代数上有组织，动力学响应通常仍难以获得，因为它们探测数量随系统规模增长的大量激发态。本文表明，量子几何嵌套（QGN）模型具有一种异常强的可解性形式，其根源在于 Fock 空间碎裂：精确无挫基态之上的激发解耦为具有固定数量粒子和空穴算符的 Krylov 子空间，因此保持动力学不变。利用这一结构，我们证明 QGN 模型中自发破缺连续对称性的刚度精确等于其在 Gaussian 流形中的变分值，从而证实了来自量子多体 bootstrap 的一个猜想。该证明表明，无穷小相位扭转只将基态耦合到一个粒子、一个空穴的碎片，而该碎片与变分流形内基态的切空间重合，因此使变分曲率成为精确结果。更一般地，对于其作用保持在固定 Fock 空间碎片内的扰动，其响应函数可由相应少体扇区精确决定，从而能够精确获得包括静态磁化率、光学电导率、动力学结构因子和单粒子 Green 函数在内的量。

articles.title: Least Variable Quantum Counting Processes
articles.title_zh: 方差最小的量子计数过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26240v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Counting processes provide a fundamental description of stochastic events ranging from photon detection to clock ticks. A central question is how accurately such events can be timed when only finite memory resources are available. Here, we investigate this problem within a general framework of finite-dimensional classical and quantum counting processes. We derive a rigorous finite-memory variance bound obeyed by every classical d-state counting process, which is tight and saturated by a discrete Erlang-type ladder process. Through numerical optimization, we identify quantum counting processes that violate this classical bound, achieving smaller first-tick fluctuations than any classical process with the same memory size and mean tick time. For the qubit case, we further derive an analytical large-mean bound within a single-Kraus no-tick family, showing that the quantum advantage persists asymptotically within this class. The optimized quantum processes exhibit coherent conditioned dynamics and approach a continuous-time quantum-jump description as the mean increases. Our results establish a finite-memory quantum advantage in temporal precision and connect discrete-time counting processes with continuous-time quantum timekeeping.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究有限记忆资源下随机事件计时精度的极限，涵盖有限维经典与量子计数过程。作者推导了所有经典 d 态计数过程必须满足的严格有限记忆方差界，并指出该界可由离散 Erlang 型阶梯过程饱和。数值优化发现量子计数过程可违反该经典界，在相同记忆大小和平均 tick 时间下获得更小的首次 tick 涨落，并表明这种量子优势在特定量子情形中可渐近保持。
authors: Bita Olamaei, Florian Meier, Costantino Budroni, Pharnam Bakhshinezhad, Giuseppe Vitagliano
articles.abstract_zh_full: 计数过程为从光子探测到时钟 tick 等随机事件提供了基本描述。一个核心问题是，当只有有限记忆资源可用时，这类事件能够以多高精度被计时。本文在有限维经典和量子计数过程的一般框架内研究这一问题。我们推导出每一个经典 d 态计数过程都遵守的严格有限记忆方差界，该界是紧的，并由一种离散 Erlang 型阶梯过程饱和。通过数值优化，我们识别出违反这一经典界的量子计数过程，在相同记忆大小和平均 tick 时间下实现比任何经典过程都更小的首次 tick 涨落。对于量子比特情形，我们进一步在单 Kraus 无 tick 家族内推导出一个解析的大均值界，表明量子优势在该类中渐近地持续存在。优化后的量子过程表现出相干的条件动力学，并随着均值增大而接近连续时间量子跃迁描述。我们的结果确立了时间精度中的有限记忆量子优势，并将离散时间计数过程与连续时间量子计时联系起来。

articles.title: Why Cooper pairs live in AdS2: a spectral analysis of the Yukawa-SYK model
articles.title_zh: 为什么 Cooper 对存在于 AdS₂ 中：Yukawa-SYK 模型的谱分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26251v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish the spectral foundation of the geometric formulation of Cooper pairing in the Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. Starting from the large-N bilocal effective action, we derive the Gaussian fluctuation kernel in the even-frequency spin-singlet Cooper channel. Following the construction of Maldacena and Stanford, we determine the kernel eigenvalue kłeft(hi̊ght) analytically for arbitrary conformal weight h and resolve the pairing fluctuations into the continuous and discrete sectors of the associated de-Sitter space Laplacian. We show that the superconducting instability and the universal low-energy fluctuations near it reside entirely in the continuous scattering sector, while the discrete modes remain non-critical. Expanding the kernel about the lowest continuum mode yields a Klein--Gordon action on m̊ dS₂, restricted to the continuous spectral subspace. This is precisely the subspace on which the inverse Radon transform to m̊ AdS₂ is well defined. The projected bilocal Cooper-pair field can therefore be mapped onto a scalar matter field propagating in m̊ AdS₂, without requiring any further spectral restriction on the bulk theory. Our results provide the missing microscopic justification for the projection implicit in earlier holographic formulations and clarify how a local bulk field emerges from the bilocal pairing theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文为 Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型中 Cooper 配对几何表述建立谱基础。作者从大 N 双局域有效作用出发，解析得到偶频自旋单态 Cooper 通道中的 Gaussian 涨落核，并将配对涨落分解为相关 de Sitter 空间 Laplacian 的连续和离散扇区。结果显示超导不稳定性及其附近的普适低能涨落完全位于连续散射扇区，从而为将投影后的双局域 Cooper 对场映射为 AdS₂ 中传播的标量物质场提供微观依据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了 Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型中 Cooper 配对几何表述的谱基础。从大 N 双局域有效作用出发，我们推导了偶频自旋单态 Cooper 通道中的 Gaussian 涨落核。遵循 Maldacena 和 Stanford 的构造，我们解析确定了任意共形权重 h 的核本征值 k(h)，并将配对涨落分解为相关 de Sitter 空间 Laplacian 的连续扇区和离散扇区。我们表明，超导不稳定性及其附近的普适低能涨落完全存在于连续散射扇区中，而离散模式保持非临界。围绕最低连续谱模式展开核，会得到限制在连续谱子空间上的 dS₂ 中 Klein-Gordon 作用。这正是到 AdS₂ 的逆 Radon 变换良好定义的子空间。因此，投影后的双局域 Cooper 对场可被映射为在 AdS₂ 中传播的标量物质场，而无需对体理论施加任何进一步的谱限制。我们的结果为早期全息表述中隐含的投影提供了缺失的微观依据，并阐明了局域体场如何从双局域配对理论中涌现。

articles.title: Quantum cellular automata and invertible phases of matter
articles.title_zh: 量子元胞自动机与物质的可逆相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26456v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce and study (fermionic and bosonic) invertible quasi-local algebras over uniformly locally finite metric spaces X with infinite-dimensional local von Neumann algebras. We show that the group of Brauer equivalence classes of such algebras is isomorphic to both the group of phases of invertible states and the group of stable equivalence classes of quantum cellular automata over X× Z. Using K-theory of the symmetric monoidal category of invertible quasi-local algebras and bounded spread isomorphisms, we propose a definition of an Ømega-spectrum of invertible phases as conjectured by Kitaev. We then show that the c=frac12 chiral Majorana fermion net and the (E₈)₁ conformal net provide Brauer non-trivial invertible quasi-local algebras, thus providing explicit constructions of non-trivial invertible states and quantum cellular automata on Z². In addition, we show that the time-slice nets of rational diagonal conformal field theories admit lattice degrees of freedom, which implies the discretization of any holomorphic conformal net is invertible.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在具有无限维局部 von Neumann 代数的均匀局部有限度量空间 X 上，引入并研究玻色和费米可逆准局域代数。作者证明，这类代数的 Brauer 等价类群同时同构于可逆态的物质相群，以及空间 X×Z 上量子元胞自动机的稳定等价类群，并据此提出由 K 理论构造的可逆相 Ω 谱定义。研究还给出了手性 Majorana 费米子网和（E₈）₁ 共形网所对应的非平凡例子，并证明有理对角共形场论的时间切片网具有晶格自由度。
authors: Corey Jones, Nikita Sopenko, Ryan Thorngren
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在具有无限维局部 von Neumann 代数的均匀局部有限度量空间 X 上，引入并研究玻色型和费米型可逆准局域代数。我们证明，这类代数的 Brauer 等价类群同构于可逆态的物质相群，也同构于空间 X×Z 上量子元胞自动机的稳定等价类群。利用可逆准局域代数的对称幺半群范畴以及有界扩展同构的 K 理论，我们提出了 Kitaev 所猜想的可逆相 Ω 谱的定义。随后我们证明，c=1/2 的手性 Majorana 费米子网和（E₈）₁ 共形网提供了 Brauer 非平凡的可逆准局域代数，从而在 Z² 上给出了非平凡可逆态和量子元胞自动机的显式构造。此外，我们证明有理对角共形场论的时间切片网具有晶格自由度，这意味着任意全纯共形网都可以被离散化为可逆系统。

articles.title: Measuring the Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂ Landé g-factor Using Singlet-Triplet Oscillations in a Circular Rydberg State of Strontium
articles.title_zh: 利用锶圆形里德伯态中的单重态-三重态振荡测量 Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂ 态的朗德 g 因子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26784v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Circular states of strontium are promising platforms for quantum technologies. They exhibit much longer lifetimes than laser-accessible Rydberg states and possess an optically active ionic core that can be manipulated with laser light. Here we trap circular states in optical tweezers by exploiting the dynamical polarizability of the ionic core. We measure the decay of the orbital component of a n=51 circular state and observe singlet-triplet spin oscillations arising from the interplay of vector light shifts induced by the optical tweezers, spin-orbit coupling associated with the Rydberg electron, and the difference in Landé g-factor between the ionic core and the Rydberg electrons. By observing the two electron spin dynamics, we measure the spin-orbit interaction and the correction δ g sim 10⁽⁻⁵⁾ of the Landé g-factor of the Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂ ionic core electron with respect to that of a free electron. This provides a first high-precision measurement of g_Sr⁺, 5s₁/₂ = 2.002290(1).
articles.abstract_zh: 锶原子的圆形态因寿命远长于激光可直接访问的里德伯态，并具有可用激光操控的光学活性离子实，而成为量子技术的有前景平台。本文利用离子实的动态极化率，将圆形态俘获于光学镊中，并观测到 n=51 圆形态轨道分量的衰减以及由光学镊诱导的矢量光移、电子自旋轨道耦合和离子实与里德伯电子朗德 g 因子差异共同产生的单重态-三重态自旋振荡。通过测量双电子自旋动力学，研究测得 Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂ 离子实电子相对于自由电子朗德 g 因子的修正量约为 10⁻⁵，并得到 g=2.002290(1)。
authors: Baptiste Muraz, Mathis Pepin, Corentin Guimard, Michel Brune, Brice Bakkali-Hassani, Sébastien Gleyzes
articles.abstract_zh_full: 锶原子的圆形态是量子技术中很有前景的平台。与激光可直接访问的里德伯态相比，它们具有长得多的寿命，并拥有能够用激光操控的光学活性离子实。在本文中，我们利用离子实的动态极化率，将圆形态俘获在光学镊中。我们测量了 n=51 圆形态轨道分量的衰减，并观测到单重态-三重态自旋振荡；这种振荡源于光学镊诱导的矢量光移、里德伯电子的自旋轨道耦合，以及离子实与里德伯电子之间朗德 g 因子的差异。通过观测两个电子的自旋动力学，我们测量了自旋轨道相互作用，以及 Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂ 离子实电子的朗德 g 因子相对于自由电子朗德 g 因子的修正量 δg≈10⁻⁵。我们获得了 gSᵣ⁺,₅ₛ₁/₂=2.002290(1) 的首次高精度测量结果。

articles.title: Geometric optimality of entanglement-induced fast qubit reset
articles.title_zh: 纠缠诱导快速量子比特复位的几何最优性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26897v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fast and reliable qubit reset is essential for the efficient operation of quantum processors. Among the proposed strategies, Mpemba-effect-based protocols offer a simple route to accelerated relaxation, but provide limited insight into the optimality of the full reset dynamics. Geometric approaches, by contrast, quantify optimality but do not generally suggest practical acceleration protocols. Here, we bridge these perspectives through a geometric analysis of entanglement-assisted qubit reset. We show that entangling operations can redistribute local coherences across a multi-qubit register, allowing the reduced state of each qubit to follow a geodesic path towards the ground state. Remarkably, this locally optimal behaviour can emerge even when the collective evolution becomes suboptimal in the full state space. We illustrate this interplay for different families of initial multi-qubit states. Our results provide a geometric perspective on Mpemba-inspired reset acceleration and clarify when extending two-qubit protocols to larger registers provides a further advantage in the reset process.
articles.abstract_zh: 快速且可靠的量子比特复位是高效运行量子处理器的基础。本文通过几何分析研究纠缠辅助的量子比特复位，表明纠缠操作能够在多量子比特寄存器中重新分配局部相干性，使每个量子比特的约化态沿通向基态的测地线路径演化。研究揭示，即使整体演化在完整状态空间中并非最优，局部最优行为仍可能出现，并进一步阐明了将双量子比特协议扩展到更大寄存器时何时能够获得额外复位优势。
authors: Davide Rinaldi, Mattia Moroder, Dario Gerace, Giacomo Guarnieri, Steve Campbell
articles.abstract_zh_full: 快速而可靠的量子比特复位对于量子处理器的高效运行至关重要。在所提出的策略中，基于 Mpemba 效应的协议为加速弛豫提供了一条简单途径，但对于完整复位动力学的最优性所能提供的认识有限。相比之下，几何方法能够量化最优性，却通常不能提出实用的加速协议。在此，我们通过对纠缠辅助量子比特复位进行几何分析，连接了这两种视角。我们表明，纠缠操作可以在多量子比特寄存器中重新分配局部相干性，使每个量子比特的约化态沿着通向基态的测地线路径演化。值得注意的是，即使整体演化在完整状态空间中变得并非最优，这种局部最优行为仍然可能出现。我们针对不同类别的初始多量子比特态说明了这种相互作用。我们的结果为受 Mpemba 效应启发的复位加速提供了几何视角，并阐明了将双量子比特协议扩展到更大寄存器时，何时能够在复位过程中带来进一步优势。

articles.title: Packora: Systematic Design for Generative Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction
articles.title_zh: Packora：生成式分子晶体结构预测的系统化设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26962v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Molecular crystal structure prediction (CSP) is important in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and organic electronics, where subtle differences in molecular conformation and packing can strongly affect material properties. We present Packora, a flow-based generative model for molecular CSP that jointly predicts atomic coordinates and the lattice from molecular graphs. Packora supports multi-component and organometallic crystals and can condition on any subset of molecular conformers, stereochemical labels, and space-group information within a single model. Inspired by the CCDC CSP blind test, we evaluate generation and ranking separately, using generation to isolate generator quality and ranking to measure end-to-end performance under a common relaxation and ranking pipeline. We also systematically study architecture, training, conditioning, inference, and scaling, identifying an effective design based on cacheable pairwise reasoning, training objective and numerical solver choices, conditioning dropout, and balanced scaling of pairwise and single representations. Packora outperforms the baselines on both structure generation and ranking benchmarks, achieving the best matched-budget coverage across all six generation benchmarks, as well as higher experimental-form recovery, lower experimental-form ranks, and faster convergence in ranking.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Packora，一种基于流的生成模型，可根据分子图联合预测分子晶体的原子坐标和晶格，并支持多组分及有机金属晶体。模型能够在统一框架下结合任意子集的分子构象、立体化学标签和空间群信息。受 CCDC 晶体结构预测盲测启发，作者分别评估结构生成和排序性能，并系统研究模型架构、训练目标、条件输入、推理及规模扩展；Packora 在生成和排序基准上均优于基线模型。
authors: Nayoung Kim, Kiyoung Seong, Sungsoo Ahn
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子晶体结构预测（CSP）在制药、农用化学品和有机电子学领域具有重要意义，因为分子构象和堆积方式的细微差异会显著影响材料性质。我们提出 Packora，这是一种基于流的分子晶体结构预测生成模型，可根据分子图联合预测原子坐标和晶格。Packora 支持多组分晶体和有机金属晶体，并且能够在单一模型中根据分子构象、立体化学标签和空间群信息的任意子集进行条件生成。受 CCDC 晶体结构预测盲测的启发，我们将生成与排序分开评估：利用生成评估生成器质量，利用排序在统一的弛豫和排序流程下衡量端到端性能。我们还系统研究了模型架构、训练、条件输入、推理和规模扩展，并确定了一种有效设计，包括可缓存的成对推理、训练目标与数值求解器的选择、条件丢弃，以及成对表示和单体表示的均衡扩展。Packora 在结构生成和排序基准上均优于基线模型：在全部六个生成基准上实现了匹配计算预算下的最佳覆盖率，同时获得了更高的实验晶型恢复率、更低的实验晶型排名，并在排序中实现了更快的收敛。

articles.title: Fast On-Chip Thermometry with TiN Kinetic Inductance Resonators in 22 nm Process Technology
articles.title_zh: 采用 22 nm 工艺技术的 TiN 动能电感谐振器实现快速片上测温
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27057v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding the temporal and spatial dependence of temperature is critical in high-performance cryogenic devices. Typical thermometry techniques struggle to simultaneously combine high bandwidth, sensitivity and on-chip integration, limiting their ability to measure fast intra-device thermal fluctuations. Here, we demonstrate a time-resolved thermometry platform based on TiN kinetic inductance resonators integrated in a 22 nm FDSOI chip. By tracking temperature-dependent shifts in the resonant frequency, we achieve sub-millikelvin temperature sensitivity down to temperatures of 100 mK. Time-resolved on-chip pulsed heating experiments as a function of distance reveal an onset delay, consistent with a quasi-ballistic heat propagation velocity of 3.9 ± 0.1 mm μs{}⁻¹. We also show that elevated temperatures increase net thermal conductance, shortening thermal relaxation times across all spatial separations. This behaviour manifests in two distinct regimes: a substrate-limited regime at 100 mK, where cooling rates vary with heater distance, and a Kapitza boundary-limited regime at 400 mK, where thermal relaxation becomes more spatially uniform.These measurements demonstrate kinetic inductance thermometry's ability to rapidly probe non-equilibrium temperature dynamics in cryogenic devices such as quantum processors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种基于 TiN 动能电感谐振器的时间分辨片上测温平台，该谐振器集成于 22 nm FDSOI 芯片中。通过跟踪与温度相关的谐振频率偏移，系统在低至 100 mK 的温度下实现了亚毫开尔文灵敏度，并测得热脉冲传播的准弹道速度为 3.9±0.1 mm/μs。研究还发现，升高温度会增加净热导并缩短热弛豫时间，在 100 mK 时表现为衬底限制机制，在 400 mK 时转为 Kapitza 界面限制机制。
authors: Johann Drayne, George Ridgard, Lorenzo Peri, Frederic Schlattner, Fabio Olivieri, Mathieu de Kruijf, Isaac Harris, Grayson Noah, James Kirkman, Alberto Gomez-Saiz, M. Fernando Gonzalez-Zalba, Thomas Swift
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解温度的时间和空间依赖性对于高性能低温器件至关重要。典型的测温技术难以同时兼具高带宽、高灵敏度和片上集成能力，从而限制了其测量器件内部快速热波动的能力。在此，我们展示了一种基于 TiN 动能电感谐振器的时间分辨测温平台，该谐振器集成在采用 22 nm FDSOI 工艺的芯片中。通过跟踪与温度相关的谐振频率偏移，我们在低至 100 mK 的温度下实现了亚毫开尔文温度灵敏度。作为距离函数进行的时间分辨片上脉冲加热实验显示存在起始延迟，这与 3.9±0.1 mm μs⁻¹ 的准弹道热传播速度一致。我们还表明，升高的温度会增加净热导，并缩短所有空间间隔下的热弛豫时间。这种行为体现为两个不同的区域：在 100 mK 时为衬底限制区域，此时冷却速率随加热器距离变化；在 400 mK 时为 Kapitza 界面限制区域，此时热弛豫在空间上变得更加均匀。这些测量结果证明，动能电感测温能够快速探测低温器件（例如量子处理器）中的非平衡温度动力学。

articles.title: Programmable Cavity Squeezing for Distributed Sensing in a Tweezer Array
articles.title_zh: 用于分布式传感的可编程腔压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27132v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Field sensing with state-of-the-art atom interferometers is restricted to the use of uncorrelated devices op- erating in parallel. We can overcome this limitation by using distributed sensing protocols where quantum correlations among spatially-separated devices are engineered in the spatial mode carrying the signal. We show that a tweezer array in a cavity offers an ideal testbed to engineer quantum states for distributed sensing, with the possibility to generate entanglement both within and between the clouds. The competition between local and intercloud cavity-mediated exchange allows the sign and spatial pattern of the intercloud couplings to select the squeezed mode. For two ensembles, positive coupling produces uniform collective squeezing, whereas negative coupling generates strong staggered, nonlocal squeezing. A semiclassical analysis reveals a counter-twisting- like phase-space flow, qualitatively distinct from standard one-axis twisting. The analysis and results can be further generalized to a larger number of ensembles. We apply the scheme to differential Ramsey interferometry with common phase noise spanning the full 2 π range, the resulting staggered states reduce the phase uncertainty below the standard quantum limit, with an ellipse estimator approaching the Cramèr-Rao bound. These results establish programmable cavity interactions as a scalable route to entanglement tailored to distributed signals.
articles.abstract_zh: 当前先进原子干涉仪的场传感通常局限于彼此独立并行运行的非关联装置。本文提出利用腔中的光镊阵列，通过腔介导的局部和云间交换工程化空间模式中的量子关联，从而实现分布式传感。研究表明，正的云间耦合产生均匀集体压缩，负的耦合产生强烈的交错型非局域压缩；在具有覆盖完整 2π 范围公共相位噪声的差分 Ramsey 干涉中，交错态可将相位不确定度压低至标准量子极限以下，并使椭圆估计器接近 Cramér-Rao 界。
authors: Youssef Trifa, Marco Fattori, Luca Pezzè
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用当前最先进的原子干涉仪进行场传感，受到只能使用彼此不相关、并行运行的装置这一限制。我们可以利用分布式传感协议克服这一限制，在承载信号的空间模式中构造空间分离装置之间的量子关联。我们表明，腔中的光镊阵列为构造分布式传感所需的量子态提供了理想的实验平台，并有可能在云团内部以及云团之间产生纠缠。局部腔介导交换与云间腔介导交换之间的竞争，使云间耦合的符号和空间模式能够选择被压缩的模式。对于两个系综，正耦合会产生均匀的集体压缩，而负耦合会产生强烈的交错型非局域压缩。半经典分析揭示了一种类似反扭转的相空间流，其性质与标准单轴扭转明显不同。该分析和结果还可以推广到数量更多的系综。我们将这一方案应用于具有覆盖完整 2π 范围公共相位噪声的差分 Ramsey 干涉测量。所得交错态能够将相位不确定度降低到标准量子极限以下，并使椭圆估计器接近 Cramér-Rao 界。这些结果表明，可编程的腔相互作用是实现针对分布式信号定制纠缠的一条可扩展途径。

articles.title: Stochastic transport of a Goldstone mode in a self-organized atomic crystal
articles.title_zh: 自组织原子晶体中戈德斯通模的随机输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27387v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spontaneous breaking of a continuous symmetry produces a massless Goldstone mode that can evolve across a degenerate manifold at zero energy cost. Goldstone modes have been identified primarily through excitation spectra, mode softening or collective oscillations. However, their time-domain transport under intrinsic fluctuations and dissipation has remained largely unexplored. Here we directly track the stochastic transport of a Goldstone mode in a self-organized atomic crystal inside an optical ring cavity. The ring cavity maps the order-parameter phase onto the real-space position of the emergent crystal. Without any external perturbation, fundamental photon-scattering recoil drives the collective transport, while cavity dissipation generates friction. We monitor individual trajectories of the atoms and their self-generated optical lattice by measuring the cavity output phase. We find that the diffusion constant decreases as 1/N, indicating that all atoms move collectively as a rigid object rather than independently. By tuning the Langevin driving force and cavity-mediated damping, we show that the normalized diffusion constant collapses onto a single universal curve. This work extends the study of continuous symmetry breaking from excitation-frequency measurements to real-time tracking of transport, and opens routes for studying non-equilibrium collective transport, phonon dynamics, and defect formation in driven-dissipative quantum matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 连续对称性的自发破缺会产生无质量的戈德斯通模，但其在内禀涨落和耗散下的时间域输运此前研究较少。本文在光学环形腔中的自组织原子晶体内，直接追踪戈德斯通模的随机输运，发现光子散射反冲驱动集体运动，而腔耗散产生摩擦。扩散常数按1/N下降，表明原子作为刚性整体协同运动；调节朗之万驱动力和腔介导阻尼后，归一化扩散常数呈现单一普适曲线。
authors: Zhanhai Yu, Di Xiang, Xiaotian Zhang, Hao Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 连续对称性的自发破缺会产生一种无质量的戈德斯通模，它能够在简并流形上演化，而无需付出能量代价。戈德斯通模主要是通过激发谱、模软化或集体振荡来识别的。然而，在内禀涨落和耗散作用下，它们在时间域中的输运仍基本未被探索。在此，我们直接追踪了光学环形腔内自组织原子晶体中戈德斯通模的随机输运。环形腔将序参量的相位映射到新生晶体的实空间位置上。在没有任何外部扰动的情况下，基本的光子散射反冲驱动集体输运，而腔耗散产生摩擦。通过测量腔输出相位，我们监测了原子及其自生成光学晶格的单个轨迹。我们发现，扩散常数随1/N下降，这表明所有原子作为一个刚性整体协同运动，而不是彼此独立地运动。通过调节朗之万驱动力和腔介导阻尼，我们表明归一化扩散常数可以塌缩到一条单一的普适曲线上。这项工作将连续对称性破缺的研究从激发频率测量拓展到输运的实时追踪，并为研究驱动—耗散量子物质中的非平衡集体输运、声子动力学和缺陷形成开辟了途径。

articles.title: Detuning- and Stark-robust Rydberg gates
articles.title_zh: 对失谐和斯塔克效应鲁棒的里德堡门
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27426v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Rydberg entangling gates driven by a two-photon transition in alkali atoms suffer from an adverse scaling of light-shift-induced errors. Robustness to such detuning errors is known to be impossible to achieve in the design of conventional Rydberg gate protocols, where only one of the qubit states is coupled to the Rydberg state. Here, we show that in a more general framework, in which both qubit states take part in the gate, full or partial robustness to these errors can be realized. We present two gate constructions, which either cancel the errors outright or convert them into single-qubit errors that can be corrected locally. We map the regimes -- in terms of light-shift strength, intensity inhomogeneity, and Rydberg decay rate -- in which these protocols outperform the widely used time-optimal Rydberg gate, and find that they already include the conditions of state-of-the-art experiments. Finally, we show the existence of a Rydberg `fly-by' entangling gate, an important primitive for an emerging class of neutral-atom quantum computing architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论碱金属原子中由双光子跃迁驱动的里德堡纠缠门，其误差会因光移诱导的失谐而不利放大。作者提出让两个量子比特态都参与门操作的更一般框架，从而实现对这些误差的完全或部分鲁棒性。文中给出两种门构造，并指出在当前先进实验条件下它们已可优于常用的时间最优里德堡门，还展示了里德堡“飞越”纠缠门的存在。
authors: Elie Bataille, Gyohei Nomura, Manuel Endres
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在碱金属原子中，由双光子跃迁驱动的里德堡纠缠门会受到光移诱导误差的不利标度影响。已知在传统里德堡门协议的设计中，若只有一个量子比特态与里德堡态耦合，就不可能实现对这类失谐误差的鲁棒性。在这里，我们表明，在一个更一般的框架中，即两个量子比特态都参与门操作时，可以实现对这些误差的完全或部分鲁棒性。我们提出两种门构造，它们要么直接抵消误差，要么将误差转化为可在局域上校正的单量子比特误差。我们在光移强度、强度不均匀性和里德堡衰减率等参数下，绘制了这些协议优于广泛使用的时间最优里德堡门的工作区域，并发现这些区域已经包含当前最先进实验的条件。最后，我们展示了一种里德堡“飞越”纠缠门的存在，这是新兴中性原子量子计算架构中一类重要的基本操作。

articles.title: Fast optical data transfer into a Josephson junction array
articles.title_zh: 向约瑟夫森结阵列进行快速光学数据传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.05074v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We employ externally shunted Nb-AlOₓ₋Nb Josephson junctions for demonstrating a circuit that is suitable for an optically driven Josephson Arbitrary Waveform Synthesizer (JAWS). This technology enables overdamped junctions with characteristic frequencies above 100 GHz and critical currents of the order of 100 μA, which is promising, e.g., for low-dissipation optical control of quantum circuits such as superconducting quantum bits. Here we utilize a double-pulse technique to experimentally determine the maximum rate at which optical pulse data can be reliably delivered to the superconducting circuit. We demonstrate the feasibility of data transfer up to 60 Gbit/s, which is about factor 4 higher than for typical JAWS.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作使用外部分流的 Nb-AlOx-Nb 约瑟夫森结，展示一种适用于光驱动约瑟夫森任意波形合成器的电路。该技术可实现特征频率超过 100 GHz、临界电流约 100 μA 的过阻尼结，有望用于低耗散光学控制超导量子电路。作者用双脉冲技术测定光脉冲数据可靠送入超导电路的最高速率，并展示了最高 60 Gbit/s 的数据传输可行性。
authors: K. Kohopää, J. Nissilä, E. Mykkänen, P. Selvasundaram, T. Fordell, K. Langi, E. T. Mannila, S. Kafanov, S. Ahopelto, H. Systä, M. Ribeiro, P. Sethi, M. Kiviranta, R. Loreto, J. -W. Lee, T. Rantanen, V. Vesterinen, O. Kieler, M. Bieler, J. Govenius, J. Senior, A. Kemppinen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用外部分流的 Nb-AlOx-Nb 约瑟夫森结，展示一种适用于光驱动约瑟夫森任意波形合成器（JAWS）的电路。该技术能够实现特征频率高于 100 GHz、临界电流约为 100 μA 的过阻尼结，这一点很有前景，例如可用于对超导量子比特等量子电路进行低耗散光学控制。在这里，我们利用双脉冲技术，通过实验确定光脉冲数据能够可靠传送到超导电路中的最高速率。我们展示了最高 60 Gbit/s 数据传输的可行性，这大约比典型 JAWS 高 4 倍。

articles.title: Photoinduced Metal-to-Insulator Transitions in 2D Moiré Devices
articles.title_zh: 二维莫尔器件中的光诱导金属到绝缘体转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.21005v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Photoexcitation has been utilized to control quantum matter and to uncover metastable phases far from equilibrium. Among demonstrations to date, the most common is the photo-induced transition from correlated insulators to metallic states; however, the reverse process without initial orders has not been observed. Here, we show ultrafast metal-to-insulator transition in gate-doped WS2/WSe2 and WSe2/WSe2 moiré devices using photo-thermionic hole injection from graphite gates. The resulting correlated insulators are metastable, with lifetimes exceeding microseconds. These findings establish an effective mechanism for the ultrafast control of correlated electronic phases in van der Waals heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用光激发控制量子物质，并关注此前少见的无初始有序条件下由金属态转变为绝缘态的反向过程。作者在栅极掺杂的 WS2/WSe2 和 WSe2/WSe2 莫尔器件中，通过石墨栅的光热电子空穴注入实现超快金属到绝缘体转变。形成的关联绝缘体为亚稳态，寿命超过微秒，为范德华异质结构中关联电子相的超快控制提供了机制。
authors: Yiliu Li, Esteban Rojas-Gatjens, Yinjie Guo, Birui Yang, Dihao Sun, Luke Holtzman, Juseung Oh, Katayun Barmak, Cory R. Dean, James C. Hone, Nathaniel Gabor, Eric A. Arsenault, Xiaoyang Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光激发已被用于控制量子物质，并揭示远离平衡态的亚稳相。在迄今为止的演示中，最常见的是光诱导的从关联绝缘体到金属态的转变；然而，在没有初始有序的情况下，其反向过程尚未被观察到。在这里，我们利用来自石墨栅的光热电子空穴注入，在栅极掺杂的 WS2/WSe2 和 WSe2/WSe2 莫尔器件中展示了超快金属到绝缘体转变。由此产生的关联绝缘体是亚稳的，其寿命超过微秒。这些发现建立了一种在范德华异质结构中对关联电子相进行超快控制的有效机制。

articles.title: Ultrafast Charge-Doping via Photo-Thermionic Injection in van der Waals Devices
articles.title_zh: 范德华器件中通过光热电子注入实现的超快电荷掺杂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.21008v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures of two-dimensional (2D) materials have become a rich playground for the exploration of correlated quantum phases, and recent studies have begun to probe their non-equilibrium dynamics under femtosecond laser excitation. In a time-resolved experiment, optical excitation of the multilayer structure can lead not only to rich dynamic responses from the target layers, such as moiré interfaces, but also to additional device functionality from the layer degree of freedom. Here, we investigate optical excitation in a prototypical moiré device of dual-gated twisted WSe2 bilayers, with few-layer graphite gates and hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) spacers. We establish an ultrafast photodoping mechanism in the moiré bilayer from photo-thermionic emission of the graphite gates. Using transient reflectance experiments, we reveal photo-induced hole injection evidenced by: (i) a shift of gate voltages at which optical signatures of correlated insulators are observed, (ii) a persistent optical signature indicative of charge diffusion at microsecond timescales and local charge buildup from pulse-to-pulse accumulation, and (iii) photoinduced absorption due likely to transient formation of correlated insulators. We further demonstrate that the injected holes can be selectively controlled by tuning the excitation energy, fluence, and gate bias.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察二维范德华异质结构在飞秒激光激发下的非平衡动力学，重点是双栅扭转 WSe2 双层莫尔器件中的光掺杂机制。作者证明石墨栅的光热电子发射可在莫尔双层中引发超快空穴注入，并通过瞬态反射实验证实其门电压偏移、微秒尺度持久光学信号和光诱导吸收等特征。研究还表明，注入空穴可通过激发能量、通量和栅压选择性控制。
authors: Yiliu Li, Esteban Rojas-Gatjens, Yinjie Guo, Birui Yang, Dihao Sun, Luke Holtzman, Juseung Oh, Katayun Barmak, Cory R. Dean, James C. Hone, Nathaniel Gabor, Eric A. Arsenault, Xiaoyang Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由二维（2D）材料构成的范德华（vdW）异质结构已成为探索关联量子相的丰富平台，近期研究也开始探测其在飞秒激光激发下的非平衡动力学。在时间分辨实验中，多层结构的光学激发不仅会导致目标层，如莫尔界面，产生丰富的动态响应，还会通过层这一自由度带来额外的器件功能。在这里，我们研究了一种典型莫尔器件中的光学激发，该器件为双栅控扭转 WSe2 双层，具有少层石墨栅和六方氮化硼（hBN）间隔层。我们确立了一种来自石墨栅光热电子发射的莫尔双层超快光掺杂机制。通过瞬态反射实验，我们揭示了光诱导空穴注入，其证据包括：（i）观察到关联绝缘体光学特征时的栅电压发生偏移；（ii）一种持久光学信号，表明微秒时间尺度上的电荷扩散以及由脉冲间积累导致的局域电荷堆积；以及（iii）很可能源于关联绝缘体瞬态形成的光诱导吸收。我们进一步证明，可以通过调节激发能量、通量和栅极偏压来选择性控制注入空穴。

articles.title: Plasmon excitations in half-filled graphene: A Comparative study between Quantum Monte Carlo and Random Phase Approximation
articles.title_zh: 半填充石墨烯中的等离激元激发：量子蒙特卡罗与随机相位近似的比较研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20559v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Transport properties of strongly correlated materials have contributions from quasiparticle excitations such as electrons and holes as well as emerging collective excitations such as plasmonic sound-like modes which are sustained by interactions. As was shown in Phys. Rev. B 106, 205127, the thermal excitation of the long-lived plasmons in graphene provides a substantial contribution to heat and momentum transport in the interaction-dominated regime. Detailed information on these excitations is therefore necessary for the quantitative understanding of hydrodynamic transport. On the other hand, dynamics of graphene plasmons is usually studied using Dirac perturbation theory, thus neglecting the effects of a finite Brillouin zone and higher-order perturbative corrections. Both these effects can be however significant for strong-interacting systems including free-standing graphene with the effective coupling constant of the order of alpha=2. In this paper, we studied the behavior of plasmons in half-filled free standing graphene using unbiased Quantum Monte Carlo calculations. We confirm the existence of well-defined resonance peaks for plasmons around the Gamma-point. Comparison with the Random-phase-approximation (RPA) calculation for the honeycomb lattice shows that RPA yields more stable plasmon modes, while QMC shows enhanced broadening due to non perturbative interaction effects. To account for this effect, we generalize the lattice RPA calculations by dressing the fermionic propagator by a constant lifetime. As a result, the plasmon frequencies are shifted towards higher energies and the spectrum is broadened, yielding a better agreement with QMC. Our findings highlight the need to account for both a finite Brillouin zone and strong interaction effects when developing theories of electronic transport in free-standing graphene.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究比较无支撑半填充石墨烯中等离激元的量子蒙特卡罗计算与蜂窝晶格随机相位近似结果。作者确认 Γ 点附近存在清晰的等离激元共振峰，但发现 RPA 给出更稳定的模式，而 QMC 显示非微扰相互作用导致的更强展宽。通过在晶格 RPA 中引入有限寿命修正，谱线与 QMC 更吻合，说明有限布里渊区和强相互作用效应都不可忽略。
authors: Adrien Reingruber, Maksim Ulybyshev, Kitinan Pongsangangan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强关联材料的输运性质既包含来自电子和空穴等准粒子激发的贡献，也包含来自由相互作用维持的集体激发的贡献，例如等离激元类声模式。正如 Phys. Rev. B 106, 205127 所示，石墨烯中长寿命等离激元的热激发在相互作用主导区域对热输运和动量输运有显著贡献。因此，关于这些激发的详细信息对于定量理解流体动力学输运是必要的。另一方面，石墨烯等离激元的动力学通常使用狄拉克微扰理论研究，从而忽略了有限布里渊区以及高阶微扰修正的影响。然而，对于强相互作用体系，包括有效耦合常数约为 alpha=2 的无支撑石墨烯，这两种效应都可能很显著。在本文中，我们使用无偏量子蒙特卡罗计算研究了半填充无支撑石墨烯中的等离激元行为。我们确认，在 Gamma 点附近存在定义良好的等离激元共振峰。与蜂窝晶格的随机相位近似（RPA）计算相比，RPA 给出了更稳定的等离激元模式，而 QMC 则显示出由非微扰相互作用效应导致的增强展宽。为解释这一效应，我们通过给费米子传播子引入一个常数寿命，对晶格 RPA 计算进行了推广。结果，等离激元频率向更高能量移动，谱线也被展宽，从而与 QMC 更好地一致。我们的发现强调，在发展无支撑石墨烯电子输运理论时，需要同时考虑有限布里渊区和强相互作用效应。

articles.title: Exponential U(1) Symmetry-Breaking Phase as a Disorder-Free Quantum Glass
articles.title_zh: 作为无无序量子玻璃的指数 U(1) 对称性破缺相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.21847v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the phase diagram of a one-dimensional spin quantum breakdown model, which has an exponential U(1) symmetry with charge unit decaying as 2⁻j with site position j. By exact diagonalization and density matrix renormalization group, we show that the model with spin Sge2 exhibits an exponential U(1) spontaneous symmetry-breaking (SSB) phase dubbed a quantum breakdown condensate. It exhibits a bulk gap violating the Goldstone theorem, and an edge mode only on the left edge if in open boundary condition. In a length L lattice, the condensate has O(2^L) number of SSB ground states originating from the O(2^L) number of exponential U(1) charge sectors, leading to a finite entropy density łn 2. This enforces a first-order SSB phase transition into this phase, as observed numerically and verified in the large S limit on an exactly solvable Rokhsar-Kivelson line. The condensate has an SSB order parameter being the local in-plane spin, which points in angles related by the chaotic Bernoulli (dyadic) map and thus is effectively random. Moreover, we show the condensate exhibits nondecaying local autocorrelations, and does not have an off-diagonal long-range order. The quantum breakdown condensate thus behaves as a disorder-free quantum glass and is beyond the existing classifications of phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析一种一维自旋量子击穿模型的相图，该模型具有电荷单位随格点位置指数衰减的 U(1) 对称性。通过精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群，作者发现自旋 Sge2 时存在指数 U(1) 自发对称性破缺相，即量子击穿凝聚体。该凝聚体具有大量基态、有限熵密度、有效随机的局域面内自旋序参量以及不衰减局域自关联，表现为无无序量子玻璃并超出现有物相分类。
authors: Yu-Min Hu, Zhaoyu Han, Biao Lian
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一维自旋量子击穿模型的相图，该模型具有一种指数 U(1) 对称性，其电荷单位随格点位置 j 按 2⁻j 衰减。通过精确对角化和密度矩阵重整化群，我们表明自旋 Sge2 的模型表现出一种指数 U(1) 自发对称性破缺（SSB）相，称为量子击穿凝聚体。它表现出违反戈德斯通定理的体能隙，并且在开边界条件下只在左边界具有边缘模。在长度为 L 的晶格中，该凝聚体具有 O(2^L) 个 SSB 基态，这些基态源自 O(2^L) 个指数 U(1) 电荷扇区，从而导致有限熵密度 ln 2。这强制进入该相的 SSB 相变为一级相变，正如数值上所观察到并在一个精确可解的 Rokhsar-Kivelson 线上于大 S 极限中得到验证。该凝聚体具有作为 SSB 序参量的局域面内自旋，其指向的角度由混沌伯努利（二进）映射相互关联，因此实际上是随机的。此外，我们表明该凝聚体表现出不衰减的局域自关联，并且不具有非对角长程序。因而，量子击穿凝聚体表现为一种无无序量子玻璃，并超出现有物质相分类。

articles.title: Metallic mean quasicrystals and their topological invariants
articles.title_zh: 金属平均准晶及其拓扑不变量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.09769v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topological invariants govern many important physical properties in condensed matter systems. In this work, we obtain the complete set of topological invariants for a family of one-dimensional quasicrystals. The first and best-studied member of the family is the Fibonacci chain, while the successive ones are known in the literature as silver, bronze... and collectively as the metallic mean chains. By considering rational approximants, and by making use of the relationship between these chains and two dimensional Quantum Hall problems, we write down a gap labeling scheme for finite systems, and extend it to the quasiperiodic limit. We show, by numerical computations on open chains, that the proposed scheme correctly yields the winding numbers of edge states in each of the gaps, in all of the quasicrystals. We observe that their relationship to the 2D model leads, in the strict 1D chains family, to spectra forming a simplified Hofstadter ``butterfly" diagram, with the analogues of Landau levels appearing in the asymptotic limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作给出一族一维准晶的完整拓扑不变量集合，其中包括斐波那契链以及银平均、铜平均等金属平均链。作者利用有理近似体及其与二维量子霍尔问题的关系，建立有限体系的能隙标记方案并推广到准周期极限。数值计算表明，该方案能正确给出各准晶能隙中边缘态的绕数，并揭示其谱与简化 Hofstadter 蝴蝶图及类朗道能级之间的联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑不变量支配着凝聚态体系中的许多重要物理性质。在这项工作中，我们获得了一族一维准晶的完整拓扑不变量集合。该族中第一个也是研究最充分的成员是斐波那契链，而后续成员在文献中被称为银、铜……并统称为金属平均链。通过考虑有理近似体，并利用这些链与二维量子霍尔问题之间的关系，我们为有限体系写出了一个能隙标记方案，并将其推广到准周期极限。我们通过开链上的数值计算表明，所提出的方案能够正确给出所有这些准晶中每个能隙内边缘态的绕数。我们观察到，它们与二维模型的关系使得在严格的一维链族中，谱形成一种简化的 Hofstadter“蝴蝶”图，并在渐近极限中出现朗道能级的类似物。

articles.title: Dynamic quantum phase transitions in the two-leg Creutz ladder with long-range hopping
articles.title_zh: 具有长程跃迁的双腿 Creutz 梯中的动态量子相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24514v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this work, we investigate quantum quenches in the two-leg Creutz model with long-range hopping, where the hopping amplitudes decay with distance as a power law characterized by an exponent ν and have a finite range D. We first obtain the exact solution of a generic two-band model in momentum space. This allows us to compute the Loschmidt amplitude and, consequently, the dynamical free energy f(textttt) of the two-band model. We also show how to determine the Yang-Lee Fisher (YLF) zeros by solving a nonlinear equation. We demonstrate that the two-leg Creutz model in momentum space is a special case of the generic two-band model. Using these results, we identify the non-analyticities in the dynamical free energy f(textttt) at critical times texttttc. We find that the number of nontrivial critical times Nₛ depends on both ν and D. In particular, we show that for small ν and large D the critical times become increasingly dense, leading, in the appropriate regime, to non-analyticities at an increasingly dense set of times---similar to what was observed by Xavier and Hoyos [Phys. Rev. B, 108, 214303 (2023)] in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model with long-range hopping terms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察具有长程跃迁的双腿 Creutz 模型中的量子淬火，其中跃迁振幅按幂律随距离衰减并具有有限作用范围。作者先求解动量空间中的通用双能带模型，从而计算 Loschmidt 振幅、动力学自由能并确定 Yang-Lee-Fisher 零点。结果显示动力学自由能在临界时间出现非解析性，且非平凡临界时间数量依赖衰减指数和跃迁范围；在小衰减指数、大范围时，临界时间可变得越来越稠密。
authors: J. A. da Silva, J. C. Xavier
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们研究具有长程跃迁的双腿 Creutz 模型中的量子淬火，其中跃迁振幅按由指数 ν 表征的幂律随距离衰减，并具有有限范围 D。我们首先获得了动量空间中一个通用双能带模型的精确解。这使我们能够计算 Loschmidt 振幅，并进而计算双能带模型的动力学自由能 f(t)。我们还展示了如何通过求解一个非线性方程来确定 Yang-Lee Fisher（YLF）零点。我们证明，动量空间中的双腿 Creutz 模型是该通用双能带模型的一个特例。利用这些结果，我们识别出动力学自由能 f(t) 在临界时间 tc 处的非解析性。我们发现，非平凡临界时间的数量 Ns 同时依赖于 ν 和 D。特别地，我们表明，对于较小的 ν 和较大的 D，临界时间会变得越来越稠密，在适当区域中导致越来越稠密时间集合上的非解析性，这类似于 Xavier 和 Hoyos [Phys. Rev. B, 108, 214303 (2023)] 在具有长程跃迁项的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型中所观察到的现象。

articles.title: Geometric control of hyperbolic exciton-polariton condensate dimers
articles.title_zh: 双曲激子-极化激元凝聚体二聚体的几何控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.14147v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Coupled many-body quantum systems exhibit rich emergent physics with diverse stationary and dynamical behaviors. By engineering platforms with tunable and distinct coupling mechanisms, new insights emerge into the collective behavior of coupled many body systems. Particles can be exchanged via evanescent or ballistic coupling: the former, based on proximity, yields large spectral splitting, while the latter requires strict phase-matching, analogous to phase-coupled harmonic oscillators, and has a smaller impact on the energy landscape. We demonstrate an all-optically tunable quantum fluid dimer based on exciton-polariton condensates in a photonic crystal waveguide with hyperbolic (saddle-like) dispersion. Varying the dimer's angle relative to the grating tunes the coupling from evanescent to ballistic. We directly observe spectral features and mass flow shaped by the saddle dispersion. This work highlights photonic crystals as powerful platforms to explore condensed matter phenomena lying at the interface between delay-coupled nonlinear oscillators and tight binding physics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示一种全光可调的量子流体二聚体，由具有双曲鞍形色散的光子晶体波导中的激子-极化激元凝聚体构成。通过改变二聚体相对于光栅的角度，作者可将耦合从倏逝耦合调节到弹道耦合，并直接观察到由鞍形色散塑造的谱特征和质量流。结果表明光子晶体是研究延迟耦合非线性振子与紧束缚物理交界处凝聚态现象的有力平台。
authors: Ioannis Georgakilas, Antonio Gianfrate, Dimitrios Trypogeorgos, Helgi Sigurdhsson, Fabrizio Riminucci, Kirk W. Baldwin, Loren N. Pfeiffer, Milena De Giorgi, Dario Ballarini, Daniele Sanvitto
articles.abstract_zh_full: 耦合多体量子系统表现出丰富的涌现物理，并具有多样的定态和动力学行为。通过设计具有可调且不同耦合机制的平台，可以对耦合多体系统的集体行为获得新的认识。粒子可以通过倏逝耦合或弹道耦合进行交换：前者基于邻近性，会产生较大的谱分裂；后者需要严格的相位匹配，类似于相位耦合谐振子，并且对能量景观的影响较小。我们展示了一种全光可调的量子流体二聚体，它基于光子晶体波导中具有双曲（鞍形）色散的激子-极化激元凝聚体。改变二聚体相对于光栅的角度，可以将耦合从倏逝耦合调节为弹道耦合。我们直接观察到由鞍形色散塑造的谱特征和质量流。这项工作突显了光子晶体作为强大平台的作用，可用于探索位于延迟耦合非线性振子与紧束缚物理交界处的凝聚态现象。

articles.title: Characterizing Liouvillian Exceptional Points Through Newton Polygons and Tropical Geometry
articles.title_zh: 通过牛顿多边形与热带几何表征刘维尔例外点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.08156v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The dynamics of open quantum systems described by the Lindblad master equation follows according to non-Hermitian operators. As a result, such systems can host non-Hermitian degeneracies called Liouvillian exceptional points (EPs). In this work, we show that Newton polygons and tropical geometric approach allow identification and characterization of Liouvillian EPs. We use two models -- dissipative spin-1/2 system and dissipative superconducting qubit system -- to illustrate our method. We demonstrate that our approach captures the anisotropy and order of the Liouvillian EPs, while also revealing the subtle dependence on the form of the perturbation. Our analytical analysis is supplemented by direct numerical calculations of the scaling and exchange of eigenvalues around Liouvillian EPs. Our analytical approach could be useful in understanding and designing Liouvillian EPs of desired order.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出用牛顿多边形和热带几何方法识别并表征开放量子系统中的刘维尔例外点。作者以耗散自旋 1/2 系统和耗散超导量子比特系统为例，说明该方法能捕捉例外点的各向异性和阶数，并揭示其对扰动形式的细致依赖。解析结果还由围绕例外点的本征值标度和交换的直接数值计算补充验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由 Lindblad 主方程描述的开放量子系统动力学遵循非厄米算符。因此，这类系统可以容纳称为刘维尔例外点（EP）的非厄米简并。在这项工作中，我们表明，牛顿多边形和热带几何方法能够识别并表征刘维尔 EP。我们使用两个模型，即耗散自旋 1/2 系统和耗散超导量子比特系统，来说明我们的方法。我们证明，该方法能够捕捉刘维尔 EP 的各向异性和阶数，同时还揭示其对扰动形式的细微依赖。我们的解析分析由围绕刘维尔 EP 的本征值标度和交换的直接数值计算加以补充。我们的解析方法可能有助于理解和设计具有期望阶数的刘维尔 EP。

articles.title: Automatic generation of exchange-correlation response kernels
articles.title_zh: 交换-相关响应核的自动生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computing density-functional response properties requires contracting derivatives of the exchange--correlation (xc) energy with perturbed densities on a grid. While the xc functional's derivatives have long been available to high orders from libraries such as Libxc, the surrounding contraction layer - the chain rule that combines them with the grid-based basis-function and density data into the total xc contribution - has instead been hand-derived and hand-coded in every program, for every functional family, spin case, and property. We present libxckernel, a library that automatically generates this layer by symbolic differentiation. The xc functional's ingredients are expressed as sesquilinear forms in the density matrix, so the xc energy can be differentiated to any order while the functional derivatives remain opaque. The basis functions and the orbital coefficients may both be complex. The chain rule then produces any xc matrix element: Fock matrices, orbital Hessians, and response terms of any order. Terms sharing a pattern are collapsed for efficiency. Extensible plugins emit the expressions as NumPy Einstein sums, compiled C kernels with C++/Fortran interfaces, or host-program specific source code. libxckernel is free and open-source software under the BSD-3-Clause license, enabling rapid implementation of functionality missing from many electronic structure programs. We demonstrate it by extending Psi4 with meta-generalized gradient approximation (mGGA) response kernels for orbital stability analysis and time-dependent density-functional theory (TD-DFT), GGA and mGGA analytic nuclear Hessians, and exact quadrature grid response, and by extending GPAW with mGGA and triplet TD-DFT kernels and gradient-corrected kernels for periodic dielectric response.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作介绍 libxckernel，一个通过符号微分自动生成密度泛函响应性质中交换-相关收缩层的开源库。该库将交换-相关泛函成分表示为密度矩阵的半双线性形式，可生成 Fock 矩阵、轨道 Hessian 和任意阶响应项，并支持复杂基函数和轨道系数。作者展示了其在 Psi4 和 GPAW 中扩展 mGGA、TD-DFT、解析核 Hessian、周期介电响应等功能的应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 计算密度泛函响应性质需要在网格上将交换-相关（xc）能量的导数与受扰密度进行收缩。虽然 xc 泛函的导数长期以来已经可从 Libxc 等库中获得到高阶，但周围的收缩层，即将这些导数与基于网格的基函数和密度数据组合成总 xc 贡献的链式法则，却一直需要在每个程序中、针对每个泛函族、自旋情形和性质进行手工推导和手工编码。我们提出 libxckernel，这是一个通过符号微分自动生成这一层的库。xc 泛函的成分被表示为密度矩阵中的半双线性形式，因此可以将 xc 能量微分到任意阶，同时将泛函导数保持为不透明对象。基函数和轨道系数都可以是复数。随后，链式法则会产生任意 xc 矩阵元：Fock 矩阵、轨道 Hessian 以及任意阶响应项。共享同一模式的项会被合并以提高效率。可扩展插件将表达式输出为 NumPy Einstein 求和、带 C++/Fortran 接口的编译 C 核，或面向宿主程序的特定源代码。libxckernel 是采用 BSD-3-Clause 许可证的自由开源软件，使许多电子结构程序中缺失功能的快速实现成为可能。我们通过以下方式展示了它：为 Psi4 扩展用于轨道稳定性分析和含时密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）的 meta-广义梯度近似（mGGA）响应核、GGA 和 mGGA 解析核 Hessian 以及精确求积网格响应；并为 GPAW 扩展 mGGA 和三重态 TD-DFT 核，以及用于周期介电响应的梯度修正核。

articles.title: Ultra-broadband transient absorption down to 200 nm enabled by soliton dynamics in gas-filled hollow capillary fibers
articles.title_zh: 气体填充空心毛细管光纤中的孤子动力学实现低至 200 nm 的超宽带瞬态吸收
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26910v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The deep ultraviolet (DUV) window (200-300 nm) is essential for the characterization of (bio)chemical and material systems through the UV signatures of nucleobases, amino acids, peptide bonds, many organic moieties, and wide bandgap transitions. However, extending ultrafast spectroscopy to the DUV to access the associated electronic and structural dynamics has largely remained elusive, due to the limited bandwidth and efficiency of common femtosecond DUV pulse sources. We now close this gap and demonstrate ultra-broadband femtosecond transient absorption (TA) spanning 200-800 nm, achieving unprecedented coverage of the entire DUV window. We generate supercontinuum probe pulses through soliton self-compression in a helium-filled hollow capillary fiber at a repetition rate of 20 kHz and fully suppress their high intrinsic intensity fluctuations via a correlation matrix referencing scheme. We thus achieve detector-noise-limited TA measurements with an exceptional resolution of 9 μOD in one second, and demonstrate these novel capabilities by resolving the ultrafast spin-crossover dynamics of a Fe(II) complex in the DUV. This work opens the path to unravel previously inaccessible photophysical and photochemical dynamics encoded in the DUV.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示覆盖 200-800 nm 的超宽带飞秒瞬态吸收技术，实现对整个深紫外窗口的前所未有覆盖。作者在氦气填充空心毛细管光纤中通过孤子自压缩产生超连续谱探测脉冲，并用相关矩阵参考方案抑制其强度波动。该方法达到探测器噪声受限的 9 μOD 每秒分辨率，并用于解析 Fe(II) 配合物在深紫外中的超快自旋交叉动力学。
authors: Pieter J. Brongers, Kyle Barlow, Deepjyoti Satpathy, John C. Travers, Christian Brahms, Malte Oppermann
articles.abstract_zh_full: 深紫外（DUV）窗口（200-300 nm）对于通过核碱基、氨基酸、肽键、许多有机基团以及宽带隙跃迁的紫外特征来表征（生物）化学和材料体系至关重要。然而，由于常见飞秒 DUV 脉冲源的带宽和效率有限，将超快光谱扩展到 DUV 以获取相关电子和结构动力学在很大程度上仍难以实现。我们现在弥合了这一缺口，并展示了覆盖 200-800 nm 的超宽带飞秒瞬态吸收（TA），实现了对整个 DUV 窗口的前所未有的覆盖。我们在 20 kHz 重复频率下，通过氦气填充空心毛细管光纤中的孤子自压缩产生超连续谱探测脉冲，并通过相关矩阵参考方案完全抑制其固有的高强度波动。因此，我们实现了受探测器噪声限制的 TA 测量，在一秒内达到 9 μOD 的卓越分辨率，并通过解析 Fe(II) 配合物在 DUV 中的超快自旋交叉动力学展示了这些新能力。这项工作为揭示此前无法获取、编码在 DUV 中的光物理和光化学动力学开辟了道路。

articles.title: Franson-Interferometric Bounds on Entangled Two-Photon Absorption
articles.title_zh: 基于弗兰森干涉的纠缠双光子吸收界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.27157v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entangled photons offer quantum correlations with no classical analogue. In entangled pair two-photon absorption (ETPA), absorption rate is predicted to scale linearly rather than quadratically with photon flux, promising molecular excitation at fluxes far below the classical threshold. Reported ETPA cross sections nevertheless vary widely across experiments, largely since the observable, the differential of the transmitted flux or weak fluorescence, is difficult to separate from scattering and linear losses. We present a method which uses Franson interference to study entangled two-photon absorption through delay-dependent coincidence measurements on dye molecules. Applying the method to Rhodamine 6G, we observe a small asymmetry in the Franson interference envelope and obtain a model-derived effective cross section of approximately 2.1 E(-21) centimeter squared for Rhodamine 6G. However, the estimated systematic uncertainty does not allow a definitive ETPA assignment. Instead, the experiment establishes a quantitative bound on the ETPA response and provides a background-free benchmark for future measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 纠缠双光子吸收被预言可使吸收率随光子通量线性而非二次标度，但实验报道的截面差异很大。作者提出利用弗兰森干涉，通过染料分子上的延迟依赖符合测量研究该效应，并在罗丹明6G中观察到很小的干涉包络不对称性。模型给出约2.1×10⁻²¹ cm²的有效截面，但系统不确定性不足以支持确定的ETPA归因，因此该实验主要给出了定量上界和无背景基准。
authors: Albin Hedse, Sankaran Ramesh, Luis Matheis, Sebastian Gstir, Andreas Wacker, Gregor Weihs, Robert Keil, Qi Shi, Amitav Sahu, Tõnu Pullerits
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠光子提供了没有经典对应物的量子关联。在纠缠对双光子吸收（ETPA）中，吸收率被预言随光子通量线性而非二次标度，从而有望在远低于经典阈值的通量下实现分子激发。然而，已报道的ETPA截面在不同实验之间差异很大，主要原因是可观测量，即透射通量的差分或弱荧光，难以同散射和线性损耗区分开来。我们提出一种方法，利用弗兰森干涉，通过染料分子上的延迟依赖符合测量来研究纠缠双光子吸收。将该方法应用于罗丹明6G时，我们观察到弗兰森干涉包络中的一个小不对称性，并得到模型导出的罗丹明6G有效截面约为2.1×10⁻²¹平方厘米。然而，估计的系统不确定性不允许对ETPA作出确定归因。相反，该实验为ETPA响应建立了一个定量界限，并为未来测量提供了无背景基准。

articles.title: Engineering of titanium transition edge sensor wafers for the BA4-90/150 receiver of BICEP Array
articles.title_zh: 用于BICEP Array BA4-90/150接收机的钛过渡边缘传感器晶圆工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26202v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: BA4-90/150, the fourth receiver to be deployed in the BICEP Array (BA) series, is a dichroic 90/150 GHz instrument targeting the frequency space where sensitivity to the CMB polarization is maximized. The receiver will be deployed in the 2026-2027 austral summer, and is set to position BA to achieve exceptionally precise measurements of cosmic microwave background (CMB) polarization and strengthen constraints on inflationary models. Recent measurements in existing BA receivers suggest that unexpectedly high loop gain in the titanium (Ti) transition edge sensors (TESs) produces excess high-frequency noise that is consequently aliased down into the science band through the time-division multiplexed readout. To reduce the loop gain, we fabricated and tested prototype Ti TES wafers containing 16 modified detector architectures designed to broaden the superconducting transition and reduce the transition steepness (alpha). We present detector performance results, which will directly inform the final integrated wafer now being designed for full receiver commissioning.
articles.abstract_zh: BA4-90/150是BICEP Array系列拟部署的第四台接收机，面向CMB偏振灵敏度较高的90/150 GHz频段。现有接收机测量显示，钛过渡边缘传感器中过高的环路增益可能引入高频噪声并混叠进科学频带。作者制备并测试了含16种改进探测器结构的原型钛TES晶圆，以拓宽超导转变并降低转变陡峭度，相关性能结果将指导最终集成晶圆设计。
