Among ferromagnets, enhanced responses emerge preferentially in alloys derived from parent compounds with small exchange splitting: no alloy derived from FePt, the archetypal L1₀ ferromagnet, reaches the high-response regime, whereas NiPt- and CoIr-derived alloys occupy it in large numbers. Small exchange splitting keeps majority- and minority-spin bands near the Fermi level, giving chemical substitution more opportunity to modify near-Fermi-level band crossings and amplify the Berry curvature. We predict a giant anomalous Hall conductivity of 2809,mathrmS,cm⁻¹ in (Co₀.₈Fe₀.₂)(Ir₀.₇Pt₀.₃) and a giant anomalous Nernst conductivity of 7.72,mathrmA,m⁻¹,K⁻¹ in (Ni₀.₈Co₀.₂)(Pt₀.₇Ir₀.₃). Our results identify the exchange splitting of the parent compound as a descriptor for chemical tunability toward giant Berry-curvature-driven transport responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 反常霍尔效应和反常能斯特效应分别描述磁性材料中的横向电响应与热电响应，对自旋电子学和能量收集具有应用潜力。本文通过高通量第一性原理计算研究 2251 种化学取代四方 L1₀ 合金，发现母体化合物交换劈裂较小时更易通过化学取代获得增强响应。作者预测了若干巨反常霍尔和能斯特响应材料，并提出母体交换劈裂可作为调控 Berry 曲率驱动输运的描述符。
authors: Ivan Kurniawan, Guangzong Xing, Yoshio Miura, Keisuke Masuda
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE）分别描述磁性材料中的横向电响应和热电响应，在自旋电子学和能量收集应用中具有前景。本文采用高通量第一性原理计算研究了 2251 种化学取代的四方 L1₀ 合金。在铁磁体中，增强的响应更倾向于出现在来源于小交换劈裂母体化合物的合金中：没有一种来源于典型 L1₀ 铁磁体 FePt 的合金达到高响应区域，而来源于 NiPt 和 CoIr 的合金大量占据该区域。小交换劈裂使多数自旋和少数自旋能带保持在费米能级附近，从而使化学取代有更多机会改变近费米能级的能带交叉并放大 Berry 曲率。我们预测 (Co₀.₈Fe₀.₂)(Ir₀.₇Pt₀.₃) 中存在 2809 S cm⁻¹ 的巨反常霍尔电导率，并预测 (Ni₀.₈Co₀.₂)(Pt₀.₇Ir₀.₃) 中存在 7.72 A m⁻¹ K⁻¹ 的巨反常能斯特电导率。我们的结果将母体化合物的交换劈裂确定为一种描述符，用于指导通过化学可调性实现巨大的 Berry 曲率驱动输运响应。

articles.title: Optical and magneto-optical interactions in Co-doped CeO₂ thin films prepared by pulsed laser deposition
articles.title_zh: 脉冲激光沉积制备的 Co 掺杂 CeO₂ 薄膜中的光学与磁光相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25599v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetically doped CeO₂ is a dilute magnetic semiconductor, promising for various applications in photonics, but the origin of its ferromagnetic properties is not fully understood. Here, thin films of Ce₁₋ₓCoₓO₂₋δ prepared by pulsed laser deposition on MgO (x=0.05 and 0.10) and oxidized Si (x=0.20) substrates were systematically studied by spectroscopic ellipsometry and magneto-optical spectroscopy. Both diagonal and off-diagonal permittivity-tensor elements were obtained. Diagonal spectra revealed two optical transitions between oxygen and cerium states. Off-diagonal spectra revealed two paramagnetic transitions involving cobalt ions, from which an essential influence of cobalt doping on resulting ferromagnetic properties of CeO₂ was inferred. The full permittivity-tensor spectra are provided for further use in prospective modelling of magneto-optical device concepts.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁性掺杂 CeO₂ 是一种稀磁半导体，在光子学应用中具有潜力，但其铁磁性起源尚未完全明确。本文系统研究了脉冲激光沉积制备的 Ce₁₋ₓCoₓO₂₋δ 薄膜的椭偏与磁光谱，获得了介电张量的对角和非对角元素。结果显示氧-铈态之间的光学跃迁以及涉及钴离子的顺磁跃迁，并推断 Co 掺杂对 CeO₂ 铁磁性质具有关键影响。
authors: Martin Zahradník, Miroslav Kučera, Roman Antoš, Martin Veis, Jan Mistrík, Lei Bi, Hyun-Suk Kim, Caroline A. Ross
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性掺杂 CeO₂ 是一种稀磁半导体，在光子学的多种应用中具有前景，但其铁磁性质的起源尚未完全理解。本文通过光谱椭偏和磁光光谱，对采用脉冲激光沉积在 MgO（x=0.05 和 0.10）以及氧化 Si（x=0.20）基底上制备的 Ce₁₋ₓCoₓO₂₋δ 薄膜进行了系统研究。研究获得了介电张量的对角和非对角元素。对角谱揭示了氧态与铈态之间的两个光学跃迁。非对角谱揭示了两个涉及钴离子的顺磁跃迁，并由此推断钴掺杂对 CeO₂ 最终铁磁性质具有重要影响。文中提供了完整的介电张量谱，以供未来磁光器件概念建模使用。

articles.title: Substitution effects in RuO₂ single crystals
articles.title_zh: RuO₂单晶中的替代效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25615v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: RuO₂ has emerged as one of the leading candidates for investigating altermagnetism. Recent quantum oscillation and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy measurements found the absence of altermagnetism or antiferromagnetism in pure RuO₂ crystals. The continuing debate over intrinsic magnetic order in RuO₂ may reflect its proximity to an altermagnetic instability. In this work, we grow single crystals of Ru₀.₉V₀.₁O₂ and investigate their structural, transport, and magnetic properties. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals an average V oxidation state near +4. The paramagnetic susceptibility remains nearly unchanged up to room temperature, with no evidence of magnetic ordering. Thus, the 10% V-substitution in RuO₂ does not induce altermagnetism. Electronic structure calculations for the V-substituted systems using two methods suggest that a higher level of V-substitution leads to a significant change in the density of states. These findings underscore the potential of nonmagnetic substitution in RuO₂ as an attractive candidate for probing altermagnetic transitions and their experimental signatures.
articles.abstract_zh: RuO₂是研究交错磁性的候选材料之一，但近期实验未在纯RuO₂晶体中发现交错磁性或反铁磁性。本文制备并研究了Ru₀.₉V₀.₁O₂单晶，发现10%的V替代未诱导磁有序或交错磁性。计算表明，进一步提高V替代比例会显著改变态密度，说明非磁性替代可用于探索RuO₂中的交错磁性转变及其特征。
authors: Shubhankar Paul, Kunihiko Yamauchi, Shogo Yamashita, Hisakazu Matsuki, Shuhei Iwashita, Mitsuhiko Maesato, Hiroshi Kitagawa, Chanchal Sow, Shingo Yonezawa, Yoshiteru Maeno
articles.abstract_zh_full: RuO₂已成为研究交错磁性的主要候选材料之一。近期的量子振荡和角分辨光电子能谱测量发现，纯RuO₂晶体中不存在交错磁性或反铁磁性。关于RuO₂内禀磁有序的持续争论，可能反映了其接近交错磁性不稳定性的状态。在本研究中，我们生长了Ru₀.₉V₀.₁O₂单晶，并研究了其结构、输运和磁学性质。X射线光电子能谱显示，V的平均氧化态接近+4。顺磁磁化率在升温至室温的过程中几乎保持不变，未观察到磁有序的证据。因此，在RuO₂中进行10%的V替代并不会诱导交错磁性。采用两种方法对V替代体系进行的电子结构计算表明，提高V替代比例会导致态密度发生显著变化。这些发现表明，在RuO₂中采用非磁性替代，是探测交错磁性转变及其实验特征的一种很有吸引力的方法。

articles.title: Nearly Isotropic Quantum-Critical Transport in Single-Crystal CeNiC2
articles.title_zh: CeNiC₂单晶中近乎各向同性的量子临界输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25616v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pressure-induced superconductivity and T-linear resistivity have been reported in polycrystalline CeNiC₂, but orientational averaging has left the directional character of the critical scattering unresolved. We report pressure-dependent resistivity of high-quality single crystals for current along each crystallographic axis. These crystals have substantially lower residual resistivity and a slightly higher maximum onset T_c than the polycrystalline sample, placing superconductivity in a cleaner transport regime. Near P_c approx 9.5-10 GPa, the normal-state resistivity becomes nearly T-linear along every axis, the fitted residual resistivity is strongly enhanced, and superconductivity forms a narrow dome. For I parallel b, the T-linear normal state remains nearly unchanged in magnetic fields up to 9 T applied along a and c; the upper critical field is large and only moderately anisotropic. The common evolution along all three axes establishes a nearly isotropic quantum-critical transport regime, inconsistent with a simple low-dimensional spin-fluctuation picture and implicates valence fluctuations as the leading source of critical scattering associated with the superconducting dome.
articles.abstract_zh: 多晶CeNiC₂中已报道压力诱导超导性和线性温度电阻率，但多晶取向平均使临界散射的方向特征尚不清楚。本文测量了沿各晶体学轴方向的高质量单晶压力依赖电阻率，在约9.5至10 GPa附近观察到各方向近乎线性的温度依赖和狭窄的超导穹顶。三个方向的共同演化表明体系处于近乎各向同性的量子临界输运状态，并支持价涨落是相关临界散射的主要来源。
authors: Hanming Ma, Jun Gouchi, Dilip Bhoi, Toru Shigeoka, Bosen Wang, J. -G. Cheng, Yoshiya Uwatoko
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在多晶CeNiC₂中已经报道了压力诱导的超导性和与温度成线性的电阻率，但取向平均使临界散射的方向特征一直未得到解决。我们报告了高质量单晶的压力依赖电阻率测量，其中电流分别沿每一个晶体学轴方向流动。这些单晶具有显著更低的残余电阻率以及略高的最大起始超导转变温度T_c，使超导性处于更洁净的输运状态。在临界压力P_c约为9.5至10 GPa附近，正常态电阻率沿每个轴方向都变得近乎与温度成线性关系，拟合得到的残余电阻率显著增强，同时超导性形成一个狭窄的穹顶。对于I平行于b轴的情况，当磁场沿a轴和c轴施加且强度最高达到9 T时，线性温度依赖的正常态几乎不发生变化；上临界场很大，并且仅表现出中等程度的各向异性。沿三个轴方向的共同演化确立了一个近乎各向同性的量子临界输运状态，这与简单的低维自旋涨落图像不一致，并表明价涨落是与超导穹顶相关的临界散射的主要来源。

articles.title: Magnetic-configuration design for reliable Heisenberg exchange parameters
articles.title_zh: 用于可靠海森堡交换参数的磁构型设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25628v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The determination of magnetic exchange interactions is essential for the quantitative description and predictive modeling of magnetic materials. In this work, we present a neighbor-shell-based screening method for selecting magnetic configurations suitable for extracting Heisenberg exchange parameters beyond nearest-neighbor from density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Using only the structure, the proposed approach identifies the linear independence of neighbor-shell contributions before any first-principles calculations instead of relying on trial-and-error generation of magnetic configurations. We apply the proposed approach to two representative classes of magnetic configurations: random spin states and spin spirals, and validate its predictions against direct DFT fitting for Fe and MnF₂. We show that only parameters obtained when all relevant neighbor-shell contributions are linearly independent remain transferable to other magnetic configurations. The proposed method provides practical guidance for selecting magnetic configurations for reliable exchange-parameter extraction and may also benefit other neighbor-shell-based models.
articles.abstract_zh: 确定磁交换相互作用对于定量描述和预测磁性材料至关重要。本文提出一种基于邻居壳层的筛选方法，可在进行第一性原理计算前，仅依据结构判断磁构型是否适合提取超越最近邻的海森堡交换参数。该方法在随机自旋态和自旋螺旋两类构型上得到验证，并表明只有邻居壳层贡献均线性独立时获得的参数，才能可靠地迁移到其他磁构型。
authors: Ben Li, Stephan von Malottki, Gian-Marco Rignanese
articles.abstract_zh_full: 确定磁交换相互作用对于磁性材料的定量描述和预测性建模至关重要。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于邻居壳层的筛选方法，用于选择适合从密度泛函理论（DFT）计算中提取超越最近邻交换参数的磁构型。该方法仅利用结构信息，在进行任何第一性原理计算之前，就能识别邻居壳层贡献的线性独立性，而不必依赖试错式的磁构型生成。我们将所提出的方法应用于两类具有代表性的磁构型，即随机自旋态和自旋螺旋，并针对Fe和MnF₂，将其预测结果与直接DFT拟合结果进行了验证。我们表明，只有当所有相关邻居壳层贡献均线性独立时所获得的参数，才能迁移到其他磁构型中。所提出的方法为选择磁构型以可靠提取交换参数提供了实用指导，也可能有益于其他基于邻居壳层的模型。

articles.title: Closed-form hard-sphere thermodynamics under nanoscale confinement: from equations of state to unmixing forces
articles.title_zh: 纳米尺度限域下硬球热力学的闭式表达：从状态方程到不混溶力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25629v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equations of state accurately describe hard-sphere thermodynamics but are generally considered to fail under nanoscale confinement. We show that this failure is geometric rather than thermodynamic: a closed-form, parameter-free mapping from apparent to effective packing fraction restores the accuracy of the Carnahan-Starling equation of state and, with it, the entire analytical thermodynamic framework, including free energies, wall pressures, chemical potentials, and the large-cavity surface response. Applied to overlapping anchored hard-sphere droplets, a geometry inherent to biomolecular force generation, it yields unmixing free energies and full distance-dependent force profiles in quantitative agreement with simulations from the dilute regime to above the bulk freezing transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 状态方程能够准确描述硬球热力学，但通常被认为在纳米尺度限域下会失效。本文表明，这种失效源于几何因素而非热力学本身；通过将表观堆积率映射为有效堆积率，可恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程及其完整解析热力学框架的准确性。将该方法应用于重叠的锚定硬球液滴后，所得不混溶自由能和距离依赖力剖面与从稀溶区到高于体相冻结转变温度范围内的模拟结果定量一致。
authors: Jose M. G. Vilar, Leonor Saiz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 状态方程能够准确描述硬球热力学，但通常认为它们在纳米尺度限域下会失效。我们表明，这种失效是几何上的，而不是热力学上的：一种从表观堆积率到有效堆积率的闭式、无参数映射，可以恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程的准确性，并由此恢复包括自由能、壁面压力、化学势以及大空腔表面响应在内的完整解析热力学框架。将该方法应用于相互重叠的锚定硬球液滴这一生物分子产生力时固有的几何体系，可以得到不混溶自由能和完整的距离依赖力剖面；这些结果与从稀溶区一直到高于体相冻结转变的模拟结果定量一致。

articles.title: Nuclearity of Copper Clusters on hBN/SiC Heterostructure Modulates Molecular Adsorption
articles.title_zh: hBN/SiC异质结构上铜团簇的核数调控分子吸附
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25640v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Defect engineering can transform inert two-dimensional (2D) materials into chemically active and electronically tunable platforms by creating anchoring sites for metal atoms and clusters. Nevertheless, precise control over the formation, thermodynamic and kinetic stability, electronic structure, and chemical reactivity of metal species confined at these defect sites remains a challenge. Here, we use density functional theory (DFT) calculations assisted by machine-learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) simulations to elucidate the stability, electronic structure, and reactivity of Cu clusters anchored at boron vacancies (VB) in hBN/SiC heterostructures. Systematic variation of the Cu-to-vacancy ratio reveals a transition from isolated Cu atoms to multiatom Cu clusters at VB sites, with cluster growth reshaping the stability, electronic structure, and surface reactivity. Our results show that a single VB defect can be passivated by three Cu atoms, which compensate the local charge deficiency and stabilize the defect through Cu-N coordination. Capturing further Cu introduces localized midgap states that could influence the reactivity of the Cu-decorated defect sites. We probe the response of the Cu-decorated surface to chemically relevant gases CO, H2, O2, N2, H2S, and CO2, revealing implications for surface reactivity and stability. The calculations show pronounced cluster-size-dependent reactivity of Cu clusters at VB sites, with CO forming strong Cu-C bonds and O2 undergoing enhanced adsorption and molecular activation. Overall, this work identifies defect-engineered hBN/SiC as a versatile 2D platform for stabilizing Cu clusters and tuning gas-surface reactivity. By correlating Cu nuclearity at VB sites with electronic structure, molecular activation, and environmental robustness, our findings provide design guidelines for nuclearity-dependent metal functionalization of 2D heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 缺陷工程能够通过为金属原子和团簇提供锚定位点，将惰性的二维材料转变为化学活性和电子结构可调的平台。本文结合密度泛函理论和机器学习分子动力学，研究了锚定于hBN/SiC异质结构硼空位处的铜团簇。结果表明，铜与空位的比例控制着从孤立铜原子到多原子团簇的转变，且团簇尺寸显著影响稳定性、电子结构及气体反应性，其中CO形成强Cu-C键，O₂表现出增强的吸附和分子活化。
authors: Reza Khakpour, Arsalan Hashemi, Xiaoya Chang, Nima Ghafari Cherati, Mikko Karttunen, Tapio Ala-Nissila
articles.abstract_zh_full: 缺陷工程可以通过为金属原子和团簇创造锚定位点，将惰性的二维（2D）材料转变为化学活性且电子结构可调的平台。然而，对于限域在这些缺陷位点处的金属物种，其形成过程、热力学和动力学稳定性、电子结构及化学反应性的精确控制仍然面临挑战。在这里，我们利用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，并辅以机器学习分子动力学（MLMD）模拟，阐明了锚定在hBN/SiC异质结构硼空位（V_B）处的铜团簇的稳定性、电子结构和反应性。对铜与空位比例进行系统改变显示，在V_B位点处会发生从孤立Cu原子到多原子Cu团簇的转变，而团簇的生长会重塑体系的稳定性、电子结构和表面反应性。我们的结果表明，单个V_B缺陷可以由三个Cu原子钝化；这些Cu原子补偿局部电荷缺失，并通过Cu-N配位使缺陷稳定。进一步捕获Cu会引入局域化的带隙中态，这些中态可能影响Cu修饰缺陷位点的反应性。我们考察了Cu修饰表面对CO、H₂、O₂、N₂、H₂S和CO₂等具有化学相关性的气体的响应，揭示了其对表面反应性和稳定性的影响。计算显示，V_B位点处Cu团簇的反应性显著依赖于团簇尺寸，其中CO会形成强Cu-C键，而O₂则表现出增强的吸附和分子活化。总体而言，本工作确定了缺陷工程化hBN/SiC是一种可用于稳定Cu团簇并调控气体-表面反应性的多功能二维平台。通过将V_B位点处Cu的核数与电子结构、分子活化和环境稳定性联系起来，我们的研究为二维异质结构中依赖核数的金属功能化提供了设计指导。

articles.title: Phase calibration of quantum oscillations in the magnetostrictive coefficient using the topological antiferromagnet YbMnBi₂
articles.title_zh: 利用拓扑反铁磁体YbMnBi₂校准磁致伸缩系数量子振荡的相位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25656v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Berry phase accumulated along a cyclotron orbit encodes important information about electronic band topology and is commonly inferred from the phase of quantum oscillations. Measurements of the ac magnetostrictive coefficient have recently emerged as a sensitive thermodynamic probe of quantum oscillations, but the phase offset has not been experimentally calibrated. Here, using the topological antiferromagnet YbMnBi₂, we calibrate this offset by directly comparing quantum oscillations in magnetization with those in the ac magnetostrictive coefficient. Measurements of both responses on the same single crystal reveal a single fundamental frequency of approximately 160 T in fields up to 14 T, enabling a direct phase comparison free from ambiguities associated with multiple frequencies. We observe an approximately π/2 relative phase shift between the two oscillatory responses, consistent with the Maxwell relation linking the magnetostrictive coefficient to the stress derivative of magnetization. Our results establish the appropriate phase needed to extract cyclotron-orbit phase information from quantum oscillations in the ac magnetostrictive coefficient.
articles.abstract_zh: 回旋轨道上积累的Berry相位包含电子能带拓扑的重要信息，通常通过量子振荡相位推断。本文以拓扑反铁磁体YbMnBi₂为对象，将磁化强度与交流磁致伸缩系数中的量子振荡直接比较，校准了后者的相位偏移。两种响应均显示约160 T的单一基本频率，并观察到约π/2的相对相移，从而确立了利用交流磁致伸缩系数量子振荡提取回旋轨道相位所需的正确相位关系。
authors: Qin Deng, Long Zhang, Zeyu Li, Ying Zhu, Shuai Wu, Yan Liu, Aifeng Wang, Yu Pan, Yisheng Chai
articles.abstract_zh_full: 沿回旋轨道积累的Berry相位编码了有关电子能带拓扑的重要信息，并且通常通过量子振荡的相位来推断。交流磁致伸缩系数的测量近年来已成为一种对量子振荡敏感的热力学探针，但其相位偏移尚未得到实验校准。在这里，我们利用拓扑反铁磁体YbMnBi₂，通过直接比较磁化强度中的量子振荡与交流磁致伸缩系数中的量子振荡，对这一相位偏移进行了校准。在同一块单晶上对两种响应进行测量，发现即使在最高达14 T的磁场中也只有一个约160 T的基本频率，从而能够进行直接的相位比较，并避免多频率带来的歧义。我们观察到两种振荡响应之间约为π/2的相对相移，这与将磁致伸缩系数和磁化强度对应力的导数联系起来的麦克斯韦关系一致。我们的结果确立了从交流磁致伸缩系数量子振荡中提取回旋轨道相位信息时应采用的相位。

articles.title: Chirality-Selective Phonon Pumping by Ferroelectric Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 铁电动力学驱动的手性选择性声子泵浦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of chiral phonons has expanded the conventional view of lattice vibrations as passive heat carriers, opening new opportunities for phononic spintronic devices. However, their realization has been largely limited to chiral crystals or to specific regions of momentum space in certain achiral materials. Here, we propose a generic mechanism for generating propagating chiral phonons in an ordinary dielectric through the precession of the electric polarization in an adjacent ferroelectric. The polarization dynamics transfers its intrinsic angular momentum to the lattice via electrostrictive coupling, thereby pumping chirality-selective phonons whose handedness is dictated by that of the polarization precession. For a typical LiNbO₃|Y₃Al₅O₁₂ bilayer, we find that the pumping efficiency quantified by an interfacial convertance substantially exceeds those of thermally induced chiral-phonon generation in chiral crystals, owing to the strong electrostrictive coupling in ferroelectrics. Our work establishes ferroelectric dynamics as a versatile electrical source of chiral phonons and provides a general route toward electrically programmable chiral-phononic and spintronic functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 手性声子的发现拓展了人们对晶格振动的认识，并为声子自旋电子器件带来新的可能。本文提出一种通用机制：相邻铁电体中电极化的进动可通过电致伸缩耦合，将其内禀角动量传递给晶格，从而在普通介电体中产生传播性的手性声子。对于典型的LiNbO₃|Y₃Al₅O₁₂双层结构，界面转换能力显著高于热诱导机制，表明铁电动力学可作为电控手性声子的有效来源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性声子的发现拓展了传统上将晶格振动视为被动热载流子的观点，并为声子自旋电子器件开辟了新的机会。然而，手性声子的实现大多局限于手性晶体，或局限于某些非手性材料中特定的动量空间区域。在这里，我们提出了一种在普通介电体中产生传播性手性声子的通用机制，其方式是利用相邻铁电体中电极化的进动。电极化动力学通过电致伸缩耦合将其内禀角动量传递给晶格，从而泵浦出手性具有选择性的声子，其左右手性由电极化进动的手性决定。对于典型的LiNbO₃|Y₃Al₅O₁₂双层结构，我们发现，以界面转换能力衡量的泵浦效率显著高于手性晶体中热诱导手性声子产生的效率，这归因于铁电体中的强电致伸缩耦合。本工作确立了铁电动力学作为手性声子的多功能电学源，并为实现电学可编程的手性声子和自旋电子功能提供了一条一般路径。

articles.title: Muonium dynamics as a probe for depth-resolved properties of 4H-SiC
articles.title_zh: 作为深度分辨探针的μ子素动力学：4H-SiC的性质研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25702v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study establishes a baseline for muonium (Mu) charge-exchange dynamics in n-type 4H-SiC through a detailed low-energy muon spin rotation (LE-uSR) investigation. Epitaxially grown and ion-implanted samples with nitrogen and phosphorus donors were characterized to assess the effect of carrier concentration and doping method on defect formation. LE-uSR enabled nanometer scale depth profiling of near-surface and implanted regions, revealing variations in charge carrier concentration due to fixed surface charges. The temperature dependence of the diamagnetic fraction and phase provided direct evidence of the Mu0 to Mu- transition, with extracted activation energies consistent with known donor ionization energies. Additionally, high-field uSR was used to analyze the Mu dynamics, and Monte-Carlo simulations to model the Mu0 electron capture process. The simulation results offer a quantitative method to extract free electron concentrations from LE-uSR data, enhancing its capability to characterize the activation of dopants and carrier depth profiles. We demonstrate that LE-uSR is a powerful depth-resolved tool that can provide insights for optimizing the fabrication of reliable SiC devices for power electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过低能μ子自旋旋转实验，建立了n型4H-SiC中μ子素电荷交换动力学的基线。深度剖析揭示了固定表面电荷导致的近表面和离子注入区域载流子浓度差异，并通过抗磁分数和相位的温度依赖性直接观察到Mu⁰向Mu⁻的转变。蒙特卡洛模拟为利用低能μ子自旋旋转数据定量提取自由电子浓度提供了方法，有助于表征掺杂激活和载流子深度分布。
authors: Maria Mendes Martins, Piyush Kumar, Marianne E. Bathen, Robert J. Scheuermann, Zurab Guguchia, Lasse Vines, Ulrike Grossner, Thomas Prokscha
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究通过详细的低能μ子自旋旋转（LE-μSR）研究，建立了n型4H-SiC中μ子素（Mu）电荷交换动力学的基线。我们对外延生长样品以及离子注入样品进行了表征；这些样品分别含有氮施主和磷施主，用于评估载流子浓度和掺杂方法对缺陷形成的影响。LE-μSR实现了对近表面区域和离子注入区域进行纳米尺度的深度剖析，并揭示了由固定表面电荷引起的载流子浓度变化。抗磁组分和相位的温度依赖性直接证明了Mu⁰向Mu⁻的转变，而提取出的活化能与已知的施主电离能一致。此外，我们还利用高场μ子自旋旋转（μSR）分析了μ子素动力学，并采用蒙特卡洛模拟对Mu⁰电子俘获过程进行了建模。模拟结果为从LE-μSR数据中提取自由电子浓度提供了一种定量方法，从而增强了LE-μSR表征掺杂激活和载流子深度分布的能力。我们证明，LE-μSR是一种强大的深度分辨工具，能够为优化电力电子器件中可靠SiC器件的制造提供重要认识。

articles.title: Observation of thermal Hall effect in diamond
articles.title_zh: 金刚石中的热霍尔效应观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25726v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Numerous insulators, including non-magnetic ones, have been unexpectedly found to display a finite thermal Hall signal, which has stimulated debate about its origin. Here, we report on a study of the thermal Hall effect in two diamond single crystals. The transverse thermal conductivity (kappaₓy) was found to peak at a temperature close to that at which the longitudinal thermal conductivity (kappaₓₓ₎ reaches its maximum. The measured kappaₓy, with an amplitude of 340 W/(m K) at B = 10 T, is the largest ever observed, while the kappaₓy/kappaₓₓ ratio follows the phenomenological trend identified in other insulators. Our observation implies the existence of an intrinsic thermal Hall effect in a generic phonon gas. We argue that the rough amplitude of both the thermal Hall angle and the thermal Hall resistivity can be accounted for by simple arguments invoking fundamental constants and quantum-mechanical constraints on solid state cohesion.
articles.abstract_zh: 包括非磁性绝缘体在内的许多绝缘体意外表现出有限的热霍尔信号，引发了对其起源的讨论。本文研究了两块金刚石单晶，发现横向热导率κₓᵧ在温度接近纵向热导率κₓₓ最大值的区域达到峰值，其在10 T下达到340 W/(m·K)。这一结果支持普通声子气中存在内禀热霍尔效应，并表明热霍尔角和热霍尔电阻率的量级可由基本常数及固体内聚的量子力学约束解释。
authors: Marcin Matusiak, Andrzej Ptok, Maria Szlawska, Kamran Behnia
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们意外地发现，包括非磁性绝缘体在内的许多绝缘体都表现出有限的热霍尔信号，这一现象引发了关于其起源的讨论。在这里，我们报告了对两块金刚石单晶中热霍尔效应的研究。横向热导率（κₓᵧ）在一个接近纵向热导率（κₓₓ）达到最大值的温度处出现峰值。在B=10 T时，测得的κₓᵧ幅值为340 W/(m·K)，这是迄今为止观测到的最大值；与此同时，κₓᵧ/κₓₓ比值遵循了在其他绝缘体中发现的现象学趋势。我们的观测意味着，普通声子气中存在内禀热霍尔效应。我们认为，通过引入基本常数以及固体内聚所受的量子力学约束，可以解释热霍尔角和热霍尔电阻率的大致幅值。

articles.title: PCB-Integrated CoPt Micromagnets for Magnetophoresis
articles.title_zh: 用于磁泳的PCB集成CoPt微磁体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25732v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integration of magnetic material with scalable microfluidic platforms can significantly improve the throughput and precision in biotechnology processes. In this work we have developed a new magnetic platform based on printed circuit board (PCB) technology. Cobalt-Platinum (CoPt) micromagnets are electroplated on copper pads with an arbitrary footprint on a Kapton substrate to enable generation of different magnetic field gradients. The magnets are characterized by XRD and VSM, before and after thermal annealing. The ordered L10 phase appear in XRD results after annealing at 600 degC, and VSM results show around six times increase for in-plane magnetic remanence from 0.24T to 1.4T. The near equiatomic ratios of Co:Pt is confirmed by EDX observations. The performance of these magnets is experimentally validated by trapping magnetic nanoparticles in microfluidic channels. These results are in excellent agreement with FEA models presented in COMSOL Multiphysics.
articles.abstract_zh: 将磁性材料集成到可规模化的微流体平台中，有望提高生物技术过程的通量和精度。本文基于印刷电路板技术开发了一种磁性平台，在Kapton基底的铜焊盘上电镀具有任意形状的CoPt微磁体，以产生不同的磁场梯度。热退火后形成有序L1₀相，面内磁剩磁由0.24 T提高至1.4 T；微流控实验和COMSOL有限元模型均验证了其捕获磁性纳米颗粒的性能。
authors: Melissa Mitchell, Henrique Mira, Simon Bending, Chris Bell, Ali Mohammadi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将磁性材料集成到可规模化的微流体平台中，可以显著提高生物技术过程的通量和精度。在本工作中，我们基于印刷电路板（PCB）技术开发了一种新的磁性平台。在Kapton基底上带有任意形状的铜焊盘处电镀钴铂（CoPt）微磁体，以实现不同磁场梯度的产生。在热退火前后，我们分别通过X射线衍射（XRD）和振动样品磁强计（VSM）对这些磁体进行了表征。XRD结果显示，在600摄氏度退火后出现了有序的L1₀相；VSM结果表明，面内磁剩磁约增加了6倍，由0.24 T升至1.4 T。能量色散X射线谱（EDX）观测证实了Co与Pt接近等原子比。通过在微流控通道中捕获磁性纳米颗粒，我们在实验上验证了这些磁体的性能。这些结果与利用COMSOL Multiphysics给出的有限元分析（FEA）模型高度一致。

articles.title: Quasi two dimensional magnetic structure of the triclinic double perovskite Ca₂CuWO₆
articles.title_zh: 三斜晶系双钙钛矿Ca₂CuWO₆的准二维磁结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25778v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present the antiferromagnetic ground state of the triclinic double perovskite Ca₂CuWO₆ₛₒₗᵥₑd by neutron powder diffraction, and analyze it in direct comparison with tetragonal Sr₂CuWO₆. Below T_N simeq 32 K, the magnetic Bragg reflections of Ca₂CuWO₆ are indexed by the commensurate propagation vector k=(tfrac12,tfrac12,0) in its native Pbar1 cell. Rietveld refinement yields a collinear structure with equal-magnitude, antiparallel moments on the crystallographically inequivalent Cu1 and Cu2 sites and an ordered moment of 0.66(3)~μₘₐₜₕᵣₘ B per Cu at 1.5 K. A direct comparison with Sr₂CuWO₆ is obscured by different crystallographic settings and orientations of the cooperative Jahn-Teller elongation axes. Hence, we introduce a common crystallographic supercell through which effects of symmetry lowering from tetragonal to triclinic in the double perovskite are explored: Apparently different magnetic propagation vectors map onto the same supercell wave vector, revealing a common magnetic structure stabilized by tungsten-mediated, second-neighbor interactions. Mean field calculations further show that tetragonal symmetry preserves the degeneracy of four magnetic k-domains in Sr₂CuWO₆, whereas the triclinic splitting of symmetry-related exchange pathways in Ca₂CuWO₆, most strongly within the Cu2 network, selects a single k-domain. These results establish the magnetic ground state of Ca₂CuWO₆ and show how symmetry breaking selects a given ordered state without changing the underlying magnetic motif of the Sr analogue.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过中子粉末衍射确定了三斜晶系双钙钛矿Ca₂CuWO₆的反铁磁基态，并将其与四方晶系Sr₂CuWO₆进行比较。Ca₂CuWO₆在约32 K以下形成共线磁结构，两个晶体学不等价的Cu位点具有等大小、反平行的磁矩。共同晶胞分析表明，两种材料具有由钨介导的次近邻相互作用稳定的共同磁结构，而三斜对称性破缺会解除磁畴简并并选择单一传播矢量畴。
authors: Bangye Qin, Dmitry D. Khalyavin, Xuan Liang, Kazunari Yamaura, Alexei A. Belik, Roger D. Johnson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过中子粉末衍射解析了三斜晶系双钙钛矿Ca₂CuWO₆的反铁磁基态，并将其与四方晶系Sr₂CuWO₆进行了直接比较。在T_N约为32 K以下，Ca₂CuWO₆的磁布拉格反射可由其本征P̅1晶胞中的公度传播矢量k=(1/2,1/2,0)标记。Rietveld精修得到一种共线结构，其中晶体学上不等价的Cu1和Cu2位点具有大小相等、方向相反的磁矩；在1.5 K时，每个Cu的有序磁矩为0.66(3) μ_B。由于晶体学设置不同以及协同Jahn-Teller伸长轴取向不同，直接比较Ca₂CuWO₆与Sr₂CuWO₆会受到影响。因此，我们引入了一个共同的晶体学超晶胞，以研究双钙钛矿从四方对称性降低到三斜对称性所产生的影响：表面上不同的磁传播矢量被映射到相同的超晶胞波矢量，揭示出一种由钨介导的次近邻相互作用稳定的共同磁结构。平均场计算进一步表明，四方对称性保持了Sr₂CuWO₆中四个磁性k畴的简并性，而Ca₂CuWO₆中与对称性相关的交换路径发生三斜分裂，其中Cu2网络内部的分裂最为显著，从而选择了单一的k畴。这些结果确立了Ca₂CuWO₆的磁基态，并表明对称性破缺能够在不改变Sr类似物基本磁性图案的情况下选择特定的有序态。

articles.title: Topological phases of a generalised tripartite Haldane model
articles.title_zh: 广义三分格Haldane模型的拓扑相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25875v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a generalised tripartite Haldane model with a complex nearest neighbour hopping parameter. The total magnetic flux through the primitive unit cell, which consists of three hexagonal unit cells is zero, and thus the model has the structure of a loop-current model. We calculate topological phase diagrams of the Chern numbers as a function of the phases of the nearest and next-nearest neighbour hopping parameters for a fixed ratio of the magnitude of the hopping parameters. We show that, unlike the Haldane model, the topological phase diagram of this model is very complex, but some aspects can still be dealt with analytically. Furthermore, the Chern numbers of the topological phases are as large as 7 in absolute value. The analysis is supported by explicit expressions for energy bands crossing at high symmetry points in the Brillouin zone, which show as linear phase boundaries in the phase diagram. We show that such lines explain many features in the topological phase diagrams. Finally, we analyse a few representative examples of the nature of level crossings away from high symmetry and their evolution with model parameters.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种具有复数最近邻跃迁参数的广义三分格Haldane模型，其原胞由三个六边形晶胞组成且总磁通为零，因此具有环流模型的结构。作者计算了固定跃迁参数模比下、随最近邻和次近邻跃迁相位变化的Chern数拓扑相图，发现其结构远比通常的Haldane模型复杂，拓扑相的Chern数绝对值最高可达7。高对称点处能带交叉的解析表达式解释了相图中的许多线性边界和特征，并进一步分析了远离高对称点的能级交叉。
authors: Ahmed Al-kharusi, Alessandro Principi, Niels R. Walet
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种具有复数最近邻跃迁参数的广义三分格Haldane模型。其原胞由三个六边形晶胞组成，穿过该原胞的总磁通为零，因此该模型具有环流模型的结构。对于跃迁参数模长的固定比值，我们计算了Chern数随最近邻和次近邻跃迁参数相位变化的拓扑相图。我们表明，与Haldane模型不同，该模型的拓扑相图非常复杂，但其中一些特征仍然可以通过解析方法处理。此外，这些拓扑相的Chern数绝对值最高可达7。我们的分析得到了布里渊区高对称点处能带交叉显式表达式的支持；这些表达式显示，相图中的能带交叉边界是相位的线性函数。我们表明，这些线能够解释拓扑相图中的许多特征。最后，我们分析了几个具有代表性的例子，研究了远离高对称点的能级交叉性质及其随模型参数的演化。

articles.title: Fluxtube Bouquets and Type-1.5 Clustering in Superfluid Neutron Star Cores
articles.title_zh: 中子星核心中的磁通管花束与1.5型聚集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study mesoscopic configurations of a neutron superfluid coupled to a proton superconductor in the outer core of a neutron star. The condensates are described by a two-component Ginzburg-Landau free energy with local couplings, neglecting genuine phase-gradient entrainment. In two spatial dimensions, we minimize the free energy using quasi-periodic boundary conditions and constrained phase-imprinting calculations to study vortex-fluxtube and fluxtube-fluxtube interactions. We find that, for locally attractive couplings in the free energy, vortex-fluxtube overlap is energetically favoured and several pre-existing proton fluxtubes can bind around a neutron vortex, forming finite vortex-centred aggregates that we call fluxtube bouquets. These bouquet configurations may become so dense that a vortex can effectively accommodate several quanta of magnetic flux. We also confirm the possible presence of a type-1.5-like regime and find that it survives in the zero-entrainment regime considered here. In this type-1.5 regime, the fluxtube-fluxtube interaction is repulsive at short distances and attractive at intermediate distances, leading to self-assembled clusters while the individual fluxtubes remain topologically distinct. Possible implications for dissipative coupling and transport in neutron stars are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究中子星外核中与质子超导体耦合的中子超流体介观构型。研究发现，在局域吸引性耦合下，中子涡旋与质子磁通管的重叠具有能量优势，可形成围绕中子涡旋的有限磁通管聚集体，即“磁通管花束”。此外，零拖曳条件下仍可能存在1.5型行为，使磁通管在短程排斥、中程吸引的作用下自组装成簇，并可能影响中子星中的耗散耦合与输运。
authors: Adarsh Karekkat, Gabriele Montefusco, Marco Antonelli
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了中子星外核中与质子超导体耦合的中子超流体的介观构型。我们采用具有局域耦合的双组分金兹堡-朗道自由能描述这两种凝聚态，并忽略真正的相位梯度拖曳效应。在二维空间中，我们利用准周期性边界条件和受约束的相位印刻计算来最小化自由能，从而研究涡旋-磁通管以及磁通管-磁通管之间的相互作用。我们发现，对于自由能中的局域吸引性耦合，涡旋与磁通管发生重叠在能量上是有利的；若干预先存在的质子磁通管可以围绕一个中子涡旋结合，形成以涡旋为中心的有限聚集体，我们将其称为磁通管花束。这些花束构型可能变得非常致密，以至于一个涡旋实际上能够容纳多个磁通量子。我们还证实，1.5型行为可能存在，并发现即使在本文考察的零拖曳条件下，这种行为仍然能够保持。在这一1.5型区域中，磁通管-磁通管相互作用在短距离处表现为排斥、在中等距离处表现为吸引，从而导致磁通管自组装成簇，同时各个磁通管在拓扑上仍彼此独立。我们讨论了这些结果对中子星中耗散耦合与输运可能产生的影响。

articles.title: Symmetry Origins of the Field-Free Superconducting Diode Effect in the Kagome Superconductor CsV₃Sb₅
articles.title_zh: 笼目超导体CsV₃Sb₅中无磁场超导二极管效应的对称性起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Field-free superconducting diode effects require both inversion-symmetry breaking and an internal time-reversal-symmetry (TRS) breaking field, making them sensitive probes of hidden order in superconductors. In centrosymmetric kagome AV₃Sb₅, the inversion symmetry generally should generally preclude the observation of the superconducting diode effect. Furthermore, though TRS breaking has been reported in the superconducting regime of CsV₃Sb₅, whether it is generated by superconductivity or inherited from charge-density-wave (CDW) order remains unresolved. Here we show that pristine CsV₃Sb₅ devices exhibit no intrinsic field-free superconducting diode effect, whereas surface oxidation or asymmetric etching activates a large nonreciprocal supercurrent. Moreover, the response is stochastic, with sweep-dependent polarity and magnitude, indicating metastable TRS-breaking domain configurations. Small out-of-plane magnetic fields stabilize the superconducting diode response, consistent with field selection of such domains. Finally, when long-range CDW order is suppressed by Ti doping, the SDE disappears. Our results establish the symmetry requirements for the field-free SDE in CsV₃Sb₅, reveal its stochastic domain-controlled character, and link superconducting-state TRS breaking to CDW-related order.
articles.abstract_zh: 无磁场超导二极管效应需要反演对称性破缺和内部时间反演对称性破缺场，因此可用于探测超导体中的隐序。本文发现，未经处理的CsV₃Sb₅器件不存在内禀的无磁场超导二极管效应，而表面氧化或非对称刻蚀会激活显著的非互易超电流。该响应具有随机性并受亚稳态时间反演对称性破缺畴控制；当长程电荷密度波序被Ti掺杂抑制时，超导二极管效应也随之消失。
authors: Xin-Jie Liu, Shengbiao Sun, Ke-Fan Song, Jia-Peng Peng, Xilin Feng, Lang Xiao, Tong Liu, Qilin Han, Ya-Qing Bie, Ning Kang, Xiaosong Wu, Yanfei Wu, Shouguo Wang, Kam Tuen Law, Shuo Wang, Dapeng Yu, Ben-Chuan Lin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无磁场超导二极管效应同时要求反演对称性破缺和内部时间反演对称性（TRS）破缺场，因此对超导体中的隐序十分敏感。在具有中心对称性的笼目材料AV₃Sb₅中，反演对称性通常应当阻止超导二极管效应的观测。此外，尽管已有研究在CsV₃Sb₅的超导态中报告了时间反演对称性破缺，但这种破缺究竟由超导性产生，还是继承自电荷密度波（CDW）序，仍未解决。在此，我们表明，未经处理的CsV₃Sb₅器件不存在内禀的无磁场超导二极管效应，而表面氧化或非对称刻蚀则会激活较大的非互易超电流。此外，该响应具有随机性，其极性和幅值会随扫描过程而变化，这表明体系存在亚稳态的时间反演对称性破缺畴构型。微小的面外磁场能够稳定超导二极管响应，这与磁场选择此类畴构型的机制相一致。最后，当通过Ti掺杂抑制长程CDW序时，超导二极管效应消失。我们的结果确立了CsV₃Sb₅中无磁场超导二极管效应的对称性要求，揭示了其由畴控制的随机特征，并将超导态中的时间反演对称性破缺与CDW相关序联系起来。

articles.title: Rare-earth oxysulfides RE₂O₂S as model mixed-anion frustrated magnets
articles.title_zh: 作为混合阴离子受挫磁体模型的稀土氧硫化物RE₂O₂S
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26023v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The study of low-dimensional and anisotropic magnetism is a promising avenue for the discovery of novel quantum phenomena. Mixed-anion materials, defined by the coordination of metal cations by two or more distinct anionic species, provide an intrinsically anisotropic platform for the tuning of structural, magnetic, and electronic properties. In this work, we report the synthesis and characterization of a family of rare-earth oxysulfide (RE₂O₂S) antiferromagnets (AFM) possessing a triangular-bilayer slab lattice geometry. Long-range AFM order is observed for the majority of compositions, with several (RE = Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm) having been previously unreported. Although assumed to form stoichiometrically, pair distribution function (PDF) analysis provides evidence for significant, synthesis-dependent interslab structural disorder as RE₂O₂₊ₓS₁₋ₓ, resulting in significant variability in the bulk magnetic response of the Nd member. This work highlights the tunability of frustrated magnetic ground states in rare-earth-based mixed-anion materials, and the importance of thorough structural characterization in the discovery of new mixed-anion magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文合成并表征了一系列具有三角形双层片层晶格结构的稀土氧硫化物反铁磁体RE₂O₂S，其中包括此前未被报道的Ce、Pr、Nd和Sm组分。多数成分表现出长程反铁磁有序，但PDF分析显示，样品中存在依赖合成条件的层间结构无序，并可形成RE₂O₂₊ₓS₁₋ₓ。该无序导致Nd组分的体磁响应显著变化，说明混合阴离子材料中的受挫磁基态具有可调性，同时凸显了细致结构表征的重要性。
authors: Austin M. Ferrenti, Ksenia Khoroshun, Mohamed Oudah, Graham King, Jonathan Gaudet, Alannah M. Hallas
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低维和各向异性磁性的研究，是发现新型量子现象的一条有前景的途径。混合阴离子材料是指金属阳离子由两种或更多种不同阴离子配位的材料，它们提供了一个可内禀调控结构、磁性和电子性质的各向异性平台。在本工作中，我们报告了一系列稀土氧硫化物（RE₂O₂S）反铁磁体的合成与表征，这些材料具有三角形双层片层晶格几何结构。大多数成分中都观察到了长程反铁磁有序，其中若干成分（RE = Ce、Pr、Nd、Sm）此前尚未被报道。尽管通常认为这些材料按化学计量比形成，但对分布函数（PDF）的分析表明，存在显著的、依赖合成条件的层间结构无序，其形式为RE₂O₂₊ₓS₁₋ₓ，并导致Nd组分的体磁响应发生显著变化。这项工作凸显了稀土基混合阴离子材料中受挫磁基态的可调控性，也说明在发现新的混合阴离子磁体时，进行全面的结构表征十分重要。

articles.title: Oxidation-resilient structural modifications in Nickel-functionalized 3D-graphene for hydrogen storage applications
articles.title_zh: 用于储氢应用的镍功能化三维石墨烯中的抗氧化结构改性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Porous materials represent a versatile solution for several applications. Indeed, the recent development of a new material, named 3D-Graphene, which combines the exceptional characteristics of graphene with a three-dimensional structure, opens perspectives for applications where a high surface-to-volume ratio is beneficial. In this study, we explore the functionalization of 3D-Graphene with nickel (Ni)-nanoparticles as a strategy to enhance hydrogen storage capabilities, and we assess the influence of the NPs on hydrogen uptake and oxidation resilience. The morphology and structural properties of pristine and Ni-functionalized samples were characterized using Scanning Electron Microscopy. Additionally, X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy was employed to analyze the surface chemical composition of the functionalized samples. Samples have been hydrogenated supplying molecular or atomic hydrogen, and hydrogen storage performance was assessed through Thermal Desorption Spectroscopy. Afterwards, oxidation effects were systematically studied by exposing the samples to atmospheric oxygen, followed by further hydrogenation experiments. Our results indicate that Ni functionalization influences both hydrogen adsorption and oxidation behavior, with potential implications for improving the stability of the material, especially for hydrogen storage applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究利用镍纳米颗粒对三维石墨烯进行功能化，以增强其储氢能力，并评估镍纳米颗粒对吸氢性能和抗氧化性的影响。研究采用扫描电子显微镜、X射线光电子能谱和热脱附谱等方法，对原始及镍功能化样品进行了形貌、表面化学组成和储氢性能表征。结果表明，镍功能化同时影响氢吸附与氧化行为，可能有助于提高该材料在储氢应用中的稳定性。
authors: Filippo Fincato, Ylea Vlamidis, Markus Leitgeb, Georg Pfusterschmied, Ulrich Schmid, Valentina Zannier, Silvia Rubini, Stefan Heun, Stefano Veronesi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多孔材料为多种应用提供了灵活的解决方案。近年来，一种名为三维石墨烯的新材料得到发展，它将石墨烯的优异特性与三维结构相结合，从而为高表面积体积比有利的应用开辟了新的可能性。在本研究中，我们探讨了利用镍（Ni）纳米颗粒对三维石墨烯进行功能化的策略，以增强其储氢能力，并评估纳米颗粒对吸氢性能和抗氧化性的影响。我们使用扫描电子显微镜对原始样品和镍功能化样品的形貌与结构性质进行了表征。此外，还利用X射线光电子能谱分析功能化样品的表面化学组成。样品分别通过供给分子氢或原子氢进行氢化，并通过热脱附谱评估储氢性能。随后，我们将样品暴露于大气氧中，系统研究氧化效应，并进一步开展氢化实验。结果表明，镍功能化会同时影响氢吸附行为和氧化行为，这对于提高材料的稳定性，尤其是面向储氢应用的稳定性，具有潜在意义。

articles.title: Electron spin resonance driven photogalvanic effect in graphene-based structures
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯基结构中电子自旋共振驱动的光伏伽伐尼效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26026v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report an electron-spin-resonance-driven linear photogalvanic effect (LPGE) in unbiased monolayer graphene and WSe₂/graphene heterostructures. Under linearly polarized 45--75 GHz radiation, the photovoltage exhibits pronounced resonant features in both Faraday and Voigt geometries. Multiple resonances associated with the electron spin resonance in graphene are observed for both out-of-plane and in-plane magnetic-field orientations. Their magnetic-field positions vary linearly with frequency, their amplitudes reverse sign across the charge-neutrality point, and the resonant contribution has the opposite sign to the nonresonant Drude photogalvanic background. We develop a microscopic theory in which radiation-induced momentum alignment followed by skew scattering generates both contributions. Their opposite signs originate from the orthogonal momentum alignments produced by indirect Drude absorption and direct spin-resonant transitions. The theory describes well the main features of the observed resonant photocurrent and provides a microscopic description of ESR-induced LPGE in two-dimensional systems. These results establish the photogalvanic response as a probe of ESR in unbiased micron-scale graphene-based devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了无偏置单层石墨烯以及WSe₂/石墨烯异质结构中的电子自旋共振驱动线性光伏伽伐尼效应。在45至75 GHz线偏振辐射下，法拉第和沃伊特几何构型中均出现显著共振光电压特征；共振位置随频率线性变化，并在电荷中性点两侧发生变号。理论表明，辐射诱导的动量排列及随后发生的偏斜散射可产生共振和非共振贡献，其相反符号源于两种正交的动量排列。
authors: C. Bray, I. Yahniuk, L. E. Golub, M. Marocko, C. Consejo, B. Benhamou-Bui, Ziyang Gan, A. George, A. Turchanin, P. Sadovyi, K. Watanabe, T. Taniguchi, J. Eroms, J. Fabian, F. Teppe, S. D. Ganichev
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报道了在无偏置单层石墨烯和WSe₂/石墨烯异质结构中由电子自旋共振驱动的线性光伏伽伐尼效应（LPGE）。在45至75 GHz的线偏振辐射下，无论在法拉第几何构型还是沃伊特几何构型中，光电压都表现出显著的共振特征。在面外和面内磁场取向下，我们都观察到了多个与石墨烯中的电子自旋共振相关的共振峰。它们的磁场位置随频率线性变化，幅值在电荷中性点两侧发生反转，而且共振贡献的符号与非共振德鲁德光伏伽伐尼背景相反。我们建立了一个微观理论，其中辐射诱导的动量排列随后通过偏斜散射产生这两种贡献。它们符号相反的原因在于，间接德鲁德吸收和直接自旋共振跃迁产生了相互正交的动量排列。该理论较好地描述了观测到的共振光电流的主要特征，并为二维系统中由电子自旋共振诱导的线性光伏伽伐尼效应提供了微观解释。这些结果确立了光伏伽伐尼响应可作为无偏置微米尺度石墨烯基器件中电子自旋共振的探测手段。

articles.title: Depth Control of Room-Temperature Quantum Emitters in Gallium Nitride
articles.title_zh: 氮化镓中室温量子发射体的深度控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26057v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bright quantum emitters are key components for quantum communication systems. Radiative point defects in gallium nitride (GaN) are promising candidates for room-temperature single-photon emission, operating from the visible to the telecom O-band. Despite their potential, their integration into photonic structures has remained limited in the literature, with experimental photon extraction efficiencies far below simulated predictions. To identify the origin of this limitation, we investigate visible and near-infrared quantum emitters in GaN epilayers grown on c-plane sapphire substrates exhibiting narrow linewidths (sim4 nm), high photon count rates ( > 2 MHz), and strong antibunching, reaching g⁽²⁾(0) values as low as 0.06 at room temperature. We find that these emitters are located near the GaN/substrate interface, explaining their limited coupling to optical modes. Building on this observation, we show that the insertion of a thin low-temperature GaN interlayer enables the formation of quantum emitters at arbitrary depths with sub-60 nm accuracy, independent of the substrate. The intentionally introduced emitters retain optical properties comparable to naturally occurring ones, including narrow linewidths (sim6 nm), saturation count rates exceeding 1.5 MHz, high Debye-Waller factors (0.69-0.98), and strong antibunching. The resulting epilayer fully coalesces within less than 250 nm ensuring compatibility with GaN-based cavity fabrication and enabling emitter placement within intrinsic regions of p-i-n diode architectures. These results mark a decisive step toward efficient emitter-cavity coupling, enabling the realization of cavity-enhanced quantum emission in GaN.
articles.abstract_zh: 明亮的量子发射体是量子通信系统的关键组件，氮化镓中的辐射点缺陷有望实现室温单光子发射。本文发现，生长在蓝宝石衬底上的氮化镓外延层中的天然发射体靠近氮化镓/衬底界面，这解释了其与光学模式耦合受限的原因。通过引入低温生长的薄氮化镓中间层，研究者实现了与衬底无关、精度优于60 nm的任意深度发射体形成，同时保持了较窄线宽、高计数率和强反聚束等优良光学性质，为高效发射体-腔耦合和氮化镓腔增强量子发射奠定基础。
authors: Alexandros Bampis, Johann Stachurski, Anna Schwab, Jean-François Carlin, Raphaël Butté, Nicolas Grandjean
articles.abstract_zh_full: 明亮的量子发射体是量子通信系统的关键组件。氮化镓（GaN）中的辐射点缺陷是室温单光子发射的有前景候选者，其工作波段可覆盖可见光至电信O波段。尽管它们具有潜力，但相关发射体在光子结构中的集成在文献中仍然有限，实验光子提取效率远低于模拟预测值。为确定这一限制的起源，我们研究了生长在c面蓝宝石衬底上的GaN外延层中的可见光和近红外量子发射体；这些发射体具有窄线宽（约4 nm）、较高光子计数率（超过2 MHz）和强反聚束特性，在室温下的g⁽²⁾(0)值最低可达0.06。我们发现，这些发射体位于GaN/衬底界面附近，从而解释了它们与光学模式耦合受限的原因。在此观察基础上，我们表明，插入一层薄的低温生长GaN中间层，能够以低于60 nm的精度在任意深度形成量子发射体，并且这一结果与衬底无关。通过这种方式有意引入的发射体保留了与天然发射体相当的光学性质，包括窄线宽（约6 nm）、超过1.5 MHz的饱和计数率、较高的德拜-沃勒因子（0.69至0.98）以及强反聚束特性。所得外延层在小于250 nm的厚度内实现了完全并合，从而兼容基于GaN的腔体制备，并能够将发射体放置在p-i-n二极管结构的本征区内。这些结果标志着实现高效发射体-腔耦合的关键进展，并为实现GaN中的腔增强量子发射创造了条件。

articles.title: Incommensurate spin fluctuations in one-dimensional Kondo metal CeCo2Ga8
articles.title_zh: 一维近藤金属CeCo₂Ga₈中的非公度自旋涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an experimental and numerical study of the spin fluctuations in 1D Kondo metal CeCo₂Ga₈. Using inelastic neutron spectroscopy, we measure highly one-dimensional magnetism with low-energy incommensurate short-ranged magnetic fluctuations. ARPES similarly shows a highly one-dimensional electronic band structure, confirming the one-dimensional nature of the system. We use density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) simulations of the 1D Kondo lattice model to interpret the measured spectrum, which successfully reproduce the neutron scattering features. We are thus able to place CeCo₂Ga₈ within the emergent incommensurate phase of the 1D Kondo lattice phase diagram, and demonstrate that the Kondo lattice simulated non-perturbatively is an accurate microscopic model for heavy fermion physics. This shows CeCo₂Ga₈ to be one-dimensional despite its complexities, and reveals a coexistence of low-energy Kondo and magnetic features in its inelastic spectrum.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合实验与数值计算研究了一维近藤金属CeCo₂Ga₈中的自旋涨落。非弹性中子谱显示，该材料具有高度一维的磁性和低能非公度短程磁涨落，角分辨光电子能谱也证实其电子能带结构高度一维。密度矩阵重整化群模拟能够再现实验中的中子散射特征，从而将CeCo₂Ga₈置于一维近藤晶格相图的涌现非公度相中，并揭示其低能谱中近藤效应与磁性特征的共存。
authors: Yixuan Huang, P. Murgatroyd, Yi Wu, M. Cook, P. F. S. Rosa, E. D. Bauer, Asish K. Kundu, A. Rajapitamahuni, E. Vescovo, S. Zhang, V. Anil, P. Piyawongwatthana, N. Murai, M. Kofu, K. M. Shen, F. Ronning, Jian-Xin Zhu, A. Scheie
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对一维近藤金属CeCo₂Ga₈中的自旋涨落进行了实验和数值研究。利用非弹性中子谱学，我们测量到高度一维的磁性以及低能非公度短程磁涨落。角分辨光电子能谱同样显示出高度一维的电子能带结构，证实了该体系的一维性质。我们采用一维近藤晶格模型的密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）模拟来解释所测得的谱，并成功再现了中子散射实验中的特征。因此，我们能够将CeCo₂Ga₈置于一维近藤晶格相图中的涌现非公度相，并表明以非微扰方式模拟的近藤晶格模型，是描述重费米子物理的准确微观模型。这说明尽管CeCo₂Ga₈具有复杂性，它仍然是一维体系，并揭示了其非弹性谱中低能近藤特征与磁性特征的共存。

articles.title: Exact analytical spectrum, eigenstates, and quantum geometry of the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model
articles.title_zh: 四分之一磁通Harper-Hofstadter模型的精确解析谱、本征态与量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry has emerged as a guiding principle across atomic and condensed-matter physics, shaping the topological responses of Bloch bands and the stability of the correlated phases they host. Beyond two-band models, however, closed-form expressions for both the spectrum and the quantum geometry are rare. Here we provide such expressions for a paradigmatic four-band model that has recently been realized experimentally with ultracold atoms, photons and in superconducting circuits: the Harper-Hofstadter model at quarter flux, describing charged particles on a two-dimensional square lattice subjected to a uniform magnetic field. We achieve this by first showing that the model possesses a sublattice symmetry, which renders its Bloch Hamiltonian anti-block-diagonal allowing us to derive the spectrum and the eigenstates analytically. From that we also obtain closed-form expressions for the full quantum geometric tensor (QGT), including both the Berry curvature and the quantum metric, for all the bands of the model. For this purpose we first derive a general expression for the QGT for sublattice-symmetric systems in terms of contributions from the individual sublattice sectors. Finally, we evaluate fractional-Chern-insulator stability criteria analytically and quantify the lowest band of the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model to be a nearly ideal Chern band.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为四分之一磁通Harper-Hofstadter模型这一四能带体系推导了能谱、本征态以及完整量子几何张量的闭式解析表达式。研究利用模型的亚晶格对称性，将布洛赫哈密顿量化为反块对角形式，从而解析得到所有能带的贝里曲率和量子度规。进一步的解析计算表明，该模型的最低能带近似为理想陈能带，并具有有利于分数陈绝缘体稳定性的量子几何性质。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子几何已经成为原子物理和凝聚态物理中的一个指导性原则，它影响着布洛赫能带的拓扑响应以及其中相关相的稳定性。然而，除了双能带模型之外，同时获得能谱和量子几何的闭式表达式仍然十分少见。在这里，我们为一种最近已在超冷原子、光子和超导电路中实现的典型四能带模型提供了这类表达式：四分之一磁通下的Harper-Hofstadter模型，该模型描述了处于均匀磁场中的二维方格晶格上的带电粒子。我们首先证明该模型具有亚晶格对称性，这使其布洛赫哈密顿量呈反块对角形式，并由此能够解析推导能谱和本征态。在此基础上，我们还为模型的所有能带获得了完整量子几何张量（QGT）的闭式表达式，其中包括贝里曲率和量子度规。为此，我们首先推导了亚晶格对称体系中QGT的一般表达式，该表达式由各个亚晶格扇区的贡献构成。最后，我们解析评估了分数陈绝缘体的稳定性判据，并定量表明四分之一磁通Harper-Hofstadter模型的最低能带是近乎理想的陈能带。

articles.title: Multicomponent Magnetic Domain Walls in Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 菱方相石墨烯中的多组分磁畴壁
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26104v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spatial textures of magnetic order, such as domain walls and skyrmions, are fundamental objects in magnetism. In rhombohedral multilayer graphene, magnetic order involves spin and valley degrees of freedom, opening the possibility of qualitatively new spatial textures. Here, we explore this possibility through a microscopic study of a one-dimensional domain wall in the valley-imbalanced quarter-metal phase of rhombohedral graphene. We uncover two different classes of domain walls. One resembles a conventional magnetic domain wall, locally rotating between the two bulk states, whereas the other is intrinsically multicomponent and explores states that are not occupied in either bulk domain. Which texture is realized is controlled by the competition between intervalley Hund's coupling and spin-orbit coupling, and we identify experimental signatures to distinguish them. We further show that, in a superconducting junction formed across the wall, the superconducting phase difference couples directly to the intervalley-coherent phase of the texture. Precession of this internal phase can therefore generate a voltage across the junction. Our theory shows that rhombohedral graphene indeed has magnetic textures beyond conventional magnet and that their dynamics can couple to superconducting transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 菱方相多层石墨烯中的磁序同时涉及自旋和谷自由度，因此可能支持不同于传统磁体的新型空间纹理。本文对菱方相石墨烯谷不平衡四分之一金属相中的一维磁畴壁进行了微观研究，发现了两类畴壁：一类类似传统磁畴壁，在两个体相态之间局域旋转；另一类具有内禀多组分特征，会经过两个体畴均未占据的状态。两类纹理由谷间洪德耦合与自旋轨道耦合的竞争决定，并可通过跨畴超导结中的相位差耦合到纹理的谷间相干相位，从而产生电压。
authors: Mainak Das, Nemin Wei, Chunli Huang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁有序的空间纹理，例如畴壁和斯格明子，是磁学中的基本对象。在菱方相多层石墨烯中，磁序涉及自旋和谷自由度，从而为定性不同的新型空间纹理提供了可能性。在这里，我们通过微观研究探讨了这一可能性，研究对象是菱方相石墨烯的谷不平衡四分之一金属相中的一维畴壁。我们发现了两种不同类别的畴壁。其中一类类似于传统磁畴壁，在两个体相态之间发生局域旋转；另一类则具有内禀的多组分特征，会探索两个体畴中均未被占据的状态。究竟形成哪种纹理，取决于谷间洪德耦合与自旋轨道耦合之间的竞争，我们还确定了可以区分它们的实验特征。进一步地，我们表明，在跨越该畴壁形成的超导结中，超导相位差会直接耦合到纹理的谷间相干相位。因此，这一内部相位的进动能够在结两端产生电压。我们的理论表明，菱方相石墨烯确实具有超越传统磁体的磁性纹理，并且这些纹理的动力学能够与超导输运发生耦合。

articles.title: Exact topology of conservative multiplicative cascades: An ultrametric transfer-operator genus
articles.title_zh: 守恒乘法级联的精确拓扑：超度量转移算子亏格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24897v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The multiplicative cascade is a well-known method for generating random fields that are both genuinely non-Gaussian and scale invariant. Its one-point and scaling statistics, namely the multifractal spectra τ(q), D_q, and f(α), are known exactly; however, its geometric and topological measures are not. In this work, we show that the topological structures of a conservative (microcanonical) random permutation cascade can be precisely predicted. We compute the digital (cubical) Euler characteristic, or genus, of the level-j excursion set of the two-dimensional cascade in closed form, using a transfer operator on the cascade's b-ary tree closed by its ultrametric structure and a conservative without-replacement sibling split. The result requires no Monte Carlo and matches simulated realizations with a maximum residual of sim!10⁻⁴ in the Euler density, a controlled discretization artifact of the atomic measure. We tie the genus scaling analytically to the multifractal spectrum, and show that for a geometric ladder of weights the genus is exactly self-similar under the multifractal-width dial. The construction uses the tree-sum cumulant machinery of Greiner et al. (Phys. Rev. E 58, 554, 1998), specialized to topological functionals; the conservative split carries the microcanonical fingerprint Cov(łn wₐ,łn w_b)/Var(łn w)=-1/(n-1) that distinguishes it from canonical and lognormal cascades. The cascade is the multiplicative counterpart of the Rayleigh--Lévy flight and a controlled benchmark for the morphology of strongly non-Gaussian fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文精确预测了守恒的微正则随机置换乘法级联中二维层级等值集的数字立方欧拉示性数或亏格。研究通过由级联的b叉树及其超度量结构构成的转移算子，并结合不放回的守恒兄弟分裂，推导出无需蒙特卡洛模拟的闭式结果；该结果与模拟实现高度吻合。作者进一步将亏格标度与多重分形谱联系起来，并指出几何权重阶梯下的亏格关于多重分形宽度参数具有精确自相似性，使该构造成为强非高斯场形态学的可控基准。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 乘法级联是一种众所周知的方法，可用于生成同时具有真正非高斯性和尺度不变性的随机场。它的单点统计和标度统计，即多重分形谱τ(q)、D_q和f(α)，已经可以精确获得；然而，其几何和拓扑测度尚未得到精确确定。在本工作中，我们表明，守恒的（微正则）随机置换级联的拓扑结构可以被精确预测。我们利用定义在级联b叉树上的转移算子，并通过其超度量结构以及守恒的无放回兄弟分裂将其闭合，以闭式形式计算二维级联第j层外逸集的数字立方欧拉示性数，即亏格。所得结果不需要蒙特卡洛模拟，并且与模拟实现相吻合；欧拉密度的最大残差约为10⁻⁴，这一残差是由原子测度产生的受控离散化伪差。我们在解析上将亏格标度与多重分形谱联系起来，并表明，对于几何权重阶梯，亏格关于多重分形宽度调节参数具有精确的自相似性。该构造使用了Greiner等人发表于《物理评论E》58卷554页（1998年）的树和累积量方法，并将其专门用于拓扑泛函；守恒分裂携带了微正则体系的特征，其协方差关系为Cov(ln wₐ, ln w_b)/Var(ln w) = -1/(n-1)，这一区别将其与正则级联和对数正态级联区分开来。该级联是瑞利-莱维飞行的乘法对应物，也是研究强非高斯场形态学的可控基准。

articles.title: Multi-Species Multi-Reaction Model Parametrization of a Commercial NCA Positive Electrode from Half-Cell Open-Circuit Potential Data
articles.title_zh: 基于半电池开路电位数据的商用NCA正极多物种多反应模型参数化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24922v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-based models of lithium-ion batteries require the open-circuit potential (OCP) of each electrode as a function of its lithiation. The multi-species multi-reaction (MSMR) model provides a compact, thermodynamically grounded description of this relationship, representing each insertion reaction by a standard potential, a site fraction and a disorder parameter. Here, we parametrize the MSMR model for nickel-cobalt-aluminum oxide (NCA), a cathode chemistry widespread in automotive cells, using the positive electrode of a commercial silicon-graphite/NCA cell. Cathode material was harvested from a pristine cell and from cells cycle-aged to the end of life under two state-of-charge windows, and its half-cell OCP was measured by slow galvanostatic cycling. Smooth differential-capacity curves were obtained by histogram counting, and the charge and discharge branches were fitted with a constrained, scale-invariant optimization that keeps every reaction anchored to a visible peak. We report the first MSMR parameter set for an NCA cathode and show, through a differential-capacity peak analysis across aging states, that its thermodynamic signature is essentially unchanged by aging. This finding supports the common modeling practice of holding the electrode's intrinsic parameters fixed and ascribing aging to electrode-level capacity and alignment changes.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于物理的锂离子电池模型需要描述各电极开路电位随嵌锂程度变化的关系。本文利用商用硅石墨/NCA电池的正极，通过缓慢恒流循环测量半电池开路电位，并对镍钴铝氧化物正极建立多物种多反应模型参数。研究报告了首个NCA正极MSMR参数集，并发现不同老化状态下其微分容量峰所反映的热力学特征基本不变，支持在模型中固定电极内禀参数、将老化归因于电极层面容量和对齐变化的做法。
authors: Michele Galasso, Petr Čech, Ivo Horstkötter, Simon Schwunk, Zuzana Vlčková Živcová, Václav Knap
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于物理的锂离子电池模型需要获得每个电极的开路电位（OCP）随其嵌锂程度变化的关系。多物种多反应（MSMR）模型以紧凑且具有热力学基础的方式描述这一关系，其中每个嵌入反应由标准电位、位点分数和无序参数表示。在本研究中，我们利用一款商用硅石墨/NCA电池的正极，对镍钴铝氧化物（NCA）这一汽车电池中广泛使用的正极化学体系进行了MSMR模型参数化。我们从未使用过的电池以及在两个荷电状态窗口下循环老化至寿命终点的电池中取出正极材料，并通过缓慢的恒流循环测量其半电池OCP。我们采用直方图计数获得了平滑的微分容量曲线，并使用受约束且具有尺度不变性的优化方法对其进行拟合，使每个反应都锚定在一个可见峰上。我们报告了首个NCA正极MSMR参数集，并通过比较不同老化状态下的微分容量峰表明，其热力学特征基本不受老化影响。这一发现支持一种常见的建模做法，即保持电极的内禀参数不变，并将老化归因于电极层面的容量变化和对齐变化。

articles.title: Mixed-State Symmetry-Protected Topology and Strong-to-Weak Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking in a Superconducting Qubit Array
articles.title_zh: 超导量子比特阵列中的混合态对称性保护拓扑与从强到弱的自发对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24993v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We experimentally investigate how symmetry-protected topological order in a one-dimensional cluster state is transformed by measurement and decoherence in a five-qubit superconducting array. We first characterize the state's nonlocal string order and show that controlled dephasing selectively suppresses one symmetry sector while leaving the other robust, consistent with average symmetry-protected topological order. We then measure one sublattice in a tunable basis and show that the remaining qubits are driven between a long-range-entangled GHZ state and a paramagnetic state. When the measurement record is discarded, the conventional long-range correlator vanishes while a nonlinear fidelity correlator remains finite, providing a finite-size signature of strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. These experiments demonstrate how conditioning, averaging, and decoherence reveal distinct manifestations of order encoded in the same underlying cluster state, and establish a superconducting-circuit setting for probing mixed-state symmetry and topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在五量子比特超导阵列中实验研究一维簇态的对称性保护拓扑序如何受到测量和退相干的影响。受控退相干会选择性抑制一个对称性扇区而保留另一个，符合平均意义下的对称性保护拓扑序；对一个子晶格进行可调基测量，则可使其余量子比特在长程纠缠GHZ态和顺磁态之间转变。当舍弃测量记录时，传统长程关联函数消失，而非线性保真度关联函数仍保持有限，从而显示出从强到弱自发对称性破缺的有限尺寸特征。
authors: Qian Cao, Zhen Bi, Kater W. Murch
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在一个由五个量子比特组成的超导阵列中，实验研究了测量和退相干如何改变一维簇态中的对称性保护拓扑序。我们首先表征该态的非局域弦序，并表明受控退相干会选择性地抑制一个对称性扇区，同时使另一个扇区保持稳健，这与平均意义下的对称性保护拓扑序相一致。随后，我们在可调基底下测量一个子晶格，并表明剩余量子比特会在长程纠缠的GHZ态和顺磁态之间转变。当舍弃测量记录时，传统的长程关联函数消失，而非线性保真度关联函数仍保持有限，从而提供了从强到弱自发对称性破缺的有限尺寸特征。这些实验展示了条件选择、平均处理和退相干如何揭示同一底层簇态中编码的不同有序表现，并建立了一个可用于探测混合态对称性与拓扑的超导电路平台。

articles.title: What Should a Large Language Model See? Physical Invariants as a Data Representation for PDE Discovery
articles.title_zh: 大型语言模型应该看到什么？作为偏微分方程发现数据表示的物理不变量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25189v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding how molecular interactions govern macroscopic behaviour is a central challenge in molecular sciences. However, conventional theory building cannot keep pace with the vast datasets modern experimentation routinely produces. Large language models offer a promising route to automating theory construction, but a spatiotemporal field cannot be directly placed in a prompt. Existing models generally learn about the data only through a score measuring how well each proposal fits it. Here we introduce data interpretation, a stage that measures the field into the quantities a theorist would consult and supplies them to the model as a direct input. On a benchmark of simulated fields, interpretation nearly triples the accuracy of recovered equations relative to showing the raw data, at negligible computational cost and without any training. By allowing a language model to read field data as a theorist does, data interpretation offers a practical route to automated field theory construction that can coevolve with experimentation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出“数据解释”阶段，将时空场测量为理论家通常会参考的物理量，并将其直接提供给大型语言模型。在模拟场基准测试中，相较于直接输入原始数据，该方法使恢复方程的准确率接近提高三倍，且几乎不增加计算成本、无需训练。研究表明，按照理论家的方式解释场数据，可为自动化场理论构建提供实用途径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解分子相互作用如何支配宏观行为，是分子科学领域面临的核心挑战。然而，传统的理论构建方式难以跟上现代实验持续产生的海量数据。大型语言模型为自动化理论构建提供了一条有前景的途径，但时空场无法直接放入提示词中。现有模型通常只能通过衡量每个候选方案对数据的拟合程度来学习数据。本文引入了数据解释这一阶段：它将场测量为理论家会参考的物理量，并将这些量作为直接输入提供给模型。在模拟场基准测试中，与展示原始数据相比，数据解释使恢复方程的准确率接近提高三倍，同时几乎不增加计算成本，也无需任何训练。通过让语言模型像理论家一样读取场数据，数据解释为自动化场理论构建提供了一条能够与实验协同演化的实用途径。

articles.title: Oscillator-Based Processing Unit for Formant Recognition
articles.title_zh: 用于共振峰识别的基于振荡器的处理单元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25191v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Oscillatory neural networks have been successfully applied to a number of computing problems, such as associative memories and computationally hard optimization tasks. In this paper, we show how to use oscillators to process time-dependent waveforms with minimal or no preprocessing. Since preprocessing and first-layer processing are often the most power-hungry steps in neural networks, our findings may open new doors to simple and power-efficient edge-AI devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究利用振荡器在几乎不进行预处理的情况下处理时间变化波形。振荡神经网络此前已成功应用于联想记忆和计算复杂的优化任务等问题。由于预处理和神经网络第一层处理通常是最耗能的步骤，该方法可能为简单且高能效的边缘人工智能设备开辟新方向。
authors: Tamás Rudner-Halász, Wolfgang Porod, Gyorgy Csaba
articles.abstract_zh_full: 振荡神经网络已经成功应用于多种计算问题，例如联想记忆和计算上困难的优化任务。在本文中，我们展示了如何利用振荡器以极少或不进行预处理的方式处理时间相关波形。由于预处理和第一层处理通常是神经网络中最耗电的步骤，我们的发现可能为简单且高能效的边缘人工智能设备开辟新的发展方向。

articles.title: The temperature-dependent non-Abelian gauge potential
articles.title_zh: 温度依赖的非阿贝尔规范势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25437v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This study shows that the usual time evolution operator can act as a U(1) gauge transformation on the initial wavefuntion. When considering the spin freedom in the system, the time evolution operator corresponds to a non-Abelian SU(2) gauge transformation for spin-1/2 particles and a SU(3) gauge transformation for spin-1 particles. If we adopt the adiabatic approximation in the magnetization dynamics of a ferromagnetic system driven by a spin-polarized current, a temperature-dependent non-Abelian thermal gauge potential will appear. We can employ a temperature-dependent Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert (LLG) equation to describe the magnetization dynamics in the semi-classical limit, a linear approximated solution for this equation is given analytically.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，通常的时间演化算符可以在初始波函数上充当 U(1) 规范变换；考虑自旋自由度后，对于自旋 1/2 粒子和自旋 1 粒子，它分别对应非阿贝尔 SU(2) 和 SU(3) 规范变换。在绝热近似下，受自旋极化电流驱动的铁磁系统磁化动力学中会出现温度依赖的非阿贝尔热规范势。作者进一步给出用于描述半经典磁化动力学的温度依赖 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 方程及其线性近似解析解。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究表明，通常的时间演化算符可以在初始波函数上充当 U(1) 规范变换。当考虑系统中的自旋自由度时，对于自旋 1/2 粒子，时间演化算符对应于非阿贝尔 SU(2) 规范变换；对于自旋 1 粒子，则对应于 SU(3) 规范变换。如果在自旋极化电流驱动的铁磁系统磁化动力学中采用绝热近似，就会出现温度依赖的非阿贝尔热规范势。在半经典极限下，我们可以采用温度依赖的 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert（LLG）方程描述磁化动力学，并且可以对该方程给出线性近似的解析解。

articles.title: Superextensive learning in quantum reservoirs at the onset of information scrambling
articles.title_zh: 信息扰乱起始点处量子储备池中的超广延学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25511v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The idea that information processing is optimised near the boundary between order and chaos has emerged as a recurring principle across neuroscience, complex systems, and machine learning. Here we test this hypothesis in quantum many-body systems, numerically simulating two-dimensional Ising networks of up to N=20 spins, operated as quantum reservoirs for time-series forecasting. Using out-of-time-order correlators (OTOCs), we locate the onset of information scrambling as the input strength is swept, separating regimes where information is frozen and scrambled across the whole reservoir state. We show that prediction precision peaks at the onset of scrambling, along with the number of computational-basis states that the reservoir actively populates. We then show that prediction precision grows as a power law sim Nα in the reservoir size, superextensively (α>1) at the onset of scrambling and only sublinearly (α<1) in either neighbouring regime. Finally, we show that scrambling enhances the nonlinear components of the reservoir memory while reducing its linear capacity. At the onset, the total memory capacity grows superextensively, provided that the necessary ``forgetting'' mechanism is supplied by a collective relaxation channel. These results consolidate the role of information scrambling in learning systems, turning it from an operating point into a scaling law for the performance of quantum reservoirs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过数值模拟含最多 20 个自旋的二维伊辛网络，检验量子多体系统在有序与混沌边界附近具有最佳信息处理能力这一假设。利用非时间序关联函数定位信息扰乱的起始点，研究发现预测精度和储备池实际占据的计算基态数量在该点达到峰值。预测精度随储备池规模呈幂律增长，并在扰乱起始点表现为超广延标度；同时，信息扰乱增强非线性记忆而降低线性容量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 信息处理在有序与混沌之间的边界附近达到最优，这一观点已经成为神经科学、复杂系统和机器学习领域反复出现的原则。在这里，我们在量子多体系统中检验这一假设，通过数值模拟含有最多 N=20 个自旋、作为时间序列预测量子储备池运行的二维伊辛网络。利用非时间序关联函数（OTOC），我们在改变输入强度的过程中定位信息扰乱的起始点，从而区分信息被冻结在储备池状态中与信息在整个储备池状态中被扰乱的不同区域。我们发现，预测精度在扰乱起始点达到峰值，储备池主动占据的计算基态数量也在此处达到峰值。随后我们表明，预测精度随储备池规模按 N 的幂律增长：在扰乱起始点处呈超广延增长（α>1），而在相邻的两个区域中仅呈次线性增长（α<1）。最后我们表明，信息扰乱增强了储备池记忆中的非线性成分，同时降低了其线性容量。在扰乱起始点，只要通过集体弛豫通道提供必要的“遗忘”机制，总记忆容量就会呈超广延增长。这些结果巩固了信息扰乱在学习系统中的作用，将其从一个运行点提升为量子储备池性能的标度定律。

articles.title: Phase-sensitive cascade quantum amplifier with nearly noiseless operation
articles.title_zh: 近乎无噪声运行的相敏级联量子放大器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25645v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Phase-sensitive parametric devices enable quadrature-selective amplification with the potential for sub-quantum-limited noise performance. In this work, we investigate the operation of a SQUID-based Josephson Parametric Amplifier (JPA), comparing its performance in the phase-preserving and phase-sensitive regimes. The device, fabricated using VTT SWAPS technology, is driven in a three-wave mixing configuration and characterized in a reflection-based measurement setup at millikelvin temperatures. To directly probe the noise performance at low JPA gains, we employ a cascaded amplification scheme in which a Traveling-Wave Parametric Amplifier (TWPA) provides low-noise pre-amplification of the JPA output. In a phase-preserving operation, the JPA exhibits near-quantum-limited performance with a system noise temperature of 351±53 mK at 6 GHz. In contrast, phase-sensitive operation yields a minimum system noise temperature of 94±12 mK, well below the standard quantum limit of 288 mK. Our results demonstrate that a JPA-TWPA amplifier cascade opens the door to direct, high-fidelity probing of quantum devices without the need for background noise subtraction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究基于 SQUID 的约瑟夫森参量放大器在保持相位和相敏工作模式下的性能，并采用行波参量放大器对其输出进行低噪声预放大。在保持相位模式下，系统在 6 GHz 时的噪声温度为 351±53 mK，接近量子极限；相敏模式下最低系统噪声温度达到 94±12 mK，显著低于 288 mK 的标准量子极限。结果表明，JPA-TWPA 级联可实现对量子器件的高保真直接探测，无需扣除背景噪声。
authors: Ilari Lilja, Ekaterina Mukhanova, Michael Perelshtein, Kirill Petrovnin, Stanislav Khaldeev, Visa Vesterinen, Gheorghe Sorin Paraoanu, Pertti Hakonen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 相敏参量器件能够选择性地放大某一正交分量，并具有实现低于量子极限噪声性能的潜力。在本研究中，我们考察了基于 SQUID 的约瑟夫森参量放大器（JPA）的运行情况，比较其在保持相位和相敏模式下的性能。该器件采用 VTT SWAPS 工艺制造，以三波混频配置驱动，并在毫开尔文温度下通过基于反射的测量装置进行表征。为了直接探测低 JPA 增益下的噪声性能，我们采用级联放大方案，由行波参量放大器（TWPA）对 JPA 输出进行低噪声预放大。在保持相位运行模式下，JPA 在 6 GHz 时实现了接近量子极限的性能，系统噪声温度为 351±53 mK。相比之下，相敏运行模式下的最低系统噪声温度为 94±12 mK，显著低于 288 mK 的标准量子极限。我们的结果表明，JPA-TWPA 放大器级联为直接、高保真地探测量子器件提供了可能，而且无需进行背景噪声扣除。

articles.title: From rings to resonance: an inverse method links biophotonic structural color to inverse photonic glasses
articles.title_zh: 从环到共振：一种将生物光子结构色与逆光子玻璃联系起来的逆向方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25900v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Structural color arises from the interaction of light with nanoscale structures and is widespread in nature. As structural complexity increases, the mechanisms governing coloration become progressively less understood. The optical response of periodic photonic crystals with a spatially periodic refractive index is well described by Bloch theory, whereas that of photonic glasses composed of randomly assembled uniform spheres is more subtle yet well studied. In contrast, disordered photonic networks found in many beetles are among the most complex natural photonic architectures, and the fundamental relationships between their structure and color remain unclear. Here, we use an inverse method to identify the structural features encoded in the reflectance spectrum. By comparing the spectrum of an unknown system with a database of simulated spectra from computer-generated photonic networks, we infer its structural properties. Applying this approach to both simulated networks and the biophotonic network responsible for the blue coloration of the weevil Pachyrhynchus congestus mirabilis, we identify rings and pores as the key local scattering motifs. Their characteristic sizes govern the spectral position of the reflectance peak, whereas short-range disorder controls its width. The inverse method reveals clear spectral signatures of short-range order, whereas the influence of hyperuniformity and primitive similarity appears comparatively weak. This suggests that blue structural coloration is governed by local scattering mechanisms rather than photonic band-gap effects. We propose an analogy to an inverse photonic glass, in which pores and rings act as correlated local resonators. This perspective provides new design principles for bio-inspired structural-color materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种逆向方法，通过将未知系统的反射光谱与计算机生成光子网络的模拟光谱数据库进行比较，推断其结构特征。应用于模拟网络和产生象鼻虫蓝色的生物光子网络后，研究确定环和孔是关键的局部散射单元，其特征尺寸决定反射峰位置，而短程无序控制峰宽。结果表明，蓝色结构色主要由局部散射机制支配，而非光子带隙效应，并为仿生结构色材料提出了新的设计思路。
authors: Florin Hemmann, Matthias Saba, Ullrich Steiner, Mauro S. Ferreira, Felipe A. Pinheiro
articles.abstract_zh_full: 结构色源于光与纳米尺度结构之间的相互作用，广泛存在于自然界中。随着结构复杂性的增加，支配着色的机制变得越来越难以理解。对于具有空间周期性折射率的周期性光子晶体，其光学响应可以由布洛赫理论很好地描述；而由随机组装的均匀球体构成的光子玻璃，其光学响应更加微妙，但也已得到较为深入的研究。相比之下，在许多甲虫中发现的无序光子网络属于最复杂的天然光子结构之一，其结构与颜色之间的基本关系仍不清楚。在这里，我们利用一种逆向方法，识别反射光谱中编码的结构特征。通过将未知系统的光谱与计算机生成光子网络的模拟光谱数据库进行比较，我们推断其结构性质。将这一方法应用于模拟网络以及负责象鼻虫 Pachyrhynchus congestus mirabilis 蓝色的生物光子网络后，我们确定环和孔是关键的局部散射单元。它们的特征尺寸决定反射峰的光谱位置，而短程无序控制反射峰的宽度。该逆向方法揭示了短程有序的清晰光谱特征，而超均匀性和原始相似性的影响则相对较弱。这表明，蓝色结构色主要由局部散射机制支配，而不是由光子带隙效应支配。我们提出了与逆光子玻璃的类比，其中孔和环充当具有相关性的局部共振器。这一观点为仿生结构色材料提供了新的设计原则。

articles.title: Structured Non-Locality and Emergent Locality in Cavity-QED Many-Body Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 腔量子电动力学多体动力学中的结构化非局域性与涌现局域性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25908v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) modifies many-body systems by combining cavity-mediated collective interactions with microscopic short-range interactions. The resulting dynamics lies between the local and fully collective limits, such that neither locality nor collectivity alone provides a complete organizing principle. In the clean conceptual limit of dominant collective coupling, we show that the effective dynamics within each energetically isolated subspace is generically controlled by whether that subspace admits a local product-state basis, and identify exceptions imposed by angular-momentum selection rules. Product-state subspaces generically retain the spatial structure of the microscopic interaction. Entangled subspaces instead generically dress local processes with global operators, generating non-local but highly structured dynamics. We illustrate this by deriving the corresponding effective Hamiltonians in two representative cavity-QED spin models. The cavity-isolated subspace thus becomes a resource for generating competing short-range interactions or globally conditioned local processes, opening a class of many-body dynamics without local or fully collective counterparts.
articles.abstract_zh: 腔量子电动力学将腔介导的集体相互作用与微观短程相互作用结合起来，使系统动力学处于局域极限和完全集体极限之间。本文表明，在占主导地位的集体耦合极限下，每个能量隔离子空间中的有效动力学通常取决于该子空间是否存在局域乘积态基，并分析了角动量选择定则导致的例外。纠缠子空间会使局域过程带上全局算符，从而产生非局域但高度结构化的动力学；这种机制为产生竞争性的短程相互作用或全局条件控制的局域过程提供了新途径。
authors: Mark A. Oehlgrien, Błażej Jaworowski, Darrick E. Chang, Charlie-Ray Mann
articles.abstract_zh_full: 腔量子电动力学（QED）通过结合腔介导的集体相互作用与微观短程相互作用，改变了多体系统的性质。由此产生的动力学处于局域极限和完全集体极限之间，因此单独的局域性或集体性都不足以提供完整的组织原则。在集体耦合占主导的理想概念极限下，我们表明，每个能量隔离子空间内的有效动力学通常由该子空间是否允许一个局域乘积态基来决定，并识别出由角动量选择定则施加的例外。乘积态子空间通常保留微观相互作用的空间结构。相反，纠缠子空间通常会使局域过程带上全局算符，从而产生非局域但高度结构化的动力学。我们通过推导两个具有代表性的腔量子电动力学自旋模型中的相应有效哈密顿量，对这一点进行了说明。因此，腔隔离子空间可以成为产生竞争性短程相互作用或全局条件控制的局域过程的资源，从而开启一类在局域或完全集体系统中都不存在的多体动力学。

articles.title: Immittance formulas for exact blackbox quantization and divergence-free effective models in circuit QED
articles.title_zh: 用于精确黑箱量子化和无发散有效模型的导纳与阻抗公式：应用于电路量子电动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26027v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Building on the first-order circuit quantization method [arXiv:2304.12252, arXiv:2401.09120], we provide simple formulas to construct exact Hamiltonians for Josephson-junction-based superconducting qudits capacitively, inductively, or galvanically coupled to passive linear environments. These environments may be multiport, multimode, discrete or continuous, reciprocal or nonreciprocal, and are characterized directly by their impedance or admittance matrices. In the weak-coupling regime, we further derive emphdivergence-free dispersive Hamiltonians for mode-resolved environments and transition-resolved weak-coupling master equations for dissipative continua. Mode structure, frequency renormalizations, environment-mediated interactions, decay rates, and directional cross couplings then follow from the same causal immittance response, while spurious Lamb-shift divergences arising from uncontrolled approximations in previous treatments are made explicit and avoided. We apply the theory to a set of illustrative circuits comprising a discrete resonator filter, finite-band metamaterial environments, nonreciprocal waveguide-QED systems, and superconducting giant atoms, for which analytical response matrices can be obtained, although the method is particularly well suited to numerical responses from electromagnetic solvers or experimental characterization. We thereby extend the black-box quantization framework to multiport, dissipative, and nonreciprocal settings, establishing a simple and scalable route toward optimized and automated electromagnetic design of large-scale superconducting quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于一阶电路量子化方法，为与无源线性环境电容性、电感性或电 galvanic 耦合的约瑟夫森结超导量子比特构造精确哈密顿量提供了简洁公式。线性环境可为多端口、多模、离散或连续、互易或非互易系统，并直接由阻抗或导纳矩阵表征。在弱耦合条件下，作者进一步推导了无发散的色散哈密顿量和主方程，使模式结构、频率重整化、环境介导相互作用及衰减率均可由同一因果响应确定，从而拓展黑箱量子化并支持大规模超导量子硬件的自动化设计。
authors: Philippe Gigon, Peter Rabl, Adrian Parra-Rodriguez
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于一阶电路量子化方法，本文提供了用于构造精确哈密顿量的简洁公式，适用于与无源线性环境进行电容性、电感性或电流式耦合的约瑟夫森结超导量子比特。所考虑的环境可以是多端口、多模、离散或连续、互易或非互易的，并直接由其阻抗矩阵或导纳矩阵表征。在弱耦合条件下，我们进一步推导了针对模式分辨环境的无发散色散哈密顿量，以及针对耗散连续谱的按跃迁分辨的弱耦合主方程。这样，模式结构、频率重整化、环境介导的相互作用、衰减率和方向性互耦都可以由同一个因果导纳或阻抗响应得到；同时，明确揭示并避免了以往处理中因不受控制的近似而产生的虚假兰姆位移发散。我们将该理论应用于一组具有代表性的电路，包括离散谐振器滤波器、有限带宽超材料环境、非互易波导量子电动力学系统以及超导巨型原子。这些系统都可以获得解析响应矩阵，不过该方法尤其适合处理来自电磁求解器或实验表征的数值响应。由此，我们将黑箱量子化框架扩展到多端口、耗散和非互易情形，为大规模超导量子硬件的优化与自动化电磁设计建立了一条简洁且可扩展的途径。

articles.title: Experimental Characterization of Additively Manufactured Metallic Alloys for Electric Propulsion Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向电推进应用的增材制造金属合金实验表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26048v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work explores the sputtering of additively manufactured (AM) materials for use in gridded ion source applications. The first part of the paper uses 316L stainless steel as an example to demonstrate that additively manufactured material does not exhibit adverse sputtering behavior, such as higher sputter yield, compared with conventionally manufactured material. To this end, three additively manufactured 316L stainless steel samples were exposed to the beam of a KDC-40 electrostatic gridded ion source at three distinct energy levels of 400, 600, and 800 eV on each side of the sample for a duration of one hour. The samples were masked to create a distinct boundary between treated and untreated regions, identifiable using profilometry, and were biased to -18V for testing. Samples were then examined using a Bruker optical profilometer and further processed using the open-source software Gwyddion to evaluate the sputtering yield. The sputter yield varied in the range 0.2-2 atoms/ion for 400-800 eV ions and increased with ion energy. The measured sputtering yield was fairly consistent with predictions from analytical models developed in prior literature, while exhibiting some variations potentially due to added effects of increased temperature and oxide layers. The second part of the paper demonstrates feasibility of using an additively manufactured tungsten-rhenium grids in existing KDC-40 electrostatic gridded ion source.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究增材制造材料在栅格式离子源中的溅射行为及应用可行性。以 316L 不锈钢为例，实验表明增材制造材料相较传统制造材料没有表现出更高溅射产额等不利特征；在 400 至 800 eV 离子能量下，测得溅射产额为 0.2 至 2 个原子每离子，并随离子能量升高而增加。研究还证明，增材制造钨铼栅极可以应用于现有 KDC-40 静电栅格式离子源。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本工作探索了增材制造（AM）材料在栅格式离子源中的溅射行为及其应用于电推进的可能性。论文第一部分以 316L 不锈钢为例，说明增材制造材料相较于传统制造材料并未表现出更高溅射产额等不利溅射行为。为此，三个增材制造 316L 不锈钢样品分别在三个不同能级下接受 KDC-40 静电栅格式离子源束流的照射：样品两侧均采用 400、600 和 800 eV 的能量照射，每次持续一小时。样品经过遮蔽，以便在处理区域和未处理区域之间形成清晰边界，并通过轮廓测量加以识别；测试期间样品偏置为 -18 V。随后使用 Bruker 光学轮廓仪检查样品，并进一步利用开源软件 Gwyddion 评估溅射产额。在 400 至 800 eV 离子能量范围内，溅射产额为 0.2 至 2 个原子每离子，并随离子能量增加而升高。测得的溅射产额总体上与先前文献中解析模型的预测一致，但也存在一定变化，这些变化可能源于温度升高和氧化层等附加影响。论文第二部分展示了在现有 KDC-40 静电栅格式离子源中使用增材制造钨铼栅极的可行性。

articles.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents
articles.title_zh: SwarmWorld：语言模型智能体社会中的基于信息素的技术演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26081v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Collective intelligence can emerge when individuals coordinate through a shared environment, allowing local actions to accumulate into durable social organization. Language-model agents offer a new substrate for this process, yet most multi-agent systems rely on direct conversation, predefined roles, or centralized workflows. It remains unclear whether decentralized agents can build functional technologies and outperform independent search. Here, initially homogeneous LLM agents in SwarmWorld self-organize without assigned roles or recipes into evolving technological societies. Agents explore a spatial environment, process resources, test materials, construct persistent artifacts, and write executable controllers evaluated by a deterministic simulator under unseen disturbances after the agents are removed. SwarmWorld splits cognition from consequence: agents propose architectures and controllers within fixed action and material schemas, while the simulated world determines function. Shared societies develop broader, more resilient technological portfolios than a strong best-of-N isolated-search baseline, although isolated search remains competitive for the strongest artifact. Agents differentiate into exploration, construction, maintenance, and coordination behaviors, transitioning as the world matures. Technologies accumulate through collaborative construction, executable inheritance, and persistent agent-artifact networks, with most reuse beginning through physical observation rather than communication. Explicit cultural mechanisms amplify collaboration and organization, but functional benefits depend on outcome and timescale. Physical stigmergy alone supports capable societies, while interaction drives persistent technological ecologies rather than universally superior individual inventions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 SwarmWorld，一个让初始同质的语言模型智能体在共享空间环境中自主形成技术社会的系统。智能体探索资源、加工材料、建造持久性器物并编写可执行控制器，由确定性模拟器在未知扰动下评估其功能。共享社会形成了比强大的独立多次搜索基线更广泛且更具韧性的技术组合，智能体也逐渐分化出探索、建造、维护和协调行为；物理环境中的间接协作足以支持有能力的社会，而互动则推动持久技术生态的形成。
authors: Subhadeep Pal, Fiona Y. Wang, Markus J. Buehler
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当个体通过共享环境进行协调，使局部行动累积为持久的社会组织时，集体智能就可能涌现。语言模型智能体为这一过程提供了新的基础，但大多数多智能体系统依赖直接对话、预先设定的角色或集中式工作流。去中心化智能体能否构建有功能的技术并超越独立搜索，目前仍不清楚。在 SwarmWorld 中，最初同质的语言模型智能体在没有指定角色或操作配方的情况下，自主组织成不断演化的技术社会。智能体探索空间环境、处理资源、测试材料、建造持久性器物，并编写可执行控制器；这些控制器会在智能体离开后，由确定性模拟器在未见过的扰动下进行评估。SwarmWorld 将认知与后果分离：智能体在固定的行动和材料模式内提出架构与控制器，而模拟世界决定其功能。与强大的独立多次搜索基线相比，共享社会形成了更广泛、更具韧性的技术组合，尽管对于最强的单个器物，独立搜索仍具有竞争力。智能体逐渐分化出探索、建造、维护和协调等行为，并随着世界趋于成熟而发生转变。技术通过协作建造、可执行继承以及持久的智能体—器物网络不断积累，其中大多数复用最初源于物理观察，而非交流。明确的文化机制会放大协作与组织，但其功能收益取决于结果和时间尺度。仅凭物理环境中的间接协作就足以支持具有能力的社会，而互动则推动持久技术生态的形成，并不一定使个体发明在所有情况下都更优。

articles.title: Yang-Lee Criticality as a Dissipative Dynamical Phase Transition: Quantum Simulation of non-Hermitian Physics without Post-selection
articles.title_zh: 杨—李临界性作为耗散动力学相变：无需后选择的非厄米物理量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26082v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that the d+0-dimensional Yang-Lee theory describing classical Ising spins in an imaginary magnetic field can be realized, without post-selection, within a (d-1)+1 open quantum system whose dynamics consist of local unitaries and engineered dissipation. Competition between the coherent unitary and dissipative dynamics drives a transition wherein the time-dependence of a particular class of linear observables changes from damped oscillatory "underdamped" to purely exponential "overdamped" decay. Our construction relies on an extensive number of weak-symmetries of the Lindbladian fixed by the choice of observable but is otherwise exact. Consequently, we show that the dynamics are described by the non-Hermitian generator of the Yang-Lee transfer matrix, leading to an effective Yang-Lee theory defined on the spacetime history of the open system. By locally modifying the dynamics, we directly measure spin correlation functions of the Yang-Lee theory as well as a related "Loschmidt Echo" correlator which we detail. We explicitly show that the required dissipation channels can be obtained through local 2-qubit gates and discuss potential realization on near-term quantum simulator devices. Finally, we generalize our construction to embed arbitrary non-Hermitian Hamiltonians within an open quantum system under Lindbladian time-evolution without post-selection, drawing connections between unconditional open quantum dynamics, exceptional point physics, and non-unitary statistical mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，描述虚磁场中经典伊辛自旋的 d+0 维杨—李理论，可以在无需后选择的开放量子系统中实现，其动力学由局域幺正操作和工程化耗散组成。相干幺正动力学与耗散动力学的竞争驱动一个转变，使特定线性观测量的时间演化由阻尼振荡的欠阻尼行为变为纯指数衰减的过阻尼行为。作者还展示了如何通过局域两量子比特门实现所需耗散通道，直接测量杨—李理论的自旋关联函数，并将构造推广到无需后选择地嵌入任意非厄米哈密顿量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，描述处于虚磁场中的经典伊辛自旋的 d+0 维杨—李理论，可以在一个无需后选择的 (d-1)+1 维开放量子系统中实现；该系统的动力学由局域幺正操作和工程化耗散构成。相干幺正动力学与耗散动力学之间的竞争会驱动一个相变，在这一转变中，特定类别线性观测量的时间依赖性由阻尼振荡的“欠阻尼”衰减改变为纯指数形式的“过阻尼”衰减。我们的构造依赖于林德布拉德算符的大量弱对称性，这些弱对称性由观测量的选择决定，但除此之外该构造是精确的。因此，我们表明，该动力学由杨—李转移矩阵的非厄米生成元描述，从而得到一个定义在开放系统时空历史上的有效杨—李理论。通过局域修改动力学，我们可以直接测量杨—李理论的自旋关联函数，以及我们将详细说明的相关“洛施密特回波”关联函数。我们明确展示了所需耗散通道可以通过局域两量子比特门获得，并讨论了在近期量子模拟器件上实现该方案的可能性。最后，我们将该构造推广到在林德布拉德时间演化下、无需后选择地将任意非厄米哈密顿量嵌入开放量子系统，并讨论其与无条件开放量子动力学、例外点物理和非幺正统计力学之间的联系。

articles.title: Low Energy Excitations in a [4]Triangulene Honeycomb Antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: [4]三角烯蜂窝反铁磁体中的低能激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2301.06171v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Carbon-based synthetic lattices offer a versatile platform for the realization and control of correlated quantum effects at the nanoscale. Advances in on-surface synthesis have facilitated the fabrication of increasingly complex molecular frameworks, opening new avenues for the exploration and engineering of custom tailored electronic and magnetic phases.
