Additionally, the corresponding operators for two-component Hamiltonians are derived, explicitly for the zeroth order regular approximation Hamiltonian. The approach is applied to demonstrate great sensitivity of highly charged polar molecules that were recently proposed for high-precision spectroscopy in [Zülch emphet al., arXiv:2203.10333[physics.chem-ph]]. In particular, a high sensitivity of a wealth of quasi-degenerate vibronic transitions in ȩPaF³⁺ and ȩCeF²⁺ to temporal variations of the fine-structure constant and the electron-proton mass ratio is shown.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出将灵敏度系数视为Dirac-Coulomb哈密顿量微扰的方法，以避免通过多次改变光速进行昂贵的数值电子结构计算。方法可将主导贡献表示为相对论动能和静止质量算符的期望值，并推导了双组分哈密顿量、特别是零阶正则近似哈密顿量的对应算符。应用结果显示，高电荷极性分子PaF³⁺和CeF²⁺中的大量准简并振电子跃迁对精细结构常数和电子-质子质量比的时间变化高度敏感。
authors: Carsten Zülch, Konstantin Gaul, Robert Berger
articles.abstract_zh_full: 原子中的准禁戒电子跃迁，以及分子中准简并态之间的振电子跃迁，是探测基本常数可能随时间变化的有力工具。 传统上，计算一个跃迁对精细结构常数变化的灵敏度，需要在复杂电子结构计算中对光速进行数值改变，因此必须进行多次独立计算。 本文提出了一种方法，将灵敏度系数作为Dirac-Coulomb哈密顿量的微扰来获得；例如，该方法允许将其最低阶贡献计算为相对论动能和静止质量算符的期望值。 几乎所有从头算相对论电子结构程序中都可获得这些量。 此外，本文还推导了适用于双组分哈密顿量的相应算符，并明确给出了零阶正则近似哈密顿量的情况。 该方法被用于展示最近在Zülch等人，arXiv:2203.10333[physics.chem-ph]中为高精度光谱学提出的高电荷极性分子的极高灵敏度。 特别地，结果显示PaF³⁺和CeF²⁺中大量准简并振电子跃迁，对精细结构常数和电子-质子质量比的时间变化具有很高灵敏度。

articles.title: A Wide Bandwidth Trans-impedance Amplifier for Picosecond-Scale SiPM Characterization in a Wide Temperature Range
articles.title_zh: 用于宽温度范围皮秒尺度SiPM表征的宽带跨阻放大器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.22727v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Future high-energy physics experiments using SiPMs as photosensitive elements may require operation at low temperatures (down to 80 K) to measure single photons with high time resolution in a highly radioactive environment. This calls for a complete characterization of these sensors over a wide temperature range to find the best compromise between detector performance and cooling requirements. This paper presents the design of a transimpedance amplifier featuring high gain (sim 7500 V/A), very high speed (<500 ps rise time) and low input noise (łesssim 20 pA/sqrtHz), able to faithfully reproduce all the features of SiPM signals without affecting its noise or jitter performance. These features make the amplifier suitable for precise measurements of the time-of-arrival of single-photon signals, as well as gain and recovery time. This article provides a detailed and thorough analysis of the circuit. The network was simulated and measured in two configurations that differ in their open-loop gain and dominant pole frequencies. After selecting the best configuration for our purposes, the amplifier was characterized in detail at ambient temperature and at 80 K. Finally, we evaluated the amplifier using a SiPM operated at low over-voltage. While SiPMs are typically characterized at high over-voltage to enhance gain and minimize timing jitter, testing at low over-voltage allowed us to assess the amplifier's performance under more challenging and realistic conditions for single-photon timing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究设计了一种适用于80 K至室温范围的宽带跨阻放大器，用于高时间分辨率单光子SiPM表征。该放大器具有约7500 V/A高增益、小于500 ps上升时间和不高于约20 pA/√Hz的低输入噪声，可用于精确测量单光子到达时间、增益和恢复时间。研究比较了两种不同开环增益与主极点频率的电路配置，并在室温、80 K及低过电压SiPM条件下开展详细测试。
authors: P. Carniti, C. Gotti, G. Pessina, D. Trotta
articles.abstract_zh_full: 未来将SiPM用作光敏元件的高能物理实验，可能需要在低温环境下运行，最低可达80 K，以便在高放射性环境中以高时间分辨率测量单个光子。 这要求在较宽温度范围内对这些传感器进行完整表征，以在探测器性能与冷却需求之间找到最佳折中。 本文提出了一种跨阻放大器的设计，该放大器具有高增益（约7500 V/A）、极高速度（上升时间小于500 ps）和低输入噪声（不高于约20 pA/√Hz），能够忠实再现SiPM信号的全部特征，而不影响其噪声或时间抖动性能。 这些特性使该放大器适合精确测量单光子信号的到达时间，以及测量增益和恢复时间。 本文对该电路进行了详细而全面的分析。 该网络在两种配置下进行了仿真和测量，这两种配置的开环增益和主极点频率不同。 在选出最符合研究目的的最佳配置后，研究人员在环境温度和80 K下对放大器进行了详细表征。 最后，我们使用在低过电压下运行的SiPM对放大器进行了评估。 尽管通常会在高过电压下表征SiPM，以提高增益并减小定时抖动，但在低过电压下测试使我们能够在对单光子定时而言更具挑战性且更接近实际的条件下评估放大器性能。

articles.title: Real-time virtual circuits for plasma shape control via neural network emulators: dynamic validation in closed-loop simulations
articles.title_zh: 用于等离子体形状控制的神经网络仿真实时虚拟电路：闭环模拟中的动态验证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.00781v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable confinement and stable performance of tokamak fusion plasmas require accurate real-time magnetic shape control. A promising route to reduced latency and increased flexibility in plasma control systems (PCS) is to emulate physics-based controllers using neural networks (NNs). In prior work, we have demonstrated that virtual circuits (VCs), which define the poloidal field coil current vectors able to modify each plasma shape parameter independently, can be accurately emulated with NN models trained on a large library of simulated Grad-Shafranov equilibria. This enables magnetic controllers to accurately adapt to evolving plasma equilibria using real-time VCs (RTVCs), in contrast to pre-set VC schedules whose performance degrades upon departure from their reference equilibria. Here, we investigate the performance and robustness of these RTVCs in closed-loop simulations using the FreeGSNKE Pulse Design Tool (FPDT): a framework that couples the FreeGSNKE evolutive equilibrium solver with a virtual PCS. The FPDT models the coupling between controllers, plasma current and shape response, and actuator constraints. Using the RTVCs within the FPDT, we demonstrate effective in-silico control of MAST Upgrade (MAST-U) plasma scenarios and show that the emulators are robust in the presence of input measurement uncertainty and under different update frequencies. These results establish the viability of RTVCs for closed-loop plasma shape control, representing a key step toward real-time deployment in the MAST-U PCS.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究用神经网络仿真器生成实时虚拟电路，以降低托卡马克等离子体磁形状控制的延迟并提高灵活性。作者在FreeGSNKE Pulse Design Tool闭环模拟框架中评估这些实时虚拟电路，框架包含控制器、等离子体电流与形状响应以及执行器约束的耦合。结果显示，该方法能有效控制MAST-U等离子体情景，并在输入测量不确定性和不同更新频率下保持稳健。
authors: K. Pentland, A. Ross, N. C. Amorisco, P. Cavestany, T. Nunn, A. Agnello, G. K. Holt, C. Vincent
articles.abstract_zh_full: 托卡马克聚变等离子体的可靠约束和稳定性能需要精确的实时磁形状控制。降低延迟并提高等离子体控制系统（PCS）灵活性的一条有前景路径，是使用神经网络（NN）仿真基于物理的控制器。在先前工作中，我们已经证明，虚拟电路（VC）能够用在大量模拟Grad-Shafranov平衡上训练的NN模型精确仿真；这些虚拟电路定义了能够独立改变每个等离子体形状参数的极向场线圈电流向量。与预设VC调度在偏离其参考平衡时性能下降不同，这使得磁控制器能够利用实时VC（RTVC）精确适应演化中的等离子体平衡。本文中，我们使用FreeGSNKE Pulse Design Tool（FPDT）在闭环模拟中研究这些RTVC的性能和稳健性；FPDT是一个将FreeGSNKE演化平衡求解器与虚拟PCS耦合的框架。FPDT模拟控制器、等离子体电流和形状响应以及执行器约束之间的耦合。通过在FPDT中使用RTVC，我们展示了对MAST Upgrade（MAST-U）等离子体情景的有效计算机内控制，并表明这些仿真器在存在输入测量不确定性以及不同更新频率下具有稳健性。这些结果确立了RTVC用于闭环等离子体形状控制的可行性，代表了迈向在MAST-U PCS中实时部署的关键一步。

articles.title: Gyrokinetic equilibria of high temperature superconducting magnetic mirrors
articles.title_zh: 高温超导磁镜的回旋动力学平衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.11684v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets and other advances have led to renewed interest in magnetic mirrors for fusion energy. The non-Maxwellian nature of mirror plasmas necessitates kinetic modeling to predict, optimize and design mirrors. Explicit gyrokinetic full-f codes can be used to study instabilities and turbulent transport in tokamaks and mirrors, but they have been prohibitively expensive to integrate directly over the very long time scales required to compute kinetic plasma equilibrium. We demonstrate that these studies are now feasible thanks to novel multiscale methods delivering a 30,000X speed-up. The resulting kinetic equilibrium, electrostatic potential, and ion confinement time are consistent with analytic theory. This transformative capability opens the door to a new way of obtaining equilibria for mirrors, and we discuss how this technique may also accelerate calculations for tokamaks and stellarators. The models presented in this article address critical multiscale problems in modeling magnetic mirrors, opening a new research avenue for equilibrium studies using an explicit continuum gyrokinetic code.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，高温超导磁体等进展重新激发了人们对用于聚变能的磁镜装置的兴趣，而磁镜等离子体的非Maxwell性质要求采用动理学建模。作者展示了新的多尺度方法可使显式全f回旋动力学计算获得约30000倍加速，从而使直接计算长时间尺度动理学平衡成为可行。所得动理学平衡、静电势和离子约束时间与解析理论一致，并可能加速托卡马克和仿星器相关计算。
authors: Maxwell H. Rosen, Manaure Francisquez, James Juno, Benicio Terry-Mendoza, Ammar Hakim, Gregory W. Hammett
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高温超导（HTS）磁体以及其他进展使人们重新关注用于聚变能的磁镜。磁镜等离子体的非Maxwell性质要求使用动理学建模来预测、优化和设计磁镜。显式回旋动力学全f代码可用于研究托卡马克和磁镜中的不稳定性与湍流输运，但若要直接积分到计算动理学等离子体平衡所需的极长时间尺度，过去其计算成本一直高得难以承受。我们证明，得益于能够带来30000倍加速的新型多尺度方法，这些研究现在已经可行。所得动理学平衡、静电势和离子约束时间与解析理论一致。这一变革性能力为获得磁镜平衡提供了一种新方法；我们还讨论了该技术如何也可能加速托卡马克和仿星器的计算。本文提出的模型解决了磁镜建模中的关键多尺度问题，为使用显式连续介质回旋动力学代码开展平衡研究开辟了一条新的研究方向。

articles.title: Exact 1D Nonlinear Solutions for Proton-Driven Plasma Wakefields: Benchmarking Against AWAKE Data Envelopes
articles.title_zh: 质子驱动等离子体尾场的一维精确非线性解：与AWAKE数据包络的基准比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06458v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The analytical modeling of a plasma wakefield driven by a relativistic proton beam is an element in optimizing advanced plasma-based acceleration schemes. In this work, we present a 1D nonlinear fluid framework under the quasi-static approximation to describe the wake potential excited by a positively charged proton driver. We examine our model using a two-bunch pump-probe configuration, demonstrating close agreement between the analytical invariants and adaptive numerical integrations. The distinct geometric curvature changes observed at the micro-bunch boundaries are shown to be physical consequences of step-discontinuities in the second derivative of the wake potential across the beam interfaces. Furthermore, by scaling this numerical framework to a train of N=100 micro-bunches undergoing seeded self-modulation (SSM), we model the physical parameters of the CERN AWAKE facility (n₀ = 7.0 × 10¹⁴ cm⁻³). Our model replicates the characteristic linear growth envelope and matches the calibrated field envelope boundaries of approximately ± 0.75 GV/m inferred from the experiment. This piece-wise framework provides a computationally efficient foundation for investigating customized, asymmetric micro-bunch profiles designed to optimize the transformer ratio beyond the fundamental symmetric limit of 2.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在准静态近似下提出一维非线性流体框架，用于描述相对论性质子束驱动的等离子体尾场势。作者先用双束泵浦-探测构型检验模型，显示解析不变量与自适应数值积分高度一致，并解释微束边界处曲率变化的物理来源。随后将框架扩展到N=100个经历种子自调制的微束列，复现CERN AWAKE实验的线性增长包络，并匹配约±0.75 GV/m的校准场包络边界。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由相对论性质子束驱动的等离子体尾场的解析建模，是优化先进等离子体加速方案的一个要素。在这项工作中，我们在准静态近似下提出一个一维非线性流体框架，用于描述由带正电的质子驱动束激发的尾场势。我们使用双束泵浦-探测构型考察我们的模型，展示了解析不变量与自适应数值积分之间的高度一致。在微束边界处观察到的独特几何曲率变化，被证明是尾场势二阶导数在束流界面两侧存在阶跃不连续性的物理后果。此外，通过将这一数值框架缩放到经历种子自调制（SSM）的N=100个微束列，我们模拟了CERN AWAKE设施的物理参数（n₀ = 7.0 × 10¹⁴ cm⁻³）。我们的模型复现了特征性的线性增长包络，并与实验推断出的约±0.75 GV/m的校准场包络边界相匹配。这一分段框架为研究定制的非对称微束轮廓提供了计算高效的基础，这些轮廓旨在将变压器比优化到超过基本对称极限2。

articles.title: On the reconstruction limits of complex networks
articles.title_zh: 复杂网络的重构极限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2501.01437v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Network reconstruction consists in retrieving the hidden interaction structure of a system from observations. Many reconstruction algorithms have been proposed, although less research has been devoted to describe their theoretical limitations. In this work, we take a first-principles approach and build on our earlier definition of reconstructability-the fraction of structural information recoverable from data. We relate this quantity to the true data-generating (TDG) process and delineate an information-theoretic reconstruction limit, i.e., the upper bound of the mutual information between the true underlying graph and any graph reconstructed from observations. These concepts lead us to a principled numerical method to assess the validity of empirically reconstructed networks, based on model selection and a quantity we introduce: the reconstruction index. This index approximates the reconstructability from data, quantifies the variability of the reconstructed network ensemble, and is shown to predict reconstruction error without requiring knowledge of the true underlying network. We characterize this method and test it on empirical time series and networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 网络重构旨在从观测数据中恢复系统隐藏的交互结构。本文从第一性原理出发，将“可重构性”与真实数据生成过程联系起来，给出信息论意义上的重构上限，并提出重构指数用于评估经验重构网络的可靠性。作者在经验时间序列和网络上检验了该方法，表明该指数可在未知真实网络时预测重构误差。
authors: Charles Murphy, Ariane Lizotte, François Thibault, Vincent Thibeault, Patrick Desrosiers, Antoine Allard
articles.abstract_zh_full: 网络重构是指从观测中恢复系统隐藏的交互结构。尽管已经提出了许多重构算法，但关于其理论局限性的研究相对较少。在这项工作中，我们采用第一性原理方法，并建立在我们先前对可重构性的定义之上；可重构性指的是可从数据中恢复的结构信息比例。我们将这一量与真实数据生成（TDG）过程联系起来，并划定一个信息论重构极限，即真实底层图与任何由观测重构出的图之间互信息的上界。这些概念引导我们提出一种有原则的数值方法，用于评估经验重构网络的有效性；该方法基于模型选择以及我们引入的一个量：重构指数。该指数从数据中近似可重构性，量化重构网络集合的变异性，并被证明能够在不需要知道真实底层网络的情况下预测重构误差。我们刻画了该方法，并在经验时间序列和网络上对其进行了测试。

articles.title: Peristaltic Flow in Compressible, Ideal Magnetohydrodynamics: A Mechanism For Solar Spicules
articles.title_zh: 可压缩理想磁流体动力学中的蠕动流：太阳针状体的一种机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09626v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present analytical model for peristaltic transport within compressible, ideal magnetohydrodynamics (MHD). By employing small-amplitude perturbation expansion, under thin-tube long-wavelength approximation with a uniform axial background magnetic field, we study non-linear coupling between thermodynamic pressure variations and Maxwell's magnetic tension stresses. The resulting net time-averaged volumetric flow rate łangle Q ångle is calculated. When applied to solar chromospheric spicules under equipartition constraints (β sim 1), where sound speed matches the Alfvén speed, we find łangle Q ångle = 4ϵ²/(M²⁻¹⁾. Because the denominator remains positive across all operational supersonic Mach numbers (M approx 2--10), upward-propagating mechanical disturbances drive a highly directional, collimated upward flow which we interpret as a spicule. Estimates show that for observationally realistic magnetosonic waves with amplitudes of approx 10%, the peristaltic mechanism generates a localized mass flux approx 100 times that of solar wind. We propose an explicit observational signature of this mechanism, wherein the launch of individual spicular jets is directly preceded by magnetosonic wave trains detectable as localized intensity modulations. Beyond solar chromospheric application, the model may be applicable to traveling magnetic field pinches in laboratory plasma devices and astrophysical mass-loading processes in stellar winds and inner regions of magnetized accretion disks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了可压缩理想磁流体动力学中蠕动输运的解析模型，用于解释太阳色球针状体。模型显示，在近似能量均分条件下，向上传播的磁声扰动可产生高度定向、准直的向上流，并带来显著局域质量通量。作者还提出了可观测特征，并指出该机制可能适用于实验室等离子体和天体物理质量加载过程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个用于可压缩理想磁流体动力学（MHD）中蠕动输运的解析模型。通过采用小振幅扰动展开，在具有均匀轴向背景磁场的细管长波长近似下，我们研究了热力学压力变化与麦克斯韦磁张力应力之间的非线性耦合。由此计算得到净时间平均体积流率〈Q〉。当将其应用于太阳色球针状体，并施加能量均分约束（β约为1），即声速与阿尔芬速度相匹配时，我们得到〈Q〉=4ε²/(M²-1)。由于在所有可运行的超声速马赫数（M约为2到10）范围内分母都保持为正，向上传播的机械扰动会驱动一种高度定向、准直的向上流，我们将其解释为针状体。估算表明，对于振幅约为10%的、符合观测实际的磁声波，蠕动机制会产生约为太阳风100倍的局域质量通量。我们提出了这一机制的明确观测特征，即单个针状喷流的发射会直接先于可探测为局域强度调制的磁声波列。除太阳色球应用之外，该模型还可能适用于实验室等离子体装置中的行进磁场箍缩，以及恒星风和磁化吸积盘内区中的天体物理质量加载过程。

articles.title: When Does Frequency Decomposition Benefit Physics-Informed Neural Networks? A Preliminary Ablation Study
articles.title_zh: 频率分解何时有益于物理信息神经网络？一项初步消融研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24940v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Partial differential equations (PDEs) often have high-frequency and multi-scale features that neural networks struggle to approximate. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) build the governing equations directly into training, but suffer from spectral bias: they learn low-frequency components faster than high-frequency ones. Techniques such as Fourier feature embeddings and sinusoidal activations address this, but most studies assume they help across the board without checking which spectral regimes actually benefit. We introduce a dual-branch, spectrally-gated architecture (DBSG-PINN) that splits low- and high-frequency components into separate subnetworks joined by an adaptive gate, and use it to run a partially controlled ablation of frequency decomposition and spectral routing. We test this on five one-dimensional benchmark PDEs, ranging from smooth, single-scale problems to oscillatory, multi-scale ones. Frequency decomposition helps most on the spectrally complex benchmarks, cutting relative L₂ error by up to 59.2% on a multimodal wave problem, but gives little benefit on smoother PDEs. On one benchmark (1D Wave), it performs substantially worse than a simpler fixed-combination variant. The gate's benefit scales with how spectrally rich the target solution is: the full model's advantage over the ablations is largest on multi-scale benchmarks and smallest (or negative) on single-scale ones, consistent with the gate exploiting frequency structure rather than acting as noise,though we do not directly visualize or quantify its spatial activations in this study. All results come from a single training seed across five 1D benchmarks, so we present this as an exploratory study meant to raise questions rather than answer them, and outline the additional seeds and benchmarks needed to test whether the pattern holds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究频率分解和谱路由在物理信息神经网络中的实际收益，提出双分支谱门控架构DBSG-PINN。五个一维PDE基准显示，频率分解主要有利于谱结构复杂、多尺度的问题，而对平滑单尺度问题收益有限，某些情况下甚至不如更简单变体。由于实验仅使用单一训练种子，作者将结果定位为探索性研究。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 偏微分方程（PDE）常常具有高频和多尺度特征，而神经网络难以近似这些特征。物理信息神经网络（PINNs）将控制方程直接纳入训练，但会遭受谱偏置：它们学习低频分量的速度快于高频分量。傅里叶特征嵌入和正弦激活等技术试图解决这一问题，但大多数研究都假定它们普遍有帮助，而没有检查究竟哪些谱区间真正受益。我们引入了一种双分支、谱门控架构（DBSG-PINN），它将低频和高频分量分离到由自适应门连接的不同子网络中，并用它对频率分解和谱路由进行部分受控的消融实验。我们在五个一维基准PDE上测试该方法，这些PDE从平滑的单尺度问题到振荡的多尺度问题不等。频率分解在谱复杂基准上帮助最大，在一个多模态波问题上将相对L2误差最多降低59.2%，但在更平滑的PDE上收益很小。在一个基准（1D Wave）上，它的表现明显差于一个更简单的固定组合变体。门控的收益随目标解的谱丰富程度而变化：完整模型相对于消融模型的优势在多尺度基准上最大，而在单尺度基准上最小（或为负），这与门控利用频率结构而非充当噪声的解释一致，尽管我们在本研究中没有直接可视化或量化其空间激活。所有结果都来自五个一维基准上的单一训练种子，因此我们将其作为一项旨在提出问题而非回答问题的探索性研究，并概述了检验这一模式是否成立所需的额外种子和基准。

articles.title: Demystifying Reinforcement Learning Post-Training of Language Models
articles.title_zh: 揭示语言模型强化学习后训练的机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training has emerged as a powerful framework for enhancing the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), enabling impressive reasoning, math, and coding capabilities. Yet for many researchers and practitioners, the principles behind classical RL remain a "black box". In this work, we deconstruct the RL post-training algorithm, investigating each step to clarify what is actually happening beneath the surface. By isolating the mechanics of RL with Verifiable Rewards in a controlled and simplified environment, we examine how RL outcomes are shaped by the base model's prior distribution, the granularity of the reward signal, the diversity of the prompt distribution, and model scale. We use the entropy of the policy's output distribution as a lens to compare the distributions learned through pretraining, SFT, and RL post-training, revealing how each stage shapes model certainty. Our investigation sheds light on how these choices interact to affect post-training success. For example, we show that the effect of so-called 'spurious rewards' depends on the prompt distribution used for post-training. We also provide insight into why the success of RL post-training depends on whether the base model already places sufficient probability mass on the desired behavior, linking it to the classical concept of exploration in RL. Ultimately, we provide this primer as a resource to those in the NLP community wishing to incorporate RL as a tool in their toolbox.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向大语言模型的强化学习后训练，拆解其算法步骤并分析其在可验证奖励环境中的作用机制。作者考察基础模型先验、奖励粒度、提示分布多样性和模型规模如何影响后训练结果，并用输出分布熵比较预训练、监督微调和强化学习阶段对模型确定性的塑造。研究强调，强化学习后训练的成功依赖于基础模型是否已对目标行为分配足够概率质量，并与经典强化学习中的探索概念相关。
authors: Donovan Clay, Saket Gollapudi, Sankar Harilal, Min Jang, Jacob Morrison, Sewoong Oh, Natasha Jaques
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强化学习（RL）后训练已成为增强大型语言模型（LLM）能力的强大框架，使其展现出令人印象深刻的推理、数学和编码能力。然而，对于许多研究者和实践者而言，经典强化学习背后的原则仍然是一个“黑箱”。在这项工作中，我们拆解RL后训练算法，研究每一步，以澄清表象之下实际发生了什么。通过在受控且简化的环境中隔离带有可验证奖励的RL机制，我们考察RL结果如何受到基础模型先验分布、奖励信号粒度、提示分布多样性和模型规模的影响。我们以策略输出分布的熵为视角，比较通过预训练、监督微调（SFT）和RL后训练学到的分布，揭示每个阶段如何塑造模型确定性。我们的研究阐明了这些选择如何相互作用并影响后训练成功。例如，我们表明所谓“虚假奖励”的影响取决于后训练所使用的提示分布。我们还解释了为什么RL后训练的成功取决于基础模型是否已经在期望行为上放置了足够的概率质量，并将其与RL中的经典探索概念联系起来。最终，我们将这篇入门性文章提供给希望将RL纳入其工具箱的自然语言处理社区成员作为资源。

articles.title: Why and When Neural Networks Improve Local Approximation in Optimization
articles.title_zh: 神经网络为何以及何时能改进优化中的局部近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24963v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Published experience with neural surrogates in derivative-free optimisation is contradictory: the same family of models that cuts the evaluation count of one solver leaves another unchanged, or makes it worse. We show that the contradiction dissolves once three factors are stated, and that these, rather than the fit accuracy a training curve reports, are what delimit when a learned local model pays. Role: a surrogate that proposes candidates the true objective must still approve helps, while one that replaces a gradient the solver depends on hurts. Radius: a model fitted to an optimisation path is reliable only inside a bounded neighbourhood, and its error neither vanishes as that neighbourhood shrinks nor survives its growth. Room: a surrogate can only accelerate progress the base method is still able to make. We formalise radius-aware local generalisation, relate it to the classical fully linear condition, and test each factor with the surrogate class, training pipeline and base method held fixed. Over 117 benchmark instances safeguarded assistance raises the instances solved to high accuracy from 67 to 84 while gradient replacement lowers them to 65; removing the gradient term from the training loss cuts surrogate acceptance from 0.703 to 0.148; and 1000 paired comparisons over ten noise levels show no noise threshold, only a base method that stops early. The same factors bound the gain: a model-based trust-region solver, which leaves little room, drops from 88 to 86 when the identical surrogate is attached, and released interpolation software stays ahead at 103, and on a Monte-Carlo inventory model repairing the acceptance interface is worth 10.40 cost units against 0.00 for the surrogate.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文解释了神经代理模型在无导数优化中表现不一致的原因，指出其收益取决于角色、半径和余地三类因素。作者形式化了半径感知的局部泛化，并通过受控实验表明，用于提出候选点且保留真实目标审批的代理更有帮助，而替代求解器依赖梯度的代理可能有害。结果还显示，代理增益受到基础方法本身可继续改进空间的限制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 关于无导数优化中神经代理模型的已发表经验彼此矛盾：同一类模型会减少一个求解器的评估次数，却让另一个求解器不变，或使其变得更差。我们表明，一旦明确三个因素，这种矛盾就会消解；限定一个学习到的局部模型何时值得使用的，正是这些因素，而不是训练曲线所报告的拟合精度。角色：提出候选点且仍需真实目标批准的代理模型会有帮助，而替代求解器所依赖梯度的代理模型会造成损害。半径：沿优化路径拟合的模型只在有界邻域内可靠，其误差既不会随着邻域缩小而消失，也无法在邻域扩大后保持可靠。余地：代理模型只能加速基础方法仍有能力取得的进展。我们形式化了半径感知的局部泛化，将其与经典的全线性条件联系起来，并在代理模型类别、训练流程和基础方法保持固定的情况下测试每个因素。在117个基准实例上，带保护的辅助将达到高精度求解的实例数从67提高到84，而梯度替代将其降低到65；从训练损失中移除梯度项会将代理接受率从0.703降至0.148；在十个噪声水平上的1000次配对比较显示，不存在噪声阈值，只有会提前停止的基础方法。同样的因素也限制了收益：一个基于模型的信赖域求解器由于留下的余地很小，在接入相同代理后从88降至86；公开的插值软件仍以103领先；而在一个蒙特卡洛库存模型上，修复接受接口带来10.40个成本单位的收益，相比之下代理模型本身带来的收益为0.00。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Error Field Learning: A Post-Training Optimization Framework for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 物理信息误差场学习：用于物理信息神经网络的后训练优化框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24970v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as an important class of numerical methods for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, during the late-stage optimization process, further parameter updates often yield diminishing accuracy improvements while increasing computational costs. To address this issue, this paper proposes a Physics-Informed Error Field Learning (PIEFL) framework for PINNs. Unlike conventional approaches that continuously approximate the solution field using a single network, PIEFL introduces an auxiliary error network after the primary network achieves satisfactory accuracy and shifts the learning objective from the solution field to the error field. By deriving error control equations under physical constraints, the error network learns the discrepancy between the current approximation and the exact solution, and the learned error correction is combined with the primary prediction to improve solution accuracy. The proposed framework avoids continuous optimization of the entire solution space and focuses computational resources on correcting existing prediction errors. Moreover, PIEFL requires no modification to the primary network architecture, making it compatible with existing PINN models and applicable as a general post-training optimization strategy. Numerical experiments on representative PDEs demonstrate that PIEFL achieves higher solution accuracy under the same computational budget, validating its effectiveness in improving the performance of PINNs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出物理信息误差场学习（PIEFL）框架，用于提升PINN在后期优化阶段的效率和精度。该方法在主网络达到一定精度后引入辅助误差网络，将学习目标从解场转向误差场，并在物理约束下学习当前近似与精确解之间的差异。实验表明，在相同计算预算下，PIEFL可提高代表性PDE问题的解精度，且无需修改原有PINN架构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）已成为求解偏微分方程（PDE）的重要数值方法类别。然而，在后期优化过程中，进一步的参数更新往往只带来递减的精度改进，却增加计算成本。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种用于PINNs的物理信息误差场学习（PIEFL）框架。不同于使用单个网络持续近似解场的传统方法，PIEFL在主网络达到令人满意的精度后引入一个辅助误差网络，并将学习目标从解场转向误差场。通过在物理约束下推导误差控制方程，误差网络学习当前近似与精确解之间的差异，并将学到的误差修正与主预测结合，以提高解的精度。所提出的框架避免了对整个解空间的持续优化，并将计算资源集中用于修正已有预测误差。此外，PIEFL不需要修改主网络架构，因此与现有PINN模型兼容，并可作为一种通用的后训练优化策略应用。代表性PDE上的数值实验表明，PIEFL在相同计算预算下实现了更高的解精度，验证了其在提升PINN性能方面的有效性。

articles.title: LibriBrain100: One Hundred Hours of Broad and Deep MEG Data for Neural Speech Decoding at Scale
articles.title_zh: LibriBrain100：用于大规模神经语音解码的一百小时宽深度MEG数据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25204v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce LibriBrain100, a large-scale MEG dataset for speech decoding designed from the ground up for reproducible, standardised evaluation. LibriBrain100 more than doubles the size of the original LibriBrain release, resulting in over 100 hours of high-quality MEG acquired while subjects listened to naturalistic continuous speech. With sim80 hours from a single subject, LibriBrain100 sets a new record for deep, within-subject neural data (8× more than the next comparable dataset and roughly 80× more than other datasets). To demonstrate the payoff of this depth-first design, we evaluate on a word-classification benchmark---an increasingly well-established stepping stone towards the open challenge of noninvasive brain-to-text decoding. Using an existing decoding model, we achieve state-of-the-art performance---validating both the quality of the recordings and the value of within-subject data at scale. Because collecting 80 hours of data per user is impractical for real-world applications, we also collected sim40 minutes of additional data from each of 32 subjects. Using the same word-classification benchmark, we demonstrate the value of broad multi-subject data: supervised finetuning of a pre-trained model can substantially compensate for limited per-subject data. We provide standard train, validation, and test splits, all reproducible through an open-sourced Python library that supports easy downloading, optional preprocessing, and data loading for common deep learning frameworks. In addition, the dataset and evaluation infrastructure are being released alongside an open machine-learning competition with a public leaderboard for standardised benchmarking. Ultimately, our hope is that LibriBrain100 will accelerate progress towards practical non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, capable of restoring communication to people living with severe paralysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍LibriBrain100，一个面向可复现、标准化语音解码评估的大规模MEG数据集。该数据集包含超过100小时自然连续语音聆听过程中的高质量MEG记录，其中约80小时来自单一受试者，同时还包含32名受试者各约40分钟的数据。作者在词分类基准上验证了深度单被试数据和广泛多被试数据的价值，并发布标准划分、开源工具库和机器学习竞赛基础设施。
authors: Francesco Mantegna, Dulhan Jayalath, Gereon Elvers, Tasha Kim, Benjamin Ballyk, Alex Fung, SungJun Cho, Teyun Kwon, Luisa Kurth, Miran Özdogan, Gilad Landau, Pratik Somaiya, Natalie Voets, Mark Woolrich, Oiwi Parker Jones
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们介绍LibriBrain100，这是一个为可复现、标准化评估而从头设计的大规模MEG语音解码数据集。LibriBrain100的规模超过原始LibriBrain版本的两倍，包含受试者聆听自然连续语音时采集的100多小时高质量MEG数据。凭借来自单一受试者的约80小时数据，LibriBrain100创下了深度被试内神经数据的新纪录（比下一个可比数据集多8倍，并约为其他数据集的80倍）。为展示这种深度优先设计的收益，我们在词分类基准上进行评估；该基准正日益成为通向非侵入式脑到文本解码这一开放挑战的成熟中间步骤。使用一个已有解码模型，我们实现了最先进性能，验证了记录质量以及大规模被试内数据的价值。由于每位用户采集80小时数据对于现实应用并不实际，我们还从32名受试者中的每一位采集了约40分钟的额外数据。使用相同的词分类基准，我们展示了广泛多被试数据的价值：对预训练模型进行监督微调可以显著弥补每名受试者数据有限的问题。我们提供标准训练、验证和测试划分，所有划分都可通过一个开源Python库复现，该库支持便捷下载、可选预处理，以及面向常见深度学习框架的数据加载。此外，该数据集和评估基础设施将与一个带公共排行榜的开放机器学习竞赛同步发布，用于标准化基准测试。最终，我们希望LibriBrain100能够加速实用非侵入式脑机接口的发展，使其有能力为重度瘫痪患者恢复交流。

articles.title: Neither Precision Nor Architecture Alone: Controlled Tests of Failure Remedies for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 既非精度也非架构单独决定：物理信息神经网络失效补救方法的受控测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25327v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) frequently fail on stiff or advection-dominated PDEs, and two recent accounts offer competing remedies: switching from FP32 to FP64 to repair an L-BFGS stopping artifact, or replacing the MLP with a state-space-model (SSM) backbone plus sub-sequence alignment to counter architectural simplicity bias. We test both under matched, seed-paired controls in a pre-registered 144-run study spanning convection, reaction, and wave, plus an independent 85-run convection/wave study; success is relative ell₂ error below 0.05. The two remedies act on disjoint regime-and-seed slices: neither substitutes for the other. On hard convection (β=50), alignment recovers 2/5 seeds in FP32 and 3/5 in FP64, where the unaligned SSM succeeds on 0/5 seeds at either precision and the vanilla MLP moves only from 0/5 to 1/5 across the precision switch---the recoveries trace to the alignment objective, not the backbone. On reaction the backbone alone already succeeds on 3/5--4/5 seeds, so each remedy covers a regime the other does not. Responses are also seed-specific: the same precision switch flips individual seeds in opposite directions and, on wave, lowers median error with no statistically significant success gain. Tightening the inner L-BFGS tolerance in an independent repeated-step runner likewise lowers median error at a large runtime cost, with success counts unchanged. Precision, stopping, backbone, and alignment must therefore be evaluated jointly and reported per seed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文比较了两类针对PINN在刚性或对流主导PDE上失效的补救方案：从FP32切换到FP64，以及使用SSM骨干并加入子序列对齐。通过配对种子控制实验，作者发现两种方法作用于不同的方程区域和种子切片，不能相互替代。结果强调，精度、停止准则、骨干网络和对齐目标必须联合评估，并逐种子报告。
authors: Jinyuan Zhang, Peng He, He Hu, Yin Yuan, ShengShuo Jiao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在刚性或对流主导的PDE上经常失败，而近期有两种解释提出了相互竞争的补救方法：从FP32切换到FP64以修复L-BFGS停止伪影，或者用状态空间模型（SSM）骨干加子序列对齐替代MLP，以抵消架构简单性偏置。我们在匹配的、种子配对的控制条件下测试两者，进行了一项预注册的144次运行研究，覆盖对流、反应和波问题，另有一项独立的85次运行对流/波研究；成功定义为相对ell2误差低于0.05。两种补救方法作用于彼此分离的区域与种子切片：二者都不能替代对方。在困难对流（β=50）上，对齐在FP32中恢复了5个种子中的2个，在FP64中恢复了5个种子中的3个；而未对齐SSM在两种精度下均为5个种子中0个成功，普通MLP在精度切换后也只从5个种子中0个成功变为1个成功——这些恢复归因于对齐目标，而不是骨干网络。在反应问题上，仅骨干网络已经在5个种子中的3到4个上成功，因此每种补救方法都覆盖了另一种方法无法覆盖的区域。响应还具有种子特异性：同样的精度切换会使不同种子朝相反方向翻转；在波问题上，它降低了中位误差，但没有带来统计显著的成功率提升。在一个独立的重复步运行器中收紧内部L-BFGS容差同样会以很大的运行时间代价降低中位误差，但成功次数不变。因此，精度、停止、骨干网络和对齐必须联合评估，并按种子报告。

articles.title: Joint Initialization of Flux Networks and Effective Multiplication Factor for Physics-Informed Neural Networks Solving Neutron Diffusion Problems
articles.title_zh: 用于求解中子扩散问题的物理信息神经网络中通量网络与有效增殖因子的联合初始化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25443v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Efficient determination of the effective multiplication factor (keff) is an important computational task in reactor core neutronics analysis. Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) incorporate neutron diffusion equations and boundary conditions into network training to efficiently determine the neutron flux distribution and keff. To further improve the efficiency of keff calculations using PINNs, a Joint Initialization Physics-Informed Neural Network (JI-PINN) is proposed in this work. In this method, a low-resolution approximate solution to the K-eigenvalue problem is used to construct a joint initial state for the flux network parameters and keff, and both are then jointly optimized under physical constraints. The proposed method was validated on a two-dimensional two-group two-material case, the IAEA 2D benchmark, a two-dimensional two-group four-material case, and a three-dimensional single-group case. For these test cases, the total computational time was reduced by 25.4%, 38.2%, 49.4%, and 28.9%, respectively, while comparable solution accuracy was maintained. The occurrence of anomalous results associated with marked deviations of keff from the reference value was also reduced. The proposed method provides a more efficient and robust initialization strategy for solving neutron diffusion K-eigenvalue problem with PINNs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出联合初始化物理信息神经网络（JI-PINN），用于提升PINN求解中子扩散K特征值问题中有效增殖因子keff的效率。该方法利用低分辨率近似解同时初始化通量网络参数和keff，并在物理约束下联合优化。多个二维和三维算例显示，该方法在保持相近精度的同时减少计算时间，并降低keff异常偏离参考值的情况。
authors: Qin Hang, Yangdi Yi, Jiayi Li, Xu Wang, Heng Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高效确定有效增殖因子（keff）是反应堆堆芯中子学分析中的一项重要计算任务。物理信息神经网络（PINNs）将中子扩散方程和边界条件纳入网络训练，以高效确定中子通量分布和keff。为进一步提高使用PINNs计算keff的效率，本文提出了一种联合初始化物理信息神经网络（JI-PINN）。在该方法中，K特征值问题的低分辨率近似解被用于为通量网络参数和keff构造联合初始状态，随后二者在物理约束下联合优化。所提出方法在二维两群两材料算例、IAEA二维基准、二维两群四材料算例以及三维单群算例上得到验证。对于这些测试算例，总计算时间分别减少了25.4%、38.2%、49.4%和28.9%，同时保持了相当的解精度。与keff显著偏离参考值相关的异常结果发生次数也有所减少。所提出方法为使用PINNs求解中子扩散K特征值问题提供了一种更高效且更稳健的初始化策略。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Foresight Pruning for Sparse PINN Solvers of Nonlinear PDEs
articles.title_zh: 用于非线性PDE稀疏PINN求解器的物理信息前瞻剪枝
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25564v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) often rely on over-parameterized models to optimize coupled solution and differential-residual objectives, leaving unclear how much capacity is necessary and what pruning should preserve. We study foresight pruning at initialization for sparse PirateNet PDE solvers. Standard neural tangent kernel spectrum-aware pruning (NTK-SAP) aims to preserve output-side training dynamics but may overlook parameters whose main influence arises through derivatives in the governing equations. We introduce physics-informed spectrum-aware pruning (PI-SAP), which assigns saliency using sensitivity of the PDE residual. Experiments on the Gray-Scott equations, complex Ginzburg-Landau equation, Burgers' equation, and linear convection equation show that PI-SAP more consistently preserves Gray-Scott residual fidelity and is competitive under aggressive sparsity. However, no criterion is uniformly optimal across equations or sparsity levels. Small-batch PINN-NTK diagnostics further show that residual fidelity, solution accuracy, and kernel conditioning are distinct objectives, motivating pruning methods that explicitly balance solution-side and residual-side training dynamics during optimization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究在初始化阶段对稀疏PirateNet PDE求解器进行前瞻剪枝，重点关注PINN中应保留哪些模型容量。作者提出物理信息谱感知剪枝（PI-SAP），用PDE残差敏感性定义参数重要性，以补足仅关注输出侧训练动态的NTK-SAP。多类方程实验显示，PI-SAP在残差保真方面更稳定且在高稀疏度下具有竞争力，但不存在对所有方程和稀疏度都最优的剪枝准则。
authors: Ahmad Ishaque Karimi, Uvini Balasuriya Mudiyanselage, Kookjin Lee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）常常依赖过参数化模型来优化耦合的解和微分残差目标，这使得究竟需要多少容量以及剪枝应保留什么仍不清楚。我们研究用于稀疏PirateNet PDE求解器的初始化前瞻剪枝。标准神经切线核谱感知剪枝（NTK-SAP）旨在保留输出侧训练动态，但可能忽略那些主要通过控制方程中的导数发挥影响的参数。我们引入物理信息谱感知剪枝（PI-SAP），它使用PDE残差的敏感性来分配显著性。在Gray-Scott方程、复Ginzburg-Landau方程、Burgers方程和线性对流方程上的实验表明，PI-SAP更一致地保留Gray-Scott残差保真度，并且在激进稀疏条件下具有竞争力。然而，没有任何准则在所有方程或稀疏水平上都统一最优。小批量PINN-NTK诊断进一步表明，残差保真度、解精度和核条件数是不同目标，这促使剪枝方法在优化过程中显式平衡解侧和残差侧训练动态。

articles.title: LDAC-Net: A Learnable Multi-Lag Differencing Attention-Convolution Network for Drift-Robust Recognition with Low-Cost MOX Gas Sensors
articles.title_zh: LDAC-Net：用于低成本MOX气体传感器抗漂移识别的可学习多滞后差分注意力卷积网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Portable electronic-nose systems based on low-cost metal-oxide (MOX) gas sensors offer a practical solution for gas and odour recognition, but their signals are affected by slow chemical transients, drifting sensor offsets, scale variation, and cross-channel correlations. Existing pipelines commonly use fixed first-order temporal differencing (FOTD), which requires a manually selected lag and may discard useful response information. We propose LDAC-Net, an end-to-end learnable multi-lag differencing attention-convolution network that operates directly on multi-channel MOX signals. Its learnable differential feature enhancement front-end combines window-conditioned statistical affine normalisation, which compensates for window-specific offset and scale variation, with learnable multi-lag differencing, which weights and combines temporal differences across multiple lags. A compact attention-convolution backbone subsequently models local transients and longer-range temporal dependencies. On the 50-class SmellNet-Base task, LDAC-Net achieves 68.2% top-1 accuracy, exceeding the best FOTD-preprocessed comparison model by approximately 14 percentage points and the raw-input Transformer by more than 30 points. Ablation studies confirm the contributions of both proposed components. The representation also transfers to SmellNet-Mixtures, improving accuracy from 45.4% to 50.5%, and generalises to the 62-channel eNose-Drift benchmark under strong long-term drift, achieving 70.6% top-1 accuracy and 69.6% macro-F1. These results outperform the best comparison model with dataset-retuned FOTD preprocessing by 8.0 and 3.0 points, respectively, demonstrating that learnable, sensor-aware preprocessing is more effective than fixed handcrafted differencing for low-cost MOX gas-sensor recognition.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出LDAC-Net，一种端到端可学习的多滞后差分注意力卷积网络，用于低成本金属氧化物气体传感器的气体和气味识别。该方法通过窗口条件统计仿射归一化和可学习多滞后差分补偿漂移、尺度变化和时间响应问题，再由注意力卷积骨干建模时序依赖。实验表明，LDAC-Net在SmellNet-Base、SmellNet-Mixtures和eNose-Drift基准上优于固定手工差分预处理方法。
authors: Xin Zhang, Liangxiu Han, Yue Shi, Tam Sobeih
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于低成本金属氧化物（MOX）气体传感器的便携式电子鼻系统为气体和气味识别提供了实用方案，但其信号会受到缓慢化学瞬态、传感器偏置漂移、尺度变化和跨通道相关性的影响。现有流程通常使用固定的一阶时间差分（FOTD），这需要手动选择滞后，并可能丢弃有用的响应信息。我们提出LDAC-Net，这是一种端到端可学习的多滞后差分注意力卷积网络，可直接处理多通道MOX信号。其可学习差分特征增强前端结合了窗口条件统计仿射归一化与可学习多滞后差分；前者补偿窗口特定的偏置和尺度变化，后者对多个滞后的时间差分进行加权和组合。随后，一个紧凑的注意力卷积骨干网络对局部瞬态和更长程时间依赖进行建模。在50类SmellNet-Base任务上，LDAC-Net达到68.2%的top-1准确率，比最佳FOTD预处理对比模型高约14个百分点，比原始输入Transformer高30多个百分点。消融研究确认了两个所提组件的贡献。该表示还可迁移到SmellNet-Mixtures，将准确率从45.4%提高到50.5%，并能在强长期漂移下泛化到62通道eNose-Drift基准，达到70.6%的top-1准确率和69.6%的宏平均F1。这些结果分别比使用数据集重新调优FOTD预处理的最佳对比模型高8.0和3.0个百分点，表明对于低成本MOX气体传感器识别，可学习的、传感器感知的预处理比固定手工差分更有效。

articles.title: A Constitutive Markov Physics-Informed Neural Operator (MPNO) for Autoregressive Stability in Transient Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于瞬态动力学自回归稳定性的本构马尔可夫物理信息神经算子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural operators applied to transient-dynamics PDEs with strong discontinuities exhibit autoregressive instability: in concrete-penetration stress-field prediction, the wavelet neural operator (WNO) diverges in autoregressive rollout, while MeshGraphNets collapse to zero predictions. WNO's instability stems from the lack of a structural constraint on the spectral radius of its propagation operator; the Fourier neural operator (FNO) is stable in these measurements but only emergently, not by construction. We propose a constitutive Markov physics-informed neural operator (MPNO) modeling one-step evolution as a Markov (row-stochastic) propagation operator. Physics-coupled edge weights (acoustic-impedance harmonic mean, contact area, and traction amplitude) encode material-interface constitutive information into a nonnegative symmetric adjacency matrix W; after normalizing the graph Laplacian L = D - W by lambdaₘₐₓ, the propagator P = I - alpha*L~ is constructively constrained to spectral radius rho(P) <= 1, suppressing exponential amplification of autoregressive errors. Stability is thus a designable architectural property, not an optimized loss objective. On three PDEs (Burgers and two-dimensional transverse-section concrete penetration), MPNO rolls out stably with bounded error on all test seeds at 100/135/165 m/s; the single-step relative L2 error is 0.7304 +/- 0.0008, better than WNO and comparable to FNO at about one quarter of FNO's parameters. The edge-weight formula transfers across scenarios by replacing material-property variables. With about 20K parameters, MPNO delivers roughly 10⁵x inference speedup over LS-DYNA.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出本构马尔可夫物理信息神经算子（MPNO），用于缓解强间断瞬态动力学PDE中的自回归不稳定。该方法将一步演化建模为马尔可夫传播算子，通过物理耦合边权和归一化图拉普拉斯构造谱半径不超过1的传播器，使稳定性成为架构设计属性。实验显示，MPNO在Burgers方程和二维混凝土侵彻问题上可稳定滚动预测，以较少参数达到与FNO相当的精度，并较LS-DYNA获得约10⁵倍推理加速。
authors: Wenpu Du, Peng Zhou, Yunlong Xia, Sinuo Xin, Congcong Zhang, Boyang Zhang, Yi Zhang, Wenzheng Xu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 应用于具有强间断的瞬态动力学PDE的神经算子会表现出自回归不稳定：在混凝土侵彻应力场预测中，小波神经算子（WNO）在自回归滚动中发散，而MeshGraphNets则塌缩为零预测。WNO的不稳定源于其传播算子的谱半径缺乏结构性约束；傅里叶神经算子（FNO）在这些测量中是稳定的，但这种稳定性是涌现的，而非由构造保证。我们提出一种本构马尔可夫物理信息神经算子（MPNO），将一步演化建模为马尔可夫（行随机）传播算子。物理耦合边权（声阻抗调和平均、接触面积和牵引幅值）将材料界面本构信息编码到非负对称邻接矩阵W中；在用lambdaₘₐₓ归一化图拉普拉斯L=D-W后，传播器P=I-alpha*L~在构造上被约束为谱半径rho(P)<=1，从而抑制自回归误差的指数放大。因此，稳定性是一种可设计的架构属性，而不是一个优化出来的损失目标。在三个PDE上（Burgers方程和二维横截面混凝土侵彻），MPNO在100/135/165 m/s的所有测试种子上都能以有界误差稳定滚动；其单步相对L2误差为0.7304 +/- 0.0008，优于WNO，并以约为FNO四分之一的参数量达到与FNO相当的水平。边权公式可通过替换材料属性变量在不同情景间迁移。MPNO约有20K个参数，相比LS-DYNA实现了约10⁵倍的推理加速。

articles.title: Learning Continuous Regional Temperature Fields with Lead-Time and Resolution Queries
articles.title_zh: 利用提前时效和分辨率查询学习连续区域温度场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25823v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate regional near-surface temperature forecasting is fundamental to short-range weather services and downstream risk assessment. Existing deep learning-based regional forecasters commonly produce a fixed set of future frames on a prescribed grid, limiting their use when forecast products must be evaluated at query-dependent lead times or display resolutions. To overcome these fixed-output constraints, we formulate regional T2M forecasting as query-conditioned continuous spatiotemporal temperature field evaluation and propose the Continuous Spatiotemporal Temperature Forecaster (CSTF), a neural field that turns forecast lead time and output resolution into explicit queries when evaluating 2-m temperature (T2M). Specifically, CSTF first encodes multivariable ERA5 histories into latent meteorological states and then decodes T2M as a coordinate-based field. Accordingly, spatial location, forecast lead time, and output resolution are introduced as queries, enabling standard hourly forecasts, intermediate lead-time diagnostics, and resolution-controllable outputs within a unified field-evaluation framework. Furthermore, to maintain coherence across flexible field queries, we design spatial-gradient, temporal-difference, and scale-consistency objectives that regularize regional thermal structures, lead-wise evolution, and cross-resolution agreement. Experiments on the Southeast China 0-6 h ERA5-Land benchmark demonstrate that CSTF achieves the best aggregate deterministic skill, including a 17.0 percent reduction in Bias, with global-scope diagnostics further illustrating flexible lead-time and resolution-controllable inference.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将区域2米气温预报表述为由查询条件控制的连续时空温度场评估问题，以突破固定时效和固定网格输出的限制。作者提出CSTF神经场模型，将空间位置、预报提前时效和输出分辨率显式作为查询，并通过空间梯度、时间差分和尺度一致性目标维持预测一致性。在中国东南部0-6小时ERA5-Land基准上的实验表明，CSTF取得最佳综合确定性技能，并显著降低偏差，同时支持灵活时效和分辨率可控推理。
authors: Chunlei Shi, Jiong Wang, Yi-Lin Wei, Junming Hou, Jinjin Liu, Yecheng Zhang, Dan Niu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确的区域近地面温度预报是短临天气服务和下游风险评估的基础。现有基于深度学习的区域预报模型通常在预设网格上生成一组固定的未来帧，当预报产品需要在依赖查询的提前时效或显示分辨率下进行评估时，这限制了它们的使用。为克服这些固定输出约束，我们将区域T2M预报表述为查询条件化的连续时空温度场评估问题，并提出连续时空温度预报器（CSTF），这是一种神经场，在评估2米气温（T2M）时将预报提前时效和输出分辨率转化为显式查询。具体而言，CSTF首先将多变量ERA5历史资料编码为潜在气象状态，然后将T2M解码为基于坐标的场。相应地，空间位置、预报提前时效和输出分辨率被引入为查询，从而在统一的场评估框架内实现标准逐小时预报、中间提前时效诊断以及分辨率可控输出。此外，为了在灵活场查询之间保持一致性，我们设计了空间梯度、时间差分和尺度一致性目标，用以正则化区域热结构、逐时效演变以及跨分辨率一致性。在中国东南部0-6小时ERA5-Land基准上的实验表明，CSTF取得了最佳的综合确定性技能，包括Bias降低17.0%，而全球范围诊断进一步展示了灵活提前时效和分辨率可控推理能力。

articles.title: Quantum-Inspired Modeling of Driving Behavior
articles.title_zh: 受量子启发的驾驶行为建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25907v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Driver behavior is heterogeneous, context-dependent, and changes over time, and these properties shape the traffic phenomena we observe. Most models, however, fix in advance which behavioral variables interact and how. Behavior outside that form is absorbed as noise, while models flexible enough to capture it tend to lose interpretability. We introduce a quantum-inspired representation of driver behavior that combines properties usually treated separately or in part: it is continuous, probabilistic, context-dependent, history-dependent, and represents interactions among behavioral variables as learned from data. Each driver is encoded as an evolving density matrix, providing a unified representation of behavioral uncertainty, temporal evolution, and context-dependent behavioral variation. Trained without supervision on the I-24 MOTION dataset, the framework recovers three interpretable driving profiles representing three regimes: free flow, transition, and congestion. The profiles capture the behavioral range of the data and the smooth transitions drivers make between regimes as conditions change. The same representation also reproduces known macroscopic phenomena, aligning with the fundamental diagram and reproducing hysteresis loops. We also show how the representation supports practical use: it supplies context-dependent parameters to classical car-following models, and gives an autonomous vehicle a live behavioral read of the surrounding drivers with a short-horizon forecast of their motion. The framework points toward models of traffic that are interpretable and trustworthy by construction. We release an open-source toolkit on GitHub (https://github.com/mselayan/quantum-driver-representation) spanning data processing, training, inference, and analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种受量子启发的驾驶行为表示，用演化的密度矩阵统一刻画行为不确定性、时间演化和上下文依赖变化。该框架在I-24 MOTION数据集上无监督训练，恢复出自由流、过渡和拥堵三种可解释驾驶画像，并能再现基本图和滞后环等宏观交通现象。作者还展示了其在经典跟驰模型参数化和自动驾驶车辆周边行为实时读取与短期预测中的应用。
authors: Mohammad Elayan, Omid Armantalab, Wissam Kontar
articles.abstract_zh_full: 驾驶员行为具有异质性、依赖情境并随时间变化，而这些性质塑造了我们观察到的交通现象。然而，大多数模型会预先固定哪些行为变量相互作用以及如何相互作用。超出该形式的行为会被吸收为噪声，而足够灵活以捕捉这些行为的模型又往往会失去可解释性。我们提出一种受量子启发的驾驶员行为表示，将通常被分开或部分处理的性质结合起来：它是连续的、概率性的、依赖情境的、依赖历史的，并且将行为变量之间的相互作用表示为从数据中学习得到的关系。每位驾驶员被编码为一个演化的密度矩阵，从而为行为不确定性、时间演化和情境依赖的行为变化提供统一表示。该框架在I-24 MOTION数据集上以无监督方式训练，恢复出三个可解释的驾驶画像，分别代表三种状态：自由流、过渡和拥堵。这些画像捕捉了数据中的行为范围，以及随着条件变化驾驶员在不同状态之间进行的平滑转换。同一表示还再现了已知的宏观现象，与交通基本图相一致，并再现了滞后环。我们还展示了该表示如何支持实际应用：它为经典跟驰模型提供情境依赖参数，并为自动驾驶车辆提供对周边驾驶员的实时行为解读以及对其运动的短时域预测。该框架指向一种在构造上具备可解释性和可信性的交通模型。我们在GitHub上发布了一个开源工具包，涵盖数据处理、训练、推理和分析。

articles.title: The Dialect Tax: Dialectal Biases Persist throughout the Language Modeling Pipeline
articles.title_zh: 方言税：方言偏差贯穿语言建模流程始终
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.24952v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Systematic dialectal performance gaps in language models (LMs) are well documented, but the source of these disparities within the modern language modeling pipeline remains unclear. Our study traces this "dialect tax" across the natural language processing pipeline. Using parallel English dialect corpora that hold meaning fixed while varying surface form, we first confirm that LMs recognize matched Standard American English (SAE) and dialectal texts as semantically equivalent. However, we discover further representational gaps corresponding to downstream performance gaps. Across model families and generations, modern LMs still encode dialectal texts unequally during tokenization, pre-training, post-training, and inference. Strikingly, bypassing traditional subword segmentation via a character-level counterfactual tokenizer removes neither input and output asymmetries nor dialectal accuracy gaps. During pre-training, dialect pairs induce more divergent gradient updates than pairs of entirely unrelated SAE documents, indicating that models find semantically equivalent dialectal content harder to learn from than unrelated SAE documents. During post-training, reward models show contextual, unstable dialect preferences, assigning higher values to isolated AAVE-exclusive tokens than to SAE-exclusive tokens, while full reasoning contexts receive task- and model-dependent dialect penalties. Overall, our findings suggest that the dialect tax is encoded and accumulated not by any one step in isolation, but at every step of the language modeling process.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究追踪语言模型中系统性方言性能差距在自然语言处理流程中的来源。尽管模型能够识别标准美式英语与方言文本在语义上等价，作者发现从分词、预训练、后训练到推理，各阶段仍持续编码并累积方言不平等。结果表明，“方言税”并非由单一步骤造成，而是在语言建模全过程中逐步形成。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 语言模型（LMs）中系统性的方言性能差距已有充分记录，但这些差异在现代语言建模流程中的来源仍不清楚。我们的研究沿自然语言处理流程追踪这种“方言税”。使用在保持意义不变的同时改变表层形式的平行英语方言语料库，我们首先确认语言模型能够将匹配的标准美式英语（SAE）文本和方言文本识别为语义等价。然而，我们发现了进一步的表征差距，并且这些差距对应于下游性能差距。跨模型家族和模型世代来看，现代语言模型在分词、预训练、后训练和推理期间仍然不平等地编码方言文本。引人注目的是，通过字符级反事实分词器绕过传统子词切分，既不能消除输入和输出不对称，也不能消除方言准确率差距。在预训练期间，方言文本对诱导出的梯度更新比完全无关的SAE文档对更加发散，这表明与无关SAE文档相比，模型更难从语义等价的方言内容中学习。在后训练期间，奖励模型表现出情境化且不稳定的方言偏好：它们赋予孤立的AAVE专有词元比SAE专有词元更高的值，而完整推理语境则受到依任务和依模型而变化的方言惩罚。总体而言，我们的发现表明，方言税不是由任何单一步骤孤立编码和积累的，而是在语言建模过程的每一步中都被编码并累积。

articles.title: Improved Analysis for Hessian-free High-resolution Monte Carlo Sampling
articles.title_zh: 无Hessian高分辨率蒙特卡洛采样的改进分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25052v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hessian-free high-resolution (HFHR) dynamics augments underdamped Langevin dynamics (ULD) with reversible position diffusion for sampling problems that arise in machine learning. We establish an explicit quantitative contraction rate for HFHR dynamics under a position Poincaré inequality, weighted Hessian and Laplacian bounds, and a compact Sobolev embedding, where the potential function is not necessarily convex. An adapted time-augmented Poincaré inequality yields an explicit rate that improves upon the contraction rate of the underdamped Langevin dynamics. We also give a weak-solution construction and a self-contained spectral proof of the divergence lemma underlying the argument. For HFHR Monte Carlo (HFHRMC) algorithm, which is based on a discretization scheme of HFHR dynamics, we use a path-space Girsanov argument to obtain a non-asymptotic convergence bound and an explicit iteration complexity in total variation distance. The bounds hold for every α≥0 and γ>0 and remain regular at the ULD endpoint. Optimizing the iteration complexity bound yields a positive, accuracy-dependent position-diffusion parameter at finite accuracy, while its leading high-accuracy order coincides with that of the optimized ULD endpoint. Our iteration complexity bound improves upon the existing work on HFHR algorithms. Numerical experiments including Bayesian learning problems on real data are provided to illustrate the effect of positive α and its benefit.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究对用于机器学习采样问题的无Hessian高分辨率动力学给出改进的定量收缩分析。作者在位置Poincaré不等式、加权Hessian与Laplacian界以及紧Sobolev嵌入条件下，建立了显式收缩率，并证明其优于欠阻尼Langevin动力学的收缩率。针对离散化得到的HFHRMC算法，论文利用路径空间Girsanov论证给出总变差距离下的非渐近收敛界和显式迭代复杂度，并通过数值实验展示正位置扩散参数的效果。
authors: Wujun Lv, Xiaoyu Wang, Yingli Wang, Lingjiong Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无Hessian高分辨率（HFHR）动力学通过加入可逆的位置扩散来增强欠阻尼Langevin动力学（ULD），用于机器学习中出现的采样问题。我们在位置Poincaré不等式、加权Hessian和Laplacian界以及紧Sobolev嵌入条件下，为HFHR动力学建立了显式的定量收缩率，其中势函数不一定是凸的。一个适配的时间增强Poincaré不等式给出了显式速率，该速率优于欠阻尼Langevin动力学的收缩率。我们还给出了弱解构造，以及对论证所依赖的散度引理的自洽谱证明。对于基于HFHR动力学离散化方案的HFHR蒙特卡洛（HFHRMC）算法，我们使用路径空间Girsanov论证获得了总变差距离下的非渐近收敛界和显式迭代复杂度。这些界对每个α≥0和γ>0都成立，并且在ULD端点处保持正则。优化迭代复杂度界会在有限精度下得到一个正的、依赖精度的位置扩散参数，而其高精度主导阶与优化后的ULD端点一致。我们的迭代复杂度界改进了关于HFHR算法的已有工作。包括真实数据上的贝叶斯学习问题在内的数值实验被用于说明正α的影响及其益处。

articles.title: Lowering the Barrier to AI-Driven Inspection: A No-Code Workflow for Automated Structural Defect Detection
articles.title_zh: 降低AI驱动检测门槛：用于结构缺陷自动检测的无代码工作流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25176v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Structural health monitoring (SHM) is essential in modern engineering, providing data for condition-based maintenance, lifecycle assessment, and predictive decision-making. Traditionally, SHM relied on visual inspection to detect defects such as cracks and deformations. Early computer vision (CV) methods, including thresholding, edge detection, and handcrafted features, aimed to automate this process but were highly sensitive to noise, imaging variations, and multiscale defects, limiting their reliability. Recent advances in machine learning, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and You Only Look Once (YOLO), have improved defect detection accuracy and enabled real-time analysis. However, adoption in SHM remains limited due to technical barriers such as data labeling, model training, and deployment, which typically require programming expertise. To address this gap, we introduce YOLOEZ, an open-source, GUI-based tool for end-to-end YOLO model application. YOLOEZ integrates data labeling, training, and inference into a single interface, enabling high-performance model development without code while supporting reproducible workflows. Evaluation against existing software and classical image processing demonstrates that YOLOEZ not only outperforms traditional methods across most detection metrics, but also lowers adoption barriers present in other modern CV tools. By combining accuracy with accessibility, YOLOEZ facilitates wider use of AI-driven monitoring for predictive maintenance, digital twins, and intelligent structural systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向结构健康监测中AI视觉检测的落地门槛，提出开源图形界面工具YOLOEZ。该工具将数据标注、模型训练和推理整合到单一界面中，使用户无需编程即可开发高性能YOLO缺陷检测模型并保持工作流可复现。评估显示，YOLOEZ在多数检测指标上优于传统图像处理方法，同时降低了现代计算机视觉工具的使用门槛。
authors: Michael Holm, Tanner McElroy, Xinghang Zhang, Guang Lin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 结构健康监测（SHM）在现代工程中至关重要，可为基于状态的维护、生命周期评估和预测性决策提供数据。传统上，SHM依赖视觉检查来检测裂缝和变形等缺陷。早期计算机视觉（CV）方法，包括阈值化、边缘检测和手工特征，旨在自动化这一过程，但它们对噪声、成像变化和多尺度缺陷高度敏感，从而限制了可靠性。近年来机器学习的进展，特别是卷积神经网络（CNN）和You Only Look Once（YOLO），提高了缺陷检测精度并实现了实时分析。然而，由于数据标注、模型训练和部署等技术障碍通常需要编程专业知识，SHM中的采用仍然有限。为解决这一缺口，我们引入YOLOEZ，这是一个开源、基于图形用户界面的端到端YOLO模型应用工具。YOLOEZ将数据标注、训练和推理整合到一个界面中，在支持可复现工作流的同时，使无需代码的高性能模型开发成为可能。与现有软件和经典图像处理方法的评估对比表明，YOLOEZ不仅在大多数检测指标上优于传统方法，而且降低了其他现代CV工具中存在的采用门槛。通过将准确性与可访问性结合起来，YOLOEZ促进了AI驱动监测在预测性维护、数字孪生和智能结构系统中的更广泛使用。

articles.title: WAVE: Reversing the Guidance Hierarchy for Coarse-to-Fine Guided Depth Super-Resolution
articles.title_zh: WAVE：为由粗到细引导的深度超分辨率反转引导层级
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25302v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Guided depth super-resolution (GDSR) typically extracts RGB guidance features through convolutional hierarchies, inheriting their fine-to-coarse bias. Thus, low-level spatial cues surface in early layers, leaving the deeper layers to suppress those that do not correspond to true depth boundaries, which risks artifacts and blurred edges. The same fine-to-coarse bias persists in semantics-based methods that consume low-level tokens early and global tokens late. We present WAVE, which introduces a multi-level discrete wavelet transform (ML-DWT) as an explicit and interpretable feature-control mechanism, enabling a coarse-to-fine reconstruction by consuming sub-bands and semantic tokens in reverse of their generation order. WAVE further exploits these sub-bands to treat high- and low-frequency content separately, filtering at its source the misleading RGB color and texture cues that often lead to blurred boundaries and artifacts, offering an intuitive alternative to the suppression learned implicitly by an opaque network. WAVE separates structure and detail reconstruction into dedicated modules that: i) model interactions within and across wavelet sub-bands, depth features, and semantic priors, ii) apply semantic gating to the high-frequency bands, and iii) fuse modalities through an invertible coupling mechanism that prevents collapse onto a single modality. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that WAVE matches or outperforms existing methods, with the largest gains at high upsampling factors, where low-resolution depth contains the least structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对引导深度超分辨率中RGB引导特征的由细到粗偏置，提出WAVE方法，通过多层离散小波变换显式控制特征并实现由粗到细重建。WAVE以与生成顺序相反的方式使用小波子带和语义词元，分别处理高频与低频内容，从源头过滤误导性的RGB颜色和纹理线索。多基准实验显示，WAVE达到或超过现有方法，尤其在高倍上采样时收益最大。
authors: Tayyab Nasir, Daochang Liu, Ajmal Mian
articles.abstract_zh_full: 引导深度超分辨率（GDSR）通常通过卷积层级提取RGB引导特征，继承了其由细到粗的偏置。因此，低层空间线索出现在早期层，而更深层则需要抑制那些不对应真实深度边界的线索，这会带来伪影和边缘模糊风险。同样的由细到粗偏置也存在于基于语义的方法中，这类方法早期使用低层词元，晚期使用全局词元。我们提出WAVE，它引入多层离散小波变换（ML-DWT）作为一种显式且可解释的特征控制机制，通过以其生成顺序的反向使用子带和语义词元，实现由粗到细的重建。WAVE进一步利用这些子带分别处理高频和低频内容，从源头过滤经常导致边界模糊和伪影的误导性RGB颜色与纹理线索，为不透明网络隐式学习的抑制提供一种直观替代方案。WAVE将结构重建和细节重建分离到专门模块中，这些模块：i）建模小波子带、深度特征和语义先验内部及其之间的交互，ii）对高频带应用语义门控，iii）通过可逆耦合机制融合模态，防止塌缩到单一模态。跨多个基准的大量实验表明，WAVE达到或优于现有方法，并且在高上采样倍数下获得最大增益，此时低分辨率深度包含的结构最少。

articles.title: BVR Sim: An Open and High-Throughput Environment for Heterogeneous Air-Combat Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: BVR Sim：面向异构空战强化学习的开放高吞吐环境
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25419v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Beyond-visual-range (BVR) air combat is a challenging reinforcement-learning domain characterized by partial observability, long-horizon decision making, energy management, and limited weapons. We present BVR Sim, an open-source Gymnasium-style environment designed for heterogeneous air-combat reinforcement learning. BVR Sim supports multiple JSBSim aircraft models, including the F-15, F-16, F/A-18, and F-22, with configurable weapons, sensors, controllers, and opponents. A unified tactical action interface specifies desired heading, altitude, speed, and weapon release above aircraft-specific inner-loop controllers, enabling policies to operate across heterogeneous platforms. The environment provides interchangeable Python and accelerated C++ backends, entity-oriented observations, compositional rewards, scripted opponents, replay and visualization, and adapters for multi-agent learning frameworks. At a 0.4-s decision interval, the C++ backend achieves 104 simulated seconds per wall-clock second in 1-vs-1 and remains practical through 10-vs-10 scenarios. A policy trained only on the F-16 transfers without retraining to four unseen aircraft, reaching a 45.5% mean win rate with aircraft-specific controller adaptation. MAPPO and HAPPO experiments further verify end-to-end compatibility with standard multi-agent reinforcement-learning pipelines.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出BVR Sim，一个开源Gymnasium风格环境，用于超视距异构空战强化学习。环境支持多种JSBSim飞机模型、可配置武器与传感器、统一战术动作接口、Python和加速C++后端，以及多智能体学习适配。实验显示其具有较高仿真吞吐，并验证了跨机型迁移和与标准多智能体强化学习流程的兼容性。
authors: Haocheng Sun (Beijing University of Posts,Telecommunications), Mulai Tan (Air Force Engineering University)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超视距（BVR）空战是一个具有挑战性的强化学习领域，其特点包括部分可观测、长时域决策、能量管理和武器有限。我们提出BVR Sim，这是一个开源的Gymnasium风格环境，面向异构空战强化学习而设计。BVR Sim支持多种JSBSim飞机模型，包括F-15、F-16、F/A-18和F-22，并具有可配置的武器、传感器、控制器和对手。统一的战术动作接口在飞机特定的内环控制器之上指定期望航向、高度、速度和武器释放，使策略能够跨异构平台运行。该环境提供可互换的Python和加速C++后端、面向实体的观测、组合式奖励、脚本化对手、回放与可视化，以及面向多智能体学习框架的适配器。在0.4秒决策间隔下，C++后端在1对1场景中达到每墙钟秒104个仿真秒，并在10对10场景中仍保持实用。仅在F-16上训练的策略无需重新训练即可迁移到四种未见过的飞机，在结合飞机特定控制器适配后达到45.5%的平均胜率。MAPPO和HAPPO实验进一步验证了其与标准多智能体强化学习流程的端到端兼容性。

articles.title: Data-driven Effective Modeling of Stochastic Chemical Reaction Networks
articles.title_zh: 随机化学反应网络的数据驱动有效建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25421v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Stochastic Simulation Algorithm (SSA), widely considered an exact algorithm for stochastic chemical reaction networks, suffers from high computational cost. In this work, we propose a data-driven effective model that operates on a user-defined coarse time step independent of the underlying microscopic reaction-event scale. This is accomplished by directly approximating the finite-time transition kernel of the continuous-time Markov chain induced by SSA, using a generative machine learning model trained on short bursts of SSA simulation data. The trained model constructs a stochastic propagator that recursively generates statistically consistent trajectories at the constant coarse time step, with significantly reduced computational cost. In this paper, we employ conditional normalizing flow as the stochastic propagator. A comprehensive set of numerical examples is presented to demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种面向随机化学反应网络的数据驱动有效模型，以用户定义的粗时间步运行，而不依赖底层微观反应事件尺度。方法通过用短时SSA仿真数据训练生成式机器学习模型，直接近似SSA诱导的连续时间Markov链的有限时间转移核。作者采用条件归一化流作为随机传播器，并通过多组数值例子展示其准确性和效率。
authors: Yuan Chen, Weize Mao, Dongbin Xiu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随机模拟算法（SSA）被广泛认为是随机化学反应网络的精确算法，但其计算成本很高。在这项工作中，我们提出一种数据驱动的有效模型，该模型在用户定义的粗时间步上运行，并且独立于底层微观反应事件尺度。这是通过直接近似由SSA诱导的连续时间Markov链的有限时间转移核来实现的，所使用的是在短时SSA仿真数据片段上训练的生成式机器学习模型。训练后的模型构造一个随机传播器，以恒定粗时间步递归生成统计上一致的轨迹，同时显著降低计算成本。在本文中，我们采用条件归一化流作为随机传播器。文中给出了一组全面的数值例子，以展示所提出方法的准确性和效率。

articles.title: SAMpLE: A SystemC-AMS Machine LEarning-based Framework for Virtual Prototyping
articles.title_zh: SAMpLE：一种基于机器学习的 SystemC-AMS 虚拟原型设计框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25910v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine Learning (ML) is increasingly used in virtual prototypes of embedded systems to model behaviors that are difficult to capture analytically. However, integrating ML models into virtual platform simulation is still typically done through ad hoc solutions, which limits reuse, comparability, and reproducibility. This paper presents textbfSAMpLE, an open-source SystemC-AMS-based framework that integrates ML models as first-class Timed Dataflow (TDF) components through a standardized plug-and-play interface. SAMpLE provides two execution backends: a native C++ backend for online training of lightweight models, and an offline backend for executing externally developed models without requiring re-implementation in C++ or manual integration steps. The framework uses ONNX as a standard model exchange format to enable integration of externally trained ML models into SystemC-AMS simulations, and allows the evaluation of different ML-based solutions within the same testbench, dataset, and simulation workflow. The modular design and unified and reproducible environment will allow future extensions of SAMpLE to new models, without modifying the SystemC-AMS structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习正 increasingly 被用于嵌入式系统虚拟原型，以建模难以通过解析方法描述的行为，但其与虚拟平台仿真的集成通常依赖临时性方案。本文提出开源的 SystemC-AMS 框架 SAMpLE，通过标准化即插即用接口，将机器学习模型作为一等定时数据流组件集成，并支持原生 C++ 在线训练和基于 ONNX 的离线模型执行。该框架使不同机器学习方案能够在相同的测试平台、数据集和仿真流程中进行可复现比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习（ML）正日益用于嵌入式系统的虚拟原型设计，以建模难以通过解析方法捕捉的行为。然而，将机器学习模型集成到虚拟平台仿真中的工作目前通常仍通过临时性方案完成，这限制了模型的复用性、可比性与可复现性。本文提出了 SAMpLE，这是一个基于开源 SystemC-AMS 的框架，通过标准化的即插即用接口，将机器学习模型作为一等定时数据流（TDF）组件进行集成。SAMpLE 提供两种执行后端：一种是用于轻量级模型在线训练的原生 C++ 后端，另一种是用于执行外部开发模型的离线后端，后者无需在 C++ 中重新实现模型，也不需要手动完成集成步骤。该框架采用 ONNX 作为标准模型交换格式，从而支持将外部训练的机器学习模型集成到 SystemC-AMS 仿真中，并允许在同一个测试平台、数据集和仿真工作流中评估不同的机器学习解决方案。其模块化设计以及统一、可复现的环境，将使 SAMpLE 未来能够扩展到新的模型，而无需修改 SystemC-AMS 的结构。

articles.title: Imitation Learning for Connection-Tableau Construction
articles.title_zh: 用于连接表推理构造的模仿学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.26009v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An automated theorem prover builds a proof step by step, choosing at each point what to add and what to remove. We cast this construction as a policy acting in a transition system induced by a formal calculus, which fixes which steps are sound: for clausal connection tableaux, leanCoP-style search and plCoP/rlCoP-style planning then become stateful policies over one interface, and policy-learning methods apply directly. We equip such policies with a graph neural network that scores proof edits from structure that transfers across problems, train it by imitation learning from found proofs, and measure how performance holds as we remove search scaffolding, from full symbolic backtracking to a policy the network drives alone. Within a fixed step budget on M2k, MPTP2078-bushy, and TPTP v9.2.1, learned policies solve up to 46% more problems than leanCoP, and reach proofs in an order of magnitude fewer steps.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将自动定理证明器逐步构造证明的过程表述为形式演算所诱导的状态转移系统中的策略，并将连接表演算搜索与规划统一到同一接口下。研究者利用图神经网络根据问题结构为证明编辑操作评分，并通过已找到的证明进行模仿学习训练。实验表明，在固定步数预算下，学习策略在多个基准数据集上最多比 leanCoP 多解决 46% 的问题，并能以少一个数量级的步数找到证明。
authors: Fredrik Rømming, Mantas Bakšys, Martin S. Fixman, Sean B. Holden
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自动定理证明器通过逐步构造证明来工作，在每一步选择要添加和删除的内容。我们将这种构造过程表述为一个作用于状态转移系统的策略，而该状态转移系统由形式演算诱导，并规定哪些步骤是可靠的：对于子句连接表，leanCoP 风格的搜索以及 plCoP/rlCoP 风格的规划随后都可被视为通过同一接口实现的有状态策略，因此策略学习方法可以直接应用。我们为这些策略配备了图神经网络，使其能够利用可跨问题迁移的结构信息，对证明编辑操作进行评分；同时，我们从已找到的证明中进行模仿学习来训练该网络，并通过逐步移除搜索辅助机制，测量性能如何从完整的符号回溯下降到完全由网络驱动的策略。在 M2k、MPTP2078-bushy 和 TPTP v9.2.1 数据集上的固定步数预算内，学习策略解决的问题数量最多比 leanCoP 高 46%，并且能够以少一个数量级的步骤找到证明。

articles.title: Provable Non-Acceleration of Standard Strang Splittings of Kinetic Langevin Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 动力学 Langevin 动力学标准 Strang 分裂的可证明非加速性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.25279v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The OBABO and BAOAB schemes and the other standard Strang splittings of kinetic (underdamped) Langevin dynamics are widely used Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms. Under a suitable friction scaling, the underlying diffusion relaxes on a ballistic time scale, suggesting that these discretizations, suitably tuned, sample targets with condition number κ in O(sqrtκ) iterations. We prove that no fixed choice of step size and friction, based only on the curvature bounds and the dimension, achieves this acceleration: total variation mixing time lower bounds for OBABO show that ballistic cold-start mixing fails uniformly over the smooth strongly convex class, and the lower bounds extend, with the same orders, to BAOAB and the other four Strang splittings. The proof transfers non-acceleration from optimization to sampling. Eliminating velocity gives an exact noisy heavy-ball recursion, and by the non-acceleration theorem of Goujaud, Taylor and Dieuleveut, for every tuning either some Gaussian target has a mode with relaxation time at least of order κ, or an attracting cycle exists on a smooth potential; dilating such a potential as U_R(x)=R²U(x/R) preserves its curvature bounds and produces metastability for a number of steps exponential in R², from an initial state at Wasserstein distance O(R) from equilibrium. Using contraction estimates of Leimkuhler, Paulin and Whalley and a Wasserstein-to-total-variation regularization estimate, we prove a complementary upper bound of O(κ) steps, up to logarithmic factors, for a fixed-parameter OBABO tuning. Hence, among fixed-parameter OBABO tunings, the optimal condition-number dependence of cold-start total variation mixing over this class is linear, up to logarithmic factors. A direct Gaussian calculation also rules out fixed-parameter acceleration for the left-endpoint exponential integrator.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文证明，OBABO、BAOAB 及其他动力学 Langevin 动力学的标准 Strang 分裂，在仅依据曲率界和维度固定选择步长与摩擦系数时，无法对具有条件数 κ 的目标分布实现普遍的平方根加速。针对 OBABO 的总变差混合时间下界表明，光滑强凸类上的弹道式冷启动混合并不统一成立，相关下界也适用于其他 Strang 分裂。研究进一步表明，在固定参数调节下，冷启动总变差混合时间的最优条件数依赖关系至多可达到带对数因子的线性阶。
articles.abstract_zh_full: OBABO 和 BAOAB 方案以及动力学（欠阻尼）Langevin 动力学的其他标准 Strang 分裂，都是广泛使用的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法。在适当的摩擦系数缩放下，其基础扩散过程会在弹道时间尺度上达到松弛，这暗示经过适当调节后，这些离散化方法或许能够在 O(sqrtκ) 次迭代内对条件数为 κ 的目标分布进行采样。我们证明，仅依据曲率界和维度进行固定选择的步长与摩擦系数，不可能实现这种加速：针对 OBABO 的总变差混合时间下界表明，在光滑强凸函数类上，弹道式冷启动混合无法一致成立；并且这些下界以相同的阶数推广到 BAOAB 和其他四种 Strang 分裂。该证明将优化问题中的非加速性转移到了采样问题中。消去速度变量后，可以得到一个精确的带噪声重球递推；根据 Goujaud、Taylor 和 Dieuleveut 的非加速定理，对于任意参数调节，要么某个高斯目标存在一个松弛时间至少为 κ 阶的模态，要么在某个光滑势函数上存在吸引周期。将这类势函数缩放为 U_R(x)=R²U(x/R) 可以保持其曲率界不变，并从一个与平衡分布的 Wasserstein 距离为 O(R) 的初始状态出发，在数量关于 R² 呈指数增长的步数内产生亚稳态。利用 Leimkuhler、Paulin 和 Whalley 的收缩估计，以及从 Wasserstein 距离到总变差距离的正则化估计，我们进一步证明，对于固定参数的 OBABO 调节，其步数上界为 O(κ)，但会相差对数因子。因此，在固定参数的 OBABO 调节中，对于该类目标分布，冷启动总变差混合的最优条件数依赖关系是线性的，至多相差对数因子。直接的高斯计算还排除了固定参数左端点指数积分器实现加速的可能性。

articles.title: On computing and the complexity of computing higher-order U-statistics, exactly
articles.title_zh: 高阶 U 统计量的精确计算及其计算复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.12627v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Higher-order U-statistics abound in fields such as statistics, machine learning, and computer science, but are known to be highly time-consuming to compute in practice. Despite their widespread appearance, a comprehensive study of their computational complexity is surprisingly lacking. This paper aims to fill this gap by presenting several results related to the computational aspect of U-statistics. First, we derive a useful decomposition from a m-th order U-statistic to a linear combination of V-statistics with orders not exceeding m, which are generally more feasible to compute. Second, we explore the connection between exactly computing V-statistics and Einstein summation, a tool often used in computational mathematics and quantum computing to accelerate tensor computations. Third, we provide an optimistic estimate of the time complexity for exactly computing U-statistics, based on the treewidth of a particular graph associated with the U-statistic kernel. The above ingredients lead to (1) a new, much more runtime-efficient algorithm to exactly compute general higher-order U-statistics, and (2) a more streamlined characterization of runtime complexity of computing U-statistics. We develop an accompanying open-source package called textttu-stats in both Python (https://github.com/zrq1706/U-Statistics-Python) and R (https://github.com/cxy0714/U-Statistics-R). We demonstrate through three examples in statistics that textttu-stats achieves impressive runtime performance compared to existing benchmarks. This paper also aspires to achieve two goals: (1) to capture the interest of researchers in both statistics and other related areas to further advance the algorithmic development of U-statistics and (2) to lift the burden of implementing higher-order U-statistics from practitioners.
articles.abstract_zh: 高阶 U 统计量广泛存在于统计学、机器学习和计算机科学中，但实际计算成本很高，相关计算复杂度研究仍不充分。本文建立了从 m 阶 U 统计量到不超过 m 阶 V 统计量线性组合的分解，分析了精确计算 V 统计量与爱因斯坦求和之间的联系，并基于相关图的树宽给出复杂度估计。研究据此提出了更高效的精确计算算法和开源 Python、R 软件包，并通过统计学实例展示了其运行性能。
authors: Xingyu Chen, Ruiqi Zhang, Lin Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 高阶 U 统计量广泛存在于统计学、机器学习和计算机科学等领域，但众所周知，它们在实践中的计算非常耗时。尽管高阶 U 统计量应用广泛，对其计算复杂度的全面研究却出人意料地不足。本文旨在通过给出若干与 U 统计量计算方面相关的结果来填补这一空白。首先，我们推导出一种有用的分解，将一个 m 阶 U 统计量分解为阶数不超过 m 的 V 统计量的线性组合，而后者通常更易于计算。其次，我们探讨了精确计算 V 统计量与爱因斯坦求和之间的联系；爱因斯坦求和是计算数学和量子计算中常用来加速张量计算的一种工具。第三，我们基于与 U 统计量核相关的特定图的树宽，为精确计算 U 统计量的时间复杂度提供了一个较为乐观的估计。上述内容促成了两个结果：（1）一种用于精确计算一般高阶 U 统计量的新算法，且其运行效率显著高于现有方法；（2）一种更加简洁的 U 统计量计算运行复杂度刻画。我们还开发了配套的开源软件包 u-stats，分别提供 Python 和 R 版本。通过统计学中的三个实例，我们展示了与现有基准方法相比，u-stats 具有出色的运行性能。本文还希望实现两个目标：（1）吸引统计学及其他相关领域的研究者进一步推进 U 统计量的算法开发；（2）减轻实践者实现高阶 U 统计量时所承担的负担。

articles.title: Surrogate-Assisted Reliability, Optimization, and Parameter Back-Analysis in Geotechnical Engineering: A State-of-the-Art Synthesis
articles.title_zh: 岩土工程中的代理辅助可靠性分析、优化与参数反分析：现状综合评述
articles.abstract: Surrogate metamodeling in geomechanics has reached a critical structural turning point. While legacy approximation frameworks built upon static, linearizing response surfaces historically optimized computational workflows, their structural failure is evident when navigating the high-dimensional parameter spaces, severe multi-physics couplings, and localized non-linear failure envelopes typical of real-world infrastructure assets. A highly rigorous, state-of-the-art critical synthesis is delivered in this paper, breaking away from redundant historical tracking to chart the 2024–2026 data-driven frontier. A definitive, comparative taxonomy of six core metamodel variants is established: Polynomial Response Surfaces (PRSM), Radial Basis Functions (RBF), Kriging (KSM), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Support Vector Regression (SVR), and Moving Least Squares (MLSM). Crucially, the limitations of traditional frameworks are exposed, and the paradigm shift toward sequential active learning loops, multi-fidelity information fusion, and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) is decoded. The operational execution of these advanced hybrid architectures is dissected across three core pillars: low-probability geotechnical reliability analysis under spatial variability (Random Fields), generative multi-objective design optimization, and real-time parameter inverse back-analysis for digital twin deployment. Finally, current structural bottlenecks — including curse-of-dimensionality limits, numerical noise filtering, and automated hyper-parameter tuning (AutoML) — are critically cross-examined. By bridging the gap between historical foundational mechanics and modern intelligent computing, a definitive strategic roadmap is provided for resilient and predictive geotechnical engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统综述了代理元建模在岩土工程可靠性分析、优化和参数反分析中的发展，重点关注 2024 至 2026 年的数据驱动方法。文章比较了多项式响应面、径向基函数、克里金、人工神经网络、支持向量回归和移动最小二乘六类元模型，并讨论了主动学习、多保真信息融合及物理信息神经网络等发展方向。研究还围绕空间变异条件下的低概率可靠性分析、多目标设计优化和数字孪生中的实时参数反演，梳理了相关混合架构及其面临的维数灾难、数值噪声和超参数自动调节等瓶颈。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 岩土力学中的代理元建模已经迎来一个关键的结构性转折点。传统上建立在静态线性化响应面之上的近似框架，曾经优化了计算工作流；然而，当面对真实基础设施资产中常见的高维参数空间、严重的多物理场耦合以及局部化非线性破坏包络时，这些框架的结构性失效已经十分明显。本文给出了一项高度严谨的前沿批判性综合评述，突破了冗余的历史脉络梳理，转而描绘 2024 至 2026 年的数据驱动前沿。文章建立了六类核心元模型变体的确定性比较分类体系：多项式响应面（PRSM）、径向基函数（RBF）、克里金（KSM）、人工神经网络（ANN）、支持向量回归（SVR）和移动最小二乘（MLSM）。文章尤其揭示了传统框架的局限，并解析了向序贯主动学习循环、多保真信息融合以及物理信息神经网络（PINN）转变的范式变化。研究围绕三项核心任务，剖析了这些先进混合架构的实际运行方式：具有空间变异性的低概率岩土可靠性分析（随机场）、生成式多目标设计优化，以及面向数字孪生部署的实时参数逆向反分析。最后，文章对当前的结构性瓶颈进行了批判性考察，包括维数灾难的限制、数值噪声滤除以及超参数自动调节（AutoML）。通过弥合历史基础力学与现代智能计算之间的差距，本文为构建具有韧性和预测能力的岩土工程提供了一份明确的战略路线图。

articles.title: Network Dominance and the MITM Exception: A Modality-Aware Analysis of IIoT Intrusion Detection on the DataSense Benchmark
articles.title_zh: 网络模态的主导地位与 MITM 例外：基于 DataSense 基准的模态感知型 IIoT 入侵检测分析
articles.abstract: The Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) is rapidly expanding the attack surface of critical infrastructure, and intrusion detection systems (IDSs) are increasingly relied upon as the principal automated defence. Recent benchmark datasets such as DataSense provide synchronized network traffic and device telemetry to enable cross-modal IDS research, and a growing body of work assumes that combining these modalities improves detection. However, the per-attack-category contribution of each modality has not been empirically tested on this newest generation of IIoT benchmarks. This paper presents a modality-aware analysis of IIoT intrusion detection on DataSense, partitioning the 84 pre-extracted features into 76 network and 8 telemetry channels (reduced to 64 network and 7 telemetry features after removal of leakage-prone string-valued columns) and constructing three feature configurations: network-only, telemetry-only, and fused. We train Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM, and Support Vector Machine classifiers under each configuration for binary, seven-class, and fine-grained eighty-four-class classification, producing 36 experimental conditions. Results show that the network channel alone is nearly sufficient: XGBoost on network-only features achieves 0.9890 macro F1 on binary detection and 0.9819 on the seven-class task, within 0.6 percentage points of the fused configuration in every category. SHAP attribution confirms that network features account for over 99 percent of explanatory weight in six of seven attack categories, with man-in-the-middle (MITM) being the single exception at approximately 10 percent telemetry contribution. The dominance result holds across both 1-second and 10-second window granularities. Practical implication: for cost-constrained IIoT monitoring, the 8 telemetry features as currently engineered in DataSense add minimal value over the network channel, except when MITM-class attacks must be distinguished.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于 DataSense 基准研究工业物联网入侵检测中网络流量与设备遥测两种模态的相对贡献，并构建网络独有、遥测独有和融合三种特征配置。研究使用随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM 和支持向量机，开展二分类、七分类和细粒度 84 分类实验。结果显示，网络特征几乎已足够完成检测，遥测特征总体增益很小；但在区分中间人攻击时，遥测信息的贡献明显增加。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 工业物联网（IIoT）正在迅速扩大关键基础设施的攻击面，而入侵检测系统（IDS）越来越多地被依赖为主要的自动化防御手段。DataSense 等近期基准数据集提供了同步的网络流量和设备遥测数据，从而支持跨模态入侵检测研究；越来越多的研究假设，结合这些模态能够改善检测效果。然而，在新一代 IIoT 基准数据集上，各种攻击类别中不同模态的具体贡献尚未得到经验性检验。本文对 DataSense 上的 IIoT 入侵检测进行了模态感知分析，将预先提取的 84 个特征划分为 76 个网络特征和 8 个遥测特征；在移除容易造成数据泄漏的字符串型列后，特征数量分别减少为 64 个网络特征和 7 个遥测特征。研究构建了三种特征配置：仅网络、仅遥测以及融合特征。针对每种配置，我们分别训练随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM 和支持向量机分类器，并在二分类、七分类和细粒度 84 分类任务下开展实验，共形成 36 种实验条件。结果表明，仅网络通道已经几乎足够完成检测：在仅使用网络特征时，XGBoost 在二分类检测中的宏平均 F1 值达到 0.9890，在七分类任务中达到 0.9819；在所有类别中，这一结果与融合配置的差距均不超过 0.6 个百分点。SHAP 归因分析进一步证实，在七类攻击中的六类中，网络特征占据了超过 99% 的解释权重；唯一的例外是中间人（MITM）攻击，其遥测贡献约为 10%。无论采用 1 秒还是 10 秒的时间窗口粒度，网络特征的主导地位均保持不变。实际意义在于：对于成本受限的 IIoT 监测系统，目前 DataSense 中设计的 8 个遥测特征相比网络通道所增加的价值非常有限；但当任务需要区分 MITM 类攻击时，遥测特征仍然具有作用。

articles.title: Electric-field control of coherent ferron oscillations
articles.title_zh: 相干铁子振荡的电场调控
articles.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 27 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03406-0 Understanding the non-equilibrium dynamics of ferrons—collective excitations of electric polarization—is crucial for device applications. Now electric-field control of coherent ferron oscillations is demonstrated in a layered ferroelectric.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕铁子这一电极化的集体激发及其非平衡动力学展开，重点关注其器件应用意义。根据所给信息，研究在层状铁电体中展示了利用电场调控相干铁子振荡的现象。具体实验方法与定量结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: Adaptive mixture-of-experts denoising for deep learning of optical ellipsometry spectra
articles.title_zh: 用于光学椭偏光谱深度学习的自适应混合专家去噪
articles.abstract: Spectral noise limits the reliability of deep-learning ellipsometry (DLE), particularly under short measurement times required for high-throughput materials characterization. Here, we propose an adaptive denoising framework that integrates a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) module into a U-Net architecture for spectroscopic ellipsometry. The MoE dynamically assigns expert weights according to input-dependent noise characteristics, enabling data-driven specialization across diverse noise regimes. To further enhance robustness, we introduce an iterative denoising strategy coupled with a pretrained DLE-based selection mechanism that enforces reliable evaluation of candidate outputs. The model is trained exclusively on simulated spectra with artificial noise, yet it is shown to be effective on experimental data from 27 semiconductor thin-film materials measured using two distinct ellipsometry systems. The proposed MoE-based method reduces the global DLE prediction error by 34.5%–65.0%, depending on the measurement time, achieving the maximum 65.0% reduction under the shortest measurement time (1 s) where noise is most severe. By adopting the MoE denoising architecture, bandgap estimation accuracy improves significantly, with the mean absolute error reduced by 44.3% using the iterative MoE approach. In addition to improving prediction accuracy, the proposed method is 43 times faster than the corresponding transfer learning approach and eliminates the need for substrate-dependent retraining. These results demonstrate that MoE-driven adaptive specialization provides a computationally efficient and highly reliable strategy for robust spectral denoising in deep-learning-based ellipsometric analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 光谱噪声限制了深度学习椭偏测量（DLE）的可靠性，尤其是在材料高通量表征所需的短测量时间下。本文提出一种将混合专家（MoE）模块整合进U-Net架构的自适应去噪框架，根据输入相关的噪声特征动态分配专家权重，并结合迭代去噪策略和基于预训练DLE的候选结果选择机制。该模型仅使用带人工噪声的模拟光谱训练，却能有效处理来自两套椭偏仪系统测量的27种半导体薄膜实验数据；根据测量时间不同，整体DLE预测误差降低34.5%至65.0%，迭代MoE方法使带隙估计平均绝对误差降低44.3%，运行速度较相应迁移学习方法快43倍，并无需依赖衬底重新训练。
authors: Yuki Yamamoto, Ren Iwayama, Yuki Ikarashi, James N Hilfiker, Jyunya Takashima, Takuji Maekawa, Hitoshi Tampo and Hiroyuki Fujiwara
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光谱噪声限制了深度学习椭偏测量（DLE）的可靠性，尤其是在材料高通量表征所需的短测量时间下。本文提出一种自适应去噪框架，将混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts，MoE）模块整合到用于光谱椭偏测量的U-Net架构中。MoE根据输入相关的噪声特征动态分配专家权重，从而能够针对不同噪声状态实现数据驱动的专业化处理。为了进一步提高鲁棒性，我们引入了迭代去噪策略，并结合一种基于预训练DLE的选择机制，以确保对候选输出进行可靠评估。该模型完全使用带人工噪声的模拟光谱进行训练，但在使用两套不同椭偏仪系统测量的27种半导体薄膜实验数据上显示出良好效果。所提出的基于MoE的方法使整体DLE预测误差降低34.5%至65.0%，具体降幅取决于测量时间；在噪声最严重的最短测量时间（1秒）下，误差降幅最大，达到65.0%。采用MoE去噪架构后，带隙估计精度显著提高；使用迭代MoE方法时，平均绝对误差降低了44.3%。除提高预测精度外，该方法的速度比相应的迁移学习方法快43倍，并且不需要依赖衬底进行重新训练。这些结果表明，由MoE驱动的自适应专业化为基于深度学习的椭偏分析中的稳健光谱去噪提供了一种计算效率高且可靠性强的策略。

articles.title: From Hyperspectral Signatures to Robotic LiDAR-Based Moisture Monitoring: A Machine Learning-Based Framework
articles.title_zh: 从高光谱特征到基于机器人激光雷达的水分监测：一种基于机器学习的框架
