Upon heating, the Tb moment decreases progressively whereas the Fe moment remains constant up to 150 K. At 160 K both Tb and Fe moments sharply decrease, and a 0.38% contraction of the cell volume is observed due to an itinerant electron metamagnetic behavior of the Fe sublattice. This transition temperature is 76 K higher than that of YFe₂D₄.₂ due to an increase in cell volume, as well as exchange interactions between the Fe and Tb moments. The deuteride becomes paramagnetic above 220 K.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合多种磁性测量、高脉冲磁场实验以及随温度和外场变化的中子衍射，研究了单斜TbFe₂D₄.₂的磁性。该化合物基态为亚铁磁态，Tb和Fe磁矩分别为8.2(2) μB和2.1(2) μB；在4.2 K时表现出与Tb磁矩有关的强磁各向异性，并在3 T和29 T处出现两个变磁转变。升温过程中，Tb磁矩逐渐减小而Fe磁矩保持不变至150 K，160 K时二者均显著下降并伴随晶胞体积收缩，氘化物在220 K以上转变为顺磁态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过结合不同的磁性测量（包括高脉冲磁场测量）以及随温度和外加磁场变化的中子衍射实验，研究了单斜TbFe₂D₄.₂的磁性质。TbFe₂D₄.₂具有亚铁磁基态，其中Tb磁矩MTb = 8.2(2) μB，Fe磁矩MFe = 2.1(2) μB。在4.2 K时观察到与Tb磁矩有关的强磁各向异性，因为即使达到50 T也尚未实现饱和。此外，在3 T和29 T的磁场下观察到两个变磁转变。升温时，Tb磁矩逐渐减小，而Fe磁矩在150 K之前保持不变。在160 K时，Tb和Fe磁矩均突然减小，同时晶胞体积收缩了0.38%，这归因于Fe子晶格中巡游电子的变磁行为。由于晶胞体积增大以及Fe磁矩与Tb磁矩之间的交换相互作用，该转变温度比YFe₂D₄.₂的转变温度高76 K。该氘化物在220 K以上转变为顺磁态。

articles.title: A DQMC study of the spectral and conductive properties of the two-dimensional Holstein model
articles.title_zh: 二维Holstein模型的谱学与导电性质：DQMC研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23379v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the dynamical properties of the two-dimensional square lattice Holstein Hamiltonian using numerically exact determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations. In particular, we report systematic calculations of the model's single-particle spectral function and optical conductivity over a range of phonon energies, electron-phonon coupling strengths, carrier concentrations, and temperatures. In doing so, we map the evolution of the system from a dressed metallic phase to a (bi)polaron liquid/insulator to a charge-density-wave insulator as the carrier concentration is tuned from dilute values to half-filling. We corroborate these results using several equal-time correlation measurements and related proxy quantities reconstructed from time-displaced correlation measurements. This paper is also accompanied by an extensive open data set, covering over 16,640 unique parameter values.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡罗方法，系统研究二维方格晶格Holstein哈密顿量的动力学性质，重点考察单粒子谱函数和光学电导率。通过改变声子能量、电子-声子耦合强度、载流子浓度和温度，研究描绘了体系从修饰金属相，经双极化子液体或绝缘体，演化到电荷密度波绝缘体的过程。研究还借助等时关联函数及由时间位移关联函数重构的相关代理量验证了这些结果，并提供了涵盖超过16,640组独特参数值的开放数据集。
authors: J. Neuhaus, B. Cohen-Stead, N. Mannella, S. Johnston
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用数值精确的行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟，研究了二维方格晶格Holstein哈密顿量的动力学性质。具体而言，我们针对一系列声子能量、电子-声子耦合强度、载流子浓度和温度，系统计算了该模型的单粒子谱函数和光学电导率。在此过程中，随着载流子浓度从稀薄值调节到半填充，我们描绘了体系从修饰金属相，经由（双）极化子液体或绝缘体，演化为电荷密度波绝缘体的过程。我们利用多种等时关联测量以及从时间位移关联测量中重构的相关代理量，对这些结果进行了佐证。本文还配套提供了一个内容广泛的开放数据集，涵盖超过16,640组独特的参数值。

articles.title: FUCrIMODo: structure recovery from atomistic descriptors via multi-stage genetic algorithms
articles.title_zh: FUCrIMODo：通过多阶段遗传算法从原子描述符恢复结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23381v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Data-driven approaches to materials discovery rely on numerical representations of atomic structures as input for machine learning models. Inverting these descriptors - recovering atomic structures from their representations - is essential for most generative material design pipelines, yet it remains challenging, particularly for periodic systems. Existing inversion methods are either tailored to specific invertible descriptors or require candidate structures with similar atomic arrangements and compositions, limiting the exploration of novel regions in chemical and configurational space. Here, we propose a generalizable, similarity-driven sampling approach, powered by a novel stage-wise optimization strategy, to recover atom types, atomic positions, and unit cell shapes directly from a descriptor. Our approach requires only descriptor features and parameters as input without any prior structural knowledge. The capability of our method is demonstrated by the averaged Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) descriptor.
articles.abstract_zh: 数据驱动的材料发现依赖于将原子结构表示为机器学习模型的数值输入，而从描述符反演出原子结构对于大多数生成式材料设计流程至关重要。本文提出一种由新型分阶段优化策略驱动的、基于相似性的通用采样方法，可直接从描述符恢复原子类型、原子位置和晶胞形状，无需任何先验结构知识。作者以平均原子位置平滑重叠（SOAP）描述符展示了该方法的能力。
authors: Louis Boehm, Martin Kuban, Claudia Draxl
articles.abstract_zh_full: 数据驱动的方法依赖于将原子结构进行数值表示，并将其作为机器学习模型的输入，以实现材料发现。从这些描述符中进行反演，即从描述符恢复原子结构，对于大多数生成式材料设计流程而言都是必不可少的，但这一任务仍然具有挑战性，尤其是对于周期性体系。现有的反演方法要么针对特定的可逆描述符设计，要么需要具有相似原子排列和组成的候选结构，从而限制了对化学空间和构型空间中新颖区域的探索。在本文中，我们提出一种可推广的、基于相似性驱动的采样方法，并由一种新颖的分阶段优化策略提供支持，用于直接从描述符中恢复原子类型、原子位置和晶胞形状。该方法的输入仅需要描述符特征和相关参数，而不需要任何先验结构知识。我们以平均原子位置平滑重叠（SOAP）描述符为例，展示了该方法的能力。

articles.title: The principle of detailed balance between electrons and phonons in presence of excitonic effects
articles.title_zh: 存在激子效应时电子与声子之间的微观可逆性原理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23403v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Based on a many-body formulation, we derive an electron-phonon coupling including excitonic effects that preserves thermodynamic detailed balance between electronic and phononic scattering processes. We start from the microscopic electron-nucleus Hamiltonian, expand around the Born-Oppenheimer equilibrium geometry, and construct an effective action for the electronic and phononic propagators. From the same effective action, we derive both electronic and phononic self-energies in terms of a nonlocal vertex mathcal Gs including excitonic effects, which generalizes the usual local interaction vertex gs. When electrons and phonons are well-defined quasiparticles in the screened-exchange approximation and mathcal Gs is taken in its static limit, both self-energies reduce to Fermi-golden-rule expressions containing the same mathcal Gs, thereby ensuring detailed balance. As an application, we compute electronic and phononic linewidths in graphene and illustrate this common-vertex construction. We analyze the competition between the reduced scattering phase space induced by the screened-exchange band structure and the enhancement of the electron-phonon vertex due to excitonic effects, finding that the vertex enhancement can compensate for and overcome the phase-space reduction in both electronic and phononic linewidths.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于多体理论推导了包含激子效应的电子-声子耦合形式，并确保电子与声子散射过程之间满足热力学微观可逆性。作者从微观电子-原子核哈密顿量出发，构造电子和声子传播子的有效作用量，并从同一作用量中导出包含激子效应的非局域顶角所决定的电子和声子自能。对石墨烯的计算表明，激子效应增强的电子-声子顶角可以补偿甚至超过屏蔽交换能带结构造成的散射相空间缩减。
authors: Alberto Guandalini, Giovanni Caldarelli, Francesco Mauri, Francesco Macheda
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于多体理论表述，我们推导了一种包含激子效应的电子-声子耦合，并使电子与声子散射过程之间保持热力学上的微观可逆性。我们从微观电子-原子核哈密顿量出发，在Born-Oppenheimer平衡几何结构附近展开，并为电子和声子传播子构造有效作用量。利用同一个有效作用量，我们分别用包含激子效应的非局域顶角𝒢s表示电子和声子的自能，该顶角是通常局域相互作用顶角gs的推广。当在屏蔽交换近似下电子和声子是定义良好的准粒子，并且将𝒢s取为其静态极限时，两个自能都化为包含相同𝒢s的费米黄金律表达式，从而确保微观可逆性。作为应用，我们计算了石墨烯中的电子和声子线宽，并展示了这种共同顶角构造。我们分析了由屏蔽交换能带结构引起的散射相空间缩减与激子效应导致的电子-声子顶角增强之间的竞争，发现顶角增强能够补偿并克服相空间缩减对电子和声子线宽的影响。

articles.title: Mapping metallic d-wave altermagnetism across the TiNiSi structural family
articles.title_zh: TiNiSi结构家族中的金属d波交错磁性图谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23409v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The prospect of using altermagnets as switchable sources of perpendicularly polarized spin currents has intensified the search for candidate materials, yet metallic d-wave systems with sizable spin-splitter responses remain scarce. Here, we identify an empirical magnetic motif that supports metallic d-wave altermagnetism in the TiNiSi structural family: ferromagnetically ordered zigzag chains with antiferromagnetic interchain coupling in a relatively low-symmetry crystal environment. The TiNiSi structure type combines this motif with broad chemical flexibility and competing magnetic ground states. By combining first-principles screening of thermodynamic stability and magnetic ground states across 280 ternary systems, we identify 16 metallic d-wave altermagnets. This set recovers four experimentally known members---WFeB, NbMnP, TaMnP, and NbMnAs---and yields 12 new predictions, of which ScMnP, TaMnAs, ScMnAs, MoMnAs, MoMnSi, and WMnSi are the most promising. Noncollinear calculations indicate that the collinear altermagnetic configuration is the ground state across them. Each of the six leading new candidates has a nonzero spin-splitter angle and a finite anomalous Hall conductivity. Notably, ScMnP and TaMnAs exhibit strong spin-splitter responses despite modest altermagnetic band splitting. These results establish TiNiSi-type metallic d-wave altermagnets as a chemically versatile platform for efficient charge-to-spin conversion and provide an empirical magnetic-motif-guided route to identifying further candidates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文识别出一种能够在TiNiSi结构家族中支持金属d波交错磁性的经验磁性构型：铁磁排列的之字形链之间以反铁磁方式耦合，并处于相对低对称性的晶体环境中。通过对280种三元体系进行热力学稳定性和磁基态的第一性原理筛选，研究发现16种金属d波交错磁体，其中包括4种已知材料和12种新预测材料。六种最有前景的新候选物均具有非零自旋分裂角和有限反常霍尔电导率，其中ScMnP和TaMnAs虽具有适中的交错磁能带分裂，却表现出强自旋分裂响应。
authors: Zhen Zhang, Subhadip Pradhan, Kirill D. Belashchenko, Vladimir Antropov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用交错磁体作为可切换的垂直偏振自旋流源的前景，推动了对候选材料的持续搜寻；然而，具有显著自旋分裂器响应的金属d波体系仍然十分稀缺。在本文中，我们识别出一种能够在TiNiSi结构家族中支持金属d波交错磁性的经验磁性构型：铁磁有序的之字形链之间具有反铁磁链间耦合，并处于相对低对称性的晶体环境中。TiNiSi结构类型兼具这一磁性构型、广泛的化学可调性以及相互竞争的磁基态。通过结合对280种三元体系的热力学稳定性和磁基态进行第一性原理筛选，我们识别出16种金属d波交错磁体。这一集合重新获得了4种实验上已知的成员，即WFeB、NbMnP、TaMnP和NbMnAs，并给出了12种新的预测材料，其中ScMnP、TaMnAs、ScMnAs、MoMnAs、MoMnSi和WMnSi最具潜力。非共线计算表明，在这些体系中，共线交错磁构型均为基态。六种最有前景的新候选物均具有非零自旋分裂角和有限的反常霍尔电导率。值得注意的是，ScMnP和TaMnAs尽管具有适中的交错磁能带分裂，却表现出很强的自旋分裂响应。这些结果确立了TiNiSi型金属d波交错磁体作为高效电荷到自旋转换的化学多样化平台，并提供了一条由经验磁性构型指导进一步寻找候选材料的路径。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文对TiNiSi结构族中的280种三元体系进行第一性原理高通量筛选，寻找具有金属d波交替磁性的候选材料。研究识别出16种候选交替磁体，并重点提出多个具有非零自旋分裂响应的新材料。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的交替磁性、磁性材料、非共线磁性、第一性原理计算、高通量筛选和自旋输运方向高度直接相关。其结构家族筛选、磁基态比较和自旋分裂响应分析可直接借鉴到新型自旋电子学材料设计。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步计算候选材料的自旋输运、磁性拓扑性质、磁晶各向异性和有限温度磁稳定性。结合自旋哈密顿量、蒙特卡洛模拟及缺陷和应变工程，有望评估其器件应用可行性。

articles.title: Interaction-mediated Co-existence of Altermagnetism and Topology
articles.title_zh: 相互作用介导的交错磁性与拓扑共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23442v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study an extended Hubbard model on Lieb lattice at electron filling 2 and 4, and demonstrate that the interactions lead to the simultaneous emergence of altermagnetic order and a topological gap. Using unrestricted Hartree-Fock theory, we evaluate both the altermagnetic and topological order parameters and show that they co-exist with an associated quantum spin Hall effect in a large region of the phase diagram, which we further support using exact diagonalization. Moreover, we demonstrate that inversion-symmetry breaking terms can also mediate second-order topological phases with associated corner modes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了Lieb晶格上电子填充数为2和4的扩展Hubbard模型，证明电子相互作用可以同时诱导交错磁有序和拓扑能隙。无约束Hartree-Fock计算显示，在相图的较大区域内，交错磁序与拓扑序共存，并伴随量子自旋霍尔效应，精确对角化结果进一步支持了这一结论。研究还表明，破缺反演对称性的项能够介导二阶拓扑相，并产生相应的角态。
authors: Jasmin Bedow, Nitin Kaushal, Marcel Franz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了Lieb晶格上电子填充数为2和4的扩展Hubbard模型，并证明相互作用能够同时诱导交错磁有序和拓扑能隙。利用无约束Hartree-Fock理论，我们计算了交错磁序参量和拓扑序参量，并表明在相图的较大区域内二者共存，同时伴随量子自旋霍尔效应；我们进一步利用精确对角化对此进行了支持。此外，我们证明，破缺反演对称性的项也能够介导二阶拓扑相，并产生相应的角态。

articles.title: Emergent Noncollinearity and Near-Degenerate Magnetic Superlattices in AT6X6 Kagome Metals
articles.title_zh: AT₆X₆ Kagome金属中的涌现非共线性与近简并磁性超晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23485v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferromagnetic AT6X6 Kagome compounds are a popular class of systems in which quantum magnetism with topological features has been observed. These systems allow easy chemical substitution, creating an opportunity to fine-tune their properties. In this paper, we present electronic-structure and magnetic ground-state studies of several AT6X6 compounds with relatively low magnetic-ground-state stability. We find unusual magnetic orderings, including complex spin-spiral states and the formation of magnetic long-range superstructures. While LiFe6Ga6 and TiMn6Ge6 retain collinear AFM ground states with low-energy FM/AFM layer sequences, competing spin-spiral and long-period antiferromagnetic structures in MgFe6Ga6 and a double-spin-spiral ground state in TiFe6Ga6 were determined. Magnetism in all these systems appears local, with adiabatic energy profiles suggesting non-Heisenberg long-range interactions, including a strong biquadratic term. In TiMn6Ge6, we found the conditions for magnetic tunneling. Our results show that, in addition to traditional magnetic topological features in such FM Kagome systems, near-degenerate magnetic superstructures suitable for spintronic switching applications can form naturally. Overall, these systems represent a potentially rich playground for neutron diffraction and spintronics experimental studies.
articles.abstract_zh: 铁磁性AT₆X₆ Kagome化合物是研究拓扑量子磁性的代表性体系，并可通过化学替代调节其性质。本文对若干磁基态稳定性较低的AT₆X₆化合物进行了电子结构和磁基态研究，发现了复杂自旋螺旋态以及磁性长程超结构等异常磁有序。研究还表明，这些体系中的磁性具有局域特征，并存在非海森堡型长程相互作用，包括强双二次项；近简并磁性超结构可能自然形成，从而适用于自旋电子学开关应用。
authors: Weiyi Xia, Wei-Shen Tee, Peter Minch, Feng Zhang, Cai-Zhuang Wang, Vladimir Antropov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁磁性AT₆X₆ Kagome化合物是一类广受关注的体系，在其中已经观察到具有拓扑特征的量子磁性。这些体系易于进行化学替代，从而为精细调控其性质提供了机会。在本文中，我们研究了若干磁基态稳定性相对较低的AT₆X₆化合物的电子结构和磁基态。我们发现了异常的磁有序，包括复杂的自旋螺旋态以及磁性长程超结构的形成。LiFe₆Ga₆和TiMn₆Ge₆保持共线反铁磁基态，并具有低能量的铁磁或反铁磁层序列；而在MgFe₆Ga₆中确定了相互竞争的自旋螺旋结构和长周期反铁磁结构，在TiFe₆Ga₆中确定了双自旋螺旋基态。这些体系中的磁性似乎均具有局域特征，绝热能量分布表明存在非海森堡型长程相互作用，其中包括强双二次项。在TiMn₆Ge₆中，我们发现了发生磁隧穿的条件。我们的结果表明，除这类铁磁Kagome体系中传统的磁性拓扑特征之外，适合自旋电子学开关应用的近简并磁性超结构也可以自然形成。总体而言，这些体系为中子衍射和自旋电子学实验研究提供了一个潜力丰富的平台。
articles.focus_summary: 本文系统研究AT6X6族Kagome金属的磁性基态和低能磁结构，发现自旋螺旋、长周期反铁磁超结构以及双自旋螺旋等复杂磁序。结果表明这些体系存在非海森堡型长程相互作用和显著双二次交换项，并揭示了磁隧穿的可能条件。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队关注的Kagome金属、非共线磁性、磁性超晶格、自旋-自旋相互作用、双二次交换和自旋哈密顿量直接相关。其近简并磁结构搜索和有效相互作用拟合方法具有较高参考价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步利用机器学习势或机器学习哈密顿量扩大磁性超晶格和自旋螺旋的构型搜索，并结合蒙特卡洛模拟研究有限温度相变。还可分析SOC和DMI对磁隧穿、拓扑磁性及输运性质的影响。

articles.title: Non-Abelian Spin Counting of Ordered Stochastic Trajectories: Reentrant Finite-Time Chern Numbers
articles.title_zh: 有序随机轨迹的非阿贝尔自旋计数：有限时间陈数的再入现象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional full counting statistics assigns commuting phases to integrated stochastic currents and therefore resolves net transport but not, in general, the temporal ordering of events associated with different cycles. We introduce a non-Abelian counting construction in which crossings of two fundamental cycles rotate an auxiliary spin about different axes. The resulting ordered trajectory statistic has an exact finite-dimensional evolution equation for its first moment. The two rotation angles form a counting torus, and whenever the mean spin is nonzero its normalized direction defines a map mathbb T²→mathbb S², equivalently a complex eigenline bundle with a Chern number. Our main analytical result is a Chern--parity correspondence. Reflection symmetry equips this eigenline with a real structure and expresses C_Tbmod2 through first Stiefel--Whitney classes on the circles fixed by reflection. When the transverse polarization has no additional zeros along the reflection-fixed circles, these classes reduce to ordinary current-parity statistics at the four high-symmetry counting points. For a five-state nonequilibrium figure-eight network, varying only the observation time produces four polarization-gap closings and the reentrant sequence C_T=0→-1→0→-1→0. Every transition occurs at (π,π) and coincides with a sign reversal of mathbb E[(-1)Q₁₊Q₂], while the full integer Chern number is obtained independently from the two-dimensional spin texture. Finite observation time can therefore organize a fixed stochastic process into distinct topological sectors of its ordered path ensemble.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统全计数统计为积分随机流赋予可交换相位，因此能够解析净输运，但通常无法解析不同循环事件的时间顺序。本文引入非阿贝尔计数构造，使两个基本循环的交叉分别绕不同轴旋转辅助自旋，并由此定义有序轨迹统计及其有限维演化方程。对于五态非平衡八字形网络，仅改变观测时间即可产生陈数序列0→−1→0→−1→0；每次转变均发生在计数点（π,π），并伴随相应奇偶统计量的符号反转。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统的全计数统计为积分随机流分配可交换的相位，因此能够解析净输运，但通常不能解析与不同循环相关事件的时间顺序。我们引入一种非阿贝尔计数构造，其中两个基本循环的交叉使辅助自旋分别绕不同的轴旋转。由此得到的有序轨迹统计，其第一矩具有一个精确的有限维演化方程。两个旋转角构成一个计数环面；只要平均自旋不为零，其归一化方向就定义了一个从二维环面T²到二维球面S²的映射，等价地定义了一个具有陈数的复特征线丛。我们的主要解析结果是陈数与奇偶性之间的对应关系。反射对称性赋予该特征线丛一个实结构，并通过反射不变圆上的第一Stiefel-Whitney类表示陈数CT模2。当横向极化沿反射不变圆没有额外零点时，这些Stiefel-Whitney类可约化为四个高对称计数点处的普通电流奇偶统计量。对于一个五态非平衡八字形网络，仅改变观测时间便产生四次极化能隙闭合以及再入序列CT = 0→−1→0→−1→0。每次转变都发生在（π,π）处，并与E[（−1）⁽Q₁+Q₂)]的符号反转相一致，而完整的整数陈数则独立地由二维自旋纹理得到。因此，有限观测时间能够将一个固定的随机过程组织成有序路径系综中的不同拓扑扇区。

articles.title: Quaternionic Hermitian Band Geometry in Four Dimensions: Realization on S⁴ and Obstruction on T⁴
articles.title_zh: 四维中的四元数厄米能带几何：S⁴上的实现与T⁴上的阻碍
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish a realization-obstruction dichotomy for quaternionic Hermitian band geometry in four-dimensional parameter spaces: the minimal-charge lowest Landau level on S⁴ provides a global realization, whereas an everywhere nondegenerate saturated realization induced by a single occupied quaternionic band is obstructed on T⁴. An antiunitary symmetry J satisfying J²=-1 makes the occupied doublet a quaternionic band. Within this setting, we formulate the quaternionic Wirtinger inequality as a band-geometric bound involving the quantum metric and the second Chern density. At every nondegenerate saturation point, the canonical geometry of the quaternionic projective space pulls back to a compatible quaternionic structure on the parameter space; if these conditions hold everywhere, the parameter space acquires quaternionic Hermitian band geometry. On S⁴, we express the minimal-charge states as quaternionic Perelomov coherent states and establish everywhere nondegenerate saturation, thereby realizing quaternionic Hermitian band geometry. On T⁴, by contrast, a minimal four-band system saturates the inequality everywhere, but topology forces the quantum metric to become degenerate somewhere, obstructing a globally induced quaternionic structure. An explicit lattice Dirac Hamiltonian exhibits this obstruction. Adding unoccupied bands cannot remove this obstruction when the inequality is saturated everywhere, since the image of any nondegenerate saturated projector remains confined to a fixed HP¹. These results provide a symmetry-aware framework for non-Abelian band geometry and show how parameter-space topology constrains the global realization of quaternionic Hermitian band geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了四维参数空间中四元数厄米能带几何的实现与阻碍二分框架：S⁴上的最小荷最低朗道能级提供了全局实现，而T⁴上由单个占据四元数能带诱导的处处非简并饱和实现则受到拓扑阻碍。作者将四元数Wirtinger不等式表述为涉及量子度量和第二陈密度的能带几何界，并表明在T⁴上拓扑必然迫使量子度量在某处简并。结果表明，参数空间拓扑限制了四元数厄米能带几何的全局实现，即使加入未占据能带也无法在处处饱和的情况下消除该阻碍。
authors: Dongju Hwang, Minjae Yu, Gil Young Cho
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们建立了四维参数空间中四元数厄米能带几何的实现-阻碍二分关系：S⁴上的最小荷最低朗道能级提供了一种全局实现，而T⁴上由单个占据四元数能带诱导的处处非简并饱和实现则受到阻碍。一个满足J² = −1的反幺正对称性J使占据双重态成为四元数能带。在这一框架下，我们将四元数Wirtinger不等式表述为一种涉及量子度量和第二陈密度的能带几何界。在每一个非简并饱和点，四元数射影空间的典型几何会拉回为参数空间上的相容四元数结构；如果这些条件处处成立，则参数空间获得四元数厄米能带几何。在S⁴上，我们将最小荷态表示为四元数Perelomov相干态，并证明处处存在非简并饱和，从而实现四元数厄米能带几何。相比之下，在T⁴上，一个最小四能带系统处处使该不等式达到饱和，但拓扑迫使量子度量在某处发生简并，从而阻碍全局诱导的四元数结构。一个显式的晶格Dirac哈密顿量展示了这一阻碍。当不等式处处饱和时，即使增加未占据能带也无法消除该阻碍，因为任何非简并饱和投影算子的像仍然局限于一个固定的HP¹中。这些结果为非阿贝尔能带几何提供了一个具有对称性意识的框架，并表明参数空间的拓扑如何限制四元数厄米能带几何的全局实现。

articles.title: Spinor condensate persistent currents in an atomtronic Josephson necklace
articles.title_zh: 原子电子学约瑟夫森项链中的旋量凝聚体持久电流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23560v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The investigation of superflow in multi-junction Josephson circuits is currently a leading frontier of physics research, probing the fundamental manifestations of macroscopic phase coherence and enabling applications to quantum simulation, metrology and computing. In this work, we extensively investigate the stability and dynamics of persistent currents of a spinor atomic Bose-Einstein condensate on a ring with multiple Josephson junctions. Specifically, we examine the effects of positive and negative interspecies interactions, co- and counter-rotation, population and Manakov asymmetry, as well as Rabi coupling on the persistent currents carried by the two components. Our analysis reveals that the presence of a second species offers multiple mechanisms for unprecedented manipulation of supercurrents on the ring, including phase-slip engineering, stability control, current-inversion switching and supercurrent pumping. Our study provides a roadmap for the engineering of persistent currents in binary ring condensates in necklace potentials, with significant implications for atomtronics, matter-wave interferometry and sensing using atomic Bose gases.
articles.abstract_zh: 多结约瑟夫森电路中的超流研究有助于探索宏观相干性的基本表现，并推动量子模拟、计量和计算应用。本文系统研究环形多结势中旋量原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体持久电流的稳定性与动力学，考察种间相互作用、相对旋转、组分不对称性及拉比耦合的影响。研究揭示，第二组分可通过相位滑移设计、稳定性控制、电流反转和超流泵浦等机制调控环上的超流。
authors: Sayan Chatterjee, Nalinikanta Pradhan, Rina Kanamoto, M. Bhattacharya, Pankaj Kumar Mishra
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多结约瑟夫森电路中的超流研究目前是物理学研究的前沿领域之一，它探测宏观相位相干性的基本表现，并为量子模拟、计量学和计算提供应用可能。在本工作中，我们系统研究了环上、具有多个约瑟夫森结的旋量原子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中持久电流的稳定性与动力学。具体而言，我们考察了正、负种间相互作用、同向与反向旋转、粒子数不对称性和马诺科夫不对称性，以及拉比耦合对两个组分所携带持久电流的影响。我们的分析表明，第二种组分的存在为环上超流的前所未有的操控提供了多种机制，包括相位滑移工程、稳定性控制、电流反转切换和超流泵浦。本研究为在项链势中的二元环形凝聚体内设计持久电流提供了路线图，并对原子电子学、物质波干涉测量以及利用原子玻色气体进行传感具有重要意义。

articles.title: Many-body ergodicity breaking from wavefunction snapshots
articles.title_zh: 从波函数快照研究多体遍历性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21524v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern quantum experiments can probe many-body wavefunctions through projective measurements, providing snapshots of individual many-body configurations. A fundamental question is whether the intrinsic structure of their measurement distributions can reveal quantum dynamics beyond predefined observables. Here, we address this question at the many-body ergodicity-breaking transition using two complementary characteristics of nonequilibrium wavefunction snapshots: their binary intrinsic dimension (BID) and the topology of wavefunction networks constructed from Hamming distances. We show that the critical point is characterized by an extensive but submaximal BID, and scale-free network connectivity with highly connected hubs. These signatures distinguish the ergodic, critical, and nonergodic regimes, and provide experimentally accessible probes of ergodicity breaking from projective measurement snapshots.
articles.abstract_zh: 现代量子实验能够通过投影测量获得单个多体构型的波函数快照。本文在多体遍历性破缺转变处，利用二元内禀维数和基于汉明距离构建的波函数网络，研究测量分布能否揭示超越预设观测量的量子动力学。结果表明，临界点具有广延但非最大化的内禀维数，以及带有高度连接枢纽的无标度网络结构，这些特征可区分遍历、临界和非遍历区域。
authors: Riccardo Andreoni, Devendra Singh Bhakuni, Marcello Dalmonte, Lev Vidmar, Miroslav Hopjan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代量子实验可以通过投影测量探测多体波函数，从而获得单个多体构型的快照。一个基本问题是：测量分布的内在结构是否能够揭示超越预先定义观测量的量子动力学。本文在多体遍历性破缺转变处，使用非平衡波函数快照的两个互补特征来回答这一问题：二元内禀维数（BID），以及由汉明距离构建的波函数网络的拓扑结构。我们表明，临界点的特征是广延但低于最大值的BID，以及具有高度连接枢纽的无标度网络连通性。这些特征能够区分遍历、临界和非遍历区域，并为利用投影测量快照实验探测遍历性破缺提供可行手段。

articles.title: Neural Network Field Theory at Finite Width
articles.title_zh: 有限宽度下的神经网络场论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21588v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Under mild assumptions, any quantum mechanical (QM) model or quantum field theory (QFT) admits a representation in terms of an ensemble of neural networks with countably many random parameters. We investigate the features of NN-QM and NN-FT models with finitely many parameters, such as a feedforward network of width N < infty. We find that, generically, such models must violate one of the properties of conventional Euclidean QFTs, such as reflection positivity or cluster decomposition. We present several complementary ways of understanding which features can and cannot be preserved at finite N, both in QM and in QFT.
articles.abstract_zh: 在温和假设下，任何量子力学模型或量子场论都可表示为具有可数多个随机参数的神经网络系综。本文研究参数有限的神经网络量子力学和神经网络场论模型，例如宽度有限的前馈网络。研究发现，这类模型通常必须违背传统欧氏量子场论的某项性质，如反射正性或簇分解，并分析了有限宽度下不同性质能够或不能够保留的原因。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在温和的假设下，任何量子力学（QM）模型或量子场论（QFT）都可以表示为具有可数多个随机参数的神经网络系综。我们研究了具有有限参数的NN-QM和NN-FT模型的性质，例如宽度为有限值N的前馈网络。我们发现，一般而言，这类模型必然会违背传统欧氏量子场论的某一项性质，例如反射正性或簇分解。我们从若干互补角度说明，在有限N的情况下，哪些性质能够保留、哪些性质无法保留；讨论同时涵盖量子力学和量子场论。

articles.title: Motional Degrees of Freedom in Network Hamiltonian Models
articles.title_zh: 网络哈密顿模型中的运动自由度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21634v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Network Hamiltonian Models (NHMs) provide an efficient framework for modeling the aggregation of interacting particles (e.g., the condensation of proteins into gel-like, oligomeric, or fibrillar states), representing the system as a network whose edges represent bound interactions. Terms within the network Hamiltonian represent multi-body interactions governing aggregation behavior, and are specified via topological degrees of freedom. Because motional degrees of freedom are not explicitly represented within the NHM, their influence must be indirectly accounted for by introduction of corresponding terms to the Hamiltonian. Here, we describe specifications for terms representing motional degrees of freedom of two, three, and four-body interactions. We also consider the impact of these terms on the aggregation states of a minimal system governed only by a pairwise edge potential, showing that three and four-body interactions favor condensation of the system into small droplet-like structures at low temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 网络哈密顿模型通过将相互作用粒子体系表示为网络，为研究蛋白质凝聚成凝胶状、寡聚或纤维状状态提供了高效框架。本文为二体、三体和四体相互作用规定了表示运动自由度的哈密顿项，并考察这些项对聚集态的影响。结果显示，在低温下，三体和四体相互作用有利于体系凝聚成小液滴状结构。
authors: Peng Huang, Elizabeth M. Diessner, Carter T. Butts
articles.abstract_zh_full: 网络哈密顿模型（NHM）为相互作用粒子的聚集建模提供了一个高效框架，例如蛋白质凝聚成凝胶状、寡聚状或纤维状状态的过程；该模型将体系表示为网络，其中边代表成键相互作用。网络哈密顿量中的各项表示支配聚集行为的多体相互作用，并通过拓扑自由度加以规定。由于运动自由度没有在NHM中被显式表示，因此必须通过向哈密顿量中引入相应项来间接考虑其影响。在这里，我们描述了表示二体、三体和四体相互作用中运动自由度的项的具体形式。我们还考察了这些项对一个仅由成对边势控制的最小体系聚集态的影响，并表明，在低温下，三体和四体相互作用有利于体系凝聚成小的液滴状结构。

articles.title: A surviving pink spinel records an early aluminous melt on the ureilite parent body
articles.title_zh: 幸存的粉红色尖晶石记录了脲辉石母体中的早期富铝熔体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21711v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ureilites are ultramafic achondrites interpreted as fragments of a differentiated parent body, yet their origin and evolution remain debated because textural equilibrium coexists with chemically primitive compositions. Here we report mineralogical, isotopic, and microstructural observations from polymict ureilite Elephant Moraine (EET) 87720. The sample contains unusually magnesian olivine (Mg# up to 98.7), Ca-poor pyroxene (Wo as low as 1.0), and rare coarse-grained pink aluminous spinel containing 56.4-58.7 wt% Al2O3 and 11.3-11.8 wt% Cr2O3. In situ triple oxygen isotope measurements of spinel and associated forsteritic olivine plot along the ~1-slope Carbonaceous Chondrite Anhydrous Mineral (CCAM) line, consistent with bulk ureilites. The clasts also follow the ureilitic Fe-loss/addition trend, with near-constant chondritic Mn/Mg ratios. These observations demonstrate that the clasts are indigenous to the ureilite parent body and extend the known ureilite oxygen isotope range to delta18O ~9.7 per mil. Three-dimensional dark-field X-ray microscopy reveals a hierarchical deformation microstructure in the spinel, comprising distributed lattice curvature, localized slip-band-like boundaries, and coherent mosaic-domain boundaries, indicating multiscale accommodation of shock-induced crystal-plastic deformation. We propose that the aluminous spinel crystallized from a locally Al-rich, Ca-poor melt under low oxygen fugacity. Al partitioning between coexisting spinel and olivine yields a crystallization temperature of 1318 +/- 43 K, consistent with a thermally elevated parent body. The spinel may therefore preserve a rare crystallization product of an early aluminous melt that has largely disappeared from the ureilite record, providing an archive of early planetary differentiation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了多晶脲辉石陨石EET 87720的矿物学、同位素和微观结构观测。样品中的富镁橄榄石、贫钙辉石和粗粒粉红色含铝尖晶石表明，这些碎屑来自脲辉石母体，并扩展了已知的脲辉石氧同位素范围。研究认为，尖晶石由低氧逸度条件下局部富铝、贫钙的熔体结晶形成，可能保存了早期行星分异过程中已大部分消失的产物。
authors: Yaozhu Li, Phil J. A. McCausland, Roberta L. Flemming, Noriko T. Kita, Carsten Detlefs
articles.abstract_zh_full: 脲辉石是一类超镁铁质无球粒陨石，被解释为经历分异的母体天体的碎片；然而，由于其中同时存在结构平衡和化学原始性，其起源与演化仍存在争议。在这里，我们报告了多晶脲辉石陨石象牙海岸象牙丘陵（EET）87720的矿物学、同位素和微观结构观测结果。该样品含有异常富镁的橄榄石（Mg#最高达98.7）、贫钙辉石（Wo最低为1.0），以及罕见的粗粒粉红色含铝尖晶石，其中Al2O3含量为56.4至58.7 wt%，Cr2O3含量为11.3至11.8 wt%。尖晶石及其伴生的富镁橄榄石原位三氧同位素测量结果沿约1斜率的碳质球粒陨石无水矿物（CCAM）线分布，与整体脲辉石一致。这些碎屑还遵循脲辉石的铁损失/添加趋势，同时具有近似恒定的球粒陨石Mn/Mg比。这些观测证明，这些碎屑来自脲辉石母体内部，并将已知脲辉石氧同位素范围扩展至δ18O约9.7‰。三维暗场X射线显微技术揭示了尖晶石中的层级变形微结构，包括分布式晶格弯曲、局部化的类似滑移带边界，以及相干的马赛克畴边界，表明其通过多尺度方式容纳了冲击诱发的晶体塑性变形。我们提出，该含铝尖晶石是在低氧逸度条件下由局部富铝、贫钙熔体结晶形成的。共存尖晶石与橄榄石之间的铝分配给出了1318±43 K的结晶温度，与温度升高的母体天体相一致。因此，该尖晶石可能保存了早期富铝熔体的一种罕见结晶产物，而这种熔体在脲辉石记录中大部分已经消失；它由此为早期行星分异提供了档案记录。

articles.title: Coexistence of Magnon-Induced Optical Vortex and Gaussian Beam Scattering Assisted by Rotational Umklapp Process
articles.title_zh: 旋转Umklapp过程辅助下磁振子诱导的光学涡旋与高斯光束散射共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21788v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The exploitation of crystal-lattice symmetries to engineer angular momentum transfer between structured light and magnons marks a novel frontier for optomagnonic research. In Brillouin light scattering, when focused light propagates parallel to an external magnetic field and interacts with ferromagnetic uniform magnons, only optical-vortex scattering is expected to be permitted. Due to the combined effects of magneto-optical coupling and optical spin-orbit interaction, the transfer of magnon spin angular momentum to photon orbital angular momentum allows for this distinctive scattering phenomenon. Here, we experimentally demonstrate that, for a specific ferromagnetic crystal orientation, Gaussian-beam scattering coexists with the optical-vortex scattering, contrary to conventional expectations based on angular momentum conservation between magnons and photons. We show that the crystal lattice, via the rotational Umklapp process, provides the missing angular momentum required for the Gaussian-beam scattering. Furthermore, we predict that as the degree of light focusing increases, the relative efficiencies of the Gaussian-beam and optical-vortex scattering processes reverse.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究利用晶格对称性在结构光与磁振子之间工程化传递角动量。在特定铁磁晶体取向下，实验发现高斯光束散射可与通常预期的光学涡旋散射共存。研究表明，晶格通过旋转Umklapp过程提供高斯光束散射所需的额外角动量，并预测随着聚焦程度提高，两种散射过程的相对效率会发生反转。
authors: Ryusuke Hisatomi, Kotaro Taga, Hisakazu Matsuki, Shutaro Karube, Yoichi Shiota, Teruo Ono
articles.abstract_zh_full: 利用晶格对称性来工程化操控结构光与磁振子之间的角动量传递，是光磁学研究的一个新前沿。在布里渊光散射中，当聚焦光沿平行于外部磁场的方向传播，并与铁磁体中的均匀磁振子相互作用时，通常预期只有光学涡旋散射是允许的。由于磁光耦合和光学自旋轨道相互作用的共同作用，磁振子自旋角动量向光子轨道角动量的传递使这种独特的散射现象成为可能。在这里，我们实验展示，在某一特定的铁磁晶体取向下，高斯光束散射能够与光学涡旋散射共存，这与基于磁振子和光子之间角动量守恒的传统预期相反。我们表明，晶格通过旋转Umklapp过程提供了高斯光束散射所需的缺失角动量。此外，我们预测，随着光聚焦程度增加，高斯光束散射与光学涡旋散射过程的相对效率会发生反转。

articles.title: A novel strategy for achieving a low-field lightweight permanent MRI magnet system with good magnetic field homogeneity and low eddy current
articles.title_zh: 实现低场轻量化、良好磁场均匀性和低涡流的永磁MRI系统的新策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21903v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In low-field, lightweight, pole-pieceless permanent-magnet MRI systems built with sintered Nd-Fe-B or Sm-Co magnets, the rapid switching of gradient fields readily induces eddy currents in the sintered magnets, leading to image artifacts. To address this, we report for the first time a Sm-Fe-N permanent-magnet MRI system based on anisotropic Sm-Fe-N bonded magnets, whose high electrical resistivity reduces the eddy currents in the X, Y and Z directions to 0.093%, 0.172% and 2.38%, respectively, while a magnetic field inhomogeneity below 150 ppm is achieved at the boundary of a 220 mm diameter of spherical volume (DSV). Compared with sintered Nd-Fe-B and Sm-Co magnets, using Sm-Fe-N bonded magnets as the source of the static magnetic field not only suppresses eddy currents but also makes a closely tiled, densely packed magnetic-circuit layout feasible, providing a more uniform static magnetic field for the MRI system. Imaging results free of obvious geometric distortion and banding artifacts further indicate that the Sm-Fe-N magnet system delivers low eddy currents and high static magnetic field homogeneity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于各向异性Sm-Fe-N粘结磁体的低场轻量化无极靴永磁MRI系统。该磁体较高的电阻率显著降低了梯度场快速切换所诱发的涡流，同时在直径220 mm球形视场边界处实现低于150 ppm的磁场不均匀度。成像结果没有明显几何畸变和带状伪影，表明该系统兼具低涡流与高静态磁场均匀性。
authors: Jingzhi Han, Jiangqian Guo, Peng Shen, Xiao Tong, Wenyun Yang, Ziheng Zhang, Jie Liu, Tianzhuo Yang, Yikun Fang, Shunquan Liu, Jie Zhang, Qing Xu, Jinbo Yang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在采用烧结Nd-Fe-B或Sm-Co磁体的低场、轻量化、无极靴永磁MRI系统中，梯度场的快速切换很容易在烧结磁体中感生涡流，从而导致成像伪影。为解决这一问题，我们首次报告了一种基于各向异性Sm-Fe-N粘结磁体的Sm-Fe-N永磁MRI系统；其较高的电阻率使X、Y和Z方向的涡流分别降低至0.093%、0.172%和2.38%，同时在直径为220 mm的球形视场（DSV）边界处实现了低于150 ppm的磁场不均匀度。与烧结Nd-Fe-B和Sm-Co磁体相比，使用Sm-Fe-N粘结磁体作为静态磁场源不仅能够抑制涡流，还使紧密铺设、致密填充的磁路布局成为可能，从而为MRI系统提供更加均匀的静态磁场。成像结果没有明显的几何畸变和带状伪影，进一步表明Sm-Fe-N磁体系统具有低涡流和高静态磁场均匀性。

articles.title: Bloch states of an infinite one-dimensional lattice under transverse electric field
articles.title_zh: 横向电场下无限一维晶格的布洛赫态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22199v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We consider an effectively one-dimensional periodic atomic chain subjected to a weak static electric field transverse to the chain axis. The intrinsic lattice is represented in reciprocal space by a harmonically weighted periodic pseudopotential, while the transverse field produces a weak elastic and polarizable response whose minimum-energy distribution is approximated by a periodically repeated catenary profile. Bloch reduction places both contributions in a common reciprocal-space Hamiltonian. The intrinsic lattice produces a  (|r-s|^ -1 ) hierarchy, whereas the catenary contribution is a symmetric Toeplitz correction with coefficients proportional to ((1+π²⁽r-2) ^ -1 ) and therefore asymptotically to  (|r-s|^ -2 ). The complete nonzero reciprocal weight of the catenary contribution is absolutely convergent and sums to  (|V_ m̊ c |/e ). At the unit-cell level, the lowest intrinsic harmonic together with the catenary term gives a Mathieu equation containing both cosine and hyperbolic-cosine modulations. A first-Brillouin-zone reduction then yields the field-dependent band energies and the corresponding hierarchy of Bragg gaps. The model isolates a simple mechanism by which a transverse electric field can reorganize the Bloch spectrum of a low-dimensional periodic system. Keywords: Bloch theory; transverse electric field; catenary potential; Mathieu equation; Brillouin zone; band structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文考虑受弱静态横向电场作用的有效一维周期性原子链。研究将内禀晶格和横向电场引起的弹性、极化响应统一表示在倒空间哈密顿量中，其中后者由周期重复的悬链线形貌近似。模型显示，横向场引入的修正具有对称托普利兹结构，并可在晶胞尺度导出同时含余弦和双曲余弦调制的马修方程，进而得到场依赖能带能量及布拉格带隙层级。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们考虑一条有效的一维周期性原子链，并令其受到垂直于链轴的弱静态电场作用。内禀晶格在倒空间中由谐波加权的周期性赝势表示，而横向电场产生弱的弹性响应和极化响应，其最小能量分布用周期重复的悬链线形貌近似。布洛赫约化将这两种贡献置于同一个倒空间哈密顿量中。内禀晶格产生(|r-s|⁻¹⁾层级，而悬链线贡献则是一个对称托普利兹修正，其系数与((1+π²(r-2)²⁾⁻¹⁾成正比，因此渐近上表现为(|r-s|⁻²⁾关系。悬链线贡献的全部非零倒空间权重绝对收敛，并求和为|V̄c|/e。在晶胞层面，最低阶内禀谐波与悬链线项共同给出一个同时包含余弦和双曲余弦调制的马修方程。随后进行第一布里渊区约化，得到场依赖的能带能量及相应的布拉格带隙层级。该模型揭示了一种简单机制，即横向电场能够重组低维周期性体系的布洛赫谱。关键词：布洛赫理论；横向电场；悬链线势；马修方程；布里渊区；能带结构。

articles.title: Evolution of cooperation with Q-learning: how much information do we need?
articles.title_zh: 利用Q学习的合作演化：我们需要多少信息？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22705v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Cooperation is ubiquitous in both natural and human societies, yet its evolutionary basis remains a major challenge. A long-standing puzzle is whether having more information leads to better decision-making and thus a higher level of cooperation. To address this question, we adopt a recently developed reinforcement learning framework in which individuals learn through trial and error to maximize cumulative rewards - a paradigm that has successfully explained diverse emergent patterns in human behaviors. Specifically, we equip a structured population with the Q-learning algorithm and systematically vary the size of the interactive neighborhood, which serves as a proxy for perceived information. Interestingly, we observe a non-monotonic relationship between cooperation prevalence and neighborhood size in both two-dimensional square lattices and Barabasi-Albert scale-free networks. This inverted U-shaped dependence reveals that an optimal amount of information exists, yielding the highest level of cooperation. Mechanistic analyses show that a moderate neighborhood size enables individuals to strike an optimal balance between information sufficiency and decision-making tractability. This balance allows them to detect reciprocal opportunities while avoiding the deterioration of decision quality due to information overload. Our findings challenge everyday intuition, suggesting that a proper amount of information - not more - is optimal for the emergence of cooperation.
articles.abstract_zh: 合作普遍存在于自然和人类社会中，但其演化基础仍是重要难题。本文在结构化种群中引入Q学习，并以互动邻域大小作为感知信息量的代理变量。结果显示，合作水平与邻域大小之间呈倒U形关系，说明适量而非越多的信息最有利于合作演化；中等邻域既能发现互惠机会，又可避免信息过载损害决策质量。
authors: Yile Ku, Xin Ou, Jiqiang Zhang, Shengfeng Deng, Huiji Yue, Li Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 合作普遍存在于自然社会和人类社会中，但其演化基础仍是一个重大挑战。一个长期存在的难题是：更多信息是否会带来更好的决策，从而提高合作水平。为回答这一问题，我们采用一种近期发展的强化学习框架，在该框架中，个体通过试错学习来最大化累积奖励；这一范式已经成功解释了人类行为中的多种涌现模式。具体而言，我们使一个结构化种群采用Q学习算法，并系统改变互动邻域的大小，将其作为感知信息量的代理变量。有趣的是，在二维方格晶格和Barabási-Albert无标度网络中，我们都观察到合作普及程度与邻域大小之间存在非单调关系。这种倒U形依赖关系揭示了一个最优信息量，它能够产生最高水平的合作。机制分析表明，中等大小的邻域使个体能够在信息充分性和决策可处理性之间取得最佳平衡。这种平衡使个体能够发现互惠机会，同时避免信息过载导致的决策质量下降。我们的发现挑战了日常直觉，表明适量的信息，而不是越多的信息，才最有利于合作的产生。

articles.title: Importance-Reweighted Fock-Space Variational Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 重要性重加权的福克空间变分蒙特卡罗
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22925v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fock-space variational Monte Carlo (FS-VMC) evaluates variational quantities by stochastic sampling over discrete many-body configurations. For ab initio electronic Hamiltonians, Born distributions can differ markedly between systems, and a Markov chain that mixes well need not yield low-variance estimators. We introduce importance-reweighted FS-VMC (IR-FS-VMC), which leaves the variational objective unchanged while redesigning its Monte Carlo evaluation. An auxiliary distribution and Hamiltonian-guided proposal define the Markov chain, while an evaluation Markov kernel defines an analytically tractable evaluation distribution. Self-normalized importance reweighting then recovers the Born-distribution expectations entering the energy, gradient, and stochastic reconfiguration (SR) matrix. Controlled comparisons on equilibrium H2O and Fe2S2 separate Markov-chain acceptance from local-energy fluctuations and optimization behavior. Using one production protocol, calculations for H2O dissociation, 36-site hydrogen lattices, and Fe2S2 and Fe4S4 active spaces yield accurate variational energies across different Born distributions and electronic-correlation regimes. Together, these results show that the production protocol can support robust FS-VMC optimization across the electronic-structure regimes studied here.
articles.abstract_zh: 福克空间变分蒙特卡罗通过对离散多体构型进行随机采样来计算变分量。本文提出重要性重加权福克空间变分蒙特卡罗方法，在保持变分目标不变的同时重新设计蒙特卡罗评估过程，并利用辅助分布、哈密顿量引导的提议和解析可处理的评估分布进行自归一化重要性重加权。针对H2O、Fe2S2、氢晶格及铁硫簇的测试表明，该方法在不同电子相关区域和玻恩分布下都能支持稳健的变分优化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 福克空间变分蒙特卡罗（FS-VMC）通过对离散多体构型进行随机采样来计算变分量。对于从头算电子哈密顿量，不同体系的玻恩分布可能存在显著差异，而混合良好的马尔可夫链并不一定会产生低方差估计量。我们提出重要性重加权福克空间变分蒙特卡罗（IR-FS-VMC），在保持变分目标不变的同时重新设计其蒙特卡罗评估过程。辅助分布和由哈密顿量引导的提议定义了马尔可夫链，而评估马尔可夫核定义了一个解析上可处理的评估分布。随后，自归一化重要性重加权恢复能量、梯度和随机重构（SR）矩阵中所涉及的玻恩分布期望。在平衡态H2O和Fe2S2上的受控比较，将马尔可夫链接受率、局域能量涨落和优化行为彼此区分开来。使用一种生产协议，对H2O解离、36位点氢晶格，以及Fe2S2和Fe4S4活性空间的计算，在不同玻恩分布和电子相关区域中均获得了准确的变分能量。总体而言，这些结果表明，该生产协议能够支持本文所研究电子结构区域中的稳健FS-VMC优化。

articles.title: Generalizing Abell-Tersoff bond-order potential with explicit high-order many-body correlations for robust extrapolation of potential energy surfaces
articles.title_zh: 通过显式高阶多体关联推广Abell-Tersoff键级势，实现势能面的稳健外推
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22933v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials enable accurate and efficient atomistic simulations, but their reliability for out-of-distribution configurations far beyond the training domain remains a significant challenge. Here, to tackle this challenge, we introduce a semiparametric interatomic potential based on a generalization of the Abell--Tersoff bond-order potential, with a chemically informed functional form and explicit high-order many-body correlations. The model is trained and evaluated on various datasets, including silicon, carbon, water, and small molecules, achieving interpolation accuracy comparable to that of existing MLIP models while demonstrating better extrapolation to unseen configurations, including those under high-pressure and high-temperature conditions. These results demonstrate that physically motivated constraints incorporated into the functional form can improve the extrapolation behavior of interatomic potentials, providing insights into the inductive biases that can be used to control extrapolation in machine-learning interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势能够高效而准确地进行原子模拟，但远离训练域的分布外构型外推仍是主要挑战。本文提出一种半参数原子间势，将化学信息驱动的Abell-Tersoff键级形式与显式高阶多体关联相结合。该模型在硅、碳、水和小分子数据集上实现了可与现有机器学习原子间势相比的插值精度，并改善了对高压、高温等未见构型的外推能力。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势能够实现准确而高效的原子尺度模拟，但对于远远超出训练域的分布外构型，其可靠性仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，为应对这一挑战，我们引入一种半参数原子间势。该势基于Abell--Tersoff键级势的推广，具有化学信息驱动的函数形式，并包含显式的高阶多体关联。我们在包括硅、碳、水和小分子在内的各种数据集上对该模型进行训练和评估。结果表明，该模型的插值精度与现有机器学习原子间势模型相当，同时对未见过的构型，包括高压和高温条件下的构型，表现出更好的外推能力。这些结果表明，将物理动机驱动的约束纳入函数形式能够改善原子间势的外推行为，并为可用于控制机器学习原子间势外推的归纳偏置提供了启示。

articles.title: mathscrPT-symmetric hydrodynamics of odd viscous liquids and their oscillator counterparts
articles.title_zh: 奇黏性液体及其振子对应物的数学PT对称流体动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22958v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Odd viscosity, the nondissipative part of the viscous response of a time-reversal-broken fluid, is notoriously difficult to measure precisely because it does no work. Here we show that parity-time (mathscrPT) symmetry, familiar from non-Hermitian optics, converts this elusiveness into a measurement principle. The odd Navier-Stokes equations, that include the nonlinear inertial terms, are mathscrPT-symmetric, follow from a Lagrangian, and linearize to a Schrödinger equation in which the odd viscosity plays the role of Planck's constant; potential vorticity obeys a generalized Ertel conservation law. A probe trapped in an odd liquid realizes a pair of oscillators coupled by odd friction, and supplying balanced loss and gain drives a twofold mathscrPT transition whose exceptional point and Rabi sidebands locate the odd viscosity with square-root-enhanced sensitivity. Upon quantization the spectrum is of Fock-Darwin form, and the dissipative pair exhibits a Liouvillian exceptional point separating linear from exponential heating. These results furnish mechanical, stochastic, and spectroscopic protocols for measuring odd transport coefficients in classical and quantum fluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 奇黏性是破坏时间反演对称性的流体中无耗散黏性响应，因不做功而难以精确测量。本文表明，奇黏性流体的PT对称性可将这一测量困难转化为测量原理：奇黏性纳维-斯托克斯方程可由拉格朗日量导出，并在线性化后对应薛定谔方程。通过在奇液体中俘获探针、引入平衡增益与损耗，研究提出利用例外点和拉比边带定位奇黏性，并讨论量子化后的谱和耗散加热转变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 奇黏性是破坏时间反演对称性的流体中黏性响应的无耗散部分；由于它不做功，通常很难精确测量。在这里，我们表明，宇称-时间（PT）对称性这一熟悉于非厄米光学的概念，能够将这种难以捉摸的性质转化为一种测量原理。包含非线性惯性项的奇黏性纳维-斯托克斯方程具有PT对称性，并且可以由一个拉格朗日量导出；将其线性化后得到一个薛定谔方程，其中奇黏性扮演普朗克常数的角色；势涡度满足广义的厄特尔守恒定律。被俘获在奇液体中的探针实现了一对由奇摩擦耦合的振子，而提供平衡的损耗和增益会驱动一个二重PT转变，其例外点和拉比边带能够以平方根增强的灵敏度定位奇黏性。量子化后，谱呈现福克-达尔文形式；耗散振子对则表现出一个李乌维尔例外点，将线性加热与指数加热分隔开来。这些结果为测量经典流体和量子流体中的奇输运系数提供了机械、随机和光谱学方案。

articles.title: Self-consistent modelling of all-optical switching and magneto-optic readout in an integrated Si₃N₄/GdFeCo waveguide
articles.title_zh: 集成式 Si₃N₄/GdFeCo 波导中全光开关与磁光读出的自洽建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22969v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: What a guided beam carries after passing through an all-optically switched magnetic film has not been computed, although such switching has been demonstrated on a silicon nitride waveguide with electrical readout. We close the chain for an integrated Si₃N₄/GdFeCo element, an 8 nm film on a 60 μm waveguide, coupling a three-dimensional dispersive finite-difference time-domain solver to absorbed optical work, a four-temperature model, and stochastic two-sublattice Landau-Lifshitz-Bloch dynamics with a fluctuation-dissipation-consistent Langevin field, the magnetization feeding back into the gyrotropic permittivity that a second guided shot reads. Transmission, reflection and absorption are magnetization-blind, closing to 0.974-0.975 and shifting by at most 0.02 between saturated, demagnetized and multidomain films, because magnetization enters the dielectric tensor only through an antisymmetric element on which absorbed power depends at second order; the odd-in-magnetization polarimetry separates them by an order of magnitude in Faraday rotation and two in Kerr. The guided geometry levies a cost free-space measurement does not: a -11.77ⁱ̧rc geometric pedestal on the reflected channel, exceeding the 8.24ⁱ̧rc rotation it hides. Referencing against a demagnetized film returns it to 0.063ⁱ̧rc. The transmitted mode carries a second signature in its lobe balance, needing no polarimetry. Calibrated pulses toggle 0.859 of the film from either saturated state across a 2.4× fluence window, and the shortfall from unity is photonic rather than magnetic: the switched fraction is the complementary cumulative distribution of the guided-mode absorption map at the single-cell threshold, holding to 8×10⁻⁴ at five full-wave anchors. From exactly zero magnetization, branch selection passes to the Langevin field alone, at occupancy 0.502 ± 0.004 over 16 seeds.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了集成式 Si₃N₄/GdFeCo 元件中全光磁性切换与后续光学读出的完整自洽模型，将三维色散有限差分时域求解器、吸收光功、四温度模型和随机双亚晶格 Landau-Lifshitz-Bloch 动力学相耦合。研究表明，透射、反射和吸收对磁化状态基本不敏感，而法拉第旋转、克尔响应及透射模式瓣强度不平衡能够区分不同磁性状态。校准脉冲可在一定通量范围内切换约 0.859 的薄膜区域，完全去磁状态下的分支选择则由朗之万涨落场决定。
authors: Muhammad Arief Mulyana, Budi Adiperdana, Ayi Bahtiar
articles.abstract_zh_full: 导引光束通过全光切换的磁性薄膜后携带了什么信息，此前尚未被计算，尽管这种切换已经在带有电学读出的氮化硅波导上得到演示。我们为集成式 Si₃N₄/GdFeCo 元件补全了这一链条：该元件是在一条 60 μm 波导上的 8 nm 薄膜，并将三维色散有限差分时域求解器与吸收光功、四温度模型以及带有符合涨落—耗散关系朗之万场的随机双亚晶格 Landau-Lifshitz-Bloch 动力学相耦合，磁化强度再反馈到回旋介电率中，由第二次导引光脉冲进行读出。透射、反射和吸收对磁化状态不敏感：对于饱和、去磁和多畴薄膜，这些量的数值均收敛在 0.974–0.975，变化最多为 0.02；这是因为磁化强度只通过介电张量中的反对称分量进入，而吸收功对该分量仅表现出二阶依赖。关于磁化强度的奇对称偏振测量则能够将这些状态区分开来，其法拉第旋转相差一个数量级，克尔响应相差两个数量级。导引几何还带来了自由空间测量所没有的代价：反射通道中存在一个 -11.77ⁱ̧rc 的几何基底项，大于其所掩盖的 8.24ⁱ̧rc 旋转信号。以去磁薄膜为参照后，该基底项可降至 0.063ⁱ̧rc。透射模式在其瓣强度平衡中还携带第二种特征信号，无需偏振测量即可获取。经过校准的脉冲能够在 2.4 倍的通量窗口内，从任一饱和态切换薄膜中 0.859 的区域，而未达到 1 的原因是光子学因素而非磁性因素：在单元阈值下，被切换的比例等于导引模式吸收分布的互补累积分布函数，并且在五个全波锚点处保持到 8×10⁻⁴ 的精度。从恰好为零的磁化状态出发，分支选择完全由朗之万场决定；在 16 个随机种子下，其占据率为 0.502 ± 0.004。

articles.title: Dissipation-induced Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev physics in many-body cavity quantum electrodynamics
articles.title_zh: 多体腔量子电动力学中的耗散诱导 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 物理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23557v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) devices can realize dissipative Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) physics, a paradigmatic setting for quantum chaos in open many-body systems. Ultracold fermions with disordered, all-to-all cavity-mediated interactions provide two complementary routes: atomic spontaneous emission in a single-mode cavity and photon leakage from a multimode cavity. Strikingly, both converge to the same non-Hermitian random-matrix universality despite originating from integrable and chaotic closed-system limits, respectively. In the single-mode case, dissipation therefore creates quantum chaos from an integrable Hamiltonian. We trace this convergence to a tunable growth in dissipative rank, controlled, respectively, by the Lamb-Dicke parameter and the cavity-mode spacing. The resulting chaos leaves a dynamical fingerprint: a crossover from long-lived prethermal memory to rapid thermalization, visible in single-atom-resolved densities.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文表明，腔量子电动力学器件能够实现开放多体系统中的耗散 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）物理。具有无序、由腔介导的全连接相互作用的超冷费米子系统，可通过单模腔中的原子自发辐射或多模腔中的光子泄漏实现这一现象。尽管两种情形分别源自可积和混沌的封闭系统极限，它们都趋向相同的非厄米随机矩阵普适性，并表现出从长寿命预热记忆到快速热化的动力学交叉。
authors: Pietro Pacchioni, Filippo Ferrari, Vincenzo Savona, Matteo Seclì
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，腔量子电动力学（QED）器件能够实现耗散 Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SYK）物理，这是开放多体系统中量子混沌的典型研究场景。具有无序、由腔介导的全连接相互作用的超冷费米子系统提供了两条互补路径：单模腔中的原子自发辐射，以及多模腔中的光子泄漏。值得注意的是，尽管二者分别源自可积和混沌的封闭系统极限，它们都趋向相同的非厄米随机矩阵普适性。在单模情形中，耗散因此能够从一个可积哈密顿量中产生量子混沌。我们将这种趋同归因于耗散秩的可调增长，而耗散秩分别由 Lamb-Dicke 参数和腔模间距控制。由此产生的混沌留下了一个动力学指纹：系统从长寿命的预热记忆向快速热化发生交叉，这一过程可以通过单原子分辨的密度观测到。

articles.title: Mapping the Phase Diagram of a Frustrated Magnet: Degeneracies, Flat Bands, and Canting Cycles on the Pyrochlore Lattice
articles.title_zh: 受挫磁体相图的映射：烧简并、平带与烧角循环
articles.abstract: arXiv:2411.03429v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We map the complete classical phase diagram of the spin Hamiltonian describing pyrochlore rare-earth magnets with all symmetry-allowed nearest-neighbor bond-dependent anisotropic two-spin interactions. We provide a simple derivation of the organization of spins into tensor degrees of freedom describing the multipole moments of a tetrahedron, whose components correspond to irreducible representations (irreps) of the tetrahedral symmetry group T_d. By parameterizing the Hamiltonian directly in terms of the energies of the individual irreps, we perform an exhaustive search of all possible irrep degeneracies which may host stable classical spin liquids. Doing so reveals four one-parameter families of models along which three phases are degenerate, all four of which merge at the Heisenberg antiferromagnet and its dual, and we give a complete three-dimensional picture of the phase diagram showing all of the phases and their intersections. The appearance of two copies of a single irrep implies an extra degenerate locus which pierces the phase boundaries at special points, yielding two additional isolated triple points. We demonstrate that one-parameter families of Hamiltonians are characterized by a topological invariant describing how the ground state spin configuration winds when adiabatically transported around this degenerate locus, analogous to a "diabolical locus". We provide a comprehensive catalog of all flat band degeneracies in the phase diagram and discuss the mechanisms that may allow for or impede the realization of a variety of classical spin liquids described by tensor gauge fields exhibiting pinch line singularities and concomitant four-fold pinch points. Lastly, we provide a list of all cases where three irreps are degenerate above the ground state, which may lead to interesting features in the spin wave spectrum within each ordered phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文完整绘制了描述烧辉石晶格稀土磁体的经典相图，该模型包含所有对称性允许的最近邻、键依赖各向异性的双自旋相互作用。作者将自旋组织为描述四面体多极矩的张量自由度，并以四面体对称群 T_d 的不可约表示能量直接参数化哈密顿量。研究发现了四条具有三相简并的一参数模型族、额外的孤立三重点以及围绕简并轨迹的拓扑绕数不变量，并系统编目了平带简并及可能形成经典自旋液体的条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们绘制了描述烧辉石晶格稀土磁体的自旋哈密顿量的完整经典相图，其中包含所有对称性允许的最近邻、键依赖各向异性双自旋相互作用。我们给出了一种简单推导，将自旋组织为描述四面体多极矩的张量自由度，其分量对应于四面体对称群 T_d 的不可约表示（irrep）。通过直接以各不可约表示的独立能量参数化哈密顿量，我们穷举搜索了所有可能承载稳定经典自旋液体的不可约表示简并。该分析揭示了四条模型的一参数族，在这些模型族上有三个相位简并；这四条模型族均在 Heisenberg 反铁磁体及其对偶点处汇合。我们还给出了相图的完整三维图像，展示了所有相位及其交汇。某一不可约表示出现两个副本会产生另一条额外的简并轨迹，该轨迹在特殊点穿过相边界，并由此产生另外两个孤立三重点。我们证明，一参数哈密顿量族具有一个拓扑不变量，用来描述当基态自旋构型绝热地绕该简并轨迹输运时的缠绕方式，这类似于“二重点轨迹”。我们全面列出了相图中的所有平带简并，并讨论了哪些机制可能促成或阻碍多种经典自旋液体的实现；这些自旋液体由张量规范场描述，并表现出尖点线奇异性及相伴的四重尖点。最后，我们列出了所有三个不可约表示在基态之上发生简并的情形，这些情形可能在每个有序相的自旋波谱中产生有趣特征。

articles.title: Quantum-Noise Induced Localization and Motional Squeezing in a Rydberg Quantum Simulator
articles.title_zh: 里德伯量子模拟器中的量子噪声诱导局域化与运动压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.19679v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the interplay between mechanical forces and the internal-state dynamics of Rydberg excitations in atom-tweezer arrays. Dipole interactions between Rydberg atoms facilitate excitation spreading, but at the same time couple electronic (spin) degrees of freedom with motional (phonon) states. With increasing spin-phonon coupling, the growth dynamics of a cluster of excited Rydberg atoms changes from ballistic spreading to Bloch-like oscillations and eventually to Anderson-like localization. We show that these effects are caused by quantum fluctuations in the phonon field: The dynamics of a Rydberg cluster can be mapped to a single particle in a semi-infinite lattice subject to phonon-induced energy shifts. The mean-field contribution of this energy shift leads to a linear potential gradient, resulting into Bloch-like oscillations. In addition, quantum fluctuations of phonons create a random local potential causing a transition from a regime of Bloch oscillations to localization. The spin-phonon coupling leads furthermore to highly correlated and non-classical phonon states in the form of squeezed states of the position of the Rydberg atoms. Depending on the form of the dipolar interaction potential, either in- or out-of-phase correlated oscillations of atoms emerge.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了原子光镊阵列中机械力与里德伯激发内部态动力学之间的相互作用。随着自旋—声子耦合增强，里德伯激发团簇的增长动力学由弹道扩展转变为类似布洛赫振荡，并最终进入类似安德森局域化的状态。声子量子涨落产生随机局域势并诱导局域化，同时自旋—声子耦合还形成位置受到压缩的高度关联非经典声子态。
authors: Benno Bock, Daniel Brady, Michael Fleischhauer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了原子光镊阵列中机械力与里德伯激发内部态动力学之间的相互作用。里德伯原子之间的偶极相互作用促进激发扩散，但与此同时也将电子（自旋）自由度与运动（声子）态耦合起来。随着自旋—声子耦合增强，里德伯激发团簇的增长动力学从弹道扩展转变为类似布洛赫振荡的行为，并最终转变为类似安德森局域化的行为。我们表明，这些效应源于声子场的量子涨落：里德伯团簇的动力学可以映射为半无限晶格中的单粒子动力学，其中存在由声子诱导的能量位移。该能量位移的平均场贡献形成线性势梯度，从而导致类似布洛赫的振荡。此外，声子的量子涨落产生随机局域势，使系统从布洛赫振荡区域转变为局域化区域。自旋—声子耦合还导致高度关联的非经典声子态，表现为里德伯原子位置的压缩态。根据偶极相互作用势的形式，原子会出现同相或反相的关联振荡。

articles.title: Free Majorana Fermions with Superconducting Quantum Wires and a Magnetic Impurity
articles.title_zh: 具有超导量子线和磁性杂质的自由马约拉纳费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.03380v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Through the two-channel Kondo model, I address a magnetic spin-1/2 impurity interacting with a bound state of spin origin at the edge in a Luther-Emery liquid showing a spin gap in the bulk. The system presents two zero-energy Majorana fermions of magnetic origin, one on the impurity site and one at the edge. I derive the wavefunction at the edge for the produced zero-energy Majorana fermion bound state within the same formalism as topological interfaces. I present alternative versions of the quantum field theory revealing the specific pairing of the Majorana fermions in the bulk. I address local physical responses. I develop the idea that this model can be realized with a magnetic impurity bridging the gap between two s-wave superconducting wires. I show the protection of the zero-energy Majorana fermions that will be referred to as free Majorana fermions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过两通道 Kondo 模型研究了磁性自旋 1/2 杂质与 Luther-Emery 液体边缘自旋起源束缚态的相互作用，该液体体内具有自旋能隙。系统产生两个具有磁性起源的零能马约拉纳费米子，分别位于杂质位置和边缘。作者推导了边缘零能马约拉纳束缚态的波函数，讨论了体内马约拉纳费米子的配对结构及局域物理响应，并提出可用连接两条 s 波超导线的磁性杂质实现和保护这些自由马约拉纳费米子。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过两通道 Kondo 模型，我研究了磁性自旋 1/2 杂质与 Luther-Emery 液体边缘一个自旋起源束缚态之间的相互作用，该液体在体内表现出自旋能隙。该系统包含两个具有磁性起源的零能马约拉纳费米子，一个位于杂质位置，另一个位于边缘。我在与拓扑界面相同的形式体系内，推导了所产生零能马约拉纳费米子束缚态的边缘波函数。我还给出了量子场论的不同表述，从而揭示马约拉纳费米子在体内的特定配对方式，并讨论了局域物理响应。我进一步提出，这一模型可以通过一个连接两条 s 波超导线的磁性杂质来实现。我证明了零能马约拉纳费米子的保护机制，并将其称为自由马约拉纳费米子。

articles.title: Refraction-induced transverse charge transport
articles.title_zh: 折射诱导的横向电荷输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.15337v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a mechanism that produces a Hall-like transverse response in time-reversal-invariant materials, driven entirely by geometric effects. Specifically, we demonstrate that a tilted potential interface causes electron wave packets to undergo a refractionlike deflection upon transmission through the barrier, leading to a finite transverse current and a corresponding Hall-like conductance. Our analytical framework captures the essential features of this refraction-driven charge transport, and the resulting transverse conductance profile is corrob- orated by numerical simulations across different lattice models and device geometries. We further visualize our predicted effect through real-time wave packet dynamics, which reveals its purely geometric origin and the robustness of the transverse response. These findings establish a fundamentally distinct class of Hall-like transport phenomena in mesoscopic systems that preserve time-reversal symmetry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种完全由几何效应驱动、可在时间反演不变材料中产生类霍尔横向响应的机制。倾斜势垒界面会使电子波包在透射时发生类似折射的偏转，从而产生有限横向电流及相应的类霍尔电导。解析理论、数值模拟和实时波包动力学共同表明，该横向响应具有纯几何起源，并且在不同晶格模型和器件几何中保持稳健。
authors: Ronika Sarkar, Arka Bandyopadhyay, Awadhesh Narayan, Diptiman Sen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种机制，能够在时间反演不变材料中产生类霍尔横向响应，而且该响应完全由几何效应驱动。具体而言，我们证明，倾斜的势垒界面会使电子波包在穿过界面时发生类似折射的偏转，从而产生有限的横向电流及相应的类霍尔电导。我们的解析框架捕捉了这种折射驱动电荷输运的基本特征，所得横向电导曲线也通过不同晶格模型和器件几何下的数值模拟得到了验证。我们还通过实时波包动力学直观展示了所预测的效应，结果揭示了横向响应的纯几何起源及其稳健性。这些发现确立了一类本质上不同的类霍尔输运现象，其存在于保持时间反演对称性的介观系统中。

articles.title: Localization from Infinitesimal Kinetic Grading: Finite-size Scaling, Kibble-Zurek Dynamics and Applications in Sensing
articles.title_zh: 无穷小动力学分级诱导的局域化：有限尺寸标度、Kibble-Zurek 动力学及其在传感中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.15795v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study a one-dimensional lattice model with site-dependent nearest-neighbor hopping amplitudes that follow a power-law profile. The hopping variation is controlled by a grading exponent, |alpha|, which serves as the tuning parameter of the system. In the thermodynamic limit, the ground state becomes localized in the limit |alpha| → 0, signaling the presence of a critical point characterized by a diverging localization length. Using exact diagonalization methods, we perform finite-size scaling analysis, and extract the associated critical exponent governing the near-critical behavior. To further characterize the criticality, we analyze inverse participation ratio (IPR), energy gap between the ground and first excited state, and fidelity-susceptibility. We also investigate the nonequilibrium dynamics by linearly ramping the hopping profile at various rates and tracking the evolution of the localization length and the IPR. The Kibble-Zurek mechanism successfully explains the resulting dynamics of the system via the critical exponents obtained from static scaling analysis. Beyond its fundamental significance, the kinetic-grading-induced localization transition provides a natural platform for quantum sensing. Using the critical enhancement of the quantum Fisher information (QFI), we demonstrate that the system enables quantum-enhanced parameter estimation of the grading exponent. We propose both adiabatic and dynamical quantum critical sensors and demonstrate that they exhibit enhanced scaling of the QFI. Our results therefore establish graded kinetic systems not only as a new setting for localization physics, but also as a potential resource for designing quantum-enhanced sensing devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一维晶格模型，其中最近邻跃迁振幅随格点位置按幂律变化，分级指数的绝对值作为调控参数。在热力学极限下，当 |α| 趋近于零时，基态发生局域化，并表现出具有发散局域化长度的临界点；有限尺寸标度分析提取了相应临界指数。进一步研究表明，Kibble-Zurek 机制能够解释线性调节跃迁分布时的非平衡动力学，而量子 Fisher 信息的临界增强则可用于构造对分级指数进行量子增强估计的绝热和动力学临界传感器。
authors: Argha Debnath, Ayan Sahoo, Debraj Rakshit
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了一个一维晶格模型，其中依赖格点位置的最近邻跃迁振幅遵循幂律分布。跃迁的变化由分级指数 |α| 控制，该指数充当系统的调控参数。在热力学极限下，当 |α| → 0 时，基态变得局域化，这表明系统存在一个以局域化长度发散为特征的临界点。我们使用精确对角化方法进行有限尺寸标度分析，并提取控制临界附近行为的相应临界指数。为了进一步刻画临界性，我们分析了逆参与率（IPR）、基态与第一激发态之间的能隙以及保真度易感性。我们还研究了非平衡动力学：以不同速率线性调节跃迁分布，并追踪局域化长度和 IPR 的演化。由静态标度分析得到的临界指数能够通过 Kibble-Zurek 机制成功解释系统所表现出的动力学。除了基础意义之外，动力学分级诱导的局域化转变还为量子传感提供了自然平台。利用量子 Fisher 信息（QFI）的临界增强，我们证明该系统能够实现对分级指数的量子增强参数估计。我们提出了绝热量子临界传感器和动力学量子临界传感器，并证明二者均表现出增强的 QFI 标度。因此，我们的结果表明，分级动力学系统不仅是研究局域化物理的新平台，也可能成为设计量子增强传感器件的资源。

articles.title: Spin Response of a Magnetic Monopole and Quantum Hall Response in Topological Lattice Models through Local Invariants and Light
articles.title_zh: 通过局域不变量与光研究磁单极子的自旋响应及拓扑晶格模型中的量子霍尔响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.19511v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Here, we elaborate on and develop the geometrical approach introduced in K. Le Hur, Physics Reports 1104 1-42 (2025) between the magnetic monopole created from a radial field, quantum physics and topological lattice models through quantum phase transitions. We introduce an effective magnetic moment for a monopole when applying an additional source field along z-direction which also mediates the quantum phase transition. We present its relation with the transverse pumped quantum Hall current. The magnetic susceptibility can be introduced as a measure of the topological invariant i.e. it remains quantized within the topological phase until the transition. We show the relation with two-dimensional topological lattice models such as a honeycomb Haldane model in real space. We develop the theory and present a numerical analysis between local invariants in momentum space introduced from Dirac points, correlation functions and the responses to circularly polarized light. We develop the formalism for coupled-planes materials including the possibility of quantum spin Hall effect and address a relation between the Ramanujan infinite alternating series and an interface in real space with a topological number one-half.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了磁单极子、量子物理与拓扑晶格模型之间的几何联系，并研究径向场产生的磁单极子在附加 z 方向源场下的有效磁矩。该有效磁矩与横向泵浦量子霍尔电流相关，而磁化率可作为拓扑不变量的度量，在拓扑相内直到相变前保持量子化。作者还将该理论与二维 Haldane 模型、动量空间局域不变量、关联函数及圆偏振光响应联系起来，并讨论耦合平面材料、量子自旋霍尔效应以及实空间半整数拓扑数。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文进一步阐述并发展 K. Le Hur 在《Physics Reports》1104 卷第 1–42 页（2025）中提出的几何方法，该方法联系了由径向场产生的磁单极子、量子物理和拓扑晶格模型，并涉及量子相变。我们引入了磁单极子的有效磁矩：当施加沿 z 方向的附加源场时，该源场同时介导量子相变。我们展示了这一有效磁矩与横向泵浦量子霍尔电流之间的关系。磁化率可以作为拓扑不变量的度量，也就是说，在拓扑相内直到相变发生之前，磁化率保持量子化。我们展示了该理论与二维拓扑晶格模型之间的联系，例如实空间中的蜂窝状 Haldane 模型。我们发展了相应理论，并对动量空间中的局域不变量、关联函数以及圆偏振光响应进行了数值分析；其中，动量空间局域不变量由 Dirac 点引入。我们还将形式体系发展到耦合平面材料，纳入了量子自旋霍尔效应的可能性，并讨论了 Ramanujan 无穷交错级数与实空间中具有半拓扑数的界面之间的关系。

articles.title: Model density approach to Ewald summations
articles.title_zh: Ewald 求和的模型密度方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.21776v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The evaluation of the electrostatic potential is fundamental to the study of condensed phase systems. We discuss the calculation of the relevant lattice summations by Ewald-type techniques. A model charge density is introduced, that cancels multipole moments of the crystalline charge distribution up to a desired order, for accelerating convergence of the Ewald sums. The method is applicable to calculations of bulk systems, employing arbitrary unit cells in a classical or quantum context, and with arbitrary basis functions to represent the charge density. The efficacy of the method is demonstrated on the calculation of the fundamental gap of the gallium arsenide bulk semiconductor, as a prototype example, where significantly accelerated convergence is numerically confirmed, due to a reduction of the number of two-electron integrals that need to be computed. The approach clarifies a decades-old implementation in the CRYSTAL code.
articles.abstract_zh: 静电势的计算是研究凝聚相体系的基础。本文讨论了利用 Ewald 型技术计算相关晶格求和，并引入一种模型电荷密度，用于抵消晶体电荷分布截至指定阶数的多极矩，从而加速 Ewald 求和的收敛。该方法适用于具有任意晶胞、处于经典或量子情形下的体相体系，也适用于表示电荷密度的任意基函数；在块体砷化镓带隙计算中的数值结果显示，其可通过减少所需计算的双电子积分数量显著加快收敛。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 静电势的计算对于凝聚相体系的研究至关重要。我们讨论了通过 Ewald 型技术计算相关晶格求和的方法。我们引入一种模型电荷密度，用于抵消晶体电荷分布截至所需阶数的多极矩，从而加速 Ewald 求和的收敛。该方法适用于采用任意晶胞的体相体系，既适用于经典情形，也适用于量子情形，并且允许使用任意基函数来表示电荷密度。我们以块体半导体砷化镓的基本带隙计算作为原型示例，展示了该方法的有效性；数值结果证实，由于需要计算的双电子积分数量减少，收敛速度得到了显著提升。该方法还澄清了 CRYSTAL 程序中一项存在数十年之久的实现。

articles.title: First-Principles AI finds crystallization of fractional quantum Hall liquids
articles.title_zh: 第一性原理人工智能发现分数量子霍尔液体的晶化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.03927v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: When does a fractional quantum Hall (FQH) liquid crystallize? Addressing this question requires a framework that treats fractionalization and crystallization on equal footing, especially in strong Landau-level mixing regime. Here, we introduce MagNet, a self-attention neural-network variational wavefunction designed for quantum systems in magnetic fields on the torus geometry. We show that MagNet provides a unifying and expressive ansatz capable of describing both FQH states and electron crystals within the same architecture. Trained solely by energy minimization of the microscopic Hamiltonian, MagNet discovers topological liquid and electron crystal ground states across a broad range of Landau-level mixing. Our results highlight the power of first-principles AI for solving strongly interacting many-body problems and finding competing phases without external training data or physics pre-knowledge.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究分数量子霍尔液体何时发生晶化，并提出了用于磁场中环面几何量子系统的自注意力神经网络变分波函数 MagNet。MagNet 在同一架构内统一描述分数量子霍尔态和电子晶体，仅通过微观哈密顿量的能量最小化进行训练。结果表明，该方法能够在广泛的 Landau 能级混合范围内自主发现拓扑液体和电子晶体基态，无需外部训练数据或预先输入物理知识。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数量子霍尔（FQH）液体何时会晶化？要回答这一问题，需要一种能够在强 Landau 能级混合区域内平等处理分数化与晶化的框架。在这里，我们引入 MagNet，这是一种为环面几何中磁场下量子系统设计的自注意力神经网络变分波函数。我们表明，MagNet 提供了一个统一且表达能力强的 Ansatz，能够在同一架构内描述 FQH 态和电子晶体。MagNet 仅通过对微观哈密顿量进行能量最小化来训练，并在广泛的 Landau 能级混合范围内自主发现拓扑液体和电子晶体基态。我们的结果凸显了第一性原理人工智能解决强相互作用多体问题、并在没有外部训练数据或预先物理知识的情况下发现竞争相的能力。

articles.title: Magnetic Breakdown Reshapes Quantum Oscillations in Kagome Metals
articles.title_zh: 磁击穿重塑 Kagome 金属中的量子振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05816v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent quantum-oscillation experiments on kagome metals have revealed markedly different phase offsets even among systems with nearly identical band structures and Fermi-surface geometries. Using a tight-binding model, we show that weak orbital hybridization can slightly modify the hybridization gaps. Small variations in these gaps can substantially alter the measured oscillation phase, despite leaving the overall electronic structure nearly unchanged. This phase shift originates from magnetic breakdown, which reconstructs cyclotron trajectories and can mask the nontrivial phase of an isolated orbit, yielding a trivial phase offset. Moreover, uniaxial strain can tune the relevant hybridization gaps and thereby weaken magnetic breakdown. This restores the nontrivial phase offset that magnetic breakdown otherwise masks, providing an experimentally accessible knob for controlling the oscillation phase. These results identify magnetic breakdown as the key mechanism controlling the phase shift and provide a plausible explanation for recent experimental phase discrepancies in kagome metals.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期 Kagome 金属量子振荡实验显示，即使体系具有近乎相同的能带结构和费米面几何，也可能出现显著不同的相位偏移。本文利用紧束缚模型表明，微弱的轨道杂化会略微改变杂化能隙，而能隙的微小变化却能显著改变测得的振荡相位。该相移源于磁击穿对回旋轨道的重构，并可能掩盖孤立轨道的非平庸相位；单轴应变能够调节杂化能隙、削弱磁击穿并恢复这一相位。
authors: Xinlong Du, Yuying Liu, Long Zhang, Juntao Song
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期对 Kagome 金属开展的量子振荡实验揭示，即使不同体系具有近乎相同的能带结构和费米面几何，它们也可能表现出显著不同的相位偏移。利用紧束缚模型，我们表明，微弱的轨道杂化会略微改变杂化能隙。尽管这些能隙的变化很小，却可能显著改变测得的振荡相位，同时总体电子结构几乎不发生变化。该相移源于磁击穿：磁击穿会重构回旋轨道，并可能掩盖孤立轨道的非平庸相位，使测得的相位偏移呈现平庸特征。此外，单轴应变能够调节相关杂化能隙，从而削弱磁击穿。这样便可以恢复原本被磁击穿掩盖的非平庸相位偏移，为实验上控制振荡相位提供了可行手段。这些结果表明，磁击穿是控制相位偏移的关键机制，并为近期 Kagome 金属实验中观察到的相位差异提供了一个合理解释。

articles.title: Emergence of Unique Steady Edge States in Trapped Ultracold Atom Systems
articles.title_zh: 受限超冷原子系统中独特稳态边缘态的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.20763v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We show that, for a one - dimensional open quantum system of ultracold atoms trapped in an array of harmonic potentials that is weakly coupled to a background Bose - Einstein Condensate (BEC), a unique steady state emerges at either of the two edges of the array due to the combined effects of excitation via lasers of these ultracold atoms and decay back to their initial energy levels via emission of excitations into the BEC, acting as an excitation reservoir. We then demonstrate the existence of steady states of the master equation that describes the dynamics of this open quantum system with respect to the expectation value of the position of the harmonic potential containing these states, and show that these steady states occur at the edges of the array of harmonic potentials trapping these atoms. Using the open quantum system's master equation to evolve initial states of the system that are trapped in other harmonic potentials in the array numerically over time, we verify the analytic calculations demonstrating the existence of these steady states at the edge of the system, and further demonstrate that these steady states will emerge regardless of the number of atoms trapped in each of the harmonic potentials in the array. We note that the emergence of these edge states irrespective of the initial state of the system is similar to the non-Hermitian skin effect seen in other open quantum systems, and are of fundamental importance in quantum technological applications such as quantum transport and quantum batteries.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了一维开放量子系统：超冷原子被囚禁在一系列谐势阱中，并与背景玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体弱耦合。激光激发与原子向初始能级衰变、同时向 BEC 发射激发的共同作用，使阵列两端之一涌现出唯一稳态。解析和数值结果表明，该边缘稳态与初始状态及每个势阱中的原子数无关，其特征类似其他开放量子系统中的非厄米皮肤效应，并可能应用于量子输运和量子电池。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，对于一个一维开放量子系统，其中超冷原子被囚禁在一系列谐势阱中，并与背景玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）弱耦合，由于激光对这些超冷原子的激发，以及它们通过向 BEC 中发射激发而衰变回初始能级这两种效应的共同作用，在阵列的两个边缘之一会涌现出唯一稳态，而 BEC 在其中充当激发储库。随后，我们证明，描述这一开放量子系统动力学的主方程存在以包含这些稳态的谐势阱位置期望值为特征的稳态，并表明这些稳态出现在囚禁原子的谐势阱阵列边缘。我们利用该开放量子系统的主方程，对最初被囚禁在阵列中其他谐势阱内的系统态进行数值时间演化，验证了边缘稳态存在的解析计算结果；我们还进一步证明，无论阵列中每个谐势阱囚禁的原子数是多少，这些稳态都会出现。我们注意到，这些边缘态不依赖系统初始状态而涌现，与其他开放量子系统中观察到的非厄米皮肤效应相似，并且对于量子输运和量子电池等量子技术应用具有基础重要性。

articles.title: Microscopic NMR evidence for successive antiferroelectric and antiferromagnetic order in the van der Waals magnet CuCrP₂S₆
articles.title_zh: 范德瓦耳斯磁体CuCrP₂S₆中连续反铁电和反铁磁有序的微观核磁共振证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.02898v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a comprehensive ³¹P and ⁶⁵Cu nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) study of the layered van der Waals magnet CuCrP₂S₆. The compound exhibits a sequence of structural and magnetic phase transitions: a high-temperature paraelectric state, followed by a quasi-antiferroelectric (QAFE) state near 185 K, a long-range antiferroelectric (AFE) phase below 150 K, and finally, antiferromagnetic (AFM) order below T_N = 30 K. The evolution of the NMR spectra, NMR shift, and spin-lattice (T₁⁻¹) and spin-spin (T₂⁻¹) relaxation rates provide direct microscopic fingerprints of these transitions. The splitting of both the NMR line and T₁⁻¹ below the AFE transition demonstrates the emergence of two inequivalent P sites. From K - ḩi analysis, we extract nearly isotropic transferred hyperfine couplings and show that the NMR shift anisotropy originates primarily from the dipolar contribution, in contrast to Mn₂P₂S₆ and Ni₂P₂S₆. We determine the ferromagnetic intralayer exchange Jᵢₙₜᵣₐapprox -4.9 K from the Curie Weiss temperature, consistent with ferromagnetic layers antiferromagnetically stacked along the c axis, and evaluate the Moriya high temperature relaxation rate including cross correlation effects of the P P dimer. Critical divergence of T₁⁻¹ near T_N yields a critical exponent γsimeq 0.45(4), placing CuCrP₂S₆ in a three dimensional Heisenberg universality regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过³¹P和⁶⁵Cu核磁共振系统考察层状范德瓦耳斯磁体CuCrP₂S₆中的结构与磁性相变。该材料依次经历高温顺电态、约185 K出现的准反铁电态、150 K以下的长程反铁电相，以及30 K以下的反铁磁有序。核磁共振谱、位移和弛豫率揭示了这些相变的微观特征，并表明该材料处于三维海森堡普适性区域。
authors: C. S. Saramgi, L. F. Prager, S. Selter, Y. Shemerliuk, S. Aswartham, B. Büchner, H. -J. Grafe, K. M. Ranjith
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对层状范德瓦耳斯磁体CuCrP₂S₆开展了全面的³¹P和⁶⁵Cu核磁共振（NMR）研究。该化合物表现出一系列结构和磁性相变：高温顺电态，随后在约185 K附近出现准反铁电（QAFE）态，在150 K以下进入长程反铁电（AFE）相，最终在T_N=30 K以下形成反铁磁（AFM）有序。NMR谱、NMR位移以及自旋—晶格（T₁⁻¹）和自旋—自旋（T₂⁻¹）弛豫率的演化，为这些相变提供了直接的微观指纹。AFE相变以下NMR谱线和T₁⁻¹均发生分裂，表明出现了两个不等价的P位点。通过K—χ分析，我们提取出近似各向同性的转移超精细耦合，并表明NMR位移各向异性主要源于偶极贡献，这与Mn₂P₂S₆和Ni₂P₂S₆中的情况不同。我们根据居里—外斯温度确定了铁磁层内交换作用Jᵢₙₜᵣₐ≈−4.9 K，这与沿c轴反铁磁堆叠的铁磁层相一致；同时，我们还评估了包含P—P二聚体交叉关联效应的Moriya高温弛豫率。在T_N附近，T₁⁻¹的临界发散给出了临界指数γ≈0.45(4)，表明CuCrP₂S₆处于三维海森堡普适性区域。

articles.title: Role of Excited States in Resonant Charge Transfer during Li⁺ Backscattering from MoS₂: A Multi-Orbital Theoretical Study
articles.title_zh: 激发态在Li⁺从MoS₂表面反向散射过程中的共振电荷转移作用：多轨道理论研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.11607v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a theoretical investigation of resonant charge transfer in low-energy Li⁺ ions backscattered from a MoS₂ surface, focusing on the influence of excited projectile states. Using a time-dependent Anderson model in the infinite-U limit, we evaluate the individual contributions from the Li 2s, 2pₓ, 2p_y, and 2p_z orbitals to the final charge state distribution. The Hamiltonian parameters are computed using an expanded Huzinaga basis set that explicitly incorporates lithium's 2p orbitals. Each orbital channel is treated separately, and electronic correlation effects are introduced approximately through a probabilistic exclusion principle applied to the final charge state. Theoretical calculations demonstrate that including 2p channels enhances the agreement with previously reported experimental neutral fractions, where the single-channel descriptions show noticeable discrepancies. Among excited states, the 2p_z orbital oriented perpendicular to the surface contributes most significantly due to its spatial extension toward the substrate. Examination of temporal evolution reveals that independent channel occupations exceed unity at small projectile-surface separations, highlighting the necessity of dynamical correlation treatments. These findings establish that excited states make non-negligible contributions to charge exchange processes for alkali ions interacting with transition metal dichalcogenide surfaces and should be incorporated for accurate quantitative modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了低能Li⁺从MoS₂表面反向散射时的共振电荷转移，重点考察入射粒子激发态的影响。基于无限U极限下的含时Anderson模型，研究分别评估了Li的2s、2pₓ、2p_y和2p_z轨道对最终电荷态分布的贡献。结果表明，纳入2p通道能够改善与实验中性分数的符合程度，其中垂直于表面的2p_z轨道贡献最大；这说明激发态对碱金属离子与过渡金属硫族化物表面之间的电荷交换不可忽略。
authors: Thomas A. Balsamo, Faustino G. Ibarlucea, Marcelo A. Romero
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开展了低能Li⁺离子从MoS₂表面反向散射过程中共振电荷转移的理论研究，重点关注入射粒子激发态的影响。利用无限U极限下的含时Anderson模型，我们评估了Li的2s、2pₓ、2p_y和2p_z轨道分别对最终电荷态分布的贡献。哈密顿量参数通过扩展的Huzinaga基组计算得到，该基组明确纳入了锂的2p轨道。每个轨道通道均被单独处理，并通过对最终电荷态施加概率性排斥原理，近似引入电子关联效应。理论计算表明，纳入2p通道后，与此前报道的实验中性分数之间的一致性得到改善，而单通道描述则存在明显偏差。在激发态中，垂直于表面取向的2p_z轨道贡献最为显著，这是因为它的空间延展方向朝向基底。对时间演化的考察显示，在入射粒子与表面距离较小时，独立通道的占据数之和超过1，这凸显了开展动力学关联处理的必要性。这些发现表明，激发态会对碱金属离子与过渡金属二硫属化物表面相互作用过程中的电荷交换产生不可忽略的贡献；为了实现准确的定量建模，应将其纳入考虑。

articles.title: Extracting conformal data from finite-size tensor-network flow in critical two-dimensional classical models
articles.title_zh: 从临界二维经典模型中的有限尺寸张量网络流提取共形数据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15749v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a general framework for extracting conformal data from critical two-dimensional classical lattice models using finite-size tensor-network flow. The central idea is to identify, from transfer-matrix spectra, a self-consistent finite-size window together with a crossover scale that separates the finite-size-scaling regime from the finite-entanglement-scaling regime induced by bond-dimension truncation. Within this window, the central charge, scaling dimensions, and conformal spins can be estimated without requiring a unique critical fixed-point tensor or detailed prior knowledge of the underlying conformal field theory. We benchmark the framework using three tensor-network renormalization schemes for the critical two-dimensional Ising and three-state clock models. Across schemes, we find robust universal behavior below the crossover scale, enabling accurate extraction of conformal data up to relatively high conformal levels. The analysis also yields a natural operational definition of entanglement scaling for classical tensor-network calculations and, in turn, a complementary estimator of the central charge.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种利用有限尺寸张量网络流，从临界二维经典晶格模型中提取共形数据的通用框架。该方法通过转移矩阵谱确定自洽的有限尺寸窗口和交叉尺度，从而在有限尺寸标度区间内估计中心荷、标度维数和共形自旋，而无需唯一的临界不动点张量或对底层共形场论的详细先验知识。该框架在临界二维 Ising 模型和三态时钟模型的三种张量网络重整化方案中得到基准检验，并在交叉尺度以下显示出稳健的普适行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一个通用框架，利用有限尺寸张量网络流从临界二维经典晶格模型中提取共形数据。核心思想是从转移矩阵谱中识别一个自洽的有限尺寸窗口以及一个交叉尺度，该交叉尺度将有限尺寸截断所导致的有限尺寸标度区间，与由键维度截断引起的有限纠缠标度区间分隔开来。在这一窗口内，可以估计中心荷、标度维数和共形自旋，而不需要唯一的临界不动点张量，也不需要对底层共形场论有详细的先验知识。我们使用临界二维 Ising 模型和三态时钟模型中的三种张量网络重整化方案对该框架进行了基准检验。在不同方案之间，交叉尺度以下均观察到稳健的普适行为，从而能够较为准确地提取共形数据，直至相对较高的共形能级。该分析还为经典张量网络计算中的纠缠标度给出了一个自然的操作性定义，并进一步提供了一个互补的中心荷估计量。

articles.title: Autonomous Emergence of Hamiltonian in Deep Generative Models
articles.title_zh: 深度生成模型中哈密顿量的自主涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.20821v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The unprecedented predictive success of deep generative models in complex many-body systems, such as AlphaFold 3, raises an epistemological question: do these networks merely memorize data distributions via high-dimensional interpolation, or do they autonomously deduce the underlying physical laws? To address this, we introduce a framework to extract the implicit physical interactions learned by generative models. Using the exact equivalence between the zero-noise limit of a diffusion score field and the thermodynamic restoring force, we directly compare the internal interaction structure of a trained neural network with the physical Hamiltonian. Applying this framework to a sequence-dependent, frustrated 1D O(3) spin glass, we probe the latent representations of an O(3)-equivariant attention architecture trained solely on thermal equilibrium snapshots. Without imposing a locality cutoff or configuration independence, the dense scalar matrix in our architecture develops locality and nearly configuration-independent coefficients that recover the microscopic interactions of the spin glass with Pearson correlation 0.993 on 2,000 unseen sequences. This provides quantitative, falsifiable evidence for the emphemergence of the Hamiltonian in a deep generative model. Similarly, in an explicit-water phenol experiment, the network is trained only on coordinate data. With sufficient expressive capacity, a molecular-graph-guided Pairformer recovers the dominant bond, angle, and proper-torsion potential-of-mean-force (PMF) sectors. A sector-preserving projection of configuration-dependent coefficients onto constants yields Rₘ̊ cₒₙₛₜ²⁼⁰.9669 on unseen molecular dynamics (MD), providing molecular-scale evidence for partial emphemergence of the Hamiltonian.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种框架，用于提取深度生成模型所学习到的隐含物理相互作用，并将其与真实物理哈密顿量直接比较。对于仅由热平衡快照训练的 O(3) 等变注意力模型，该方法在序列依赖、受挫的一维 O(3) 自旋玻璃中恢复了微观相互作用，在 2000 个未见序列上取得 0.993 的 Pearson 相关系数。对显式水中的苯酚体系，分子图引导的 Pairformer 还恢复了主要的键、键角和适当扭转势能平均力势扇区，表明生成模型内部可以部分涌现出哈密顿量结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 深度生成模型在复杂多体系统中的预测成功前所未有，例如 AlphaFold 3 的成功引发了一个认识论问题：这些网络仅仅通过高维插值记忆数据分布，还是能够自主推导出背后的物理定律？为回答这一问题，我们提出了一个用于提取生成模型所学习到的隐含物理相互作用的框架。利用扩散得分场在零噪声极限下与热力学恢复力之间的严格等价关系，我们直接比较训练好的神经网络内部的相互作用结构与物理哈密顿量。我们将这一框架应用于一个具有序列依赖性和受挫特征的一维 O(3) 自旋玻璃，并考察了一个仅使用热平衡快照训练的 O(3) 等变注意力架构的潜在表示。在不施加局域性截断或构型无关性约束的情况下，我们架构中的稠密标量矩阵呈现出局域性和近似与构型无关的系数，并在 2000 个未见序列上以 0.993 的 Pearson 相关系数恢复了自旋玻璃的微观相互作用。这为深度生成模型中哈密顿量的涌现提供了定量且可证伪的证据。在显式水中的苯酚实验中，网络仅使用坐标数据进行训练。在具有足够表达能力的情况下，分子图引导的 Pairformer 恢复了主要的键、键角和适当扭转势能平均力势能扇区。将与扇区保持一致的、依赖构型的系数投影到常数上后，在未见分子动力学数据上得到 R²_const = 0.9669，这从分子尺度为哈密顿量的部分涌现提供了证据。

articles.title: Analytical Treatment of Noise-Suppressed Klein Tunneling in Graphene with Possible Implications for Quantum-Dot Qubits
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯中噪声抑制型 Klein 隧穿的解析处理及其对量子点量子比特的潜在意义
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.23279v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study quantum tunneling through a potential barrier whose height fluctuates in time and is modeled by Gaussian white noise. We map the stochastic dynamics onto an equivalent time-independent Lindblad equation for the density matrix, allowing fully analytical solutions. For Schrödinger particles, noise introduces dissipation that suppresses Fabry-Pérot oscillations and yields an exponentially decaying transmission. Applying the same formalism to graphene, we demonstrate that noise induces a complex longitudinal wavevector within the barrier, leading to a strong suppression of transmission and Klein tunneling, even at normal incidence. Our approach promises improved control over Klein tunneling. These results demonstrate that noisy barriers can act as tunable dissipative elements, offering a pathway to enhanced control of electron transport in graphene-based devices. We also briefly discuss how our results could guide the design of graphene quantum dots for potential use in spin qubit devices.
