Our results demonstrate that 1-2 eV spectral blueshifts previously reported in the literature arise from single-particle GW convergence artifacts rather than deficiencies in the electron--hole kernels. We show that the near-perfect cancellation between ΔQP and E_b breaks down as cluster volume increases, driven by the rapid onset of dielectric screening attenuating E_b faster than ΔQP and leading to a pronounced divergence from mean-field predictions. Spatial inverse participation ratio analysis of the electronic structure reveals that optical suppression of fundamental pre-peaks stems from a severe spatial mismatch between localized valence orbitals and delocalized conduction states. Finally, we demonstrate that the confinement-induced scaling of the quasiparticle gap and the optical onset is accurately reproduced by a scissor-corrected, DFT-parameterized TB model. As such, this work provides a quantitative multiscale roadmap for embedding effective many-body effects kernels into computationally efficient models, enabling reliable optical predictions for realistic semiconducting nanostructures containing up to thousands of atoms.
authors: Surender Kumar, Martin Thümmler, Alexander Croy, Stefanie Gräfe, Caterina Cocchi

articles.title: Competing Extended-s- and d-Wave Pairing from Distinct Spin-Fluctuation Channels in Stoichiometric FeTe
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent observation of superconductivity in stoichiometric FeTe raises the question of how pairing develops in this tetragonal 11-type chalcogenide once interstitial Fe is removed. We construct an experimentally constrained five-orbital tight-binding model from first-principles calculations and treat electronic correlations and pairing within the fluctuation-exchange approximation. The linearized Eliashberg equation yields competing extended-s- and dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave spin-singlet pairing instabilities. Near stoichiometric filling, spin fluctuations near (π,0) and (0,π) in the unfolded one-Fe Brillouin zone connect the Γ/M hole pockets with the X/Y electron pockets and favor an extended-s gap that changes sign between the hole and electron sheets. Upon electron doping, depletion of the hole pockets shifts the dominant scattering toward the X--Y channel near (π,π), making the dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave state the leading instability, with nodal lines that avoid most of the Fermi surface. The relative strengths of the two pairing channels vary with filling and interaction strength as the dominant spin-fluctuation channel changes. Under matched interaction strength, temperature, and filling, the extended-s eigenvalue is larger in FeTe than in FeSe throughout the range considered, while the dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave eigenvalue is also generally larger, particularly under electron doping. These results give concrete gap structures against which spectroscopic measurements of stoichiometric FeTe can be compared.
authors: Yichen Hua, Wen-lin Yang, Jian-Jian Miao, Hu Xu, Changming Yue

articles.title: The Pauli Probability Spectrum Carries the Pure-State Quantum Fisher Metric
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21437v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Stabilizer Rényi entropies compress the distribution of squared Pauli expectation values of a pure quantum state into scalar measures of nonstabilizerness. Here we show that, before this compression, the distribution has a remarkably simple information-geometric structure. For any smooth pure-state family of N qubits, its classical Fisher information matrix is exactly twice the quantum Fisher information matrix of the state at every regular point. This information can be accessed directly: by preparing the state together with its complex conjugate and performing pairwise Bell measurements between corresponding qubits, one samples the same Pauli distribution and saturates the quantum Fisher information matrix of the conjugate pair. The readout is fixed and does not depend on the number of estimated parameters or on the particular pure-state sensing model. We show that the origin of this result is more general than Pauli algebra: conjugation identifies the doubled pure state with the vectorized density operator, whose coordinates are real in any Hermitian Hilbert--Schmidt operator basis. The situation changes for mixed states, for which the Bell probabilities no longer coincide with normalized squared Pauli expectation values and the same fixed readout is generally not optimal. We derive an exact positive-semidefinite expression for the missing Fisher information, identifying the components of the state variation that are invisible to Bell sampling. Our results reveal a direct connection between stabilizer Rényi statistics, quantum-state geometry, and fixed multiparameter readout.
authors: E. A. Ramirez Trino, M. A. Rajabpour

articles.title: Anomalous Local Heat Capacity and Bipartite Entanglement
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21508v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The heat capacity of a system quantifies how it energetically responds to changes in temperature at equilibrium. Whilst this quantity is positive and even additive for non-interacting systems, self-gravitating systems such as stars or subsystems of strongly interacting quantum systems are known to have negative or anomalous specific heat capacities. In this work, we investigate how the presence of entanglement at equilibrium can influence how an interacting system responds energetically to changes in temperature. We examine the local heat capacity of interacting quantum systems providing an analytical understanding for when anomalies occur. Most interestingly, we find a connection between local heat capacity anomalies and entanglement by deriving a separability bound based on the fluctuations of local and interaction energies. We illustrate our results with two examples (i) a nearest neighbour spin-1/2 chain and (ii) two coupled quantum harmonic oscillators. Lastly, we provide an information-theoretic formula connecting mutual information and athermality to the non-additivity of the heat capacity. Our results provide model-independent thermodynamic entanglement detection bounds and insight into the relationship between quantum correlations and the heat capacity of quantum systems.
authors: Jake Xuereb, A. de Oliveira Junior

articles.title: Experimental Investigation of Tunable-Order Hilbert-Space Ergodicity
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21959v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hilbert-space ergodicity (HSE) provides a new framework for studying thermalization in driven quantum systems, complementing the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis, which is restricted to static systems. This ergodicity is hierarchical: by quantifying how randomly the dynamics explores the Hilbert space, one obtains a family of levels termed k-HSE. While HSE has been observed at the lowest and highest levels, finite-order HSE dynamics remains largely unexplored due to the difficulty of constructing such drives. Here, we explore this intermediate regime and uncover its distinctive physics. We first propose and prove that a family of m-tone drives on qubits realizes k-HSE up to k = 2m-3, with drive parameters determined at O(k) cost. Using a single nitrogen-vacancy center in diamond, we verify this design by showing that a 3-tone drive realizes 3-HSE, with fourth-order statistics depending on the initial state. Further in-depth theoretical analysis shows that this initial-state dependence is generic across drives, demonstrating the possibility of recovering the initial state from higher-order statistics even when the dynamics is ergodic. Our work broadens the study of quantum ergodicity and reveals intriguing physics within its hierarchy.
authors: Zou-Wei Pan, Wenquan Liu, Xing Rong

articles.title: Laughlin quasihole geometry from a single snapshot ensemble
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22384v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Can a probability distribution measured in one basis determine complex quantum geometry? The answer is affirmative for a lattice Laughlin quasihole. The exact occupation law at one generic reference position, together with the known analytic quasihole factor, fixes the complete complex Gram kernel. A finite snapshot ensemble estimates this kernel without preparing another member of the family, and thereby determines finite-distance overlaps, Bargmann phases, the quantum metric, and the Berry curvature. The same analytic structure confines the family to an exact projective subspace whose dimension grows at most linearly with particle number. Exact enumeration of a Nielsen-Cirac-Sierra state demonstrates finite-shot reconstruction of both the metric and a geometric phase. Moreover, a Rényi-2 divergence sets the statistical range of the reconstruction while, at nondegenerate points, occupation readout also attains the local single-copy multiparameter information bound.

articles.title: Deterministic Preparation of Arbitrary Spin Eigenfunctions
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22892v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum states with conserved total spins, or spin eigenfunctions, are important for studying quantum chemistry and quantum manybody physics problems. A typical class of spin eigenfunctions are Dicke states, which attain maximal spins. While we already have many efficient quantum algorithms to prepare Dicke states, it is not yet clear if we could do so for arbitrary spin eigenfunctions deterministically. Generalizing Bärtschi and Eidenbenz's elegant algorithms for Dicke state preparation, we successfully prepare arbitrary spin eigenfunctions characterized by branching paths and binary spin trees. As a byproduct, we also develop the corresponding classical algorithms to reconstruct all these spin states.
authors: Wenxuan Tao, Jianan Wang, Fen Zuo

articles.title: Universal equilibrium magic in quantum many-body systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22939v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Thermalization conventionally describes local properties of isolated many-body systems at equilibrium. Magic, or nonstabilizerness n̆icodex2013 the resource enabling universal quantum computation n̆icodex2013 is by contrast encoded in the global structure of the many-body wavefunction. We show that, despite its global nature, the magic of equilibrium pure states of chaotic many-body systems, including late-time evolved states and energy eigenstates, is universal: it is captured by the thermal Scrooge ensemble, the minimally informative ensemble of pure states consistent with the Gibbs state at the same effective temperature. Therefore, for systems with no conserved quantities other than the total energy, equilibrium magic is a function of temperature alone, independent of the initial state and other microscopic features of the equilibrium state. This yields concrete universal predictions for the stabilizer Rényi entropies (SREs). At infinite temperature, the SRE is set by Haar-like fluctuations of the Pauli spectrum, while at finite temperature energy conservation induces a volume-law thermodynamic correction controlled by the thermal Pauli spectrum. We support these predictions with analytical arguments and extensive numerical simulations. We further show that chaotic many-body systems at high temperatures possess long-range magic and entanglement that cannot be removed by finite-depth local quantum circuits. Our results establish magic as a thermodynamic property of chaotic many-body systems and suggest that Scrooge ensembles may provide a unified framework for quantum many-body resources.
authors: Soumyadeep Sarma, Tobias Haug, John Preskill, Wai-Keong Mok

articles.title: `It from Bit': is there a second law of quantum complexity?
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22977v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: At a deeper level the principle of least action is interpreted as the law of least entropy increase consistent with Prigogine's principle of minimum entropy production, and the implications of quasistatic information quantization rule (Proc. R. Soc. A 480: 20240024), are explored for the conjectured second law of quantum complexity. It is thus shown that the conjectured second law of complexity is derivable from the information quantization rule such that long after heat-death the quantum state complexity evolves as C(t)=Cₘ̊ ₘₐₓexp(-1/t), increasing with time to a saturation value Cₘ̊ ₘₐₓ that is exponential in the equilibrium entropy Sₘ̊ ₘₐₓ. For the out-of-equilibrium circumstances, however, the quantum complexity can decrease with the time, asymptotically tending to a minimum determined by the distance from equilibrium.
authors: S. Davatolhagh, A. Sheykhi, M. H. Zarei

articles.title: Correlation inequalities for transversal field models with application to quantum glasses
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23177v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the class of transversal field models with pair interactions, including the quantum Curie-Weiss and the transversal field Ising model, as well as quantum spin glasses based on the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) and Edwards-Anderson models. Our main result is a general correlation inequality based on a Gaussian convolution estimate, which is derived from an extension of the Ding-Song-Sun inequality and an application of Brascamp-Lieb convexity techniques. The results apply for sufficiently strong transversal fields and, for quantum spin glasses, yield a high-field regime without replica order. Combined with the previously established low-field replica-symmetry-breaking regime, this gives distinct low- and high-field overlap phases. As a corollary of the logarithmic Sobolev inequalities for the underlying functional integrals derived here, we show the concentration of the self- and replica-overlap, and determine the high-field asymptotics of the pressure in the quantum SK model.

articles.title: Quantum Monte Carlo in the Age of Many-Body Quantum Information
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23231v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) methods are among the central numerical tools for studying strongly correlated quantum many-body systems, particularly in higher dimensions. As quantum information has introduced new information-theoretic perspectives and diagnostics into many-body physics, QMC methods have accordingly been extended beyond the measurement of conventional linear observables. This review summarizes recent progress in adapting QMC to many-body quantum-information, focusing on qubit or spin-1/2 systems as a concrete setting while keeping the discussion broadly applicable to qudit and bosonic systems. We present a unified perspective on the extraction of nonlinear diagnostics, including entanglement entropies and entanglement spectra, Rényi negativities for mixed-state entanglement, stabilizer entropies for quantum magic, and decoherence-driven phenomena such as the interplay between imaginary-time evolution and decoherence and strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking.
authors: Yi-Ming Ding, Bin-Bin Mao, Zheng Yan

articles.title: Quantum-Geometric Length Scale for Long-distance Squeezing in Bosonic Bogoliubov Systems
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23380v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multimode squeezing is a key resource for continuous-variable quantum technologies, but its spatial range in bosonic lattices is usually tied to dispersive propagation. Here we show that parametric pairing can create an exactly flat Bogoliubov band spanned by compact Bogoliubov generators, while producing phase-sensitive anomalous correlations and sub-vacuum collective-mode squeezing that extend far beyond their finite support. Each compact generator mixes annihilation and creation operators, thereby encoding the Bogoliubov squeezing structure, and neighboring translated generators can have nonzero commutator overlap. Enforcing canonical bosonic commutation relations therefore requires spatially extended linear combinations of these translated compact generators, which define the canonical Bogoliubov modes. The squeezing transformation of these modes varies with momentum and is quantified by the squeezing-sector symplectic quantum metric. A complex-momentum singularity of the analytically continued canonical Bogoliubov modes sets both the anomalous-correlation decay length and the momentum-space width of this metric, defining an intrinsic quantum-geometric length scale. This singularity can be tuned continuously while preserving exact flatness, thereby controlling the spatial range of correlations and squeezing. Away from exact flatness, long-distance correlations persist through multiple decay channels, while modes localized by defects and dimerized boundaries provide complementary probes of the underlying quantum geometry. In the weak-damping limit, the same quantum-geometric length scale can be extracted from frequency-filtered two-port correlations. Our results establish the quantum geometry of canonical Bogoliubov modes as a mechanism for spatially extended quantum resources arising from compact Bogoliubov generators.
authors: Sonu Verma, Sangmo Cheon, Myung-Joong Hwang, Moon Jip Park

articles.title: Environmental Control Extends Beyond Quantum Dephasing in Exciton Energy Transfer
articles.title_zh: 环境调控超越激子退相干对能量转移的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23423v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Excitation-energy transfer underpins the conversion of light into usable energy in photosynthetic organisms and serves as a paradigm for evolutionary optimized transport in open quantum systems. Although this process is often described as incoherent thermally assisted hopping, such descriptions become inadequate when electronic coupling, vibronic interactions and environmental fluctuations occur on comparable energy scales. Determining how the environment controls transport therefore remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we use temperature-dependent 2DES to investigate energy transfer in the photosynthetic antenna protein allophycocyanin over the range 10 - 296 K. The dominant β i̊ghtarrow α transfer step exhibits a pronounced non-monotonic temperature dependence: the transfer time decreases from 400 fs at 10 K to 200 fs near 30- 40 K before increasing again to 400 fs at 296 K. In contrast, the homogeneous optical dephasing time decreases monotonically across the same temperature range. To interpret these observations, we model APC as a vibronically coupled excitonic dimer interacting with a structured environment and solve the dynamics using hierarchical equations of motion. Conventional fixed-bath models, including Drude-Lorentz and explicit intermolecular-mode spectral densities, fail to reproduce the observed turnover. Quantitative agreement is obtained only when the low-frequency sector of the environmental spectral density is allowed to anharmonically evolve strongly with temperature, while the high-frequency bath remains essentially unchanged. More broadly, these findings demonstrate that transport efficiency is controlled not simply by the magnitude of environmental fluctuations, but by the distribution of environmental spectral weight across frequency space, providing new experimental constraints on theories of molecular transport in complex quantum environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究人员利用温度依赖的二维电子光谱，研究了藻蓝蛋白天线蛋白中的激发能量转移。β→α转移时间随温度呈非单调变化，而均匀光学退相干时间则单调减小。层级运动方程分析表明，只有考虑低频环境谱密度随温度发生强烈非简谐演化，才能再现实验结果，说明输运效率取决于环境谱权重在频率空间中的分布，而非仅取决于涨落强度。
authors: Junhua Zhou, Tianrui Chen, Dehao Yuan, Enhu He, Vandana Tiwari, Maxim Gelin, Francoise Remacle, R. J. Dwayne Miller, Fulu Zheng, Ajay Jha, Hong-Guang Duan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 激发能量转移是光合作用生物体将光转化为可用能量的基础，也是开放量子系统中经进化优化的输运过程的典型范例。尽管这一过程通常被描述为非相干的热辅助跃迁，但当电子耦合、振电相互作用和环境涨落处于相近能标时，这类描述便不再充分。因此，确定环境如何调控输运仍然是一个基础性挑战。在本研究中，我们采用温度依赖的二维电子光谱学（2DES），研究了光合天线蛋白藻蓝蛋白在10—296 K范围内的能量转移。占主导地位的β→α转移步骤表现出显著的非单调温度依赖性：转移时间从10 K时的400 fs下降到约30—40 K时的200 fs，随后在296 K时再次增加到400 fs。相比之下，在相同温度范围内，均匀光学退相干时间单调减小。为解释这些观测结果，我们将藻蓝蛋白建模为与结构化环境相互作用的振电耦合激子二聚体，并利用层级运动方程求解其动力学。包括Drude–Lorentz谱密度和显式分子间模式谱密度在内的传统固定浴模型，都无法再现实验中观察到的转折行为。只有允许环境谱密度的低频部分随温度发生强烈的非简谐演化，而保持高频浴基本不变时，才能获得定量上的一致。更广泛地说，这些发现表明，输运效率并非简单由环境涨落的大小控制，而是由环境谱权重在频率空间中的分布控制，从而为复杂量子环境中分子输运理论提供了新的实验约束。

articles.title: Phonon-Mediated Chirality Transfer from Organic Cation to Inorganic lattice in Hybrid Perovskites
articles.title_zh: 混合钙钛矿中从有机阳离子到无机晶格的声子介导手性转移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.10036v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Two-dimensional hybrid metal halide perovskites combine spin-orbit coupling, soft lattice dynamics, and molecular tunability, making them promising platforms for chiral optoelectronics. While chiral organic spacers are known to induce optical activity in the inorganic framework, the microscopic mechanism by which molecular chirality couples to the inorganic lattice is actively studied. Here, we investigate coherent vibrational dynamics in chiral (R-MBA)₂PbI₄ and its racemic analogue using circular-polarized transient absorption spectroscopy. A vibrational mode at ~5.7 meV is present in the chiral material and not observed in the racemic counterpart, confirmed as a lattice phonon by agreement between time-domain and steady-state measurements. Ab-initio calculations reveal correlated libration of the organic spacer and bending displacement of the Pb-I framework analogous to a classical Wilberforce pendulum whose sense is locked to the structural handedness of the lattice. Polarization-resolved measurements reveal a transient circular dichroism whose exact sign reversal between (R-MBA)₂PbI₄ and (S-MBA)₂PbI₄ is consistent with a periodic modulation of the excitonic rotational strength driven by the coupled lattice displacement. These results establish dynamic chirality transfer through the coupled librational-bending mechanism, with direct implications for phonon-driven chiral optical responses and spin-selective transport.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过圆偏振瞬态吸收光谱，比较了手性(R-MBA)₂PbI₄与外消旋类似物中的相干振动动力学。手性材料中出现约5.7 meV、外消旋材料中未观察到的晶格声子模式，其运动表现为有机间隔体摆动与Pb–I骨架弯曲的耦合。偏振分辨测量显示，手性转移可通过该耦合机制动态调制激子的旋转强度，并产生符号随结构手性反转的瞬态圆二色性。
authors: Sankaran Ramesh, Prasenjit Mandal, Rafael Araujo, Jakob Thyr, Pratik Bhagwat, Yong Li, Tomas Edvinsson, Tönu Pullerits, Dmitry Baranov
articles.focus_summary: 该研究通过圆偏振瞬态吸收实验和从头算揭示手性有机阳离子与无机Pb-I晶格之间的相干振动耦合。在手性二维杂化卤化物钙钛矿中，约5.7 meV的晶格声子由有机间隔基的转动与Pb-I骨架弯曲协同构成，并表现出与结构手性相关的瞬态圆二色性。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的杂化有机-无机钙钛矿、非绝热动力学、电子-声子耦合、光学响应和界面电荷转移方向相关。该工作可为研究分子自由度调控钙钛矿晶格动力学、手性光电响应及声子介导能量转移提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步结合非绝热分子动力学和GW-BSE计算，研究手性声子对激子、自旋轨道耦合、载流子弛豫和非辐射复合的影响，并比较不同有机阳离子和层间堆垛结构。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维杂化金属卤化物钙钛矿结合了自旋—轨道耦合、软晶格动力学和分子可调性，因此成为手性光电子学的有前景平台。尽管已知手性有机间隔体能够在无机骨架中诱导光学活性，但分子手性与无机晶格发生耦合的微观机制仍在积极研究之中。在本研究中，我们利用圆偏振瞬态吸收光谱，研究了手性(R-MBA)₂PbI₄及其外消旋类似物中的相干振动动力学。在手性材料中观察到一个约5.7 meV的振动模式，而在外消旋对应物中未观察到该模式；通过时域测量与稳态测量结果的一致性，确认它是一个晶格声子。第一性原理计算揭示，有机间隔体的相关摆动与Pb–I骨架的弯曲位移相互耦合，类似于经典的Wilberforce摆，其运动方向被晶格的结构手性锁定。偏振分辨测量显示存在瞬态圆二色性；该信号在(R-MBA)₂PbI₄与(S-MBA)₂PbI₄之间发生精确的符号反转，这与由耦合晶格位移驱动的激子旋转强度周期性调制相一致。这些结果确立了通过摆动—弯曲耦合机制实现的动态手性转移，并对声子驱动的手性光学响应和自旋选择性输运具有直接意义。

articles.title: Spinon Singlet Pairing: Origin of d-Wave Sign Structure in a Partially-Filled Stripe
articles.title_zh: 自旋子单态配对：部分填充条纹中d波符号结构的起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.18892v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Significant research advances have led to a consensus that the Fermi-Hubbard model and its extended variants are archetypical frameworks for elucidating the intertwined relationship between stripe orders and superconductivity in hole-doped high-T_c materials. Notably, the Hubbard quantum simulator has recently achieved several remarkable breakthroughs, e.g., being cooled down to the cryogenic regime and enabling the observation of stable fluctuating stripes. However, the microscopic mechanism underlying the d-wave pairing of electrons in the presence of stripes at low temperatures remains poorly understood due to the intricate interplay between strongly correlated effects and non-negligible thermal fluctuations. Here, we conduct a close investigation of a partially-filled stripe in the representative t-J and t-t'-U models with both numerical and analytical methods. Analogous to quantum gas microscopy, the perfect sampling technique allows us to obtain the high-confidence-level statistics of the Fock basis states appearing in the ground-state wavefunction. In a novel physical paradigm, these data demonstrate that two spinons with opposite chiralities tend to pair spontaneously into a singlet state, thereby naturally giving rise to the d-wave pairing pattern. Then, using the updated effective theory of quantum colored string, we have reconstructed the wavefunction and have determined the nature of spinon pairing and its connection to the d-wave sign structure of pair-pair correlation. Furthermore, spinon singlet pairs enable the establishment of a long-range pair-pair correlation between the two stripes. Our work offers new insights into the microscopic physics of stripes and paves the way for further exploration of multi-stripe-mediated pairing mechanisms in the Fermi-Hubbard model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用数值与解析方法研究了t-J模型和t-t′-U模型中的部分填充条纹。研究发现，具有相反手性的两个自旋子倾向于自发形成单态，从而自然产生d波配对图样及配对关联函数中的d波符号结构。自旋子单态配对还能够在两条条纹之间建立长程配对—配对关联，为理解条纹与超导性的微观联系提供了新视角。
authors: Jia-Long Wang, Shi-Jie Hu, Xue-Feng Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大量研究进展已经使人们形成共识：费米—Hubbard模型及其扩展模型是阐明空穴掺杂高温超导材料中条纹序与超导性相互交织关系的典型理论框架。值得注意的是，Hubbard量子模拟器近期取得了若干重大突破，例如冷却至低温区间并实现了稳定涨落条纹的观测。然而，由于强关联效应与不可忽略的热涨落之间存在复杂相互作用，低温下条纹存在时电子d波配对的微观机制仍未得到充分理解。在本研究中，我们结合数值和解析方法，对具有代表性的t-J模型和t-t′-U模型中的部分填充条纹进行了细致研究。类似于量子气体显微镜，完美采样技术使我们能够获得基态波函数中出现的Fock基态的高置信度统计数据。在一种新颖的物理图景中，这些数据表明，两个具有相反手性的自旋子倾向于自发配对成单态，从而自然产生d波配对图样。随后，我们利用更新后的量子有色弦有效理论重构了波函数，并确定了自旋子配对的性质及其与配对—配对关联中d波符号结构的联系。此外，自旋子单态对能够在两条条纹之间建立长程配对—配对关联。本工作为理解条纹的微观物理提供了新见解，并为进一步探索费米—Hubbard模型中由多条纹介导的配对机制铺平了道路。

articles.title: Scaling of the Electrical Conductivity Spectra Reveals Distinct Transport Responses in A2SmTaO6 [A = Ba, Sr, Ca]
articles.title_zh: A₂SmTaO₆（A = Ba、Sr、Ca）电导率谱的标度揭示不同的输运响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.21621v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Disorder plays an important role in materials science, influencing material behavior across different length scales. Imperfections like vacancies, atomic substitutions, lattice distortions, and microstructural inhomogeneities, disrupt ideal periodicity thereby altering physical properties. Analogous to spin-glass systems, electrical 'glassiness' arises when charge carriers confront disordered energy landscapes, leading to a broad range of relaxation times, especially in polycrystalline materials where dipoles experience competing exchange interactions. Complex impedance, permittivity, and electric modulus distill out separate resistive and capacitive effects, offering insights into how microstructural inhomogeneities affects conduction mechanism. In polycrystalline double perovskites A2SmTaO6 (A = Ba, Ca), with a power law driven ac conductivity, the hopping and relaxation of carriers is affected by both grains and grain boundaries. Scaling of ac conductivity and impedance response reveals correlation between conduction and relaxation timescales. The inhomogeneities in local energy landscape of 'frustrated' dipoles restrict the 'universality' of conduction mechanism across the bulk length scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了多晶双钙钛矿A₂SmTaO₆（A = Ba、Ca）中的交流电导与阻抗响应，重点考察晶粒和晶界对载流子跳跃与弛豫的影响。交流电导率和阻抗响应的标度关系揭示了传导时间尺度与弛豫时间尺度之间的关联。局域能量景观的不均匀性限制了受挫偶极子在宏观体尺度上的传导机制普适性。
authors: Saswata Halder, Binita Ghosh, T. P. Sinha
articles.abstract_zh_full: 无序在材料科学中发挥着重要作用，并在不同长度尺度上影响材料行为。空位、原子取代、晶格畸变和微观结构非均匀性等缺陷会破坏理想周期性，从而改变物理性质。类似于自旋玻璃系统，当电荷载流子面对无序能量景观时，会产生电学“玻璃态”特征，导致宽广的弛豫时间分布，尤其是在偶极子经历相互竞争的交换相互作用的多晶材料中。复阻抗、介电常数和电模量能够分离出不同的电阻性与电容性效应，从而有助于理解微观结构非均匀性如何影响传导机制。在具有幂律驱动交流电导的多晶双钙钛矿A₂SmTaO₆（A = Ba、Ca）中，载流子的跳跃与弛豫同时受到晶粒和晶界的影响。交流电导率和阻抗响应的标度关系揭示了传导与弛豫时间尺度之间的关联。受挫偶极子局域能量景观中的非均匀性，限制了传导机制在整个体尺度上的“普适性”。

articles.title: Momentum correlations of the Hawking effect in a quantum fluid
articles.title_zh: 量子流体中霍金效应的动量关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17807v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Hawking effect -- the amplification of fluctuations at the horizon -- has been detected in quantum fluids through real-space density correlations. However, real-space observables integrate over frequency, mixing distinct scattering channels into a single interference pattern and obscuring the spectral and entanglement structure of the emission. Here, we numerically compute momentum-space two-point correlations in a transcritical quantum fluid, using the truncated Wigner approximation applied to a realistic, driven-dissipative polariton system. We spectrally resolve the Hawking--partner as well as greybody factor channels and find that both carry comparable correlation strength, demonstrating that the well-known real-space ``moustache'' is an interference between these spectrally distinct contributions. The Hawking--partner channel is dominated by negative correlations, a direct signature of quantum-vacuum pair creation. All features reach amplitudes detectable in state-of-the-art experiments. Our results establish that the full three-mode output state must be considered for entanglement characterization, and provide a general framework applicable to any quantum fluid.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子流体中的霍金效应已通过实空间密度关联被探测到，但实空间观测会对频率进行积分，从而混合不同散射通道。本文利用截断Wigner近似，数值计算了现实驱动耗散极化激元系统中跨临界量子流体的动量空间二点关联。结果分辨出霍金—伙伴通道和灰体因子通道，表明实空间中熟知的“胡子”图样是两种频谱上不同贡献的干涉，并指出必须考虑完整的三模输出态来刻画纠缠。
authors: Marcos Gil de Olivera, Malo Joly, Antonio Z. Khoury, Alberto Bramati, Maxime J. Jacquet
articles.abstract_zh_full: 霍金效应，即视界处涨落的放大，已经通过实空间密度关联在量子流体中被探测到。然而，实空间可观测量会对频率进行积分，把不同的散射通道混合成单一干涉图样，从而掩盖辐射的频谱结构和纠缠结构。在本研究中，我们使用截断Wigner近似，对跨临界量子流体中的动量空间二点关联进行了数值计算；所采用的模型是一个现实的、受驱动—耗散的极化激元系统。我们在频谱上分辨出霍金—伙伴通道以及灰体因子通道，并发现二者携带的关联强度相当，这表明众所周知的实空间“胡子”图样实际上是这些频谱上彼此不同的贡献之间的干涉。霍金—伙伴通道以负关联为主，这是量子真空成对产生的直接特征。所有这些特征的振幅都达到当代最先进实验可以探测的水平。我们的结果表明，在纠缠表征中必须考虑完整的三模输出态，并为适用于任意量子流体的研究提供了一个通用框架。

articles.title: Optimization of Si/SiGe Heterostructures for Large and Robust Valley Splitting in Silicon Qubits
articles.title_zh: 面向硅量子比特大幅且稳健谷劈裂的Si/SiGe异质结构优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.18064v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Small and device-dependent valley splittings remain a key challenge for electron spin qubits in silicon (Si), directly limiting qubit fidelity, device uniformity, and the scalability of Si-based quantum processors. In silicon-germanium (SiGe) heterostructures, this problem can be addressed through engineering of the epitaxial layer stack. Several heuristic strategies have been proposed to enhance the energy gap between the two nearly degenerate valley states in strained Si/SiGe quantum wells (QWs), e.g., sharp Si/SiGe interfaces, Ge spikes, or oscillating Ge concentrations within the QW. Here, we develop a systematic variational optimization approach to compute optimal Ge concentration profiles that enhance selected properties of the intervalley coupling matrix element. Our free-shape optimization framework is augmented by realistic technological constraints to ensure feasibility of the resulting epitaxial profiles and is based on an effective-mass envelope-function theory accounting for strain and compositional alloy disorder. Previously proposed heterostructure designs are recovered as special cases of the constrained optimization problem. Our main result is a novel heterostructure design, which we refer to as the "modulated wiggle well", providing both a large deterministic enhancement of the valley splitting and a strong suppression of disorder-induced variability. In addition, this design enables wide electrical tunability of the valley splitting - from approximately 200,μ eV to above 1,meV - offering new opportunities for engineering robust and switchable silicon qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 硅自旋量子比特中的谷劈裂通常较小且依赖器件，这限制了量子比特保真度、器件一致性和量子处理器的可扩展性。本文发展了一种系统的变分优化方法，用于设计满足实际工艺约束的锗浓度剖面，并增强谷间耦合矩阵元的目标性质。提出的“调制波纹量子阱”既能确定性地增大谷劈裂，又能抑制无序引起的波动，并实现约200 μeV至超过1 meV的宽范围电调控。
authors: Abel Thayil, Lasse Ermoneit, Lars R. Schreiber, Thomas Koprucki, Markus Kantner
articles.abstract_zh_full: 较小且依赖器件的谷劈裂仍然是硅（Si）电子自旋量子比特面临的关键挑战，并直接限制量子比特保真度、器件一致性以及基于硅的量子处理器的可扩展性。在硅锗（SiGe）异质结构中，可以通过设计外延层堆栈来解决这一问题。人们已经提出了若干启发式策略，以增强应变Si/SiGe量子阱（QW）中两个近简并谷态之间的能隙，例如形成尖锐的Si/SiGe界面、引入Ge尖峰，或在量子阱内采用振荡的Ge浓度。本文发展了一种系统的变分优化方法，用于计算能够增强谷间耦合矩阵元特定性质的最优Ge浓度剖面。我们的自由形状优化框架加入了现实的技术约束，以确保所得外延剖面具有可实现性；该框架基于考虑应变和成分合金无序的有效质量包络函数理论。此前提出的异质结构设计都可以作为这一受约束优化问题的特殊情形得到。我们的主要结果是一种新颖的异质结构设计，称为“调制波纹量子阱”，它既能确定性地大幅增强谷劈裂，又能强烈抑制无序引起的变异性。此外，该设计能够实现谷劈裂的宽范围电调控，即从约200 μeV调节至超过1 meV，为设计稳健且可切换的硅量子比特提供了新的机会。

articles.title: Multiple superconducting phases and order-parameter evolution in pressurized UTe₂
articles.title_zh: 加压UTe₂中的多重超导相与序参量演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.01843v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The recently discovered heavy-fermion spin-triplet superconductor candidate UTe₂ provides a rich platform for unconventional pairing and topological phenomena. However, limited has been known about its superconducting order parameters and their evolution with control parameters, largely due to the lack of appropriate symmetry-sensitive detections. Here, we report comprehensive point-contact spectroscopy measurements of pressurized UTe₂ on the (0~0~1) surface. The observation of Andreev bound states strongly suggests the presence of a p_z component in the superconducting order parameters. Quantitative analysis based on an extended Blonder-Tinkham-Klapwijk model unveils the superconducting order parameters with a finite odd-k_z component (e.g. B₂ᵤ or B₃ᵤ) for both ambient and pressurized UTe₂. Remarkably, the multiple superconducting phases can be distinguished by a single parameter łangle Δzångle/łangleΔₓ₍y₎ångle, the relative weight between the p_z-wave and pₓ₍y₎-wave pairings. These findings place stringent constraints on the pairing symmetry and provide essential spectroscopic signatures for distinguishing pressure-induced multiple superconducting phases in UTe₂.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过在（001）表面开展加压UTe₂点接触谱测量，研究其超导序参量及其随压力的变化。安德烈夫束缚态表明超导序参量中存在p_z分量，扩展Blonder–Tinkham–Klapwijk模型分析则支持环境压力和加压条件下均存在有限的奇数k_z分量。不同超导相可由p_z波与pₓ(y)波配对的相对权重区分，从而为确定配对对称性和识别压力诱导的多重超导相提供了谱学约束。
authors: Shuo Zou, Fengrui Shi, Zhuolun Qiu, Jia-Long Zhang, Yan Zhang, Weilong Qiu, Zhuo Wang, Hai Zeng, Yinina Ma, Zheyu Wu, Andrej Cabala, Michal Valiska, Ning Li, Zihan Yang, Kaixin Ye, Jiawen Zhang, Yanan Zhang, Kangjian Luo, Binbin Zhang, Alexander G. Eaton, Chaofan Zhang, Gang Li, Jianlin Luo, Wen Huang, Huiqiu Yuan, Xin Lu, Yongkang Luo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期发现的重费米子自旋三重态超导体候选材料UTe₂，为研究非常规配对和拓扑现象提供了丰富平台。然而，由于缺乏合适的对称性敏感探测手段，人们对其超导序参量及其随调控参数的演化知之甚少。在本研究中，我们报告了在加压UTe₂的（0 0 1）表面进行的综合点接触谱测量。对安德烈夫束缚态的观测强烈表明，超导序参量中存在p_z分量。基于扩展Blonder–Tinkham–Klapwijk模型的定量分析揭示，在环境压力和加压UTe₂中，超导序参量均具有有限的奇数k_z分量，例如B₂ᵤ或B₃ᵤ。值得注意的是，多重超导相可以通过单一参数〈Δ_z〉/〈Δₓ(y)〉加以区分，该参数表示p_z波与pₓ(y)波配对之间的相对权重。这些发现对配对对称性施加了严格约束，并为区分UTe₂中由压力诱导的多重超导相提供了重要的谱学特征。

articles.title: Random matrix theory universality of current operators in spin-S Heisenberg chains
articles.title_zh: 自旋S海森堡链中电流算子的随机矩阵理论普适性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.10211v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum chaotic systems exhibit certain universal statistical properties that closely resemble predictions from random matrix theory (RMT). With respect to observables, it has recently been conjectured that, when truncated to a sufficiently narrow energy window, their statistical properties can be described by an unitarily invariant ensemble, and testable criteria have been introduced, which are based on the scaling behavior of free cumulants. In this paper, we investigate the conjecture numerically in translationally invariant Heisenberg spin chains with spin quantum number S =frac12,1,frac32. Combining a quantum-typicality-based numerical method with the exploitation of the system's symmetries, we study the spin current operator and find clear evidence of consistency with the proposed criteria in chaotic cases. Our findings further support the conjecture of the existence of RMT universality as manifest in the observable properties in quantum chaotic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子混沌系统具有与随机矩阵理论预测相近的普适统计性质，近期研究猜想，限制在足够窄能量窗口内的可观测量也可由酉不变系综描述。本文在自旋量子数S = 1/2、1和3/2的平移不变海森堡自旋链中，对这一猜想进行了数值检验。基于量子典型性的方法结合系统对称性分析表明，在混沌情形下，自旋电流算子的统计性质符合所提出的自由累积量标度判据。
authors: Mariel Kempa, Markus Kraft, Robin Steinigeweg, Jochen Gemmer, Jiaozi Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子混沌系统表现出某些普适统计性质，这些性质与随机矩阵理论（RMT）的预测高度相似。对于可观测量，近期有人提出猜想：当可观测量被截断在足够窄的能量窗口内时，其统计性质可以由一个酉不变系综描述；同时，人们还提出了可检验的判据，这些判据基于自由累积量的标度行为。在本文中，我们在自旋量子数S = 1/2、1和3/2的平移不变海森堡自旋链中，对这一猜想进行了数值研究。我们结合基于量子典型性的数值方法与对系统对称性的利用，研究了自旋电流算子，并在混沌情形下发现了与所提出判据相一致的明确证据。我们的发现进一步支持了这样一种猜想：在量子混沌系统中，随机矩阵理论的普适性能够以可观测量的性质为表现形式而存在。

articles.title: Quantum Technologies: System-Level Performance and Validation Priorities
articles.title_zh: 量子技术：系统级性能与验证优先事项
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21436v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Performance claims in quantum technology are not properties of hardware alone. They are properties of a declared task, system boundary, normalization denominator, uncertainty or security convention, and comparator. We perform a cross-domain analysis spanning quantum computing, simulation, communication, sensing, clocks, randomness generation, and their enabling technologies. The analysis changes substantive conclusions in several representative cases. For the longest direct finite-key quantum key distribution case analyzed here, the same final key gives rates differing by a factor of 1.91 when normalized by complete acquisition rather than transmission-active time. In Advanced LIGO, 6.1,dB peak quantum-noise reduction coexists with a 0.534 coincident analysis-ready fraction, separating detector-level gain from delivered observing service. In quantum computation and photonic sampling, matching the observable, error tolerance, loss model, sample count, amortization, and classical hardware moves or reverses published crossover claims. Across domains, the recurring limits are correlated error, multiplicative interface loss, thermal and nonequilibrium occupation, calibration covariance, measurement efficiency, fabrication yield, and control latency. A quantum advantage is therefore established only for a fixed task and boundary when the accepted output outperforms the best documented alternative at matched accuracy, elapsed time, availability, and lifecycle cost. The resulting framework identifies the measurements required to convert component records into reproducible system capability. Credible progress is defined by reproduced logical workloads, prospectively validated simulations, repeater links outperforming direct transmission, long-duration calibrated sensors and clocks, integrated hardware with predictable yield and reliability.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，量子技术的性能声明并非仅由硬件决定，而取决于任务定义、系统边界、归一化分母、不确定性或安全约定以及比较对象。作者跨量子计算、模拟、通信、传感、时钟和随机数生成等领域进行分析，强调相关误差、接口损耗、热与非平衡占据、校准协方差、测量效率、制造良率和控制延迟是反复出现的系统瓶颈。只有在任务和边界固定，并以匹配的精度、耗时、可用性和全生命周期成本超过有据可查的最佳替代方案时，才能确立量子优势。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子技术中的性能声明并不是硬件本身的属性，而是所声明任务、系统边界、归一化分母、不确定性或安全约定以及比较对象的属性。我们开展了一项跨领域分析，涵盖量子计算、量子模拟、量子通信、量子传感、时钟、随机数生成及其支撑技术。在若干具有代表性的案例中，这种分析改变了实质性结论。在本文分析的最长直接有限密钥量子密钥分发案例中，相同的最终密钥在以完整采集时间而非传输活跃时间进行归一化时，所得速率相差1.91倍。在Advanced LIGO中，6.1 dB的峰值量子噪声抑制与0.534的符合事件分析就绪比例并存，这将探测器层面的增益与实际交付的观测服务区分开来。在量子计算和光子采样中，使观测量、误差容限、损耗模型、样本数量、摊销方式以及经典硬件保持一致，会改变甚至逆转已发表的交叉比较结论。在不同领域中反复出现的限制因素包括相关误差、乘法式接口损耗、热占据与非平衡占据、校准协方差、测量效率、制造良率和控制延迟。因此，只有针对固定的任务和系统边界，当所接受的输出在精度、耗时、可用性和全生命周期成本均经过匹配的条件下优于有据可查的最佳替代方案时，才能确立量子优势。由此形成的框架确定了将部件级记录转化为可复现系统能力所需的测量项目。可信的进展应由以下成果定义：可复现的逻辑工作负载、经过前瞻性验证的模拟、性能超过直接传输的中继链路、经过长期校准的传感器和时钟，以及具有可预测良率和可靠性的集成硬件。

articles.title: Dynamically twistable three-dimensional moiré photonic crystals
articles.title_zh: 可动态扭转的三维莫尔光子晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22052v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Three-dimensional woodpile photonic crystals constitute one of the most successful architectures for realizing photonic band gaps, yet their optical response is traditionally fixed by the geometry established during fabrication. Here, we introduce a twist-controlled woodpile photonic crystal in which the relative angular orientation between successive rod layers acts as an additional, in situ-tunable geometrical degree of freedom. Using an extension of rigorous coupled-wave analysis adapted to multilayer structures with rotated reciprocal lattices, we systematically investigate the evolution of the transmission spectrum as a function of twist angle. We show that twisting drives the structure through three distinct photonic regimes. In the fully aligned configuration, broad frequency intervals exhibit near-unity transmission. At intermediate twist angles, the spectrum becomes populated by strongly dispersive resonances displaying characteristic Fano line shapes, high quality-factor and pronounced angular sensitivity. As the twist angle approaches 90deg, the conventional woodpile structure is recovered, and these resonances evolve into a broad photonic stop band characteristic of three-dimensional photonic crystals. A simplified analytical model based on reciprocal-lattice considerations accurately reproduces the principal resonance modification observed in the numerical calculations. Our results demonstrate a continuous twist-induced transition from broadband transmission to photonic stop bands through an intermediate Fano-resonant regime, establishing twisted woodpiles as a versatile platform for three-dimensional twist-engineered photonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种由扭转控制的木堆光子晶体，将相邻杆层之间的相对角度作为可原位调节的几何自由度。数值研究表明，随扭转角变化，结构经历宽带透射、Fano共振和光子禁带三种光学状态。扭转可连续地将系统从宽带透射转变为光子禁带，并经过具有高品质因数和显著角度敏感性的中间Fano共振区。
authors: Henri Lemineur, Abhishek Padhy, Nicolas Roy, Benoit Hackens, Michaël Lobet
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三维木堆光子晶体是实现光子带隙最成功的架构之一，但其光学响应传统上由制造过程中确定的几何结构固定。本文提出一种扭转控制的木堆光子晶体，其中相邻杆层之间的相对角度取向充当额外的、可原位调节的几何自由度。我们采用一种扩展的严格耦合波分析方法，并将其适用于具有旋转倒易晶格的多层结构，系统研究了透射光谱随扭转角的演化。我们表明，扭转会驱动该结构经历三种不同的光子状态。在完全对齐的构型中，宽广的频率区间表现出接近1的透射率。在中等扭转角下，光谱中充满强色散共振，并呈现特征性的Fano线形、高品质因数和显著的角度敏感性。当扭转角接近90°时，传统木堆结构得到恢复，这些共振也演化为三维光子晶体所特有的宽光子禁带。基于倒易晶格考虑建立的简化解析模型，能够准确再现数值计算中观察到的主要共振变化。我们的结果表明，扭转能够诱导结构从宽带透射经由中间Fano共振状态连续转变为光子禁带，从而确立了扭转木堆结构作为三维扭转工程光子学的多功能平台。

articles.title: Real-Time Density--Source Mapping for Open Electron--Photon Systems
articles.title_zh: 开放电子—光子系统的实时密度—源映射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22995v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-time quantum-electrodynamical density-functional theory (QEDFT) for an open device requires local electron and field histories to determine their sources. For occupation-dependent interactions and a gapped finite-band photon continuum, we prove a causal one-to-one map on the forward image over a nonzero time interval. Three source-reconstruction benchmarks test the electronic limit, the photon-continuum limit, and a coupled joint inverse against a closed-form continuum endpoint. This provides the density--source foundation for real-time open-system QEDFT.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究开放器件实时量子电动力学密度泛函理论中的电子密度、光场历史与源之间的关系。对于占据数依赖相互作用和具有带隙的有限带宽光子连续谱，作者证明了在非零时间区间正向像上的因果一一映射。针对电子极限、光子连续谱极限和耦合联合逆问题的三个源重构基准，为实时开放系统QEDFT提供了密度—源基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开放器件的实时量子电动力学密度泛函理论（QEDFT）需要局域电子历史和局域场历史来确定其源。对于占据数依赖的相互作用以及具有带隙的有限带宽光子连续谱，我们证明了在一个非零时间区间的正向像上存在因果的一一映射。三个源重构基准分别检验了电子极限、光子连续谱极限以及耦合联合逆问题，并将结果与一个闭式连续谱端点进行了比较。这为实时开放系统QEDFT建立了密度—源基础。

articles.title: Reinventing the Single-pixel Imaging Paradigm via Quantum-Operator-Based Signal Processing
articles.title_zh: 借助基于量子算子的信号处理重新构想单像素成像范式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21783v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A fundamental bottleneck across modern computational imaging and high-dimensional sensing is the conventional decoupled acquisition-reconstruction hierarchy, which subjects high-dimensional spatial sensing to the classical shot-noise limit and intense computational overhead. As a prominent manifestation of this limitation, single-pixel imaging (SPI) suffers severely from this paradigm. We reinvent this paradigm by introducing a quantum-operator-based SPI theoretical framework driven by coherent signal processing. Within this architecture, the spatial inverse problem is analytically mapped into the eigenvalue spectrum of a quantum operator via tailored light-matter interactions. By analytically synthesizing non-linear reconstruction operators via ultra-shallow quantum architectures, we theoretically demonstrate an exponential decay of spatial approximation errors, completely bypassing traditional linear solvers. This operator-space embedding not only shields reconstruction from noise via a strategic error-saturation zone but also bridges the gap from classical shot-noise scaling O(1/sqrtNₚₕ) to the ultimate Heisenberg limit O(1/Nₚₕ). Crucially, while formulated within SPI, this coherent operator paradigm fundamentally extends to general photon-starved, high-dimensional imaging modalities. This work establishes a universal theoretical blueprint for next-generation quantum-enhanced sensing, shifting the paradigm from iterative optimization to coherent operator-space evolution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于量子算子的单像素成像理论框架，通过相干信号处理将空间逆问题解析映射到量子算子的本征值谱中。作者理论上表明，利用超浅层量子架构合成非线性重构算子，可以使空间逼近误差呈指数衰减，并将噪声抑制与从经典散粒噪声标度向海森堡极限的推进结合起来。该方法还被认为可推广到一般的光子匮乏型高维成像任务，将重构范式从迭代优化转向相干算子空间演化。
authors: Bu-Ran Yu, Yi-Zhu Zhang, Kan-Xu Jia, Qian-Qian Bao, Shao-Ying Meng, Xi-Hao Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代计算成像和高维传感共同面临的一个基本瓶颈，是传统的采集—重构相互分离的层级结构；这种结构使高维空间传感受到经典散粒噪声极限的限制，并带来巨大的计算开销。单像素成像（SPI）正是这一局限的突出体现，因而受到严重影响。本文通过引入由相干信号处理驱动的基于量子算子的SPI理论框架，重新构想了这一范式。在该架构中，空间逆问题通过定制的光—物质相互作用被解析地映射到量子算子的本征值谱中。通过超浅层量子架构解析合成非线性重构算子，我们在理论上证明了空间逼近误差呈指数衰减，从而完全绕过传统的线性求解器。这种算子空间嵌入还通过策略性误差饱和区保护重构过程免受噪声影响，并将经典散粒噪声标度O(1/√Nₚₕ₎推进至终极海森堡极限O(1/Nₚₕ₎。重要的是，尽管该方法是在SPI框架内提出的，这种相干算子范式从根本上可以扩展到一般的光子匮乏型高维成像模态。本文建立了下一代量子增强传感的通用理论蓝图，将范式从迭代优化转向相干算子空间演化。

articles.title: Does Probability Require a Single History?
articles.title_zh: 概率是否需要单一历史？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.22733v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Everettian quantum mechanics is often said to lack coherent probability because every possible measurement result occurs. If all of them exist globally, what is probability supposed to be a probability of? This paper defends an axiomatic answer: normalized Born measure is postulated as objective probability over the records borne by an observer's future continuations. A collapse law assigns the same probabilities to possible global outcomes. Neither theory derives the probabilities from its ontology. I relate this minimal proposal to earlier axiomatic accounts, separate it from their accompanying theories of personal persistence, and defend it against recent arguments that the axiomatic route cannot succeed. At the level of recorded results, the Everettian law supports the same predictions and empirical inferences as the collapse law, despite the theories' different ontologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为埃弗雷特量子力学中的概率问题提出一种公理化回答：将归一化的玻恩测度假定为观察者未来延续体所记录结果的客观概率。作者指出，埃弗雷特理论与坍缩理论都不会从自身本体论中推导出概率，但在记录结果层面，二者支持相同的预测与经验推断。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们常说，埃弗雷特量子力学缺乏连贯的概率概念，因为每一种可能的测量结果都会发生。如果所有这些结果在整体上都存在，那么概率究竟应当是什么的概率？本文为此辩护一种公理化回答：将归一化的玻恩测度公设为观察者未来延续体所承载记录的客观概率。坍缩定律则为可能的全局结果赋予相同的概率。两种理论都没有从其本体论中推导出这些概率。我将这一最小方案与早期的公理化解释联系起来，将其与那些解释所伴随的个人持续性理论区分开来，并针对近期关于公理化路径不可能成功的论证进行辩护。在所记录的结果层面，尽管埃弗雷特理论与坍缩理论具有不同的本体论，埃弗雷特定律仍然支持与坍缩定律相同的预测和经验推断。

articles.title: Quantum observables as Fréchet sensitivity kernels
articles.title_zh: 作为弗雷歇敏感性核的量子可观测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23191v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a variational--adjoint interpretation of quantum mechanics in which the interaction between forward and adjoint wavefunctions defines a general sensitivity kernel of the system. This Fréchet interaction density quantifies how perturbations in the wavefunction (or system parameters) influence a chosen observable. The familiar Born probability density appears as a special case when the adjoint wavefunction is chosen as the complex conjugate of the forward wavefunction, for which the interaction density becomes real and non-negative. Within this framework, probability is a particular positive-definite form of sensitivity described by the Fréchet interaction density. In general, the variational--adjoint interpretation also produces Fréchet sensitivity kernels associated with other quantum observables, including momentum, energy, and spin. This suggests that the Born probability density belongs to a broader class of Fréchet sensitivity kernels associated with quantum observables. The proposed interpretation also provides a connection with time-symmetric interpretations of quantum mechanics and possible future applications in quantum control and quantum metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种量子力学的变分—伴随解释，其中正向波函数与伴随波函数的相互作用定义了系统的一般敏感性核。该弗雷歇相互作用密度描述波函数或系统参数的扰动如何影响给定可观测量，熟悉的玻恩概率密度是其一个特殊情形。该框架还可为动量、能量和自旋等其他量子可观测量产生敏感性核，并与时间对称解释、量子控制和量子计量学相联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种量子力学的变分—伴随解释，其中正向波函数与伴随波函数之间的相互作用定义了系统的一般敏感性核。这种弗雷歇相互作用密度量化了波函数或系统参数的扰动如何影响所选定的可观测量。当伴随波函数被选为正向波函数的复共轭时，熟悉的玻恩概率密度便作为一个特殊情形出现；在此情况下，相互作用密度为实数且非负。在这一框架内，概率是由弗雷歇相互作用密度描述的一种特殊的正定敏感性。一般而言，变分—伴随解释还会产生与其他量子可观测量相关的弗雷歇敏感性核，包括动量、能量和自旋。这表明，玻恩概率密度属于与量子可观测量相关的更广泛弗雷歇敏感性核类别。所提出的解释还建立了与量子力学时间对称解释之间的联系，并可能在量子控制和量子计量学中得到应用。

articles.title: Breakout/Interchange Reconnection as a driver of Jets, Fast CME, and Solar Energetic Particles
articles.title_zh: 作为喷流、快速日冕物质抛射和太阳高能粒子驱动机制的突破/交换重联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23362v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding how energetic particles are accelerated and released from the low corona into the interplanetary medium during solar eruptions is crucial for space weather research. Here, we present multiwavelength observations of a solar eruption that are consistent with breakout reconnection playing an important role in driving a fast coronal mass ejection (CME) and the associated solar energetic particle (SEP) event. Extreme-ultraviolet and radio observations reveal evidence of breakout reconnection within a fan-spine topology. The filament eruption begins after the pre-eruption opening, accompanied by quasiperiodic jets and associated downflows near the null point, as well as recurrent faint Type III radio bursts during the ongoing slow breakout reconnection. Furthermore, the observations also reveal the formation of pre-eruption coronal rain via slow interchange reconnection near the null point. A large-scale circular ribbon, along with simultaneous four hard X-ray footpoint sources and intense Type III radio bursts, was observed during the explosive breakout reconnection that enabled opening of field lines and allowed energetic particles to escape into interplanetary space. In situ measurements by PSP and Wind confirm the prompt injection of electron beams consistent with the timing of the explosive breakout reconnection. A fast shock associated with the erupting flux rope during interchange reconnection played a major role in producing the gradual SEP event. These observations highlight the key role of breakout reconnection in producing a fast CME/shock with the SEP release and acceleration process. These results have broader implications for particle acceleration and release processes in multiscale null-point topologies, which produce a continuum of eruptions ranging from small-scale jets to large-scale CMEs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过多波段观测研究太阳爆发期间低日冕高能粒子的加速与释放过程，结果表明突破重联在驱动快速日冕物质抛射及相关太阳高能粒子事件中发挥重要作用。观测揭示了扇形—脊形拓扑中的突破重联、准周期喷流、日冕雨以及爆发性重联期间粒子沿开放磁力线逃逸的证据。PSP和Wind的原位测量证实了与爆发性突破重联时序一致的电子束注入，而互换重联期间形成的快速激波则在渐进型太阳高能粒子事件中发挥了重要作用。
authors: Pankaj Kumar, Judith T. Karpen, David Lario, Benjamin J. Lynch, Peter F. Wyper, Spiro K. Antiochos, P. K. Manoharan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 了解太阳爆发期间高能粒子如何在低日冕中被加速并释放到行星际介质，对于空间天气研究至关重要。在此，我们展示了一次太阳爆发的多波段观测结果，这些结果与以下情形相一致：突破重联在驱动快速日冕物质抛射（CME）及相关太阳高能粒子（SEP）事件中发挥了重要作用。极紫外和射电观测揭示了扇形—脊形拓扑内部存在突破重联的证据。爆发前的开放过程开始之后，丝状体爆发随即发生；与此同时，在零点附近出现了准周期喷流及相关下流，并且在缓慢突破重联持续期间反复出现微弱的III型射电暴。此外，观测还揭示出，在零点附近通过缓慢的互换重联形成了爆发前的日冕雨。在爆发性突破重联期间，观测到大尺度环形耀斑带、同时出现的四个硬X射线足点源以及强烈的III型射电暴；这一过程促成磁力线开放，使高能粒子能够逃逸到行星际空间。PSP和Wind的原位测量证实，电子束被及时注入，其时序与爆发性突破重联相一致。在互换重联期间，伴随爆发磁通绳形成的快速激波，在产生渐进型SEP事件方面发挥了重要作用。这些观测突出表明，突破重联在快速CME/激波的产生以及SEP释放和加速过程中具有关键作用。这些结果对于多尺度零点拓扑中的粒子加速与释放过程具有更广泛的意义；这类拓扑能够产生从小尺度喷流到大尺度CME的连续爆发谱。

articles.title: Dual-Isotope Sympathetic Cooling in a Long Ion Chain
articles.title_zh: 长离子链中的双同位素共生冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.23386v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Owing to their high controllability and connectivity, one-dimensional ion chains are attractive building blocks for near-term quantum computers. However, long ion chains are susceptible to motional heating caused by fluctuating external electric fields. To enable deep computations, this source of noise must be suppressed without inducing qubit decoherence or degrading qubit connectivity. We demonstrate steady-state mid-circuit sympathetic cooling of all computationally-relevant motional modes of a 23-ion chain consisting of qubit qubit and o̧olant coolant ions without using any qubit operations. In a room-temperature system, our cooling scheme preserves the mean phonon occupations of the long-wavelength axial and radial modes near their values following state preparation, while keeping the modes used to implement entangling gates near their ground states throughout a 56-ms circuit. Crucially, we show that our cooling sequence preserves qubit coherence, and evaluate its impact on single- and two-qubit gate operations. Additionally, we demonstrate a parallel qubit reset protocol leveraging the shared radial mode coupling between species. Our sympathetic cooling scheme represents a critical step toward reducing gate errors in individually-addressed long ion chains and establishes a versatile platform for simulating open quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在由量子比特离子和冷却离子组成的23离子链中，实现了无需量子比特操作的稳态中途共生冷却，并覆盖所有与计算相关的运动模式。该方案在室温系统中将长波长轴向和径向模式的平均声子占据数保持在制备后的附近，同时使纠缠门所用模式在56毫秒电路期间保持接近基态。实验还表明，冷却序列能够保持量子比特相干性，并支持利用不同离子种类之间共享的径向模式耦合实现并行量子比特复位。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于具有高度的可控性和连接性，一维离子链是近期量子计算机具有吸引力的构建模块。然而，长离子链容易受到波动外部电场引起的运动加热影响。为了实现深度计算，必须抑制这一噪声源，同时不引发量子比特退相干或降低量子比特连接性。我们在一个由23个离子组成的离子链中实现了稳态中途共生冷却，该离子链包含量子比特离子和冷却离子，并且无需使用任何量子比特操作即可冷却所有与计算相关的运动模式。在室温系统中，我们的冷却方案使长波长轴向和径向模式的平均声子占据数保持在其状态制备后的数值附近，同时使实现纠缠门所使用的模式在整个56毫秒电路期间保持接近基态。关键的是，我们证明了冷却序列能够保持量子比特相干性，并评估了其对单量子比特门和双量子比特门操作的影响。此外，我们还展示了一种并行量子比特复位协议，该协议利用了不同离子种类之间共享的径向模式耦合。我们的共生冷却方案是降低单独寻址长离子链中门操作误差的关键一步，也为模拟开放量子系统建立了一个多用途平台。

articles.title: Algorithmic Idealism I: Reconceptualizing Reality Through Information and Experience
articles.title_zh: 算法唯心主义 I：通过信息与经验重新概念化现实
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.20485v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Algorithmic idealism represents a transformative approach to understanding reality, emphasizing the informational structure of self-states and their algorithmic transitions over traditional notions of an external, objective universe. Rooted in algorithmic information theory, it redefines reality as a sequence of self-state transitions governed by principles such as Solomonoff induction. This framework offers a unified solution to longstanding challenges in quantum mechanics, cosmology, and metaphysics, addressing issues like the measurement problem, the Boltzmann brain paradox, and the simulation hypothesis. Algorithmic idealism shifts the focus from describing an independent external world to understanding first-person experiences, providing epistemic interpretations of physical theories and dissolving metaphysical divides between "real" and simulated realities. Beyond resolving these conceptual challenges, it raises profound ethical questions regarding the continuity, duplication, and termination of informational entities, reshaping discussions on identity, consciousness, and existence in the digital and quantum age. By offering a mathematically rigorous yet philosophically innovative framework, algorithmic idealism invites a rethinking of reality as an emergent property of informational dynamics rather than a static external construct.
articles.abstract_zh: 算法唯心主义强调自我状态的信息结构及其算法转换，试图取代传统的外部客观宇宙观。该框架借助算法信息论和索洛莫诺夫归纳，将现实重新定义为由特定原则支配的一系列自我状态转换，并为量子力学、宇宙学和形而上学中的若干问题提供统一处理方式。它将重点从描述独立外部世界转向理解第一人称经验，同时引发关于信息实体的连续性、复制与终止，以及身份、意识和存在的伦理问题。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 算法唯心主义代表了一种理解现实的变革性路径，它强调自我状态的信息结构及其算法转换，而不是传统意义上的外部客观宇宙。该理论植根于算法信息论，通过索洛莫诺夫归纳等原则支配的自我状态转换序列来重新定义现实。这一框架为量子力学、宇宙学和形而上学中长期存在的挑战提供了统一解决方案，涉及测量问题、玻尔兹曼大脑悖论和模拟假说等问题。算法唯心主义将重点从描述一个独立存在的外部世界转向理解第一人称经验，为物理理论提供认识论解释，并消解“真实”与模拟现实之间的形而上学鸿沟。除了处理这些概念性挑战之外，它还针对信息实体的连续性、复制和终止提出了深刻的伦理问题，从而重塑了数字与量子时代关于身份、意识和存在的讨论。通过提供一个兼具数学严谨性与哲学创新性的框架，算法唯心主义促使人们重新思考现实：现实不是静态的外部构造，而是信息动力学的涌现属性。

articles.title: Statistical Gravity and entropy of spacetime
articles.title_zh: 统计引力与时空熵
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.06441v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We discuss the foundations of the statistical gravity theory we proposed in a recent publication [Riccardo Fantoni, Quantum Reports, 6, 706 (2024)].
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论作者近期提出的统计引力理论的基础，以及该理论对时空熵的理解。摘要未提供该理论的具体模型、推导或结论，详细内容需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文讨论我们在近期发表的论文中提出的统计引力理论的基础，以及时空的熵。

articles.title: Topological Regularization
articles.title_zh: 拓扑正则化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.00885v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This work introduces topological regularization as a framework for handling ultraviolet divergences in quantum field theory, reinterpreting infinities as topological obstructions at spacetime boundaries. Through geometric compactification via stereographic projection, singularities are reframed as boundary artifacts. The framework employs causal embeddings and the causality group to preserve Lorentz invariance and unitarity, while homotopy-equivalent defect structures guarantee regularization independence via Stokes-Poincaré duality. The Physical Equivalence Theorem shows that homotopy-equivalent schemes yield identical renormalized observables. Renormalization group flows are governed by Euler characteristics, and anomalies are resolved through cobordism and Chern character integrals. This approach unifies UV/IR duality, anomaly cancellation, and Osterwalder-Schrader reconstruction. Applications extend to AdS/CFT, PDEs, quantum simulators, and noncommutative geometry. Topological regularization replaces artificial cutoffs with intrinsic geometric mechanisms, positioning spacetime as a defect-entangled structure governed by topological invariants, with testable predictions in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种处理量子场论紫外发散的拓扑正则化框架，将无穷大重新解释为时空边界处的拓扑障碍，并通过几何紧化把奇点视为边界伪影。该框架利用因果嵌入和因果群保持洛伦兹不变性与幺正性，并通过同伦等价缺陷结构和斯托克斯—庞加莱对偶性保证正则化独立性。作者还提出物理等价定理，试图统一紫外/红外对偶、反常抵消和奥斯特瓦尔德—施拉德重构，并讨论其在多个领域的应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本工作提出拓扑正则化，将其作为处理量子场论中紫外发散的框架，并将无穷大重新解释为时空边界处的拓扑障碍。通过借助立体投影进行几何紧化，奇点被重新表述为边界伪影。该框架采用因果嵌入和因果群来保持洛伦兹不变性与幺正性，同时通过同伦等价的缺陷结构，利用斯托克斯—庞加莱对偶性保证正则化的独立性。物理等价定理表明，同伦等价的方案会产生相同的重整化可观测量。重整化群流由欧拉示性数支配，而反常则通过配边和陈特征类积分得到解决。这一方法统一了紫外/红外对偶、反常抵消和奥斯特瓦尔德—施拉德重构。其应用范围扩展到反德西特空间/共形场论（AdS/CFT）、偏微分方程、量子模拟器和非交换几何。拓扑正则化以固有的几何机制取代人为截断，将时空定位为由缺陷纠缠而成、受拓扑不变量支配的结构，并在量子材料中提出可检验的预测。

articles.title: Multi-Partitioned Computing Quantum-Particle Approach: A Hybrid Quantum Framework for Fluid Flow
articles.title_zh: 多分区计算量子粒子方法：一种流体流动混合量子框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.11276v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This study established a quantum-classical hybrid framework that integrates quantum computing paradigm with meshfree finite particle method. By harnessing quantum superposition and entanglement, it hybridized the critical computational kernels (termed as quantum finite particle method). A resource-efficient quantum computational strategy on multi-partitioned zones was proposed, which leverages a fixed small-scale quantum circuit as a fundamental processing unit to handle inner product for arbitrarily sized arrays. This approach employs iterative nesting of the quantum-core operation to accommodate varying input dimensions while maintaining hardware feasibility throughout. Motivated with developed quantum framework, the novel numerical discretization for hybrid quantum computational particle dynamics can be derived commonly and applied in fluid flows. Through a sequence of numerical experiments purposefully, the proposed numerical model was thoroughly validated and analyzed. Results demonstrate that integrating quantum computing to hybridize conventional linear combinations of particle dynamics serves as a novel computing paradigm. By further extending into the numerical investigation of viscoelastic, highly elastic, and purely elastic fluids under high Weissenberg number conditions, the applicability of simulation framework is broadened. Despite bottlenecks in quantum hardware and computational efficiency on this process, these advances offer critical insights for transitioning quantum-enhanced fluid simulation to practical engineering applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个融合量子计算范式与无网格有限粒子方法的量子—经典混合框架，并将关键计算内核量子化为量子有限粒子方法。作者提出在多分区区域中使用固定的小规模量子电路作为处理单元，通过迭代嵌套处理任意规模数组的内积，同时保持硬件可行性。基于该框架，研究构造了适用于流体流动的混合量子计算粒子动力学离散方法，并通过数值实验验证其有效性，进一步考察了高魏森贝格数条件下黏弹性、高弹性和纯弹性流体的模拟。
authors: Yudong Li, Wenkui Shi, Zhihao Qian, Yan Li, Chunfa Wang, Ling Tao, Zhuojia Fu, Moubin Liu, Zhiqiang Feng
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究建立了一个量子—经典混合框架，将量子计算范式与无网格有限粒子方法相结合。通过利用量子叠加和量子纠缠，研究将关键计算内核（称为量子有限粒子方法）进行了量子化。作者提出了一种面向多分区区域、资源高效的量子计算策略，该策略以固定的小规模量子电路作为基本处理单元，用于处理任意规模数组的内积。该方法采用量子核心操作的迭代嵌套，以适应不同的输入维度，同时在整个过程中保持硬件可行性。受所建立量子框架的启发，研究进一步推导出一种新的混合量子计算粒子动力学数值离散方法，并将其应用于流体流动。通过有针对性地开展一系列数值实验，对所提出的数值模型进行了全面验证和分析。结果表明，将量子计算引入传统粒子动力学中的线性组合混合起来，构成了一种新的计算范式。通过进一步扩展到高魏森贝格数条件下黏弹性、高弹性和纯弹性流体的数值研究，该模拟框架的适用性得到拓展。尽管这一过程仍面临量子硬件和计算效率方面的瓶颈，这些进展为量子增强流体模拟向实际工程应用过渡提供了重要见解。

articles.title: Influence of Fe Doping on the Structural, Electrical, and Room-Temperature Ethanol Sensing Properties of Sol–Gel Spin-Coated TiO₂ Thin Films
articles.title_zh: Fe掺杂对溶胶—凝胶旋涂TiO₂薄膜结构、电学性质及室温乙醇传感性能的影响
articles.abstract: Using the sol–gel spin-coating process, pure and Fe-doped TiO₂ thin films were effectively created on glass substrates to study the ethanol-sensing behavior at room temperature. This technique made it possible to create consistent, well-adhered films, which offered a good platform for researching how Fe³⁺ doping affected their structural, electrical, and sensing properties. It was discovered that adding Fe ions to the TiO₂ lattice greatly altered the microstructure and improved the films' charge transport characteristics. The introduction of defect states and a rise in the concentration of oxygen vacancies, which are essential for gas-sensing processes, are responsible for these advances. The TiO₂ thin film with 0.5% Fe showed the most promising sensing ability toward ethanol vapors at ambient temperature among the several doping doses investigated. The 0.5% Fe-doped TiO₂ film showed a high sensor response of 19.54 when exposed to 500 ppm of ethanol, which was much greater than that of the undoped and other doped samples. The optimal balance between surface active sites and electrical conductivity attained at this specific doping level is probably the cause of this improved response. Furthermore, during several testing cycles, no deterioration in the sensor response was noted, and the stability of the sensing features was assessed. This suggests that the Fe-doped TiO₂ thin films have dependable sensing capability and good durability. Overall, the study demonstrates that controlled Fe doping is a successful method for enhancing the ethanol-sensing capacity of TiO₂ thin films at ambient temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用溶胶—凝胶旋涂工艺在玻璃基底上制备纯TiO₂和Fe掺杂TiO₂薄膜，研究其室温乙醇传感行为。Fe³⁺掺杂显著改变了薄膜微结构，并通过引入缺陷态和增加氧空位浓度改善电荷输运与气体传感过程。在所研究的掺杂剂量中，0.5% Fe掺杂TiO₂薄膜对乙醇表现出最佳传感性能，在500 ppm乙醇下传感响应达到19.54，并在多次测试中保持稳定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 采用溶胶—凝胶旋涂工艺，在玻璃基底上有效制备了纯TiO₂和Fe掺杂TiO₂薄膜，以研究其室温下的乙醇传感行为。该技术能够制备均匀且附着良好的薄膜，为研究Fe³⁺掺杂如何影响薄膜的结构、电学和传感性质提供了良好平台。研究发现，将Fe离子加入TiO₂晶格会显著改变微结构，并改善薄膜的电荷输运特性。这些改善源于缺陷态的引入以及氧空位浓度的增加，而氧空位对于气体传感过程至关重要。在所考察的多种掺杂剂量中，含0.5% Fe的TiO₂薄膜对室温乙醇蒸气表现出最有希望的传感能力。暴露于500 ppm乙醇时，0.5% Fe掺杂TiO₂薄膜表现出19.54的高传感响应，显著高于未掺杂样品和其他掺杂样品。在这一特定掺杂水平下获得的表面活性位点与电导率之间的最佳平衡，可能是响应增强的原因。此外，在多次测试循环中未观察到传感响应衰减，并对传感特性的稳定性进行了评估。这表明Fe掺杂TiO₂薄膜具有可靠的传感能力和良好的耐久性。总体而言，该研究表明，受控的Fe掺杂是提高TiO₂薄膜室温乙醇传感能力的一种有效方法。

articles.title: “Who did you eat before I ate you?”: a metagenomic analysis of gut contents of the Arctic lamprey (Lethenteron camtschaticum) during its feeding phase (Gulf of Ob, Kara Sea)
articles.title_zh: “在我吃掉你之前，你吃了谁？”：以宏基因组学分析进食期北极七鳃鳗（Lethenteron camtschaticum）肠内容物（鄂毕湾，喀拉海）
articles.abstract: Shotgun metagenomic sequencing was applied to analyse gut contents of two Arctic lamprey (Lethenteron camtschaticum) specimens collected in the Gulf of Ob (Kara Sea, Russia) in August 2018. After stringent bioinformatic filtering to remove human, lamprey and bacterial DNA, we developed a combined ranking index that incorporates prior knowledge of the regional fish fauna to minimise classification artefacts. Fish DNA from the genus Coregonus dominated both samples, accounting for the majority of reliably identified sequences after normalisation, establishing whitefishes as the primary hosts in this Arctic estuary. Traces of ninespine stickleback (Pungitius pungitius), Arctic char (Salvelinus alpinus) and Gadidae were also detected. The presence of exotic taxa was attributed to incomplete reference databases, while stickleback DNA likely reached the lamprey gut via secondary consumption. Diet composition differed markedly from that reported in the Bering Sea (Shink et al., 2019), reflecting regional host availability. Despite the exploratory nature of this study, our findings demonstrate the utility of shotgun metagenomics for investigating lamprey feeding ecology, emphasise the critical need for curated, region-specific reference databases, and show that combining molecular data with regional faunal knowledge enables reliable interpretation of complex metagenomic datasets in data-limited systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用鸟枪法宏基因组测序分析了2018年8月在俄罗斯喀拉海鄂毕湾采集的两条北极七鳃鳗肠内容物。经严格过滤去除人类、七鳃鳗和细菌DNA后，结合区域鱼类群落先验知识建立综合排序指数，以减少分类伪影。标准化结果显示，Coregonus属鱼类DNA在两个样本中占主导，表明白鱼是该北极河口七鳃鳗的主要宿主；同时还检测到刺鱼、北极红点鲑和鳕科鱼类的痕量DNA。研究表明，区域宿主可获得性会造成饮食组成差异，而区域化、经过整理的参考数据库对于可靠解释复杂宏基因组数据至关重要。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究采用鸟枪法宏基因组测序，分析了2018年8月在俄罗斯喀拉海鄂毕湾采集的两条北极七鳃鳗（Lethenteron camtschaticum）标本的肠内容物。在严格进行生物信息学过滤、去除人类、七鳃鳗和细菌DNA之后，我们建立了一个结合区域鱼类群落先验知识的综合排序指数，以最大限度减少分类伪影。来自Coregonus属的鱼类DNA在两个样本中占主导地位；在标准化之后，这些DNA占据了可靠鉴定序列的绝大多数，从而确定白鱼是这一北极河口中的主要宿主。此外，还检测到了刺鱼（Pungitius pungitius）、北极红点鲑（Salvelinus alpinus）和鳕科鱼类的痕量DNA。外来分类群的出现被归因于参考数据库不完整，而刺鱼DNA很可能是通过二次摄食进入七鳃鳗肠道的。其食物组成与白令海中已有报道的结果（Shink等，2019）存在显著差异，这反映了区域宿主可获得性的影响。尽管本研究具有探索性，我们的研究结果证明了鸟枪法宏基因组学在研究七鳃鳗摄食生态学方面的实用性，强调了建立经过整理的区域特异性参考数据库的关键必要性，并表明在数据有限的系统中，将分子数据与区域动物群落知识相结合，能够实现对复杂宏基因组数据集的可靠解释。

articles.title: Active quantum flocks
articles.title_zh: 主动量子群体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2308.01603v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Flocks of animals represent a prominent archetype of collective behavior in the macroscopic classical world, where the constituents, such as birds, concertedly perform motions and actions as if being one single entity. Here, we address the so far open question of whether flocks can also form in the microscopic world at the quantum level. For that purpose, we introduce the concept of active quantum matter by formulating a class of models of active quantum particles on a one-dimensional lattice. We provide both analytical and large-scale numerical evidence that these systems can give rise to quantum flocks. A key finding is that these quantum flocks exhibit distinct quantum properties by developing strong quantum coherence over long distances. We propose that quantum flocks could be experimentally observed in Rydberg atom arrays.
articles.abstract_zh: 动物群体是宏观经典世界中集体行为的典型范例，其成员能够协同运动和行动，仿佛构成一个整体。本文通过在一维晶格上建立主动量子粒子模型，探讨微观量子层面是否也能形成类似群体。解析分析和大规模数值证据表明，这些系统能够产生量子群体，并在长距离上发展出强量子相干；作者提出可在里德伯原子阵列中实验观测这一现象。
authors: Reyhaneh Khasseh, Sascha Wald, Roderich Moessner, Christoph A. Weber, Markus Heyl
articles.abstract_zh_full: 动物群体是宏观经典世界中集体行为的突出范例，其中鸟类等组成个体能够协同地进行运动和行动，仿佛是一个单一实体。在此，我们研究了一个迄今尚未解决的问题：群体是否也能在微观世界的量子层面形成。为此，我们提出主动量子物质的概念，方法是在一维晶格上构建一类主动量子粒子模型。我们提供了解析证据和大规模数值证据，表明这些系统能够产生量子群体。一个关键发现是，这些量子群体会在很长距离上形成强量子相干，从而表现出独特的量子性质。我们提出，可以在里德伯原子阵列中实验观测量子群体。

articles.title: MADE: Benchmark Environments for Closed-Loop Materials Discovery
articles.title_zh: MADE：用于闭环材料发现的基准环境
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.20996v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Existing benchmarks for computational materials discovery primarily evaluate static predictive tasks or isolated computational sub-tasks. While valuable, these evaluations neglect the inherently iterative and adaptive nature of scientific discovery. We introduce MAterials Discovery Environments (MADE), a novel framework for benchmarking end-to-end autonomous materials discovery pipelines. MADE simulates closed-loop discovery campaigns in which an agent or algorithm proposes, evaluates, and refines candidate materials under a constrained oracle budget, capturing the sequential and resource-limited nature of real discovery workflows. We formalize discovery as a search for thermodynamically stable compounds relative to a given convex hull, and evaluate efficacy and efficiency via comparison to baseline algorithms. The framework is flexible; users can compose discovery agents from interchangeable components such as generative models, filters, and planners, enabling the study of arbitrary workflows ranging from fixed pipelines to fully agentic systems with tool use and adaptive decision making. We demonstrate this by conducting systematic experiments across a family of systems, enabling ablation of components in discovery pipelines, and comparison of how methods scale with system complexity.
articles.abstract_zh: 现有计算材料发现基准主要评估静态预测任务或彼此孤立的计算子任务，忽略了科学发现本质上具有迭代性和自适应性。本文提出材料发现环境（MADE），用于评估端到端自主材料发现流程；该框架在受限预言机预算下模拟智能体提出、评估和改进候选材料的闭环发现活动。作者将发现形式化为相对于给定凸包寻找热力学稳定化合物，并支持由生成模型、过滤器和规划器等可互换组件构成的多种工作流，进而比较基线算法、开展组件消融并研究方法随系统复杂度的扩展性。
authors: Shreshth A Malik, Tiarnan Doherty, Panagiotis Tigas, Muhammed Razzak, Stephen J. Roberts, Aron Walsh, Yarin Gal
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现有的计算材料发现基准主要评估静态预测任务或彼此孤立的计算子任务。尽管这些评估具有价值，但它们忽略了科学发现本质上具有迭代性和自适应性这一事实。我们提出材料发现环境（MAterials Discovery Environments，MADE），这是一个用于对端到端自主材料发现流程进行基准测试的新框架。MADE模拟闭环发现活动：在受限的预言机预算下，智能体或算法提出、评估并改进候选材料，从而刻画真实发现工作流所具有的序列性和资源受限特征。我们将发现形式化为相对于给定凸包寻找热力学稳定化合物的问题，并通过与基线算法进行比较来评估效果和效率。该框架具有灵活性；用户可以利用生成模型、过滤器和规划器等可互换组件来组合发现智能体，从而能够研究各种工作流，包括固定流程，以及具有工具使用和自适应决策能力的完全智能体化系统。我们通过在一系列系统中开展系统性实验展示了这一点，这些实验支持对发现流程中的组件进行消融，并比较不同方法如何随系统复杂度扩展。

articles.title: Phase control of magnon-phonon coupling via magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 通过磁场控制磁振子-声子耦合的相位
articles.abstract: Author(s): Yasuhiro Todaka, Motoki Asano, Isamu Yasuda, Masashi Kawaguchi, Daiki Hatanaka, and Masamitsu Hayashi Magnon-phonon coupling has attracted considerable interest because of its potential applications in hybrid quantum systems and magnonic devices. Here, the authors show that the coupling constant evolves from real to complex as the external magnetic field is reduced, thereby causing a pronounced minimum in phonon transmittance near zero field. The results demonstrate that the phase and magnitude of the complex coupling constant can be tuned with magnetic field in strongly damped magnets, offering a platform for exploring novel regimes of magnon-phonon interaction. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 084426] Published Tue Aug 25, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 磁振子-声子耦合因其在混合量子系统和磁振子器件中的潜在应用而受到广泛关注。研究表明，随着外部磁场减小，耦合常数会由实数演变为复数，从而导致声子透射率在接近零磁场处出现显著极小值。结果表明，在强阻尼磁体中，可以利用磁场调控复耦合常数的相位和幅值，为探索磁振子-声子相互作用的新机制提供了平台。
authors: Yasuhiro Todaka, Motoki Asano, Isamu Yasuda, Masashi Kawaguchi, Daiki Hatanaka, and Masamitsu Hayashi

articles.abstract: Author(s): F. Morineau, C. Paulsen, G. Balakrishnan, D. Prabhakaran, K. Matsuhira, S. R. Giblin, and E. Lhotel Magnetic noise spectroscopy provides direct access to spontaneous magnetization fluctuations in correlated magnetic systems. Here, the authors investigate how demagnetizing fields influence magnetic noise spectra. By combining magnetic noise and ac susceptibility measurements across samples of different sizes and shapes, they show that sample geometry plays a decisive role in the measured fluctuations and must therefore be treated as a key experimental control parameter when probing intrinsic dynamics. Their results underscore the importance of boundary conditions and establish a framework for quantitatively comparing magnetic noise measurements with microscopic theories. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 094433] Published Tue Aug 25, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 磁噪声谱学能够直接获取关联磁性系统中的自发磁化涨落。研究通过对不同尺寸和形状样品进行磁噪声与交流磁化率测量，考察了退磁场对磁噪声谱的影响。结果显示，样品几何形状对所测涨落具有决定性作用，在研究材料的本征动力学时必须将其作为关键实验控制参数加以考虑。
authors: F. Morineau, C. Paulsen, G. Balakrishnan, D. Prabhakaran, K. Matsuhira, S. R. Giblin, and E. Lhotel
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁噪声谱学能够直接获取关联磁性系统中的自发磁化涨落。在此，作者研究了退磁场如何影响磁噪声谱。通过结合对不同尺寸和形状样品开展的磁噪声测量与交流磁化率测量，他们表明，样品几何形状对所测得的涨落具有决定性作用，因此，在探测本征动力学时必须将其视为关键的实验控制参数。他们的结果强调了边界条件的重要性，并建立了一个用于将磁噪声测量结果与微观理论进行定量比较的框架。

articles.title_zh: 自旋-1三角形反铁磁体NiI₂中显著的配体介导键依赖相互作用
articles.abstract: Author(s): Hao Xu, Weiqin Zhu, Shufan Cheng, Yanyan Shangguan, Song Bao, Junbo Liao, Bo Zhang, Zihang Song, Shuai Dong, Maofeng Wu, Stanislav E. Nikitin, Travis J. Williams, Changsong Xu, and Jinsheng Wen Kitaev interaction can generate unusual quantum states and is usually sought in compounds with strongly spin-orbit-coupled magnetic ions. Here, the authors combine neutron scattering with calculations of magnetic structure and excitations to establish sizable Kitaev and off-diagonal interactions in the spin-1 triangular magnet NiI 2 , with spin-orbit coupling supplied instead by surrounding iodine atoms. These interactions stabilize its canted proper-screw order and open an excitation gap. This finding extends the search for Kitaev physics into high‑spin systems with intrinsically weak ionic spin–orbit coupling. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L080405] Published Tue Aug 25, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: Kitaev相互作用能够产生反常量子态，通常在具有强自旋-轨道耦合磁性离子的化合物中寻找。研究结合中子散射以及磁结构和激发的计算，证实自旋-1三角形磁体NiI₂中存在显著的Kitaev相互作用和非对角相互作用，其中自旋-轨道耦合由周围的碘原子提供。这些相互作用稳定了其倾斜的正规螺旋磁序并打开激发能隙，表明Kitaev物理可以拓展到离子自旋-轨道耦合本征较弱的高自旋体系。
authors: Hao Xu, Weiqin Zhu, Shufan Cheng, Yanyan Shangguan, Song Bao, Junbo Liao, Bo Zhang, Zihang Song, Shuai Dong, Maofeng Wu, Stanislav E. Nikitin, Travis J. Williams, Changsong Xu, and Jinsheng Wen

articles.title: Precomputed grid potential (PGP) method: Exact reciprocal-space acceleration of particle mesh Ewald for Monte Carlo simulations
articles.abstract: When conducting Monte Carlo (MC) simulations using a fixed or infrequently updated charge environment, each insertion or deletion of a particle requires an O(N log N) particle mesh Ewald (PME) long-range electrostatics calculation. To address this, we have developed Precomputed Grid Potential (PGP). This approach is a mathematically exact redesign of the smoothed PME (SPME) stationary-mobile reciprocal cross-term, which has an O(1) reciprocal-space cost in the stationary region size per insertion and achieves no loss of accuracy when compared to the discrete SPME calculation using the same mesh. After precomputing the static contribution of the stationary charges on a 3D grid employing a B-spline interpolation operator, particle insertions only require O(1) interpolations of the stationary potential and not a Fourier transform. The PGP and PME cross-terms are algebraically the same, and the only source of numerical variation between them is the position-dependent mesh self-artifact included in discrete PME. This is eliminated by construction in PGP's cross-term formulation. We have compared PGP to PME for water sampling in protein systems of up to 56K atoms, showing through grand canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) simulations that, after independent calibration of the chemical potential, all distribution measurements, including mean occupancy and interaction energy, were statistically indistinguishable, while accept/reject ratios differed by no more than 0.23%. For these fixed-stationary region GCMC workloads, PGP reduces the per-trial reciprocal-space cost (4678× to 9857×) at an identical SPME Hamiltonian, mesh size, and order of B-spline.

articles.title: Bond dissociation energies of OV + –O, V + –N, and VN + –NH 3 measured by photodissociation
articles.abstract: A newly constructed cryogenically cooled ion photodissociation spectrometer has been used to measure the bond dissociation energies (BDEs) of D 0 (OV + –O) = 4.562(4) eV, D 0 (V + –N) = 4.688(12) eV, and D 0 (VN + –NH 3 ) = 2.249(40) eV, where the estimated error limit is given in parentheses in units of the last quoted digit. The instrument employs a laser-ablation, supersonic expansion source to generate jet-cooled metal-containing ions that are mass selected and collected in a cryogenically cooled linear quadrupole ion trap. The cold cations are then irradiated with a pulse from a tunable optical parametric oscillator laser, given time to dissociate, and released from the trap. The mass-selected photofragment ion signal as a function of laser wavelength provides the photodissociation action spectrum. With the laser intensity reduced to eliminate two-photon processes, the measured predissociation threshold provides the BDE of the selected ion species, which is compared to the literature and to quantum chemical calculations conducted at the coupled cluster with single, double, and perturbative triple excitations [CCSD(T)], using a complete basis set extrapolation from aug-cc-pVXZ (X = T and Q) basis sets. The measured BDEs were combined in thermochemical cycles to derive the ionization energy IE(VO 2 ) = 8.40(21) eV and additional BDEs of D 0 (V + –O 2 ) = 5.490(4) eV and D 0 (N–V + NH 3 ) = 4.97(13) eV. For VN, the BDEs of VN and VN + combined with the ionization energies of V and VN satisfy a thermochemical cycle to high precision (within 12 meV), demonstrating the validity of predissociation thresholds as a means of measuring BDEs.

articles.title: State-averaged quantum algorithms for multiconfigurational surface chemistry: A benchmark on Rh@TiO 2 (110)
articles.abstract: Accurate modeling of surface catalytic processes often requires methods capable of describing strong correlation, charge transfer, and multiple closely lying electronic states. While density functional theory remains widely used, its limitations for localized electronic states motivate the use of wavefunction-based approaches and, more recently, quantum computing algorithms. However, the performance of quantum Ansätze in chemically motivated, multistate settings remains largely unexplored. Here, we benchmark state-averaged factorized unitary coupled cluster with singles and doubles (SA-fUCCSD) and the adaptive, problem-tailored Ansatz (SA-ADAPT) using an embedded cluster model of NO adsorption on Rh-doped TiO 2 (110). The system exhibits pronounced multiconfigurational character and multiple state crossings, providing a stringent test. State-averaged CASSCF serves as a reference, and the quantum Ansätze are evaluated as solvers for the corresponding complete active space configuration interaction problem within a fixed orbital basis. We find that SA-fUCCSD improves with increasing circuit depth but requires many parameters and shows sensitivity to initialization. In contrast, SA-ADAPT achieves near-CASSCF accuracy with significantly fewer operators. A modified operator selection scheme, incorporating multiple operators per iteration, substantially accelerates convergence. Our results demonstrate the efficiency of adaptive Ansätze for multistate problems and establish a controlled benchmark for quantum algorithms in chemically motivated systems beyond minimal models.

articles.title: On the alignment between chemical foundation models and neural processing of olfactory perception
articles.title_zh: 化学基础模型与嗅觉感知神经加工之间的一致性
articles.abstract: Transformer models pre-trained on sensory stimuli such as vision and audition have been shown to capture neural representations and to effectively predict brain responses to corresponding stimuli. Olfactory perception, however, remains a relatively underexplored sensory modality in this context.
