This transition is interpreted as a Hall-mediated dynamical bifurcation between steady flux-pumping and quasi-periodic sawtooth relaxation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了双流体效应在反场箍缩等离子体磁弛豫过程中的作用。在多螺旋度状态下，双流体模拟产生了明显的锯齿振荡，而单流体模拟则得到无锯齿状态。分析表明，撕裂模共同产生维持磁弛豫的发电机电场，类似于托卡马克中的磁通泵；霍尔效应介导的非线性能量再分配会破坏稳定磁通泵所需的相干撕裂模动力学，从而促进间歇性重联。
authors: Wentan Yan, Ping Zhu, Hong Li, Wandong Liu, Bing Luo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究考察了双流体效应在反场箍缩（RFP）等离子体磁弛豫过程中的作用。在多螺旋度（MH）状态下，双流体模拟产生了独特的锯齿振荡，这与单流体模拟得到的无锯齿状态形成对比。对法拉第定律沿磁场方向投影的分析表明，撕裂模共同产生了一个发电机电场，从而维持磁弛豫；这一过程类似于托卡马克中的磁通泵。尽管撕裂模的线性增长率降低，但在所考察的参数范围内，更强的双流体效应会产生更显著的锯齿活动。模态能量分析显示，霍尔效应介导的非线性能量再分配破坏了维持稳定磁通泵所需的相干撕裂模动力学，从而促进了间歇性磁重联。作者将这一转变解释为稳定磁通泵与准周期锯齿弛豫之间由霍尔效应介导的动力学分岔。

articles.title: Advantage-level Aggregation Reinforcement Learning for X-point Target Magnetic Configuration Control in an EXL-50U Experiment-Calibrated Simulation Environment
articles.title_zh: 面向X点靶磁构型控制的优势层级聚合强化学习：基于EXL-50U实验标定的仿真环境
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20834v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Managing divertor heat loads is a central challenge for compact, high-power tokamaks. To increase local flux expansion and decouple the dissipation volume from the core, EHL-2 adopts the X-point target (XPT) divertor. This requires the secondary X-point to remain on the divertor leg; displacement degrades the topology and exhaust geometry. Current experiments, including EXL-50U discharges, rely on precomputed feedforward waveforms with PID loops on global quantities. Lacking dedicated closed-loop feedback for the secondary null, XPT operation is repeatable but not routine. We formulate XPT feedback as a multi-objective reinforcement learning (RL) control problem in a free-boundary environment calibrated to EXL-50U discharge #13906. To address strong coupling among plasma current, shape, and null constraints - where reward scalarisation collapses objective-specific temporal credit - we develop Advantage Aggregation (AdvA). AdvA preserves objective-wise temporal credit before worst-objective-aware nonlinear scalarisation and introduces a residual correction to policy updates. AdvA-PPO is evaluated against Reward-PPO and a feedforward-plus-PID baseline under nominal operation, measurement uncertainties, and unseen initial equilibria. On a 500 ms rollout, AdvA-PPO raises the mean worst-channel score from 0.23 to 0.81 over Reward-PPO, reducing X-point flux RMSE by ~20x. Under combined measurement uncertainties, it is the only learned controller completing the horizon while retaining a usable XPT shape. Multi-initialization fine-tuning enables a single AdvA-PPO policy to complete full-horizon operation across divertor and limiter initial equilibria. These results provide a simulation-based foundation for future real-time XPT validation on EXL-50U.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对紧凑型高功率托卡马克中的X点靶偏滤器控制，提出了优势聚合强化学习方法AdvA及其PPO实现。该方法在最差目标感知的非线性标量化之前保留各目标独立的时间信用，并对策略更新引入残差修正。与基于奖励的PPO及前馈加PID基线相比，AdvA-PPO在测量不确定性和未见初始平衡条件下表现出更强的控制性能，为EXL-50U上的实时验证提供了仿真基础。
authors: Siqi Ding, Xuanhe Wang, Pei Guo, Guoyang Shi, Changquan Yu, Yiting Wang, Xianming Song, Xiang Gu, Zhengyuan Chen, Lei Xing, Yapeng Zhang, Jianguo Chen, Tianyuan Liu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 管理偏滤器热负荷是紧凑型高功率托卡马克面临的核心挑战。为了增加局部磁通膨胀并使耗散体积与核心解耦，EHL-2采用了X点靶（XPT）偏滤器。这要求次级X点始终位于偏滤器支腿上；其位移会降低拓扑结构和排热几何形状的性能。目前的实验，包括EXL-50U放电，依赖预先计算的前馈波形以及针对全局量的PID回路。由于缺少针对次级零点的专用闭环反馈，XPT运行虽然具有可重复性，但还不能成为常规操作。我们在一个根据EXL-50U第13906号放电标定的自由边界环境中，将XPT反馈表述为一个多目标强化学习（RL）控制问题。为处理等离子体电流、形状和零点约束之间的强耦合问题，以及奖励标量化会使目标特定的时间信用发生塌缩的问题，我们提出了优势聚合方法（AdvA）。AdvA在进行面向最差目标的非线性标量化之前保留各目标独立的时间信用，并在策略更新中引入残差修正。我们在标称运行、测量不确定性和未见初始平衡条件下，将AdvA-PPO与Reward-PPO以及前馈加PID基线进行了比较。在500毫秒的运行过程中，AdvA-PPO使最差通道得分的平均值从Reward-PPO的0.23提高到0.81，并将X点磁通均方根误差降低了约20倍。在综合测量不确定性条件下，AdvA-PPO是唯一能够完成整个时间范围、同时保持可用XPT形状的学习控制器。通过多初始状态微调，单个AdvA-PPO策略能够在偏滤器和限制器初始平衡条件下完成全时域运行。这些结果为未来在EXL-50U上开展实时XPT验证提供了基于仿真的基础。

articles.title: Reinforcement learning for vertical position control on the EXL-50U spherical tokamak
articles.title_zh: 球形托卡马克EXL-50U中的垂直位置强化学习控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20901v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vertical position control is essential for sustaining high-performance operation in spherical tokamaks, where increased plasma elongation introduces stringent requirements on fast and robust stabilization. This work presents an experimentally validated reinforcement-learning(RL)-based vertical position control framework for the EXL-50U spherical tokamak. A high-fidelity discharge-reconstructed simulation environment is developed by integrating physics-based plasma-circuit models with experimental equilibrium information, enabling systematic controller synthesis and sim-to-real evaluation. Within this framework, RL is benchmarked in simulation against operational proportional--integral--derivative (PID) and model-based linear quadratic regulator (LQR) controllers under identical plant dynamics, actuator constraints, and measurement imperfections.Simulation results show that RL achieves tracking accuracy comparable to PID with consistently lower vertical-stabilization coil effort, while lightweight integral compensation improves robustness against residual model--plant mismatch. The RL controller is subsequently deployed on EXL-50U for closed-loop experiments. Across more than ten discharges with RL takeover, stable vertical regulation is achieved within the controlled windows. For seven representative discharges, RL maintains millimetre-scale tracking accuracy comparable to the operational PID controller (MAE typically ~ 1-5 mm) while consistently reducing actuator effort. These results demonstrate the feasibility of learning-based plasma control on a real spherical tokamak and establish a practical pathway toward future fusion control systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出并实验验证了用于EXL-50U球形托卡马克垂直位置控制的强化学习框架。作者构建了融合物理等离子体—电路模型和实验平衡信息的高保真放电重构仿真环境，并在相同条件下将强化学习与PID和LQR控制器进行比较。仿真及闭环实验表明，强化学习能够实现与PID相当的毫米级跟踪精度，同时持续降低垂直稳定线圈的执行器负荷。
authors: Lei Xing, Huicong Ma, Changquan Yu, Xuanhe Wang, Jiayi Zhi, Pei Guo, Mengyao Li, Zhengyuan Chen, Yapeng Zhang, Guoyang Shi, Dongkai Qi, Xiang Gu, Siqi Ding, Yong Liu, Jianguo Chen, Tianyuan Liu, the EXL-50U Teama
articles.abstract_zh_full: 垂直位置控制对于维持球形托卡马克的高性能运行至关重要，因为更高的等离子体拉长率对快速且稳健的稳定提出了严格要求。本文提出了一个经过实验验证的、基于强化学习（RL）的EXL-50U球形托卡马克垂直位置控制框架。作者开发了一个高保真放电重构仿真环境，将基于物理的等离子体—电路模型与实验平衡信息相结合，从而能够系统地进行控制器设计以及从仿真到现实的评估。在这一框架中，作者在相同的装置动力学、执行器约束和测量不完美条件下，将RL与实际运行的比例—积分—微分（PID）控制器及基于模型的线性二次型调节器（LQR）控制器进行了仿真比较。仿真结果表明，RL能够达到与PID相当的跟踪精度，同时垂直稳定线圈的控制力度始终更低；轻量级积分补偿则提高了其对残余模型—装置不匹配的鲁棒性。随后，RL控制器被部署到EXL-50U上进行闭环实验。在十余次采用RL接管的放电中，控制时间窗内均实现了稳定的垂直调节。对于七次具有代表性的放电，RL保持了与实际运行PID控制器相当的毫米级跟踪精度（平均绝对误差通常约为1—5毫米），同时持续降低执行器负荷。这些结果证明了在真实球形托卡马克上采用学习型等离子体控制的可行性，并为未来聚变控制系统的发展建立了实践路径。

articles.title: Direction-Selective Wave Freezing and Amplification at a Hyperbolic Time Interface
articles.title_zh: 双曲时间界面处的方向选择性波冻结与放大
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20968v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hyperbolic media are well known for converting high k-components that are evanescent in conventional dielectrics into propagating bulk waves through their open equifrequency contours. Here, we reveal a complementary temporal effect: after a sudden transition into an effectively nondispersive hyperbolic state, conservation of the full wavevector causes the indefinite dispersion to partition momentum space into real-, zero-, and purely imaginary-frequency regimes. Consequently, p-polarized waves undergo conventional temporal scattering, critical magnetic-field freezing, or exponential growth and decay, depending solely on their conserved wavevector direction, whereas s-polarized waves remain in the real-frequency regime. A second temporal boundary releases the frozen or amplified fields into propagating waves at original frequency. Analytical temporal boundary theory, k-space pulse reconstruction, and finite-difference time-domain simulations corroborate these dynamics. These results establish hyperbolic temporal boundaries as a compact route to direction-selective imaginary frequency dynamics and wave amplification without Floquet periodicity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文揭示了进入有效无色散双曲状态后的互补时间效应：在完整波矢守恒下，不定型色散会将动量空间划分为实频率、零频率和纯虚频率区域。由此，p偏振波仅根据守恒波矢的方向，就可能发生常规时间散射、临界磁场冻结或指数增长与衰减，而s偏振波仍处于实频率区域。第二个时间边界能够将冻结或放大的场释放为原始频率的传播波。
authors: Zhao Wang, Ai Gang, Xinghong Zhu, Hongru Ma, Wen Xiao, Huanyang Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双曲介质因能够借助其开放的等频轮廓，将传统介质中的倏逝高波矢分量转换为传播体波而广为人知。在此，我们揭示了一种互补的时间效应：在突然转变为有效无色散双曲状态之后，完整波矢的守恒使不定型色散将动量空间划分为实频率、零频率和纯虚频率区域。因此，p偏振波仅取决于其守恒波矢的方向，分别经历常规时间散射、临界磁场冻结，或指数增长与衰减；与此同时，s偏振波始终处于实频率区域。第二个时间边界会将冻结场或放大场释放为具有原始频率的传播波。解析的时间边界理论、k空间脉冲重构和时域有限差分模拟共同证实了这些动力学现象。这些结果表明，双曲时间边界提供了一条紧凑途径，可以在无需Floquet周期性的情况下实现方向选择性的虚频动力学和波放大。

articles.title: Resolving positive semi-definiteness in physics-informed kernels for scientific machine learning
articles.title_zh: 解决面向物理信息的科学机器学习核中的半正定性问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20985v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many modern machine learning models can be understood as kernel-based function-space models, including Gaussian processes and neural tangent kernels. In scientific machine learning, differential operators are increasingly used to encode physical structure directly into such models. However, it has remained unclear under which conditions these constructions are valid machine learning models, i.e. preserve positive semi-definiteness, and whether observed instabilities arise from ill-posed modeling or numerical effects. Here, we establish a simple and sufficient condition for positive semi-definiteness: for linear differential operators of order m, the base kernel must be m-times continuously differentiable. Crucially, this guarantee holds for operators with non-constant and even discontinuous coefficients. Examples are ubiquitous in physical systems, including diffusion, material elasticity, wave propagation in inhomogeneous media, and quantum systems. We conclude that remaining instabilities are attributable to numerical issues, providing a unifying validity foundation for operator-informed kernel methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 许多现代机器学习模型都可理解为基于核的函数空间模型，包括高斯过程和神经切线核。本文建立了一个简单且充分的正半定性条件：对于m阶线性微分算子，基础核只需具有m阶连续可微性，即可保证相应构造有效；该结论也适用于系数非恒定甚至不连续的算子。由此，剩余的不稳定性可归因于数值问题，为算子信息核方法提供了统一的有效性基础。
authors: J. Moser, C. Albert, S. Ranftl
articles.abstract_zh_full: 许多现代机器学习模型都可以理解为基于核的函数空间模型，包括高斯过程和神经切线核。在科学机器学习中，微分算子越来越多地被用于将物理结构直接编码到这类模型中。然而，对于这些构造在何种条件下才是有效的机器学习模型，即保持正半定性，以及已观察到的不稳定性究竟源于病态建模还是数值效应，人们一直缺乏明确认识。在此，我们建立了一个简单且充分的正半定性条件：对于m阶线性微分算子，基础核必须具有m阶连续可微性。关键在于，即使算子的系数不是常数，甚至是不连续的，这一保证仍然成立。物理系统中的相关例子十分普遍，包括扩散、材料弹性、非均匀介质中的波传播以及量子系统。我们据此得出结论，剩余的不稳定性应归因于数值问题，从而为算子信息核方法提供了一个统一的有效性基础。

articles.title: Intracavity Photon Statistics from Correlated Molecular Electronic Structure
articles.title_zh: 来自相关分子电子结构的腔内光子统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21071v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum optics characterizes light through photon correlations, but ab initio cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) has only calculated raw field moments at present. In this study, intracavity photon statistics of cavity-coupled molecules are computed from QED coupled-cluster (QED-CCSD-22) densities and validated against exact diagonalization of the Pauli-Fierz Hamiltonian. A change of coordinate origin or dipole convention displaces the ground state coherently, so second-order and higher cumulants of the cavity field are well defined even for molecular ions. The photon subsystem of QED Hartree-Fock is exactly coherent, so the invariant statistics measure electron-photon correlation. The field fluctuations are super-Poissonian, and their degree of second-order coherence is set by the cavity frequency rather than by the coupling strength, falling from 18.5 to 4.9 for H2 as the cavity is detuned from 5 to 20 eV. A parity selection rule makes the sign of the third cumulant a probe of the orientation of the molecular charge asymmetry along the cavity polarization.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用QED耦合簇方法QED-CCSD-22的密度计算腔耦合分子的腔内光子统计，并通过Pauli-Fierz哈密顿量的精确对角化进行验证。研究指出，坐标原点或偶极约定的改变会使基态发生相干位移，因此二阶及更高阶累积量能够为分子离子定义良好的腔场统计。结果表明，光场涨落呈超泊松分布，二阶相干度主要由腔频率而非耦合强度决定，且三阶累积量的符号可探测分子电荷不对称沿腔偏振方向的取向。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子光学通过光子关联来刻画光，但目前从头算腔量子电动力学（QED）只计算了原始场矩。在本研究中，我们利用QED耦合簇（QED-CCSD-22）密度计算了腔耦合分子的腔内光子统计，并将结果与Pauli-Fierz哈密顿量的精确对角化进行了验证。坐标原点或偶极约定的改变会使基态发生相干位移，因此即使对于分子离子，腔场的二阶及更高阶累积量仍然具有良好定义。QED Hartree-Fock的光子子系统严格地处于相干态，因此这些不变量统计量度量的是电子—光子关联。场涨落呈超泊松分布，其二阶相干度由腔频率而非耦合强度决定：对于H2，当腔失谐从5 eV增加到20 eV时，该相干度从18.5下降到4.9。宇称选择定则使三阶累积量的符号成为分子电荷不对称沿腔偏振方向取向的探针。

articles.title: Remote sensing of the temporal and spatial variability of atmospheric refractivity using ADS-B interferometry (ADSBi)
articles.title_zh: 利用ADS-B干涉测量法（ADSBi）遥感大气折射率的时间与空间变化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21108v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The extreme variability of humidity in the lower atmosphere over short spatial and temporal scales presents an enormous challenge for existing observing systems. Variations in humidity can be detected due to changes in the refractive properties of the atmosphere, which influence the propagation of electromagnetic radiation. We demonstrate the ability to retrieve high-resolution refractivity gradient measurements using an interferometer to measure the refraction of the Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) radio transmission routinely broadcast by commercial aircraft. The ADS-B interferometry (ADSBi) technique is sensitive to small-scale spatial and temporal variability in the refractivity gradient due to changes in humidity. We demonstrate how the retrieval of refractivity profiles is possible exploiting the differences in the observed refraction of radio transmissions broadcast by aircraft at different distances and altitudes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了利用干涉仪测量商用飞机常规广播的自动相关监视—广播（ADS-B）无线电信号折射，从而反演高分辨率大气折射率梯度的能力。ADS-B干涉测量法对由湿度变化引起的小尺度空间和时间折射率梯度变化具有敏感性。通过比较不同距离和高度飞机发射信号所产生的观测折射差异，该方法能够反演大气折射率廓线。
authors: Ollie Lewis, Chris Brunt, Malcolm Kitchen, Neill E. Bowler, Edmund K. Stone
articles.abstract_zh_full: 低层大气湿度在短空间尺度和时间尺度上的极端变化，对现有观测系统构成了巨大挑战。湿度变化会改变大气的折射特性，而这种变化可以通过其对电磁辐射传播的影响加以探测。我们展示了利用干涉仪测量商用飞机常规广播的自动相关监视—广播（ADS-B）无线电信号折射，从而获取高分辨率折射率梯度测量结果的能力。ADS-B干涉测量法（ADSBi）能够感知由湿度变化引起的小尺度空间和时间折射率梯度变化。我们说明，通过利用不同距离和不同高度飞机广播的无线电信号所产生的观测折射差异，可以实现折射率廓线反演。

articles.title: A Fourier Neural Operator for Accelerated Discretization-Invariant Solutions of the Radiative Transfer Equation
articles.title_zh: 用于辐射传输方程加速、离散化不变求解的傅里叶神经算子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21173v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The radiative transfer equation (RTE) governs thermal radiation in participating media, which is critical to modeling combustion, atmospheric, high-temperature, and radiative thermal management applications. However, due to the inherently high-dimensional nature of radiative transfer, numerical solutions to the RTE induce significant computational cost. This work develops a Fourier neural operator (FNO) as a fast, discretization-invariant, surrogate model for predicting the absorbed heat flux field in participating media. A dataset is generated on a benchmark 2-dimensional problem modeling thermal surface emission into a participating medium with spatially varying properties using Monte Carlo simulations. The FNO is trained to learn the solution operator, mapping the input property fields and geometry to the resulting heat flux field. The trained FNO provides up to 26-times computational acceleration compared to Monte Carlo simulation at equivalent error. Furthermore, as the FNO learns the solution operator and not an image-to-image mapping, the trained FNO accurately generalizes to various spatial discretizations, including those not seen in the training dataset. A spectral analysis of the spatial frequencies present in the heat flux prediction demonstrates the FNO's ability to suppress the high-frequency noise present in the training dataset, while preserving the physically meaningful low-mid frequency spectrum. These results demonstrate the Fourier neural operator surrogate model can provide accurate, computationally efficient, and discretization-invariant predictions for radiative transfer in a participating medium. By learning the underlying solution operator, this approach moves toward the development of surrogate models for radiative transfer capable of generalizing across a broad range of geometries, discretizations, and boundary conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文开发了一种傅里叶神经算子（FNO），作为快速且离散化不变的代理模型，用于预测参与性介质中的吸收热通量场。模型通过二维基准问题的蒙特卡洛模拟数据进行训练，并学习将输入的介质属性场和几何信息映射到热通量场。结果表明，在误差相当时，FNO相较蒙特卡洛模拟最高可实现26倍加速，并能推广到训练中未出现的空间离散方式，同时抑制高频噪声并保留具有物理意义的低至中频谱。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 辐射传输方程（RTE）支配参与性介质中的热辐射过程，对于燃烧、大气、高温以及辐射热管理等应用的建模至关重要。然而，由于辐射传输具有固有的高维特性，RTE的数值求解会产生很高的计算成本。本研究开发了一种傅里叶神经算子（FNO），作为快速且离散化不变的代理模型，用于预测参与性介质中的吸收热通量场。作者针对一个二维基准问题生成了数据集，该问题描述了具有空间变化属性的参与性介质中的热表面发射过程，数据通过蒙特卡洛模拟获得。FNO经过训练以学习解算子，将输入的属性场和几何信息映射为相应的热通量场。训练后的FNO在误差相当的情况下，相比蒙特卡洛模拟可实现最高26倍的计算加速。此外，由于FNO学习的是解算子而不是图像到图像的映射，训练后的模型能够准确推广到多种空间离散方式，包括训练数据中未出现的离散方式。对热通量预测中空间频率的谱分析表明，FNO能够抑制训练数据中存在的高频噪声，同时保留具有物理意义的低频至中频谱。这些结果表明，傅里叶神经算子代理模型能够为参与性介质中的辐射传输提供准确、高效且离散化不变的预测。通过学习底层解算子，该方法推动了辐射传输代理模型的发展，使其能够跨越广泛的几何形状、离散方式和边界条件进行泛化。

articles.title: First step toward multi machine ELM energy scalings and extrapolations to SPARC and ITER
articles.title_zh: 多装置ELM能量标度及向SPARC和ITER外推的第一步
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21179v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: It is shown that the ELM energy loss normalized by the plasma stored energy (ΔEELM/Wplasma) for high-density small/QCE ELM regimes scales inversely with the separatrix turbulence parameter aₜ. In contrast, the neoclassical electron collisionality at the pedestal top, nu*e,neo, expected to regulate ΔEELM/Wplasma according to the Loarte scaling (Plasma Phys. Control. Fusion 2003 45 1549), does not adequately capture ΔEELM/Wplasma data for peeling-ballooning-limited type-I ELMs and ballooning-limited small/QCE ELMs, limiting its applicability for extrapolation to one scenario window. A multi-machine database including seven tokamaks and with ΔEELM/Wplasma ranging from 0.5% to 14%, has been analyzed. A regression analysis on only type-I ELMs yields ((ΔE_ELM)/Wₚₗₐₛₘₐ )₍Type-I ) [%]=6.8*T₍ₑ,ped)⁰.03 n₍ₑ,ped)⁽⁻⁰.4) kappa⁽⁻⁰.4) Rₘₐⱼₒᵣ⁰.4, corresponding to ΔEELM/Wplasma =4.5% for nominal SPARC pedestal parameters and 12% for the ITER D-T Q=10 scenario. For the small/QCE ELM class, however, as aₜ increases, the pedestal moves toward a ballooning-limited boundary, the toroidal mode number increases, the ELM frequency rises following the scaling f_ELM=46e⁽⁽².25*aₜ₎₎, and ΔEELM/Wplasma decreases via the relation (ΔE_ELM)/Wₚₗₐₛₘₐ [%]=1.6e⁽⁻⁽αₜ/2)). For SPARC QCE-relevant aₜ₌₀.86 and ITER high-fueling scenario aₜ = 0.64, the scaling favorably predicts ΔEELM/Wplasma of 1.0% and 1.2%, respectively, with values below 1% if the small/QCE ELM regime is pushed beyond aₜ >1. The small/QCE ELM-fitted results represent an initial step toward future analysis on broader datasets, which will be necessary to improve the accuracy of projections for future reactor-relevant scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了七台托卡马克的数据，研究高密度小型/QCE ELM和I型ELM的能量损失标度关系。结果显示，小型/QCE ELM中归一化ELM能量损失与磁面湍流参数aₜ呈反比，而顶部台基新经典电子碰撞率不能充分描述相关数据。基于回归关系，研究给出了SPARC和ITER相关场景的预测值，并指出小型/QCE ELM标度为未来反应堆场景外推提供了初步基础，但仍需更大数据集提高精度。
authors: R. Perillo, A. Redl, T. Eich, C. J. Lasnier, A. Nelson, R. Rizkallah, D. Silvagni, A. Stagni, J. A. Boedo, A. McLean, P. Traverso, N. Vianello, the DIII-D team, JET contributors, the ASDEX Upgrade team, the TCV team, the EUROfusion Tokamak Exploitation team
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究表明，对于高密度小型/QCE ELM状态，归一化于等离子体储能的ELM能量损失（ΔE_ELM/Wₚₗₐₛₘₐ）与磁面湍流参数aₜ成反比。相比之下，根据Loarte标度（《等离子体物理与受控聚变》2003年45卷1549页），预计能够调节ΔE_ELM/Wₚₗₐₛₘₐ的台基顶部新经典电子碰撞率ν*e,neo，无法充分描述剥离—气球模受限I型ELM和气球模受限小型/QCE ELM的数据，这限制了其在一个情景窗口中的外推适用性。研究分析了一个包含七台托卡马克的多装置数据库，其中ΔE_ELM/Wₚₗₐₛₘₐ的范围为0.5%至14%。仅针对I型ELM进行回归分析得到：(ΔE_ELM/Wₚₗₐₛₘₐ₎_Type-I[%]=6.8 Tₑ,ped⁰.03 nₑ,ped⁻⁰.4 κappa⁻⁰.4 Rₘₐⱼₒᵣ⁰.4；对于标称SPARC台基参数，该关系对应的ΔE_ELM/Wₚₗₐₛₘₐ为4.5%，而对于ITER氘氚Q=10情景则为12%。然而，对于小型/QCE ELM类别，随着aₜ增加，台基向气球模受限边界移动，环向模数增加，ELM频率按照f_ELM=46 exp(2.25aₜ₎的标度升高，而ΔE_ELM/Wₚₗₐₛₘₐ则按照(ΔE_ELM/Wₚₗₐₛₘₐ₎[%]=1.6 exp(-aₜ/2)的关系下降。对于SPARC中与QCE相关的aₜ₌₀.86以及ITER高加料情景中的aₜ₌₀.64，该标度分别有利地预测ΔE_ELM/Wₚₗₐₛₘₐ为1.0%和1.2%；如果将小型/QCE ELM状态推进到aₜ>1，则预测值将低于1%。基于小型/QCE ELM拟合的结果是未来开展更广泛数据集分析的初步步骤，而更广泛的数据集对于提高未来反应堆相关情景预测的准确性仍然是必要的。

articles.title: A Variational Principle for the Vorticity Equation
articles.title_zh: 涡量方程的一个变分原理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21279v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a variational formulation of the incompressible vorticity equation based on Gauss's principle of least constraint using the Gauss constraint functional Zvec_ømega. The central result is the Euler--Lagrange equation Z_ømega = -nabla h, where h = u ḑotboldsymbolomega is the helicity density. This reveals that the helicity gradient nabla h acts as the constraint force maintaining the solenoidality of the vorticity field, exactly as the pressure gradient nabla p maintains incompressibility in Taha et al.'s pressure-gradient minimization principle. The helicity density naturally emerges as the Lagrange multiplier enforcing nabla ḑot boldysmbolomega=0, and at the solution the flow minimizes the norm of the helicity gradient |nabla h|². This establishes the exact duality: helicity is to vorticity as pressure is to velocity. We apply the variational principle to the Burgers vortex and verify the the Euler-Lagrange equation. The variational principle connects to Moffatt's helicity conservation theorem, Arnold's geometric formulation of ideal fluid flow, and Kambe's gauge-theoretic formulation. This work provides a unified variational framework for fluid dynamics that spans classical mechanics, geometric mechanics, and topological field theory. We discuss how this work may provide a theoretical foundation for understanding the role of helicity gradients in boundary layer dynamics, with potential implications for the formation of coherent structures and the onset of transition. These applications are reserved for future work.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于高斯最小约束原理，利用高斯约束泛函提出不可压缩涡量方程的变分表述。核心结果是欧拉—拉格朗日方程将涡量约束泛函与螺度密度梯度联系起来，表明螺度梯度是维持涡量场无散性的约束力，并建立了螺度与涡量、压力与速度之间的对偶关系。作者将该原理应用于伯格斯涡并验证了相应方程，同时讨论了其与螺度守恒、理想流体几何表述和规范场论表述的联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们基于高斯最小约束原理，利用高斯约束泛函Zₒₘₑga，提出了不可压缩涡量方程的一个变分表述。核心结果是欧拉—拉格朗日方程Zₒₘₑga=-∇h，其中h=u·omega为螺度密度。这表明，螺度梯度∇h充当维持涡量场无散性的约束力，正如压力梯度∇p在Taha等人提出的压力梯度最小化原理中维持不可压缩性一样。螺度密度自然地作为拉格朗日乘子出现，用于施加∇·omega=0的约束；在解处，流动使螺度梯度的范数平方|∇h|²最小化。这建立了一个严格的对偶关系：螺度之于涡量，正如压力之于速度。我们将该变分原理应用于伯格斯涡，并验证了欧拉—拉格朗日方程。该变分原理与Moffatt的螺度守恒定理、Arnold关于理想流体运动的几何表述以及Kambe的规范场论表述相联系。本文为流体动力学提供了一个统一的变分框架，覆盖经典力学、几何力学和拓扑场论。我们还讨论了该工作如何为理解边界层动力学中的螺度梯度作用提供理论基础，并可能对相干结构的形成和转捩的开始产生影响。这些应用留待未来研究。

articles.title: Machine-Learned NMR Shieldings in Molecular Solids with Built-In Hybrid-Functional Molecular Corrections
articles.title_zh: 具有内置混合泛函分子修正的分子固体机器学习核磁屏蔽
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21313v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fast and accurate chemical shielding estimators are essential for shielding-driven Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) crystallography. Machine-learning models for shielding predictions have matured significantly and today are primarily limited by the electronic structure reference data they are trained on. Here, we introduce ShiftML4, a shielding-tensor model trained directly on monomer-corrected calculations that approximate PBE0, rather than the PBE reference targeted by earlier ShiftML models. ShiftML4 is trained on a diverse set of structures containing 12 of the most common NMR nuclei in molecular organic solids. On experimental benchmark sets, the 13C isotropic RMSE against experiment is 1.67 ppm, compared with 2.34 ppm for GIPAW-PBE on the same geometries. ShiftML4 gives a similar 1H prediction RMSE to ShiftML3 (0.5 ppm) and improves the 15N RMSE from 7.24 to 6.08 ppm. The model also reduces errors in the shielding-tensor anisotropy, with an RMSE of 4.63 ppm on 13C CSA principal components against 5.85 ppm for GIPAW. The improvements in prediction accuracy are retained on better geometries. Basing shift predictions on structures relaxed with PET-MOLS, a recent machine-learned interatomic potential that reaches approximate hybrid-DFT geometries in seconds, lowers the ShiftML4 errors further to 0.48 ppm (1H), 1.49 ppm (13C) and 3.66 ppm (15N).
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出了 ShiftML4，这是一种直接基于单体修正计算训练的核磁屏蔽张量模型，用于近似 PBE0 级别的结果。该模型涵盖分子有机固体中12种常见核种，在实验基准中改善了 13C、15N 及屏蔽张量各向异性的预测精度，同时保持了与前代模型相近的 1H 性能。结合 PET-MOLS 优化得到的高质量结构后，预测误差可进一步降低。
authors: Matthias Kellner, Ruben Rodriguez-Madrid, Jacob B. Holmes, Pablo A. Unzueta, Gregory J. O. Beran, Lyndon Emsley, Michele Ceriotti
articles.abstract_zh_full: 快速且准确的化学屏蔽估计器对于以屏蔽为驱动的核磁共振（NMR）晶体学至关重要。用于预测屏蔽的机器学习模型已经取得了显著发展，而目前其性能主要受限于训练所采用的电子结构参考数据。在此，我们提出 ShiftML4，这是一种直接基于单体修正计算训练的屏蔽张量模型；这些计算近似于 PBE0，而不是早期 ShiftML 模型所针对的 PBE 参考。ShiftML4 在包含分子有机固体中12种最常见 NMR 核种的多样化结构集合上进行训练。在实验基准数据集上，13C 各向同性化学位移相对于实验值的均方根误差（RMSE）为1.67 ppm，而在相同几何结构上，GIPAW-PBE 的 RMSE 为2.34 ppm。ShiftML4 对 1H 的预测 RMSE 与 ShiftML3 相近（0.5 ppm），并将 15N 的 RMSE 从7.24 ppm改善至6.08 ppm。该模型还降低了屏蔽张量各向异性的误差：相对于 GIPAW 在 13C 化学位移各向异性（CSA）主分量上5.85 ppm的 RMSE，ShiftML4 的 RMSE 为4.63 ppm。在更优的几何结构上，这些预测精度提升仍然能够保持。使用由 PET-MOLS（一种新近提出的机器学习原子间势，可在数秒内得到近似混合 DFT 几何结构）弛豫后的结构进行位移预测，可将 ShiftML4 的误差进一步降低至 1H 的0.48 ppm、13C 的1.49 ppm和 15N 的3.66 ppm。

articles.title: Machine learning predictions of the Hessian matrix for peptides chains and small proteins
articles.title_zh: 肽链和小型蛋白质的 Hessian 矩阵机器学习预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21322v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular Hessians have a key role in describing molecular vibrations, trajectories and optimization paths. An explicit calculation of them through standard quantum mechanical methods can be computationally expensive for medium-large systems, and in many applications not even needed. Machine learning methods can be a shortcut to tackle efficiently the computational difficulties. This paper will present a ML model able to predict the Hessian matrix of biological system made of thousands of atoms. The method, based on learning the Hessian in internal coordinates is intrinsically invariant to molecular rotations and translations, and has a very good scaling with the systems' size. The training was performed on a dataset of simple aminoacids, as they constitute the building blocks of larger proteins. From the predicted Hessian matrix it is possible to calculate thermochemical properties within the harmonic approximations, among them enthalpies, entropies, Gibbs' free energies, and zero point vibrational energies.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子 Hessian 矩阵对于描述分子振动、轨迹和优化路径具有关键作用，但对中大型体系进行显式量子力学计算的成本很高。作者提出了一种在内坐标中学习 Hessian 矩阵的机器学习模型，该方法天然具有旋转和平移不变性，并能较好地适应体系规模增长。模型基于简单氨基酸数据集训练，可进一步计算谐近似下的焓、熵、吉布斯自由能和零点振动能等热化学性质。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子 Hessian 矩阵在描述分子振动、轨迹和优化路径方面发挥着关键作用。通过标准量子力学方法显式计算 Hessian 矩阵对于中大型体系而言计算成本高昂，而且在许多应用中甚至并非必需。机器学习方法可以作为一种捷径，高效应对这些计算难题。本文将介绍一种能够预测由数千个原子组成的生物体系 Hessian 矩阵的机器学习模型。该方法基于在内坐标中学习 Hessian 矩阵，因此天然具有分子旋转和平移不变性，并且随着体系规模增大具有良好的可扩展性。模型使用简单氨基酸数据集进行训练，因为氨基酸是更大蛋白质的组成单元。利用预测得到的 Hessian 矩阵，可以在谐近似下计算热化学性质，其中包括焓、熵、吉布斯自由能和零点振动能。

articles.title: Excitation and Recombination Data for Nd I-V with Applications to Kilonovae
articles.title_zh: Nd I–V 的激发与复合数据及其在千新星中的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20881v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neodymium (Nd), a key r-process element, significantly influences the opacity and emergent spectra of kilonovae resulting from neutron star mergers. We present new atomic data for the first five ionization stages of Neodymium, with emphasis on recombination rate coefficients and electron-impact excitation relevant to non-local thermodynamic equilibrium (non-LTE) modelling. Using the relativistic atomic structure code sc autostructure, we compute energy levels, radiative and dielectronic recombination rates using the isolated-resonance approximation, and excitation data for these ions. Excitation datasets are constructed using both direct (distorted-wave) and resonant excitation approaches, allowing a systematic assessment of the impact of resonance contributions on effective collision strengths. For the case of Nd sc ii, we compare collisional strengths with those produced by the Dirac Atomic R-matrix Codes (sc darc). These comparisons demonstrate the importance of resonance-mediated excitation, especially for low-charge ions where near-threshold resonances significantly enhance rates. In terms of recombination for higher ionization stages, dielectronic recombination (DR) is found to dominate over a wide temperature range, while radiative recombination (RR) is comparable with DR at low temperatures for near-neutral species. Our results highlight the pivotal role of non-LTE atomic physics in interpreting kilonovae observations and constraining nucleosynthesis yields. This work strengthens the atomic foundation necessary for linking observed electromagnetic signals to the physics of compact object mergers and heavy element formation.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者给出了钕前五个电离阶段的新原子数据，重点关注非局域热力学平衡（非 LTE）模型所需的复合速率系数和电子碰撞激发数据。研究采用相对论原子结构程序计算能级、辐射复合、双电子复合和激发数据，并系统评估共振对有效碰撞强度的影响。结果表明，低电荷离子中的近阈值共振会显著增强激发速率，而高电离阶段通常由双电子复合主导。
authors: N. Ferguson, L. P. Mulholland, M. McCann, C. P. Ballance, M. G. O'Mullane
articles.abstract_zh_full: 钕（Nd）是 r 过程中的关键元素，对中子星并合产生的千新星的不透明度和出射光谱具有重要影响。我们给出了钕前五个电离阶段的新原子数据，重点关注非局域热力学平衡（non-LTE）建模所涉及的复合速率系数和电子碰撞激发数据。我们使用相对论原子结构代码 sc autostructure，计算了这些离子的能级、辐射复合和双电子复合速率（采用孤立共振近似），以及激发数据。激发数据集同时采用直接激发（畸变波）方法和共振激发方法构建，从而能够系统评估共振贡献对有效碰撞强度的影响。对于 Nd II，我们将碰撞强度与 Dirac Atomic R-matrix Codes（sc darc）计算得到的结果进行了比较。这些比较表明，共振介导的激发十分重要，尤其对于低电荷离子而言，近阈值共振会显著增强速率。对于较高电离阶段的复合，在较宽的温度范围内，双电子复合（DR）占主导；而对于接近中性的物种，在低温下辐射复合（RR）与 DR 相当。我们的结果凸显了非 LTE 原子物理在解释千新星观测和约束核合成产额方面的关键作用。本工作加强了必要的原子物理基础，从而有助于将观测到的电磁信号与致密天体并合及重元素形成的物理过程联系起来。

articles.title: A tunable photonic band gap resonator for axion dark matter searches
articles.title_zh: 用于轴子暗物质搜索的可调谐光子带隙谐振器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2408.03861v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Axions are a well-motivated dark matter candidate particle. Haloscopes aim to detect axions in the galactic halo by measuring the photon signal resulting from axions interacting with a strong magnetic field. Existing haloscopes are primarily targeting axion masses which produce microwave-range photons and rely on microwave resonators to enhance the signal power. Only a limited subset of resonator modes are useful for this process, and current cylindrical-style cavities suffer from mode mixing and crowding from other fundamental modes. The majority of these modes can be eliminated by using photonic band gap (PBG) resonators. The band gap behavior of these structures allows for a resonator with mode selectivity based on frequency. We present results from the first tunable PBG resonator, a proof-of-concept design with a footprint compatible with axion haloscopes. We have thoroughly characterized the tuning range of two versions of the structure and report the successful confinement of the operating TM₀₁₀ (transverse magnetic) mode and the elimination of all transverse electric modes within the tuning range.
articles.abstract_zh: 轴子是一个理论上很有吸引力的暗物质候选粒子，卤代镜实验通过测量轴子在强磁场中转化产生的光子信号来进行探测。作者提出并实现了首个可调谐光子带隙谐振器，其尺寸适用于轴子探测实验。实验表明，该结构能够在调谐范围内有效约束工作 TM010 模式，并排除所有横向电模式。
authors: Samantha M. Lewis, Dillon T. Goulart, Mirelys Carcana Barbosa, Shriram Jois, Alexander F. Leder, Aarav M. Sindhwad, Isabella Urdinaran, Karl van Bibber
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轴子是一种理论依据充分的暗物质候选粒子。卤代镜实验旨在通过测量轴子与强磁场相互作用所产生的光子信号，探测银河晕中的轴子。现有卤代镜实验主要针对能够产生微波频段光子的轴子质量，并依靠微波谐振器增强信号功率。只有一小部分谐振器模式适用于这一过程，而当前的圆柱形腔体会受到其他基模引起的模式混合和模式拥挤影响。利用光子带隙（PBG）谐振器可以消除其中大多数模式。这些结构的带隙特性使谐振器能够根据频率进行模式选择。我们给出了首个可调谐 PBG 谐振器的结果，这是一种占地尺寸与轴子卤代镜实验兼容的概念验证设计。我们对该结构的两个版本的调谐范围进行了全面表征，并报告了成功约束工作 TM010（横向磁）模式，以及在整个调谐范围内消除所有横向电模式的结果。

articles.title: Fault-tolerant hyper-Ramsey spectroscopy of ultra-narrow clock transitions with dynamical decoupling
articles.title_zh: 利用动力学解耦实现超窄钟跃迁的容错超拉姆齐光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.23091v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A probe laser field that interrogates an atomic transition also shifts it. Although Hyper-Ramsey (HR) spectroscopy was developed to mitigate these light-induced frequency shifts, the technique remains sensitive to probe intensity fluctuations. In this work, we introduce a novel class of dynamically decoupled hyper-Ramsey (DDHR) sequences that utilize a modified refocusing pulse to effectively eliminate this residual sensitivity. This three-pulse interferometric protocol significantly enhances the contrast of quantum interference fringes while providing robust immunity against probe-induced frequency shifts, even in the presence of external field inhomogeneities. We experimentally validate both HR and DDHR protocols on the NQCH and textcolorblueIQM superconducting quantum processor, demonstrating an error scaling that is rigorously consistent with theoretical simulations of the optical clock regime. DDHR spectroscopy yields superior suppression of residual probe-induced frequency shifts compared to the standard HR scheme under probe amplitude fluctuation and decoherence. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the implementation of composite refocusing pulses, derived from a Pascal binomial tree architecture, gives substantial resilience against technical pulse area imperfections. Ultimately, fault-tolerant, dynamically decoupled hyper-clocks will offer a promising experimental platform for the evaluation of advanced, NMR-inspired DDHR sequences of multiple refocusing pulses holding significant potential for high-precision matter/antimatter quantum sensing and rigorous tests of fundamental physics within harsh electromagnetic environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 探测原子跃迁的激光场也会引起跃迁频移。作者提出了一类采用改进重聚焦脉冲的动力学解耦超拉姆齐（DDHR）序列，以消除对探测光强度波动的残余敏感性。实验结果表明，DDHR 能在外场不均匀和退相干条件下更有效地抑制探测光诱导的频移，并通过复合重聚焦脉冲增强对脉冲面积误差的容忍度。
authors: B. Ilikj, T. Zanon-Willette, D. Wilkowski, B. Darquié, N. V. Vitanov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 用于探测原子跃迁的探测激光场也会使该跃迁发生频移。尽管超拉姆齐（HR）光谱技术被用于减弱光诱导频移，但该技术仍然对探测光强度波动敏感。在本工作中，我们提出了一类新的动力学解耦超拉姆齐（DDHR）序列，该序列采用改进的重聚焦脉冲，从而有效消除这种残余敏感性。这种三脉冲干涉协议能够显著提高量子干涉条纹的对比度，同时对探测光诱导的频移具有稳健的免疫能力，即使存在外部场不均匀性也是如此。我们在 NQCH 和标记为 IQM 的超导量子处理器上对 HR 和 DDHR 协议进行了实验验证，证明其误差标度与光学时钟体系理论模拟严格一致。在探测光振幅波动和退相干条件下，与标准 HR 方案相比，DDHR 光谱能够更好地抑制残余探测光诱导频移。此外，我们还证明，采用由帕斯卡二项式树架构导出的复合重聚焦脉冲，可以显著增强系统对技术性脉冲面积误差的鲁棒性。最终，容错的动力学解耦超精密时钟将为评估先进的、受 NMR 启发的多重重聚焦脉冲 DDHR 序列提供有前景的实验平台，并有望应用于高精度物质/反物质量子传感，以及在严苛电磁环境中对基础物理学进行严格检验。

articles.title: Efficient Computation of Stellarator Coils with an Augmented Lagrangian Optimization Method
articles.title_zh: 利用增广拉格朗日优化方法高效计算仿星器线圈
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.12681v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Finding feasible coils for stellarator fusion devices is a critical challenge of realizing this concept for future power plants. Current design efforts struggle to navigate the highly nonconvex optimization landscape, spend considerable resources scanning the parameter space, and may produce suboptimal coils. In this work, we present an augmented Lagrangian approach to tackle the ill-posed problem of coil optimization. We illustrate its effectiveness and versatility by generating coils for five stellarators with very different symmetries and magnetic field shaping. In all cases, we find Pareto-optimal coil solutions that in various ways outperform published coil sets.
articles.abstract_zh: 为仿星器聚变装置寻找可行线圈是实现未来聚变电站概念的关键挑战。作者提出一种增广拉格朗日方法，用于处理线圈优化中的病态和高度非凸问题。针对具有不同对称性和磁场塑形特征的五种仿星器，该方法均获得了帕累托最优线圈解，并在多个方面优于已发表的线圈集合。
authors: Pedro F. Gil, Weiping Li, Julianne Stratton, Alan A. Kaptanoglu, Eve V. Stenson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为仿星器聚变装置寻找可行线圈，是实现这一未来聚变电站概念的关键挑战。当前的设计工作难以在高度非凸的优化景观中进行有效搜索，需要投入大量资源扫描参数空间，并且可能得到次优线圈。在本工作中，我们提出一种增广拉格朗日方法，用于处理线圈优化这一病态问题。我们通过为五种具有显著不同对称性和磁场塑形特征的仿星器生成线圈，展示了该方法的有效性和多样适用性。在所有情况下，我们都找到了帕累托最优的线圈解，并且这些解以不同方式优于已发表的线圈集合。

articles.title: Matrix-free algorithms for fast ab initio calculations on distributed CPU architectures using finite-element discretization
articles.title_zh: 利用有限元离散在分布式 CPU 架构上进行快速第一性原理计算的无矩阵算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.08571v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Finite-element (FE) discretisations have emerged as a powerful real-space alternative to large-scale Kohn-Sham density functional theory (DFT) calculations, offering systematic convergence, excellent parallel scalability, while accommodating generic boundary conditions. However, the dominant computational bottleneck in FE-based DFT arises from the repeated application of the discretised sparse Hamiltonian to large blocks of trial vectors during iterations in an iterative eigensolver. Traditional sparse matrix-vector multiplications and FE cell-matrix approaches encounter memory limitations and high data-movement overheads, particularly at higher polynomial orders, typically used in DFT calculations. To overcome these challenges, this work develops matrix-free algorithms for FE-discretised DFT that substantially accelerate these products by doing on-the-fly operations that utilize structured tensor contractions over 1D basis functions and quadrature data. A unified multilevel batched data layout that handles both real and complex-valued operators is introduced to maximise cache reuse and SIMD utilisation on Frontier (AVX2), Param Pravega (AVX512) and Fugaku (SVE). We also combine terms for optimal cache reuse, even-odd decomposition to reduce FLOP, and mixed-precision intrinsics. Extensive benchmarks show that for large multivector pseudopotential DFT calculations, the matrix-free kernels deliver 1.5-4x speedups over the state-of-the-art cell-matrix approach baselines. For all-electron DFT calculations, the matrix-free operator achieves gains of up to 5.8x due to its efficient implementation and superior arithmetic intensity. When integrated with an error-tolerant Chebyshev-filtered subspace iteration eigensolver, the matrix-free formalism yields substantial reductions in end-to-end time-to-solution using FE meshes that deliver desired accuracies in ground-state properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 有限元离散已成为大规模 Kohn–Sham 密度泛函理论计算的有力实空间替代方案，但其主要瓶颈是迭代本征求解过程中对大批量试探向量反复施加离散稀疏哈密顿量。作者提出无矩阵有限元 DFT 算法，利用一维基函数和求积数据上的结构化张量收缩进行即时计算，从而减少内存和数据移动开销。在多种超级计算机架构上，算法相较单元矩阵方法取得了1.5至4倍的加速；全电子 DFT 中最高加速达到5.8倍。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有限元（FE）离散已经成为大规模 Kohn–Sham 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算的一种强大实空间替代方案，具有可系统收敛、良好的并行扩展性以及支持通用边界条件等优点。然而，在基于有限元的 DFT 中，主要计算瓶颈来自迭代本征求解器在迭代过程中反复将离散稀疏哈密顿量作用于大批量试探向量。传统的稀疏矩阵-向量乘法和有限元单元矩阵方法会受到内存限制和较高的数据移动开销影响，尤其是在 DFT 计算通常采用的较高多项式阶数下。为克服这些挑战，本工作为有限元离散 DFT 开发了无矩阵算法，通过利用一维基函数和求积数据上的结构化张量收缩进行即时运算，显著加速这些乘积操作。我们引入统一的多层次批处理数据布局，同时处理实值和复值算子，以在 Frontier（AVX2）、Param Pravega（AVX512）和 Fugaku（SVE）平台上最大化缓存复用和 SIMD 利用率。我们还结合了用于优化缓存复用的项合并、用于减少浮点运算量的奇偶分解，以及混合精度内在函数。大量基准测试表明，对于大规模多向量赝势 DFT 计算，无矩阵内核相较当前最先进的单元矩阵方法基线可实现1.5至4倍加速。对于全电子 DFT，无矩阵算子凭借高效实现和更高的算术强度，最高可获得5.8倍的性能提升。当与具有误差容忍能力的 Chebyshev 滤波子空间迭代本征求解器集成后，无矩阵形式在能够达到基态性质所需精度的有限元网格上，显著减少了端到端求解时间。

articles.title: Optimization of Cryogenic Detector Test Station by Rejecting Electromagnetic Interference
articles.title_zh: 通过抑制电磁干扰优化低温探测器测试台
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.03158v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report on the solution optimized for characterizing SNSPDs by rejecting electromagnetic interference (EMI) from various sources. The proposed readout method enhances measurement stability and enables reliable device characterization at low bias currents, where the signal-to-noise ratio is typically limited. By effectively suppressing EMI-induced noise, the method improves the ability to distinguish genuine detection events from spurious signals and reduces the effort required for data analysis. The approach has been applied to preliminary measurements of SNSPDs exposed to α particles emitted from a ²⁴¹Am source, demonstrating stable operation and clean signal acquisition. While a detailed study of α detection is underway, the method establishes a foundation for further characterization of SNSPDs with various incident particles. The demonstrated EMI rejection technique is expected to facilitate future research in particle detection and support ongoing SNSPD development for applications in nuclear and accelerator-based experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者报告了一种通过抑制多种来源的电磁干扰来优化超导纳米线单光子探测器（SNSPD）表征的方法。该读出方案提高了测量稳定性，使低偏置电流下的可靠器件表征成为可能，并有助于区分真实探测事件与伪信号。对接受 241Am 源发射 α 粒子照射的 SNSPD 进行初步测量表明，该方法能够实现稳定运行和洁净信号采集。
authors: Sangbaek Lee, Whitney Armstrong, Maximo DiPreta, Jacob Dulya, Valentine Novosad, Tomas Polakovic
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了一种通过抑制各种来源的电磁干扰（EMI）而优化的、用于表征超导纳米线单光子探测器（SNSPD）的解决方案。所提出的读出方法提高了测量稳定性，并能够在低偏置电流下可靠地表征器件；在低偏置电流下，信噪比通常受到限制。通过有效抑制电磁干扰引起的噪声，该方法提高了区分真实探测事件与伪信号的能力，并减少了数据分析所需的工作量。该方法已应用于 SNSPD 的初步测量，器件接受了 241Am 源发射的 α 粒子照射，结果显示出稳定运行和洁净的信号采集。尽管针对 α 粒子探测的详细研究仍在进行中，该方法为进一步表征不同入射粒子作用下的 SNSPD 奠定了基础。所展示的电磁干扰抑制技术有望促进未来的粒子探测研究，并支持 SNSPD 在核实验和加速器实验中的持续发展。

articles.title: Deterministic and probabilistic neural surrogates of global hybrid-Vlasov simulations
articles.title_zh: 全局混合 Vlasov 模拟的确定性与概率性神经代理模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.12614v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Hybrid-Vlasov simulations resolve ion-kinetic effects in the solar wind-magnetosphere interaction, but even 5D (2D + 3V) configurations are computationally expensive. We show that graph-based machine learning emulators can learn the spatiotemporal evolution of electromagnetic fields and lower-order moments of the ion velocity distribution function in near-Earth space from four 5D Vlasiator runs, each driven by steady solar wind conditions. The upstream ion number density is systematically varied between the runs, while the grid spacing is held constant, to scan the ratio of ion inertial length to grid size. Using a graph neural network (GNN) operating on the 2D spatial simulation grid comprising 670k cells, we demonstrate that both a deterministic forecasting model (Graph-FM) and a probabilistic ensemble forecasting model (Graph-EFM) based on a latent variable formulation produce accurate predictions of future plasma states. A divergence penalty is incorporated to encourage divergence-freeness in the magnetic fields. For the probabilistic model, a continuous ranked probability score objective is added to improve the calibration of the ensemble forecasts. In terms of wall time per output step, the trained emulators run over two orders of magnitude faster on a single GPU than the Vlasiator simulations on 100 CPUs. Most forecasted fields have Pearson correlations above 0.95 at 50 seconds lead time. Fields that exhibit degenerate (near-zero) distributions in the 5D setting are more challenging for the emulator to keep well correlated. The ensemble forecasts remain underdispersive, with spread-skill ratios of approximately 0.2-0.3, and thus provide spatially structured relative uncertainty estimates. Overall, these results demonstrate that GNNs provide a viable framework for rapid ensemble generation in hybrid-Vlasov modeling and highlight promising directions for future work.
articles.abstract_zh: 混合 Vlasov 模拟能够解析太阳风—磁层相互作用中的离子动力学效应，但即使采用二维空间加三维速度的五维配置，计算成本仍然很高。作者利用基于图的机器学习模型，从四次不同上游离子数密度驱动的五维 Vlasiator 模拟中学习近地空间电磁场和离子速度分布函数低阶矩的时空演化。确定性和概率性图神经网络代理模型在单个 GPU 上的每步输出耗时比100个 CPU 上的原始模拟快两个数量级以上，并在50秒预报时长下对多数场取得超过0.95的 Pearson 相关系数。
authors: Daniel Holmberg, Ivan Zaitsev, Markku Alho, Ioanna Bouri, Fanni Franssila, Haewon Jeong, Minna Palmroth, Teemu Roos
articles.abstract_zh_full: 混合 Vlasov 模拟能够解析太阳风与磁层相互作用中的离子动力学效应，但即使采用五维（二维空间加三维速度，2D + 3V）配置，计算成本仍然十分高昂。我们展示了基于图的机器学习仿真器能够从四次五维 Vlasiator 运行中学习近地空间电磁场以及离子速度分布函数低阶矩的时空演化，这四次运行均由稳态太阳风条件驱动。我们系统改变运行之间的上游离子数密度，同时保持网格间距不变，以扫描离子惯性长度与网格尺寸之比。我们使用作用于包含67万个网格单元的二维空间模拟网格上的图神经网络（GNN），证明确定性预报模型 Graph-FM 和基于潜变量形式的概率性集成预报模型 Graph-EFM 均能够准确预测未来等离子体状态。模型中加入了散度惩罚项，以促使磁场保持无散。对于概率模型，我们还加入连续秩概率评分（CRPS）目标，以改善集成预报的校准。在每个输出步的墙钟时间方面，训练完成的仿真器在单个 GPU 上的运行速度比使用100个 CPU 的 Vlasiator 模拟快两个数量级以上。在提前50秒进行预报时，大多数预报场的 Pearson 相关系数超过0.95。对于在五维设置中呈现退化分布（接近零分布）的场，仿真器更难以维持较高相关性。集成预报仍然表现为离散度不足，其 spread-skill 比约为0.2至0.3，因此只能提供具有空间结构的相对不确定性估计。总体而言，这些结果表明，图神经网络为混合 Vlasov 建模中的快速集成生成提供了可行框架，并指出了未来研究方向。

articles.title: Two-photon-excited fluorescence spectroscopy of Rb atoms in a magneto-optical trap
articles.title_zh: 磁光阱中铷原子的双光子激发荧光光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.07161v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report the results of two-photon-excited fluorescence (TPEF) measurements of the 5S₁/₂ i̊ghtarrow 5D₅/₂ transition of ⁸⁵Rb and ⁸⁷Rb cooled in a magneto-optical trap (MOT). We observe TPEF at excitation powers as low as 1 μW or fluxes as low as 2.98₋₀.₉₄⁺¹.³⁷ × 10¹⁸ photons,cm⁻²,s⁻¹ (⁸⁵Rb) and 3.31₋₁.₃₃⁺².²¹ × 10¹⁸ photons,cm⁻²,s⁻¹ (⁸⁷Rb). Our results demonstrate that optically cooled Rb is a promising platform for observing sensitive two-photon spectral signatures at low photon fluxes.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者报告了在磁光阱中冷却的 85Rb 和 87Rb 原子从 5S1/2 到 5D5/2 跃迁的双光子激发荧光（TPEF）测量结果。实验在低至1 μW的激发功率或约 2.98×10¹⁸ 至 3.31×10¹⁸ photons·cm−2·s−1 的光子通量下观测到 TPEF。结果表明，光学冷却的铷原子可作为在低光子通量下观测灵敏双光子光谱信号的平台。
authors: Alan McLean, Christian Drago, Daniel Podos, Chengyi Luo, Caleb Brzezinski, Ting-Wei Hsu, John Sipe, Ralph Jimenez
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了在磁光阱（MOT）中冷却的 85Rb 和 87Rb 原子从 5S1/2 到 5D5/2 跃迁的双光子激发荧光（TPEF）测量结果。在低至1 μW的激发功率下，我们观测到了 TPEF；对应的光子通量分别低至 2.98+1.37−0.94 × 10¹⁸ photons·cm−2·s−1（85Rb）和 3.31+2.21−1.33 × 10¹⁸ photons·cm−2·s−1（87Rb）。我们的结果表明，光学冷却的铷原子是观测低光子通量下灵敏双光子光谱特征的有前景平台。

articles.title: Quantum-corrected NMR crystallography at scale
articles.title_zh: 大规模量子修正核磁共振晶体学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.06236v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Structure determination by chemical-shift-driven NMR crystallography relies on comparing chemical shieldings measured in solid-state NMR experiments with simulations. However, computational cost limits the accuracy of shielding predictions, that usually rely on low-level electronic-structure approximations and neglect thermal and quantum mechanical nuclear motion, leading to large errors, especially for highly informative hydrogen-bonded protons. To address these limitations, we introduce a quantum-nuclei-corrected (QNC-NMR) approach. We generate inexpensively quantum ensembles using PET-MOLS, a novel machine-learning learning model of the interatomic potential transferable across molecular crystals. Using them as inputs to a chemical-shift model results in a 33 % improvement of the agreement with experiments for hydrogen-bonded protons, without the need for empirical corrections. The ability to sample structures consistent with the experimental conditions enables further refinement of the shielding model by finetuning it against measured shieldings. The favorable scaling with system size allows similar improvements for amorphous materials that are otherwise inaccessible to explicit DFT simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出量子核修正核磁共振晶体学（QNC-NMR）方法，以处理化学位移驱动的 NMR 晶体学中热运动和量子核运动造成的误差。该方法利用可迁移于分子晶体的机器学习原子间势 PET-MOLS 高效生成量子系综，使氢键质子的实验符合度提高33%。该方法还可根据实验屏蔽值微调模型，并由于具有良好的体系规模扩展性而适用于非晶材料。
authors: Matthias Kellner, Ruben Rodriguez-Madrid, Jacob B. Holmes, Victor Paul Principe, Seio Inoue, Lyndon Emsley, Michele Ceriotti
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于化学位移驱动的 NMR 晶体学通过比较固态 NMR 实验测得的化学屏蔽与模拟结果来确定结构。然而，计算成本限制了屏蔽预测的精度；这类预测通常依赖低水平的电子结构近似，并忽略热运动和量子力学核运动，因此会产生较大误差，尤其是在信息量很高的氢键质子方面。为解决这些限制，我们提出量子核修正（QNC-NMR）方法。我们利用 PET-MOLS（一种可迁移到不同分子晶体的原子间势机器学习模型）低成本地生成量子系综。将这些系综作为化学位移模型的输入后，在不需要经验修正的情况下，氢键质子与实验结果的一致性提高了33%。生成与实验条件相符的结构样本，还使得能够根据实测屏蔽值对屏蔽模型进行进一步微调。该方法对体系尺寸具有良好的扩展性，因此也能将类似的改进应用于通常无法通过显式 DFT 模拟处理的非晶材料。

articles.title: Patched-Wall Quasistatic Cavity Resonators for 3-D Wireless Power Transfer
articles.title_zh: 用于三维无线能量传输的贴壁式准静态腔体谐振器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.26636v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Traditional wireless power transfer (WPT) systems are largely limited to 1-D charging pads or 2-D charging surfaces and therefore do not support a truly ubiquitous device-powering experience. Although room-scale WPT based on multimode quasistatic cavity resonance (QSCR) has demonstrated full-volume coverage by leveraging multiple resonant modes, existing high-coverage implementations require obstructive internal conductive structures, such as a central pole. Here, we present a new structure, termed the patched-wall QSCR, that eliminates such internal obstructions while preserving full-volume coverage. By using conductive wall segments interconnected by capacitors, the proposed structure supports two complementary resonant modes that cover both the peripheral and central regions without obstructions within the charging volume. Electromagnetic simulations show that, by selectively exciting these two resonant modes, the proposed structure achieves a minimum power-transfer efficiency of 48.1% throughout the evaluated interior volume of a 54m³ enclosure while preserving an unobstructed charging space.
articles.abstract_zh: 传统无线能量传输系统主要局限于一维充电垫或二维充电表面，难以实现真正的全方位设备供电。作者提出贴壁式准静态腔体谐振器，通过电容器连接的导电壁段支持两种互补谐振模式，在移除内部导电障碍物的同时覆盖充电空间的外围和中心区域。电磁仿真表明，在体积为54 m³的腔体内部，该结构在评估区域内实现了48.1%的最低功率传输效率。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 传统的无线能量传输（WPT）系统在很大程度上局限于一维充电垫或二维充电表面，因此无法支持真正无处不在的设备供电体验。尽管基于多模准静态腔体谐振（QSCR）的房间尺度 WPT 通过利用多个谐振模式实现了全体积覆盖，但现有的高覆盖率实现方案需要使用具有阻碍作用的内部导电结构，例如中心柱。在此，我们提出一种称为贴壁式 QSCR 的新结构，在保留全体积覆盖能力的同时消除了这类内部障碍物。该结构利用由电容器互相连接的导电壁段，支持两种互补的谐振模式；通过这两种模式，可以分别覆盖外围区域和中心区域，同时使充电体积内部保持无障碍。电磁仿真表明，通过选择性激发这两种谐振模式，所提出的结构在一个体积为54 m³的封闭空间评估内部区域中实现了48.1%的最低功率传输效率，同时保留了无障碍的充电空间。

articles.title: Hierarchical resonators for localized charging in room-scale magnetoquasistatic wireless power systems
articles.title_zh: 用于室尺度磁准静态无线电力系统局部充电的分层谐振器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.27305v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetoquasistatic wireless power transfer can deliver substantial power to mobile devices over near-field links. Room-scale implementations, such as quasistatic cavity resonators, extend this capability over large enclosed volumes, but their efficiency drops sharply for centimeter-scale or misoriented receivers because the magnetic field is spatially broad and weakly coupled to small coils. Here, we introduce hierarchical resonators that act as selectively activated relays within a room-scale quasistatic cavity resonator, coupling to the ambient magnetic field and re-emitting a stronger local field near a target receiver. This architecture enables localized power delivery to miniature devices without requiring global reshaping of the room-scale cavity mode. Experimentally, the hierarchical link improves power transfer efficiency by more than two orders of magnitude relative to direct room-scale transfer and delivers up to 500 mW of DC power to a 15 mm receiver. We further demonstrate selective multi-relay operation and field reorientation for furniture-embedded charging scenarios. These results establish a scalable route to reconfigurable wireless power delivery for miniature and batteryless devices in room-scale environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 磁准静态无线电力传输能够通过近场链路为移动设备提供较大功率，但室尺度系统对厘米级或方向偏转的接收器效率较低。本文提出分层谐振器，将其作为室尺度准静态腔体谐振器中的选择性激活中继，在目标接收器附近重新辐射更强的局部磁场。实验表明，该架构相较直接室尺度传输可将功率传输效率提高两个数量级以上，并能为15毫米接收器提供最高500毫瓦直流功率。
authors: Takuya Sasatani, Alanson P. Sample, Yoshihiro Kawahara
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁准静态无线电力传输能够通过近场链路向移动设备提供较大功率。室尺度实现方式，例如准静态腔体谐振器，可以将这一能力扩展到大型封闭空间，但对于厘米级或方向偏转的接收器，其效率会急剧下降，因为磁场在空间中分布广泛，且与小型线圈的耦合较弱。在此，我们提出分层谐振器，将其作为室尺度准静态腔体谐振器中的选择性激活中继，使其与环境磁场耦合，并在目标接收器附近重新辐射更强的局部磁场。该架构无需对室尺度腔体模态进行全局重塑，即可实现对微型设备的局部供电。在实验中，与直接室尺度传输相比，分层链路将功率传输效率提高了两个数量级以上，并向一个直径15毫米的接收器提供了最高500毫瓦的直流功率。我们进一步展示了选择性多中继运行以及磁场重新定向能力，适用于嵌入家具的充电场景。这些结果为在室尺度环境中向微型及无电池设备提供可重构无线电力传输建立了一条可扩展路径。

articles.title: Cherenkov and scintillation light separation in BGO and BSO crystals coupled to SiPMs for dual-readout electromagnetic calorimetry at future colliders
articles.title_zh: 用于未来对撞机双读出电磁量能器的BGO和BSO晶体中切伦科夫光与闪烁光的分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.09918v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report on the separation of Cherenkov and scintillation light in BGO and BSO crystals read out with silicon photomultipliers (SiPMs). The two light components are disentangled on an event-by-event basis by combining optical filtering with waveform template fitting, exploiting their distinct spectral and temporal characteristics. Measurements were carried out using high-energy muon and positron beams at the CERN SPS North Area, demonstrating Cherenkov yields of up to sim150 ph.e./GeV in electromagnetic showers. This work provides the first demonstration of Cherenkov-scintillation separation in BGO and BSO crystals with SiPM readout, supporting the use of this technology as a building block for a dual-readout electromagnetic calorimeter, as foreseen in the IDEA detector concept for a future e⁺e⁻ Higgs factory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了使用硅光电倍增管读取BGO和BSO晶体时，对切伦科夫光与闪烁光进行分离的研究。研究结合光学滤波和波形模板拟合，利用两类光在光谱和时间特性上的差异实现逐事件分离。基于CERN SPS北区的高能缪子束和正电子束测量，电磁簇射中的切伦科夫光产额最高达到约150光电子/GeV，为未来正负电子希格斯工厂的双读出电磁量能器提供了技术依据。
authors: M. Alviggi, B. Argiento, E. Auffray, A. Benaglia, M. Biasini, V. Bisignani, D. Boccanfuso, L. Borriello, M. Campajola, C. Cecchi, F. Cirotto, F. Conventi, A. D'Avanzo, J. Delenne, G. De Nardo, C. Di Fraia, A. D'Onofrio, L. Favilla, M. Francesconi, G. Gaudino, A. O. M. Iorio, V. Izzo, M. T. Lucchini, E. Manoni, M. Mirra, S. Moneta, P. Paolucci, S. Perna, B. Rossi, E. Rossi, J. Scamardella, G. Sekhniaidze
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了使用硅光电倍增管读取BGO和BSO晶体时对切伦科夫光与闪烁光进行分离的研究。通过结合光学滤波与波形模板拟合，并利用这两种光在光谱和时间特性上的差异，我们在逐事件层面将两种光成分解耦。测量工作使用CERN SPS北区的高能缪子束和正电子束完成，结果表明，电磁簇射中的切伦科夫光产额最高可达约150光电子/GeV。这项工作首次展示了在采用硅光电倍增管读出的BGO和BSO晶体中实现切伦科夫光与闪烁光分离，为将该技术用作双读出电磁量能器的构建模块提供了支持；这种量能器正是未来正负电子希格斯工厂IDEA探测器概念所设想的方案。

articles.title: Small but Tubby: A Magnetic Loop Antenna Made from 100 mm Copper Tubing
articles.title_zh: 小巧但粗壮：采用100毫米铜管制作的磁环天线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10828v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper presents the electrical model, key equations, and practical construction of a small transmitting magnetic loop antenna built from unusually large 100 mm diameter copper tubing. The large conductor surface area and wide-area transitions to the vacuum capacitors were designed to minimize resistive losses. The frequency range from 1.8 MHz to 31 MHz is unusually wide. Frequency, impedance matching, and azimuth are all adjusted automatically by servo motors. Indoor losses originate predominantly from near-field coupling to the environment rather than from the antenna itself. Temperature-rise measurements confirm that the bulk of the dissipated power is absorbed by the environment, not by the antenna components. The conducted H-field measurements demonstrate good agreement between the measured H-field and the theoretical free-space H-field calculated from the antenna geometry and an estimated loop current. The loop current was estimated from the measured antenna bandwidth and the applied transmit power. The antenna was developed for indoor operation where outdoor installation is not possible.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一种采用直径100毫米铜管构建的小型发射磁环天线的电学模型、关键方程和实际制造方法。大导体表面积以及与真空电容器之间的宽面积过渡结构用于降低电阻损耗，天线工作频率范围为1.8至31 MHz，并可通过伺服电机自动调节频率、阻抗匹配和方位角。测量表明，室内损耗主要来自天线与环境的近场耦合，而非天线本身，实测磁场也与理论自由空间磁场较好吻合。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文介绍了一种采用不同寻常的直径100毫米铜管制作的小型发射磁环天线，包括其电学模型、关键方程和实际构造方法。较大的导体表面积以及与真空电容器之间的宽面积过渡结构，旨在将电阻损耗降至最低。其工作频率范围为1.8 MHz至31 MHz，频带异常宽广。频率、阻抗匹配和方位角均通过伺服电机自动调节。室内损耗主要源于天线与环境之间的近场耦合，而不是天线本身。温升测量证实，所耗散功率的绝大部分被环境吸收，而不是由天线部件吸收。对磁场的传导测量表明，实测磁场与根据天线几何结构和估算环路电流计算得到的理论自由空间磁场吻合良好。环路电流是根据实测天线带宽和施加的发射功率估算得到的。该天线是为无法进行室外安装的室内运行场景开发的。

articles.title: Online design of dynamic networks
articles.title_zh: 动态网络的在线设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.08875v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Designing a network (e.g., a telecommunication or transport network) is mainly done offline, in a planning phase, prior to the operation of the network. On the other hand, a massive effort has been devoted to characterizing dynamic networks, i.e., those that evolve over time. The novelty of this paper is that we introduce a method for the online design of dynamic networks. The need to do so emerges when a network needs to operate in a dynamic and stochastic environment. In this case, one may wish to build a network over time, on the fly, in order to react to the changes of the environment and to keep certain performance targets. We tackle this online design problem with a rolling horizon optimization based on Monte Carlo Tree Search. The potential of online network design is showcased for the design of a futuristic dynamic public transport network, where bus lines are constructed on the fly to better adapt to a stochastic user demand. In such a scenario, we compare our results with state-of-the-art dynamic vehicle routing problem (VRP) resolution methods, simulating requests from a New York City taxi dataset. Differently from classic VRP methods, that extend vehicle trajectories in isolation, our method enables us to build a structured network of line buses, where complex user journeys are possible, thus increasing system performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 网络设计通常在线路运行前的规划阶段离线完成，而动态网络会随时间演化并受到随机环境影响。本文提出一种基于滚动时域优化和蒙特卡洛树搜索的动态网络在线设计方法，使网络能够按需逐步构建并维持性能目标。以未来动态公共交通网络为例，实验表明，该方法能够在线构建公交线路以适应随机需求，并形成支持复杂换乘行程的结构化线路网络，从而提升系统性能。
authors: Duo Wang, Andrea Araldo, Mounim El Yacoubi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 网络设计，例如电信网络或交通网络的设计，主要在网络运行之前的规划阶段离线完成。另一方面，人们已经投入了大量工作来刻画动态网络，即那些随时间演化的网络。本文的创新之处在于提出一种动态网络的在线设计方法。当网络需要在动态且随机的环境中运行时，就会产生进行在线设计的需求。在这种情况下，人们可能希望随着时间推移、即时地构建网络，以响应环境变化并维持特定的性能目标。我们采用基于蒙特卡洛树搜索的滚动时域优化来处理这一在线设计问题。我们以一种未来式动态公共交通网络的设计为例展示在线网络设计的潜力：在该场景中，公交线路根据随机用户需求动态构建，以实现更好的适应性。针对这一场景，我们使用来自纽约市出租车数据集的请求进行仿真，并将结果与当前最先进的动态车辆路径问题求解方法进行比较。不同于经典车辆路径问题方法分别独立延伸车辆轨迹，我们的方法能够构建结构化的公交线路网络，使复杂的用户出行路径成为可能，从而提高系统性能。

articles.title: Rapid Manufacturing of Lightweight Drone Frames Using Single-Tow Architected Composites
articles.title_zh: 采用单束架构复合材料快速制造轻量化无人机机架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.09024v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The demand for lightweight and high-strength composite structures is rapidly growing in aerospace and robotics, particularly for optimized drone frames. However, conventional composite manufacturing methods struggle to achieve complex 3D architectures for weight savings and rely on assembling separate components, which introduce weak points at the joints. Additionally, maintaining continuous fiber reinforcement remains challenging, limiting structural efficiency. In this study, we demonstrate the lightweight Face Centered Cubic (FFC) lattice structured conceptualization of drone frames for weight reduction and complex topology fabrication through 3D Fiber Tethering (3DFiT) using continuous single tow fiber ensuring precise fiber alignment, eliminating weak points associated with traditional composite assembly. Mechanical testing demonstrates that the fabricated drone frame exhibits a high specific strength of around four to eight times the metal and thermoplastic, outperforming other conventional 3D printing methods. The drone frame weighs only 260 g, making it 10% lighter than the commercial DJI F450 frame, enhancing structural integrity and contributing to an extended flight time of three minutes, while flight testing confirms its stability and durability under operational conditions. The findings demonstrate the potential of single tow lattice truss-based drone frames, with 3DFiT serving as a scalable and efficient manufacturing method.
articles.abstract_zh: 航空航天和机器人领域对轻质高强复合结构的需求不断增长，但传统复合材料制造方法难以实现复杂三维结构，并且分体组装会在连接处引入薄弱点。本文通过三维纤维系留技术，利用连续的单束纤维制造面心立方晶格结构的无人机机架，实现精确纤维对齐并减少装配弱点。制造出的机架质量为260克，比商用DJI F450机架轻10%，比金属和热塑性材料具有约4至8倍的更高比强度，并在飞行测试中表现出稳定性和耐久性。
authors: Md Habib Ullah Khan, Kaiyue Deng, Ismail Mujtaba Khan, Kelvin Fu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 航空航天和机器人领域，尤其是经过优化的无人机机架，对轻质高强度复合材料结构的需求正在迅速增长。然而，传统复合材料制造方法难以实现复杂的三维架构以减轻重量，并且依赖于独立部件的组装，这会在连接处引入薄弱点。此外，保持连续纤维增强仍然具有挑战性，从而限制了结构效率。在本研究中，我们通过三维纤维系留技术，展示了用于减重和复杂拓扑结构制造的轻量化面心立方晶格结构无人机机架概念；该技术使用连续的单束纤维，确保纤维精确对齐，并消除了传统复合材料组装所带来的薄弱点。力学测试表明，所制造的无人机机架具有较高的比强度，约为金属和热塑性材料的4至8倍，性能优于其他传统三维打印方法。该无人机机架仅重260克，比商用DJI F450机架轻10%，从而增强了结构完整性，并使飞行时间延长了三分钟；飞行测试进一步证实了其在运行条件下的稳定性和耐久性。研究结果表明，基于单束纤维晶格桁架的无人机机架具有应用潜力，而三维纤维系留技术可作为一种可扩展且高效的制造方法。

articles.title: HIP: Hessian Interatomic Potentials without derivatives
articles.title_zh: HIP：无需求导的海森矩阵原子间势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.21624v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Molecular Hessians, the second derivatives of the potential energy, are fundamental to many workflows in computational chemistry. Usually, accurate Hessians are computationally expensive to calculate and scale poorly with system size, whether computed using quantum chemistry methods or machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). In this work, we introduce Hessian interatomic potentials (HIPs), a deep learning model that directly predicts Hessians without relying on automatic differentiation or finite differences. To do so, we construct SE(3)-equivariant, symmetric Hessians from irreducible representation (irrep) features up to degree l=2, computed by a graph neural network. HIP Hessians are one to two orders of magnitude faster, more accurate, more memory efficient, easier to train, and exhibit more favourable scaling with system size. We validate our predictions across a wide range of downstream tasks, demonstrating consistently superior performance in transition state search, geometry optimization, zero-point energy corrections, and vibrational analysis. We open-source the HIP code and model weights.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子海森矩阵是势能的二阶导数，对计算化学中的许多流程至关重要，但其计算成本高且随体系规模扩展性较差。本文提出海森矩阵原子间势HIP，一种无需自动微分或有限差分、能够直接预测海森矩阵的深度学习模型。HIP利用图神经网络计算的最高阶为l=2的SE(3)等变不可约表示特征构造对称海森矩阵，并在过渡态搜索、几何优化、零点能修正和振动分析等任务中展现出更快、更准确和更高效的性能。
authors: Andreas Burger, Luca Thiede, Nikolaj Rønne, Varinia Bernales, Nandita Vijaykumar, Tejs Vegge, Arghya Bhowmik, Alan Aspuru-Guzik
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子海森矩阵，即势能的二阶导数，是计算化学中许多工作流程的基础。通常，无论使用量子化学方法还是机器学习原子间势来计算精确海森矩阵，其计算成本都很高，并且难以随体系规模良好扩展。在本研究中，我们提出海森矩阵原子间势HIP，这是一种无需依赖自动微分或有限差分、能够直接预测海森矩阵的深度学习模型。为此，我们利用图神经网络计算的、最高阶数为l=2的SE(3)等变不可约表示特征，构造出具有对称性的海森矩阵。HIP预测的海森矩阵速度提高了一个至两个数量级，准确性更高，内存效率更好，训练更容易，并且随体系规模扩展时表现出更有利的复杂度。我们在广泛的下游任务中验证了预测结果，结果表明其在过渡态搜索、几何优化、零点能修正和振动分析方面始终具有更优性能。我们将公开HIP代码和模型权重。
articles.focus_summary: 本文提出 Hessian Interatomic Potentials，通过等变图神经网络直接预测分子 Hessian 矩阵，避免自动微分和有限差分。该模型在过渡态搜索、结构优化、零点能修正和振动分析等任务中表现出更高的速度、精度和内存效率。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的机器学习势、等变神经网络、分子动力学、声子和热输运方法高度相关。直接预测二阶导数的建模策略可用于加速声子计算、势能面分析、相变研究及材料动力学模拟。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议评估该方法在周期性固体、缺陷体系、铁电材料和磁性材料中的适用性，并考察其对声子频率、力常数和热输运性质的预测能力。进一步可将 Hessian 预测与机器学习 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量或自旋-晶格耦合模型结合。

articles.title: MeltwaterBench: Deep learning for spatiotemporal downscaling of surface meltwater
articles.title_zh: MeltwaterBench：用于地表融水时空降尺度的深度学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.12142v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Greenland ice sheet is melting at an accelerated rate due to processes that are not fully understood and hard to measure. The distribution of surface meltwater can help understand these processes and is observable through remote sensing, but current maps of meltwater face a trade-off: They are either high-resolution in time or space, but not both. We develop a deep learning model that creates gridded surface meltwater maps at daily 100m resolution by fusing data streams from remote sensing observations and physics-based models. In particular, we spatiotemporally downscale regional climate model (RCM) outputs using synthetic aperture radar (SAR), passive microwave (PMW), and a digital elevation model (DEM) over the Helheim Glacier in Eastern Greenland from 2017-2023. Using SAR-derived meltwater as "ground truth", we show that a deep learning-based method that fuses all data streams is over 10 percentage points more accurate over our study area than existing non deep learning-based approaches that only rely on a regional climate model (83% vs. 95% Acc.) or passive microwave observations (72% vs. 95% Acc.). Alternatively, creating a gridded product through a running window calculation with SAR data underestimates extreme melt events, but also achieves notable accuracy (90%) and does not rely on deep learning. We evaluate standard deep learning methods (UNet and DeepLabv3+), and publish our spatiotemporally aligned dataset as a benchmark, MeltwaterBench, for intercomparisons with more complex data-driven downscaling methods. The code and data are available at github.com/blutjens/hrmelt.
articles.abstract_zh: 由于尚未完全理解且难以测量的过程，格陵兰冰盖正在加速消融。本文开发了一种深度学习模型，融合遥感观测与基于物理的模型数据，生成每日100米分辨率的网格化地表融水图。以2017至2023年格陵兰东部海尔海姆冰川为研究区域，融合SAR、被动微波和数字高程模型数据的方法达到95%的准确率，优于仅依赖区域气候模型或被动微波观测的方法，并发布了用于比较研究的MeltwaterBench数据集。
authors: Björn Lütjens, Patrick Alexander, Raf Antwerpen, Til Widmann, Guido Cervone, Marco Tedesco
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于一些尚未被完全理解且难以测量的过程，格陵兰冰盖正在以加速的速率融化。地表融水的分布有助于理解这些过程，并且可以通过遥感观测，但当前的融水地图面临一种权衡：它们要么具有较高的时间分辨率，要么具有较高的空间分辨率，无法同时兼顾二者。我们开发了一种深度学习模型，通过融合遥感观测数据流与基于物理的模型数据流，生成每日100米分辨率的网格化地表融水地图。具体而言，我们利用2017年至2023年间格陵兰东部海尔海姆冰川区域的合成孔径雷达、被动微波和数字高程模型数据，对区域气候模型输出进行时空降尺度。我们以由合成孔径雷达得到的融水作为“真实值”表明，在研究区域内，融合全部数据流的深度学习方法准确率达到95%，比现有仅依赖区域气候模型的非深度学习方法高出超过10个百分点；后者的准确率为83%，而仅依赖被动微波观测的方法准确率为72%。另一种利用合成孔径雷达数据通过运行窗口计算生成网格化产品的方法会低估极端融化事件，但同样取得了值得注意的90%准确率，且不依赖深度学习。我们评估了标准深度学习方法UNet和DeepLabv3+，并发布了经过时空对齐的数据集MeltwaterBench，作为一个基准，用于与更复杂的数据驱动降尺度方法进行比较。代码和数据已公开发布。

articles.title: Approximate Homomorphisms and Convergent Representations in Transducers
articles.title_zh: 变换器中的近似同态与收敛表示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the stability of minimal representations of controlled stochastic processes (in particular, transducers) under perturbations. This question is motivated by recent experiments finding predictive-state structure in the latent representations of neural networks. We consider standard, linear and predictive transducers. We introduce notions of approximate homomorphism capturing local structural similarity between them, together with metrics comparing their induced dynamics (which we refer to as interfaces), and prove properties such as composability of the approximate homomorphisms. For standard transducers, we show that there exist simple interfaces for which there is no approximate homomorphism between the different implementations of the dynamics. In contrast, for every finite-rank interface mathcal I, we prove that all minimal linear transducers implementing interfaces sufficiently close to mathcal I have an approximate homomorphism to the minimal implementation of mathcal I, with error linear in the perturbation size. We prove an analogous stability result for predictive transducers under a residual metric using some mild hypothesis regarding the indistinguishability of the belief states. These results identify conditions under which canonical transducer representations are robust to perturbations, while showing that such convergence fails without additional structural restrictions. Under the assumption that these type of abstractions are embedded into the hidden layers of modern AI models, this gives some theoretical support to the hypothesis that their latent representations exhibit structural convergence.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究受扰动时受控随机过程，尤其是变换器的最小表示是否保持稳定。作者提出刻画局部结构相似性的近似同态概念，以及比较其诱导动力学的接口度量，并证明了近似同态的可组合性等性质。研究表明，有限秩接口下，充分接近的最小线性变换器具有误差与扰动规模线性相关的近似同态；类似结果也适用于满足一定条件的预测变换器，从而为人工智能模型潜在表示的结构收敛提供理论支持。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究受扰动时受控随机过程的最小表示的稳定性，尤其关注变换器。该问题的动机来自近期实验，这些实验在神经网络的潜在表示中发现了预测状态结构。我们考虑标准变换器、线性变换器和预测变换器。我们引入了刻画它们之间局部结构相似性的近似同态概念，同时引入了比较其诱导动力学的度量，并将这些动力学称为接口；我们还证明了近似同态的可组合性等性质。对于标准变换器，我们证明存在一些简单接口，使得不同动力学实现之间不存在近似同态。相比之下，对于每个有限秩接口I，我们证明所有实现了充分接近I的接口的最小线性变换器，都存在一个指向I的最小实现的近似同态，并且误差与扰动大小呈线性关系。对于预测变换器，在关于信念状态不可区分性的一个温和假设下，我们利用残差度量证明了类似的稳定性结果。这些结果确定了规范化变换器表示在何种条件下能够对扰动保持稳健，同时也表明，在没有额外结构限制时，这种收敛会失败。假设这类抽象被嵌入现代人工智能模型的隐藏层中，这些结果为如下假设提供了一定理论支持：它们的潜在表示会表现出结构收敛。

articles.title: Decision Tree and K-Means Analysis of Raman Spectra for Edible Oils: A Physics-Informed AI Approach
articles.title_zh: 食用油拉曼光谱的决策树与K均值分析：一种物理信息人工智能方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20440v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Authentication of edible oils in processed foods is important for food quality, fraud prevention, and regulatory compliance. This study establishes an integrated Raman spectroscopy and machine-learning framework that links intrinsic spectral organization, interpretable classification, and Physics-Informed Artificial Intelligence (PI-AI). Five edible oils were investigated in pure form and within a fried-potato-chip matrix using t-SNE, K-means clustering, Decision Trees, and Non-Negative Least Squares (NNLS)-based spectral decomposition. Unsupervised analyses revealed substantially stronger class organization and separability in pure oils, whereas food-matrix effects introduced pronounced spectral overlap. Decision Trees achieved 100% classification accuracy for pure oils using only four Raman variables from the original 1866-feature spectral space. These four variables, consistently identified by both pre-pruned and post-pruned models, represented only approximately 0.21% of the available spectral information while retaining perfect test-set performance. For matrix-containing samples, NNLS-based PI-AI spectral decomposition substantially improved classification by separating oil-related signatures from paper and potato contributions. Optimized post-pruned models achieved accuracies of 86.4% and 85.4% for paper-subtracted and paper-plus-potato-subtracted datasets, respectively, while reducing the number of important Raman variables to only five and four. The compact four-feature representation further reduced the data footprint by 99.44% without loss of classification accuracy. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that accurate Raman-based oil identification can be achieved through physically meaningful, highly compact, and interpretable spectral representations, providing a promising foundation for Frugal AI, Edge AI, portable sensing, and embedded food-quality monitoring.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个结合拉曼光谱与机器学习的食用油鉴别框架，用于食品质量控制、防欺诈和监管合规。研究对五种纯食用油及其在炸薯片基质中的样品，采用t-SNE、K均值聚类、决策树和基于非负最小二乘的光谱分解进行分析。纯油样品仅用原始1866个光谱特征中的4个变量即可实现100%的分类准确率；对于含食品基质的样品，物理信息人工智能光谱分解将准确率提高至85.4%至86.4%，并显著压缩了数据表示。
authors: Amrita Shaw, Chandrasekar S. N., Sai Muthukumar V., Jhinuk Gupta, Deepak L. N. Kallepalli
articles.abstract_zh_full: 加工食品中食用油的鉴别对于食品质量、欺诈防范和监管合规非常重要。本研究建立了一个集成拉曼光谱与机器学习的框架，将内在光谱组织、可解释分类和物理信息人工智能联系起来。研究考察了五种纯食用油以及存在于炸薯片基质中的这五种食用油，并使用t-SNE、K均值聚类、决策树和基于非负最小二乘的光谱分解进行分析。无监督分析表明，纯油中的类别组织和可分性明显更强，而食品基质效应引入了显著的光谱重叠。对于纯油，决策树仅使用原始1866维光谱空间中的4个拉曼变量，就达到了100%的分类准确率。这4个变量同时被预剪枝模型和后剪枝模型稳定识别出来，它们仅代表约0.21%的可用光谱信息，却保持了完美的测试集性能。对于含基质的样品，基于非负最小二乘的物理信息人工智能光谱分解通过分离与油相关的特征以及纸张和马铃薯的贡献，显著改善了分类效果。优化后的后剪枝模型在纸张扣除数据集和纸张加马铃薯扣除数据集上的准确率分别达到86.4%和85.4%，同时将重要拉曼变量的数量分别减少到仅5个和4个。紧凑的四特征表示在不损失分类准确率的情况下，进一步将数据规模减少了99.44%。总体而言，这些发现表明，基于拉曼光谱的食用油识别可以通过具有物理意义、高度紧凑且可解释的光谱表示来实现，为节俭型人工智能、边缘人工智能、便携式传感和嵌入式食品质量监测提供了有前景的基础。

articles.title: Trojaning the Alignment: Stealthy Backdoor Attacks against Graph Foundation Models
articles.title_zh: 劫持对齐机制：针对图基础模型的隐蔽后门攻击
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20991v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) align graph representations with language semantics to support transferable graph learning. Despite these advantages, the backdoor vulnerability of GFMs on TAGs remains insufficiently understood, especially under graph-language alignment, where graph and text representations are trained to constrain each other in a shared semantic space. Existing backdoor attacks mainly target either the graph side or the text side, treating the two modalities independently. This makes direct adaptation ineffective: graph-only triggers can be constrained by clean text semantics, while text-only triggers alter the language view but do not directly shift the graph representation being aligned and scored. TAGs also impose a stealth challenge because triggers are exposed as both node text and local graph structure, making incoherent trigger attributes or anomalous subgraphs easy to inspect or filter. In this paper, we propose STAG, a stealthy trojan attack framework designed for the graph-language alignment interface of GFMs on TAGs. STAG coordinates a graph-trigger generator with a text-side soft prompt so that trigger-attached graph representations and triggered text representations move toward the same target-class text region. To address TAG-specific stealthiness, STAG realizes trigger nodes as readable text through candidate retrieval and regularizes the trigger-attached subgraph so that its local structure remains close to the original subgraph. Extensive experiments on multiple TAG datasets and representative GFMs demonstrate the effectiveness and stealthiness of STAG. Our code is available at https://github.com/ventr1c/STAG.
articles.abstract_zh: 文本属性图上的图基础模型通过将图表示与语言语义对齐来支持可迁移的图学习，但其在图语言对齐场景下的后门脆弱性仍缺乏研究。本文提出STAG，一种面向图语言对齐接口的隐蔽木马攻击框架，通过协调图触发器生成器和文本侧软提示，使被触发的图表示与文本表示共同接近目标类别区域。该方法还通过候选检索生成可读触发节点，并约束触发子图保持与原始局部结构相近；多数据集实验验证了其有效性和隐蔽性。
authors: Minhua Lin, Zhicheng Gao, Yilong Wang, Hanqing Lu, Xiang Zhang, Suhang Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 文本属性图上的图基础模型通过将图表示与语言语义对齐，支持可迁移的图学习。尽管具有这些优势，文本属性图上图基础模型的后门脆弱性仍未得到充分理解，尤其是在图语言对齐场景中，因为图表示和文本表示会在共享语义空间中相互约束。现有后门攻击主要针对图侧或文本侧中的一侧，并将两种模态独立处理。这使得直接改造这些方法并不有效：仅针对图的触发器可能受到干净文本语义的约束，而仅针对文本的触发器虽然会改变语言视图，却不会直接移动经过对齐并用于评分的图表示。文本属性图还带来了隐蔽性方面的挑战，因为触发器同时以节点文本和局部图结构的形式暴露，不连贯的触发属性或异常子图很容易被检查或过滤。在本文中，我们提出STAG，一种专为文本属性图图基础模型的图语言对齐接口设计的隐蔽木马攻击框架。STAG协调图触发器生成器与文本侧软提示，使附着触发器的图表示和被触发的文本表示共同移向目标类别的文本区域。为解决文本属性图特有的隐蔽性问题，STAG通过候选检索将触发节点实现为可读文本，并对附着触发器的子图进行正则化，使其局部结构保持接近原始子图。在多个文本属性图数据集和具有代表性的图基础模型上的大量实验表明，STAG具有有效性和隐蔽性。

articles.title: Keyed Provenance Watermarking with Complementary Lattice-Based Secure Aggregation for Federated Learning
articles.title_zh: 采用互补格基安全聚合的密钥化溯源水印联邦学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20580v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is vulnerable to multi-level attacks. However, existing methods address them separately, leaving FL exposed to data leakage, unauthorized reuse, and malicious gradient manipulation. In this work, we propose an FL framework that couples keyed context-provenance watermarking with verifiable lattice-based secure aggregation of Real-World Anchored Watermarking and Lattice-Based Zero-Knowledge Secure Aggregation. At the data layer, we propose a Kerckhoffs-compliant scheme that utilizes Physical Anchor Metadata (PAM) to ensure data provenance. PAM is defined as a context-provenance token derived from trusted infrastructure data (time, location, and server ID) and then subjected to a keyed HMAC-SHA-256 transformation to produce a watermark payload that cannot be generated without the client's secret key. We further design FMGAN, a GAN-based robust image watermarking framework that embeds this transformed payload using a feature fusion module and a Mamba-guided linear attention mechanism. At the computation layer, we adopt a lattice-based zero-knowledge secure aggregation (LZKSA) protocol that verifies key correctness, L2 norm bounds, and cosine similarity constraints over committed gradients without revealing private updates. The RLWE-based design guarantees post-quantum security. Extensive experiments validate the complementary protection of the two layers under composite attack scenarios. To our knowledge, no prior verification workflow has jointly evaluated both layers in a hybrid, end-to-end trustworthy FL framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 联邦学习容易受到多层次攻击，而现有方法通常分别处理数据泄露、未授权复用和恶意梯度操纵问题。本文提出一种联邦学习框架，将密钥化上下文溯源水印与可验证的格基安全聚合相结合：数据层利用物理锚点元数据和密钥化HMAC-SHA-256生成溯源水印，计算层采用基于RLWE的格基零知识安全聚合协议验证梯度约束而不泄露私有更新。实验表明，该双层框架能够在复合攻击场景下提供互补保护，并具备后量子安全性。
authors: Xinyun Liu, Zhi Lu, Yu Chen, Ronghua Xu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 联邦学习容易受到多层次攻击。然而，现有方法通常分别处理这些攻击，使联邦学习仍然面临数据泄露、未授权复用和恶意梯度操纵风险。在本研究中，我们提出一种联邦学习框架，将密钥化上下文溯源水印与可验证的基于格的安全聚合相结合，其中包括现实世界锚定水印和基于格的零知识安全聚合。在数据层面，我们提出一种符合Kerckhoffs原则的方案，利用物理锚点元数据确保数据溯源。物理锚点元数据被定义为一种上下文溯源令牌，由可信基础设施数据，即时间、位置和服务器标识生成，随后通过密钥化HMAC-SHA-256变换产生水印载荷；没有客户端的秘密密钥便无法生成该载荷。我们进一步设计了FMGAN，这是一种基于生成对抗网络的鲁棒图像水印框架，利用特征融合模块和Mamba引导的线性注意力机制嵌入经过变换的载荷。在计算层面，我们采用基于格的零知识安全聚合协议LZKSA，在不披露私有更新的情况下，验证已承诺梯度的密钥正确性、L2范数界限和余弦相似度约束。基于RLWE的设计保证了后量子安全性。大量实验验证了这两个层次在复合攻击场景下的互补保护能力。据我们所知，此前没有验证工作在混合式、端到端可信联邦学习框架中联合评估这两个层次。

articles.title: Predicting Resource Efficient Hamiltonian Decomposition for Continuous-Time Quantum Walk Simulations
articles.title_zh: 连续时间量子游走模拟中资源高效哈密顿量分解的预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20660v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Simulating a continuous-time quantum walk (CTQW) on a graph in the circuit model of quantum computing requires decomposing its Hamiltonian into terms that can be Trotterized into hardware-native gates. We consider two such decompositions: the standard Pauli decomposition and the recently introduced matching decomposition. Prior work suggests that the matching decomposition uses fewer CX gates on sparse graphs, while the Pauli decomposition uses fewer on denser graphs. Since CX gates dominate error and runtime on current hardware, we train machine learning models to predict, for a given graph, which of the two decompositions produces the smaller CX gate count. We train and evaluate on the complete population of all 11,117 connected eight-vertex graphs from Brendan McKay's database, so the class balance and overlap are measured directly rather than estimated. We use twelve features: ten topological properties of the graph and two that count the terms the Pauli and matching decompositions produce (n_Pauli and nₘₐₜch), both computable without transpiling the simulation circuit. Standard topological properties alone provide little predictive power. Instead, the dominant signal comes from n_Pauli, a property of the Hamiltonian decomposition rather than an intrinsic property of the graph; degree variance is the only other feature that carries signal. Across a range of models the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) falls in a narrow band, from 0.569 untuned to 0.593 after tuning, so no single architecture stands out. We adopt a single-hidden-layer neural network at MCC 0.593. Applied frozen to a held-out, class-balanced test set of larger graphs (up to 256 vertices) from structured and Erdos-Renyi families, the model transfers, with MCC rising from 0.785 at N=8 to 1 at N>=64.
articles.abstract_zh: 在量子计算的电路模型中模拟图上的连续时间量子游走，需要将其哈密顿量分解为可通过Trotter化映射到硬件原生门的项。本文比较标准Pauli分解和匹配分解，并训练机器学习模型预测给定图采用哪种分解能够获得更少的CX门。模型使用全部11117个连通八顶点图进行训练和评估，结果表明主要预测信号来自分解项数量而非图的拓扑特征；在更大结构化图和Erdős-Rényi图上测试时，模型表现出良好的迁移能力。
authors: Mostafa Atallah, Rebekah Herrman, Zain H. Saleem
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在量子计算的电路模型中模拟图上的连续时间量子游走，需要将其哈密顿量分解为若干项，以便通过Trotter化将这些项转换为硬件原生量子门。我们考察两种此类分解：标准Pauli分解和近期提出的匹配分解。已有研究表明，在稀疏图上匹配分解使用的CX门更少，而在较稠密的图上Pauli分解使用的CX门更少。由于CX门主导当前硬件中的误差和运行时间，我们训练机器学习模型来预测，对于给定图，两种分解中的哪一种会产生更少的CX门。我们在Brendan McKay数据库中的全部11117个连通八顶点图上进行训练和评估，因此类别平衡和类别重叠可以直接测量，而不必进行估计。我们使用12个特征，包括10个图的拓扑性质，以及分别统计Pauli分解和匹配分解所产生项数的两个特征，即n_Pauli和nₘₐₜch；这两个数量无需对模拟电路进行转译即可计算。仅使用标准拓扑性质时，模型的预测能力很弱。相反，主要信号来自n_Pauli，它是哈密顿量分解的属性，而不是图本身的内在属性；度方差是唯一具有额外预测信号的特征。在一系列模型中，Matthews相关系数处于较窄范围内，从未经调优的0.569到调优后的0.593，因此没有任何单一架构表现出明显优势。我们最终采用一个Matthews相关系数为0.593的单隐藏层神经网络。在更大图的独立、类别平衡测试集上冻结模型参数进行测试时，测试图来自结构化图族和Erdős-Rényi图族，顶点数最高达到256；模型实现了迁移，其Matthews相关系数从N=8时的0.785上升到N≥64时的1。

articles.title: Spatially Aware Dictionary-Free Koopman Eigenfunction Identification for Modeling and Control
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.22648v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A spatially aware dictionary-free eigenfunction discovery (SADFED) framework is proposed for identification of low-rank Koopman models from data without prescribing a lifting dictionary, kernel, or neural-network eigenfunction architecture. A reference trajectory is selected and used to determine the Koopman modes by regularized least squares (LS). Then, a transformed temporal basis allows the eigenfunction values at all sampled initial conditions to be obtained by a second regularized LS projection. Consequently, only the real and imaginary parts of the eigenvalues remain as the optimization variables. Interpolation of the identified eigenfunction samples reveals their spatial structure, enabling numerical estimation of their gradients. A joint objective combines trajectory reconstruction error with a normalized Koopman partial differential equation (KPDE) residual, promoting spatial consistency with the KPDE over the sampled region and serving as a physics-informed regularizer. The method is evaluated on a system with analytical Koopman eigenfunctions, the FitzHugh-Nagumo system, the van der Pol oscillator, the Duffing system, and a two-spool turbojet engine.
