articles.title: Target-driven inverse design of battery cathodes via constraint-prioritised cross-entropy search
articles.title_zh: 通过约束优先的交叉熵搜索进行电池正极的目标驱动逆向设计
articles.abstract: Batteries are central to transport electrification, grid-scale storage, and low-carbon energy systems, yet cathode discovery remains constrained by the size and sparsity of composition space. Inverse design can map desired electrochemical targets to candidate materials, but cathodes must satisfy coupled constraints involving charge balance, redox accessibility, capacity, stability, volume change, and electronic properties. Here, we introduce a physics-aware, chemically type-conditioned, voltage-stratified cross-entropy method (CEM) for inverse cathode design, combining structured chemical blueprints with constraint-prioritised lexicographic elite selection rather than a single manually weighted scalar objective. The framework searches oxide–fluoride, phosphate, and sulphate cathode spaces. Candidate blueprints define mobile-ion identity, redox-active elements, spectator cations, and stoichiometric coefficients on a discrete grid. A deterministic feasibility solver converts blueprints into charge-balanced formulas, while a redox-capacity function limits charge storage by mobile-ion charge transfer and available redox capacity. Surrogate models trained on density-functional-theory data estimate voltage, redox-limited capacity, formation-energy-related stability, relative volume change, band gap, and predictive uncertainty. The structured blueprint space contains approximately possible sampled compositions before charge-balance filtering, of which approximately ( ) satisfy the formal charge-balance and redox-feasibility rules. Uniform random search confirmed that jointly feasible candidates are rare, especially in high-voltage buckets. Across the 2.5–4.5 V range, chemically type-conditioned CEM identified unique all-satisfying candidates across three independent seeds and achieved sample-efficiency gains of 38.6–292 relative to random search, with a mean gain of 174.5 , while retaining a wall-clock advantage after CEM overhead. The final archive contained oxide–fluoride and phosphate subsets, with no sulphate candidates under the current thresholds, and showed enrichment in selected mobile-ion/framework combinations and vanadium-based redox chemistry. The study is limited by the discretised blueprint space, surrogate-model domain coverage, and indirect computational assessment of synthesis feasibility.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出一种物理感知、化学类型条件化且按电压分层的交叉熵方法，用于在氧化物–氟化物、磷酸盐和硫酸盐正极空间中进行逆向设计。该方法以结构化化学蓝图、确定性电荷平衡求解器、氧化还原容量限制和基于密度泛函理论数据的代理模型为基础，并采用约束优先的词典序精英选择。跨2.5–4.5 V电压范围，该方法相较随机搜索实现了38.6–292倍的采样效率提升，但最终在当前阈值下未发现硫酸盐候选物。
authors: Ali Badakhshan, Naeem Adibi, Andrew Gallant and Mehdi Keshavarz Hedayati
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电池是交通电气化、电网规模储能和低碳能源系统的核心，但正极发现仍受到组成空间规模庞大且稀疏的限制。逆向设计可以将期望的电化学目标映射为候选材料，但正极必须满足涉及电荷平衡、氧化还原可及性、容量、稳定性、体积变化和电子性质的耦合约束。在此，我们提出一种物理感知、化学类型条件化且按电压分层的交叉熵方法（CEM），用于正极逆向设计；该方法将结构化化学蓝图与按约束优先级进行的词典序精英选择相结合，而不是采用单一的人工加权标量目标。该框架搜索氧化物–氟化物、磷酸盐和硫酸盐正极空间。候选蓝图在离散网格上定义可移动离子、氧化还原活性元素、旁观阳离子和化学计量系数。确定性的可行性求解器将蓝图转换为电荷平衡化学式，而氧化还原容量函数则根据可移动离子的电荷转移和可用氧化还原容量限制电荷存储。基于密度泛函理论数据训练的代理模型用于估计电压、氧化还原限制容量、与形成能相关的稳定性、相对体积变化、带隙和预测不确定性。结构化蓝图空间在电荷平衡筛选前包含约[原文数值缺失]种可能的采样组成，其中约[原文数值缺失]种满足形式电荷平衡和氧化还原可行性规则。均匀随机搜索证实，同时满足多项约束的候选物十分稀少，尤其是在高电压区间。跨2.5–4.5 V范围，化学类型条件化CEM在三个独立随机种子下识别出一批各项指标均满足要求的候选物，并相较随机搜索实现38.6–292倍的采样效率提升，平均提升174.5倍，同时在计入CEM开销后仍保持墙钟时间优势。最终候选档案包含氧化物–氟化物和磷酸盐子集，在当前阈值下没有硫酸盐候选物，并显示出特定可移动离子/骨架组合以及钒基氧化还原化学的富集。该研究受离散化蓝图空间、代理模型覆盖的适用域以及对合成可行性的间接计算评估所限制。

articles.title: Robust Discovery of Coarse-Grained Continuum Equations from Microscopic Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 从微观动力学稳健发现粗粒化连续介质方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of governing partial differential equations (PDEs) directly from spatiotemporal data has emerged as a powerful tool for understanding the dynamics of complex systems. In this work, we apply PDE-SINDy to well-known phase-separating systems and examine how its performance depends on the amount of available data, the size of the function library, and the presence of noise. Our results show that the accuracy of equation discovery depends strongly on the amount of available data. Although the correct equation can be identified with limited data, several spurious terms also acquire finite selection probabilities. As the amount of data increases, these spurious terms are progressively suppressed, leading to a more robust identification of the governing equation. In contrast, increasing the size of the function library adversely affects the efficiency of equation discovery. Further, for the Glauber spin-flip Ising model, we show that the selection probabilities reveal a hierarchy of equations with varying levels of complexity. A sufficiently stringent selection threshold recovers a Model-A-like dynamical equation that accurately reproduces the dynamical and statistical features of phase separation and domain growth.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究将PDE-SINDy应用于熟知的相分离系统，考察可用数据量、函数库规模和噪声对偏微分方程发现性能的影响。数据增加会逐步抑制伪项并提高控制方程识别的稳健性，而扩大函数库会降低发现效率。对于Glauber自旋翻转Ising模型，选择概率揭示了不同复杂度方程的层级；足够严格的阈值可恢复类似Model-A的动力学方程，并准确再现相分离和畴生长特征。
authors: Partha Sarathi Mondal, Manav Kumar Jalan, Anish Kumar, Shradha Mishra
articles.abstract_zh_full: 直接从时空数据中发现控制偏微分方程（PDE），已成为理解复杂系统动力学的有力工具。在本工作中，我们将PDE-SINDy应用于众所周知的相分离系统，并考察其性能如何依赖于可用数据量、函数库规模以及噪声的存在。结果表明，方程发现的准确性强烈依赖于可用数据量。尽管利用有限数据可以识别出正确方程，但若干伪项也会获得非零的选择概率。随着数据量增加，这些伪项会逐步受到抑制，从而更稳健地识别控制方程。相反，增大函数库规模会不利于方程发现的效率。此外，对于Glauber自旋翻转Ising模型，我们表明，选择概率揭示了一组具有不同复杂程度的方程层级。足够严格的选择阈值能够恢复一种类似Model-A的动力学方程，该方程可以准确再现相分离和畴生长的动力学及统计特征。

articles.title: An LLM agent for end-to-end computational materials discovery
articles.title_zh: 用于端到端计算材料发现的大语言模型智能体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20434v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coordination of multi-scale tasks is an effective strategy for computational materials discovery, yet the repeated application of diverse algorithms and tools renders it challenging. We report MAESTRO, a large language model (LLM) agent system capable of executing the entire screening pipeline for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs). It processes a large body of MOF literature, links relevant publications to their crystal structures, and curates the results into a computation-ready database, which is then screened through a strategy of progressively increasing computational cost. The promising candidates identified for separation under wet flue gas conditions all originate from unrelated studies. By connecting the heterogeneous stages of computational materials discovery, the LLM-based agents of MAESTRO can operate across application domains and uncover high-performance materials that conventional screening approaches would be unlikely to consider.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究报告了MAESTRO，这是一种能够执行金属有机框架（MOF）完整筛选流程的大语言模型智能体系统。它处理大量MOF文献，将相关论文与晶体结构关联起来，构建可直接用于计算的数据库，并采用逐步增加计算成本的策略筛选候选物。在湿法烟气条件下用于分离的有希望候选物均来自彼此无关的研究，表明该系统能够连接异构流程并发现传统筛选不易考虑的高性能材料。
authors: Chen Yuntong, Huang Ju, Liu Yu, Zhao Dan, Sun Mingqi, Ju Chentian, Liu Yanbing, Huang Lijiang, Zhao Guobin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多尺度任务的协调是计算材料发现的有效策略，但反复应用不同算法和工具使这一过程充满挑战。我们报告了MAESTRO，一种能够执行金属有机框架（MOF）完整筛选流程的大语言模型（LLM）智能体系统。它处理大量MOF文献，将相关出版物与其晶体结构关联起来，并将结果整理为可直接用于计算的数据库；随后，该数据库通过逐步增加计算成本的策略进行筛选。在湿法烟气条件下用于分离的有希望候选物均源自彼此无关的研究。通过连接计算材料发现中的异构阶段，MAESTRO的基于LLM的智能体能够跨应用领域运行，并发现传统筛选方法不太可能考虑的高性能材料。

articles.title: Self-limiting electrostriction of a single ion in an ultracold polar gas: From mesoscopic ions to crystalline molecular rings
articles.title_zh: 超冷极性气体中单离子的自限制电致伸缩：从介观离子到晶态分子环
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the self-assembly of polar molecules around a single ion immersed in an ultracold, dilute two-dimensional molecular gas. The ion aligns and attracts the molecules through charge-dipole interactions, producing a strong electrostrictive accumulation around the impurity, while intermolecular repulsion limits further densification and favors spatially extended configurations. By combining global optimization with diffusion Monte Carlo, we calculate the evaporation energy as a function of the number of molecules bound to the ion. In contrast to conventional charged and van der Waals clusters, the evaporation energy exhibits a plateau-like dependence on cluster size, reflecting the sequential formation of concentric molecular rings. These structures are governed by the topology of the ion's electric field and by the competition between attractive ion-molecule interactions, repulsive intra-ring interactions, and attractive correlations between neighboring rings, rather than by conventional coordination or icosahedral packing. In the weak-interaction regime, the resulting structures form extended mesoscopic molecular ions, whereas stronger interactions produce increasingly rigid, crystal-like molecular rings. We further analyze their stability against thermal perturbations and the time-dependent ion trap and find that a broad range of clusters remain stable under experimentally relevant conditions. The intermolecular repulsion and dipolar geometry also suppress close-range ion-molecule encounters, suggesting an intrinsic shielding mechanism. Our results establish ion-bound polar-molecule clusters as a distinct class of mesoscopic molecular ions and open a route to studying charged impurities in quantum baths with anisotropic interactions.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究考察了浸没于超冷稀二维分子气体中的单个离子如何诱导极性分子自组装。电荷–偶极相互作用使分子排列并聚集，而分子间排斥限制进一步致密化，并促成同心分子环的连续形成。全局优化与扩散蒙特卡洛计算显示，蒸发能随团簇大小呈平台状变化；弱相互作用下形成延展的介观分子离子，强相互作用下则形成更刚性的类晶态分子环，并在实验相关条件下保持稳定。
authors: Ruiren Shi, Saajid Chowdhury, Leon Karpa, Jesús Pérez-Ríos
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了浸没在超冷、稀薄二维分子气体中的单个离子周围极性分子的自组装。离子通过电荷–偶极相互作用使分子排列并吸引分子，在杂质周围产生强烈的电致伸缩聚集；与此同时，分子间排斥限制进一步致密化，并有利于形成空间延展的构型。通过结合全局优化和扩散蒙特卡洛方法，我们计算了束缚在离子上的分子数所对应的蒸发能。不同于传统的带电团簇和范德华团簇，蒸发能随团簇大小呈现类似平台的依赖关系，这反映了同心分子环的逐级形成。这些结构由离子电场的拓扑，以及离子–分子吸引、环内排斥和相邻分子环之间的吸引关联之间的竞争所决定，而不是由传统配位或二十面体堆积决定。在弱相互作用区域，所得结构形成延展的介观分子离子；而更强的相互作用会产生越来越刚性的类晶态分子环。我们还分析了它们在热扰动和随时间变化的离子阱作用下的稳定性，发现大量团簇在实验相关条件下仍能保持稳定。分子间排斥和偶极几何结构还会抑制离子–分子近距离接触，表明体系可能存在内禀屏蔽机制。我们的结果确立了离子束缚极性分子团簇这一类独特的介观分子离子，并为研究各向异性相互作用量子浴中的带电杂质开辟了途径。

articles.title: Interband plasmons due to Mexican hat dispersion in two-dimensional materials with inverted bands
articles.title_zh: 具有反转能带的二维材料中由墨西哥帽色散导致的带间等离激元
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20560v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional topological materials with Mexican-hat dispersion exhibit numerous nontrivial features, such as double-valued isoenergetic contours in k-space, strong mixing of electron and hole states, a van Hove singularity in the density of states, and specific quantum geometric properties. We find that, due to these features, Mexican-hat dispersion significantly strengthens interband plasmons, reduces their damping, and gives rise to an additional branch of the plasmon spectrum when electron-hole symmetry is broken. The plasmon spectra are limited to a finite range of the wave vector, the boundaries of which depend on the strength of the electron-electron interaction. We also reveal a relationship between the features of the plasmon spectrum and singularities of the joint density of states with a finite plasmon wave vector q, as well as features of the interband quantum metric, which also depend on q.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究发现，具有墨西哥帽色散的二维拓扑材料能够显著增强带间等离激元、降低其阻尼，并在电子–空穴对称性破缺时产生额外的等离激元分支。该色散还使等离激元谱仅存在于有限波矢范围内，其边界取决于电子–电子相互作用强度。研究进一步揭示了等离激元谱特征与有限波矢联合态密度奇异性及带间量子度量特征之间的联系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有墨西哥帽色散的二维拓扑材料表现出许多非平凡特征，例如k空间中双值的等能轮廓、电子态与空穴态的强混合、态密度中的范霍夫奇异性，以及特定的量子几何性质。我们发现，由于这些特征，墨西哥帽色散会显著增强带间等离激元、降低其阻尼，并在电子–空穴对称性破缺时产生等离激元谱的额外分支。等离激元谱仅限于有限的波矢范围，其边界取决于电子–电子相互作用的强度。我们还揭示了等离激元谱特征与具有有限等离激元波矢q的联合态密度奇异性之间的关系，以及它们与带间量子度量特征之间的联系；后者同样取决于q。

articles.title: Note on proliferation transitions of non-Abelian anyons
articles.title_zh: 关于非阿贝尔任意子的增殖相变的注记
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study phase transitions out of a (2+1)d topological phase driven by the proliferation of anyons in a braided fusion subcategory. We describe a general theoretical framework for such transitions, in which the topological quantum field theory (TQFT) is coupled to dynamical matter associated with anyons in the subcategory. We interpret this construction using symmetry topological field theory (SymTFT), where the dynamics is localized on the symmetry boundary of the (3+1)d slab. We analyze several examples, and present explicit Chern-Simons-Higgs (CSH) field theories realizing the proliferation transitions. We also examine proliferation transitions that implement gauging of non-invertible one-form symmetry in the parent TQFT. This includes a general construction for m̊ Rep(G) one-form symmetry for a finite group G, and a CSH realization of the non-invertible one-form gauging m̊ SU(2)₁₀i̊ghtarrow m̊ Spin(5)₁. We discuss which anyons proliferate at these transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究了由编织融合子范畴中任意子增殖驱动的（2+1）维拓扑相转变。作者建立了将拓扑量子场论与任意子相关动力学物质耦合的一般理论框架，并利用对称性拓扑场论解释该构造。文章分析了若干实例，给出了实现任意子增殖转变的陈–西蒙斯–希格斯场论，也讨论了母拓扑量子场论中非可逆一形式对称性的规范化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了由编织融合子范畴中任意子的增殖驱动的、离开（2+1）维拓扑相的相变。我们描述了这类相变的一般理论框架，其中拓扑量子场论（TQFT）与和该子范畴中任意子相关的动力学物质耦合。我们利用对称性拓扑场论（SymTFT）解释这一构造，在该解释中，动力学局域于（3+1）维薄片的对称性边界上。我们分析了若干实例，并提出了实现增殖相变的明确陈–西蒙斯–希格斯（CSH）场论。我们还考察了在母TQFT中实现非可逆一形式对称性规范化的增殖相变。这包括有限群G的Rep(G)一形式对称性的一般构造，以及一个将非可逆一形式规范化从SU(2)₁₀实现到Spin(5)₁的CSH构造。我们讨论了这些相变中哪些任意子发生增殖。原摘要中的个别数学符号存在编码缺失，相关表达按上下文作了谨慎还原。

articles.title: Aging Phase Diagram and Exact Asymptotic Energies of Mixed Spherical Spin Glasses
articles.title_zh: 混合球形自旋玻璃的老化相图与精确渐近能量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20623v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We determine the aging phase diagram of mixed spherical (p+s)-spin glasses quenched from random configurations to zero temperature. Solving the asymptotic dynamical equations of Cugliandolo and Kurchan, we find transitions between aging states with one, two, and continuously many effective temperatures, including phases in which discrete and continuous hierarchies coexist. We obtain analytic expressions for the energies reached asymptotically by the dynamics. In models combining pairwise and higher-order interactions, and sufficiently separated interaction orders (s>3), a fully continuous phase exists, where the gradient descent relaxation converges to the algorithmic energy lower bound. Instead, in mixed models with only high-order interactions (pge3) the energy relaxation remains strictly above it. Numerical integration of the dynamical equations is consistent with the predicted two-step and mixed discrete--continuous aging states.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究确定了从随机构型淬火至零温的混合球形（p+s）自旋玻璃的老化相图及渐近动力学能量。研究发现，体系可在具有一个、两个及连续多个有效温度的老化态之间发生转变，且可能存在离散与连续层级共存的相。对于包含成对相互作用和高阶相互作用且阶数充分分离的模型，存在完全连续相，其中梯度下降可达到算法能量下界；而仅含高阶相互作用的模型始终高于该下界。
authors: Johannes Lang, Vincenzo Citro, Luca Leuzzi, Federico Ricci-Tersenghi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们确定了从随机构型淬火到零温的混合球形（p+s）自旋玻璃的老化相图。通过求解Cugliandolo和Kurchan的渐近动力学方程，我们发现了具有一个、两个以及连续多个有效温度的老化态之间的转变，包括离散层级与连续层级共存的相。我们得到了动力学渐近达到的能量的解析表达式。在结合成对相互作用和高阶相互作用、且相互作用阶数充分分离（s>3）的模型中，存在完全连续相，在该相中梯度下降弛豫会收敛到算法能量下界。相反，在仅含高阶相互作用（p≥3）的混合模型中，能量弛豫始终严格高于该下界。对动力学方程的数值积分与所预测的两步老化态以及混合离散–连续老化态相一致。

articles.title: First-principles design of main-group dimer defects in ZnO as candidate quantum defects
articles.title_zh: ZnO中主族二聚体缺陷的第一性原理设计：候选量子缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20837v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Zinc oxide (ZnO), a wide-band-gap semiconductor with mature growth techniques, is a promising host for optically active quantum spins. Yet, optically active quantum defects in ZnO remain largely unexplored. Here, we identify and characterize a family of double substitutional impurities in ZnO, formed by main-group donor-acceptor (DA) pairs, as candidates for optically active quantum defects. Using hybrid density functional theory (DFT), we systematically investigate double substitutional DA complexes and their defect physics, including electronic structure, thermodynamic stability, and optical properties. The proposed defects exhibit isolated defect states, strong spin localization on the acceptor site, and C₃ᵥ symmetry. Importantly, the electronic structure of the DA pairs is largely determined by the atomic properties of their constituent atoms. We further examine their optical characteristics, including zero-phonon lines (ZPLs), radiative lifetimes, and nonradiative decay to assess their viability as color centers. Notably, among the dimers, (SiZₙ-B_O)⁺ and (GeZₙ-B_O)⁺ exhibit visible optical transitions with sub-microsecond radiative lifetimes and robust charge states against optical ionization, while (SiZₙ-C_O)²⁺ shows the smallest Huang-Rhys factor, approximately 5.6. Our results propose a new family of main-group donor-acceptor defects in ZnO as promising candidates for optically active spin defects.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用混合密度泛函理论系统考察了ZnO中的主族供体–受体双替位杂质对，评估其电子结构、热力学稳定性和光学性质。所提出的缺陷具有孤立缺陷态、局域于受体位点的强自旋以及C3v对称性。特别是（Si_Zn-B_O）+和（Ge_Zn-B_O）+表现出可见光跃迁、亚微秒辐射寿命和抗光电离的稳健电荷态，而（Si_Zn-C_O)2+具有约5.6的最小Huang–Rhys因子，表明这类缺陷可作为光学活性自旋缺陷。
authors: Taejoon Park, Erik Alfredo Perez, Shimin Zhang, Yuan Ping, Hosung Seo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 氧化锌（ZnO）是一种具有成熟生长技术的宽带隙半导体，是光学活性量子自旋的有前景宿主。然而，ZnO中的光学活性量子缺陷仍基本未被探索。在此，我们鉴定并表征了一类由主族供体–受体（DA）对形成的ZnO双替位杂质，提出其作为光学活性量子缺陷的候选者。利用混合密度泛函理论（DFT），我们系统研究了双替位DA复合体及其缺陷物理，包括电子结构、热力学稳定性和光学性质。所提出的缺陷表现出孤立缺陷态、局域在受体位点的强自旋以及C3v对称性。重要的是，DA对的电子结构主要由其组成原子的原子性质决定。我们进一步考察了其光学特征，包括零声子线（ZPL）、辐射寿命和非辐射衰减，以评估其作为色心的可行性。值得注意的是，在这些二聚体中，（Si_Zn-B_O）+和（Ge_Zn-B_O）+表现出可见光学跃迁、亚微秒辐射寿命以及抗光电离的稳健电荷态，而（Si_Zn-C_O）2+显示出最小的Huang–Rhys因子，约为5.6。我们的结果提出了一类新的ZnO主族供体–受体缺陷，可作为光学活性自旋缺陷的有前景候选者。

articles.title: Time-Resolved Thermal Susceptibility Mapping via Low-Temperature Scanning Laser Microscopy
articles.title_zh: 基于低温扫描激光显微镜的时间分辨热敏感性成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20862v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a multiharmonic lock-in detection approach that utilizes the inverse Fast Fourier Transform to reconstruct the time evolution of thermal susceptibility with high spatial resolution. The method is implemented on a custom-built, modular scanning laser microscope designed for operation in low working-distance optical cryostats and thoroughly calibrated for spatial accuracy. A demonstrative case study using a superconducting resonator highlights the capability of this technique to generate thermal images on time scales significantly shorter than the intrinsic scanning speed, thus enabling dynamic thermal characterization with high spatial fidelity. The proposed technique of low-temperature time-resolved scanning laser microscopy offers unique opportunities to explore superconducting devices, 2D materials, hybrid planar structures, and other low-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种多谐波锁相检测方法，利用逆快速傅里叶变换以高空间分辨率重建热敏感性的时间演化。该方法在定制的模块化扫描激光显微镜上实现，该显微镜可在低工作距离光学低温恒温器中运行，并经过了空间精度的全面校准。超导谐振器案例表明，该技术能够在显著短于本征扫描速度的时间尺度上生成热成像，从而实现具有高空间保真度的动态热表征，并为研究超导器件、二维材料、混合平面结构及其他低维系统提供新的可能。
authors: Nicolas Lejeune, Simon Van der Heyde, Alejandro V. Silhanek
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种多谐波锁相检测方法，该方法利用逆快速傅里叶变换，以高空间分辨率重建热敏感性的时间演化。该方法在一台定制的模块化扫描激光显微镜上实现；这台显微镜专为在低工作距离光学低温恒温器中运行而设计，并针对空间精度进行了全面校准。以超导谐振器为例的演示性研究突出表明，该技术能够在显著短于本征扫描速度的时间尺度上生成热图像，从而以高空间保真度实现动态热表征。所提出的低温时间分辨扫描激光显微技术，为探索超导器件、二维材料、混合平面结构以及其他低维系统提供了独特机会。

articles.title: Quasi-one-dimensional topological band structure and van Hove singularities in monolayer TaIrTe₄ from laser μ-ARPES
articles.title_zh: 通过激光微区角分辨光电子能谱研究单层 TaIrTe₄ 中的准一维拓扑能带结构与范霍夫奇异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20978v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent transport experiments reported a quantum spin Hall insulator phase in monolayer 1T-TaIrTe₄ gated away from charge neutrality. This phase is not predicted by band structure calculations and has been attributed to an electronic instability induced by strong correlations at a putative van Hove singularity. Here, we investigate the electronic structure of exfoliated monolayer 1T-TaIrTe₄ using micro-focus laser angle resolved photoemission. We find a strongly anisotropic band structure susceptible to density wave instabilities. Our data further reveal a saddle point singularity in the density of states. However, we find that the saddle point lies at a density for which transport experiments found no anomalies. Moreover, the quasiparticle line widths suggest weak electron correlations only. This points to a secondary role of van Hove singularities and electron correlations in the transport phase diagram of monolayer 1T-TaIrTe₄.
articles.abstract_zh: 近期输运实验报道，偏离电荷中性的单层 1T-TaIrTe₄ 中存在量子自旋霍尔绝缘体相，并将其归因于假定范霍夫奇异性处强关联诱导的电子不稳定性。作者利用微聚焦激光角分辨光电子能谱研究剥离的单层材料，发现其能带结构高度各向异性并易发生密度波不稳定性，同时观测到态密度中的鞍点奇异性。然而，该鞍点对应的载流子密度处输运实验并未发现异常，准粒子线宽也表明电子关联较弱，说明范霍夫奇异性和电子关联在其输运相图中的作用可能是次要的。
authors: Honey Boban, Tanguy Prongué, Amarjyoti Choudhury, Dario Marchiani, Andrés Bareño, Felix Eder, Enrico Giannini, Fabian O. von Rohr, Alberto F. Morpurgo, Marco Gibertini, Anna Tamai, Felix Baumberger
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期输运实验报道，单层 1T-TaIrTe₄ 在通过栅极调控偏离电荷中性点后会出现量子自旋霍尔绝缘体相。能带结构计算并未预测这一相，因此人们将其归因于假定范霍夫奇异性处由强关联诱导的电子不稳定性。在本文中，我们利用微聚焦激光角分辨光电子能谱研究了剥离的单层 1T-TaIrTe₄ 的电子结构。我们发现其能带结构具有很强的各向异性，并且容易发生密度波不稳定性。我们的数据进一步揭示了态密度中的一个鞍点奇异性。然而，我们发现该鞍点所处的载流子密度，正是输运实验未发现异常的密度范围。此外，准粒子线宽表明电子关联仅较弱。这说明范霍夫奇异性和电子关联在单层 1T-TaIrTe₄ 输运相图中的作用处于次要地位。

articles.title: Pair size versus coherence length and quantum geometry in the spin-orbit coupled BCS-BEC crossover
articles.title_zh: 自旋轨道耦合 BCS-BEC 交叉中的成对尺寸、相干长度与量子几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21110v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the interplay between pairing correlations and quantum geometry in the spin-orbit-coupled BCS-BEC crossover. Working in the helicity basis, we derive the exact pair-size tensor for the two-body bound states and show that it separates into intraband and quantum-geometric interband contributions, with the latter determined by the quantum metric. We extend this decomposition to two distinct many-body length scales at zero temperature: the Cooper-pair size, obtained from mean-field BCS theory, and the coherence length, obtained from the Gaussian fluctuation theory. Although these quantities almost coincide in the BCS regime, they describe distinct physical properties away from it, with the pair size characterizing the internal extent of a pair and the coherence length characterizing the long-wavelength response of the order parameter. We evaluate both quantities for three-dimensional Rashba, three-dimensional Weyl, and two-dimensional Rashba spin-orbit coupling models. We find that the pair size decreases monotonically with increasing spin-orbit coupling as the pair localizes, whereas the coherence length develops a pronounced minimum in the crossover regime before growing again in the BEC regime as the composite bosons become weakly interacting. This minimum is tied to the collapse of the noninteracting Fermi surface onto the ring or sphere of helicity-band minima. The quantum-geometric contributions reach up to nearly one third of the pair size and about 40% of the coherence length, tracking these same changes in the underlying helicity Fermi-surface topology.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们研究自旋轨道耦合 BCS-BEC 交叉中配对关联与量子几何之间的相互作用。在螺旋基底下，作者推导了二体束缚态的精确成对尺寸张量，并将其分解为带内贡献和由量子度规决定的量子几何带间贡献。零温下，类似分解也适用于库珀对尺寸和相干长度；前者描述配对的内部尺度，后者描述序参量的长波响应。结果表明，成对尺寸随自旋轨道耦合增强而单调减小，而相干长度在交叉区出现明显极小值，随后在 BEC 区重新增大；量子几何贡献最高可分别达到成对尺寸的近三分之一和相干长度的约 40%。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了自旋轨道耦合 BCS-BEC 交叉中配对关联与量子几何之间的相互作用。在螺旋基底下，我们推导出二体束缚态的精确成对尺寸张量，并证明该张量可以分解为带内贡献和量子几何带间贡献，后者由量子度规决定。我们将这种分解推广到零温下两种不同的多体长度尺度：由平均场 BCS 理论得到的库珀对尺寸，以及由高斯涨落理论得到的相干长度。尽管在 BCS 区域这两个量几乎重合，但离开该区域后，它们描述的是不同的物理性质：成对尺寸刻画一个配对的内部延展范围，而相干长度刻画序参量的长波长响应。我们分别对三维 Rashba、三维 Weyl 和二维 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合模型计算了这两个量。我们发现，随着自旋轨道耦合增强，成对尺寸单调减小，这是因为配对逐渐局域化；而相干长度在交叉区域出现显著极小值，随后在 BEC 区域再次增大，这是由于复合玻色子变得弱相互作用。这个极小值与非相互作用费米面塌缩到螺旋能带极小值所形成的环或球面有关。量子几何贡献最高可达到成对尺寸的近三分之一以及相干长度的约 40%，并且跟随底层螺旋费米面拓扑的相同变化。

articles.title: Symmetry-Induced Weyl Nodes in Interacting Multi-Terminal Josephson Junctions
articles.title_zh: 相互作用多端约瑟夫森结中的对称性诱导外尔节点
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that an emergent geometric symmetry generates non-trivial topology in quantum-dot-based multi-terminal Josephson junctions. It confines same-spin Andreev bound state crossings to an analytic one-dimensional manifold of the synthetic Brillouin zone, where interdot coupling selects Weyl nodes of charge ±1 in the singlet sector and doubly degenerate cones of charge ±2 in the doublet sector, at gate-tunable locations. The mechanism yields a spectroscopic detection protocol and a design principle for fabricating devices with non-trivial topological signatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们表明，一种涌现的几何对称性能够在基于量子点的多端约瑟夫森结中产生非平庸拓扑。该对称性将同自旋安德烈夫束缚态交叉限制在合成布里渊区的一维解析流形上；点间耦合进一步在单态和双态扇区分别选择出电荷为 ±1 的外尔节点和电荷为 ±2 的二重简并锥体。它们的位置可以通过栅极调控，从而形成一种光谱探测方案和制备具有非平庸拓扑特征器件的设计原则。
authors: Peter Zalom, Gustavo Diniz, David Christian Ohnmacht, Wolfgang Belzig
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，一种涌现的几何对称性能够在基于量子点的多端约瑟夫森结中产生非平庸拓扑。它将同自旋安德烈夫束缚态的交叉限制在合成布里渊区的一条解析一维流形上；在单态扇区，点间耦合选择出电荷为 ±1 的外尔节点，而在双态扇区，点间耦合选择出电荷为 ±2 的二重简并锥体，并且这些结构的位置可以通过栅极调控。该机制提供了一种光谱探测方案，也提供了制造具有非平庸拓扑特征器件的设计原则。

articles.title: The Continuum Model for Uniaxially Strained Bilayer Graphene Moiré Systems
articles.title_zh: 单轴应变双层石墨烯莫尔系统的连续模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21228v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct a continuum model for a one-dimensional moiré superlattice formed by stretching one layer of AB-stacked bilayer graphene along the x direction by a factor s. Following the spirit of the Bistritzer-MacDonald model for twisted bilayer graphene, we treat the interlayer coupling as hopping between several Dirac points. At a critical stretch factor s ~ 1.018 the two bands near the Fermi level touch, forming two degeneracy points along the k_y direction. This gap closing is accompanied by a topological phase transition, in which the Chern number changes from 1 to -1, and by a sign change of the Berry-curvature dipole, which we propose can be detected through the nonlinear Hall effect. We find that uniaxial strain modulates inter-Dirac-valley coupling, which drives band gap collapse and subsequent topological number inversion. This opens a route to engineer topological transport and quantum anomalous Hall effects via strain engineering of moiré heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个连续模型，用于描述沿 x 方向将 AB 堆垛双层石墨烯的一层拉伸为因子 s 后形成的一维莫尔超晶格。借鉴 Bistritzer-MacDonald 扭转双层石墨烯模型，我们将层间耦合视为多个狄拉克点之间的跃迁。在临界拉伸因子 s 约为 1.018 时，费米能级附近的两条能带接触，并沿 k_y 方向形成两个简并点；同时陈数由 1 变为 -1，贝里曲率偶极子发生变号。结果表明，单轴应变可调制不同狄拉克谷之间的耦合，驱动带隙闭合及后续拓扑数反转，为通过应变工程调控莫尔异质结构中的拓扑输运和量子反常霍尔效应提供途径。
authors: Tong Liu (Department of Physics, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, Hong Kong, Shenzhen Institute for Quantum Science and Engineering, Southern University of Science and Technology, Shenzhen, China), X. R. Wang (School of Science and Engineering, Chinese University of Hong Kong), Jiansheng Wu (Shenzhen Institute for Quantum Science and Engineering, Southern University of Science and Technology, Shenzhen, China)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构建了一个连续模型，用于描述这样一种一维莫尔超晶格：将 AB 堆垛双层石墨烯中的一层沿 x 方向拉伸，拉伸因子为 s。遵循 Bistritzer-MacDonald 扭转双层石墨烯模型的思想，我们将层间耦合处理为多个狄拉克点之间的跃迁。在临界拉伸因子 s 约为 1.018 时，费米能级附近的两条能带发生接触，并沿 k_y 方向形成两个简并点。这一带隙闭合伴随着拓扑相变，在相变过程中陈数由 1 变为 -1，同时贝里曲率偶极子发生变号；我们提出可通过非线性霍尔效应探测这一变化。我们发现，单轴应变能够调制不同狄拉克谷之间的耦合，从而驱动带隙塌缩以及随后发生的拓扑数反转。这为通过莫尔异质结构的应变工程来设计拓扑输运和量子反常霍尔效应开辟了途径。

articles.title: Chemical Control of Electronic Structure and Topology in Tellurium-Encapsulated Silicene
articles.title_zh: 碲封装硅烯中电子结构与拓扑性质的化学调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21295v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate chemical control of the electronic, optical, and topological properties of two-dimensional ȩSi2X2Te2 (ȩX = ȩB, ȩAl, ȩGa, and ȩIn) monolayers using first-principles calculations. All compounds are dynamically stable semiconductors, with their vibrational and electronic properties evolving systematically upon group-III substitution. Hybrid-functional calculations including spin--orbit coupling reveal predominantly p-orbital band edges and increasingly pronounced relativistic effects from B to In. Most notably, the calculated Z₂ invariant identifies ȩSi2In2Te2 as a candidate quantum spin Hall insulator, while the B-, Al-, and Ga-based monolayers remain topologically trivial. Bethe--Salpeter calculations further show that electron--hole interactions redistribute oscillator strength near the absorption onset while preserving a weak in-plane optical anisotropy. Our results establish group-III substitution as a simple chemical route to tune the electronic structure and drive a transition from trivial to nontrivial topology in ȩSi2X2Te2 monolayers.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们通过第一性原理计算研究了二维 Si₂X₂Te₂（X = B、Al、Ga、In）单层材料中电子、光学和拓扑性质的化学调控。所有化合物均为动力学稳定的半导体，其振动和电子性质随 III 族元素替换呈系统性演化；包含自旋轨道耦合的杂化泛函计算显示，带边主要由 p 轨道构成，且从 B 到 In 的相对论效应逐渐增强。Z₂ 不变量表明 Si₂In₂Te₂ 可能是量子自旋霍尔绝缘体，而 B、Al 和 Ga 基单层保持拓扑平庸。结果说明，III 族元素替换是调控电子结构并推动该类单层材料由平庸拓扑转变为非平庸拓扑的简单化学途径。
authors: Gabriel Elyas Gama Araujo, Andre Luis de Oliveira Batista, Willian Oliveira Santos, Alexandre Amaral Leitao, Alexandre Cavalheiro Dias, Andreia Luisa da Rosa
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用第一性原理计算研究了二维 Si₂X₂Te₂（X = B、Al、Ga 和 In）单层材料中电子、光学和拓扑性质的化学调控。所有化合物都是动力学稳定的半导体，其振动性质和电子性质会随着 III 族元素的替换而系统性演化。包含自旋轨道耦合的杂化泛函计算表明，带边主要由 p 轨道构成，并且从 B 到 In，相对论效应日益显著。最值得注意的是，计算得到的 Z₂ 不变量将 Si₂In₂Te₂ 确定为量子自旋霍尔绝缘体候选材料，而基于 B、Al 和 Ga 的单层材料仍然是拓扑平庸的。进一步的 Bethe-Salpeter 计算表明，电子-空穴相互作用会重新分配吸收起始附近的振子强度，同时保留较弱的面内光学各向异性。我们的结果表明，III 族元素替换是调控 Si₂X₂Te₂ 单层电子结构并驱动其由平庸拓扑转变为非平庸拓扑的一种简单化学途径。
articles.focus_summary: 研究利用第一性原理、杂化泛函、自旋轨道耦合和Bethe-Salpeter方程，系统考察碲包覆硅烯体系中不同第三主族元素替代对电子、光学和拓扑性质的影响。主要结论是铟替代体系可能成为量子自旋霍尔绝缘体，而其他替代体系保持拓扑平庸，并且电子-空穴相互作用会重分配带边附近的光学振子强度。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的二维材料、拓扑材料、电子结构计算、GW-BSE、SOC和光学响应研究直接相关。其化学替代调控拓扑相变和光学性质的策略可用于二维半导体及范德华异质结构的材料设计。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步验证候选体系的边缘态、拓扑相变路径、应变稳定性和有限温度性质，并研究缺陷、基底和层间耦合对量子自旋霍尔态的影响。还可结合高通量筛选寻找更多可通过化学替代实现拓扑调控的二维材料。

articles.title: Multiparameter Quantum Affine Spaces and the Scalene Yang--Baxter Equation
articles.title_zh: 多参数量子仿射空间与不等边杨-巴克斯特方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20714v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We construct representation-independent families of solutions of the non-braided scalene Yang--Baxter equation from quadratic noncommutative algebras. Beginning with two anticommuting generators, we obtain a continuous deformation in terms of quantum-plane algebras and extend the construction to an arbitrary number of generators. In the latter case the scalene Yang--Baxter relation fixes the multiparameter exchange matrix to an exact multiplicative form, thereby selecting a distinguished subclass of multiparameter quantum affine spaces. We construct finite-dimensional realizations using singular matrices and finite Heisenberg--Weyl operators, as well as infinite-dimensional realizations in terms of bilateral weighted shifts and multiplicative-shift operators. The explicit realizations are generically emphpurely scalene: although the ordered triple satisfies the scalene Yang--Baxter equation, its individual constituent operators do not satisfy the ordinary non-braided Yang--Baxter equation. These results provide a representation-independent algebraic framework for constructing Yang--Baxter-irreducible scalene triples and a starting point for investigating their possible applications to quantum integrability.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从二次非交换代数出发，构造了不依赖表示的非编织不等边杨-巴克斯特方程解族。以两个反对易生成元为起点，可通过量子平面代数得到连续形变，并推广到任意多个生成元；此时不等边关系将多参数交换矩阵确定为精确的乘法形式，从而选出一类特殊的多参数量子仿射空间。作者还构造了有限维和无限维实现，并指出这些有序三元组通常是真正的不等边结构，即三元组满足不等边杨-巴克斯特方程，但各组成算子并不分别满足通常的非编织杨-巴克斯特方程。
authors: Pramod Padmanabhan, Somnath Maity, Vladimir Korepin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从二次非交换代数出发，构造了不依赖表示的非编织不等边杨-巴克斯特方程解族。以两个反对易生成元为起点，我们通过量子平面代数获得连续形变，并将这一构造推广到任意多个生成元。在后一种情形下，不等边杨-巴克斯特关系将多参数交换矩阵确定为精确的乘法形式，从而选出多参数量子仿射空间中的一个特殊子类。我们利用奇异矩阵和有限维海森堡-魏尔算子构造了有限维实现，同时利用双边加权移位算子和乘法移位算子构造了无限维实现。这些显式实现通常是真正的不等边结构：尽管有序三元组满足不等边杨-巴克斯特方程，但其中各个组成算子并不满足通常的非编织杨-巴克斯特方程。这些结果为构造杨-巴克斯特不可约的不等边三元组提供了一个不依赖表示的代数框架，并为研究其在量子可积性中的潜在应用提供了起点。

articles.title: A Classification of Translation-Invariant Quantum Codes in Any Dimension
articles.title_zh: 任意维度平移不变量子码的分类
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20981v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum error-correcting codes with two-dimensional translation invariance are known to be equivalent to copies of the two-dimensional toric code. Such a simple classification is not possible for quantum codes with higher dimensional translation invariance due to the existence of multiple types of toric codes and infinite families of fracton codes. Here, we focus on D-dimensional translation-invariant quantum codes based on length-D chain complexes. This includes multivariate multicycle codes where the number of variables equals the number of cycles. We show that such codes are equivalent to copies of D-dimensional toric codes. This directly generalizes the classification result for two-dimensional translation-invariant codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 已知具有二维平移不变性的量子纠错码等价于二维环面码的若干副本，但更高维情形存在多种环面码和无穷多个分形子码类型，因而无法进行同样简单的分类。本文聚焦于基于长度为 D 的链复形的 D 维平移不变量子码，其中包括变量数等于循环数的多变量多循环码。作者证明，这类量子码等价于 D 维环面码的若干副本，从而直接推广了二维平移不变量子码的分类结果。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 已知具有二维平移不变性的量子纠错码等价于二维环面码的若干副本。由于存在多种类型的环面码以及分形子码的无穷族，对于具有更高维平移不变性的量子码而言，不可能实现如此简单的分类。在本文中，我们考察基于长度为 D 的链复形的 D 维平移不变量子码。这类量子码包括多变量多循环码，其中变量的数量等于循环的数量。我们证明，这些量子码等价于 D 维环面码的若干副本。这一结果直接推广了二维平移不变量子码的分类结论。

articles.title: Entangling Power Dynamics: Ergodicity and Mixing
articles.title_zh: 纠缠能力动力学：遍历性与混合性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21151v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study quantum dynamics through the lens of entanglement generation and characterize the underlying unitary evolution by the distinct signatures it imprints on the time-dependent entangling power. For a unitary operator, we characterize ergodicity by the equality between its long-time-averaged entangling power and the Haar-averaged linear entropy. We define mixing more stringently as the convergence of the time-dependent entangling power itself to the Haar value at long times. Within this framework, we establish the ergodic hierarchy of dynamical behavior, showing in particular that mixing implies ergodicity, whereas ergodicity does not necessarily imply mixing. As an application, we find that two-qubit unitary gates are neither ergodic nor mixing: their long-time-averaged entangling power can take only four discrete values, none of which coincides with the Haar average. We then investigate many-body dynamics using the kicked Ising chain and find that the long-time-averaged entangling power converges to the Haar value in both integrable and nonintegrable cases, indicating ergodicity. Remarkably, however, the nonintegrable chain exhibits mixing, whereas the integrable chain, despite being ergodic, is demonstrably nonmixing. We also introduce a Lyapunov-like exponent to characterize the rate at which the time-dependent entangling power approaches its saturation value. We find that this exponent increases systematically with the degree of integrability breaking in the many-body system. Our results establish entanglement generation as a useful framework for characterizing dynamical systems and reveal qualitatively different signatures of integrability beyond conventional diagnostics.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们从纠缠生成的角度研究量子动力学，并利用时间依赖的纠缠能力所留下的不同特征刻画幺正演化。对于一个幺正算子，作者将遍历性定义为其长时间平均纠缠能力等于 Haar 平均线性熵，并将混合性更严格地定义为时间依赖纠缠能力本身在长时间极限收敛到 Haar 值。研究建立了动力学行为的遍历层级，证明混合性蕴含遍历性，但反之不成立；在踢振伊辛链中，积分和非积分情形都表现出遍历性，而只有非积分情形表现出混合性。作者还引入类似李雅普诺夫指数的量来刻画趋于饱和值的速率，并发现该指数随可积性破缺程度系统性增加。
authors: Rahul V, Ranjan Modak, Shaon Sahoo, S Aravinda
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过纠缠生成的视角研究量子动力学，并利用时间依赖的纠缠能力所留下的不同特征来刻画其背后的幺正演化。对于一个幺正算子，我们通过其长时间平均纠缠能力等于 Haar 平均线性熵这一条件来刻画遍历性。我们将混合性定义得更加严格，即时间依赖的纠缠能力本身在长时间内收敛到 Haar 值。在这一框架下，我们建立了动力学行为的遍历层级，特别表明混合性蕴含遍历性，而遍历性并不一定蕴含混合性。作为应用，我们发现，二量子比特幺正门既不具有遍历性也不具有混合性：其长时间平均纠缠能力只能取四个离散值，且其中没有一个等于 Haar 平均值。随后，我们研究了踢振伊辛链中的多体动力学，发现无论在可积还是非可积情形下，长时间平均纠缠能力都会收敛到 Haar 值，这表明系统具有遍历性。然而，值得注意的是，非可积链表现出混合性，而可积链虽然具有遍历性，却明确表现为非混合。我们还引入了一个类似李雅普诺夫指数的指数，用于刻画时间依赖纠缠能力趋近其饱和值的速率。我们发现，随着多体系统中可积性破缺程度的增加，该指数会系统性增大。我们的结果确立了以纠缠生成为基础的动力学系统刻画框架，并揭示了传统诊断方法之外、与可积性相关的动力学差异化特征。

articles.title: Quantum annealing through a first-order phase transition: field theory approach
articles.title_zh: 穿越一级相变的量子退火：场论方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21329v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Unlike second-order phase transitions, a first-order transition has a stage, in which a system is trapped in a metastable state. The decay of this state leads to abundant excitations over the ground state. We present a field theory for kinetics of defects emerging during quantum annealing computations. This theory predicts several power laws for the error generation rate during quantum annealing either though or near the first-order phase transition. Sharp changes between the power exponents are predicted for continuous parameter changes. Observation of this behavior would be a signature of first-order critical points and could help identify and avoid them for better computations. The driven Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick model (LMGm) serves as the minimal model of interacting Ising spins that demonstrates this behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 不同于二级相变，一级相变包含系统被困于亚稳态的阶段，而该状态的衰变会在基态之上产生大量激发。我们提出了描述量子退火计算中缺陷产生动力学的场论，并预测了系统穿越或接近一级相变时错误产生率的多种幂律。对于连续变化的参数，幂律指数会发生突变式变化；观测到这种行为可作为一级临界点的特征，并有助于识别和规避这些临界点。受驱动的 Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick 模型是展示这一行为的相互作用伊辛自旋最小模型。
authors: Diego Andrés Rivera Orona, Predrag Punoševac, Nikolai A. Sinitsyn
articles.abstract_zh_full: 与二级相变不同，一级相变存在一个阶段，在这一阶段系统会被困在亚稳态中。该亚稳态的衰变会在基态之上产生大量激发。我们提出了一种用于描述量子退火计算中产生缺陷动力学的场论。该理论预测，在量子退火穿越一级相变或接近一级相变的过程中，错误产生率会遵循多种幂律。对于连续变化的参数，理论预言幂律指数之间会发生尖锐变化。观测到这种行为将成为一级临界点的一个标志，并可能有助于识别和避开这些临界点，从而改善计算性能。受驱动的 Lipkin-Meshkov-Glick 模型是能够展示这一行为的相互作用伊辛自旋最小模型。

articles.title: Anisotropic Electronic Correlations in the Spin Density Wave State of La₃Ni₂O₇
articles.title_zh: La₃Ni₂O₇ 自旋密度波态中的各向异性电子关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.07998v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The bilayer nickelate superconductor La₃Ni₂O₇ undergoes a density wave transition near 150 K that has attracted intensive scrutiny, yet its microscopic origin remains elusive. Here we report polarization-resolved electronic Raman scattering measurements on high-quality single crystals of La₃Ni₂O₇. Below 150,K, we observe a pronounced, symmetry-dependent redistribution of spectral weight in B₁g and B₂g channels, consistent with the formation of spin-density-wave (SDW) gaps. Quantitative analysis reveals momentum-selective SDW gap amplitudes, with intermediate-to-strong coupling near X/Y points of the Brillouin zone and weaker coupling along the diagonal direction, indicating an unconventional SDW driven by anisotropic electronic correlations. Our results establish the electronic character of the SDW in La₃Ni₂O₇, and provide a microscopic foundation for understanding the emergence of high-temperature superconductivity under pressure in nickelates.
articles.abstract_zh: 双层镍酸盐超导体 La₃Ni₂O₇ 在约 150 K 发生密度波相变，但其微观起源仍不清楚。作者对高质量单晶进行了偏振分辨电子拉曼散射测量，在 150 K 以下观察到 B₁g 和 B₂g 通道中显著且依赖对称性的谱权重重分布，与自旋密度波能隙的形成一致。定量分析显示，自旋密度波能隙幅度具有动量选择性：布里渊区 X/Y 点附近为中等至强耦合，而对角线方向耦合较弱，表明该自旋密度波由各向异性电子关联驱动。结果确立了 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中自旋密度波的电子学性质，并为理解镍酸盐中加压条件下高温超导性的出现提供了微观基础。
authors: Ge He, Jun Shen, Shiyu Xie, Haotian Zhang, Mengwu Huo, Jun Shu, Deyuan Hu, Xiaoxiang Zhou, Yanmin Zhang, Lei Qin, Liangxin Qiao, Hengjie Liu, Chuansheng Hu, Xijie Dong, Dengjing Wang, Jun Liu, Wei Hu, Jie Yuan, Yajun Yan, Zeming Qi, Kui Jin, Zengyi Du, Meng Wang, Donglai Feng
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双层镍酸盐超导体 La₃Ni₂O₇ 在约 150 K 附近经历一次密度波相变，但其微观起源仍然尚未明确，因此受到了广泛研究。在本文中，我们对高质量 La₃Ni₂O₇ 单晶进行了偏振分辨电子拉曼散射测量。在 150 K 以下，我们在 B₁g 和 B₂g 通道中观察到显著且依赖对称性的谱权重重分布，这与自旋密度波能隙的形成相一致。定量分析揭示了具有动量选择性的自旋密度波能隙幅度：在布里渊区的 X/Y 点附近为中等至强耦合，而沿对角线方向则为较弱耦合。这表明该体系中的自旋密度波是由各向异性电子关联驱动的非常规自旋密度波。我们的结果确立了 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中自旋密度波的电子学性质，并为理解镍酸盐中高压条件下高温超导性的出现提供了微观基础。

articles.title: Causally constrained quantum operator dynamics
articles.title_zh: 因果约束的量子算符动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06913v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper explores a route to non-ergodic quantum dynamics where algebraic restrictions in operator space arise from local constraints on the causal light cone. We model this through tri-partite unitaries (we dub 'walls') that permanently arrest local operator spreading in periodic time-evolution. We show that the structure of the resulting causally independent subsystems can be understood rigorously through the invariance of embedded operator algebras (ie. super-operator symmetries). Our work involves a detailed study of local conserved quantities and generalisation to time-dependent dynamics. Using representation theory, the general form of wall gates is derived from the unitary automorphism group of the embedded algebra with links to quantum error-correcting codes. From the point of view of operator spreading, our theory is a minimal model for non-ergodic quantum circuit dynamics and we explore its effects on probes of many-body quantum chaos. We prove an entanglement area law due to causal constraints and discuss its stability against local measurements. In a random unitary ensemble with causally independent subsystems, we compare spectral correlations with the universal (chaotic) ensemble using the spectral form factor. Our results offer a rigorous understanding of locally constrained quantum dynamics from a quantum information perspective.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究一种非遍历量子动力学，其算符空间中的代数限制源于因果光锥上的局域约束。作者以三分体幺正门“墙”为模型，证明其可通过嵌入算符代数的不变性理解，并推导墙门的一般形式。研究还讨论局域守恒量、时间依赖动力学、纠缠面积律、局域测量稳定性及谱关联。
authors: Marcell D. Kovács, Christopher J. Turner, Lluís Masanes
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文探索了一条通向非遍历量子动力学的路径：算符空间中的代数限制由因果光锥上的局域约束产生。我们通过三分体幺正算符（称其为“墙”）对这一过程建模；在周期性时间演化中，这些墙会永久阻止局域算符的扩散。我们严格证明，由此产生的因果独立子系统结构可以通过嵌入算符代数的不变性（即超算符对称性）来理解。我们的工作包含对局域守恒量的详细研究，并推广到时间依赖的动力学。利用表示论，我们从嵌入代数的幺正自同构群推导出墙门的一般形式，并揭示其与量子纠错码的联系。从算符扩散的角度看，我们的理论是非遍历量子线路动力学的一个最小模型，并探究了它对多体量子混沌探针的影响。我们证明，因果约束会导致纠缠面积律，并讨论其在局域测量下的稳定性。在具有因果独立子系统的随机幺正系综中，我们利用谱形状因子将谱关联与普适的（混沌）系综进行比较。我们的结果从量子信息角度为局域约束量子动力学提供了严格理解。

articles.title: Symmetry Adapted Hierarchical Equations of Motion for Exact Simulations of Large Polariton Systems
articles.title_zh: 用于大型极化激元系统精确模拟的对称性适配层级运动方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hierarchical equations of motion(HEOM) provide exact dynamics of open quantum systems coupled to harmonic baths, but their computational cost becomes prohibitive for systems with many independent local environments. In this work, we develop a symmetry-adapted HEOM formalism to significantly reduce the computational cost for the permutationally invariant Holstein-Tavis-Cummings (HTC) model. The method removes redundant information in two stages. First, all auxiliary density operators (ADOs) related only by relabeling identical molecules and their bath channels are replaced by a single canonical occupation-pattern representative. Second, molecules with the same local hierarchy occupation produce repeated matrix elements within each representative, allowing only the distinct complex variables to be propagated instead of the full (N + 1) × (N + 1) ADO matrices. The resulting matrix-free equations are evaluated using precomputed connections and molecular multiplicities. At fixed hierarchy depth L and number of bath correlation exponentials m, the number of canonical representatives becomes independent of the ensemble size for N ≥ L and the number of unique variables saturates for N ≥ L + 2. The formulation easily extends to multiple-exponential bath decompositions, arbitrary initial density operators, static disorders, and cavity loss. Our benchmarks reproduce conventional HEOM dynamics while requiring far fewer propagated variables and substantially less memory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对具有置换不变性的Holstein-Tavis-Cummings模型，提出对称性适配的层级运动方程方法，以降低传统HEOM的计算成本。该方法通过规范化占据模式和去除重复矩阵变量压缩辅助密度算符。结果表明，在固定层级深度和浴关联指数个数时，所需表示数量及变量数会随分子数达到饱和，并能准确复现常规HEOM动力学。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层级运动方程（HEOM）能够给出与谐和浴耦合的开放量子系统的精确动力学，但对于具有许多相互独立的局域环境的系统，其计算成本会变得难以承受。在本文中，我们针对具有置换不变性的Holstein-Tavis-Cummings（HTC）模型，发展了一种对称性适配的HEOM形式，以显著降低计算成本。该方法分两个阶段去除冗余信息。首先，将仅因相同分子及其浴通道重新标记而相关的所有辅助密度算符（ADO）替换为单一的规范占据模式代表。其次，在每个代表中，具有相同局域层级占据的分子会产生重复的矩阵元，因此只传播不同的复变量，而不是完整的(N+1)×(N+1)ADO矩阵。所得的无矩阵方程利用预先计算的连接关系和分子重数进行求值。在固定层级深度L和浴关联指数个数m时，当N≥L后，规范代表的数量与系综规模无关；当N≥L+2后，唯一变量的数量达到饱和。该形式可以方便地扩展到多指数浴分解、任意初始密度算符、静态无序和腔损耗。我们的基准测试复现了传统HEOM的动力学，同时所需传播的变量显著减少，内存占用也大幅降低。

articles.title: Collective Quantum Logic Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 集体量子逻辑光谱学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20471v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Scaling trapped-ion quantum sensors from single ions to large ensembles is a key challenge for next-generation precision measurements. At the same time, many ion species of interest for optical clocks and tests of fundamental physics lack closed cycling transitions required for direct laser cooling and state detection. Collective quantum logic spectroscopy addresses both limitations by coupling an ensemble of sensor, or spectroscopy, ions to one or more logic ions that provide sympathetic cooling and state readout. Here, we establish the fundamental performance limits and operating regimes of this protocol, identifying how the interaction strength, interrogation time, and logic-ensemble size govern sensitivity, dynamic range, and robustness to experimental imperfections. We show that quantum-limited sensitivity can be retained even with a single logic ion, while increasing the number of logic ions substantially improves readout efficiency and robustness. Beyond precision metrology, the same collective interface enables many-body measurements relevant to quantum information processing, including parity measurements and stabilizer-like syndrome extraction. Our results establish collective quantum logic spectroscopy as a scalable framework for optical clocks, quantum-enhanced sensing, and trapped-ion quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究集体量子逻辑光谱学，用逻辑离子为传感离子系综提供协同冷却和状态读出，从而克服大规模离子传感器扩展及某些离子缺乏闭合循环跃迁的问题。作者确定了相互作用强度、询问时间和逻辑离子数对灵敏度、动态范围及实验鲁棒性的影响。结果显示，单个逻辑离子也可保持量子极限灵敏度，而增加逻辑离子数能改善读出效率和抗缺陷能力。
authors: Raphael Kaubruegger, Matthew Patkowski, Yicheng Zhang, Robert J. Lewis-Swan, David B. Hume, Ana Maria Rey
articles.abstract_zh_full: 将囚禁离子量子传感器从单个离子扩展到大规模系综，是下一代精密测量面临的关键挑战。同时，许多对光钟和基础物理检验有价值的离子种类缺乏直接激光冷却和状态探测所需的闭合循环跃迁。集体量子逻辑光谱学通过将传感离子（或光谱离子）系综与一个或多个逻辑离子耦合，同时解决这两个限制；逻辑离子提供协同冷却和状态读出。在本文中，我们确立了这一方案的基本性能极限和工作区域，确定了相互作用强度、询问时间以及逻辑离子系综规模如何决定灵敏度、动态范围和对实验缺陷的鲁棒性。我们表明，即使只有一个逻辑离子，也能保持量子极限灵敏度；而增加逻辑离子数量则可显著提高读出效率和鲁棒性。除精密计量学外，同一集体接口还支持与量子信息处理相关的多体测量，包括宇称测量和类似稳定子综合征的提取。我们的结果确立了集体量子逻辑光谱学作为光钟、量子增强传感和囚禁离子量子信息处理的可扩展框架。

articles.title: Data-Driven Characterisation of Wave-Forced Turbulence Using Time-Resolved Forecast-Error Growth
articles.title_zh: 利用时间分辨预测误差增长对波浪强迫湍流进行数据驱动表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20931v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Periodic surface-wave forcing can reorganise turbulent flows through coherent spectral response, synchronization, intermittency, and changes in short-term predictability, so its dynamical effect need not vary monotonically with forcing frequency. We reanalyse laboratory acoustic Doppler velocimetry records obtained at constant discharge under four conditions (0, 0.5, 0.67, and 1~Hz) using one common KNN--GMAE forecast-error-growth protocol. A distance-weighted k-nearest-neighbour predictor generates out-of-sample forecasts over multiple horizons, and the slope of the early quasi-linear region of łn(GMAE) versus physical forecast time is reported as a finite-horizon forecast-error-growth rate, łFEG. For the full 120-s records, łFEG is 5.68, 0.85, 3.39, and 4.11~s⁻¹ for 0, 0.5, 0.67, and 1~Hz, respectively. The ordering 0~Hz > 1~Hz > 0.67~Hz > 0.5~Hz is preserved in all seven nearby parameter configurations, indicating that the comparative result is not an artefact of a single KNN setting. A 40-s sliding-window analysis with a 10-s step reveals substantial temporal structure. The no-wave condition remains predominantly high and the 0.5-Hz condition predominantly low, whereas the 1-Hz record has weaker local support for a single exponential-growth regime: only 3 of 9 windows satisfy the adopted early-fit criterion RFEG≥0.90, compared with 8/9, 7/9, and 7/9 for 0, 0.5, and 0.67~Hz.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文使用统一的KNN-GMAE预测误差增长方法，重新分析恒定流量下四种表面波强迫条件的实验声学多普勒测速记录。全时段结果显示，有限时间预测误差增长率按无波、1 Hz、0.67 Hz、0.5 Hz依次降低；七组邻近参数均保持这一排序。滑动窗口分析表明，不同强迫频率下的局部可预测性具有显著时间结构。
authors: Raj Jyoti Baishya, Joychen Kenglang, Andrei Velichko, Bimlesh Kumar
articles.abstract_zh_full: 周期性表面波强迫可以通过相干谱响应、同步化、间歇性以及短期可预测性的变化重组湍流流动，因此其动力学影响不一定随强迫频率单调变化。我们使用一种统一的KNN--GMAE预测误差增长方法，重新分析了恒定流量下四种条件（0、0.5、0.67和1 Hz）的实验室声学多普勒测速记录。距离加权的k近邻预测器在多个预测时域上生成样本外预测，并将ln(GMAE)相对于实际预测时间的早期准线性区域斜率报告为有限时域预测误差增长率FEG。对于完整的120 s记录，0、0.5、0.67和1 Hz条件下的FEG分别为5.68、0.85、3.39和4.11 s⁻¹。排序关系0 Hz＞1 Hz＞0.67 Hz＞0.5 Hz在全部七组相邻参数配置中均得到保持，表明该比较结果并非单一KNN设置造成的伪象。采用步长为10 s的40 s滑动窗口分析揭示了显著的时间结构。无波条件总体上持续处于较高水平，0.5 Hz条件总体上处于较低水平；相比之下，1 Hz记录对单一指数增长机制的局部支持较弱：只有9个窗口中的3个满足所采用的早期拟合标准RFEG≥0.90，而0、0.5和0.67 Hz条件分别为8/9、7/9和7/9。

articles.title: Minimization of micromotion for nanoparticles in a Paul trap
articles.title_zh: 保罗阱中纳米颗粒微运动的最小化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21011v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When a charged particle in a Paul trap is displaced from the node of the AC trapping field, excess micromotion arises as an undesired effect. Excess micromotion heats the particle, limits the precision with which the particle can be localised, and acts as a decoherence channel in quantum mechanical experiments. However, thus far there is no standard procedure for micromotion compensation with mesoscopic particles. Here, we experimentally demonstrate three different methods for minimizing the micromotion of a nanoparticle in a linear Paul trap along three axes. The most precise method allows us to nullify the stray field to within 2.9 V/m, which is comparable to reported values in trapped-ion experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 带电粒子偏离保罗阱交流囚禁场节点时会产生多余微运动，导致加热、定位精度下降和量子实验中的退相干。本文实验演示了在线性保罗阱三条轴上最小化纳米颗粒微运动的三种方法。最精确的方法可将杂散电场抵消至2.9 V/m以内，达到囚禁离子实验中已报道的相当水平。
authors: Jamie Morley, Jean Paul Louys Sansó, Dmitry Bykov, Simon Baier, Tracy Northup
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当保罗阱中的带电粒子偏离交流囚禁场的节点时，就会产生多余微运动这一不良效应。多余微运动会加热粒子，限制粒子定位的精度，并在量子力学实验中充当退相干通道。然而，迄今尚无针对介观粒子进行微运动补偿的标准程序。在本文中，我们在线性保罗阱的三条轴上实验演示了三种最小化纳米颗粒微运动的方法。最精确的方法能够将杂散电场抵消到2.9 V/m以内，这与囚禁离子实验中报道的数值相当。

articles.title: Symmetry Constrained Quantum Error Mitigation for the Schwinger Model
articles.title_zh: 薛温格模型的对称性约束量子误差缓解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.21103v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum error mitigation (QEM) is at the very heart of near-term quantum simulations and lattice gauge theories are no exceptions, rather their physical symmetries provide natural consistency checks on noise quantum states. In this work, we exploit the parity and fermion-number symmetries of a gauge theory, the (1+1)-dimensional Schwinger model, under depolarising noise and investigate symmetry verification under digital quantum simulation. We investigate two set-ups - symmetry- sector post-selection in adiabatic state preparation followed by real-time measurements of the chiral condensate and symmetry verification within a variational quantum eigensolver (VQE). In the first case, post-selection reduces the bias in the chiral condensate consistently removing up to 60% of the quantum noise induced error in our system. Motivated by the observed regularity of the residual bias (in the low-noise regime), we further introduce a global-noise calibration obtained from classically accessible smaller lattices and implemented on larger lattices recovering noiseless chiral condensate values within statistical uncertainty. However, in VQE, symmetry verification does not seem to generally improve the optimised parameters or the fidelity of the prepared states, although it reduces the bias in the estimated ground-state energy. This demonstates that improving a noisy cost-function estimator in variational algorithms does not necessarily improve the outcome of the algorithm. Our results show the strength of symmetry verification in different approaches while establishing that its usefulness critically depends on where it is applied in the computational workflow, and provide practical guidance for symmetry-assisted quantum error mitigation in quantum simulations of lattice gauge theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用(1+1)维薛温格模型中的宇称和费米子数对称性，研究去极化噪声下数字量子模拟中的对称性验证。对绝热制备后的对称扇区后选择可稳定降低手性凝聚的噪声偏差，并结合全局噪声校准在更大晶格上恢复无噪声结果。VQE中对称性验证虽能降低基态能量估计偏差，却未必改善优化参数或制备态保真度，说明其效果取决于应用所在的计算流程环节。
authors: Alexander Tomlinson, Graham Van Goffrier, Bipasha Chakraborty, Zhenyu Cai
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子误差缓解（QEM）是近期量子模拟的核心，晶格规范理论也不例外；相反，它们的物理对称性为噪声量子态提供了天然的一致性检验。在本文中，我们利用规范理论(1+1)维薛温格模型的宇称和费米子数对称性，在去极化噪声下研究数字量子模拟中的对称性验证。我们考察了两种设置：绝热态制备中的对称扇区后选择，随后对手性凝聚进行实时测量；以及变分量子本征求解器（VQE）中的对称性验证。在第一种情况下，后选择持续降低手性凝聚的偏差，在我们的系统中最多消除由量子噪声诱导误差的60%。受低噪声区域中所观察到的残余偏差规律性启发，我们进一步引入一种从经典可处理的小型晶格获得的全局噪声校准，并将其用于更大晶格，从而在统计不确定度范围内恢复无噪声的手性凝聚值。然而，在VQE中，对称性验证似乎通常不能改善优化后的参数或制备态的保真度，尽管它能降低估计基态能量的偏差。这说明，在变分算法中改善有噪声的代价函数估计器，并不一定会改善算法结果。我们的结果展示了对称性验证在不同方法中的作用，同时表明其效用严格取决于它被应用于计算流程的哪个环节，并为晶格规范理论量子模拟中的对称性辅助量子误差缓解提供了实践指导。

articles.title: Natural-Language-Guided Generator-Agnostic Shortlisting for Protein Binder Design
articles.title_zh: 自然语言引导的生成器无关蛋白质结合剂候选筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20755v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modern de novo design workflows generate many candidate protein binders, but wet-lab validation capacity remains limited, making shortlisting a major bottleneck. We study whether LLMs can generate multi-metric ranking policies from precomputed structural-confidence and interface-quality proxy scores. Rather than proposing a new protein binder design pipeline, we focus on post-generation binder shortlisting: selecting the final top-K candidates from already generated binder pools using a shared panel of precomputed proxy scores. On the 10-target held-out split, averaging performance over five sampled global iterative gpt-4o policies reaches 0.589 Recall@10, modestly improving over the strongest single-feature fixed baseline, Protenix binder ipTM, which reaches 0.571 Recall@10. On the 3-target held-out subset comprising Nipah, RBX1, and TREM2, target-conditioned iterative gpt-5.4 policies reach the strongest LLM performance, with 0.519 Recall@10 and 0.583 NDCG@10. These results suggest that LLM-generated ranking policies can act as an interpretable post-generation decision layer for combining heterogeneous proxy metrics to prioritize binders from large candidate pools.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究大语言模型能否根据预先计算的结构置信度和界面质量代理分数生成多指标排序策略，用于已生成蛋白质结合剂候选的后处理筛选。结果显示，在10个靶标的留出数据上，五个GPT-4o全局迭代策略的平均Recall@10为0.589，略高于最强单特征基线0.571。在三个靶标的留出子集上，目标条件化GPT-5.4策略取得0.519的Recall@10和0.583的NDCG@10。
authors: Gyubok Lee, Kiwoong Yoo, Jimin Seo, Kyunghoon Hur, Edward Choi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代从头设计流程会生成大量候选蛋白质结合剂，但湿实验验证能力有限，使得候选筛选成为主要瓶颈。我们研究大语言模型能否根据预先计算的结构置信度和界面质量代理分数生成多指标排序策略。我们并不提出新的蛋白质结合剂设计流程，而是聚焦于生成后的结合剂筛选：使用一组共享的预计算代理分数，从已经生成的结合剂候选池中选出最终的前K名候选。在10个靶标的留出划分上，对五个采样得到的全局迭代GPT-4o策略取平均后，Recall@10达到0.589，相比最强的单特征固定基线Protenix binder的ipTM指标0.571有小幅提升。在由Nipah、RBX1和TREM2组成的三个靶标留出子集上，目标条件化的迭代GPT-5.4策略取得了最强的大语言模型表现，Recall@10为0.519，NDCG@10为0.583。这些结果表明，大语言模型生成的排序策略可以作为一种可解释的生成后决策层，结合异质代理指标，以便从大规模候选池中优先筛选结合剂。

articles.title: Nonequilibrium bosonization of fractional quantum Hall edges
articles.abstract: Author(s): Christian Spånslätt, Jinhong Park, and Alexander D. Mirlin Edge transport is a powerful probe of anyons in fractional quantum Hall states. Here, the authors develop a nonequilibrium bosonization theory of interacting fractional quantum Hall edges, enabling a unified treatment of full counting statistics, anyon correlations, and tunneling transport far from equilibrium. For multimode edges, the theory reveals how interaction-induced fractionalization affects anyon dynamics through mutual braiding phases. It further predicts distinct signatures in experimentally accessible Fano factors, providing a route to probe anyonic braiding and fractionalization in nonequilibrium transport. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 105418] Published Mon Aug 24, 2026

articles.title: Trigonal warping enables linear optical spectroscopy in single-valley superconductors
articles.abstract: Author(s): Benjamin A. Levitan and Étienne Lantagne-Hurtubise Internal vibrations of the superconducting condensate, such as clapping modes and Bardasis-Schrieffer modes, are often invisible to linear optical spectroscopy due to crystallographic selection rules. Here, the authors show how, in threefold-symmetric valley-polarized superconductors, trigonal warping allows these modes to absorb light at linear order. Consequently, the modes appear in both components of the optical conductivity tensor. The authors then discuss how rhombohedral graphene multilayers provide natural candidate materials in which to probe superconducting collective excitations by microwave spectroscopy. [Phys. Rev. articles.title: Machine learning enhanced prediction of optical properties via reverse Monte Carlo method
articles.abstract: We present a machine learning (ML) approach for the accelerated extraction of optical properties from the experimental reflection electron energy loss spectroscopy (REELS) spectra by the reverse Monte Carlo (RMC) method. Taking platinum (Pt) as an example, experimental REELS spectra recorded at incident electron energies of 2.0 and 1.5 keV over an energy loss range of 0–200 eV are processed by one-dimensional convolutional neural networks trained specifically for each incident energy. The training processes incorporate the physical constraints based on the perfect-screening ( ps -) and oscillator-strength ( f -) sum rules of ELF into the loss functions to guarantee the validity of the results. The networks are trained on datasets generated by the RMC method, which pairs the simulated REELS spectra with the corresponding energy loss functions (ELFs). This approach enables the direct prediction of the ELF and optical constants from measured REELS spectra with reduced computational cost as compared to the previous RMC method. The predicted ELFs from ML exhibit high accuracy as verified by sum rules, and the optical properties of Pt are derived from these ELFs.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Role of spin–orbit and nuclear motion assisted spin–orbit coupling on the structural isomerism dependent intersystem crossing mechanism
articles.abstract: We investigate the intersystem crossing (ISC) mechanism of three isomeric molecules, namely, methyl 2-(9H-carbazol-9-yl)benzoate (o-MCBA), methyl 3-(9H-carbazol-9-yl)benzoate (m-MCBA), and methyl 4-(9H-carbazol-9-yl)benzoate (p-MCBA). Our analyses highlight the role of direct spin–orbit (DSO) coupling, Herzberg–Teller (HT) coupling, and spin–vibronic (SV) coupling in facilitating the ISC processes in these molecules. We have found that the dominant ISC pathway between the lowest excited singlet state (SCT1o/p) having charge-transfer (CT) character and the triplet state (TCT1+LE1o/p) with mixed CT and locally excited (LE) characters is primarily governed by both DSO and HT interactions in o-MCBA and p-MCBA, whereas for m-MCBA, the ISC pathway between the lowest excited singlet state (SLE1m) and the triplet state (TLE1m) is mainly assisted by HT and SV interactions. The time-dependent correlation function based method has been employed for the calculations of ISC rate constant (k ISC ). The computed DSO/HT assisted k ISC s for the ISC pathway involving the lowest excited singlet and the triplet states of ortho, para, and meta isomers are found to be 0.87 × 10 6 /4.16 × 10 6 , 1.18 × 10 6 /2.24 × 10 6 , and 5.67 × 10 3 /4.02 × 10 6 s −1 , respectively, while the SV-aided k ISC of m-MCBA is turned out to be 5.45 × 10 6 s −1 . Our theoretical analysis reveals that while the SV interaction plays a crucial role on the ISC mechanism of meta isomer, the larger energy gaps between the lowest excited singlet state (SCT1o/p) and the higher lying triplet state (TCT2+LE2o/p) as well as that between (TCT2+LE2o/p) and the lowest excited triplet state (TCT1+LE1o/p) suppress the SV-driven ISC processes in ortho and para isomers. This study emphasizes that the origins of the same order of the experimental k ISC s of the structural isomers are completely different.

articles.title: Role of excited states in resonant charge transfer during Li + backscattering from MoS 2 : A multi-orbital theoretical study
articles.abstract: We present a theoretical investigation of resonant charge transfer in low-energy Li + ions backscattered from a MoS 2 surface, focusing on the influence of excited projectile states. Using a time-dependent Anderson model in the infinite- U limit, we evaluate the individual contributions from the Li 2 s , 2 p x , 2 p y , and 2 p z orbitals to the final charge state distribution. The Hamiltonian parameters are computed using an expanded Huzinaga basis set that explicitly incorporates lithium’s 2 p orbitals. Each orbital channel is treated separately, and electronic correlation effects are introduced approximately through a probabilistic exclusion principle applied to the final charge state. Theoretical calculations demonstrate that including 2 p channels enhances the agreement with previously reported experimental neutral fractions, where the single-channel descriptions show noticeable discrepancies. Among excited states, the 2 p z orbital oriented perpendicular to the surface contributes most significantly due to its spatial extension toward the substrate. Examination of temporal evolution reveals that independent channel occupations exceed unity at small projectile–surface separations, highlighting the necessity of dynamical correlation treatments. These findings establish that excited states make non-negligible contributions to charge exchange processes for alkali ions interacting with transition metal dichalcogenide surfaces and should be incorporated for accurate quantitative modeling.

articles.title: Study on Flame Retardancy and Smoke Suppression of Silicone Rubber Foam Containing Aluminum Hydroxide and Carbon Molecular Sieve
articles.title_zh: 含氢氧化铝和碳分子筛的硅橡胶泡沫阻燃与抑烟性能研究
articles.abstract: To enhance the flame retardancy and smoke suppression performance of silicone rubber foam (SRF), an efficient and environmentally friendly flame-retardant and smoke-suppression system was developed by incorporating aluminum hydroxide (Al(OH)3) and carbon molecular sieve (CMS). Al(OH)3/CMS/SRF composites were fabricated via physical blending, and their flame retardancy, smoke suppression performance, and associated mechanisms were systematically investigated. Results indicate that at mass fractions of 5 wt% and 2 wt% for Al(OH)3 and CMS, respectively, the composite achieves a limiting oxygen index of 30.8% and attains a UL-94 V-0 rating. Compared with pure SRF, the composite exhibits reductions by 21.41%, 51.8%, 70.3%, and 93.9% in peak heat release rate, total heat release, smoke production rate, and total smoke production, respectively, demonstrating excellent flame retardancy and smoke suppression performance at this optimal loading. Mechanistic analysis reveals that CMS provides a physical supporting skeleton and synergistically forms a dense SiO2/char barrier layer with Al2O3, which effectively prolongs the ignition time and impedes heat and oxygen transfer. This design offers a green, highly efficient synergistic flame-retardant and smoke-suppression strategy, showing great potential for application in silicone rubber foams.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究通过加入氢氧化铝（Al(OH)3）和碳分子筛（CMS），构建了高效且环境友好的硅橡胶泡沫阻燃抑烟体系。在Al(OH)3和CMS质量分数分别为5 wt%和2 wt%时，复合材料的极限氧指数达到30.8%，并获得UL-94 V-0等级；与纯硅橡胶泡沫相比，其峰值热释放速率、总热释放量、产烟速率和总产烟量分别降低21.41%、51.8%、70.3%和93.9%。机理分析表明，CMS提供物理支撑骨架，并与Al2O3协同形成致密的SiO2/炭层屏障，从而延长点燃时间并阻碍热量和氧气传递。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为提高硅橡胶泡沫（SRF）的阻燃和抑烟性能，本研究通过加入氢氧化铝（Al(OH)3）和碳分子筛（CMS），开发了一种高效且环境友好的阻燃抑烟体系。采用物理共混法制备了Al(OH)3/CMS/SRF复合材料，并系统研究了其阻燃性能、抑烟性能及相关机理。结果表明，当Al(OH)3和CMS的质量分数分别为5 wt%和2 wt%时，复合材料的极限氧指数达到30.8%，并取得UL-94 V-0等级。与纯SRF相比，在这一最佳添加量下，复合材料的峰值热释放速率、总热释放量、产烟速率和总产烟量分别降低了21.41%、51.8%、70.3%和93.9%，表现出优异的阻燃和抑烟性能。机理分析显示，CMS提供了物理支撑骨架，并与Al2O3协同形成致密的SiO2/炭层屏障，该屏障能够有效延长点燃时间并阻碍热量和氧气传递。这一设计提供了一种绿色、高效的协同阻燃抑烟策略，在硅橡胶泡沫中的应用展现出很大潜力。

articles.title: Relational reduction protects massless spin-2 modes in a programmable quantum network
articles.title_zh: 关系约化保护可编程量子网络中的无质量自旋2模
articles.abstract: Positive quantum response metrics seem incompatible with the indefinite scalar direction of covariant spin-2 actions. We establish a transferable design rule that removes this obstacle before a continuum limit is taken. A positive full-rank quantum chart is equipped with an exact relational complex; its response is reduced to a two-dimensional cohomology; and the complete finite spectral kernel is tested before any derivative expansion. We prove that positive and covariant representatives then differ only by a quadratic form in the imposed constraint, and that Gaussian quantum feedback preserves the quotient, masslessness and physical spectral measure. The theorem holds for arbitrary finite exact complexes of the stated form and passes 3,000 randomized tests with chart condition numbers up to 1010. An eight-route, four-port unitary network supplies an explicit realization with a positive six-coordinate Gram chart, two tensor modes and a Stieltjes-positive response. We give a five-qubit closed-time-path protocol requiring 57 native entanglers on an all-to-all architecture, with quantitative gates for helicity degeneracy, subthreshold noise, residue positivity and root--threshold interlacing. The protocol tests relational protection directly, without requiring a gravitational interpretation.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究针对协变自旋2作用量中不定标量方向与正定量子响应度量之间的矛盾，提出了一种在连续极限之前实施关系约化的设计规则。通过精确关系复形、二维上同调约化和有限谱核检验，作者证明正定协变表示之间的差异仅为施加约束的二次型，且高斯量子反馈保持商空间、无质量性和物理谱测度。研究还给出了八路径四端口酉网络和五量子比特闭时路径协议，用于直接检验关系保护，而不要求引入引力解释。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 正定量子响应度量似乎与协变自旋2作用量中的不定标量方向不相容。我们建立了一条可迁移的设计规则，在取连续极限之前消除这一障碍。我们为一个正定的满秩量子图表配备精确的关系复形；将其响应约化为二维上同调；并在进行任何导数展开之前检验完整的有限谱核。我们证明，正定表示与协变表示之间的差异随后仅表现为所施加约束的一个二次型，并且高斯量子反馈保持商空间、无质量性以及物理谱测度。该定理适用于所述形式的任意有限精确复形，并通过了3000次随机化测试，图表条件数最高达到10¹⁰。一个八路径、四端口的酉网络提供了具体实现，其中包含正定的六坐标 Gram 图表、两个张量模和一个Stieltjes正响应。我们给出了一种五量子比特闭时路径协议，在全连接架构上需要57个原生纠缠门，并配备了用于检验螺旋度简并、阈下噪声、留数正性以及根—阈值交错关系的定量判据。该协议直接检验关系保护，而不要求对其作出引力解释。

articles.title: When Reward Is Not Grammar: A Reward-Action Validity Audit of Deep Reinforcement Learning for English Inflection
articles.title_zh: 奖励并非语法：深度强化学习英语屈折变化的奖励—动作有效性审计
articles.abstract: Small reinforcement-learning demonstrations are increasingly used to argue that an agent has acquired linguistic rules without a large language model. Such claims can be invalid even when the training curve is favorable: the reward may accept malformed outputs, the action interface may be unable to express the gold form, and the observation encoder may change between executions. We introduce a reward-action validity audit and apply it to a supplied Deep Q-Network notebook that targets English noun pluralization, past-tense formation, and subject-verb agreement. The experimented notebook reports proxy accuracies of 64.86%, 100.00%, and 69.57%, respectively. Exhaustive enumeration of all 180 context-action pairs shows that only 40% of positively rewarded plural pairs and 25% of positively rewarded tense pairs are exact matches. Moreover, exact targets are reachable for only 66.7% of plural contexts and 50.0% of tense contexts. The rulebased oracle itself agrees with standard English outputs for 83.3% of plural contexts, 83.3% of tense contexts, and 62.5% of agreement contexts. The observation mapping uses Python’s salted hash() modulo 50; across 256 interpreter hash seeds, 71.5% of mappings contain at least one state alias and 38.7% contain an alias that merges contexts with conflicting reward-optimal actions. Finally, the environment repeats a fixed context for 30 steps and makes transitions independent of action, reducing the claimed sequential task to a contextual-bandit-like classification problem with artificial bootstrapping. These findings do not establish that DQN cannot model morphology. They establish that the notebook’s reward, action, state, evaluation, and visualization contracts do not support a claim of grammar acquisition. We conclude with a repair protocol based on exact string evaluation, expressive edit actions, stable encodings, lexically disjoint tests, multi-seed reporting, and measured transfer analyses.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究提出了奖励—动作有效性审计，并将其应用于一个用于英语名词复数、过去时和主谓一致学习的深度Q网络笔记本。审计发现，虽然实验笔记本报告的代理准确率较高，但正奖励并不总是对应准确输出，动作空间也无法表达部分标准答案；此外，状态编码和环境转移进一步削弱了语法学习结论的有效性。作者据此提出基于精确字符串评估、可表达的编辑动作、稳定编码、词汇不相交测试、多随机种子报告和迁移分析的修复方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 小规模强化学习演示正越来越多地被用于论证智能体在没有大型语言模型的情况下习得了语言规则。即使训练曲线表现良好，这类论断也可能无效：奖励可能接受形式错误的输出，动作接口可能无法表达标准答案，而观测编码器还可能在不同次执行之间发生变化。我们提出了一种奖励—动作有效性审计，并将其应用于一个给定的深度Q网络笔记本，该笔记本旨在处理英语名词复数、过去时构成和主谓一致。实验笔记本分别报告了64.86%、100.00%和69.57%的代理准确率。对全部180个上下文—动作对进行穷举表明，获得正奖励的复数配对中只有40%是精确匹配，获得正奖励的时态配对中只有25%是精确匹配。此外，对于复数上下文，仅有66.7%的上下文能够到达精确目标；对于时态上下文，这一比例为50.0%。规则型预言机本身与标准英语输出的一致率，在复数上下文、时态上下文和一致关系上下文中分别为83.3%、83.3%和62.5%。观测映射采用Python带盐的hash()函数再对50取模；在256个解释器哈希种子中，71.5%的映射至少包含一个状态别名，38.7%的映射包含将具有冲突的最优奖励动作的上下文合并在一起的别名。最后，环境将同一上下文重复30步，并使状态转移独立于动作，从而把所声称的序列任务简化为类似上下文老虎机的分类问题，同时引入人为的自举过程。这些发现并不能证明DQN无法建模形态学。它们证明的是，该笔记本的奖励、动作、状态、评估和可视化契约不足以支持其关于语法习得的论断。我们最后提出了一套修复方案，包括精确的字符串评估、具有表达能力的编辑动作、稳定编码、词汇不相交的测试集、多随机种子报告以及经过测量的迁移分析。

articles.title: Nontrivial spin and orbital textures in YbMn2Ge2
articles.title_zh: YbMn2Ge2中的非平凡自旋与轨道纹理
articles.abstract: Altermagnetism has attracted considerable research interest as a new platform for spintronic functionalities without net magnetization. Extending altermagnetism to two dimensions is highly desirable for applications but remains challenging because the symmetries of most two-dimensional (2D) collinear magnetic materials preserve spin degeneracy, rendering experimentally verified intrinsic two-dimensional altermagnets elusive in bulk materials. Recent theoretical advances demonstrate a route to two-dimensional altermagnetism through surface-induced symmetry breaking in layered antiferromagnetic materials. Using angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy and first-principles calculations, we directly resolve such intrinsic 2D altermagnetic electronic states on the surface of YbMn2Ge2 that emerge despite the magnetically compensated bulk order. These surface states are guaranteed by the quantized Berry phase of the bulk states which enforces their emergence at the terminating surface. Beyond the realization of pure 2D altermagnetism, we further identify a symmetry-protected p-wave orbital angular momentum texture localized at the surface, revealing an orbital analogue of unconventional p-wave magnetic order. Moreover, the anomalous Hall effect is observed, which is unexpected in pristine YbMn2Ge2 with combined time reversal and inversion symmetry. Our work experimentally establishes antiferromagnetic surfaces as a realizable versatile platform for realizing two-dimensional altermagnetism and uncovers a route toward spin–orbital quantum phenomena in magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究利用角分辨光电子能谱和第一性原理计算，直接解析了YbMn2Ge2表面由对称性破缺诱导的内禀二维交错磁性电子态，尽管其体相具有磁补偿有序。研究表明，这些表面态由体相态的量子化贝里相所保证，并进一步发现了局域于表面的、受对称性保护的p波轨道角动量纹理。实验还观测到原本具有时间反演与反演联合对称性的纯净YbMn2Ge2中出人意料的反常霍尔效应，确立了反铁磁表面作为实现二维交错磁性和自旋—轨道量子现象的平台。
articles.focus_summary: 该预印本结合角分辨光电子能谱和第一性原理计算，在 YbMn2Ge2 表面解析出由表面诱导对称性破缺产生的二维交替磁性电子态。工作还识别了受对称性保护的表面 p 波轨道角动量纹理，并将其与体态量子化 Berry 相联系。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的交替磁性、磁性拓扑性质、第一性原理电子结构、二维/表面磁态和自旋轨道耦合方向高度相关。其表面诱导二维交替磁性的机制可为低维磁性与拓扑界面态研究提供直接参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议跟进其对称性分析、Berry 相判据和表面态计算细节，并与我们已有的二维磁体、范德华磁体和磁性拓扑材料筛选框架对接。可进一步研究不同表面终止、应变或异质结界面对交替磁性自旋劈裂和轨道纹理的调控。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交错磁性作为一种无需净磁化的新型自旋电子学功能平台，已经引起了广泛研究兴趣。将交错磁性扩展到二维对于应用十分理想，但仍然充满挑战，因为大多数二维共线磁性材料的对称性会保持自旋简并，使得经过实验验证的本征二维交错磁体在块体材料中仍难以实现。近期理论研究表明，在层状反铁磁材料中通过表面诱导的对称性破缺，可以实现二维交错磁性。我们结合角分辨光电子能谱和第一性原理计算，直接解析了YbMn2Ge2表面上的这类本征二维交错磁性电子态；尽管其体相具有磁补偿有序，这些表面态仍然出现。这些表面态由体相态的量子化贝里相所保证，量子化贝里相强制其在终止表面出现。除了实现纯粹的二维交错磁性之外，我们还发现了局域于表面的、受对称性保护的p波轨道角动量纹理，揭示了非常规p波磁有序的轨道对应物。此外，我们还观测到了反常霍尔效应；对于具有时间反演与反演联合对称性的纯净YbMn2Ge2而言，这一现象出乎意料。我们的工作通过实验确立了反铁磁表面是一种可实现且多用途的平台，可用于实现二维交错磁性，并揭示了通向磁性材料中自旋—轨道量子现象的一条路径。

articles.title: Reliableformer: A Device Aware Framework for Reliable Memristor Transformer Accelerators
articles.title_zh: Reliableformer：面向可靠忆阻器变压器加速器的器件感知框架
articles.abstract: Transformer networks power modern artificial intelligence, yet at data-centre scale their energy and cooling demand limits sustainable deployment. Analog in-memory computing on memristor crossbars promises order-of-magnitude savings, but exposes computation to accuracy-eroding device non-idealities. Because fabrication is expensive, a pre-tapeout-calibrated physically-consistent digital twin de-risks the design. Reliableformer, a device-aware framework, maps a six-block, multi-head Vision Transformer for CIFAR-10 onto a cascaded memristor-crossbar attention datapath, propagating non-idealities from device, through array and architecture, to the computing level. It quantifies the accuracy/area/energy trade-offs of read-out and cell precision, conductance, and programming variation, evaluates each crossbar under IR-drop and temperature-dependent retention physics. Circuit- and software-level mitigations are adopted to recover accuracy through, 46% to 64% under strong variation, 16% to 80% after retention stress. Since material choice determines retention and the on/off ratio, and the dominant non-ideality shifts with scenario, engineers adopt counter-measures accordingly. It is, to our knowledge, the first end-to-end physically-consistent twin for transformers, constituting, unlike CNN implementations, dynamically generated attention products, digital softmax and normalisation layers, and signed in-crossbar encoding. Benchmarking against a fabricated fully-analog perovskite transformer engine confirms these strategies' directional realism, yielding seven transferable design principles. These physics-grounded findings are transferable to memristor accelerators for other architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: Reliableformer是一种器件感知框架，用于将六模块多头视觉Transformer映射到级联忆阻器交叉阵列注意力数据通路，并从器件、阵列和架构层面传播非理想因素。该框架量化了读出与单元精度、电导和编程波动带来的准确率、面积和能耗权衡，并评估了红外压降和温度依赖保持特性。通过电路和软件层面的缓解措施，模型在强波动和保持应力下的准确率得到恢复；研究还总结了七项可迁移的设计原则，并以已制造的全模拟钙钛矿Transformer引擎验证策略的方向性现实性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Transformer网络驱动着现代人工智能，但在数据中心规模下，其能源和冷却需求限制了可持续部署。忆阻器交叉阵列上的模拟存内计算有望实现数量级的节能，但也会使计算暴露于降低准确率的器件非理想因素之中。由于制造成本高昂，经过流片前校准且具有物理一致性的数字孪生模型能够降低设计风险。Reliableformer是一种器件感知框架，它将一个六模块、多头的CIFAR-10视觉Transformer映射到级联忆阻器交叉阵列注意力数据通路，并将非理想因素从器件层、经过阵列层和架构层传播到计算层。该框架量化了读出精度和单元精度、电导以及编程波动带来的准确率、面积和能耗权衡，并在红外压降和温度依赖的保持物理条件下评估每个交叉阵列。在强波动条件下，通过采用电路和软件层面的缓解措施，准确率可恢复到46%至64%；在保持应力之后，可恢复到16%至80%。由于材料选择决定保持特性和开关比，且主导非理想因素会随情景变化，工程师需要据此采用相应的对策。据我们所知，这是首个面向Transformer的端到端、具有物理一致性的数字孪生模型。与卷积神经网络实现不同，该模型包含动态生成的注意力乘积、数字softmax和归一化层，以及交叉阵列内的有符号编码。与已制造的全模拟钙钛矿Transformer引擎进行基准比较，证实了这些策略在方向上的现实性，并得到七项可迁移的设计原则。这些以物理学为基础的发现可迁移到其他架构的忆阻器加速器中。

articles.title: Franz Diffusion Cell Analysis of Hydrogen Peroxide Transport across Cross- linked Seaweed-Derived Bio-Patches: a model for Reactive Oxygen Species- Responsive Wound Management
articles.title_zh: 基于Franz扩散池分析交联海藻衍生生物贴片中的过氧化氢传输：一种用于活性氧响应型伤口管理的模型
articles.abstract: The development of intelligent wound dressings capable of dynamically regulating the oxidative microenvironment is vital for chronic wound care. This study systematically characterizes the transmembrane transport kinetics of hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) across ionic cross-linked seaweed-derived bio-patches (Ulva lactuca and Sargassum sp.) utilizing an adapted vertical Franz-type diffusion cell coupled with real-time colorimetric starch–iodide spectrophotometry. Structural characterization via FTIR and XRD demonstrated that blending amorphous sulfated ulvan into a semi-crystalline calcium-alginate matrix establishes an intermediate molecular sieve with adjustable packing density. Mass transport evaluations over a 60-minute window revealed distinct formulation-dependent transport mechanisms. Pure ulvan thin control (M-G100-Thin) displayed the highest steady-state flux of 5.163 × 10− 4 mmol·cm− 2·min− 1 (apparent permeability P = 5.163 × 10− 5 cm·min− 1) and a short lag phase due to its highly open, hydrophilic network. Conversely, the dense 'egg-box' cross-linked structure of pure alginate thin control (M-B100-Thin) significantly restricted transport, minimizing steady-state flux to 3.513 × 10− 4 mmol·cm− 2·min− 1 (P = 3.513 × 10− 5 cm·min− 1). The optimized heteropolymeric blend film (M-Blend-Thin) successfully balanced these properties, delivering a reliable baseline steady-state flux of 3.739 × 10− 4 mmol•cm− 2•min− 1 (P = 3.739 × 10− 5 cm·min− 1, R2 = 0.9789). Furthermore, scaling physical thickness from ~ 50 to ~ 100 µm (M-Blend-Thick) demonstrated rigorous Fickian behavior, increasing transport resistance to yield a significantly lower flux of 2.518 × 10− 4 mmol·cm− 2·min− 1 (P = 2.518 × 10− 5 cm·min− 1, R2 = 0.9997) and an extended lag phase of 15 minutes. Statistical modeling via Shapiro-Wilk and Levene's tests validated population normality and homoscedasticity, confirming that minor sampling anomalies in the blend profile were isolated procedural events rather than matrix degradation. These findings establish a direct structure-property framework for tailoring marine-derived bio-patches to sustain vital physiological transport while preventing cellular oxidative shock.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究采用改进的垂直Franz型扩散池和实时淀粉—碘化物比色分光光度法，系统表征了过氧化氢在离子交联海藻衍生生物贴片中的跨膜传输动力学。结构表征显示，将无定形硫酸化石莼多糖混入半结晶海藻酸钙基体，可形成具有可调堆积密度的中间分子筛。不同配方表现出明显不同的传输机制：纯石莼多糖薄膜通量最高，纯海藻酸盐薄膜通量最低，而优化的共混薄膜在传输稳定性和阻隔能力之间取得平衡；增加膜厚则表现出严格的菲克行为并延长滞后期。研究建立了结构—性能关系，为调控海洋来源生物贴片的生理性传输并避免细胞氧化冲击提供依据。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 开发能够动态调节氧化微环境的智能伤口敷料，对于慢性伤口护理至关重要。本研究利用改进的垂直Franz型扩散池，并结合实时比色淀粉—碘化物分光光度法，系统表征了过氧化氢（H2O2）在离子交联海藻衍生生物贴片（石莼（Ulva lactuca）和马尾藻属（Sargassum sp.））中的跨膜传输动力学。通过傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）和X射线衍射（XRD）进行的结构表征表明，将无定形硫酸化石莼多糖混入半结晶海藻酸钙基体后，可形成一种具有可调堆积密度的中间分子筛。在60分钟的质量传输评估期间，不同配方表现出不同的传输机制。纯石莼多糖薄膜对照样品（M-G100-Thin）表现出最高的稳态通量，为5.163 × 10−4 mmol·cm−2·min−1（表观渗透系数P = 5.163 × 10−5 cm·min−1），并且由于其高度开放、亲水的网络结构而具有较短的滞后期。相比之下，纯海藻酸盐薄膜对照样品（M-B100-Thin）的致密“蛋盒”交联结构显著限制了传输，使稳态通量降至3.513 × 10−4 mmol·cm−2·min−1（P = 3.513 × 10−5 cm·min−1）。优化的异质聚合物共混膜（M-Blend-Thin）成功平衡了上述性质，提供了可靠的基线稳态通量，为3.739 × 10−4 mmol·cm−2·min−1（P = 3.739 × 10−5 cm·min−1，R2 = 0.9789）。此外，将物理厚度从约50 µm增加到约100 µm（M-Blend-Thick）表现出严格的菲克行为，传输阻力增加，使通量显著降低至2.518 × 10−4 mmol·cm−2·min−1（P = 2.518 × 10−5 cm·min−1，R2 = 0.9997），并使滞后期延长至15分钟。通过Shapiro–Wilk检验和Levene检验进行的统计建模验证了总体正态性和方差齐性，确认共混样品曲线中的轻微取样异常属于孤立的操作事件，而不是基体降解。这些发现建立了一个直接的结构—性能框架，可用于调节海洋来源生物贴片，使其维持重要的生理性传输，同时防止细胞氧化冲击。

articles.title: The interfacial electronic properties of two-dimensional TiI 3 /Sc 2 CO 2 multiferroic heterojunctions for nonvolatile switching
articles.title_zh: 用于非易失性切换的二维TiI3/Sc2CO2多铁异质结界面电子性质
articles.abstract: Publication date: Available online 22 August 2026 Source: Chemical Physics Letters Author(s): Shiying Guo, Chengxu Ge, Chen Zhuang, Mengke Xie, Jing Pan, Jingguo Hu
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕二维TiI3/Sc2CO2多铁异质结的界面电子性质及其在非易失性切换中的应用展开。原始信息仅提供题名、期刊、作者和在线发表日期，具体计算方法、界面特征及切换性能需查阅论文全文。
