These findings establish Ti₂X₂Y monolayers as a versatile platform for exploring spin- and valley-dependent electronic, optical, and transport phenomena in two-dimensional altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 交替磁体兼具完全补偿的磁化强度和依赖动量的自旋劈裂，但具有优异谷特性的本征交替磁性材料仍然稀缺。本文鉴定出单层钛基硫属化物卤化物 Ti₂X₂Y（X = F、Cl、Br、I；Y = O、S、Se、Te）这一新的二维交替磁性谷材料家族。它们具有稳定的 d 波交替磁性序、半导体带隙和显著的自旋极化谷特性；单轴应变可打破谷简并并诱导巨大的谷极化，而面内电场和自旋–轨道耦合则分别带来非共线自旋流以及反常霍尔效应、谷选择性线性二色性和磁光克尔效应。
authors: Ruo-Yu Ning, Zhi-Hua Yan, Jin-Yang Li, Yong-Kun Wang, Si Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体（AM）兼具完全补偿的磁化强度和依赖动量的自旋劈裂，然而具有优异谷特性的本征交替磁性材料仍然十分稀缺。在本文中，我们鉴定出单层钛基硫属化物卤化物 Ti₂X₂Y（X = F、Cl、Br、I；Y = O、S、Se、Te）这一新的二维交替磁性谷材料家族。这些单层材料表现出稳定的 d 波交替磁性序、半导体带隙以及显著的自旋极化谷特性。我们表明，单轴应变能够打破谷简并，诱导巨大的谷极化，并产生可调的压磁响应。面内电场能够产生非共线自旋流，而自旋–轨道耦合则会引起反常霍尔效应、谷选择性线性二色性和磁光克尔效应。这些发现表明，Ti₂X₂Y 单层材料是探索二维交替磁体中自旋依赖和谷依赖电子、光学及输运现象的多用途平台。

articles.title: Tilted p-wave magnet candidate CeNiAsO
articles.title_zh: 倾斜 p 波磁体候选材料 CeNiAsO
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The unexpectedly small ordered moments of CeNiAsO, a candidate for correlated p-wave magnet, have posed a serious challenge to the precise determination of its magnetic structure, hindering the understanding of its fundamental properties. By leveraging the high sensitivity to local internal fields, our ⁷⁵As nuclear quadrupole / magnetic resonance experiments reveal a commensurate antiferromagnetic order with a small out-of-plane moment m_zapprox0.05 μB. This tilted magnetic configuration not only rotates the spin polarization axis away from the crystallographic c-axis, but also enhances the non-relativistic spin splitting. We refer to this rare paradigm as a tilted p-wave magnet.
articles.abstract_zh: CeNiAsO 中出乎意料的小有序磁矩给其磁结构的精确测定带来了挑战，也阻碍了对其基本性质的理解。本文利用对局域内部磁场高度敏感的 ⁷⁵As 核四极/磁共振实验，揭示出具有小面外磁矩的共格反铁磁序，其中 m_z 约为 0.05 μB。该倾斜磁构型不仅使自旋极化轴偏离晶体学 c 轴，还增强了非相对论自旋劈裂，因此作者将这一罕见范式称为倾斜 p 波磁体。
authors: Zhuo Wang, Zheng Liu, Shuo Zou, Hua-Xun Li, Jin-Xin Hu, Zhuolun Qiu, Ze Wang, Jiamin Gong, Lucheng Wei, Kangjian Luo, Hai Zeng, Meng Zhang, Chao Dong, Chuanyin Xi, Junfeng Wang, Jiakun Fang, Xiaotao Han, Guang-Han Cao, Liang Li, Yongkang Luo
articles.abstract_zh_full: CeNiAsO 中出乎意料的小有序磁矩，一直对其磁结构的精确测定构成严重挑战，并阻碍了对其基本性质的理解。通过利用对局域内部磁场的高灵敏度，我们开展了 ⁷⁵As 核四极共振/磁共振实验，揭示出一种具有小面外磁矩 m_z 约为 0.05 μB 的共格反铁磁序。这种倾斜的磁构型不仅使自旋极化轴从晶体学 c 轴方向发生偏转，而且增强了非相对论自旋劈裂。我们将这一罕见范式称为倾斜 p 波磁体。

articles.title: Search for Majorana Bound States in Short Chains of Proxmitised Quantum Dots
articles.title_zh: 短链近邻诱导量子点中的马约拉纳束缚态搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19911v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Majorana zero modes (MZM) appearing at the ends of artificially created one-dimensional p-wave superconductors have been intensively studied recently both theoretically and experimentally. Among possible platforms, proximitised semiconducting wires, and short chains of quantum dots with a superconductor in between were investigated. Here, we propose a different platform consisting of a chain of quantum dots (QDs) sandwiched between an s-wave superconductor and a strong spin-orbit semiconductor, subject to a Zeeman magnetic field. Neglecting spin-conserving hopping processes between QDs and local on-dot superconducting correlations induced by the superconducting proximity effect, reduces the Hamiltonian to the sum of two equivalent Hamiltonians with two independent Hilbert spaces. The resulting model has a staggered structure due to spin-flipping processes tₛₒ and cross-Andreev reflections ΔCAR between neighbouring dots. Our central result is the phase diagram of a short chain consisting of four QDs and coupled to two external reservoirs, obtained by means of the Green function in chiral Majorana representation. The modulus of the retarded Green function, probing the whole chain and calculated for zero energy, is shown to contain information on topology and spatial character of Majorana zero modes. The features observed in the Green function nicely agree with those obtained from the transfer matrix approach. In particular the region in parameter space in which Majorana zero modes display oscillatory wave functions are well reproduced. Likewise the borders of the fermion parity changes obtained by the Green function agree with those obtained by other means.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种寻找马约拉纳零模的新平台：将量子点链夹在 s 波超导体和强自旋–轨道耦合半导体之间，并施加塞曼磁场。忽略量子点之间的自旋守恒跃迁和近邻效应诱导的局域超导关联后，模型可化为两个具有独立希尔伯特空间的等价哈密顿量，其结构由自旋翻转跃迁和邻近量子点间的交叉安德烈夫反射决定。针对四量子点短链，作者利用手性马约拉纳表象中的格林函数得到相图，并表明零能迟延格林函数的模能够反映拓扑性质、马约拉纳零模的空间特征、振荡波函数区域及费米子宇称变化边界。
authors: Bogdan R. Bułka, Karol I. Wysokiński
articles.abstract_zh_full: 出现在人工构造的一维 p 波超导体两端的马约拉纳零模（MZM），近年来在理论和实验上都得到了广泛研究。在各种可能的平台中，近邻诱导超导的半导体线以及中间夹有超导体的量子点短链都曾受到研究。在本文中，我们提出了另一种平台：将量子点（QD）链夹在一个 s 波超导体和一个强自旋–轨道耦合半导体之间，并使其处于塞曼磁场中。忽略量子点之间的自旋守恒跃迁过程以及由超导近邻效应诱导的量子点局域超导关联后，哈密顿量可化为两个等价哈密顿量之和，并对应两个相互独立的希尔伯特空间。由此得到的模型由于自旋翻转过程 t_SO 和相邻量子点之间的交叉安德烈夫反射 Δ_CAR 而具有交错结构。本文的核心结果是一个由四个量子点组成、并与两个外部储库耦合的短链相图，该相图通过手性马约拉纳表象中的格林函数获得。对整个量子点链进行探测并在零能处计算得到的迟延格林函数模，被证明包含有关拓扑性质和马约拉纳零模空间特征的信息。格林函数中观察到的特征与转移矩阵方法得到的结果高度一致。特别是，马约拉纳零模呈现振荡波函数的参数空间区域得到了良好重现。同样，由格林函数得到的费米子宇称变化边界也与其他方法获得的边界相符。

articles.title: Tuning of Photoexcited Electron Dynamics at Monolayer h-BN/Metal Interfaces by Corrugation
articles.title_zh: 通过起伏调控单层六方氮化硼/金属界面光激发电子动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19946v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomic-scale corrugation in two-dimensional materials can modify interfacial electronic coupling, yet its influence on ultrafast carrier relaxation remains poorly established. Here, we compare image potential states (IPS) at monolayer h-BN/Ir(111) and h-BN/Pt(111) interfaces using structural characterization and time-resolved two-photon photoemission spectroscopy. Consistent with literature, h-BN is strongly corrugated on Ir(111) but comparatively flat on Pt(111). The first (n = 1) and second (n = 2) IPS appears at similar energies on both substrates, whereas their relaxation dynamics differ markedly. On h-BN/Ir(111), the IPS decay is response-limited (<20 fs), while h-BN/Pt(111) exhibits lifetimes of 56 fs (n = 1) and 75 fs (n = 2). The lifetime contrast is most consistently explained by corrugation-enhanced overlap of the IPS wavefunction with the metal substrate, which accelerates electron decay. These results indicate that atomic-scale corrugation is an effective physical parameter for tuning ultrafast electron dynamics at two-dimensional material and metal interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 原子尺度起伏能够改变二维材料中的界面电子耦合，但其对超快载流子弛豫的影响尚未得到充分认识。本文通过结构表征和时间分辨双光子光电子能谱，比较了单层 h-BN/Ir(111) 与 h-BN/Pt(111) 界面中的图像势态。尽管两个体系的图像势态能量相近，强烈起伏的 h-BN/Ir(111) 中的寿命受响应限制而小于 20 fs，而较平坦的 h-BN/Pt(111) 中 n = 1 和 n = 2 态的寿命分别为 56 fs 和 75 fs，表明起伏增强了波函数与金属基底的重叠并加速了电子衰减。
authors: Masahiro Shibuta, Maximilian Schaal, Marco Gruenewald, Jonas Brandhoff, Felix Otto, Roman Forker, Torsten Fritz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维材料中的原子尺度起伏能够改变界面电子耦合，但其对超快载流子弛豫的影响仍缺乏充分认识。在本文中，我们结合结构表征和时间分辨双光子光电子能谱，对单层 h-BN/Ir(111) 和 h-BN/Pt(111) 界面中的图像势态（IPS）进行了比较。与文献报道一致，h-BN 在 Ir(111) 上具有强烈起伏，而在 Pt(111) 上则相对平坦。两个基底上的第一态（n = 1）和第二态（n = 2）图像势态出现在相近的能量位置，但它们的弛豫动力学存在显著差异。在 h-BN/Ir(111) 上，图像势态的衰减受到仪器响应限制，时间小于 20 fs；而在 h-BN/Pt(111) 上，n = 1 和 n = 2 态的寿命分别为 56 fs 和 75 fs。最一致的解释是，起伏增强了图像势态波函数与金属基底之间的重叠，从而加速了电子衰减。这些结果表明，原子尺度起伏是调控二维材料/金属界面超快电子动力学的有效物理参数。

articles.title: A low-temperature setup for lock-in technique based dynamic magnetoelectric coupling measurements
articles.title_zh: 用于低温锁相技术动态磁电耦合测量的实验装置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19956v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetoelectric (ME) phenomena in emerging material classes, such as two-dimensional van der Waals (vdW) magnets and Single-Molecule Magnets (SMMs), hold immense promise for next-generation cryogenic memory and quantum technologies. However, ME coupling in these systems predominantly manifests at low temperatures, making a sensitive, cryo-compatible ME characterization techniques critical. To address this requirement, we report the design, validation, and performance of a custom closed-cycle refrigerator-based setup for dynamic lock-in ME coupling measurements across 20-300 K under dc magnetic fields up to 7.5 kOe. Key design considerations for mitigating parasitic inductive background signals are also presented. The setup was validated on a CoFe2O4-BaTiO3 (CFO-BTO) particulate composite, reproducing the characteristic room-temperature butterfly ME loop with a maximum ME coefficient value of 0.23 mV/cm-Oe at ~ 3 kOe. Temperature-dependent measurements resolved ME anomalies at ~ 200 K and 280 K, coinciding with the rhombohedral-orthorhombic and orthorhombic-tetragonal structural transitions of BaTiO3, and were corroborated by simultaneous dielectric measurements on the same sample without cryostat reconfiguration. The instrument enables reliable ME and dielectric characterization down to 20 K, making it well suited for probing weak magnetoelectric coupling and phase transitions in multiferroic composites and quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维范德华磁体和单分子磁体等新兴材料中的磁电现象通常在低温下表现出来，因此需要灵敏且兼容低温环境的磁电表征技术。本文设计、验证并评估了一套基于定制闭循环制冷机的动态锁相磁电耦合测量装置，可在 20–300 K 和最高 7.5 kOe 的直流磁场下工作，并针对寄生感应背景信号提出了抑制措施。该装置在 CoFe2O4–BaTiO3 复合材料上的测试重现了室温蝴蝶形磁电回线及约 0.23 mV/cm-Oe 的最大磁电系数，并观察到与 BaTiO3 结构相变对应的低温磁电异常。
authors: Balwant Singh Chauhan, Priyanka Sharma, Rie Y. Umetsu, Ratnamala Chatterjee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 新兴材料类别中的磁电（ME）现象，例如二维范德华（vdW）磁体和单分子磁体（SMM）中的磁电现象，对下一代低温存储器和量子技术具有巨大潜力。然而，这些体系中的磁电耦合主要在低温下表现出来，因此灵敏且兼容低温环境的磁电表征技术至关重要。为满足这一需求，我们报告了一套基于定制闭循环制冷机的动态锁相磁电耦合测量装置的设计、验证和性能。该装置能够在 20–300 K 的温度范围内、最高 7.5 kOe 的直流磁场下进行测量。我们还介绍了用于减小寄生感应背景信号的关键设计考虑。我们使用 CoFe2O4–BaTiO3（CFO–BTO）颗粒复合材料对该装置进行了验证，重现了具有特征性的室温蝴蝶形磁电回线，其最大磁电系数在约 3 kOe 处达到 0.23 mV/cm-Oe。温度依赖测量分辨出了约 200 K 和 280 K 处的磁电异常，这些异常分别与 BaTiO3 的菱方相–正交相和正交相–四方相结构转变相吻合；同时，在无需重新配置低温恒温器的情况下，对同一样品开展的介电测量也证实了这些异常。该仪器能够可靠地实现低至 20 K 的磁电和介电表征，适用于研究多铁性复合材料和量子材料中的弱磁电耦合及相变。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文介绍了一套用于20至300 K、外加磁场条件下动态磁电耦合测量的低温锁相技术平台，并通过CoFe₂O₄-BaTiO₃复合材料验证装置性能。实验解析了磁电响应随温度的变化，并观察到与BaTiO₃结构相变相关的异常。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的磁电耦合、铁电/多铁材料、二维磁体和低温磁性研究相关，但论文核心是实验测量装置与表征方法，而不是材料模拟或理论建模。其温度依赖磁电响应数据可为有效哈密顿量、声子耦合和有限温度模拟提供实验验证依据。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可结合第一性原理计算和有效哈密顿量，解析BaTiO₃结构相变、磁致伸缩和界面耦合对动态磁电系数的贡献。若研究二维范德华磁电材料，也可借鉴该平台开展低温频率依赖和磁场依赖测量。

articles.title: Role of topology in scaling laws for studying mechanics in open-porous solids: Moving beyond classical Gibson-Ashby scaling
articles.title_zh: 拓扑在开放孔隙固体力学标度定律研究中的作用：超越经典 Gibson–Ashby 标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20003v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The elastic modulus of porous materials is commonly described using power-law scaling relations with relative density, where the scaling exponent is often interpreted in terms of the underlying deformation mechanism. However, in highly disordered porous networks, changes in density are generally accompanied by changes in network topology, which can substantially modify the apparent scaling behavior. In this paper, we propose a topology-informed framework that separates the intrinsic mechanical contribution from the effects of network structure. Three representative topological descriptors are considered: the mean coordination number, the fraction of the load-bearing backbone, and the tortuosity of the load paths. For each case, the corresponding density-dependent contribution to the apparent modulus-scaling exponent is derived and analyzed. The results show that variations in connectivity, mechanical participation of the solid phase, and load-path efficiency can all lead to apparent scaling exponents exceeding the intrinsic exponent associated with the local deformation mechanism. These effects are particularly pronounced at low relative densities, where network topology evolves most strongly. The framework provides a physically interpretable basis for understanding anomalous modulus-density scaling in disordered porous materials and highlights the need to consider topology explicitly alongside relative density.
articles.abstract_zh: 多孔材料的弹性模量通常用相对密度的幂律关系描述，但在高度无序的孔隙网络中，密度变化往往伴随网络拓扑变化，从而改变表观标度行为。本文提出一种融入拓扑信息的框架，将材料的内禀力学贡献与网络结构效应分离，并分析平均配位数、承载骨架比例和载荷路径曲折度对表观标度指数的影响。结果表明，连通性、固相的力学参与程度以及载荷路径效率均可能使表观指数超过局部变形机制对应的内禀指数，尤其在低相对密度下更为明显。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多孔材料的弹性模量通常利用相对于密度的幂律标度关系进行描述，其中标度指数常被解释为潜在变形机制的体现。然而，在高度无序的多孔网络中，密度变化通常伴随着网络拓扑的变化，而这种变化可能显著改变表观标度行为。本文提出一种融入拓扑信息的框架，用于将内禀力学贡献与网络结构的影响分离开来。研究考虑了三种具有代表性的拓扑描述量：平均配位数、承载骨架的比例以及载荷路径的曲折度。针对每一种描述量，本文推导并分析了其对表观模量标度指数的相应密度依赖贡献。结果表明，连通性、固相的力学参与程度以及载荷路径效率的变化，都可能导致表观标度指数超过与局部变形机制相关的内禀指数。在低相对密度下，这些效应尤其显著，因为此时网络拓扑的演化最为强烈。该框架为理解无序多孔材料中异常的模量—密度标度关系提供了具有物理可解释性的基础，并强调除了相对密度之外，还必须明确考虑拓扑因素。

articles.title: Anomalous behavior of native point defects in C2-ordered antiferromagnet α-MnO₂
articles.title_zh: C2 有序反铁磁 α-MnO₂ 中本征点缺陷的反常行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20039v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: α-MnO₂ is an emerging material for electronic, optoelectronic, and energy applications, owing to its structural flexibility and defect-driven functionality. During synthesis of α-MnO₂, native oxygen vacancies readily form and are typically compensated by foreign dopants. A thorough understanding of intrinsic defects is therefore essential for enabling controlled extrinsic doping and optimizing material performance. Using density functional approach, we investigate the structural, electronic, magnetic, and optical properties of the ground state C2-type antiferromagnetic α-MnO₂ in the presence of native point defects, including interstitials, vacancies, and antisites. We compute their thermodynamic stability, incorporating electrostatic corrections to eliminate spurious long-range interactions. Mn interstitial (Mnᵢ₎ and Mn antisite O (Mn_O) introduce shallow donor levels, whereas O-vacancy (V_O) exhibit amphoteric behavior and act as compensating centers. The calculated defect formation energies reveal pronounced competition between donor- and acceptor-type native defects, leading to strong intrinsic defect compensation under both Mn-rich and O-rich growth conditions. Mn vacancy (V_Mn) remains ionized across the band gap and behaves as a shallow acceptor, suggesting its potential role under suitable non-equilibrium growth conditions, whereas O antisite Mn (O_Mn) forms deep acceptor levels. BSE@G₀W₀ calculations reveal a strongly anisotropic optical response in stoichiometric α-MnO₂, while native point defects introduce pronounced sub-gap excitations and enhanced dielectric screening, with vacancies producing the largest effect.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用密度泛函方法研究了基态 C2 型反铁磁 α-MnO₂ 中间隙、空位和反位等本征点缺陷的结构、电子、磁学和光学性质。Mn 间隙和 Mn 替代 O 的反位缺陷引入浅施主能级，氧空位表现出两性特征并充当补偿中心，而 Mn 空位是浅受主，O 替代 Mn 则形成深受主能级。缺陷形成能显示，在富 Mn 和富 O 生长条件下，施主型与受主型缺陷之间均存在显著竞争；缺陷还会引起明显的带隙内激发和介电屏蔽增强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: α-MnO₂ 凭借其结构灵活性和缺陷驱动的功能性，正成为电子、光电子和能源应用中的一种新兴材料。在 α-MnO₂ 的合成过程中，本征氧空位很容易形成，并且通常由外来掺杂剂进行补偿。因此，全面理解本征缺陷对于实现可控的外源掺杂和优化材料性能至关重要。本文采用密度泛函方法，研究了存在本征点缺陷时基态 C2 型反铁磁 α-MnO₂ 的结构、电子、磁学和光学性质，所考察的缺陷包括间隙缺陷、空位和反位缺陷。研究计算了这些缺陷的热力学稳定性，并纳入静电修正，以消除无关的长程相互作用。Mn 间隙缺陷（Mnᵢ）和 Mn 替代 O 的反位缺陷（Mn_O）会引入浅施主能级，而氧空位（V_O）表现出两性特征并充当补偿中心。计算得到的缺陷形成能表明，在富 Mn 和富 O 两种生长条件下，施主型与受主型本征缺陷之间都存在显著竞争，从而导致强烈的本征缺陷补偿。Mn 空位（V_Mn）在整个带隙范围内保持电离状态并表现为浅受主，这表明在适当的非平衡生长条件下，它可能发挥作用；相比之下，O 替代 Mn 的反位缺陷（O_Mn）会形成深受主能级。BSE@G₀W₀ 计算揭示，化学计量 α-MnO₂ 具有强烈的各向异性光学响应，而本征点缺陷会引入显著的带隙内激发并增强介电屏蔽，其中空位产生的影响最大。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文利用密度泛函理论研究C2型反铁磁α-MnO₂中间隙、空位和反位等本征点缺陷的结构、电子、磁性与光学性质，并计算包含静电修正的缺陷形成能。结果表明，Mn间隙和Mn替代O位可形成浅施主能级，氧空位具有两性缺陷特征并可能成为补偿中心，体系存在显著的本征缺陷补偿效应。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的半导体缺陷、磁性材料、缺陷形成能、电荷补偿和第一性原理计算方向高度相关，也涉及反铁磁基态及缺陷诱导电子和光学性质变化。其静电修正方法和缺陷竞争机制分析可直接借鉴到氧化物、磁性半导体及功能材料研究中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合缺陷跃迁能级、载流子俘获与非辐射复合理论，研究缺陷对α-MnO₂输运和光电性能的影响。还可使用机器学习势或有效自旋哈密顿量开展缺陷环境下的有限温度结构和磁性动力学研究。

articles.title: Effect of molecular constraints on vibrational and quasilocalized excitations in glasses
articles.title_zh: 分子约束对玻璃中振动激发与准局域化激发的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20049v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent years have seen substantial progress in elucidating the statistical physics of the vibrational properties of structural glasses. Although many real-world glasses relevant for science and technology are molecular, the majority of computational studies concerning the mechanical and vibrational properties of structural glasses employ simple atomistic glass-forming models. Thus, the effects of stiff molecular constraints on mechanical and vibrational glass physics remain largely unexplored. In this work, we directly compare the properties of a molecular computer glass with those of an atomistic model featuring the same inter-molecular interaction potential, and created using the same formation protocol. We find that the molecular glass features a higher degree of mechanical disorder, with larger mesoscopic correlation lengths, while at the same time it hosts a lower number of soft, quasilocalized vibrations per atom -- compared to the atomistic glass. We rationalize these differences by accounting for the reduction in the effective number of degrees of freedom induced by the stiff molecular constraints. We additionally find that nonlinear plastic modes --- that carry plastic deformation in driven glassy solids --- couple much more strongly to volumetric strains in the molecular glass. Future research directions are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文比较了具有分子间相互作用势的分子计算玻璃与原子模型玻璃的力学和振动性质，两者采用相同的形成过程。分子玻璃具有更高程度的力学无序和更大的介观关联长度，但单位原子所承载的软准局域化振动更少，这些差异可由刚性分子约束导致的有效自由度减少来解释。研究还发现，承载受驱玻璃态固体塑性变形的非线性塑性模态，在分子玻璃中与体积应变的耦合显著更强。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，人们在阐明结构玻璃振动性质的统计物理方面取得了 substantial 的进展。尽管许多与科学和技术相关的现实玻璃都是分子型的，但有关结构玻璃力学和振动性质的大多数计算研究仍采用简单的原子级成玻璃模型。因此，刚性分子约束对玻璃力学和振动物理的影响在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在本研究中，我们直接比较了一种分子计算玻璃与一种原子模型的性质；两者具有相同的分子间相互作用势，并采用相同的形成过程。我们发现，与原子玻璃相比，分子玻璃具有更高程度的力学无序和更大的介观关联长度，但同时每个原子对应的软准局域化振动数量更少。我们通过考虑刚性分子约束所导致的有效自由度减少，对这些差异作出了解释。此外，我们还发现，在受驱玻璃态固体中承载塑性变形的非线性塑性模态，在分子玻璃中与体积应变的耦合强得多。最后，本文讨论了未来的研究方向。

articles.title: Effects of the surface on double surface Fermi arcs in a realistic tight-binding model of Na₃Bi (100)
articles.title_zh: 真实紧束缚模型中表面对 Na₃Bi（100）双表面费米弧的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Na₃Bi is a topological Dirac semimetal (TDSM) that can support double surface Fermi arcs (DSFAs), which are important for its material classification and their potential use in spintronic devices. However, it is unclear how the surfaces affect realistic Na₃Bi (100) systems. To investigate the effects of diverse surfaces on DSFAs, we consider first principles derived tight-binding models of two Na₃Bi (100) terminations. On the stoichiometric termination, we find DSFAs as expected. On the non-stoichiometric structure there are DSFAs on one termination and two loops that retain many of the properties of DSFAs. Thus, the local properties such as spin momentum locking and hybridization with the Dirac points appear to be more robust than their global connectivity. That is, the surface can reshape the arc fingerprint without destroying the arc-like physics.
articles.abstract_zh: Na₃Bi 是一种可支持双表面费米弧的拓扑狄拉克半金属，但不同表面对真实 Na₃Bi（100）体系的影响尚不清楚。本文基于第一性原理推导的紧束缚模型，研究了两种 Na₃Bi（100）表面终止结构。化学计量终止面呈现预期的双表面费米弧；非化学计量结构的一种终止面仍具有双表面费米弧，另一种则出现保留许多费米弧性质的两个环。结果表明，自旋—动量锁定和与狄拉克点的杂化等局域性质比整体连通性更稳健。
authors: Vasilios K. Passias, Lucas K. Wagner
articles.abstract_zh_full: Na₃Bi 是一种拓扑狄拉克半金属（TDSM），能够支持双表面费米弧（DSFA）；这种性质对于其材料分类以及在自旋电子器件中的潜在应用都十分重要。然而，表面如何影响真实的 Na₃Bi（100）体系，目前尚不清楚。为研究不同表面对双表面费米弧的影响，我们考虑了两种由第一性原理推导得到的 Na₃Bi（100）终止结构的紧束缚模型。在化学计量终止结构上，我们发现了预期的双表面费米弧。在非化学计量结构上，一个终止面存在双表面费米弧，而另一个终止面出现了两个环，这两个环仍保留了双表面费米弧的许多性质。因此，自旋—动量锁定以及与狄拉克点的杂化等局域性质，似乎比其整体连通性更加稳健。换言之，表面可以重塑费米弧的特征图样，却不会破坏其类费米弧的物理性质。

articles.title: Quantum Dissipative Paraelectricity
articles.title_zh: 量子耗散顺电性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20168v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Whether a quantum system with a double-well effective potential undergoes spontaneous symmetry breaking depends not only on the potential landscape but also on the kinetics and the coupling with additional degrees of freedom. Here we introduce a quasi-exactly solvable model to study this problem in the context of ferroelectrics, with results that apply to a broad class of quantum phase transitions. Exploiting the analytical solutions, we provide a strict definition of the quantum paraelectric regime and identify a distinct quantum ferroelectric regime in which symmetry breaking can be realized without tunneling features. We then show that explicit symmetry breaking cannot be inferred from the order-parameter Hamiltonian alone, but requires additional couplings. This leads us to identify a regime of emphquantum dissipative paraelectricity, in which observable symmetry breaking is suppressed during the evolution toward the ground state, even when the double-well structure dominates over zero-point quantum fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文引入一个准精确可解模型，研究具有双阱有效势的量子系统在动力学和附加自由度耦合作用下是否发生自发对称性破缺。作者严格定义了量子顺电区域，并识别出一种无需隧穿特征即可实现对称性破缺的量子铁电区域。研究进一步表明，显式对称性破缺不能仅由序参量哈密顿量推断，而需要额外耦合；由此得到量子耗散顺电性区域，其中即使双阱结构压倒零点量子涨落，向基态演化过程中的可观测对称性破缺仍会受到抑制。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一个具有双阱有效势的量子系统是否会发生自发对称性破缺，不仅取决于势能景观，也取决于动力学以及系统与其他自由度之间的耦合。本文引入一个准精确可解模型，在铁电体背景下研究这一问题，其结果适用于一大类量子相变。利用解析解，我们严格定义了量子顺电区域，并确定了一种不同的量子铁电区域，在该区域中，即使不存在隧穿特征，也可以实现对称性破缺。随后我们证明，显式对称性破缺不能仅由序参量哈密顿量本身推断出来，而必须引入额外耦合。这使我们确定了一个量子耗散顺电性区域：在向基态演化的过程中，即使双阱结构相对于零点量子涨落占主导地位，可观测的对称性破缺仍会受到抑制。

articles.title: Floquet Theory for Light-Driven Rotation of Dipolar and Multipolar Particles
articles.title_zh: 偶极与多极粒子光驱动旋转的 Floquet 理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nano- or micro-particle rotation driven by light has been well known in the fields of optical manipulation and optical physics since the end of the last century. It is viewed as a sort of angular-momentum transfer from light to material, but its microscopic analysis based on the Hamiltonian or the equation of motion has been less developed. We model this rotation with a simple setup of an electrically dipolar or multipolar particle irradiated by circularly polarized laser and comprehensively analyze the Langevin-type equation of motion by using the Floquet theory for dissipative classical systems and the mode separation method. Furthermore, we numerically compute the time evolution of the particle. As a result, we accurately estimate the dependence of the laser-frequency, laser-intensity, particle mass, temperature, and friction (dissipation) on the laser-driven rotation. We determine the ``nonequilibrium phase diagram'' of the laser-driven rotation in a broad parameter regime, which consists of three regimes: the rotation frequency Ømegaproptoømega⁻¹, Ømegaproptoømega⁻³, or Ømega=ømega (ømega is the laser frequency). Comparing our theoretical result with some experiments, we show that the result of the overdamped Langevin equation is qualitatively consistent with the experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文以受到圆偏振激光照射的电偶极或多极粒子为模型，利用耗散经典系统的 Floquet 理论和模态分离方法，系统分析光驱动旋转的 Langevin 型运动方程。研究计算了激光频率、激光强度、粒子质量、温度和摩擦耗散对旋转的影响，并确定了广泛参数范围内的非平衡相图。该相图包含旋转频率分别与激光频率的负一次方、负三次方成正比以及与激光频率相等的三个区域，过阻尼 Langevin 方程的结果与实验在定性上相符。
authors: Amane Takano, Minoru Kanega, Masahiro Sato
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自上世纪末以来，光驱动纳米或微米粒子旋转一直是光学操控和光学物理领域中的一个众所周知的现象。它通常被视为光向物质传递角动量的一种形式，但基于哈密顿量或运动方程的微观分析仍发展不足。本文以受到圆偏振激光照射的电偶极或多极粒子这一简单体系对该旋转过程建模，并利用耗散经典系统的 Floquet 理论和模态分离方法，对 Langevin 型运动方程进行了全面分析。此外，本文还数值计算了粒子的时间演化。结果表明，我们能够准确估计激光频率、激光强度、粒子质量、温度以及摩擦（耗散）对激光驱动旋转的依赖关系。我们在广泛的参数范围内确定了激光驱动旋转的“非平衡相图”，其中包含三个区域：旋转频率与激光频率成反比、与激光频率的三次方成反比，以及旋转频率等于激光频率（激光频率记为 ω）。通过将理论结果与一些实验进行比较，我们表明，过阻尼 Langevin 方程的结果在定性上与实验相一致。

articles.title: Universal meson spectra near (1+1)-dimensional Ising criticality
articles.title_zh: （1+1）维伊辛临界性附近的普适介子谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20221v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Near (1+1)-dimensional [(1+1)D] Ising criticality, a magnetic perturbation induces confinement and produces a cascade of bound-state excitations known as mesons. Here we show these mesons share a universal mass scaling after independently rescaling the model-dependent microscopic couplings. The number of stable mesons is controlled by the lightest two-meson threshold, while the lightest-meson mass follows a continuous trajectory characterized by a single scaling parameter. Using Hamiltonian truncation method, we obtain the trajectory numerically in both Ising field theory and the near-critical mixed-field Ising chain (MFIC). Under the rescaling, the trajectory and stable-meson-count crossover windows of MFIC both collapse onto the field-theory results. To further demonstrate the above universal organization of the meson spectra, we consider a class of four-periodic spin-1/2 Heisenberg-Ising chains under transverse fields, whose parameter space contains a family of quantum Ising critical points. The Hamiltonian family includes effective spin models for the quasi-one-dimensional antiferromagnets Ba(Sr)Co₂V₂O₈. Using tensor-network calculations, we obtain the corresponding lightest-meson mass trajectory for BaCo₂V₂O₈ and find that it also collapse onto the same universal curve given by field-theory result. Our results suggest that the universal scaling structure of quantum Ising criticality extends into the nearby confining regime, governing the organization of the meson spectrum. They thereby provide a practical criterion for interpreting excitations of quasi-1D Ising-like magnets in mixed fields beyond E₈ integrability.
articles.abstract_zh: 在（1+1）维伊辛临界性附近，磁场扰动会产生禁闭并形成一系列称为介子的束缚态激发。本文表明，在分别重标度模型依赖的微观耦合后，这些介子具有普适的质量标度关系；稳定介子数目由最低的双介子阈值控制，而最低介子质量沿单一标度参数决定的连续轨迹变化。哈密顿量截断和张量网络计算显示，近临界混合场伊辛链以及 BaCo₂V₂O₈ 的结果均塌缩到场论给出的同一普适曲线。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在（1+1）维伊辛临界性附近，磁场扰动会诱导禁闭，并产生一系列被称为介子的束缚态激发。本文表明，在分别对模型依赖的微观耦合进行重标度之后，这些介子具有普适的质量标度关系。稳定介子的数量由最低的双介子阈值控制，而最低介子的质量沿一条由单一标度参数刻画的连续轨迹变化。我们采用哈密顿量截断方法，在伊辛场论和近临界混合场伊辛链（MFIC）中数值获得了这条轨迹。在重标度之后，MFIC 的轨迹以及稳定介子数目的交叉窗口都塌缩到场论结果上。为进一步展示介子谱的上述普适组织结构，我们考察了一类具有四周期结构、处于横向场中的自旋 1/2 海森堡—伊辛链；其参数空间包含一族量子伊辛临界点。这族哈密顿量包括准一维反铁磁体 Ba(Sr)Co₂V₂O₈ 的有效自旋模型。利用张量网络计算，我们获得了 BaCo₂V₂O₈ 中最低介子的质量轨迹，并发现它同样塌缩到由场论结果给出的同一条普适曲线上。我们的结果表明，量子伊辛临界性的普适标度结构可以延伸到邻近的禁闭区域，并支配介子谱的组织方式。因此，这些结果为解释混合场中类伊辛准一维磁体的激发提供了一个实用判据，其适用范围超越了 E₈ 可积性情形。

articles.title: Coulomb blockade-like transport and enhanced memory in organic transistors embedded with sub-nm Pt nanoparticles for neuromorphic computing
articles.title_zh: 嵌入亚纳米铂纳米颗粒的有机晶体管中的类库仑阻塞输运与增强记忆：面向神经形态计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20245v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organic transistors are playing an increasingly important role for neuromorphic applications. However, devices that rely solely on ferroelectric switching or on interface traps for their multi-conductance states exhibit limited memory windows. Here, we introduce an ultrathin oxide layer with a uniform distribution of sub-nm platinum nanoparticles (PtNPs) at the interface of a polymer semiconducting and a ferroelectric dielectric in a thin film transistor architecture. The interfacial stack, Al₂O₃/PtNP/Al₂O₃, provides a viable route for localized charge trapping and de-trapping in a region where it can most effectively influence the channel conductance. The organic transistors display a large memory window (> 20 V) in their current-voltage characteristics. The sub-nm PtNPs give rise to features that are consistent with room temperature Coulomb blockade-like transport, supporting discrete and well-separated levels within the memory window. The devices support multimodal programming using electrical and optical stimuli with both long-term plasticity and enhanced short-term plasticity (STP) phenomena. These results open new directions for implementing STP in the development of neuromorphic computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在聚合物半导体与铁电介质界面引入均匀分布的亚纳米铂纳米颗粒，并构建了 Al₂O₃/PtNP/Al₂O₃ 界面结构，以实现局域电荷俘获和释放。所得有机晶体管的电流—电压特性具有超过 20 V 的大记忆窗口，亚纳米铂颗粒产生了与室温类库仑阻塞输运一致的特征。器件支持电和光两种刺激下的多模式编程，同时表现出长期可塑性和增强的短期可塑性，为神经形态计算中的短期可塑性实现提供了新方向。
authors: Arash Ghobadi, Thomas B. Kallaos, Abhi Abhijeet, Stephen C. Klue, Joseph C. Mathai, Carsten A. Ullrich, Shubhra Gangopadhyay, Suchismita Guha
articles.abstract_zh_full: 有机晶体管在神经形态应用中正发挥日益重要的作用。然而，仅依赖铁电切换或界面陷阱来实现多电导态的器件，其记忆窗口受到限制。本文在薄膜晶体管结构中，于聚合物半导体与铁电介质的界面处引入一个含有均匀分布亚纳米铂纳米颗粒（PtNP）的超薄氧化物层。Al₂O₃/PtNP/Al₂O₃ 界面堆叠结构为局域电荷俘获和释放提供了可行途径，并且这一过程发生在能够最有效影响沟道电导的区域。有机晶体管在电流—电压特性中表现出较大的记忆窗口（大于 20 V）。亚纳米 PtNP 产生了与室温类库仑阻塞输运相一致的特征，支持记忆窗口内离散且彼此分离的能级。器件支持利用电刺激和光刺激进行多模式编程，同时表现出长期可塑性和增强的短期可塑性（STP）现象。这些结果为在神经形态计算发展中实现短期可塑性开辟了新的方向。

articles.title: Learning Potts Models and Z₃ Toric Codes: Higher and Ordinary Nishimori Criticality
articles.title_zh: 学习 Potts 模型与 Z₃ 托里克码：高阶与普通 Nishimori 临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20268v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by a previous Ising study, we identify a it higher Nishimori line in the learning phase diagram of the 2D q-state Potts model (2 < qłeq 4) under bond-energy measurements. This it higher Nishimori line meets the critical temperature line of the Potts model, in a it higher Nishimori critical point -- a tricritical point at finite inference strength that separates a paramagnetic, a ferromagnetic and a 'spin-glass' phase. With analytical tools, we discuss the general structure of the rich phase diagram, which contains two unstable and three stable fixed points, and obtain a number of exact results for universal quantities, including the decay exponent of the Edwards-Anderson correlator, using a Gaussian measurement protocol which allows for exact calculations. Using extensive numerical tools, we confirm these statements for a generic, discrete q-state measurement protocol and determine precise numerical estimates for the location of higher and ordinary Nishimori critical points as well as RG flows between the various fixed points. We also discuss the Casimir effective central charges of the critical points in the learning phase diagram, and their monotonic it decrease along measurement-induced RG flows, as established non-perturbatively by the c-effective theorem and its extensions, and contrast it to the monotonic increase along the corresponding RG flows in the random-bond Potts model. Finally, we discuss a general argument based on it Elitzur's ; theorem that establishes stability of the ordinary Nishimori critical points in their respective learning phase diagrams. Equivalently, our results describe a monitored deformed Z_q toric code where the tricritical it higher Nishimori point is an 'information' critical point that separates stable quantum, classical, and no memory phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在键能测量下的二维 q 态 Potts 模型学习相图中，识别出一条高阶 Nishimori 线，并研究其与 Potts 模型临界温度线相交形成的高阶 Nishimori 临界点。该点是一个有限推断强度下的三临界点，分隔顺磁、铁磁和自旋玻璃相；研究解析地讨论了相图结构，并结合数值计算确定了高阶和普通 Nishimori 临界点的位置及固定点之间的重整化群流。结果还可等价解释为受监测的变形 Z_q 托里克码，其中高阶 Nishimori 点是分隔稳定量子相、经典相和无记忆相的信息临界点。
authors: Rushikesh A. Patil, Malte Pütz, Rohit Mukherjee, Guo-Yi Zhu, Simon Trebst, Andreas W. W. Ludwig
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受先前一项伊辛模型研究的启发，我们在键能测量下二维 q 态 Potts 模型（2 < q ≤ 4）的学习相图中识别出一条高阶 Nishimori 线。这条高阶 Nishimori 线与 Potts 模型的临界温度线相交于一个高阶 Nishimori 临界点；该点是有限推断强度下的三临界点，分隔顺磁相、铁磁相和“自旋玻璃”相。借助解析工具，我们讨论了这一丰富相图的一般结构。相图包含两个不稳定固定点和三个稳定固定点；利用允许精确计算的高斯测量方案，我们获得了包括 Edwards–Anderson 关联函数衰减指数在内的一些普适量的精确结果。通过广泛的数值方法，我们对一般的离散 q 态测量方案验证了这些论断，并精确确定了高阶和普通 Nishimori 临界点的位置，以及不同固定点之间的重整化群流。我们还讨论了学习相图中各临界点的 Casimir 有效中心荷，以及这些中心荷沿测量诱导的重整化群流单调减小的性质；这一性质已由有效 c 定理及其推广以非微扰方式确立。我们将其与随机键 Potts 模型中相应重整化群流所表现出的单调增加进行对比。最后，我们基于 Elitzur 定理提出一个一般性论证，说明普通 Nishimori 临界点在各自学习相图中的稳定性。等价地，我们的结果描述了一个受监测的变形 Z_q 托里克码，其中三临界的高阶 Nishimori 点是一个“信息”临界点，分隔稳定的量子相、经典相和无记忆相。

articles.title: Strange Metal Hall Effect in Underdoped BaFe₂₍As₁₋ₓPₓ₎₂
articles.title_zh: 欠掺杂 BaFe₂(As₁₋ₓPₓ)₂ 中奇异金属的霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20325v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The unusual transport properties of strange metals point to the breakdown of the quasiparticle picture, the understanding of which remains one of the most vexing problems in physics. Here, we report investigations of the electrical Hall effect of the strange metal superconductor BaFe₂₍As₁₋ₓPₓ₎₂. We show that a doping-independent contribution to the Hall effect exists within a fan shaped region above a putative quantum critical point. This `strange metal Hall' contribution echoes many of the properties of the antiferromangetic Hall response, but attains universal properties that distinguish it from the effects of Fermi surface reconstruction. This is consistent with an underlying origin connected to the presence of critical fluctuations, tying it to observations of T-linear resistivity and the appearance of unconventional superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了奇异金属超导体 BaFe₂(As₁₋ₓPₓ)₂ 的电霍尔效应。研究发现，在假定量子临界点上方的扇形区域内存在与掺杂无关的霍尔效应贡献，该贡献具有类似反铁磁霍尔响应的性质，同时又表现出区别于费米面重构效应的普适特征。结果支持其起源与临界涨落有关，并将其与 T 线性电阻率及非常规超导性的出现联系起来。
authors: Augusto Ghiotto, Darian Hall, Yuanqi Lyu, Kohtaro Yamakawa, Sophie Rodehutskors, Corina Dunn, Philip J. W. Moll, John Singleton, Nikola Maksimovic, James G. Analytis
articles.abstract_zh_full: 奇异金属的异常输运性质表明，准粒子图像可能发生了失效，而对这一问题的理解仍是物理学中最棘手的问题之一。本文报告了对奇异金属超导体 BaFe₂(As₁₋ₓPₓ)₂ 电霍尔效应的研究。我们表明，在一个位于假定量子临界点上方的扇形区域内，存在一个与掺杂无关的霍尔效应贡献。这一“奇异金属霍尔”贡献与反铁磁霍尔响应的许多性质相呼应，但同时获得了能够将其与费米面重构效应区分开的普适性质。该结果与一种源于临界涨落的机制相一致，并将其与 T 线性电阻率的观测以及非常规超导性的出现联系起来。

articles.title: Competing triangular and stripe supersolid orders in a dipolar quantum gas
articles.title_zh: 偶极量子气体中相互竞争的三角形与条纹超固体序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20327v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Supersolids are exotic quantum states in which long-range phase coherence coexists, and may interplay, with emergent spatial orders. A particularly rich phase diagram featuring several competing spatial orders is predicted for dipolar supersolids with two-dimensional crystals, yet the experimental observation of this structural variety has remained limited. Here we experimentally form competing triangular and stripe density-modulated states in a quantum gas of highly magnetic atoms confined in a surfboard-shaped trap by tuning contact interaction strength and dipole orientation. We define a structural order parameter and study its statistical behavior. Thereby, we identify both the triangular and stripe phases and the transition between them, the associated critical behavior being marked by enhanced non-Gaussian fluctuations. Furthermore, we observe each spatial structure in both the phase-coherent supersolid regime and the phase-incoherent insulating one, near and far from the unmodulated-to-modulated transition, respectively. Our results establish a versatile platform in which multiple phases of the two-dimensional-supersolid phase diagram, and more generally, intertwined symmetry-breaking phenomena, can be investigated.
articles.abstract_zh: 超固体是一类奇特量子态，其中长程相位相干性与新生的空间有序共存，并可能相互作用。本文通过调节接触相互作用强度和偶极取向，在冲浪板形囚禁势中的高度磁性原子量子气体内，实验形成了相互竞争的三角形和条纹密度调制态。作者定义结构序参量并研究其统计行为，识别出三角形相、条纹相及其转变，发现相变伴随增强的非高斯涨落；两种空间结构还分别出现在相干超固体和非相干绝缘态区域。
authors: Karthik Chandrashekara, Christian Gölzhäuser, Lily Platt, Jianshun Gao, Julian Kusch, Lennart Hoenen, Manon Ballu, Wyatt Kirkby, Lauriane Chomaz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超固体是一类奇特的量子态，其中长程相位相干性与新生的空间有序共存，并且可能相互作用。对于具有二维晶体结构的偶极超固体，理论预言了一个包含多个相互竞争空间有序的特别丰富的相图，但这种结构多样性的实验观测仍然有限。本文通过调节接触相互作用强度和偶极取向，在被限制于冲浪板形囚禁势中的高度磁性原子量子气体内，实验形成了相互竞争的三角形密度调制态和条纹密度调制态。我们定义了一个结构序参量，并研究了它的统计行为。由此，我们识别出三角形相、条纹相以及两者之间的转变；相关临界行为的特征是增强的非高斯涨落。此外，在相干超固体区域和相位不相干的绝缘区域中，我们都观察到了这两种空间结构；前者和后者分别位于未调制态到调制态转变的附近和远离该转变的位置。我们的结果建立了一个灵活的平台，可用于研究二维超固体相图中的多个相，以及更一般的交织对称性破缺现象。

articles.title: Searching for symmetric mass generation with staggered fermions in four dimensions
articles.title_zh: 利用四维交错费米子寻找对称性质量生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18239v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We conduct numerical simulations to map out the phase diagram and critical behavior of a lattice Higgs model composed of two massless staggered fermion fields forming a doublet under a global SU(2) and coupled to a scalar field in the adjoint representation of the group. The scalar action consists of a potential comprising quadratic and quartic terms and a scalar kinetic term. At fixed quartic coupling we explore a two-dimensional parameter space finding a massless symmetric phase at weak coupling and a massive symmetric phase (SMG phase) at strong coupling. An intermediate anti-ferromagnetic phase separates these two regimes. These results are consistent with leading order weak and strong coupling expansions. We find that the critical lines bounding the intermediate phase merge at a unique point where all fermion bilinear condensates vanish but fermion susceptibilities diverge as non-trivial powers of the lattice size. We conjecture that this merged point corresponds to a multicritical point and may describe a phase consisting of a condensate of certain topological defects.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过数值模拟绘制了一个晶格 Higgs 模型的相图和临界行为，该模型包含两个组成 SU(2) 全局对称性双重态的无质量交错费米子场，并与伴随表示的标量场耦合。在固定四次耦合下，研究发现弱耦合处存在无质量对称相，强耦合处存在有质量对称相，即 SMG 相，两者之间由反铁磁相分隔。两个临界线在一个唯一点合并，在该点所有费米子双线性凝聚均消失，而费米子磁化率随晶格尺寸按非平凡幂律发散；作者推测该点是多临界点，可能对应于某些拓扑缺陷的凝聚相。
authors: Nouman Butt, Simon Catterall, Gwen Hartshaw, Anna Hasenfratz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们开展了数值模拟，以绘制一个晶格 Higgs 模型的相图并研究其临界行为。该模型由两个无质量交错费米子场组成，这两个场形成全局 SU(2) 的一个双重态，并与该群伴随表示中的一个标量场耦合。标量作用量包括由二次项和四次项构成的势能，以及一个标量动能项。在固定四次耦合的条件下，我们探索了一个二维参数空间，并在弱耦合处发现无质量对称相，在强耦合处发现有质量对称相（SMG 相）。这两个区域之间由一个反铁磁相分隔。这些结果与最低阶弱耦合和强耦合展开相一致。我们发现，限定中间相的两条临界线在一个唯一的点处合并；在该点，所有费米子双线性凝聚均消失，但费米子磁化率会随着晶格尺寸按照非平凡幂律发散。我们推测，这个合并点对应于一个多临界点，并且可能描述一种由特定拓扑缺陷凝聚形成的相。

articles.title: Statistical Mechanics of Non-Abelian Learnability Transitions
articles.title_zh: 非阿贝尔可学习性转变的统计力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19325v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Monitored many-body quantum systems can undergo sharp learnability transitions characterized by how much information can be learned by the observer. When the dynamics conserves a non-Abelian charge, such as an SU(2) spin, understanding how the observer learns the total charge remains an outstanding problem. Unlike the Abelian case, where charge measurements on distinct sites commute, the SU(2)-symmetric readouts are noncommuting fusion measurements, making learning a genuinely quantum inference problem. In this work, we propose a theory of 1+1d monitored quantum dynamics with SU(2) symmetry, and show that it can be described by an effective replicated loop model comprised of a replica-pairing field and a diffusive (z=2) background sector that carries the SU(2) charge and remains gapless throughout the phase diagram. Our theory predicts that the "spin-sharpening'' and entanglement transitions coincide as a single transition. Ordering of the pairing field produces volume-law entanglement and hides the background sector from measurements, leading to a learning time of tsim L³ for the total spin. When the pairing field disorders, the background sector alone gives logarithmic entanglement and a diffusive learning time tsim L². Our analysis is controlled by a large-loop-fugacity expansion.
articles.abstract_zh: 受监测多体量子系统可以发生由观测者可获取信息量刻画的突变式可学习性转变。本文研究具有SU(2)等非阿贝尔守恒荷的情形，提出一种具有SU(2)对称性的1+1维受监测量子动力学理论，并将其描述为有效的复制环模型。理论表明，“自旋锐化”转变与纠缠转变重合；配对场有序时学习总自旋需要约L³时间，而无序时则产生对数纠缠和约L²的扩散学习时间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受监测的多体量子系统可以发生尖锐的可学习性转变，其特征取决于观测者能够学习多少信息。当动力学守恒一个非阿贝尔荷（例如SU(2)自旋）时，理解观测者如何学习总荷仍是一个尚未解决的重要问题。不同于阿贝尔情形中不同位置的荷测量彼此对易，SU(2)对称的读出是非对易的融合测量，因此学习过程成为一个真正的量子推断问题。在本工作中，我们提出了一种具有SU(2)对称性的1+1维受监测量子动力学理论，并表明该理论可以由一个有效的复制环模型描述。该模型由一个复制配对场和一个携带SU(2)荷、在整个相图中保持无能隙的扩散背景扇区组成。我们的理论预言，“自旋锐化”转变与纠缠转变作为一个单一转变彼此重合。配对场的有序会产生体积律纠缠，并使背景扇区隐藏于测量之外，从而使总自旋的学习时间达到tₛᵢₘ∼L³。当配对场无序时，仅背景扇区便会产生对数纠缠和扩散型学习时间tₛᵢₘ∼L²。我们的分析受控于大环逸度展开。

articles.title: Deep neural networks as lattice gauge theories
articles.title_zh: 作为晶格规范理论的深度神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19331v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We modify the NN/QFT duality [1] to incorporate the layerwise permutation symmetry of the network, resulting in a (0!+!1)-dimensional lattice gauge theory, in which each layer of N neurons acts as an N-component lattice site, and the weight matrices play the role of gauge fields living on the links. In this framework, we compute the tree-level neuron-neuron propagator which describes the evolution of layer variance in the network, and develop the Feynman diagram machinery to compute interactions in the perturbative expansion in 1/N. In particular, we obtain a recursive expression for all corrections to the exact propagator at O(1), representing statistical fluctuations in the ensemble of networks, including infinitely-many loop diagrams mediating the interactions from previous layers. We also present a preliminary analysis of neuron scattering amplitudes that contribute order-by-order in 1/N, which provides a field-theoretic framework for studying higher-point correlations, and by extension information propagation, in deep networks. We remark on some interesting directions for future work at the intersection of neural networks and quantum field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将神经网络/量子场论二重性加以修改，以纳入网络逐层置换对称性，从而得到一种(0+1)维晶格规范理论。该框架中，每一层的N个神经元构成一个N分量晶格点，权重矩阵则对应生活在链路上的规范场。作者计算了描述网络层间方差演化的树级神经元传播子，并建立了关于1/N微扰展开的费曼图方法，进一步给出传播子全部O(1)修正的递归表达式，并初步分析了神经元散射振幅。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们修改了神经网络/量子场论二重性[1]，以纳入网络逐层置换对称性，从而得到一种(0+1)维晶格规范理论，其中每一层的N个神经元充当一个N分量晶格点，而权重矩阵则扮演生活在链路上的规范场。基于这一框架，我们计算了树级神经元—神经元传播子，该传播子描述网络中层方差的演化，并建立了用于计算1/N微扰展开中相互作用的费曼图方法。特别地，我们获得了精确传播子在O(1)阶全部修正的递归表达式，这些修正代表网络系综中的统计涨落，其中包括介导来自前面各层相互作用的无穷多个环图。我们还初步分析了神经元散射振幅，它们按照1/N的阶次逐阶贡献；这为研究高阶点关联函数，进而研究深度网络中的信息传播，提供了一个场论框架。最后，我们讨论了神经网络与量子场论交叉领域中若干有趣的未来研究方向。

articles.title: Multipolar Light-Matter Hamiltonians in Symmetry-Breaking Photonic Vacuums
articles.title_zh: 破缺对称性光子真空中的多极光—物质哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19336v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that the conventional multipolar Hamiltonian is qualitatively modified when the photonic vacuum breaks inversion or time-reversal symmetry. By explicitly applying the Power-Zienau-Woolley transformation, we derive the resulting multipolar Hamiltonians for two idealized chiral photonic environments: a spatial-chiral vacuum, which breaks inversion symmetry, and a temporal-chiral vacuum, which breaks time-reversal symmetry. In the spatial-chiral case, the transformation generates an inversion-breaking self-energy, whereas in the temporal-chiral case it produces an additional Zeeman-like energy. Using a trapped hydrogen-like atom and a charged harmonic oscillator in cavities as minimal examples, we show that these symmetry-dependent terms lead to characteristic spectral shifts. Our work provides a general framework for describing light-matter interactions in chiral quantum electrodynamics and identifying the associated symmetry-dependent effects on cavity-embedded atoms, molecules, and quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 当光子真空破缺空间反演或时间反演对称性时，传统多极哈密顿量会发生定性改变。本文通过显式施加Power–Zienau–Woolley变换，推导了两类理想手性光子环境中的多极哈密顿量：破缺反演对称性的空间手性真空和破缺时间反演对称性的时间手性真空。前者产生破缺反演对称性的自能，后者产生额外的类塞曼能量；以腔中的类氢原子和带电谐振子为例，作者展示了这些项导致的特征性谱移。
authors: Liu Yang, Jiadu Lin, Qing-Dong Jiang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们表明，当光子真空破缺反演对称性或时间反演对称性时，传统的多极哈密顿量会发生定性改变。通过显式施加Power–Zienau–Woolley变换，我们推导了两种理想化手性光子环境中的相应多极哈密顿量：一种是破缺反演对称性的空间手性真空，另一种是破缺时间反演对称性的时间手性真空。在空间手性情形中，该变换会产生一个破缺反演对称性的自能；而在时间手性情形中，它会产生一个额外的类塞曼能量。以腔中的受限类氢原子和带电谐振子作为最小示例，我们表明，这些依赖对称性的项会导致具有特征性的谱移。我们的工作为描述手性量子电动力学中的光—物质相互作用，以及识别其对置于腔中的原子、分子和量子材料所产生的相关对称性效应，提供了一个一般框架。

articles.title: Beyond Integrability Preserving Renormalization-Group Protocol in Non-Hermitian Hamiltonians with Time-Dependent Interaction Strengths
articles.title_zh: 超越可积性保持的重整化群协议：具有时间依赖相互作用强度的非厄米哈密顿量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19519v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: It is well established that in time-dependent quantum systems, integrability preserving time-dependent interaction strengths are identical to the renormalization group (RG) trajectories of the corresponding static model when time `t' in the driven model is identified with the logarithm of the cutoff `łogŁambda' of the static model. We refer to this integrability preserving driving as the RG protocol. In this work we extend the class of time-dependent integrable models to include non-Hermitian quantum models with time-dependent interaction strengths. Using the recently formulated generalized Bethe ansatz framework [P. R. Pasnoori, Phys. Rev. B 112, L060409 (2025)], we show that the constraints imposed by integrability are more general: The interaction strengths of the static model that flow in the RG follow the respective RG trajectories in the corresponding time-dependent model as described above. In addition, the interaction strengths of the static model that are RG invariant can either be constant or have a specific time-dependence in the corresponding time-dependent model which is constrained by integrability. Thus we establish that in the context of time-dependent non-Hermitian systems, the set of integrability preserving time-dependent strengths is larger than the set corresponding to the RG protocol.
articles.abstract_zh: 在时间依赖量子系统中，保持可积性的时间依赖相互作用强度通常对应于静态模型的重整化群轨迹，其中驱动模型的时间t被对应为静态模型截止量的对数。本文将时间依赖可积模型扩展到非厄米量子模型，并利用广义Bethe Ansatz框架研究其约束。结果表明，静态模型中沿重整化群流动的相互作用强度仍遵循相应轨迹，而重整化群不变量既可以保持常数，也可以具有由可积性约束的特定时间依赖性，因此保持可积性的驱动范围大于通常的重整化群协议。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 众所周知，在时间依赖量子系统中，保持可积性的时间依赖相互作用强度，与相应静态模型的重整化群（RG）轨迹相同；在这一对应关系中，驱动模型的时间t被认定为静态模型截止量Λ的对数。我们将这种保持可积性的驱动称为RG协议。在本工作中，我们将时间依赖可积模型的范围扩展到具有时间依赖相互作用强度的非厄米量子模型。利用近期提出的广义Bethe Ansatz框架[P. R. Pasnoori, Phys. Rev. B 112, L060409 (2025)]，我们表明，可积性施加的约束更加一般：静态模型中沿RG流动的相互作用强度，在相应的时间依赖模型中遵循如上所述的相应RG轨迹。此外，静态模型中具有RG不变性的相互作用强度，在相应的时间依赖模型中既可以是常数，也可以具有一种由可积性约束的特定时间依赖性。因此，我们确立了这样一个结论：对于时间依赖的非厄米系统，保持可积性的时间依赖强度集合大于与RG协议相对应的强度集合。

articles.title: Physics-guided machine learning for sim-to-real calibration of NV diamond magnetometers
articles.title_zh: 用于NV金刚石磁力计仿真到真实校准的物理引导机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19582v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ensemble nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond enable robust vector magnetometry in unshielded environments, yet deployment remains bottlenecked by complex calibration and a reliance on external data references. Conventional statistical machine learning requires an exorbitantly large volume of training data and suffers from severe simulation-to-reality mismatches. To address this, we introduce a physics-guided hybrid machine learning framework that embeds the Zeeman splitting directly into the learning pipeline. Our physics-guided model significantly reduces the average tracking error demonstrating a 372-fold precision improvement over purely statistical baselines. Furthermore, our hybrid architecture pairs a sparse physical measurement with scalable synthetic data generation, seamlessly incorporating real-world hardware non-idealities. When deployed to decode uncalibrated, raw experimental ODMR data, our framework delivers exceptional predictive accuracy for the scalar magnetic field. This work paves the way toward self-calibrated sensors while establishing a machine learning training method applicable to other data-scarce physical systems
articles.abstract_zh: 金刚石中的系综氮—空位（NV）中心能够在无屏蔽环境中实现稳健的矢量磁力测量，但复杂的校准流程和对外部数据参考的依赖限制了其部署。本文提出一种将塞曼分裂直接嵌入学习流程的物理引导混合机器学习框架，以减小传统统计机器学习所需的大量训练数据和仿真到现实之间的失配。该模型相较纯统计基线将平均跟踪误差降低到相应水平，精度提高372倍，并能结合稀疏物理测量、可扩展合成数据和真实硬件非理想性，实现对未经校准的原始ODMR数据中标量磁场的高精度预测。
authors: Jonathan Daniel, Martin Y. Kim, Jesse Hernandez, Emanuel Suarez, Sangwoo Lee, Jinhee Lee, Je-Hyung Kim
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金刚石中的系综氮—空位（NV）中心能够在无屏蔽环境中实现稳健的矢量磁力测量，但其部署仍受到复杂校准过程以及对外部数据参考依赖的限制。传统统计机器学习需要极其庞大的训练数据量，并且会受到严重的仿真到现实失配的影响。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种物理引导的混合机器学习框架，将塞曼分裂直接嵌入学习流程。与纯统计基线相比，我们的物理引导模型显著降低了平均跟踪误差，实现了372倍的精度提升。此外，该混合架构将稀疏的物理测量与可扩展的合成数据生成相结合，并能无缝纳入现实世界中的硬件非理想性。当用于解码未经校准的原始实验ODMR数据时，我们的框架能够以出色的预测精度获得标量磁场。该工作为自校准传感器的发展铺平了道路，同时建立了一种可应用于其他数据稀缺物理系统的机器学习训练方法。

articles.title: Dissipation-tunable extended and localized steady states in a non-disordered lattice
articles.title_zh: 非无序晶格中耗散可调的扩展态与局域化稳态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19694v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dissipation is usually regarded as a source of decoherence that suppresses quantum interference and localization. Here we show that suitably engineered dissipation can instead be used to select localized or extended states in a strictly non-disordered one-dimensional lattice. The underlying clean lattice has spatially inhomogeneous hopping and supports both extended bulk states and localized boundary states, including an algebraically localized bound state in the continuum. We introduce a nonlocal bond jump operator with a tunable relative phase and show that this phase selectively favors eigenstates with different spatial phase correlations. As a result, the long-time density matrix can be steered toward sectors dominated by localized or extended Hamiltonian eigenstates without changing any Hamiltonian parameter. The microscopic origin of the selection is quantified by the fraction of site pairs separated by a distance l that are phase matched with the dissipative channel. We further characterize the dissipative quench through the quantum fidelity and show that the selected character of the steady state can persist after the dissipation is removed. Our results establish phase-selective bond dissipation as a route to controllable state preparation and transport manipulation in non-disordered lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 耗散通常被视为抑制量子干涉和局域化的退相干来源。本文表明，在严格无无序的一维晶格中，经过适当设计的耗散也可以选择局域态或扩展态。该体系具有空间非均匀跃迁，支持扩展体态和局域边界态，包括代数局域化的连续谱束缚态；带有可调相对相位的非局域键跳跃算符能够根据空间相位关联选择不同本征态扇区，使长时间密度矩阵趋向由局域或扩展哈密顿本征态主导的状态。
authors: Ming-Jie Tao, Yi-Ting Wang, Jing Li, Hongsheng Hou, Xiang-Ping Jiang, Lei Pan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 耗散通常被视为退相干的来源，会抑制量子干涉和局域化。在这里我们表明，经过适当设计的耗散反而可以在一个严格无无序的一维晶格中选择局域态或扩展态。其基础的洁净晶格具有空间非均匀的跃迁，并同时支持扩展体态和局域边界态，其中包括一个代数局域化的连续谱束缚态。我们引入一个具有可调相对相位的非局域键跳跃算符，并表明该相位可以选择性地偏好具有不同空间相位关联的本征态。因此，在不改变任何哈密顿量参数的情况下，长时间密度矩阵可以被引导至由局域化或扩展哈密顿本征态扇区主导的状态。我们通过相隔距离l的格点对中与耗散通道相位匹配的格点对比例，定量刻画了这种选择机制的微观起源。我们还通过量子保真度进一步表征耗散淬火，并表明选定的稳态性质在移除耗散后仍可保持。我们的结果表明，相位选择性键耗散可以成为无无序晶格中可控态制备和输运操控的一种途径。

articles.title: Gradient flow towards quantum states with ideal quantum geometry
articles.title_zh: 通过梯度流趋向具有理想量子几何的量子态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19770v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a gradient-flow method for quantum states in lattice models, generated by an action consisting of the quantum-metric and the square of the Berry curvature. These two terms drive the spectral projector toward Bogomolny saturation and uniform Berry curvature, respectively. We show that, due to a no-go theorem for finite-dimensional projectors, the two conditions cannot in general be satisfied simultaneously in lattice models. Hence the flow is expected to approach a nontrivial fixed point that balances the two geometric requirements. For the Wilson-Dirac model, we demonstrate that the flowed projector exhibits almost uniform Berry curvature while remaining close to the Bogomolny bound. We further construct a short-range truncated flattened Hamiltonian from the flowed projector and obtain a lattice model with nearly flat bands and nearly uniform Berry curvature. We also apply the method to the Hofstadter model and confirm the roles of the metric and Berry-curvature terms in a Chern band with higher Chern number.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于晶格模型量子态的梯度流方法，其作用量由量子度规和贝里曲率平方构成。两项分别推动谱投影算符趋向Bogomolny饱和与均匀贝里曲率，但有限维投影算符的禁戒定理表明二者通常无法在晶格模型中同时满足。对于Wilson–Dirac模型，演化后的投影算符在接近Bogomolny界的同时具有近乎均匀的贝里曲率，并可构造出具有近乎平带和近乎均匀贝里曲率的短程模型；该方法也应用于高陈数Chern带的Hofstadter模型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种用于晶格模型量子态的梯度流方法，该方法由一个作用量生成，而作用量由量子度规和贝里曲率的平方构成。这两项分别推动谱投影算符趋向Bogomolny饱和以及均匀的贝里曲率。我们表明，由于有限维投影算符存在一个禁戒定理，在晶格模型中这两个条件通常无法同时满足。因此，预期该流将趋向一个在两种几何要求之间取得平衡的非平凡不动点。对于Wilson–Dirac模型，我们证明，流作用后的投影算符在保持接近Bogomolny界的同时，呈现出近乎均匀的贝里曲率。我们进一步利用流作用后的投影算符构造了一个短程截断的平坦化哈密顿量，并获得了具有近乎平坦能带和近乎均匀贝里曲率的晶格模型。我们还将该方法应用于Hofstadter模型，并在具有较高陈数的Chern带中确认了量子度规项和贝里曲率项各自发挥的作用。

articles.title: Imaginary time evolution of a quantum system through analytic continuation from real-time quantum simulation
articles.title_zh: 通过从实时间量子模拟进行解析延拓实现量子系统的虚时间演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19943v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Though quantum computing naturally offers an advantage for simulations of real-time quantum systems, implementing Imaginary-Time Evolution (ITE) is comparatively more difficult. Nevertheless, quantum implementations of ITE are useful both in cases where classical implementations have associated sign problems, and also as an exact method of preparing eigenstates on quantum computers. In this work we present an algorithm to obtain ITE of a generic quantum Hamiltonian by performing analytic continuation of measured real-time correlation functions. We present simulations and demonstrations on IBM quantum hardware of 1D Fokker-Planck equations for classical diffusion process and imaginary-time evolution of integrated correlation functions in 1D quantum mechanical scattering as examples to demonstrate the effectiveness of the method.
articles.abstract_zh: 尽管量子计算天然适合模拟实时间量子系统，但实现虚时间演化相对困难，而虚时间演化对于规避经典符号问题和在量子计算机上精确制备本征态都很有用。本文提出一种算法，通过对测得的实时间关联函数进行解析延拓，获得一般量子哈密顿量的虚时间演化。作者以一维Fokker–Planck方程和一维量子力学散射中积分关联函数的虚时间演化为例，在模拟及IBM量子硬件上展示了该方法的有效性。
authors: Peng Guo, Anto Shibu, Joshua Lin, Yong Zhao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 尽管量子计算天然能够在模拟实时间量子系统方面提供优势，但实现虚时间演化（ITE）相对更加困难。然而，虚时间演化的量子实现不仅适用于经典实现存在符号问题的情形，也可以作为在量子计算机上制备本征态的一种精确方法。在本工作中，我们提出了一种算法，通过对测得的实时间关联函数进行解析延拓，获得一般量子哈密顿量的虚时间演化。作为展示该方法有效性的例子，我们对经典扩散过程的一维Fokker–Planck方程，以及一维量子力学散射中积分关联函数的虚时间演化进行了模拟，并在IBM量子硬件上进行了演示。

articles.title: Reinforcement LearningtoHarness Approximation Errors for Long-Time QuantumSimulation
articles.title_zh: 利用强化学习驾驭近似误差进行长时间量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20139v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Accurate digital quantum simulation at long times is limited by the accumulation of errors inherent to approximate simulation. Here we introduce RL-Trotter, a reinforcement-learning framework that treats unavoidable approximation errors as resources for error correction rather than merely imperfections to suppress. We show that low-dimensional information from conservation laws, such as the energy and energy variance, provides a sufficient learning signal to guide the agent, which learns to adapt a single scalar---the next Trotter step size---without access to the target wave function. By optimizing the entire long-time evolution rather than individual steps, RL-Trotter discovers self-correcting sequences in which later errors compensate for those accumulated earlier, increasing the accuracy of the long-time dynamics. The learned policies are intrinsically robust to measurement noise, substantially reducing measurement overhead. They also generalize to previously unseen, physically similar initial states and transfer from small, classically simulable systems to systems an order of magnitude larger. This enables a practical protocol based on classical pretraining followed by direct deployment or limited fine-tuning on quantum hardware. Our results establish a broader perspective for quantum algorithms: errors in approximate evolution can be orchestrated into resources for accurate and resource-efficient quantum dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 长时间数字量子模拟的准确性受到近似模拟误差累积的限制。本文提出RL-Trotter强化学习框架，将不可避免的近似误差视为可用于误差校正的资源；智能体仅依据能量和能量方差等守恒律信息，调节下一个Trotter步长，并通过优化整个长时间演化发现误差自补偿序列。该策略对测量噪声具有内在鲁棒性，可降低测量开销，并能推广到未见过的相似初态以及从小型经典可模拟系统迁移到大一个数量级的系统。
authors: Yu-Bo Shi, Markus Heyl, Roderich Moessner, Marin Bukov, Hongzheng Zhao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 准确的长时间数字量子模拟受到近似模拟中固有误差累积的限制。在这里我们提出RL-Trotter，这是一种强化学习框架，将不可避免的近似误差视为误差校正的资源，而不仅仅是需要抑制的不完美因素。我们表明，守恒律提供的低维信息（例如能量和能量方差）足以作为学习信号，引导智能体在无法访问目标波函数的情况下调节一个单一标量，即下一个Trotter步长。通过优化整个长时间演化，而不是优化单个步骤，RL-Trotter能够发现自校正序列，使后续误差补偿之前累积的误差，从而提高长时间动力学的准确性。学习得到的策略对测量噪声具有内在鲁棒性，并能显著降低测量开销。这些策略还能够推广到之前未见过的、物理性质相近的初态，并能从小型、可由经典计算模拟的系统迁移到规模大一个数量级的系统。这使得一种实用协议成为可能：先进行经典预训练，随后直接部署到量子硬件上，或在硬件上进行有限微调。我们的结果为量子算法确立了一个更广泛的观点：近似演化中的误差可以被组织成资源，以实现准确且节省资源的量子动力学。

articles.title: The ebbs and flows of quantum learning and sensing
articles.title_zh: 量子学习与量子传感的潮起潮落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20155v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: What is the relation between subsystem quantum complexity and the emergence of computationally useful structure? We address this by studying a family of minimally tunable postvariational quantum circuits, and show how spectral nonflatness and metrological response directly control the ensemble-typical information processing power. This unveils an intermediate "learning phase" that precedes the onset of quantum chaos, characterized by pronounced nonflatness and sensitivity of readout states. The optimal information processing capacity improves with system size, while deep scrambling suppresses observable response. The results reveal how such features of random quantum dynamics can be viewed as computational resources for scalable nonlinear computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究子系统量子复杂性与计算有用结构出现之间的关系，考察一类可进行最小调参的后变分量子电路。结果表明，谱的非平坦性和计量响应直接控制系综典型的信息处理能力，并存在一个先于量子混沌出现的中间“学习相”。随着系统规模增大，最优信息处理能力提高；而深度扰乱会抑制可观测响应，说明随机量子动力学中的相关结构可以成为可扩展非线性计算的资源。
authors: Matias Karjula, Teemu Ojanen, Tapio Ala-Nissila, Moein N. Ivaki
articles.abstract_zh_full: 子系统量子复杂性与计算有用结构的出现之间是什么关系？我们通过研究一类只需进行最小调参的后变分量子电路来回答这一问题，并表明，谱的非平坦性和计量响应直接控制系综典型的信息处理能力。这揭示出一个先于量子混沌开始的中间“学习相”，其特征是读出态具有显著的非平坦性和敏感性。最优信息处理能力会随系统规模增大，而深度扰乱则会抑制可观测响应。我们的结果表明，随机量子动力学的这些特征可以被视为可扩展非线性计算的计算资源。

articles.title: Rigorous existence and location of quantum phase transitions in lattice Hamiltonian systems
articles.title_zh: 晶格哈密顿量系统中量子相变的严格存在性与位置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20209v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We extend the analysis of the class of quantum phase transitions (QPTs) that can be interpreted as condensations in state space, first introduced in [M. Ostilli and C. Presilla, J. Phys. A 54, 055005 (2021)], by generalizing the arguments of [M. Ostilli and C. Presilla, Phys. Rev. Lett. 127, 040601 (2021)] to prove the existence and determine the location (via simple bounds) of QPTs in general one-parameter lattice Hamiltonians. Unlike our original formulation, this extension also encompasses second-order QPTs, for which we provide the explicit example of the transverse-field Ising model. Our analysis suggests that, under conditions typically satisfied in physical contexts, any QPT taking place in lattice systems can be interpreted as a condensation in state space.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文扩展了对可解释为态空间凝聚的量子相变的研究，将既有分析推广到一般单参数晶格哈密顿量，并证明量子相变的存在性及其位置的简单界。该扩展也涵盖二阶量子相变，横场Ising模型提供了具体例子。分析表明，在物理体系通常满足的条件下，晶格系统中的任意量子相变都可能被解释为态空间中的凝聚现象。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们扩展了对一类量子相变（QPT）的分析，这类量子相变可以被解释为态空间中的凝聚，并最初由[M. Ostilli and C. Presilla, J. Phys. A 54, 055005 (2021)]提出。具体而言，我们将[M. Ostilli and C. Presilla, Phys. Rev. Lett. 127, 040601 (2021)]中的论证加以推广，从而证明一般单参数晶格哈密顿量中量子相变的存在性，并通过简单的界确定其位置。不同于我们最初的表述，这一扩展还涵盖二阶量子相变；我们为此给出了横场Ising模型的具体例子。我们的分析表明，在物理情形通常满足的条件下，发生在晶格系统中的任何量子相变都可以被解释为态空间中的凝聚。

articles.title: Nonthermal Dynamics of a One-dimensional Rydberg-atom Chain with Constraint Four-body Interactions
articles.title_zh: 具有受限四体相互作用的一维里德伯原子链的非热动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20233v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate dynamics of a linear chain of Rydberg atoms driven by a constrained four-body interaction, where two neighboring atoms are excited simultaneously from the electronic ground state |0ångle to Rydberg state |1ångle only when their closest neighbors are in |0ångle state. By employing an ansatz for the many-body ground state, the low-energy Hamiltonian is given by a tridiagonal form. The many-body ground state energy, which scales linearly with the chain length L, is obtained analytically in the thermodynamic limit and agrees with the one of the exact diagonalization. Our model supports quantum many-body scar eigenstates that are nearly equally spaced energetically. The scar states overlap strongly with the basis state |0ångle=|0ḑots 0ångle. We show that the overlap distribution is tilted by the state-dependent four-body interaction. This leads to non-ergodic dynamics, evidenced by the revival of the initial state. The four-body constrained model can be realized with Rydberg atoms in a Peierls array with alternating bond lengths, where atoms on the shorter and longer bonds experience Rydberg blockade and antiblockade, respectively. Our study provides a pathway to explore constrained non-ergodic dynamics with four-body interactions by combining the Rydberg blockade and antiblockade.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究由受限四体相互作用驱动的一维里德伯原子链动力学，其中相邻原子只有在其最近邻处于基态时才能同时激发。作者解析地求得热力学极限下随链长线性标度的基态能量，并发现近似等间隔的量子多体疤痕本征态。疤痕态导致初态复现和非遍历动力学；该模型可通过具有交替键长的里德伯原子Peierls阵列实现。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究由受限四体相互作用驱动的线性里德伯原子链动力学：只有当相邻原子最近邻处于电子基态|0⟩时，这两个原子才会同时从电子基态|0⟩激发到里德伯态|1⟩。通过采用多体基态的一个试探波函数，低能哈密顿量可写成三对角形式。我们在热力学极限下解析地得到随链长L线性标度的多体基态能量，并且该结果与精确对角化所得结果一致。我们的模型支持能量近似等间隔的量子多体疤痕本征态。这些疤痕态与基态|0⟩=|0⋯0⟩有很强的重叠。我们表明，依赖状态的四体相互作用会使重叠分布发生倾斜。这导致非遍历动力学，其证据是初态的复现。该四体受限模型可以在具有交替键长的里德伯原子Peierls阵列中实现，其中位于较短键和较长键上的原子分别经历里德伯阻塞和反阻塞。我们的研究通过结合里德伯阻塞与反阻塞，为利用四体相互作用探索受限非遍历动力学提供了一条路径。

articles.title: Flip rate prediction in the double pendulum
articles.title_zh: 双摆中的翻转率预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20276v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The intermediate-energy double pendulum is a prototypical chaotic system. Despite its irregular motion, it exhibits recurrent flips - events in which one of the arms passes over the top. We develop a statistical prediction for the mean flip rate in terms of phase space flux. Applying this flux-based approach to the equal-mass, equal arm ("egalitarian") double pendulum, we find excellent agreement between the statistical prediction and numerical simulations: ensemble-averaged flip rates agree at about the 1% level, while even the statistics of individual chaotic trajectories agree at the few-percent level, quantifying the validity of the ergodic approximation. This agreement holds for flips of either arm and over a broad range of energies. This flux-based approach is closely related to that used for the egalitarian three-body system. A central role is played by the saddle orbits: periodic orbits that tend to the stable saddle eigenmode as the energy approaches the saddle energy from above and approximately follow the ridge of the potential at higher energies. These orbits provide a natural dividing surface for defining flips while avoiding recrossings. Indeed, the resulting distribution of crossing times exhibits a distinct gap. We also present two alternative simplified dividing surfaces, one of which is based on an accurate analytic approximation to the saddle orbits.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对中等能量双摆这一典型混沌系统，基于相空间通量提出平均翻转率的统计预测方法。对于等质量、等臂长双摆，预测与数值模拟高度一致，系综平均翻转率约在1%水平吻合，单条混沌轨道统计也在数个百分点内一致。研究强调鞍点轨道在定义翻转分界面、避免重复穿越中的核心作用，并给出两种简化分界面方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中等能量双摆是典型的混沌系统。尽管其运动不规则，它仍表现出反复出现的翻转，即其中一条摆臂越过顶部的事件。我们基于相空间通量，发展了一种关于平均翻转率的统计预测。将这种基于通量的方法应用于等质量、等臂长的“平等型”双摆，我们发现统计预测与数值模拟高度一致：系综平均翻转率在约1%的水平上一致，而即使单条混沌轨道的统计也在数个百分点的水平上一致，从而量化了遍历近似的有效性。这种一致性对任一摆臂的翻转均成立，并且在很宽的能量范围内成立。这种基于通量的方法与用于平等型三体系统的方法密切相关。鞍点轨道发挥核心作用：它们是周期轨道，当能量从鞍点能量上方趋近鞍点能量时趋向稳定鞍点本征模，而在更高能量下近似沿势能脊运动。这些轨道为定义翻转提供了自然的分界面，同时避免了重复穿越。事实上，由此得到的穿越时间分布呈现出明显的间隙。我们还提出了两种替代性的简化分界面，其中一种基于对鞍点轨道的精确解析近似。

articles.title: Quantum-mechanical wave functions in singular potentials: linear and nonlinear states
articles.title_zh: 奇异势中的量子力学波函数：线性态与非线性态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20282v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: It is known that the attractive singular inverse-square potential gives rise to the critical quantum collapse in the framework of the three-dimensional (3D) linear Schroedinger equation. This article summarizes theoretical results which demonstrate suppression of the collapse, caused by this singular potential, and the creation of the otherwise missing ground state (GS) in a 3D gas of bosonic particles, carrying an electric dipole moment, which are pulled to the central electric charge, with repulsive contact interactions between the particles. In the mean-field approximation, the repulsive interactions are represented by the cubic term in the respective Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) equation. In addition to the GS, excited states with angular momentum are briefly considered too. Another topic considered in the article is 1D and 2D bound states in the linear Schroedinger and GP equations with the repulsive potential, which demonstrates a singularity at r --> infinity. A very recent result is that such a potential, growing faster than the negative harmonic-oscillator potential, produces a full spectrum of counter-intuitive normalizable (localized) bound states. The article puts forward perspectives for further studies of linear and nonlinear bound states existing under the action of the potentials with the singularity at r --> 0 or r --> infinity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了奇异反平方吸引势相关量子坍缩的理论结果，并讨论在具有排斥接触相互作用的三维偶极玻色气体中如何抑制坍缩并产生基态。文章还涉及带角动量激发态，以及在线性薛定谔方程和Gross-Pitaevskii方程中由无穷远处奇异排斥势产生的一维和二维束缚态。作者提出了进一步研究在原点或无穷远奇异势作用下线性和非线性束缚态的前景。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 众所周知，在三维线性薛定谔方程框架下，吸引性的奇异反平方势会导致临界量子坍缩。本文总结了一些理论结果，这些结果表明，在由带电偶极矩并被中心电荷吸引的玻色粒子组成的三维气体中，粒子之间的排斥接触相互作用会抑制这种奇异势导致的坍缩，并产生原本缺失的基态。在平均场近似中，排斥相互作用由相应Gross-Pitaevskii方程中的三次项表示。除基态外，文章还简要考虑了具有角动量的激发态。文章考虑的另一个主题是线性薛定谔方程和Gross-Pitaevskii方程中，由在r趋于无穷远处表现出奇异性的排斥势所产生的一维和二维束缚态。一个非常新的结果是，这种增长快于负谐振子势的势会产生一整套反直觉的可归一化局域束缚态谱。文章提出了进一步研究在r趋于0或r趋于无穷远处具有奇异性的势作用下存在线性和非线性束缚态的前景。

articles.title: Programmable cavity QED with a fiber-integrated atomic array
articles.title_zh: 采用光纤集成原子阵列的可编程腔量子电动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20291v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Strong atom-photon interactions in optical cavities are a key resource for quantum information processing, quantum networking, and the exploration of quantum optical effects. Optical tweezer arrays offer scalable, site-resolved control of neutral atoms, but their integration with high-cooperativity cavity QED systems remains challenging. Here we combine a twelve-site ⁸⁷Rb optical tweezer array with a high-cooperativity fiber Fabry-Pérot microcavity. The array is positioned within the cavity mode and individual sites are controlled with subwavelength precision, enabling continuous tuning of the single-atom coupling strength via deterministic displacement through the standing-wave field. For up to five atoms coupled to the cavity, we measure collectively enhanced vacuum Rabi splitting and implement cavity-based non-destructive readout of the number of coupled atoms. These results establish a scalable architecture for cavity-mediated entanglement generation and many-body cavity QED with single-atom control, and they lay the foundation for fiber-integrated quantum network nodes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将十二站点87Rb光镊阵列与高协同性光纤Fabry-Pérot微腔结合，实现了可编程腔QED平台。通过将阵列置于腔模内并以亚波长精度控制单个站点，研究者可连续调节单原子耦合强度。实验观测到多达五个原子与腔耦合时的集体增强真空Rabi劈裂，并实现了基于腔的耦合原子数非破坏读出。
authors: Stephan Roschinski, Johannes Schabbauer, Franz von Silva-Tarouca, Marvin Holten, Damien Bloch, Julian Léonard
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光学腔中的强原子-光子相互作用是量子信息处理、量子网络以及量子光学效应探索的关键资源。光镊阵列为中性原子提供了可扩展且可逐站点分辨的控制，但它们与高协同性腔量子电动力学系统的集成仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们将一个十二站点87Rb光镊阵列与一个高协同性光纤Fabry-Pérot微腔结合起来。该阵列被定位在腔模内，并且单个站点以亚波长精度受到控制，从而能够通过在驻波场中进行确定性位移来连续调节单原子耦合强度。对于多达五个与腔耦合的原子，我们测量了集体增强的真空Rabi劈裂，并实现了基于腔的耦合原子数非破坏读出。这些结果建立了一种可扩展架构，用于腔介导纠缠生成和具有单原子控制的多体腔量子电动力学，并为光纤集成量子网络节点奠定了基础。

articles.title: Spin-torque microwave detectors of positive rectangular pulse signals
articles.title_zh: 正矩形脉冲信号的自旋转矩微波探测器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20323v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We analyze the performance of a spin-torque microwave detector (STMD) driven by positive rectangular current pulses I(t) of various amplitudes I₀, durations τ, and repetition periods T and reveal two distinct regimes of STMD operation. In the first (linear) regime, the time-averaged voltage across the detector, Uₘ̊ dc, changes linearly with the pulse amplitude I₀ and depends on the ratio τ/T: Uₘ̊ dc sim I₀ (τ/T). This regime is observed for a wide range of pulse amplitudes I₀ in the case of in-plane (IP) magnetization dynamics and for rather small pulse amplitudes I₀ łe Iₘ̊ ₜₕ in an STMD with out-of-plane (OOP) magnetization dynamics. The other (nonlinear) regime is characterized by voltage jumps and drops and is observed only in a structure with OOP magnetization dynamics for input pulses with short repetition periods and large amplitudes I₀ ge Iₘ̊ ₜₕ. We believe that the linear regime of STMD operation can be used to unambiguously detect input pulse parameters, which could be important for the development and optimization of spintronic devices capable of detecting and processing non-harmonic (e.g., digital) microwave signals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文分析了自旋转矩微波探测器在不同幅值、持续时间和重复周期的正矩形电流脉冲驱动下的性能，并揭示两种工作机制。在线性机制中，探测器平均电压与脉冲幅值及占空比成正比；在非线性机制中，电压出现跳变和下降，且仅在面外磁化动力学结构的大幅值、短周期脉冲下出现。作者认为线性机制可用于明确检测输入脉冲参数，有助于自旋电子器件处理非谐波微波信号。
authors: V. Prokopenko, O. Shtanko, I. Sotnyk, O. Prokopenko
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们分析了由不同幅值I0、持续时间τ和重复周期T的正矩形电流脉冲I(t)驱动的自旋转矩微波探测器的性能，并揭示了自旋转矩微波探测器工作的两种不同机制。在第一种线性机制中，探测器两端的时间平均电压Udc随脉冲幅值I0线性变化，并依赖于比值τ/T：Udc约正比于I0(τ/T)。这种机制在面内磁化动力学情况下对很宽范围的脉冲幅值I0均可观察到，而在具有面外磁化动力学的自旋转矩微波探测器中，则对相当小的脉冲幅值I0小于等于阈值电流Ith时可观察到。另一种非线性机制以电压跳变和下降为特征，并且只在具有面外磁化动力学的结构中，对重复周期短且幅值较大的输入脉冲I0大于等于阈值电流Ith时观察到。我们认为，自旋转矩微波探测器的线性工作机制可用于无歧义地检测输入脉冲参数，这对于开发和优化能够检测并处理非谐波，例如数字，微波信号的自旋电子器件可能很重要。

articles.title: A Diagrammer's Note on Superconducting Fluctuation Transport for Beginners: II. Hall and Nernst Effects with Perturbational Treatment of Magnetic Field
articles.title_zh: 面向初学者的超导涨落输运图解札记：II. 磁场微扰处理下的霍尔效应与能斯特效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:1203.0127v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A diagrammatic approach based on thermal Green function to superconducting fluctuation transport is reviewed focusing on Hall and Nernst effects. The treatment of weak magnetic field is carefully discussed within the linear order perturbation. In the Appendix the linear response theory for the DC Hall conductivity of the Dirac fermion in 2+1 space-time dimensions is reviewed. One focus is the Chern-Simons effective action for the gauge field. Another is the exact formula by Ishikawa and Matsuyama.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文综述了基于热格林函数的超导涨落输运图解方法，重点讨论霍尔效应和能斯特效应。文章在一阶微扰范围内仔细处理弱磁场。附录回顾了2+1维时空中Dirac费米子直流霍尔电导的线性响应理论，包括Chern-Simons有效作用量和Ishikawa-Matsuyama精确公式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文综述了基于热格林函数的超导涨落输运图解方法，重点关注霍尔效应和能斯特效应。文中在一阶线性微扰范围内仔细讨论了弱磁场的处理。在附录中，回顾了2+1维时空中Dirac费米子直流霍尔电导的线性响应理论。一个重点是规范场的Chern-Simons有效作用量。另一个重点是Ishikawa和Matsuyama给出的精确公式。

articles.title: Surface charge density wave in UTe2
articles.title_zh: UTe2中的表面电荷密度波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.12505v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The spatially uniform electronic density characteristic of a metal can become unstable at low temperatures, leading to the formation of charge density waves (CDWs). These CDWs, observed in dichalcogenides, cuprates and pnictides, arise from the interplay between the crystal lattice and the electronic structure, which can facilitate charge ordering. However, CDWs are rarely observed in the presence of Kondo screening and heavy fermion quasiparticles. The heavy fermion topological superconductor candidate UTe₂ presents a notable exception, exhibiting a CDW whose origin remains elusive. Here we report high resolution scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) experiments that reveal the primitive wavevectors of the CDW in UTe₂. This allows us to identify hot spots in the electronic band structure that are connected to the CDW. Although the corresponding wavevectors have apparently no specific influence on some bulk properties, for example on antiferromagnetic fluctuations, we find that they lead to a spatial modulation of the heavy fermion hybridization pattern. We propose that surface induced modifications in the U 5f electron valence enable a novel form of purely electron-driven charge ordering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过高分辨率扫描隧道显微镜实验揭示了UTe2中电荷密度波的本征波矢，并将其与电子能带结构中的热点联系起来。研究发现，这些波矢虽似乎不显著影响某些体性质，如反铁磁涨落，却会导致重费米子杂化图样的空间调制。作者提出，表面诱导的U 5f电子价态改变可能使一种纯电子驱动的新型电荷有序成为可能。
authors: Pablo García Talavera, Miguel Águeda Velasco, Makoto Shimizu, Beilun Wu, Óscar Bou Marqués, Georg Knebel, Midori Amano Patino, Gerard Lapertot, Jacques Flouquet, Jean Pascal Brison, Dai Aoki, Youichi Yanase, Edwin Herrera, Isabel Guillamón, Hermann Suderow
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属所具有的空间均匀电子密度在低温下可能变得不稳定，从而形成电荷密度波（CDW）。这类在二硫属化物、铜酸盐和磷族化合物中观察到的CDW，源于晶格与电子结构之间的相互作用，而这种相互作用能够促进电荷有序。然而，在存在近藤屏蔽和重费米子准粒子的情况下，CDW极少被观测到。重费米子拓扑超导候选材料UTe₂则是一个显著例外，它表现出一种起源尚未明确的CDW。在这里，我们报道了高分辨率扫描隧道显微镜（STM）实验，揭示了UTe₂中CDW的原始波矢。这使我们能够确定电子能带结构中与CDW相连的热点。尽管相应波矢似乎对某些体性质没有特定影响，例如反铁磁涨落，但我们发现它们会导致重费米子杂化图样发生空间调制。我们提出，表面诱导的铀5f电子价态变化，使一种纯电子驱动的新型电荷有序成为可能。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文利用高分辨扫描隧道显微镜确定重费米子拓扑超导候选材料UTe₂中电荷密度波的原始波矢，并将其与电子能带中的热点联系起来。研究认为，该电荷密度波可能源于表面诱导的铀5f电子价态变化及重费米子杂化图样的空间调制。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的电荷密度波、强关联材料、超导、拓扑材料和电子结构方向相关，但主要采用STM实验，且其重费米子表面机制并非团队最集中的材料模拟主题。电荷序与杂化、能带热点之间的联系可为电子结构计算和有效模型研究提供参考。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可开展包含强关联效应的第一性原理或模型计算，比较表面与体相中不同电荷序构型的能量和电子谱。进一步研究电荷密度波与超导序、磁涨落及拓扑表面态之间的耦合关系。

articles.title: Finite-temperature Green's function theory of terahertz-induced phonon angular momentum in polar crystals
articles.title_zh: 极性晶体中太赫兹诱导声子角动量的有限温格林函数理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.05715v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a self-energy-dressed Green's-function framework for terahertz-induced phonon angular momentum in polar crystals. The rectified angular-momentum response is formulated as a second-order response and, within a dressed-bubble approximation, is expressed in terms of retarded phonon propagators weighted by mode-resolved polarization and angular-momentum matrix elements. Anharmonic self-energies enter through the dressed propagators, incorporating finite-temperature frequency renormalization and linewidth broadening directly into the response kernel. Applying this framework to wurtzite GaN, we show that the terahertz propagation direction and polarization select distinct rotational phonon channels: a nondegenerate E₁(TO)--A₁(TO) channel with phase- and frequency-tunable angular momentum, and a degenerate E₁(TO) channel with helicity-selected response. Anharmonic broadening suppresses and smooths the resonant structures while preserving the characteristic phase dependence of each channel. An order-of-magnitude estimate based on the phonon inverse Faraday-effect framework gives an mT-scale effective magnetic field for representative electron--phonon coupling strengths. This work places coherent terahertz-driven circular-phonon physics in a first-principles-based response framework and provides a starting point for going beyond constant-damping driven-mode descriptions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个自能修饰的格林函数框架，用于描述极性晶体中太赫兹诱导的声子角动量。该框架将整流角动量响应表述为二阶响应，并通过含自能的声子传播子纳入有限温频率重整化和线宽展宽。应用于纤锌矿GaN后，研究表明太赫兹传播方向和偏振可选择不同旋转声子通道，且非谐展宽会削弱并平滑共振结构但保留通道特征相位依赖。
authors: Hong Sun, Xiaozhe Li, Lifa Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为极性晶体中的太赫兹诱导声子角动量发展了一个自能修饰的格林函数框架。整流角动量响应被表述为二阶响应，并且在修饰气泡近似下，被表示为由模式分辨的极化矩阵元和角动量矩阵元加权的推迟声子传播子。非谐自能通过修饰传播子进入，直接将有限温频率重整化和线宽展宽纳入响应核。将该框架应用于纤锌矿GaN，我们表明太赫兹传播方向和偏振会选择不同的旋转声子通道：一个具有相位和频率可调角动量的非简并E1(TO)-A1(TO)通道，以及一个具有螺旋性选择响应的简并E1(TO)通道。非谐展宽抑制并平滑了共振结构，同时保留了每个通道的特征相位依赖性。基于声子逆Faraday效应框架的数量级估算表明，在代表性电子-声子耦合强度下，有效磁场可达毫特斯拉量级。本工作将相干太赫兹驱动的圆偏振声子物理置于一个基于第一性原理的响应框架中，并为超越常数阻尼驱动模描述提供了起点。

articles.title: Topological Flat Minibands and Fractional Chern Insulators in Rashba Systems with Tunable Superlattice Potentials
articles.title_zh: 具有可调超晶格势的Rashba系统中的拓扑平坦微带与分数量子Chern绝缘体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.22173v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fractional Chern insulators are interaction-driven topological states that realize the lattice analogue of the fractional quantum Hall effect without external magnetic fields. Here we propose a programmable platform for engineering topological flat bands by combining a Zeeman field with a tunable electrostatic superlattice potential in a Rashba spin-orbit-coupled thin film. The Zeeman field generates a nearly flat segment of the Rashba band, which is isolated by the superlattice potential into a flat band with Chern number C=1. Using many-body exact diagonalization, we show that this band supports fractional Chern insulators at filling factors n = 1/3 and 2/3, both of which remain robust over broad parameter ranges. We further identify realistic material candidates and the corresponding device conditions that enable experimental realization. These results establish a versatile and experimentally accessible platform for engineering topological flat bands and exploring correlated topological phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出通过在Rashba自旋轨道耦合薄膜中结合Zeeman场和可调静电超晶格势，构造拓扑平带的可编程平台。Zeeman场产生近乎平坦的Rashba能带片段，超晶格势进一步将其隔离为Chern数C=1的平带。多体精确对角化显示该能带在1/3和2/3填充下支持稳健的分数量子Chern绝缘体，并具有现实材料与器件实现条件。
authors: Bokai Liang, Wei Qin, Zhenyu Zhang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分数量子Chern绝缘体是由相互作用驱动的拓扑态，它们在没有外加磁场的情况下实现了分数量子Hall效应的晶格类比。在这里，我们提出一种用于工程化拓扑平带的可编程平台，该平台在Rashba自旋轨道耦合薄膜中将Zeeman场与可调静电超晶格势结合起来。Zeeman场产生Rashba能带的一个近乎平坦片段，该片段由超晶格势隔离成一个Chern数C=1的平带。利用多体精确对角化，我们表明该能带在填充因子n=1/3和2/3处支持分数量子Chern绝缘体，二者都在宽广参数范围内保持稳健。我们进一步确定了现实材料候选者以及能够实现实验制备的相应器件条件。这些结果建立了一个通用且实验上可及的平台，用于工程化拓扑平带并探索关联拓扑相。

articles.title: Comprehensive Structure Exploration and Thermodynamics of Graphitic Heteroatom Doped Graphene Superstructures
articles.title_zh: 石墨型杂原子掺杂石墨烯超结构的全面结构探索与热力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.08352v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graphene has been studied in detail due to its mechanical, electrical, and thermal properties. It is well documented that the introduction of dopants or defects in the lattice can be used to tune material properties for a specific application, such as in electronics, sensors, or catalysis. To design graphene with specific properties, one must achieve control over the composition and concentration of defects. This requires a fundamental understanding of the stability of defects and their interaction in a superstructure. We present a comprehensive defect structure determination approach that enables close to exhaustive enumeration of all relevant defect structures. The approach uses a combination of Density Functional Theory and machine learning to build a transferable energy model for defect formation. We show the capabilities of our approach for free-standing graphene with heteroatom defects, establishing a thermodynamic model to investigate how temperature affects the configuration space of doped graphene. Our analysis yields physical insights into defect interactions. A characteristic peak in the heat capacity indicates a structural transition. We provide a mechanistic explanation for this behavior and demonstrate how the transition temperature shifts with different thermodynamic reservoirs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种全面的缺陷结构确定方法，接近穷举枚举相关缺陷结构，并结合密度泛函理论与机器学习建立可迁移的缺陷形成能模型。作者将该方法用于含杂原子缺陷的自由悬空石墨烯，建立热力学模型研究温度对掺杂石墨烯构型空间的影响。分析揭示了缺陷相互作用的物理图像，并通过热容峰解释一种结构转变及其随热力学储库变化的转变温度移动。
authors: Benedict Saunders, Lukas Hörmann, Reinhard J. Maurer
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由于石墨烯的机械、电学和热学性质，人们已对其进行了详细研究。众所周知，在晶格中引入掺杂原子或缺陷可用于针对特定应用调控材料性质，例如电子学、传感器或催化。为了设计具有特定性质的石墨烯，必须实现对缺陷组成和浓度的控制。这需要从根本上理解缺陷的稳定性及其在超结构中的相互作用。我们提出一种全面的缺陷结构确定方法，能够对所有相关缺陷结构进行接近穷举的枚举。该方法结合密度泛函理论和机器学习，建立可迁移的缺陷形成能模型。我们展示了该方法在具有杂原子缺陷的自由悬空石墨烯中的能力，并建立热力学模型来研究温度如何影响掺杂石墨烯的构型空间。我们的分析给出了关于缺陷相互作用的物理见解。热容中的一个特征峰表明存在结构转变。我们为这种行为提供了机制解释，并展示了转变温度如何随不同热力学储库而移动。

articles.title: Cascade of topological phase transitions and revival of topological zero modes in imperfect double helical liquids
articles.title_zh: 不完美双螺旋液体中的拓扑相变级联与拓扑零模复现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.10335v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Two parallel helical edge channels hosting interacting electrons, when proximitized by local and nonlocal pairings, can host time-reversal-invariant pairs of topological zero modes at the system corners. Here we show that realistic imperfections substantially enrich the physics of such proximitized double helical liquids. Specifically, we analyze this platform and its fractional counterparts in the presence of pairing and interaction asymmetries between the two channels, as well as random spin-flip terms arising from either magnetic disorder or coexisting charge disorder and external magnetic fields. Using renormalization-group analysis, we determine how Coulomb interactions, pairings, and magnetic disorder collectively influence the transport behavior and topological properties of the double helical liquid. As the system now belongs to class BDI, an additional topological phase supporting a single Majorana zero mode per corner emerges. We further show how additional pairing or Coulomb asymmetry influences the stability of various topological phases and uncovers a revival of Majorana zero modes and cascades of successive topological transitions through topological phases characterized by a mathbb Z invariant, which are accessible through controlling the electrical screening effect.
