Then, we apply the method to compute RR spectra of anthracene by performing dynamics on a 66-dimensional harmonic potential energy surface constructed from density functional theory calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种实用的从头算含时方法，利用海格顿波包模拟多原子分子的共振拉曼光谱。海格顿函数可表示初态和末态，并能在至多二次势中精确求解含时薛定谔方程，因此除传播引导高斯波包的代价外几乎无需额外传播成本。该方法经二维谐模型验证后，被用于基于密度泛函理论构建的66维势能面上模拟蒽的共振拉曼光谱。
authors: Davide Barbiero, Léa Zupan, Jiří J. L. Vaníček
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种实用的从头算含时方法，使用海格顿波包模拟多原子分子的共振拉曼（RR）光谱。海格顿函数是乘以特定多项式的高斯函数；由于这些函数在至多二次的势能中是含时薛定谔方程的精确解，因此可将其用于表示RR初态和末态，并且其传播所需的额外成本仅为传播引导高斯波包的成本之外的零成本。借助高效的海格顿波包重叠递推公式，我们可以计算任意光谱信号的RR激发剖面，例如基频、泛频、组合带和热带。随后，我们利用这些激发剖面构造斯托克斯和反斯托克斯RR光谱。首先，我们在二维位移、畸变并经过Duschinsky旋转的谐模型中，将该方法与数值精确的分裂算符计算进行比较，以验证其有效性。随后，我们在由密度泛函理论计算构建的66维谐势能面上进行动力学计算，用该方法模拟蒽的RR光谱。

articles.title: 3-D numerical modelling of the feedback between deformation and thermal structure during subduction initiation for the French Lesser Antilles
articles.title_zh: 俯冲起始过程中变形与热结构反馈的三维数值建模：以法国小安的列斯群岛为例
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19990v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We used 3-D thermomechanical modelling to investigate conditions during subduction-zone initiation and early thermal development with focus on the Lesser Antilles. Our model imposes a convergence velocity of 2 cm per year and incorporates heating caused by irreversible deformation of mantle and crustal rocks, using elasticity, creep, and non-associative plastic flow laws. Our results show that deformational heating before slab development is unexpectedly strong. After several million years, buckling and heating due to irreversible deformation create distinctive patterns of topography and surface heat flow that resemble present-day observations, despite the slab and subduction interface being incompletely developed. Within the Caribbean plate, plate buckling produces a high topographic ridge underlain by a large positive thermal anomaly of approximately 200 K, centred just below the Moho. The conductive thermal boundary layer transporting this heat to the surface thins from about 100 km to 10 km beneath the topographic maximum, allowing the ridge to rise above sea level. This thermal structure suggests the potential initiation of a volcanic arc approximately 180 km from the inter-plate contact. A hot zone at 30-50 km depth has pressures consistent with those inferred from Lesser Antilles primitive magmas and represents the most plausible location for partial melting of Caribbean mantle if volatiles are present. The thick Caribbean crust, approximately 20-25 km, is also heated sufficiently for possible silicic melt generation. The inferred lithospheric thickness of 50-100 km aligns with tomography studies. Thus, subduction thermal structure is strongly influenced by several million years of initiation processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用三维热力学模型，研究俯冲带起始及早期热演化条件，重点关注小安的列斯群岛。模型施加每年2厘米的汇聚速度，并考虑地幔和地壳不可逆变形产生的热量。结果表明，板片形成前的变形生热异常强烈；数百万年后，板块屈曲和变形生热形成的地形与地表热流模式可解释现今观测，并可能在板块接触带约180千米处促成火山弧起始。
authors: E. Momoh, S. Tait, H. S. Bhat
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用三维热力学建模研究俯冲带起始及早期热演化期间的条件，重点关注小安的列斯群岛。我们的模型施加每年2厘米的汇聚速度，并采用弹性、蠕变和非关联塑性流动本构关系，纳入地幔与地壳岩石不可逆变形所产生的加热。结果表明，板片形成之前的变形生热强度出乎意料地高。数百万年后，由屈曲以及不可逆变形导致的加热产生了独特的地形和地表热流模式，尽管板片和俯冲界面尚未完全发育，这些模式仍与现今观测结果相似。在加勒比板块内部，板块屈曲形成了一条高地形脊，其下方存在一个约200开尔文的大型正热异常，中心位于莫霍面正下方。将该热量输送到地表的导热热边界层在地形最高处下方由约100千米变薄至10千米，使该山脊能够升至海平面以上。这种热结构表明，火山弧可能在距板块间接触带约180千米处起始。在30至50千米深度处存在一个高温区，其压力与从小安的列斯群岛原始岩浆推断出的压力一致；如果存在挥发分，该区域是加勒比地幔发生部分熔融的最可能位置。厚度约20至25千米的加勒比地壳也被加热到足以生成硅质熔体。因此推断的50至100千米岩石圈厚度与层析成像研究结果一致。由此可见，俯冲热结构受到起始过程数百万年演化的强烈影响。

articles.title: Nonzero-temperature vibronic spectra of polyatomic molecules from a zero-temperature classical trajectory
articles.title_zh: 从零温经典轨迹获得多原子分子的非零温振电光谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20075v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: By combining coherence thermofield dynamics with the single-Hessian approximation, we enable simulations of low- to medium-resolution vibronic spectra of weakly anharmonic systems at nonzero temperatures, at negligible additional cost relative to zero-temperature calculations. Single-Hessian coherence thermofield Gaussian wavepacket dynamics is exact in any harmonic potential, provided that the reference Hessian is that of the final surface. When applied to Morse systems of increasing anharmonicity and varying temperature, this method successfully captures excited-state anharmonicity and key temperature-dependent spectral features, including hot bands and broadening. By combining the method with on-the-fly ab initio dynamics, we demonstrate its utility by computing the absorption spectra of naphthalene, aminocoumarin C450, and phenyl radical, and the photoelectron spectrum of SeO₂⁻ . Within the ab initio single-Hessian approximation, after the zero-temperature spectrum is obtained at the cost of classical molecular dynamics (on the order of hours), all nonzero-temperature spectra are computed in seconds.
articles.abstract_zh: 通过将相干热场动力学与单赫essian近似相结合，本文实现了弱非谐体系在非零温度下的低至中分辨率振电光谱模拟，其额外成本相对于零温计算可以忽略。对不同非谐性和温度的莫尔斯体系测试表明，该方法能够捕捉激发态非谐性以及热带和谱线展宽等温度依赖特征。结合即时从头算动力学后，零温光谱计算完成后，所有非零温光谱均可在数秒内得到。
authors: Davide Barbiero, Jiří J. L. Vaníček
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过将相干热场动力学与单赫essian近似相结合，我们能够以相对于零温计算几乎可以忽略的额外成本，模拟弱非谐体系在非零温度下的低至中等分辨率振电光谱。单赫essian相干热场高斯波包动力学在任意谐势中都是精确的，前提是参考赫essian矩阵取自最终势能面。在非谐性不断增强且温度不同的莫尔斯体系中应用该方法时，它能够成功捕捉激发态非谐性以及关键的温度依赖光谱特征，包括热带和谱线展宽。通过将该方法与即时从头算动力学相结合，我们展示了其应用价值，计算了萘、氨基香豆素C450和苯基自由基的吸收光谱，以及SeO₂⁻的光电子光谱。在从头算单赫essian近似下，零温光谱只需经典分子动力学的计算成本（约为数小时）即可获得，而在此之后，所有非零温度光谱都可在数秒内计算完成。

articles.title: Incorporating multiscale mechanics in lithium-ion battery models
articles.title_zh: 在锂离子电池模型中纳入多尺度力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Lithiation-induced swelling in lithium-ion batteries generates stresses not only within active particles, but also across the surrounding non-active matrix, electrodes, and cell stack. These stresses can modify the chemical potential of lithium and therefore influence transport, reaction kinetics, and terminal voltage. We derive a reduced-order electro-chemo-mechanical model that captures this multiscale coupling while retaining a complexity comparable to standard Doyle--Fuller--Newman models. The electrode is modelled as a periodic array of spherical active particles embedded in a homogenised elastic non-active matrix. Exploiting the small stiffness of the non-active matrix relative to the active material, together with scale separation between particles, electrodes, and the full cell, we obtain an effective mechanical correction to the active-particle chemical potential and overpotential. This correction depends on particle swelling, electrode-scale strain, and macroscopic boundary conditions such as clamping or applied pressure. The resulting formulation can be incorporated directly into DFN, SPMe, and SPM frameworks, providing a computationally efficient route to include battery-scale mechanical effects in electrochemical simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 锂化引起的锂离子电池膨胀会在活性颗粒内部以及周围非活性基体、电极和电芯堆叠中产生应力。这些应力能够改变锂的化学势，进而影响传输、反应动力学和端电压。本文推导了一种降阶电化学-化学-力学耦合模型，在保持与标准Doyle-Fuller-Newman模型相近复杂度的同时，纳入颗粒、电极和电芯尺度的力学效应，并可直接嵌入DFN、SPMe和SPM框架。
authors: Andrea Giudici, Andres F. Galvis, Smita Sahu, Robert Timms, Colin Please, Jon Chapman, Jamie M. Foster
articles.abstract_zh_full: 锂离子电池中由锂化引起的膨胀，不仅会在活性颗粒内部产生应力，也会在周围的非活性基体、电极和电芯堆叠中产生应力。这些应力能够改变锂的化学势，因此会影响传输、反应动力学和端电压。我们推导了一种降阶电化学-化学-力学模型，在保留与标准Doyle-Fuller-Newman模型相近复杂度的同时，捕捉这种多尺度耦合。电极被建模为嵌入均质化弹性非活性基体中的周期性球形活性颗粒阵列。利用非活性基体相对于活性材料较小的刚度，以及颗粒、电极和完整电芯之间的尺度分离，我们得到了对活性颗粒化学势和过电势的有效力学修正。该修正取决于颗粒膨胀、电极尺度应变以及夹持或施加压力等宏观边界条件。所得模型可直接纳入DFN、SPMe和SPM框架，为在电化学模拟中高效考虑电池尺度力学效应提供了一条途径。

articles.title: Excitation of the lower-hybrid drift instability in the outflow of electron-only magnetic reconnection
articles.title_zh: 电子型磁重联外流中下混杂漂移不稳定性的激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report experimental evidence for the lower-hybrid drift instability in the current sheet normal direction of electron-only magnetic reconnection. In our laser-driven capacitor-coil experiment, the system size (sim3 ion skin depths) places it in the electron-only regime. Yet, Thomson scattering reveals out-of-plane electron drift oscillations at the local lower-hybrid frequency, with kinetic energy density reaching sim18% of the local magnetic energy density. Linear theory with the measured parameters predicts more than ten e-folding times of growth, indicating that the instability reaches the nonlinear regime within the measurement window. Supported by particle-in-cell simulations, these results demonstrate the importance of ions in the dissipation and energy transfer in electron-only reconnection where their significance has not been previously recognized.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报告了电子型磁重联电流片法向方向上存在下混杂漂移不稳定性的实验依据。在激光驱动的电容线圈实验中，系统尺度约为3个离子惯性长度，属于电子型重联状态。汤姆孙散射观测到局地下混杂频率下的面外电子漂移振荡，其动能密度达到局地磁能密度的约18%；线性理论和粒子模拟表明，该不稳定性可在观测时间窗内进入非线性阶段，并凸显离子在耗散和能量传递中的作用。
authors: B. K. Russell, K. Sakai, Y. Zhang, L. Gao, E. G. Blackman, W. Daughton, C. Dong, J. Katz, S. R. Klein, C. C. Kuranz, X. Li, X. M. Li, A. L. Milder, J. Ng, K. Orr, G. Pomraning, J. P. Schell, A. Stanier, J. Yoo, H. Ji
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了电子型磁重联中电流片法向方向下混杂漂移不稳定性的实验证据。在我们的激光驱动电容线圈实验中，系统尺度约为3个离子惯性长度，使其处于电子型重联状态。然而，汤姆孙散射显示，在局地下混杂频率处存在面外电子漂移振荡，其动能密度达到局地磁能密度的约18%。利用实测参数进行的线性理论预测表明，增长时间超过10个e折，这说明该不稳定性能够在测量时间窗内达到非线性阶段。粒子模拟支持这些结果，并证明在电子型重联中，离子对于耗散和能量传递具有重要作用，而此前尚未认识到它们的重要性。

articles.title: Gisin's Argument and the Limits of Causal Explanations in Relativistic Spacetime
articles.title_zh: Gisin论证与相对论时空中因果解释的限度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18010v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gisin has provided an argument for the conclusion that no covariant nonlocal model can reproduce the operational statistics observed in Bell experiments. Gisin's argument applies only to deterministic models and we argue that proposed generalizations of the argument beyond determinism based solely on statistical notions are unconvincing, as they lack the resources to formulate a satisfactory notion of no-retrocausality. We introduce the framework of frame-indexed causal models in order to extend Gisin's argument to the genuinely probabilistic case. Frame-indexed causal models associate potentially different causal models with different reference frames while requiring corresponding operational variables to agree runwise. Within this framework, we establish two no-go results based on Gisin's argument. First, we show that no empirically adequate frame-indexed causal model can jointly satisfy Independent Settings, No-Retrocausality, and Causal Lorentz Invariance. Second, it is established that this result continues to hold when Causal Lorentz Invariance is weakened to Lorentz Invariance of Causal Connections, which requires only the skeleton of the causal structure to remain invariant, thereby allowing the direction of causal influence to depend on the choice of reference frame. These results are discussed in the context of relativistic interpretations of quantum theory and nonclassical causal inference.
articles.abstract_zh: Gisin论证认为，协变的非局域模型无法复现实验上观测到的贝尔实验统计。本文指出，原论证仅适用于确定性模型，而仅依靠统计概念推广到非确定性情形的方案缺乏令人满意的非逆因果性概念。作者引入按参考系索引的因果模型，并证明不存在同时满足独立设定、非逆因果性和因果洛伦兹不变性的经验充分模型；即使将后者弱化为因果连接的洛伦兹不变性，该结论仍然成立。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Gisin提出了一种论证，其结论是，没有任何协变的非局域模型能够复现实验上在贝尔实验中观测到的操作统计。Gisin的论证仅适用于确定性模型；我们认为，仅凭统计概念将该论证推广到确定性之外的做法并不令人信服，因为这些做法缺乏表述令人满意的非逆因果性概念所需的资源。我们引入按参考系索引的因果模型框架，以便将Gisin论证扩展到真正的概率情形。按参考系索引的因果模型允许不同参考系对应潜在不同的因果模型，同时要求相应的操作变量逐次运行地保持一致。在这一框架内，我们基于Gisin论证建立了两个禁止性结果。首先，我们证明，任何经验上充分的按参考系索引因果模型，都不可能同时满足独立设定、非逆因果性和因果洛伦兹不变性。其次，我们证明，当因果洛伦兹不变性弱化为因果连接的洛伦兹不变性时，该结果仍然成立；后者只要求因果结构的骨架保持不变，因此允许因果影响的方向依赖于参考系的选择。最后，我们在相对论量子理论的不同解释以及非经典因果推断的背景下讨论这些结果。

articles.title: Complementary, Not Cumulative: Interaction Effects in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Navier-Stokes Vortex Shedding
articles.title_zh: 互补而非累积：物理信息神经网络中技术交互对纳维-斯托克斯涡脱落模拟的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19632v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) embed governing partial differential equations directly into the training loss, offering a promising alternative to costly CFD solvers for unsteady flows. Yet the growing list of techniques proposed to improve PINN training is typically validated one at a time, leaving open whether these techniques actually compose. We study this question in depth on the DFG/Schafer-Turek unsteady cylinder wake benchmark. In isolation, nearly every technique performs no better than an untreated baseline. However, combining periodic (SIREN) activations with causal weighting unlocks a previously inaccessible regime, reconstructing velocity and pressure fields to within 4.1% average relative L2 error against an OpenFOAM reference solution. Adding further techniques instead causes catastrophic performance degradation, demonstrating that individually effective PINN interventions can interact nonlinearly and that more elaborate training recipes are not necessarily better.
articles.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络将控制偏微分方程直接嵌入训练损失，为非定常流动模拟提供了替代高成本计算流体力学求解器的可能。然而，各种训练改进技术能否有效组合仍缺乏系统研究。本文以DFG/Schafer-Turek非定常圆柱尾流基准为对象，发现多数单独技术并不优于未经处理的基线；周期性SIREN激活函数与因果加权结合后，则能将速度和压力场重构误差降至相对于OpenFOAM参考解的4.1%，而继续叠加技术反而会导致灾难性性能下降。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）将控制偏微分方程直接嵌入训练损失，为非定常流动提供了一种有希望的替代方案，可以取代成本高昂的计算流体力学求解器。然而，目前提出的、用于改进PINN训练的技术不断增加，而这些技术通常是逐一验证的，因此它们能否真正组合使用仍是一个开放问题。我们以DFG/Schafer-Turek非定常圆柱尾流基准为对象，深入研究了这一问题。单独使用时，几乎所有技术的表现都不优于未经处理的基线。可是，将周期性（SIREN）激活函数与因果加权相结合后，便进入了此前无法达到的性能区域：相对于OpenFOAM参考解，速度和压力场的平均相对L2误差被重构至4.1%以内。进一步加入其他技术反而会造成灾难性的性能下降，这表明单独有效的PINN干预措施之间可能存在非线性交互，而更加复杂的训练方案并不一定更好。

articles.title: Kerr Quasinormal Modes without Variable Separation: A Two-Dimensional Hyperboloidal Teukolsky Solver with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 无需变量分离的Kerr准正规模：一种结合物理信息神经网络的二维双曲面Teukolsky求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19774v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We use physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) to solve the gravitational quasinormal-mode (QNM) eigenvalue problem for Kerr spacetime directly in the two-dimensional hyperboloidal formulation of the Teukolsky equation. This formulation does not require separation of variables and thus retains the coupled radial--angular structure. Such a scheme provides a prototype for calculating the QNMs of beyond-Kerr black holes for which the perturbation equations are non-separable. Sequences with increasing angular momentum are constructed, reaching close to the extremal limit. We focus on the fundamental modes (ell,m,n)=(2,0,0), (2,1,0), (2,2,0), (3,3,0) and (4,4,0), together with the first overtone (2,2,1). Independent benchmark evaluation shows that every reported real and imaginary frequency component remains below 0.5% error, with a median deviation of 0.1%. This accuracy is maintained in the near-extremal regime, where the damping rate becomes small and the modes are longest-lived. The results establish a non-spectral numerical route to multidimensional black-hole perturbation eigenproblems which does not match the substantially higher precision of dedicated Kerr solvers but offers greater flexibility and requires less analytical pre-processing. Non-separable rotating backgrounds and coupled systems, such as gravitational--electromagnetic Kerr--Newman perturbations, are natural extensions of the same construction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用物理信息神经网络，直接在Kerr时空Teukolsky方程的二维双曲面形式中求解引力准正规模本征值问题，无需进行变量分离，因此保留了径向与角向的耦合结构。研究构造了随角动量增加的模态序列，并覆盖接近极端自旋的区域；所有报告的实部和虚部频率分量误差均低于0.5%，中位偏差为0.1%。该方法虽然精度低于专用Kerr求解器，但为不可分离背景下的黑洞扰动问题提供了更灵活、分析预处理需求更低的非谱数值途径。
authors: Antonio Ferrer-Sánchez, Daniela D. Doneva, José D. Martín-Guerrero, Stoytcho S. Yazadjiev, Roberto Ruiz de Austri-Bazan, Yolanda Vives-Gilabert, José A. Font
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用物理信息神经网络（PINN），直接在Teukolsky方程的二维双曲面形式中求解Kerr时空的引力准正规模（QNM）本征值问题。该形式不需要变量分离，因此保留了径向和角向之间的耦合结构。这种方案为计算超越Kerr黑洞的QNM提供了原型，因为对于这类黑洞，其扰动方程可能无法分离。我们构造了角动量逐渐增加的序列，最远达到接近极端极限的区域。我们重点研究了基模（ell,m,n）=(2,0,0)、(2,1,0)、(2,2,0)、(3,3,0)和(4,4,0)，以及第一泛音（2,2,1）。独立基准评估表明，所报告的每一个实部和虚部频率分量的误差均低于0.5%，中位偏差为0.1%。在近极端区域，阻尼率变小且模态寿命最长，但该精度仍然保持不变。结果建立了一条针对多维黑洞扰动本征值问题的非谱数值途径；该途径无法达到专用Kerr求解器的显著更高精度，但具有更大的灵活性，并且所需的分析预处理更少。不可分离的旋转背景以及引力-电磁耦合系统（例如Kerr-Newman扰动）都是这一构造的自然扩展方向。

articles.title: SAKE: Spectral Autodiff Kernel Expansion for Geometric Liouvillian Transport. A Differential-Geometric Framework for Response Transport in Quantum Dynamical Systems
articles.title_zh: SAKE：用于几何李乌维尔输运的谱自动微分核展开——量子动力学系统响应输运的微分几何框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20132v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce the Spectral Autodiff Kernel Expansion (SAKE), a differentiable computational framework for transporting nonlinear spectroscopic response between neighboring quantum dynamical models. Rather than recomputing multidimensional spectra independently for each Hamiltonian or Liouvillian, SAKE constructs local transport expansions about a reference model by combining forward-mode automatic differentiation with Duhamel transport theory. Automatic differentiation generates first-, second-, and third-order derivatives of the parameter-dependent Liouvillian, which are assembled into a pathway transport operator that maps the nonlinear response of a reference model onto neighboring systems. The framework is validated for a four-level excitonic dimer possessing an su(2)× su(2) symmetry by comparing second- and third-order transported pathway operators with exact projected transport matrices obtained from direct calculations. The third-order expansion accurately reproduces the projected transport operator and its associated pathway mixing. Beyond providing an efficient computational strategy, the transport operator reveals how coherent and dissipative perturbations redistribute amplitude among double-sided Feynman pathways, exposing mechanistic information that is not directly apparent from the nonlinear spectrum. SAKE thereby establishes a differentiable computational framework for nonlinear spectroscopy that supports efficient local parameter exploration, sensitivity analysis, and future inverse-design applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出谱自动微分核展开（SAKE），一种用于在相邻量子动力学模型之间输运非线性光谱响应的可微计算框架。该方法结合前向模式自动微分与杜阿梅尔输运理论，在参考模型附近构造局部输运展开，并利用参数依赖李乌维尔算符的高阶导数建立路径输运算子。对具有 su(2)×su(2) 对称性的四能级激子二聚体的验证表明，三阶展开能够准确再现精确投影输运算子及其路径混合，为参数探索、敏感性分析和逆向设计提供了有效工具。
authors: Eric R. Bittner, Carlos Silva-Acuna, Hao Li, Simon Paiva-Ortega
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出谱自动微分核展开（SAKE），一种用于在相邻量子动力学模型之间输运非线性光谱响应的可微计算框架。该方法不再针对每个哈密顿量或李乌维尔算符分别重新计算多维光谱，而是结合前向模式自动微分与杜阿梅尔输运理论，在参考模型周围构造局部输运展开。自动微分生成参数依赖李乌维尔算符的一阶、二阶和三阶导数，并将其组装为路径输运算子，把参考模型的非线性响应映射到相邻体系。我们以具有 su(2)×su(2) 对称性的四能级激子二聚体为例，通过将二阶和三阶输运路径算子与直接计算得到的精确投影输运矩阵进行比较，对该框架进行验证。三阶展开能够准确再现投影输运算子及其相关的路径混合。除提供高效计算策略外，输运算子还揭示了相干和耗散扰动如何在双面费曼路径之间重新分配振幅，从而展现出非线性光谱中无法直接看出的机制信息。SAKE 因而建立了一个用于非线性光谱学的可微计算框架，支持高效的局部参数探索、敏感性分析以及未来的逆向设计应用。

articles.title: Unraveling Geometric-phase at Conical Intersection by Cavity-enhanced Two-dimensional Electronic Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: 利用腔增强二维电子光谱揭示圆锥交叉处的几何相位
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.08889v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The geometric phase is a fundamental quantum mechanical phenomenon uniquely associated with conical intersections (CI) between potential energy surfaces and serves as a definitive signature of their presence. In this study, we propose a novel spectroscopic approach to directly detect the geometric phase using two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy (2DES) enhanced by strong light-matter interactions within an optical cavity. Focusing on a prototypical pentacene dimer undergoing singlet fission, we model the nonadiabatic wave packet dynamics as it evolves through a CI between electronically excited states. The optical cavity enables dynamic modulation of the coupling between the optical field and molecular vibrational modes, allowing precise control over the wave packet pathways. Importantly, we identify a cancellation in the spectral amplitude, arising from phase differences accumulated along different trajectories, which serves as a clear spectroscopic manifestation of the geometric phase (GP). This cavity-enhanced 2DES framework not only enables direct observation of GP effects but also offers a versatile platform for probing ultrafast nonadiabatic processes. Our results provide fundamental insights into topological effects in molecular dynamics and pave the way for experimental strategies in quantum control, photochemistry, and the design of advanced optoelectronic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种利用光学腔增强二维电子光谱直接探测几何相位的新型光谱方法，并以经历单线态裂分的并五苯二聚体为模型。光学腔能够动态调节光场与分子振动模之间的耦合，从而控制非绝热波包的演化路径。不同轨迹积累的相位差导致光谱振幅发生抵消，这被确定为几何相位的明确光谱表现。
authors: Yang-Cheng Ye, Fulu Zheng, Ajay Jha, Hong-Guang Duan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 几何相位是一种基本的量子力学现象，与势能面之间的圆锥交叉（CI）独特相关，并且是其存在的决定性标志。在本研究中，我们提出一种新型光谱方法，利用光学腔内强光–物质相互作用增强的二维电子光谱（2DES），直接探测几何相位。我们以经历单线态裂分的典型并五苯二聚体为研究对象，模拟非绝热波包穿过电子激发态之间CI时的动力学演化。光学腔能够动态调制光场与分子振动模之间的耦合，从而精确控制波包的传播路径。重要的是，我们发现，由不同轨迹上积累的相位差会导致光谱振幅发生抵消，这构成了几何相位（GP）的清晰光谱表现。该腔增强二维电子光谱框架不仅能够直接观测GP效应，还为探测超快非绝热过程提供了多功能平台。我们的结果为分子动力学中的拓扑效应提供了基本认识，并为量子控制、光化学和先进光电材料设计中的实验策略铺平了道路。

articles.title: Stability, degeneracy, and scalability of a 600-site cavity array microscope
articles.title_zh: 600位点腔阵列显微镜的稳定性、简并性与可扩展性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06587v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Optical cavities are a foundational technology for controlling light-matter interactions. While interfacing a single cavity to either an atom or ensemble has become a standard tool, the advent of single atom control in large atomic arrays has spurred interest in a new frontier of ``many-cavity QED,'' featuring many independent resonators capable of separately addressing individual quantum emitters. In this fast-evolving landscape, the cavity array microscope was recently introduced -- employing free space intra-cavity optics to engineer a two-dimensional array of tightly spaced cavity TEM₀₀ modes with wavelength-scale waists, ideally suited for interfacing with atom arrays. Here we realize the next-generation of this architecture, achieving hundreds of degenerate cavity modes with improved, uniform finesse, and explore the technical features of the system which will enable further scalability. In particular, we study imperfections, including optical aberrations, field of view constraints, array non-degeneracies, and losses from optical elements. We identify the sensitivity to these various vectors and exposit the control knobs and techniques necessary to align and operate the system in a stable manner. Ultimately, we lay out a pathway towards operation with tens of thousands of independent cavities while maintaining compatibility with existing atom arrays, paving the way to myriad applications including highly parallelized remote entanglement generation, fast and non-destructive mid-circuit readout, and the implementation of hybrid atom-photon Hamiltonians.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者实现了新一代腔阵列显微镜架构，获得数百个具有改进且均匀精细度的简并腔模，并系统研究了其可扩展运行所需的技术特性。研究分析了光学像差、视场限制、阵列非简并性和光学元件损耗等缺陷，确定了系统对这些因素的敏感性及稳定对准和运行所需的控制手段。该成果为在兼容现有原子阵列的同时扩展到数万个独立腔提供了路径。
authors: Anna Soper, Danial Shadmany, Adam L. Shaw, Lukas Palm, David I. Schuster, Jonathan Simon
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光学腔是控制光–物质相互作用的基础技术。将单个腔与单个原子或原子系综耦合已经成为标准工具，而大规模原子阵列中单原子控制技术的出现，则激发了人们对“多腔量子电动力学”的兴趣。在这一新兴方向中，多个相互独立的谐振器能够分别寻址单个量子发射体。腔阵列显微镜是近期提出的一种架构，它利用腔内自由空间光学元件，构造紧密排列的二维腔TEM₀₀模阵列，并具有波长尺度的束腰，因而非常适合与原子阵列耦合。在这里，我们实现了该架构的下一代版本，获得了数百个简并腔模，同时提高了精细度的一致性，并研究了能够支持进一步扩展的系统技术特性。具体而言，我们研究了包括光学像差、视场限制、阵列非简并性以及光学元件损耗在内的各种不完美因素。我们确定了系统对这些不同因素的敏感性，并阐明了稳定对准和运行系统所需的控制旋钮与技术。最终，我们提出了一条运行数万个独立腔的扩展路径，同时保持与现有原子阵列的兼容性，为高度并行化的远程纠缠生成、快速且无损的中途测量，以及混合原子–光子哈密顿量的实现等众多应用铺平道路。

articles.title: Enhanced nondipole momentum offsets in triple ionization of atoms driven by mid-infrared laser fields
articles.title_zh: 中红外激光场驱动原子三重电离中增强的非偶极动量偏移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.10837v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the dependence on wavelength of nondipole effects in triple ionization of Ne driven by intense infrared and mid-infrared laser pulses using a three-dimensional semiclassical model that fully accounts for nondipole effects and the Coulomb singularity in the electron-core interaction. We find in triple ionization of strongly driven Ne a large positive average momentum offset along the direction of laser propagation, which vanishes in the dipole approximation. This positive momentum offset significantly increases with increasing wavelength of the laser pulse. This increase is present for all triple ionization events as well as for the main direct and delayed pathways of triple ionization. We attribute the increase of the momentum offset to the contribution of the effect of the magnetic field of the laser pulse on the bound electrons. This contribution counterbalances the decrease of electron-electron correlation in recollisions with increasing wavelength. We find that 1200 nm is an ideal wavelength for experimentally measuring the momentum offset related to correlated three-electron escape.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用充分考虑非偶极效应及电子-原子核相互作用中库仑奇异性的三维半经典模型，研究红外和中红外激光脉冲驱动氖原子三重电离中的波长依赖性。结果表明，沿激光传播方向的正平均动量偏移会随波长增加而显著增强，其来源与激光磁场对束缚电子的作用有关。研究指出，1200 nm 可能是实验测量关联三电子逃逸动量偏移的理想波长。
authors: Samuel James Praill, Georgios Petros Katsoulis, Daria Romero Torres, Agapi Emmanouilidou
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用一种三维半经典模型，研究强红外和中红外激光脉冲驱动的氖原子三重电离中非偶极效应对波长的依赖性；该模型充分考虑了非偶极效应以及电子-原子核相互作用中的库仑奇异性。在强场驱动的氖原子三重电离中，我们发现沿激光传播方向存在较大的正平均动量偏移，而在偶极近似下该偏移会消失。随着激光脉冲波长增加，这一正动量偏移显著增强。对于所有三重电离事件，以及三重电离的主要直接路径和延迟路径，这种增强均会出现。我们将动量偏移的增加归因于激光脉冲磁场对束缚电子作用的贡献。随着波长增加，再碰撞过程中电子-电子关联作用会减弱，而上述磁场贡献能够抵消这种减弱。我们发现，1200 nm 是实验测量与关联的三电子逃逸有关的动量偏移的理想波长。

articles.title: Nested homogenization of xylem-inspired porous fluidic networks
articles.title_zh: 受木质部启发的多孔流体网络的嵌套均质化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13888v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Fluidic networks may contain hierarchical porous structures in which transport across macroscopic interfaces is controlled by geometrical features at multiple nested length scales. Direct resolution of all these scales rapidly becomes computationally prohibitive for network-scale studies, while reduced descriptions require a priori effective hydraulic properties. Here, we develop a nested homogenization framework for rigid porous interfaces under single-phase viscous flow. The pore-scale structure is first replaced by an effective stress-jump interface law, which is then embedded as an internal interface condition within a second characteristic problem at the intermediate scale. This successive upscaling propagates the pore-scale geometry through effective tensors to obtain a closure for flow across the whole porous structure. The approach is validated against fully resolved simulations at the mesoscopic and macroscopic scales, for two xylem-inspired channel configurations, and accurately captures pressure drops and flow redistribution while strongly reducing computational cost. The framework provides a tractable bottom-up description of a network composed of nested porous membranes and a basis for extensions to deformable structures and multiphase flows.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对具有多层嵌套长度尺度的刚性多孔界面，建立了适用于单相黏性流动的嵌套均质化框架。该方法先将孔隙尺度结构转化为有效应力跳跃界面定律，再将其作为中间尺度特征问题中的内部界面条件，从而获得整个多孔结构的流动闭合关系。针对两种受木质部启发的通道构型，方法能够准确预测压降和流量再分配，并显著降低计算成本。
authors: Pier Giuseppe Ledda, Giacomo Ferrari, Giuseppe Antonio Zampogna
articles.abstract_zh_full: 流体网络可能包含具有层级化多孔结构的体系，其中跨越宏观界面的输运由多个相互嵌套的长度尺度上的几何特征所控制。直接解析所有这些尺度会使网络尺度研究迅速变得难以承受计算成本，而降阶描述则需要预先获得有效水力性质。在此，我们针对单相黏性流动中的刚性多孔界面，建立了一种嵌套均质化框架。首先，将孔隙尺度结构替换为一种有效应力跳跃界面定律；随后，在中间尺度的第二个特征问题中，将该定律作为内部界面条件嵌入。通过这种逐级上尺度过程，孔隙尺度几何信息经由有效张量传递，从而获得整个多孔结构中流动的闭合关系。我们针对两种受木质部启发的通道构型，在介观和宏观尺度上将该方法与完全解析模拟进行了验证。结果表明，该方法能够准确捕捉压降和流量再分配，同时大幅降低计算成本。该框架为由嵌套多孔膜组成的网络提供了一种可处理的自底向上描述，并为向可变形结构和多相流的扩展奠定了基础。

articles.title: WavePID: Low-energy flavor identification using single-PMT time series in IceCube
articles.title_zh: WavePID：利用 IceCube 单光电倍增管时间序列进行低能味道识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02078v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The IceCube Neutrino Observatory, a cubic-kilometer detector at the South Pole, identifies neutrino flavor through event morphology. Sparse photon detection makes this classification particularly challenging in the 5--100~GeV regime, the energy range relevant for oscillation measurements and searches for physics beyond the Standard Model. We introduce WavePID, a template-based log-likelihood-ratio classifier that exploits nanosecond-scale timing on individual detector modules through three observables: the distance to the reconstructed vertex, the early-charge fraction, and the module-to-module time difference. Evaluated on a cascade-enriched sample selected by a state-of-the-art graph neural network, WavePID improves both cascade purity and classification performance over the neural network alone. This demonstrates that per-module pulse timing carries flavor-identification information complementary to morphology-based classifiers, opening a new physics-motivated observable for low-energy neutrino reconstruction. Geant4 simulations associate this signal with differences in Cherenkov emission geometry between muon tracks and electromagnetic showers. These results motivate exploiting nanosecond-scale pulse timing in future low-energy classifiers and in detector designs with improved per-module timing in next-generation neutrino telescopes.
