articles.title: Mag4: An Automated First-Principles Workflow to Extract Magnetic Interactions, from Pair Couplings to Four-Spin Ring Exchange
articles.title_zh: Mag4：从成对耦合到四自旋环交换的磁相互作用自动化第一性原理工作流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.18986v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Chemists design magnetic materials through structure-property relationships built on pairwise exchange couplings J, now extracted routinely from first principles by energy-mapping. But wherever four magnetic centers close a loop---as in cuprate CuO₂ planes or infinite-layer square nets---a four-spin ring exchange Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg can arise, reshaping ground states and corrupting the J values used for design. Missing has been a direct, local way to obtain it, as the four-state method gives for J. We supply it by generalizing that method to a sixteen-state (2⁴⁾ scheme, automated in the open Mag4 package---the first automatic implementation of the four-state family. From one cif file, Mag4 proposes the supercell that isolates the couplings, generates DFT inputs in the user's chosen functional, extracts J and Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg with band-gap and local-moment diagnostics, and predicts the magnetic order, propagation vector, and critical temperature. Symmetry reduces the sixteen configurations to six or eight inequivalent energies, so the cost is modest. The derivation shows the conventional four-state J is itself ring-renormalized by mp 2 Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg S², the sign set by the reference state. T-La₂CuO₄ confirms this: three routes agree on Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg to 0.2%, giving Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg/J₁₌₀.25, and a four-state J₁ quoted without its reference is wrong by 12%. The sixteen-state value is itself reference-dependent---Néel and ferromagnetic baths bracket it---a fourth-order fingerprint of interactions beyond the pair-plus-ring model, resolved by further baths into a bare Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg and a converging tower of six- and eight-spin loop couplings. SrFeO₂ (S=2), same plaquette yet Jₘ̊ ᵣᵢₙg/J=0.006, is the negative control: a plaquette is necessary for ring exchange but far from sufficient---a structure-property criterion for screening new multi-spin magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出开源Mag4软件包，通过将四态方法推广至十六态方案，自动从晶体结构文件中提取成对交换耦合和四自旋环交换，并预测磁有序、传播矢量和临界温度。推导表明，传统四态法得到的交换耦合会受到环交换重整化，且提取的环交换本身还依赖于参考磁背景。对T-La2CuO4和SrFeO2的案例说明，具有四边形磁性结构单元是出现显著环交换的必要条件，但远非充分条件。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 化学家通过建立在成对交换耦合J基础上的结构-性质关系来设计磁性材料；如今，J通常可通过基于能量映射的第一性原理计算得到提取。然而，只要四个磁性中心围成一个回路，如在铜酸盐CuO2平面或无限层方格网络中，就可能出现四自旋环交换Jᵣᵢₙg，从而重塑基态，并使设计中使用的J值受到影响。此前缺少一种直接的局域方法来获得它，正如四态方法能够获得J那样。我们通过将该方法推广至十六态（2⁴）方案来填补这一空白，并将其自动化为开源Mag4软件包，这是四态方法家族的首个自动化实现。仅从一个cif文件出发，Mag4即可提出能够隔离相关耦合的超胞，按用户选择的泛函生成DFT输入文件，借助带隙和局域磁矩诊断提取J和Jᵣᵢₙg，并预测磁有序、传播矢量和临界温度。对称性将十六种构型减少为六种或八种不等价能量，因此计算成本较低。推导表明，传统四态法得到的J本身受到±2JᵣᵢₙgS²的环交换重整化，其符号由参考态确定。T-La2CuO4证实了这一点：三种途径给出的Jᵣᵢₙg结果在0.2%以内一致，得到Jᵣᵢₙg/J1=0.25；若不说明参考态，采用四态法给出的J1将产生12%的误差。十六态得到的数值本身也依赖于参考态，奈尔背景和铁磁背景给出其范围；这是超越成对加环交换模型的相互作用的四阶指纹。通过进一步引入不同背景，可将其解析为裸Jᵣᵢₙg以及逐渐收敛的一系列六自旋和八自旋回路耦合。SrFeO2（S=2）具有相同的方形单元，但Jᵣᵢₙg/J=0.006，是一个反例对照：方形单元是环交换出现的必要条件，却远非充分条件，这为筛选新的多自旋磁体提供了一项结构-性质判据。

articles.title: Lightweight attention mechanisms in breast ultrasound lesion segmentation: parameter cost, protocol choice, data leakage, and what the data can resolve
articles.abstract: Background. Reported segmentation results on the Breast Ultrasound Images (BUSI) dataset span a wide range, and the protocols behind them differ in ways not always stated. Whether the architectural differences those results support are large enough to be resolved by the data has not been established. Methods. We trained eleven U-Net variants under a single evaluation protocol on the 647 lesion-bearing images, using three independent random splits (Monte Carlo cross-validation) with a held-out test partition separate from validation, and computed all metrics from stored masks with one evaluation module. Five attention mechanisms were compared against a common reference and four ablation-axis steps as a separate family, each corrected for multiplicity within its family. For every comparison we report a minimum detectable effect from that comparison's own paired differences, with standard errors on independent clusters rather than images. Parameter cost was counted from the trained model files. Results. Parameter cost spanned three orders of magnitude across the five mechanisms (12 to 32,595 parameters in the deployed model) while measured gains spanned 0.0020 to 0.0137 Dice. The largest gain came from the cheapest mechanism, efficient channel attention with deep supervision, at 12 parameters. No gain reached the threshold its own comparison could resolve; the largest was 0.52 of a multiplicity-corrected threshold of 0.0262, with win rates between 49.1 % and 56.4 %. Network depth, by contrast, produced a resolved effect of +0.0400. Selecting the reported checkpoint on the evaluation partition rather than a held-out one moved the reported value by +0.0316 to +0.0355 in our own runs. A published lightweight baseline exceeded the best ablation configuration by +0.0150, a margin that its own comparison could not resolve either. An audit of the distributed dataset found 146 near-duplicate pairs; removing them moved absolute Dice by 0.0203 but paired differences by 0.0065. Conclusions. On this benchmark the parameter cost of an attention module and the effect it produces are not aligned, and the effects lie below what the data can resolve. We report these magnitudes so that the cost of an architectural decision can be weighed against the evidence for its benefit.

articles.title: FORCE: FORward matching for Complex microstructure Estimation
articles.abstract: Diffusion Magnetic Resonance Imaging (dMRI) is a noninvasive modality that enables the study of brain tissue microstructure and the reconstruction of neural pathways. To achieve this, most reconstruction methods rely on inverse modeling techniques that fit the measured signal to narrow parametric spaces, each designed to recover either fiber orientations or microstructural properties. Obtaining a comprehensive characterization of tissue microstructure and architecture therefore often requires combining multiple models, which is computationally demanding and potentially inconsistent due to model-specific assumptions and acquisition settings. This work introduces FORCE, a forward modeling paradigm that reframes how diffusion data is analyzed. Instead of inverting the measured signal, FORCE simulates a large set of biologically plausible intra-voxel fiber configurations and tissue compositions. It then identifies the best-matching simulations for each voxel by operating directly in the signal space, retaining a local posterior over plausible configurations. This unified framework performs three tasks in a single process: resolving low-angle fiber crossings, generating a large suite of microstructural maps, and producing partial volume maps, while also yielding a per-voxel measure of estimation uncertainty. The proposed approach demonstrates robust performance across synthetic and real datasets from both human and mouse brains, encompassing multiple resolutions and acquisition types, and requires no specialized acquisition or additional scan time.

articles.title: Amorphous High-κ Dielectrics for Top-Gate Integration in 2D Semiconductor Transistors
articles.abstract: High‑κ dielectrics compatible with two‑dimensional (2D) semiconductors and their reliable integration remain key bottlenecks limiting the development of 2D semiconductor electronics. Here, we introduce a room-temperature fabrication strategy that combines magnetron sputtering with a van der Waals assembly process to form amorphous high‑κ top-gate dielectrics on 2D semiconductors. Amorphous dielectric materials feature no grain boundaries, atomically smooth surfaces, and uniform dielectric properties. Magnetron sputtering is demonstrated as a general deposition approach for various amorphous high‑κ dielectrics, including CaCu3Ti4O12 (CCTO), BaTiO3 (BTO), and Ga2O3. To avoid direct sputter-induced damage to the 2D semiconductor channel, an efficient transfer strategy is developed that exploits the strong hydrophilicity of freshly deposited SiOx (contact angle of ~0°) and the extremely weak adhesion of the SiOx-Au interface (adhesion strength of ~0.14 MPa). Top-gate MoS2 transistors incorporating such amorphous high‑κ dielectrics exhibit excellent electrical characteristics. In particular, the top-gate MoS2 transistor with the CCTO dielectric (relative dielectric constant κ of ~46 as the maximum value) achieved a near-Boltzmann-limit subthreshold swing of 60 mV/decade and an on/off ratio exceeding 10⁶. Our work identifies amorphous high‑κ dielectrics as a new material system for 2D semiconductor‑compatible top‑gate dielectrics in future nanoelectronics.

articles.title: Formation mechanism and optical/magnetic properties of high-entropy (FeCuMn)(WMo)O₄₋ₓSₓ nanosheets synthesized via hydrothermal method
articles.abstract: Breaking the NIR-II bottleneck, conventional inorganic semiconductors have long suffered from inadequate optical absorption, limiting their phototherapeutic efficacy. Here, we report a paradigm-shifting breakthrough: the first-ever hydrothermal synthesis of high-entropy (FeCuMn)(WMo)O₄₋ₓSₓ nanosheets. By overcoming the fundamental immiscibility of five transition metals, our monoclinic nanosheets unlock an unprecedented broadband absorption spanning 400–1400 nm, achieving record-high photothermal conversion in both the NIR-I and NIR-II biological windows (ΔT = 38°C at 808 nm). Remarkably, this high-entropy configuration simultaneously endows the material with strong T₁/T₂ magnetic relaxivity, enabling novel dual-modal MR imaging capability. This first demonstration of integrating photothermal and magnetic functionalities via hydrothermal high-entropy engineering opens a new avenue for theranostic nanoplatforms.

articles.title: Derivation of the Exact Source Functions of the Grad–Shafranov equation
articles.abstract: Exact expressions for the source functions of the Grad–Shafranov equation (GSE), namely, the poloidal current (:f), plasma pressure (:p), and toroidal current density (:Jǎᵣₚₕᵢ:) are derived through systematic mathematical manipulations. After eliminating the derivatives with respect to the poloidal flux (:łeft(fracpartial:partial:ψ:i̊ght)), the GSE is transformed into a fourth-order partial differential equation that governs plasma equilibrium in tokamaks and other similar axisymmetric devices. By solving this fourth-order partial differential equation, we obtained four independent solutions. A systematic procedure was then employed to determine the flux and the exact source functions. To validate this method, a numerical computation of the poloidal flux was performed. The algorithm was subsequently applied to the International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER) using published parameters for the baseline inductive scenario: a (:15:MA)-plasma current, a (:32.86:T.m) on-axis poloidal current, a (:5.3:T) on-axis toroidal magnetic field, and characteristic radii corresponding to pulsed operation at a fusion gain factor of (:Q=10). To the best of our knowledge, this approach is novel and has not been previously reported for finding the source functions of the Grad-Shafranov equation.

articles.title: Quasi-One-Dimensional Sb2(S,Se)3 Self-Powered Photodetector for Diamond Fluorescence Magnetometry
articles.abstract: Photodetectors (PDs) are indispensable for optical readout in quantum-sensing systems, including diamond fluorescence magnetometry. Quasi-one-dimensional Sb2(S,Se)3 is a promising PD material, owing to its strong optical absorption and favorable anisotropic carrier transport. However, its application as an optical-readout unit in quantum sensing system remains largely unexplored. Here, we employ buried-interface engineering during hydrothermal growth to fabricate Sb2(S,Se)3 heterostructure with improved carrier separation and transport, enabling self-powered PD for nitrogen-vacancy-fluorescence readout. The optimized device delivers a responsivity of 0.48 A·W− 1, an external quantum efficiency of 87% in the red spectral region, and a noise-equivalent power of 0.53 pW·Hz− 1/2, substantially lower than that of the unoptimized device. Integrated into a diamond NV-center magnetometry system, the PD achieves a magnetic-field sensitivity of 2.37 nT·Hz− 1/2 @1000 Hz and improves magnetic-field measurement precision by approximately one order of magnitude relative to a commercial silicon PD. These findings link interfacial materials engineering to system-level quantum-sensing performance.

articles.title: Intense light bent out of shape—ultrafast lenses made from gas
articles.abstract: Researchers from the MPIK in Heidelberg used an atomic gas as a time-dependent lens to shape and spectrally manipulate intense high-frequency laser pulses. This gas-based optical element could pave the way toward better XUV- and X-ray pulse control for applications such as chemical reaction steering, quantum computing, and advanced spectroscopy methods for fundamental science. The paper is published in the journal Science Advances.

articles.title: New measurements explain how silicon and diamond achieve extreme reversible stretching
articles.abstract: A research team led by Yang Lu from the Department of Mechanical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering, The University of Hong Kong (HKU), has uncovered the microscopic physical nature of ultralarge elasticity in covalent semiconductors such as silicon and diamond. The discovery provides quantitative guidance for deep elastic strain engineering (DESE), paving the way for the development of next-generation electronic, optoelectronic and quantum devices.

articles.title: Exact expressions of correlation functions between two spins in the boundary row of the two-dimensional rectangular Ising model with periodic-free boundary conditions and finite size
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19274v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present exact expressions of correlation functions between two spins in the boundary row of the two-dimensional rectangular Ising model with periodic-free boundary conditions and finite size. Some properties of exact expressions obtained are discussed. The fundamental property of the Ising model that the long range order emerge as the temperature decrease is shown clearly; expressions of the correlation functions in the thermodynamic limit varies depending on the order of taking limits of two parameters L and N; the impact of different sizes on correlation functions is illustrated with the aid of diagrams. Expressions of the correlation function discussed in this paper in the thermodynamic limit has been presented by previous researchers, and we prove that expressions obtained in this article is identical in form to expressions provided by previous researchers in the thermodynamic limit.

articles.title: Extension of the Shockley-Queisser Limit for Nanostructured Solar Cells
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19284v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This article extends the Shockley-Queisser limit to nanostructured solar cells using the quantum phase space formalism. The parameter Bₗₗ represents the momentum variance in each confinement direction and acts as a variance-covariance matrix linking the nanostructure geometry to thermodynamic properties. Electron-electron interactions are included via an exchange-correlation energy with an adjustable coefficient theta. The authors derive an analytical expression for the maximum efficiency as a function of size, shape, temperature, and doping. For the cylindrical geometry, the exact confinement energy uses the first zero of the Bessel function j₀,1. Numerical simulations are performed with Python 3.8.1, NumPy, and Matplotlib for PbS quantum dots in four geometries: cube, square parallelepiped, cylinder, and sphere. The integral is evaluated using an exact convergent series expansion. Results show that the maximum efficiency reaches 48.7 percent for a 5 nanometre cube, 49.0 percent for flattened parallelepiped and cylinder shapes, and 49.1 percent for a 3 nanometre sphere. These values greatly exceed the bulk PbS efficiency of 15.8 percent and surpass classical Shockley-Queisser limits. For constant-volume shapes, two efficiency peaks appear corresponding to different aspect ratios. The model correctly returns to classical values for large sizes. This approach provides a theoretical framework for optimising nanostructured solar cells and demonstrates that quantum confinement offers a promising route to surpass traditional photovoltaic limits.
authors: Rivo Herivola Manjakamanana Ravelonjato, Jean Patrice Rakotoniaina, Ravo Tokiniaina Ranaivoson, Wilfrid Chrysante Solofoarisina

articles.title: Interferometric Signatures of Zero Modes in Fractional Quantum Hall-Superconductor Heterostructures
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19312v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fractional quantum Hall-superconductor (FQH-SC) heterostructures are predicted to host defect-bound parafermion zero modes (PZMs). We propose two related configurations to probe their fusion structure. In a Josephson junction coupled to a single quantum point contact (QPC), quasiparticle tunneling switches the defect fusion channel, producing stochastic transitions between branches of the fractional Josephson spectrum. Embedding the junction in a two-QPC Fabry-Pérot interferometer provides a complementary probe. Weak zero mode tunneling produces fusion-channel-dependent interference while strong tunneling makes the interferometer probe a superposition of fusion channels and strongly suppresses the signal: in the topological limit it vanishes exactly, revealing the defects' non-Abelian nature even when the parent FQH state is Abelian.
authors: Junyi Cao, Ramanjit Sohal, Angela Kou, Eduardo Fradkin

articles.title: Quantum Rényi-Jarzynski Equality
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Jarzynski equality provides a strict link between nonequilibrium work and equilibrium free energy changes. Its typical quantum formulations, however, rely on measurement protocols that destroy coherence. In this Letter, we use the resource-theoretic approach to derive a non-destructive quantum Jarzynski equality conditioned on the outcomes of an arbitrary bath observable. This yields the Rényi-Jarzynski equality, which quantifies a finite bath's drift from equilibrium under a non-adiabatic drive via the Rényi k-divergence. We further demonstrate that the Rényi-Jarzynski equality provides a tunable cost function for quantum optimal control problems where minimizing bath drift is desired, such as state preparation and gate design, enabling the minimization of cross-talk in finite quantum systems. Our toy model exhibits a transition between competing minima for some critical value of k, illustrating how the Rényi order tunes sensitivity to different regions of a bath distribution. Strikingly, when drive parameters vary across bath energy levels, minimizing bath drift requires generating system-bath entanglement.
authors: Benjamin Bobell, Mert Okyay, Rahul Nandkishore

articles.title: Self-calibrating thermal interferometry of vortex parity in a two-dimensional chiral superconductor
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19343v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A chiral superconductor carries chiral Majorana modes along its boundary, and the integer that counts them fixes everything that follows, yet that integer has never been measured together with a local parity observable on one object. Proximitized one-dimensional wires read fermion parity rapidly but diagnose bulk topology through a separate protocol. Here we show that a reconfigurable domain wall between regions of opposite Chern number in an intrinsic two-dimensional chiral superconductor performs both functions. Opened to its contacts the wall is a ballistic channel whose quantized thermal conductance counts its Majorana modes; closed, the same wall is a Fabry--Pérot resonator whose spectrum shifts by half a level spacing when the parity of the enclosed vortices changes, giving a two-level heat conductance. We derive the exact transmission, the elastic heat full counting statistics, and a theorem showing that linear-response heat scattering of a fixed quadratic problem resolves vortex parity but not the fusion channel of well-separated cores. An outside vortex hybridized with the wall is an intrinsic false positive; temperature, geometry and a finite-bias mean--noise test separates it. Rhombohedral-graphene parameters place submicron loops in the resolved regime at millikelvin temperatures, where chiral-domain reconfiguration and noise thermometry are both established.

articles.title: Coherence protection of a silicon hole spin qubit with phase-modulated microwave driving
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19696v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hole spins in silicon quantum dots are a promising platform for quantum computing due to their strong intrinsic spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which enables fast, all-electrical control. However, this coupling also increases their susceptibility to charge noise, thereby limiting coherence times. Moreover, holes in silicon are also affected by hyperfine interactions with residual nuclear spins in the silicon substrate, introducing a non-negligible source of low-frequency noise. Here, we implement a phase-modulated concatenated continuous driving (CCD) technique for hole spin qubits to suppress low-frequency noise through microwave phase modulation. This approach stabilizes Rabi oscillations and extends the oscillation decay time compared to the conventional method. Furthermore, by defining a qubit in the CCD frame, we achieve coherent control while simultaneously protecting the qubit from noise, confirming coherence protection during gate operations. These results demonstrate a viable route toward noise-robust hole spin qubits.
authors: Sayyid I. Ibad, Yusuke Sato, Takuma Kuno, Itaru Yanagi, Toshiyuki Mine, Ryuta Tsuchiya, Digh Hisamoto, Hiroyuki Mizuno, Raisei Mizokuchi, Jun Yoneda, Tetsuo Kodera

articles.title: Kibble--Zurek Scaling in the Dicke Model at Mesoscopic Scales
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20067v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Dicke model is a paradigmatic setting for collective light-matter physics and the superradiant phase transition. Yet extracting the critical exponents is challenging at experimentally accessible mesoscopic sizes, due to the slow divergence of the correlation time under all-to-all coupling and a photon-loss-driven crossover to a distinct dissipative universality class. Here, we perform a large-N analysis that identifies distinct coherent and dissipative fixed points for the closed and open Dicke models. We then develop a unified mesoscopic scaling framework that incorporates the leading irrelevant correction and, going beyond static and spectral probes, brings ramping dynamics under the same scaling description. It recovers the corresponding exponents, verifies Kibble-Zurek scaling, and clarifies how finite size, dissipation, and speed compete in the ramping dynamics. Our work thus establishes a unified framework for resolving static and dynamical critical scaling in closed and open quantum systems, with broader applicability to mesoscopic systems with long-range interactions.

articles.title: Josephson transport in YBa{}₂Cu{}₃O{}₇ weak links created by focused-helium-ion-beam irradiation: Analysis based on diffusive-SNS-junction model
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20109v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fabrication of YBCO weak links by focused helium ion beam irradiation is a promising approach for realizing high-temperature superconducting Josephson junction devices. Although empirical dose-characteristic relationships have been established, the underlying transport mechanisms remain unclear. In this study, we perform a detailed investigation of the transport properties of YBCO weak links fabricated using a helium ion microscope (HIM) and provide a unified phenomenological description of the observed behavior based on the theory of SNS junctions with a diffusive metallic interlayer. We demonstrate that the temperature dependence of the critical current Ic and the IcRₙ product are well described by diffusive SNS junction models over a wide temperature range. Analyses show that the observed dose dependences of Ic and IcRₙ cannot be explained solely by variations in the effective Thouless energy ET. The discrepancy suggests reduced interface transparency and a reduction in the density of states, leading to a decrease in the effective number of conducting channels contributing to transport. This interpretation is also consistent with the observed exponential increase in Rₙ with irradiation dose. These results provide a diffusion-based framework for understanding Josephson transport and guiding junction design in helium-ion-irradiated YBCO weak links.
authors: Tetsuro Misawa, Shigeyuki Ishida, Hiroshi Eisaki, Yukinori Morita, Shinichi Ogawa, Chiharu Urano

articles.title: Structural complexity of an SU(3) Fermi Hubbard model
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20131v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional quantum gas microscopy provides an unparalleled tool to study quantum many-body systems using ultracold atoms. For the SU(2) Fermi Hubbard model (FHM), access to spin-resolved projective measurements has been vital for quantifying correlation functions and mapping out the phase diagram. Recent progress in quantum gas microscopy for experiments with ultracold alkaline-earth atoms, which are well described by the SU(N) FHM and are predicted to host exotic ground-state phases, calls for the development of theory-free numerical techniques to extract physical information from their projective measurements. To that end, we evaluate the multiscale structural complexity of snapshots of an SU(3) FHM in the square lattice at 1/3-filling. We employ mean-field theory to generate spin-resolved density distributions and compute their structural complexity using rectangular coarse-graining windows. We demonstrate that these complexities are linked to relevant physical observables such as the entanglement entropy, and are extremely sensitive for locating phase boundaries. The results presented here validate the structural complexity as an efficient and reliable tool for analyzing the outputs of SU(N) quantum gas microscopes, offering a theory-free property, immediately accessible to experiments.
authors: Jiani Fu, Zewen Zhang, Eduardo Ibarra-García-Padilla

articles.title: Biorthogonal Conformal Dynamics in Non-Hermitian Quantum Quenches
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20156v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Global quenches at one-dimensional critical points admit a boundary conformal field theory (BCFT) description in which Euclidean strip correlators are analytically continued to real time. We formulate this construction for interacting non-Hermitian critical systems, where a right ket alone does not specify the dynamical readout and the left covector is part of the microscopic quench protocol. Independent left and right preparations flowing to the same conformal boundary define the two temporal boundaries of a strip with generally complex one-sided extrapolation parameters; linear and antilinear symmetry pairings are exploited to constrain this geometry. In the interacting Yang-Lee spin chain, statically calibrated boundary data determine the biorthogonal dynamics of the complete-character return amplitude, a primary one-point function, and a spatial correlator. The imaginary part of the linear-paired extrapolation parameter predicts the temporal center of an independently evolved antilinear-paired one-point function at the 10⁻³ relative level; the same preparation phase controls local phase evolution and the analytic-continuation path of boundary blocks. Further results test this formalism with a direct field-on quench, mixed left and right preparations, and a complex five-state Potts fixed point with complex primary dimensions. These results establish a BCFT framework for biorthogonal global quenches in interacting non-Hermitian critical systems, in which complex temporal-boundary data organize universal post-quench dynamics.

articles.title: Photogalvanic transport of nonreciprocal Cooper-pair fluctuations
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20166v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a theory of the nonlinear optical and transport responses of two-dimensional noncentrosymmetric superconductors in the fluctuation regime above the transition temperature, encompassing the photogalvanic effect, second-harmonic generation, and the photovoltaic Hall effect. In the vicinity of the transition these responses are strongly enhanced by preformed Cooper pairs, whose nonreciprocity enters the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau description in two physically distinct ways: through thermodynamic Lifshitz invariants, which encode an asymmetric pair spectrum, and through kinetic Lifshitz invariants, which encode an asymmetric pair relaxation and are locked to the Langevin noise by the fluctuation-dissipation theorem. We derive generalized master formulas for the paraconductivity (Aslamazov-Larkin) and the quantum-interference (Maki-Thompson) channels of the nonlinear current, valid at arbitrary drive frequency and to linear order in the nonreciprocal perturbations, and reduce them to closed-form dimensionless functions. Circular polarization discriminates sharply between the mechanisms: for reciprocal momentum-structureless noise the Aslamazov-Larkin channel is polarization insensitive and its circular photogalvanic response vanishes for any pair spectrum, whereas the Maki-Thompson channel and the nonreciprocal noise support helicity-odd rectified currents, including a fluctuation photovoltaic Hall current flowing transverse to the strain axis. Applications to Rashba-type (C₃ᵥ) and Ising-type (D₃ₕ) superconductors demonstrate how the point-group symmetry dictates the allowed vector structures of the nonlinear currents, and how polarization analysis together with the frequency and dephasing dependences can be used to separate the individual channels experimentally.
authors: Joaquim Telles de Miranda, Alex Levchenko

articles.title: A Unified Theoretical Framework for Photoemission and Its Inverse: Reciprocity, Spin, and Photon Polarization
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a unified theoretical framework for spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (SARPES) and its inverse process (SARIPES), treating both on an equal footing. The formulation is based on a response tensor that encodes the reciprocity between the two processes. We show that polarization tomography within SARPES calculations provides a systematic route for reconstructing the tensor elements. The number of independent components is significantly reduced by symmetry constraints, which in turn allows for explicit expressions describing spin-reversal processes and intensity modulations. The formalism is illustrated for the W(110) surface. The resulting framework provides a symmetry-adapted description of spin-dependent optical transitions at surfaces and enables the direct prediction of SARIPES intensities from SARPES calculations.

articles.title: Three-dimensional imaging of oxygen dopant distribution in Sr₂CuO₃₊δ by electron ptychography
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Oxygen dopants play a critical role in tuning the properties of cuprate superconductors, yet it is challenging to visualize them at the atomic scale. Here, we use multislice electron ptychography to directly image oxygen dopants in a Sr2CuO3+delta film. We observe oxygen dopants at interstitial sites between the Cu-O chains, with a strong preference for clustering in tensile-strained regions, which are often associated with dislocations and interfacial steps. These findings indicate that the oxygen dopant distribution in cuprates is not random but rather sensitive to strain field, suggesting strain as a doping tuning parameter.
authors: Hongbin Yang, Jinkwon Kim, Desheng Ma, Dasol Yoon, Darrell G. Schlom, David A. Muller

articles.title: Signatures of a light-induced exciton condensate exhibiting BEC-BCS crossover
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20310v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exciton condensates provide a platform to study quasiparticle pairing, Bose-Einstein condensation-Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BEC-BCS) crossover, and excitonic topological phenomena. Achieving a nonequilibrium exciton condensate allows the ultimate tunability of these emergent phenomena. Yet, evidence of a light-induced, nonequilibrium exciton condensate and its BEC-BCS crossover remains elusive. Here, we use time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to demonstrate signatures of a non-equilibrium exciton condensate and its BEC-BCS crossover in monolayer MnBi2Te4. Following optical excitation, a distinctive hole-like dispersion representing excitons emerges and persists for >20 ps. Strikingly, energy-domain sharpening in the valence band occurs 2 ps after time zero and exhibits a sharp onset at a threshold pump fluence of 0.84 mJ/cm2. The delayed and strongly nonlinear response is difficult to reconcile with transient field effects or conventional carrier-induced band shifts but is consistent with a model of exciton condensation governed by a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition. The estimated threshold exciton density agrees quantitatively with the Nelson-Kosterlitz critical density. At higher fluences, the exciton feature develops a camel-back-shaped dispersion, consistent with the BEC-BCS crossover in the condensate framework. Our work establishes ultrathin MnBi2Te4 as a model system for studying nonequilibrium exciton condensates with a connection to superconductivity and exciton-driven topological phases.
authors: Khanh Duy Nguyen, Gabriele Berruto, Yunhe Bai, Thomas Marchese, Woojoo Lee, Haoran Lin, Jiangang Yang, Chong Liu, Y. Shirley Meng, Shuolong Yang

articles.title: Imaging the vacuum fluctuations of a quantum field
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20311v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Heisenberg uncertainties lead to inevitable fluctuations in the measurement outcomes for quantum-mechanical observables. For quantum fields, these uncertainties result in random spatial structures in snapshots of a field, even when the field is in its ground (vacuum) state. Such `vacuum fluctuations' are at the heart of a wide range of phenomena, from spontaneous decay processes to the Casimir force and Hawking radiation. Their existence is a key manifestation of the quantumness of the physical world, but usually it is only their consequences that are directly observed. Here, we directly observe spatial vacuum fluctuations of a bosonic quantum field. Our experiments are based on a homogeneous planar atomic Bose--Einstein condensate. The condensate comprises two coherently coupled interacting components (spin states), and the quantum field describes its spin degrees of freedom. In the regime where the interactions dominate over the coherent coupling, our system emulates a (massive relativistic) sine-Gordon field. Images of the field reveal simultaneous fluctuations on different length scales, with scale-dependent amplitudes consistent with theoretical predictions for a vacuum state. Observing such fluctuations in the sine-Gordon limit opens many possibilities for laboratory simulations of relativistic fields in regimes that are presently not theoretically tractable.
authors: Yansheng Zhang, Feiyang Wang, Yi Jiang, Alexander C. Jenkins, Paul H. C. Wong, Christoph Eigen, Gehrig Carlse, Zoran Hadzibabic

articles.title: Torus Berry Data Determine All-Genus Abelian Topological Orders
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that for Abelian Chern-Simons topological orders, torus Berry matrices determine the all-genus extended TQFT. We identify the topological part of the projective Berry holonomy under metric deformations with the mapping-class-group representation of the Abelian Chern-Simons TQFT and prove that the normalized torus data reconstruct its finite quadratic module (G,q). Recent work showed that (G,q) classifies the extended theory up to symmetric monoidal natural isomorphism, then genus-one data determine the all-genus theory without choosing a K-matrix presentation. We also prove that, for normalized character row errors δ<21.96%, nearest-row decoding recovers the Abelian fusion algebra independently of the number of anyons. The result applies to Abelian fractional quantum Hall and spin-liquid phases described by even-lattice Chern-Simons theories.

articles.title: Holographic Local Operator Quenches with Conserved Momentum and Spin
articles.title_zh: 具有守恒动量与自旋的全息局域算符淬火
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19305v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the holographic dictionary relating point particles carrying longitudinal momentum or angular momentum in asymptotically AdS₃ spacetimes to suitably regulated, time-evolved states created by local primary operators in the dual two-dimensional conformal field theory (2D CFT). We find that asymmetric left/right Euclidean smearing of local operators produces states carrying momentum, and the corresponding bulk excitation is a particle with conserved momentum. We compute the energy density and entanglement entropy in these states and in their dual back-reacted geometries, finding exact agreement between the CFT and gravity descriptions. We further extend this correspondence to particles with intrinsic spin, whose CFT duals are primary operators with unequal holomorphic and anti-holomorphic scaling dimensions. We again find a precise match between CFT and holographic calculations of energy densities and entanglement entropies. Finally, we explore applications of these setups beyond holography by deriving the evolution of Rényi entropies in 2D rational CFTs and introducing a new class of local quantum quench protocols with conserved longitudinal or angular momentum.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究渐近 AdS3 时空中携带纵向动量或角动量的点粒子，与其对偶二维共形场论中由局域主算符产生并经适当调节、时间演化的态之间的全息对应。结果表明，局部算符左右不对称的欧几里得展宽能够产生携带动量的态，其体对偶为具有守恒动量的粒子；CFT 与引力对能量密度和纠缠熵的计算完全一致。研究还推广到具有内禀自旋的粒子，并推导了二维有理共形场论中 Rényi 熵的演化以及带守恒纵向或角动量的新型局域量子淬火方案。
authors: Pawel Caputa, Pedro Castellini Grand, Justin R. David, Rahul Metya
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究渐近 AdS3 时空中携带纵向动量或角动量的点粒子，与对偶二维共形场论（2D CFT）中由局域主算符产生、经过适当调节并随时间演化的态之间的全息字典。我们发现，对局域算符进行左右不对称的欧几里得展宽会产生携带动量的态，而相应的体激发是一个具有守恒动量的粒子。我们计算了这些态及其对偶的、包含反作用的几何中的能量密度和纠缠熵，发现 CFT 描述与引力描述之间存在精确一致。我们进一步将这种对应推广到具有内禀自旋的粒子，其 CFT 对偶是全纯与反全纯标度维数不相等的主算符。我们再次发现，CFT 与全息计算得到的能量密度和纠缠熵精确匹配。最后，我们探讨了这些构型在全息之外的应用，推导二维有理共形场论中 Rényi 熵的演化，并引入了一类新的、具有守恒纵向动量或角动量的局域量子淬火方案。

articles.title: Dissipation-enhanced scrambling in the SYK model coupled to a lossy cavity
articles.title_zh: 与耗散腔耦合的 SYK 模型中的耗散增强信息 scrambling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19310v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model, a disordered model of N Majorana fermions and R=γ N bosons in which the bosons are linearly coupled to independent realizations of SYK p-body interactions, in the presence of dissipation, modeled by a Lindblad master equation. Motivated by recent proposals for implementing SYK models in quantum simulators, we focus on bosonic leakage at rate κ. Initializing the system in the steady state, we analyze the late-time fermionic relaxation rate and the Lyapunov exponent, solving the large-N theory both numerically and for p large, finding a rich landscape of dynamical behaviors. Most notably, the Lyapunov exponent remains positive for every value of κ and, for p>2, can even grow as κ increases. The QED case p=2, which lies between the fully chaotic regime p>2 and the integrable case p=1, exhibits special features. We also identify a critical value of the boson-to-fermion ratio γ_c approx 2/p² separating distinct dynamical regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究存在耗散时的 Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型，其中 Majorana 费米子与玻色子通过独立的 SYK 多体相互作用耦合，并以 Lindblad 主方程描述玻色子泄漏。大 N 理论的数值分析和大 p 极限分析显示，系统具有丰富的动力学行为；特别是 Lyapunov 指数在任意泄漏率下都保持为正，并且在 p>2 时可能随耗散增强而增大。研究还发现，玻色子与费米子的比例存在临界值，约为 2/p²，用于区分不同动力学区域。
authors: Pietro Pelliconi, Bastien Lapierre, Shinsei Ryu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究 Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev 模型：这是一个由 N 个无序 Majorana 费米子和 R=γ N 个玻色子组成的无序模型，其中玻色子分别与独立实现的 SYK p 体相互作用线性耦合；系统中的耗散由 Lindblad 主方程描述。受近期在量子模拟器中实现 SYK 模型的方案启发，我们关注速率为 κ 的玻色子泄漏。我们将系统初始化于稳态，分析晚时间的费米子弛豫速率和 Lyapunov 指数，并通过数值方法以及大 p 情形求解大 N 理论，从而发现了丰富的动力学行为。最值得注意的是，对于 κ 的每一个取值，Lyapunov 指数都保持为正；而且当 p>2 时，Lyapunov 指数甚至可能随 κ 的增大而增长。QED 情形 p=2 处于完全混沌的 p>2 情形与可积的 p=1 情形之间，表现出特殊性质。我们还确定了玻色子与费米子数量比的临界值 γ_c，约为 2/p²；该临界值将不同的动力学区域分隔开来。

articles.title: Thermal Throttling of Quantum State Transfer
articles.title_zh: 量子态传输的热节流效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19315v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum state transfer on qubit lattices is a crucial step in a panoply of quantum information processing tasks. Understanding its fundamental limits in the presence of practical imperfections remains a pressing open question. In particular, it is unclear how thermal noise in the intermediate ancilla sites impedes transfer. In this work, we derive tight lower bounds on the necessary growth of commutator norms to achieve approximate state transfer. Specializing to 1D power-law systems with thermal ancilla states, we demonstrate that state transfer runtimes depend sensitively on the scaling of temperature with system size, improving logarithmic bounds to algebraic ones. Our work extends previous results on exact state transfer to the qualitatively different and more practically relevant regime of approximate state transfer.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究量子比特晶格上的近似量子态传输在中间辅助量子比特受到热噪声时的基本限制。作者推导了实现近似态传输所需的对易子范数增长的紧下界，并针对具有热辅助态的一维幂律系统分析传输时间。结果表明，传输时间对温度随系统尺寸的标度关系十分敏感，并将既有的对数界改进为代数界。
authors: Twesh Upadhyaya, T. C. Mooney, Yifan Hong, Alexey V. Gorshkov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子比特晶格上的量子态传输是大量量子信息处理任务中的关键步骤。在存在实际不完美因素时理解其基本极限，仍然是一个亟待解决的开放问题。特别是，中间辅助量子比特上的热噪声如何阻碍态传输，目前尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们推导了实现近似态传输所必需的对易子范数增长的紧下界。针对具有热辅助态的一维幂律系统，我们证明态传输运行时间取决于温度随系统尺寸变化的标度关系，并将对数界改进为代数界。我们的工作将此前关于精确态传输的结果扩展到性质显著不同、且在实际应用中更为重要的近似态传输情形。

articles.title: Simulating Black Hole Thermality and Interior Scrambling on a Superconducting Quantum Processor
articles.title_zh: 在超导量子处理器上模拟黑洞热性与内部 scrambling
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19318v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We implement a chiral spin-chain black hole simulator on IBM superconducting quantum hardware and probe, within a common microscopic framework, both semiclassical horizon physics and interacting quantum scrambling. We first measure the dispersion relation across the exterior, horizon and over-tilted interior regimes, reproducing the predicted evolution of the effective light-cone structure. To probe Hawking thermality, we prepare a localised excitation inside the horizon and monitor its density response at an exterior site, observing the predicted inverse relation between the peak arrival time and the surface gravity, thereby establishing a calibrated dynamical estimator of the Hawking temperature. Beyond the semiclassical regime, we continuously tune the interactions and distinguish non-exponential operator spreading in the free-fermion limit from Lyapunov-like OTOC decay in the strongly interacting chiral regime. These measurements use observable-specific Floquet circuits derived from the same parent chiral model, including its mean-field and coordinate-equivalent XY descriptions, to reduce circuit depth while preserving the physics relevant to each probe. Our results provide a unified programmable platform for studying horizon geometry, Hawking thermality and interacting scrambling on quantum hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在 IBM 超导量子硬件上实现手性自旋链黑洞模拟器，并在统一的微观框架中探测半经典视界物理与相互作用量子 scrambling。实验复现了外部、视界和过倾斜内部区域中有效光锥结构的演化，并通过视界内激发在外部位置的响应建立了霍金温度的动力学估计方法。研究还区分了自由费米子极限中的非指数算符扩展与强相互作用手性区域中的类 Lyapunov OTOC 衰减。
authors: Ryan Smith, Ewan Forbes, Iason Sofos Andrew Hallam, Jiannis Pachos
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在 IBM 超导量子硬件上实现了一个手性自旋链黑洞模拟器，并在共同的微观框架内同时探测半经典视界物理和相互作用量子 scrambling。我们首先测量外部区域、视界区域和过倾斜内部区域中的色散关系，复现了有效光锥结构的预言性演化。为探测霍金热性，我们在视界内部制备局域化激发，并监测其在外部位置的密度响应；我们观测到峰值到达时间与表面引力之间预言的反比关系，由此建立了霍金温度的经校准动力学估计量。在超越半经典区域的研究中，我们连续调节相互作用，并区分自由费米子极限中的非指数型算符扩展与强相互作用手性区域中 Lyapunov 型的 OTOC 衰减。这些测量采用源自同一母手性模型、针对具体观测量设计的 Floquet 电路，其中包括其平均场描述和坐标等价的 XY 描述，从而在保留各探测对象相关物理的同时降低电路深度。我们的结果为在量子硬件上研究视界几何、霍金热性和相互作用 scrambling 提供了一个统一且可编程的平台。

articles.title: Inflationary Bispectra and IR Physics from Quantum Simulators
articles.title_zh: 来自量子模拟器的暴胀双谱与红外物理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19327v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Bose-Einstein condensates have been used successfully as quantum simulators for early-universe particle production. Here we extend this analogy to the interacting theory. To this end, we compute the leading interaction terms expected in a general experimental setup that determine the 3-point correlations. We apply them to cosmologically motivated expanding model universes, but also periodically oscillating ones. While expanding scale factors do not necessarily lead to easily observable signatures due to experimental constraints on the realizable scale factor, periodically driven ones produce resonant correlators that grow linearly over time and lend themselves well to experimental detection. One direct application of this analysis is the experimental study of late-time infrared divergencies often discussed in the context of massless scalars in de Sitter space.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体作为早期宇宙粒子产生量子模拟器的类比推广到相互作用理论，并计算一般实验设置中决定三点关联的主导相互作用项。研究考察了宇宙学动机下的膨胀模型宇宙和周期振荡模型，发现周期驱动能够产生随时间线性增长、易于实验探测的共振关联函数。该分析可用于实验研究无质量标量场在 de Sitter 空间中常讨论的晚时红外发散。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体已经成功用于模拟早期宇宙中的粒子产生。在这里，我们将这一类比扩展到相互作用理论。为此，我们计算一般实验设置中预期会决定三点关联的主导相互作用项。我们将这些相互作用项应用于具有宇宙学动机的膨胀模型宇宙，同时也应用于周期振荡的模型宇宙。尽管膨胀尺度因子未必会由于实验上可实现尺度因子的限制而产生容易观测的信号，但周期驱动会产生共振关联函数；这些关联函数随时间线性增长，因此适合实验探测。该分析的一个直接应用，是实验研究在 de Sitter 空间无质量标量场背景下经常讨论的晚时红外发散。

articles.title: Glassy dynamics with softened kinetic constraints on a noisy quantum computer
articles.title_zh: 噪声量子计算机上软化动力学约束的玻璃态动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19335v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mid-circuit measurements provide direct access to trajectory-level observables, revealing dynamical structures in many-body systems that are invisible in ensemble-averaged quantities. We exploit this capability to realize and study an instance of the Floquet-East model on a superconducting quantum processor. Here, the combination of mid-circuit measurements, kinetically constrained unitary operations and hardware noise gives rise to intricate many-body phenomena. Analyzing trajectories obtained from temporally and spatially resolved mid-circuit measurements, we identify dynamical heterogeneity --- a hallmark of glassy dynamics. We quantify this emergent behavior by studying the probability of finding inactive space-time regions of a given size. This quantity displays a crossover from an area- to perimeter-dominated scaling, which is a characteristic property of glasses and is associated with the proximity to a dynamical first-order phase transition. Our results establish current noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices as scalable testbeds for investigating correlated many-body phenomena at the level of measurement trajectories.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用中途测量直接获取量子轨迹层面的观测量，并在超导量子处理器上实现和研究 Floquet-East 模型。中途测量、动力学约束幺正操作与硬件噪声共同产生了复杂的多体现象，实验轨迹显示出玻璃态动力学的典型特征——动力学异质性。通过研究给定大小的不活跃时空区域的出现概率，作者观察到从面积主导到周长主导的标度交叉，并将其与接近动力学一级相变联系起来。
authors: Marcel Cech, Igor Lesanovsky, Federico Carollo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 中途测量能够直接获取轨迹层面的观测量，从而揭示许多体系统中在系综平均量里不可见的动力学结构。我们利用这一能力，在超导量子处理器上实现并研究 Floquet-East 模型。在该模型中，中途测量、动力学约束的幺正操作和硬件噪声共同导致复杂的多体现象。通过分析由时间和空间分辨的中途测量得到的轨迹，我们识别出动力学异质性，这是玻璃态动力学的标志性特征。我们通过研究找到具有给定大小的不活跃时空区域的概率，对这一涌现行为进行定量刻画。该概率表现出从面积主导标度到周长主导标度的交叉，这是玻璃态的特征性质，并且与接近动力学一级相变有关。我们的结果表明，当前的含噪中等规模量子设备可以作为可扩展的测试平台，在测量轨迹层面研究关联多体现象。

articles.title: Rethinking Quantum Circuits
articles.title_zh: 重新思考量子电路
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19370v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: These notes develop four interconnected ways of reading a quantum circuit. A circuit for us begins as an operational composition of gates; then, it becomes a diagram whose local equalities may be used as calculations; next, it becomes a protected process once errors, syndromes, and logical degrees of freedom are separated; and finally, it becomes geometric when its connectivity, topology, and boundary data are treated as physical design parameters. The development begins at the level of bits and qubits before appealing to Deutsch's and Grover's algorithms as basic examples of quantum circuits. With the basics in hand, we interpret quantum circuits diagramatically, leading us to compact closed string diagrams and the ZX-calculus. After that, we consider how to correct quantum circuits by introducing the Knill--Laflamme condition, homological surface codes, and related concepts with a view towards thinking of these as operations on diagrams. The lectures eventually arrive at the properties of hyperbolic quantum codes and the prospect of physical superconducting circuits emulating the negatively-curved lattices needed to support those codes. These mathematical ideas and physical experiments, taken together, represent one way to impart a geometric layer onto quantum circuits. By the very end, we bring the ideas nearly full circle by assessing the extent to which these device physics experiments operationalize the basic ZX diagrams encountered much earlier in the story. While the later material reports on original research, and while the discussion becomes increasingly mathematical as the sections progress, no prior knowledge of quantum information, quantum computing, or quantum error correction is actually assumed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从四个相互关联的角度阐释量子电路：门操作的组合、可用于计算的图表、经纠错保护的过程，以及由连通性、拓扑和边界数据决定的几何对象。内容从比特和量子比特基础出发，介绍 Deutsch 与 Grover 算法，继而讨论闭合弦图、ZX 演算、量子纠错、表面码和双曲量子码。全书不要求读者预先具备量子信息、量子计算或量子纠错知识，并最终讨论超导电路实验如何将 ZX 图表中的数学结构具体化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 这些讲义发展了理解量子电路的四种相互关联的方式。对我们而言，电路首先是门的操作性组合；随后它成为一种图表，可以利用其中的局部等式进行计算；接着，在误差、综合征和逻辑自由度被分离之后，它成为一个受保护的过程；最后，当其连通性、拓扑和边界数据被视为物理设计参数时，它又成为几何对象。全文从比特和量子比特层面开始，然后以 Deutsch 算法和 Grover 算法作为量子电路的基本例子。在掌握基础知识后，我们从图表角度解释量子电路，引出紧致的闭合弦图和 ZX 演算。之后，我们通过介绍 Knill--Laflamme 条件、同调曲面码及相关概念，讨论如何纠正量子电路，并将这些内容视为图表上的操作。讲义后半部分最终抵达双曲量子码的性质，以及利用物理超导电路模拟支撑这些编码所需负曲率晶格的可能性。这些数学思想与物理实验结合起来，构成了为量子电路赋予几何层次的一种方式。到全文结尾，我们几乎将讨论带回起点，评估这些器件物理实验在多大程度上实现了故事早期遇到的基本 ZX 图表。尽管后文内容涉及原创研究，且随着章节推进讨论日益数学化，但全文并不要求读者预先了解量子信息、量子计算或量子纠错。

articles.title: Stability and squeezing of the three-photon degenerate parametric down-conversion
articles.title_zh: 三光子简并参量下转换的稳定性与压缩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19494v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Nonlinear multiphoton conversion processes are theoretically and experimentally challenging systems in quantum optics and related areas. These phenomena bring remarkable quantum properties and can be of fundamental relevance in quantum information and computation applications. Based on recent experimental advances and the possible uses in generalized three-photon squeezing, we investigate degenerate three-photon parametric down-conversion generated inside a cavity fed by a classical pump. In addition, we consider that the process is stimulated by a coherent driving mode and subjected to dissipation by spontaneous emission of the cavity. A treatment using phase-space methods and stochastic differential equations is applied and the stability conditions of its steady states are found. We find that the system does not exhibit multistability, instead it has a limited parameter region leading to a single stable steady branch, alongside multiple unstable branches. Focusing on the stable steady states and linearizing the dynamics around them, we calculate the spectral densities of the quadrature variables. We identify and characterize the squeezing of three-photon down-conversion. Moreover, since the quasi-probability differential equations of the higher-order multiphoton processes have higher-order derivatives, hindering their mapping into stochastic differential equations, we make use of a positive Wigner function approach to calculate two-dimensional spectral densities associated with three-time correlation functions, with the goal of studying non-Gaussian properties of the system.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究由经典泵浦驱动、并受到相干驱动和腔自发辐射耗散影响的三光子简并参量下转换。作者利用相空间方法和随机微分方程求得稳态稳定性条件，发现系统不存在多稳态，而是具有一个有限参数区域中的单一稳定稳态分支及多个不稳定分支。通过在线性化稳态附近分析动力学，研究计算了正交分量的谱密度，刻画了三光子压缩，并利用正 Wigner 函数方法研究非高斯性质。
authors: Vinícius V. Seco, Alencar J. de Faria
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非线性多光子转换过程在量子光学及相关领域中既具有理论挑战，也具有实验挑战。这些现象会产生显著的量子性质，并可能对量子信息和量子计算应用具有基础意义。基于近期实验进展以及广义三光子压缩的潜在用途，我们研究了在经典泵浦驱动的腔内产生的简并三光子参量下转换。此外，我们考虑该过程受到相干驱动模式的激发，并受到腔自发辐射造成的耗散影响。我们采用相空间方法和随机微分方程处理问题，并求得其稳态的稳定性条件。我们发现该系统不表现出多稳态；相反，它具有一个有限的参数区域，在该区域内存在单一稳定稳态分支，同时还存在多个不稳定分支。我们聚焦于稳定稳态，并围绕这些稳态将动力学线性化，计算正交分量变量的谱密度。我们识别并刻画了三光子下转换中的压缩现象。此外，由于高阶多光子过程的准概率微分方程包含高阶导数，妨碍了将其映射为随机微分方程，我们采用正 Wigner 函数方法计算与三时间关联函数相关的二维谱密度，以研究系统的非高斯性质。

articles.title: Cavity-Enhanced Activation of Radiatively Suppressed Light-Hole Exciton Emission in Colloidal Nanoplatelets
articles.title_zh: 腔增强胶体纳米片中辐射受抑光空穴激子发射的激活
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19681v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Light-hole (LH) excitons provide access to well-defined polarization and spin degrees of freedom that are central to quantum photonics and chiral light-matter interactions. Achieving LH emission is challenging because LH states are energetically unfavoured and typically relax non-radiatively. Existing strategies to access LH excitons rely on modifying the electronic band structure through strain, shape anisotropy, or piezoelectric fields, approaches that are material-specific and offer limited post-synthesis tunability. Here we demonstrate an all-photonic route to activate LH exciton emission in colloidal CdSe-CdS nanoplatelets (NPLs) using a distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) cavity, without altering the underlying band structure. In the absence of a cavity mode, the system exhibits amplified spontaneous emission from heavy-hole (HH) states without detectable LH emission at low excitation powers. By spectrally matching a cavity resonance to the LH exciton, cavity-coupled LH emission emerges at significantly lower excitation powers. Temperature-dependent spectroscopy reveals reversible switching between LH- and HH-coupled emission through exciton-cavity detuning, while polarization-resolved and spectrally resolved time-resolved photoluminescence measurements provide independent evidence distinguishing the cavity-coupled LH and HH emission channels. These findings establish cavity engineering as a general materials-level approach for accessing radiatively suppressed optical states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种无需改变材料能带结构、利用分布式布拉格反射器腔激活胶体 CdSe-CdS 纳米片光空穴激子发射的全光学方法。通过将腔共振与光空穴激子匹配，研究在远低于通常条件的激发功率下观察到腔耦合的光空穴发射。温度依赖光谱和偏振、时间分辨光致发光测量进一步证明了光空穴与重空穴发射通道可通过激子—腔失谐实现可逆切换。
authors: Komal Sharma, Riya Dutta, Prathmesh Deshmukh, Vinod M. Menon, Jaydeep K. Basu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光空穴激子能够提供定义明确的偏振和自旋自由度，而这些自由度是量子光子学和手性光—物质相互作用的核心。实现光空穴发射具有挑战性，因为光空穴态在能量上不利，通常会发生非辐射弛豫。现有获取光空穴激子的方法依赖于通过应变、形状各向异性或压电场改变电子能带结构；这些方法具有材料特异性，并且在合成后可调性有限。在这里，我们展示了一种全光学途径：利用分布式布拉格反射器（DBR）腔，在不改变底层能带结构的情况下，激活胶体 CdSe-CdS 纳米片（NPLs）中的光空穴激子发射。在没有腔模时，该系统在低激发功率下表现出来自重空穴（HH）态的放大自发发射，而无法探测到光空穴（LH）发射。当腔共振在光谱上与光空穴激子匹配时，腔耦合的光空穴发射会在显著更低的激发功率下出现。温度依赖光谱显示，通过激子—腔失谐可以在光空穴耦合发射和重空穴耦合发射之间实现可逆切换；偏振分辨和光谱分辨的时间分辨光致发光测量则提供了独立证据，用以区分腔耦合的光空穴和重空穴发射通道。这些发现表明，腔工程是一种可推广的材料层面方法，可用于获取受到辐射抑制的光学态。

articles.title: Dynamical one-from-many quantum metrology: Sum rule and matrix-free precision bound
articles.title_zh: 动力学一对多量子计量：求和规则与无矩阵精度界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19988v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Practical quantum single-parameter estimation is rarely a pristine task; it almost invariably involves nuisance parameters, casting it as a one-from-many problem. Existing approaches to this problem rely on multi-parameter metrology, reducing the matrix quantum Cramér-Rao bound to obtain scalar quantum precision limits. However, these methods are often hampered by the demanding inversion of the quantum Fisher information (QFI) matrix and the requisite choice of a weight matrix, and they break down when the QFI matrix becomes singular. Here, we show that for dynamical one-from-many estimation, a previously overlooked sum rule connecting the QFI about all model parameters to the QFI about time necessitates including the latter to consider an augmented QFI matrix while simultaneously rendering it inherently singular--precisely the scenario where conventional approaches fail. To meet this challenge, we derive a tight, matrix-free quantum precision bound that involves only scalar quantities, offers broad applicability, and subsumes existing results as special cases. Validated in both unitary and noisy settings, our findings provide a refined operational framework for practical quantum single-parameter metrology.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究含有干扰参数的实际单参数量子估计问题，并将其视为一对多估计。作者发现，动力学系统中所有模型参数的量子 Fisher 信息与时间量子 Fisher 信息之间存在求和规则；引入时间参数后得到的增广 QFI 矩阵必然奇异，因而传统矩阵求逆方法失效。为此，研究推导出仅涉及标量的紧量子精度界，并在幺正和含噪情形中验证其有效性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 实际的量子单参数估计很少是纯粹的任务；它几乎总是涉及干扰参数，因此应被视为一对多问题。现有方法依赖多参数计量，通过化简多参数量子 Cramér-Rao 界来得到标量量子精度极限。然而，这些方法通常受到量子 Fisher 信息（QFI）矩阵求逆要求的限制，也需要选择权重矩阵；当 QFI 矩阵变为奇异矩阵时，它们还会失效。在这里，我们证明，对于动力学一对多估计，存在一条此前被忽视的求和规则，将关于所有模型参数的 QFI 与关于时间的 QFI 联系起来；该规则要求在考虑增广 QFI 矩阵时纳入后者，同时又使该矩阵必然奇异，这正是传统方法失效的情形。为应对这一挑战，我们推导出一个紧的、无矩阵的量子精度界，该界只涉及标量，适用范围广，并将已有结果作为特殊情形包含在内。我们在幺正和含噪设置中验证了这些结果，从而为实际量子单参数计量提供了更完善的操作性框架。

articles.title: Boltzmann counting in Hilbert space
articles.title_zh: 希尔伯特空间中的玻尔兹曼计数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20136v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce a geometric entropy for quantum preparations, defined as the logarithm of the Hilbert-space volume of pure states compatible with a given set of constraints. This construction extends Boltzmann's counting perspective to the quantum setting, where compatible states need not be orthogonal and the relevant notion of "number of states" is naturally replaced by a volume in state space. We analyze three classes of constraints: restriction to a subspace, fixed expectation values, and coarse-grained subsystem descriptions. For representative examples, including subspace projection, spin expectation values, partial trace, and an imperfect detector map, we obtain explicit scaling laws and closed-form expressions for the associated volumes. The resulting framework provides a geometric measure of quantum ignorance at the level of the preparation and complements entropy notions based on density matrices and coarse graining.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为量子制备引入一种几何熵，将其定义为满足给定约束的纯态希尔伯特空间体积的对数。该构造把玻尔兹曼的计数思想推广到量子情形，其中相容态不必彼此正交，状态“数目”自然由态空间中的体积取代。研究分析了子空间限制、固定期望值和子系统粗粒化描述三类约束，并为多个代表性例子给出体积的显式标度律和闭式表达式。
authors: Raúl O. Vallejos, Isadora Veeren, Frederico Brito, Fernando de Melo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为量子制备引入一种几何熵，将其定义为与给定约束相容的纯态希尔伯特空间体积的对数。这一构造把玻尔兹曼的计数观点扩展到量子情形；在量子情形中，相容态不必彼此正交，而“态的数目”这一相关概念自然地由态空间中的体积所取代。我们分析了三类约束：限制在一个子空间内、固定期望值，以及对子系统进行粗粒化描述。对于包括子空间投影、自旋期望值、部分迹和不完美探测器映射在内的代表性例子，我们得到了相关体积的显式标度律和闭式表达式。由此得到的框架在制备层面提供了量子无知的一种几何度量，并补充了基于密度矩阵和粗粒化的熵概念。

articles.title: A Zoology of Quantum Turing Patterns
articles.title_zh: 量子图灵斑图的动物学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20151v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We explore quantum Turing pattern zoology, where the same Lindblad equation supports a morphology atlas of stripes, spots, holes, labyrinths, and defects. The stable stripe species provides a quantitatively controlled case in which morphology and Gaussian witness loss separate parametrically. In particular, visible Turing stripes can remain after two Gaussian witness margins associated with the same k_* mode cross zero in a completely positive Lindblad lattice. The witness thresholds on the exact shell fall as N⁻¹. The stripe nematic threshold tends to a nonzero value at fixed lattice size, time window, and morphology criterion. The ratio of the morphology threshold to either witness threshold therefore grows with N. Imaging and momentum-resolved covariance measurements probe these sectors separately.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文探索量子图灵斑图的形态分类，其中同一个 Lindblad 方程能够支持条纹、斑点、孔洞、迷宫和缺陷等多种形态。研究表明，在完全正的 Lindblad 晶格中，可见的图灵条纹在与同一 k_* 模式相关的两个高斯见证裕度越过零点后仍可存在，显示形态与高斯见证损失可以发生参数分离。精确壳层上的见证阈值按 N⁻¹ 下降，而条纹向列相阈值趋于非零值，因此形态阈值与任一见证阈值之比会随 N 增长。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们探索量子图灵斑图的形态分类：在这种分类中，同一个 Lindblad 方程支持由条纹、斑点、孔洞、迷宫和缺陷组成的形态图谱。稳定的条纹种类提供了一个在定量上可控的案例，在该案例中，形态与高斯见证损失在参数上彼此分离。具体而言，在一个完全正的 Lindblad 晶格中，当与同一 k_* 模式相关的两个高斯见证裕度都越过零点之后，可见的图灵条纹仍然能够存在。精确壳层上的见证阈值按 N⁻¹ 下降。在固定晶格尺寸、时间窗口和形态判据下，条纹向列相阈值趋于一个非零值。因此，形态阈值与任一见证阈值之比会随 N 增大。成像测量和动量分辨的协方差测量能够分别探测这些扇区。

articles.title: Maximal Torus Topological Entanglement Entropy in WZW Theories at Bounded Ground-State Degeneracy
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20333v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: For an untwisted Wess--Zumino--Witten modular tensor category Ç(mathfrak g,k), let r(mathfrak g,k) be the number of simple objects and Ḑ(mathfrak g,k) its total quantum dimension. The vacuum-flux state on a torus divided into two cylinders has positive universal entropy contribution ΓT^₂=2łogḐ. We maximize this quantity over all simple Lie algebras and positive integral levels subject to r(mathfrak g,k)łeq R. If q_R=łog₂R, then Γₘₐₓ(R)sim[7ζ(3)/(4π²⁾]q_R² as R→infty. The sequence Sp(2n)ₙ attains the asymptotic coefficient. At equal rank and level, the Fourier expansion of the type-C root product loses its even modes, leaving 2π⁻²sumₘ,ₒddm⁻³=7ζ(3)/(4π²⁾. An entropy--spectral inequality proves optimality among the classical families, while rank--level duality and fixed-rank estimates control unbalanced and exceptional sequences.

articles.title: Robust two-dimensional surface superconductivity and vortex lattice in the Weyl semimetal γ-PtBi₂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.04867v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The layered compound γ-PtBi₂ is a topological semimetal with Fermi arcs at the surface joining bulk Weyl points. Recent work has found signatures of surface superconductivity consisting of gap openings compatible with a critical temperature orders of magnitude larger than the bulk value. However, no superconducting vortices have been identified, raising questions about the robustness of the phase coherence. Here we use very low temperature Scanning Tunneling Microscopy (STM) and find robust superconductivity with T_C=2.9 K and HC₂approx1.8 T linked to the Fermi arcs. We observe quantized superconducting vortices and the Josephson effect, demonstrating two-dimensional macroscopic quantum phase coherence.
authors: Jose Antonio Moreno, Pablo García Talavera, Edwin Herrera, Sara López Valle, Zhuoqi Li, Lin-Lin Wang, Sergey Bud'ko, Alexander I. Buzdin, Isabel Guillamón, Paul C. Canfield, Hermann Suderow

articles.title: Bridging atomic and mesoscopic length scales with Replica Scanning Tunneling Microscopy: Visualizing the atomic lattice of UTe₂ and the atomic scale superconducting gap modulations of FeSe close to micron length scales
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.19678v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Scanning Tunneling Microscopy is a cornerstone technique for visualizing the electronic density of states with atomic resolution (typically below 0.1 nm). While the field of view of most STM setups extends up to a few microns, obtaining atomic resolution over these large areas is often impractical and excessively time-consuming. This is due to the need to acquire maps with a point number reaching 10⁷ or more with a full current or conductance vs voltage curve at each point. The standard procedure is to make large scale maps and then select small regions to zoom-in for high-resolution atomic scale analysis. However, this approach fails to address a question which is often critical: Does a specific atomic-scale modulation of the electronic density of states persist over much larger, mesoscopic length scales? Here we present a new method: Replica STM (R-STM), that overcomes this limitation, allowing the study of atomic-scale phenomena up to micron length scales. We obtained new large-area STM tunneling conductance maps in UTe₂ and FeSe, spanning areas over 200 nm in size. In these large scale maps we discovered periodic signals with wavelengths significantly exceeding interatomic distances. We show that these large-wavelength periodic signals are replicas of the underlying atomic-scale density of states modulations. R-STM leverages these replica signals to efficiently track atomic-scale features over large areas. We discuss the influence of phase slips, disorder and defects in the replicas. Our results suggest that atomic scale modulations of the superconducting density of states could persist over large length scales in FeSe. R-STM provides a new capability for STM to compare atomic scale with micrometer scale phenomena. The proof of principle of R-STM can be extended to any other scanning probe microscopy experiment where a periodic signal is traced as a function of position.
