Obtaining reliable results requires both considerable expertise and software-specific knowledge, and applying these methods at scale typically relies on custom scripts written for each application. High-throughput experiments and autonomous self-driving laboratories increasingly utilize powder diffraction analysis to proceed programmatically and to return structured, machine-readable results. Here, we introduce PowderLine, a Python application that encapsulates a complete refinement into a single declarative recipe, validates that recipe against a versioned schema, and executes it through refinement software to return structured results. The refinement recipe is an all-inclusive, machine-readable and -writable description of either Rietveld or single peak analysis that users, scripts, and automated agents can specify and run in the same way. As a result of PowderLine's composability, it naturally fits into interactive, scripted, and autonomous workflows alike.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍PowderLine，这是一种面向粉末衍射分析的Python应用，旨在将完整精修流程封装为单一声明式配方。该配方可根据版本化模式进行验证，并通过精修软件执行以返回结构化结果。PowderLine适用于交互式、脚本化和自主实验工作流，有助于高通量和自动化场景中的机器可读分析。
authors: Adam A. Corrao, Jennifer A. Perez, John D. Langhout, Megan M. Butal, Thomas A. Caswell, Daniel Olds
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17009v1。公告类型：新稿。摘要：全谱拟合方法，如Rietveld精修，擅长从粉末衍射数据中提取详细的结构、化学和微结构信息。获得可靠结果需要相当多的专业知识和特定软件知识，而在规模化场景中应用这些方法通常依赖为每个应用编写的自定义脚本。高通量实验和自主自驱动实验室越来越多地利用粉末衍射分析以程序化方式推进实验，并返回结构化、机器可读的结果。在这里，我们介绍PowderLine，这是一种Python应用，它将完整精修封装为单一声明式配方，根据版本化模式验证该配方，并通过精修软件执行该配方以返回结构化结果。该精修配方是对Rietveld分析或单峰分析的全包含、机器可读且机器可写的描述，用户、脚本和自动化代理都可以用相同方式指定并运行它。由于PowderLine具有可组合性，它能够自然融入交互式、脚本化和自主工作流。

articles.title: Local magnetic resonance of scalar spin chirality
articles.title_zh: 标量自旋手性的局域磁共振
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17040v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum states with finite scalar spin chirality carry an orbital magnetic moment that has so far eluded direct measurement. We show that, whereas uniform electron spin resonance preserves chirality, a local drive breaks the cyclic symmetry and activates chirality-changing transitions, providing direct access to the chiral orbital magnetic moment. Lindblad simulations demonstrate experimentally accessible signatures in platforms with local spin addressability, including electron spin resonance with a scanning tunneling microscope, donor spins in silicon, and quantum-dot spin qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有有限标量自旋手性的量子态携带轨道磁矩，但迄今尚未被直接测量。作者指出，均匀电子自旋共振保持手性不变，而局域驱动会打破循环对称性并激活改变手性的跃迁，从而可直接探测手性轨道磁矩。Lindblad 模拟表明，在具备局域自旋寻址能力的平台中可观测到实验可及的信号。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17040v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：具有有限标量自旋手性的量子态携带一种轨道磁矩，而这种磁矩迄今尚未被直接测量到。我们表明，尽管均匀电子自旋共振会保持手性不变，局域驱动会打破循环对称性并激活改变手性的跃迁，从而提供对手性轨道磁矩的直接访问。Lindblad 模拟展示了在具有局域自旋寻址能力的平台中可实验实现的信号，包括利用扫描隧道显微镜的电子自旋共振、硅中的施主自旋以及量子点自旋量子比特。

articles.title: Emissivity by Design: Geometric Mesh Inductance Governs Thermal Radiation in Metallic Nanowire Networks
articles.title_zh: 按设计调控发射率：几何网格电感支配金属纳米线网络中的热辐射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17061v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The thermal infrared emissivity of metallic nanowire networks - the property that makes them candidate low-emissivity transparent electrodes - follows regularities that have resisted physical explanation: a strong wire-diameter dependence with no wire-length dependence, a correlation with sheet resistance that breaks down above ~15 ohm/sq, and an angular signature that turns from dielectric-like to metallic as the network densifies. We show that all of them follow from one local geometric length, the average inter-wire gap g, acting through the geometric inductance of a mesh finer than the thermal wavelength: X_L = Z₀ (g/łambda) łn(2g/π D), a parameter-free reactance that exceeds the ohmic loss and, unlike the DC sheet resistance, stays finite instead of diverging at the percolation threshold. Since the gap is fixed by areal density and wire diameter alone, the optics is length-independent and decoupled from percolative transport; what has been read as a second, optical percolation is instead a smooth impedance crossing. With a single fitted parameter the theory reproduces 56 silver-nanowire samples across four diameters to a mean absolute error of 0.04, collapses them onto one universal curve, and - unchanged - predicts the emissivity-transmittance data of five independent groups and the measured spectral emissivity, including the silica phonon band. Because this reactance contains no material constant, the inter-wire gap emerges as the master design variable for the radiative properties of metallic nanowire transparent conductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 金属纳米线网络的热红外发射率呈现出若干长期缺乏物理解释的规律，包括强烈依赖线径、与线长无关以及与片电阻关系的失效。作者提出，平均线间距通过亚热波长网格的几何电感控制这些光学行为，并给出无材料常数的反应项表达式。该理论用一个拟合参数即可统一解释大量银纳米线样品和独立实验数据，表明线间距是设计金属纳米线透明导体辐射性质的主导变量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17061v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：金属纳米线网络的热红外发射率，也就是使其成为候选低发射率透明电极的性质，遵循一些一直难以获得物理解释的规律：对线径有强烈依赖而对线长没有依赖；与片电阻存在相关性但在约 15 欧姆/平方以上失效；以及一种角度特征，会随着网络致密化从类似介电体转变为类似金属。我们表明，所有这些规律都源于一个局域几何长度，即平均线间距 g，它通过细于热波长的网格几何电感发挥作用：X_L = Z₀ (g/λ) ln(2g/π D)，这是一个无参数反应项，它超过欧姆损耗，并且不同于直流片电阻，在渗流阈值处保持有限而不是发散。由于间距仅由面密度和线径决定，光学性质与线长无关，并与渗流输运解耦；过去被解读为第二种光学渗流的现象，实际上是一种平滑的阻抗跨越。该理论仅使用一个拟合参数，就能再现四种直径下 56 个银纳米线样品的结果，平均绝对误差为 0.04，并将它们归并到一条普适曲线上；且在不作改变的情况下，预测了五个独立研究组的发射率-透过率数据以及测得的光谱发射率，包括二氧化硅声子带。由于这一反应项不含材料常数，线间距成为金属纳米线透明导体辐射性质的主设计变量。

articles.title: Over what length scale does an inorganic substrate perturb the structure of a glassy organic semiconductor?
articles.title_zh: 无机衬底会在多大长度尺度上扰动玻璃态有机半导体的结构？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While the bulk structure of vapor-deposited glasses has been extensively studied, structure at buried interfaces has received little attention, despite being important for organic electronic applications. To learn about glass structure at buried interfaces, we study the structure of vapor-deposited glasses of the organic semiconductor DSA-Ph (1,4-di-[4-(N,N-diphenyl)amino]styryl-benzene) as a function of film thickness; structure is probed with grazing incidence X-ray scattering. We deposit on silicon and gold substrates and span a film thickness range of 10-600 nm. Our experiments demonstrate that interfacial molecular packing in vapor-deposited glasses of DSA-Ph is more disordered compared to the bulk. At a deposition temperature near room temperature, we estimate ~ 8 nm near the substrate can have modified molecular packing. Molecular dynamics simulations of a coarse-grained representation of DSA-Ph reveal a similar length scale. In both the simulations and the experiments, deposition temperature controls glass structure beyond this interfacial layer of a few nanometers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注气相沉积有机半导体玻璃在埋藏界面处的结构，考察 DSA-Ph 薄膜厚度和衬底类型对分子堆积的影响。掠入射 X 射线散射实验显示，靠近衬底的界面分子堆积比体相更无序，在接近室温沉积时约 8 纳米区域受到影响。粗粒化分子动力学模拟得到相近长度尺度，并表明界面层之外的玻璃结构主要由沉积温度控制。
authors: Kushal Bagchi, Chuting Deng, Camille Bishop, Yuhui Li, Nicholas E Jackson, Lian Yu, M. F. Toney, J. J. de Pablo, M. D. Ediger
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17089v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：尽管气相沉积玻璃的体相结构已被广泛研究，埋藏界面处的结构却很少受到关注，虽然它对有机电子学应用十分重要。为了解埋藏界面处的玻璃结构，我们研究了有机半导体 DSA-Ph（1,4-二-[4-(N,N-二苯基)氨基]苯乙烯基-苯）的气相沉积玻璃结构随薄膜厚度的变化；结构通过掠入射 X 射线散射进行探测。我们在硅和金衬底上沉积，并覆盖 10 至 600 纳米的薄膜厚度范围。我们的实验表明，与体相相比，DSA-Ph 气相沉积玻璃中的界面分子堆积更加无序。在接近室温的沉积温度下，我们估计靠近衬底约 8 纳米的区域可能具有改变的分子堆积。对 DSA-Ph 粗粒化表示的分子动力学模拟揭示了相似的长度尺度。在模拟和实验中，沉积温度都控制着这一数纳米界面层之外的玻璃结构。

articles.title: Temperature-Induced Reorganization of Supported Zn₃ Clusters on Cu(111): From Minimum-Energy Structures to Finite-Temperature Ensembles
articles.title_zh: Cu(111) 表面负载 Zn₃ 团簇的温度诱导重组：从最低能结构到有限温系综
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17149v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the nature of catalytic active sites under reaction conditions remains a central challenge in heterogeneous catalysis. In industrial copper/zinc oxide/alumina catalysts for methanol synthesis, small Zn-based species at the Cu interface have long been proposed as active-site candidates, yet their atomic-scale structure and stability remain controversial. Computational studies typically identify such species from optimized 0 K structures, assuming that minimum-energy configurations remain representative under reaction conditions. Here, we combine machine-learning-interatomic-potential-accelerated global optimization, molecular dynamics, and enhanced-sampling free-energy calculations to investigate supported Zn₃₍OH)₃ and Zn₃₍OH)₂CHOO clusters on Cu(111)-based surfaces from 0 to 450 K. While compact triangular configurations are generally favored among minimum-energy structures at 0 K, finite-temperature free-energy calculations reveal a pronounced shift toward extended linear configurations with increasing temperature. This transition is driven primarily by entropic stabilization and cannot be inferred from potential energies alone. Molecular dynamics further shows substantial cluster mobility on pristine Cu(111), indicating that long-term persistence depends not only on configurational stability but also on surface mobility. Surface Zn alloying strongly suppresses diffusion, thereby stabilizing isolated interfacial Zn species. Together, these results show that thermodynamically relevant structures of supported Zn-based clusters can differ fundamentally from static 0 K predictions because of competing enthalpic and entropic effects. Our findings highlight the limitations of identifying catalytic active sites solely from 0 K structures and underscore the importance of explicit finite-temperature sampling in catalyst modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究 Cu(111) 基表面上 Zn₃(OH)₃ 和 Zn₃(OH)₂CHOO 团簇在 0 至 450 K 的结构稳定性。尽管 0 K 最低能结构通常偏好紧凑三角构型，有限温自由能计算显示升温会显著推动其转向延展线性构型，这主要由熵稳定化驱动。分子动力学还表明团簇在洁净 Cu(111) 上具有较强迁移性，而表面 Zn 合金化可抑制扩散并稳定孤立界面 Zn 物种。
authors: Jiayan Xu, Zheng Yu, Abhirup Patra, Amar Deep Pathak, Sharan Shetty, Detlef Hohl, Roberto Car
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17149v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：理解反应条件下催化活性位点的本质仍然是非均相催化中的核心挑战。在用于甲醇合成的工业铜/氧化锌/氧化铝催化剂中，Cu 界面处的小型 Zn 基物种长期以来被提出为活性位点候选者，但其原子尺度结构和稳定性仍有争议。计算研究通常从优化的 0 K 结构中识别这类物种，并假定最低能构型在反应条件下仍具有代表性。在这里，我们结合由机器学习原子间势加速的全局优化、分子动力学和增强采样自由能计算，研究 Cu(111) 基表面上负载的 Zn₃(OH)₃ 和 Zn₃(OH)₂CHOO 团簇在 0 至 450 K 范围内的行为。虽然在 0 K 的最低能结构中，紧凑三角构型通常更受偏好，但有限温自由能计算揭示，随着温度升高，构型会明显转向延展线性构型。这一转变主要由熵稳定化驱动，不能仅从势能推断出来。分子动力学进一步显示，团簇在洁净 Cu(111) 上具有显著迁移性，表明长期存在不仅取决于构型稳定性，也取决于表面迁移性。表面 Zn 合金化强烈抑制扩散，从而稳定孤立的界面 Zn 物种。综合来看，这些结果表明，由于竞争性的焓效应和熵效应，负载 Zn 基团簇的热力学相关结构可能与静态 0 K 预测根本不同。我们的发现强调了仅从 0 K 结构识别催化活性位点的局限性，并凸显了在催化剂建模中进行显式有限温采样的重要性。

articles.title: Discovery of novel magnetic Y-Mn-B compounds via advanced machine learning guided framework
articles.title_zh: 通过先进机器学习引导框架发现新型磁性 Y-Mn-B 化合物
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth transition-metal borides offer critical structural motifs for permanent-magnet design; however, the manganese-rich regions within these compositional phase spaces remain largely unexplored. In this work, we develop an advanced machine-learning-assisted discovery framework to explore Y-Mn-B ternary system. Starting from over one million hypothetical structures generated from known structures in databases, we filtered promising candidates by first applying graph neural networks to predict material stability, then using machine-learning-interatomic-potential to relax their structures, and finally validating the results with first-principles calculations. We identify 5 stable and near-stable Y-Mn-B phases along with 61 metastable compounds with the formation energy within 100 meV/atom with respect to the ternary convex hull. Among them, Y2Mn7B7 and YMn4B4 are structurally analogous to the previously synthesized R₁₊ϵFe₄B₄ 1D incommensurate composite chain compounds. In striking contrast to the strongly suppressed Fe moments reported, our first-principles calculations reveal that the predicted Mn-chain phases preserve sizable local Mn moments (approximately 1.1 μ_B) and favored ferromagnetic ordering. Electronic structure analyses elucidate the microscopic origin of moment recovery via an enhanced exchange splitting driven by a Stoner-like instability. We also perform systematic Mn-Fe substitution to confirm the thermodynamic continuity and a monotonic enhancement of the macroscopic magnetization, from Fe to Mn. These findings indicate that targeted transition-metal substitution within a one-dimensional boride family can recover transition-metal magnetism, offering a physically interpretable route for designing new magnetic rare-earth transition-metal borides.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构建机器学习辅助发现框架，用于探索 Y-Mn-B 三元体系中富锰区域的新型硼化物。作者从逾百万个假想结构出发，结合图神经网络、机器学习原子间势结构弛豫和第一性原理验证，识别出稳定、近稳定和亚稳相。计算表明部分 Mn 链相保留较大的局域 Mn 磁矩并偏好铁磁有序，说明在一维硼化物家族中进行靶向过渡金属替换可恢复过渡金属磁性。
authors: Weiyi Xia, Wei Shen Tee, Maxim Moraru, Ying Wai Li, Cai-Zhuang Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17200v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：稀土-过渡金属硼化物为永磁体设计提供关键结构基元；然而，这些成分相空间中的富锰区域仍基本未被探索。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种先进的机器学习辅助发现框架，用于探索 Y-Mn-B 三元体系。我们从数据库中已知结构生成的一百多万个假想结构出发，首先应用图神经网络预测材料稳定性以筛选有前景的候选物，随后使用机器学习原子间势弛豫其结构，最后用第一性原理计算验证结果。我们识别出 5 个稳定和近稳定的 Y-Mn-B 相，以及 61 个相对于三元凸包形成能在 100 meV/原子以内的亚稳化合物。其中，Y2Mn7B7 和 YMn4B4 在结构上类似于先前合成的 R₁₊ϵFe₄B₄ 一维非公度复合链化合物。与报道中强烈受抑制的 Fe 磁矩形成鲜明对比，我们的第一性原理计算显示，预测的 Mn 链相保留了可观的局域 Mn 磁矩（约 1.1 μ_B），并偏好铁磁有序。电子结构分析阐明了磁矩恢复的微观起源，即由类似 Stoner 不稳定性驱动的增强交换劈裂。我们还进行了系统的 Mn-Fe 替换，以确认从 Fe 到 Mn 的热力学连续性以及宏观磁化强度的单调增强。这些发现表明，在一维硼化物家族内进行有目标的过渡金属替换可以恢复过渡金属磁性，为设计新的磁性稀土-过渡金属硼化物提供了一条物理上可解释的路径。
articles.focus_summary: 该工作面向 Y-Mn-B 三元体系，先用图神经网络筛选稳定性，再用机器学习原子势弛豫结构，最后用第一性原理验证，发现了 5 个稳定或近稳定相以及 61 个亚稳相。作者还指出若干 Mn 链相具有保留较强磁矩的特征，说明这类材料可能适合作为永磁或磁功能材料候选。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在磁性材料、第一性原理、高通量筛选和机器学习势方向高度相关，也涉及磁性化合物的反向设计。可借鉴其“GNN 预筛选 + ML 势局部优化 + DFT 终验证”的多级搜索流程。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步关注其稳定性判据、结构生成策略和磁矩保持机制，评估是否能迁移到稀土磁体、反铁磁或交替磁体体系。也值得对比其机器学习势在磁性体系中的泛化能力与局限。

articles.title: Windmill Spin Dynamics and Its Induced Anomalous Hall Effect in Noncollinear Antiferromagnet Mn3Sn
articles.title_zh: 非共线反铁磁体 Mn3Sn 中的风车式自旋动力学及其诱导的反常霍尔效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17225v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that the spin dynamics of the noncollinear antiferromagnet Mntextsubscript3Sn possesses a special soft eigen mode, which starts as a small-angle oscillation and eventually develops into a large-angle, windmill-type precession, when the canting angle surpasses a threshold value determined by the bending of the spin order. Such windmill precession possesses a unique chiral direction of motion, which can be sensed by electrons, producing a Berry curvature through the Berry connection polarizability in the mixed parameter space. Such Berry curvature can then yield a characteristic static anomalous Hall effect during windmill precession, even though the anomalous Hall effect from the equilibrium spin order vanishes. Our work reveals rich dynamical information in noncollinear antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者表明，非共线反铁磁体 Mn3Sn 的自旋动力学具有一种特殊软本征模，可从小角振荡发展为大角度风车式进动。该进动具有独特的手性运动方向，可被电子感知，并通过混合参数空间中的 Berry 连接极化率产生 Berry 曲率。由此，即使平衡自旋有序本身的反常霍尔效应为零，风车式进动也可产生特征性的静态反常霍尔效应。
authors: Jikun Zhou, Yang Gao, Qian Niu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17225v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们证明，非共线反铁磁体 Mn3Sn 的自旋动力学具有一种特殊的软本征模，当倾斜角超过由自旋有序弯曲所决定的阈值时，该模式从小角度振荡开始，并最终发展为大角度的风车式进动。这种风车式进动具有独特的手性运动方向，可被电子感知，并通过混合参数空间中的 Berry 连接极化率产生 Berry 曲率。这种 Berry 曲率随后可在风车式进动过程中产生一种特征性的静态反常霍尔效应，尽管来自平衡自旋有序的反常霍尔效应为零。我们的工作揭示了非共线反铁磁体中丰富的动力学信息。

articles.title: Zero Point Density Fluctuations and Electron Brownian Motion
articles.title_zh: 零点密度涨落与电子布朗运动
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The fluctuations in the phonon vacuum state can lead to zero point density fluctuations in a material, which in turn lead to local zero point fluctuations of the dielectric properties of the material. We argue that the density fluctuations lead to a fluctuating force on a test charge, such as an electron, located a short distance outside of the material. This force is due to fluctuating dipole moments inside the material, and produces Brownian motion of the electron. We calculate the mean squared velocity of the electron in both the normal and transverse direction relative to the boundary of the material. The result is nonzero in both directions, but larger in the normal case. We estimate the magnitude of this quantum Brownian motion and find that, in some cases, it can exceed the effects of both thermal motion and quantum momentum uncertainty. This suggests that the effect may be observable, and could constitute a source of quantum noise in nanoscale devices. It also potentially offers a means to remotely sense zero point density fluctuations in a material.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论材料中声子真空态涨落如何导致零点密度涨落，并进一步引起介电性质的局域零点涨落。作者认为，这些密度涨落会通过材料内部涨落偶极矩对靠近材料表面的测试电荷施加涨落力，从而产生电子布朗运动。计算显示电子在法向和横向的均方速度均非零，并估计在某些情况下该量子布朗运动可能超过热运动和量子动量不确定性的影响。
authors: L. H. Ford, G. O. Heymans, N. F. Svaiter
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17230v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：声子真空态中的涨落会导致材料中的零点密度涨落，而这些涨落又会导致材料介电性质的局域零点涨落。我们认为，密度涨落会对位于材料外部短距离处的测试电荷，例如电子，产生一种涨落力。这种力源于材料内部涨落的偶极矩，并会产生电子的布朗运动。我们计算了电子相对于材料边界在法向和横向两个方向上的均方速度。结果在两个方向上均为非零，但法向情况下更大。我们估计了这种量子布朗运动的大小，并发现，在某些情况下，它可能超过热运动和量子动量不确定性的影响。这表明该效应可能是可观测的，并可能构成纳米尺度器件中的一种量子噪声来源。它还可能提供一种远程感测材料中零点密度涨落的手段。

articles.title: Spontaneous symmetry-breaking in equilibrium tree-packing configurations of a kinetically constrained cubic-lattice system
articles.title_zh: 动力学受限立方晶格系统中平衡树堆积构型的自发对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17308v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore kinetic-constraint induced thermodynamic phase transition in the cubic lattice, employing the Fredrikson-Anderson spin model with hyperparameter K=2 as a representative kinetic system. Each lattice site may flip its binary occupation state if at most one of its six nearest neighbors is currently occupied. The whole set of microscopic configurations that are kinetically connected with the fully empty one is described by an equilibrium partition function with a single global constraint, that is, the occupied sites do not form closed loops but instead organize into different tree components in the lattice. We discover a continuous thermodynamic gas--crystal phase transition in the cubic system and determine the critical chemical potential μ^* approx -3.252, at which the occupied sites of the equilibrium tree-packing configurations start to prefer one of the two nested cubic sublattices. This thermodynamic phase transition is absent in the two-dimensional square lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以超参数 K=2 的 Fredrikson-Anderson 自旋模型为代表，考察立方晶格中由动力学约束诱导的热力学相变。与全空构型动力学连通的微观构型可由一个全局约束的平衡配分函数描述，即占据位点不形成闭环，而组织成不同树分量。作者发现立方系统存在连续的气体-晶体热力学相变，临界化学势约为 -3.252，而二维方格中不存在该相变。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17308v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们探索立方晶格中由动力学约束诱导的热力学相变，采用超参数 K=2 的 Fredrikson-Anderson 自旋模型作为代表性动力学系统。如果一个晶格位点当前最多只有一个六个最近邻被占据，则该位点可以翻转其二元占据状态。与完全空态动力学连通的整组微观构型可由带有单个全局约束的平衡配分函数描述，即占据位点不形成闭合环路，而是在晶格中组织成不同的树分量。我们在立方系统中发现了一种连续的热力学气体-晶体相变，并确定临界化学势 μ^* 约为 -3.252；在该点，平衡树堆积构型中的占据位点开始偏好两个嵌套立方子晶格之一。这种热力学相变在二维方格晶格中不存在。

articles.title: Fresnel diffraction imaging of surface nanostructure using coherent resonant X-ray scattering
articles.title_zh: 利用相干共振 X 射线散射对表面纳米结构进行菲涅耳衍射成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17377v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigated surface nanostructures on an antiferromagnet MnBi₂Te₄ using a novel imaging technique, direct (real)-space and real time coherent X-ray imaging (direct-CXI). This technique has provided new insights into antiferromagnetic textures, including the formation of anti-phase antiferromagnetic (AFM) domains and thermal dynamics of AFM domains and domain walls. While this method produces real-space images of AFM textures without requiring a complex imaging retrieval process, its underlying imaging mechanism has not been fully understood, limiting a deep understanding of AFM textures and the information they contain. By investigating the well-defined structural characteristics of the nanostructures fabricated on MnBi₂Te₄, we elucidate the imaging principle of this novel technique. We find that the observed images can be well explained by Fresnel diffraction integral. Using a simple model from classical optics, our calculations successfully reproduce the experimentally observed images of the nanostructures. This demonstrates that direct-CXI not only provides straightforward real-space imaging but also contains phase information through its Fresnel diffraction integral.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作使用直接实空间、实时相干 X 射线成像技术研究反铁磁体 MnBi₂Te₄ 表面纳米结构。为阐明该方法的成像机制，作者分析了在 MnBi₂Te₄ 上制备的具有明确结构特征的纳米结构。结果显示观测图像可由菲涅耳衍射积分很好解释，说明 direct-CXI 不仅提供直接实空间成像，也通过菲涅耳衍射积分包含相位信息。
authors: L. Burgard, C. Neupane, A. Balodhi, S. Bista, S. Butun, R. Jangid, A. Barbour, N. Basit, D. F. Agterberg, M. Weinert, C. Mazzoli, M. G. Kim
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17377v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们使用一种新型成像技术，即直接（实）空间和实时相干 X 射线成像（direct-CXI），研究了反铁磁体 MnBi₂Te₄ 上的表面纳米结构。该技术为反铁磁织构提供了新的认识，包括反相反铁磁（AFM）畴的形成以及 AFM 畴和畴壁的热动力学。虽然该方法无需复杂的成像重建过程即可生成 AFM 织构的实空间图像，但其底层成像机制尚未被充分理解，这限制了对 AFM 织构及其所含信息的深入认识。通过研究在 MnBi₂Te₄ 上制备的纳米结构的明确定义结构特征，我们阐明了这一新技术的成像原理。我们发现，观测到的图像可以由菲涅耳衍射积分很好地解释。利用经典光学中的一个简单模型，我们的计算成功再现了实验观测到的纳米结构图像。这表明 direct-CXI 不仅提供直接的实空间成像，还通过其菲涅耳衍射积分包含相位信息。

articles.title: Flux-tunable global and local superconductivity in a topological insulator nano-SQUID
articles.title_zh: 拓扑绝缘体纳米 SQUID 中通量可调的全局与局域超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17404v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological systems are defined by global properties that enforce the existence of local boundary modes. Three-dimensional topological insulators (TIs) were among the earliest proposed systems for hosting topological superconductivity, but experimental focus subsequently shifted to other platforms. Here, we revisit bulk-insulating TIs using a columnar nano-superconducting quantum interference device (nano-SQUID) architecture. This geometry optimises the proximity effect on the TI surface and enables simultaneous probing of global superconducting properties - via the critical current through the nano-SQUID - alongside the local states at the ends of the nano-SQUID via tunnel junctions. We observe several global superconducting features that appear to show a flux-driven global phase transition consistent with entering the topological regime, including periodic critical current oscillations and a sign reversal in the superconducting diode effect. Simultaneously, tunnelling spectroscopy reveals spectral jumps in local and nonlocal conductance that align with these global features. However, zero-bias peaks (ZBPs) in local conductance are present both within the predicted topological range of magnetic fields and in theoretically trivial regimes, including at zero magnetic field. Ultimately, the lack of correlation between local ZBP signatures and global signatures emphasises that conclusively identifying Majorana bound states will necessitate a combined approach, integrating the establishment of global topological properties with the use of local and other, more advanced, probes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在体绝缘三维拓扑绝缘体中采用柱状纳米 SQUID 架构，以同时探测全局超导性质和纳米 SQUID 端部的局域态。实验观察到若干全局超导特征，似乎与通量驱动的全局相变和进入拓扑区域相一致，同时隧穿谱中也出现与这些特征对齐的局域和非局域电导谱跳变。然而，局域零偏压峰在理论预测的拓扑磁场范围内外均出现，表明单靠局域 ZBP 不能确证 Majorana 束缚态。
authors: Ella Nikodem, Jakob Schluck, Michał Papaj, Max Geier, Mahasweta Bagchi, Liang Fu, Henry F. Legg, Yoichi Ando
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17404v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：拓扑系统由强制局域边界模式存在的全局性质来定义。三维拓扑绝缘体（TI）是最早被提出可承载拓扑超导性的系统之一，但实验重点随后转向了其他平台。在这里，我们使用柱状纳米超导量子干涉器件（nano-SQUID）架构重新考察体绝缘 TI。这种几何结构优化了 TI 表面的邻近效应，并能够通过 nano-SQUID 的临界电流探测全局超导性质，同时通过隧穿结探测 nano-SQUID 两端的局域态。我们观察到若干全局超导特征，它们似乎显示出一种由通量驱动的全局相变，与进入拓扑区域相一致，包括周期性临界电流振荡和超导二极管效应中的符号反转。与此同时，隧穿谱揭示了局域和非局域电导中的谱跃迁，这些跃迁与上述全局特征相一致。然而，局域电导中的零偏压峰（ZBP）既出现在预测的拓扑磁场范围内，也出现在理论上平庸的区域中，包括零磁场。最终，局域 ZBP 信号与全局信号之间缺乏相关性，这强调了要确凿识别 Majorana 束缚态，将需要一种综合方法，将全局拓扑性质的确立与局域探针以及其他更先进探针的使用结合起来。

articles.title: Many-Anyon Braiding in Non-Abelian Fractional Quantum Hall Effect with Hybrid Monte Carlo Simulation
articles.title_zh: 利用混合蒙特卡罗模拟研究非阿贝尔分数量子霍尔效应中的多任意子编织
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17424v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We employ the hybrid Monte Carlo method to efficiently compute the many-anyon non-Abelian braiding matrices associated with different braiding schemes of the Moore-Read quasiholes. A novel proposal in this work is that anyon braiding schemes based on a global rotation are robust against finite-size effects, as demonstrated by benchmarking their errors in the braiding matrix against those of a simple two-anyon exchange. Moreover, we investigate how electron-electron interactions and local electrostatic trapping potentials influence the energetic preference of different fusion channels. Their effect on the non-Abelian braiding matrices has been verified, a surprising phenomenon that demonstrates long-range entanglement of non-Abelian states. Our results are relevant to the experimental realization of non-Abelian physics in fractional quantum Hall and other analogous systems, including the fast-growing field of fractional quantum anomalous Hall states in moiré materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作采用混合蒙特卡罗方法高效计算 Moore-Read 准空穴在不同编织方案下的多任意子非阿贝尔编织矩阵。作者提出，基于全局旋转的任意子编织方案对有限尺寸效应具有稳健性，并通过与简单双任意子交换的误差比较加以验证。研究还考察了电子相互作用和局域静电俘获势对不同融合通道能量偏好的影响，并验证其对非阿贝尔编织矩阵的作用。
authors: Ting-Tung Wang, Ha Quang Trung, Qianhui Xu, Min Long, Bo Yang, Zi Yang Meng
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17424v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们采用混合蒙特卡罗方法，高效计算与 Moore-Read 准空穴不同编织方案相关的多任意子非阿贝尔编织矩阵。本工作中的一个新提议是，基于全局旋转的任意子编织方案对有限尺寸效应具有稳健性；这一点通过将其编织矩阵误差与简单双任意子交换的误差进行基准比较而得到证明。此外，我们研究了电子-电子相互作用和局域静电俘获势如何影响不同融合通道的能量偏好。它们对非阿贝尔编织矩阵的影响已经得到验证，这是一种令人惊讶的现象，展示了非阿贝尔态的长程纠缠。我们的结果与分数量子霍尔体系以及其他类似系统中非阿贝尔物理的实验实现相关，包括莫尔材料中快速发展的分数量子反常霍尔态领域。

articles.title: Flat band and Bulk-Boundary correspondence in a non-Hermitian trimerized lattice model with generic boundary conditions
articles.title_zh: 具有一般边界条件的非厄米三聚化晶格模型中的平带与体-边对应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17428v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger(SSH)-type trimer model with next-nearest-neighbor(NNN) interaction and balanced loss-gain(BLG) to study the combined effect of lattice symmetries, topology, non-hermiticity and general boundary conditions(GBC)on the existence of flat band and the nature of Bulk-Boundary correspondence(BBC). We derive the necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of an entirely real spectrum under the periodic boundary condition(PBC). The exact expressions for the compact localized states(CLS) and energy eigenvalues corresponding to flat bands are derived analytically under the PBC. We establish topological phase transitions(TPT) for PT-symmetry and pseudo-chiral symmetry through the computation of the Zak phase and sub-lattice Zak phase, respectively. The Hamiltonian under the open boundary condition(OBC) is studied numerically, and edge states are observed in the topologically non-trivial phase, thereby establishing the non-hermitian BBC. The CLS exists in both bulk and the boundary for systems having only pseudo-chiral symmetry, and an additional PT-symmetry destroys the CLS at the boundary. We generalize a known formalism to study the same Hamiltonian under GBC, and derive analytic expressions for the energy and eigenstates for a class of boundary conditions in parametric ranges which admit flat band under the PBC. The edge states for these boundary conditions, including the OBC, are obtained analytically in the topologically non-trivial phase, thereby establishing BBC. The non-hermitian skin effect(NHSE) is seen in the model with reciprocal bulk interaction and strongly non-reciprocal boundary terms. The winding number based on spectral topology is computed analytically.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察含次近邻相互作用和平衡损耗-增益的 SSH 型三聚体模型，分析晶格对称性、拓扑、非厄米性和一般边界条件对平带与体-边对应的共同影响。作者在周期边界条件下推导了全实能谱的充要条件，并解析得到平带紧致局域态和能量本征值。研究还在开边界和更一般边界条件下建立非厄米体-边对应，讨论边缘态、非厄米趋肤效应及谱拓扑绕数。
authors: Supriyo Ghosh, Pijush K. Ghosh, Shreekantha Sil
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.17428v1 公告类型：新稿 摘要：我们考虑一个具有次近邻（NNN）相互作用和平衡损耗-增益（BLG）的 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）型三聚体模型，以研究晶格对称性、拓扑、非厄米性和一般边界条件（GBC）对平带存在性以及体-边对应（BBC）性质的综合影响。我们推导了在周期边界条件（PBC）下存在完全实能谱的充要条件。在 PBC 下，我们解析推导了与平带对应的紧致局域态（CLS）和能量本征值的精确表达式。通过计算 Zak 相和子晶格 Zak 相，我们分别建立了 PT 对称性和赝手征对称性的拓扑相变（TPT）。我们数值研究了开边界条件（OBC）下的哈密顿量，并在拓扑非平庸相中观察到边缘态，从而建立了非厄米 BBC。对于仅具有赝手征对称性的系统，CLS 同时存在于体相和边界中，而额外的 PT 对称性会破坏边界处的 CLS。我们推广了一种已知形式体系，用于在 GBC 下研究同一哈密顿量，并在 PBC 下允许平带的参数范围内，针对一类边界条件推导了能量和本征态的解析表达式。对于这些边界条件，包括 OBC，在拓扑非平庸相中解析获得了边缘态，从而建立了 BBC。在具有互易体相相互作用和强非互易边界项的模型中，可以看到非厄米趋肤效应（NHSE）。基于谱拓扑的绕数被解析计算出来。

articles.title: Intra-atomic magnetic octupoles and their coupling to cluster magnetic octupoles in Chiral antiferromagnets Mn₃Sn
articles.title_zh: 手性反铁磁体 Mn₃Sn 中原子内磁八极矩及其与团簇磁八极矩的耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17461v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate that Mn₃Sn hosts finite intra-atomic magnetic octupoles (AMOs) o in addition to the well-established cluster magnetic octupole (CMO) O. In contrast to the cluster-scale CMO, the AMO is a site-localized magnetic multipole associated with the anisotropic intra-atomic spin density. Symmetry analysis shows that the CMO and AMO transform in the same representation, allowing a bilinear interaction of the form -g,Oḑoto. Using first-principles calculations, we confirm the presence of finite AMO densities and show that the AMO transforms concomitantly with the CMO under rotations of the noncollinear magnetic structure, providing microscopic evidence for the coupling between them. We further show that the magnetic band splitting can be represented by projected AMO operators, with manifold-dependent effective octupolar exchange coefficients in realistic Mn₃Sn. The presence of AMOs has three important implications. First, we show that the nonrelativistic spin splitting of Mn₃Sn can be described in terms of projected AMO operators, with manifold-dependent effective octupolar exchange coefficients, establishing the AMO as a microscopic operator underlying the spin splitting. Second, the AMO reveals a close connection between Mn₃Sn and d-wave altermagnets from the magnetic-octupole perspective. Third, the Oḑoto coupling suggests a new route to manipulate the CMO using AMO currents, opening a direction for controlling the multipolar order in Mn₃Sn.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，Mn₃Sn 除了已知的团簇磁八极矩外，还存在有限的原子内磁八极矩。对称性分析和第一性原理计算显示，两类八极矩属于相同表示，因此可发生双线性耦合，并在非共线磁结构旋转时协同变换。作者进一步指出，原子内磁八极矩可作为解释非相对论自旋劈裂的微观算符，并可能为通过原子内磁八极矩流操控多极序提供新路径。
authors: Dohoon Park, Seungyun Han, Hyun-Woo Lee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，Mn₃Sn 除了已确立的团簇磁八极矩（CMO）O 之外，还具有有限的原子内磁八极矩（AMO）o。不同于团簇尺度的 CMO，AMO 是一种位点局域的磁多极矩，与各向异性的原子内自旋密度相关。对称性分析表明，CMO 与 AMO 按相同表示变换，从而允许形如 -g O·o 的双线性相互作用。利用第一性原理计算，我们确认了有限 AMO 密度的存在，并表明 AMO 在非共线磁结构旋转时与 CMO 协同变换，为二者之间的耦合提供了微观证据。我们进一步表明，在实际 Mn₃Sn 中，磁能带劈裂可由投影 AMO 算符表示，并具有依赖于流形的有效八极交换系数。AMO 的存在具有三点重要含义。第一，我们表明 Mn₃Sn 的非相对论自旋劈裂可用投影 AMO 算符描述，并具有依赖于流形的有效八极交换系数，从而确立 AMO 是自旋劈裂背后的微观算符。第二，从磁八极矩视角看，AMO 揭示了 Mn₃Sn 与 d 波交替磁体之间的紧密联系。第三，O·o 耦合提示了一条利用 AMO 电流操控 CMO 的新途径，为控制 Mn₃Sn 中的多极序开辟了方向。

articles.title: Universal quantum corrections of two-body correlation in a weakly interspecies interacting binary Bose mixture
articles.title_zh: 弱种间相互作用二元玻色混合物中二体关联的普适量子修正
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate universal quantum corrections to two-body correlations in a zero-temperature binary Bose mixture using the Cornwall-Jackiw-Tomboulis two-particle-irreducible effective action formalism. In the weak interspecies-coupling regime, a saddle-point treatment based on Hubbard-Stratonovich transformations can be combined with a two-loop expansion and a gapless Hartree-Fock correction, thereby preserving the Goldstone theorem and reducing the coupled two-component problem to two analytically solvable single-component theories. Within this framework, we derive the ground-state energy density as a low-density expansion in the gas parameter, together with the quantum depletion and chemical potentials. The results exhibit a simple mapping to the single-component case: the universal quantum corrections of the mixture are obtained by evaluating the known single-component series at an effective scattering length aσσ-a₁₂ for each species, where aσσ and a₁₂ are the intra- and interspecies s-wave scattering lengths. This reproduces Petrov's equation of state at one-loop order in the weak-coupling limit and yields beyond-Lee-Huang-Yang corrections at two-loop order. We also analyze the role of mass imbalance, which enters the energy density through the exact rescaling factor (1+m₁/m₂)/2.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 Cornwall-Jackiw-Tomboulis 二粒子不可约有效作用量形式，研究零温二元玻色混合物中二体关联的普适量子修正。在弱种间耦合条件下，作者将两组分问题化约为两个可解析求解的单组分理论，并推导基态能量密度、量子耗尽和化学势。结果显示，混合物的普适量子修正可映射到以有效散射长度 aσσ-a₁₂ 评估的单组分级数，并给出超出 Lee-Huang-Yang 阶的二环修正。
authors: Rui-Yan Chen, Zhaoxin Liang, Gao Xianlong
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用 Cornwall-Jackiw-Tomboulis 二粒子不可约有效作用量形式，研究零温二元玻色混合物中二体关联的普适量子修正。在弱种间耦合区域，基于 Hubbard-Stratonovich 变换的鞍点处理可与二环展开和无能隙 Hartree-Fock 修正相结合，从而保持 Goldstone 定理，并将耦合的双组分问题化约为两个可解析求解的单组分理论。在这一框架内，我们推导出作为气体参数低密度展开的基态能量密度，以及量子耗尽和化学势。结果呈现出到单组分情形的简单映射：混合物的普适量子修正可通过对每个物种在有效散射长度 aσσ-a₁₂ 处评估已知单组分级数得到，其中 aσσ 和 a₁₂ 分别为种内和种间 s 波散射长度。这在弱耦合极限的一环阶再现了 Petrov 的状态方程，并在二环阶给出了超出 Lee-Huang-Yang 的修正。我们还分析了质量不平衡的作用，它通过精确的重标度因子 (1+m₁/m₂)/2 进入能量密度。

articles.title: Unconventional Pressure Evolution of Spin-Density-Wave State in La₃Ni₂O₇
articles.title_zh: La₃Ni₂O₇ 中自旋密度波态随压力演化的反常行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17505v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of pressure-induced high temperature superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate La₃Ni₂O₇ has raised the question of how its spin-density-wave (SDW) state evolves toward the superconducting regime. Here, we report a systematic electronic Raman study of La₃Ni₂O₇ single crystals under hydrostatic pressures up to 16.51 GPa. Both the SDW gap energy and the transition temperature TSDW show an overall increase with pressure, while the dimensionless coupling ratio 2ΔSDW/(kBTSDW) remains constant around sim7.5, indicating a robust strong-coupling character of SDW state. At the same time, the Raman SDW peak broadens as pressure is applied, indicating a gradual weakening of long-range SDW order. These results reveal an unusual pressure evolution in which the SDW energy scale is enhanced while the SDW state becomes progressively less coherent, providing spectroscopic constraints on the magnetic correlations relevant to superconductivity in bilayer nickelates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过高达 16.51 GPa 的静水压电子拉曼实验，系统考察双层镍酸盐 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中自旋密度波态向超导区域演化的过程。结果显示，SDW 能隙和转变温度总体随压力升高而增大，而强耦合比值约保持在 7.5。与此同时，拉曼 SDW 峰随压力展宽，说明长程 SDW 有序逐渐减弱，揭示了能量尺度增强但相干性下降的异常压力演化。
authors: Xiaoxiang Zhou, Shiyu Xie, Liangxin Qiao, Hengyuan Zhang, Jun Shu, Rui Liu, Mengwu Huo, Deyuan Hu, Hengjie Liu, Chuansheng Hu, Yilin Wang, Ge He, Zeming Qi, Meng Wang, Dong-Lai Feng, Zengyi Du
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双层镍酸盐 La₃Ni₂O₇ 中压力诱导高温超导的发现，引出了其自旋密度波（SDW）态如何向超导区域演化的问题。在这里，我们报告了在高达 16.51 GPa 静水压力下对 La₃Ni₂O₇ 单晶进行的系统电子拉曼研究。SDW 能隙能量和转变温度 TSDW 都随压力总体升高，而无量纲耦合比 2ΔSDW/(kBTSDW) 保持在约 7.5，表明 SDW 态具有稳健的强耦合特征。与此同时，随着施加压力，拉曼 SDW 峰发生展宽，表明长程 SDW 有序逐渐减弱。这些结果揭示了一种不寻常的压力演化：SDW 能量尺度增强，而 SDW 态逐渐变得不那么相干，为双层镍酸盐中与超导相关的磁关联提供了光谱学约束。

articles.title: Growth of Altermagnetic α-MnTe Films: Substrate Variation and Surface Modification
articles.title_zh: 交替磁性 α-MnTe 薄膜的生长：衬底变化与表面改性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Manganese telluride (MnTe) in its hexagonal α-MnTe crystal structure has evolved as one of the altermagnet workhorse materials. The synthesis of MnTe thin films is highly relevant for both fundamental science and device applications. Here, we report on the epitaxial growth of MnTe thin films and heterostructures. The films are studied by X-ray and electron diffraction as well as soft X-ray angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. We demonstrate the ability to grow high-quality α-MnTe on various substrates, ranging from transparent band insulators, over topological insulators, metallic transition metal chalcogenides, to the van der Waals ferromagnet Fe₃GeTe₂. While insulating substrates are useful for transport experiments or optical spectroscopy, metallic topological surface states may trigger spintronic interface effects, such as spin-orbit torques. Metallic substrates, in general, are highly relevant to avoid charging at the insulating MnTe films in electron spectroscopy or microscopy methods. Lastly, ferromagnetic substrates will be of interest to control magnetization across the interface. In addition, we discuss the formation of superstructures on the MnTe(0001) surfaces, that emerge directly after growth, upon subsequent tellurium evaporation and after thermal treatment. This will be relevant in further studying the surface magnetic and electronic structure in α-MnTe.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了六方 α-MnTe 薄膜和异质结构的外延生长，并利用衍射和软 X 射线角分辨光电子能谱进行表征。作者证明可在从绝缘体、拓扑绝缘体、金属过渡金属硫属化物到范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe₂ 等多种衬底上制备高质量 α-MnTe。研究还讨论了 MnTe(0001) 表面在生长后、碲蒸发后和热处理后形成的超结构，对后续研究其表面磁性与电子结构具有意义。
authors: M. Dittmar, L. Hirnet, H. Haberkamm, F. Beisler, C. -W. Chuang, R. Ganser, P. Kagerer, M. -J. Huang, J. Buck, M. Hoesch, K. Rossnagel, M. Ünzelmann, F. Reinert
articles.abstract_zh_full: 六方 α-MnTe 晶体结构中的碲化锰（MnTe）已发展成为交替磁体的代表性材料之一。MnTe 薄膜的合成对于基础科学和器件应用都高度相关。在这里，我们报告 MnTe 薄膜和异质结构的外延生长。我们通过 X 射线和电子衍射以及软 X 射线角分辨光电子能谱研究这些薄膜。我们证明了在多种衬底上生长高质量 α-MnTe 的能力，这些衬底范围从透明带绝缘体，到拓扑绝缘体、金属过渡金属硫属化物，再到范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe₂。绝缘衬底适用于输运实验或光学光谱，而金属拓扑表面态可能触发自旋电子学界面效应，例如自旋轨道力矩。一般而言，金属衬底对于在电子能谱或显微方法中避免绝缘 MnTe 薄膜带电高度相关。最后，铁磁衬底将有助于跨界面控制磁化。此外，我们讨论了 MnTe(0001) 表面上超结构的形成，这些超结构可在生长后直接出现，也可在随后碲蒸发和热处理后出现。这对于进一步研究 α-MnTe 的表面磁性和电子结构将具有重要意义。

articles.title: Absence of nontrivial local conserved quantities in a class of U(1)-symmetric spin-1 chains
articles.title_zh: 一类 U(1) 对称自旋 1 链中非平凡局域守恒量的缺失
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We prove the absence of nontrivial local conserved quantities in a class of U(1)-symmetric spin-1 chains with nearest-neighbor interactions in which some of the quadrupolar couplings vanish, a class that is not covered by previous studies. Applying the technique of Shiraishi to these systems, we show that, for every model in this class on a periodic chain of N sites, there is no k-local conserved quantity for any 3łe kłe N/2. In particular, for a frustration-free spin-1 chain that exhibits spontaneous U(1) symmetry breaking at zero temperature in one spatial dimension, we prove that every local conserved quantity with support up to half of the system size is a linear combination of the identity, the total magnetization S^z, and the Hamiltonian itself. This rigorously establishes that, unlike the Heisenberg ferromagnet, the model admits no local order parameter commuting with the Hamiltonian, so that its continuous symmetry breaking is enabled by the frustration-free structure rather than by a conserved order parameter. We also prove the absence of k-local conserved quantities for 3łe kłe N/2 in the periodic Motzkin chain, a frustration-free spin-1 chain closely related to the original Motzkin chain, for which spontaneous U(1) symmetry breaking at zero temperature has also been reported.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究证明，在一类具有最近邻相互作用且部分四极耦合消失的 U(1) 对称自旋 1 链中，不存在非平凡局域守恒量。作者将 Shiraishi 的技术用于这些体系，证明周期链上不存在支撑长度在 3 到 N/2 之间的 k 局域守恒量。对于一个无阻挫自旋 1 链，这意味着半系统尺度以内的局域守恒量只能由恒等算符、总磁化和哈密顿量线性组合而成，从而澄清其零温连续对称性破缺并非来自守恒序参量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，在一类具有最近邻相互作用且某些四极耦合为零的 U(1) 对称自旋 1 链中，不存在非平凡局域守恒量，而这一类体系此前研究尚未覆盖。将 Shiraishi 的技术应用于这些系统，我们表明，对于这一类中定义在 N 个格点周期链上的每个模型，对任意 3≤k≤N/2 都不存在 k 局域守恒量。特别地，对于一个在一维零温下表现出自发 U(1) 对称性破缺的无阻挫自旋 1 链，我们证明每个支撑范围不超过系统尺寸一半的局域守恒量都是恒等算符、总磁化 S^z 和哈密顿量本身的线性组合。这严格确立了该模型不同于 Heisenberg 铁磁体，它不存在与哈密顿量对易的局域序参量，因此其连续对称性破缺是由无阻挫结构而非由守恒序参量实现的。我们还证明，对于周期 Motzkin 链，在 3≤k≤N/2 范围内不存在 k 局域守恒量；该链是与原始 Motzkin 链密切相关的无阻挫自旋 1 链，并且也有报道称其在零温下存在自发 U(1) 对称性破缺。

articles.title: Inducing metal-insulator transition via disorder in correlated kagome systems
articles.title_zh: 通过无序在关联 Kagome 系统中诱导金属-绝缘体转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17558v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The metal-insulator transition is often accompanied by fascinating quantum phenomena, including superconducting domes, antiferromagnetic phase transitions, and quantum spin liquids. Concurrently, kagome materials are predominantly metallic, necessitating the realization of insulating states to fully exploit their significant potential in logic and optoelectronic device applications. To address this, we investigate the electronic transport and magnetic properties in correlated kagome systems with hopping disorder using the determinant quantum Monte Carlo method. Through comprehensive analysis of the kinetic energy, dc conductivity, and density of states at the Fermi level, we demonstrate that the cooperative interplay between hopping disorder and electron correlations promotes electron localization. Within the insulator, an increase in the disorder level reduces the Coulomb interaction required for the Mott transition. Additionally, while disorder partially suppresses antiferromagnetic ordering, it remains insufficient to induce a complete magnetic transition. Finally, we summarize two schematic regions distinguishing between antiferromagnetic metal, correlated Anderson insulator, and disordered Mott insulator. Our study advances the understanding of metal-insulator transition in kagome systems by disorder and provides actionable insights for experimental control of these transitions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法，考察含跃迁无序的关联 Kagome 系统中的电子输运和磁性质。通过分析动能、直流电导率和费米能级态密度，作者表明跃迁无序与电子关联的协同作用促进电子局域化。在绝缘相中，无序增强会降低 Mott 转变所需的库仑相互作用，同时虽会部分抑制反铁磁有序，但不足以引发完整磁转变。
authors: Qingzhuo Duan, Hongdao Zhuge, Zixuan JIa, Tianxing Ma
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金属-绝缘体转变常伴随引人关注的量子现象，包括超导穹顶、反铁磁相变和量子自旋液体。同时，Kagome 材料主要呈现金属性，因此需要实现绝缘态，以充分发挥其在逻辑和光电子器件应用中的巨大潜力。为此，我们使用行列式量子蒙特卡洛方法，研究具有跃迁无序的关联 Kagome 系统中的电子输运和磁性质。通过对动能、直流电导率和费米能级态密度的综合分析，我们证明跃迁无序与电子关联之间的协同作用促进了电子局域化。在绝缘体内部，无序程度的增加会降低 Mott 转变所需的库仑相互作用。此外，尽管无序会部分抑制反铁磁有序，但仍不足以诱导完整的磁相变。最后，我们总结了两个示意区域，用于区分反铁磁金属、关联 Anderson 绝缘体和无序 Mott 绝缘体。我们的研究推进了对 Kagome 系统中由无序引起的金属-绝缘体转变的理解，并为实验调控这些转变提供了可操作的见解。

articles.title: Chiral Spinterfaces as an Overlooked Component of the Chiral-Induced Spin Selectivity Effect
articles.title_zh: 手性自旋界面作为手性诱导自旋选择效应中被忽视的组成部分
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17608v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect is generally attributed to spin-selective transport through chiral molecules, while the role of the molecule-electrode interface remains largely unexplored. Here, we show that adsorption of chiral amino acid derived molecules on ferromagnetic Ni thin films generates a remanent chirality-dependent magneto-optical response that is localized to the molecule-Ni/NiO interface and can be reversibly switched by an external magnetic field, demonstrating its genuine magnetic character. A comprehensive series of control experiments establishes that the response originates from the interfacial region rather than from the molecular layer or the bulk ferromagnet. First-principles calculations reveal that Boc-methionine adsorption proceeds through energetically accessible sulfur- and carboxyl-bound configurations that produce distinct molecular orientations and ligand-p/Ni-d hybridization, thereby defining structurally and electronically distinct interfaces. Together, the experimental and theoretical results support the formation of chiral spinterfaces, identifying the molecule-ferromagnet interface as an active and previously overlooked component of CISS systems. These findings broaden the microscopic picture of CISS beyond the chiral molecule itself and reveals interface electronic structure as a key design parameter for spin-selective molecular devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，手性诱导自旋选择效应不仅涉及手性分子中的自旋选择输运，分子-电极界面也起主动作用。实验表明，手性氨基酸衍生分子吸附在铁磁 Ni 薄膜上后，会在分子-Ni/NiO 界面产生具有剩磁、依赖手性的磁光响应，且可由外磁场可逆切换。第一性原理计算进一步揭示不同吸附构型和杂化方式形成结构与电子性质不同的手性自旋界面，为自旋选择分子器件设计提供了关键界面参数。
authors: Franziska Schölzel, Aybüke Gülkaya, Rico Ehrler, Dominik Hornig, Lokesh Rasabathina, Aleksandra Lindner, Jürgen Lindner, Aleksandr Kazimir, Christina Lamers, Dietrich R. T. Zahn, Michael Mehring, Olav Hellwig, Shuxia Tao, Georgeta Salvan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 手性诱导自旋选择（CISS）效应通常归因于通过手性分子的自旋选择输运，而分子-电极界面的作用在很大程度上尚未被探索。在这里，我们表明，手性氨基酸衍生分子吸附在铁磁 Ni 薄膜上，会产生一种具有剩磁、依赖手性的磁光响应，该响应局域于分子-Ni/NiO 界面，并可由外加磁场可逆切换，证明其真正的磁性特征。一系列全面的对照实验确定，该响应源自界面区域，而不是分子层或体相铁磁体。第一，第一性原理计算显示 Boc-蛋氨酸吸附通过能量上可实现的硫结合和羧基结合构型进行，这些构型产生不同的分子取向和配体 p/Ni d 杂化，从而定义了结构和电子性质不同的界面。实验和理论结果共同支持手性自旋界面的形成，将分子-铁磁体界面识别为 CISS 系统中一个主动且此前被忽视的组成部分。这些发现将 CISS 的微观图像从手性分子本身扩展出去，并揭示界面电子结构是自旋选择分子器件的关键设计参数。
articles.focus_summary: 这项研究讨论了手性分子吸附在铁磁 Ni 薄膜上的界面效应，指出所谓 CISS 响应与分子-铁磁体界面形成的 chiral spinterface 密切相关。第一性原理计算揭示了不同吸附构型和轨道杂化带来的结构与电子学差异。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在自旋相关材料、界面电荷/自旋转移和第一性原理计算方面有交集，尤其贴近自旋电子学与界面磁性问题。它不完全属于团队主轴，但物理机制和理论工具都较接近。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步关注其界面构型采样、磁性响应的计算判据和实验-理论对应方式，看看是否能迁移到其他磁性异质结或低维界面。若做相关方向，可补读 CISS 和分子-铁磁界面理论文献。

articles.title: Quantized Spin Hall Effect in Three-Dimensional Nodal-Ring Semimetal: Geometric Scaling and Symmetry-Engineered Spin Response
articles.title_zh: 三维节线环半金属中的量子化自旋霍尔效应：几何标度与对称性工程自旋响应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The anomalous Hall conductivity in magnetic Weyl semimetals scales linearly with the momentum separation between Weyl nodes, establishing a geometric paradigm for three-dimensional Hall responses. Here we discover an analogous phenomenon in the spin Hall effect: a quantized spin Hall conductivity (SHC) in nodal-ring semimetals that scales linearly with the nodal-ring radius R. From an ideal model with a single nodal ring, we derive analytically that the SHC inside the spin-orbit-coupled gap obeys σα βS, ³D=σ₀S,²D ḑot (π R/2 π), where σ₀S,²D=(e²/h) ḑot (hbar/2 e) is the two-dimensional quantum spin Hall conductance. Crucially, the symmetry of the spin-orbit coupling acts as an independent switch: Rashba coupling generates purely conventional SHC components, while Weyl coupling additionally activates unconventional ones, providing separate control over response magnitude and tensor symmetry. We validate this principle in yttrium nitride, where strain tunes R and symmetry breaking toggles between response types. Our work establishes a new paradigm for engineering quantized geometric responses in three dimensions, opening pathways to tailored spin-orbit functionalities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究发现，节线环半金属中的量子化自旋霍尔电导与节线环半径 R 线性标度，类似于磁性 Weyl 半金属中反常霍尔电导与 Weyl 节点动量间距的几何关系。作者从单一节线环理想模型解析推导了自旋轨道耦合能隙内的电导表达式，并指出自旋轨道耦合对称性可独立控制响应张量类型。该原理在氮化钇中得到验证，其中应变调节 R，对称性破缺切换不同响应类型。
authors: Jiali Chen, Chaoxi Cui, Zhi-Ming Yu, Wei Jiang, Yugui Yao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性 Weyl 半金属中的反常霍尔电导与 Weyl 节点之间的动量间距呈线性标度关系，从而为三维霍尔响应建立了几何范式。在这里，我们在自旋霍尔效应中发现了类似现象：节线环半金属中的量子化自旋霍尔电导（SHC）与节线环半径 R 呈线性标度。从具有单一节线环的理想模型出发，我们解析推导出，在自旋轨道耦合能隙内，SHC 满足 σαβS,3D=σ0S,2D·(πR/2π)，其中 σ0S,2D=(e²/h)·(hbar/2e) 是二维量子自旋霍尔电导。关键的是，自旋轨道耦合的对称性充当独立开关：Rashba 耦合产生纯常规 SHC 分量，而 Weyl 耦合还会激活非常规分量，从而可分别控制响应大小和张量对称性。我们在氮化钇中验证了这一原理，其中应变调节 R，而对称性破缺在不同响应类型之间切换。我们的工作为在三维中设计量子化几何响应建立了新范式，并为定制自旋轨道功能开辟了路径。

articles.title: Gauge-constrained Spinon Complexes Near Deconfined Quantum Criticality
articles.title_zh: 退禁闭量子临界附近受规范约束的自旋子复合体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum magnets provide a microscopic platform for studying confinement and gauge-constrained structures mediated by emergent gauge fields. We investigate confined spinon complexes in the columnar valence-bond-solid (VBS) phase near deconfined quantum criticality using pinned-spin defects and quantum Monte Carlo simulations. The pinned spins act as static spinon sources with controlled positions, spin projections, and VBS vorticities, enabling measurement of defect energies and direct real-space visualization of the associated VBS domain-wall strings. For matched spinon-antispinon sources, the excitation energy saturates beyond a characteristic separation as one extended dipole reorganizes into two shorter neutral dipoles, providing energetic and real-space evidence of string breaking. We further show that domain-wall connectivity is governed by lattice-scale VBS phase offsets in addition to vorticity and spin-projection neutrality. Compatible multi-pin patterns generate connected four-spinon complexes and extended domain-wall networks that retain their global connectivity under local distortions. These results establish pinned-spin defects as a controlled tool for assembling and resolving multi-spinon structures and their confining strings in a VBS phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用钉扎自旋缺陷和量子蒙特卡洛模拟，研究退禁闭量子临界附近柱状价键固体相中的受限自旋子复合体。钉扎自旋作为可控静态自旋子源，使作者能够测量缺陷能量并直接可视化 VBS 畴壁弦。结果显示，匹配的自旋子-反自旋子源在超过特征距离后发生弦断裂，并且多钉扎构型可生成连通的四自旋子复合体和扩展畴壁网络。
authors: Zhi-Yao Ning, Xue-Feng Zhang, Naoki Kawashima, Jun Takahashi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子磁体为研究由涌现规范场介导的禁闭和受规范约束结构提供了微观平台。我们利用钉扎自旋缺陷和量子蒙特卡洛模拟，研究退禁闭量子临界附近柱状价键固体（VBS）相中的受限自旋子复合体。钉扎自旋作为静态自旋子源，其位置、自旋投影和 VBS 涡旋度可控，从而能够测量缺陷能量，并在实空间直接可视化相关的 VBS 畴壁弦。对于匹配的自旋子-反自旋子源，激发能量在超过特征间距后趋于饱和，因为一个扩展偶极会重组为两个较短的中性偶极，这为弦断裂提供了能量和实空间证据。我们进一步表明，畴壁连通性除受涡旋度和自旋投影中性约束外，还受晶格尺度 VBS 相位偏移控制。相容的多钉扎图案会生成连通的四自旋子复合体和扩展畴壁网络，并且这些网络在局部畸变下保持其全局连通性。这些结果确立了钉扎自旋缺陷作为一种可控工具，可用于在 VBS 相中组装和解析多自旋子结构及其禁闭弦。

articles.title: Wavelength-Resolved Control of Photovoltaic Screening and Defect-Mediated Doping in Photo-Ferroelectric/Graphene Devices
articles.title_zh: 光铁电/石墨烯器件中光伏屏蔽与缺陷介导掺杂的波长分辨调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectrics enable large charge doping of two-dimensional overlayers, but the coexistence of switching and nonswitching charge dynamics complicate electro-optical analysis. Here, we investigate the optoelectronic response of a ferroelectric/graphene device under 365 and 530 nm illumination, disentangling effects on ferroelectric dipole alignment from extrinsic current pathways. Graphene acts as a high-gain sensor, amplifying subtle polarization dynamics into a pronounced resistance difference. By resolving switching and nonswitching channels in dark and illuminated conditions, we reveal a competition between photovoltaic charge screening and defect-assisted excitation that governs device electrostatics. Above-band gap illumination generates free carriers that induce leaky ferroelectric hysteresis and suppress the graphene resistance ratio between opposite remanent polarization states from 290% to 15% due to dynamic photovoltaic charge screening. In contrast, 530 nm illumination primarily induces charge redistribution in ferroelectrics via defect-state excitation, leading to a significantly weaker suppression of the resistance variation of graphene. These results establish practical guidelines for selecting photon energy and intensity to either preserve remanent polarization while tuning channel doping or deliberately reconfigure polarization through optical programming.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察铁电/石墨烯器件在 365 nm 和 530 nm 光照下的光电响应，以区分铁电偶极排列与外禀电流通道的影响。石墨烯作为高增益传感层，将细微极化动力学放大为明显电阻差异。结果表明，带隙以上光照通过动态光伏电荷屏蔽显著削弱相反剩余极化态之间的电阻比，而 530 nm 光照主要通过缺陷态激发引起较弱的电荷重分布效应。
authors: Krishna Prasad Maity, Mohd Uvais, Jean-Francois Dayen, Bernard Doudin, Roman Gumeniuk, Bohdan Kundys
articles.abstract_zh_full: 铁电体能够对二维覆盖层实现大幅电荷掺杂，但可开关和不可开关电荷动力学的共存使电光分析复杂化。在这里，我们研究铁电/石墨烯器件在 365 和 530 nm 光照下的光电子响应，将对铁电偶极排列的影响与外禀电流通道区分开来。石墨烯充当高增益传感器，将细微的极化动力学放大为显著的电阻差异。通过分辨暗态和光照条件下的可开关与不可开关通道，我们揭示了光伏电荷屏蔽与缺陷辅助激发之间的竞争，这种竞争支配器件静电学。带隙以上光照产生自由载流子，诱导漏电的铁电滞回，并由于动态光伏电荷屏蔽，将相反剩余极化态之间的石墨烯电阻比从 290% 抑制到 15%。相比之下，530 nm 光照主要通过缺陷态激发在铁电体中诱导电荷重分布，从而对石墨烯电阻变化产生显著较弱的抑制。这些结果为选择光子能量和强度提供了实用准则，可用于在调节沟道掺杂的同时保持剩余极化，或通过光学编程有意重构极化。

articles.title: Dispersive Shock Waves in a 1D Quantum Liquid
articles.title_zh: 一维量子液体中的色散冲击波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17668v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We implement a moving boundary condition in a 1D quantum liquid to study nonlinear wave breaking and its regularization by dispersion. Programmable optical potentials allow us to compress a weakly interacting ultra-cold Bose gas trapped on an atomchip at tunable speeds of up to three times the speed of sound and we subsequently measure the quasi-in-situ density distribution to extract the shock wave edge dynamics. We resolve both leading and trailing edge velocities and observe a shock wave width that increases linearly in time, which are distinguishing features of dispersive shock waves, consistent with asymptotic predictions using Whitham's method. Quantitative agreement is found with finite temperature non-polynomial Schrödinger equation simulations, taking into account the imaging process and the finite height of the piston potential. Our results constitute a controlled, quantitative test of dispersive shock dynamics in a 1D quantum fluid and demonstrate that the coarse-grained dispersive-shock phenomenology remains robust even as the microscopic dynamics depart from the strictly integrable 1D regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在一维量子液体中实现移动边界条件，用于研究非线性波破裂及其由色散导致的正规化。作者通过可编程光势以最高三倍声速压缩原子芯片上的弱相互作用超冷玻色气体，并测量准原位密度分布以提取冲击波边缘动力学。实验解析了前后边缘速度和线性增长的冲击波宽度，结果与 Whitham 方法和有限温度非多项式薛定谔方程模拟相符。
authors: Philipp Schüttelkopf, Mohammadamin Tajik, Federica Cataldini, Si-Cong Ji, Igor Mazets, Sebastian Erne, Nataliia Bazhan, Mojtaba Alyannezhadi, Mostafa Alyannezhadi, Jörg Schmiedmayer, Frederik Møller
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在一维量子液体中实现移动边界条件，以研究非线性波破裂及其由色散实现的正规化。可编程光势使我们能够以最高达到声速三倍的可调速度压缩限制在原子芯片上的弱相互作用超冷玻色气体，随后我们测量准原位密度分布以提取冲击波边缘动力学。我们解析了前沿和后沿速度，并观察到冲击波宽度随时间线性增加，这是色散冲击波的区别性特征，与使用 Whitham 方法得到的渐近预言一致。在考虑成像过程和活塞势有限高度后，结果与有限温度非多项式薛定谔方程模拟定量一致。我们的结果构成了对一维量子流体中色散冲击动力学的受控定量检验，并证明即使在微观动力学偏离严格可积一维区域时，粗粒化的色散冲击现象学仍保持稳健。

articles.title: Robust stabilization of high-frequency magnetic droplets in W-CoFeB-MgO nanoconstriction spin Hall nano-oscillators
articles.title_zh: W-CoFeB-MgO 纳米收缩自旋霍尔纳米振荡器中高频磁液滴的稳健稳定
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17677v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic droplets are highly nonlinear spin-wave solitons that can be excited in nanoscale spintronic devices with strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Although extensively studied in nanocontact-based spin-torque oscillators, their stabilization in pure spin current-driven devices such as spin Hall nano-oscillators (SHNOs) has remained elusive. Here, we micromagnetically demonstrate the robust stabilization of non-propagating high-frequency droplets in CMOS-compatible W/CoFeB/MgO nanoconstriction SHNOs under oblique magnetic fields. While the constriction geometry gives rise to noncircular droplet shapes in an inhomogeneous effective field landscape, stable droplet modes exhibiting complete core magnetization reversal and pronounced hysteresis are observed. At lower current densities, droplets display breathing oscillations with periodic expansion and contraction, whereas higher drive currents lead to drift, deformation, and the emergence of sidebands around the fundamental frequency. Tuning the strength and orientation of the applied magnetic field alters the effective field landscape, allowing droplets to escape confinement and propagate over distances exceeding 2μm.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过微磁模拟表明，在 CMOS 兼容的 W/CoFeB/MgO 纳米收缩自旋霍尔纳米振荡器中，可在倾斜磁场下稳健稳定非传播高频磁液滴。尽管纳米收缩几何和非均匀有效场导致液滴形状非圆，系统仍显示出完全核心磁化反转和明显滞回的稳定液滴模式。低电流下液滴出现呼吸振荡，高驱动电流则导致漂移、变形和边带出现；调节外磁场强度与方向还可使液滴逃逸束缚并长距离传播。
authors: Hind Prakash, Arunima TM, Roman Khymyn, Himanshu Fulara
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁液滴是高度非线性的自旋波孤子，可在具有强垂直磁各向异性的纳米尺度自旋电子器件中被激发。尽管它们已在基于纳米接触的自旋转移振荡器中得到广泛研究，但在由纯自旋流驱动的器件，如自旋霍尔纳米振荡器（SHNO）中实现其稳定化仍然困难。在这里，我们通过微磁模拟证明，在 CMOS 兼容的 W/CoFeB/MgO 纳米收缩 SHNO 中，在倾斜磁场下可稳健稳定非传播的高频液滴。尽管收缩几何在非均匀有效场景观中产生非圆形液滴形状，但仍可观察到表现出完整核心磁化反转和显著滞回的稳定液滴模式。在较低电流密度下，液滴表现出具有周期性扩张和收缩的呼吸振荡，而较高驱动电流会导致漂移、变形，并在基频周围出现边带。调节外加磁场的强度和方向会改变有效场景观，使液滴能够逃离束缚并传播超过 2 μm 的距离。

articles.title: Atomistic Structure Generation and Neural-Network Screening of Hard Carbons to Identify High-Capacity Sodium Storage
articles.title_zh: 硬碳的原子级结构生成与神经网络筛选：识别高容量钠储存材料
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17716v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hard carbons are established anodes for lithium-ion batteries and leading candidates for sodium-ion batteries, yet their electrochemical performance is governed by a heterogeneous network of graphitic domains, defects, and nanopores that conventional atomistic methods cannot model at the required length scales. We combine universal machine-learned interatomic potentials with the RAFFLE structure-generation framework to construct 13,096 realistic hard carbon models containing up to 4,378 atoms, matching experimentally measured densities, porosities, and sp²/sp³ bonding fractions. Explicit sodium intercalation of representative structures reproduces the characteristic sloping-to-plateau voltage profiles, revealing that capacity increases with decreasing carbon density and increasing porosity. To screen the full library, we train a lightweight neural-network surrogate that predicts capacity directly from the host using frozen universal-potential descriptors augmented by geometric void features. The surrogate identifies high-capacity candidates exceeding 800 mAh g⁻¹, which are validated by full intercalation calculations. This scalable framework links hard carbon microstructure to sodium-storage performance and provides atomistic design principles for high-capacity anodes. More broadly, the workflow enables systematic exploration of synthesis-dependent amorphous microstructures, including precursor chemistry, pyrolysis, heteroatom doping, and pore engineering, providing a route toward atomistically informed hard carbon design.
articles.abstract_zh: 硬碳是锂离子电池成熟负极，也是钠离子电池的重要候选材料，但其复杂微结构难以用常规原子级方法建模。作者结合通用机器学习原子间势与 RAFFLE 结构生成框架，构建了超过一万种真实硬碳模型，并通过显式钠嵌入与神经网络代理模型评估储钠容量。结果表明低密度、高孔隙率结构更有利于容量提升，并筛选出超过 800 mAh g⁻¹ 的高容量候选材料。该工作为硬碳微结构与钠储存性能之间建立了可扩展的原子级设计框架。
authors: Harry Mclean, Aiden Daniel Emery, Theodore Thomas Walton, Ned Thaddeus Taylor, Steven Paul Hepplestone
articles.abstract_zh_full: 硬碳是锂离子电池中已确立的负极材料，也是钠离子电池的主要候选材料，但其电化学性能受由石墨化域、缺陷和纳米孔组成的异质网络控制，而传统原子级方法无法在所需长度尺度上对其建模。我们将通用机器学习原子间势与 RAFFLE 结构生成框架相结合，构建了 13,096 个真实的硬碳模型，最多包含 4,378 个原子，并与实验测得的密度、孔隙率以及 sp²/sp³ 成键比例相匹配。对代表性结构进行显式钠嵌入再现了特征性的斜坡到平台电压曲线，揭示容量随碳密度降低和孔隙率增加而提高。为筛选完整结构库，我们训练了一个轻量级神经网络代理模型，利用冻结的通用势描述符并结合几何空隙特征，直接从宿主结构预测容量。该代理模型识别出容量超过 800 mAh g⁻¹ 的高容量候选材料，并通过完整嵌入计算得到验证。这个可扩展框架将硬碳微结构与钠储存性能联系起来，并为高容量负极提供了原子级设计原则。更广泛地说，该工作流程能够系统探索依赖合成条件的非晶微结构，包括前驱体化学、热解、杂原子掺杂和孔工程，为基于原子级认识的硬碳设计提供了途径。

articles.title: Vacancy-Driven Electronic Reconstruction in Monolayer PtSe₂: Formation Thermodynamics and Charge States
articles.title_zh: 单层 PtSe₂ 中空位驱动的电子重构：形成热力学与电荷态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered transition metal dichalcogenides are an important platform for two-dimensional materials, where the inevitable intrinsic defects provide new degrees of freedom for tuning their physical properties. Based on first-principles calculations, this work systematically investigates the formation energies, charge states, and electronic structural characteristics of VPₜ, VSₑ, and composite vacancies in monolayer PtSe₂. The results indicate that while vacancy formation energies are highly sensitive to chemical potentials, the VSₑ structure consistently exhibits the lowest formation energy. The charge defect calculation reveals the stable charge state intervals of VSₑ and VPₜ as a function of the Fermi level, thus describing the evolution of the charge states of intrinsic vacancies at different electronic chemical potentials. Climbing Image Nudged Elastic Band calculations reveal high migration barriers for VSₑ and VPₜ, indicating strongly hindered vacancy diffusion at room temperature, while short Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics simulations confirm the absence of immediate structural collapse within the simulated time window. Optical property calculations indicate that point defects significantly alter the dielectric response of monolayer PtSe₂ and generate new low-energy absorption channels associated with in-gap defect states. These findings provide new insights into defect-mediated electronic and optical property modulation in monolayer PtSe₂, offering guidance for its potential device design.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于第一性原理计算，研究系统分析了单层PtSe₂中Pt空位、Se空位及复合空位的形成能、电荷态和电子结构。Se空位在不同化学势条件下始终具有最低形成能，且两类主要空位在室温下的迁移均受到高能垒抑制。点缺陷会显著改变材料的介电响应，并通过带隙内缺陷态引入新的低能吸收通道。
authors: Xiwen Gai, Jingang Wang, Tianxing Ma
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层状过渡金属二硫族化物是二维材料的重要平台，其中不可避免的本征缺陷为调控其物理性质提供了新的自由度。基于第一性原理计算，本文系统研究了单层 PtSe₂ 中 VPₜ、VSₑ 和复合空位的形成能、电荷态及电子结构特征。结果表明，尽管空位形成能对化学势高度敏感，VSₑ 结构始终表现出最低的形成能。带电缺陷计算揭示了 VSₑ 和 VPₜ 的稳定电荷态区间随费米能级变化的情况，从而描述了不同电子化学势下本征空位电荷态的演化。攀爬图像弹性带计算显示 VSₑ 和 VPₜ 具有较高迁移势垒，表明室温下空位扩散受到强烈阻碍，而短时间从头算分子动力学模拟证实，在模拟时间窗口内未出现即时结构坍塌。光学性质计算表明，点缺陷显著改变单层 PtSe₂ 的介电响应，并产生与带隙内缺陷态相关的新低能吸收通道。这些发现为单层 PtSe₂ 中缺陷介导的电子和光学性质调控提供了新的认识，并为其潜在器件设计提供指导。
articles.focus_summary: 该文用第一性原理系统研究了单层 PtSe2 中空位缺陷的形成能、带电态、迁移势垒和电子结构。结果表明 Se 空位形成能最低，缺陷电荷态随费米能级变化明显，而较高的迁移势垒说明室温下空位扩散受限。短时 AIMD 还显示结构在模拟时间窗内没有立即坍塌。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在二维半导体缺陷、点缺陷热力学、带电缺陷和输运/光学性质方向高度相关，也符合缺陷物理的常见研究范式。其对缺陷形成、迁移与电荷态的联合分析可直接借鉴。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合非辐射复合、载流子俘获和缺陷补偿机制，评估这些空位对器件性能的实际影响。若要扩展，适合接入更长时间尺度的分子动力学或更精细的缺陷电荷修正。

articles.title: Bridging ambient- and high-pressure superconductivity in La₂LnNi₂O₇ films
articles.title_zh: 连接 La₂LnNi₂O₇ 薄膜中的常压与高压超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17745v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The discovery of high critical-temperature Tc superconductivity near 80 K in bilayer nickelates under high pressure has sparked extensive studies. While superconductivity exceeding 40 K was subsequently discovered at ambient pressure in compressively strained films, the relationship between ambient- and high-pressure regimes remains an open question. Here we present a systematic investigation of superconductivity in compressively strained La₂LnNi₂O₇ films (Ln = lanthanides) at ambient and high pressures. The normal-state resistivity at ambient pressure, revealed by suppressing superconductivity with magnetic fields of 59 T, tends toward T² behaviour. Under high pressure in a cubic-anvil cell, Tc was enhanced from 41-42 K at ambient pressure to 67-73 K at 16 GPa. On the other hand, lattice compression induced by Ln substitution, which may mimic effects of pressure, lowers Tc. In both cases, Tc correlates with the evolution of normal-state transport between T² and T-linear behaviour, offering insight into the interplay between lattice structure and superconductivity in bilayer nickelates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察了压缩应变 La₂LnNi₂O₇ 薄膜在常压和高压下的超导行为，旨在理解双层镍酸盐常压与高压超导之间的关系。通过高磁场抑制超导，作者发现常压正常态电阻率趋向 T² 行为；在高压下，Tc 从约 41-42 K 提升至 67-73 K。另一方面，由镧系元素替代引起的晶格压缩反而降低 Tc。结果表明 Tc 与正常态输运在 T² 与 T 线性行为之间的演化相关。
authors: Motoki Osada, Chieko Terakura, Shusaku Imajo, Jean-Baptiste Morée, Akiko Kikkawa, Masamichi Nakajima, Hsiao-Yi Chen, Yusuke Nomura, Koichi Kindo, Ryotaro Arita, Yoshinori Tokura, Atsushi Tsukazaki
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双层镍酸盐在高压下发现接近 80 K 的高临界温度 Tc 超导性，引发了广泛研究。尽管随后在压缩应变薄膜中于常压下发现了超过 40 K 的超导性，但常压与高压区域之间的关系仍是一个未解问题。在这里，我们对压缩应变 La₂LnNi₂O₇ 薄膜（Ln = 镧系元素）在常压和高压下的超导性进行了系统研究。通过 59 T 磁场抑制超导所揭示的常压正常态电阻率趋向 T² 行为。在立方砧高压装置中施加高压时，Tc 从常压下的 41-42 K 提高到 16 GPa 下的 67-73 K。另一方面，由 Ln 替代引起的晶格压缩可能模拟压力效应，却会降低 Tc。在两种情况下，Tc 均与正常态输运在 T² 和 T 线性行为之间的演化相关，为理解双层镍酸盐中晶格结构与超导性的相互作用提供了 insight。

articles.title: Rheology and Dynamic Arrest in Colloidal Depletion Gels Mediated by Surface Brush Density
articles.title_zh: 表面刷密度调控的胶体耗尽凝胶流变学与动力学冻结
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use the density of surface-grafted polymers as a geometry-preserving control parameter for tuning the rheology of colloidal depletion gels. Reducing brush density accelerates gelation and produces gels with higher plateau storage modulus and yield stress. This mechanical enhancement is not accompanied by increased local densification; low-brush networks exhibit lower average contact number and reduced spatial heterogeneity while displaying stronger elastic responses than their high-brush counterparts. Our findings demonstrate a reduced coordination threshold to form elastic nodes in the low-brush gel network. In addition, low-brush gels relax more slowly, accumulate less creep deformation, and exhibit lower effective noise temperatures within the Soft Glassy Rheology framework. These results establish surface-brush density as an experimentally accessible control parameter for colloidal depletion gel rheology with coupled changes in effective attraction, network architecture, and contact kinematics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以表面接枝聚合物密度作为不改变几何形貌的控制参数，调节胶体耗尽凝胶的流变性质。降低刷密度会加速凝胶化，并提高平台储能模量和屈服应力，但这种增强并不源于局部致密化增加。低刷密度网络表现出更低平均接触数、更低空间异质性和更强弹性响应，说明形成弹性节点所需配位阈值降低。结果确立了表面刷密度作为调控胶体耗尽凝胶力学行为的实验可及参数。
authors: Ziye Zhuang, Robert A. Campbell, Safa Jamali, Ali Mohraz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用表面接枝聚合物的密度作为保持几何形貌不变的控制参数，以调节胶体耗尽凝胶的流变学。降低刷密度会加速凝胶化，并产生具有更高平台储能模量和屈服应力的凝胶。这种力学增强并不伴随局部致密化增加；低刷密度网络表现出更低的平均接触数和降低的空间异质性，同时相比高刷密度对应物显示出更强的弹性响应。我们的发现表明，在低刷密度凝胶网络中形成弹性节点所需的配位阈值降低。此外，低刷密度凝胶弛豫更慢，累积的蠕变形变更少，并且在软玻璃流变学框架下表现出更低的有效噪声温度。这些结果确立了表面刷密度作为一种实验上可获得的控制参数，可用于调控胶体耗尽凝胶流变学，并伴随有效吸引、网络结构和接触运动学的耦合变化。

articles.title: Defect Geometry Selects Polar and Anomalous Hall Phases in Two-Dimensional Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 二维交替磁体中缺陷几何选择极性相与反常霍尔相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Point defects in altermagnets can create phases absent in the pristine host by selectively breaking crystal symmetries. Combining symmetry analysis, first-principles calculations, and Hamiltonian modeling, we identify how point impurities modify the altermagnetic phase. Using the pristine d- wave altermagnetic monolayer V2Se2O as a testbed, we identify three distinct classes of impurities: those that preserve spin-momentum locking, those that induce a hybrid-parity state associated with Edelstein spin conversion, and those that produce a metallic ferrimagnetic state with an anomalous Hall effect. We further discuss the robustness of two-dimensional altermagnets against point impurities. Results for other two-dimensional systems, such as Mn4N2 and 2H-FeBr3, reveal the same symmetry-based control across distinct lattices and parent spin harmonics, establishing defect geometry as a general route for engineering spin textures and transport properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，交替磁体中的点缺陷可通过选择性破坏晶体对称性，诱导洁净体系中不存在的相。作者结合对称性分析、第一性原理计算和哈密顿量建模，以 d 波交替磁性单层 V2Se2O 为例识别出三类杂质。不同杂质可分别保持自旋-动量锁定、诱导与 Edelstein 自旋转换相关的混合宇称态，或产生具有反常霍尔效应的金属亚铁磁态。结果说明缺陷几何是工程化二维交替磁体自旋纹理和输运性质的一般途径。
authors: Xujia Gong, Amar Fakhredine, Hosein Alavi-Rad, Mahyar Hassani-Vasmejani, Xing Ming, Xiangang Wan, Carmine Autieri, Meysam Bagheri Tagani, Sahar Izadi Vishkayi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体中的点缺陷可以通过选择性破坏晶体对称性，产生洁净母体中不存在的相。结合对称性分析、第一性原理计算和哈密顿量建模，我们识别了点杂质如何改变交替磁性相。以洁净的 d 波交替磁性单层 V2Se2O 作为测试平台，我们识别出三类不同杂质：保持自旋-动量锁定的杂质、诱导与 Edelstein 自旋转换相关的混合宇称态的杂质，以及产生具有反常霍尔效应的金属亚铁磁态的杂质。我们进一步讨论了二维交替磁体对点杂质的鲁棒性。对其他二维体系，如 Mn4N2 和 2H-FeBr3 的结果显示，在不同晶格和母体自旋谐波中也存在相同的基于对称性的控制，确立了缺陷几何作为工程化自旋纹理和输运性质的一般途径。

articles.title: Observation of magnetic quantum phase crossovers in a semiconductor spin ladder
articles.title_zh: 半导体自旋梯中磁性量子相交叉的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding collective phases of strongly correlated quantum magnets relies on theoretically tractable model systems with precise microscopic control. Antiferromagnetic spin ladders provide such a setting, hosting field-tunable gapped and gapless phases at half filling and unconventional pairing tendencies upon doping. Here, we realize a programmable Heisenberg spin ladder in a half-filled germanium quantum dot array featuring site-resolved, continuously tunable exchange interactions. Under a fixed magnetic field, we vary the rung and leg coupling to map the rung-singlet, canted antiferromagnetic, and fully polarized phases. Hamiltonian-learning protocols combining equilibrium and dynamical measurements quantitatively characterize the ladder, incorporating spin-orbit interactions to reproduce the observed crossover behavior. Measurements of higher-order spin correlators -- including four-point correlations inaccessible to conventional bulk probes -- reveal signatures of the underlying phase structure despite the finite size. Our results establish germanium quantum dot arrays as a controllable platform for quantum magnetism, opening routes to investigate unconventional superconductivity in doped ladders.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在半填充锗量子点阵列中实现了可编程的海森堡自旋梯，并观测磁性量子相之间的交叉行为。作者在固定磁场下调节横档和梯腿耦合，绘制出横档单重态、倾斜反铁磁态和完全极化相。结合平衡与动力学测量的哈密顿量学习协议定量表征了体系，并纳入自旋-轨道相互作用以解释观测到的交叉。高阶自旋关联测量进一步揭示了有限尺寸体系中的相结构特征。
authors: Elizaveta Morozova, Xin Zhang, Utso Bhattacharya, Pablo Cova Fariña, Daniel Jirovec, Alexander Nico-Katz, Stefan D. Oosterhout, Sougato Bose, Giordano Scappucci, Menno Veldhorst, Eugene Demler, Lieven M. K. Vandersypen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解强关联量子磁体的集体相依赖于理论上可处理且具有精确微观控制的模型体系。反铁磁自旋梯提供了这样的环境，在半填充时承载磁场可调的有能隙和无能隙相，并在掺杂后表现出非常规配对倾向。在这里，我们在半填充锗量子点阵列中实现了一个可编程海森堡自旋梯，其交换相互作用可按位点分辨并连续调节。在固定磁场下，我们改变横档和梯腿耦合，以绘制横档单重态、倾斜反铁磁态和完全极化相。结合平衡和动力学测量的哈密顿量学习协议对该自旋梯进行了定量表征，并纳入自旋-轨道相互作用以再现实验观测到的交叉行为。对高阶自旋关联的测量，包括传统体相探针无法获得的四点关联，尽管体系尺寸有限，仍揭示了底层相结构的特征。我们的结果确立了锗量子点阵列作为量子磁性的可控平台，并为研究掺杂自旋梯中的非常规超导性开辟了路径。

articles.title: The Deformed Image Vortex Ansatz: A Perturbation-Aware Description of Magnetic Vortices in In-Plane Fields
articles.title_zh: 形变镜像涡旋 Ansatz：面内磁场中磁涡旋的扰动感知描述
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17840v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thiele-based descriptions of magnetic vortex dynamics in thin ferromagnetic nanodots rely on magnetization ansätze that describe the equilibrium texture but cannot represent perturbation-induced deformations. We introduce the Deformed Image Vortex Ansatz (DIVA): a perturbation-aware ansatz in which the response to an external perturbation is built into the magnetization profile itself, rather than appended to the dynamics as a correction. Here, we demonstrate the concept for a uniform, stationary in-plane field applied to a Permalloy nanodot, for which the deformation is analytically tractable. A symmetry-based perturbative expansion identifies the leading deformation as a single m = 1 harmonic around the disk, while energy minimization and a dominant-balance analysis yield a closed-form interpolant for the radial profile. Benchmarked against micromagnetic simulations on Permalloy disks of aspect ratio t/R = 0.1 and 0.0125, this realization reduces the disk-averaged angular deviation by a factor of 3 to 6 relative to the two-vortex ansatz, depending on geometry and field, and reduces the total-energy deviation by about a factor of six in the thicker disk.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出形变镜像涡旋 Ansatz（DIVA），用于描述薄铁磁纳米圆盘中受扰动影响的磁涡旋结构。与传统仅描述平衡织构的 Ansatz 不同，DIVA 将外部扰动响应直接内置于磁化轮廓中。作者以 Permalloy 纳米圆盘中的均匀静态面内磁场为例，解析构造主要形变并与微磁模拟对比。结果显示，相比双涡旋 Ansatz，该方法显著降低角偏差和能量偏差。
authors: Thomas G. Coppée, Colin Ducarme, Simon de Wergifosse, Flavio Abreu Araujo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于Thiele理论的薄铁磁纳米圆点磁涡旋动力学描述依赖于能够刻画平衡磁织构、却无法表示扰动诱导形变的磁化试探函数。我们提出形变像涡旋试探函数（DIVA）：这是一种具有扰动感知能力的试探函数，其中对外部扰动的响应被内建于磁化剖面本身，而不是作为修正项附加到动力学中。本文以施加于坡莫合金纳米圆点的均匀、静态面内磁场为例展示这一概念，在该情形下形变可进行解析处理。基于对称性的微扰展开表明，主导形变是圆盘周向上的单一m=1谐波；能量最小化和主导平衡分析则给出了径向剖面的闭式插值表达。通过与厚径比t/R=0.1和0.0125的坡莫合金圆盘微磁模拟进行基准比较，这一实现相较于双涡旋试探函数，可将圆盘平均角度偏差降低3至6倍，具体取决于几何构型和磁场；对于较厚圆盘，还可将总能量偏差降低约6倍。

articles.title: Energy-efficient, Reconfigurable Optoelectronic Artificial Synapses Based on MoWS₂ Alloy for Pattern Recognition and Color Image Filtering Applications
articles.title_zh: 基于 MoWS₂ 合金的节能可重构光电子人工突触用于模式识别与彩色图像滤波
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18013v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenide alloys are potential candidates for advanced optoelectronic and neuromorphic applications due to their strong light-matter interactions and controllable defect properties. However, large-area growth of such alloys remains challenging, while the correlation between their physical and neuromorphic properties remains largely unclear. In this work, we present an innovative microcavity chemical vapor deposition (CVD) reactor pathway to grow uniform, and large-area MoWS₂ mono- and few-layer alloy films for demonstrating optoelectronic synaptic functionalities. Driven by growth-induced intrinsic sulfur vacancies, as confirmed by XPS, KPFM, and STEM measurements, our optoelectronic synaptic device (OSD) successfully emulates essential biological synaptic features, such as excitatory postsynaptic currents (EPSC), paired-pulse facilitation (PPF~170%), and stimulus-dependent short- and long-term plasticities (STP & LTP). With picojoule-order energy consumption per synaptic event and nanoampere-order dark current, the device enables low-power neuromorphic learning, including emulation of Pavlovian associative learning. Furthermore, the experimentally measured conductance weight-update characteristics enabled an artificial neural network (ANN) simulation to achieve 92.43% recognition accuracy on the MNIST handwritten digit dataset. Finally, we demonstrate advanced neuromorphic visual processing by executing color image filtering based on the device's wavelength-selective photoresponse characteristics. This simple, yet multifunctional device architecture provides a promising path toward energy-efficient, spectral-selective neuromorphic vision applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种微腔化学气相沉积路径，用于生长均匀大面积 MoWS₂ 单层和少层合金薄膜，并展示其光电子突触功能。由生长诱导的硫空位驱动，该器件可模拟兴奋性突触后电流、双脉冲易化以及短期和长期可塑性等生物突触特征。器件具有皮焦量级能耗和纳安量级暗电流，并在 MNIST 识别和波长选择性彩色图像滤波中表现出应用潜力。该架构为低功耗、光谱选择性神经形态视觉提供了可行路径。
authors: Deepak Kumar Sahu, Santu Kumar Ghosh, Sagarneel Ghoshal, Saranya Das, Samit K. Ray
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维过渡金属二硫族化物合金因其强光-物质相互作用和可控缺陷性质，是先进光电子和神经形态应用的潜在候选材料。然而，此类合金的大面积生长仍具有挑战性，而其物理性质与神经形态性质之间的关联在很大程度上仍不清楚。在本工作中，我们提出一种创新的微腔化学气相沉积（CVD）反应器路径，用于生长均匀、大面积的 MoWS₂ 单层和少层合金薄膜，并展示光电子突触功能。由生长诱导的本征硫空位驱动，并经 XPS、KPFM 和 STEM 测量证实，我们的光电子突触器件（OSD）成功模拟了基本生物突触特征，如兴奋性突触后电流（EPSC）、双脉冲易化（PPF 约 170%）以及刺激依赖的短期和长期可塑性（STP 和 LTP）。凭借每次突触事件皮焦量级的能耗和纳安量级暗电流，该器件实现了低功耗神经形态学习，包括对巴甫洛夫联想学习的模拟。此外，实验测得的电导权重更新特性使人工神经网络（ANN）模拟在 MNIST 手写数字数据集上达到 92.43% 的识别准确率。最后，我们基于器件的波长选择性光响应特性执行彩色图像滤波，展示了先进的神经形态视觉处理能力。这种简单而多功能的器件架构为节能、光谱选择性神经形态视觉应用提供了一条有前景的路径。

articles.title: Electronic Reconstruction at the Quasicrystal-Moiré Crossover in Twisted Bilayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: 扭转双层石墨烯中准晶-莫尔交叉处的电子重构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18052v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large twist angles in twisted bilayer graphene are widely expected to be electronically trivial, with negligible interlayer coupling and no electronic reconstruction, in contrast to the rich moiré-driven band reconstruction and correlated physics that emerge at small twist angles. Here, we show that this paradigm breaks down near a twist angle of 29deg, where the system crosses over between quasicrystalline and commensurate order. Atomic-resolution transmission electron microscopy directly reveals the coexistence of near-dodecagonal quasicrystalline symmetry and emerging moiré periodicity, indicating an intermediate, nonperiodic structural regime. Magnetotransport measurements uncover strong interlayer hybridization mediated by Umklapp scattering, manifested by magneto-intersubband oscillations and a highly unconventional Landau-level spectrum. Remarkably, the Landau-level degeneracy evolves from 4- to 12-fold with increasing temperature, a behavior incompatible with two decoupled graphene monolayers. These findings establish large-angle twisted bilayer graphene as a platform where quasiperiodic symmetry fundamentally reshapes low-energy electronic states beyond the conventional moiré framework.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究发现，在约29°的大扭角扭转双层石墨烯中，传统上认为可忽略的层间耦合会导致显著电子重构。原子分辨透射电子显微镜揭示了近十二重准晶对称性与新生莫尔周期性的共存，磁输运则显示出由Umklapp散射介导的强层间杂化。朗道能级简并度随温度从4重演化至12重，表明准周期对称性能从根本上重塑低能电子态。
authors: Kuo-En Chang, Aitor Garcia-Ruiz, Ta-Lei Chou, Yen-Ting Liu, Sheng-Chin Ho, Yu-Chiang Hsieh, Ching-Hua Kao, Chiu-Hua Huang, Ying-Mei Yang, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Ming-Wen Chu, Ming-Hao Liu, Tse-Ming Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 大扭角扭转双层石墨烯通常被广泛认为在电子性质上是平庸的，具有可忽略的层间耦合且没有电子重构，这与小扭角下由丰富莫尔效应驱动的能带重构和关联物理形成对比。在这里，我们表明这一范式在约 29 度扭角附近失效，此时体系在准晶有序与公度有序之间发生交叉。原子分辨透射电子显微镜直接揭示了近十二重准晶对称性与新生莫尔周期性的共存，表明存在一个中间的非周期结构区域。磁输运测量发现由 Umklapp 散射介导的强层间杂化，表现为磁子带间振荡和高度非常规的朗道能级谱。值得注意的是，朗道能级简并度随温度升高从 4 重演化为 12 重，这一行为与两个解耦的石墨烯单层不相容。这些发现确立了大角度扭转双层石墨烯作为一个平台，其中准周期对称性从根本上重塑了超出传统莫尔框架的低能电子态。

articles.title: Quantum Geometric Tensor Preconditioning for Stable Training of Recurrent Neural Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 用于循环神经量子态稳定训练的量子几何张量预条件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18065v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Neural Quantum States (NQS) provide a powerful neural network-based variational framework for representing many-body wave functions and solving for ground states. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) are particularly promising owing to their relatively low computational cost and their autoregressive property, which enables perfect sampling. Recently, RNNs have been reported to be unstable under curvature-based optimizers such as the minimum-step stochastic reconfiguration (minSR) method. In this paper, we address this perceived limitation and show that minSR can be stabilized through simple regularization techniques, enabling robust training of RNN-based NQS with only a few samples. Our approach outperforms the Adam optimizer on the one-dimensional transverse-field Ising model and the one-dimensional cluster state, and provides competitive results on the two-dimensional Heisenberg and J₁₋J₂ models. This work offers a promising pathway for using modern optimization techniques with autoregressive NQS to address open questions in quantum simulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对循环神经网络形式的神经量子态在曲率优化器下训练不稳定的问题，展示了通过简单正则化稳定最小步随机重构方法的可行性。作者表明，该方法可在少量样本下稳健训练 RNN 基神经量子态。其在一维横场 Ising 模型和一维簇态上优于 Adam 优化器，并在二维 Heisenberg 与 J₁-J₂ 模型上取得有竞争力结果。该工作为将现代优化技术用于自回归神经量子态提供了路径。
authors: Adil Attar, Amine M. Aboussalah, Mohamed Hibat-Allah
articles.abstract_zh_full: 神经量子态（NQS）为表示多体波函数和求解基态提供了一种强大的基于神经网络的变分框架。循环神经网络（RNN）由于其相对较低的计算成本和自回归性质而尤其有前景，后者能够实现完美采样。最近，有报道称 RNN 在基于曲率的优化器，如最小步随机重构（minSR）方法下不稳定。在本文中，我们针对这一被认为的局限性展开研究，并表明 minSR 可以通过简单的正则化技术得到稳定，从而能够仅用少量样本稳健训练基于 RNN 的 NQS。我们的方法在一维横场 Ising 模型和一维簇态上优于 Adam 优化器，并在二维 Heisenberg 和 J₁-J₂ 模型上提供了有竞争力的结果。这项工作为将现代优化技术与自回归 NQS 结合以解决量子模拟中的开放问题提供了一条有前景的路径。

articles.title: Composite worldline instantons and the nonperturbative particle decay in constant external electric and magnetic fields
articles.title_zh: 复合世界线瞬子与恒定外部电磁场中的非微扰粒子衰变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.12083v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we discuss the validity of the composite worldline instanton approach for the nonperturbative decay of charged particles in constant electric and magnetic fields. It is shown that the instanton results in the leading exponential approximation in the different limits agree with the ones obtained by the imaginary part of the self-energy in the external field and by overlap of the wave functions. We comment on the possible application of our results for the estimation of the decay rate of the proton in the external electric and magnetic field in the leading exponential approximation. The effects of entanglement of the particles in the final state are briefly mentioned.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文讨论复合世界线瞬子方法在恒定电场和磁场中描述带电粒子非微扰衰变的有效性。作者表明，在不同极限下，该方法给出的主导指数近似与外场中自能虚部和波函数重叠方法的结果一致。文章还讨论了这些结果用于估计外部电磁场中质子衰变率的可能应用，并简要提及末态粒子纠缠效应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本文中，我们讨论复合世界线瞬子方法对于恒定电场和磁场中带电粒子非微扰衰变的有效性。结果表明，在不同极限下，瞬子方法在主导指数近似中得到的结果，与通过外场中自能虚部以及波函数重叠所获得的结果一致。我们评论了将我们的结果用于在主导指数近似下估计外部电场和磁场中质子衰变率的可能应用。文中还简要提到了末态粒子纠缠的影响。

articles.title: Bulk Criticality and Boundary Spectra in AdS from Matrix Product States
articles.title_zh: 矩阵乘积态方法研究AdS中的体临界性与边界谱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.16992v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study interacting scalar quantum field theories in anti-de Sitter (AdS) space using a tensor-network approach based on matrix product states. We develop methods for extracting low-lying boundary spectra from global-AdS energy levels, probing bulk criticality through finite-size scaling in the AdS radius, and identifying conformal boundary conditions. Applying these methods to scalar φ⁴ theory in AdS₂, we compute the lowest non-trivial Z₂₋ₒdd and even boundary scaling dimensions non-perturbatively. We then locate the bulk Z₂ symmetry-breaking transition and extract critical exponents and central charge consistent with the 2D Ising universality class.
