These results demonstrate clear differences between the locally and globally probed magnetic textures, typically assumed to be representative of the system as a whole, highlighting the importance of spatially-resolved probes for accurately describing the magnetic behavior of this class of materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用共振弹性X射线散射研究Eu(Al₀.₄Ga₀.₆)₄零场磁自旋织构的不均匀性。空间分辨结果显示，两个磁转变来自两组近简并但不同的正交q矢量对，并对应空间分离的自旋密度波区域和螺旋区域。研究强调局域探针与整体探针得到的磁织构可能显著不同，空间分辨测量对于准确描述此类材料至关重要。
authors: Fellipe B. Carneiro, Zéetény Bacsó, Kevin Allen, Aly H. Abdeldaim, Rebecca Scatena, Jaime M. Moya, Roger D. Johnson, Emilia Morosan, Alessandro Bombardi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这里，我们利用共振弹性X射线散射（REXS）研究Eu(Al₀.₄Ga₀.₆)₄零场磁自旋织构的不均匀性。通过使用空间分辨REXS，我们表明TN₁=17 K和TN₂=14 K处的两个磁转变源自两组近乎简并但彼此不同的正交q矢量对。相应相在空间上发生分离，使得样品的一部分包含共存的正交自旋密度波畴，而另一部分则承载共存的正交螺旋畴。此外，螺旋态形成反演畴，表明反演对称性在磁转变之前并未被破缺。我们的结果表明磁态是单q态，并揭示了样品表面0.8–1 mm区域内自旋织构存在很大变化。这些结果显示出局域探测和整体探测的磁织构之间存在明显差异，而后者通常被假定为能够代表整个体系；这突出了空间分辨探针对于准确描述此类材料磁行为的重要性。

articles.title: Competition between local magnetic disorder and altermagnetism in doped FeSb₂
articles.title_zh: 掺杂FeSb₂中局域磁无序与交替磁性的竞争
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11089v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experimental reports suggest that the narrow-gap nonmagnetic semiconductor FeSb₂ can be transformed into an altermagnetic metal through Co doping (Co₀.₁₅Fe₀.₈₅Sb₂₎, or into a magnetically disordered or short-range-ordered state through Cr doping (Cr₀.₁₅Fe₀.₈₅Sb₂₎. Here we explore the energy landscape and magnetic states of these doped systems from first principles, relying on Hubbard-augmented density-functional theory (DFT+U) combined with the Romeo ground-state search algorithm. Within the established virtual-crystal approximation (VCA), we show that textttRomeo finds several non-trivial magnetic states, which inform targeted explicit simulations of doping in supercells. We rely on these findings to discuss strengths and limitations of the VCA-Romeo approach versus the explicit-doping supercell approach, and how they can be used in synergy. Overall, our simulations suggest that the ground state of the Cr-doped system is a Locally Disordered Spin-Compensated (LDSC) configuration, formally compatible with Néel's L-type fully compensated ferrimagnetism, whereas the ground state of the Co-doped system is found to be altermagnetic (AFMo). This work shows how approximate and explicit simulations of magnetic alloys can be mutually informative, and establishes a protocol for studying candidate metallic altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从第一性原理研究Co或Cr掺杂FeSb₂中的能量景观和磁态，以解释实验中由掺杂诱导的交替磁金属或磁无序状态。作者结合DFT+U与Romeo基态搜索算法，并比较虚晶近似与显式掺杂超胞方法。模拟表明Cr掺杂体系基态为局域无序自旋补偿构型，而Co掺杂体系基态为交替磁态，并提出了研究候选金属交替磁体的计算流程。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期实验报道表明，窄带隙非磁性半导体FeSb₂可通过Co掺杂（Co₀.₁₅Fe₀.₈₅Sb₂）转变为交替磁金属，或通过Cr掺杂（Cr₀.₁₅Fe₀.₈₅Sb₂）转变为磁无序或短程有序状态。在这里，我们依托Hubbard修正的密度泛函理论（DFT+U）并结合Romeo基态搜索算法，从第一性原理探索这些掺杂体系的能量景观和磁态。在既有的虚晶近似（VCA）框架内，我们表明Romeo能够找到若干非平庸磁态，这些结果为超胞中有针对性的显式掺杂模拟提供了指导。我们依托这些发现讨论VCA-Romeo方法与显式掺杂超胞方法各自的优势和局限，以及它们如何协同使用。总体而言，我们的模拟表明，Cr掺杂体系的基态是局域无序自旋补偿（LDSC）构型，在形式上与Néel的L型完全补偿亚铁磁性相容；而Co掺杂体系的基态被发现为交替磁态（AFMo）。本工作展示了磁性合金的近似模拟和显式模拟如何相互提供信息，并建立了研究候选金属交替磁体的流程。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文利用 DFT+U 结合 Romeo 基态搜索算法研究 Co 和 Cr 掺杂 FeSb2 中的磁性基态与能量景观。结果表明 Cr 掺杂体系倾向于局域无序自旋补偿态，而 Co 掺杂体系可能形成交替磁性金属态，并比较了虚晶近似与显式掺杂超胞方法的优缺点。
articles.focus_relation: 该工作与我们的交替磁性、磁性材料第一性原理、非平庸磁序搜索和掺杂调控磁态方向直接相关。其对局域磁无序和交替磁性竞争的处理方式，可借鉴到复杂磁性材料的自旋哈密顿量构建和高通量筛选中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步跟进其磁各向异性、自旋分裂能带、输运响应和可能的自旋流特性计算。建议比较不同 U 值、显式无序构型和磁交换参数对交替磁性稳定性的影响。

articles.title: Tunable chiral anomaly in electron magnetotransport in the Weyl semimetallic Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe:Cr alloy
articles.title_zh: Weyl半金属Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe:Cr合金中电子磁输运的可调手征反常
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11148v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study magnetotransport properties of semiconductor substitutional alloy Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe, known to exhibit Sn-content dependent properties of topological crystalline insulators with a semimetallic zero-gap state at a specific band inversion point. We experimentally verify the theoretically predicted role of chemical disorder in this multivalley electron system, which leads to sequential band inversions in various valleys and places the Fermi level close to the pairs of Weyl nodes, as identified in the density functional theory calculations. Doping with mixed-valence Cr resonant impurities enables exploitation of the unique properties of dopant resonant states, which provide an effective means of tuning carrier concentration. The combination of these two effects results in the pinning of the Fermi level in the vicinity of the nodal touching points across a wide range of composition. To address the above issues, we grow Bridgman bulk crystals of Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe heavily doped with chromium and covering the full range of tin (0 łeq x łeq 1), i.e. spanning both the topological crystalline insulator and trivial electronic regimes. We observe the emergence of the three dimensional (3D) Weyl semimetal phase over a range of Sn compositions, namely for 0.25 < x < 0.45. We provide magnetotransport evidence for this and verify the relationship between the magnitude of the experimentally determined Berry curvature and the electrical properties of these materials. Quantum transport regime observed in magnetoresistance is also independently confirmed by thermal conductivity measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了重掺Cr的Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe体晶在全Sn组分范围内的磁输运性质。结果表明，在0.25 < x < 0.45范围内出现三维Weyl半金属相，且Cr共振杂质与化学无序共同使费米能级钉扎在节点接触点附近。作者通过磁输运与热导率测量验证量子输运特征，并关联了Berry曲率大小与电学性质。
authors: A. Królicka, E. Łusakowska, M. Matusiak, A. Mirowska, A. Łusakowski, T. Story, K. Dybko
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了半导体置换合金Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe的磁输运性质，该材料已知表现出依赖Sn含量的拓扑晶体绝缘体性质，并在特定能带反转点处具有半金属性零带隙态。我们通过实验验证了理论预言的化学无序在这一多谷电子体系中的作用：化学无序导致不同谷中的能带依次反转，并使费米能级靠近Weyl节点对，这一点已在密度泛函理论计算中得到识别。采用混合价Cr共振杂质进行掺杂，使得能够利用掺杂剂共振态的独特性质，从而提供一种调控载流子浓度的有效手段。这两种效应的结合导致费米能级在宽组分范围内被钉扎在节点接触点附近。为了解决上述问题，我们生长了采用Bridgman法制备的、重掺铬且覆盖完整锡含量范围（0 ≤ x ≤ 1）的Pb₁₋ₓSnₓTe体晶，即跨越拓扑晶体绝缘体和普通电子态区域。我们观察到三维（3D）Weyl半金属相在一定Sn组分范围内出现，即0.25 < x < 0.45。我们提供了支持这一结论的磁输运证据，并验证了实验确定的Berry曲率大小与这些材料电学性质之间的关系。磁阻中观察到的量子输运区域也通过热导率测量得到了独立确认。

articles.title: Floquet Engineering of Topological Phases and Magneto-Optical Response in a Driven d-wave Altermagnet
articles.title_zh: 受驱d波交错磁体中拓扑相与磁光响应的Floquet工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how Floquet driving with linearly polarized light controls the topology and magneto-optical response of a two-dimensional (2D) d-wave altermagnet. In the absence of linearly polarized optical field and under spin conservation, we find that the system hosts a spin-Chern (a quantum-spin-Hall analog) phase with Chern numbers of opposite sign in the two spin sectors. The irradiated optical field breaks the C₄zT crystalline antiunitary symmetry between the spin sectors. Symmetry breaking originates from polarization-dependent Peierls phases, which renormalize hopping anisotropically along the two axes. The resulting spin-selective gap closures produce intermediate Chern-insulating phases with C=±1. The drive amplitude A₀ determines the inversion thresholds, while rotating the polarization by π/2 swaps the spin sectors and reverses the Chern number. Using the Kubo formalism, we compute the frequency-dependent longitudinal and Hall conductivities and derive the corresponding Faraday and Kerr rotations for a free-standing conducting sheet. The longitudinal response tracks the Floquet-renormalized interband thresholds, whereas the optical Hall response, together with the sign of the magneto-optical rotations, distinguishes the two opposite Berry-curvature chiralities. Sizable Kerr angles occur only within narrow resonant windows and should be interpreted together with the reflected intensity and Kerr ellipticity. These results identify linearly polarized light as a symmetry-selective handle for spin-resolved band inversion, Chern-number switching, and contact-free optical detection in d-wave altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究线偏振光Floquet驱动如何调控二维d波交错磁体的拓扑和磁光响应。无光场时体系具有自旋Chern相，而驱动通过偏振相关Peierls相破坏晶体反幺正对称性，引发自旋选择性能隙闭合和C=±1的Chern绝缘相。作者进一步用Kubo形式计算光电导、Faraday和Kerr旋转，指出线偏振光可用于自旋分辨能带反转、Chern数切换及无接触光学探测。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了线偏振光Floquet驱动如何控制二维（2D）d波交错磁体的拓扑和磁光响应。在不存在线偏振光场且自旋守恒的情况下，我们发现该体系承载一种自旋Chern相（量子自旋Hall类似相），其中两个自旋扇区具有符号相反的Chern数。照射的光场破坏了自旋扇区之间的C₄zT晶体反幺正对称性。对称性破缺源于偏振依赖的Peierls相，它们沿两个轴向各向异性地重整化跃迁。由此产生的自旋选择性能隙闭合会形成具有C=±1的中间Chern绝缘相。驱动振幅A₀决定反转阈值，而将偏振旋转π/2会交换自旋扇区并反转Chern数。利用Kubo形式体系，我们计算了频率依赖的纵向电导和Hall电导，并推导了自由悬置导电薄片相应的Faraday旋转和Kerr旋转。纵向响应追踪Floquet重整化的带间跃迁阈值，而光学Hall响应以及磁光旋转的符号则区分两种相反的Berry曲率手性。显著的Kerr角只出现在狭窄的共振窗口内，并应与反射强度和Kerr椭圆率一起加以解释。这些结果表明，线偏振光是一种具有对称性选择性的调控手段，可用于d波交错磁体中的自旋分辨能带反转、Chern数切换以及非接触式光学探测。

articles.title: Exact First-Passage Time Response Theory from Steady-State Response
articles.title_zh: 由稳态响应导出的精确首达时间响应理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11202v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The mean first-passage time (MFPT) provides a universal temporal measure of transport, reaction, search, and switching processes in physical, chemical, and biological systems. Understanding how MFPTs respond to perturbations is therefore crucial for prediction and control, yet a systematic theory has been lacking. We establish a compact theoretical framework for linear and nonlinear MFPT response in continuous-time Markov processes. The key tool is an exact correspondence that maps the intrinsically transient response of MFPTs onto the steady-state response of an auxiliary system. This correspondence yields exact and universal response relations for MFPTs between arbitrary state pairs, expressed entirely in terms of unperturbed MFPTs and steady-state probabilities. We then obtain a factorized physical decomposition of the MFPT response into linear upstream, linear downstream, and nonlinear contributions. Further corollaries include response-curve inference rules, fundamental bounds on MFPT responses, analytical expressions for higher-order responses of MFPTs and steady-state probabilities, and multi-rate response formulas. Additionally, our result offers computational advantages in calculating both MFPTs and steady-state distributions. Finally, a biologically motivated folding network is analyzed, and a recently reported paradox on MFPT is clarified.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文为连续时间Markov过程中的平均首达时间响应建立了线性与非线性的统一理论框架。核心结果是将本质上瞬态的MFPT响应精确映射到辅助系统的稳态响应，从而得到普适响应关系。作者进一步给出物理分解、响应界限、高阶响应和多速率公式，并用生物折叠网络澄清了近期关于MFPT的一个悖论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平均首达时间（MFPT）为物理、化学和生物系统中的输运、反应、搜索以及切换过程提供了一种普适的时间度量。因此，理解MFPT如何响应扰动对于预测和控制至关重要，然而此前一直缺乏系统理论。我们为连续时间Markov过程中的线性和非线性MFPT响应建立了一个紧凑的理论框架。关键工具是一种精确对应关系，它将MFPT本质上瞬态的响应映射到辅助系统的稳态响应。这一对应关系给出了任意状态对之间MFPT的精确且普适的响应关系，并且这些关系完全用未扰动MFPT和稳态概率表示。随后，我们得到了一种因子化的物理分解，将MFPT响应分解为线性上游贡献、线性下游贡献和非线性贡献。进一步的推论包括响应曲线推断规则、MFPT响应的基本界限、MFPT和稳态概率高阶响应的解析表达式，以及多速率响应公式。此外，我们的结果在计算MFPT和稳态分布方面也具有计算优势。最后，我们分析了一个受生物学启发的折叠网络，并澄清了近期报道的一个关于MFPT的悖论。

articles.title: MEDA: Measurement-Efficient Disorder-Aware Majorana Zero Mode Detection in Realistic Devices
articles.title_zh: MEDA：面向真实器件的测量高效、无序感知Majorana零模探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.26208v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Fault-tolerant topological quantum computing relies on identifying Majorana zero modes (MZMs), but reliable detection in realistic devices remains challenging. Conventional topological indicators are inherently biased in finite, disordered systems, blurring the distinction between true MZMs and trivial states. Furthermore, attempts to map these indicators to real observables via machine learning require dense, expensive conductance measurements, creating a severe scaling bottleneck. To simultaneously address topological bias and measurement limitations, we present MEDA: a Measurement-Efficient, Disorder-Aware framework for MZM detection in realistic devices. MEDA maps sparse, practically obtainable observables directly to the robust periodic disorder invariant (PDI). Using a novel sparse parameter regime, MEDA reduces measurement volume by 10x while maintaining predictive quality, even in moderate to strong disorder regimes that limit conventional methods. Furthermore, MEDA naturally prioritizes input features consistent with the topological gap protocol, demonstrating strong physical interpretability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出MEDA框架，用于在有限且无序的真实器件中更可靠地探测Majorana零模。MEDA直接将稀疏、实验上可获得的观测量映射到稳健的周期无序不变量，从而同时缓解拓扑指标偏差和测量规模瓶颈。结果显示，该方法可将测量量减少10倍，并在中强无序下保持预测质量和良好的物理可解释性。
authors: Nathan Jones, Binayyak Roy, Valentine Mohaugen, Ian Lewis, Toby Cox, Sumanta Tewari, Rong Ge
articles.abstract_zh_full: 容错拓扑量子计算依赖于识别Majorana零模（MZMs），但在真实器件中进行可靠探测仍然具有挑战性。传统拓扑指标在有限、无序系统中存在内在偏差，从而模糊了真实MZM与平庸态之间的区分。此外，试图通过机器学习将这些指标映射到真实可观测量，需要密集且昂贵的电导测量，从而造成严重的可扩展性瓶颈。为同时解决拓扑偏差和测量限制，我们提出MEDA：一种面向真实器件中MZM探测的测量高效、无序感知框架。MEDA将稀疏且实际可获得的观测量直接映射到稳健的周期无序不变量（PDI）。利用一种新的稀疏参数区域，MEDA将测量量减少了10倍，同时即使在限制传统方法的中等到强无序区域中也能保持预测质量。此外，MEDA自然优先选择与拓扑能隙协议一致的输入特征，显示出很强的物理可解释性。

articles.title: Global Non-Identifiability of Fubini-Study Geometry from Complete One-Period Endpoint Data
articles.title_zh: 无法从完整单周期端点数据全局辨识Fubini-Study几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10051v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We establish a global, worst-case non-identifiability theorem for periodically driven finite-dimensional quantum systems. On the unrestricted smooth periodic Hamiltonian class, we show that the period-averaged Fubini-Study metric component of a fixed initial state cannot, in general, be reconstructed from exact one-period propagators indexed by every starting time and external parameter. Thus, even complete starting-time-resolved endpoint data are insufficient to determine this intra-period geometric quantity. The obstruction is characterized exactly. The starting-time-indexed endpoint data determine the conjugation path of the monodromy, but not its particular unitary lift. On each fixed-monodromy slice, the observational fibres are precisely the right orbits generated by smooth parameter-dependent based loops taking values in the pointwise centralizer of the monodromy. The Fubini-Study functional is not invariant under this fibre action and therefore does not factor through the endpoint observation map. An explicit real-analytic two-level witness demonstrates the obstruction within a commuting, one-generator Hamiltonian family, so neither non-Abelian time ordering nor Floquet-logarithm ambiguity is required. A continuous family of Hamiltonians produces identical starting-time-indexed one-period endpoint data while yielding different, and on the unrestricted class arbitrarily separated, period-averaged Fubini-Study geometry. Non-identifiability persists under any prescribed uniform bound on the parameter derivative of the Hamiltonian. The result is a deterministic global statement, not a claim of generic non-identifiability or experimental impossibility. It identifies a precise information gap between complete one-period endpoint data and full intra-period dynamics: the missing information is the unitary lift of the observed monodromy path rather than ordinary scalar phase freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文证明了周期驱动有限维量子系统中的一个全局最坏情形不可辨识定理。即使已知所有起始时间和外部参数标记的精确单周期传播子，也通常不能重构固定初态的周期平均Fubini-Study度量分量。作者精确刻画了阻碍来源：端点数据确定的是单值矩阵的共轭路径，而非其特定酉提升。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为周期驱动的有限维量子系统建立了一个全局的最坏情形不可辨识定理。在不受限制的光滑周期Hamilton量类上，我们证明，对于一个固定初始态，其周期平均Fubini-Study度量分量一般不能从由每个起始时间和外部参数标记的精确单周期传播子中重构出来。因此，即便是完整的、分辨起始时间的端点数据，也不足以确定这一周期内几何量。该阻碍被精确刻画。以起始时间为索引的端点数据确定了单值矩阵的共轭路径，但并不确定其特定的酉提升。在每个固定单值矩阵切片上，观测纤维恰好是由光滑的、依赖参数的基点环生成的右轨道，这些环取值于单值矩阵的逐点中心化子。Fubini-Study泛函在这一纤维作用下并不不变，因此不能通过端点观测映射分解。一个显式的实解析二能级见证例子在一个对易的单生成元Hamilton量族中展示了该阻碍，因此既不需要非Abel时间排序，也不需要Floquet对数歧义。一个连续的Hamilton量族会产生相同的、以起始时间为索引的单周期端点数据，却给出不同的周期平均Fubini-Study几何；在不受限制的类上，这些几何差异可以任意大。即使对Hamilton量关于参数的导数施加任意预设的一致界，不可辨识性仍然存在。该结果是一个确定性的全局陈述，而不是关于泛型不可辨识性或实验不可能性的主张。它指出了完整单周期端点数据与完整周期内动力学之间的精确信息缺口：缺失的信息是被观测单值矩阵路径的酉提升，而不是通常的标量相位自由度。

articles.title: Degenerate high-order hybrid bound states in the continuum beyond diffraction limit
articles.title_zh: 衍射极限之外的简并高阶杂化连续谱束缚态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10125v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We demonstrate the existence of at-Γ degenerate hybrid bound-states in the continuum (BICs) with high-order topological charges and quadratic band degeneracy in periodic photonic structures with C₆ᵥ symmetry above the diffraction limit. The degenerate BICs are realized by combining symmetry protection, which suppresses radiation into zeroth-order diffraction channel, with quadratic band degeneracy and parameter tuning to eliminate radiation into first-order diffraction channels. An effective Hamiltonian is used to investigate the band structure around the degeneracy point, and the topological dynamics in all diffraction channels are characterized. This work reveals a novel mechanism for realizing degenerate BICs above the diffraction limit, opening up opportunities for new physics and applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文展示了在具有C₆ᵥ对称性的周期光子结构中，衍射极限以上可存在位于Γ点的简并杂化连续谱束缚态，具有高阶拓扑荷和二次能带简并。其实现机制结合了对零阶衍射通道的对称保护、二次能带简并以及对一阶衍射通道辐射的参数调谐消除。研究揭示了衍射极限以上实现简并BIC的新机制。
authors: Ji Tong Wang, Nicolae C. Panoiu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们证明，在具有C₆ᵥ对称性的周期光子结构中，衍射极限以上存在位于Γ点的简并杂化连续谱束缚态（BICs），其具有高阶拓扑荷和二次能带简并。通过将抑制向零阶衍射通道辐射的对称保护，与二次能带简并以及消除向一阶衍射通道辐射的参数调谐相结合，实现了这些简并BIC。我们使用有效Hamilton量研究简并点附近的能带结构，并表征所有衍射通道中的拓扑动力学。这项工作揭示了一种在衍射极限以上实现简并BIC的新机制，为新的物理现象和应用开辟了机会。

articles.title: Predicting Space Groups of Double Perovskites by LLM with Dynamic Few-Shot Learning
articles.title_zh: 使用动态少样本学习的大语言模型预测双钙钛矿空间群
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10483v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Double perovskites (DPs) offer broad compositional tunability, but predicting the space groups (SGs) of stable structures remains difficult because available datasets are often strongly imbalanced toward dominant SG classes. We refer to dominant SG classes as major SGs and underrepresented classes as minor SGs. We introduce Dynamic and Diversity-enhanced Few-shot Retrieval and Rule-Guided Inference for Space-Group Prediction (DyRIS), an LLM-agent-based framework that predicts ranked SG candidates from a given DP composition. DyRIS uses diversity-enhanced dynamic few-shot prompting to retrieve relevant in-context examples while limiting the dominance of frequently represented SGs. It further incorporates rule-guided inference based on B/B' cation ordering, quantitative indicators, and major-SG bias control to refine and rank the final Top-3 SG candidates. We evaluate DyRIS on 3,528 thermodynamically filtered DP entries and compare it with composition-based and descriptor-based baselines. At a training-data ratio of 0.5, DyRIS achieves competitive overall accuracy while obtaining the best Overall Top-1 macro-F1 score and the best performance across all Minor-SG metrics. DyRIS improves Minor-SG Top-1 accuracy by 3.26 percentage points relative to CrabNet and achieves higher Minor-SG Top-3 accuracy than the strongest PyCaret-based baseline. Ablation studies show that diversity-enhanced retrieval, quantitative indicators, major-SG bias control, and B/B' ordering information each contribute to prediction performance. Additional experiments show that the final rule-guided inference step is not easily replaced by conventional classifier- or ranker-based models. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining retrieval-based LLM reasoning with crystallographic domain knowledge for SG prediction in imbalanced materials datasets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出DyRIS，一种基于LLM智能体的框架，用于从双钙钛矿组成预测排序的空间群候选。该方法通过增强多样性的动态少样本检索和规则引导推理，缓解数据集中主要空间群类别占优导致的类别不平衡问题。实验表明，DyRIS在少数空间群指标上表现最佳，并证明检索式LLM推理结合晶体学知识可提升不平衡材料数据中的空间群预测。
authors: Jongwon Park, Inhyo Lee, Junhyeong Lee, Seunghwa Ryu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 双钙钛矿（DPs）具有广泛的组分可调性，但预测稳定结构的空间群（SGs）仍然困难，因为可用数据集往往强烈偏向占主导地位的SG类别。我们将占主导地位的SG类别称为主要SG，将代表性不足的类别称为少数SG。我们提出Dynamic and Diversity-enhanced Few-shot Retrieval and Rule-Guided Inference for Space-Group Prediction（DyRIS），这是一种基于LLM智能体的框架，可由给定DP组成预测排序的SG候选。DyRIS使用增强多样性的动态少样本提示来检索相关的上下文示例，同时限制频繁出现SG的主导性。它进一步结合基于B/B'阳离子有序、定量指标和主要SG偏置控制的规则引导推理，以细化并排序最终的Top-3 SG候选。我们在3528个经过热力学筛选的DP条目上评估DyRIS，并将其与基于组成和基于描述符的基线方法进行比较。在训练数据比例为0.5时，DyRIS取得了具有竞争力的总体准确率，同时获得最佳的总体Top-1宏F1分数，并在所有少数SG指标上表现最佳。相对于CrabNet，DyRIS将少数SG Top-1准确率提高了3.26个百分点，并取得了高于最强PyCaret基线的少数SG Top-3准确率。消融研究表明，增强多样性的检索、定量指标、主要SG偏置控制以及B/B'有序信息分别都对预测性能有贡献。额外实验表明，最终的规则引导推理步骤并不容易被传统的分类器或排序器模型替代。这些发现展示了将基于检索的LLM推理与晶体学领域知识相结合用于不平衡材料数据集空间群预测的潜力。

articles.title: Nanoscale graphitization and defect evolution in silicon-vacancy center-containing nanodiamonds under high-pressure high-temperature annealing
articles.title_zh: 高压高温退火下含硅空位中心纳米金刚石中的纳米尺度石墨化与缺陷演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10632v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Group-IV color centers, such as the silicon-vacancy (SiV) defect, are highly promising for solid-state quantum technologies. However, nanodiamonds typically exhibit significant lattice strain and structural disorder, which degrade their optical properties and hinder the resolution of the fine spectral structure at cryogenic temperatures. High-pressure high-temperature (HPHT) annealing offers a potential route to relax internal strain, although the phase stability of diamond at the nanoscale under such conditions remains poorly constrained. Here, we investigate the structural evolution of nanodiamonds during HPHT annealing using a Paris-Edinburgh press coupled with in situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction at SOLEIL. A dedicated sample assembly combining nanodiamonds - NaCl - Pt enabled accurate pressure-temperature calibration and real-time monitoring of phase transformations. The diffraction data reveal that the onset of diamond-to-graphite transition occurs at approximately 1800 K at 2 GPa and 2120 K at 4 GPa under the applied HPHT heating protocol. These experimentally determined graphitization onsets define a practical pressure-temperature processing window for HPHT annealing of nanodiamonds while avoiding detectable graphitization and provide a calibrated framework for reliable off-beam annealing treatments that avoid graphitization. Photoluminescence measurements on samples annealed below the graphitization threshold show improved optical response, with partial resolution of the SiV fine structure at 12 K. These optical measurements suggest a relationship between nanoscale phase stability and the optical response of individual SiV-containing nanodiamonds following HPHT annealing. The experimentally established HPHT processing window provides a practical framework for the controlled processing of quantum nanodiamonds while avoiding graphitization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用Paris-Edinburgh压机与原位同步辐射X射线衍射，考察含SiV中心纳米金刚石在高压高温退火中的结构演化。实验确定了不同压力下金刚石向石墨转变的起始温度，从而给出避免可检测石墨化的工艺窗口。低于石墨化阈值退火后的样品显示改善的光致发光响应，并在12 K下部分分辨SiV精细结构。
authors: M. De Feudis, B. Yavkin, L. Henry, K. O. Ho, M. -P. Adam, P. Goldner, F. Benedic, S. Desgreniers, J. -F. Roch
articles.abstract_zh_full: 第四族色心，例如硅空位（SiV）缺陷，对于固态量子技术非常有前景。然而，纳米金刚石通常表现出显著的晶格应变和结构无序，这会降低其光学性质，并阻碍在低温下分辨精细光谱结构。高压高温（HPHT）退火提供了一条可能缓解内部应变的途径，尽管在这种条件下纳米尺度金刚石的相稳定性仍然缺乏充分约束。在这里，我们使用Paris-Edinburgh压机并结合SOLEIL的原位同步辐射X射线衍射，研究纳米金刚石在HPHT退火过程中的结构演化。一种结合纳米金刚石-NaCl-Pt的专用样品组件实现了准确的压力-温度校准和相变的实时监测。衍射数据显示，在所施加的HPHT加热方案下，金刚石向石墨转变的起始大约发生在2 GPa下1800 K和4 GPa下2120 K。这些实验确定的石墨化起始条件为纳米金刚石的HPHT退火定义了一个实用的压力-温度处理窗口，同时避免可检测的石墨化，并为避免石墨化的可靠离线退火处理提供了经校准的框架。对低于石墨化阈值退火样品进行的光致发光测量显示出改善的光学响应，并在12 K下部分分辨了SiV精细结构。这些光学测量表明，在HPHT退火后，纳米尺度相稳定性与单个含SiV纳米金刚石的光学响应之间存在关系。实验建立的HPHT处理窗口为量子纳米金刚石的受控处理提供了实用框架，同时避免石墨化。

articles.title: T1, T2, and complex permittivities of hydrogels, paramagnetic salt solutions, and oils at 0.35, 1.5, and 3 Tesla
articles.title_zh: 水凝胶、顺磁盐溶液和油在0.35、1.5与3特斯拉下的T1、T2和复介电常数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11117v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Approach: The T1, T2, and complex permittivities of candidate MRI phantom constituents (hydrogels, paramagnetic electrolytes, and oils) were measured at different magnetic field strengths and concentrations. Data: T1 decreased with increasing concentration except for PEG. The T1 and T2 relaxivities of polyethylene glycol (PEG), polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP), sodium polyacrylate, and deionized water did not significantly vary with field strength. The T2 relaxivities of gelatin and sodium alginate did not significantly vary with field strength. All of the hydrogels and paramagnetic electrolyte solutions had high static dielectrics (e.g., ϵs~70) similar to water. The static electrical conductivities of Miller's LB agar, gelatin, PVA, sodium alginate, sodium polyacrylate, xanthan gum, CuSO4, NiCl2, and Mn(NO3)2 rose with concentration. However, the conductivities of PEG and PVP did not rise with concentration. Conclusions: Sodium polyacrylate, PVP, and PEG hydrogels are challenging for generating consistent phantoms. Sodium alginate, Miller's LB agar, and xanthan gum were good hydrogel candidates. Mn(NO3)2 had the highest relaxivities of the tested samples. All three oils (canola, castor, and grapeseed) are good candidates for low dielectric (ϵs<10) phantoms for high field applications) but with low conductivities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究测量了候选MRI体模组分在不同磁场强度和浓度下的T1、T2与复介电常数。结果显示，多数材料T1随浓度升高而降低，但PEG例外；若干水凝胶的弛豫率不随场强显著变化。作者认为海藻酸钠、Miller's LB琼脂和黄原胶是较好的水凝胶候选，Mn(NO3)2弛豫率最高，而三种油适用于低介电高场体模。
authors: H Michael Gach, Kerri Prinos, Hannah Sechaga
articles.abstract_zh_full: 方法：在不同磁场强度和浓度下测量候选MRI体模组分（水凝胶、顺磁电解质和油）的T1、T2以及复介电常数。数据：除PEG外，T1随浓度增加而降低。聚乙二醇（PEG）、聚乙烯吡咯烷酮（PVP）、聚丙烯酸钠和去离子水的T1和T2弛豫率不随场强显著变化。明胶和海藻酸钠的T2弛豫率不随场强显著变化。所有水凝胶和顺磁电解质溶液都具有类似水的高静态介电常数（例如ϵs约为70）。Miller's LB琼脂、明胶、PVA、海藻酸钠、聚丙烯酸钠、黄原胶、CuSO4、NiCl2和Mn(NO3)2的静态电导率随浓度升高而上升。然而，PEG和PVP的电导率并未随浓度升高而上升。结论：聚丙烯酸钠、PVP和PEG水凝胶在制备一致性体模方面具有挑战性。海藻酸钠、Miller's LB琼脂和黄原胶是良好的水凝胶候选材料。Mn(NO3)2在测试样品中具有最高弛豫率。三种油（菜籽油、蓖麻油和葡萄籽油）都是用于高场应用的低介电（ϵs<10）体模的良好候选材料，但其电导率较低。

articles.title: Fragility of local moments against hybridization with flat bands
articles.title_zh: 局域磁矩对与平带杂化的脆弱性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.14326v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Kondo screening of a localized magnetic moment crucially depends on the spectral properties of the electronic bath to which it is coupled. Unlike textbook examples, realistic systems as well as dynamical mean-field theory of correlated lattice models force us to consider sharp features in the hybridization function near the Fermi energy. Divergencies of this kind can play a relevant role in twisted bilayer graphene, for which local-moment formation and isospin entropy at finite temperature are currently under the spotlight. We clarify how a low-frequency singularity impacts the screening mechanisms by means of a toy model with a tunable δ-peak in the hybridization function, superimposed to a regular part. Our analysis unveils an unexpectedly big impact on the local-moment physics already for a parametrically small weight of the flat band in the bath.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究电子浴杂化函数中费米能附近尖锐特征对Kondo屏蔽和局域磁矩物理的影响。作者构造了一个含可调δ峰并叠加规则部分的玩具模型，用以模拟平带对杂化函数的贡献。结果揭示，即使浴中平带权重参数上很小，也会对局域磁矩物理产生出乎意料的显著影响。
authors: Max Fischer, Arianna Poli, Lorenzo Crippa, Dumitru Călugăru, Sergio Ciuchi, Matthias Vojta, Alessandro Toschi, Giorgio Sangiovanni
articles.abstract_zh_full: 局域磁矩的Kondo屏蔽关键取决于与其耦合的电子浴的谱性质。不同于教科书中的例子，真实系统以及关联晶格模型的动力学平均场理论迫使我们考虑费米能附近杂化函数中的尖锐特征。这类发散可能在扭转双层石墨烯中发挥重要作用，而其中的局域磁矩形成和有限温度下的同位旋熵目前正受到关注。我们借助一个玩具模型来阐明低频奇异性如何影响屏蔽机制，该模型在杂化函数中叠加了一个可调δ峰和一个规则部分。我们的分析揭示，即使浴中平带的权重在参数上很小，也已会对局域磁矩物理产生出乎意料的巨大影响。

articles.title: Magnetization of electronic ground states in frustrated superstable graphs
articles.title_zh: 受挫超稳定图中电子基态的磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.07079v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Geometric frustration lies at the heart of many unconventional quantum phases in strongly interacting electron systems. Here, we analytically determine the ground state magnetization of the half-filled Hubbard model on frustrated geometries where superstable states -- eigenstates which are robust against frustration -- are manifest. Our results apply to a broad class of lattices, including those where altermagnetic and superconducting states are known to emerge. Furthermore, they provide evidence for phase transitions involving a geometric rearrangement of magnetic correlations in the thermodynamic limit.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文解析确定了半填充Hubbard模型在存在超稳定态的受挫几何上的基态磁化。结果适用于广泛晶格类型，包括已知可出现交错磁态和超导态的晶格。研究还为热力学极限中涉及磁关联几何重排的相变提供了证据。
authors: F. P. M. Méndez-Córdoba, J. Tindall, D. Jaksch, F. Schlawin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 几何受挫是强相互作用电子系统中许多非常规量子相的核心。在这里，我们解析确定了半填充Hubbard模型在受挫几何上的基态磁化，在这些几何中，超稳定态——即对受挫具有鲁棒性的本征态——是显性的。我们的结果适用于广泛的一类晶格，包括那些已知会出现交错磁态和超导态的晶格。此外，它们为热力学极限中涉及磁关联几何重排的相变提供了证据。

articles.title: Percolation and criticality of systems with competing interactions on Bethe lattices: limitations and potential strengths of cluster schemes
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.02961v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The random clusters introduced by Fortuin and Kasteleyn (FK) and analyzed by Coniglio and Klein (CK) for Ising and related models have led first Swendsen and Wang and then Wolff to formulate remarkably efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling schemes that weaken the critical slowing down. In frustrated models, however, no standard way to produce a comparable gain at small frustration -- let alone efficiently sample the large frustration regime -- has yet been identified. In order to understand why formulating appropriate cluster criteria for frustrated models has thus far been elusive, we here study minimal short-range attractive and long-range repulsive as well as spin-glass models on Bethe lattices. Using a generalization of the CK approach and the cavity-field method, the appropriateness and limitations of the FK--CK type clusters are identified. We find that a standard, constructive cluster scheme is then inoperable, and that the frustration range over which generalized FK--CK clusters are even definable is finite. These results demonstrate the futility of seeking constructive cluster schemes for frustrated systems but leaves open the possibility that alternate approaches could be devised.
authors: Greivin Alfaro Miranda, Mingyuan Zheng, Patrick Charbonneau, Antonio Coniglio, Leticia F. Cugliandolo, Marco Tarzia

articles.title: Obstruction to Ergodicity from Locality and U(1) Higher Symmetries on the Lattice
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.21815v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We argue that the presence of any exact U(1) higher-form symmetry, under mild assumptions, presents a fundamental obstruction to ergodicity under unitary dynamics in lattice systems with local interactions and finite on-site Hilbert space dimension. Focusing on the two-dimensional case, we show that such systems necessarily exhibit Hilbert space fragmentation and explicitly construct Krylov sectors whose number scales exponentially with system size. While these sectors cannot be distinguished by symmetry quantum numbers, we identify the emergent integrals of motion which characterize them. Our symmetry-based approach is insensitive to details of the Hamiltonian and the lattice, providing a systematic explanation for ergodicity-breaking in a range of systems, including quantum link models.

articles.title: Direct demonstration of time-reversal-symmetry-breaking spin injection from a compensated magnet
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.17427v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The injection, propagation and detection of spin currents are essential physical processes in spintronics. So far, the separation of charge and spin currents was facilitated by the electrical spin injection from a ferromagnet (FM) or the injection by a relativistic spin Hall effect. The devices employed are lateral spin valves comprising spatially separated injection and detection electrodes, connected by a spin-propagation channel. The time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking FM spin injection is realized in a geometry with an electrical bias applied between the injection electrode and the channel and is modelled by a conserved spin-polarized drift current. In contrast, the spin injection by the T-symmetric relativistic spin Hall mechanism is driven by an electrical bias applied across the injection electrode alone, and is modelled by a non-conserved spin current transverse to the applied bias. In this work, we use a lateral spin valve with a Mn5Si3 injection electrode to directly demonstrate a TRS-breaking spin injection from a compensated magnet with a vanishing net magnetization. Specifically, the TRS-breaking is demonstrated by the fact that switching between time-reversed states of the compensated magnet changes the detected spin signal. Moreover, the TRS-breaking nature of the spin injection is observed in both experimental geometries with the different electrical biasing, while using the same detection electrode. We show that this unconventional spin-injection is consistent with different magnitudes and propagation angles of electrical currents in the spin-up and spin-down channel in a d-wave altermagnet. Here our symmetry analysis and first-principles calculations are based on the compensated collinear altermagnetic order which has provided a comprehensive microscopic interpretation of earlier structural, magnetic, and anomalous Hall and Nernst measurements in Mn5Si3 thin films.
authors: Jone Mencos, Antonin Badura, Eoin Dolan, Sebastian Beckert, Rafael Gonzalez-Hernandez, Nicolás Sigales, Tim Kokkeler, Ismaila Kounta, Matthieu Petit, Charles Guillemard, Anna Birk Hellenes, Warlley Campos, Javier Rial, Dominik Kriegner, Vincent Baltz, Luis E. Hueso, Jairo Sinova, F. Sebastian Bergeret, Olena Gomonay, Tomas Jungwirth, Libor Smejkal, Lisa Michez, Helena Reichlova, Fèlix Casanova

articles.title: Tuneable skyrmion and anti-skyrmion fluids via mechanical strain in chiral kagome lattice
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.00982v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic skyrmions are nanometric swirling spin textures that exhibit remarkable stability at finite temperatures, making them promising candidates for spintronic applications. Achieving controllable stability and transitions between distinct topological structures is crucial for practical implementations. In this work, we investigate the effect of uniaxial mechanical strain on a magnetic model on the kagome lattice, focusing on skyrmion stability and emergent topological phases. To this end, we consider a Heisenberg model that includes exchange interactions and both in-plane and out-of-plane Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions. Using a combination of Spin-Lattice Dynamics and Monte Carlo simulations, we explore uniaxial strain variations in the range of -10% to 10%, showing important effects on the phase diagram. For compressive strain, we find that the density of skyrmions in the skyrmion gas (SkG) phase can be tuned and that the stability of this phase extends to higher temperatures. Tensile strain, in contrast, reduces the number of skyrmions and promotes transitions to other magnetic states. Within this regime, strain levels of about (sim4-6%) lead to a change in topological charge, turning skyrmions (Q=-1) into antiskyrmions (Q=+1). We also examine how strain affects other phases commonly appearing in skyrmion-hosting systems, such as the helical and fully polarized states, showing that mechanical deformation alters their stability and characteristic properties. Finally, we compare these results with the strain response of a more conventional skyrmion model, in order to clarify the role of the different interactions involved. Our results identify strain as an experimentally accessible route for engineering topological spin textures.
authors: Gonzalo dos Santos, Flavia A. Gómez Albarracín, Ludovic D. C. Jaubert, Pierre Pujol, Eduardo M. Bringa, H. Diego Rosales

articles.title: Emergent gauge flux and spin ordering in magnetized triangular spin liquids: Applications to Hofstadter-Hubbard model
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.12898v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by recent progress in moiré superlattices and spin-1/2 triangular-lattice antiferromagnets, we study how orbital magnetic flux and Zeeman coupling compete or cooperate in generating internal U(1) gauge flux in a triangular spin liquid. We show that orbital flux favors a chiral spin liquid with staggered internal flux, whereas Zeeman coupling destabilizes the spinon Fermi-pocket state toward a Landau-level state with spontaneous uniform internal flux and conical spin order. We demonstrate this mechanism in a spin-1/2 J₁₋J₂₋Jḩᵢ model, and further identify thermal Hall and magnetic signatures that distinguish these regimes, with potential applications to moiré Hofstadter-Hubbard systems and triangular-lattice antiferromagnets.
authors: Jiahao Yang, Hao Tian, Si-Yu Pan, Gang v. Chen

articles.title: Chirality and quasi-long-range order in finite-flux Gutzwiller states for magnetized frustrated magnets
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.14458v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study Gutzwiller-projected wavefunctions for triangular-lattice U(1) Dirac spin liquids in a Zeeman field, where we allow the U(1) gauge field to develop a gauge flux, resulting in (spin-split) spinon Landau levels. We find that at a given magnetization, the optimal candidate state has a finite flux chosen such that the spinon filling lies in a |C|=1 Landau-level gap: it gives the lowest variational energy and the smallest energy variance within our correlation-matrix reconstruction for local Heisenberg-type models. By symmetry, we argue that the finite gauge flux results in a non-zero (staggered) scalar spin chirality, as also numerically observed, and further find that the |C|=1 state exhibits dominant quasi-long-ranged 120ⁱ̧rc magnetic correlations. Studying the next-to-optimal wavefunction with a |C|=2 Landau-level gap, we observe unusual spin-nematic correlations. Our results may provide guidance for analyzing the magnetic-field response of DSL candidate materials and offer numerical diagnostics that can connect to the underlying theory of spinons coupled to an emergent U(1) gauge field.
authors: Wen O. Wang, Urban F. P. Seifert, Oleg A. Starykh, Leon Balents

articles.title: Structural Distortions and Ferroelectricity in Antiperovskite Oxides with Tetrel Elements
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.06324v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antiperovskites share the same structure as perovskites, but allow completely different chemistries and nominal charge states of anions to be stabilized. This gives rise to many interesting phenomena, including septet superconductivity and topological crystalline insulating phases in these systems. Despite this, the work on the crystal structural trends in these compounds is more limited compared to perovskites. In this study, we consider the family of antiperovskite oxides with tetrel elements (Si, Ge, Sn, Pb) and alkaline earth metals (Ca, Sr, Ba), and perform a detailed study of their crystal structures using first principles density functional theory. We show how tolerance factor arguments can be constructed to predict their structure in a way parallel to the perovskites, and furthermore, how heterostructuring (or cation-order) can be used to induce ferroelectricity in these systems which may provide an experimental knob to modify electronic structure. We conclude with a discussion of the electronic structure of antiperovskites, and show that they display interesting trends not observed in regular perovskites, including significant antibonding interactions between face-center ions, which might need to be taken into account when building effective electronic models of these compounds.
articles.focus_summary: 该论文用第一性原理密度泛函理论系统研究含 Si、Ge、Sn、Pb 等 tetrel 元素的反钙钛矿氧化物结构畸变规律。作者提出类似钙钛矿容忍因子的结构判据，并指出通过异质结构化或阳离子有序可诱导铁电性，从而调控电子结构。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们的铁电材料、功能氧化物和第一性原理材料设计方向高度相关，尤其涉及结构畸变诱导铁电性和异质结构调控。可借鉴其容忍因子构建思路用于新型铁电氧化物筛选。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议进一步关注其极化翻转势垒、Born 有效电荷、畴壁和缺陷对铁电稳定性的影响。也可用高通量 DFT 或机器学习模型扩展筛选更多反钙钛矿铁电候选材料。

articles.title: Experimental Signatures of Topological Transport in Polycrystalline FeSi Thin Films
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.17103v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Iron monosilicide ϵ-FeSi has recently been predicted to host nontrivial topological states, yet experimental evidence remains scarce. Here we report transport signatures of Weyl semimetal behavior in polycrystalline ϵ-FeSi films (65 nm thick) grown by solid-state reaction of Fe on Si (100). Below 200 K, the anomalous Hall conductivity σₓyAHE becomes temperature-independent (σₓyAHEapprox14 S/sq.sim const(σₓₓ)), unequivocally demonstrating an intrinsic anomalous Hall effect driven by Berry curvature. By comparing our data with the large set of data available in the literature for FeSi single crystals and polycrystalline/amorphous/crystalline FeSi thin films of thicknesses between 10 nm and 1 mm, we discover a universal scaling of h̊oₓyAHEsimh̊oₓₓ², which confirms the existence of surface-dominated electron transport. In this regime, the chiral anomaly manifests in both anisotropic longitudinal magnetoresistance and the planar Hall effect as well. The above observations establish ϵ-FeSi as a Weyl semimetal and allow to relate σₓyAHE to a "quantized" Hall response estimating the effective Weyl-point separation as (k₊^W-k₋W)/(2π)approx0.36. Our findings confirm the topological origin of electron transport in ϵ-FeSi and discover its potential as a new high temperature and noble metal-free Weyl semimetal.
authors: R. Mantovan, A. Bozhko, V. Zhurkin, A. Bogach, A. Khanas, S. Zarubin, A. Zenkevich, V. Glushkov

articles.title: Spin-current model of electric polarization with the tensor gyromagnetic ratio
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.22968v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The spin-current model of electric polarization of spin origin is developed for a magnetic structure with anisotropic tensor gyromagnetic ratio (g-factor). Three mechanisms of the magnetoelectric effect are proposed, caused by the symmetric Heisenberg exchange interaction, the Dzyaloshinsky-Moriya interaction, and the spin-spin interaction related to the odd anisotropy of the symmetric exchange interaction of magnetic ions via nonmagnetic ion. The dependence of electric polarization on the spin density and tensor g-factor in the generalized spin-current model is derived. New solutions for macroscopic electric polarization, that arise in the cycloidal and helicoidal spin orders and are caused by the non-diagonal components of the gyromagnetic ratio, are predicted. The extended of the spin-current model to including a tensor g-factor can be important for the magnetic ferroelectrics with heavy ions which take part in the formation of magnetoelectric effect.
authors: Mariya Iv. Trukhanova, Pavel A. Andreev

articles.title: Numerical evidence of a critical point in the (2+1)D SO(5) nonlinear sigma model with Wess-Zumino-Witten term
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.03700v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop an optimized continuous-field quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) algorithm to investigate the projected SO(5) nonlinear sigma model with a Wess-Zumino-Witten term, which describes half-filled Dirac fermions in 2+1 space-time dimensions akin to graphene and Yukawa coupled to a quintuplet of compatible mass terms. Our algorithm reduces the computational complexity to O(β Nq N_φ²⁾, yielding a speedup of a factor of N_φ (the number of magnetic fluxes, i.e., system size) relative to prior works [1-4]. This advance enables us to simulate system sizes up to N_φ=140 on the torus and N_φ=59 on the sphere, far exceeding the maximum sizes previously accessed, and to map out the universal phase diagram of the model on both geometries. Most notably, we identify and characterize a critical point that separates an SO(5)-broken ordered phase at small coupling from an SO(5)-symmetric disordered phase at large coupling. The critical point becomes multicritical upon the inclusion of terms that break the SO(5) symmetry down to U(1) × SU(2), relevant for the deconfined phase transition between Néel antiferromagnetic and valence-bond-solid orders in quantum magnets. Our finding of a multicritical point in the phase diagram of the SO(5) nonlinear sigma model with Wess-Zumino-Witten term resolves the long-standing open question of its global structure, and our QMC algorithm opens a new avenue for systematic studies of projected Hamiltonians, ranging from correlated flat bands to fractional quantum (anomalous) Hall systems.
authors: Yuan Da Liao, Bin-Bin Chen, Junchen Rong, Fakher F. Assaad, Lukas Janssen, Zi Yang Meng

articles.title: Field evolution of the magnetic structure and spin Hamiltonian in Cs₂RuO₄
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.23363v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report neutron diffraction under applied magnetic fields and complementary zero-field neutron spectroscopy measurements on Cs₂RuO₄. Previous work [S. D. Nabi et al., Phys. Rev. B 112, 134436 (2025)] identified a spin-flop-like transition accompanied by a quantum critical point within the ordered phase, attributed to strong frustration between alternating single-ion anisotropy planes. Here, we quantitatively confirm the predicted field evolution of the magnetic structure using neutron diffraction. Furthermore, analysis of the excitation spectrum within an SU(3) spin-wave framework resolves previously undetermined parameters of the minimal spin Hamiltonian and lifts the associated degeneracies.
authors: S. D. Nabi, E. Ressouche, D. G. Mazzone, J. Lass, R. Sibille, Z. Yan, S. Gvasaliya, A. Zheludev

articles.title: Magnetic ordering in VI3: a van der Waals material combining vastly different magnetic anisotropies
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02759v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Among magnetic van der Waals materials, the vanadium trihalide family exhibits unique features. In particular, VI3 contains V atoms of two different types, as two energetically close electronic occupations can coexist in real samples. These types show strikingly different magnetic anisotropy, predicted to differ by more than an order of magnitude. The combination forms a distinctive magnetic system. VI3 also displays an unusual thickness dependence: the monolayer Curie temperature (TC) is higher than that of the bulk, contrary to the expectation that interlayer coupling reinforces magnetic order. Using atomistic spin-dynamics simulations informed by first-principles calculations, we investigate the critical temperature behavior from the combined perspective of single-ion anisotropy and exchange interactions. The strong anisotropy contrast significantly affects thermal stability: increasing the fraction of high-anisotropy sites raises the energy cost of transverse spin fluctuations and increases the ordering temperature. Furthermore, V-atom inhomogeneity makes the interlayer super-superexchange network spatially nonuniform, creating competing exchange pathways. This weakens coherent interlayer order while preserving robust intralayer ferromagnetic correlations, thus modifying the bulk-monolayer TC relation. Our model reproduces experimental TC values when the ratio of the two V types is close to 1:1, in agreement with two experimental methods. This supports the coexistence of two V configurations in VI3. The monolayer TC is reproduced with a slightly modified ratio, possibly linked to polaron concentration. The sensitivity of TC to this ratio suggests that the ordering temperature of VI3 can in principle be tuned over a broad range by controlling the relative occupation of the two vanadium configurations.
authors: K. K. Pokhrel, S. Ray, N. Machavcova, A. Koliogiorgos, K. Carva
articles.focus_summary: 该论文研究范德华磁体 VI3 中由两类 V 原子电子占据导致的不同磁各向异性及其对磁有序温度的影响。作者结合第一性原理参数和原子自旋动力学模拟，分析单离子各向异性、交换作用和层间非均匀超超交换网络如何共同决定单层与体相的居里温度差异。
articles.focus_relation: 该工作与我们的二维范德华磁体、自旋哈密顿量、磁各向异性、交换相互作用和自旋动力学方向高度吻合。其从第一性原理到自旋模型再到热稳定性模拟的流程，可直接借鉴于二维磁体和磁性超晶格研究。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步计算不同 V 占据比例、应变、层数和缺陷对交换参数、磁各向异性和临界温度的影响。也可考虑引入机器学习势或机器学习自旋哈密顿量，加速含无序和大尺度磁畴动力学模拟。

articles.title: Synthesis of Bulk Superconducting LiNbO₂ Crystals through CaH₂ Reduction
articles.title_zh: 通过 CaH₂ 还原合成块体超导 LiNbO₂ 晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06819v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We have synthesized layered superconducting LiNbO₂ crystals through a bulk phase transformation from LiNbO₃ single crystals via CaH₂ reduction. As the Nb valence is reduced from 5+ to 3+, the material undergoes a structural transformation to the resulting product, LiNbO₂, which is accompanied by metallic behavior and a superconducting transition, Tc onset, as high as 14.4 K. Secondary ion mass spectroscopy (SIMS) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) show that the resulting phase is hole-doped through de-lithiation during the reduction. Magnetization and AC susceptibility measurements from a tunnel diode resonator confirm the bulk nature of superconductivity with a superconducting volume fraction of approximately 77% and an upper critical field approaching 26 T. Our study demonstrates extreme hydride reduction as an effective method to induce phase transformations with non-topotactic pathways and can be used to synthesize bulk materials with exotic properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过 CaH₂ 还原 LiNbO₃ 单晶，实现了向层状超导 LiNbO₂ 晶体的块体相转变。所得材料表现出金属性和最高 14.4 K 的超导转变起始温度，并被证实具有约 77% 的超导体积分数。研究表明，强氢化物还原可作为诱导非拓扑外延相变并合成具有奇异性质块体材料的有效方法。
authors: Ryan Paxson, Stephanie J. Hong, Bicky S. Moirangthem, Parham Kabirifar, Saya Takeuchi, Tianyu Li, Chih-Yu Lee, Haotong Liang, Keenan Avers, Kamal R. Joshi, Amlan Datta, Makariy A. Tanatar, Shanta Saha, Joseph A. Dura, Peter Zavalij, Johnpierre Paglione, Ruslan Prozorov, Alexander J. Grutter, Efrain E. Rodriguez, Ichiro Takeuchi
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2607.06819v3，公告类型：替换。摘要：我们通过 CaH₂ 还原，使 LiNbO₃ 单晶发生块体相转变，合成了层状超导 LiNbO₂ 晶体。随着 Nb 价态从 5+ 降低到 3+，材料经历结构转变形成产物 LiNbO₂，并伴随出现金属性行为和超导转变，其超导转变起始温度 Tc onset 最高可达 14.4 K。二次离子质谱（SIMS）和 X 射线光电子能谱（XPS）表明，所得相在还原过程中通过脱锂实现空穴掺杂。来自隧道二极管谐振器的磁化强度和交流磁化率测量证实了超导性的块体性质，超导体积分数约为 77%，上临界场接近 26 T。我们的研究表明，强氢化物还原是一种诱导具有非拓扑外延路径的相转变的有效方法，并可用于合成具有奇异性质的块体材料。

articles.title: Dynamically Robust Counterdiabatic Topological Pumping
articles.title_zh: 动态鲁棒的反绝热拓扑泵浦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2402.10872v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Thouless pumping is a transport phenomenon whereby an insulating, time-periodic Hamiltonian induces a robustly quantized transfer of charge, per driving cycle, in the quasi-adiabatic limit. In this work we apply the shortcuts to adiabaticity (STA) method of counterdiabatic (CD) driving to the Rice-Mele model, an archetypal model for Thouless pumping. We show that the charge pumped rapidly across each bond of our CD Rice-Mele model is robustly quantized and determined by a Chern number. The CD Hamiltonian generally involves long-range, hence non-local, hopping. Therefore we also derive an exact, local, nearest-neighbor CD Hamiltonian for our lattice system. We show that our nearest neighbor non-adiabatic protocol possesses the same topological robustness to onsite disorder as quasi-adiabatic Thouless pumps and is moreover surprisingly robust to onsite disorder and noise errors in implementing the CD protocol, for sufficiently rapid driving. The protocol also reproduces finite-temperature Thouless pump results away from the adiabatic limit. In addition, we develop a general method to produce non-trivial, finite-time quantized pumping starting from any Rice-Mele initial ground state using only nearest-neighbor hopping.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将反绝热驱动这一绝热捷径方法应用于 Thouless 泵浦的典型 Rice-Mele 模型。作者证明，反绝热 Rice-Mele 模型中快速跨键泵浦的电荷由陈数决定并保持鲁棒量子化。研究还构造了精确的局域最近邻反绝热哈密顿量，并显示该非绝热方案对无序和实现误差具有显著鲁棒性。
authors: Joshua Chiel, Christopher Jarzynski, Jay Sau
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2402.10872v2，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：Thouless 泵浦是一种输运现象，其中一个绝缘的、时间周期的哈密顿量在准绝热极限下会在每个驱动周期诱导鲁棒量子化的电荷转移。在这项工作中，我们将绝热捷径（STA）方法中的反绝热（CD）驱动应用于 Rice-Mele 模型，这是 Thouless 泵浦的一个原型模型。我们表明，在我们的反绝热 Rice-Mele 模型中，快速跨越每条键泵浦的电荷是鲁棒量子化的，并由一个陈数决定。反绝热哈密顿量通常涉及长程、因而非局域的跃迁。因此，我们还为我们的晶格系统推导出一个精确的、局域的、最近邻反绝热哈密顿量。我们表明，我们的最近邻非绝热协议具有与准绝热 Thouless 泵相同的对位点无序的拓扑鲁棒性，并且在足够快速驱动时，对位点无序以及实现反绝热协议时的噪声误差也出人意料地鲁棒。该协议还在绝热极限之外再现了有限温度 Thouless 泵浦结果。此外，我们发展了一种通用方法，可从任意 Rice-Mele 初始基态出发，仅使用最近邻跃迁产生非平凡的有限时间量子化泵浦。

articles.title: Robust Tripartite Entanglement Generation via Correlated Noise in Spin Qubits
articles.title_zh: 通过自旋量子比特中的关联噪声鲁棒地产生三方纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.20466v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate the generation of genuine tripartite entanglement in a triangular spin-qubit system due to spatially correlated noise. In particular, we demonstrate how the formation of a highly entangled dark state -- a W state -- enables robust, long-lived tripartite entanglement. Surprisingly, we find that environmentally induced coherent coupling does not play a crucial role in sustaining this entanglement. This contrasts sharply with the two-qubit case, where the induced coupling significantly influences the entanglement dynamics. Furthermore, we explore two promising approaches to enhance the tripartite entanglement by steering the system towards the dark state: post-selection and coherent driving. Our findings offer a robust method for generating high-fidelity tripartite entangled states with potential applications in quantum computation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了三角形自旋量子比特系统中由空间关联噪声诱导的真正三方纠缠。作者发现，高纠缠暗态 W 态的形成能够实现鲁棒且长寿命的三方纠缠，而环境诱导的相干耦合并非维持该纠缠的关键。研究还提出后选择和相干驱动两种增强纠缠的方法，面向高保真三方纠缠态制备。
authors: Sander Driessen, Ji Zou, Even Thingstad, Jelena Klinovaja, Daniel Loss
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2506.20466v3，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：我们研究了三角形自旋量子比特系统中由于空间关联噪声而产生真正三方纠缠的问题。具体而言，我们展示了一个高度纠缠暗态——W 态——的形成如何实现鲁棒、长寿命的三方纠缠。令人惊讶的是，我们发现环境诱导的相干耦合在维持这种纠缠方面并不起关键作用。这与双量子比特情形形成鲜明对比，在双量子比特情形中，诱导耦合会显著影响纠缠动力学。此外，我们探索了两种通过将系统引导至暗态来增强三方纠缠的有前景方法：后选择和相干驱动。我们的发现提供了一种生成高保真三方纠缠态的鲁棒方法，并在量子计算中具有潜在应用。

articles.title: Controlling Liouvillian topological phases via Hamiltonian band topology under chiral symmetry
articles.title_zh: 在手征对称性下通过哈密顿量能带拓扑控制 Liouvillian 拓扑相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22323v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We establish a direct connection between Hamiltonian band topology and the Liouvillian spectral winding of open quantum systems with quadratic dissipations. This allows the band topology to act as a knob for controlling Liouvillian topology and corresponding non-equilibrium dynamics. In particular, we show analytically that, for chiral Hamiltonians under sublattice-unidirectional chiral dissipation, the Liouvillian spectral winding depends on the Hamiltonian solely through its band winding number, thereby enabling direct band-topological control of the Liouvillian skin effect. We further identify two distinguished coherent and incoherent Liouvillian skin effects therein: the former hosts a band-topological dark state of the Hamiltonian, whereas the latter yields a mixed steady state driven by dissipative nonreciprocity. Our results establish a systematic framework for topological control of spectral and spatial organization in open quantum systems and provide a unified perspective on topology in Hamiltonian and dissipative dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作建立了二次耗散开放量子系统中哈密顿量能带拓扑与 Liouvillian 谱绕数之间的直接联系。作者证明，在特定手征耗散条件下，Liouvillian 谱绕数仅通过哈密顿量的能带绕数依赖于哈密顿量，从而可用能带拓扑调控 Liouvillian 皮肤效应。研究进一步区分了相干与非相干两类 Liouvillian 皮肤效应，为开放量子系统拓扑控制提供了统一框架。
authors: Shu Long, Hong-Sen Yin, Chao Yang, Sen Mu, Jia-Wei Zhang, Linhu Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2602.22323v3，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：我们在具有二次耗散的开放量子系统中建立了哈密顿量能带拓扑与 Liouvillian 谱绕数之间的直接联系。这使得能带拓扑可以作为控制 Liouvillian 拓扑及相应非平衡动力学的调节旋钮。特别地，我们解析地表明，对于处于子晶格单向手征耗散下的手征哈密顿量，Liouvillian 谱绕数对哈密顿量的依赖仅通过其能带绕数体现，从而能够直接以能带拓扑控制 Liouvillian 皮肤效应。我们进一步在其中识别出两种有区别的相干和非相干 Liouvillian 皮肤效应：前者承载哈密顿量的能带拓扑暗态，而后者产生由耗散非互易性驱动的混合稳态。我们的结果为开放量子系统中谱与空间组织的拓扑控制建立了系统框架，并为哈密顿量动力学和耗散动力学中的拓扑提供了统一视角。

articles.title: What DINO saw: ALiBi positional encoding reduces positional bias in Vision Transformers
articles.title_zh: DINO 看到了什么：ALiBi 位置编码降低视觉 Transformer 中的位置偏差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.16840v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Vision transformers (ViTs) - especially feature foundation models like DINOv2 - learn rich representations useful for many downstream tasks. However, architectural choices (such as positional encoding) can lead to these models displaying positional biases and artefacts independent of semantic content. This makes zero-shot adaption difficult in fields like material science, where images are often cross-sections of homogeneous microstructure (i.e. having no preferred direction). In this work, we investigate the positional bias in ViTs via linear probing, finding it present across a range of objectives and positional encodings, and subsequently reduce it by finetuning models to use ALiBi relative positional encoding. We demonstrate that these models retain desirable general semantics and their unbiased features can be used successfully in trainable segmentation of complex microscopy images.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了视觉 Transformer，尤其是 DINOv2 等特征基础模型中的位置偏差问题。作者通过线性探测发现，不同目标函数和位置编码下均存在与语义无关的位置偏差，并通过微调模型使用 ALiBi 相对位置编码来减弱该偏差。结果表明，改进后的模型保留了通用语义能力，并可用于复杂显微图像的可训练分割。
authors: Moritz Pawlowsky, Antonis Vamvakeros, Alexander Weiss, Anja Bielefeld, Samuel J. Cooper, Ronan Docherty
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2603.16840v2，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：视觉 Transformer（ViT）——尤其是像 DINOv2 这样的特征基础模型——能够学习对许多下游任务有用的丰富表征。然而，架构选择（如位置编码）可能导致这些模型表现出与语义内容无关的位置偏差和伪影。这使得在材料科学等领域进行零样本适配变得困难，因为这些领域中的图像通常是均匀微结构的截面（即没有优选方向）。在这项工作中，我们通过线性探测研究 ViT 中的位置偏差，发现它存在于一系列目标函数和位置编码中，随后通过微调模型使其使用 ALiBi 相对位置编码来降低该偏差。我们证明，这些模型保留了理想的通用语义，并且其无偏特征可成功用于复杂显微图像的可训练分割。

articles.title: Krylov complexity and fidelity susceptibility in two-band Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 两能带哈密顿量中的 Krylov 复杂度与保真度易感性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.18594v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We investigate Krylov spread complexity for the ground state of two-band Hamiltonians, where the reference state is a generic state on the Bloch sphere. The spread complexity is obtained by using a purely geometric formulation in terms of Bloch sphere data without constructing the circuit Hamiltonian. For generic reference states, the derivative of the spread complexity is logarithmically divergent at the topological phase transition in the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model. We demonstrate that the derivative of the spread complexity is bounded by fidelity susceptibility for general two-band models, indicating the sensitivity of the spread complexity to any gap closing (topological or trivial). This is illustrated in the massive Dirac Hamiltonian with a trivial gap closing. Finally, we introduce a non-unitary duality in the SSH model between the topological and trivial phases, which manifests itself in the spread complexity and fidelity susceptibility.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究了两能带哈密顿量基态的 Krylov 扩展复杂度，其中参考态为 Bloch 球上的一般态。作者用纯几何方法从 Bloch 球数据得到扩展复杂度，并发现其导数在 SSH 模型拓扑相变处呈对数发散。研究还证明了扩展复杂度导数受保真度易感性约束，说明其对拓扑或平庸能隙闭合均敏感。
authors: Rishav Chaudhuri, Ayush Raj, Soham Ray, Sai Satyam Samal
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2605.18594v2，公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：我们研究了两能带哈密顿量基态的 Krylov 扩展复杂度，其中参考态是 Bloch 球上的一个一般态。扩展复杂度通过一种纯几何表述获得，该表述基于 Bloch 球数据，而不需要构造线路哈密顿量。对于一般参考态，扩展复杂度的导数在 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）模型的拓扑相变处呈对数发散。我们证明，对于一般两能带模型，扩展复杂度的导数受保真度易感性的约束，这表明扩展复杂度对任何能隙闭合（拓扑的或平庸的）都敏感。这一点在具有平庸能隙闭合的大质量 Dirac 哈密顿量中得到说明。最后，我们在 SSH 模型中引入了一种拓扑相和平庸相之间的非幺正对偶性，该对偶性体现在扩展复杂度和保真度易感性中。

articles.title: Physics-informed genetic algorithms (PIGAs) facilitating LIBS spectral normalization with shockwave characteristics
articles.title_zh: 物理信息遗传算法结合冲击波特征促进 LIBS 光谱归一化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09960v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inspired by physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) inheriting both the interpretability of physical laws and the efficient integration capability of machine learning, we propose a framework based on stoichiometric ablation for LIBS spectral normalization, encoding physical constraints between LIBS intensities and shockwave characteristics (temperature Tshock and pressure P) into optimization algorithms with multiple independent objectives, named physics-informed genetic algorithms (PIGAs). It is characterized by its applicability to the wider laser energy range covering laser-induced breakdown to significant plasma shielding and spectral lines undergoing self-absorption outperforming the widely-used physical linear or multivariate data-driven normalization methods. The home-made end-to-end LAP-RTE codes serves as the benchmark to validate the physical reciprocal-logarithmic transformation and its extensibility to self-absorption spectral lines for PIGAs. Next experimental spectral lines are statistically used to validate PIGAs correction effects, the median RSDs of spectral intensities can be effectively reduced by 85% (corrected by P) and 88% (corrected by Tshock) for 108 Fe I lines, while for 33 Fe II lines, reduced by 77% (corrected by P) and 86% (corrected by Tshock). Seventeen self-absorption lines are also corrected effectively, with RSDs being reduced by 78% (corrected by P) and 89% (corrected by Tshock). Our proposed idea of combining optimization methods to quantify unknown parameters in normalization strategies can also be extended to excavate the correlation between parameters for other low-temperature plasma fields with similar processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于化学计量烧蚀的 LIBS 光谱归一化框架，将 LIBS 强度与冲击波温度、压力之间的物理约束嵌入多目标遗传优化算法。该方法适用于更宽激光能量范围和存在自吸收的谱线，并优于常用线性物理归一化或多变量数据驱动归一化方法。实验结果显示，PIGAs 可显著降低 Fe I、Fe II 及自吸收谱线强度的相对标准偏差。
authors: Ying Zhou, Jian Wu, Mingxin Shi, Minxin Chen, Jinghui Li, Xinyu Guo, Yuhua Hang, Cuixiang Pei, Xingwen Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.09960v1，公告类型：新。摘要：受物理信息神经网络（PINNs）兼具物理定律可解释性和机器学习高效集成能力的启发，我们提出了一种基于化学计量烧蚀的 LIBS 光谱归一化框架，将 LIBS 强度与冲击波特征（温度 Tshock 和压力 P）之间的物理约束编码到具有多个独立目标的优化算法中，命名为物理信息遗传算法（PIGAs）。其特点在于适用于更宽的激光能量范围，覆盖从激光诱导击穿到显著等离子体屏蔽的情形，并适用于经历自吸收的谱线，其性能优于广泛使用的物理线性归一化方法或多变量数据驱动归一化方法。自制的端到端 LAP-RTE 代码作为基准，用于验证 PIGAs 的物理倒数-对数变换及其对自吸收谱线的可扩展性。随后，实验谱线被用于统计验证 PIGAs 的校正效果：对于 108 条 Fe I 谱线，谱线强度的中位相对标准偏差（RSD）可有效降低 85%（由 P 校正）和 88%（由 Tshock 校正）；而对于 33 条 Fe II 谱线，可降低 77%（由 P 校正）和 86%（由 Tshock 校正）。17 条自吸收谱线也得到有效校正，其 RSD 降低了 78%（由 P 校正）和 89%（由 Tshock 校正）。我们提出的将优化方法结合起来以量化归一化策略中未知参数的思想，也可扩展到挖掘其他具有类似过程的低温等离子体领域中参数之间的相关性。

articles.title: Numerical modeling and simulation on nanosecond laser-target interactions
articles.title_zh: 纳秒激光-靶相互作用的数值建模与仿真
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09969v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nanosecond lasers are widely used in industrial applications as they are relatively inexpensive, and their compactness and robustness are an advantage. Much experimental work has been carried out to understand deeper the interaction between the nanosecond laser pulses and the targets, as these are complex, transient processes with spatial inhomogeneities. Beside the experiments, the modeling and numerical simulation on the laser interaction with the target are also crucial for understanding the dynamics of laser-material interactions and for optimizing laser processing applications. In this review, the progress of numerical modeling and simulation on nanosecond laser-target interactions are summarized from the aspects of laser-target interactions and target-plasma interface, laser-plasma interactions and plasma radiation, and numerical models on different scales with artificial intelligence advancing. The laser ablation, mass and energy transfer, and mechanical coupling are discussed in the aspect of the nanosecond laser-target interactions and target-plasma interface. The plasma expansion, plasma ionization and recombination, and plasma radiation are discussed in the aspect of the nanosecond laser-plasma interactions and plasma radiation. Then the numerical advances, including microscopic approaches based on molecular dynamics, mesoscopic approaches based on kinetic and statistical physics, macroscopic approaches based on fluid dynamics, and numerical simulations with machine learning are discussed. Finally, the challenges currently being encountered by numerical modeling and simulation on nanosecond laser-target interactions and its potential development direction are considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述总结了纳秒激光与靶相互作用数值建模和仿真的进展。文章从激光-靶相互作用与靶-等离子体界面、激光-等离子体相互作用与等离子体辐射，以及不同尺度数值模型和人工智能辅助方法等方面展开。最后，作者讨论了当前面临的挑战及未来潜在发展方向。
authors: Jian Wu, Ying Zhou, Minxin Chen, Xingwen Li
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.09969v1，公告类型：新。摘要：纳秒激光由于相对廉价，并且其紧凑性和鲁棒性具有优势，因此被广泛用于工业应用。为了更深入理解纳秒激光脉冲与靶之间的相互作用，已经开展了大量实验工作，因为这些过程复杂、瞬态且具有空间非均匀性。除实验之外，激光与靶相互作用的建模和数值仿真对于理解激光-材料相互作用动力学以及优化激光加工应用也至关重要。在这篇综述中，从激光-靶相互作用和靶-等离子体界面、激光-等离子体相互作用和等离子体辐射，以及由人工智能推进的不同尺度数值模型等方面，总结了纳秒激光-靶相互作用数值建模与仿真的进展。在纳秒激光-靶相互作用和靶-等离子体界面方面，讨论了激光烧蚀、质量和能量传递以及力学耦合。在纳秒激光-等离子体相互作用和等离子体辐射方面，讨论了等离子体膨胀、等离子体电离和复合以及等离子体辐射。随后讨论了数值进展，包括基于分子动力学的微观方法、基于动力学和统计物理的介观方法、基于流体动力学的宏观方法，以及结合机器学习的数值仿真。最后，考虑了纳秒激光-靶相互作用数值建模与仿真当前面临的挑战及其潜在发展方向。

articles.title: Deep Learning-Based Statistical Downscaling of Sea Surface Temperature Using a Residual Corrective Neural Network
articles.title_zh: 基于深度学习的海表温度统计降尺度：使用残差校正神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The large-scale oceanic and atmospheric forecasts provided by global climate models typically lack sufficient resolution to accurately capture the response of the coastal ocean to atmospheric forcing and coastal circulation that drive fine-scale SST variability. Dynamical downscaling is computationally prohibitive, when applied to extensive coastlines, predictive ensembles, or long time periods. Therefore, this work presents a statistical downscaling of sea surface temperature (SST) from the seasonal coupled ocean-atmosphere forecast system (ACCESS-S2) using machine learning techniques. This study proposes a novel deep learning framework that uses a U-Net to generate an initial high-resolution SST estimate, which is subsequently refined using a residual corrective approach. The target SST fields are derived from the Regional Ocean Modeling System (ROMS). This two step approach called Residual Corrective Neural Network (RCNN) progressively refines initial U-Net predictions by incorporating dynamically scaled residuals at each step, enabling accurate capture of broad patterns and fine-grained features such as eddies and fronts. We also introduce a custom loss-assisted RCNN variant to improve performance during extreme events, which may be absent from training data due to climate-driven shifts in SST extremes. The framework efficiently downscales SST along the west coast of Australia. A 2011 marine heatwave case study shows that the RCNN improves ACCESS-S2 SST predictions by increasing horizontal resolution from 25 km to 2 km, enabling identification of fine-scale anomalies unresolved in the ACCESS-S2 dataset. This balance between computational efficiency and accuracy supports applications in coastal impact assessment and marine ecosystem studies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种用于海表温度统计降尺度的深度学习框架，将全球季节耦合海气预报系统 ACCESS-S2 的低分辨率结果细化到区域尺度。方法先用 U-Net 生成高分辨率初始估计，再通过残差校正神经网络逐步修正，以捕捉涡旋、锋面等细尺度特征。西澳海岸及 2011 年海洋热浪案例表明，该框架在提升分辨率和识别细尺度异常方面有效。
authors: Onkar Jadhav, Tim French, Ivica Janekovic, Nicole L. Jones, Matthew Rayson
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.10022v1，公告类型：新。摘要：全球气候模型提供的大尺度海洋和大气预报通常缺乏足够分辨率，无法准确捕捉沿海海洋对大气强迫以及驱动细尺度海表温度（SST）变率的沿海环流的响应。当应用于广阔海岸线、预报集合或长时间段时，动力降尺度在计算上代价过高。因此，本工作提出使用机器学习技术，对来自季节耦合海气预报系统（ACCESS-S2）的海表温度（SST）进行统计降尺度。本研究提出一种新的深度学习框架，使用 U-Net 生成初始高分辨率 SST 估计，随后使用残差校正方法对其进行细化。目标 SST 场来自区域海洋建模系统（ROMS）。这种称为残差校正神经网络（RCNN）的两步方法，通过在每一步纳入动态缩放的残差，逐步细化初始 U-Net 预测，从而能够准确捕捉大尺度模式以及涡旋和锋面等细粒度特征。我们还引入了一种自定义损失辅助的 RCNN 变体，以改善极端事件期间的性能；由于气候驱动的 SST 极端值变化，这些极端事件可能在训练数据中缺失。该框架能够高效地对澳大利亚西海岸沿线的 SST 进行降尺度。一个 2011 年海洋热浪案例研究表明，RCNN 通过将水平分辨率从 25 km 提高到 2 km，改进了 ACCESS-S2 的 SST 预测，使得能够识别 ACCESS-S2 数据集中无法解析的细尺度异常。这种计算效率与准确性之间的平衡支持其在沿海影响评估和海洋生态系统研究中的应用。

articles.title: SABRE Hyperpolarization of Unmodified Amino Acids in Partially Aqueous Media: L-[1-13C]-Valine as a Model System
articles.title_zh: 部分水相介质中未修饰氨基酸的 SABRE 超极化：以 L-[1-13C]-缬氨酸为模型体系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10044v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hyperpolarization techniques enhance the sensitivity of nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), enabling detection of low concentration metabolites and dynamic processes. Signal Amplification by Reversible Exchange (SABRE) transfers spin polarization from parahydrogen without permanent chemical modification of the substrate. Here, we demonstrate SABRE-mediated 13C hyperpolarization of unmodified amino acids using L-[1- 13C]-valine as the primary model system and provide preliminary evidence of applicability to glycine. Signal enhancements exceeding 60-fold were observed on a 1.1 T benchtop NMR spectrometer. The dependence of polarization on parahydrogen bubbling time, solvent composition, and substrate-to-catalyst ratio was investigated.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了利用 SABRE 技术对未修饰氨基酸进行 13C 超极化的可行性，主要以 L-[1-13C]-缬氨酸为模型，并给出对甘氨酸适用性的初步证据。在 1.1 T 台式 NMR 上观察到超过 60 倍的信号增强。作者还考察了对位氢鼓泡时间、溶剂组成以及底物-催化剂比例对极化效果的影响。
authors: Oksana A. Bondar, Thomas B. R. Robertson
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.10044v1，公告类型：新。摘要：超极化技术增强了核磁共振（NMR）和磁共振成像（MRI）的灵敏度，使低浓度代谢物和动态过程的检测成为可能。可逆交换信号放大（SABRE）在不对底物进行永久化学修饰的情况下，从对位氢转移自旋极化。在这里，我们展示了使用 L-[1-13C]-缬氨酸作为主要模型体系，对未修饰氨基酸进行 SABRE 介导的 13C 超极化，并提供了其适用于甘氨酸的初步证据。在 1.1 T 台式 NMR 光谱仪上观察到超过 60 倍的信号增强。研究考察了极化对对位氢鼓泡时间、溶剂组成以及底物-催化剂比例的依赖性。

articles.title: Active Electronic Terahertz Imaging for Industrial Applications: From Hardware to the Paradigm Shift by Artificial Intelligence
articles.title_zh: 面向工业应用的主动电子太赫兹成像：从硬件到人工智能引发的范式转变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Imaging with terahertz (THz) radiation (0.3-10 THz) benefits from a unique combination of attributes: penetration through dry, non-polar packaging materials; variations of dielectric functions to provide contrast; the existence of spectral fingerprint resonances for some classes of materials; non-ionizing photon energies that are safe for use around humans; and - viewed from the low-frequency side - an extension of the capabilities of microwave radar to higher frequencies and thus to substantially better spatial resolution, at wavelengths which still permit direct measurement of the complex-valued radiation field. This review concentrates on active THz imaging with electronic sources combined with power detectors or coherent receivers - the system class most likely to deliver fast (ideally real-time), cost-effective and deployable solutions for a wide range of industrial applications such as quality control, non-destructive testing, security screening and ranging for situational awareness. Such systems should be deployable on robotic and emerging autonomous platforms. We review the state of the art of compact semiconductor detector arrays, of imaging modalities ranging from focused-beam raster and frequency-modulated continuous-wave architectures to coherent Fourier-plane acquisition, and of augmentation techniques such as compressive sensing. Particular attention is paid to the growing role of artificial intelligence: from convolutional neural networks and physics-informed deep learning for phase retrieval and image reconstruction, to agentic frameworks for autonomous system design. The bottlenecks of THz imaging - acquisition speed, resolution, contrast and cost - are re-examined in the light of these innovations, and a reference-anchored technology roadmap is derived which projects an order-of-magnitude reduction in the measurement requirements of THz imaging.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述聚焦使用电子源与功率探测器或相干接收机结合的主动太赫兹成像系统，面向质量控制、无损检测、安全筛查和态势感知测距等工业应用。文章回顾了紧凑半导体探测器阵列、各类成像模态、压缩感知等增强技术，以及人工智能在相位恢复、图像重建和自主系统设计中的作用。作者还从采集速度、分辨率、对比度和成本等瓶颈出发，提出了面向未来的技术路线图。
authors: Aparajita Bandyopadhyay, Hui Yuan, Willie J. Padilla, David J. Brady, Hartmut G. Roskos
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.10200v1，公告类型：新。摘要：使用太赫兹（THz）辐射（0.3–10 THz）成像受益于一组独特属性的组合：可穿透干燥的非极性包装材料；介电函数的变化能够提供对比度；某些类别材料存在光谱指纹共振；非电离光子能量使其在人类周围使用是安全的；并且——从低频侧来看——它将微波雷达的能力扩展到更高频率，从而在仍允许直接测量复值辐射场的波长范围内，实现显著更好的空间分辨率。本综述重点关注使用电子源并结合功率探测器或相干接收机的主动 THz 成像——这是最有可能为质量控制、无损检测、安全筛查以及态势感知测距等广泛工业应用提供快速（理想情况下实时）、成本有效且可部署解决方案的系统类别。此类系统应能够部署在机器人和新兴自主平台上。我们回顾了紧凑半导体探测器阵列的最新水平，回顾了从聚焦光束栅格扫描和调频连续波架构到相干傅里叶平面采集的成像模态，以及压缩感知等增强技术。特别关注人工智能日益增长的作用：从用于相位恢复和图像重建的卷积神经网络与物理信息深度学习，到用于自主系统设计的智能体框架。THz 成像的瓶颈——采集速度、分辨率、对比度和成本——在这些创新的背景下被重新审视，并推导出一个以参考依据为锚定的技术路线图，预计可使 THz 成像的测量需求降低一个数量级。

articles.title: A Concept of LNA with Low Input Impedance Using Common Base BJT for Low-Field MRI
articles.title_zh: 用于低场 MRI 的基于共基极 BJT 的低输入阻抗 LNA 概念
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10225v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Purpose: In magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), preamplifier decoupling is used to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of a multichannel receive coil array. In low-field and ultra-low-field MRI, low-noise amplifier (LNA) solutions with low input impedance (LII) are poorly represented and consist mostly of field-effect transistors. We propose a low-cost LNA based on a common-base circuit with bipolar transistors to achieve LII (<5 Ohm), a low noise figure (<1.3 dB), and high gain (>30 dB). Methods: The proposed LNA circuits were simulated, fabricated, and tested at frequencies of 3 MHz and 21.2 MHz. The decoupling capabilities of the proposed LNA were experimentally evaluated, and MR imaging was performed in a 0.5T MRI scanner alongside a comparative study with a commercial LNA. At 3 MHz, the LNA was evaluated by analyzing free induction decay signals. Results: Proposed LNA solutions demonstrate a low noise figure below 1.3 dB with an input impedance of 3 Ohm. It was also shown that the presented LNA circuit enables high SNR values in MR imaging. The developed amplifiers demonstrate superior performance compared to available commercial options within the selected HF band. Conclusion: Due to the availability and cost-effectiveness of the selected transistors, the proposed LNA circuit is highly suitable for low-field MRI applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种面向低场和超低场 MRI 的低成本低噪声放大器方案，基于双极晶体管共基极电路实现低输入阻抗、低噪声系数和高增益。作者在 3 MHz 和 21.2 MHz 下进行了仿真、制作和测试，并在 0.5 T MRI 扫描仪中与商用 LNA 进行了对比成像。结果显示，该方案噪声系数低于 1.3 dB、输入阻抗约 3 Ω，适合低场 MRI 应用。
authors: Aleksei A. Nasonov, Mikhail V. Murzin, Nikolay V. Anisimov, Vasily S. Severikov, Anna A. Dyatlovich, Anna A. Hurshkainen, Georgiy A. Solomakha
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.10225v1，公告类型：新。摘要：目的：在磁共振成像（MRI）中，前置放大器去耦用于提高多通道接收线圈阵列的信噪比。在低场和超低场 MRI 中，具有低输入阻抗（LII）的低噪声放大器（LNA）方案代表性不足，且大多由场效应晶体管构成。我们提出一种基于双极晶体管共基极电路的低成本 LNA，以实现低输入阻抗（<5 Ω）、低噪声系数（<1.3 dB）和高增益（>30 dB）。方法：所提出的 LNA 电路在 3 MHz 和 21.2 MHz 频率下进行了仿真、制造和测试。实验评估了所提出 LNA 的去耦能力，并在 0.5 T MRI 扫描仪中进行了 MR 成像，同时与商用 LNA 进行了比较研究。在 3 MHz 下，通过分析自由感应衰减信号对 LNA 进行了评估。结果：所提出的 LNA 方案表现出低于 1.3 dB 的低噪声系数，输入阻抗为 3 Ω。还表明，所提出的 LNA 电路能够在 MR 成像中实现高 SNR 值。在所选高频频段内，所开发的放大器相较于现有商用选项表现出更优性能。结论：由于所选晶体管的可获得性和成本效益，所提出的 LNA 电路非常适合低场 MRI 应用。

articles.title: Causality Sum Rules in Conventional Scattering Matrices
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scattering matrices are the standard experimental and computational description of photonic and electromagnetic devices. Passivity is explicit in the conventional incoming-outgoing matrix, whereas causality sum rules are usually formulated only after transforming the response into auxiliary variables. Here we show that these rules can be written directly in the conventional scattering matrix by removing the time advance introduced by the reference domain. Using the earliest-arrival delay of each channel, we define a domain-delayed matrix that preserves real-frequency passivity while restoring the causal time origin. Under explicit analyticity, transparency, and regularity assumptions, this matrix becomes a Schur function, enabling a Cayley-Herglotz construction. The resulting projected and determinant bounds constrain coherent channel superpositions and aggregate multichannel loss. The framework recovers Rozanov's absorber limit and spherical-multipole sum rules, while extending causality bounds to measurable quantities including insertion loss, suppressed singular-value channels, and conditional lossless delay-bandwidth trade-offs. Our work directly connects fundamental causality theory with experimentally accessible scattering data. The initial theoretical route is autonomously explored by Qiushi Engine, an AI research system for open-ended scientific discovery, and subsequently verified, refined, and developed by the authors, demonstrating a hybrid AI-human discovery workflow.
authors: Ning Han, Rui Zhao, Shuxing Yang, Mingzhu Li, Hongsheng Chen, Yihao Yang

articles.title: Potential of Atmospheric Pressure Thermal Plasma Technology towards Waste Processing: A Comprehensive Review
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The enhancement of living standards has significantly contributed to the rapid growth of urban populations, resulting in a substantial increase in municipal solid waste (MSW) generation. This trend underscores the critical need for sustainable, environmentally friendly, cost-effective, and highly efficient waste management solutions. This study highlights the pressing necessity for effective MSW management and examines plasma pyrolysis/gasification as an emerging technology to address this challenge. The article provides a detailed analysis of thermal plasma generation techniques employing diverse power sources, including direct current, alternating current, radiofrequency inductively coupled, and microwave-based systems. A comparative evaluation of various plasma torch designs is conducted, emphasizing their applicability in waste-to-energy and waste treatment processes. A comprehensive overview of the treatment of a broad spectrum of waste materials, such as MSW, sewage sludge, coal, wood, plastics, tyres, and rubber, using thermal arc plasma technology is presented. The process predominantly converts waste into a combustible gas (syngas) with a calorific value ranging from 5 to 15 MJ/Nm3 and produces vitrified slag or ash as a by-product. The findings suggest that thermal plasma pyrolysis/gasification offers a promising approach to waste management, facilitating energy generation and material recovery while addressing the challenges of increasing MSW generation.
authors: Tejashwi Rana, Aishik Basu Mallick, Radhika T P, Suryasunil Rath, Pratyay Chattopadhyay, Satyananda Kar

articles.title: Direct experimental measurement of femtonewton-scale momentum transfer force from electron beams
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10582v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron beams (e-beams) are ubiquitous in imaging, patterning, and propulsion. This prevalence is rooted in the profound mastery of their wave-particle duality and energy-transfer pathways. Yet, a fundamental dimension remains largely unexplored: while the mechanical effect (i.e., the momentum transfer to a target) is theoretically known, quantification of its femtonewton-range force has remained elusive. This discrepancy represents a missing piece of the puzzle toward a comprehensive understanding of e-beam-matter interactions, and ultimately limits the multi-dimensional exploitation of e-beams. A force sensor combining femtonewton sensitivity, immunity to electromagnetic noise, compatibility with vacuum, and absolute calibration is critical to bridge the gap between theory and experiment. Here the FINEST (Femtonewton Interferometric Nanomechanical Electron-beam Sensing Technology) sensor is proposed and successfully tested to measure the force of an e-beam. FINEST is an optical-pressure-calibrated 3D spring-type optical sensor that operates reliably under e-beam conditions. Femtonewton-scale forces from 2-30 keV e-beams are directly measured, ranging from 505 fN to 13 pN. Both linear scaling with beam current and a non-monotonic energy dependence (peaking near 10 keV) are observed. Based on this calibrated force, the mechanical contribution to e-beam ice etching was quantitatively confirmed; its effect is orders of magnitude lower than the total etch depth and lacks noticeable energy dependence. By achieving the first direct experimental measurement of e-beam momentum transfer, this work adds a long-missing dimension to the physical landscape of e-beam processes.
