articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06570v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The quantum lattice Boltzmann (QLB) scheme of Succi and Dellar advances a four-component Dirac spinor on a lattice by a fixed sequence of local, exactly norm-preserving operations: a basis rotation, a collision, a streaming shift, and the inverse rotation. This unitarity is a structural property of the scheme, not an approximation, which suggests that a QLB time step should map onto a sequence of quantum gates. Here we make that mapping explicit. We give a gate-level construction of every operation of the three-dimensional Dirac QLB scheme: the fixed rotation gates, the collision gate, the streaming shift as a controlled increment on a position register, the position-dependent potential as a phase oracle, and periodic and reflecting (bounce-back) boundary conditions as unitary circuits. We then compose them into single-axis, two- and three-dimensional time steps. On a state-vector emulator the resulting circuits reproduce the classical QLB solver to machine precision (maximum density deviation between 3.7×10⁻¹² and 1.0×10⁻¹⁷ across the one-, two-, and three-dimensional tests), so the circuits are the scheme rather than an approximation of it. The scope is narrow: we establish that the Succi-Dellar theory can be implemented on a (gate-model) quantum computer, and report the associated gate counts. We make no claim of computational advantage; state preparation, measurement, and asymptotic cost are discussed as open questions. All operators, circuits, tests, and figures are reproducible from the open-source quantumKineticMethods library.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将 Succi-Dellar 量子格子 Boltzmann 格式的三维 Dirac 演化显式映射为门模型量子线路。作者给出了旋转、碰撞、流动位移、位置相关势以及周期和反射边界条件等操作的门级构造，并在状态矢量模拟器上达到与经典 QLB 求解器机器精度一致的结果。论文强调该工作证明了可实现性并报告门数，但不主张计算优势。
authors: Nilesh Sawant, Ethan Young, Kevin Griffin, Michael Martin
articles.abstract_zh_full: Succi 和 Dellar 的量子格子 Boltzmann（QLB）格式通过一系列固定的局域、严格保持范数的操作在格点上推进四分量 Dirac 旋量：基变换、碰撞、流动位移以及逆变换。这种幺正性是该格式的结构性质，而不是近似，这表明 QLB 的一个时间步应当能够映射为一系列量子门。在这里，我们使这一映射显式化。我们给出了三维 Dirac QLB 格式中每个操作的门级构造：固定旋转门、碰撞门、作为位置寄存器受控增量的流动位移、作为相位 oracle 的位置相关势，以及作为幺正线路的周期边界条件和反射（回弹）边界条件。随后，我们将它们组合成单轴、二维和三维时间步。在状态矢量模拟器上，所得线路以机器精度复现经典 QLB 求解器，在一维、二维和三维测试中最大密度偏差介于 3.7×10⁻¹² 和 1.0×10⁻¹⁷ 之间，因此这些线路就是该格式本身，而非对其的近似。本文范围较窄：我们确立了 Succi-Dellar 理论可在（门模型）量子计算机上实现，并报告了相关门数。我们不声称存在计算优势；态制备、测量和渐近成本作为开放问题讨论。所有算符、线路、测试和图均可由开源 quantumKineticMethods 库复现。

articles.title: Quantum-State Projectors on Grassmannian: Geometry, Holonomy, and Topology
articles.title_zh: Grassmann 流形上的量子态投影算符：几何、和乐与拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06777v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An isolated group of k bands in an N-level quantum system defines a rank-k spectral projector and hence a map into the complex Grassmannian Gr(k,N). For a smooth gapped Hamiltonian, this projector is globally smooth and periodic even when band topology obstructs a globally smooth periodic, or symmetry-compatible, Bloch frame. We take the globally defined differential dd P as the central object: it is the tangent field of the Grassmannian map, removes unphysical rotations within the selected subspace, and retains the physical interband transition. The interband block of this tangent data simultaneously determines the quantum metric and Berry curvature; the associated horizontal generator produces finite Grassmannian motion, while wedge products of dd P enter topological forms. We construct a shortest path between two projectors in the ambient Grassmannian and show that the singular values of its horizontal generator block are the principal angles between the endpoint subspaces. This construction provides a piecewise-geodesic interpretation of discrete geometric phases. In a separate development, we derive a basis-independent expression for the determinant of a multiband Wilson loop from traces of powers of an ordered projector product, without decomposing a degenerate band multiplet into individual bands. Finally, the same tangent-vector calculus organizes Chern characters, chiral winding numbers, and the time-reversal mathbb Z₂ index. The resulting framework unifies local quantum geometry, finite subspace distance, holonomy, and topology while avoiding global gauge fixing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以孤立多能带子空间的谱投影算符为核心，构建了描述量子几何、有限子空间距离、Wilson 回路和拓扑不变量的统一框架。作者强调全局定义的微分 dP 可避免所选子空间内部的非物理规范旋转，同时保留物理带间跃迁信息。该框架可在无需全局规范固定的情况下组织陈特征类、手征绕数和时间反演 Z₂ 指标。
articles.abstract_zh_full: N 能级量子系统中的一组孤立的 k 条能带定义了一个秩为 k 的谱投影算符，因而定义了一个到复 Grassmann 流形 Gr(k,N) 的映射。对于光滑有能隙哈密顿量，即使能带拓扑阻碍了全局光滑周期的、或与对称性兼容的 Bloch 标架，该投影算符仍是全局光滑且周期的。我们将全局定义的微分 dP 作为核心对象：它是 Grassmann 映射的切向场，去除了所选子空间内部的非物理旋转，并保留了物理带间跃迁。该切向数据的带间块同时决定量子度量和 Berry 曲率；相关的水平生成元产生有限的 Grassmann 运动，而 dP 的外积进入拓扑形式。我们构造了环境 Grassmann 流形中两个投影算符之间的最短路径，并表明其水平生成元块的奇异值就是端点子空间之间的主角。该构造为离散几何相提供了分段测地线解释。在另一项展开中，我们从有序投影算符乘积的幂迹出发，推导了多能带 Wilson 回路行列式的基无关表达式，而无需将简并能带多重态分解为单条能带。最后，同一套切向量微积分组织了陈特征、手征绕数和时间反演 Z₂ 指标。所得框架在避免全局规范固定的同时，统一了局域量子几何、有限子空间距离、和乐与拓扑。

articles.title: Many-Body Localization Induced by Correlated Disorder in Interacting Superconducting Qubits
articles.title_zh: 相互作用超导量子比特中由关联无序诱导的多体局域化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07149v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The failure of quantum thermalization due to Many-Body Localization (MBL) has evolved from a theoretical concept in spin chains to an experimental reality in synthetic quantum platforms, most notably superconducting circuits based on transmon qubits. Despite its significance, the MBL transition has been studied primarily under purely random disorder and local couplings, leaving more complex and realistic configurations largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the quantum dynamics of transmon networks subject to the unavoidable competing effects of correlated disorder and network-mediated non-local interactions. First, we show how to engineer the physical parameters of the quantum hardware to systematically control the correlated disorder patterns emerging in the system. Then, we demonstrate that the MBL phase transition is robust against such correlations, which is essential for tuning localization properties in realistic transmon devices. This robustness is established through the analysis of the block entanglement entropy variance across disorder realizations, which precisely locates the MBL critical point. Independently, we introduce a local memory parameter, whose dynamics at long evolution times reveals memory retention in the localized phase and yields a critical point consistent with the entropy analysis. These results provide a framework for understanding localization in complex quantum network topologies, with potential implications for multi-qubit processor design.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了 transmon 超导量子比特网络中关联无序与网络介导非局域相互作用共同存在时的多体局域化。作者展示了如何通过硬件物理参数系统控制无序关联模式，并证明 MBL 相变对这类关联具有稳健性。通过块纠缠熵方差和局域记忆参数，研究得到了相互一致的临界点判据。
authors: Thiago R. Girão Souza, Andreia Saguia, Alan C. Santos, Marcelo S. Sarandy
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由多体局域化（MBL）导致的量子热化失败，已经从自旋链中的理论概念发展为合成量子平台中的实验现实，尤其是在基于 transmon 量子比特的超导线路中。尽管其意义重大，MBL 转变主要是在纯随机无序和局域耦合下被研究，而更复杂且更现实的构型在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们研究 transmon 网络在关联无序和网络介导的非局域相互作用这两种不可避免的竞争效应下的量子动力学。首先，我们展示如何设计量子硬件的物理参数，以系统地控制系统中出现的关联无序模式。随后，我们证明 MBL 相变对这类关联具有稳健性，这对于在现实 transmon 器件中调控局域化性质至关重要。这种稳健性通过分析不同无序实现之间的块纠缠熵方差得以确立，该方差能够精确定位 MBL 临界点。独立地，我们引入一个局域记忆参数，其长时间演化揭示了局域化相中的记忆保持，并给出与熵分析一致的临界点。这些结果为理解复杂量子网络拓扑中的局域化提供了框架，并可能对多量子比特处理器设计产生影响。

articles.title: Exploring the Relaxation Landscape of a 2D Quantum Magnet on a 256-Qubit Processor
articles.title_zh: 在 256 量子比特处理器上探索二维量子磁体的弛豫图景
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07178v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How quantum matter relaxes far from equilibrium is a central open problem in many-body physics, and one for which analog quantum simulators are well positioned to move from confirming theory to discovering new physics. Here, we use a two-dimensional Rydberg atom array of 256 qubits to map the relaxation landscape of the two-dimensional transverse-field Ising model across its phase diagram. Beyond the expected rapid thermalization, we identify two further regimes. The first is a prethermal regime whose dynamics are governed by an effective XY model. The second, and most unexpected, is a crossover regime characterized by a slowdown in relaxation. This slowdown occurs precisely where state-of-the-art classical tensor-network methods lose control at late times, whereas the quantum simulation remains consistent across system sizes. These results establish Rydberg atom arrays as a platform for scientific discovery in nonequilibrium quantum many-body dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 256 量子比特二维 Rydberg 原子阵列，绘制二维横场 Ising 模型在相图中的远离平衡弛豫图景。除预期的快速热化外，作者还识别出由有效 XY 模型支配的预热化区以及一个出人意料的弛豫减慢交叉区。该减慢区恰好位于经典张量网络方法在长时间失控的位置，显示 Rydberg 阵列可用于发现非平衡多体动力学中的新现象。
authors: Tiago Mendes-Santos, Joseph Vovrosh, Sergi Julià-Farré, Dorian Claveau, Guillaume Villaret, Lucas Béguin, Lucas Leclerc, Laurin Brunner, Wladislaw Krinitsin, Matthias Hecker, Fergus Hayes, Boris Albrecht, Lilian Bourachot, Clémence Briosne-Frejaville, Antoine Cornillot, Julius de Hond, Djibril Diallo, Clément Dupays, Robin Dupont, Thomas Eritzpokhoff, Loïc Henriet, Lucas Lassablière, Arvid Lindberg, Yohann Machu, Hadriel Mamann, Thomas Pansiot, Julien Ripoll, Bruno Ximenez, Henrique Silvério, Joseph Tindall, Markus Schmitt, Markus Heyl, Adrien Signoles, Constantin Dalyac, Antoine Browaeys, Alexandre Dauphin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子物质如何在远离平衡的情况下弛豫，是多体物理中的一个核心开放问题，也是模拟量子模拟器有望从验证理论走向发现新物理的领域。在这里，我们使用由 256 个量子比特组成的二维 Rydberg 原子阵列，绘制二维横场 Ising 模型在其相图中的弛豫图景。除了预期的快速热化之外，我们还识别出另外两个区域。第一个是预热化区域，其动力学由一个有效 XY 模型支配。第二个也是最出乎意料的是一个以弛豫减慢为特征的交叉区域。这种减慢恰好发生在最先进的经典张量网络方法在晚期时间失去控制的位置，而量子模拟在不同系统尺寸下仍保持一致。这些结果确立了 Rydberg 原子阵列作为非平衡量子多体动力学中科学发现平台的地位。

articles.title: Anomaly quenching and dynamical cooling of Hawking evaporation in Horndeski gravity
articles.title_zh: Horndeski 引力中 Hawking 蒸发的反常抑制与动力学冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07182v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the semiclassical Hawking evaporation of a two-dimensional Callan-Giddings-Harvey-Strominger (CGHS) black hole perturbed by first-order Horndeski scalar-tensor couplings. By evaluating the exact scalar curvature invariants, we demonstrate that coordinate singularities near the apparent horizon parametrize a physical deformation of the surface gravity while preserving a strictly regular event horizon. In the linear-order γ₃ Φ X coupling sector, the surface gravity and correspondingly the Hawking temperature decreases dynamically as the black hole loses mass. Extrapolating this cooling effect via a resummed temperature equation suggests that evaporation halts, potentially leaving behind a stable, macroscopic cold remnant at the boundary of perturbative control. Utilizing both the conformal trace anomaly and the Robinson-Wilczek gravitational anomaly, we establish that the asymptotic radiation flux identically reflects this geometric shift. Consequently, the fine-grained entanglement entropy of the Hawking radiation departs from linear growth and transitions to an asymptotic logarithmic regime. This indicates that quantum information may be permanently retained within the remnant, altering the standard semiclassical Page curve without requiring a breakdown of horizon regularity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了在一阶 Horndeski 标量-张量耦合作用扰动下，二维 Callan-Giddings-Harvey-Strominger（CGHS）黑洞的半经典 Hawking 蒸发。结果表明，表观视界附近的坐标奇点对应表面引力的物理形变，而事件视界仍保持严格正则；在线性阶 γ₃ΦX 耦合下，黑洞随失质量增大时温度会动态降低。基于重求和温度方程的外推显示蒸发可能停止，留下稳定的冷残骸，并且轨道外辐射通量与这一几何变化完全一致。
authors: Amogh Srivastav (IIT Bombay), S. Shankaranarayanan (IIT Bombay)
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在一阶 Horndeski 标量-张量耦合作用扰动下，二维 Callan-Giddings-Harvey-Strominger（CGHS）黑洞的半经典 Hawking 蒸发。通过计算精确的标量曲率不变量，我们表明，表观视界附近的坐标奇点参数化了表面引力的物理形变，同时保持事件视界严格正则。在线性阶 γ₃ΦX 耦合部门中，表面引力以及相应的 Hawking 温度会随着黑洞失去质量而动态降低。将这一冷却效应通过重求和温度方程外推，表明蒸发会停滞，并可能在微扰控制边界处留下一个稳定的、宏观尺度的冷残骸。利用共形迹反常和 Robinson-Wilczek 引力反常两种方法，我们建立了渐近辐射通量与这一几何变化完全一致。因而，Hawking 辐射的细粒度纠缠熵不再线性增长，而是转变为渐近的对数行为。这表明量子信息可能被永久保留在残骸中，在不需要视界正则性破坏的情况下改变标准的半经典 Page 曲线。

articles.title: Discrete chiral ballistic polariton laser
articles.title_zh: 离散手性弹道极化激元激光器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.02816v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) of light appears when the phase of an electromagnetic wavefront winds around its direction of propagation, also known as optical vorticity. Contrary to the binary-valued photon spin, the integer-valued optical vortex charge is unbounded with many advantages in optical communication and trapping and enhancing the capacity of data encoding and multiplexing. Singular optoelectronic and chiroptic quantum technologies rely on the development of coherent and compact light sources of well-defined and reconfigurable OAM. We propose an optically tunable discrete chiral exciton-polariton microlaser that leverages strong spin-dependent polariton interactions, structured pumping, and inherent cavity photon spin-to-angular momentum conversion to emit coherent nonlinear light of variable OAM. By choosing pumping patterns with broken inversion symmetry in the microcavity plane we invoke geometric frustration between spinor ballistic condensates which spontaneously obtain a high-charge circulating current locked with the pump polarization. Our optically configurable system requires only a planar cavity thus avoiding the need for specialized irreversible cavity patterning or metasurfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种可光学调控的离散手性激子-极化激元微腔激光器，可产生具有可变轨道角动量的相干非线性光。该方案利用自旋依赖的极化激元相互作用、结构化泵浦以及腔内光子自旋到角动量的转换机制，通过破缺反演对称性的泵浦图样实现高拓扑荷的环流态。整个系统只需平面微腔，无需特殊的不可逆腔体刻蚀或超表面设计。
authors: Zuzanna Werner, Andrzej Frkaczak, Valtýr Kári Daníelsson, Jacek Szczytko, Barbara Piketka, Helgi Sigurdhsson
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光的轨道角动量（OAM）出现在电磁波前的相位绕其传播方向发生缠绕时，也称为光学涡旋。与二值的光子自旋不同，整数值的光学涡旋荷是无界的，在光通信、捕获以及提升数据编码和复用容量方面具有许多优势。奇异光电与手性量子技术依赖于具有明确且可重构 OAM 的相干、紧凑光源的发展。我们提出一种可光学调控的离散手性激子-极化激元微激光器，它利用强的自旋依赖极化激元相互作用、结构化泵浦，以及内禀的腔光子自旋到角动量转换，来发射具有可变 OAM 的相干非线性光。通过选择在微腔平面内破缺反演对称性的泵浦图样，我们引入自旋子弹道凝聚体之间的几何挫折，这些凝聚体会自发获得与泵浦偏振锁定的高电荷环流。我们的光学可配置系统只需要一个平面腔体，因此避免了对特殊的、不可逆的腔体图案化或超表面的需求。

articles.title: Engineering Tunable Kagome Moiré Superlattices in Twisted Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
articles.title_zh: 在扭转过渡金属二硫族化物中构建可调的 Kagome 莫尔超晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.13422v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Kagome systems are an ideal platform for exploring strongly correlated phases due to their unique electronic structure and geometric frustration. While recent solid-state realizations have uncovered a wealth of correlated states, they suffer from key limitations, including limited tunability of carrier density and interaction strength. Here, we propose an experimentally viable scheme to realize a breathing kagome moiré superlattice using a twisted trilayer of transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs). By twisting the top and bottom layers relative to the middle by small angles θ and 2θ, respectively, we generate a kagome-like moiré potential on the central layer. Continuum model calculations reveal isolated kagome bands featuring flat bands, Dirac points with tunable gaps, and van Hove singularities. Crucially, this platform offers unprecedented control over band structure, carrier density, and interactions, achievable via twist angle and electrostatic gating. Our work opens a new route to realizing clean, tunable kagome metals and provides a versatile platform for studying strongly correlated and topological phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种在扭转三层过渡金属二硫族化物中实现 breathing kagome 莫尔超晶格的实验可行方案。通过让上下两层相对中间层分别以小角度 θ 与 2θ 扭转，中心层上会形成类 Kagome 的莫尔势，从而得到孤立的 Kagome 能带，包括平带、可调能隙的狄拉克点和范霍夫奇点。该平台可通过扭转角和静电栅压同时调控能带结构、载流子密度与相互作用，为研究强关联与拓扑现象提供了新的洁净平台。
authors: Adrian Fedorko, Chao-Xing Liu, Zhen Bi
articles.abstract_zh_full: Kagome 体系由于其独特的电子结构和几何挫折，是研究强关联相的理想平台。尽管近期的固体实现揭示了丰富的关联态，但它们存在一些关键局限，包括载流子密度和相互作用强度的可调性有限。本文提出一种实验上可行的方案：利用扭转三层过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）实现 breathing kagome 莫尔超晶格。通过使顶层和底层分别相对于中间层以小角度 θ 和 2θ 扭转，我们在中心层上生成了一个类 Kagome 的莫尔势。连续模型计算显示，体系形成了孤立的 Kagome 能带，具有平带、带隙可调的狄拉克点以及范霍夫奇点。关键在于，这一平台可通过扭转角和静电栅控实现对能带结构、载流子密度和相互作用的前所未有的控制。我们的工作开辟了一条实现洁净、可调 Kagome 金属的新途径，并为研究强关联与拓扑现象提供了一个多功能平台。

articles.title: Disorder-induced proximate quantum spin ice phase in Pr2Sn2O7
articles.title_zh: Pr2Sn2O7 中由无序诱导的近邻量子自旋冰相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.19248v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetic pyrochlores with non-Kramers rare-earth ions provide a platform for exploring emergent gauge physics and quantum spin-ice behavior, yet the influence of structural disorder on their ground states remains insufficiently understood. Here we combine bulk characterization and single-crystal neutron-scattering measurements to investigate the non-Kramers pyrochlore Pr2Sn2O7. At temperatures below ~1 K, the system exhibits key hallmarks of quantum spin-ice physics, including anisotropic spin-ice correlations and two distinct dynamical timescales. Upon further cooling, however, we observe a complete spin-freezing transition at T_f ~ 0.15 K, accompanied by recovery of the full nuclear Schottky anomaly, the emergence of a gapped magnetic excitation, and the development of incipient (100) magnetic correlations. Comparison with related Pr-based pyrochlores places Pr2Sn2O7 near the spin-frozen boundary of a disorder-perturbed phase diagram. These results establish a disorder-driven framework for the evolution of quantum spin-ice behavior into frozen ground states, revealing how signatures of a proximate quantum spin liquid can persist despite disorder-induced spin freezing in non-Kramers pyrochlores.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合体性质表征和单晶中子散射，研究了非 Kramers 稀土磁性焦绿石 Pr2Sn2O7。结果表明，在低于约 1 K 时，体系呈现量子自旋冰的特征，包括各向异性的自旋冰关联和两种不同的动力学时间尺度；但进一步降温后，体系在约 0.15 K 发生完全自旋冻结。该冻结伴随核 Schottky 异常的恢复、带隙磁激发的出现以及初现的 (100) 磁关联，说明无序会驱动量子自旋冰向冻结基态演化。
authors: Yi Luo, Brenden R. Ortiz, Miles J. Knudtson, Stephen D. Wilson, Jue Liu, Benjamin A. Frandsen, Si Athena Chen, Matthias D. Frontzek, Andrey A. Podlesnyak, Joseph A. M. Paddison, Adam A. Aczel
articles.abstract_zh_full: 含有非 Kramers 稀土离子的磁性焦绿石为探索涌现规范物理和量子自旋冰行为提供了一个平台，但结构无序对其基态的影响仍不够清楚。本文结合体性质表征和单晶中子散射测量，研究了非 Kramers 焦绿石 Pr2Sn2O7。结果显示，在约 1 K 以下，体系表现出量子自旋冰物理的关键特征，包括各向异性的自旋冰关联以及两种不同的动力学时间尺度。然而，在进一步降温时，我们观察到在 T_f ~ 0.15 K 发生完全的自旋冻结转变，同时伴随完整核 Schottky 异常的恢复、带隙磁激发的出现，以及初生的 (100) 磁关联的发展。与相关的 Pr 基焦绿石对比表明，Pr2Sn2O7 处于受无序扰动的相图中接近自旋冻结边界的位置。这些结果建立了一个由无序驱动的框架，用于描述量子自旋冰行为向冻结基态的演化，并揭示了即使在无序诱导的自旋冻结存在时，近邻量子自旋液体的特征信号仍可在非 Kramers 焦绿石中持续存在。

articles.title: Ideal Optical Flux Lattices
articles.title_zh: 理想光学磁通晶格
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.01481v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The realization of fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states in cold atomic gases is a long-standing goal in quantum simulation. Established approaches, including rapidly rotating gases and tight-binding lattices, are often hampered by low interaction energies and small many-body energy gaps. While optical flux lattices (OFLs) can achieve higher effective magnetic flux densities, standard two-state configurations generate highly non-uniform fields, and extensions to multi-state systems introduce significant experimental complexity. Here, we present a new paradigm for engineering robust FQH phases in OFLs using only two internal atomic states. We show that the introduction of an additional scalar potential provides a generic mechanism for creating Chern bands that are simultaneously essentially flat and "ideal". These desirable properties arise by tuning lattice parameters to certain N-flat manifolds (N=1,2,dots), where the 1-flat manifold shares its origin with certain "magic-angle" conditions familiar from moiré materials. A central result is the design of a dark-state OFL whose adiabatic Hamiltonian is exactly of Aharonov-Casher (AC) form. This exact AC equivalence guarantees perfectly flat, exactly vortexable Chern bands in the adiabatic limit. This method allows for precise tuning of band flatness and stabilizes both Abelian and non-Abelian FQH phases. Our scheme is compatible with existing experimental capabilities using vector polarizability, opening practical routes to exploring strongly correlated topological physics with cold atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种仅依赖两种原子内部态的光学磁通晶格新方案，用于实现稳健的分数量子霍尔相。通过引入额外的标量势，可以在原则上构造既近乎平坦又“理想”的 Chern 能带，并可通过调节到 N-flat 流形上实现精确控制。文中还设计了一个其绝热哈密顿量严格满足 Aharonov-Casher 形式的暗态光学磁通晶格，从而保证在绝热极限下出现完全平坦、可涡旋化的 Chern 能带。
authors: Ophelia Evelyn Sommer, Nigel R. Cooper
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在冷原子气体中实现分数量子霍尔（FQH）态是量子模拟领域长期追求的目标。现有方法，包括快速旋转气体和紧束缚晶格，往往受限于较低的相互作用能量和较小的多体能隙。尽管光学磁通晶格（OFLs）能够实现更高的有效磁通密度，但标准的双态构型会产生非常不均匀的磁场，而扩展到多态系统又会引入显著的实验复杂性。本文提出一种在 OFLs 中工程化稳健 FQH 相的新范式，只需两种原子内部态即可实现。我们证明，引入额外的标量势提供了一种通用机制，可生成同时近乎平坦且“理想”的 Chern 能带。这些理想性质可通过将晶格参数调节到某些 N-flat 流形（N=1,2,……）上获得，其中 1-flat 流形的起源与莫尔材料中熟悉的某些“魔角”条件相同。一个核心结果是设计出一种暗态 OFL，其绝热哈密顿量严格呈现 Aharonov-Casher（AC）形式。这种精确的 AC 等价性保证了在绝热极限下出现完全平坦、严格可涡旋化的 Chern 能带。该方法允许精确调控能带平坦度，并稳定 Abelian 和非 Abelian FQH 相。我们的方案与现有基于向列极化率的实验能力兼容，为利用冷原子探索强关联拓扑物理开辟了切实可行的路径。

articles.title: The anisotropic Heisenberg model close to the Ising limit: triangular lattice vs. effective models
articles.title_zh: 接近 Ising 极限的各向异性海森堡模型：三角晶格与有效模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.12667v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Stimulated by recent experiments on materials representing the realization of the anisotropic Heisenberg spin-1/2 model on the triangular lattice, we explore further properties of such a model in the easy-axis regime α = Jₚₑᵣₚ/J_z < 1 and the plausibility of finding effective models that capture similar physics. We show that, at finite fields, the magnetization curve as well as the transverse magnetization (superfluid) order parameter mₚₑᵣₚ of the triangular lattice model are indeed qualitatively reproduced by anisotropic Heisenberg models on the honeycomb or the square lattice. At the point of correspondence to the zero-field triangular lattice model, however, the bipartite models are qualitatively different as they remain gapless even at α łl 1 with a small but finite mₚₑᵣₚ >0 . Conversely, we present several additional numerical studies of the full model on the triangular lattice which support the appearance of a gap at zero field and α łl 1. In particular, the magnetization curve m(h) as well as the spin stiffness h̊oₛ indicate a transition/crossover from gappless to gapped regimes at α sim α^* with α^* łesssim 0.5. We also show that deviations from the linear spin-wave theory and the emergence of the gap can be traced back to the strong effective repulsion between magnon excitations, showcasing similarity to strongly correlated systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文围绕三角晶格上的自旋 1/2 各向异性海森堡模型在易轴区间的性质展开研究，并考察蜂窝晶格和正方晶格上的有效模型是否能够复现相似物理。在有限磁场下，这些双分晶格模型可以定性再现三角晶格模型的磁化曲线与横向磁化序参量。然而在零场对应点上，它们与三角晶格模型存在定性差异，尤其是在 α ≪ 1 时仍保持无能隙。相反，作者的数值结果支持三角晶格模型在零场、强 Ising 极限下出现能隙，并显示从无隙到有隙的转变/交叉可能发生在 α* ≲ 0.5 附近。
authors: Martin Ulaga, Jure Kokalj, Takami Tohyama, Peter Prelovšek
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受近期关于代表三角晶格上各向异性海森堡自旋 1/2 模型实现的材料实验激励，我们进一步研究了该模型在易轴区间 α = Jₚₑᵣₚ/J_z < 1 中的性质，以及能否找到能够捕捉类似物理的有效模型的可能性。我们表明，在有限磁场下，三角晶格模型的磁化曲线以及横向磁化（超流）序参量 mₚₑᵣₚ，确实可以被蜂窝晶格或正方晶格上的各向异性海森堡模型在定性上复现。然而，在与零场三角晶格模型相对应的点上，这些双分模型在定性上是不同的，因为即便在 α ≪ 1 且 mₚₑᵣₚ > 0 的情况下，它们仍保持无能隙。反过来，我们对三角晶格上完整模型的若干额外数值研究支持在零场和 α ≪ 1 时能隙的出现。尤其是磁化曲线 m(h) 以及自旋刚度 h̊ₒₛ 表明，在 α ~ α* 处存在从无隙到有隙区间的转变/交叉，而 α* ≲ 0.5。我们还表明，与线性自旋波理论的偏离以及能隙的出现可以追溯到磁振子激发之间强烈的有效排斥，这展示了其与强关联系统的相似性。

articles.title: Boundary Criticality at the Nishimori Multicritical Point
articles.title_zh: Nishimori 多临界点处的边界临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.19523v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study boundary criticality at the Nishimori multicritical point of the two-dimensional (2D) random-bond Ising model. Using tensor-network methods, we construct a family of microscopic boundary conditions that incorporates both boundary-spin rotation and boundary disorder. We identify three conformal boundary fixed points, corresponding to free, fixed, and random boundary conditions, and map out the boundary renormalization group flows among them. We extract the corresponding boundary conformal data, including the boundary entropies and the scaling dimensions of boundary primary operators, which characterize the boundary universality class. At the free boundary fixed point, we uncover the multifractal scaling of boundary spin fields. We further complement the numerical results with a controlled renormalization group analysis. Finally, we connect the boundary conformal data to quantum error-correcting codes, establishing a bridge between boundary universality class and boundary decoding threshold.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究二维随机键 Ising 模型的 Nishimori 多临界点处的边界临界现象。作者利用张量网络方法构造了同时包含边界自旋旋转和边界无序的一类微观边界条件，并识别出自由、固定和随机三种共形边界固定点及其间的重整化群流。研究还提取了边界熵和边界主算符标度维数等边界共形数据，并发现自由边界固定点处边界自旋场呈现多重分形标度。
authors: Sheng Yang, Xinyu Sun, Shao-Kai Jian
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究二维（2D）随机键 Ising 模型在 Nishimori 多临界点处的边界临界性。利用张量网络方法，我们构造了一族微观边界条件，其中同时包含边界自旋旋转和边界无序。我们识别出三个共形边界固定点，分别对应自由、固定和随机边界条件，并描绘了它们之间的边界重整化群流。我们提取了相应的边界共形数据，包括边界熵和边界主算符的标度维数，这些量刻画了边界普适类。在自由边界固定点处，我们发现了边界自旋场的多重分形标度。我们进一步用受控的重整化群分析补充了数值结果。最后，我们将边界共形数据与量子纠错码联系起来，建立了边界普适类与边界译码阈值之间的桥梁。

articles.title: Non-reciprocal circular dichroism of axial phonons coupled to ferro-rotational order
articles.title_zh: 与铁旋转序耦合的轴向声子之非互易圆二色性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.22050v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Circular dichroism (CD) in X-ray absorption, defined as the difference in absorption between opposite circular polarizations, is fundamentally enabled by the breaking of time-reversal symmetry or inversion symmetry. It is therefore sensitive to magnetism, chirality, and their interplay. In contrast, the sample symmetry alone is insufficient to determine whether CD in resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) is allowed. Rather, RIXS-CD is governed by both the sample symmetry and the scattering geometry. Here, using RIXS, we identify circularly polarized phonons coupled to ferro-rotational order in MnTiO₃, which we refer to as ferro-axial phonons. Their excitations provide a direct demonstration of non-reciprocal RIXS-CD, in which the dichroic response changes upon reversing the propagation direction of the incident X-rays, although the system globally preserves both inversion and time-reversal symmetries. We propose that a condensate of these phonons, manifested as standing waves, underlies the ferro-rotational order in MnTiO₃. The observed non-reciprocal CD reflects the interplay among photon helicity, phonon polarization, and ferro-rotational order.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用共振非弹性 X 射线散射研究 MnTiO3 中与铁旋转序耦合的圆偏振声子，即铁轴向声子。作者发现，这些激发表现出非互易圆二色性：当入射 X 射线的传播方向反转时，二色响应会改变，尽管体系整体同时保持反演和时间反演对称性。结果表明，RIXS 中的圆二色性不仅受样品对称性影响，还与散射几何密切相关。
authors: H. Y. Huang, G. Channagowdra, D. Banerjee, E. V. Komleva, J. Okamoto, C. T. Chen, M. Guennou, S. Johnston, S. V. Streltsov, C. Y. Mou, A. Fujimori, S-W. Cheong, D. J. Huang
articles.abstract_zh_full: X 射线吸收中的圆二色性（CD）定义为对相反圆偏振光的吸收差异，其根本上由时间反演对称性或反演对称性的破缺所允许，因此对磁性、手性及其相互作用十分敏感。相较之下，仅靠样品对称性并不足以决定共振非弹性 X 射线散射（RIXS）中是否允许出现 CD。实际上，RIXS-CD 同时受样品对称性和散射几何的支配。本文利用 RIXS，在 MnTiO3 中识别出与铁旋转序耦合的圆偏振声子，我们将其称为铁轴向声子（ferro-axial phonons）。这些激发直接展示了非互易 RIXS-CD，即当反转入射 X 射线的传播方向时，二色响应会发生变化，尽管体系整体同时保持反演和时间反演对称性。我们提出，这些声子的凝聚态表现为驻波，可能是 MnTiO3 中铁旋转序的根源。所观测到的非互易 CD 反映了光子螺旋度、声子极化和铁旋转序之间的相互作用。

articles.title: Restoring Sparsity in Potts Machines via Mean-Field Constraints
articles.title_zh: 通过平均场约束恢复 Potts 机中的稀疏性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.04200v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ising machines and related probabilistic hardware have emerged as promising platforms for NP-hard optimization and sampling. However, many practical problems involve constraints that induce dense or all-to-all couplings, undermining scalability and hardware efficiency. We address this constraint-induced density through two complementary approaches. First, we introduce a hardware-aware native formulation for multi-state probabilistic digits (p-dits) that avoids the locally dense intra-variable couplings required by binary Ising encodings. We validate p-dit dynamics by reproducing known critical behavior of the 2D Potts model. Second, we propose mean-field constraints (MFC), a hybrid scheme that replaces dense pairwise constraint couplings with dynamically updated single-node biases. Applied to balanced graph partitioning, MFC achieves solution quality comparable to exact all-to-all constraint formulations while dramatically reducing graph density. Finally, we demonstrate the practical impact of restored sparsity through an FPGA implementation. In comparisons using FPGA kernel time and CPU solver-loop time, and excluding the current prototype's host-device schedule transfer overhead, the FPGA reaches the 50% success threshold more than an order of magnitude faster than the CPU probabilistic solvers and more than two orders of magnitude faster than the Tabu Ising baseline. Together, these results outline a pathway for scaling constrained optimization on probabilistic hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对约束导致的稠密耦合问题，提出了两种互补方案以提升概率硬件的可扩展性。其一是面向多态概率数字（p-dits）的硬件友好原生表示，可避免二值 Ising 编码中变量内部所需的局域稠密耦合；其二是平均场约束（MFC）混合方案，用动态更新的单节点偏置替代稠密的成对约束耦合。作者在平衡图划分问题和 FPGA 实现中验证了方法的有效性，并显示其在保持解质量的同时显著降低图密度。
authors: Kevin Callahan-Coray, Kyle Lee, Kyle Jiang, Kerem Y. Camsari
articles.abstract_zh_full: Ising 机及相关概率硬件已成为求解 NP-hard 优化和采样问题的有前景平台。然而，许多实际问题包含会引入稠密或全连接耦合的约束，从而削弱可扩展性和硬件效率。我们通过两种互补方法来处理这种由约束引起的稠密性。首先，我们提出一种面向多态概率数字（p-dits）的硬件感知原生表述，它避免了二值 Ising 编码中变量内部所需的局域稠密耦合。我们通过复现二维 Potts 模型已知的临界行为来验证 p-dit 动力学。其次，我们提出平均场约束（MFC），这是一种混合方案，用动态更新的单节点偏置替代稠密的成对约束耦合。将其应用于平衡图划分时，MFC 在大幅降低图密度的同时，获得了与精确全连接约束表述相当的解质量。最后，我们通过 FPGA 实现展示了恢复稀疏性的实际影响。在对 FPGA 内核时间和 CPU 求解器循环时间的比较中，并排除当前原型的主机-设备调度传输开销后，FPGA 达到 50% 成功阈值的速度比 CPU 概率求解器快一个数量级以上，比 Tabu Ising 基线快两个数量级以上。总体而言，这些结果勾勒出一条在概率硬件上扩展受约束优化问题的路径。

articles.title: Semiclassical theory for the orbital magnetic moment of superconducting quasiparticles
articles.title_zh: 超导准粒子轨道磁矩的半经典理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.17376v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the orbital magnetic moment of Bogoliubov quasiparticles in superconductors with the semiclassical approach. We derive the orbital magnetic moment of a quasiparticle wavepacket by considering the energy correction of the wavepacket to the linear order of the magnetic field. The semiclassical result is further verified by a linear response calculation with a full quantum mechanical method. From the analytical expression we find that nontrivial structure in the superconducting pairing gap alone is unable to produce quasiparticle orbital magnetic moment, which is in sharp contrast to the behavior of quasiparticle Berry curvatures. We apply the formula to study a tight-binding model with chiral d-wave superconducting gap, and show the influence of orbital magnetic moment on the energy spectrum and local density of states. We also calculate the orbital Nernst effect driven by the interplay between the orbital magnetic moment and the Berry curvature of Bogoliubov quasiparticles.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用半经典方法研究超导体中 Bogoliubov 准粒子的轨道磁矩。作者推导了准粒子波包在磁场一阶修正下的轨道磁矩，并用完整量子力学的线性响应计算加以验证。结果表明，仅凭超导配对能隙的非平庸结构并不能产生准粒子的轨道磁矩，这与准粒子 Berry 曲率的行为形成鲜明对比。
authors: Jian-Hua Zeng, Zhongbo Yan, Zhi Wang, Qian Niu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用半经典方法研究超导体中 Bogoliubov 准粒子的轨道磁矩。通过考虑波包能量在磁场线性阶的修正，我们推导了准粒子波包的轨道磁矩。随后，借助完整量子力学方法的线性响应计算验证了这一半经典结果。由解析表达式可知，仅有超导配对能隙的非平庸结构并不足以产生准粒子的轨道磁矩，这与准粒子 Berry 曲率的行为形成鲜明对比。我们将该公式应用于一个具有手性 d 波超导能隙的紧束缚模型，展示了轨道磁矩对能谱和局域态密度的影响。我们还计算了由 Bogoliubov 准粒子轨道磁矩与 Berry 曲率共同驱动的轨道 Nernst 效应。

articles.title: Combining Quasiparticle Self-Consistent GW and Machine-Learned DFT+U to Assess Half-Metallicity in Co- and Ni-Based Heuslers
articles.title_zh: 结合准粒子自洽 GW 与机器学习 DFT+U 评估 Co 基和 Ni 基 Heusler 合金的半金属性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.20621v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Half-metallic Heusler compounds are of significant interest for spintronics. For device fabrication, compounds that can be epitaxially grown on III-V semiconductors are particularly attractive. We present a first-principles investigation of four Co-based and two Ni-based Heusler compounds that are lattice-matched to InAs. The results of density functional theory (DFT) using semi-local and hybrid functionals are compared to quasiparticle self-consistent GW (QPGW). We also consider DFT with machine-learned Hubbard U corrections [npj Computational Materials 6, 180 (2020)] with a new Bayesian optimization (BO) objective function to determine the U values that yield the closest agreement with the QPGW band structure and magnetic moments. We find that DFT+U(BO) can adequately reproduce the key QPGW features in most cases. Our results reveal a strong method dependence of the degree of spin polarization at the Fermi level and, in some cases, even the dominant spin channel (majority or minority). Of the materials studied here, Co₂TiSn and Co₂ZrAl are the most likely to be half-metals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对四种 Co 基和两种 Ni 基、且与 InAs 晶格匹配的 Heusler 合金进行了第一性原理研究，并将半局域/杂化泛函的 DFT 结果与准粒子自洽 GW 结果进行比较。作者还结合机器学习的 Hubbard U 修正与贝叶斯优化，以使 DFT+U 的能带结构和磁矩尽可能接近 QPGW。结果表明，DFT+U(BO) 在大多数情况下可以较好复现 QPGW 的关键特征，但不同方法对费米能级处自旋极化程度，甚至主导自旋通道的判断可能不同。
authors: Zefeng Cai, Malcolm J. A. Jardine, Maituo Yu, Chenbo Min, Jiatian Wu, Hantian Liu, Derek Dardzinski, Christopher J. Palmstrøm, Noa Marom
articles.abstract_zh_full: 半金属性 Heusler 化合物在自旋电子学中具有重要意义。对于器件制备而言，能够在 III-V 半导体上外延生长的化合物尤其具有吸引力。我们对四种 Co 基和两种 Ni 基、与 InAs 晶格匹配的 Heusler 化合物进行了第一性原理研究。我们将采用半局域和杂化泛函的密度泛函理论（DFT）结果与准粒子自洽 GW（QPGW）结果进行了比较。我们还考虑了带有机器学习 Hubbard U 修正的 DFT [npj Computational Materials 6, 180 (2020)]，并引入新的贝叶斯优化（BO）目标函数来确定 U 值，使其得到与 QPGW 能带结构和磁矩最接近的一组结果。我们发现，DFT+U(BO) 在大多数情况下能够充分再现 QPGW 的关键特征。我们的结果揭示了费米能级处自旋极化程度对方法的强烈依赖，在某些情况下，甚至主导自旋通道（多数自旋或少数自旋）的判断也会不同。在本文研究的材料中，Co2TiSn 和 Co2ZrAl 最有可能表现为半金属。

articles.title: Quantum-geometry-driven exact ferromagnetic ground state in a nearly flat band
articles.title_zh: 近乎平带中由量子几何驱动的精确铁磁基态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.01922v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We construct a Hubbard model with a nearly flat band whose quantum geometry can be tuned independently of the energy dispersion and the Coulomb interaction. We show that, when the nearly flat band is half-filled, the exact ground state of the model exhibits ferromagnetism and that this ferromagnetism is stabilized by the quantum metric through the spin stiffness. Furthermore, we demonstrate that tuning the quantum geometry alone drives a magnetic phase transition. Our nonperturbative results without resorting to mean-field approximations reveal the quantum-geometric origin of ferromagnetism and the underlying many-body physics in dispersive-band systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文构造了一个 Hubbard 模型，其中近乎平带的量子几何可以独立于能量色散和库仑相互作用进行调控。作者证明，在该近乎平带半填充时，模型的精确基态呈现铁磁性，而且这种铁磁性由量子度量通过自旋刚度所稳定。进一步地，仅调控量子几何就足以驱动磁相变，揭示了铁磁性的量子几何起源。
authors: Taisei Kitamura, Hiroki Nakai, Hosho Katsura, Ryotaro Arita
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们构造了一个 Hubbard 模型，其中近乎平带的量子几何可以独立于能量色散和库仑相互作用进行调控。我们证明，当该近乎平带处于半填充时，模型的精确基态呈现铁磁性，而且这种铁磁性由量子度量通过自旋刚度来稳定。此外，我们表明，仅调控量子几何本身就能驱动磁相变。我们的非微扰结果不依赖平均场近似，揭示了铁磁性的量子几何起源以及色散能带体系中潜在的多体物理。

articles.title: Chirality Breaking of Majorana Edge Modes Induced by Chemical Potential Shifts
articles.title_zh: 化学势偏移诱导的马约拉纳边缘模手性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.05901v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum anomalous Hall insulator-superconductor heterostructures are predicted to host chiral Majorana fermions as edge modes, which is essential for topological quantum computing applications. Although the edge states have been extensively studied at zero chemical potential μ = 0, the practically relevant regime with a shifted chemical potential (μ ≠ 0) remains less explored. Here, we present an analytical treatment of the edge states for μ ≠ 0, deriving an approximate but highly accurate solution applicable to realistic experimental parameters. Surprisingly, we find that the energy dispersion of the edge band exhibits nonlinearity and transforms into a twisted, braid-like structure within specific parameter ranges. This unique braid-like band leads to non-chirality of the edge modes, allowing propagation in both directions.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子反常霍尔绝缘体-超导体异质结构被认为可在边缘态中支持手性马约拉纳费米子，这对拓扑量子计算很重要。本文针对化学势偏离零的情形给出边缘态的解析处理，并得到一种适用于实验参数的近似高精度解。作者发现，在特定参数范围内，边缘带色散会显著非线性化并演化为扭结状、类似编辫的结构，从而导致边缘模不再具有单向手性，并允许双向传播。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子反常霍尔绝缘体-超导体异质结构被预测会支持作为边缘模的手性马约拉纳费米子，这对于拓扑量子计算应用至关重要。尽管在零化学势 μ = 0 的情况下边缘态已被广泛研究，但在实际更相关的化学势偏移（μ ≠ 0）情形下，相关问题仍知之甚少。本文对 μ ≠ 0 时的边缘态进行了解析处理，推导出一种适用于现实实验参数的近似但高度精确的解。令人惊讶的是，我们发现边缘带的能量色散表现出非线性，并在特定参数范围内转变为一种扭曲的、类似编辫的结构。这种独特的编辫状能带导致边缘模不再具有手性，从而允许沿两个方向传播。

articles.title: Effect of polar distortions on the linear and nonlinear anomalous Hall conductivity of altermagnetic α-MnTe
articles.title_zh: 极化畸变对反铁磁α-MnTe线性与非线性反常霍尔电导的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12311v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnetic α-MnTe with Néel vector along the y-axis exhibits a finite anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) and weak ferromagnetism along the z-axis. As already demonstrated in the bulk, there is the breaking of the C₆ symmetry by the in-plane Néel vector, leaving a C₂₋ₜype magnetic symmetry. The surface of α-MnTe breaks the C₂, leaving only a time-reversed mirror symmetry with respect to the x=0 plane. Therefore, we demonstrate that on the surface, the interplay between breaking of the crystal symmetry and Néel vector orientation produces a reduction of the space group from hexagonal P6₃/mmc to orthorhombic Amm2. As a result, the surface exhibits not only a polar distortion along the z-axis, but also a polar distortion and a weak ferrimagnetism along the y-axis. To describe the surface of MnTe in an accessible way, we simplify the problem and examine the effect of the in-plane electric field in bulk MnTe. Moreover, as a doped ionic semiconductor, the properties of MnTe can be influenced by lattice polarization under an applied electric field. We investigate the interplay between the intrinsic anomalous Hall effect and lattice polarization, showing that polarization effects can substantially affect the AHC. Since the electric field breaks inversion symmetry, this contribution from the lattice polarization coexists with the non-linear anomalous Hall effect, highlighting the rich transport phenomenology of altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 具有奈尔矢量沿 y 轴的代替磁性 α-MnTe 具有有限的反常霍尔电导和沿 z 轴的弱铁磁性。本文指出，在表面上，晶体对称性破缺与奈尔矢量取向的相互作用会将空间群从六方 P6₃/mmc 降低为正交 Amm2。作者进一步研究了电场诱导的极化与内禀反常霍尔效应的耦合，表明极化效应可显著改变反常霍尔电导，并与非线性反常霍尔效应共存。
authors: Mathews Benny, Sahar Izadi Vishkayi, Amar Fakhredine, Chanchal K. Barman, Carmine Autieri
articles.abstract_zh_full: 奈尔矢量沿 y 轴的代替磁性 α-MnTe 具有有限的反常霍尔电导（AHC）以及沿 z 轴的弱铁磁性。正如在体材料中已经展示的那样，平面内奈尔矢量会打破 C₆ 对称性，只留下 C₂ 型磁对称性。α-MnTe 的表面会打破 C₂ 对称性，只保留关于 x=0 平面的时间反演镜面对称性。因此，我们证明，在表面上，晶体对称性破缺与奈尔矢量取向的相互作用会使空间群从六方 P6₃/mmc 降低为正交 Amm2。由此，表面不仅表现出沿 z 轴的极化畸变，而且还表现出沿 y 轴的极化畸变和弱铁磁性。为了以更易处理的方式描述 MnTe 的表面，我们简化问题并考察体相 MnTe 中面内电场的影响。此外，作为一种掺杂的离子半导体，MnTe 的性质也会受到外加电场下晶格极化的影响。我们研究了内禀反常霍尔效应与晶格极化之间的相互作用，表明极化效应可显著影响 AHC。由于电场打破了反演对称性，该晶格极化贡献与非线性反常霍尔效应共存，凸显了代替磁体丰富的输运现象。

articles.title: Constraints on Atomistic Disorder for Scalable Electron Spin Shuttling
articles.title_zh: 可扩展电子自旋搬运的原子尺度无序约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.03113v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Electron spin shuttling, the gate-controlled, coherent transport of electrons between qubit registers, increases qubit connectivity and enables efficient quantum-error-correction schemes. It is emerging as a key enabler of scalable silicon spin-qubit quantum computing. As an electron travels over micrometers, it encounters angstrom-scale disorder, causing fluctuations in its confinement potential, valley splitting, and valley phase. These lead to leakage into the valley-excited state, limiting high-fidelity shuttling speeds. Accurate predictions of shuttling fidelities thus require modeling tools that link atomistic and mesoscopic physics. We develop a multiscale simulation workflow to quantify these effects in the experimentally-realized Si/SiGe "QuBus" conveyor-belt architecture. First, we resolve the time-dependent, gate-controlled device electrostatics by solving the Poisson equation using the finite-element method. Second, we construct conveyor belt atomic structures with realistic atomistic disorder (random alloying and interface roughness); we resolve strain atomistically using the Keating valence force-field model. Third, we perform position-tracked atomistic tight-binding simulations of the shuttled electrons to obtain their time-dependent valley splittings and phases. Finally, these time traces parametrize a time-dependent Schrödinger equation, which we solve to predict valley dynamics. We find that interface roughness strongly suppresses shuttling fidelities, with a sharp anomaly near the atomic-layer scale. Overall, our predictions set practical, quantitative guidelines to realize scalable, high-fidelity shuttling in silicon spin-qubit architectures.
articles.abstract_zh: 电子自旋搬运是指利用栅极控制，在量子比特寄存器之间相干传输电子，这可提升量子比特连通性并支持高效量子纠错。本文针对实验实现的 Si/SiGe “QuBus” 输运带架构，建立了一个多尺度模拟流程，以量化原子级无序对搬运保真度的影响。结果表明，界面粗糙会强烈压低搬运保真度，并在原子层尺度附近出现明显异常，从而为实现可扩展、高保真硅自旋量子比特搬运提供了定量指导。
authors: Raphaël J. Prentki, Pericles Philippopoulos, Mohammad Reza Mostaan, Félix Beaudoin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 电子自旋搬运是指由栅极控制的、电子在量子比特寄存器之间的相干传输，它能够增加量子比特连通性并支持高效的量子纠错方案。它正成为可扩展硅自旋量子比特量子计算的关键使能技术。随着电子在微米尺度上运动，它会遇到埃尺度的无序，导致其约束势、谷分裂和谷相位发生波动。这些效应会引起向谷激发态的泄漏，从而限制高保真搬运的速度。因此，对搬运保真度的准确预测需要能够连接原子尺度与介观物理的建模工具。我们开发了一套多尺度仿真流程，用于量化这些效应在实验实现的 Si/SiGe “QuBus” 输运带架构中的表现。首先，我们使用有限元方法求解泊松方程，解析随时间变化、由栅极控制的器件静电势。其次，我们构建具有真实原子尺度无序（随机合金化和界面粗糙度）的输运带原子结构；并采用 Keating 价键力场模型在原子尺度上解析应变。第三，我们进行位置跟踪的原子尺度紧束缚模拟，以获得被搬运电子的时间依赖谷分裂和谷相位。最后，我们将这些时间轨迹参数化为一个随时间变化的薛定谔方程，并求解以预测谷动力学。我们发现，界面粗糙会强烈抑制搬运保真度，并在原子层尺度附近出现一个尖锐异常。总体而言，我们的预测为在硅自旋量子比特架构中实现可扩展、高保真的搬运提供了实用且定量的指南。

articles.title: Universal computational super-resolution framework for imaging of quantum dots
articles.title_zh: 量子点成像的通用计算超分辨框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.06076v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We present a universal deep-learning method that reconstructs super-resolved images of quantum emitters from a single camera frame measurement. Trained on physics-based synthetic data spanning diverse point-spread functions, aberrations, and noise, the network generalizes across experimental conditions without system-specific retraining. We validate the approach on low- and high-density In(Ga)As quantum dots and strain-induced dots in 2D monolayer WSe₂, resolving overlapping emitters even under low signal-to-noise and inhomogeneous backgrounds. By eliminating calibration and iterative acquisitions, this single-shot strategy enables rapid, robust computational super-resolution for nanoscale characterization and quantum photonic device fabrication.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种通用的深度学习方法，可从单帧相机测量中重建量子发射体的超分辨图像。该网络基于覆盖不同点扩散函数、像差与噪声的物理合成数据训练，因而无需针对具体系统重新训练即可适应不同实验条件。作者在不同密度的 In(Ga)As 量子点以及二维单层 WSe₂ 中应变诱导量子点上验证了该方法，即使在低信噪比和非均匀背景下也能分辨重叠发射体。
authors: Dominik Vašinka, Jaewon Lee, Charlie Stalker, Victor Mitryakhin, Ivan Solovev, Sven Stephan, Sven Höfling, Falk Eilenberger, Seth Ariel Tongay, Christian Schneider, Miroslav Ježek, Ana Predojević
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出一种通用的深度学习方法，可以从单帧相机测量中重建量子发射体的超分辨图像。该网络使用基于物理的合成数据进行训练，这些数据覆盖了多样的点扩散函数、像差和噪声，因此无需针对特定系统重新训练即可在不同实验条件下泛化。我们在低密度和高密度的 In(Ga)As 量子点以及二维单层 WSe₂ 中的应变诱导量子点上验证了这一方法，即使在低信噪比和非均匀背景下也能分辨重叠的发射体。通过消除标定和迭代采集的需要，这种单次拍摄策略为纳米尺度表征和量子光子器件制造提供了快速、稳健的计算超分辨方案。

articles.title: Scattering phase shift in quantum mechanics on quantum computers: non-Hermitian systems and imaginary-time simulations
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上散射相移的量子力学：非厄米系统与虚时间模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.00127v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: To overcome the fast oscillatory behavior of correlation functions for extracting scattering phase shift in real-time quantum simulations encountered in Ref.i̧teGuo:2026qkx, we propose and test two solutions in the present work. One is to simulate Hermitian systems in imaginary time, the other is to simulate non-Hermitian systems in real time. We demonstrate that both approaches lead to the problem of non-unitary quantum evolution which can be solved by combining two quantum algorithms: block encoding and Hadamard test. The combined quantum algorithm does not require mid-circuit measurements or adjustment of the input parameters of the Hamiltonian, and can be easily implemented on quantum computers. Numerical tests on quantum simulators show that both approaches agree with exact solutions for a sufficiently long time before the signal is lost in statistical fluctuations. The results bode well for using non-Hermitian and imaginary-time simulations to circumvent oscillations inherent in real-time simulation of other quantum systems. In particular, the non-Hermitian approach shows a decisive advantage over the imaginary-time one on the number of required ancillary qubits, and hence is more practical to scale up.
articles.abstract_zh: 为克服实时间量子模拟中用于提取散射相移的关联函数快速振荡问题，本文提出并检验了两种方案：一是用虚时间模拟厄米系统，二是用实时间模拟非厄米系统。作者表明，这两种方法都会带来非幺正量子演化问题，但可通过块编码与 Hadamard 测试两种量子算法的结合来解决。数值实验显示，在统计涨落淹没信号之前，两种方法都能与精确解在足够长时间内一致，其中非厄米方法在所需辅助量子比特数量上更具优势。
authors: Peng Guo, Paul LeVan, Frank X. Lee, Yong Zhao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 为克服文献 Ref.i̧teGuo:2026qkx 中在实时间量子模拟里提取散射相移时所遇到的相关函数快速振荡行为，本文提出并测试了两种解决方案。一种是在虚时间中模拟厄米系统，另一种是在实时间中模拟非厄米系统。我们证明，这两种方法都会导致非幺正量子演化问题，而这一问题可以通过结合两种量子算法来解决：块编码和 Hadamard 测试。这个组合量子算法不需要中途电路测量，也不需要调整哈密顿量的输入参数，而且可以很容易地在量子计算机上实现。量子模拟器上的数值测试表明，在统计涨落淹没信号之前，两种方法都能在足够长的时间内与精确解一致。这些结果预示着，利用非厄米和虚时间模拟可以规避实时间模拟中固有的振荡，并可推广到其他量子系统。尤其是，与虚时间方法相比，非厄米方法在所需辅助量子比特数量上具有决定性优势，因此更便于扩展。

articles.title: Competing Energetics Govern Gas Permeation in Polymer of Intrinsic Microporosity (PIM) Membranes
articles.title_zh: 支配聚合物内在微孔膜中气体渗透的竞争能量学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06413v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polymer membranes, particularly polymers of intrinsic microporosity (PIMs), hold great promise for gas separation applications. However, the long-dominant solution-diffusion model, which treats the membrane as a nonporous homogeneous medium, does not resolve how gas-solid atomic interactions govern molecular transport in intrinsic micropores, limiting rational bottom-up membrane design. In this work, we employ non-equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations to investigate the permeation of various gases (He, H2, CH4, N2, O2, and CO2) through PIM-1 as a representative PIM membrane across a range of temperatures. By analyzing the scaling of gas permeability with molecular mass, we identify a temperature-induced transition in the dominant transport mechanism. We demonstrate that this transition is governed by the competition between gas-wall interaction potential energy and thermal kinetic energy: weak interactions or elevated temperatures facilitate Knudsen-type ballistic transport, whereas strong interactions and lower temperatures favor adsorption-mediated surface diffusion. Furthermore, molecular trajectory analysis at the membrane interface reveals two distinct entry pathways: direct entry through pore openings and surface-diffusion-assisted entry. The surface-diffusion-assisted pathway greatly promotes the entry of strongly interacting gases into the membrane, contributing to higher overall permeability, albeit this enhancement diminishes with increasing temperature. These findings offer a mechanistic picture of gas permeation in PIM-1 and explain the dependence of gas permeation on both gas type and temperature. More broadly, they highlight the importance of adopting a pore-flow perspective to understand gas transport in microporous polymer membranes.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚合物膜，尤其是内在微孔聚合物（PIM），在气体分离中具有很大应用潜力。本文用非平衡分子动力学模拟研究了多种气体穿过代表性 PIM 膜 PIM-1 的渗透行为，并识别出温度驱动的主导输运机制转变。结果表明，气体-膜壁相互作用势能与热动能之间的竞争决定了这一转变：弱相互作用或较高温度有利于类似 Knudsen 的弹道传输，而强相互作用和较低温度则更倾向于由吸附介导的表面扩散。
authors: Jianhao Qian, Ruoyu Wang, Menachem Elimelech
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚合物膜，尤其是内在微孔聚合物（PIMs），在气体分离应用中具有巨大潜力。然而，长期占主导地位的溶解-扩散模型将膜视为非多孔的均匀介质，并未揭示气体-固体原子相互作用如何在内在微孔中支配分子传输，这限制了自下而上的理性膜设计。本文采用非平衡分子动力学模拟，研究了多种气体（He、H2、CH4、N2、O2 和 CO2）在不同温度下穿过作为代表性 PIM 膜的 PIM-1 的渗透行为。通过分析气体渗透率随分子质量的标度关系，我们识别出一种由温度驱动的主导输运机制转变。我们表明，这一转变由气体-壁相互作用势能与热动能之间的竞争所支配：弱相互作用或较高温度促进类似 Knudsen 的弹道传输，而强相互作用和较低温度则有利于由吸附介导的表面扩散。此外，对膜界面处分子轨迹的分析揭示了两条不同的进入路径：一是通过孔口的直接进入，二是借助表面扩散辅助的进入。后者显著促进了强相互作用气体进入膜内，从而提高了总体渗透率，但这种增强效应会随着温度升高而减弱。这些发现为 PIM-1 中的气体渗透提供了机制图景，并解释了气体渗透对气体种类和温度的依赖。更广泛地说，它们强调了采用孔流视角来理解微孔聚合物膜中气体传输的重要性。

articles.title: Ground-State Energy Estimation of HeH⁺, ArH⁺, and H₂O via Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization
articles.title_zh: 通过基于样本的量子对角化估算 HeH⁺、ArH⁺ 和 H₂O 的基态能量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06415v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate ground-state energies are essential for understanding molecular structure, chemical bonding, and reaction energetics in quantum chemistry. In this work, we investigate the ground-state properties of the molecular systems HeH⁺, ArH⁺, and H₂O using Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD), a hybrid quantum-classical framework designed for near-term quantum devices. Unlike variational approaches such as VQE, which require deep parameterized circuits and repeated expectation-value measurements, SQD reconstructs a low-energy determinant subspace directly from measured bitstrings. For the present calculations, bitstrings were generated on IBM quantum hardware using shallow local unitary cluster Jastrow (LUCJ) circuits whose parameters were constructed from the t₁ and t₂ amplitudes of coupled-cluster singles and doubles (CCSD) calculations based on restricted Hartree--Fock (RHF) references. From these samples, we compute ground-state potential-energy curves of HeH⁺, ArH⁺, and H₂O with the 6-31G and cc-pVDZ basis sets. For all three systems, the SQD results obtained with the cc-pVDZ basis closely follow the corresponding same-basis CCSD energies and reproduce the equilibrium-region trends of the potential-energy curves. HeH⁺ and ArH⁺ were chosen as simple yet astrophysically important molecular-ion benchmarks, while H₂O was included as a representative polyatomic molecule to assess the applicability of SQD beyond diatomic ionic systems. At the adopted equilibrium geometries, the deviations from the same-active-space CASCI references are 0.00, 2.51, and 6.34 mHa for HeH⁺, ArH⁺, and H₂O, respectively. These results demonstrate the feasibility of hardware-assisted SQD for the present benchmark systems and motivate further studies of its accuracy and computational scaling for larger molecular active spaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 精确的基态能量对于理解量子化学中的分子结构、化学键和反应能量学至关重要。本文利用面向近期量子器件的混合量子-经典框架——基于样本的量子对角化（SQD）——研究了 HeH⁺、ArH⁺ 和 H₂O 的基态性质。结果表明，基于 IBM 量子硬件和浅层电路获得的样本能够重建低能行列式子空间，并在 cc-pVDZ 基组下给出与同基组 CCSD 结果相当的势能曲线。
authors: Jubin Park, Chae-Hyun Yoon, Minkyu Lee, Myung-Ki Cheoun
articles.abstract_zh_full: 精确的基态能量对于理解量子化学中的分子结构、化学键和反应能量学至关重要。本文利用基于样本的量子对角化（Sample-Based Quantum Diagonalization, SQD）——一种为近期量子设备设计的混合量子-经典框架——研究了分子体系 HeH⁺、ArH⁺ 和 H₂O 的基态性质。与需要深层参数化电路和重复期望值测量的 VQE 等变分方法不同，SQD 可直接从测得的 bitstring 重建低能行列式子空间。在本工作中，bitstring 由 IBM 量子硬件生成，所用的是浅层局域酉簇 Jastrow（LUCJ）电路，其参数由基于限制性 Hartree--Fock（RHF）参考态的耦合簇单激发和双激发（CCSD）计算得到的 t₁ 和 t₂ 振幅构造而成。基于这些样本，我们利用 6-31G 和 cc-pVDZ 基组计算了 HeH⁺、ArH⁺ 和 H₂O 的基态势能曲线。对于这三个体系，采用 cc-pVDZ 基组得到的 SQD 结果都与对应同基组 CCSD 能量高度一致，并再现了势能曲线在平衡区域的趋势。HeH⁺ 和 ArH⁺ 被选作简单但在天体物理上重要的分子离子基准，而 H₂O 则作为代表性多原子分子被纳入，以评估 SQD 超越双原子离子体系的适用性。在所采用的平衡几何构型下，相对于同活性空间 CASCI 参考值的偏差分别为 HeH⁺ 0.00 mHa、ArH⁺ 2.51 mHa、H₂O 6.34 mHa。这些结果表明，对于当前基准体系，硬件辅助 SQD 是可行的，并激励进一步研究其在更大分子活性空间中的准确性与计算标度。

articles.title: The Quantitative and dynamical analysis of anisotropic dispersive optical solitons
articles.title_zh: 各向异性色散光孤子的定量与动力学分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06484v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this article, we explore the integrable aspects of generalized non-linear fluid equation possessing mixed spatial and time evolutions. This non-linear model has been acknowledged as integrable tool for the non-linear dynamical character- ization of dense material such as in optical fibre, metallic ionic fluid. This model widely has been applied in physical interpretations of electromagnetic propaga- tion through perturbed charged plasma. Here, we use few integrable approaches and attain a broad range of solitary solutions involve deep analytical analysis. These results are furnished with computational simulations, which enrich under- standing about the accurate pictorial flow of energy. We also present a bifurcation analysis for canonical coordinates to examine the impact of parameter variations on non-linear behavior of the systems under consideration. Subsequently, we per- form stability analysis to evaluate the robustness of optical solitons features in the vicinity of equilibrium points. These results establish the reliable and accurate framework for analyzing non linear response of materials for energy propagation by varying physical parameters associated with this non-linear equation model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了具有空间与时间混合演化的一类广义非线性流体方程的可积性质。该非线性模型可用于描述光纤、金属离子流体等致密介质中的非线性动力学，并广泛应用于受扰带电等离子体中的电磁传播分析。作者结合多种可积方法得到了一系列孤子解，并通过数值模拟、分岔分析与稳定性分析考察其动力学特征和参数变化影响。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文探讨了具有空间与时间混合演化的一般化非线性流体方程的可积性方面。该非线性模型已被公认为一种可积工具，可用于对光纤、金属离子流体等致密材料的非线性动力学特征进行描述。该模型还被广泛应用于对受扰带电等离子体中电磁传播的物理解释。在这里，我们采用若干可积方法，获得了一大类孤立波解，并进行了深入的解析分析。这些结果配以计算机模拟，从而加深了对能量精确图像传播的理解。我们还对典型坐标进行了分岔分析，以考察参数变化对所研究系统非线性行为的影响。随后，我们进行稳定性分析，以评估在平衡点附近光孤子特征的稳健性。这些结果为通过改变与该非线性方程模型相关的物理参数来分析材料的非线性响应和能量传播建立了可靠而准确的框架。

articles.title: A 28-GHz Varactor-Based RIS With Continuous Phase Control: From Unit-Cell Modeling to Programmable Wavefront Control and Synthesis
articles.title_zh: 一种 28 GHz 基于变容二极管、具有连续相位控制的 RIS：从单元建模到可编程波前控制与合成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06541v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents a 28 GHz varactor-based reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) platform with continuous phase control and establishes a unified device-to-system validation framework for programmable wavefront control and synthesis. The proposed RIS comprises 96 independently controlled elements, each employing a single varactor diode, with a board-integrated analog-bias control architecture. It builds on an experimentally validated unit-cell model providing approximately 300deg of continuous reflection-phase tuning at normal incidence. An analytical framework incorporating measured horn illumination, finite phase availability, and unit-cell reflection losses consistently relates device-level characteristics to beamforming performance. It is evaluated via near-field-to-near-field characterization, near-field-to-far-field beam-steering, and far-field-to-far-field wireless-link experiments. The near-field-to-far-field results show close agreement among analytical predictions, full-wave simulations, and measurements, while the far-field-to-far-field response agrees with simulation and a first-order link-budget estimate. Accurate steering is demonstrated for all investigated angles within ±45deg across three azimuthal planes, with maximum deviation of approximately 2deg. The complete prototype, including driver and bias network, draws only 0.85 W with an estimated full-aperture reconfiguration time of approximately 50 ms. Beyond beam steering, the same platform enables experimental investigation of 3-bit, 2-bit, and 1-bit phase quantization and programmable multi-beam wavefront synthesis using a common RF aperture and control architecture. Collectively, these results bridge realistic varactor behavior, analytical modeling, and programmable wavefront synthesis, providing a rigorous basis for developing and experimentally validating continuously tunable millimeter-wave RISs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种 28 GHz 基于变容二极管的可重构智能表面（RIS）平台，具备连续相位控制能力，并建立了统一的器件到系统验证框架用于可编程波前控制与合成。该 RIS 由 96 个独立控制单元组成，每个单元采用单个变容二极管，并配备板载模拟偏置控制架构。作者通过近场到近场、近场到远场以及远场到远场实验验证了该平台，结果表明其可在多个平面内实现精确波束指向与多波束合成。
authors: Spandan Manna, Florian Reher, Karim El Isa, Amar Al-Bassam, Dirk Heberling
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种 28 GHz 基于变容二极管的可重构智能表面（RIS）平台，具备连续相位控制能力，并建立了一个统一的器件到系统验证框架，用于可编程波前控制与合成。所提出的 RIS 包含 96 个独立控制的单元，每个单元采用一个变容二极管，并配有板载模拟偏置控制架构。该平台建立在一个经过实验验证的单元模型之上，在法向入射条件下可提供约 300 度的连续反射相位调谐。一个解析框架将实测喇叭天线照明、有限相位可用性以及单元反射损耗纳入考虑，系统地将器件级特性与波束形成性能联系起来。该方法通过近场到近场表征、近场到远场波束指向实验以及远场到远场无线链路实验进行了评估。近场到远场结果显示，解析预测、全波仿真与测量之间高度一致，而远场到远场响应则与仿真及一阶链路预算估计一致。在所研究的三个方位平面内，±45 度范围的所有角度均实现了精确指向，最大偏差约为 2 度。完整原型，包括驱动与偏置网络，仅消耗 0.85 W，估计全孔径重构时间约为 50 ms。除波束指向外，该平台还可利用同一射频孔径和控制架构，对 3 比特、2 比特和 1 比特相位量化以及可编程多波束波前合成进行实验研究。总体而言，这些结果将真实变容二极管行为、解析建模与可编程波前合成连接起来，为开发并实验验证可连续调谐的毫米波 RIS 提供了严格基础。

articles.title: Grape expectations: direct thermographic imaging of electric fields in microwave Mie resonators
articles.title_zh: 葡萄式预期：微波 Mie 谐振器中电场的直接热成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06603v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Internal electromagnetic fields determine the behaviour of dielectric nano-resonators, yet they remain exceptionally difficult to measure directly because subwavelength scales place them beyond conventional optical measurement, and any probe capable of local sensing perturbs the field it seeks to measure. We circumvent this limitation using water's high refractive index at microwave frequencies, which lets centimetre-scale aqueous spheres---grapes---serve as directly measurable, scale-invariant analogs of high-index nanophotonic resonators. Using polarization-controlled free-space excitation and infrared thermography, we show that internal heating patterns in grapes closely track simulated electric-, but not magnetic-, field distributions for both the fundamental magnetic- and electric-dipole Mie resonances. Extending this approach to grape dimers, we demonstrate that the massively sub-wavelength inter-object hotspot associated with microwave-induced sparking forms only under axial polarization, thus providing both a clue to its origin and a means for its control.
articles.abstract_zh: 介电纳米谐振器内部的电磁场决定其行为，但由于尺度远小于波长且局域探针会扰动待测场，直接测量极为困难。本文利用水在微波频率下的高折射率，将厘米尺度的含水球体——葡萄——作为可直接测量、与尺度无关的高折射率纳米光子谐振器类比对象。通过偏振可控的自由空间激励与红外热成像，作者展示了葡萄内部加热分布与模拟电场分布高度一致，而与磁场分布不符，并将这一方法推广到葡萄二聚体以研究微波诱导火花热点的形成机制及其控制。
authors: Kallan K. Ronholm, Yuchen Song, Aaron D. Slepkov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 内部电磁场决定了介电纳米谐振器的行为，但由于其尺度处于亚波长范围，已超出常规光学测量的能力，而且任何能够进行局域探测的探针都会扰动其欲测量的场，因此它们仍然极难被直接测量。我们利用水在微波频率下的高折射率来规避这一限制，使厘米尺度的含水球体——葡萄——能够作为高折射率纳米光子谐振器的可直接测量、尺度无关的类比系统。通过偏振可控的自由空间激励和红外热成像，我们表明，葡萄内部的加热图样与模拟得到的电场分布高度吻合，而与磁场分布并不一致，这一结论适用于基模磁偶极和电偶极 Mie 谐振。将该方法扩展到葡萄二聚体后，我们证明，微波诱导火花所对应的、远小于波长的两物体间热点只会在轴向偏振下形成，从而既为其起源提供线索，也为其控制提供手段。

articles.title: The Equations of Reduced Magnetohydrodynamics in Dipole Coordinates
articles.title_zh: 偶极坐标下的简化磁流体力学方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06617v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The equations of reduced magnetohydrodynamics (RMHD) isolate the Alfvénic energy transfer and turbulence dynamics from MHD in a computationally tractable way. In this study, we derive the equations of RMHD for a low β plasma in a dipole coordinate system aligned with the background magnetic field using a multiscale analysis. The Kreiss theorem is used to derive the equilibrium conditions that the background conditions must satisfy on the time scale of MHD turbulence. From these, we find a connection between plasma flow along flux tubes and changes in the Alfvén speed that may drive nonlinear wave effects. The final equations demonstrate an intimate coupling between field aligned currents and plasma vorticity including the effects of nonuniform flux tube area and realistic plasma density profiles. This work has immediate application to the magnetosphere-ionosphere coupling problem in the Earth's magnetosphere as it provides a way to link dynamically evolving field aligned currents from the magnetosphere, especially important during geomagnetic storms and substorms, with the development of magnetohydrodynamic turbulence at low altitudes in a self-consistent manner. This also clarifies the role of Alfvén waves as a transfer mechanism of energy under these inhomogeneous circumstances while remaining simple enough to make predictions. Furthermore, this study makes use of a novel methodology, a computer algebra system, in performing the brunt of algebraic work under complicated coordinate systems. We hope this approach serves as a template for performing reproducible and verifiable multiscale perturbation analysis under arbitrarily complex geometries.
articles.abstract_zh: 简化磁流体力学（RMHD）方程能够以可计算的方式提取 MHD 中的阿尔芬能量传输与湍流动力学。本文在与背景磁场对齐的偶极坐标系中，通过多尺度分析推导了低 β 等离子体的 RMHD 方程，并给出了背景条件在 MHD 湍流时间尺度上必须满足的平衡条件。该工作有助于将磁层与电离层耦合中的场向电流演化与低高度处的磁流体湍流发展联系起来。
authors: Ian M. DesJardin, Christopher Bard, Natalia Y. Buzulukova, John C. Dorelli
articles.abstract_zh_full: 简化磁流体力学（RMHD）方程以一种计算上可处理的方式，从磁流体力学（MHD）中分离出阿尔芬能量传输和湍流动力学。在本研究中，我们通过多尺度分析，在与背景磁场对齐的偶极坐标系中推导了低 β 等离子体的 RMHD 方程。我们使用 Kreiss 定理推导了背景条件在 MHD 湍流时间尺度上必须满足的平衡条件。由此，我们发现了沿磁通管的等离子体流与阿尔芬速度变化之间的联系，这种变化可能驱动非线性波动效应。最终方程表明，场向电流与等离子体涡度之间存在密切耦合，并包含了非均匀磁通管截面积和真实等离子体密度分布的影响。该工作可直接应用于地球磁层中磁层-电离层耦合问题，因为它提供了一种自洽方式，将磁层中动态演化的场向电流，尤其是在地磁暴和亚暴期间尤为重要的场向电流，与低高度处磁流体湍流的发展联系起来。这也澄清了阿尔芬波作为这种非均匀条件下能量传输机制所起的作用，同时仍足够简洁以作出预测。此外，本研究采用了一种新的方法，即使用计算机代数系统来完成复杂坐标系下的大部分代数工作。我们希望这一方法能够成为在任意复杂几何下进行可重复、可验证多尺度摄动分析的模板。

articles.title: Linear and nonlinear benchmark of gyrokinetic simulation of energetic particle driven toroidal Alfven eigenmodes in ITPA TAE benchmark case
articles.title_zh: ITPA TAE 基准案例中高能粒子驱动环向阿尔芬本征模的 gyrokinetic 模拟线性与非线性基准测试
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A new gyrokinetic code, TEK, was benchmarked in simulating energetic particle (EP) driven toroidal Alfven eigenmodes (TAEs) in the simple tokamak configuration chosen by the ITPA-EP group for code benchmarking purpose. Linear benchmark has been well established by other codes, whereas nonlinear benchmark for this case is lacking. This paper presents, besides the linear benchmark, nonlinear results for both single-n and multiple-n simulations (n is the toroidal mode number). The nonlinear results are in good agreement with an analytical theory on zonal field beat-driven by Alfven eigenmodes, partially verifying correctness of the nonlinear simulations. The saturation level and the resulting EP transport are examined. This provides data for future inter-code nonlinear benchmarking. In TEK, all species (electrons, thermal ions, EPs) are treated on the same footing using the gyrokinetic model (with electrons in the zero Larmor radius limit). The electromagnetic cancellation problem is mitigated by using the mixed-variable pullback method. Numerical details related to electromagnetic gyrokinetic simulation are discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用新的 gyrokinetic 代码 TEK，对国际热核聚变实验堆计划（ITPA）为代码基准测试选取的简化托卡马克构型中，高能粒子驱动的环向阿尔芬本征模进行了数值研究。除已较为成熟的线性基准外，作者还给出了单 n 与多 n 模拟的非线性结果，并与阿尔芬本征模驱动的 zonal 场拍频理论相符。结果为今后的跨代码非线性基准测试提供了数据，也展示了 TEK 在处理电磁 gyrokinetic 问题时的数值实现。
authors: Youjun Hu, Yang Chen, Lei Ye, Zhiyong Qiu, Youwen Sun
articles.abstract_zh_full: 新的 gyrokinetic 代码 TEK 已在国际热核聚变实验堆计划（ITPA-EP）小组为代码基准测试而选取的简化托卡马克构型中，对高能粒子（EP）驱动的环向阿尔芬本征模（TAEs）进行了基准测试。线性基准测试已经由其他代码较好建立，而这一案例的非线性基准尚付阙如。本文除给出线性基准外，还展示了单 n 与多 n 模拟的非线性结果，其中 n 为环向模数。非线性结果与阿尔芬本征模驱动 zonal 场拍频的解析理论符合良好，从而部分验证了非线性模拟的正确性。文中考察了饱和水平以及由此产生的 EP 输运。这为今后的跨代码非线性基准测试提供了数据。在 TEK 中，所有粒子种类（电子、热离子、EP）都在 gyrokinetic 模型下以同等方式处理（电子采用零拉莫尔半径极限）。通过采用混合变量 pullback 方法，电磁抵消问题得到缓解。文中还讨论了与电磁 gyrokinetic 模拟相关的数值细节。

articles.title: Autonomous discovery of accelerator commissioning algorithms
articles.title_zh: 加速器调试算法的自主发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07138v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulated commissioning has become essential for de-risking modern light-source design and commissioning, but the procedures being simulated are still designed entirely by human experts. Their labor-intensive redevelopment after lattice changes makes such studies hard to repeat and limits their use during early design iteration. This Letter demonstrates a closed research loop in which a language-model agent writes commissioning code, tests it in simulation, and improves the algorithm from the results. Applied to RF beam capture in the ALS-U accumulator-ring model, the loop substantially improves a working expert procedure and can construct a working one from a minimal starting point, with more capable models succeeding from less initial code. Extending the same framework to multiple objectives produces 16 non-dominated algorithms spanning physically distinct trade-offs between rapid beam capture and correction of seeded machine errors. This reframes commissioning studies from evaluating human-designed procedures toward a mode in which agents participate directly in discovering accelerator algorithms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了一种闭环研究流程，使语言模型智能体能够编写加速器调试代码、在模拟中测试并基于结果改进算法。应用于 ALS-U 累积环模型中的射频束流捕获时，该流程不仅显著改进专家程序，也能从极少初始代码构造可工作的程序。多目标扩展产生了多种非支配算法，体现快速束流捕获与机器误差校正之间不同物理权衡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 模拟调试已成为降低现代光源设计与调试风险的关键工具，但被模拟的程序仍完全由人类专家设计。在晶格变化后，这些程序需要劳动密集型地重新开发，这使得此类研究难以重复，并限制了其在早期设计迭代中的使用。本快报展示了一个闭环研究流程，在其中语言模型智能体编写调试代码，在模拟中测试代码，并根据结果改进算法。将该流程应用于 ALS-U 累积环模型中的射频束流捕获时，它显著改进了一个可工作的专家程序，并且能够从最小起点构造出一个可工作的程序；能力更强的模型能够从更少的初始代码开始成功运行。将同一框架扩展到多个目标后，得到 16 种非支配算法，涵盖了快速束流捕获与种子机器误差校正之间在物理上不同的权衡。这将调试研究从评估人类设计的程序，重新定义为一种智能体直接参与发现加速器算法的模式。

articles.title: Electron-Scale-Driven Turbulence by Negative-Density-Gradient in NSTX
articles.title_zh: NSTX 中由负密度梯度驱动的电子尺度湍流
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Gyrokinetic simulations of an NSTX spherical-tokamak plasma reveal novel negative-density-gradient (NDG) drift waves at electron-gyroradius-scale that drive turbulent transport comparable to the experimental power flow. Linear simulations indicate that the dominant instability is a trapped-electron electron-scale tearing-parity mode driven mainly by negative electron density gradient, a/Lₙₑ equiv - a/nₑ , (dnₑ/dr) < 0. Although thermal transport is mainly carried by transverse magnetic, δ Aₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ, fluctuations, the growth rate is sensitive to compressional magnetic fluctuations, δ Bₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ, differentiating these from standard microtearing modes (MTMs). Linear sensitivity analysis also reveals that the modes are most unstable at lower collisionality, consistent with the trapped-electron character. Electron-scale and multi-scale nonlinear simulations show that these modes can account for several megawatts of experimental power, with the latter suggesting that experimental gradients may lie at a bifurcation between distinct turbulence regimes.
articles.abstract_zh: 对 NSTX 球形托卡马克等离子体的回旋动理学模拟揭示了由负密度梯度驱动的电子回旋半径尺度新型漂移波，其湍流输运可与实验功率流相当。线性分析表明，主导不稳定性是以俘获电子为特征、主要由负电子密度梯度驱动的电子尺度撕裂宇称模，并且不同于标准微撕裂模。非线性电子尺度与多尺度模拟显示，这些模可解释数兆瓦实验功率，并提示实验梯度可能处于不同湍流机制之间的分岔附近。
authors: C. Clauser, J. Candy, J. Parisi, T. Rafiq, W. Guttenfelder, G. Avdeeva, E. Belli, J. Berkery, I. Sfiligoi, E. Schuster
articles.abstract_zh_full: 对 NSTX 球形托卡马克等离子体开展的回旋动理学模拟揭示了新型负密度梯度（NDG）漂移波，这些漂移波发生在电子回旋半径尺度，并驱动与实验功率流相当的湍流输运。线性模拟表明，主导不稳定性是一种俘获电子型电子尺度撕裂宇称模，主要由负电子密度梯度 a/Lₙₑ ≡ -a/nₑ·(dnₑ/dr) < 0 驱动。尽管热输运主要由横向磁矢势 δAₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ 涨落承载，但增长率对压缩磁场涨落 δBₚₐᵣₐₗₗₑₗ 敏感，这使其区别于标准微撕裂模（MTM）。线性敏感性分析还表明，这些模在较低碰撞性下最不稳定，与其俘获电子特征一致。电子尺度和多尺度非线性模拟显示，这些模能够解释数兆瓦的实验功率，其中多尺度模拟提示实验梯度可能位于不同湍流状态之间的分岔点附近。

articles.title: Quantum sensing of radiofrequency fields using cold Rydberg atoms in a super-molasses trap
articles.title_zh: 利用超摩擦光阱中的冷里德堡原子进行射频场量子传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07260v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate the quantum sensing of radiofrequency fields based on cold Rydberg atoms in a super-molasses trap, without the need for magnetic coils. Our approach combines the metrological advantages of cold atoms with a metal-free dielectric sensor head minimizing perturbations to the electromagnetic environment, a feature that was previously restricted to vapor-cell-based devices. Moreover, the absence of inductive loads allows to rapidly alternate between the cooling phase and the Rydberg excitation, leading to trap-loss spectroscopy signals one order of magnitude narrower than for conventional magneto-optical traps. This enables self-calibrated microwave power measurements with an unprecedented dynamic range of 43dB, opening the door to new perspectives of applications in calibration measurements. We also report a scale factor linearity better than 1%, the absence of drifts over several tens of minutes leading to a 3μV/cm resolution, and the possibility to retrieve the ellipticity of the applied microwave field. By demonstrating a cold-atom metrological platform in a compact dielectric sensor head, this work paves the way for new applications in the field of radiofrequency measurements with Rydberg atoms, and in other fields of quantum sensing based on cold atoms such as magnetometry, gravimetry or inertial navigation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种基于超摩擦光阱中冷里德堡原子的射频场量子传感方法，无需磁线圈。该方案结合冷原子的计量优势与无金属介电传感头，减少对电磁环境的扰动，并实现了窄谱信号和大动态范围微波功率自校准测量。结果显示其具有优良线性、低漂移和微弱场分辨率，并可恢复微波场椭圆率，为紧凑型冷原子射频测量及其他量子传感应用奠定基础。
authors: Romain Granier, Anthony El Bekai, Miguel Angel Cifuentes Marín, Cédric Blanchard, Nassim Zahzam, Yannick Bidel, Alexandre Bresson, Vilius Atkočius, Chester Camm, Florence Concepcion, Konstantinos Karakostas, Matt Himsworth, Alexander Jantzen, Alexis Bonnin, Sylvain Schwartz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们展示了基于超摩擦光阱中冷里德堡原子的射频场量子传感，且不需要磁线圈。我们的方法将冷原子的计量学优势与无金属介电传感头相结合，后者可最大限度减小对电磁环境的扰动，而这一特性此前仅限于基于蒸汽池的器件。此外，由于不存在感性负载，可以在冷却阶段与里德堡激发之间快速切换，从而得到比传统磁光阱窄一个数量级的阱损耗光谱信号。这使得自校准微波功率测量具有前所未有的 43 dB 动态范围，为校准测量应用开辟了新的前景。我们还报告了优于 1% 的比例因子线性度、在数十分钟内无漂移并由此达到 3 μV/cm 的分辨率，以及恢复所施加微波场椭圆率的可能性。通过在紧凑介电传感头中展示冷原子计量平台，本工作为利用里德堡原子进行射频测量领域的新应用，以及基于冷原子的其他量子传感领域如磁测量、重力测量或惯性导航铺平了道路。

articles.title: Beyond the Four-Decade DIIS Default:Auxiliary-Curvature Acceleration of Self-Consistent-Field Calculations
articles.title_zh: 超越四十年来的 DIIS 默认方法：自洽场计算的辅助曲率加速
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07354v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Direct inversion in the iterative subspace (DIIS), introduced in 1980, remains the practical default for accelerating Hartree-Fock and Kohn-Sham self-consistent-field (SCF) calculations. Many later methods improve robustness or iteration count, but the near-zero overhead of DIIS makes a broad reduction in total wall time difficult. We introduce AURORA-SCF (auxiliary-curvature unified Riemannian orbital-response acceleration), which evaluates energy and gradient only with the requested target Hamiltonian while obtaining most orbital curvature from an independent valence-STO-3G model. A target-level, transported L-BFGS history corrects the model mismatch; a shifted matrix-free solve, trust region, and geodesic orbital update control the step. In 16 direct CPU RHF pairs spanning 137-1484 atomic orbitals, AURORA-SCF was faster in every case, reducing mean wall time by 26.2% and target J/K builds by 33.3%. In a separate set of 63 converged, energy-matched density-fitted GPU pairs spanning seven molecules, closed- and open-shell formalisms, and HF, PBE, B3LYP, and M06-2X, it was again faster in every included pair, with mean reductions of 26.5% in wall time and 31.9% in target J/K builds. Focused direct CPU and GPU sweeps show mean wall-time reductions of 30-34%. These results establish a specific advance beyond the four-decade DIIS default: transferred, secant-corrected curvature can reduce total SCF wall time, not merely iteration count, without changing the target stationary equations. The same optimization pattern also suggests a route to faster orbital optimization elsewhere in quantum chemistry and to multifidelity optimization across scientific computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 AURORA-SCF，一种利用独立价层 STO-3G 模型提供大部分轨道曲率、并以目标能量与梯度维持目标哈密顿量精度的自洽场加速方法。通过目标层级的输运 L-BFGS 历史、移位无矩阵求解、信赖域和测地轨道更新，该方法校正模型不匹配并控制迭代步。多个 CPU 与 GPU 测试表明，AURORA-SCF 在所有纳入配对中均快于 DIIS，显著减少总墙钟时间和目标 J/K 构建次数，证明转移并经割线校正的曲率可降低实际 SCF 计算时间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 1980 年提出的迭代子空间直接反演（DIIS）仍然是加速 Hartree-Fock 和 Kohn-Sham 自洽场（SCF）计算的实际默认方法。许多后续方法提高了稳健性或减少了迭代次数，但 DIIS 近乎为零的额外开销使得广泛降低总墙钟时间变得困难。我们提出 AURORA-SCF（辅助曲率统一黎曼轨道响应加速），它只使用所请求的目标哈密顿量来评估能量和梯度，同时从一个独立的价层 STO-3G 模型获得大部分轨道曲率。目标层级的、经输运的 L-BFGS 历史用于校正模型不匹配；移位的无矩阵求解、信赖域和测地轨道更新用于控制步长。在涵盖 137–1484 个原子轨道的 16 组直接 CPU RHF 配对中，AURORA-SCF 在每种情况下都更快，使平均墙钟时间减少 26.2%，目标 J/K 构建次数减少 33.3%。在另一组包含 63 个已收敛且能量匹配的密度拟合 GPU 配对中，涵盖七种分子、闭壳层和开壳层形式以及 HF、PBE、B3LYP 和 M06-2X，它在每个纳入配对中同样更快，墙钟时间平均减少 26.5%，目标 J/K 构建次数平均减少 31.9%。聚焦的直接 CPU 和 GPU 扫描显示平均墙钟时间减少 30–34%。这些结果确立了超越四十年来 DIIS 默认方法的一项具体进展：转移的、经割线校正的曲率能够减少总 SCF 墙钟时间，而不仅仅是减少迭代次数，同时不改变目标定态方程。同样的优化模式还提示了在量子化学其他轨道优化任务中加速的途径，以及在科学计算中开展多保真度优化的途径。

articles.title: Optomechanical Levitation and Control of High Aspect Ratio Silicon Nanorods
articles.title_zh: 高纵横比硅纳米棒的光机械悬浮与控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07415v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nano- and micro-particles levitated by optical, electrical or magnetic fields are a new frontier in precision sensing and for tests of fundamental physics. For optically levitated anisotropic particles it is possible to control their translation, alignment and rotation. We report on the levitation and characterization of nanofabricated, high uniformity, high aspect ratio, high refractive index silicon cylinders, with diameters as low as 50 nm and lengths up to 1500 nm. We are able to tune their oscillation frequencies from 10 kHz to over 1 MHz, and exert huge optical torque to generate high rotation rates. These optically levitated silicon nanorods will enable precision torque sensing, and when pushed to smaller sizes, tests of quantum physics through the generation of angular momentum superposition states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了纳米制造的高均匀性、高纵横比、高折射率硅圆柱的光学悬浮与表征，其直径低至 50 nm、长度达 1500 nm。研究者能够将其振荡频率从 10 kHz 调谐到超过 1 MHz，并施加强光学力矩产生高速旋转。这类光悬浮硅纳米棒有望用于精密力矩传感，并在进一步缩小尺寸后用于角动量叠加态等量子物理测试。
authors: Zhenan Chen, Sophie Sanghera, Yanhui Hu, James Sabin, Maryam Nikkhou, Alex Gee, David Burt, Qiongyuan Wu, Joseph Kelly, James Millen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由光场、电场或磁场悬浮的纳米和微米颗粒是精密传感以及基础物理检验的新前沿。对于光学悬浮的各向异性颗粒，可以控制其平移、取向和旋转。我们报道了对纳米制造的、高均匀性、高纵横比、高折射率硅圆柱的悬浮与表征，其直径低至 50 nm，长度最高达 1500 nm。我们能够将其振荡频率从 10 kHz 调谐到超过 1 MHz，并施加巨大的光学力矩以产生高旋转速率。这些光学悬浮的硅纳米棒将能够实现精密力矩传感，并且在推进到更小尺寸时，可通过产生角动量叠加态来检验量子物理。

articles.title: Observation of Π-symmetry ultralong-range Rydberg molecules
articles.title_zh: Π 对称超长程里德堡分子的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07447v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We observe weakly-bound Π-symmetry electronic states in the spectroscopy of ⁸⁷Rb(nP₃/₂)+⁸⁷Rb(5S₁/₂) ultralong-range Rydberg molecules. We detect these molecules in Rydberg states having principal quantum number 13łe n łe 16. Their Π-state character is unambiguously identified via their observed multiplet structure: the 2F+1 magnetic sublevels of the ground-state rubidium atom separate, as in the Zeeman effect, because of the spin-spin coupling between the Rydberg and valence electrons. We find a rapid decrease in the molecular binding energy propto (n-μ_P₃/₂)⁻¹¹, where μ_P₃/₂ is the quantum defect, indicating that the low-n regime of Rydberg states is ideally suited for studies of Π-symmetry molecules. Our observations are in good agreement with Green's function-based calculations for 14łe nłe 16, with poorer agreement for n=13 hinting at the beginning of a breakdown of the Fermi pseudopotential approach at low n.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在 ⁸⁷Rb(nP₃/₂)+⁸⁷Rb(5S₁/₂) 超长程里德堡分子的光谱中观测到弱束缚 Π 对称电子态，涉及主量子数 13 至 16 的里德堡态。其 Π 态特征由基态铷原子磁子能级的多重结构清楚识别，该分裂源于里德堡电子与价电子之间的自旋-自旋耦合。实验发现束缚能随有效主量子数快速下降，并与格林函数计算在较高 n 区间符合良好，但 n=13 的偏差暗示低 n 下费米赝势方法可能开始失效。
authors: Matthew T. Eiles, Aleksandr Zaitsev, Dominik Dorer, Shinsuke Haze, Markus Deiß, S. Efe Gürleyen, Chris H. Greene, Johannes Hecker Denschlag
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们在 ⁸⁷Rb(nP₃/₂)+⁸⁷Rb(5S₁/₂) 超长程里德堡分子的光谱中观测到弱束缚的 Π 对称电子态。我们在主量子数 13 ≤ n ≤ 16 的里德堡态中探测到这些分子。它们的 Π 态特征通过观测到的多重态结构被明确识别：基态铷原子的 2F+1 个磁子能级由于里德堡电子与价电子之间的自旋-自旋耦合而分裂，类似于塞曼效应。我们发现分子束缚能快速降低，正比于 (n-μ_P₃/₂)⁻¹¹，其中 μ_P₃/₂ 为量子缺陷，这表明里德堡态的低 n 区域非常适合研究 Π 对称分子。我们的观测结果与基于格林函数的计算在 14 ≤ n ≤ 16 时符合良好，而 n=13 时符合较差，这暗示在低 n 下费米赝势方法开始出现失效。

articles.title: Characterization of a prototype parallel-plate ²³⁸U fission chamber with DD and DT fusion neutron sources
articles.title_zh: 利用 DD 和 DT 聚变中子源表征平行板 ²³⁸U 裂变室原型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The SPARC tokamak will employ ²³⁸U-based fission chambers (FCs) to monitor high-performance deuterium-tritium (DT) plasma operations, spanning neutron yield rates from sim10¹⁵ to >10¹⁹ n/s. This work validates the ²³⁸U FC design, which utilizes a parallel-plate detector geometry and borated polyethylene collimation to prioritize unscattered DD and DT fusion neutrons. Experimental testing with both DD and DT neutron generators corroborates vendor-specified efficiencies and demonstrates excellent detector linearity, with measured count rates showing good agreement with OpenMC neutronics simulations. Further characterization confirms the ²³⁸U FC's robustness against SPARC-relevant environmental challenges, including stray magnetic fields up to 14 mT and possible signal degradation risks associated with sim30 m long cable runs. These results confirm that the ²³⁸U FC, supported by indirect neutron shielding as well as appropriate pulse height thresholds, provides a reliable solution for fusion power measurements as part of the SPARC neutron diagnostics suite.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文验证了用于 SPARC 托卡马克高性能氘氚等离子体运行中子监测的 ²³⁸U 裂变室设计。该设计采用平行板探测器几何结构和含硼聚乙烯准直，以优先探测未散射的 DD 与 DT 聚变中子。DD 和 DT 中子发生器实验结果支持供应商给出的效率参数，显示良好线性并与 OpenMC 中子学模拟一致，同时证实其可耐受 SPARC 相关磁场和长电缆信号传输挑战。
authors: V. Hagenlocker, R. A. Tinguely, X. Wang, J. L. Ball, B. Buschmann, M. Gatu-Johnson, R. Gocht, P. Raj
articles.abstract_zh_full: SPARC 托卡马克将采用基于 ²³⁸U 的裂变室（FC）来监测高性能氘氚（DT）等离子体运行，其覆盖的中子产额率范围从约 10¹⁵ 到超过 10¹⁹ n/s。本工作验证了 ²³⁸U 裂变室设计，该设计采用平行板探测器几何结构和含硼聚乙烯准直，以优先探测未散射的 DD 和 DT 聚变中子。使用 DD 和 DT 中子发生器进行的实验测试证实了供应商给定的效率，并展示出优异的探测器线性，测得的计数率与 OpenMC 中子学模拟符合良好。进一步表征证实了 ²³⁸U 裂变室能够抵御与 SPARC 相关的环境挑战，包括高达 14 mT 的杂散磁场，以及与约 30 m 长电缆传输相关的潜在信号退化风险。这些结果确认，²³⁸U 裂变室在间接中子屏蔽以及适当脉冲高度阈值的支持下，可作为 SPARC 中子诊断套件中聚变功率测量的可靠解决方案。

articles.title: Entanglement-enhanced optical magnetometry beyond the standard quantum limit
articles.title_zh: 超越标准量子极限的纠缠增强光学磁测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06815v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Optical atomic magnetometry is a powerful tool for continuous sensing applications, yet, in the absence of quantum correlations, its sensitivity is limited by the standard quantum limit (SQL) stemming from a trade-off between optical probe imprecision and quantum measurement backaction. Beyond-SQL sensitivity requires quantum correlations that modify these measurement noise sources. Here we demonstrate such sensitivity by using entangled state of the probe light and by engineering correlations between measurement imprecision and backaction. Having first explored SQL in a broad range of frequencies, we demonstrate overcoming the limit by combining variational readout with coupling the magnetometer to one mode of a bipartite entangled light state and conditioning the results on the other entangled mode. Tuning the detected light quadratures and combining the signals from the two measurement channels, we achieve sensitivity beyond the SQL in a broad range of acoustic frequencies which has so far remained inaccessible to quantum-noise-limited optical magnetometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了通过量子关联增强连续光学原子磁测量灵敏度并超越标准量子极限。研究利用双模纠缠光态中的一模耦合磁力计，并以另一纠缠模进行条件化，同时结合变分读出和测量通道信号组合。结果在宽广声学频率范围内实现了超越 SQL 的灵敏度，该频段此前对量子噪声受限光学磁测量而言难以达到。
authors: Jun Jia, Túlio Brito Brasil, Maimouna Bocoum, Andrea Grimaldi, Laurits Møberg, Mikhail Balabas, Jörg Helge Müller, Emil Zeuthen, Eugene Simon Polzik
articles.abstract_zh_full: 光学原子磁测量是连续传感应用中的强大工具；然而，在没有量子关联的情况下，其灵敏度受到标准量子极限（SQL）的限制，该极限源自光学探针不精确性与量子测量反作用之间的折衷。超越 SQL 的灵敏度需要能够改变这些测量噪声来源的量子关联。在这里，我们通过使用探针光的纠缠态，并通过工程化测量不精确性与反作用之间的关联，展示了这种灵敏度。在首先在宽广频率范围内探索 SQL 之后，我们通过将变分读出与把磁力计耦合到二分纠缠光态的一个模式相结合，并根据另一个纠缠模式对结果进行条件化，展示了对该极限的超越。通过调谐被探测光的正交分量并组合来自两个测量通道的信号，我们在宽广的声学频率范围内实现了超越 SQL 的灵敏度，而该范围迄今为止仍是量子噪声受限光学磁测量难以触及的。

articles.title: Thermodynamic Human-Computer Interaction
articles.title_zh: 热力学人机交互
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.07123v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Traditional human-computer interaction models rely on domain-specific techniques to model target prediction; models designed for cursor interaction prediction fail to generalize to mobile interfaces and vice versa. We introduce a unifying framework grounded in thermodynamics, proposing that human interaction is composed of phases in thermodynamic equilibrium and non-equilibrium. To demonstrate this, we derive Fitts' law and the proposed target prediction model from equilibrium thermodynamics by assigning kinetic and potential energies to a moving agent and target.
