To guide the dynamics toward scientifically relevant topological targets, we formulate objectives that encompass distribution matching, task specific topological statistics, and structure-preserving compression. The resulting rewards balance task specific distributional targets, diagram fidelity, and complexity reduction, and yield a framework for adaptive topological simplification and probabilistic modeling. Experiments on synthetic and neuroimaging PDs demonstrate that the proposed framework can preserve dominant topological structure while reducing diagram complexity.
articles.abstract_zh: 持久性图为多尺度拓扑结构提供了稳定且可解释的概括。尽管持久性图的统计分析已取得大量进展，现有研究往往将其视为静态对象，对持久性图空间上的概率建模与随机演化关注不足。本文提出一个用于持久性图空间随机动力学的强化学习框架，使图通过拓扑感知的局部编辑操作进行演化。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 持久性图（PD）为多尺度拓扑结构提供了稳定且可解释的概括。尽管在持久性图的统计分析方面已取得显著进展，现有文献往往将图视为静态对象，并对PD空间中的概率建模与随机演化提供有限的框架。我们提出一个用于PD空间随机动力学的强化学习框架，其中图通过拓扑感知的局部编辑操作进行演化。这些动力学在有限且基数可变的PD空间上定义了受控马尔可夫过程。我们建立了相应条件，在这些条件下，所诱导的马尔可夫链是不可约、非周期且几何遍历的，从而意味着PD空间上存在唯一的平稳概率法则。为将动力学引导至科学上有意义的拓扑目标，我们构造了涵盖分布匹配、任务特定拓扑统计量以及结构保持压缩的目标函数。由此得到的奖励在任务特定的分布目标、图的保真度与复杂度降低之间取得平衡，并形成了一个用于自适应拓扑简化与概率建模的框架。在合成数据与神经影像PD上的实验表明，所提出的框架在降低图复杂度的同时，能够保持主导拓扑结构。

articles.title: Agentic Nesting: A New Methodology for Existing Enterprise Application Integration and Services
articles.title_zh: Agentic Nesting：面向既有企业应用集成与服务的一种新方法论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05159v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise operations extensively rely on multiple heterogeneous business systems and information applications, which also result in severe data silos and process fragmentation. Enterprises have invested considerable financial and material resources in building these applications, however, effectively leveraging and orchestrating them remains a formidable challenge. Conventional approaches to enterprise application integration, encompassing middleware architectures such as Enterprise Service Bus (ESB), API gateway infrastructures, and Robotic Process Automation (RPA), suffer from inherent limitations like high architectural coupling, escalating operation and maintenance costs, and limited intelligence capabilities. This paper proposes Agentic Nesting, a multi-agent collaboration framework in which existing enterprise applications are encapsulated as autonomous AI agents within a hierarchically nested structure. Rather than flat interconnection, agents are organized into layered stewardship topologies that mirror the compositional complexity of enterprise ecosystems. The framework extracts a digital agent proxy from each legacy application to enable natural-language interaction and autonomous manipulation, coordinates multiple agents through a central orchestrator for task decomposition and dynamic dispatching, and exposes a unified conversational interface for cross-application querying and process orchestration. The main contributions of this paper are the proposition of the "Application-as-Agent" integration paradigm and the "Conversation-as-Integration" interaction philosophy, together with an exploration of the generalization potential of this methodology in scenarios encompassing heterogeneous system coordination, and large-scale data applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 企业运营高度依赖多个异构业务系统和信息应用，也因此造成严重的数据孤岛与流程割裂。本文指出，传统企业应用集成方法，如ESB、API网关和RPA，存在架构耦合高、运维成本上升以及智能能力有限等问题。为此，作者提出Agentic Nesting，将既有企业应用封装为层级嵌套结构中的自主AI代理，并通过统一对话接口实现跨应用查询与流程编排。
authors: Xi Wang, Kun Li, Xianyao Ling, Gang Yin, Liang Zhang, Jiang Wu, Wenbo Lei, Jun Xu, Annie Wang, Fu Zhang, Weizhe Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 企业运营广泛依赖多个异构业务系统和信息应用，这也导致了严重的数据孤岛和流程碎片化。企业已投入大量资金和物力建设这些应用，然而，如何有效利用并编排它们仍然是一项艰巨挑战。传统的企业应用集成方法，包括企业服务总线（ESB）等中间件架构、API网关基础设施以及机器人流程自动化（RPA），都存在内在局限，例如架构耦合度高、运维成本不断上升以及智能能力有限。本文提出Agentic Nesting，这是一种多智能体协作框架，其中现有企业应用被封装为层级嵌套结构中的自主AI代理。该框架并非采用扁平化互联，而是将代理组织为分层的托管拓扑，以反映企业生态系统的组合复杂性。该框架从每个遗留应用中提取数字代理替身，以支持自然语言交互和自主操作；通过中央编排器协调多个代理，实现任务分解与动态调度；并暴露统一的对话式接口，以支持跨应用查询和流程编排。本文的主要贡献在于提出了“应用即代理”（Application-as-Agent）的集成范式和“对话即集成”（Conversation-as-Integration）的交互理念，同时探讨了该方法在异构系统协调和大规模数据应用等场景中的泛化潜力。

articles.title: AppDeltaWorld: Transition-Grounded Delta Code World Model for Mobile GUI Agents
articles.title_zh: AppDeltaWorld：面向移动GUI代理的转移约束增量代码世界模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05891v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile GUI agents can operate apps through pixel perception and touch actions, making them a promising interface for collecting and improving long-horizon mobile interaction policies. However, real trajectories are difficult to obtain for sensitive apps and privacy-critical operations. At the same time, existing simulated environments are costly to scale up, and GUI world models still suffer from unstable generation, limited modality coverage, and inconsistent action-transition logic. To address these limitations, we propose AppDeltaWorld, a transition-grounded delta code world model that predicts the next GUI as a reachable code update rather than as an unconstrained image or text description. AppDeltaWorld retrieves app-specific Level-1 HTML references under an action-transition constraint, generates Level-2 executable HTML conditioned on the current screen, action, predicted next-screen text, and retrieved structure, and inserts generated visual assets into image slots before browser rendering. As a world model, AppDeltaWorld achieves the highest fidelity on CMGUIBench-500 under Code2World evaluation, with clear gains in structural layout and UI element reconstruction over image-only and code-only baselines. As a training environment, AppDeltaWorld supports filtered closed-loop SFT data construction that, when combined with public supervision, enables AppDeltaAgent to achieve state-of-the-art performance on AndroidLens and consistent gains on MobileGym and MobileWorld. Moreover, world-model-based test-time reinforcement learning enables policy adaptation and shows further improvements without additional interaction with real apps.
articles.abstract_zh: 移动GUI代理可通过像素感知和触控动作操控应用，是收集并改进长程移动交互策略的有前景接口。然而，对于敏感应用和隐私关键操作，真实轨迹难以获取。为此，本文提出AppDeltaWorld，一种转移约束的增量代码世界模型，将下一步GUI表示为可达的代码更新，而非无约束的图像或文本描述。
authors: Weikai Xu, Yunren Feng, Haoxiang Lei, Kun Huang, Yuxuan Liu, Kang Zhao, Xiaolin Hu, Shuo Shang, Bo An
articles.abstract_zh_full: 移动GUI代理可以通过像素感知和触控动作来操作应用程序，这使其成为收集并改进长程移动交互策略的有前景接口。然而，对于敏感应用和隐私关键操作，真实轨迹很难获得。与此同时，现有模拟环境的扩展成本较高，而GUI世界模型仍然存在生成不稳定、模态覆盖有限以及动作—转移逻辑不一致等问题。为解决这些限制，我们提出AppDeltaWorld，这是一种转移约束的增量代码世界模型，它将下一步GUI预测为一个可达的代码更新，而不是无约束的图像或文本描述。AppDeltaWorld在动作—转移约束下检索应用特定的一级HTML参考，基于当前屏幕、动作、预测的下一屏文本以及检索到的结构生成二级可执行HTML，并在浏览器渲染前将生成的视觉资产插入图像占位符。作为世界模型，AppDeltaWorld在Code2World评测下的CMGUIBench-500上取得了最高保真度，相比仅图像和仅代码的基线，在结构布局和UI元素重建方面均有明显提升。作为训练环境，AppDeltaWorld支持过滤后的闭环SFT数据构建，并与公开监督结合，使AppDeltaAgent在AndroidLens上达到最先进性能，同时在MobileGym和MobileWorld上也获得一致提升。此外，基于世界模型的测试时强化学习能够实现策略自适应，并在不增加真实应用交互的情况下带来进一步改进。

articles.title: GSBF: Gaussian Splatting for Environment-Aware Beamforming
articles.title_zh: GSBF：面向环境感知波束成形的高斯泼溅方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05896v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Beamforming plays a key role in multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) communication systems. However, conventional beamforming design normally requires accurate instantaneous channel state information (CSI) and iterative optimization, which incur substantial pilot overhead and computational complexity. Recognizing that radio propagation is intrinsically governed by the physical geometry, we develop a 3D Gaussian splatting for environment-aware beamforming (GSBF) pipeline based on multi-modal data, which characterizes the environment through a persistent 3D Gaussian representation. Specifically, GSBF models the environmental scattering response with reciprocity-preserving bidirectional spherical Gaussian (Bi-SG) kernels and performs two-sided electromagnetic rasterization to render an angular propagator map. The rendered map is then aggregated through an over-complete array-manifold dictionary and projected to the constant-modulus beamformers, thereby synthesizing beams directly from the access point (AP) pose and user position without online instantaneous CSI. Simulations demonstrate that GSBF consistently outperforms baselines such as exhaustive beam alignment (EBA) with lower latency.
articles.abstract_zh: 波束成形在多输入多输出通信系统中起关键作用，但传统设计通常依赖准确的瞬时信道状态信息和迭代优化，带来较高导频开销与计算复杂度。本文利用多模态数据构建三维高斯泼溅流程，以持久化的三维高斯表示刻画环境，并据此实现环境感知波束成形。仿真结果表明，GSBF在无需在线瞬时CSI的情况下，可从接入点姿态和用户位置直接合成波束，并在时延上优于穷举波束对齐等基线。
authors: Yijie Bian, Wei Guo, Zixin Wang, Shenghui Song, Jun Zhang, Khaled B. Letaief
articles.abstract_zh_full: 波束成形在多输入多输出（MIMO）通信系统中起关键作用。然而，传统波束成形设计通常需要准确的瞬时信道状态信息（CSI）以及迭代优化，这会带来显著的导频开销和计算复杂度。考虑到无线传播本质上受物理几何结构支配，我们基于多模态数据开发了一个用于环境感知波束成形（GSBF）的三维高斯泼溅流程，该流程通过持久化的三维高斯表示来表征环境。具体而言，GSBF使用保留互易性的双向球面高斯（Bi-SG）核来建模环境散射响应，并执行双侧电磁栅格化以渲染角度传播图。随后，将渲染得到的图通过过完备阵列流形字典进行聚合，并投影到恒模波束成形器上，从而无需在线瞬时CSI即可仅根据接入点（AP）姿态和用户位置直接合成波束。仿真表明，GSBF始终优于穷举波束对齐（EBA）等基线，同时具有更低的时延。

articles.title: CogVis: Must Open-Vocabulary Change Detection Perceive the Scene Anew for Every Query?
articles.title_zh: CogVis：开放词汇变化检测是否必须针对每个查询重新感知场景？
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06150v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Earth-surface monitoring requires change detection models capable of recognizing arbitrary semantic categories. Open-Vocabulary Change Detection (OVCD) addresses this need. However, existing methods often entangle temporal perception, semantic discrimination, and region verification, causing unstable results and redundant computation. Inspired by human visual change perception, we propose CogVis, a cognitive memory-guided framework that reformulates OVCD as a perception-memory-verification paradigm. CogVis first employs a Scene Change Perceptron (SCP) to extract a reusable, category-agnostic change prior from frozen bi-temporal features, thereby decoupling temporal evidence from semantic category decisions. A Semantic Memory Calibrator (SMC) then compensates for category-dependent score shifts by dynamically estimating an image-query-specific decision threshold. Finally, an Adaptive Region Filter (ARF) filters connected candidates using learned semantic, temporal, and structural reliability. Experiments on seven benchmarks spanning semantic change detection, binary change localization, and building-damage assessment show that CogVis achieves state-of-the-art performance across all evaluated datasets. By sharing scene-level change perception, CogVis further avoids repeating category-agnostic temporal perception across queries and improves inference throughput by 28.50%.
articles.abstract_zh: 地表监测需要能够识别任意语义类别的变化检测模型，开放词汇变化检测正是为此而提出。然而，现有方法往往将时序感知、语义判别和区域验证纠缠在一起，导致结果不稳定且计算冗余。本文提出CogVis，将开放词汇变化检测重构为“感知—记忆—验证”范式，并在七个基准上取得了最先进性能。
authors: Zijie Wang, Chen Zhong, Wei He
articles.abstract_zh_full: 地表监测需要能够识别任意语义类别的变化检测模型。开放词汇变化检测（OVCD）正是为满足这一需求而提出的。然而，现有方法往往将时序感知、语义判别和区域验证纠缠在一起，导致结果不稳定且计算冗余。受人类视觉变化感知启发，我们提出CogVis，一个由认知记忆引导的框架，将OVCD重新表述为“感知—记忆—验证”范式。CogVis首先采用场景变化感知器（SCP），从冻结的双时相特征中提取可复用、与类别无关的变化先验，从而将时序证据与语义类别决策解耦。随后，语义记忆校准器（SMC）通过动态估计图像—查询特定的决策阈值，来补偿类别相关的分数偏移。最后，自适应区域过滤器（ARF）利用学习到的语义、时间和结构可靠性，对连通候选区域进行筛选。跨越语义变化检测、二分类变化定位和建筑损坏评估的七个基准实验表明，CogVis在所有评测数据集上均取得了最先进性能。通过共享场景级变化感知，CogVis进一步避免了对每个查询重复执行与类别无关的时序感知，并将推理吞吐量提升了28.50%。

articles.title: MicroEvo: Knowledge-Guided LLM Sampling for Efficient Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration
articles.title_zh: MicroEvo：知识引导的LLM采样，用于高效微体系结构设计空间探索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Microarchitecture design space exploration suffers from expansive search spaces and expensive PPA evaluation, leaving only a small simulation budget for design decision-making. Existing methods perform blind search without considering microarchitectural dependencies and fail to learn from the iterative search effectively, leading to wasted evaluations and weak Pareto convergence. In this paper, we propose MicroEvo, a knowledge-guided framework that couples off-the-shelf LLMs with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) for multi-objective microarchitecture optimization. MicroEvo combines LLM-driven evolutionary operators, a Pareto-aware tree policy that balances Pareto contribution and diversity, an active knowledge accumulation mechanism that extracts and reuses optimization insights, and state-aware directives that adapt the search behavior online. Experiments show that MicroEvo improves Pareto-front quality by up to 36.2% over NSGA-II and achieves 10.6x higher search efficiency, and also demonstrates strong scalability to a complex industrial-scale core. The code repository is available at: https://github.com/GEAR-SEU/MicroEvo-ICCAD-26.
articles.abstract_zh: 微体系结构设计空间探索面临搜索空间庞大与PPA评估昂贵的问题，留给设计决策的仿真预算十分有限。现有方法往往忽视微体系结构之间的依赖关系，并且难以从迭代搜索中有效学习，导致评估浪费和帕累托收敛较弱。本文提出MicroEvo，将现成LLM与蒙特卡洛树搜索结合，用于多目标微体系结构优化。
authors: Jia Xiong, Runkai Li, Chenxu Niu, Guangyuan Gao, Changwen Xing, Yifan Zhang, Xinlai Wan, Jieran Cui, Chen Bai, Yusheng Hua, Ying Wang, Ming Ling, Xi Wang, Tao Xie
articles.abstract_zh_full: 微体系结构设计空间探索面临庞大的搜索空间和昂贵的PPA评估，因此可用于设计决策的仿真预算非常有限。现有方法往往在不考虑微体系结构依赖关系的情况下进行盲目搜索，并且难以从迭代搜索过程中有效学习，从而造成评估浪费和较弱的帕累托收敛。在本文中，我们提出MicroEvo，这是一种知识引导框架，将现成的LLM与蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）相结合，用于多目标微体系结构优化。MicroEvo结合了由LLM驱动的进化算子、兼顾帕累托贡献与多样性的帕累托感知树策略、用于提取并复用优化经验的主动知识积累机制，以及可在线调整搜索行为的状态感知指令。实验表明，MicroEvo相较于NSGA-II最多可将帕累托前沿质量提升36.2%，并实现10.6倍更高的搜索效率，同时在复杂的工业级核心上也表现出很强的可扩展性。代码仓库见： https://github.com/GEAR-SEU/MicroEvo-ICCAD-26。

articles.title: The Closing Window: How Governments Could Lose Their Ability to Restrain Advanced AI
articles.title_zh: 收窄的窗口：政府如何可能失去约束先进人工智能的能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05173v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As AI capabilities advance, AI systems will pose greater risks to national security and potentially humanity as a whole. Governments may eventually conclude that these risks warrant restraining AI development. This motivates the question: will governments still be able to restrain AI development in the future, should they want to do so? In this paper we analyze which world events and changes to the state of AI development would make future governance more difficult or even effectively impossible. Our analysis surfaces likely pathways that would lead to these difficulties, including hardware proliferation, continued algorithmic progress, and the release of catastrophically dangerous AI models. Due to the field's lack of understanding of AI development, it may be difficult or impossible to know when we will hit a "point of no return", and we therefore recommend a conservative approach. The window may be closing, but governments currently have an opportunity to preserve their optionality if they act soon. Our policy recommendations would enable governments to restrain AI development in the future, while imposing relatively small costs today.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着AI能力不断提升，AI系统将对国家安全乃至整个人类构成更大风险。政府最终可能认为这些风险足以要求限制AI发展，但问题在于未来是否仍有能力做到这一点。本文分析了哪些世界事件和AI发展状态的变化会使未来治理更困难，甚至实际上不可能，并建议采取保守策略以保留政策选择空间。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 随着AI能力的提升，AI系统将对国家安全乃至整个人类整体构成更大的风险。政府最终可能会认为这些风险足以要求约束AI发展。这引出了一个问题：如果未来政府希望这样做，它们是否仍然有能力约束AI发展？在本文中，我们分析了哪些世界事件以及AI发展状态的哪些变化会使未来治理变得更加困难，甚至实际上不可能。我们的分析揭示了可能导致这些困难的路径，包括硬件扩散、持续的算法进步，以及灾难性危险AI模型的发布。由于该领域对AI发展的理解不足，我们可能难以甚至不可能知道何时会到达“不可逆转点”，因此我们建议采取保守方法。这个窗口可能正在关闭，但政府目前仍有机会，如果及早行动，就能保留其政策选择空间。我们的政策建议将使政府在未来能够约束AI发展，同时在今天只带来相对较小的成本。

articles.title: Reinforcement Learning for Intelligent Vehicle-to-Grid Integration: Balancing Clean Energy Utilization and Battery Degradation Preservation
articles.title_zh: 用于智能车辆到电网集成的强化学习：在清洁能源利用与电池衰减保护之间取得平衡
articles.abstract: The transition toward sustainable mobility requires an  intelligent integration of Electric Vehicles (EVs) into the power grid.  This paper proposes a Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework  using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to manage bidirectional  Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) power flow. Utilizing the Indian Grid Master  dataset, the system optimizes for economic arbitrage and carbon  reduction while strictly adhering to a 90% State of Charge (SoC)  mobility requirement. A core innovation of this work is an  asymmetric reward function that applies a 35x penalty to battery  discharge relative to charging, ensuring hardware longevity. Results  across various 10-hour shift profiles demonstrate the agent's ability  to achieve mobility targets while maximizing grid stability.
articles.abstract_zh: 实现可持续出行需要将电动汽车与电网进行智能集成。本文提出一个基于PPO的强化学习框架，用于管理双向V2G功率流，并在严格满足90%荷电状态出行要求的同时优化经济套利与碳减排。其核心创新是非对称奖励函数，对电池放电施加高于充电35倍的惩罚，以保护电池寿命。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 向可持续出行的转变要求将电动汽车（EV）智能地集成到电网中。本文提出一个采用近端策略优化（PPO）的强化学习（RL）框架，用于管理双向车辆到电网（V2G）功率流。系统利用印度电网主数据集，在严格满足90%荷电状态（SoC）出行要求的前提下，优化经济套利和碳减排。本文的核心创新是一种非对称奖励函数，其对电池放电施加相对于充电35倍的惩罚，以确保硬件寿命。针对不同的10小时班次配置的结果表明，该智能体能够在最大化电网稳定性的同时实现出行目标。

articles.title: Microstructural Evolution and Optical Properties of Hydrothermally Synthesized CuO/ZrO2 Nanocomposites
articles.title_zh: 水热法合成CuO/ZrO2纳米复合材料的微结构演化与光学性质
articles.abstract: In this study, pure CuO, pure ZrO2 nanoparticles (NPs) and CuO/ZrO2 nanocomposite (NC) were synthesized via a solution assisted hydrothermal method at 150 ᵒC and systematically investigated to understand the influence of CuO incorporation on the structural, optical and luminescence properties of ZrO2. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed the formation of monoclinic CuO and predominantly monoclinic ZrO2, while the CuO/ZrO2 NC exhibited partial stabilization of the tetragonal ZrO2 phase. Williamson‒Hall (WH) analysis revealed reduced lattice strain and dislocation density in the CuO/ZrO2 NC. The average crystallite sizes were found to be 14.2 nm for CuO, 8.4 nm for ZrO2 and ⁓38 nm for the CuO/ZrO2 NC. SEM revealed agglomerated micron-sized particles assembled from nanoscale crystallites, while EDAX analysis confirmed the homogeneous distribution of Cu, Zr and O elements. FTIR spectra showed characteristic Cu‒O and Zr‒O vibrational modes, together with band broadening in the composite arising from interfacial interactions between the constituent oxides. DRS studies revealed optical band gaps of 2.44 eV for CuO, 4.04 eV for ZrO2 and 3.64 eV for the CuO/ZrO2 NC, indicating significant modification of the electronic structure after composite formation. PL studies demonstrated defect‒assisted visible emissions associated with oxygen-vacancy-related states and interfacial defect centers. The combined structural and spectroscopic analyses revealed a strong correlation between phase evolution, microstructural modification and optical response, which may enhance the potential of CuO/ZrO2 NCs for photocatalytic, sensing and optoelectronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本研究通过150℃溶液辅助水热法合成纯CuO、纯ZrO2纳米颗粒及CuO/ZrO2纳米复合材料，并系统考察CuO引入对ZrO2结构、光学和发光性质的影响。结果表明，复合后ZrO2的四方相得到部分稳定，晶格应变和位错密度降低，带隙与发光行为也发生明显改变。综合分析显示，微结构演化与光学响应之间存在强相关性，这有助于其在光催化、传感和光电器件中的应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本研究中，采用150℃的溶液辅助水热法合成了纯CuO、纯ZrO2纳米颗粒（NPs）以及CuO/ZrO2纳米复合材料（NC），并系统研究了CuO引入对ZrO2结构、光学和发光性质的影响。X射线衍射分析证实形成了单斜CuO和以单斜相为主的ZrO2，而CuO/ZrO2纳米复合材料表现出四方相ZrO2的部分稳定化。Williamson-Hall（WH）分析表明，CuO/ZrO2纳米复合材料中的晶格应变和位错密度降低。平均晶粒尺寸分别为CuO的14.2 nm、ZrO2的8.4 nm以及CuO/ZrO2纳米复合材料的约38 nm。扫描电子显微镜（SEM）显示，样品由纳米级晶粒组装形成的团聚微米级颗粒构成，而EDAX分析证实Cu、Zr和O元素均匀分布。FTIR光谱显示了具有特征性的Cu-O和Zr-O振动模式，同时由于组分氧化物之间的界面相互作用，复合材料中出现了峰展宽。漫反射光谱（DRS）研究显示，CuO、ZrO2和CuO/ZrO2纳米复合材料的光学带隙分别为2.44 eV、4.04 eV和3.64 eV，表明复合形成后电子结构发生了显著改变。PL研究表明，发光与缺陷辅助的可见光发射有关，这些发射与氧空位相关态和界面缺陷中心有关。综合结构与光谱分析表明，材料的相演化、微结构变化与光学响应之间存在强相关性，这可能提升CuO/ZrO2纳米复合材料在光催化、传感和光电应用中的潜力。

articles.title: Design and Control of Atmospheric Water Electrolysis Systems for Green Hydrogen in Arid Environments
articles.title_zh: 面向干旱环境绿色制氢的大气取水电解系统设计与控制
articles.abstract: Freshwater scarcity limits green hydrogen production in arid regions like the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), despite high solar potential. This study compares two atmospheric-moisture-based systems: a Direct Air Electrolyzer (DAE) using a hygroscopic H₂SO₄ electrolyte in a porous sponge, and a hybrid dehumidifier–alkaline electrolyzer (DH-AE) that condenses ambient moisture via vapor-compression refrigeration. Both are designed for Cairo's worst-case relative humidity (RH = 38.19%). The four-module DAE sizing is anchored to a platinum-referenced electrochemical ceiling (1.686 V per module, 87.8% energy efficiency, 97.3% electrolysis efficiency). For the SS‑904L stainless-steel prototype employed herein, an electrode-material correction (80–140 mV penalty) yields a realistic operating band of 1.766–1.826 V and an energy efficiency of 81.1–83.9%, which brackets the measured prototype range of 1.82–1.95 V. The DH‑AE achieves equivalent output at 68.5% overall efficiency. Thermal simulations (ANSYS) confirm safe operation of SS‑904L electrodes within the iso-corrosion envelope. A closed-loop control framework (humidity/temperature sensing, PID current regulation, SCADA) is proposed and validated in simulation, enabling autonomous operation. Techno-economic analysis for 50–1,000 kg·day⁻¹ shows a benchmark levelized cost of hydrogen (LCOH) of 4.7 USD·kg⁻¹ for the DAE at 1,000 kg·day⁻¹. When full maintenance, electrolyte replenishment, and long-term degradation are included, the fully loaded LCOH rises to approximately 5.8 USD·kg⁻¹—yet this remains roughly 15% lower than the comparable DH‑AE estimate. Prototype implementations are presented. Overall, atmospheric-moisture-based electrolysis offers a viable, decentralized, water-independent pathway for green hydrogen in arid environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 淡水短缺限制了中东和北非等干旱地区的绿色制氢，即便这些地区太阳能资源丰富。本文比较了两种基于大气水分的系统：一种是使用吸湿性硫酸电解质和多孔海绵的直接空气电解器，另一种是通过蒸汽压缩制冷冷凝空气水分的混合式除湿-碱性电解系统。研究在开罗最不利相对湿度条件下对系统进行了设计、仿真和经济分析，并提出闭环控制框架以支持自主运行。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 淡水稀缺限制了中东和北非（MENA）等干旱地区的绿色制氢，尽管这些地区拥有很高的太阳能潜力。本研究比较了两种基于大气水分的系统：一种是直接空气电解器（DAE），其采用置于多孔海绵中的吸湿性H₂SO₄电解质；另一种是混合式除湿—碱性电解器（DH-AE），其通过蒸汽压缩制冷冷凝环境湿气。两种系统均按开罗最不利的相对湿度条件（RH = 38.19%）进行设计。四模块DAE的尺寸设计以参考铂的电化学上限为基础（每模块1.686 V、87.8%的能量效率、97.3%的电解效率）。对于本文所采用的SS-904L不锈钢原型，电极材料修正（80–140 mV惩罚）给出了1.766–1.826 V的实际工作区间以及81.1%–83.9%的能量效率，这一范围与实测原型的1.82–1.95 V相吻合。DH-AE在68.5%的总体效率下实现了等效输出。热模拟（ANSYS）证实SS-904L电极可在等腐蚀包络内安全运行。本文提出并在仿真中验证了一个闭环控制框架（湿度/温度传感、PID电流调节、SCADA），可实现自主运行。针对50–1,000 kg·day⁻¹的技术经济分析表明，DAE在1,000 kg·day⁻¹时的基准制氢平准化成本（LCOH）为4.7美元/kg。若计入全部维护、电解质补充和长期衰减，完全负担化的LCOH上升到约5.8美元/kg，但这仍比相应的DH-AE估计值低约15%。文中还给出了原型实现。总体而言，基于大气水分的电解为干旱环境中的绿色制氢提供了一条可行、去中心化且不依赖水资源的路径。

articles.title: Green-Synthesized Co₃O₄ Nanoparticles from Thyme, Teucrium oliverianum, and Cercis siliquastrum: Enhanced Photocatalytic Degradation of Methylene Blue
articles.title_zh: 基于百里香、Teucrium oliverianum与紫荆叶的绿色合成Co₃O₄纳米颗粒：增强的亚甲蓝光催化降解
articles.abstract: Cobalt oxide nanoparticles (CoO NPs) were synthesized using leaf extracts of , (thyme), and , and compared with chemically synthesized CoO NPs prepared by co-precipitation. The nanoparticles were characterized by UV–Vis spectroscopy, FTIR, X-ray diffraction (XRD), field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM) with energy-dispersive X-ray (EDX) analysis, transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and dynamic light scattering (DLS). The green-synthesized CoO NPs exhibited smaller crystallite sizes (18.20–23.39 nm, XRD) and particle sizes (20–25.6 nm, TEM) than the chemically synthesized CoO NPs (26.82 nm and approximately 32 nm, respectively), together with larger zeta-potential magnitudes (− 35.7 to − 60 mV versus − 30 mV), indicating greater colloidal stability. Under UV irradiation (50 W, ˂400 nm), the green-synthesized CoO NPs degraded methylene blue (MB, 50 mg/L) with efficiencies of 98.99% (), 95.42% (thyme), and 95.30% () after 240 min, compared with 89.64% for the chemically synthesized CoO NPs and 25.98% for UV photolysis alone (catalyst-free control). Inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES) confirmed lower Co leaching from the green-synthesized catalysts (0.32–0.78 mg/L) than from the chemically synthesized catalyst (1.21 mg/L), indicating better structural stability. These results identify plant-mediated CoO nanoparticles, particularly those synthesized using leaf extract, as effective, low-leaching photocatalysts for the removal of methylene blue from dye-contaminated wastewater.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究使用植物叶提取物制备了氧化钴纳米颗粒，并与化学共沉淀法制备的样品进行比较。绿色合成样品具有更小的晶粒与颗粒尺寸、更高的ζ电位绝对值，表明胶体稳定性更好。在紫外照射下，这些纳米颗粒对亚甲蓝表现出更高的降解效率，同时金属钴浸出更低，说明其结构更稳定。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本研究使用叶片提取物制备了氧化钴纳米颗粒（CoO NPs），来源包括百里香、Teucrium oliverianum和紫荆，并与通过共沉淀法化学合成的CoO纳米颗粒进行比较。采用UV-Vis光谱、FTIR、X射线衍射（XRD）、带能谱分析的场发射扫描电子显微镜（FE-SEM/EDX）、透射电子显微镜（TEM）以及动态光散射（DLS）对纳米颗粒进行了表征。与化学合成的CoO纳米颗粒相比，绿色合成的CoO纳米颗粒具有更小的晶粒尺寸（XRD：18.20–23.39 nm）和颗粒尺寸（TEM：20–25.6 nm），同时具有更大的ζ电位绝对值（−35.7至−60 mV，相比之下化学样品为−30 mV），表明其胶体稳定性更高。在紫外照射（50 W，<400 nm）下，绿色合成的CoO纳米颗粒在240 min后对亚甲蓝（MB，50 mg/L）的降解效率分别达到98.99%（紫荆）、95.42%（百里香）和95.30%（Teucrium oliverianum），而化学合成的CoO纳米颗粒为89.64%，仅有紫外光解的无催化剂对照为25.98%。电感耦合等离子体光学发射光谱（ICP-OES）证实，绿色合成催化剂的Co浸出更低（0.32–0.78 mg/L），而化学合成催化剂为1.21 mg/L，说明前者具有更好的结构稳定性。这些结果表明，植物介导的CoO纳米颗粒，尤其是利用叶提取物合成的样品，是去除染料污染废水中亚甲蓝的高效、低浸出光催化剂。

articles.title: Analysis of Fully-Heavy and Hidden-Heavy Tetraquarks in Anisotropic Plasma Using the Generalized Fractional Derivatives
articles.title_zh: 利用广义分数阶导数分析各向异性等离子体中的全重味与隐重味四夸克态
articles.abstract: Investigating the spectroscopy and thermal stability of exotic multiquark states provides crucial insights into the fundamental confinement mechanisms of quantum chromodynamics (QCD) under extreme regimes. This work presents an innovative study of the spectroscopy and dissociation of fully-heavy tetraquarks in an anisotropic plasma via the generalized fractional derivatives (GFD) structure. The radial Schrödinger equation (SE) with an extended Cornell potential that includes Debye screening and plasma anisotropy is solved by applying the parametric generalized fractional Nikiforov-Uvarov (PGFNU) technique. The analysis of systems consisting of cc¯ c¯ c and bb ¯ b ¯ b shows that the binding potential of the systems and the dissociation energy increase with the anisotropy parameter and decrease with temperature. The fractional paradigm also shows that when the fractional orders are lower, the systems will be more strongly bound than in classical quantum mechanics. Furthermore, the mass spectra for all considered tetraquark configurations, including the cc¯ c¯ c, bb ¯ b ¯ b, c¯ qc¯ q, and b¯ qb¯ q systems, are calculated for both ground and excited states. These calculations were performed across both the fractional and classical regimes. The findings indicate that the GFD framework provides an effective mathematical basis for modelling hadronic systems in complex contexts, and they demonstrate significant agreement with earlier theoretical studies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用广义分数阶导数框架，研究各向异性等离子体中全重味四夸克态的能谱和解离行为。作者在含德拜屏蔽和等离子体各向异性的扩展 Cornell 势下求解径向薛定谔方程，发现各向异性参数和温度会显著影响束缚势与解离能。研究还计算了多种四夸克构型的基态与激发态质量谱，并认为该框架可有效刻画复杂环境中的强子体系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 研究奇异多夸克态的能谱和热稳定性，为理解极端条件下量子色动力学（QCD）的基本禁闭机制提供了关键见解。本工作通过广义分数阶导数（GFD）结构，对各向异性等离子体中全重味四夸克态的能谱和解离进行了创新性研究。通过应用参数化广义分数阶 Nikiforov-Uvarov（PGFNU）技术，求解了带有扩展 Cornell 势的径向薛定谔方程（SE），该势包含德拜屏蔽和等离子体各向异性。对由 cc¯ c¯ c 和 bb ¯ b ¯ b 组成的体系的分析表明，体系的束缚势和解离能随各向异性参数增大而增大，并随温度升高而减小。分数阶范式还表明，当分数阶阶数较低时，与经典量子力学相比，体系将具有更强的束缚。此外，还计算了所有所考虑四夸克构型的质量谱，包括 cc¯ c¯ c、bb ¯ b ¯ b、c¯ qc¯ q 和 b¯ qb¯ q 体系的基态和激发态。这些计算在分数阶和经典两种区域中均进行了。研究结果表明，GFD 框架为在复杂情境下模拟强子体系提供了有效的数学基础，并且它们与早期理论研究表现出显著一致性。

articles.title: AI-Assisted Model Predictive Control with Reliability Analysis of a Split-Capacitor-Type Elementary Additional-Series Positive-Output Super-Lift DC–DC Converter for Electric Vehicle Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向电动汽车应用的分裂电容型初等附加串联正输出超升压 DC–DC 变换器的 AI 辅助模型预测控制与可靠性分析
articles.abstract: Electric-vehicle (EV) powertrains supplied from low-voltage battery packs demand power-conditioning stages capable of establishing a high and tightly regulated DC-link while preserving efficiency, dynamic agility and long-term reliability. Conventional boost and quadratic-boost converters either provide insufficient gain or operate at extreme duty ratios that degrade efficiency and stress semiconductors. This paper presents a split-capacitor-type elementary additional-series positive-output super-lift DC–DC converter that elevates an 8 V source to a regulated 42 V DC-link, together with an artificial-intelligence-assisted model-predictive-control (AI-MPC) scheme and a comprehensive reliability assessment. The converter employs a single inductor, two controlled switches, nine diodes and five split capacitors to realise a geometric voltage-lift mechanism, achieving a conversion ratio of 5.25 at a nominal duty of 0.5 while confining the device voltage stress. A complete continuous- and discontinuous-conduction-mode analysis is derived from the inductor volt-second and capacitor charge-balance principles, and is extended to a state-space averaged model and a small-signal formulation that exposes the right-half-plane zero limiting the achievable bandwidth. The proposed controller augments a finite-horizon predictive core with a feed-forward artificial neural network that maps the battery voltage, load power, inductor current and output voltage to an optimal duty command, reducing the online optimisation burden and improving transient recovery. A reliability framework based on the MIL-HDBK-217F part-stress methodology yields component failure rates, the system mean-time-between-failures and the time-dependent reliability function, while a Monte-Carlo study with 1000 parameter realisations quantifies robustness to component tolerances. Simulation and hardware-oriented results demonstrate that the AI-MPC scheme reduces settling time and overshoot by more than 60% and 78% respectively relative to a proportional-integral baseline, sustains a peak efficiency of 96.5%, and improves the predicted reliability margin, confirming the suitability of the converter for demanding EV applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种用于电动汽车低压电池组升压供电的分裂电容型正输出超升压 DC–DC 变换器，并结合 AI 辅助模型预测控制和可靠性评估。该拓扑可将 8 V 输入升至稳定的 42 V 直流母线，并通过几何电压提升机制限制器件电压应力。仿真和面向硬件的结果显示，相比 PI 控制，AI-MPC 显著降低调节时间和超调量，并实现较高效率和更好的可靠性裕度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由低压电池组供电的电动汽车（EV）动力总成需要能够建立高且严格调节的直流母线、同时保持效率、动态敏捷性和长期可靠性的电能调理级。传统升压和二次升压变换器要么提供的增益不足，要么在极端占空比下工作，从而降低效率并增加半导体应力。本文提出一种分裂电容型初等附加串联正输出超升压 DC–DC 变换器，可将 8 V 电源升高到受调节的 42 V 直流母线，并提出一种人工智能辅助模型预测控制（AI-MPC）方案和全面的可靠性评估。该变换器采用一个电感、两个受控开关、九个二极管和五个分裂电容，以实现几何电压提升机制，在标称占空比 0.5 时达到 5.25 的变换比，同时限制器件电压应力。基于电感伏秒平衡和电容电荷平衡原理，推导了完整的连续导通模式和断续导通模式分析，并将其扩展到状态空间平均模型和小信号表述，从而揭示了限制可实现带宽的右半平面零点。所提出的控制器在有限时域预测核心中加入前馈人工神经网络，该网络将电池电压、负载功率、电感电流和输出电压映射到最优占空比指令，从而降低在线优化负担并改善瞬态恢复。基于 MIL-HDBK-217F 部件应力方法的可靠性框架给出了元件失效率、系统平均无故障时间以及随时间变化的可靠性函数，同时采用 1000 组参数实现的蒙特卡罗研究量化了对元件容差的鲁棒性。仿真和面向硬件的结果表明，与比例积分基线相比，AI-MPC 方案分别将调节时间和超调量降低了 60% 以上和 78% 以上，保持 96.5% 的峰值效率，并改善了预测的可靠性裕度，证实了该变换器适用于要求严苛的电动汽车应用。

articles.title: A Quantum Circuit Framework for Protein Ensemble-Level Energetics
articles.title_zh: 用于蛋白质集合层级能量学的量子电路框架
articles.abstract: Proteins occupy heterogeneous free-energy landscapes, where broad, high-entropy ensembles converge toward compact, low-energy basins containing multiple sub-states. Molecular dynamics can capture these landscapes at atomic resolution, but exhaustively sampling rare transitions remains computationally demanding. Furthermore, most quantum approaches to protein modelling target only a single optimal structure, leaving the energetic heterogeneity of the full ensemble largely unexplored. We introduce a residue-level, gate-based quantum circuit framework for coarse-graining protein thermodynamics. Each amino acid is represented as a two-state qubit with stabilised and excited solvation states, initialised from solvation energetics. Following this, a structure-informed entanglement block of parametrised controlled gates encodes covalent bonds and non-covalent contacts across the residue network. The circuit is then measured approx 106 times, yielding an ensemble of binary thermodynamic microstates, from which we compute energy distributions, residue-level statistical couplings, energetic sensitivities, and information gain relative to total free energy. We showcase the comparative results for Trp-cage miniprotein (PDB:1L2Y) and the disulfide-stabilised chimera (PDB:9GDL), which comprises a structured, folding-funnel-like energy distribution for 1L2Y. Moreover, comparison with 9GDL reveals clear shifts in global energy and residue-level profiles, localising the residues driving stabilisation and ensemble reorganisation. Additionally, dimer- and trimer-level couplings resolve both direct and interaction-mediated dependencies, showing the circuit captures network-level, not just isolated, correlations. The framework moves quantum protein modelling beyond single-structure optimisation toward interpretable, ensemble-level characterisation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种残基层级、基于量子门的量子电路框架，用于粗粒化表征蛋白质热力学集合。每个氨基酸被表示为具有稳定和激发溶剂化状态的二态量子比特，并通过结构信息纠缠模块编码共价键和非共价接触。作者在 Trp-cage 小蛋白和二硫键稳定嵌合体上展示了该方法，可获得能量分布、残基层级耦合、能量敏感性和信息增益，从而将量子蛋白质建模推进到可解释的集合层级表征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 蛋白质处于异质的自由能景观中，其中宽广的高熵集合收敛到包含多个子态的紧凑低能盆地。分子动力学能够以原子分辨率捕捉这些景观，但对罕见跃迁进行穷尽采样仍然计算量巨大。此外，大多数用于蛋白质建模的量子方法只针对单一最优结构，使得整个集合的能量异质性在很大程度上未被探索。我们提出一种残基层级、基于量子门的量子电路框架，用于蛋白质热力学的粗粒化。每个氨基酸被表示为一个二态量子比特，具有稳定化和激发的溶剂化状态，并根据溶剂化能量学进行初始化。随后，一个结构信息纠缠模块由参数化受控门组成，用于在残基网络中编码共价键和非共价接触。然后对该电路测量约 10⁶ 次，得到二元热力学微态集合，并据此计算能量分布、残基层级统计耦合、能量敏感性以及相对于总自由能的信息增益。我们展示了 Trp-cage 小蛋白（PDB:1L2Y）和二硫键稳定嵌合体（PDB:9GDL）的比较结果，其中 1L2Y 表现出结构化的、类似折叠漏斗的能量分布。此外，与 9GDL 的比较揭示了全局能量和残基层级谱的明显变化，定位了驱动稳定化和集合重组的残基。另外，二聚体和三聚体层级耦合解析了直接依赖关系和由相互作用介导的依赖关系，表明该电路捕捉的是网络层级相关性，而不仅是孤立相关性。该框架将量子蛋白质建模从单结构优化推进到可解释的集合层级表征。

articles.title: Bose-Einstein condensation and collective Bogoliubov excitations of microwave photons in superconducting quantum electrodynamics circuits
articles.title_zh: 超导量子电动力学电路中微波光子的玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚与集体 Bogoliubov 激发
articles.abstract: The seminal phenomenon of the Bose-Einstein condensation has been observed on a large variety of physical platforms, e.g., superfluid helium, fermions with attractive interactions, quasiparticles in solids, and ultracold atomic gases. Recently, the Bose–Einstein condensation of non-interacting photons in an optical microcavity has been confirmed experimentally. Here, we report the experimental observation of Bose-Einstein like condensation and collective Bogoliubov excitations in a low dissipative microwave resonator with embedded superconducting quantum network composed of multiple flux qubits. Under strong coherent pumping the resonator mode becomes macroscopically populated, giving rise to hybridized photon–qubit collective modes. The Bogoliubov-like collective excitations appearing in a response to a nearby-frequency probe tone, accompanied by pronounced bistability and hysteresis in the measured transmission coefficient, provide the first experimental evidence of a Bose–Einstein–like condensate of microwave photons on a superconducting circuit platform. A theoretical framework based on Gross-Pitaevskii formalism and taking into account the ac Stark effect inducing the effective interaction between photons, quantitatively reproduces the experimental observations and identifies the regime of appearance of microwave Bogoliubov excitations. These results establish a proof of principle for exploiting driven collective states in superconducting circuits as a platform for quantum-limited microwave detection and engineered many-body photonic systems for quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了在嵌入多个磁通量子比特的低耗散微波谐振器中，观察到类似玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚的现象和集体 Bogoliubov 激发。强相干泵浦使谐振器模式发生宏观占据，并形成杂化的光子—量子比特集体模式。实验中的双稳态、滞回和探测响应中的 Bogoliubov 类激发表明，超导电路可作为微波光子多体集体态平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚这一开创性现象已经在多种物理平台上被观察到，例如超流氦、具有吸引相互作用的费米子、固体中的准粒子以及超冷原子气体。最近，非相互作用光子在光学微腔中的玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚已得到实验证实。在这里，我们报告了在嵌入由多个磁通量子比特组成的超导量子网络的低耗散微波谐振器中，对类似玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚和集体 Bogoliubov 激发的实验观测。在强相干泵浦下，谐振器模式发生宏观占据，从而产生杂化的光子—量子比特集体模式。对邻近频率探测音的响应中出现的 Bogoliubov 类集体激发，伴随着测得传输系数中显著的双稳态和滞回，提供了在超导电路平台上微波光子类玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚的首次实验证据。基于 Gross-Pitaevskii 形式并考虑由交流 Stark 效应诱导的光子间有效相互作用的理论框架，定量再现了实验观测结果，并确定了微波 Bogoliubov 激发出现的区域。这些结果为利用超导电路中的受驱集体态作为量子极限微波探测平台以及用于量子信息处理的工程化多体光子系统奠定了原理验证基础。

articles.title: Electrical Transport and Magnetoresistance Properties of the La0.8Sr0.2Mn1-xCoxO3
articles.title_zh: La0.8Sr0.2Mn1-xCoxO3 的电输运与磁电阻性质
articles.abstract: In this experiment, La0.8Sr0.2Mn1−xCoxO3 (x = 0, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 0.03) (LSMCO) polycrystalline ceramics were mainly prepared by the sol-gel method. The effects of Co doping on the crystal structure, surface morphology, electrical transport properties, and magnetoresistance of the LSMCO polycrystalline ceramics were systematically investigated. X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns, compared with standard PDF cards, show that the angular positions of all characteristic diffraction peaks are in good agreement, indicating that the as-prepared series of samples crystallize in a typical perovskite structure with a rhombohedral crystal symmetry, and all samples belong to the R-3c space group. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) observations indicate that the polycrystalline ceramic samples exhibit almost no porosity, well‑defined grain boundaries, similar polygonal grain structures, and compact grain packing. EDS results demonstrate that in the overall elemental mapping, La, Sr, Mn, O, and Co are uniformly distributed throughout the ceramic samples, with no noticeable elemental segregation, enrichment regions, or phase separation. This indicates that the principal elements have achieved homogeneous doping and form a solid solution both within the grains and at the grain boundaries. Temperature Coefficient of Resistance (TCR) measurements indicate that, with increasing doping content, the TCR remains nearly unchanged, while Tk gradually decreases. Magnetoresistance (MR) measurements show that a maximum MR value of 28.61% is achieved at 304.53 K for the doping level of x = 0.005. This study broadens the application prospects of polycrystalline ceramics in magnetic sensors, magnetic storage, thermistors, and other related fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验采用溶胶—凝胶法制备了 La0.8Sr0.2Mn1−xCoxO3 多晶陶瓷，并系统研究 Co 掺杂对其结构、形貌、电输运和磁电阻性质的影响。XRD、SEM 和 EDS 结果显示样品具有菱方钙钛矿结构、致密显微形貌和均匀元素分布。电阻温度系数和磁电阻测量表明，低含量 Co 掺杂可在接近室温下获得较高磁电阻值，拓展了其在磁传感、磁存储和热敏电阻等领域的应用前景。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本实验中，La0.8Sr0.2Mn1−xCoxO3（x = 0、0.005、0.01、0.02、0.03）（LSMCO）多晶陶瓷主要通过溶胶—凝胶法制备。系统研究了 Co 掺杂对 LSMCO 多晶陶瓷的晶体结构、表面形貌、电输运性质和磁电阻的影响。与标准 PDF 卡片比较的 X 射线衍射（XRD）图谱显示，所有特征衍射峰的角位置均高度一致，表明所制备的一系列样品结晶为典型钙钛矿结构，具有菱方晶体对称性，并且所有样品均属于 R-3c 空间群。扫描电子显微镜（SEM）观察表明，多晶陶瓷样品几乎没有孔隙，晶界清晰，具有相似的多边形晶粒结构和致密的晶粒堆积。EDS 结果表明，在整体元素面分布中，La、Sr、Mn、O 和 Co 在陶瓷样品中均匀分布，没有明显的元素偏析、富集区域或相分离。这表明主要元素已经实现均匀掺杂，并在晶粒内部和晶界处均形成固溶体。电阻温度系数（TCR）测量表明，随着掺杂含量增加，TCR 几乎保持不变，而 Tk 逐渐降低。磁电阻（MR）测量显示，当掺杂水平 x = 0.005 时，在 304.53 K 下获得 28.61% 的最大 MR 值。本研究拓宽了多晶陶瓷在磁传感器、磁存储、热敏电阻及其他相关领域中的应用前景。

articles.title: A Dual-Gate TIPS-Pentacene OTFT with Asymmetric HfO2/SiO2 Stacks for Low-Voltage, Threshold-Tunable Operation
articles.title_zh: 采用非对称 HfO2/SiO2 叠层的双栅 TIPS-并五苯 OTFT：面向低电压与阈值可调工作
articles.abstract: In this paper, a physics-based design and simulation analysis is presented for an asymmetric dual-gate organic thin-film transistor (DG-OTFT) based on the TIPS-pentacene organic semiconductor and Ge/HfO2 high-k gate dielectric. The transistor incorporates a poly-Si/SiO2 control gate to improve the electrostatic control, reduce the operating voltage, and enhance the threshold voltage tunability. In this work, the oxide capacitance density (M) framework is correctly reported in F/cm2. The effects of dielectric thickness (t DIE), work-function difference (W F), interface charge (Q IF) and gate stacks are analyzed by using compact-model-based simulation to extract transfer and output characteristics, electric field distribution, channel charge density, leakage current, and charge sensitivity. The proposed asymmetric dual-gate architecture is compared with various OTFTs, including pentacene-based, HfO2-based, flexible OTFTs, and dual-gate OTFTs, and it demonstrates its potential as a low-voltage and threshold voltage tunable OTFT platform for various flexible electronic and sensor interface applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文对基于 TIPS-并五苯有机半导体和 Ge/HfO2 高 k 栅介质的非对称双栅有机薄膜晶体管进行物理设计与仿真分析。器件引入 poly-Si/SiO2 控制栅，以增强静电控制、降低工作电压并提高阈值电压可调性。通过紧凑模型仿真，作者分析了介质厚度、功函数差、界面电荷和栅叠层等因素，并表明该结构适合低电压柔性电子和传感接口应用。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文对一种基于 TIPS-并五苯有机半导体和 Ge/HfO2 高 k 栅介质的非对称双栅有机薄膜晶体管（DG-OTFT）进行了基于物理的设计和仿真分析。该晶体管引入 poly-Si/SiO2 控制栅，以改善静电控制、降低工作电压并增强阈值电压可调性。在本工作中，氧化物电容密度（M）框架被正确地以 F/cm2 为单位报告。利用基于紧凑模型的仿真，分析了介质厚度（t DIE）、功函数差（W F）、界面电荷（Q IF）和栅叠层的影响，以提取转移特性和输出特性、电场分布、沟道电荷密度、漏电流以及电荷敏感性。将所提出的非对称双栅结构与多种 OTFT 进行比较，包括基于并五苯的 OTFT、基于 HfO2 的 OTFT、柔性 OTFT 和双栅 OTFT，结果表明其作为低电压且阈值电压可调的 OTFT 平台，在多种柔性电子和传感器接口应用中具有潜力。
articles.focus_summary: 该论文提出并模拟了一种采用非对称 HfO₂/SiO₂ 栅介质堆叠的双栅 TIPS-并五苯有机薄膜晶体管。工作通过紧凑模型分析介质厚度、功函数差、界面电荷和栅堆叠对阈值调控、漏电和电荷灵敏度的影响。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们工作的直接关联较弱，主要交集在 HfO₂ 介质、界面电荷和半导体器件模拟方面。其并非 HfO₂ 铁电、缺陷物理或第一性原理材料设计研究。
articles.focus_suggestion: 若关注 HfO₂ 相关界面电荷或低压器件，可作为工程背景阅读。进一步跟进时可重点考察 HfO₂/有机半导体界面缺陷、电荷俘获和介电层稳定性是否适合用第一性原理方法研究。

articles.title: When Stronger Cycles Build Weaker Polar Fields: An Adjoint Response Theory for Surface Flux Transport
articles.title_zh: 当更强的太阳活动周产生更弱的极区磁场：表面磁通输运的伴随响应理论
articles.abstract: We develop a reduced response theory for the nonlinear modulation of the signed axial dipole generated by a Babcock--Leighton source in a one-dimensional surface flux transport model. The formulation separates cycle amplitude from the efficiency with which emerged flux is converted into the final dipole. Across normalised amplitudes from 0.2 to 2.5, the reduced predictions reproduce the SFT responses to within (3%).  An adjoint dipole-yield kernel provides an exact representation of the linear response and reproduces the forward finite-volume calculation to numerical precision. It also improves the latitude-quenching approximation: replacing Gaussian-envelope moments with kernel-weighted moments reduces the maximum absolute normalised error from (2.81×10⁻²) to (2.40×10⁻⁶). Physical tests define the domain of validity of positive multiplicative efficiency factors. A poleward displacement of the activity belt changes the source geometry rather than its amplitude; a Gaussian approximation using the kernel-derived effectivity range reproduces it to (1.1×10⁻²) in (Q), whereas one using a prescribed range is substantially less accurate. Explicit converging inflows modify the transport operator itself and are represented adequately only in the weak-to-moderate regime. Both testsrequire the two polarities of each bipolar pair to carry equal and opposite flux: rings of equal peak amplitude are not polarity-flux balanced on a spherical surface, and the resulting imbalance changes the response qualitatively. In multi-cycle simulations, the surviving magnetic field introduces strong intercycle memory when no explicit decay is included. A memory-corrected map reproduces the simulated fixed points and period-doubling behaviour, unlike the memoryless description. Adjoint parameter scans further yield compact scaling relations for the dynamo effectivity range and the dependence of cycle memory on the decay time.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为一维表面磁通输运模型中由 Babcock–Leighton 源产生的有符号轴向偶极矩的非线性调制建立了简化响应理论。该理论通过伴随偶极产额核精确刻画线性响应，并显著改进纬度猝灭近似；同时指出活动带位移、汇聚内流和多周期记忆对极场形成的影响。研究还强调双极磁对必须保持两极性等量反号磁通，并给出了发电机效应范围和周期记忆的紧凑标度关系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们为一维表面磁通输运模型中由 Babcock--Leighton 源产生的有符号轴向偶极矩的非线性调制发展了一种简化响应理论。该表述将活动周振幅与新生磁通被转换为最终偶极矩的效率分离开来。在归一化振幅从 0.2 到 2.5 的范围内，简化预测能够在 3% 以内再现表面磁通输运响应。一个伴随偶极产额核给出了线性响应的精确表示，并以数值精度再现了正向有限体积计算。它还改进了纬度猝灭近似：用核加权矩替代高斯包络矩，可将最大绝对归一化误差从 2.81×10⁻² 降低到 2.40×10⁻⁶。物理检验界定了正的乘性效率因子的适用范围。活动带向极移动改变的是源的几何结构而非其振幅；使用由核导出的有效性范围的高斯近似在 Q 上以 1.1×10⁻² 的精度再现了这一效应，而使用预设范围的近似精度则显著较低。显式汇聚内流会改变输运算子本身，并且只有在弱到中等强度范围内才能得到充分表示。两项检验都要求每个双极磁对的两种极性携带等量反号磁通：在球面上，等峰值振幅的环并不满足极性磁通平衡，由此产生的不平衡会定性地改变响应。在多周期模拟中，若不包含显式衰减，残余磁场会引入强烈的周期间记忆。与无记忆描述不同，经过记忆修正的映射能够再现模拟得到的不动点和倍周期行为。伴随参数扫描进一步给出了发电机有效性范围以及周期记忆对衰减时间依赖性的紧凑标度关系。

articles.title: Complete particle physics from an exactly solvable 21-state vacuum: 27 Standard Model predictions with zero free parameters and quantum hardware validation
articles.title_zh: 来自精确可解 21 态真空的完整粒子物理：零自由参数的 27 个标准模型预言及量子硬件验证
articles.abstract: Recent work on emergent gauge symmetries in discrete lattice systems [1–6] demonstrates that continuous gauge groups can arise from finite combinatorial structures. Several recent frameworks—including G2-holonomy compactifications, primorial lattices, and hypergraph rewriting—have attempted to derive Standard Model parameters from discrete postulates; however, all rely on continuous manifolds or infinite lattices with intractable path integrals. We present an exactly solvable alternative. Starting from a Hamiltonian on the 6-dimensional hypercube 0,16, we apply an exact Feshbach–Schur projection to integrate out 43 high-energy states, obtaining a unique 21 × 21 effective infrared operator A. The physical transition graph of the resulting 21-state vacuum manifold is isomorphic to the dodecahedron (Aut = A5 × ℤ2). The CP involution partitions the vacuum into 13 gauge channels with block dimensions 8 ⊕ 3 ⊕ 2, matching the adjoint dimensions of SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1). The spectral invariants of A then determine, with zero adjustable parameters: α−1 = 137.033 (22 ppm from PDG), sin2θW = 0.2312 (exact), vH = 246.17 GeV (0.02%), the complete meson spectrum (mη′ at 0.02%), quark and lepton masses, CKM mixing elements, the baryon asymmetry, and Newton’s gravitational constant—27 observables across 13 orders of magnitude with a median error of 0.33%. The discrete path integral is a convergent finite sum verified to machine precision (10− 14). Crucially, the same Hamiltonian has been independently implemented on IBM quantum hardware (ibm_fez, 48–156 qubits, 230 + jobs) and validated across four unrelated application domains. Two falsifiable BSM predictions are reported: a topologically stable 180.5 GeV dark matter candidate and a 5.17 TeV boundary state.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种从六维超立方体哈密顿量经精确 Feshbach–Schur 投影得到 21×21 有效红外算符的离散、精确可解框架，并声称其真空流形与十二面体图同构。作者认为该结构可在无可调参数下预测标准模型及相关物理的 27 个观测量，并报告与 IBM 量子硬件实现相关的验证结果。论文还提出两个可证伪的超越标准模型预言，包括暗物质候选体和边界态。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近期关于离散晶格系统中涌现规范对称性的工作 [1–6] 表明，连续规范群可以从有限组合结构中产生。若干近期框架——包括 G2-完整性紧化、素数阶乘晶格和超图重写——曾试图从离散公设推导标准模型参数；然而，它们都依赖连续流形或具有难以处理路径积分的无限晶格。我们提出一种精确可解的替代方案。从 6 维超立方体 0,16 上的哈密顿量出发，我们应用精确的 Feshbach–Schur 投影以积分掉 43 个高能态，得到一个唯一的 21 × 21 有效红外算符 A。所得 21 态真空流形的物理跃迁图同构于十二面体（Aut = A5 × ℤ2）。CP 对合将真空划分为 13 个规范通道，其块维数为 8 ⊕ 3 ⊕ 2，与 SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1) 的伴随表示维数相匹配。随后，A 的谱不变量在没有任何可调参数的情况下确定了以下量：α−1 = 137.033（与 PDG 相差 22 ppm）、sin2θW = 0.2312（精确）、vH = 246.17 GeV（0.02%）、完整介子谱（mη′ 达 0.02%）、夸克和轻子质量、CKM 混合元、重子不对称以及牛顿引力常数——跨越 13 个数量级的 27 个可观测量，其中位误差为 0.33%。离散路径积分是一个收敛的有限和，并已在机器精度（10−14）下得到验证。关键的是，同一哈密顿量已在 IBM 量子硬件（ibm_fez，48–156 个量子比特，230 多项作业）上独立实现，并在四个互不相关的应用领域中得到验证。本文报告了两个可证伪的超越标准模型预言：一个拓扑稳定的 180.5 GeV 暗物质候选体和一个 5.17 TeV 边界态。

articles.title: Reciprocating-Disc-type Magnetorheological Finishing with Long-term Removal-function Stability
articles.title_zh: 具有长期去除函数稳定性的往复式盘式磁流变抛光
articles.abstract: The well known Disc-type magnetorheological finishing (DMRF) has damage-free advantage due to “surface contact” during polishing process. It has got more attention from integrated circuit (IC) industry to obtain wafer-level ultra-smooth planarization and other fields requiring ultra-precise surface processing. However, conventional DMRF configurations exhibiting unstable material removal rate (MRR) which constrain their application, one reason is the variation of the linear speed of the disc polishing surface, the another is evaporation of water in magnetorheological polishing fluid (MRPF) during polishing. To obtain stable material removal rate (MRR), a kind of reciprocating-disc-type magnetorheological finishing (RDMRF) equipment is designed and practiced in our experiment, and the effect factors contributing to drift in removal-function accuracy are identified and discussed, including influence of time. MRPF with sodium-hexametaphosphate (SHAMP) and vapor-deposited silica was used in polishing, and the results showed that the shear stress rises by 47% and sedimentation rate falls by 57% compared with pure magnetorheological fluid. Using this MRPF can achieve a surface roughness of Sa 1.562 nm on workpieces. A Preston-type model integrating workpiece elastic modulus and magnetic-field gradient is established. In order to avoid instability caused by temperature and evaporation, a magnetically actuated recovery loop was constructed to provide on-the-fly replenishment and continuous agitation of the MR fluid. With this loop engaged, the material-removal-rate drift was suppressed to < 8% over 180 min and the areal roughness Sa converged to 1.519 nm. Deviation is caused by minute fluctuations in the composition of the slurry during the polishing process. This reveals the root cause limiting the stability of removal and further improvement in surface quality.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对传统盘式磁流变抛光材料去除率不稳定的问题，设计并实验验证了一种往复式盘式磁流变抛光设备。研究讨论了抛光液成分、时间、温度和水分蒸发等因素对去除函数精度漂移的影响，并建立了结合工件弹性模量和磁场梯度的 Preston 型模型。通过磁驱动回收循环实现在线补液和持续搅拌后，180 分钟内材料去除率漂移被抑制到 8% 以下，表面粗糙度达到纳米级。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 众所周知的盘式磁流变抛光（DMRF）由于抛光过程中采用“面接触”而具有无损伤优势。它已受到集成电路（IC）行业以及其他需要超精密表面加工领域的更多关注，用于实现晶圆级超光滑平坦化。然而，传统 DMRF 构型表现出不稳定的材料去除率（MRR），这限制了其应用；其中一个原因是盘式抛光表面线速度的变化，另一个原因是抛光过程中磁流变抛光液（MRPF）中的水分蒸发。为获得稳定的材料去除率（MRR），我们在实验中设计并实践了一种往复式盘式磁流变抛光（RDMRF）设备，并识别和讨论了导致去除函数精度漂移的影响因素，包括时间的影响。抛光中使用了含六偏磷酸钠（SHAMP）和气相沉积二氧化硅的 MRPF，结果表明，与纯磁流变流体相比，其剪切应力提高了 47%，沉降率降低了 57%。使用这种 MRPF 可在工件上实现 Sa 1.562 nm 的表面粗糙度。建立了一个结合工件弹性模量和磁场梯度的 Preston 型模型。为避免温度和蒸发导致的不稳定性，构建了一个磁驱动回收循环，以提供在线补充和磁流变流体的连续搅拌。启用该循环后，材料去除率漂移在 180 min 内被抑制到 < 8%，面粗糙度 Sa 收敛至 1.519 nm。偏差由抛光过程中浆料成分的微小波动引起。这揭示了限制去除稳定性和表面质量进一步提升的根本原因。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Dual-Target Optimization of Hardness and Tensile Strength in Multi-Element Aluminum Alloys
articles.title_zh: 用于多元铝合金硬度与抗拉强度双目标优化的物理信息机器学习
articles.abstract: The simultaneous optimization of Brinell hardness (HB) and ultimate tensile strength (UTS) in multi-element aluminum alloys presents a persistent challenge due to the complex, nonlinear interplay between alloy composition, heat treatment condition, and resulting microstructural state. Existing machine learning (ML) frameworks have primarily targeted single mechanical properties, limiting practical applicability where multiple performance criteria must be jointly satisfied. This study presents a physics-informed machine learning design system (PI-MLDS) for dual-target prediction and optimization of HB and UTS across 1xxx–7xxx series aluminum alloys. A curated dataset of 163 alloy compositions was assembled from the MatWeb database following rule-based data cleaning. Four ML algorithms, k-nearest neighbors (KNN), support vector regression (SVR), gradient boosting regression (GBR), and artificial neural network (ANN), were deployed and benchmarked. An empirical Tabor-type physical constraint relating UTS to HB was embedded as an auxiliary regularization term to enforce dual-output physical consistency. SVR achieved the highest UTS accuracy (R² = 89.3%, RMSE = 48.4 MPa, MAPE = 15.6%), while GBR performed best for HB (R² = 87.8%, RMSE = 13.6 HB, MAPE = 18.0%). Leave-one-out MLDS validation across six reference alloys yielded mean MAPE of 12.7% (HB) and 6.5% (UTS), with UTS prediction more reliably satisfying the stringent accuracy threshold. Multi-objective Pareto optimization identified an optimal 7075-based composition (Cu = 2.20, Mg = 2.90, Zn = 7.10 wt%, Fe eliminated) with predicted HB = 179.6 and UTS = 599.3 MPa, representing improvements of 19.7% and 9.3%, respectively, over the AA 7075-T6 baseline. Pearson correlation analysis identifies Zn, Cu, and Mg as the primary positive correlates of both targets, while Cu dominates global feature importance (GBR score > 0.43). These results establish PI-MLDS as a practical pre-screening tool for accelerated aluminum alloy composition design.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种物理信息机器学习设计系统，用于在 1xxx–7xxx 系铝合金中同时预测并优化布氏硬度和极限抗拉强度。研究比较了 KNN、SVR、GBR 和 ANN，并引入 Tabor 型经验物理约束以提高双输出的一致性。多目标 Pareto 优化给出一种改进的 7075 基成分，预测硬度和强度均优于 AA 7075-T6 基准，表明该方法可作为铝合金成分加速设计的预筛选工具。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在多元铝合金中同时优化布氏硬度（HB）和极限抗拉强度（UTS）是一个长期挑战，因为合金成分、热处理状态和由此产生的微观组织状态之间存在复杂的非线性相互作用。现有机器学习（ML）框架主要针对单一力学性能，从而限制了其在需要共同满足多个性能指标的实际场景中的适用性。本研究提出一种物理信息机器学习设计系统（PI-MLDS），用于在 1xxx–7xxx 系铝合金范围内对 HB 和 UTS 进行双目标预测与优化。按照基于规则的数据清洗流程，从 MatWeb 数据库整理出一个包含 163 种合金成分的数据集。部署并基准比较了四种 ML 算法，即 k 最近邻（KNN）、支持向量回归（SVR）、梯度提升回归（GBR）和人工神经网络（ANN）。嵌入了一个将 UTS 与 HB 相关联的经验 Tabor 型物理约束，作为辅助正则化项，以强制双输出的物理一致性。SVR 在 UTS 精度方面最高（R² = 89.3%，RMSE = 48.4 MPa，MAPE = 15.6%），而 GBR 在 HB 方面表现最佳（R² = 87.8%，RMSE = 13.6 HB，MAPE = 18.0%）。在六种参考合金上的留一法 MLDS 验证得到的平均 MAPE 为 12.7%（HB）和 6.5%（UTS），其中 UTS 预测更可靠地满足严格精度阈值。多目标 Pareto 优化确定了一种最优的 7075 基成分（Cu = 2.20、Mg = 2.90、Zn = 7.10 wt%，去除 Fe），其预测 HB = 179.6、UTS = 599.3 MPa，相较 AA 7075-T6 基准分别提高 19.7% 和 9.3%。Pearson 相关分析表明，Zn、Cu 和 Mg 是两个目标的主要正相关元素，而 Cu 在全局特征重要性中占主导地位（GBR 分数 > 0.43）。这些结果确立了 PI-MLDS 作为加速铝合金成分设计实用预筛选工具的价值。
articles.focus_summary: 该预印本提出一种物理信息机器学习系统，用于同时优化多元素铝合金的布氏硬度和抗拉强度。研究整合 MatWeb 数据库中的合金成分与热处理信息，并通过物理约束提升双目标预测的一致性。
articles.focus_relation: 该工作与我们在机器学习材料设计方面有方法层面的弱相关，但材料体系和目标性质与我们的凝聚态功能材料、电子结构和量子功能性质研究关联较弱。可借鉴其物理约束嵌入多目标优化的思路。
articles.focus_suggestion: 若关注方法，可快速浏览其物理约束损失函数和多目标优化流程。更值得进一步转化到我们关注的缺陷形成能、载流子寿命、铁电极化或磁相变温度等目标性质上。

articles.title: Two-qubit entangling gate flags its own errors as detectable photon losses
articles.title_zh: 双量子比特纠缠门将自身错误标记为可探测的光子损失
articles.abstract: Quantum errors are a normal part of quantum computing because fragile physical qubits (the tiny components storing data) can easily break down because of environmental noise, like heat, stray signals or microscopic vibrations. Typical fixes involve vast amounts of extra hardware qubits, which make computers larger, more expensive and harder to build.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻围绕一种能够将自身错误表现为可探测光子损失的双量子比特纠缠门展开。报道指出，量子计算中的误差通常源于脆弱物理量子比特受热、杂散信号或微观振动等环境噪声影响，而传统纠错往往需要大量额外硬件量子比特。详情需查阅原文以了解该门的具体实现与性能。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子误差是量子计算中的正常组成部分，因为脆弱的物理量子比特（用于存储数据的微小组件）很容易由于环境噪声而失效，例如热、杂散信号或微观振动。典型的修复方法涉及大量额外的硬件量子比特，这会使计算机更大、更昂贵且更难构建。
