articles.title: Electrically Tunable Valley-Based Qubits in Moiré Quantum Dots
articles.title_zh: 莫尔量子点中电可调的谷基量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05229v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The search for scalable, electrically controlled qubits remains a central challenge in quantum technology. We introduce gate-defined moiré quantum dots as a promising platform for valley-based qubits. Moiré engineering resolves the central conflict of valley physics: momentum-space separation protects the states, while the enlarged moiré length scale allows smooth gates to mix them controllably. Dot geometry and confinement strength program valley hybridization, while a displacement field controls detuning, providing two noncommuting electrostatic axes for qubit control.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出栅极定义的莫尔量子点作为谷基量子比特的潜在平台。莫尔工程一方面利用动量空间分离保护谷态，另一方面借助扩大的莫尔长度尺度使平滑栅极能够可控地混合谷态。量子点几何、限域强度和位移场分别用于调控谷杂化与失谐，从而提供两条不对易的静电量子比特控制轴。
authors: Yasser Saleem, Pawel Potasz, Ewelina M. Hankiewicz
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.05229v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：寻找可扩展、可电控的量子比特仍然是量子技术中的核心挑战。我们提出栅极定义的莫尔量子点作为谷基量子比特的一个有前景平台。莫尔工程解决了谷物理中的核心矛盾：动量空间分离保护这些态，而增大的莫尔长度尺度允许平滑栅极可控地混合它们。量子点几何结构和限域强度可设定谷杂化，而位移场控制失谐，从而为量子比特控制提供两个不对易的静电轴。

articles.title: Observing the emergence of a velocity hierarchy in matter waves
articles.title_zh: 观测物质波中速度层级的涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05241v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Classical waves in dispersive media naturally exhibit distinct phase and group velocities. Whether an analogous separation of velocities can emerge in matter waves under strong many-body interactions has remained experimentally unexplored. Here, we demonstrate the emergence of a velocity hierarchy in a strongly interacting lattice gas. Using quench spectroscopy together with time-resolved correlation measurements, we independently determine the sound, group, and phase velocities across the superfluid-to-Mott-insulator transition. These velocities are nearly degenerate close to the transition, but progressively separate as the Mott gap opens and the quasiparticle dispersion acquires a massive relativistic-like form. Strikingly, phase-coherence fronts propagate faster than the Lieb-Robinson velocity scale while remaining fully consistent with locality. The measured velocities satisfy a relativistic-like invariance relation in the insulating regime. Our results establish propagation-velocity hierarchies as emergent signatures of strongly correlated quantum dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在强相互作用晶格气体中实验展示了速度层级的涌现。研究利用淬火谱学和时间分辨关联测量，独立确定了超流到莫特绝缘体转变过程中的声速、群速度和相速度。结果显示这些速度在转变附近近似简并，但随着莫特能隙打开而逐渐分离，并在绝缘区满足类相对论不变关系。
authors: Xudong Yu, Wenhan Chen, Igor Zhuravlev, Yi Zeng, Sudipta Dhar, Milena Horvath, Thierry Giamarchi, Laurent Sanchez-Palencia, Manuele Landini, Hanns-Christoph Nägerl, Yanliang Guo
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.05241v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：色散介质中的经典波自然表现出不同的相速度和群速度。在强多体相互作用下，物质波中是否能够涌现出类似的速度分离，此前在实验上仍未得到探索。在这里，我们展示了强相互作用晶格气体中速度层级的涌现。通过将淬火谱学与时间分辨关联测量相结合，我们在超流到莫特绝缘体转变过程中独立确定了声速、群速度和相速度。这些速度在接近转变时几乎简并，但随着莫特能隙打开以及准粒子色散获得有质量的类相对论形式而逐渐分离。引人注目的是，相位相干前沿以快于 Lieb-Robinson 速度尺度的速度传播，同时仍完全符合局域性。测得的速度在绝缘区满足一种类相对论不变关系。我们的结果确立了传播速度层级作为强关联量子动力学涌现特征的地位。

articles.title: Superconducting and charge-ordered phases from Dirac quantum spin liquids on the triangular lattice
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格上由狄拉克量子自旋液体产生的超导相与电荷有序相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05277v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Triangular-lattice quantum spin-liquid insulators are observed to undergo transitions to superconductivity under pressure or doping, and exhibit enhanced terahertz conductivity when driven by mid-infrared light. We present a general theoretical framework for the emergence of superconducting and charge-ordered phases from a U(1) Dirac spin liquid with fermionic spinons, as well as from its gapped Z₂ and chiral descendants. Numerical studies have provided substantial evidence for these spin-liquid states. The spin-liquid phase hosts fractionalized Dirac spinons coupled to an emergent gauge field, whereas the superconducting and charge-ordered phases are conventional, with neither fractionalized excitations nor emergent gauge dynamics. The transition between these phases is driven by the Higgs condensation of spinless charge-e bosonic chargons (``doublons'' and ``holons''). We show that the projective symmetry group of the Dirac spinons uniquely determines the symmetry and dispersion of the chargons, allowing us to construct an effective low-energy theory near the chargon band minima. Gauge-invariant composites of the chargon Higgs fields provide the order parameters characterizing the phases. The resulting phase diagram contains a rich variety of ordered states, including d+id superconductivity, charge-density waves, bond-density waves, and pair-density waves.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一个理论框架，用以描述三角晶格 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体及其有能隙 Z₂ 和手征后代中超导相与电荷有序相的涌现。作者认为相变由无自旋、电荷 e 的玻色 chargon 发生 Higgs 凝聚驱动，而规范不变的 chargon Higgs 复合场构成有序相的序参量。所得相图包含 d+id 超导、电荷密度波、键密度波和对密度波等多种有序态。
authors: Andreas Feuerpfeil, Ronny Thomale, Subir Sachdev, Pietro M. Bonetti
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.05277v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：人们观察到，三角晶格量子自旋液体绝缘体在压力或掺杂下会发生向超导性的转变，并且在中红外光驱动下表现出增强的太赫兹电导。我们提出一个通用理论框架，用于描述具有费米子自旋子的 U(1) 狄拉克自旋液体以及其有能隙 Z₂ 和手征后代中超导相和电荷有序相的涌现。数值研究已为这些自旋液体态提供了大量证据。自旋液体相包含与涌现规范场耦合的分数量子化狄拉克自旋子，而超导相和电荷有序相是常规相，既没有分数量子化激发，也没有涌现规范动力学。这些相之间的转变由无自旋、电荷 e 的玻色 chargon（“双占子”和“空穴子”）的 Higgs 凝聚驱动。我们表明，狄拉克自旋子的投影对称群唯一地决定了 chargon 的对称性和色散，使我们能够在 chargon 能带极小值附近构建有效低能理论。chargon Higgs 场的规范不变复合体提供了表征这些相的序参量。所得相图包含丰富多样的有序态，包括 d+id 超导、电荷密度波、键密度波和对密度波。

articles.title: Theory of Measurement-Altered Criticality
articles.title_zh: 测量改变临界性的理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05289v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Local measurements can alter long-range correlations in gapless quantum matter. We propose a theory of weakly-monitored Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids, a broad class of quantum critical states in one dimension. In order to address the intrinsic randomness of the measurement record, we develop a replica instanton calculation to study Born-averaged observables. We find that when measurements are relevant, average correlators of density and phase fluctuations decay at long distances as universal power laws with logarithmic corrections, a feature we argue is peculiar to measurement-induced randomness. We characterize the full multifractal spectrum of moments of correlations functions, revealing broad, strongly non-gaussian fluctuations across the ensemble of post-measurement states. We support these analytic results with matrix-product-state calculations, and provide a general picture of measurement-altered criticality for ground states described by 1+1d conformal field theories. Our results establish that physical measurements alter critical quantum states in a manner that lies beyond both forced measurements and conventional critical scaling.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究局域测量如何改变无能隙量子物质中的长程关联，并提出弱监测 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体理论。作者发展了副本瞬子计算以处理测量记录的内禀随机性，发现当测量为相关扰动时，密度和相位涨落的平均关联函数呈现带对数修正的普适幂律衰减。研究还刻画了关联函数矩的完整多重分形谱，并用矩阵乘积态计算支持解析结果。
authors: Kabir Khanna, Sara Murciano, Romain Vasseur
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.05289v1 发布类型：新稿 摘要：局域测量可以改变无能隙量子物质中的长程关联。我们提出弱监测 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体理论，这是一大类一维量子临界态。为处理测量记录的内禀随机性，我们发展了一种副本瞬子计算，以研究 Born 平均观测量。我们发现，当测量是相关的时，密度和相位涨落的平均关联函数在长距离上以带有对数修正的普适幂律衰减，我们认为这是测量诱导随机性所特有的特征。我们刻画了关联函数矩的完整多重分形谱，揭示了后测量态系综中宽广且强烈非高斯的涨落。我们用矩阵乘积态计算支持这些解析结果，并为由 1+1 维共形场论描述的基态提供了测量改变临界性的一般图景。我们的结果表明，物理测量会以一种超越强制测量和传统临界标度的方式改变临界量子态。

articles.title: Exact statistical transmutation of quantum mixtures on a ring
articles.title_zh: 环上量子混合物的精确统计嬗变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05290v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: One-dimensional strongly repulsive quantum mixtures exhibit non-trivial exchange statistics arising from the interplay between orbital and spin degrees of freedom. Using an exact solution, we demonstrate that in the single-impurity limit the wavefunction of Fermi-Fermi and Bose-Bose mixtures on a ring threaded by an artificial gauge field display exact anyonic statistics under exchange of the impurity with the majority particles. The resulting fractional exchange phase is fixed by the angular momentum sector selected through the applied flux. We find that the impurity momentum distribution coincide exactly with the anyonic one, independently of the bosonic or fermionic nature of the mixture, with the large-momentum tails encoding a direct signature of the anyonic statistical angle. Finally, we devise a quench protocol for reversible dynamical anyonization. Our results provide a path for realizing and manipulating anyonized states with ultracold atoms.
articles.abstract_zh: 一维强排斥量子混合物因轨道与自旋自由度耦合而呈现非平凡交换统计。作者用精确解表明，在单杂质极限下，穿有人工规范场的环上 Fermi-Fermi 与 Bose-Bose 混合物在杂质与多数粒子交换时表现出精确任意子统计。杂质动量分布与任意子情形完全一致，并可通过大动量尾部直接编码统计角；文中还提出可逆动力学任意子化的淬火方案。
authors: Wayne J. Chetcuti, Nathan Goldman, Patrizia Vignolo, Anna Minguzzi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一维强排斥量子混合物表现出由轨道与自旋自由度之间相互作用所产生的非平凡交换统计。利用一个精确解，我们证明，在单杂质极限下，穿有人工规范场的环上的 Fermi-Fermi 和 Bose-Bose 混合物的波函数，在杂质与多数粒子交换时显示出精确的任意子统计。由此产生的分数交换相位由通过外加通量所选择的角动量扇区固定。我们发现，杂质动量分布与任意子的动量分布完全一致，并且不依赖于混合物的玻色或费米性质，其大动量尾部编码了任意子统计角的直接特征。最后，我们设计了一种用于可逆动力学任意子化的淬火协议。我们的结果为利用超冷原子实现和操控任意子化态提供了一条路径。

articles.title: Topological Charge-Transfer Excitons
articles.title_zh: 拓扑电荷转移激子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05308v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excitons possess internal structure absent from single-particle Bloch particles, allowing their band topology to emerge from the bound-state structure rather than being inherited from their constituents. This raises the question of how the internal structure of a bound state can provide a microscopic origin of exciton topology. Here we show that the real-space embedding of charge-transfer excitons can generate an intrinsic manifold of symmetry-related off-site composite orbitals whose coupling supports topological exciton bands. Lateral electron-hole separation embeds the localized exciton on the bond connecting its constituent sites rather than on either site. We demonstrate this mechanism in a honeycomb lattice, where three bond-centered charge-transfer exciton orbitals form a Kagome lattice. By solving the Bethe-Salpeter equation, we show that this emergent multi-orbital manifold supports a topological exciton flat band upon time-reversal symmetry breaking, even when the electron and hole bands are topologically trivial. The resulting band exhibits nearly uniformly distributed quantum geometry, favorable for interaction-driven bosonic states. Our results establish a general route toward topological bands of localized composite bound states and unconventional strongly correlated bosonic phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，激子的带拓扑可源于束缚态内部结构，而不必继承自电子和空穴的单粒子拓扑。作者提出，电荷转移激子的实空间嵌入会产生对称相关的离位复合轨道流形，其耦合可支持拓扑激子能带。以蜂窝晶格为例，三种键中心激子轨道形成 Kagome 晶格，并在破坏时间反演对称性时产生拓扑激子平带。
authors: Huiyuan Zheng, Kaijie Yang, Ting Cao, Di Xiao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 激子具有单粒子 Bloch 粒子所没有的内部结构，这使得它们的能带拓扑可以从束缚态结构中涌现，而不是从其组成粒子那里继承而来。这提出了一个问题：束缚态的内部结构如何能够为激子拓扑提供微观起源。在这里，我们表明，电荷转移激子的实空间嵌入可以生成一个由对称性相关的离位复合轨道组成的内禀流形，而这些轨道之间的耦合支持拓扑激子能带。横向电子-空穴分离使局域激子嵌入在连接其组成格点的键上，而不是嵌入在任一格点上。我们在蜂窝晶格中展示了这一机制，其中三个键中心电荷转移激子轨道形成一个 Kagome 晶格。通过求解 Bethe-Salpeter 方程，我们表明，即使电子能带和空穴能带在拓扑上是平庸的，这一涌现的多轨道流形在时间反演对称性破缺时也支持一个拓扑激子平带。所得能带表现出近乎均匀分布的量子几何，这有利于相互作用驱动的玻色态。我们的结果建立了一条通向局域复合束缚态拓扑能带以及非常规强关联玻色相的普适路径。

articles.title: Fine-Tuning Small Language Models for Reliable VASP INCAR Generation
articles.title_zh: 面向可靠生成 VASP INCAR 的小语言模型微调
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models can prepare VASP INCAR files from natural-language requests, but so far only large proprietary cloud models come close to handling the tightly coupled, physics-sensitive settings reliably, a dependence that fits poorly with local, high-throughput materials workflows where privacy, cost, and offline deployment matter. We show that a small language model (SLM) can close this gap. The SLM is fine-tuned on reference VASP calculations and paired with VASPGuard, a deterministic post-processor that checks syntax, workflow, and material-dependent constraints; we call the combined model INCAR-SLM. On INCARBench, a benchmark for VASP INCAR generation, INCAR-SLM built on Qwen3-4B outperforms every general-purpose LLM evaluated, exceeding GPT-5.4 by 15.55 points on the 100-point INCAR Score. Most of this gain comes from fine-tuning, with VASPGuard correcting the errors that remain. We further find that model size matters less than expected: once fine-tuning and post-processing are applied, performance saturates at a few billion parameters, and Qwen3-4B outperforms larger models in the same family.
articles.abstract_zh: 语言模型可从自然语言请求生成 VASP INCAR 文件，但此前可靠处理强耦合且物理敏感设置的主要是大型专有云模型。本文表明，经参考 VASP 计算微调的小语言模型结合确定性后处理器 VASPGuard 后，可显著提升本地高通量材料工作流中的 INCAR 生成可靠性。在 INCARBench 上，基于 Qwen3-4B 的 INCAR-SLM 超越所有评测的通用大语言模型，并显示微调与规则校验比单纯增大模型规模更关键。
authors: Xinyue Zhang, Jixiang Li, Bin Shao, Baishun Yang, Zhiyang Liu, Weichao Wang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 语言模型可以根据自然语言请求准备 VASP INCAR 文件，但迄今为止，只有大型专有云模型接近于能够可靠处理这些紧密耦合、对物理高度敏感的设置，而这种依赖并不适合重视隐私、成本和离线部署的本地高通量材料工作流。我们表明，一个小语言模型（SLM）可以弥合这一差距。该 SLM 在参考 VASP 计算上进行微调，并与 VASPGuard 配对；VASPGuard 是一个确定性的后处理器，用于检查语法、工作流以及材料相关约束；我们将这一组合模型称为 INCAR-SLM。在 INCARBench 这一用于 VASP INCAR 生成的基准测试上，基于 Qwen3-4B 构建的 INCAR-SLM 优于所有被评估的通用 LLM，在 100 分制的 INCAR Score 上超过 GPT-5.4 达 15.55 分。这一提升的大部分来自微调，而 VASPGuard 则纠正了剩余错误。我们进一步发现，模型规模的重要性低于预期：一旦应用微调和后处理，性能在几十亿参数规模即趋于饱和，并且 Qwen3-4B 优于同一系列中更大的模型。

articles.title: Local Spin Excitations Mediate Quasiparticle Breakdown in the Orbital-Selective Mott Phase
articles.title_zh: 局域自旋激发介导轨道选择性 Mott 相中的准粒子崩解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The orbital-selective Mott phase (OSMP) is commonly described as a coexistence of localized and itinerant electrons within effectively decoupled orbitals, but emerging evidence for quasiparticle breakdown points to physics beyond this picture, whose microscopic origin remains unknown. Using dynamical mean-field theory for the two-band Hubbard model, we show that the spin-flip and Ising-type components of Hund's coupling generate local spin excitations (LSEs). These LSEs couple electrons between different orbitals, renormalize quasiparticle lifetimes and binding energies, and thereby destroy well-defined quasiparticles in the OSMP. Removing these two components of Hund's coupling restores coherent quasiparticle behavior and fully decouples the charge dynamics of the two bands. Our results therefore identify electronic coupling to LSEs as the fundamental mechanism driving quasiparticle breakdown within the OSMP.
articles.abstract_zh: 轨道选择性 Mott 相通常被描述为局域电子与巡游电子在近似解耦轨道中的共存，但准粒子崩解现象表明还存在超出该图像的物理机制。作者利用双带 Hubbard 模型的动力学平均场理论，指出 Hund 耦合的自旋翻转与 Ising 型分量会产生局域自旋激发。它们耦合不同轨道电子并重整化准粒子寿命和束缚能，从而导致 OSMP 中准粒子不再良定义。
authors: Yuekun Niu, Yu Ni, Jia-Ming Wang, Zhong-Yi Lu, Yun Song, Shiping Feng
articles.abstract_zh_full: 轨道选择性 Mott 相（OSMP）通常被描述为局域电子和巡游电子在有效解耦轨道中的共存，但越来越多关于准粒子崩解的证据指向超越这一图像的物理，其微观起源仍然未知。利用双带 Hubbard 模型的动力学平均场理论，我们表明，Hund 耦合的自旋翻转分量和 Ising 型分量会产生局域自旋激发（LSEs）。这些 LSEs 在不同轨道之间耦合电子，重整化准粒子寿命和束缚能，并由此破坏 OSMP 中良定义的准粒子。移除 Hund 耦合的这两个分量会恢复相干准粒子行为，并使两个能带的电荷动力学完全解耦。因此，我们的结果将电子与 LSEs 的耦合确定为驱动 OSMP 内准粒子崩解的基本机制。

articles.title: Impact of spin-orbit coupling on electron correlation corrections to the density of states in anisotropic conductors
articles.title_zh: 自旋-轨道耦合对各向异性导体中态密度电子关联修正的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05622v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study Altshuler-Aronov-type interaction corrections to the single-particle density of states (DOS) in a strongly anisotropic 2D conductor with an open Fermi surface (FS) and weak disorder, in the presence of coexisting Rashba and Dresselhaus spin-orbit couplings (SOCs) constrained to the longitudinal direction. The low-energy band consists of two warped sheets weakly tunnel-coupled transversely; SOC splits the sheets into helicity branches with a fixed spin axis. Working in a Matsubara space, we compute the exchange contribution in the diffusion channel with dynamically screened Coulomb interaction and an impurity ladder. The resulting DOS anomaly exhibits a dimensional crossover governed by the transverse coupling scale ǎrepsilon_c. Close to the Fermi level (|ǎrepsilon-ǎrepsilon_F|<ǎrepsilon_c), the system behaves two-dimensionally, featuring a logarithmic DOS dip whose magnitude is enhanced by intrinsic SOCs. Further from the Fermi level (|ǎrepsilon-ǎrepsilon_F|!>!ǎrepsilon_c), the system behaves quasi-one-dimensionally, featuring a sharper square-root singularity whose amplitude is remarkably enhanced by the SOCs. Notably, we identify a critical SOC strength at which these spin-orbit effects exactly cancel the electron-correlation correction, perfectly restoring the unperturbed density of states. Furthermore, increasing the SOC beyond this critical point inverts the sign of the anomaly entirely, yielding a positive DOS correction. This sign reversal fundamentally alters the energy dependence, such that at energies beyond ǎrepsilon_F + ǎrepsilon_c, the positive correction decays to smaller values as energy increases, opposite to the standard negative correction. This contrasting trend provides a distinct spectroscopic signature of SOC-modulated correlation effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察具有开放费米面和弱无序的强各向异性二维导体中，Rashba 与 Dresselhaus 自旋-轨道耦合共存时的 Altshuler-Aronov 型态密度修正。结果显示，态密度异常随横向耦合尺度发生二维到准一维的维度交叉，且内禀自旋-轨道耦合可显著增强相关修正。在某一临界自旋-轨道耦合强度处，这些效应会完全抵消电子关联修正；进一步增强则使异常符号反转，形成可由谱学识别的特征。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在具有开放费米面（FS）和弱无序的强各向异性二维导体中，在共存的 Rashba 和 Dresselhaus 自旋-轨道耦合（SOCs）被限制在纵向方向的情况下，对单粒子态密度（DOS）的 Altshuler-Aronov 型相互作用修正。低能能带由两个横向弱隧穿耦合的翘曲片层组成；SOC 将这些片层分裂为具有固定自旋轴的螺旋度分支。我们在 Matsubara 空间中，利用动态屏蔽库仑相互作用和杂质梯形图，计算了扩散通道中的交换贡献。所得 DOS 异常表现出由横向耦合尺度 ε_c 控制的维度交叉。在费米能级附近（|ε-ε_F|<ε_c），体系呈二维行为，表现为对数型 DOS 凹陷，其幅度被内禀 SOCs 增强。离费米能级更远时（|ε-ε_F|>ε_c），体系呈准一维行为，表现为更尖锐的平方根奇异性，其振幅被 SOCs 显著增强。值得注意的是，我们识别出一个临界 SOC 强度，在该强度下，这些自旋-轨道效应恰好抵消电子关联修正，从而完全恢复未受扰动的态密度。此外，将 SOC 增大到超过该临界点会使异常的符号完全反转，产生正的 DOS 修正。这种符号反转从根本上改变了能量依赖关系，使得在超过 ε_F + ε_c 的能量处，正修正随能量增加而衰减到更小值，这与标准负修正相反。这种相反的趋势为 SOC 调制的关联效应提供了一个独特的谱学特征。

articles.title: Annular Majorana mode in a superconducting topological insulator
articles.title_zh: 超导拓扑绝缘体中的环形 Majorana 模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When the surface states of a topological insulator becomes superconducting, topological superconductivity can be obtained, and each vortex on the surface can host one single Majorana zero-energy mode which is usually a wave packet decaying exponentially off the vortex core. Here, we predict stable Majorana zero-energy mode whose wave function is ring-shape, dubbed as annular Majorana mode, in the superconducting vortex in topological insulators respecting 3-fold or 6-fold rotational symmetry. Such topological insulators are featured with a single nonlinear Dirac cone located at barΓ or three linear Dirac cones at barM in the surface Brillouin zone. The annular Majorana mode originates from the effective chiral f-wave superconductivity on the nonlinear Dirac cone in the former case and the interference of the effective chiral p-wave superconductivity on the three linear Dirac cones in the latter. In both cases, the annular Majorana mode is stabilized by the rotational symmetry and the winding number 3 carried by the surface states. Candidate materials supporting the annular Majorana mode are predicted. Our work provides new insights into the topological superconductivity in superconducting topological insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 当拓扑绝缘体表面态进入超导态时，表面涡旋通常可束缚一个在涡旋芯附近指数衰减的 Majorana 零能模。本文预言，在具有三重或六重旋转对称性的超导拓扑绝缘体涡旋中，可出现波函数呈环形的稳定 Majorana 零能模，即环形 Majorana 模式。其起源分别与非线性 Dirac 锥上的有效手征 f 波超导性，或三个线性 Dirac 锥上有效手征 p 波超导性的干涉有关，并由旋转对称性和表面态携带的绕数 3 稳定。
authors: Shengshan Qin, Chi Wu, Lun-hui Hu, Tiantian Zhang, Jiangping Hu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 当拓扑绝缘体的表面态变为超导时，可以获得拓扑超导性，并且表面上的每个涡旋都可以承载一个单独的 Majorana 零能模，该模式通常是一个从涡旋芯向外指数衰减的波包。在这里，我们预言，在遵循三重或六重旋转对称性的拓扑绝缘体中的超导涡旋里，存在一种稳定的 Majorana 零能模，其波函数呈环形，我们将其称为环形 Majorana 模式。这类拓扑绝缘体的特征是在表面 Brillouin 区的 Γ-bar 处具有一个单一的非线性 Dirac 锥，或在 M-bar 处具有三个线性 Dirac 锥。在前一种情形中，环形 Majorana 模式源自非线性 Dirac 锥上的有效手征 f 波超导性；在后一种情形中，则源自三个线性 Dirac 锥上的有效手征 p 波超导性的干涉。在两种情形中，环形 Majorana 模式都由旋转对称性以及表面态携带的绕数 3 所稳定。文中还预测了支持环形 Majorana 模式的候选材料。我们的工作为超导拓扑绝缘体中的拓扑超导性提供了新的见解。

articles.title: Large Spin-Wave Fluctuations Suppress Activity in Malthusian Flocks
articles.title_zh: 大自旋波涨落抑制 Malthusian 群集中活性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Novel phases, beyond long-range order in two dimensions, have continued to be discovered within flocking models, establishing flocking as one of the pivotal paradigms in active matter. However, much of the discussion around ``Malthusian'' (constant density) flocks, an analytically more tractable alternative to the Vicsek model, has centred around the scaling exponents governing the intermediate regime prior to the proliferation of asters, leaving open the question of what other phases the model might display. Here, we study the two-dimensional dynamics of Malthusian flocks and identify a previously unnoticed phase, where the dynamics is that of the equilibrium XY Model. By identifying the symmetries of the model, we derive the effective equations of motion for the Goldstone modes and analyse the spin-wave fluctuations. We identify a novel critical point separating two distinct phases and, using a perturbative RG procedure, determine the RG flows in its vicinity. This allows us to calculate the universal scaling behaviour at the critical point, along with its logarithmic corrections. The novel phase transition here is due to the interaction of activity and spin-waves, unlike the equilibrium counterpart, which undergoes a phase transition in effective degrees of freedom, namely vortices. Nevertheless, the RG flows are similar to those of the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless transition, and we show that for sufficiently strong noise, the activity becomes irrelevant and the system crosses over to the equilibrium XY universality class.
articles.abstract_zh: 群集模型中不断发现超越二维长程有序的新相，使其成为活性物质研究的重要范式。本文研究二维 Malthusian（恒定密度）群集动力学，发现一个此前未被注意到的相，其动力学与平衡 XY 模型相同。作者通过对称性分析、Goldstone 模有效方程和重整化群计算，识别出由活性与自旋波相互作用导致的新临界点，并说明强噪声下体系会交叉到平衡 XY 普适类。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在群集模型中，人们持续发现超越二维长程有序的新相，这使群集成为活性物质中的关键范式之一。然而，围绕“Malthusian”（恒定密度）群集的许多讨论集中在星状结构大量增殖之前的中间区域所对应的标度指数上；Malthusian 群集是 Vicsek 模型的一种在解析上更易处理的替代方案，这也留下了该模型还可能显示哪些其他相的问题。在这里，我们研究 Malthusian 群集的二维动力学，并识别出一个此前未被注意到的相，其中动力学与平衡 XY 模型相同。通过识别该模型的对称性，我们推导出 Goldstone 模的有效运动方程，并分析自旋波涨落。我们识别出一个分隔两个不同相的新临界点，并使用微扰重整化群过程确定其附近的 RG 流。这使我们能够计算临界点处的普适标度行为及其对数修正。这里的新相变源于活性与自旋波的相互作用，这不同于其平衡对应物；后者在有效自由度即涡旋中发生相变。尽管如此，RG 流与 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 转变的 RG 流相似，并且我们表明，在足够强的噪声下，活性变得无关，体系交叉到平衡 XY 普适类。

articles.title: Tuning the Optoelectronics of Mixed-Semiconductors through the interplay of Quantum confinement and Stoichiometry Engineering
articles.title_zh: 通过量子限域与化学计量工程的相互作用调控混合半导体的光电子性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05890v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: All-inorganic cesium lead bromide (CsPbBr3) nanocrystals (NCs) have established themselves as an emerging semiconductor for next-generation optoelectronic technologies due to their unique combination of properties, such as near unity photoluminescence quantum yields, narrow color pure emission, and exceptional defect tolerance. Although size-dependent optical signatures of these NCs are well reported, the complexity of mixed ionic-electronic transport remains largely unexplored. In this study, we provide a comprehensive analysis of size-dependent charge transport by decoupling ionic and electronic transport dynamics through carefully designed transient current and space charge limited current measurements. By employing NCs of different sizes ranging from 5.6 nm to 11.3 nm in thin films, we provide a comprehensive understanding of quantum confinement effects and related synthetic chemistry. Contrary to popular beliefs of quantum confinement and band gap broadening, our results demonstrate that the smallest NCs exhibit the most efficient transport characteristics, evidenced by the lowest activation energy (hole activation energy = 78 meV) for hole transport and the highest barrier for vacancy-mediated ion migration (ion activation energy = 370 meV). This work paves a way forward for perovskite-based efficient quantum devices, by demonstrating that moving into a strong quantum confinement regime, a superior charge transport can be facilitated, when supported by carefully tailored stoichiometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 全无机 CsPbBr3 纳米晶因高光致发光量子产率、窄谱纯色发射和缺陷容忍性而受到关注，但其混合离子-电子输运机制仍不充分清楚。本文通过瞬态电流和空间电荷限制电流测量，解耦不同尺寸纳米晶薄膜中的离子与电子输运动力学。结果表明，与通常关于量子限域导致带隙展宽的直觉不同，最小纳米晶表现出最优输运特性，提示强量子限域结合精确化学计量调控可促进高效钙钛矿量子器件。
authors: Kanha Ram Khator, Anupam Manna, Amlandeep Nayak, Pravat Nayek, Prasenjit Mal, Satyaprasad P Senanayak
articles.abstract_zh_full: 全无机溴化铯铅（CsPbBr3）纳米晶（NCs）由于其独特的性质组合，例如接近统一的光致发光量子产率、窄的高色纯度发射以及卓越的缺陷容忍性，已经成为下一代光电子技术中一种新兴半导体。尽管这些 NCs 的尺寸依赖光学特征已有充分报道，但混合离子-电子输运的复杂性在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在本研究中，我们通过精心设计的瞬态电流和空间电荷限制电流测量来解耦离子和电子输运动力学，从而对尺寸依赖的电荷输运进行全面分析。通过在薄膜中采用尺寸从 5.6 nm 到 11.3 nm 不等的 NCs，我们对量子限域效应及相关合成化学提供了全面理解。与关于量子限域和带隙展宽的流行观点相反，我们的结果表明，最小的 NCs 表现出最高效的输运特性，其证据是空穴输运具有最低的活化能（空穴活化能 = 78 meV），并且空位介导的离子迁移具有最高势垒（离子活化能 = 370 meV）。这项工作为基于钙钛矿的高效量子器件铺平了前进道路，因为它证明了当由精心调控的化学计量提供支持时，进入强量子限域区间能够促进更优越的电荷输运。

articles.title: Resilient strange metal at an unconventional quantum critical point in d=2
articles.title_zh: 二维非常规量子临界点处的稳健奇异金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05988v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Properties of the two-dimensional Hubbard model with nearest-neighbor hopping are under scrutiny in cold-atom experiments and diagrammatic quantum Monte Carlo. Given the controlled nature of these approaches, it is timely to make predictions about strange-metal behavior and its relation to quantum-critical properties. Even for interaction strengths below the Mott transition, several peculiarities occur at the quantum critical point separating Fermi liquid and incommensurate spin-density wave order. Here, we predict, using the non-perturbative improved two-particle self-consistent approach, that for correlation lengths ranging from about one to one hundred lattice spacings, Kohn anomalies on the underlying Fermi surface lead to unconventional critical exponents. The temperature dependence of the single-particle self-energy acquires strong momentum dependence along the Fermi surface with no clear evidence of Landau quasiparticles. Nevertheless, we observe strange-metal behavior, namely, resistivity that scales linearly with temperature as Ti̊ghtarrow0. Our work shows that a linear temperature dependence of resistivity arises without a linear-in-temperature self-energy along the Fermi surface, as is often assumed.
articles.abstract_zh: 二维最近邻 Hubbard 模型正受到冷原子实验和图解量子 Monte Carlo 的关注，因此有必要对奇异金属行为及其与量子临界性的关系作出预测。作者使用非微扰改进两粒子自洽方法预言，在 Fermi 液体与非公度自旋密度波有序之间的量子临界点附近，底层费米面上的 Kohn 异常会导致非常规临界指数。尽管单粒子自能沿费米面具有强动量依赖且缺乏清晰 Landau 准粒子证据，电阻仍在低温极限呈线性温度标度。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有最近邻跃迁的二维 Hubbard 模型的性质正在冷原子实验和图解量子 Monte Carlo 中受到仔细研究。鉴于这些方法的受控性质，现在正是对奇异金属行为及其与量子临界性质之间关系作出预测的合适时机。即使在相互作用强度低于 Mott 转变的情况下，在分隔 Fermi 液体和非公度自旋密度波有序的量子临界点处，也会出现若干特异性。在这里，我们使用非微扰的改进两粒子自洽方法预言，对于从约一个到一百个晶格间距范围内的关联长度，底层 Fermi 面上的 Kohn 异常会导致非常规临界指数。单粒子自能的温度依赖沿 Fermi 面获得强烈的动量依赖，并且没有清楚证据表明存在 Landau 准粒子。尽管如此，我们观察到了奇异金属行为，即电阻率在 T→0 时与温度 T 线性标度。我们的工作表明，电阻率的线性温度依赖可以在沿 Fermi 面不存在温度线性自能的情况下出现，而后者常常被假定为必要条件。

articles.title: An Effective String Theory Toolbox for Quantum Hall Interfaces II: Majorana Fermions on Fluctuating Moore-Read Worldsheets
articles.title_zh: 量子霍尔界面的有效弦理论工具箱 II：涨落 Moore-Read 世界面上的 Majorana 费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A Moore--Read interface carries a chiral Majorana mode on a boundary whose geometry may itself fluctuate. Fixed-edge theory does not determine how this neutral mode should be transported when the interface bends and moves, or how its dynamics couples to the fluctuating shape. Here we construct a spatially reparametrization-invariant Majorana theory on the nonrelativistic worldsheet of a freely moving interface. The changing line element fixes a universal half-density transport law, while additional curvature- and velocity-dependent couplings remain controlled by microscopic interface physics. The resulting framework identifies the Majorana stress tensor as the mediator between neutral and geometric dynamics and provides the neutral sector needed for effective theories of dynamical non-Abelian quantum Hall interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: Moore-Read 界面在可涨落边界几何上承载手征 Majorana 模，而固定边缘理论无法决定该中性模在弯曲和运动界面中的输运及其与形状动力学的耦合。本文构造了一个定义在自由运动界面的非相对论世界面上的空间重参数化不变 Majorana 理论。该框架给出由线元变化决定的普适半密度输运律，并将 Majorana 应力张量确定为中性动力学与几何动力学之间的媒介。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Moore-Read 界面在其几何本身可能涨落的边界上承载一个手征 Majorana 模。固定边缘理论并不能决定当界面弯曲和运动时应如何输运这一中性模，也不能决定其动力学如何耦合到涨落形状。在这里，我们在自由运动界面的非相对论世界面上构造了一个空间重参数化不变的 Majorana 理论。变化的线元固定了一个普适的半密度输运律，而额外的曲率依赖和速度依赖耦合仍由微观界面物理控制。由此产生的框架将 Majorana 应力张量识别为中性动力学与几何动力学之间的媒介，并为动力学非阿贝尔量子霍尔界面的有效理论提供了所需的中性扇区。

articles.title: Multi-State Geometry of Density Matrices and Rectification Sum Rules
articles.title_zh: 密度矩阵的多态几何与整流求和规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06326v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The geometry of quantum states has emerged as a key ingredient in understanding the linear and nonlinear responses of quantum materials. To date, however, the connection between geometry and nonlinear response is best understood for clean, noninteracting systems at zero temperature. In this work, we develop a theory of multi-state geometry for density matrices and use it to derive sum rules for second-order rectification, making no assumptions about the strength of disorder or interactions. We first show that perturbation theory for thermal density matrices gives rise to two dual information-theoretic connections and an almost complex structure. We introduce a complex, quantum generalization of the Amari-Chentsov tensor of classical information theory, the cQAC tensor, which captures the multi-state geometry of the perturbed density matrix. We derive a zero-temperature sum rule for the frequency-integrated DC rectification response of an insulator as a difference between a ground state third cumulant and the complex distortion tensor, a multi-state geometric quantity built from the cQAC tensor. This generalizes known single-particle sum rules for the shift and nonlinear Hall currents to many-body systems and general perturbations. Specializing to the shift current, we resolve the geometric contribution for multiband insulators into particle-like and hole-like terms. We verify the sum rule numerically in a generalized Kane-Mele model, finding that the geometric contribution can dominate the integrated response. Finally, we show that although the splitting of the sum rule into cumulant and geometric contributions does not survive at nonzero temperature, the measured sum rule for insulators differs from its zero-temperature form by corrections exponentially small in the gap, allowing low-temperature rectification measurements to probe the multi-state geometry of insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子态几何是理解量子材料线性和非线性响应的关键，但此前其与非线性响应的联系主要限于零温、洁净、非相互作用体系。本文发展了密度矩阵的多态几何理论，并在不假设无序或相互作用强弱的情况下推导二阶整流求和规则。作者引入复量子 Amari-Chentsov 张量，并将零温绝缘体频率积分直流整流响应表示为基态三阶累积量与多态几何畸变张量之差，同时讨论了多带绝缘体、数值验证及有限温度修正。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子态的几何已经成为理解量子材料线性和非线性响应的关键要素。然而迄今为止，几何与非线性响应之间的联系在零温洁净非相互作用体系中被理解得最为充分。在这项工作中，我们发展了密度矩阵的多态几何理论，并用它推导二阶整流的求和规则，而不对无序或相互作用的强度作任何假设。我们首先表明，热密度矩阵的微扰理论会产生两个对偶的信息论联络以及一个近复结构。我们引入经典信息论中 Amari-Chentsov 张量的一个复的量子推广，即 cQAC 张量，它刻画了受扰密度矩阵的多态几何。我们推导出绝缘体频率积分直流整流响应的零温求和规则，其形式为基态三阶累积量与复畸变张量之差；复畸变张量是由 cQAC 张量构成的多态几何量。这将已知的关于位移电流和非线性 Hall 电流的单粒子求和规则推广到多体体系和一般微扰。专门考虑位移电流时，我们将多带绝缘体的几何贡献分解为类粒子项和类空穴项。我们在广义 Kane-Mele 模型中数值验证了该求和规则，并发现几何贡献可以主导积分响应。最后，我们表明，尽管在非零温度下求和规则分解为累积量贡献和几何贡献的形式不再成立，但绝缘体中测得的求和规则与其零温形式之间的差异只是随能隙指数小的修正，这使得低温整流测量能够探测绝缘体的多态几何。

articles.title: Phonon spectral functions of low-density polaron metals
articles.title_zh: 低密度极化子金属的声子谱函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06357v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) to compute the phonon spectral function of a one-dimensional spinless Holstein model doped with a low but finite carrier concentration, x łeq 0.15, as a function of the electron-phonon coupling łambda. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first such results in this regime, complementing extensive prior work at the single-polaron level (x→ 0). We find that significant phonon spectral weight is transferred both below, all the way down to ømega=0, and above the bare phonon energy Ømega, in stark contrast with the Kohn-anomaly phenomenology expected in the Migdal limit, where weight remains centered near Ømega with a kink at q=2k_F. No signature of this 2k_F kink appears in our results. This behavior is captured qualitatively by the Random Phase Approximation (RPA), and semi-quantitatively, at negligible extra computational cost, by a ``dressed RPA'' scheme in which the electron addition propagator is renormalized using the Momentum Average (MA) approximation for the low-density electron-polaron. By contrast, adding the lowest-order vertex correction to this dressed scheme produces unphysical negative spectral weight, signaling that vertex and propagator dressings must be treated consistently once the propagators are dressed nonperturbatively. Our results provide an efficient approximation for the phonon spectral functions of low-density polaron metals, a regime relevant to weakly doped insulators.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者使用密度矩阵重整化群计算了一维无自旋 Holstein 模型在低但有限载流子浓度下的声子谱函数随电子-声子耦合的变化。结果显示，声子谱权重会显著转移到裸声子能量以下直至零能以及以上区域，与 Migdal 极限下预期的 Kohn 异常图像形成鲜明对比，且未见 2k_F 折 kink 特征。随机相近似和结合动量平均近似的“修饰 RPA”能较好描述结果，而不一致加入最低阶顶角修正会产生非物理负谱权重。
authors: Luis Walther, Alberto Nocera, Mona Berciu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）计算一维无自旋 Holstein 模型的声子谱函数，该模型掺杂有低但有限的载流子浓度 x≤0.15，并考察其随电子-声子耦合 λ 的变化。据我们所知，这些是在该区间内的首批此类结果，补充了此前在单极化子层面（x→0）的大量研究。我们发现，显著的声子谱权重被转移到裸声子能量 Ω 以下，并一直延伸到 ω=0，同时也转移到 Ω 以上，这与 Migdal 极限中预期的 Kohn 异常现象学形成鲜明对比；在 Migdal 极限中，谱权重保持集中在 Ω 附近，并在 q=2k_F 处出现折点。我们的结果中没有出现这种 2k_F 折点的任何迹象。随机相近似（RPA）可以定性捕捉这一行为，而一种“修饰 RPA”方案则能够以可忽略的额外计算成本实现半定量描述；在该方案中，电子添加传播子利用低密度电子-极化子的动量平均（MA）近似进行重整化。相比之下，在这一修饰方案中加入最低阶顶角修正会产生非物理的负谱权重，这表明一旦传播子以非微扰方式被修饰，顶角修饰和传播子修饰就必须一致处理。我们的结果为低密度极化子金属的声子谱函数提供了一种高效近似，而这一体系区间与弱掺杂绝缘体相关。

articles.title: Identifying slow relaxation in many-body quantum systems through state-graph geometry and state-graph heterogeneity
articles.title_zh: 通过态图几何与态图异质性识别多体量子系统中的慢弛豫
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05298v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We adapt tools from the theory of quantum random walks to investigate slow relaxation dynamics through the many-body state graph. Specifically, we construct a probe of heterogeneity between basis states defined using hitting times derived from the unitary time-evolution operator. We find that the state-graph geometry, encoded by the pairwise hitting time of basis states, is a highly sensitive indicator of slow relaxation dynamics in a variety of systems. We study three paradigmatic models: the Rosenzweig-Porter model, the quantum East model, and the triangular lattice gas model, exhibiting a sudden onset of slow dynamics upon tuning of a control parameter. As a global characterization of the graph geometry, we analyze the spectral radius of the hitting matrix. We find that it increases sharply at the onset of slow dynamics, spanning many orders of magnitude, with a characteristic crossing point at the transition. Our work provides a geometric framework for describing and identifying phases with slow relaxation using a unified graph-theoretic formalism.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将量子随机游走理论中的工具用于研究多体态图上的慢弛豫动力学。作者利用由幺正时间演化算符导出的首达时间来构造基态之间异质性的度量，并发现由基态两两首达时间编码的态图几何对慢弛豫极为敏感。对Rosenzweig-Porter模型、量子East模型和三角晶格气体模型的研究表明，在控制参数调节下慢动力学会突然出现，而首达矩阵的谱半径在转变处显著跃升。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文将量子随机游走理论中的工具改造后，用于借助多体态图来研究慢弛豫动力学。具体而言，作者基于幺正时间演化算符导出首达时间，构造了一个用于探测基态之间异质性的量。研究发现，由基态两两首达时间所编码的态图几何，是多种系统中慢弛豫动力学的高度灵敏指示器。作者考察了三个典型模型：Rosenzweig-Porter模型、量子East模型以及三角晶格气体模型，它们在调节某个控制参数时都会表现出慢动力学的突然出现。作为对图几何的整体表征，作者分析了首达矩阵的谱半径。结果表明，在慢动力学出现之初，谱半径会急剧增大，跨越多个数量级，并在相变处呈现一个特征性交点。该工作提供了一个几何框架，通过统一的图论形式主义来描述并识别具有慢弛豫的相。

articles.title: Transverse quantum-state characterization of programmable electron optics
articles.title_zh: 可编程电子光学的横向量子态表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05749v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Programmable electron optics -- electronically controlled phase plates -- underpin proposals from dose-efficient phase imaging to shaped-electron X-ray sources, nearly all assuming a pure, fully coherent delivered wave whose purity has never been measured. Here we reconstruct the transverse density matrix of a microelectromechanical electrostatic spiral phase plate by mixed-state ptychography, from one four-dimensional STEM scan per state and without added hardware. The delivered beam is substantially mixed: its purity falls from approximately 0.47 to approximately 0.24 as the applied bias grows, inconsistent with a fixed lateral source-blur model, while the real-space coherence width stays near 1 nm. The same scans calibrate the device in situ, allow virtual orbital-angular-momentum sorting and, through a partial-coherence-aware transfer theory, indicate that purifying the output could improve dose efficiency roughly threefold. One acquisition thus becomes a quantum-state acceptance test for programmable electron optics, supplying the purity and coherence that emerging phase-plate and diffractive-imaging schemes assume but leave unquantified.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对可编程电子光学中的电子相位板，直接重构了其横向密度矩阵。作者通过混合态拼接层析技术，在无需额外硬件的情况下，仅用每种状态一次四维STEM扫描，就测量了微机电静电螺旋相位板所输出电子束的量子态。结果显示输出束明显是混态，纯度随偏置升高从约0.47降至约0.24，而实空间相干宽度仍约为1纳米，这为该器件的原位校准、轨道角动量虚拟分选及剂量效率提升提供了依据。
authors: Shengbo You, Paolo Rosi, Enzo Rotunno, Alberto Roncaglia, Luca Belsito, Amir H. Tavabi, Rafal E. Dunin-Borkowski, Vincenzo Grillo, Philipp M. Pelz
articles.abstract_zh_full: 可编程电子光学——即电子控制的相位板——支撑着从低剂量成像到形状化电子X射线源等一系列方案，而这些方案几乎都假定所输出的电子波是纯净且完全相干的，但这种纯度此前从未被测量过。本文通过混合态拼接层析技术，重构了一个微机电静电螺旋相位板的横向密度矩阵，且每种状态只需一次四维STEM扫描，并且无需额外硬件。结果表明，输出电子束相当混合：随着施加偏压增大，其纯度从约0.47降至约0.24，这与固定的横向源模糊模型不一致，而实空间相干宽度仍保持在约1纳米。相同的扫描还可对器件进行原位标定，支持虚拟轨道角动量分选，并通过考虑部分相干的传输理论表明，若能净化输出，剂量效率可提高约三倍。因此，一次采集便可成为可编程电子光学的量子态验收测试，为新兴相位板和衍射成像方案提供其所假定却未量化的纯度与相干性。

articles.title: Exponential Speedup of Entanglement Generation by Quantum Mpemba Effects
articles.title_zh: 量子姆彭巴效应实现纠缠生成的指数加速
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05935v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entanglement is a key resource for quantum technologies. We show that protocols employing quantum Mpemba effects allow one to exponentially accelerate the generation of entanglement, or to slow down the decay thereof. Two entanglement Mpemba effects with different operational meaning are introduced, focusing either on the task of rapidly generating a certain threshold value for entanglement or on achieving the asymptotic steady-state value. We show that entanglement Mpemba effects depend on the chosen entanglement measure. Using cluster elimination methods, many-body quantum systems also benefit from the exponential speedup of entanglement generation, as we demonstrate for a dissipative long-range Ising chain.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者表明，利用量子姆彭巴效应的方案可以指数级加速纠缠生成，或相应减缓纠缠衰减。文中提出了两种具有不同操作含义的纠缠姆彭巴效应，分别对应尽快达到某个纠缠阈值与达到渐近稳态值两类任务。研究还指出，纠缠姆彭巴效应取决于所选纠缠度量，并以耗散长程Ising链为例说明多体量子系统同样能够获得这种指数加速。
authors: Sara M. Benjadi, Reinhold Egger, Igor Gornyi, Andrea Nava
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠是量子技术中的关键资源。我们表明，采用量子姆彭巴效应的方案能够指数级加速纠缠的生成，或者减缓其衰减。文中引入了两种具有不同操作意义的纠缠姆彭巴效应，一种关注快速生成某个特定阈值的纠缠，另一种关注达到渐近稳态值。我们证明，纠缠姆彭巴效应取决于所选用的纠缠度量。借助簇消去方法，多体量子系统同样可以受益于纠缠生成的指数加速，我们以耗散长程Ising链为例进行了展示。

articles.title: Field-Space Entanglement Dynamics Between Tunnel-Coupled Luttinger Liquids
articles.title_zh: 隧穿耦合Luttinger液体之间的场空间纠缠动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05968v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Entanglement dynamics depend not only on how a quantum system is partitioned, but critically on how interactions across that partition are structured. For a spatial bipartition of a locally interacting system, entanglement is generated near the boundary and then propagates into the bulk. By contrast, when two extended quantum fields are coupled locally along their entire length, the interaction crosses the field-space partition everywhere, and this generates correlations throughout the system. Here, we study the entanglement dynamics between two gapless one-dimensional quantum many-body systems described by Luttinger liquid theory. The systems are initially decoupled and prepared at zero or finite temperature, after which a time-dependent tunneling interaction is activated uniformly along their length. Within a Gaussian approximation, we derive general analytical expressions for the logarithmic negativity, mutual information, and Rényi entropies under arbitrary coupling protocols. At zero temperature, entanglement displays an early-time power-law growth whose exponent is fixed solely by the first non-null derivative of the tunneling protocol. Once the coupling saturates, we obtain exact long-time averages of the information-theoretic quantities and characterise how the correlations scale with temperature and the final coupling strength. We also analyse how mutual information and logarithmic negativity approach the adiabatic limit for a very slow protocol with respect to intrinsic system timescale. This work extends the study of entanglement dynamics in nonequilibrium field theory to field-space partitions and mixed initial states.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究两个无能隙一维量子多体系统之间的纠缠动力学，这两个系统由Luttinger液体理论描述。作者考虑它们在初始解耦、零温或有限温条件下，通过沿全长均匀开启的时间依赖隧穿相互作用发生耦合，并在高斯近似下推导了对数负性、互信息和Rényi熵的通用解析表达式。结果表明，零温时纠缠在早期呈幂律增长，其指数仅由隧穿协议的首个非零导数决定；在耦合饱和后，还可得到相关信息量的长时间平均以及其随温度和最终耦合强度的标度规律。
authors: Léonce Dupays, Taufiq Murtadho, Bi Hong Tiang, Nelly H. Y. Ng, Paola Ruggiero
articles.abstract_zh_full: 纠缠动力学不仅取决于量子系统如何被分割，也关键取决于跨越该分割的相互作用结构。对于局域相互作用系统的空间二分，纠缠先在边界附近生成，再向体内传播。相反，当两个延展的量子场沿其整个长度局域耦合时，相互作用在场空间分割的每一点都跨越边界，从而在整个系统中生成关联。本文研究了由Luttinger液体理论描述的两个无能隙一维量子多体系统之间的纠缠动力学。系统初始时彼此解耦，并制备在零温或有限温条件下，随后沿其长度均匀开启一个时间依赖的隧穿相互作用。借助高斯近似，我们在任意耦合协议下推导了对数负性、互信息和Rényi熵的通用解析表达式。零温下，纠缠表现出早期幂律增长，其指数仅由隧穿协议的第一个非零导数决定。一旦耦合达到饱和，我们得到了信息论量的精确长时平均，并刻画了这些关联如何随温度和最终耦合强度标度。我们还分析了在相对于系统内禀时间尺度而言非常缓慢的协议下，互信息和对数负性如何逼近绝热极限。该工作将非平衡场论中纠缠动力学的研究拓展到了场空间分割和混合初态。

articles.title: Quantum fluctuation relations in first-detection processes
articles.title_zh: 首次探测过程中的量子涨落关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06194v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We derive two quantum fluctuation relations for systems undergoing repeated projective measurements. These fluctuation relations characterize the work that can be extracted from a quantum device when a first-detection event triggers a mechanical operation leading to positive work production. The correction to the standard quantum Jarzynski equality depends logarithmically on the mean first-detection time for the time-reversed dynamics. Application of Jensen's inequality leads to fundamental limits on both the total work involved in the repeated measurements and final mechanical operation, and the extracted work alone. The general case of a device connected to an external environment is also considered.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对经历重复投影测量的系统推导了两条量子涨落关系。这些关系刻画了当首次探测事件触发机械操作并导致正功输出时，量子器件可提取的功，并给出了对标准量子Jarzynski等式的修正。进一步利用Jensen不等式，作者导出了对重复测量及最终机械操作所涉及总功、以及仅可提取功的基本限制；同时还讨论了与外部环境耦合的更一般情形。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们针对经历重复投影测量的系统推导了两条量子涨落关系。这些涨落关系刻画了这样一种情形：首次探测事件触发机械操作，并导致正的功输出，从而决定了量子器件可提取的功。对标准量子Jarzynski等式的修正项以对时间反演动力学的平均首次探测时间的对数形式出现。应用Jensen不等式后，可以得到对重复测量与最终机械操作所涉及的总功，以及仅由提取功本身构成的功量的基本极限。文中还考虑了与外部环境相连的一般情形。

articles.title: Approximate Quantum Error Correction at Chiral Topological Edges
articles.title_zh: 手性拓扑边缘上的近似量子纠错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06258v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Topologically ordered phases naturally realize quantum error correction through nonlocal encoding of quantum information. More recently, conformal field theories have been shown to realize approximate quantum error-correcting codes, but such constructions generally require fine tuning to criticality. Here we introduce a family of approximate quantum error-correcting codes realized by the chiral edges of two-dimensional topologically ordered phases. The proposed encoding combines the robustness of a gapped topological bulk with the flexibility of gapless edge conformal field theories. To characterize its robustness, we study coherent-information loss under local erasure. We derive an exact expression relating coherent-information loss to relative entropy, reducing the recoverability problem to universal properties of the edge theory. This leads to power-law scaling of coherent-information loss with the size of the erased region. We further show that, for geometrically local erasures near one edge, the two-dimensional chiral edge code is at least as robust as the dimensionally reduced CFT code, and is strictly more robust in several representative examples. For Abelian code subspaces, we further construct a power-law-range recovery map supported on the erased region together with a power-law-range buffer; this recovery map depends only on the code subspace, not on the unknown encoded state. We provide numerical calculations for lattice realizations of compact free boson and Ising CFT examples that support the theoretical predictions of the power-law exponents.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出了一类由二维拓扑有序相的手性边缘实现的近似量子纠错码。该方案结合了有能隙拓扑体的鲁棒性与无能隙边缘共形场论的灵活性，并通过局域擦除下的相干信息损失来刻画其稳健性。文中建立了相干信息损失与相对熵之间的精确关系，将可恢复性问题化归为边缘理论的普适性质，并进一步得到随擦除区域大小呈幂律标度的结果。
authors: Yuntai Song, Zejun Liu, Zhencheng Wang, Jong Yeon Lee, Bowen Shi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 拓扑有序相可通过信息的非局域编码自然实现量子纠错。近年来，共形场论也被证明可以实现近似量子纠错码，但此类构造通常需要对临界性进行精细调谐。本文提出了一类由二维拓扑有序相的手性边缘实现的近似量子纠错码。所建议的编码结合了有能隙拓扑体的鲁棒性与无能隙边缘共形场论的灵活性。为了表征其鲁棒性，作者研究了局域擦除下相干信息的损失。文中推导了一个将相干信息损失与相对熵联系起来的精确表达式，从而把可恢复性问题化约为边缘理论的普适性质。这进一步导出了相干信息损失随被擦除区域大小按幂律标度的结果。作者还表明，对于靠近一侧边缘的几何局域擦除，二维手性边缘码至少与降维后的CFT码一样稳健，并且在若干代表性例子中更为稳健。对于阿贝尔码子空间，作者进一步构造了一个支持在被擦除区域及其一个幂律范围缓冲区上的恢复映射；该恢复映射仅依赖于码子空间，而不依赖于未知的编码态。文中还针对紧致自由玻色子和Ising CFT的晶格实现给出了数值计算，支持理论预言的幂律指数。

articles.title: Extensive entanglement between coupled Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids in and out of equilibrium
articles.title_zh: 平衡与非平衡下耦合Tomonaga-Luttinger液体中的广延纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.20533v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum entanglement exists in nature but is absent in classical physics, hence it fundamentally distinguishes quantum from classical theories. While entanglement is routinely observed for few-body systems, it is significantly more challenging to witness in quantum many-body systems. Here, we theoretically study entanglement between two parallel and spatially separated Tomonaga-Luttinger liquids (TLLs) partitioned along the longitudinal axis. In particular, we focus on 1D Bose gases as a realization of TLLs and investigate two experimentally relevant situations: tunnel-coupled gases at finite temperatures and after coherent splitting. In both scenarios, we analytically calculate the logarithmic negativity and identify a threshold temperature below which the system is entangled. Notably, this threshold temperature is accessible in the current and near-term 1D Bose gas experiments. Furthermore, we investigate the crossover between quantum and classical correlations in the vicinity of the threshold temperature by comparing logarithmic negativity with mutual information. We argue that the initial mutual information established by the coherent splitting is conserved in TLL dynamics, thus preventing certain generalized Gibbs ensembles from being reached during prethermalization. Moreover, both logarithmic negativity and mutual information are found to scale extensively with the subsystem's length. Although the ground-state entanglement between coupled TLLs has been predicted to be extensive, this setting is largely overlooked compared to other partitions. Our work extends the study of entanglement between coupled TLLs to finite temperatures and out-of-equilibrium regimes, and provides a strategy towards experimental detection of extensive entanglement in quantum many-body systems at finite temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论研究了沿纵向轴划分的两条平行且空间分离的Tomonaga-Luttinger液体之间的纠缠，重点关注作为其实现的一维玻色气体。作者分析了有限温下的隧穿耦合气体以及相干分裂后的情况，解析计算了对数负性并确定了系统在低于某一阈值温度时会出现纠缠。研究还表明，对数负性与互信息都随子系统长度呈广延标度，并指出相干分裂建立的初始互信息在TLL动力学中得以保持，从而阻止某些广义Gibbs系综在预热化过程中被实现。
authors: Taufiq Murtadho, Marek Gluza, Nelly H. Y. Ng
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子纠缠存在于自然界中，而经典物理中并不存在，因此它在根本上区分了量子理论与经典理论。虽然少体系统中的纠缠已被常规观测到，但在量子多体系统中证明纠缠则困难得多。本文从理论上研究了沿纵向轴分割的两条平行且空间分离的Tomonaga-Luttinger液体之间的纠缠。我们特别以一维玻色气体作为TLL的实现，考察了两种实验上相关的情形：有限温下的隧穿耦合气体，以及相干分裂之后的系统。在这两种情形下，我们解析计算了对数负性，并确定了一个低于该温度时系统处于纠缠态的阈值温度。值得注意的是，这个阈值温度可由当前和近期的一维玻色气体实验接触到。我们还通过比较对数负性与互信息，研究了阈值温度附近量子关联与经典关联之间的过渡。我们论证，相干分裂所建立的初始互信息在TLL动力学中是守恒的，因此阻止某些广义Gibbs系综在预热化过程中达到。进一步地，我们发现对数负性和互信息都随子系统长度呈广延标度。尽管耦合TLL之间的基态纠缠早已被预言为广延的，但与其他分割方式相比，这一设定长期被忽视。我们的工作将耦合TLL中纠缠的研究扩展到了有限温和非平衡情形，并为在有限温度下实验探测量子多体系统中的广延纠缠提供了一种策略。

articles.title: Full Eigenstate Thermalization in Integrable Spin Systems
articles.title_zh: 可积自旋系统中的完整本征态热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.05887v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis (ETH) is a standard tool to understand the thermalization properties of an isolated quantum system. Its generalization to higher order correlations of matrix elements of local operators, dubbed the full ETH, relates the ETH free cumulants to the corresponding thermal free cumulants in the thermodynamic limit. In this work, we numerically test the full ETH predictions using exact diagonalization of two integrable spin models: the Ising and the XXZ Heisenberg models. The differences from the behavior predicted by full ETH in chaotic systems are highlighted and contrasted along the way. We further study the out-of-time-ordered correlator (OTOC) through its approximate decomposition into contributions involving the second- and fourth-order ETH free cumulants. We find that, although the fourth-order contribution governs the late-time behavior of the OTOC in these integrable models, its dynamics differs significantly from that found in nonintegrable systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用精确对角化，对两个可积自旋模型——Ising模型和XXZ Heisenberg模型——的完整ETH预言进行数值检验。作者比较了这些可积系统与混沌系统中完整ETH所预言行为的差异，并通过将OTOC近似分解为与二阶和四阶ETH自由累积量相关的贡献来研究其动力学。结果发现，尽管四阶贡献主导了这些可积模型中OTOC的晚时行为，但其动力学与非可积系统中的情形有显著不同。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本征态热化假说（ETH）是理解孤立量子系统热化性质的标准工具。其对局域算符矩阵元高阶关联的推广，即所谓完整ETH，将热力学极限中的ETH自由累积量与相应的热自由累积量联系起来。本文利用精确对角化，对两个可积自旋模型——Ising模型和XXZ Heisenberg模型——的完整ETH预言进行了数值检验。文中还强调并比较了这些系统与混沌系统中该行为的差异。作者进一步研究了时序外关联函数（OTOC），并将其近似分解为包含二阶和四阶ETH自由累积量的贡献。结果发现，尽管四阶贡献主导了这些可积模型中OTOC的晚时行为，但其动力学与非可积系统中的结果存在显著差异。

articles.title: Spin Glass Transitions Obstruct Decoded Quantum Interferometry
articles.title_zh: 自旋玻璃相变阻碍解码量子干涉测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.14509v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum algorithms are believed to offer advantages in solving certain hard discrete optimization problems, yet identifying when such advantages persist in explicit distributions of problem instances remains a foundational challenge. Recently, a new quantum algorithm known as Decoded Quantum Interferometry (DQI) has been proposed to solve optimization problems by decoding a corresponding LDPC error-correcting code. Although DQI exhibits quantum advantage on certain structured problem instances, the possibility for advantage on random, unstructured problem instances is less well-understood. Here we prove that, assuming decoding threshold upper bounds satisfied by state-of-the-art decoders, DQI is asymptotically obstructed by a spin glass phase transition in random local combinatorial optimization problems. This phase transition is heralded by the onset of the overlap gap property (OGP), a topological fragmentation of the near-optimal solution space widely conjectured to exactly characterize the asymptotic performance of optimal efficient classical algorithms. Our results therefore indicate that DQI, applied on the best known efficient decoders, is unlikely to exhibit quantum advantage on unstructured problem instances. We support this result by proving that approximate message passing, a classical optimization algorithm, outperforms DQI on certain problem distributions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究随机局域组合优化问题中的量子算法优势何时会失效，重点考察一种名为解码量子干涉测量（DQI）的新算法。作者在假设现有最佳译码器满足某些译码阈值上界的前提下证明，DQI会受到自旋玻璃相变的渐近阻碍，而该相变由重叠间隙性质的出现所预示。结果表明，在当前最优高效译码器条件下，DQI不太可能在无结构问题实例上体现量子优势。
authors: Eric R. Anschuetz, David Gamarnik, Jonathan Z. Lu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 人们普遍认为，量子算法在求解某些困难离散优化问题时可能具有优势，但在具体的问题实例分布中，何时这种优势能够保留仍是一个基础性挑战。最近，一种名为解码量子干涉测量（Decoded Quantum Interferometry，DQI）的新量子算法被提出，其思路是通过译码一个相应的LDPC纠错码来求解优化问题。尽管DQI在某些结构化问题实例上表现出量子优势，但它在随机、无结构问题实例上是否同样具有优势尚不清楚。本文证明，在假设现有最优译码器所满足的译码阈值上界成立的情况下，DQI会在随机局域组合优化问题中受到自旋玻璃相变的渐近阻碍。该相变由重叠间隙性质（OGP）的出现所预示；OGP是一种对近最优解空间的拓扑碎裂现象，通常被猜想可精确刻画最优高效经典算法的渐近性能。因此，我们的结果表明，在使用当前已知最优高效译码器时，将DQI应用于无结构问题实例不太可能体现量子优势。我们还证明了，近似消息传递这一经典优化算法在某些问题分布上优于DQI，从而支持了这一结论。

articles.title: Spin stiffness and resilience phase transition in a noisy toric-rotor code
articles.title_zh: 噪声托里克-转子码中的自旋刚度与韧性相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.23751v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We use a quantum formalism for the partition function of the classical XY model to identify a resilience phase transition in the zero-syndrome postselected sector of a noisy toric-rotor code. To this end, we consider a logical state of toric-rotor code under phase-shift noise described by a von Mises probability distribution. We then show that the fidelity of the noisy state with respect to the initial logical state is proportional to the partition function of the XY model, such that a Kosterlitz-Thouless phase transition at a critical temperature T_c corresponds to a resilience phase transition at a critical width σ_c. To characterize this transition, we map the spin stiffness of the XY model to a topological order parameter 0łeq łambda łeq 1, which quantifies the intrinsic resilience of the code to decoherence within the zero-syndrome subspace. We show that the initial logical state exhibits partial resilience to noise for widths less than σ_c approx 0.89, where łambda satisfies 0< łambda <1 and drops discontinuously to zero at σ_c. We further discuss the implications of our results for postselected quantum error correction in the toric-rotor code in higher dimensions. Our work shows that the quantum formalism for partition functions provides a mathematically rigorous framework for studying noisy continuous-variable quantum codes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用经典XY模型配分函数的量子形式主义，研究了带噪托里克-转子码在零综合征后选择子空间中的韧性相变。作者将相位移噪声用冯·米塞斯分布描述，并证明带噪逻辑态与初始逻辑态的保真度与XY模型的配分函数成正比，从而将Kosterlitz-Thouless相变对应到临界宽度处的韧性相变。进一步地，文中把XY模型的自旋刚度映射为一个拓扑序参量，用以刻画零综合征子空间中编码对退相干的内禀韧性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用经典XY模型配分函数的量子形式主义，识别了带噪托里克-转子码零综合征后选择子空间中的韧性相变。为此，我们考虑了在相位移噪声作用下的托里克-转子码逻辑态，该噪声由冯·米塞斯概率分布描述。随后我们表明，带噪状态相对于初始逻辑态的保真度与XY模型的配分函数成正比，因此，临界温度T_c处的Kosterlitz-Thouless相变对应于临界宽度σ_c处的韧性相变。为了刻画这一转变，我们将XY模型的自旋刚度映射为一个拓扑序参量0≤λ≤1，它量化了在零综合征子空间中编码对退相干的内禀韧性。我们证明，初始逻辑态在宽度小于σ_c约0.89时对噪声表现出部分韧性，此时λ满足0<λ<1，并在σ_c处不连续地降为零。我们还讨论了这些结果对高维托里克-转子码中后选择量子纠错的含义。我们的工作表明，用于配分函数的量子形式主义为研究含噪连续变量量子码提供了一个数学上严格的框架。

articles.title: X-ray Driven Trihydrogen Formation on Silica Nanosurfaces
articles.title_zh: X射线驱动的二氧化硅纳米表面三氢离子形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05590v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The trihydrogen cation (H₃⁺⁾ initiates the ion-molecule reactions that build molecular complexity in interstellar space. Whether its canonical formation reaction, H₂⁺ + H₂ i̊ghtarrow H₃⁺ + H, proceeds on inorganic surfaces under radiation-driven ionization has remained untested. Here we drive H₃⁺ formation on hydrated silica nanoparticles using intense 1.88 keV X-ray pulses, combining ion velocity map imaging, electron time-of-flight spectroscopy, and single-particle coherent diffractive imaging to resolve this chemistry on individual particles. The self-induced surface electric field on the V/nm scale drives interfacial charge transfer and water fragmentation. This field is the dominant parameter governing the relative yields of H⁺, H₂⁺, and H₃⁺ across particle size, composition, and aggregation. Density functional theory and nonadiabatic quantum molecular dynamics simulations trace this field-driven charge transfer, directly analogous to band bending at semiconductor photoelectrodes. These results establish surface-field-driven charge transfer as a unifying mechanism between radiation dominated astrophysical environments and field-driven surface catalysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在受X射线驱动电离条件下，研究了H3+在水合二氧化硅纳米粒子表面形成的过程。作者结合离子速度映射成像、电子飞行时间谱和单粒子相干衍射成像，直接解析了单颗粒上的相关化学反应，并发现自发形成的表面电场是决定H+、H2+和H3+产率的主导因素。理论与动力学模拟进一步表明，这一由表面电场驱动的电荷转移机制与半导体光电极中的能带弯曲具有直接类比关系。
authors: Samuel Sahel-Schackis, Adam Summers, Ritika Dagar, Alexandra Feinberg, Martin Grassl, Simon Dold, Rebecca Boll, Yevheniy Ovcharenko, Chris Aikens, Cesar Costa Vera, Alberto De Fanis, Avijit Duley, Felix Gerke, Daniel Jost, Regina Leiner, Michael Meyer, Ilana J. P. Molesky, Razib Obaid, Jeffrey Powell, Nils Rennhack, Björn Senfftleben, Hendrik Tackenberg, Paul Tuemmler, Sergey Usenko, Christian Peltz, Thomas Fennel, Markus Gallei, Eckart Rühl, Artem Rudenko, Daniel Rolles, Thomas Linker, Matthias F. Kling
articles.abstract_zh_full: 三氢离子（H3+）是驱动星际空间中构建分子复杂性的离子-分子反应的起点。其经典形成反应H2+ + H2 → H3+ + H，是否会在无机表面上经由辐射驱动电离而发生，过去一直未经检验。本文利用强1.88 keV X射线脉冲，在水合二氧化硅纳米粒子上驱动H3+形成，并结合离子速度映射成像、电子飞行时间谱和单粒子相干衍射成像，在单个颗粒尺度上解析这一化学过程。纳米粒子表面由其自身诱导产生的电场达到V/nm量级，驱动界面电荷转移和水的碎裂。该电场是决定H+、H2+和H3+相对产率、并随粒径、成分和聚集状态变化的主导参数。密度泛函理论和非绝热量子分子动力学模拟描绘了这一由电场驱动的电荷转移过程，其与半导体光电极中的能带弯曲直接类似。上述结果确立了表面电场驱动电荷转移作为一个统一机制，将辐射主导的天体物理环境与电场驱动的表面催化联系起来。

articles.title: Simulation of positronium laser cooling using the Lindblad master equation
articles.title_zh: 使用Lindblad主方程模拟正电子素激光冷却
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a formulation and numerical results for positronium (Ps) laser cooling. The formulation is based on the Lindblad master equation and follows the time evolution of the density matrix of Ps atoms. It therefore accounts for atomic coherence, which is necessary to describe the interaction of Ps with the train of short laser pulses generated by the system developed by Shu et al. [K. Shu et al., Phys. Rev. A 109, 043520 (2024)]. Using this formulation, we calculate the time evolution of the populations in each internal and momentum state and thereby quantitatively predict the momentum distribution after laser cooling. We present the representative time evolution of the internal-state populations and momentum distribution, together with a comprehensive scan of the laser parameters used to optimize the cooling efficiency. A prominent feature of the simulated distributions is sub-recoil cooling through velocity-selective coherent population trapping, a coherent effect captured by the quantum-mechanical treatment.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于Lindblad主方程建立了正电子素激光冷却的理论与数值模拟框架。该方法跟踪正电子素原子密度矩阵的时间演化，因此能够描述原子相干性，并据此定量预测冷却后的动量分布。作者还扫描了用于优化冷却效率的激光参数，结果显示分布中出现了由速度选择性相干布居俘获导致的亚反冲冷却这一显著特征。
authors: Kenji Shu, Sohma Shiraishi, Kosuke Yoshioka
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了正电子素（Ps）激光冷却的一个理论形式化和数值结果。该形式化基于Lindblad主方程，并跟踪正电子素原子密度矩阵的时间演化。因此它考虑了原子相干性，而这对于描述正电子素与由Shu等人开发的系统所产生的短脉冲串之间的相互作用是必要的[ K. Shu et al., Phys. Rev. A 109, 043520 (2024) ]。利用这一形式化，我们计算了各个内部态和动量态布居的时间演化，从而定量预测了激光冷却后的动量分布。我们给出了内部态布居和动量分布的代表性时间演化，并对用于优化冷却效率的激光参数进行了全面扫描。模拟分布的一个突出特征是通过速度选择性相干布居俘获实现的亚反冲冷却，这一相干效应被量子力学处理所捕捉。

articles.title: Nuclear-Spin Statistical Weights from Young Diagrams
articles.title_zh: 基于杨图的核自旋统计权重
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06339v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Nuclear-spin statistical weights and selection rules in molecular spectroscopy are governed by the permutation symmetry of identical nuclei, although rigid and semi-rigid molecules typically realize only a proper subgroup of the full symmetric group. Building on the Schur-Weyl framework of Schmiedt, Jensen, and Schlemmer, we extend this approach to molecular geometries whose rovibrational motion realizes cyclic and dihedral permutation subgroups. By combining the Schur-Weyl decomposition of the n-spin Hilbert space with the Kraśkiewicz-Weyman-Adin-Roichman major-index branching rule for the restriction S_N downarrow Cₘ, we obtain a fully combinatorial method for determining nuclear-spin symmetry species and statistical weights. Each standard Young tableau corresponds to a definite cyclic character determined by its major index, with reflections yielding the associated dihedral symmetry, so that nuclear-spin species follow directly from tableau data without projection operators or case-specific constructions. Applications to XeOF₄, SF₄, benzene, deuterated benzene, and the tropylium cation demonstrate that the method applies uniformly to realistic molecular point groups and reproduces established statistical weights while providing a transparent spin-resolved structure. The approach supplies the symmetry information required for rovibrational line-intensity modeling and provides a practical, automatable framework for nuclear-spin symmetry analysis in polyatomic molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究分子光谱中由相同原子核置换对称性决定的核自旋统计权重与选择定则，并将 Schur-Weyl 框架推广到实现循环与二面体置换子群的分子几何。作者结合 Schur-Weyl 分解与主指标分支规则，提出一种完全组合化、可自动化的方法，由标准杨表直接给出核自旋对称种类和统计权重。对多种实际分子的应用表明，该方法统一适用于现实分子点群，并能复现实有统计权重。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子光谱中的核自旋统计权重和选择定则受相同原子核的置换对称性支配，尽管刚性和半刚性分子通常只实现完整对称群的一个真子群。在 Schmiedt、Jensen 和 Schlemmer 的 Schur-Weyl 框架基础上，我们将这一方法扩展到其转振运动实现循环和二面体置换子群的分子几何。通过将 n 自旋希尔伯特空间的 Schur-Weyl 分解与用于限制 S_N 下箭头 Cₘ 的 Kraśkiewicz-Weyman-Adin-Roichman 主指标分支规则相结合，我们得到了一种完全组合化的方法，用于确定核自旋对称种类和统计权重。每个标准杨表都对应一个由其主指标确定的明确循环特征标，而反射给出相应的二面体对称性，因此无需投影算符或针对个案的构造，即可直接由杨表数据得到核自旋种类。对 XeOF₄、SF₄、苯、氘代苯和卓鎓阳离子的应用表明，该方法可统一适用于现实分子点群，并在给出透明的自旋分辨结构的同时复现已确立的统计权重。该方法提供了转振谱线强度建模所需的对称性信息，并为多原子分子的核自旋对称性分析提供了实用且可自动化的框架。

articles.title: A Scale-Invariant Theory of the Universe
articles.title_zh: 一种尺度不变的宇宙理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05929v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern physics has achieved extraordinary empirical success while retaining much of the absolute, unobservable structure introduced by Newton, largely without questioning its necessity. We investigate how far this structure can be eliminated by adopting a relational ontology guided by Leibniz's principle of sufficient reason. Removing absolute position, orientation, time and, finally, scale leads naturally to a formulation of the gravitational N-body problem where only dimensionless ratios are physically meaningful. Within this framework, the scale-invariant variety V becomes a central quantity, providing a measure of structure, a natural ordering of shapes, and an emergent gravitational arrow of time. We argue that the resulting formulation unifies classes of Newtonian solutions previously regarded as distinct, uncovering a possible new symmetry, suggests a notion of explanation based on timeless spatial correlations rather than temporal evolution, and points towards a more economical ontology. Although developed in the context of Newtonian gravity, the principles proposed here may also offer a new perspective on general relativity and quantum mechanics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从关系本体论与莱布尼茨充足理由原则出发，探讨现代物理中绝对位置、取向、时间和尺度等不可观测结构能在多大程度上被消除。作者提出在引力 N 体问题中仅无量纲比值具有物理意义，并以尺度不变的“多样性”作为结构度量、形状排序和涌现引力时间箭头的核心。该框架可能统一若干以往被视为不同的牛顿解类型，并为广义相对论和量子力学提供新的视角。
authors: Julian Barbour, Maria I. R. Lourenço
articles.abstract_zh_full: 现代物理取得了非凡的经验成功，同时仍保留了牛顿引入的大量绝对且不可观测的结构，并且在很大程度上没有质疑其必要性。我们研究在由莱布尼茨充足理由原则引导的关系本体论下，这种结构能够被消除到何种程度。去除绝对位置、取向、时间以及最终的尺度，自然导向一种引力 N 体问题的表述，其中只有无量纲比值具有物理意义。在这一框架中，尺度不变的多样性 V 成为一个核心量，它提供了结构的度量、形状的自然排序以及一种涌现的引力时间箭头。我们认为，由此得到的表述统一了以往被视为彼此不同的牛顿解类别，揭示了一种可能的新对称性，提出了一种基于无时间空间关联而非时间演化的解释观念，并指向一种更经济的本体论。尽管这些思想是在牛顿引力的背景下发展出来的，本文提出的原则也可能为广义相对论和量子力学提供新的视角。

articles.title: One Qubit Can Beat One Bit: Quantum Advantage for Post-Training Quantization
articles.title_zh: 一个量子比特可以胜过一个比特：后训练量化中的量子优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05240v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: One-bit post-training quantization represents each weight using only its sign, requiring all deployment contexts to share the same binary weight matrix even when their activation statistics favor different sign patterns. We study this shared-sign constraint and introduce Quantum Random Access Quantization (QRAQ). This framework encodes context-dependent signs in a quantum random-access code and retrieves them via context-matched Pauli measurements. Under an explicit fresh-copy logical readout model, QRAQ produces an unbiased, context-specific binary surrogate with a tractable shot-noise penalty. We prove a row-wise separation from shared-sign one-bit PTQ with signed per-row scales. When the optimal context-wise signs are incompatible, QRAQ achieves a strictly lower ideal reconstruction risk. We also derive finite-shot and calibrated-noise conditions under which this separation is retained. Fixed-readout quantum schemes are classically simulable, so the relevant resource in this model is measurement incompatibility rather than quantization alone. Finally, we characterize the role of scale granularity, provide finite-sample certificates, and evaluate the predicted ideal, finite-shot, noisy, and multi-context regimes in simulator experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究一比特后训练量化中所有部署上下文必须共享同一二值权重矩阵所带来的“共享符号”约束，并提出量子随机访问量化（QRAQ）。QRAQ 将上下文相关的符号编码进量子随机访问码，并通过匹配上下文的 Pauli 测量读取，从而生成无偏的上下文特定二值替代权重。作者证明在符号需求不兼容时，QRAQ 相比共享符号一比特 PTQ 具有严格更低的理想重构风险，并分析了有限测量、噪声、尺度粒度与实验仿真情形。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一比特后训练量化仅使用权重的符号来表示每个权重，要求所有部署上下文共享同一个二值权重矩阵，即使它们的激活统计特性偏好不同的符号模式。我们研究这一共享符号约束，并引入量子随机访问量化（QRAQ）。该框架将依赖上下文的符号编码在量子随机访问码中，并通过与上下文匹配的 Pauli 测量将其取回。在一个显式的新副本逻辑读出模型下，QRAQ 产生一种无偏的、上下文特定的二值替代表示，并带有可处理的抽样噪声惩罚。我们证明了它与带符号逐行尺度的共享符号一比特 PTQ 之间存在逐行分离。当最优的逐上下文符号彼此不兼容时，QRAQ 实现严格更低的理想重构风险。我们还推导了有限抽样和校准噪声条件，在这些条件下这种分离得以保持。固定读出的量子方案可由经典方式模拟，因此在该模型中相关资源是测量不相容性，而不仅仅是量化本身。最后，我们刻画了尺度粒度的作用，提供了有限样本证书，并在模拟器实验中评估了所预测的理想、有限抽样、含噪和多上下文状态。

articles.title: Provably Efficient Self-Calibrating Quantum Fault Tolerance
articles.title_zh: 可证明高效的自校准量子容错
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.05686v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum error correction protects logical information only when every physical operation remains below the fault-tolerance threshold, a condition that must be maintained continuously rather than only at the initial calibration. In practice, however, analog control parameters inevitably drift because of environmental fluctuations. As future fault-tolerant quantum computations are expected to run for days or even months, interrupting computation for repeated recalibration becomes fundamentally impractical. A promising alternative is to integrate calibration directly into computation by repurposing syndrome measurements as a calibration signal (Sivak et al, Nature 2026), but whether such self-calibration can be achieved with provable efficiency remains an open question. Here we establish a theoretical framework for self-calibrating quantum fault tolerance. We prove that, for a broad class of control-induced errors, the detection rate defines a locally strongly convex surrogate objective for analog calibration with high probability. This geometric property enables efficient online optimization using only syndrome measurements collected during normal error correction. We prove convergence to an ǎrepsilon detection rate within O(1/ǎrepsilon²⁾ epochs for time-independent drifts and also establish guarantees for time-dependent drifts. We further show that the convergence rate is independent of the code distance for quantum low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes. Pulse-level simulations of neutral-atom arrays and large-scale circuit-level Clifford simulations confirm these theoretical predictions. Our results establish self-calibrating fault tolerance as a provably efficient paradigm in which the same syndrome measurements simultaneously protect logical information and stabilize the underlying hardware.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对容错量子计算中物理操作参数会随环境漂移而需持续保持在阈值以下的问题，建立了自校准量子容错的理论框架。作者证明，对广泛的控制诱导误差，探测率可高概率地定义一个局部强凸的模拟校准目标，从而可仅用常规纠错中的综合征测量进行高效在线优化。理论结果给出静态和时变漂移下的收敛保证，并由中性原子阵列脉冲级仿真和大规模 Clifford 电路仿真验证。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子纠错只有在每个物理操作都保持在容错阈值以下时才能保护逻辑信息，而这一条件必须持续维持，而不能只在初始校准时满足。然而在实践中，模拟控制参数不可避免地会因环境波动而发生漂移。由于未来的容错量子计算预计将运行数天甚至数月，中断计算以进行反复重新校准从根本上变得不切实际。一个有前景的替代方案是将校准直接整合进计算之中，即把综合征测量重新用作校准信号（Sivak 等，Nature 2026），但这种自校准是否能够以可证明的高效方式实现仍是一个开放问题。在这里，我们建立了一个自校准量子容错的理论框架。我们证明，对于一大类由控制引起的误差，探测率以高概率为模拟校准定义了一个局部强凸的替代目标。这一几何性质使得只使用正常纠错过程中收集到的综合征测量即可进行高效在线优化。我们证明，对于与时间无关的漂移，在 O(1/ε²) 个时期内收敛到 ε 探测率，并且也为随时间变化的漂移建立了保证。我们进一步表明，对于量子低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）码，收敛速率与码距无关。中性原子阵列的脉冲级模拟和大规模电路级 Clifford 模拟证实了这些理论预测。我们的结果确立了自校准容错作为一种可证明高效的范式，在这一范式中，同一组综合征测量同时保护逻辑信息并稳定底层硬件。

articles.title: Tytan: Interactive Neurosymbolic Construction of Analytic Semantic Schemas from Relational Data
articles.title_zh: Tytan：从关系数据交互式神经符号构建分析语义模式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.06331v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: From natural-language query interfaces to automated report generation, data analysis tools need a description of the data: the real-world entities it contains, which columns function as measures or identifiers, and how tables connect into units of analysis. Today, this semantic layer is usually written by hand. This is a knowledge-acquisition bottleneck that limits the scalability of analytic systems, keeps non-technical users dependent on experts, and is itself error-prone. We present TYTAN, a system for automatically constructing an analytic semantic schema from a relational database and, when available, a short user-provided description. TYTAN combines symbolic analysis of the database with LLM-based semantic inference for entity proposal, role assignment, and naming. When the evidence leaves a decision ambiguous, TYTAN asks the user a targeted natural-language question. We evaluate TYTAN on eight databases spanning real-world and benchmark domains along the three axes that define a schema's functional utility: (i) coverage, are all important entities and features captured?; (ii) retrieval correctness, do the schema's instructions actually reach the data; and (iii) characterization accuracy, are semantic types correct? Across the seven reference domains, TYTAN reaches every entity, attribute, and aggregable feature of the expert-corrected reference schemas (100% coverage). Additionally, 100% of its retrieval instructions execute correctly (1,678 of 1,678 self-generated claims), and semantic roles agree with the reference on 92-100% of matched attributes. Checking the underlying data showed the small disagreement is in the reference, not in TYTAN. On a held-out blind test (a live, ten-table database with no declared keys), TYTAN recovers the full entity structure with verified keys and satisfies 100% of the satisfiable expectations of five independent blind annotators.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 TYTAN，用于从关系数据库及可选的简短用户描述中自动构建分析语义模式，以缓解语义层手工编写带来的知识获取瓶颈。系统结合数据库符号分析与大语言模型语义推断，并在证据不足时向用户提出定向自然语言问题。评估显示，TYTAN 在多个真实与基准数据库上实现高覆盖率、检索指令完全可执行，并在盲测数据库中恢复完整实体结构。
authors: Donna Hooshmand, Shubham Shahi, Cameron Barrie, Abhratanu Dutta, Marko Sterbentz, Harper Pack, Kristian J. Hammond
articles.abstract_zh_full: 从自然语言查询接口到自动报告生成，数据分析工具都需要对数据进行描述：其中包含的现实世界实体，哪些列作为度量或标识符，以及表如何连接成分析单元。如今，这一语义层通常由人工编写。这是一个知识获取瓶颈，它限制了分析系统的可扩展性，使非技术用户依赖专家，并且其本身也容易出错。我们提出 TYTAN，这是一个用于从关系数据库以及在可用时由用户提供的简短描述中自动构建分析语义模式的系统。TYTAN 将数据库的符号分析与基于大语言模型的语义推断相结合，用于实体提议、角色分配和命名。当证据使某个决策存在歧义时，TYTAN 会向用户提出一个有针对性的自然语言问题。我们在跨越真实世界和基准领域的八个数据库上评估 TYTAN，评估沿着定义模式功能效用的三个轴进行：（i）覆盖率，是否捕获了所有重要实体和特征；（ii）检索正确性，模式的指令是否确实能够到达数据；以及（iii）表征准确性，语义类型是否正确。在七个参考领域中，TYTAN 覆盖了专家校正参考模式中的每一个实体、属性和可聚合特征（100% 覆盖率）。此外，它的检索指令 100% 能够正确执行（1,678 条自生成声明中的 1,678 条），并且语义角色在匹配属性上与参考的一致率为 92–100%。对底层数据的检查表明，少量不一致来自参考，而非 TYTAN。在一个留出的盲测中（一个实时的、包含十张表且没有声明键的数据库），TYTAN 恢复了完整实体结构及经验证的键，并满足了五名独立盲注释者提出的所有可满足期望的 100%。

articles.title: On the Symplectic Propagation of the Spin-MInt Algorithm for Non-Adiabatic Quantum Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 用于非绝热量子动力学的 Spin-MInt 算法的辛传播性质
articles.abstract: Mapping methods are often used for the numerical simulation of nonadiabatic systems by propagating classical mapping variable trajectories. A recently popularised mapping method is spin-mapping, whose mapping variables arise from quantum mechanical operators with symmetries described by a Lie-Poisson algebra. Simulating the classical-like dynamics of spin-mapping systems accurately is generally challenging, with many methods unable to preserve the underlying geometric structure of the symplectic form. The Spin-MInt algorithm is a recently proposed algorithm propagating spin-mapping variables, with a direct proof of symplecticity existing only for 2 electronic states. Here, we directly prove the symplecticity of the Spin-MInt algorithm for a general K electronic states. A review of the symplectic nature of coadjoint orbits of the su(K) Lie-Poisson algebra provides the framework needed to understand symplecticity of the Spin-MInt algorithm in this general case. The symplecticity of the method on the associated coadjoint orbit is then shown for what we believe to be the first time via an explicit verification of the symplecticity condition MJMT = J exploiting the Lie-Poisson structure of the system. To our knowledge, this is the first time the monodromy matrix for the Spin-MInt algorithm has been explicitly stated using canonical coordinates on the coherent state manifold for a general number of states. We hope that this will assist the development of classical-like spin-mapping methods which might utilise elements of the monodromy matrix, and inform future work on similar symplectic algorithms for coupled and uncoupled Lie-Poisson systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究非绝热体系数值模拟中的自旋映射方法，重点证明 Spin-MInt 算法在一般 K 个电子态情形下的辛性。作者回顾 su(K) Lie-Poisson 代数余伴随轨道的辛结构，并利用系统的 Lie-Poisson 结构显式验证辛条件。该工作给出了任意态数下相干态流形正则坐标中的 Spin-MInt 单值矩阵表达，有助于发展保持几何结构的类经典自旋映射算法。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 映射方法常用于通过传播经典映射变量轨迹来对非绝热体系进行数值模拟。近来受到关注的一种映射方法是自旋映射，其映射变量源自量子力学算符，这些算符的对称性由 Lie-Poisson 代数描述。准确模拟自旋映射体系的类经典动力学通常具有挑战性，许多方法无法保持辛形式的底层几何结构。Spin-MInt 算法是一种近期提出的用于传播自旋映射变量的算法，但其辛性的直接证明此前仅存在于 2 个电子态的情形。在这里，我们直接证明了 Spin-MInt 算法对于一般 K 个电子态的辛性。对 su(K) Lie-Poisson 代数余伴随轨道的辛性质的回顾，为理解 Spin-MInt 算法在这一一般情形中的辛性提供了所需框架。随后，我们通过利用体系的 Lie-Poisson 结构显式验证辛条件 MJMT = J，展示了该方法在相关余伴随轨道上的辛性，据我们所知这是首次实现。就我们所知，这也是首次使用相干态流形上的正则坐标，在一般态数情形下明确给出 Spin-MInt 算法的单值矩阵。我们希望这将有助于发展可能利用单值矩阵要素的类经典自旋映射方法，并为未来关于耦合与非耦合 Lie-Poisson 体系中类似辛算法的研究提供参考。

articles.title: Cosmic Inflation With Massive Kaluza-Klein Scalar As Inflaton
articles.title_zh: 以有质量 Kaluza-Klein 标量作为暴胀子的宇宙暴胀
articles.abstract: A Kaluza-Klein model for inflation is developed by adding mass to the scalar field associated with the fifth metric component. The resulting equation for time evolution of the scalar field differs from that usually encountered in inflation models. This article shows that this model provides inflation consistent with observation and provides a suitable background for quantum-mechanical fluctuations. The resulting curvature spectrum can yield the observed scalar spectral index with negligible running, and the tensor-to-scalar ratio is 0.002, corresponding to a level of primordial gravitational radiation much lower than current measurement bounds.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文通过为与第五个度规分量相关的标量场加入质量，构建了一个 Kaluza-Klein 暴胀模型。所得标量场时间演化方程不同于常见暴胀模型，并被作者用于说明该模型可与观测相容且可作为量子力学涨落的背景。该模型产生的曲率谱可给出观测到的标量谱指数、可忽略的跑动，以及低于当前观测上限的张标比。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文通过向与第五个度规分量相关的标量场加入质量，发展了一个用于暴胀的 Kaluza-Klein 模型。由此得到的标量场随时间演化方程不同于暴胀模型中通常遇到的方程。本文表明，该模型提供了与观测相一致的暴胀，并为量子力学涨落提供了合适背景。所得曲率谱能够产生观测到的标量谱指数且具有可忽略的跑动，张量标量比为 0.002，对应于远低于当前测量界限的原初引力辐射水平。

articles.title: Binding PQC to Copyleft via QGPL and Evaluating Quantum-Safe Distribution Integrity
articles.title_zh: 通过 QGPL 将后量子密码绑定到 Copyleft 并评估量子安全的分发完整性
articles.abstract: The post-quantum transition is usually framed as a confidentiality problem 'harvest now, decrypt later'. Its integrity dual is less discussed but structurally identical. A classical asymmetric signature attached to a released dataset today is forgeable by a future quantum computer, allowing an adversary to substitute the artifact without detection. For open science, whose archival horizons routinely exceed the security horizon of the primitives that protect distributions at release, this is a live threat. This work introduces the Quantum General Public License (QGPL) v3.0, making post-quantum (PQ) distribution integrity a copyleft condition, and evaluates its compliance toolkit. The method combines ML-DSA and SLH-DSA signatures, JCS-canonicalized JSON manifests, a two-tier offline-root key hierarchy, and strictly additive hybrid signatures. On commodity ARM64 hardware, ML-DSA-65 signs in 0.72 ms and verifies in 0.37 ms; adding Ed25519 increases signature size by 64 bytes and the sign-verify path by under 0.3 ms. Aggregate manifests amortize metadata to 148 bytes per artifact for 1,000 files. The verifier correctly classified all conformance cases, and PQ-only verification recovered a hybrid release after classical-component failure. These results demonstrate that license-propagated post-quantum integrity is practical for long-term scientific artifact distribution without centralized infrastructure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，后量子转型不仅涉及“先收集、后解密”的保密性问题，也涉及当前经典签名在未来量子计算机面前可被伪造的分发完整性风险。作者提出 Quantum General Public License（QGPL）v3.0，将后量子分发完整性作为 copyleft 条件，并评估了相应合规工具链。结果表明，结合 ML-DSA、SLH-DSA、规范化清单、离线根密钥层级和加性混合签名，可在普通 ARM64 硬件上实现实用的长期科学制品分发完整性保护。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 后量子转型通常被表述为“现在收集、以后解密”的保密性问题。其完整性对偶问题较少被讨论，但在结构上完全相同。今天附加在已发布数据集上的经典非对称签名，未来可被量子计算机伪造，从而使攻击者能够在不被发现的情况下替换该制品。对于开放科学而言，其归档期限通常超过发布时保护分发所用原语的安全期限，因此这是一个现实威胁。本文引入 Quantum General Public License（QGPL）v3.0，将后量子（PQ）分发完整性作为 copyleft 条件，并评估其合规工具包。该方法结合了 ML-DSA 和 SLH-DSA 签名、JCS 规范化 JSON 清单、两层离线根密钥层级以及严格加性的混合签名。在普通 ARM64 硬件上，ML-DSA-65 签名耗时 0.72 毫秒，验证耗时 0.37 毫秒；加入 Ed25519 会使签名大小增加 64 字节，并使签名—验证路径增加不到 0.3 毫秒。聚合清单在 1,000 个文件上将元数据摊销到每个制品 148 字节。验证器正确分类了所有符合性案例，并且在经典组件失效后，仅后量子验证恢复了一个混合发布。这些结果表明，在没有中心化基础设施的情况下，通过许可证传播的后量子完整性对于长期科学制品分发是切实可行的。

articles.title: Anharmonic dephasing in the electron-phonon interaction
articles.title_zh: 电子—声子相互作用中的非谐退相干
articles.abstract: Author(s): Mingran Kong and Bartomeu Monserrat The electron-phonon interaction governs superconductivity, electrical transport, and the optical response of solids, and is now routinely computed from first principles. These calculations typically assume that lattice vibrations live forever, but in reality anharmonic interactions between phonons give them finite lifetimes. The authors derive here a tractable expression that includes this phonon dephasing into the electron-phonon scattering rate, implement it within standard computational workflows, and apply it to silicon, silicon carbide, and lead telluride, thus opening a long-neglected regime to systematic first-principles study. [Phys. Rev. B 114, 084303] Published Fri Aug 07, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 电子—声子相互作用控制着超导、电输运和固体光学响应，并且如今通常可从第一性原理计算获得。传统计算常假设晶格振动寿命无限，而该研究将由声子—声子非谐相互作用导致的有限声子寿命纳入电子—声子散射率。作者推导了可处理的理论表达式，将其并入标准计算流程，并应用于硅、碳化硅和碲化铅。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 作者：Mingran Kong 和 Bartomeu Monserrat。电子—声子相互作用支配着超导性、电输运以及固体的光学响应，并且现在通常可以从第一性原理进行计算。这些计算通常假设晶格振动永远存在，但在现实中，声子之间的非谐相互作用会赋予它们有限寿命。作者在此推导出一个可处理的表达式，将这种声子退相干纳入电子—声子散射率之中，并在标准计算工作流程中实现了它，随后将其应用于硅、碳化硅和碲化铅，从而使一个长期被忽视的领域能够接受系统性的第一性原理研究。[《Physical Review B》114, 084303] 2026年8月7日星期五发表。
