articles.title: Variational adaptive Gaussian decomposition: Scalable quadrature-free time-sliced thawed Gaussian dynamics
articles.abstract: Time-slicing has emerged as a strategy for incorporating semiclassical propagation into real-time path integral formulation and recovering full quantum dynamics. A central step is the decomposition of a time-evolved wave function into a superposition of Gaussian wave packets (GWPs). Here, we introduce a quadrature-free variational framework for GWP decomposition, reformulating it as an optimization problem in which the GWP parameters are chosen to maximize the overlap with the time-evolving wave function. An autoencoder–decoder neural network is used for this optimization, with the representation being adaptively reoptimized during propagation. Each wave packet in this decomposition represents a localized patch of the underlying semiclassical manifold, while retaining full correlations between all degrees of freedom. This variational adaptive Gaussian decomposition (VAGD) approach yields a compact Gaussian expansion, providing a scalable route to time-sliced semiclassical quantum dynamics. While general, applying VAGD to facilitate time-slicing of thawed Gaussian dynamics allows a route to improving the semiclassical treatment to the full quantum mechanical result in a systematic manner.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Enhanced oxygen evolution reaction via the tunability of spin and electronic states in a flexible van der Waals membranous catalyst
articles.abstract: Perovskite transition metal oxide membranes with exact chemical composition and ordered lattice structures facilitate atomic-level catalytic mechanisms in diverse electrochemical processes, thus aiding in the development and design of potential catalysts. Nevertheless, the puzzling ascendancy of spin in the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) process remains an enigma owing to the robust correlation between TM 4 d and oxygen 2 p orbitals. Herein, we employed SrRuO 3 (SRO) with 4 d electron states as a ferromagnetic catalyst for the OER, which were deposited onto the flexible mica substrates. By applying compressive or tensile stresses to the SRO film, the bipolar enhancement of OER activity was observed. At the potential of 1.8 V, the current density ( j ) of SRO enhanced by ∼34% or ∼44%, with a 0.2% compressive or tensile strain, respectively, attributing to the diminished chemisorption of Ru–O. In addition, it was found that j enhanced by ∼86% or ∼104% and the overpotential reduced by ∼20% or ∼26% at a 0.2% compressive or tensile strain with a 13 kOe in-plane (IP) magnetic field, respectively. Those were attributing to the enhancement of the double exchange effect and the concentration of O 2 2− in SRO, thus promoting electron transfer and regulating the adsorption/desorption capacity of reaction intermediates, respectively. Moreover, the magnetohydrodynamic-induced bubble effect is one of the factors that enhance the electrocatalytic activity. This investigation offers experimental evidence to comprehend the regulation of spin degree and electronic state during OER, hence advancing the design and engineering of the flexible magnetoelectrochemistry catalysts with encouraging prospects.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Orbital angular momentum textures and currents in a discrete helix: Equilibrium and linear response
articles.abstract: Recently, nonequilibrium orbital angular momentum in low-dimensional systems has attracted renewed attention. Here, we introduce a minimal three-orbital tight-binding model for a single helical chain and show that chirality alone generates a momentum-dependent orbital-angular-momentum texture through Slater–Koster hybridization in the local basis ( p r , p ϕ , p z ), without requiring atomic spin–orbit coupling. In the single-helix geometry, the radial orbital texture vanishes identically, while the azimuthal and longitudinal components remain finite and arise from the odd-in-momentum ( p z , p r ) and ( p r , p ϕ ) sectors. As a result, the equilibrium average orbital texture vanishes by parity, although persistent-like orbital angular momentum currents may still exist and imply chirality-dependent end magnetization in a finite helix. Under an applied longitudinal electric field, the system develops a finite orbital Edelstein response, whereas the projected longitudinal orbital conductivity vanishes in the linear regime by parity. When spin degrees of freedom are included, the orbital texture acts as a source of spin polarization through orbital-to-spin transduction. Instead of being limited by the weak, natural spin–orbit coupling of individual atoms, the overall spin response is driven by the much stronger interactions of overlapping molecular orbitals, making it a stronger candidate for spin injection than the conventional spin Edelstein mechanism. These results identify chirality as the minimal microscopic ingredient for generating orbital angular momentum response in one-dimensional systems and support an orbital route to spin selectivity in chiral conductors.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Modulating intermolecular interactions and vibrational energy transfer in energetic systems with external electric fields
articles.abstract: The controllable application and property modulation of energetic materials is a long-standing challenge, as their macroscopic behavior fundamentally depends on structures formed by microscopic intermolecular interactions and the accompanying vibrational energy transfer (VET). Here, we present the regulatory capability of external electric fields (EEFs) toward intermolecular interactions and VET in energetic systems. First-principles structural studies confirm that EEFs applied parallel or antiparallel to the system dipole reshape binding properties by modulating intermolecular interaction contributions. Furthermore, first-principles molecular dynamics simulations reveal that fields aligned with the dipole promote vibrational energy accumulation on intermolecular N–N trigger bonds. This phenomenon, driven by field-induced reshaping of potential energy surfaces, is evidenced by short-time Fourier transform VET spectra of excited C–H vibrations. Our findings highlight that EEFs can manipulate intermolecular interactions by influencing molecular dipoles at the atomic level, thereby providing a potential feasible pathway for property modulation in energetic molecular systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Evolution of the energy landscape for n -alkanes: n -C 14 H 30 to n -C 20 H 42
articles.abstract: Unbranched n -alkanes provide useful models for investigating how conformational complexity evolves with chain length. In this work, we examine the energy landscapes of n -C 14 H 30 to n -C 20 H 42 with a Δ-corrected transferable many-body permutationally invariant polynomial potential, explored with the Cambridge Energy Landscape software. Basin-hopping global optimization was used to identify low energy minima, and discrete path sampling was employed to construct kinetic transition networks connecting the conformational families. We find that the lowest energy family changes systematically with chain length: extended all- trans structures are most favorable for n -C 14 H 30 , hairpin structures are favored for n -C 15 H 32 to n -C 17 H 36 , and a more compact folded conformation becomes the global minimum on the MB-PIP surface from n -C 18 H 38 onward. Additional DLPNO-CCSD(T1)-F12 calculations suggest that the hairpin conformer is actually more stable for these longer chains, but the compact conformations are still relevant. Analysis of the pathways connecting representative minima reveals that interconversion proceeds through multistep paths that become increasingly complex with chain length. Disconnectivity graphs further reveal competing low energy funnels, indicating that increasing chain length reorganizes, not only relative stability, but also the underlying landscape. For n -C 18 H 38 , we further analyzed first-passage times and heat capacity signatures to characterize the kinetic and thermodynamic features of the multifunnel organization. Relaxation to the global minimum occurs over a broad range of timescales, and a low-temperature heat capacity feature arises from configurational redistribution among competing low energy minima and funnels. Overall, this study provides a detailed picture of how folding behavior, landscape organization, and the associated kinetics and thermodynamics evolve with chain length in n -alkanes.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: The rocky path of DFT into chemistry—Discussions at a symposium and reflections on a circular journey in honor of Axel Becke 1953–2025
articles.abstract: We summarize a recent symposium on density functional theory for electronic structure in chemical applications and honor a key contributor, Axel Becke. The theory of electronic structure is entirely quantum mechanical and, in its original wave function form, runs into mathematical and numerical problems due to high spatial dimensionality, as each electron adds three new coordinates. The approximate reduction of dimensionality in the form of density functional theory (DFT) was first proposed in the mid-1920s but took 40 years to be verified as possible in principle. The development of increasingly accurate functionals, expressing the electronic energy in terms of the density of the electrons, was initially driven by the physics community, but after a series of innovations, including (i) going from local to non-local exchange–correlation energy functionals and (ii) partial retention of exact exchange in terms of wave functions, there was a breakthrough in the early 1990s, and leading quantum chemists accepted DFT. The resulting improved ability to solve chemical problems by computation was rewarded with a Nobel Prize to Walter Kohn and John Pople in 1998. Given the many controversies surrounding the introduction of DFT into chemistry, a symposium was held at the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences on November 7 and 8, 2024, to look back at the barriers and breakthroughs and identify the key contributors and their advancements. Axel Becke played a major role in bringing DFT into chemistry. We record the unique breadth and depth of the discussions at the symposium and the role of Becke, whose life ended a year thereafter.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Harmonic-oscillator-referenced ring-polymer molecular dynamics. I. Practical computation of correlation functions
articles.title_zh: 以谐振子为参照的环聚合物分子动力学 I：相关函数的实用计算
articles.abstract: We present a practical formulation of harmonic-oscillator-referenced ring-polymer molecular dynamics (RPMD) for the calculation of linear and nonlinear real-time correlation functions under quantum statistical conditions. The method is formulated as a direct extension of standard RPMD but incorporates three coordinated modifications aimed at observables for which a direct ring-polymer average is either inconvenient or strongly contaminated by internal-mode artifacts. First, the imaginary-time distribution is built from an exact harmonic oscillator reference rather than the primitive free particle Trotter factorization so that the exact harmonic canonical variance is already recovered at a finite bead number. Second, the real-time dynamics is centroid-anchored, ensuring that the slow collective mode evolves on the physical timescale while the internal modes remain statistically organized by the reference quadratic form. Third, nonlinear observables are reconstructed from the anchored linear correlation and sampled static moments through a Gaussian moment reconstruction. In the present work, this reconstruction is used primarily for canonical/Wigner-type correlation functions, while a Kubo mixed-moment reconstruction is retained as a special harmonic benchmark. The resulting scheme preserves the familiar ring-polymer workflow, is straightforward to incorporate into existing RPMD implementations, and provides a practical route to higher moments such as x(0)x(t)3 and related mixed correlations. We present the working formulation, implementation strategy, and benchmark structure for harmonic, mildly anharmonic, and strongly anharmonic quartic model systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种以谐振子为参照的环聚合物分子动力学（RPMD）实用形式，用于在量子统计条件下计算线性和非线性实时相关函数。该方法在标准RPMD基础上引入谐振子参考的虚时采样、质心锚定的实时动力学以及基于高斯矩的非线性可观测量重构。作者给出了工作公式、实现策略，并针对谐振、弱非谐和强非谐四次模型体系设计了基准测试框架。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种以谐振子为参照的环聚合物分子动力学（RPMD）的实用表述，用于在量子统计条件下计算线性和非线性实时相关函数。该方法被表述为标准RPMD的直接扩展，但包含三项相互协调的修改，旨在处理那些直接环聚合物平均要么不便、要么受到内模伪影强烈污染的可观测量。首先，虚时分布由精确的谐振子参考构建，而不是由原始自由粒子Trotter分解构建，因此在有限珠子数下就已经能够恢复精确的谐振子正则方差。其次，实时动力学采用质心锚定，从而保证缓慢的集体模式在物理时间尺度上演化，而内模仍由参考二次型进行统计组织。第三，非线性可观测量通过锚定线性相关函数和采样得到的静态矩，借助高斯矩重构来重建。在当前工作中，这种重构主要用于正则/Wigner型相关函数，而Kubo混合矩重构则作为一种特殊的谐振基准保留。所得方案保留了熟悉的环聚合物工作流程，易于并入现有RPMD实现，并为诸如x(0)x(t)3及相关混合相关函数等高阶矩提供了一条实用途径。我们给出了谐振、轻微非谐以及强非谐四次模型体系的工作表述、实现策略和基准测试结构。

articles.title: NOPT: Quantum chemistry package for multireference perturbation theory calculations and its non-orthogonal extensions
articles.title_zh: NOPT：用于多参考微扰理论计算及其非正交扩展的量子化学程序包
articles.abstract: NOPT is an ab initio package for calculations using N on- O rthogonal methods and multireference P erturbation T heory. It can be used both as a ready-to-use quantum chemistry program and as an open-source system for modifying existing methods and developing new ones. The key functionality includes restricted Hartree–Fock, configuration interaction with single excitations, complete active space self-consistent field, and several multireference perturbation theory (MRPT) methods. The MRPT module provides extended multiconfigurational quasi-degenerate perturbation theory (XMCQDPT2), multipartitioning perturbation theory (MPPT2), and a novel variant of uncontracted MRPT—CDAS-PT2. NOPT allows one to perform a complete computational workflow starting from a molecular geometry. It also contains an interface for using data calculated by other quantum chemistry programs. The implemented non-orthogonal methods are aimed at the fragment-based calculations with multireference wave functions. All the methods are implemented with the resolution of identity approximation to gain higher performance. We hope that this makes NOPT a useful tool for the calculations with both standard and novel methods of quantum chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: NOPT是一个从头算量子化学软件包，面向非正交方法和多参考微扰理论计算。它既可作为现成程序使用，也可作为开源平台用于修改既有方法和开发新方法。该软件实现了限制性Hartree–Fock、单激发组态相互作用、CASSCF以及多种MRPT方法，并支持从分子几何出发的完整计算流程及与其他程序的数据接口。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: NOPT是一个用于采用非正交方法和多参考微扰理论进行计算的从头算程序包。它既可以作为一个即用型量子化学程序使用，也可以作为一个开源系统，用于修改现有方法和开发新方法。其关键功能包括限制性Hartree–Fock、含单激发的组态相互作用、完全活性空间自洽场，以及若干多参考微扰理论（MRPT）方法。MRPT模块提供扩展多构型准简并微扰理论（XMCQDPT2）、多分区微扰理论（MPPT2）以及一种新的未收缩MRPT变体——CDAS-PT2。NOPT允许用户从分子几何出发执行完整的计算工作流程。它还包含一个接口，用于使用其他量子化学程序计算得到的数据。所实现的非正交方法面向采用多参考波函数的基于片段的计算。所有方法均采用分辨恒等近似实现，以获得更高性能。我们希望这使NOPT成为一种有用工具，可用于采用标准和新型量子化学方法的计算。

articles.title: Singlet fission spin dynamics from molecular structure: A modular computational pipeline
articles.title_zh: 从分子结构出发的单线态裂分自旋动力学：一种模块化计算流程
articles.abstract: Singlet fission (SF), which has applications in areas ranging from solar energy to quantum information, relies critically on transitions within a multi-spin manifold. These transitions are driven by fluctuations in the spin–spin exchange interaction, which have been linked to changes in nuclear geometry or exciton migration. While simple calculations have supported this mechanism, to date, limited efforts have been made to model realistic fluctuations, which are informed by the actual structure and properties of physical materials. In this paper, we develop a modular computational pipeline for calculating SF spin dynamics by way of electronic structural calculations, molecular dynamics, and numerical models of spin dynamics. The outputs of this pipeline aid in the interpretation of measured spin dynamics and allow us to place constraints on geometric fluctuations, which are consistent with these observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一种模块化计算流程，用于通过电子结构计算、分子动力学和数值自旋动力学模型研究单线态裂分中的自旋动力学。单线态裂分依赖多自旋流形内的跃迁，而这些跃迁受自旋–自旋交换相互作用涨落驱动，并与核几何变化或激子迁移有关。该流程可帮助解释实验观测的自旋动力学，并约束与观测相一致的几何涨落。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 单线态裂分（SF）在从太阳能到量子信息等领域具有应用，它关键依赖于多自旋流形内的跃迁。这些跃迁由自旋–自旋交换相互作用的涨落所驱动，而这种涨落已被联系到核几何的变化或激子迁移。尽管简单计算已支持这一机制，但迄今为止，针对由实际物理材料的真实结构和性质所约束的真实涨落进行建模的努力仍然有限。在本文中，我们开发了一种模块化计算流程，通过电子结构计算、分子动力学和自旋动力学数值模型来计算SF自旋动力学。该流程的输出有助于解释测得的自旋动力学，并使我们能够对与这些观测相一致的几何涨落施加约束。

articles.title: UV photodissociation rates and cross sections of the NaS molecule including diabatization and spin–orbit coupling
articles.title_zh: 包含透热化与自旋–轨道耦合的NaS分子紫外光解离速率和截面
articles.abstract: Based on previously reported high-accuracy electronic states of the ΛΣ presentation, we calculate the temperature-dependent photodissociation cross sections and rates of the NaS molecule in the ultraviolet region. The calculation includes transitions from the ground state X 2 Π to several excited electronic states, up to 1 2 Δ. Particular attention is given to the nonadiabatic couplings between the 2 2 Π-3 2 Π and A 2 Σ + -2 2 Σ + states and their influence on the photodissociation dynamics. Spin–orbit coupling among the avoiding crossing electronic states and the ground state as well as the nonadiabatic couplings are incorporated through diabatic representation. Photodissociation cross sections obtained from the coupled channel calculations are compared with adiabatic results that include only spin–orbit coupling. The results show that nonadiabatic interactions significantly modify the cross sections near the avoided crossing regions and induce the pronounced Feshbach resonances. Using the local thermodynamic equilibrium cross sections, photodissociation rates of NaS are further evaluated under the standard interstellar radiation field and blackbody radiation fields. The rates show a relatively weak dependence on the molecular temperature. These results provide useful data for astrochemical modeling of NaS in ultraviolet radiation environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 基于先前报道的高精度ΛΣ表示电子态，本文计算了NaS分子在紫外区域的温度依赖光解离截面和速率。研究纳入了非绝热耦合和自旋–轨道耦合，并比较了耦合通道结果与仅含自旋–轨道耦合的绝热结果。结果表明，非绝热相互作用会显著改变避免交叉区域附近的截面并诱导明显的Feshbach共振，所得速率数据可用于紫外辐射环境下NaS的天体化学建模。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于先前报道的ΛΣ表示下的高精度电子态，我们计算了NaS分子在紫外区域的温度依赖光解离截面和速率。计算包括从基态X 2Π到若干激发电子态的跃迁，最高至1 2Δ。特别关注2 2Π-3 2Π和A 2Σ+ -2 2Σ+态之间的非绝热耦合及其对光解离动力学的影响。避免交叉电子态之间以及这些态与基态之间的自旋–轨道耦合和非绝热耦合通过透热表示纳入。将耦合通道计算得到的光解离截面与仅包含自旋–轨道耦合的绝热结果进行比较。结果表明，非绝热相互作用显著改变了避免交叉区域附近的截面，并诱导出明显的Feshbach共振。利用局域热力学平衡截面，进一步在标准星际辐射场和黑体辐射场下评估了NaS的光解离速率。这些速率对分子温度表现出相对较弱的依赖性。这些结果为紫外辐射环境中NaS的天体化学建模提供了有用数据。

articles.title: Revisiting the electronic structure of PtO: Cryogenic photoelectron spectroscopy and relativistic insights
articles.title_zh: 重新审视PtO的电子结构：低温光电子能谱与相对论见解
articles.abstract: We investigate the electronic structure of PtO via cryogenic anion photoelectron spectroscopy combined with relativistic multireference calculations, clarifying long-standing ambiguities in the assignment of its low-lying electronic manifold. Vibrationally resolved spectra covering the low-lying states are obtained via 193 nm photodetachment and 400 nm velocity map imaging (VMI) of PtO − anions cooled to 13 K. The adiabatic and vertical detachment energies are measured to be 2.16 and 2.29 eV, respectively, in good agreement with relativistic SOC-NEVPT2 predictions within 0.12 eV. High-resolution VMI reveals a fine-structure splitting of 1008 ± 30 cm −1 in the X3Σ− ground state, quantitatively reproduced by SOC-NEVPT2 as a 959 cm −1 second-order spin–orbit splitting. The two components display nearly identical vibrational structure, confirmed by Franck–Condon simulations. At higher binding energy, an intense σ-detachment feature is observed at 3.27 eV, providing a decisive spectroscopic anchor for reassessing the electronic manifold. Together with theoretical results, this feature establishes that the band at 2.73 eV corresponds to the A1Δ singlet state rather than to a widely split 3 Π-state manifold, as previously proposed. These results establish a revised, experimentally benchmarked electronic structure of PtO and demonstrate that cryogenic cooling combined with high-energy photodetachment is essential for resolving spin-orbit-coupled manifolds in heavy transition-metal oxides.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合低温阴离子光电子能谱和相对论多参考计算，研究PtO的电子结构，并澄清其低能电子态归属中的长期争议。13 K冷却的PtO−阴离子经193 nm光脱附和400 nm速度映射成像测得振动分辨谱，实验能量与SOC-NEVPT2预测符合良好。研究修正了PtO低能电子流形的归属，并表明低温冷却与高能光脱附对于解析重过渡金属氧化物中的自旋–轨道耦合态至关重要。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过低温阴离子光电子能谱并结合相对论多参考计算研究PtO的电子结构，澄清其低能电子流形归属中长期存在的模糊性。通过对冷却至13 K的PtO−阴离子进行193 nm光脱附和400 nm速度映射成像（VMI），获得了覆盖低能态的振动分辨谱。测得的绝热和垂直脱附能分别为2.16和2.29 eV，与相对论SOC-NEVPT2预测在0.12 eV以内良好一致。高分辨率VMI揭示了X3Σ−基态中1008 ± 30 cm−1的精细结构分裂，SOC-NEVPT2将其定量再现为959 cm−1的二阶自旋–轨道分裂。两个组分显示出几乎相同的振动结构，并由Franck–Condon模拟得到确认。在更高结合能处，观察到位于3.27 eV的强σ脱附特征，为重新评估电子流形提供了决定性的光谱锚点。结合理论结果，该特征确立了2.73 eV处的能带对应于A1Δ单重态，而不是先前提出的宽分裂3Π态流形。这些结果建立了经过实验标定的PtO修正电子结构，并证明低温冷却结合高能光脱附对于解析重过渡金属氧化物中的自旋–轨道耦合流形至关重要。

articles.title: Breaking the Passivation‐Band‐Alignment Trade‐Off in PbS Colloidal Quantum Dot Photodiodes via Gradient Doping
articles.title_zh: 通过梯度掺杂打破PbS胶体量子点光电二极管中的钝化–能带对准权衡

articles.title: Quantum fluid reveals hidden states that can be switched with a magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 量子流体揭示可由磁场切换的隐藏态
articles.abstract: Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs) are often described as a "fifth state of matter": a quantum state in which many particles lose their individual identities and behave as one collective object. For more than 60 years, researchers have sought to create such condensates from excitons—electron-hole pairs—as a solid-state route to macroscopic quantum coherence, which is useful for quantum technologies. This has been difficult to realize in controllable semiconductor devices because optically generated excitons have very short lifetimes of around a billionth of a second, and BECs are normally attained with ultracold gases in a vacuum.
articles.abstract_zh: 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）常被描述为“物质的第五态”：在这种量子态中，大量粒子失去各自的独立身份，作为一个集体对象共同表现。60多年来，研究人员一直试图从激子——电子-空穴对——构建这类凝聚体，以此作为实现宏观量子相干的固态途径，这对量子技术很有价值。然而，在可控半导体器件中实现这一目标一直很困难，因为光学产生的激子寿命极短，约为十亿分之一秒，而BEC通常是在真空中的超冷气体中获得的。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（BECs）常被描述为“物质的第五态”：一种量子态，在其中许多粒子失去各自的个体身份，并作为一个集体对象共同表现。60多年来，研究人员一直在寻找从激子——电子-空穴对——制备这类凝聚体的方法，以此作为实现宏观量子相干的一条固态路径，而这对量子技术很有用。要在可控的半导体器件中实现这一点一直很困难，因为光学产生的激子寿命极短，约为十亿分之一秒；而BEC通常是在真空中的超冷气体中获得的。

articles.title: Pushing the boundaries of ultracold neutral plasmas
articles.title_zh: 推进超冷中性等离子体的边界
articles.abstract: Using a combination of laser cooling techniques and strong magnetic fields, researchers at Colorado State University have for the first time created an ultracold neutral plasma with electrons cooled to temperatures measured to be within one degree Kelvin.
articles.abstract_zh: 科罗拉多州立大学的研究人员结合激光冷却技术和强磁场，首次制备出一种超冷中性等离子体，其中电子被冷却到测得接近1开尔文的温度。这一结果推动了超冷等离子体研究的极限，并为探索强关联等离子体物理提供了新平台。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 科罗拉多州立大学的研究人员结合激光冷却技术和强磁场，首次制备出一种超冷中性等离子体，其中电子被冷却到测得接近1开尔文的温度。这一结果推动了超冷等离子体研究的极限，并为探索强关联等离子体物理提供了新平台。

articles.title: Surface Roughness and Tool Wear Prediction in Machining of Nimonic 90 Through Machine Learning Under Various Lubrication Conditions
articles.title_zh: 通过机器学习预测不同润滑条件下Nimonic 90加工中的表面粗糙度与刀具磨损
articles.abstract: Nimonic 90 is a nickel based super alloy that is widely used in aerospace and gas turbine applications because it possesses a very high temperature strength, resistance to creep and micro structural stability. Nevertheless, these properties are advantageous making them "difficult-to-cut" materials with low thermal conductivity, quick work hardening, and excessive wear of the tools in machining. This paper includes extensive research of the machinability of Nimonic 90 in three different lubrication conditions: the traditional minimum quantity lubrication (MQL) with oil, the ionic liquid-based MQL (ILMQL) and the cryogenic liquid nitrogen (LN₂) cooling. Taguchi L 1 9 orthogonal array was adopted in the experimental design with three cutting speeds (410, 620, 830 m/min), two feed rates (0.1, 0.5 mm/rev), and constant depth of cut (0.5 mm). The machining behaviour in terms of surface roughness (Ra), flank wear (Vb) and cutting temperature was analyzed systematically. Because of the cost limitation of machining super alloy experimentally, the original sample size of 18 samples was enriched to 27 samples through a powerful Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) framework. A 5-fold cross-validation strategy was strictly performed on four machine learning algorithms namely Linear Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). The outcomes of the experiment show that cryogenic LN₂ machining produced a better surface topography (Ra = 0.45 µm), lower tool wear (73% less than oil-based machining), and improved microstructure refinement. The XGBoost model had a better predictive performance with R2 of 0.95 and RMSE of 0.12 to predict the surface roughness. The study provides a paradigm of data-driven precision machining of high-performance alloys, which can represent a direction to autonomous optimization of the process in aerospace manufacturing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了镍基高温合金 Nimonic 90 在三种润滑条件下的可加工性：传统最小量润滑（MQL）油润滑、离子液体基 MQL（ILMQL）和液氮（LN₂）低温冷却。作者采用 Taguchi L19 正交试验设计，并结合高斯过程回归扩充样本，再通过线性回归、随机森林、支持向量机和 XGBoost 等模型对表面粗糙度、刀具磨损和切削温度进行预测。结果表明，低温 LN₂ 加工可获得更好的表面质量、更低的刀具磨损；其中 XGBoost 的预测性能最佳。
articles.abstract_zh_full: Nimonic 90 是一种镍基高温合金，因其具有极高的高温强度、抗蠕变性能和微观结构稳定性而被广泛用于航空航天和燃气涡轮应用。然而，这些特性也使其成为“难切削”材料，表现为导热性低、加工硬化快以及加工过程中刀具磨损严重。本文考察了 Nimonic 90 在三种不同润滑条件下的可加工性：传统最小量润滑（MQL）油润滑、基于离子液体的 MQL（ILMQL）以及液氮（LN₂）低温冷却。实验设计采用 Taguchi L19 正交表，设置三种切削速度（410、620、830 m/min）、两种进给率（0.1、0.5 mm/rev），以及恒定切深（0.5 mm）。作者系统分析了加工行为，包括表面粗糙度（Ra）、后刀面磨损（Vb）和切削温度。由于高温合金实验加工成本限制，原始18个样本通过强大的高斯过程回归（GPR）框架扩增至27个样本。随后，针对线性回归（LR）、随机森林（RF）、支持向量机（SVM）和极端梯度提升（XGBoost）四种机器学习算法，严格实施了5折交叉验证策略。实验结果表明，低温 LN₂ 加工获得了更好的表面形貌（Ra = 0.45 µm）、更低的刀具磨损（比油基加工低73%），并改善了微观组织细化。XGBoost 模型在表面粗糙度预测方面表现更佳，R2 为0.95，RMSE 为0.12。该研究为高性能合金的数据驱动精密加工提供了一个范式，代表了航空制造中实现工艺自主优化的一个方向。

articles.title: Li 2 AgAl inverse Heusler alloy under first-principles study: structural stability, elasticity, electronic structure, optical response, and thermoelectric transport
articles.title_zh: Li₂AgAl 反式 Heusler 合金的第一性原理研究：结构稳定性、弹性、电子结构、光学响应与热电输运
articles.abstract: This work aims to explore the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical, and thermoelectric properties of the inverse Heusler alloy Li2AgAl via ab-initio DFT calculations integrated with the semiclassical Boltzmann transport model. The GGA and HSE approximations were employed to describe the exchange–correlation potential. The results confirm that Li2AgAl is thermodynamically and dynamically stable in the inverse Heusler structure and retains its thermal stability up to T = 2000 K. Mechanical analysis indicates a relatively high Young’s modulus, suggesting a rigid nature of the alloy. Electronic structure calculations reveal metallic behavior. The optical analysis shows metallic characteristics with strong absorption in the ultraviolet region. Regarding thermoelectric behavior, Li2AgAl exhibits a p-type dominant response associated with relatively high Seebeck coefficient and electrical conductivity. Overall, the results provide insight into the fundamental physical properties of Li2AgAl and may be useful for further investigations of inverse Heusler alloys in energy-related and optoelectronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文基于第一性原理密度泛函理论，并结合半经典玻尔兹曼输运模型，系统研究了逆 Heusler 合金 Li₂AgAl 的结构、力学、电子、光学和热电性质。结果表明，该合金在逆 Heusler 结构下热力学与动力学稳定，并可在最高 2000 K 下保持热稳定。其电子结构呈金属性，且在紫外区域具有强吸收特征；热电性质则表现出以 p 型为主的响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文旨在利用结合半经典玻尔兹曼输运模型的从头算密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，探索逆 Heusler 合金 Li₂AgAl 的结构、力学、电子、光学和热电性质。研究采用了 GGA 和 HSE 近似来描述交换-相关势。结果证实，Li₂AgAl 在逆 Heusler 结构中具有热力学和动力学稳定性，并且在 T = 2000 K 以内仍保持热稳定。力学分析表明该合金具有相对较高的杨氏模量，说明其具有较强的刚性。电子结构计算显示其呈现金属行为。光学分析表明该材料具有金属性特征，并在紫外区域具有强吸收。关于热电行为，Li₂AgAl 表现出以 p 型为主的响应，并伴随相对较高的塞贝克系数和电导率。总体而言，这些结果加深了对 Li₂AgAl 基本物理性质的认识，并可能有助于进一步研究用于能源和光电应用的逆 Heusler 合金。

articles.title: Chiral Ni 2+ /Yb 3+ molecular complex with room-temperature magnetic-field driven 180° polarization reversal
articles.title_zh: 具有室温磁场驱动180°极化翻转的手性 Ni²⁺/Yb³⁺ 分子复合物
articles.abstract: Publication date: September 2026 Source: Materials Today, Volume 98 Author(s): Maxim Ivanov, Maxime Aragon-Alberti, Chloé Boucleinville, Bruno Donnadieu, Vladimir A. Khomchenko, José Antonio Paixão, Paula M. Vilarinho, Mickaël Beaudhuin, Jérôme Long

articles.title: Investigation of GeSn aspect ratio trapping growth up to 8% Sn
articles.title_zh: 锡含量最高达 8% 的 GeSn 纵横比俘获生长研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02710v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Aspect ratio trapping (ART) growth of germanium-tin (GeSn) is a promising approach to target important objectives on the quest towards commercialization of complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS)-compatible GeSn optoelectronics devices. Its local growth on patterned substrate allows for versatile device integration into photonics integrated circuit or for stand-alone structure like focal plane array imager. Additionally, high aspect ratio from nano-sized window can terminate early threading dislocation propagation on the oxide sidewalls, leaving subsequent growth defect-free and potentially improving the device performance. Knowledge remains missing regarding GeSn ART growth kinetics, morphology and how they evolve from thin film growth, with successful growth itself yet to be demonstrated. In this work, we report GeSn ART growth up to 8% Sn. Two configurations -- self-induced Ge core/GeSn shell for Sn content between 6% and 8%, and bulk GeSn ART for Sn content below 1% -- are observed. We present a comprehensive study on GeSn ART growth kinetics through different growth rounds and designs, showing a link between pyramid shape of ART island and successful Sn incorporation, as well as the role of growth selectivity and local heating.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了锡含量最高达 8% 的 GeSn 纵横比俘获生长，并考察其生长动力学与形貌演化。作者观察到两种构型：6% 至 8% Sn 范围内的自诱导 Ge 核/GeSn 壳结构，以及 Sn 含量低于 1% 时的体 GeSn 纵横比俘获结构。研究还指出 ART 岛的金字塔形貌与成功掺入 Sn 相关，并讨论了生长选择性和局域加热的作用。
authors: Hryhorii Stanchu, Quang Minh Thai, Fernando M. de Oliveira, Mourad Benamara, Stephen Margiotta, Matthew Cook, Xiaoxin Wang, Jifeng Liu, Perry C. Grant, Baohua Li, Wei Du, Gregory Salamo, Shui-Qing Yu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02710v1，公告类型：新稿。摘要：锗锡（GeSn）的纵横比俘获（ART）生长是一种有前景的方法，可服务于实现与互补金属氧化物半导体（CMOS）兼容的 GeSn 光电子器件商业化进程中的重要目标。其在图案化衬底上的局域生长允许器件以多种方式集成到光子集成电路中，或形成焦平面阵列成像器等独立结构。此外，来自纳米尺寸窗口的高纵横比可使穿通位错在氧化物侧壁上较早终止传播，从而使后续生长无缺陷，并可能提升器件性能。关于 GeSn ART 生长动力学、形貌以及它们如何从薄膜生长演化而来的认识仍然缺失，且成功生长本身尚未得到展示。在本工作中，我们报道了 Sn 含量最高达 8% 的 GeSn ART 生长。我们观察到两种构型——Sn 含量在 6% 至 8% 之间的自诱导 Ge 核/GeSn 壳，以及 Sn 含量低于 1% 的体 GeSn ART。我们通过不同生长轮次和设计，对 GeSn ART 生长动力学进行了全面研究，显示了 ART 岛的金字塔形状与成功掺入 Sn 之间的联系，以及生长选择性和局域加热的作用。

articles.title: Universal crossovers in weakly-monitored quantum critical states
articles.title_zh: 弱监测量子临界态中的普适交叉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02716v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study post-measurement ensembles of ground states of tricritical and critical 1D quantum Ising Hamiltonians subjected, respectively, to weak energy and spin measurements without post-selection. These measurements act as relevant perturbations about the unmeasured critical ground states. Using finite-size renormalization group (RG) crossover analyses, we characterize their universal properties through the entanglement effective central charge, effective Affleck-Ludwig boundary entropy, and signatures of multifractality from moments of measurement-averaged correlation functions. In both cases, we find evidence for "measurement-dominated" or "measurement-altered" fixed points governed by the underlying Born-rule randomness. For critical Ising, we find a direct RG flow to a projective-measurement fixed point with area-law entanglement, whereas for the tricritical Ising model, we find evidence for a weak-measurement fixed point with logarithmic entanglement. These results clarify the RG-flow structure of weakly measured multicritical Ising ground states and show how intrinsic measurement-induced randomness can generate complex and rich universal long-distance scaling behavior in the post-measurement ensembles, accessible to controlled analytical RG and numerical finite-size RG crossover analyses.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察三临界与临界一维量子 Ising 哈密顿量基态在弱能量测量和弱自旋测量后的后测量系综，并分析这些测量作为相关微扰所导致的普适交叉行为。作者利用有限尺寸重整化群交叉分析，研究纠缠有效中心荷、有效 Affleck-Ludwig 边界熵以及测量平均关联函数矩的多重分形迹象。结果表明，测量诱导的 Born 规则随机性可产生由测量主导或测量改变的固定点，并在不同模型中导致面积律或对数纠缠等不同长距离标度行为。
authors: Abhishek Kumar, Rushikesh A. Patil, Andreas W. W. Ludwig, Romain Vasseur
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02716v1，公告类型：新稿。摘要：我们研究三临界和临界一维量子 Ising 哈密顿量基态在分别受到弱能量测量和弱自旋测量且不进行后选择时的后测量系综。这些测量作为围绕未测量临界基态的相关微扰而起作用。利用有限尺寸重整化群（RG）交叉分析，我们通过纠缠有效中心荷、有效 Affleck-Ludwig 边界熵，以及来自测量平均关联函数矩的多重分形迹象，表征其普适性质。在两种情况下，我们都发现了由底层 Born 规则随机性支配的“测量主导”或“测量改变”固定点的证据。对于临界 Ising 模型，我们发现其直接 RG 流向具有面积律纠缠的投影测量固定点；而对于三临界 Ising 模型，我们发现了具有对数纠缠的弱测量固定点的证据。这些结果阐明了弱测量多临界 Ising 基态的 RG 流结构，并显示内禀的测量诱导随机性如何在后测量系综中产生复杂而丰富的普适长距离标度行为，这些行为可通过受控解析 RG 和数值有限尺寸 RG 交叉分析加以研究。

articles.title: 1+1d Lattice Dirac Fermions from Non-Onsite Vector and Axial Symmetries
articles.title_zh: 来自非定域矢量与轴矢量对称性的 1+1 维晶格 Dirac 费米子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02722v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct an exactly solvable Hamiltonian lattice model realizing a 1+1d Dirac fermion, with exact microscopic vector and axial vector U(1) symmetries. The mixed anomaly between these is accommodated by the not-on-site action of the symmetries. Our Hilbert space is a Z₂₋graded tensor product of local Z₂₋graded Hilbert spaces which include infinite dimensional rotor degrees of freedom. The Hamiltonian becomes manifestly exactly solvable after a locality-preserving unitary mapping to an equivalent fermionic Villain Hilbert space. Our construction also allows an exactly solvable realization of interacting fermionic Luttinger liquids. At the free Dirac fixed point, our Hamiltonian contains irrelevant interactions, which we compute to leading order.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究构造了一个精确可解的哈密顿量晶格模型，用以实现具有精确微观矢量和轴矢量 U(1) 对称性的 1+1 维 Dirac 费米子。矢量与轴矢量对称性之间的混合反常通过非现场对称性作用得到容纳。作者还表明，该构造可精确实现相互作用费米 Luttinger 液，并计算了自由 Dirac 固定点处哈密顿量中无关相互作用的领先阶贡献。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02722v1，公告类型：新稿。摘要：我们构造了一个精确可解的哈密顿量晶格模型，实现了一个 1+1 维 Dirac 费米子，并具有精确的微观矢量和轴矢量 U(1) 对称性。二者之间的混合反常由这些对称性的非现场作用来容纳。我们的希尔伯特空间是局域 Z₂ 分次希尔伯特空间的 Z₂ 分次张量积，其中包括无限维转子自由度。在通过保持局域性的酉映射变换到等价的费米 Villain 希尔伯特空间之后，哈密顿量变得显然精确可解。我们的构造还允许对相互作用费米 Luttinger 液进行精确可解的实现。在自由 Dirac 固定点处，我们的哈密顿量包含无关相互作用，并且我们计算了其领先阶贡献。

articles.title: Spin-charge separation in the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 三角晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型中的自旋—电荷分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02727v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent experiments in moiré materials have enabled the realization of a variety of exotic quantum phases. In this context, the Hofstadter-Hubbard model has been proposed as a possible setting for hosting chiral spin liquid. Concurrently, significant progress has been recently made in the computational methods for two-dimensional many-body fermion systems, which makes numerically studying this challenging model a real possibility in genuine 2D geometry. Motivated by these advances, we investigate the putative chiral spin liquid phase in the triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model using variational Monte Carlo with neural quantum states (NQS) and projected entangled pair states (PEPS). We observe spin-charge separation directly in real space through numerical spin-pumping simulation and real-time spin and charge motion. In addition, in the context of anyonic superconductivity conjectured in this model, we find a positive two-electron binding energy on small systems, but it decreases below our numerical resolution as the system size increases. Our work demonstrates NQS and PEPS as powerful tools, capable of cross-checking each other, for diagnosing topological order and fractionalized excitations in strongly correlated electronic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用神经量子态变分蒙特卡罗和投影纠缠对态方法，考察三角晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型中可能存在的手性自旋液相。作者通过数值自旋泵浦模拟以及实时自旋和电荷运动，在实空间中直接观察到自旋—电荷分离。关于该模型中猜想的任意子超导性，作者在小体系中发现正的双电子束缚能，但其随体系尺寸增大而降至数值分辨率以下。
authors: Yuntian Gu, Hui Yang, Zhehao Dai, Yantao Wu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02727v1，公告类型：新稿。摘要：最近在莫尔材料中的实验使多种奇异量子相的实现成为可能。在这一背景下，Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型被提出为可能承载手性自旋液的体系。与此同时，二维多体费米子体系的计算方法最近取得了显著进展，这使得在真正二维几何中对这一具有挑战性的模型进行数值研究成为现实可能。受这些进展推动，我们使用带神经量子态（NQS）的变分蒙特卡罗和投影纠缠对态（PEPS），研究三角晶格 Hofstadter-Hubbard 模型中被认为可能存在的手性自旋液相。我们通过数值自旋泵浦模拟以及实时自旋和电荷运动，直接在实空间中观察到自旋—电荷分离。此外，在该模型中所猜想的任意子超导性的背景下，我们在小体系中发现正的双电子束缚能，但随着体系尺寸增大，它降低到我们的数值分辨率以下。我们的工作表明，NQS 和 PEPS 是强有力的工具，能够相互交叉验证，用于诊断强关联电子体系中的拓扑序和分数量子化激发。

articles.title: Particle-Vortex Duality of Hydrodynamics
articles.title_zh: 流体动力学的粒子—涡旋对偶性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02732v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Equipped with the recently recognized symmetry structure of mixed states of matter and "strong-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking" (SW-SSB), we develop a quantum particle-vortex duality of emergent model-F and model-A hydrodynamics of 2d boson/rotor systems. This duality relation demonstrates that classical hydrodynamics of 2d bosons can be described in terms of the charge symmetry U(1)_c, but also equivalently in terms of the dual (emergent) 1-form symmetry U(1)⁽¹⁾ₑ, as well as U(1)ᵥ associated with the conservation of vortices. This duality provides a bridge between the hydrodynamics of matter and magnetohydrodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于混合态物质中新近认识到的对称性结构和“强—弱自发对称性破缺”，发展了二维玻色子/转子体系中涌现 model-F 与 model-A 流体动力学的量子粒子—涡旋对偶性。该对偶性表明，二维玻色子的经典流体动力学既可用电荷对称性 U(1)c 描述，也可等价地用对偶涌现一形式对称性 U(1)e(1) 以及与涡旋守恒相关的 U(1)v 描述。该框架在物质流体动力学与磁流体动力学之间建立了联系。
authors: Cenke Xu, Matthew P. A. Fisher
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02732v1，公告类型：新稿。摘要：借助最近被认识到的混合态物质对称性结构以及“强—弱自发对称性破缺”（SW-SSB），我们发展了二维玻色子/转子体系中涌现 model-F 和 model-A 流体动力学的量子粒子—涡旋对偶性。这一对偶关系表明，二维玻色子的经典流体动力学可以用电荷对称性 U(1)_c 来描述，但也可以等价地用对偶的涌现一形式对称性 U(1)⁽¹⁾ₑ 以及与涡旋守恒相关的 U(1)ᵥ 来描述。这一对偶性在物质流体动力学与磁流体动力学之间提供了一座桥梁。

articles.title: Two-Parameter Ansatz for the Violation of Eigenstate Thermalization
articles.title_zh: 本征态热化违背的双参数拟设
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02744v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH) provides the prevailing framework for understanding quantum thermalization and ergodicity in isolated many-body systems. Yet, no general theory describes the continuous onset of ETH violation between the conventional ETH and its complete breakdown. Here, we introduce a two-parameter ansatz for the ETH violation that unifies and distinguishes two mechanisms: fading ergodicity and trapped ergodicity. While fading ergodicity captures the established route to ergodicity breaking, trapped ergodicity describes a distinct scenario in which ETH is violated in finite systems but restored in the thermodynamic limit. We test this framework in the spin-1/2 J₁₋J₂ chains with on-site disorder and linear potential. In both cases, we find that the observed ETH violation is consistent with trapped ergodicity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一个描述本征态热化假说违背的双参数拟设，用以统一并区分“衰退遍历性”和“受困遍历性”两种机制。前者对应已知的遍历性破缺路径，后者则描述有限体系中 ETH 被违背但热力学极限中恢复的情形。作者在具有现场无序和线性势的自旋 1/2 J1-J2 链中检验该框架，并发现观测到的 ETH 违背与受困遍历性一致。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02744v1，公告类型：新稿。摘要：本征态热化假说（ETH）为理解孤立多体体系中的量子热化和遍历性提供了主导性框架。然而，目前尚无一般理论描述从常规 ETH 到其完全破缺之间 ETH 违背的连续发生。在这里，我们提出一个用于 ETH 违背的双参数拟设，统一并区分两种机制：衰退遍历性和受困遍历性。衰退遍历性刻画了通向遍历性破缺的既有路径，而受困遍历性描述一种不同情形，即 ETH 在有限体系中被违背，但在热力学极限中恢复。我们在具有现场无序和线性势的自旋 1/2 J₁-J₂ 链中检验这一框架。在两种情况下，我们发现所观察到的 ETH 违背都与受困遍历性一致。

articles.title: Large scale neural quantum states reveal the interplay between superconductivity and quantum criticality in the Hofstadter-Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 大规模神经量子态揭示Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中超导性与量子临界性的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how a parent insulating state shapes the superconductivity that emerges upon doping is a long-standing problem dating back to Anderson's resonating-valence-bond proposal. The triangular-lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model with π/2 flux per plaquette offers an ideal setting for this question: at half filling it hosts two distinct parent states---an integer quantum Hall insulator at weak coupling and a chiral spin liquid at intermediate coupling---separated by a topological phase transition. Using neural quantum states on tori of up to 432 sites, we present strong evidence that the transition is continuous, with a vanishing 2e charge gap and critical charge fluctuations. Upon doping, we find a topological superconductor with off-diagonal long-range order consistent with d+id pairing on either side of the transition. The two ingredients of superconductivity, pair formation and phase coherence, respond to the parent state in sharply different ways: while the pairing order parameter remains nearly unchanged across the transition, the superfluid stiffness is strongly enhanced near the critical point. The energy scale of the superconductor is therefore set not by which parent state is doped, but by proximity to the transition between them. Our results establish neural quantum states as a powerful tool for understanding the delicate interplay between long-ranged electronic correlations and superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用最多432个格点上的神经量子态，研究了Hofstadter-Hubbard模型在掺杂后超导如何受母体绝缘态影响。结果表明，中点附近存在连续的拓扑相变，而掺杂后两侧都会出现具有d+id配对特征的拓扑超导；其中配对序参量几乎不变，超流刚度却在临界点附近显著增强，说明超导能标主要由接近相变而非母体类型决定。
authors: Christopher Roth, Andrew Millis, Tomohiro Soejima
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解母体绝缘态如何塑造掺杂后出现的超导性，是一个可追溯到Anderson共振价键方案的长期问题。三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型在每个晶格胞元上具有π/2磁通，为这一问题提供了理想场景：在半填充时，它支持两种不同的母体态——弱耦合下的整数霍尔绝缘体，以及中等耦合下的手性自旋液体——二者由一个拓扑相变分隔。我们使用最多432个格点环面上的神经量子态，给出了强有力的证据表明该相变是连续的，具有消失的2e电荷能隙和临界电荷涨落。掺杂后，我们发现一种拓扑超导体，其非对角长程序在相变两侧都与d+id配对一致。超导性的两个要素，即配对形成和相位相干，对母体态的响应方式截然不同：虽然配对序参量在相变前后几乎不变，但超流刚度在临界点附近显著增强。因此，这一超导体的能量尺度并不是由掺杂的是哪一种母体态决定，而是由接近这两种母体态之间的转变所决定。我们的结果表明，神经量子态是理解长程电子相关与超导性之间微妙相互作用的强大工具。

articles.title: Magneto-oscillations, nonlinearity, and nonreciprocity of Coulomb drag in quantum circuits
articles.title_zh: 量子电路中库仑拖曳的磁振荡、非线性与非互易性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We consider the problem of Coulomb drag in interactively coupled quantum circuits built of adiabatic constrictions: quantum point contacts and short quantum-wire channels. The interplay of spatial confinement and magnetic field leads to a rich oscillatory response of the drag current as a function of gate voltage and magnetic field: drag peaks track the depopulation of magnetoelectric subbands, are asymptotically periodic in inverse field, and their visibility is controlled by the competition of temperature with the field-sharpened tunneling width of the constriction. We derive a closed expression for the linear drag conductance whose interaction kernel simplifies dramatically in the experimentally relevant limit of a long thermal length compared with the range of the interwire coupling, investigate the drag in the nonlinear regime, where the drag current measures the transconductance of the drive channel at any field, and discuss physically motivated models of dissipation-induced nonreciprocity of the drag signal. Extensions accounting for Zeeman splitting, interaction renormalization of the barrier transmission, backscattering at high field, and the frequency structure of the circuit coupling delineate how each mechanism imprints itself on the temperature dependence and lineshapes of the drag oscillations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究由量子点接触和短量子线等绝热收缩结构构成的相互作用耦合量子电路中的库仑拖曳。作者推导了线性拖曳电导的闭式表达式，并分析了栅压、磁场、温度和隧穿宽度共同决定的拖曳振荡。研究还扩展到非线性拖曳、耗散诱导的非互易性，以及塞曼劈裂、相互作用重整化、高场反散射和频率依赖耦合等机制的影响。
authors: Alex Levchenko, Mingyang Zheng, Dominique Laroche
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们考察由绝热收缩结构——量子点接触和短量子线通道——构成的相互作用耦合量子电路中的库仑拖曳问题。空间限制与磁场的相互作用使拖曳电流随栅极电压和磁场呈现丰富的振荡响应：拖曳峰跟随磁电子带的退占据，在反磁场中渐近地呈周期性，其可见度由温度与磁场锐化后的收缩区隧穿宽度之间的竞争控制。我们推导了线性拖曳电导的闭式表达式；在实验相关的、热长度远大于线间耦合范围的极限下，其相互作用核大幅简化；我们研究了非线性区间中的拖曳，其中拖曳电流在任意磁场下测量驱动通道的跨电导，并讨论了由耗散诱导拖曳信号非互易性的物理动机模型。进一步考虑塞曼劈裂、势垒透射的相互作用重整化、高磁场下的反散射以及电路耦合的频率结构等扩展，勾勒出每种机制如何在拖曳振荡的温度依赖性和线形中留下印记。

articles.title: Tunable Skyrmions in a Topological Wigner Crystal
articles.title_zh: 拓扑维格纳晶体中的可调斯格明子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02832v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In low density systems with strong interactions electrons are expected to crystallize into a Wigner solid. Recently, advances in two-dimensional systems where electrons carry Berry curvature have added a topological dimension to Wigner crystallization. Using a model for pseudospin interactions in a topological Wigner crystal, here we show that the competition between ferromagnetic Heisenberg exchange J and the chiral interaction γ on the triangular lattice stabilizes a zero-field skyrmion crystal whose density is continuously tunable through the ratio γ/J. The chiral interaction originates from finite Berry curvature in an underlying time-reversal broken Wigner crystal. In the continuum limit, the chiral interaction acts as a chemical potential for skyrmions, while higher-order gradient terms beyond the nonlinear sigma model select the skyrmion density. At large chiral coupling, we uncover a 24-site tetra-skyrmion crystal carrying four units of topological charge per magnetic unit cell, which becomes degenerate with four-sublattice tetrahedral order as J → 0. We characterize the magnon structure for these phases and discuss the transition between the tunable skyrmion crystal to these states at large γ/J. Our results establish the phase diagram of ferromagnetic topological Wigner crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究具有贝里曲率的拓扑维格纳晶体中赝自旋相互作用导致的磁性拓扑结构。作者发现三角晶格上铁磁海森堡交换与手性相互作用的竞争可稳定零场斯格明子晶体，其密度可由相互作用比值连续调控。研究还揭示了强手性耦合下的四重斯格明子晶体、相关磁振子结构以及铁磁拓扑维格纳晶体的相图。
authors: David A. Dahlbom, Daniel Kaplan, Premala Chandra, Cristian D. Batista
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在具有强相互作用的低密度体系中，电子预期会结晶形成维格纳固体。近年来，在电子携带贝里曲率的二维体系方面的进展为维格纳结晶增添了拓扑维度。利用拓扑维格纳晶体中赝自旋相互作用的模型，我们在此表明，三角晶格上铁磁海森堡交换 J 与手性相互作用 γ 之间的竞争稳定了一种零场斯格明子晶体，其密度可通过 γ/J 的比值连续调节。手性相互作用源自底层时间反演破缺维格纳晶体中的有限贝里曲率。在连续极限中，手性相互作用充当斯格明子的化学势，而非线性 sigma 模型之外的高阶梯度项选择斯格明子密度。在大的手性耦合下，我们发现一种含 24 个格点的四重斯格明子晶体，其每个磁性原胞携带四个单位的拓扑荷，并在 J → 0 时与四子晶格四面体有序发生简并。我们表征了这些相的磁振子结构，并讨论了可调斯格明子晶体向大 γ/J 下这些态转变的过程。我们的结果确立了铁磁拓扑维格纳晶体的相图。

articles.title: Lifshitz transitions and isospin polarization in twist-decoupled monolayer-bilayer graphene
articles.title_zh: 扭转解耦单层-双层石墨烯中的利夫希茨转变与同位旋极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02899v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Bernal-stacked bilayer graphene (BLG) hosts correlated electronic phases tied to low-energy Lifshitz transitions at saddle points in its valence band. To access this regime, ultralow charge disorder and control over a vertical electric field are simultaneously required. Here, we employ a twist-decoupled monolayer (MLG) to bias a proximal BLG in the absence of an external displacement field (D). We thereby reveal three-fold degenerate quantum Hall states at D = 0, with multiple transitions driven by doping, magnetic and electric field. Spontaneous broken symmetry in the vicinity of the valence band edge is signaled by the emergence of quantum oscillations with anomalous frequencies and large quasiparticle mass. These results indicate that electronic interactions in BLG are preserved in presence of an atomically close MLG, while showcasing the potential of CVD-grown graphene multilayers for the exploration of correlated phases of matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用扭转解耦的单层石墨烯在无外加位移场下调控邻近伯纳尔堆垛双层石墨烯，以探索其价带鞍点附近的关联电子相。实验揭示了零位移场下三重简并量子霍尔态以及由掺杂、磁场和电场驱动的多重转变。异常量子振荡和较大准粒子质量表明价带边附近存在自发对称性破缺，并显示近邻单层石墨烯并未破坏双层石墨烯中的相互作用效应。
authors: Alex Boschi, Leonardo Sabattini, Sergey Slizovskiy, Vaidotas Mišeikis, Zewdu M. Gebeyehu, Stiven Forti, Antonio Rossi, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Fabio Beltram, Vladimir I. Fal'ko, Camilla Coletti, Sergio Pezzini
articles.abstract_zh_full: 伯纳尔堆垛双层石墨烯（BLG）承载与其价带鞍点处低能利夫希茨转变相关的关联电子相。要进入这一区域，需要同时具备超低电荷无序和对垂直电场的控制。在这里，我们采用扭转解耦的单层石墨烯（MLG），在不存在外部位移场（D）的情况下对邻近 BLG 施加偏置。由此，我们在 D = 0 时揭示了三重简并的量子霍尔态，并观察到由掺杂、磁场和电场驱动的多个转变。价带边附近自发对称性破缺的迹象表现为具有异常频率和大准粒子质量的量子振荡的出现。这些结果表明，在存在原子尺度接近的 MLG 时，BLG 中的电子相互作用仍得以保留，同时展示了 CVD 生长石墨烯多层结构在探索物质关联相方面的潜力。

articles.title: Symmetry-Guided Computational Screening of Two-Dimensional Altermagnets with ab initio Hubbard Corrections
articles.title_zh: 采用从头算 Hubbard 修正的二维交替磁体对称性指导计算筛选
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated antiferromagnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, offering a promising platform for spintronic applications without macroscopic magnetization or stray magnetic fields. Although a wide range of three-dimensional (3D) materials have been identified as altermagnets, two-dimensional (2D) altermagnets remain comparatively limited. In this work, we perform a high-throughput computational search for altermagnetism across 2710 materials in the Materials Cloud 2D Crystals (MC2D) database. Our approach combines symmetry-based screening with first-principles density functional theory calculations, including self-consistent Hubbard-U corrections, to reliably capture magnetic ground states. Through a systematic exploration of magnetic configurations and their energetic stability, we identify 42 materials exhibiting altermagnetic ground states for at least one value of U, of which 24 remain robust upon determination of the Hubbard-U parameters from first principles--including 4 materials previously reported in the literature and 20 newly predicted candidates. These comprise promising monolayers such as metallic Fe₂Si₂SbO₉, and insulating CoBrO, with spin splittings about 294 meV and 330 meV, respectively. Our results significantly expand the pool of potential 2D altermagnet candidates with favorable exfoliation energetics and provide valuable guidance for experimental efforts. In addition, this work establishes a high-throughput computational framework for reproducible discovery and characterization of altermagnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文对 Materials Cloud 2D Crystals 数据库中的 2710 种二维材料开展高通量交替磁性筛选。方法结合对称性判据与含自洽 Hubbard-U 修正的第一性原理计算，以可靠确定磁基态。研究识别出 24 种在第一性原理确定 U 后仍稳健的二维交替磁体候选材料，其中 20 种为新预测材料，并为实验探索和可重复计算发现提供了框架。
authors: Anumita Bose, Nataliia Manko, Marco Gibertini, Antimo Marrazzo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体结合了补偿的反铁磁有序与动量依赖自旋劈裂，为无需宏观磁化或杂散磁场的自旋电子学应用提供了有前景的平台。尽管已经识别出大量三维（3D）材料作为交替磁体，二维（2D）交替磁体仍相对有限。在这项工作中，我们对 Materials Cloud 2D Crystals（MC2D）数据库中的 2710 种材料进行了交替磁性的高通量计算搜索。我们的方法将基于对称性的筛选与第一性原理密度泛函理论计算相结合，并包含自洽 Hubbard-U 修正，以可靠地捕捉磁性基态。通过系统探索磁构型及其能量稳定性，我们识别出 42 种材料在至少一个 U 值下表现出交替磁性基态，其中 24 种在从第一性原理确定 Hubbard-U 参数后仍保持稳健——包括文献中此前报道的 4 种材料和 20 种新预测候选材料。这些材料包括有前景的单层材料，如金属性 Fe₂Si₂SbO₉ 和绝缘性 CoBrO，其自旋劈裂分别约为 294 meV 和 330 meV。我们的结果显著扩展了具有有利剥离能学性质的潜在二维交替磁体候选材料库，并为实验工作提供了有价值的指导。此外，本工作建立了一个用于交替磁性材料可重复发现和表征的高通量计算框架。

articles.title: Exotic superconductivity in the doped Kitaev quantum spin liquid
articles.title_zh: 掺杂 Kitaev 量子自旋液体中的奇异超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03024v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate superconductivity in a doped Kitaev quantum spin liquid by applying the many-variable variational Monte Carlo method to the hole-doped t-J-type Kitaev model. Using a projected pair-product wave function that can exactly represent the Kitaev quantum spin liquid, we examine the stability of superconducting phases on isotropic two-dimensional clusters. For the ferromagnetic Kitaev interaction, robust triplet p-wave superconductivity coexists with ferromagnetism in the low-to-intermediate doping regime but is suppressed as the system approaches the fully polarized ferromagnetic phase. For the antiferromagnetic Kitaev interaction, superconductivity exhibits a change in the dominant pairing symmetry from spin-dependent triplet p-wave at low doping to singlet d+id at intermediate doping. By varying the strength of the ferromagnetic Kitaev interaction at fixed doping, we show that the triplet superconductivity increases together with the ferromagnetic moment and becomes strongest slightly below full polarization. Our results provide a theoretical basis for experimental searches for unconventional superconductivity, such as triplet superconductivity coexisting with ferromagnetism, in carrier-doped Kitaev candidate materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用多变量变分蒙特卡罗方法研究空穴掺杂 t-J 型 Kitaev 模型中的超导性。结果显示，铁磁 Kitaev 相互作用下低至中等掺杂区存在与铁磁性共存的稳健三重态 p 波超导，而反铁磁 Kitaev 相互作用下配对对称性随掺杂由自旋依赖三重态 p 波转变为单重态 d+id。研究为在载流子掺杂 Kitaev 候选材料中寻找非常规超导提供了理论依据。
articles.focus_summary: 这篇工作研究了掺杂 Kitaev 量子自旋液体中的超导行为，采用变分蒙特卡洛分析了不同 Kitaev 相互作用下的配对对称性和磁性共存关系。结果显示，体系可出现从三重态 p 波到单态 d+id 的配对转变。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们关注的 Kitaev 相互作用、量子磁性、强关联体系和超导方向相关，也涉及蒙特卡洛方法。虽然论文偏模型理论而非材料计算，但其关于非常规超导和自旋液体的物理图景与我们的研究主题较为契合。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可以进一步关注具有 Kitaev 相互作用候选材料中的掺杂效应与超导不稳定性，结合第一性原理和有效模型参数化。也可比较不同磁相邻近区域的配对机制，探索材料实现路径。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过将多变量变分蒙特卡罗方法应用于空穴掺杂的 t-J 型 Kitaev 模型，研究掺杂 Kitaev 量子自旋液体中的超导性。利用能够精确表示 Kitaev 量子自旋液体的投影成对乘积波函数，我们考察了各向同性二维团簇上超导相的稳定性。对于铁磁 Kitaev 相互作用，稳健的三重态 p 波超导在低至中等掺杂区域与铁磁性共存，但随着系统接近完全极化铁磁相而受到抑制。对于反铁磁 Kitaev 相互作用，超导性表现出主导配对对称性的变化，即从低掺杂下的自旋依赖三重态 p 波转变为中等掺杂下的单重态 d+id。通过在固定掺杂下改变铁磁 Kitaev 相互作用的强度，我们表明三重态超导随铁磁矩一起增强，并在略低于完全极化时达到最强。我们的结果为在载流子掺杂 Kitaev 候选材料中实验寻找非常规超导性，例如与铁磁性共存的三重态超导，提供了理论基础。

articles.title: Pressure induced magnetic-field-free superconducting diode effect in NbSe2 flake
articles.title_zh: NbSe₂ 薄片中压力诱导的无磁场超导二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The superconducting diode effect (SDE) is a fascinating nonreciprocal phenomenon where the critical current is different for opposite current directions. It is widely believed that realizing SDE requires breaking both inversion symmetry (IS) and time-reversal symmetry (TRS), which are usually achieved via heterostructure engineering and applying external magnetic fields. Here, we report a pressure-induced magnetic-field-free SDE in NbSe2 flakes without any heterostructures. We show that pressure alone breaks the IS, as confirmed by the second harmonic generation. Crucially, upon applying an out-of-plane magnetic field (B), the SDE exhibits even-in-B behavior, implying the absence of explicit TRS breaking. This finding challenges the prevailing theoretical paradigm and demonstrates that a magnetic-field-free SDE can emerge without explicitly breaking TRS. Thereby, our work establishes pressure engineering as a powerful tool for inducing nonreciprocal superconductivity and designing versatile, magnetic-field-free superconducting devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了无异质结构 NbSe₂ 薄片中由压力诱导的无磁场超导二极管效应。实验表明压力可破坏反演对称性，并且二极管效应对垂直磁场呈偶函数行为，暗示不存在显式时间反演对称性破缺。该发现挑战了通常认为超导二极管效应必须同时破缺反演与时间反演对称性的理论图景，并展示了压力工程在非互易超导器件中的潜力。
authors: Shihao Zhu, Tian Le, Cuiying Pei, Changhua Li, Yi Liao, Yi Zhao, Lingxiao Zhao, Qi Wang, Juefei Wu, Qilian Zhang, Yueshen Wu, Tonghuan Fu, Xujie Lü, Wenge Yang, Jie Shen, Jun Li, Yulin Chen, Xiao Lin, Wen-Yu He, Yanpeng Qi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 超导二极管效应（SDE）是一种引人入胜的非互易现象，其中相反电流方向的临界电流不同。人们普遍认为，实现 SDE 需要同时破缺反演对称性（IS）和时间反演对称性（TRS），这通常通过异质结构工程和施加外部磁场来实现。在这里，我们报道了在没有任何异质结构的 NbSe₂ 薄片中压力诱导的无磁场 SDE。我们表明，仅压力就能破缺 IS，这一点由二次谐波产生得到证实。关键的是，在施加面外磁场（B）时，SDE 表现出关于 B 的偶函数行为，意味着不存在显式 TRS 破缺。这一发现挑战了现行理论范式，并证明无磁场 SDE 可以在不显式破缺 TRS 的情况下出现。因此，我们的工作确立了压力工程作为诱导非互易超导性和设计多功能无磁场超导器件的强大工具。

articles.title: Exact Resonances Are Not Sufficient for Phonon Energy Diffusion
articles.title_zh: 精确共振不足以导致声子能量扩散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03180v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-phonon resonance conditions underpin kinetic theories of phonon transport and lattice thermalization. We show that exact resonance matching, nonzero interaction coefficients, and network connectivity do not guarantee persistent energy diffusion. Symmetry-enforced balance relations drive exact-resonant collision currents to nonthermal zero-flux states, producing kinetic arrest from individual resonant sets to connected networks. Complete energy spreading is sustained by quasi-resonances. The thermodynamic and weak-nonlinearity limits do not commute: the leading kinetic behavior is recovered in the former, whereas at fixed finite size the thermalization time diverges through higher-order crossovers as the nonlinearity vanishes. Exact-resonance existence and connectivity are therefore kinematic, not sufficient dynamical, criteria for phonon energy diffusion.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，多声子精确共振、非零相互作用系数和网络连通性并不能保证持续的能量扩散。作者发现对称性强制的平衡关系会使精确共振碰撞流进入非热零通量态，从而产生动力学停滞；完整能量扩散主要由准共振维持。研究强调精确共振的存在和连通性只是运动学条件，而非声子能量扩散的充分动力学条件。
authors: Wei Lin, Yong Zhang, Hong Zhao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多声子共振条件构成声子输运和晶格热化动力学理论的基础。我们表明，精确共振匹配、非零相互作用系数以及网络连通性并不保证持久的能量扩散。对称性强制的平衡关系将精确共振碰撞流驱动到非热的零通量态，从单个共振集合到连通网络均会产生动力学停滞。完整的能量扩散由准共振来维持。热力学极限和弱非线性极限并不对易：在前一种极限中可恢复主导动理学行为，而在固定有限尺寸下，随着非线性趋于消失，热化时间会通过高阶交叉而发散。因此，精确共振的存在和连通性是运动学判据，而不是声子能量扩散的充分动力学判据。

articles.title: Contrasting anisotropic electron-phonon-spin coupling in Fe₃GeTe₂ and Fe₅GeTe₂: A helicity-resolved Raman study
articles.title_zh: Fe₃GeTe₂ 与 Fe₅GeTe₂ 中各向异性电子-声子-自旋耦合的对比：螺旋度分辨拉曼研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03193v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional van der Waals ferromagnets Fe₃GeTe ₂ (F3GT) and Fe₅GeTe₂ (F5GT) exhibit pronounced magneto-optical responses, which open promising platforms for investigating the interplay among lattice, electronic, and magnetic degrees of freedom. Here, we present a comparative study of optical resonance-induced anisotropic electron-phonon coupling and its association with magnetic ordering in these systems using wavelength- and temperature-dependent helicity-resolved Raman spectroscopy. By resolving the doubly degenerate E modes under left- and right-circularly polarized excitations, we demonstrate that the temperature evolution of the chiral mode splitting (Δ f) does not track the magnetization behavior, indicating that the helicity-dependent Raman response arises not solely from time-reversal symmetry breaking due to magnetic order, but also from spin-orbit-coupled electronic interactions. Notably, in F3GT, the out-of-plane magnetization indirectly governs the in-plane anisotropic electron-phonon coupling under optical resonance, whereas F5GT exhibits static anisotropic interactions. The Fano asymmetry parameter 1/q reveals mode- and temperature-dependent coupling strengths between phonons and the electronic continuum, with pronounced angular anisotropy in F3GT but isotropic behavior in F5GT--- a consequence of its multiple Fe sites and enhanced interlayer hybridization in the latter. Our results demonstrate the role of crystal structure and magnetic anisotropy in shaping the anisotropically coupled electron-phonon-spin dynamics in these layered metallic ferromagnets, and highlight FeₓGeTe₂ as a versatile platform for microscopic insight into chiral light-matter interactions in layered metallic ferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过波长和温度依赖的螺旋度分辨拉曼光谱，对二维范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe₂ 和 Fe₅GeTe₂ 中光学共振诱导的各向异性电子-声子耦合及其与磁有序的关系进行了比较研究。结果表明，手性模劈裂的温度演化并不简单跟随磁化行为，说明响应还受到自旋-轨道耦合电子相互作用影响。研究揭示了晶体结构和磁各向异性如何塑造层状金属铁磁体中的电子-声子-自旋动力学。
authors: Smrutiranjan Mekap, Jyoti Saini, Andrzej Ptok, Pawan Kumar Srivastava, Changgu Lee, Subhasis Ghosh, Anushree Roy
articles.abstract_zh_full: 二维范德华铁磁体 Fe₃GeTe₂（F3GT）和 Fe₅GeTe₂（F5GT）表现出显著的磁光响应，为研究晶格、电子和磁自由度之间的相互作用提供了有前景的平台。在这里，我们利用波长和温度依赖的螺旋度分辨拉曼光谱，对这些体系中由光学共振诱导的各向异性电子-声子耦合及其与磁有序的关联进行了比较研究。通过在左旋和右旋圆偏振激发下分辨二重简并的 E 模，我们证明手性模劈裂（Δf）的温度演化并不追踪磁化行为，这表明螺旋度依赖的拉曼响应并非仅源自磁有序导致的时间反演对称性破缺，还源自自旋-轨道耦合的电子相互作用。值得注意的是，在 F3GT 中，面外磁化在光学共振下间接支配面内各向异性电子-声子耦合，而 F5GT 则表现出静态各向异性相互作用。Fano 不对称参数 1/q 揭示了声子与电子连续谱之间具有模式和温度依赖的耦合强度，其中 F3GT 具有显著的角向各向异性，而 F5GT 表现出各向同性行为——这是后者具有多个 Fe 位点和增强层间杂化的结果。我们的结果展示了晶体结构和磁各向异性在塑造这些层状金属铁磁体中各向异性耦合的电子-声子-自旋动力学方面的作用，并突出了 FeₓGeTe₂ 作为获取层状金属铁磁体中手性光-物质相互作用微观认识的多功能平台。

articles.title: Topological properties and phase diagram of the triangular Hofstadter model with staggered flux
articles.title_zh: 具有交错磁通的三角 Hofstadter 模型的拓扑性质与相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the topological properties and phase diagram of the triangular Hofstadter model with staggered flux in adjacent triangles in this work. This lattice can be used to describe the low energy physics of the twisted bilayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMD) in a certain range of the electric displacement field between the two layers. We show that the Hofstadter spectrum of this model is generally asymmetric except at specific staggered flux 3φ= π/2 mod π due to an additional P symmetry at such φ. Breaking the translation symmetry by dimerization lifts the P symmetry and results in rich topological phases in the system. The dimerized model with different rational external magnetic flux Φ_B = 2π p/q has phase diagram with the following common features. For even q, the dimerized model generally has three gapped regimes. The one with small dimerization has finite Chern number and the other two have zero Chern number. For odd q, the model is gapped with zero Chern number at any finite dimerization. For both q even and odd, the two regimes with zero Chern number can be further characterized by the inversion symmetry of the parametrized one-dimensional chains of the system at φ = 0 mod π/3, and one regime is topologically non-trivial and the other is trivial. Our results may be tested in twisted bilayer TMD with weak interaction or cold atom systems in optical lattice or photonic crystals achieved in recent experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究相邻三角形中具有交错磁通的三角 Hofstadter 模型，该模型可描述特定电位移场范围内扭转双层过渡金属二硫族化物的低能物理。作者发现 Hofstadter 能谱通常不对称，但在特定交错磁通下因额外 P 对称性而呈现特殊性质；二聚化破坏平移对称性并产生丰富拓扑相。相图随外磁通分母奇偶性展现不同普遍特征，并可能在扭转双层 TMD、冷原子光晶格或光子晶体中检验。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们研究了相邻三角形中具有交错磁通的三角 Hofstadter 模型的拓扑性质和相图。该晶格可用于描述两层之间电位移场处于一定范围内的扭转双层过渡金属二硫族化物（TMD）的低能物理。我们表明，由于在特定交错磁通 3φ = π/2 mod π 处存在额外的 P 对称性，该模型的 Hofstadter 能谱除这些特定 φ 外通常是不对称的。通过二聚化破坏平移对称性会解除 P 对称性，并导致体系中丰富的拓扑相。对于不同有理外磁通 Φ_B = 2π p/q，二聚化模型的相图具有以下共同特征。对于偶数 q，二聚化模型通常有三个有能隙区域。小二聚化对应的区域具有有限陈数，另外两个区域的陈数为零。对于奇数 q，模型在任意有限二聚化下都有能隙且陈数为零。对于 q 为偶数和奇数两种情况，在 φ = 0 mod π/3 时，两个陈数为零的区域可进一步由体系参数化一维链的反演对称性表征，其中一个区域在拓扑上非平庸，另一个为平庸。我们的结果可在弱相互作用的扭转双层 TMD 中，或在近期实验已实现的光晶格冷原子体系或光子晶体中进行检验。

articles.title: AccelNet: Exact backward-compatible acceleration of polynomial angular descriptors through Cartesian moment factorization
articles.title_zh: AccelNet：通过笛卡尔矩分解精确且向后兼容地加速多项式角描述符
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03280v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present AccelNet, an exact, backward-compatible method for accelerating existing trained aenet and n2p2 neural-network potentials without retraining. For angular terms with separable one-neighbor weights and a finite polynomial dependence on o̧s θ, the method exploits their hidden finite-rank structure to replace explicit neighbor-pair loops by one-neighbor Cartesian moments. AccelNet reads models trained with either package and reproduces their descriptors, energies, and analytic forces to floating-point roundoff. We verified this equivalence for H₂O and TiO₂ models and tested the resulting potentials in LAMMPS molecular-dynamics simulations. The implementation, model-conversion tools, and LAMMPS interfaces are released as open-source software.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 AccelNet，一种无需重新训练即可加速已有 aenet 和 n2p2 神经网络势的精确向后兼容方法。该方法利用特定角项中隐藏的有限秩结构，将显式邻居对循环替换为单邻居笛卡尔矩。作者在 H₂O 和 TiO₂ 模型中验证了描述符、能量和解析力的浮点精度一致性，并发布了开源实现与 LAMMPS 接口。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出 AccelNet，这是一种精确且向后兼容的方法，可在无需重新训练的情况下加速现有已训练的 aenet 和 n2p2 神经网络势。对于具有可分离单邻居权重且对 cos θ 具有有限多项式依赖的角项，该方法利用其隐藏的有限秩结构，用单邻居笛卡尔矩取代显式邻居对循环。AccelNet 读取由任一软件包训练得到的模型，并以浮点舍入误差精度再现其描述符、能量和解析力。我们在 H₂O 和 TiO₂ 模型上验证了这种等价性，并在 LAMMPS 分子动力学模拟中测试了所得势函数。该实现、模型转换工具和 LAMMPS 接口均作为开源软件发布。

articles.title: Magnetic and crystal electric field excitations in a spin-orbit coupled frustrated hyperkagome magnet Nd₃Li₃W₂O₁₂
articles.title_zh: 自旋-轨道耦合受挫超 kagome 磁体 Nd₃Li₃W₂O₁₂ 中的磁激发与晶体电场激发
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03365v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare-earth based garnets provide a viable platform for studying the frustrated driven magnetic properties of the hyperkagome lattices. Herein, we report a comprehensive study of the magnetic properties and crystal electric field (CEF) scheme of a new Nd³⁺ based hyperkagome antiferromagnet, Nd₃Li₃W₂O₁₂ belonging to the garnet family via magnetization, heat capacity, and inelastic neutron scattering (INS) measurements. Magnetization measurement reveals a dominant antiferromagnetic interaction with a low temperature Curie-Weiss temperature θₘ̊ CWm̊ LT simeq -0.2 K. Two broad maxima are observed in the magnetic heat capacity data under magnetic fields, implying multilevel Schottky anomalies due to the effect of CEF and display a two-step magnetic entropy release. No magnetic long-range order is observed down to 0.1 K. The CEF excitations of the Nd³⁺ (J=9/2) ion with D₂ point group symmetry, probed via INS experiments, show non-dispersive excitations characterizing the transitions among the CEF energy levels. The simultaneous fit of the INS spectra at different temperatures enabled the mapping of the CEF Hamiltonian and the energy eigenvalues of the Kramers' doublets. The simulation using the obtained CEF parameters reproduces the experimental magnetic susceptibility, magnetic isotherms, and magnetic heat capacity data. The thermodynamic properties and INS-derived crystal-field scheme confirm a Kramers' doublet ground state with an effective spin Jₘ̊ ₑff = 1/2 at low temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过磁化、热容和非弹性中子散射研究了新型 Nd³⁺ 基石榴石家族超 kagome 反铁磁体 Nd₃Li₃W₂O₁₂ 的磁性和晶体电场能级结构。实验显示体系具有主导反铁磁相互作用，在低至 0.1 K 未观察到长程磁有序，并呈现由晶体电场影响导致的多能级 Schottky 异常。对中子散射谱的拟合确定了 CEF 哈密顿量和 Kramers 双重态能级，表明低温基态为有效自旋 1/2 的 Kramers 双重态。
authors: R. Kolay, S. Guchhait, Indrajeet S. Rathore, S. Nandi, M. D. Le, N. B. Christensen, R. Nath
articles.abstract_zh_full: 稀土基石榴石为研究超 kagome 晶格中受挫驱动的磁性性质提供了可行平台。在此，我们通过磁化、热容和非弹性中子散射（INS）测量，报告了属于石榴石家族的一种新的 Nd³⁺ 基超 kagome 反铁磁体 Nd₃Li₃W₂O₁₂ 的磁性性质和晶体电场（CEF）方案的综合研究。磁化测量显示存在主导的反铁磁相互作用，其低温居里-外斯温度 θ_CW^LT ≃ -0.2 K。在磁场下，磁热容数据中观察到两个宽峰，意味着由于 CEF 影响产生的多能级 Schottky 异常，并显示出两步磁熵释放。低至 0.1 K 未观察到磁长程有序。通过 INS 实验探测到的、具有 D₂ 点群对称性的 Nd³⁺（J=9/2）离子的 CEF 激发表现为非色散激发，表征 CEF 能级之间的跃迁。对不同温度下 INS 谱的同时拟合使我们能够确定 CEF 哈密顿量和 Kramers 双重态的能量本征值。利用所得 CEF 参数进行的模拟再现了实验磁化率、磁等温线和磁热容数据。热力学性质和 INS 得到的晶体场方案证实，低温下基态为具有有效自旋 Jₑff = 1/2 的 Kramers 双重态。

articles.title: Helicity in monoaxial chiral magnets
articles.title_zh: 单轴手性磁体中的螺旋度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03389v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The equilibrium state of a monoaxial chiral magnet surrounded by a non-magnetic medium (such as air or vacuum) is a helical texture characterized by a single, well-defined wave vector. No metastable states have ever been observed in such systems. Recently, however, it was demonstrated that when a chiral magnet is in close contact with two uniaxial ferromagnets, a large number of metastable helical states emerge in addition to the equilibrium state [Phys. Rev. B 109, 214424]. These helical states are distinguished by their wave number (helicity). In the present work, we elucidate the topological origin of the stabilization of these states --a mechanism we term dynamical topological protection-- and investigate their static and dynamic properties. We find that, as a consequence of this dynamical topological protection, the winding number of the helical states remains constant under the application of sufficiently weak magnetic fields and polarized electric currents. Furthermore, when a polarized current is applied to a metastable helical state, a static configuration is reached. This state retains the original winding number, but its winding number density becomes non-homogeneously distributed, concentrating near the interface with one of the ferromagnets. The dynamic response to sufficiently large magnetic fields and currents provides mechanisms to switch between different helical states. Since the magnetic properties depend on helicity, these metastable helical states are highly promising for applications in spintronics and magnonics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究与两个单轴铁磁体紧密接触的单轴手性磁体中大量亚稳螺旋态的拓扑起源及其静态和动力学性质。作者提出“动力学拓扑保护”机制，解释这些由波数或螺旋度区分的态为何能够稳定，并发现弱磁场和极化电流下其缠绕数保持不变。较强磁场和电流可实现不同螺旋态之间的切换，使其在自旋电子学和磁振子学中具有应用潜力。
authors: Victor Laliena, Diego Gironés-Magaña, Javier Campo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 被非磁介质（如空气或真空）包围的单轴手性磁体的平衡态是一种由单一且明确的波矢表征的螺旋织构。在这类体系中从未观察到亚稳态。然而，最近有研究证明，当手性磁体与两个单轴铁磁体紧密接触时，除平衡态之外会出现大量亚稳螺旋态 [Phys. Rev. B 109, 214424]。这些螺旋态由其波数（螺旋度）加以区分。在本工作中，我们阐明这些态稳定化的拓扑起源——一种我们称为动力学拓扑保护的机制——并研究其静态和动态性质。我们发现，作为这种动力学拓扑保护的结果，在施加足够弱的磁场和极化电流时，螺旋态的缠绕数保持不变。此外，当对一个亚稳螺旋态施加极化电流时，体系会达到一种静态构型。该态保持原始缠绕数，但其缠绕数密度变为非均匀分布，并集中在与其中一个铁磁体的界面附近。对足够大磁场和电流的动态响应提供了在不同螺旋态之间切换的机制。由于磁性质依赖于螺旋度，这些亚稳螺旋态在自旋电子学和磁振子学应用中非常有前景。

articles.title: The intermediate scattering function of an interacting adlayer as a characteristic function: a closed-form theory of Ising lattice-gas surface diffusion
articles.title_zh: 相互作用吸附层的中间散射函数作为特征函数：Ising晶格气表面扩散的闭式理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03398v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The intermediate scattering function (ISF) measured by helium spin-echo is a characteristic function (CF): the Fourier transform of the distribution of adsorbate displacements, whose value at zero time is the static structure factor. We use this double role to bring lateral interactions of Ising lattice-gas type into surface diffusion. The ISF then follows in closed form in momentum transfer, time, coverage and temperature, and with it the whole linear-response hierarchy. A single correlation parameter fixes both the equilibrium structure and the interaction-renormalized hop rate; it is exact along a one-dimensional channel, and is carried onto the surface as the nearest-neighbour correlation of a pair approximation, the momentum dependence of the structure factor then coming from a collective (random-phase) treatment. The closed form is not postulated. Projecting the master equation onto the density gives an exact equation of motion whose amplitude is an identity and whose initial rate obeys a sum rule, so that the quasi-elastic weight is the layer's own structure factor and de Gennes narrowing becomes a theorem rather than an analogy; the closed form is what remains when the memory kernel of that equation is dropped. Kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) on the same Hamiltonian reproduces the dressed hop rate to better than about one per cent and the initial collective rate to 1--2%. Four correlated, non-critical fingerprints of the interaction follow --- in the quasi-elastic amplitude, its linewidth, the Arrhenius slope, and the dependence of the fitted linewidth on the range of times over which the decay is fitted. They invert in closed form for the attempt frequency, the static barrier and the interaction. Applications to Na/Cu(111) and H/Pt(111) are analysed and discussed.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将氦自旋回波测得的中间散射函数视为吸附质位移分布的特征函数，并据此把Ising晶格气型横向相互作用引入表面扩散理论。作者推导了关于动量转移、时间、覆盖度和温度的闭式表达，并指出准弹性强度、线宽、Arrhenius斜率和拟合时间窗依赖性可作为相互作用的非临界指纹。理论与动能Monte Carlo结果符合良好，并被用于分析Na/Cu(111)和H/Pt(111)体系。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 由氦自旋回波测得的中间散射函数（ISF）是一个特征函数（CF）：即吸附质位移分布的傅里叶变换，其零时刻取值为静态结构因子。我们利用这种双重作用，将Ising晶格气类型的横向相互作用引入表面扩散。由此，ISF在动量转移、时间、覆盖度和温度上以闭式形式给出，整个线性响应层级也随之得到。一个单一的相关参数同时确定平衡结构和相互作用重整化后的跳跃速率；它在一维通道中是精确的，并作为成对近似的最近邻相关被推广到表面，而结构因子的动量依赖性则来自一种集体的随机相位处理。该闭式形式并非假设而来。将主方程投影到密度上，会得到一个精确的运动方程，其振幅是一个恒等式，其初始速率满足一个求和规则，因此准弹性权重就是该层自身的结构因子，de Gennes变窄因而成为一个定理而不是类比；当该方程的记忆核被忽略时，剩下的就是闭式形式。在相同Hamilton量上的动能Monte Carlo（KMC）以优于约百分之一的精度再现了修饰后的跳跃速率，并以1%–2%的精度再现了初始集体速率。由相互作用产生四个相关但非临界的指纹——体现在准弹性振幅、其线宽、Arrhenius斜率，以及拟合线宽对衰减拟合所用时间范围的依赖性中。它们可用闭式形式反演得到尝试频率、静态势垒和相互作用。文中分析并讨论了对Na/Cu(111)和H/Pt(111)的应用。

articles.title: Magnetoresistance in Magnetic Weyl semimetal Mn₃ZnC
articles.title_zh: 磁性Weyl半金属Mn₃ZnC中的磁阻
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03414v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The magnetoresistance (MR) in magnetic materials reveal an intriguing spin-dependent electron scattering, highlighting the role of spin polarization on the electronic transport properties. This becomes even more interesting for the topological magnetic materials where a finite Berry curvature leads to an intrinsic scattering channel also. In this report, we investigate MR of Mn₃ZnC, an antiperovskite magnetic nodal line semimetal. Mn₃ZnC shows a ferromagnetic (FM) transition at sim 420 K, followed by an ferrimagnetic (FIM) transition at sim 195 K. We focus on the interpretation of MR data and highlight the relation between MR and its magnetization. The signature of magnetization induced MR shows correlation at low magnetic fields and displays distinct behaviors in the FIM and FM states. Similar to the isothermal magnetization M(H) curve of FM and FIM state, the MR curves exhibit a sharp increase, followed by a linear behavior at higher fields. As the magnetic field varies, the cusp-like anomaly becomes more pronounced, and vanishes at the magnetic phase transition, which then reappears as the temperature increases. The sign change in the MR curves in the FIM state is attributed to a drastic change in the carrier mobility. Interestingly, this system shows a positive MR in FM state at very low field, which is quite unusual.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了反钙钛矿磁性节点线半金属Mn₃ZnC的磁阻行为及其与磁化强度的关系。Mn₃ZnC在约420 K发生铁磁转变，并在约195 K发生亚铁磁转变；其磁阻在低场与磁化诱导效应相关，并在亚铁磁和铁磁态中表现出不同特征。作者将亚铁磁态中的磁阻符号变化归因于载流子迁移率的显著变化，并指出铁磁态极低场正磁阻较为反常。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁性材料中的磁阻（MR）揭示了引人关注的自旋相关电子散射，突出了自旋极化在电子输运性质中的作用。对于拓扑磁性材料而言，这一点变得更加有趣，因为有限Berry曲率还会导致一个内禀散射通道。在本报告中，我们研究了Mn₃ZnC的MR，Mn₃ZnC是一种反钙钛矿磁性节点线半金属。Mn₃ZnC在约420 K表现出铁磁（FM）转变，随后在约195 K发生亚铁磁（FIM）转变。我们重点解释MR数据，并突出MR与其磁化强度之间的关系。磁化诱导MR的特征在低磁场下显示出相关性，并在FIM和FM态中表现出不同的行为。类似于FM和FIM态的等温磁化M(H)曲线，MR曲线表现出急剧增加，随后在较高磁场下呈线性行为。随着磁场变化，尖点状异常变得更加明显，并在磁相变处消失，随后又随温度升高而重新出现。FIM态中MR曲线的符号变化归因于载流子迁移率的剧烈变化。有趣的是，该体系在FM态极低磁场下表现出正MR，这是相当不寻常的。

articles.title: Spin-Chirality-Driven Bulk Photovoltaic Effect in van der Waals Magnet CrSBr
articles.title_zh: 范德华磁体CrSBr中由自旋手性驱动的体光伏效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03492v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The bulk photovoltaic effect (BPVE) can be greatly enriched in magnetic materials. Here, we establish vector spin chirality as a tunable knob for generating an unconventional time-reversal-even magnetic BPVE, comprising the chiral shift current (CSC) and chiral injection current (CIC). Using bilayer antiferromagnetic (AFM) CrSBr as a prototype, we theoretically demonstrate the emergence of CSC and CIC. Compared with conventional photovoltaic currents arising from noncentrosymmetric crystal structures or collinear magnetic orderings, CSC and CIC not only possess comparable magnitudes but also exhibit exceptional tunability. Specifically, they can be switched on and off by magnetic-field-induced spin canting, reversed in direction upon canting-direction reversal, and continuously modulated in intensity via canting-angle variation. Furthermore, we reveal an unusual optical transition channel governing both currents in CrSBr. Our work establishes an unconventional magnetic BPVE with remarkable controllability, paving the way for applications in optoelectronics and magnetic sensing in noncollinear magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出矢量自旋手性可作为产生非常规时间反演偶磁性体光伏效应的可调控旋钮，该效应包括手性位移电流和手性注入电流。以双层反铁磁CrSBr为原型，作者从理论上展示了这两类电流的出现及其显著可调性。它们可通过磁场诱导的自旋倾斜开关、随倾斜方向反转而反向，并可随倾斜角连续调制。
authors: Dezhao Wu, Yong Xu, Meng Ye, Wenhui Duan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 体光伏效应（BPVE）在磁性材料中可以得到极大丰富。在这里，我们确立矢量自旋手性作为一种可调旋钮，用于产生非常规的时间反演偶磁性BPVE，包括手性位移电流（CSC）和手性注入电流（CIC）。以双层反铁磁（AFM）CrSBr为原型，我们从理论上证明了CSC和CIC的出现。与源自非中心对称晶体结构或共线磁有序的传统光伏电流相比，CSC和CIC不仅具有可比的量级，还表现出卓越的可调性。具体而言，它们可以通过磁场诱导的自旋倾斜来开启和关闭，在倾斜方向反转时反转方向，并通过倾斜角变化连续调制强度。此外，我们揭示了CrSBr中支配这两种电流的一种异常光学跃迁通道。我们的工作建立了一种具有显著可控性的非常规磁性BPVE，为非共线磁体中光电子学和磁传感应用铺平了道路。

articles.title: Vector-field control and emergent basal-plane anisotropy of magnetic textures in noncentrosymmetric (Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P
articles.title_zh: 非中心对称(Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P中磁织构的矢量场控制与涌现基面各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: (Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P is a room-temperature magnet with S₄ symmetry that hosts a rich variety of topological spin textures. Here, we report a combined resonant small-angle x-ray scattering and ptychography study of (Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P in vector magnetic fields over a broad temperature range. We demonstrate deterministic vector-field control of magnetic stripe domains, where in-plane fields continuously rotate their orientation via a transition from a chiral stripe to an achiral fan configuration. Furthermore, at 50 K and below, the stripe orientation becomes metastably pinned and retains its field-trained direction. While the magnitude of the wavevector is nearly isotropic within the basal plane at room temperature, a pronounced temperature evolution of anisotropic interactions emerges upon cooling. In particular, non-trivial anisotropy axes develop at 20-50 K reflecting the combined effects of magnetocrystalline anisotropy, anisotropic exchange, and Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI), whose effective orientation is found to rotate with temperature. These results establish (Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P as a model system for vector-field control of chiral spin textures and reveal a previously unrecognized temperature-driven evolution of the effective DMI landscape in a noncentrosymmetric magnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合共振小角X射线散射和叠层成像，在矢量磁场和宽温区下研究了非中心对称室温磁体(Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P的拓扑自旋织构。研究展示了面内磁场对磁条纹畴取向的确定性控制，并发现低温下条纹取向可亚稳钉扎。冷却时基面内各向异性相互作用显著演化，揭示了有效Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用景观随温度旋转的现象。
authors: Victor Ukleev, Oleg I. Utesov, Lorenzo Ubilla, Chen Luo, Radu-Marius Abrudan, Peter Wild, Holger Kropf, Moritz Winter, Sebastian Schneider, Alexander Tahn, Bernd Rellinghaus, Tim A. Butcher, Simone Finizio, Sebastian Wintz, Markus Weigand, Max T. Birch, Yoshinori Tokura, Yasujiro Taguchi, Kosuke Karube, Florin Radu
articles.abstract_zh_full: (Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P是一种具有S₄对称性的室温磁体，承载着丰富多样的拓扑自旋织构。在这里，我们报告了在宽温度范围内、矢量磁场下对(Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P进行的共振小角X射线散射和叠层成像联合研究。我们展示了对磁条纹畴的确定性矢量场控制，其中面内磁场通过从手性条纹到非手性扇形构型的转变，连续旋转其取向。此外，在50 K及以下，条纹取向变得亚稳钉扎，并保持其场训练方向。虽然在室温下波矢大小在基面内几乎各向同性，但冷却时各向异性相互作用出现显著的温度演化。特别是，在20–50 K出现了非平凡的各向异性轴，反映了磁晶各向异性、各向异性交换和Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya相互作用（DMI）的综合效应，其有效取向被发现会随温度旋转。这些结果确立了(Fe₀.₆₃Ni₀.₃Pd₀.₀₇)₃P作为矢量场控制手性自旋织构的模型体系，并揭示了非中心对称磁体中有效DMI景观此前未被认识的温度驱动演化。

articles.title: The New High-entropy Compound RhMnFeCoGe4 with Cubic Non-centrosymmetric B20 Structure
articles.title_zh: 具有立方非中心对称B20结构的新型高熵化合物RhMnFeCoGe₄
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03523v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A novel high-entropy compound, RhMnFeCoGe₄, with a cubic non-centrosymmetric B20 struc- ture, has been synthesized under conditions of high pressure and temperature. The electrical transport and magnetic properties of the obtained compound at both ambient and elevated pres- sures have been investigated. In addition, nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra were obtained at 4.2 K and ab initio calculations were performed. The new material exhibits ferromag- netic behavior with a critical temperature of T_C = 146 K and a spontaneous moment of 2.5 μ_B per formula unit. The magnetization data obtained at the critical region yielded the critical temperature and exponents, which were found to be T_C = 146(1) K, β = 0.337(1), γ = 1.121(1), and δ = 4.326(1). The magnetic moments of Mn and Co were determined from NMR spectra to be 2.2 μ_B and 0.5 μ_B, respectively. Ab initio calculations yielded reasonable values for the lattice parameter and the magnetic moments of all constituents. The density of states and band structure are determined for both paramagnetic and ferromagnetic states. Lattice compression results in the increase in the T_C.
