articles.abstract_zh: 本文在高压高温条件下合成了具有立方非中心对称B20结构的新型高熵化合物RhMnFeCoGe₄，并研究了其常压和高压下的电输运与磁性质。该材料表现出铁磁行为，临界温度为146 K，自发磁矩为每化学式单元2.5 μB。NMR和从头算结果给出了各元素磁矩与电子结构信息，并显示晶格压缩会提高居里温度。
authors: V. A. Sidorov, V. N. Krasnorussky, A. V. Bokov, Z. N. Volkova, A. P. Gerashchenko, N. M. Chtchelkatchev, M. V. Magnitskaya, D. A. Salamatin, A. V. Semeno, V. V. Brazhkin, A. V. Tsvyashchenko
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一种新型高熵化合物RhMnFeCoGe₄已在高压高温条件下合成，其具有立方非中心对称B20结构。研究了所得化合物在常压和高压下的电输运和磁性质。此外，在4.2 K获得了核磁共振（NMR）谱，并进行了从头算计算。该新材料表现出铁磁行为，临界温度T_C = 146 K，每化学式单元自发磁矩为2.5 μ_B。在临界区域获得的磁化数据给出了临界温度和指数，分别为T_C = 146(1) K、β = 0.337(1)、γ = 1.121(1)和δ = 4.326(1)。由NMR谱确定Mn和Co的磁矩分别为2.2 μ_B和0.5 μ_B。从头算计算给出了晶格参数和所有组成元素磁矩的合理数值。确定了顺磁态和铁磁态的态密度和能带结构。晶格压缩导致T_C升高。

articles.title: Manipulation of localized excitons in CrPS₄ by temperature and magnetic field
articles.title_zh: 通过温度和磁场操控 CrPS₄ 中的局域激子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03543v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Layered van der Waals magnetic semiconductors provide a versatile platform for exploring excitonic phenomena intertwined with spin and lattice degrees of freedom, enabling excitons to act as sensitive probes of magnetic order. CrPS₄ is a layered antiferromagnetic semiconductor that hosts rich excitonic features whose microscopic origin and connection to magnetic ordering remain incompletely understood. Here, we investigate the electronic and excitonic properties of bulk CrPS₄ using a combination of many-body perturbation theory, dynamical mean-field theory, and photoluminescence-based experiments. Our calculations establish CrPS₄ as a direct-gap semiconductor with a bandgap of 2.48~eV in the antiferromagnetic phase. Several sub-bandgap excitonic transitions are predicted by theory, comprising multiple spin-allowed excitons and an additional spin-flip excitation, predominantly localized on the Cr³⁺ ions. Temperature- and magnetic-field-dependent optical measurements reveal thermally driven exciton redistribution among localized states and identify characteristic energy shifts that provide clear optical signatures of magnetic phase transitions in CrPS₄. These results provide new insights into the excitonic transitions of antiferromagnets and suggest potential routes for all-optical sensing and light-driven control of their magnetic order.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合多体微扰理论、动力学平均场理论和光致发光实验，研究层状反铁磁半导体 CrPS₄ 的电子与激子性质。结果表明，反铁磁相中的 CrPS₄ 是直接带隙半导体，并存在多个主要局域在 Cr³⁺ 离子上的亚带隙激子跃迁。温度和磁场依赖的光学测量揭示了局域激子态间的热驱动重分布，并给出了磁相变的清晰光学特征。
authors: Dipankar Jana, Swagata Acharya, Amit Pawbake, Dmitrii Litvinov, Aljoscha Soll, Zdenek Sofer, Clement Faugeras, Dimitar Pashov, Mark van Schilfgaarde, Kostya S. Novoselov, Marek Potemski, Maciej Koperski
articles.abstract_zh_full: 层状范德华磁性半导体为探索与自旋和晶格自由度交织的激子现象提供了一个多功能平台，使激子能够作为磁有序的敏感探针。CrPS₄ 是一种层状反铁磁半导体，具有丰富的激子特征，但其微观起源及其与磁有序之间的联系仍未被完全理解。在这里，我们结合多体微扰理论、动力学平均场理论以及基于光致发光的实验，研究了体相 CrPS₄ 的电子和激子性质。我们的计算确定 CrPS₄ 在反铁磁相中是一种直接带隙半导体，带隙为 2.48 eV。理论预测了若干亚带隙激子跃迁，包括多个自旋允许激子以及一个额外的自旋翻转激发，它们主要局域在 Cr³⁺ 离子上。温度和磁场依赖的光学测量揭示了局域态之间由热驱动的激子重分布，并识别出特征性能量位移，这些位移为 CrPS₄ 中的磁相变提供了清晰的光学信号。这些结果为反铁磁体中的激子跃迁提供了新的认识，并提示了用于全光学传感和光驱动控制其磁有序的潜在途径。

articles.title: Emergence and Detection of Surface altermagnetism in KV₂Se₂O
articles.title_zh: KV₂Se₂O 中表面交替磁性的涌现与探测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03551v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate the recent concept of emergent surface altermagnetism through its unique signatures in KVSO. We show that for bulk antiferromagnetically ordered KVSO, the (001) surface exhibits d-wave altermagnetism. Our results fully explain the recent seemingly contradicgting experimental evidence, independently showing both an antiferromagnetically ordered bulk from neutron diffraction, and d-wave spin splitting from photoemission spectroscopy. To fully verify this conecept, we predict, as a key experimental signature, a large nonlinear Edelstein response, which is localized at the surface, and follows the d-wave altermagnetic symmetry. These results are not only relevant for the metallic and room-temperature magnet KVSO, but also for several other Lieb lattice systems. Our work expands the pool of techniques that can be used to detect altermagnetism emerging at the surfaces of antiferromagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作以 KV₂Se₂O 为例展示了涌现表面交替磁性的概念及其独特信号。作者指出，体相反铁磁有序的 KV₂Se₂O 在 (001) 表面表现出 d 波交替磁性，从而解释了中子衍射与光电子能谱实验看似矛盾的结果。研究还预测了局域于表面的强非线性 Edelstein 响应，作为验证该概念的关键实验特征。
authors: Rodrigo Jaeschke-Ubiergo, Xanthe H. Verbeek, Colin Lange, Sergio Rodriguez, Atasi Chakraborty, Alexander Mook, Jairo Sinov
articles.focus_summary: 该预印本提出并检测表面 altermagnetism，展示 KV2Se2O 的体相反铁磁序在 (001) 表面可表现出 d 波自旋分裂。作者还预测了局域于表面的非线性 Edelstein 响应作为实验信号。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们关注的磁性材料、altermagnetism、磁性拓扑性质和自旋输运高度相关。该工作涉及表面磁性与对称性分析，也可与我们的自旋哈密顿量和磁输运研究互补。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步结合对称性分析、第一性原理和自旋模型研究类似表面 altermagnetic 体系。若团队后续关注磁性拓扑界面态或自旋电输运，这篇具有启发性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过 KV₂Se₂O 中的独特信号展示了近期提出的涌现表面交替磁性概念。我们表明，对于体相反铁磁有序的 KV₂Se₂O，其 (001) 表面呈现 d 波交替磁性。我们的结果完整解释了近期看似相互矛盾的实验证据，即中子衍射独立显示体相为反铁磁有序，而光电子能谱显示 d 波自旋劈裂。为充分验证这一概念，我们预测了一个关键实验信号，即一种大的非线性 Edelstein 响应，该响应局域在表面，并遵循 d 波交替磁性对称性。这些结果不仅与金属性、室温磁体 KV₂Se₂O 相关，也适用于若干其他 Lieb 晶格体系。我们的工作扩展了可用于探测反铁磁体表面涌现交替磁性的技术范围。

articles.title: Strain Tuning of Orbital-Driven Giant Magnetoresistance in van der Waals ferrimagnet Mn₃Si₂Te₆
articles.title_zh: 范德华亚铁磁体 Mn₃Si₂Te₆ 中轨道驱动巨磁阻的应变调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03568v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Strain engineering of magnetotransport offers a powerful strategy for uncovering emergent electronic and domain phenomena in quantum magnetic materials, while providing a promising pathway toward next-generation mechanically programmable spintronic technologies. Van der Waals magnets are particularly attractive in this context because their high crystallinity and mechanical flexibility allow exceptionally large, precisely controllable strain, enabling access to strain-induced functionalities unattainable in conventional solids. Here, we report systematic strain control of the van der Waals magnet Mn₃Si₂Te₆, which exhibits an unconventional colossal magnetoresistance whose microscopic origin remains under debate. We demonstrate in situ large-strain modulation of the electrical resistance in bulk crystals and show that the effect can be consistently explained by strain-tunable chiral orbital-current domains. Furthermore, measurements on exfoliated flake devices containing a single chiral domain reveal direct strain control of the electronic structure affected by orbital magnetic moment, establishing a unified microscopic mechanism for the unconventional colossal magnetoresistance. These results identify strain as an exceptionally effective control parameter for tailoring electronic and magnetic states in van der Waals magnets and provide a conceptual framework for realizing spin-straintronic functionalities based on orbital degrees of freedom.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统考察了应变对范德华磁体 Mn₃Si₂Te₆ 磁输运行为的调控，该材料表现出微观机制仍有争议的非常规巨磁阻。实验显示，体晶中电阻可被大应变原位调制，并可由应变可调的手性轨道电流畴解释。单手性畴薄片器件进一步证明，应变能直接调控受轨道磁矩影响的电子结构，为非常规巨磁阻提供统一机制。
authors: Abdul Ahad, Miuko Tanaka, Shunta Aoki, Darius-Alexandru Deaconu, Varun Shah, Tenta Kitamura, Hao Ou, Mohammad Saeed Bahramy, Jiang Pu, Toshiya Ideue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁输运的应变工程为揭示量子磁性材料中新兴的电子和畴现象提供了一种强有力策略，同时也为下一代机械可编程自旋电子技术提供了一条有前景的路径。范德华磁体在这一背景下尤其具有吸引力，因为其高结晶性和机械柔性允许异常大的、精确可控的应变，从而能够获得传统固体中无法实现的应变诱导功能。在这里，我们报道了对范德华磁体 Mn₃Si₂Te₆ 的系统应变控制研究，该材料表现出一种非常规的超大磁阻，其微观起源仍存在争论。我们展示了体晶中电阻的原位大应变调制，并表明该效应可由应变可调的手性轨道电流畴一致地解释。此外，对包含单个手性畴的剥离薄片器件的测量揭示了对应受轨道磁矩影响的电子结构的直接应变控制，从而建立了非常规超大磁阻的统一微观机制。这些结果确认应变是调控范德华磁体中电子态和磁态的一种极其有效的控制参数，并为实现基于轨道自由度的自旋-应变电子功能提供了概念框架。

articles.title: Microscopic Origin of Random Singlet Behavior in B-site Disordered Spin-1/2 Perovskite BaCu₁/3Nb₂/3O₃ Revealed by EXAFS and Thermodynamics
articles.title_zh: EXAFS 与热力学揭示 B 位无序自旋 1/2 钙钛矿 BaCu₁/₃Nb₂/₃O₃ 中随机单重态行为的微观起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03671v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a combined structural and thermodynamic study of the ABO₃₋ₜype disordered perovskite BaCu₁/₃Nb₂/₃O₃ (BCNO), whose B site is jointly occupied by Cu and Nb in the 1:2 ratio. Using synchrotron powder x-ray diffraction (XRD) and x-ray absorption fine structure (XAFS) spectroscopy, we investigate the microscopic nature of Cu²⁺/Nb⁵⁺ disorder on the pseudo-cubic B-sublattice and its relation to the emergent random-singlet (RS) behavior evidenced at low temperatures. While XRD reveals no long-range Cu/Nb ordering and average site occupancy consistent with stoichiometry, XAFS reveals a peculiar local chemical order characterized by preferential heteroatomic Cu:Nb correlations. This local arrangement strongly suppresses direct Cu:Cu linkages, despite the Cu concentration being close to the percolation threshold of a cubic lattice. The resulting exchange network explains the absence of spin-glass freezing or long-range magnetic order in the presence of substantial antiferromagnetic interactions, as indicated by a Curie-Weiss temperature ΘCWapprox -50 K. Instead, the magnetic susceptibility ḩi(T) and specific heat cₚ₍T) exhibit power-law behavior and characteristic single-parameter T/H scaling over broad temperature and magnetic-field ranges, consistent with random-singlet phenomenology. Notably, at very low temperatures, the specific heat behavior transitions from T¹⁻γ (γ approx 0.6 from the T/H scaling) in zero-field to a T-linear dependence under high field, indicating a crossover to a distinct low-energy regime whose microscopic origin remains to be established.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合结构表征与热力学测量，考察 B 位由 Cu 和 Nb 无序占据的钙钛矿 BaCu₁/₃Nb₂/₃O₃。XRD 显示无长程 Cu/Nb 有序，而 XAFS 揭示了偏好异原子 Cu:Nb 关联的局域化学有序，从而显著抑制直接 Cu:Cu 连接。由此形成的交换网络解释了在较强反铁磁相互作用下仍无自旋玻璃冻结或长程磁序，并支持低温随机单重态行为。
authors: Sagar Mahapatra, Francesco De Angelis, Martin Etter, Edmund Welter, M. P. Saravanan, Rajeev Rawat, Carlo Meneghini, Surjeet Singh
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们报道了对 ABO₃ 型无序钙钛矿 BaCu₁/₃Nb₂/₃O₃（BCNO）的结构和热力学联合研究，其 B 位由 Cu 和 Nb 按 1:2 的比例共同占据。利用同步辐射粉末 X 射线衍射（XRD）和 X 射线吸收精细结构（XAFS）谱学，我们研究了伪立方 B 子晶格上 Cu²⁺/Nb⁵⁺ 无序的微观性质及其与低温下出现的随机单重态（RS）行为之间的关系。尽管 XRD 未显示长程 Cu/Nb 有序，并且平均位点占有率与化学计量一致，XAFS 却揭示了一种特殊的局域化学有序，其特征是偏好的异原子 Cu:Nb 关联。尽管 Cu 浓度接近立方晶格的渗流阈值，这种局域排布仍强烈抑制直接的 Cu:Cu 连接。所得交换网络解释了在存在显著反铁磁相互作用的情况下没有自旋玻璃冻结或长程磁有序的原因，这一点由约 ΘCW ≈ -50 K 的居里-外斯温度所表明。相反，磁化率 χ(T) 和比热 cp(T) 在宽广的温度和磁场范围内表现出幂律行为以及特征性的单参数 T/H 标度，这与随机单重态现象学一致。值得注意的是，在极低温下，比热行为从零场中的 T¹⁻γ（由 T/H 标度得到 γ ≈ 0.6）转变为高场下的 T 线性依赖，表明其跨越到一个不同的低能区域，而该区域的微观起源仍有待确定。

articles.title: Machine Learning Bandgap Prediction of Nanoporous Graphenes with Water
articles.title_zh: 含水纳米多孔石墨烯带隙的机器学习预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The structure and dynamical behavior of water confined at or within nanostructures is a topic central to many fields, from biology to emerging electronics such as carbon nanostructures. Nanoporous graphene (NPG) containing periodic nanoscale pores with specific topologies has emerged as a promising material in carbon-based nanoelectronics; however, its interaction with ambient water remains poorly understood. Here, we combine density functional theory (DFT), ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD), and interpretable machine learning (ML) to reveal how water controls quantum transport in NPGs. Depending on the local hydration structure, the bandgap varies by more than a factor of two across NPG and nitrogen-doped hybrid (h-NPG) systems. To uncover the underlying mechanism, we develop Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP)-based black-box and physics-informed grey-box ML models. The Gaussian process regression model achieves near-DFT accuracy while enabling physical interpretation. Analysis identifies water dipole orientation, water-substrate distance, water center-of-geometry, and ribbon-resolved dipole moments as the dominant factors controlling bandgap modulation across NPG and h-NPG systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合 DFT、从头算分子动力学和可解释机器学习，揭示水如何影响纳米多孔石墨烯的量子输运。结果显示，不同局域水合结构可使 NPG 和氮掺杂 h-NPG 体系的带隙变化超过两倍。基于 SOAP 的机器学习模型接近 DFT 精度，并识别出水偶极取向、水-基底距离和带分辨偶极矩等关键调控因素。
authors: Sneha Mittal, Alan E. Anaya Morales, Victor Rosendal, Mads Brandbyge
articles.focus_summary: 该工作结合 DFT、从头算分子动力学和可解释机器学习研究水对纳米孔石墨烯及氮掺杂体系带隙和量子输运的影响。结果显示局域水合结构可使带隙变化超过两倍，SOAP-GPR 和物理启发模型识别出水偶极取向、距离和局域偶极矩等关键因素。
articles.focus_relation: 与团队的第一性原理、AIMD、机器学习材料性质预测、二维材料和量子输运方向有一定相关性。其可解释 ML 解析环境分子对电子结构调控的思路，可借鉴到二维半导体、界面电荷转移和湿度/吸附调控器件研究中。
articles.focus_suggestion: 建议选择性阅读其 SOAP 特征、灰盒模型和输运-结构关联分析方法。若团队关注二维半导体传感或界面吸附效应，可进一步扩展到缺陷、极化基底或电场下的载流子输运调控。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受限于纳米结构处或其内部的水的结构和动力学行为，是从生物学到碳纳米结构等新兴电子学在内许多领域的核心课题。含有特定拓扑周期性纳米尺度孔洞的纳米多孔石墨烯（NPG）已成为碳基纳米电子学中的一种有前景材料；然而，它与环境水之间的相互作用仍了解不足。在这里，我们结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、从头算分子动力学（AIMD）和可解释机器学习（ML），揭示水如何控制 NPG 中的量子输运。取决于局域水合结构，NPG 和氮掺杂杂化 NPG（h-NPG）体系中的带隙变化超过两倍。为揭示其内在机制，我们开发了基于原子位置平滑重叠（SOAP）的黑箱和物理信息灰箱机器学习模型。高斯过程回归模型实现了接近 DFT 的精度，同时能够进行物理解释。分析确定，水偶极取向、水-基底距离、水的几何中心以及按带分辨的偶极矩，是控制 NPG 和 h-NPG 体系中带隙调制的主导因素。

articles.title: Machine Learning-Guided Screening of Advantageous Solvents for Solid Polymer Electrolytes in Lithium Metal Batteries
articles.title_zh: 机器学习引导筛选锂金属电池固态聚合物电解质的优势溶剂
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03688v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Trace residual solvents in solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs) significantly affect electrolyte and interface properties, where optimal selection enhances ionic conductivity and transference numbers. However, solvent complexity hinders general screening methods. We establish a universal criterion linking electronic (HOMO, LUMO) and macroscopic properties (dielectric constant, dipole moment, polarizability) via machine learning on an approximately 10,000-solvent dataset from high-throughput DFT. Two solvents, N-methoxy-N-methyl-2,2,2-trifluoroacetamide and 2,2,2-trifluoro-N,N-dimethylacetamide, were identified. Experimental incorporation of trace N-methoxy-N-methyl-2,2,2-trifluoroacetamide into a poly(vinylidene fluoride-co-hexafluoropropylene) matrix achieves a 4.5 V window, 5.5x10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹ conductivity (30 C), and 0.78 Li+ transference number. The cell retains 86.7% capacity over 500 cycles (LiFePO4) and 98.7% after 200 cycles at 2C (LiNi0.9Co0.05Mn0.05O2), outperforming 2,2,2-trifluoro-N,N-dimethylacetamide, dimethylformamide, N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone, and dimethyl sulfoxide. This synergy enables balanced ion transport, wide stability, and cycling durability, advancing safer, high-energy lithium metal batteries. Our integrated approach establishes a solvent screening paradigm for rational SPE design, accelerating next-generation battery development.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用约一万个溶剂的高通量 DFT 数据和机器学习，建立了将电子性质与宏观性质相联系的通用溶剂筛选准则。研究筛选出两种含氟酰胺类溶剂，并实验证明痕量 N-methoxy-N-methyl-2,2,2-trifluoroacetamide 掺入 PVDF-HFP 基体后可显著提升电化学窗口、离子电导率、锂离子迁移数和循环稳定性。该方法为固态聚合物电解质的理性设计提供了筛选范式。
authors: Jiadong Shen, Junjie Chen, Xiaosa Xu, Jin Li, Zhenyu Wang, Pengzhu Lin, Zixiao Guo, Yu Wang, Jing Sun, Baoling Huang, Tianshou Zhao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 固态聚合物电解质（SPEs）中的痕量残余溶剂显著影响电解质和界面性质，其中优化选择可提高离子电导率和迁移数。然而，溶剂复杂性阻碍了通用筛选方法的发展。我们基于来自高通量 DFT 的约 10,000 种溶剂数据集，通过机器学习建立了一个连接电子性质（HOMO、LUMO）与宏观性质（介电常数、偶极矩、极化率）的通用准则。两种溶剂 N-methoxy-N-methyl-2,2,2-trifluoroacetamide 和 2,2,2-trifluoro-N,N-dimethylacetamide 被识别出来。实验中将痕量 N-methoxy-N-methyl-2,2,2-trifluoroacetamide 掺入聚（偏二氟乙烯-co-六氟丙烯）基体，实现了 4.5 V 的电化学窗口、5.5×10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹ 的电导率（30 °C）以及 0.78 的 Li⁺ 迁移数。该电池在 LiFePO4 中 500 次循环后保持 86.7% 的容量，并在 LiNi0.9Co0.05Mn0.05O2 中以 2C 循环 200 次后保持 98.7% 的容量，性能优于 2,2,2-trifluoro-N,N-dimethylacetamide、二甲基甲酰胺、N-甲基-2-吡咯烷酮和二甲基亚砜。这种协同作用实现了均衡的离子传输、宽稳定窗口和循环耐久性，推动了更安全、高能量锂金属电池的发展。我们的集成方法为合理 SPE 设计建立了溶剂筛选范式，加速了下一代电池的发展。

articles.title: Cavity control of quantum phase transitions in a two-dimensional kondo lattice
articles.title_zh: 二维 Kondo 晶格中量子相变的腔控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cavity quantum electrodynamics offers a route to control quantum phases by using vacuum fluctuations of confined electromagnetic fields. In particular, planar cavities based on polar van der Waals materials can generate strongly confined modes and are promising for controlling two-dimensional correlated materials. Recently, moiré materials have become central platforms for studying two-dimensional heavy-fermion systems and their quantum phase transitions. Kondo lattices provide a prototypical model for studying quantum phase boundaries, driven by competition between Kondo screening and the ordering of local magnetic moments. We show that a cavity-induced interaction can shift the quantum phase transitions between a heavy-fermion phase and an antiferromagnetic phase in a two-dimensional Kondo lattice through a momentum-dependent self-energy of the conduction bands. For the longitudinal projected field motivated by h-BN hyperbolic phonon polaritons, the self-energy favors Kondo hybridization and expands the heavy-fermion region. Transverse and circular in-plane model structures give distinct effects, with the transverse case relatively favoring the magnetically ordered phase and the circular case lying between the longitudinal and transverse cases. These results indicate that electromagnetic vacuum fluctuations can effectively modify the control parameters of strongly correlated two-dimensional Kondo materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出利用腔量子电动力学中的电磁真空涨落调控二维 Kondo 晶格量子相变。作者表明，腔诱导相互作用可通过导带的动量依赖自能，移动重费米子相与反铁磁相之间的相边界。不同腔场结构对相竞争产生不同影响，其中受 h-BN 双曲声子极化激元启发的纵向投影场有利于 Kondo 杂化并扩展重费米子区域。
authors: Jun Mochida, Atac Imamoglu, Yuto Ashida
articles.abstract_zh_full: 腔量子电动力学提供了一条利用受限电磁场的真空涨落来控制量子相的途径。特别是，基于极性范德华材料的平面腔能够产生强受限模式，并有望用于控制二维关联材料。近年来，莫尔材料已成为研究二维重费米子体系及其量子相变的核心平台。Kondo 晶格为研究由 Kondo 屏蔽与局域磁矩有序之间的竞争所驱动的量子相边界提供了原型模型。我们表明，腔诱导相互作用能够通过导带的动量依赖自能，移动二维 Kondo 晶格中重费米子相与反铁磁相之间的量子相变。对于受 h-BN 双曲声子极化激元启发的纵向投影场，自能有利于 Kondo 杂化并扩大重费米子区域。横向和圆形面内模型结构产生不同效应，其中横向情形相对有利于磁有序相，而圆形情形介于纵向和横向情形之间。这些结果表明，电磁真空涨落能够有效改变强关联二维 Kondo 材料的控制参数。

articles.title: Guided Synthesis of EMT Zeolites by Machine Learning
articles.title_zh: 机器学习引导的 EMT 沸石合成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Zeolites are microporous crystalline materials with diverse frameworks, widely used in industrial applications such as petroleum refining and molecular separation. Unlike most zeolites, EMT can be synthesized under mild conditions (at low temperatures and without the use of organic structure-directing agents), making it attractive for cost-effective and environmentally sustainable production. However, the specific synthesis conditions that selectively produce EMT rather than similar frameworks like FAU are not yet well established. In this work, we develop machine learning (ML) models to guide the discovery of synthesis conditions for EMT zeolites. Our dataset comprises 174 experimental synthesis attempts, recording reaction time, temperature, silica and alumina sources, Si/Al stoichiometric ratio, and other synthesis parameters. We apply both classical ML methods and pretrained foundation models to predict zeolite framework outcomes from these synthesis parameters. Feature importance analysis identifies critical parameters for EMT formation, validating known synthesis principles. Leveraging the ML models, we explore the synthesis space and identify six promising new conditions for EMT formation. Experimental validation confirms EMT crystallization in five cases, including two with Si/Al stoichiometric ratios outside the training dataset's range. Evaluation on independent literature-reported synthesis conditions further demonstrates the generalizability of the model. This work demonstrates a data-driven approach to accelerating zeolite synthesis, closing the loop between ML prediction and experimental validation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发机器学习模型，用于从实验合成参数预测 EMT 沸石框架的形成条件。模型基于 174 次合成尝试，识别出影响 EMT 形成的关键参数，并提出六组新的候选条件。实验验证显示其中五组成功结晶出 EMT，表明机器学习可有效加速沸石合成条件发现。
authors: Emmanuel A. Olanrewaju, Santosh Adhikari, Zhiyin Niu, Michael Nikolaou, Jeremy C. Palmer, Jeffrey D. Rimer, Mingjian Wen
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03760v1 公告类型：新 摘要：沸石是具有多样骨架的微孔晶体材料，广泛用于石油炼制和分子分离等工业应用。不同于大多数沸石，EMT 可以在温和条件下合成，即低温且不使用有机结构导向剂，因此对低成本和环境可持续生产具有吸引力。然而，能够选择性生成 EMT 而非 FAU 等相似骨架的具体合成条件尚未得到充分确立。在本工作中，我们开发机器学习模型来指导 EMT 沸石合成条件的发现。我们的数据集包含 174 次实验合成尝试，记录了反应时间、温度、二氧化硅和氧化铝来源、Si/Al 化学计量比以及其他合成参数。我们同时采用经典机器学习方法和预训练基础模型，根据这些合成参数预测沸石骨架结果。特征重要性分析识别出 EMT 形成的关键参数，验证了已知的合成原则。借助机器学习模型，我们探索合成空间，并确定了六组有望形成 EMT 的新条件。实验验证确认其中五种情况下发生了 EMT 结晶，包括两种 Si/Al 化学计量比超出训练数据集范围的情况。在独立的文献报道合成条件上的评估进一步证明了模型的泛化能力。本工作展示了一种数据驱动的方法，可加速沸石合成，并实现机器学习预测与实验验证之间的闭环。

articles.title: Antisymmetric Dynamical Spin Correlations: Spin-Space-Group Constraints and Frequency-Moment Sum Rules
articles.title_zh: 反对称动力学自旋关联：自旋空间群约束与频率矩求和规则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03786v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polarized inelastic neutron scattering probes the handedness of magnetic excitations through the spin-component-antisymmetric part of the dynamical spin-structure-factor tensor. We derive its symmetry constraints under unitary and antiunitary residual operations of magnetic space groups and spin-space groups. These constraints determine the allowed tensor components, their parity under momentum reversal, and symmetry-enforced nodes. We then introduce the corresponding antisymmetric commutator spectral function and derive exact zero-temperature sum rules for its frequency moments. The zeroth moment is fixed by the uniform magnetization. For Heisenberg or XXZ exchange Hamiltonians, the first moment of the xy component is fixed by a momentum-weighted static vector chirality. For compensated collinear antiferromagnets, the antisymmetric dynamical structure factor is forbidden when inversion or a translation relates the opposite-spin sublattices. In rotation-related altermagnets, however, an xy component that is even under momentum reversal is allowed at generic wave vectors. Finite antisymmetric spectral weight can therefore coexist with vanishing zeroth and first moments of the commutator spectral function. In a planar helix, by contrast, a residual antiunitary spin-space-group symmetry makes the allowed xy component odd under momentum reversal. Its first moment is generally nonzero and is fixed by a momentum-weighted static vector chirality through the first-moment sum rule. Linear spin-wave calculations for representative altermagnetic and helical models explicitly realize these symmetry and sum-rule constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究推导了磁空间群和自旋空间群残余对称性对反对称动力学自旋结构因子的约束。作者进一步建立了相应的反对易谱函数频率矩求和规则，并分析了反铁磁体、交替磁体和螺旋磁体中的允许谱权重。线性自旋波计算验证了这些对称性和求和规则约束。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03786v1 公告类型：新 摘要：极化非弹性中子散射通过动力学自旋结构因子张量中关于自旋分量反对称的部分探测磁激发的手性。我们推导了其在磁空间群和自旋空间群的幺正与反幺正残余操作下的对称性约束。这些约束决定了允许的张量分量、它们在动量反演下的奇偶性以及由对称性强制产生的节点。随后，我们引入相应的反对称对易子谱函数，并推导其频率矩的精确零温求和规则。零阶矩由均匀磁化决定。对于海森堡或 XXZ 交换哈密顿量，xy 分量的一阶矩由动量加权的静态矢量手性决定。对于补偿型共线反铁磁体，当反演或平移把相反自旋子晶格联系起来时，反对称动力学结构因子被禁止。然而，在由旋转相关的交替磁体中，在一般波矢处允许存在一个在动量反演下为偶的 xy 分量。因此，有限的反对称谱权重可以与对易子谱函数的零阶和一阶矩同时为零共存。相比之下，在平面螺旋磁体中，残余的反幺正自旋空间群对称性使允许的 xy 分量在动量反演下为奇。其一阶矩通常非零，并通过一阶矩求和规则由动量加权的静态矢量手性决定。针对代表性交替磁模型和螺旋模型的线性自旋波计算明确实现了这些对称性和求和规则约束。

articles.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Refractory Alloy Design
articles.title_zh: 用于难熔合金设计的物理信息机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03805v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Refractory complex concentrated alloys (CCAs) exhibit exceptional mechanical properties at elevated temperatures, but their vast compositional space (approximately 10¹⁵ possible combinations) poses significant challenges for experimental exploration. We develop a physics-informed machine learning framework combining quantile gradient boosting with Born stability constraints to predict eight mechanical properties (bulk modulus B, shear modulus G, Vickers hardness Hv, elastic constants C11, C12, C44, Young's modulus E, and Poisson's ratio nu) of refractory CCAs. Using 393 density functional theory (DFT)-computed alloys from a 10-element design space (Cr, Hf, Mo, Nb, Re, Ta, Ti, V, W, Zr), we achieve coefficient of determination (R²⁾ values of 0.89 to 0.97 with mean absolute errors of 0.85 to 14.74 GPa across six properties on a held-out test set (n = 59). Remarkably, all test predictions satisfy the Born stability criteria (100% compliance), demonstrating the efficacy of physics-informed constraints. Compositional screening in valence electron concentration (VEC)-atomic size mismatch (delta) space identifies high-performance candidates, with MoReW exhibiting the highest predicted shear rigidity (C44 = 139 GPa). Elemental analysis reveals that rhenium appears in 100% of the top-performing alloys, molybdenum in 90%, and chromium in 80%, establishing quantitative design rules: VEC = 6.0 to 6.4, delta < 10%, and Re-Mo-Cr ternary systems maximize shear resistance. This physics-informed screening framework enables accelerated discovery of mechanically stable, high-performance refractory alloys from the trillion-scale compositional space.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出结合分位数梯度提升与 Born 稳定性约束的物理信息机器学习框架，用于预测难熔复杂集中合金的多种力学性质。模型在 393 个 DFT 计算合金数据上表现良好，并在测试集中全部满足 Born 稳定性准则。筛选结果给出高性能合金设计规则，强调 Re、Mo、Cr 体系及特定 VEC 和原子尺寸失配范围的重要性。
authors: Blaise Awola Ayirizia, Bimal K C, Jorge A. Munoz San Martin
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03805v1 公告类型：新 摘要：难熔复杂集中合金在高温下表现出优异的力学性能，但其巨大的成分空间，约有 10¹⁵ 种可能组合，给实验探索带来了重大挑战。我们开发了一个物理信息机器学习框架，将分位数梯度提升与 Born 稳定性约束相结合，用于预测难熔复杂集中合金的八种力学性质，包括体模量 B、剪切模量 G、维氏硬度 Hv、弹性常数 C11、C12、C44、杨氏模量 E 和泊松比 nu。利用来自 10 元素设计空间 Cr、Hf、Mo、Nb、Re、Ta、Ti、V、W、Zr 的 393 个密度泛函理论计算合金，我们在保留测试集 n = 59 上，对六种性质取得了 0.89 至 0.97 的决定系数 R² 值，平均绝对误差为 0.85 至 14.74 GPa。值得注意的是，所有测试预测均满足 Born 稳定性准则，符合率为 100%，证明了物理信息约束的有效性。在价电子浓度 VEC—原子尺寸失配 delta 空间中的成分筛选识别出高性能候选材料，其中 MoReW 具有最高的预测剪切刚度，C44 = 139 GPa。元素分析显示，铼出现在 100% 的顶级性能合金中，钼出现在 90% 中，铬出现在 80% 中，由此建立了定量设计规则：VEC = 6.0 至 6.4，delta < 10%，以及 Re-Mo-Cr 三元体系可最大化剪切抗力。该物理信息筛选框架能够从万亿量级的成分空间中加速发现力学稳定且高性能的难熔合金。

articles.title: Generalized Space Groups from Internal Configuration Spaces
articles.title_zh: 由内部构型空间得到的广义空间群
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop a unified construction of generalized space groups for crystals with unconventional internal degrees of freedom. Starting from the full group G_P of allowed internal transformations and the stabilizer P of a reference object, we determine the pointwise and setwise symmetries, J and K, of the allowed configuration set. Goursat's lemma then couples the internal quotient K/J to a spatial quotient. The framework includes ordinary, magnetic, spin, and color space groups as special cases. As an example, we consider a dodecahedral object with P=Isimeq A₅, for which we obtain the nontrivial pair Ttriangleleft O with O/Tsimeqmathbb Z₂. The resulting generalized space group hosts a point node with topological charge |C|=12.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种统一方法，用于构造具有非常规内部自由度晶体的广义空间群。框架从允许内部变换群和参考对象稳定子出发，利用 Goursat 引理耦合内部商群与空间商群，并涵盖普通、磁、 spin 和颜色空间群等情形。作者以十二面体对象为例，得到一个具有拓扑电荷 |C|=12 点节点的广义空间群。
authors: Zeying Zhang, Zhenye Li, Zhi-Ming Yu, Gui-Bin Liu, Yugui Yao
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03808v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们为具有非常规内部自由度的晶体发展了一种广义空间群的统一构造。从允许的内部变换全群 G_P 和参考对象的稳定子 P 出发，我们确定允许构型集合的逐点对称性和集合对称性 J 与 K。随后，Goursat 引理将内部商群 K/J 与一个空间商群耦合起来。该框架把普通空间群、磁空间群、自旋空间群和颜色空间群作为特例包含在内。作为一个例子，我们考虑一个具有 P=I≃A₅ 的十二面体对象，对此得到非平凡的对 T◁O，且 O/T≃Z₂。所得广义空间群容纳一个拓扑电荷 |C|=12 的点节点。

articles.title: Two-phonon pairing and superconductivity in SrTiO₃
articles.title_zh: SrTiO₃ 中的双声子配对与超导性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03823v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We explore the possibility that the two-phonon pairing mechanism proposed by Ngai can explain superconductivity in doped strontium titanate (STO). The two-phonon deformation potential is evaluated using two distinct theoretical estimates based on first-principles calculations and two empirical estimates based on experimental data, yielding very large values of the same order of magnitude. We derive the effective electron-electron interaction mediated by two-phonon exchange. Crucial to our computations is the strong dispersion of the involved soft phonons. Because the scale of the two-phonon interaction is much larger than the Fermi energy, the Migdal theorem does not apply. We obtain a one-loop Eliashberg equation that can be solved in the weak-coupling limit. We find that despite the significant electron-phonon matrix element, phase space considerations considerably reduce the effective coupling. A two-phonon mechanism can not be excluded based on the T_c magnitude, but its value is dominated by the high-energy-frequency physics and is weakly affected by the soft-phonon behavior. The theory predicts a T_c that monotonously increases with doping, which is not in accordance with the experiment. We identify the conditions for a two-phonon mechanism to be effective in other materials and discuss possible candidates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨 Ngai 提出的双声子配对机制是否可解释掺杂钛酸锶的超导性。作者基于第一性原理和实验数据估算双声子形变势，并推导双声子交换介导的有效电子相互作用。结果表明该机制不能仅凭 Tc 大小被排除，但其预测的 Tc 随掺杂单调增加，与实验不符。
authors: Antonio Santacesaria, Cristiano Muzzi, Maria Eleonora Temperini, Paolo Barone, Maria N. Gastiasoro, José Lorenzana
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03823v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们探索 Ngai 提出的双声子配对机制是否能够解释掺杂钛酸锶 STO 中的超导性。双声子形变势通过两种基于第一性原理计算的不同理论估计和两种基于实验数据的经验估计进行评估，得到的数值都非常大且处于同一数量级。我们推导了由双声子交换介导的有效电子—电子相互作用。对我们的计算至关重要的是所涉及软声子的强色散。由于双声子相互作用的尺度远大于费米能量，Migdal 定理不适用。我们得到一个单圈 Eliashberg 方程，并可在弱耦合极限下求解。我们发现，尽管电子—声子矩阵元很大，相空间因素显著降低了有效耦合。基于 T_c 的大小不能排除双声子机制，但其数值主要由高能频率物理主导，而受软声子行为的影响较弱。该理论预测 T_c 随掺杂单调增加，这与实验不符。我们确定了双声子机制在其他材料中有效所需的条件，并讨论了可能的候选材料。

articles.title: Local magnetic order in vacancy-disrupted spin ice Ho2TiO5
articles.title_zh: 空位扰乱自旋冰 Ho2TiO5 中的局域磁有序
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03850v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how local magnetic correlations evolve when the classical pyrochlore spin-ice Ho2Ti2O7 is transformed into the partially disordered stuffed compound Ho2TiO5. Neutron scattering measurements were analyzed using real-space magnetic pair distribution function, reciprocal-space reverse Monte Carlo, and half-polarized neutron powder diffraction methods to connect the average crystal structure with local magnetic correlations. Both compounds retain long-range Fd-3m symmetry, but in Ho2TiO5 this average structure distorts locally through Ho-O, Ti-O and O-O bond-length disorder associated with partial Ho/Ti occupancy. Despite this disorder, half-polarized neutron powder diffraction shows that the Ho moments retain local <111> rangle Ising anisotropy and form spin-in/spin-out configurations on the tetrahedral network. In Ho2Ti2O7, real- and reciprocal-space analyses reveal a nearly ideal two-in/two-out spin-ice state at 0.3K, with 95% of tetrahedra satisfying the ice rule, followed by progressive thermal disordering on warming. In Ho2TiO5, most tetrahedra are magnetically incomplete because some tetrahedral vertices are occupied by nonmagnetic Ti rather than Ho; nevertheless, the dominant incomplete configurations are 2-in/1-out and 1-in/2-out, which are locally compatible with the ice rule if the missing Ho spin is restored. The single-ion <111> Ising anisotropy is therefore retained throughout, while the collective ice ordering is strongly disrupted: Ho2TiO5 is a vacancy-disrupted spin ice in which a local ice-rule tendency persists on a topologically incomplete magnetic network.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察经典烧绿石自旋冰 Ho2Ti2O7 转变为部分无序填充化合物 Ho2TiO5 时局域磁关联的演化。中子散射分析表明，Ho2TiO5 虽存在局域结构无序和磁性网络不完整，但 Ho 磁矩仍保持局域 <111> Ising 各向异性。结果显示 Ho2TiO5 是一种空位扰乱的自旋冰，局域冰规则倾向在拓扑不完整网络中仍然存在。
authors: Raju Baral, Haidong Zhou, Qiang Zhang, Benjamin A. Frandsen, Stuart Calder
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03850v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们研究当经典烧绿石自旋冰 Ho2Ti2O7 转变为部分无序的填充化合物 Ho2TiO5 时，局域磁关联如何演化。中子散射测量通过实空间磁对分布函数、倒空间反向蒙特卡洛和半极化中子粉末衍射方法进行分析，以连接平均晶体结构与局域磁关联。两种化合物都保持长程 Fd-3m 对称性，但在 Ho2TiO5 中，这一平均结构由于与部分 Ho/Ti 占位相关的 Ho-O、Ti-O 和 O-O 键长无序而发生局域畸变。尽管存在这种无序，半极化中子粉末衍射显示 Ho 磁矩仍保持局域 <111> Ising 各向异性，并在四面体网络上形成 spin-in/spin-out 构型。在 Ho2Ti2O7 中，实空间和倒空间分析显示在 0.3 K 时存在近乎理想的二进二出自旋冰态，95% 的四面体满足冰规则，随后在升温时逐渐发生热无序化。在 Ho2TiO5 中，由于某些四面体顶点被非磁性 Ti 而非 Ho 占据，大多数四面体在磁性上是不完整的；尽管如此，主导的不完整构型是 2-in/1-out 和 1-in/2-out，如果缺失的 Ho 自旋被恢复，它们在局域上与冰规则相容。因此，单离子 <111> Ising 各向异性始终保留，而集体冰有序受到强烈扰乱：Ho2TiO5 是一种空位扰乱的自旋冰，其中局域冰规则倾向在拓扑不完整的磁性网络上持续存在。

articles.title: Magnetic-field control of Fermi polaron fine structure and polarization in strained monolayer semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 应变单层半导体中磁场对费米极化子精细结构和偏振的控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03853v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The theory of attractive Fermi polaron energy spectrum fine structure and polarization in doped two-dimensional semiconductors in external magnetic field is developed. Fermi polaron g factor renormalization due to correlations with the valley-polarized Fermi sea of resident charge carriers is calculated. We study the competition between Zeeman and strain-induced splittings in monolayers under uniaxial strain. The control of strain, magnetic field and electron density allows continuous tuning of energy splitting and eigenstate polarization. Linearly polarized strain-induced split doublet exhibits quadratic Zeeman shift changing to linear Zeeman splitting with elliptical polarization with the increase of magnetic field. We identify a critical magnetic field above which resident charge carriers become fully valley polarized and only one circularly polarized Fermi polaron state remains. Within the Green's function approach we calculate energy levels and Stokes parameters of attractive Fermi polaron states and introduce a simplified effective two-level model allowing us to study analytically the interplay of Zeeman and pseudo-Zeeman splitting. We calculate absorption and reflection spectra, including circular and linear dichroism in the trion spectral range. These results show that real and strain-induced pseudomagnetic fields provide complementary tools for controlling the optical response of many-body excitonic quasiparticles in two-dimensional semiconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究建立了外磁场中掺杂二维半导体吸引型费米极化子能谱精细结构与偏振的理论。作者分析了单轴应变下 Zeeman 分裂与应变诱导分裂的竞争，并表明应变、磁场和电子密度可连续调控能级分裂与本征态偏振。计算结果说明真实磁场和应变诱导伪磁场可协同控制二维半导体多体激子准粒子的光学响应。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03853v1 公告类型：新 摘要：本文发展了外磁场中掺杂二维半导体吸引型费米极化子能谱精细结构和偏振的理论。计算了由于与驻留载流子的谷极化费米海关联而导致的费米极化子 g 因子重整化。我们研究了单轴应变单层中 Zeeman 分裂与应变诱导分裂之间的竞争。对应变、磁场和电子密度的控制允许连续调节能量分裂和本征态偏振。线偏振的应变诱导分裂双重态表现出二次 Zeeman 位移，并随着磁场增强转变为具有椭圆偏振的线性 Zeeman 分裂。我们确定了一个临界磁场，超过该磁场后驻留载流子变为完全谷极化，并且只剩下一个圆偏振的费米极化子态。在格林函数方法中，我们计算了吸引型费米极化子态的能级和 Stokes 参数，并引入一个简化的有效二能级模型，使我们能够解析研究 Zeeman 分裂与伪 Zeeman 分裂之间的相互作用。我们计算了吸收和反射光谱，包括三激子光谱范围内的圆二色性和线二色性。这些结果表明，真实磁场和应变诱导的伪磁场为控制二维半导体中多体激子准粒子的光学响应提供了互补工具。

articles.title: Emergence of Chiral Helimagnetic Order in Chromium-intercalated Tantalum Disulfide CrTa₃S₆ Powders with Controlled Intercalation
articles.title_zh: 受控插层 CrTa₃S₆ 粉末中手性螺旋磁有序的出现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03953v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a highly sensitive change in magnetic properties of a chiral Cr-intercalated transition-metal dichalcogenide CrₓTa₃S₆. Magnetization curves and small-angle neutron scattering data revealed that the powder samples exhibit chiral helimagnetism with a Cr intercalation quantity x below 0.996, while they show ferromagnetism above 1.000. The emergence and temperature-dependent evolution of the helimagnetic period are argued in terms of sample dimensions of powders and microfabricated crystals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了手性 Cr 插层过渡金属二硫属化物 CrₓTa₃S₆ 的磁性质对 Cr 插层量高度敏感。磁化曲线和小角中子散射显示，x 低于 0.996 的粉末样品表现出手性螺旋磁性，而 x 高于 1.000 时表现出铁磁性。作者从粉末与微加工晶体的样品尺寸角度讨论了螺旋磁周期的出现及其随温度演化。
authors: Ayaka Toshima, Keigo Mizutani, Yusuke Kousaka, Kazuki Ohishi, Hiroaki Shishido, Yoshihiko Togawa
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03953v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们报道了一种手性 Cr 插层过渡金属二硫属化物 CrₓTa₃S₆ 的磁性质对 Cr 插层量具有高度敏感的变化。磁化曲线和小角中子散射数据表明，当 Cr 插层量 x 低于 0.996 时，粉末样品表现出手性螺旋磁性，而当 x 高于 1.000 时则表现出铁磁性。本文从粉末和微加工晶体的样品尺寸角度讨论了螺旋磁周期的出现及其随温度变化的演化。

articles.title: Structure of matrix product locally purifiable density operators
articles.title_zh: 矩阵乘积局域可纯化密度算符的结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02724v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tensor network methods provide powerful analytical and numerical tools for characterizing quantum phases of matter. While the mathematical structure of matrix product states (MPS) is well understood through the MPS fundamental theorem, an analogous understanding for mixed-state tensor networks remains largely absent: if two purification tensors generate the same density matrix, how are they related? In this work, we initiate the study of a fundamental theorem for matrix product locally purifiable density operators (LPDOs) and focus on sequentially generated LPDOs (sLPDOs), a broad subclass admitting an interpretation in terms of successive applications of quantum channels on an initial state. We prove that, under suitable invertibility or cyclic conditions, two sLPDO representations generate the same density matrix for arbitrary system sizes if and only if they are related by a matrix product isometry acting on the purification bonds. Beyond the sLPDO setting, we provide a counterexample that suggests an obstruction to a general fundamental theorem for LPDOs with periodic boundary conditions. Finally, we discuss implications for mixed-state symmetry-protected topological phases, including the possibility of nontrivial phases protected only by weak symmetry conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨混态张量网络中矩阵乘积局域可纯化密度算符的基本结构，重点关注顺序生成的 LPDO。作者证明，在适当可逆性或循环条件下，两个 sLPDO 表示在任意系统大小下生成相同密度矩阵，当且仅当它们由作用于纯化键的矩阵乘积等距变换联系。研究还指出周期边界条件下一般 LPDO 基本定理可能存在障碍，并讨论了对混态对称保护拓扑相的影响。
authors: Yale Yauk, Yuhan Liu, Ignacio Cirac
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02724v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：张量网络方法为表征物质量子相提供了强大的解析和数值工具。虽然矩阵乘积态 MPS 的数学结构已经通过 MPS 基本定理得到充分理解，但对于混态张量网络仍然很大程度上缺乏类似理解：如果两个纯化张量生成相同的密度矩阵，它们之间如何相关？在本工作中，我们开启对矩阵乘积局域可纯化密度算符 LPDO 基本定理的研究，并聚焦于顺序生成的 LPDO，即 sLPDO，这是一个广泛的子类，可解释为量子通道在初态上的连续作用。我们证明，在适当的可逆性或循环条件下，两个 sLPDO 表示对任意系统大小生成相同的密度矩阵，当且仅当它们通过作用于纯化键上的矩阵乘积等距变换相联系。在 sLPDO 情形之外，我们给出一个反例，表明对于具有周期边界条件的一般 LPDO，建立一般基本定理可能存在障碍。最后，我们讨论了其对混态对称保护拓扑相的影响，包括仅由弱对称条件保护的非平凡相的可能性。

articles.title: Fermionic Villain model with exact lattice chiral symmetries
articles.title_zh: 具有精确晶格手征对称性的费米子 Villain 模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02728v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a fermionic lattice Hamiltonian that exactly realizes the U(1)_L× U(1)_R global symmetry and the associated chiral anomalies of a massless Dirac fermion in 1+1 dimensions. The construction couples Villain bosons to a Kitaev chain of Majorana fermions, where the bosonic fields are essential for evading Nielsen-Ninomiya-type no-go theorems. For two copies of our model, we realize the anomaly-free U(1)₃₄₅₀ global symmetry and construct symmetric boundary conditions. We analytically demonstrate symmetric mass generation by mapping the symmetry-preserving six-fermion interactions to fermion bilinear terms using fermionic T-duality. Finally, by gauging general anomaly-free global symmetries, we obtain a broad class of lattice chiral gauge theories. As nontrivial applications, we compute the mass spectra of the lattice Schwinger model and the 3450 gauge theory, finding agreement with the corresponding continuum results.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种费米子晶格哈密顿量，可精确实现 1+1 维无质量 Dirac 费米子的 U(1)_L×U(1)_R 全局对称性及其手征反常。模型将 Villain 玻色子与 Majorana 费米子的 Kitaev 链耦合，并利用玻色场规避 Nielsen-Ninomiya 型禁阻定理。作者进一步构造无反常对称、展示对称质量生成，并通过规范化无反常全局对称得到一类晶格手征规范理论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02728v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们提出一种费米子晶格哈密顿量，它精确实现了 1+1 维无质量 Dirac 费米子的 U(1)_L× U(1)_R 全局对称性及其相关手征反常。该构造将 Villain 玻色子与 Majorana 费米子的 Kitaev 链相耦合，其中玻色场对于规避 Nielsen-Ninomiya 型禁阻定理是必不可少的。对于我们模型的两个副本，我们实现了无反常的 U(1)₃₄₅₀ 全局对称性，并构造了对称边界条件。我们通过利用费米子 T 对偶将保持对称性的六费米子相互作用映射为费米子双线性项，解析地展示了对称质量生成。最后，通过规范化一般无反常全局对称性，我们得到了一大类晶格手征规范理论。作为非平凡应用，我们计算了晶格 Schwinger 模型和 3450 规范理论的质量谱，发现其与相应连续理论结果一致。

articles.title: Dynamic Induction of Lattice Gauge Theories on a Quantum Computer
articles.title_zh: 量子计算机上晶格规范理论的动态诱导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02756v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gauge invariance is central to modern physics and underpins quantum simulations of lattice gauge theories (LGTs). Existing quantum simulation approaches employ Gauss's law either to energetically suppress gauge-violating processes in analog platforms or to detect and discard gauge-violating outcomes in digital devices. Here we introduce a third paradigm, in which Gauss's law is used to dynamically generate the gauge theory itself from a substantially simpler Hamiltonian. Starting from a readily programmable three-body XXX model, we employ experimentally efficient single-qubit U(1) gauge symmetry-generator terms that induce the dynamics of a U(1) LGT. We implement this approach using 101 qubits on a 156-qubit IBM quantum processor and observe real-time dynamics in quantitative agreement with the target LGT while reducing the entangling-gate depth per Trotter step by a factor of five compared with a direct implementation. Our results establish gauge protection as a resource for Hamiltonian engineering rather than merely symmetry preservation, opening a scalable resource-efficient route towards digital quantum simulations of increasingly complex gauge theories in higher spatial dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种利用 Gauss 定律动态生成晶格规范理论的新范式，而不仅是抑制或筛除规范破缺过程。作者从较简单的三体 XXX 模型出发，加入单量子比特 U(1) 规范对称生成元项以诱导 U(1) 晶格规范理论动力学。该方法在 IBM 量子处理器的 101 个量子比特上实现，并显著降低了每个 Trotter 步的纠缠门深度。
authors: Barbara Andrade, Declan Millar, Lewis Anderson, Vincent R. Pascuzzi, Maciej Lewenstein, Ivano Tavernelli, Jad C. Halimeh, Tobias Grass
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02756v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：规范不变性是现代物理的核心，并支撑着晶格规范理论 LGT 的量子模拟。现有量子模拟方法要么在模拟平台中利用 Gauss 定律以能量方式抑制破坏规范的过程，要么在数字设备中检测并丢弃破坏规范的结果。这里我们引入第三种范式，其中 Gauss 定律被用于从一个显著更简单的哈密顿量动态生成规范理论本身。从一个易于编程的三体 XXX 模型出发，我们采用实验上高效的单量子比特 U(1) 规范对称生成元项，诱导 U(1) LGT 的动力学。我们使用 IBM 156 量子比特量子处理器上的 101 个量子比特实现了这一方法，并观察到与目标 LGT 定量一致的实时动力学，同时相比直接实现，每个 Trotter 步的纠缠门深度降低了五倍。我们的结果确立了规范保护作为哈密顿量工程资源的地位，而不仅仅是对称性保持手段，为在更高空间维度中对日益复杂的规范理论进行可扩展且资源高效的数字量子模拟开辟了道路。

articles.title: Compound symmetries and double antisymmetry groups in linear time-invariant photonic systems
articles.title_zh: 线性时不变光子系统中的复合对称性与双反对称群
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02902v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Symmetry is fundamental to photonic systems. External (spatial) symmetries and internal symmetries---Lorentz reciprocity, energy conservation, and time-reversal symmetry---constrain the electromagnetic response. Photonic systems can also possess compound symmetries that combine external and internal transformations, exemplified by parity-time (PT) symmetry. However, a unified framework for general compound symmetries involving reciprocity, energy conservation, and time reversal remains lacking, leaving their classification and physical implications unexplored. In this paper, we present such a framework for linear photonic systems. We define compound transformations and symmetries, and derive their constraints on electromagnetic fields and scattering matrices. We show that internal, external, and compound symmetries are naturally described by the theory of double antisymmetry groups. This theory classifies linear time-invariant photonic systems into twelve symmetry categories, each imposing characteristic constraints on the electromagnetic response. We illustrate two representative categories with numerical examples of photonic crystal slabs and apply the theory to examine Kirchhoff's law of thermal radiation for a gyrotropic sphere. Our work provides a systematic foundation for analyzing and engineering symmetry in photonic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究为线性光子系统中结合空间对称性与互易性、能量守恒、时间反演等内部对称性的复合对称性建立统一框架。作者推导了这些对称性对电磁场和散射矩阵的约束，并用双反对称群理论将线性时不变光子系统分为十二类。数值示例和热辐射 Kirchhoff 定律分析展示了该理论在光子系统对称性分析与工程设计中的作用。
authors: Yunrui Wang, Shiyu Li, Cheng Guo
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02902v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：对称性是光子系统的基础。外部即空间对称性以及内部对称性——Lorentz 互易性、能量守恒和时间反演对称性——约束着电磁响应。光子系统还可以具有把外部和内部变换结合起来的复合对称性，其典型例子是宇称—时间 PT 对称性。然而，目前仍缺乏一个针对涉及互易性、能量守恒和时间反演的一般复合对称性的统一框架，使得它们的分类和物理含义尚未得到探索。在本文中，我们为线性光子系统提出了这样一个框架。我们定义了复合变换和复合对称性，并推导了它们对电磁场和散射矩阵的约束。我们表明，内部、外部和复合对称性可由双反对称群理论自然描述。该理论将线性时不变光子系统划分为十二个对称性类别，每一类都对电磁响应施加特征性约束。我们用光子晶体板的数值例子说明了两个代表性类别，并将该理论应用于考察旋磁球体的热辐射 Kirchhoff 定律。我们的工作为分析和工程化设计光子系统中的对称性提供了系统基础。

articles.title: A Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator for Transient Magnetization Prediction in Power Magnetics
articles.title_zh: 用于功率磁性器件瞬态磁化预测的物理信息混合神经算子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02965v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetic components in high-frequency, high-power-density converters are increasingly driven by non-sinusoidal flux-density waveforms with fast transitions, minor-loop operation, dc bias, and temperature variation. Under these conditions, steady-state core-loss formulas and single-valued material curves cannot fully capture transient magnetization responses. This work proposes the Physics-Informed Hybrid Neural Operator (PI-HNO), a compact material-specific neural model with B-H energy-consistency regularization for core-loss-oriented transient magnetization prediction. Given the measured B(t)-H(t) history, the input B(t) series over the prediction interval and operating-condition information, PI-HNO predicts the H(t) series and the corresponding reconstructed B-H trajectory. The model integrates a local recurrent branch for boundary-state representation and rate-dependent response evolution with a Preisach-inspired global branch that extracts waveform-level hysteresis context. Evaluation on the MagNetX transient database using material-specific models for 14 ferrite materials demonstrates that PI-HNO achieves a compact trade-off between sequence accuracy and B(t)-H(t) energy consistency, with the mean and 95th percentile B(t)-H(t) energy consistency errors of 1.92% and 7.60%, respectively, using only 4777 trainable parameters per model. Ablation studies further demonstrate that the local, global, and energy-aware regularized components provide distinct contributions to transient magnetization prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种面向磁芯损耗的紧凑型材料专用模型 PI-HNO，用于在非正弦磁通密度波形、直流偏置和温度变化等条件下预测瞬态磁化响应。该模型结合局部递归分支、受 Preisach 启发的全局分支以及 B-H 能量一致性正则化，可由 B(t)-H(t) 历史和工作条件预测 H(t) 与重构磁滞轨迹。在 MagNetX 数据库上对 14 种铁氧体材料的评估表明，该方法以很少参数实现了序列精度与能量一致性的良好折中。
authors: Yachao Zhu, Qiujie Huang, Sinan Li, Yang Li, Gang Lei, Jianguo Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.02965v1 公告类型：交叉。高频、高功率密度变换器中的磁性元件越来越多地由具有快速跃迁、小回线运行、直流偏置和温度变化的非正弦磁通密度波形驱动。在这些条件下，稳态磁芯损耗公式和单值材料曲线无法充分捕捉瞬态磁化响应。本文提出物理信息混合神经算子（PI-HNO），这是一种紧凑的材料专用神经模型，带有用于面向磁芯损耗的瞬态磁化预测的 B-H 能量一致性正则化。给定测得的 B(t)-H(t) 历史、预测区间内的输入 B(t) 序列以及工作条件信息，PI-HNO 预测 H(t) 序列及相应重构的 B-H 轨迹。该模型整合了一个用于边界状态表征和速率相关响应演化的局部递归分支，以及一个受 Preisach 启发、用于提取波形级磁滞上下文的全局分支。在 MagNetX 瞬态数据库上使用针对 14 种铁氧体材料的材料专用模型进行评估表明，PI-HNO 在序列精度与 B(t)-H(t) 能量一致性之间实现了紧凑折中；每个模型仅使用 4777 个可训练参数时，B(t)-H(t) 能量一致性误差的均值和第 95 百分位数分别为 1.92% 和 7.60%。消融研究进一步表明，局部、全局和能量感知正则化组件对瞬态磁化预测提供了不同的贡献。

articles.title: Negative Differential Capacitance from Composition-Dependent Stern Capacitance in a Binary Mixture
articles.title_zh: 二元混合物中由组成依赖 Stern 电容导致的负微分电容
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03189v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a thermodynamic theory of electric double layers in binary liquid mixtures by allowing the Stern-layer capacitance to depend on the local solvent composition. This coupling produces an additional negative contribution to the inverse differential capacitance. As a result, the surface potential can become a nonmonotonic function of the surface charge density, leading to negative differential capacitance and a voltage-induced first-order transition between two electric-double-layer states. We determine the coexistence condition using a common-tangent construction for the surface-charge-controlled grand potential and obtain phase diagrams in terms of the Stern-capacitance contrast, surface charge density, bulk composition, and surface potential. We also compare the theory with capacitance data for tetrabutylammonium chloride in water/1-propanol mixtures, finding semi-quantitative agreement in the continuous-response regime. These results suggest that solvent exchange inside the Stern layer can strongly control the capacitance and interfacial phase behavior of binary mixtures.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了二元液体混合物中电双层的热力学理论，允许 Stern 层电容依赖局域溶剂组成。该耦合可对逆微分电容产生额外负贡献，从而引发负微分电容和电压诱导的一阶界面状态转变。作者给出了相图，并与水/1-丙醇混合物中四丁基氯化铵的电容数据进行了半定量比较。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03189v1 公告类型：交叉。我们发展了一种二元液体混合物中电双层的热力学理论，其中允许 Stern 层电容依赖于局域溶剂组成。这种耦合会对逆微分电容产生一个额外的负贡献。因此，表面电势可能成为表面电荷密度的非单调函数，从而导致负微分电容以及两个电双层状态之间由电压诱导的一阶转变。我们使用针对表面电荷控制的巨势的公切线构造来确定共存条件，并获得了以 Stern 电容反差、表面电荷密度、体相组成和表面电势表示的相图。我们还将该理论与水/1-丙醇混合物中四丁基氯化铵的电容数据进行了比较，发现其在连续响应区域具有半定量一致性。这些结果表明，Stern 层内部的溶剂交换可以强烈控制二元混合物的电容和界面相行为。

articles.title: Entangling Topological Invariants
articles.title_zh: 纠缠拓扑不变量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03634v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An isolated occupied multiplet may admit local tensor-product descriptions without a globally consistent subsystem structure. We characterize the obstruction by comparing the transition functions of the occupied multiplet with those generated by independent basis changes in the two candidate subsystems. When a decomposition into rank-one sectors over a closed surface is specified, the resulting quotient removes row- and column-additive Chern data and yields mixed Chern classes. Momentum-dependent mixing of the sector labels adds the Gauss--Codazzi curvature of the moving lines, while in the label-conserving limit the mixed class is measured by a crossed Thouless pump. When only the factor dimensions p and q are specified, the comparison is made at the level of the clutching map of a rank-pq bundle over S⁴. Product frames generate winding numbers in qmathbb Z+pmathbb Z, so global factorization is possible exactly when C₂ is divisible by gcd(p,q); in particular, odd C₂ obstructs a 2×2 factorization. We illustrate the two settings with finite eight-level Hamiltonians and give pumping and occupied-projector tomography protocols for their readout.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究占据多重态虽可局域写成张量积但缺乏全局一致子系统结构时的拓扑阻碍。作者通过比较占据多重态的过渡函数与候选子系统独立基变换生成的过渡函数，定义了混合 Chern 类等不变量。研究还讨论了秩为 pq 的丛在 S⁴ 上的拼接映射条件，并给出有限八能级哈密顿量示例及泵浦和投影层析读出方案。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03634v1 公告类型：交叉。一个孤立的占据多重态可能允许局域的张量积描述，却没有全局一致的子系统结构。我们通过比较占据多重态的过渡函数与由两个候选子系统中的独立基变换所生成的过渡函数来刻画这种阻碍。当指定了闭合曲面上分解为秩一扇区的方式时，所得商结构去除了行可加和列可加的 Chern 数据，并产生混合 Chern 类。扇区标签的动量依赖混合会增加运动直线的 Gauss--Codazzi 曲率，而在标签守恒极限中，混合类由交叉 Thouless 泵来测量。当只指定因子维数 p 和 q 时，比较是在 S⁴ 上秩为 pq 的丛的拼接映射层面进行的。乘积标架生成 qmathbb Z+pmathbb Z 中的绕数，因此全局因子化恰好在 C₂ 可被 gcd(p,q) 整除时可能；特别地，奇数 C₂ 会阻碍 2×2 因子化。我们用有限八能级哈密顿量说明这两种情形，并给出用于读出的泵浦协议和占据投影算符层析协议。

articles.title: A table-top few-femtosecond broadband extreme-ultraviolet absorption spectrometer with cryogenic cooling
articles.title_zh: 一种带低温冷却的台式数飞秒宽带极紫外吸收光谱仪
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.03955v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a table-top cryogenic ultrafast broadband XUV absorption spectroscopy (c-UBXAS) beamline designed for temperature-dependent and time-resolved investigations of quantum materials. The instrument combines a broadband high-harmonic generation source spanning 22-73 eV with automated image registration and cryogenic sample control down to 20 K, enabling element-specific measurements under both equilibrium and nonequilibrium conditions. The beamline provides sub-50-meV energy resolution and a sub-10-fs instrument response function, while maintaining long-term stability suitable for extended, ultrasensitive measurements. Benchmark experiments on NiI₂, a van der Waals multiferroic, reveal temperature-dependent spectral evolution across its magnetic phase transitions, demonstrating the ability to identify element-specific contributions to the ground state and its transient response in the femtosecond regime. This instrument introduces the opportunity to unravel the very first response of a solid-state material during light-matter interaction, paving the way for understanding the complex phase space of nonequilibrium dynamics and emergent states in strongly correlated systems where the few-femtosecond electronic response has eluded most other types of time-resolved techniques.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了一条台式低温超快宽带极紫外吸收光谱（c-UBXAS）光束线，用于量子材料的温度依赖和时间分辨研究。该装置结合 22–73 eV 的宽带高次谐波光源、自动图像配准和最低 20 K 的样品温控，实现元素特异性测量。对 NiI₂ 的基准实验展示了其在飞秒尺度解析磁相变相关光谱演化和瞬态响应的能力。
authors: Sheng-Chih Lin, Alfred Zong, Emma Berger, Bailey R. Nebgen, Marcus Hui, Shuaiwei Pan, Jackson McClellan, Michael W. Zuerch
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2608.03955v1 公告类型：交叉。我们提出了一条台式低温超快宽带 XUV 吸收光谱（c-UBXAS）光束线，设计用于量子材料的温度依赖和时间分辨研究。该仪器结合了覆盖 22–73 eV 的宽带高次谐波产生光源、自动图像配准以及低至 20 K 的低温样品控制，从而能够在平衡和非平衡条件下进行元素特异性测量。该光束线提供低于 50 meV 的能量分辨率和低于 10 fs 的仪器响应函数，同时保持适合长期、超灵敏测量的稳定性。对范德华多铁材料 NiI₂ 的基准实验揭示了其跨越磁相变时的温度依赖光谱演化，展示了在飞秒范围内识别基态及其瞬态响应中元素特异性贡献的能力。该仪器带来了揭示固态材料在光-物质相互作用期间最初响应的机会，为理解强关联体系中非平衡动力学和涌现态的复杂相空间铺平道路，而其中数飞秒电子响应一直难以被大多数其他类型的时间分辨技术捕捉。

articles.title: Engineering correlated Dirac fermions and flat bands on SiC with transition-metal adatom lattices
articles.title_zh: 利用过渡金属吸附原子晶格在 SiC 上工程化关联 Dirac 费米子和平带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.17165v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose three transition-metal adatom systems on SiC surfaces as a versatile platform to realize massless Dirac fermions and flat bands with strong electronic correlations. Using density functional theory combined with the constrained random phase approximation and dynamical mean-field theory, we investigate the electronic properties of Ti, V, and Cr adatoms. The triangular surface lattices exhibit narrow bandwidths and effective two-band Hubbard models near the Fermi level, originating from partially filled adatom d orbitals. For the undoped systems our calculations reveal two distinct Mott insulating ground states. While the V lattice is a paramagnetic textbook case with large local moments, the Cr lattice, in contrast, is on the edge of a phase transition toward a flat-band Fermi liquid. The Ti lattice realizes a heavy Dirac semimetal at zero doping.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出三种 SiC 表面过渡金属吸附原子体系，作为实现强电子关联无质量 Dirac 费米子和平带的平台。作者结合密度泛函理论、受限随机相近似和动态平均场理论研究 Ti、V、Cr 吸附原子的电子性质。结果显示三角表面晶格在费米能级附近形成窄带和有效两带 Hubbard 模型，并在不同元素中呈现 Mott 绝缘体、平带费米液体临界和重 Dirac 半金属等状态。
authors: Henri Menke, Niklas Enderlein, Roland Gillen, Yi-Ting Tseng, Michel Bockstedte, Janina Maultzsch, Giorgio Sangiovanni, Philipp Hansmann
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2410.17165v2 公告类型：替换。我们提出了 SiC 表面上的三种过渡金属吸附原子体系，作为实现具有强电子关联的无质量 Dirac 费米子和平带的多功能平台。利用密度泛函理论结合受限随机相近似和动态平均场理论，我们研究了 Ti、V 和 Cr 吸附原子的电子性质。三角形表面晶格表现出窄带宽以及费米能级附近的有效两带 Hubbard 模型，这些模型源自部分填充的吸附原子 d 轨道。对于未掺杂体系，我们的计算揭示了两种不同的 Mott 绝缘基态。V 晶格是具有大局域磁矩的顺磁教科书式案例，而 Cr 晶格则处在向平带费米液体相变的边缘。Ti 晶格在零掺杂下实现了重 Dirac 半金属。

articles.title: Quantum Monte Carlo study of the bond- and site-diluted transverse-field Ising model
articles.title_zh: 键稀释和位点稀释横场 Ising 模型的量子蒙特卡罗研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.07627v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the transverse-field Ising model on a square lattice with bond- and site-dilution at zero temperature by stochastic series expansion quantum Monte Carlo simulations. Tuning the transverse field h and the dilution p, the quantum phase diagram of both models is explored. Both quantum phase diagrams show long-range order for small h and small p. The ordered phase of each is separated from the disordered (quantum) Griffiths phase by second-order phase transitions on two critical lines touching at a multi-critical point. Using Binder ratios we locate quantum critical points with high accuracy. The order-parameter critical exponent β and the average correlation-length exponent νₐᵥ are determined along the critical lines and at the multi-critical points via finite-size scaling. We find three internally consistent sets of critical exponents and compare them with potentially connected universality classes. The quantum Griffiths phase in the vicinity of the phase transition lines is analyzed through the local susceptibility. Our results indicate that activated scaling occurs not only at the percolation transition, but also at the phase transition line for p smaller than the percolation threshold p_c.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗模拟研究零温下平方晶格上的键稀释和位点稀释横场 Ising 模型。通过调节横场和稀释度，作者得到两类模型的量子相图，并用 Binder 比高精度定位量子临界点。研究给出临界指数、分析 Griffiths 相局域磁化率，并指出激活标度不仅出现在渗流转变处，也出现在低于渗流阈值的相变线上。
authors: C. Krämer, M. Hörmann, K. P. Schmidt
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2505.07627v2 公告类型：替换。我们通过随机级数展开量子蒙特卡罗模拟研究了零温下平方晶格上具有键稀释和位点稀释的横场 Ising 模型。通过调节横场 h 和稀释度 p，探索了两个模型的量子相图。两个量子相图都在小 h 和小 p 时显示长程有序。每个模型的有序相都通过两条临界线上的二阶相变与无序的（量子）Griffiths 相分隔，这两条临界线在一个多临界点相接。利用 Binder 比，我们高精度地确定了量子临界点。通过有限尺寸标度，沿临界线并在多临界点处确定了序参量临界指数 β 和平均关联长度指数 νₐᵥ。我们发现了三组内部自洽的临界指数，并将它们与可能相关的普适类进行了比较。通过局域磁化率分析了相变线附近的量子 Griffiths 相。我们的结果表明，激活标度不仅出现在渗流转变处，也出现在 p 小于渗流阈值 p_c 时的相变线上。

articles.title: Majorana modes in graphene strips: polarization, wavefunctions, disorder, and Andreev states
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯条带中的 Majorana 模式：极化、波函数、无序与 Andreev 态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.22713v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Topologically protected Majorana zero modes (MZMs) have attracted intense interest due to their potential application in fault-tolerant quantum computation (TQC). Graphene nanoribbons, with tunable edge terminations and compatibility with planar device architectures, offer a promising alternative to semiconductor nanowires. Here we present a comprehensive theoretical study of finite graphene strips with armchair, zigzag, and nearly square geometries, proximitized by an s-wave superconductor and subject to Rashba spin-orbit coupling, Zeeman fields, and disorder. Using exact diagonalization of the Bogoliubov-de Gennes tight-binding Hamiltonian, we analyze Majorana polarization, low-energy spectra, and real-space wavefunctions to identify the non-trivial topological phases supporting MZMs and distinguish them from from partially separated Andreev bound states (psABS) or the quasi-Majoranas. We systematically chart the robustness of these modes across geometries and disorder regimes, finding that armchair strips with short zigzag edges provide the most stable platform. Our results unify polarization diagnostics with spatial wavefunction analysis and disorder effects, yielding concrete design guidelines for graphene-based topological superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文系统研究了有限石墨烯条带在 s 波超导近邻、Rashba 自旋轨道耦合、Zeeman 场和无序作用下的 Majorana 零模。作者通过 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 紧束缚哈密顿量的精确对角化，分析 Majorana 极化、低能谱和实空间波函数，以区分拓扑零模与部分分离 Andreev 束缚态。结果表明，带短锯齿边的扶手椅型条带是最稳定的平台，并给出石墨烯拓扑超导器件的设计准则。
authors: Shubhanshu Karoliya, Sumanta Tewari, Gargee Sharma
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2511.22713v2 公告类型：替换。受拓扑保护的 Majorana 零模（MZM）因其在容错量子计算（TQC）中的潜在应用而受到强烈关注。石墨烯纳米带具有可调的边缘终止形式，并与平面器件架构兼容，因此为半导体纳米线提供了一种有前景的替代方案。在这里，我们对有限石墨烯条带进行了全面的理论研究，这些条带具有扶手椅型、锯齿型和近似方形几何形状，并与 s 波超导体近邻耦合，同时受到 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合、Zeeman 场和无序的作用。利用 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 紧束缚哈密顿量的精确对角化，我们分析 Majorana 极化、低能谱和实空间波函数，以识别支持 MZM 的非平庸拓扑相，并将其与部分分离的 Andreev 束缚态（psABS）或准 Majorana 区分开来。我们系统绘制了这些模式在不同几何形状和无序条件下的稳健性，发现具有短锯齿边的扶手椅型条带提供了最稳定的平台。我们的结果将极化诊断与空间波函数分析和无序效应统一起来，为基于石墨烯的拓扑超导体给出了具体的设计指南。

articles.title: Quantum decay of magnons in the unfrustrated honeycomb Heisenberg model
articles.title_zh: 无阻挫蜂窝 Heisenberg 模型中磁振子的量子衰变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.19162v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the physical properties of elementary magnon excitations of the ordered antiferromagnetic Heisenberg model on the honeycomb lattice using quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations, series expansions (SE), and continuous similarity transformations (CST). The stochastic analytic continuation method is used to determine the dynamic structure factor from correlation functions in imaginary time obtained by QMC. In contrast to the "roton minimum" of the square lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet, we find that magnons on the honeycomb lattice completely decay in the corner of the Brillouin zone (K-point); the entire weight is shifted into the continuum. These findings are fully supported by SE and CST in momentum space. The extrapolated one-magnon dispersion obtained from SE about the Ising limit quantitatively agrees with the extracted QMC excitation energies except around the K-point, where large uncertainties in the extrapolation indicate the magnon decay. This quantum decay is further confirmed and understood by the CST, which yields a divergent flow when enforcing a magnon quasi-particle picture. The divergence originates from strong attractive magnon-magnon interactions leading to a bound state and thereby to a three-magnon continuum overlapping with the one-magnon state. This has the magnon quasi-particle picture break down at high energies on the honeycomb lattice.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用量子蒙特卡罗、级数展开和连续相似变换研究蜂窝晶格有序反铁磁 Heisenberg 模型的基本磁振子激发。结果显示，与平方晶格反铁磁体的“旋子极小值”不同，蜂窝晶格磁振子在布里渊区 K 点完全衰变，谱权重转移到连续谱中。级数展开和连续相似变换均支持这一结论，并表明强吸引磁振子相互作用导致束缚态和三磁振子连续谱与单磁振子态重叠，从而破坏高能准粒子图像。
authors: Calvin Krämer, Dag-Björn Hering, Vanessa Sulaiman, Matthias R. Walther, Götz S. Uhrig, Kai Phillip Schmidt
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2512.19162v2 公告类型：替换。我们利用量子蒙特卡罗（QMC）模拟、级数展开（SE）和连续相似变换（CST）研究了蜂窝晶格上有序反铁磁 Heisenberg 模型基本磁振子激发的物理性质。随机解析延拓方法被用于从 QMC 获得的虚时间关联函数中确定动态结构因子。不同于平方晶格 Heisenberg 反铁磁体的“旋子极小值”，我们发现蜂窝晶格上的磁振子在布里渊区角点（K 点）完全衰变；全部权重都转移到连续谱中。这些发现得到了动量空间中 SE 和 CST 的完全支持。从 Ising 极限出发通过 SE 得到的外推单磁振子色散与从 QMC 提取的激发能量在定量上相符，除了 K 点附近；在那里外推中的大不确定性表明了磁振子衰变。CST 进一步证实并解释了这种量子衰变；当强制采用磁振子准粒子图像时，CST 产生发散流。该发散源于强吸引的磁振子-磁振子相互作用，这种相互作用导致束缚态，并进而导致三磁振子连续谱与单磁振子态重叠。这使得蜂窝晶格上高能处的磁振子准粒子图像失效。

articles.title: Electrically Controllable Flat Band in Two-Dimensional Electron Gases under Nonuniform Magnetic Fields
articles.title_zh: 非均匀磁场下二维电子气中电可控平带
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.05064v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Flat bands underlie a diverse range of quantum phenomena, from strongly correlated phases to superconductivity. We theoretically establish that a two-dimensional electron gas under a linear magnetic-field gradient and a transverse electric field exhibits electrically tunable flat bands. When the electric field magnitude is tuned to a value within a discrete sequence, these bands become strictly dispersionless. By providing exact classical and quantum solutions, we demonstrate that these states are high-order Landau levels associated with drift-compensated cyclotron orbits of carriers arising from the synergy between the magnetic-field gradient and the electric field. These electrically controllable Landau levels exhibit quantized Hall conductance and a strongly enhanced density of states. Our results provide a new route for flat-band creation, magnetoelectric band engineering, and quantized Hall currents controlled via source-drain voltage.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文理论证明，处于线性磁场梯度和横向电场中的二维电子气可表现出电可调平带。当电场强度取离散序列中的特定值时，这些能带严格无色散。作者通过精确经典和量子解说明这些态是由磁场梯度与电场协同产生、与漂移补偿回旋轨道相关的高阶 Landau 能级，并具有量子化 Hall 电导和增强态密度。
authors: You-Ting Huang, Chao-Cheng Kaun, Ching-Hao Chang
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2601.05064v3 公告类型：替换。平带是从强关联相到超导等多种量子现象的基础。我们从理论上确定，处于线性磁场梯度和横向电场下的二维电子气表现出电可调的平带。当电场大小被调节到离散序列中的某个值时，这些能带变得严格无色散。通过给出精确的经典和量子解，我们证明这些态是高阶 Landau 能级，相关于载流子由磁场梯度和电场协同作用产生的漂移补偿回旋轨道。这些电可控 Landau 能级表现出量子化 Hall 电导和显著增强的态密度。我们的结果为平带产生、磁电能带工程以及通过源漏电压控制的量子化 Hall 电流提供了一条新途径。

articles.title: Phase-space networks and connectivity of the kagome antiferromagnet
articles.title_zh: Kagome 反铁磁体的相空间网络与连通性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.05933v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the coplanar ground-state manifold of the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet using a phase-space network representation, in which nodes correspond to coplanar ground states and edges represent transitions generated by weathervane loop rotations. In the coplanar manifold, each configuration can be mapped to a three-coloring problem on the dual honeycomb lattice, where a weathervane mode corresponds to a closed loop of two alternating colors. By comparing networks that include all weathervane loops with networks restricted to elementary six-spin loops, we examine how energetic constraints shape phase-space structure. We find that connectivity distributions are sharply peaked in large systems, while restrictions to short loops reduce typical connectivity. Spectral properties further distinguish the two cases, with short-loop networks exhibiting Gaussian spectra and full networks displaying non-Gaussian features associated with correlated loop updates. Finally, a box-counting analysis reveals distinct fractal properties of the two networks, demonstrating how energetic constraints control the global geometry of configuration space. These results show that the hierarchy of weathervane loop rotations provides a direct link between microscopic constraints and emergent phase-space geometry in a frustrated magnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文用相空间网络表示研究 kagome Heisenberg 反铁磁体的共面基态流形，其中节点为共面基态，边为风向标环旋转诱导的跃迁。通过比较包含所有风向标环的网络与仅含基本六自旋环的网络，作者分析能量约束如何塑造相空间结构。结果显示短环限制会降低典型连通性，并在谱性质和盒计数分形性质上与完整网络明显不同，揭示微观约束与涌现相空间几何之间的联系。
authors: Brandon B. Le, Seung-Hun Lee, Gia-Wei Chern
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2601.05933v2 公告类型：替换。我们使用相空间网络表示研究 kagome Heisenberg 反铁磁体的共面基态流形，其中节点对应于共面基态，边表示由风向标环旋转生成的转变。在共面流形中，每个构型都可以映射到对偶蜂窝晶格上的三着色问题，其中一个风向标模式对应于由两种交替颜色组成的闭合环。通过比较包含所有风向标环的网络与限制为基本六自旋环的网络，我们考察能量约束如何塑造相空间结构。我们发现，在大系统中连通性分布呈尖锐峰形，而对短环的限制会降低典型连通性。谱性质进一步区分了这两种情况，短环网络表现出高斯谱，而完整网络显示出与相关环更新相关的非高斯特征。最后，盒计数分析揭示了两个网络不同的分形性质，表明能量约束如何控制构型空间的整体几何。这些结果显示，风向标环旋转的层级结构在受阻磁体中提供了微观约束与涌现相空间几何之间的直接联系。

articles.title: Theory of Little-Parks oscillations by vortices in two-dimensional superconductors
articles.title_zh: 二维超导体中由涡旋产生的 Little-Parks 振荡理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.23050v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Little-Parks (LP) effect is a quantum phenomenon in which the superconducting transition temperature of a superconducting cylinder (or ring) oscillates periodically as a function of the magnetic flux threading the loop. Recently, multiple experiments have observed half-quantum flux shifts in measurements of LP oscillations, where the oscillations are globally shifted by half a flux quantum compared to conventional cases, a behavior referred to as a π-ring. Such observations are commonly linked to unconventional pairing symmetries. In this work, we demonstrate that half-quantum flux shifts can arise in two-dimensional (2D) superconducting rings without invoking unconventional pairing symmetry, provided that vortices near the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition are taken into account. Specifically, based on the vortex-charge duality theory near the BKT transition, we map the problem onto a Coulomb gas model, in which the magnetic flux is represented as a pair of opposite boundary charges (or vortices) at the two edges. The screening of these boundary charges by thermally excited vortex-antivortex pairs is investigated through explicit Monte Carlo simulations. Importantly, we demonstrate that the oscillation of the free-vortex density as a function of magnetic flux can exhibit an anomalous half-quantum flux shift. Our work thus predicts the LP oscillations induced by vortices in 2D superconducting rings near the BKT transition, which provides a new mechanism for generating π-rings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出二维超导环在 BKT 转变附近由涡旋诱导 Little-Parks 振荡的新机制。作者基于涡旋-电荷对偶理论，将磁通表示为边界处一对相反边界电荷或涡旋，并用蒙特卡罗模拟研究热激发涡旋-反涡旋对的屏蔽。结果表明，自由涡旋密度随磁通的振荡可出现反常半量子磁通位移，从而无需非常规配对也可能产生 π 环行为。
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2601.23050v2 公告类型：替换。Little-Parks（LP）效应是一种量子现象，其中超导圆柱（或环）的超导转变温度会随穿过环的磁通呈周期性振荡。最近，多项实验在 LP 振荡测量中观察到半量子磁通位移，即振荡相对于常规情况整体移动了半个磁通量子，这种行为被称为 π 环。这类观察通常与非常规配对对称性相关联。在这项工作中，我们证明，在二维（2D）超导环中，只要考虑 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless（BKT）转变附近的涡旋，半量子磁通位移可以在不诉诸非常规配对对称性的情况下产生。具体而言，基于 BKT 转变附近的涡旋-电荷对偶理论，我们将该问题映射到一个 Coulomb 气模型，其中磁通被表示为位于两个边界处的一对相反边界电荷（或涡旋）。我们通过显式蒙特卡罗模拟研究了热激发涡旋-反涡旋对对这些边界电荷的屏蔽。重要的是，我们证明自由涡旋密度随磁通的振荡可以表现出反常的半量子磁通位移。因此，我们的工作预言了二维超导环在 BKT 转变附近由涡旋诱导的 LP 振荡，为产生 π 环提供了一种新机制。

articles.title: Polytype-Dependent Upconversion Photoluminescence in 3R-MoS2
articles.title_zh: 3R-MoS₂ 中依赖多型的上转换光致发光
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.03780v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ferroelectric van der Waals materials offer switchable polarization states, yet optical readout of their stacking configurations remains challenging. Here, building on the resonant exciton-exciton annihilation (EEA) mechanism recently identified in 2H-phase TMDs, we report the first observation of upconversion photoluminescence (UPL) in rhombohedral MoS₂ and demonstrate that this many-body process is strongly polytype-dependent. Using low-temperature spectroscopy, we observe anti-Stokes emission with superlinear power dependence characteristic of EEA. Beyond serving as an accurate layer-number sensor due to discrete bandgap variations, UPL provides a sensitive probe of stacking order across thicknesses. The two neutral trilayer polytypes, which remain indistinguishable by surface potential measurements and second harmonic generation, exhibit markedly different UPL intensities. This sensitivity persists in thicker samples where multiple configurations coexist. First-principles calculations suggest that the intensity contrast originates primarily from the layer confinement of the annihilating excitons, while energy matching to the Γ final-state manifold provides additional intensity selectivity. Power-dependent spectroscopy further disentangles two distinct annihilation channels originating from different dark exciton valleys, identified through their contrasting intensity scaling and opposite density-induced energy shifts. Crucially, the annihilation process doubles the energy separation of nearly degenerate dark excitons while converting their weak emission into bright signal, providing experimental access to valley-specific responses that are obscured in direct dark-exciton spectroscopy. Our findings demonstrate that ferroelectric configurations provide a new degree of freedom for controlling nonlinear optical processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文首次报道菱方相 MoS₂ 中的上转换光致发光，并证明该多体过程强烈依赖多型结构。低温光谱显示出具有激子-激子湮灭特征的反 Stokes 发射和超线性功率依赖，使其可作为层数和堆垛顺序的敏感探针。第一性原理和功率依赖光谱进一步表明，强度差异主要来自湮灭激子的层限域，并揭示了不同暗激子谷的两个湮灭通道。
authors: Omri Meron, Idan Kizel, Dror Hershkovitz, Youngki Yeo, Nirmal Roy, Wei Cao, Alon Ron, Moshe Ben Shalom, Haim Suchowski
articles.abstract_zh_full: arXiv:2602.03780v2 公告类型：替换。铁电范德华材料提供可切换的极化态，然而其堆垛构型的光学读出仍然具有挑战性。在这里，基于最近在 2H 相 TMD 中识别出的共振激子-激子湮灭（EEA）机制，我们报道了菱方 MoS₂ 中上转换光致发光（UPL）的首次观察，并证明这一多体过程强烈依赖多型。利用低温光谱，我们观察到具有 EEA 特征的反 Stokes 发射，其功率依赖呈超线性。除了由于离散带隙变化而可作为精确的层数传感器之外，UPL 还提供了一种跨不同厚度探测堆垛有序性的敏感手段。两个中性三层多型通过表面电势测量和二次谐波产生仍然无法区分，但它们表现出显著不同的 UPL 强度。这种敏感性在多种构型共存的更厚样品中仍然存在。第一性原理计算表明，强度反差主要源自发生湮灭的激子的层限域，而与 Γ 终态流形的能量匹配提供了额外的强度选择性。功率依赖光谱进一步区分了源自不同暗激子谷的两个不同湮灭通道，这些通道通过其相反的强度标度和相反的密度诱导能量位移来识别。关键的是，湮灭过程使近简并暗激子的能量分离加倍，同时将其微弱发射转化为明亮信号，从而提供了对谷特异性响应的实验访问途径，而这些响应在直接暗激子光谱中会被遮蔽。我们的发现表明，铁电构型为控制非线性光学过程提供了一个新的自由度。

articles.title: Singularity of information flow at the Hopf bifurcation point
articles.title_zh: Hopf 分岔点处信息流的奇异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.02632v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the singular behavior of information flow near the Hopf bifurcation point by analyzing the learning rate as a specific measure of information flow. We study the Brusselator, a model system exhibiting the Hopf bifurcation. We first numerically compute the learning rate in the stationary regime and find that it remains finite even in the deterministic limit, suggesting that the learning rate can be quantified in deterministic dynamics through probabilistic descriptions. Linear analysis accurately reproduces the numerical results in the stationary regime but fails near the bifurcation point. To overcome this limitation, we employ the singular perturbation method, well known in deterministic bifurcation theory, and carry out the corresponding calculation explicitly for a stochastic system described by a Langevin equation. This allows us to evaluate the learning rate near the bifurcation point. We then theoretically derive its non-smooth behavior in the deterministic limit. Our results demonstrate that changes in dynamical behavior are reflected in the learning rate and provide a basis for analyzing information processing in biochemical oscillations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过学习率这一信息流度量，分析 Hopf 分岔点附近信息流的奇异行为。作者以 Brusselator 模型为例，发现学习率在确定性极限下仍保持有限，并可通过概率描述量化确定性动力学中的信息流。进一步的奇异摄动分析揭示了分岔点附近学习率在确定性极限中的非光滑行为，为理解生化振荡中的信息处理提供基础。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过分析学习率这一信息流的特定度量，研究 Hopf 分岔点附近信息流的奇异行为。我们研究了 Brusselator 这一表现出 Hopf 分岔的模型系统。我们首先在定态区域数值计算学习率，并发现即使在确定性极限中它仍保持有限，这表明可以通过概率描述来量化确定性动力学中的学习率。线性分析能够准确再现定态区域中的数值结果，但在分岔点附近失效。为克服这一限制，我们采用确定性分岔理论中熟知的奇异摄动方法，并对由 Langevin 方程描述的随机系统显式进行了相应计算。这使我们能够评估分岔点附近的学习率。随后，我们从理论上推导了其在确定性极限中的非光滑行为。我们的结果表明，动力学行为的变化会反映在学习率中，并为分析生化振荡中的信息处理提供了基础。

articles.title: Divergence of detachment forces in the finite Voronoi model
articles.title_zh: 有限 Voronoi 模型中脱附力的发散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.15481v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Detachment and fracture are central to many tissue-level processes, but they are challenging to simulate with Voronoi-type models that typically assume a confluent tissue. Here we analyze the finite Voronoi model, a nonconfluent extension of conventional Voronoi models, in which cell boundaries are composed of straight Voronoi edges and circular arcs of fixed radius ell. When the line tension on cell-medium interfaces exceeds the tension on cell-cell contacts, we find that the model exhibits a strong time-step dependence in the fracture timescale of initially intact active clusters: decreasing Δ t can unphysically suppress cluster rupture events. We trace this behavior to a divergence of detachment forces in the finite Voronoi model and introduce a simple regularization. We then compare the finite Voronoi model's near-detachment mechanics to a deformable polygon model and propose two potential calibration strategies. Finally, we examine the fracture--no-fracture transition in nonconfluent tissues and show that it is governed by detachment mechanics: the calibration can even determine the sign of the transition's dependence on cell shape. Our results show that, for studies focused on fracture or intercellular adhesion in nonconfluent monolayers, a physically motivated calibration of near-detachment mechanics in the finite Voronoi model is essential.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了用于非汇合组织模拟的有限 Voronoi 模型，重点关注脱附与断裂过程。作者发现，当细胞-介质界面线张力超过细胞-细胞接触张力时，完整主动团簇的断裂时间尺度会强烈依赖时间步长，减小时间步长可能非物理地抑制破裂事件。研究将该问题追溯到脱附力发散，并提出正则化与校准策略，强调近脱附力学对断裂研究的重要性。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 脱附和断裂是许多组织尺度过程的核心，但它们很难用通常假定组织汇合的 Voronoi 类型模型来模拟。在这里，我们分析有限 Voronoi 模型，这是一种传统 Voronoi 模型的非汇合扩展，其中细胞边界由直线 Voronoi 边和固定半径 ell 的圆弧组成。当细胞-介质界面上的线张力超过细胞-细胞接触上的张力时，我们发现该模型在最初完整的主动团簇的断裂时间尺度上表现出强烈的时间步长依赖性：减小 Δt 会非物理地抑制团簇破裂事件。我们将这种行为追溯到有限 Voronoi 模型中的脱附力发散，并引入了一种简单的正则化。随后，我们将有限 Voronoi 模型的近脱附力学与可变形多边形模型进行比较，并提出两种潜在的校准策略。最后，我们考察了非汇合组织中的断裂—不断裂转变，并表明该转变由脱附力学控制：校准甚至可以决定该转变对细胞形状依赖性的符号。我们的结果表明，对于关注非汇合单层中断裂或细胞间黏附的研究而言，对有限 Voronoi 模型中的近脱附力学进行物理动机明确的校准是必不可少的。

articles.title: Localization phase diagram of the Hexagonal Lattice with irrational magnetic flux
articles.title_zh: 非有理磁通下六角晶格的局域化相图
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.09974v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the Hofstadter model on a hexagonal lattice with irrational magnetic flux in this work. The Hofstadter model of the square lattice with irrational flux has been solved mathematically by Avila and his collaborators in his Fields medal work. However, this theory is usually not applicable to lattices with internal degrees of freedom, such as spin or sublattice. In this work, we show that for the hexagonal lattice with only nearest neighbor hopping, the system can still be characterized by a two by two transfer matrix and solved exactly by the Avila global theory although this lattice has two sublattices. We obtained the exact localization phase diagram of the hexagonal lattice with irrational flux by this theory, which reveals three pure phases, i.e., the extended, localized and critical states but no mobility edge due to the chiral symmetry. We used the renormalization group (RG) theory to verify these results, which can determine part of the phase diagram. We then computed the fractal dimension of the remaining part numerically. The results from both the RG theory and numerical analysis confirmed the phase diagram we get from the Avila global theory. Our results can be tested in various hexagonal Moire lattices and artificial superlattices in recent experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了非有理磁通下六角晶格上的 Hofstadter 模型。作者表明，尽管六角晶格具有两个子晶格，仅含最近邻跃迁时体系仍可由 2×2 转移矩阵表征，并可用 Avila 全局理论精确求解。所得精确局域化相图包含扩展态、局域态和临界态三种纯相，并因手征对称性而不存在迁移率边。
authors: Qi Gao, Shuo Zhang, Wei Chen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在这项工作中，我们研究了具有非有理磁通的六角晶格上的 Hofstadter 模型。具有非有理磁通的方晶格 Hofstadter 模型已由 Avila 及其合作者在其菲尔兹奖工作中从数学上求解。然而，该理论通常不适用于具有内部自由度的晶格，例如自旋或子晶格。在这项工作中，我们表明，对于仅含最近邻跃迁的六角晶格，尽管该晶格具有两个子晶格，体系仍可由一个二乘二转移矩阵表征，并可通过 Avila 全局理论精确求解。我们利用该理论得到了非有理磁通下六角晶格的精确局域化相图，该相图揭示了三种纯相，即扩展态、局域态和临界态，但由于手征对称性而不存在迁移率边。我们使用重整化群（RG）理论验证这些结果，该理论能够确定相图的一部分。随后，我们对剩余部分的分形维数进行了数值计算。来自 RG 理论和数值分析的结果均证实了我们从 Avila 全局理论得到的相图。我们的结果可在近期实验中的各种六角莫尔晶格和人工超晶格中得到检验。

articles.title: Lattice Gauging Interfaces and Noninvertible Defects in Higher Dimensions
articles.title_zh: 高维中的晶格规范化界面与非可逆缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.12601v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study gauging interfaces and their defect descendants in lattice models with generalized symmetries in higher dimensions. We construct explicit interface Hamiltonians for gauging a mathbb Z₂⁽⁰⁾ symmetry in (2+1)d and a mathbb Z₂⁽¹⁾ symmetry in (3+1)d. In higher dimensions, and especially in the presence of higher-form symmetries, the topological nature of gauging interfaces is obscured by the fact that the constrained Hilbert space depends on the location of the interface. We resolve this by introducing movement operators acting on a common unconstrained Hilbert space, which transport both the interface Hamiltonians and the associated constraints. As applications, we analyze condensation defects obtained from finite-region gauging and reconstruct the gauging map from movement operators. Finally, we apply the same framework to subgroup gauging, focusing on the example of gauging mathbb Z₂subset mathbb Z₄. This produces a dual symmetry carrying a mixed anomaly, which we diagnose on the lattice through symmetry fractionalization on condensation defects. Our results provide an explicit lattice framework for studying topological interfaces, condensation defects, and the associated anomalies arising from gauging in higher-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论了高维广义对称晶格模型中的规范化界面及其缺陷后代。作者构造了在 (2+1) 维规范化 Z₂⁽⁰⁾ 对称性和在 (3+1) 维规范化 Z₂⁽¹⁾ 对称性的显式界面哈密顿量。通过引入作用于共同无约束 Hilbert 空间的移动算符，研究解决了界面位置改变时受约束 Hilbert 空间随之变化而导致的拓扑性不显问题，并进一步分析凝聚缺陷、规范化映射和混合反常。
authors: David Hofmeier, Giovanna Pimenta, Weiguang Cao
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了高维中具有广义对称性的晶格模型里的规范化界面及其缺陷后代。我们构造了用于在 (2+1) 维中规范化 Z₂⁽⁰⁾ 对称性以及在 (3+1) 维中规范化 Z₂⁽¹⁾ 对称性的显式界面哈密顿量。在更高维中，尤其是在存在高形式对称性时，规范化界面的拓扑性质会因受约束 Hilbert 空间依赖于界面位置这一事实而变得不明显。我们通过引入作用于一个共同的无约束 Hilbert 空间上的移动算符来解决这一问题，这些算符同时传输界面哈密顿量及其相关约束。作为应用，我们分析了由有限区域规范化得到的凝聚缺陷，并从移动算符重构了规范化映射。最后，我们将同一框架应用于子群规范化，重点研究规范化 Z₂ ⊂ Z₄ 的例子。这产生了一个携带混合反常的对偶对称性，我们通过凝聚缺陷上的对称性分数化在晶格上诊断了该反常。我们的结果为研究高维系统中由规范化产生的拓扑界面、凝聚缺陷及相关反常提供了一个显式晶格框架。

articles.title: Spatial statistics for screening molecular structures
articles.title_zh: 用于分子结构筛选的空间统计方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.17147v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The dominant paradigm in computational materials discovery relies on heavily parameterized deep architectures, including message-passing graph networks and equivariant models, that require millions of DFT-labeled training structures and produce non-convex latent representations that complicate continuous optimization for inverse design. These architectures are impractical in data-scarce regimes, which is the typical case in molecular screening, and exhibit well-documented limitations in capturing chemically disordered configurations and chiral geometries. This review presents feature engineering based on spatial statistics as a physically rigorous and immediately deployable alternative. Molecular structures are encoded as voxelized scalar fields, and two-point auto- and cross-correlations are evaluated deterministically via Fast Fourier Transforms, explicitly transferring the burden of spatial pattern recognition from the learning algorithm to a closed-form, physics-informed operation.
