We find that the SHG signal is strongly enhanced at small twist angles due to the emergence of moiré flat bands and the associated increase in the joint density of states. Beyond this conventional enhancement mechanism, we demonstrate that the reduced bandwidth enables a pronounced double-resonant process, in which optical transitions at both ømega and 2ømega are simultaneously satisfied over extended regions of the moiré Brillouin zone. This mechanism leads to a substantial amplification of the SHG response, analogous to the enhancement observed in systems with discrete energy levels, but realised here in a tuneable moiré band structure. Furthermore, we show that the AB--AB and AB--BA configurations exhibit a systematic π phase shift in the SHG response at large bias voltages, reflecting their distinct symmetry and electronic structure. Our results identify double-resonance effects as a generic mechanism for enhancing SHG in moiré systems and provide a unified framework for understanding and controlling nonlinear optical responses in tuneable flat-band materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上研究AB-AB和AB-BA堆垛扭转双双层石墨烯中的二次谐波产生响应。结果显示，小扭角下莫尔平带和联合态密度增加会强烈增强SHG信号，而窄带宽还允许在ω和2ω处同时满足光学跃迁的双共振过程，进一步显著放大响应。研究还发现两种堆垛在大偏压下SHG响应存在系统性π相移，为调控平带材料非线性光学响应提供了统一框架。
authors: Takaaki V. Joya, Takuto Kawakami, Mikito Koshino
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们采用基于有效连续哈密顿量的微扰方法，从理论上研究了具有AB--AB和AB--BA堆垛构型的扭转双双层石墨烯（TDBG）中的二次谐波产生（SHG）。我们系统分析了SHG响应随扭转角、垂直偏置电压、费米能和堆垛构型的变化。我们发现，由于莫尔平带的出现以及相关的联合态密度增加，小扭转角下SHG信号得到强烈增强。除了这种常规增强机制之外，我们还证明，减小的带宽使一种显著的双共振过程成为可能，其中在ω和2ω处的光学跃迁可在莫尔布里渊区的扩展区域内同时得到满足。这一机制导致SHG响应大幅放大，类似于离散能级系统中观察到的增强，但在这里是在可调谐的莫尔能带结构中实现的。此外，我们表明，AB--AB和AB--BA构型在大偏置电压下的SHG响应表现出系统性的π相位移动，反映了它们不同的对称性和电子结构。我们的结果将双共振效应确定为增强莫尔体系中SHG的一种普适机制，并为理解和控制可调谐平带材料中的非线性光学响应提供了统一框架。

articles.title: Floquet spin-group framework and its application to light-tailored spin splitting in collinear magnets
articles.title_zh: Floquet自旋群框架及其在共线磁体中光调控自旋劈裂的应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02393v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine momentum-dependent spin splitting with vanishing net magnetization, opening new opportunities for spintronics. Recent studies have shown that periodic driving by linearly or circularly polarized light, as well as by multicolor light fields, can control spin splitting in altermagnets and conventional antiferromagnets, and can even generate spin splitting patterns absent in equilibrium. Despite this progress, a unified principle connecting the dynamical symmetry of light to the symmetry of spin-split bands remains lacking, limiting the systematic design of light-induced spin structures. Here, by combining the spin group of crystals with the dynamical group of light, we establish a unified Floquet spin group framework for the study of periodically driven collinear magnets with negligible spin-orbit coupling. This framework systematically determines the allowed parity, momentum dependence, and nodal structure of spin splitting under different driving protocols. Guided by this symmetry classification, we show that odd-parity, even-parity, and mixed-parity spin splittings can be switched within the same material by tailoring the driving field. We further uncover higher-order h-wave and k-wave spin splittings in three-dimensional systems. Our work establishes a unified symmetry framework for light-controlled spin splitting and provides general principles for engineering nonequilibrium spin-band structures in altermagnets and related magnetic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出将晶体自旋群与光的动力学群相结合的Floquet自旋群框架，用于研究周期驱动、弱自旋轨道耦合共线磁体中的自旋劈裂。该框架可系统确定不同驱动方案下自旋劈裂允许的宇称、动量依赖和节点结构。作者展示了同一材料中可通过定制光场切换奇宇称、偶宇称和混合宇称自旋劈裂，并揭示三维体系中的高阶h波和k波自旋劈裂。
authors: Tongshuai Zhu, Zixuan Li, Huaiqiang Wang, Su-Huai Wei, Jiawei Ruan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体将动量依赖的自旋劈裂与净磁化为零相结合，为自旋电子学开辟了新机遇。近期研究表明，线偏振光或圆偏振光以及多色光场的周期驱动，可以控制交替磁体和常规反铁磁体中的自旋劈裂，甚至能够产生平衡态中不存在的自旋劈裂图案。尽管已有这些进展，仍缺乏将光的动力学对称性与自旋劈裂能带的对称性联系起来的统一原则，这限制了光诱导自旋结构的系统设计。在这里，通过将晶体的自旋群与光的动力学群相结合，我们建立了一个统一的Floquet自旋群框架，用于研究具有可忽略自旋轨道耦合的周期驱动共线磁体。该框架系统地确定了不同驱动方案下自旋劈裂所允许的宇称、动量依赖性和节点结构。在这一对称性分类的指导下，我们表明，通过定制驱动场，可以在同一种材料中切换奇宇称、偶宇称和混合宇称自旋劈裂。我们进一步揭示了三维体系中的高阶h波和k波自旋劈裂。我们的工作建立了一个用于光控自旋劈裂的统一对称性框架，并为在交替磁体及相关磁性材料中工程化非平衡自旋能带结构提供了普适原则。

articles.title: Magnetically tunable symmetry-enforced nodal lines producing huge anomalous Hall conductivity in altermagnetic α-MnTe
articles.title_zh: 交替磁性α-MnTe中产生巨大反常霍尔电导的磁可调对称性强制节点线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnetic α-MnTe exhibits huge anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) up to room-temperature together with weak ferromagnetism arising from spin and orbital polarizations. We clarify the origin of the large value of the AHC by identifying two sets of distinct symmetry-enforced nodal lines in the valence bands with Mn character, located at k_z=0 and k_z=fracπc, protected by mirror symmetry M_z and glide symmetry G_z = M_z,|,0,0,tfracc2, respectively. Both nodal lines are energy-dependent with an approximate C₆ symmetry, which is reduced to an exact C₂ symmetry due to the presence of the Néel vector. The highest valence band exhibits a Mexican-hat dispersion, whereas the second-highest valence band exhibits an inverted Mexican-hat dispersion, with nodal lines at the crossing between the two bands. Within first-principles accuracy, we demonstrate that these nodal lines give rise to the large AHC observed experimentally and exhibit a strong interplay with the weak ferromagnetism. We further show that even a small spin canting strongly modifies the nodal lines and the AHC, making them both magnetically tunable. By disentangling the altermagnetic and ferromagnetic contributions to the AHC, the altermagnetic contribution dominates at small canting angles, while the ferromagnetic contribution becomes sizeable for larger values. Using linear dichroism in angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, we show a signature of the nodal line at the border of the Brillouin zone.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文阐明交替磁性α-MnTe中室温附近巨大反常霍尔电导的起源，指出其来自价带中两组由对称性保护的节点线。作者表明，这些位于kz=0和kz=π/c的节点线分别受镜面对称性和滑移对称性保护，并与弱铁磁性强烈耦合。小的自旋倾斜即可显著改变节点线和反常霍尔电导，使二者具备磁可调性，角分辨光电子能谱线二色性也显示出节点线迹象。
authors: Mathews Benny, Xujia Gong, Amar Fakhredine, Raphaël Salazar, Ashutosh S. Wadge, Juraj Krempaský, Gunther Springholz, Sarath Sasi, Dawid Wutke, Rafał Kurleto, Natalia Olszowska, Sahar Izadi Vishkayi, Asiyeh Shokri, Ján Minár, Carmine Ortix, Jeroen van den Brink, Jakub Schusser, Carmine Autieri
articles.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁性α-MnTe表现出可达室温的巨大反常霍尔电导（AHC），同时具有由自旋和轨道极化产生的弱铁磁性。我们通过识别价带中具有Mn特征的两组不同的对称性强制节点线，阐明了AHC大数值的起源；这些节点线分别位于k_z=0和k_z=π/c，并分别受到镜面对称性M_z和滑移对称性G_z = M_z | 0,0,c/2的保护。两种节点线都是能量依赖的，并具有近似C6对称性，而由于尼尔矢量的存在，该对称性降低为精确的C2对称性。最高价带表现出墨西哥帽色散，而次高价带表现出反转的墨西哥帽色散，节点线位于两条能带的交叉处。在第一性原理精度范围内，我们证明这些节点线产生了实验中观察到的大AHC，并且与弱铁磁性表现出强烈相互作用。我们进一步表明，即使很小的自旋倾斜也会强烈改变节点线和AHC，使二者都具有磁可调性。通过解缠AHC中的交替磁性贡献和铁磁性贡献，我们发现小倾斜角下交替磁性贡献占主导，而在较大倾斜角下铁磁性贡献变得可观。利用角分辨光电子能谱中的线二色性，我们展示了布里渊区边界处节点线的一个特征信号。

articles.title: Screening phonon-mediated superconductors from static orbital Hamiltonians
articles.title_zh: 从静态轨道哈密顿量筛选声子介导超导体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The first-principles search for superconductors is severely limited by the high cost of electron-phonon coupling (EPC) calculations. Here we develop a low-cost, physically transparent framework that identifies strong-EPC materials directly from static orbital-based Hamiltonians without explicit phonon perturbation calculations. Verification using density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) for representative superconductors shows that the framework captures semi-quantitatively the EPC scale at substantially lower computational cost. Applied to more than 36,000 compounds in the MattKeyBond database, it identifies 34 dynamically stable superconducting candidates with calculated T_c > 10 K after DFPT verification. These candidates reveal two distinct routes to relatively high-T_c superconductivity: a metallized covalent σ-bond route that is more favorable for achieving high-T_c superconductors, and a Fermi-level density-of-states accumulation route that can enhance T_c but usually to a more limited extent.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种低成本、物理图像清晰的框架，可在不进行显式声子微扰计算的情况下，从静态轨道基哈密顿量中识别强电子-声子耦合材料。通过密度泛函微扰理论验证，该框架能以更低计算成本半定量捕捉电子-声子耦合尺度。应用于MattKeyBond数据库中超过36000种化合物后，作者筛选并验证出34种动力学稳定且计算Tc大于10 K的候选超导体，并总结了两条相对高Tc路径。
authors: Jian-Feng Zhang, Ze-Feng Gao, Xiao-Qi Han, Dingshun Lv, Miao Gao, Kai Liu, Xinguo Ren, Zhong-Yi Lu, Tao Xiang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 基于第一性原理寻找超导体受到电子-声子耦合（EPC）计算高成本的严重限制。在这里，我们发展了一个低成本、物理上透明的框架，它无需显式的声子微扰计算，即可直接从静态的轨道基哈密顿量中识别强EPC材料。利用密度泛函微扰理论（DFPT）对代表性超导体进行验证表明，该框架能够以显著更低的计算成本半定量地捕捉EPC尺度。将其应用于MattKeyBond数据库中超过36,000种化合物后，经DFPT验证，它识别出34种动力学稳定且计算T_c > 10 K的超导候选材料。这些候选材料揭示了通向相对高T_c超导性的两条不同路径：一条是金属化共价σ键路径，它更有利于实现高T_c超导体；另一条是费米能级态密度积累路径，它可以提高T_c，但通常提升幅度更为有限。

articles.title: Discrete states and ballistic interference in quantum wires approaching macroscopic lengths
articles.title_zh: 接近宏观长度的量子线中的离散态与弹道干涉
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02431v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Increasing the size of a system showing quantum effects is a difficult task limited by decoherence, a diminishing quantum level spacing, and the effects of disorder spoiling the quantum behavior when growing in size. Systems in 1D offer very strong confinement in the transverse directions, thus generally enhancing quantum effects, but are notoriously sensitive to disorder. In this work, we present a system of 1D electrons exhibiting discrete quantum levels and fully ballistic coherent quantum interference with lengths of up to 18,μm. Tunneling spectroscopy between two parallel quantum wires with a central gated segment shows intricate interference patterns exhibiting several different periods in magnetic field and density. An analysis over three different wire lengths and a comparison with single particle numerical simulations without any free parameters remarkably explains the full pattern including the observed periods. Therefore, these wires are essentially ideal 1D systems with aspect ratios approaching 1'000. In addition, at low bias, we also observe not only the Coulomb charging energies but can clearly resolve the discrete orbital and spin states in up to 10,μm long wires when filling 100 electrons with the center gate. This is made visible by a state-of-the-art low temperature and low noise measurement system. The spin filling sequence is completely regular, strictly alternating spin up and down, avoiding high spin states, while the peak conductance is modulated in accordance with the previously discussed interference patterns. These striking results show that single particle Schrödinger quantum mechanics such as ballistic quantum interference and discrete quantum states may be observed, under the right conditions, in systems of up to 18,μm length, thus approaching macroscopic sizes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一维电子系统在长度最高达18微米时仍表现出离散量子能级和完全弹道相干量子干涉。通过两条平行量子线间的隧穿谱，作者观察到随磁场和密度变化的复杂干涉图案，并用无自由参数的单粒子数值模拟解释了不同长度样品的完整图案。低偏压下还可在最长10微米量子线中解析库仑充电能、离散轨道态和自旋态，表明在合适条件下单粒子薛定谔量子力学可扩展到接近宏观尺寸的系统。
authors: Henok Weldeyesus, Taras Patlatiuk, Christian P. Scheller, Amir Yacoby, Loren N. Pfeiffer, Ken W. West, Dominik M. Zumbühl
articles.abstract_zh_full: 增大表现出量子效应的系统尺寸是一项困难任务，受到退相干、量子能级间距减小以及尺寸增大时破坏量子行为的无序效应的限制。一维系统在横向方向上提供非常强的限制，因此通常会增强量子效应，但它们也以对无序极其敏感而著称。在这项工作中，我们展示了一个一维电子系统，其在长度最高达18 μm时表现出离散量子能级和完全弹道的相干量子干涉。带有中心栅控段的两条平行量子线之间的隧穿谱显示出复杂的干涉图案，在磁场和密度上表现出几个不同的周期。对三种不同线长的分析，以及与不含任何自由参数的单粒子数值模拟的比较，令人瞩目地解释了包括观测周期在内的完整图案。因此，这些量子线本质上是理想的一维系统，其长宽比接近1000。此外，在低偏压下，当用中心栅填充100个电子时，我们不仅观察到库仑充电能，而且能够在最长达10 μm的量子线中清晰分辨离散的轨道态和自旋态。这得益于最先进的低温低噪声测量系统。自旋填充序列完全规则，严格交替为自旋向上和自旋向下，避免了高自旋态，而峰值电导则按照前述干涉图案受到调制。这些惊人的结果表明，在合适条件下，诸如弹道量子干涉和离散量子态这样的单粒子薛定谔量子力学现象，可以在长度最高达18 μm、从而接近宏观尺寸的系统中被观察到。

articles.title: Real-time dynamics of the two-step charge-density-wave transition in bulk 1T-TaS₂
articles.title_zh: 块体1T-TaS₂中两步电荷密度波转变的实时动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02456v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The charge-density wave (CDW) of bulk 1T-TaS2 is built from Star-of-David (SoD) clusters tiling a sqrt13 x sqrt13 superlattice, and it melts through a two-step sequence accompanied by order-of-magnitude changes in resistivity. Whether these steps proceed by collapse of the SoD amplitude or by rearrangement of the SoD lattice has remained unresolved, because the relevant dynamics occur on length and time scales beyond the reach of ab initio molecular dynamics. Here we follow the CDW transitions in real time using a machine-learning force field trained on first-principles data, giving access to 1404-atom supercells over 5 ns. The two steps are mechanistically distinct. Above 200 K, SoD clusters translate coherently by transiently dissolving and re-forming about shifted centers, a deformation-formation process that preserves the local SoD amplitude while randomizing the interlayer stacking order and nucleating domain walls. Only near 350 K does the SoD distortion itself collapse. These results provide microscopic support for the recently proposed two-step model of the CDW transition and offer a framework for interpreting light-induced hidden phases and cavity-modified transition temperatures in 1T-TaS2.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用以第一性原理数据训练的机器学习力场，实时跟踪块体1T-TaS2中电荷密度波转变，覆盖1404原子超胞和5纳秒时间尺度。结果表明，两步转变机制不同：200 K以上星形大卫簇通过暂时溶解并在平移中心重组实现相干平移，而局域畸变幅度基本保留；接近350 K时星形大卫畸变本身才坍塌。研究为1T-TaS2电荷密度波两步转变模型提供微观支持，并有助于理解光诱导隐藏相和腔调控转变温度。
authors: Daeheon Kim, Jinseok Oh, Kahyeon Koh, Yejun Cho, Angel Rubio, Noejung Park, Dongbin Shin
articles.abstract_zh_full: 块体1T-TaS2的电荷密度波（CDW）由星形大卫（SoD）团簇构成，这些团簇铺排成sqrt13 × sqrt13超晶格，并且它通过一个两步序列熔化，同时伴随电阻率数量级的变化。这些步骤究竟是通过SoD振幅的坍塌进行，还是通过SoD晶格的重排进行，一直未得到解决，因为相关动力学发生在从头算分子动力学难以达到的长度和时间尺度上。在这里，我们使用以第一性原理数据训练的机器学习力场，实时跟踪CDW转变，从而能够研究包含1404个原子的超胞并持续5 ns。两步转变在机制上截然不同。在200 K以上，SoD团簇通过围绕平移后的中心暂时溶解并重新形成而发生相干平移，这一变形-形成过程保留了局域SoD振幅，同时使层间堆垛有序随机化并成核畴壁。只有在接近350 K时，SoD畸变本身才会坍塌。这些结果为近期提出的CDW转变两步模型提供了微观支持，并为解释1T-TaS2中的光诱导隐藏相和腔调控转变温度提供了框架。

articles.title: Optimized Tensor-Network Renormalization for Quantum Dynamics: Resolving the Spectral Function of K₂Co(SeO₃₎₂
articles.title_zh: 用于量子动力学的优化张量网络重整化：解析 K₂Co(SeO₃)₂ 的谱函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tensor-network methods have opened a powerful route for the study of dynamical spectral functions in two-dimensional quantum systems. However, existing approaches within the framework of infinite projected entangled-pair states construct the required renormalization tensors solely from the ground-state environment and can suffer from severe numerical instability. We identify the origin of this instability and introduce an excitation-tailored corner-transfer-matrix renormalization-group (ET-CTMRG) method to resolve it. By incorporating excitation tensors into the renormalization procedure, the method constructs a substantially more accurate effective Hamiltonian matrix and thereby yields reliable and well-converged excitation spectra. For Heisenberg antiferromagnets, it reduces truncation errors by orders of magnitude and for the particularly complex case of the supersolid phase in the triangular-lattice XXZ magnet K₂Co(SeO₃₎₂, it achieves excellent quantitative agreement with inelastic neutron-scattering measurements. ET-CTMRG therefore provides a robust framework for investigating the dynamical properties of strongly correlated quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种面向激发的角转移矩阵重整化群（ET-CTMRG）方法，以解决无限投影纠缠对态框架中动力学谱函数计算的数值不稳定问题。该方法将激发张量纳入重整化过程，从而构造更准确的有效哈密顿量并获得可靠收敛的激发谱。其在海森堡反铁磁体和三角晶格 XXZ 磁体 K₂Co(SeO₃)₂ 的超固相中显著降低误差，并与非弹性中子散射实验取得良好一致。
authors: Jiahang Hu, Runze Chi, B. Normand, Hai-Jun Liao, T. Xiang
articles.abstract_zh_full: 张量网络方法为研究二维量子系统中的动力学谱函数开辟了一条强有力的途径。然而，现有的无限投影纠缠对态框架内的方法仅从基态环境构造所需的重整化张量，因而可能遭受严重的数值不稳定性。我们确定了这种不稳定性的来源，并引入一种面向激发的角转移矩阵重整化群（ET-CTMRG）方法来解决这一问题。通过将激发张量纳入重整化过程，该方法构造出显著更精确的有效哈密顿量矩阵，从而给出可靠且良好收敛的激发谱。对于海森堡反铁磁体，它将截断误差降低了数个数量级；对于三角晶格 XXZ 磁体 K₂Co(SeO₃)₂ 中特别复杂的超固相情形，它与非弹性中子散射测量实现了极佳的定量一致。因此，ET-CTMRG 为研究强关联量子系统的动力学性质提供了一个稳健框架。

articles.title: Superconducting dome due to the Fano-Feshbach shape resonance in artificial high-Tc superlattices
articles.title_zh: 人工高 Tc 超晶格中由 Fano-Feshbach 形状共振导致的超导穹顶
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we provide compelling experimental validation of the Bianconi Perali Valletta (BPV) theory predicting a superconducting dome based on a quantum material design of Artificial High TC Superlattices (AHTS) made with a selected nanoscale heterostructure geometry. These AHTS are SNSN superlattices of quantum wells of period d, composed of first units, superconducting doped Mott insulator layers with Rashba spin orbit coupling (S) of thickness L, intercalated by second units, normal metal spacers (N). In these superlattices, grown by molecular beam epitaxy (MBE), the experimental superconducting dome is obtained by material quantum design changing the chemical potential via the quantum geometrical factor L/d which tunes the Fano-Feshbach shape resonance in the pair transfer between superconducting gaps in the BCS regime and different gaps in the BEC-BCS crossover. Here we present a systematic magneto-transport study of AHTS artificial superlattices across the full doping range of the superconducting dome, from the deeply underdoped to the overdoped regime, using pulsed magnetic fields up to 72 T. By varying the L/d ratio, we tune the effective hole concentration delta=0.45(1-L/d) and map the evolution of the resistive transitions, the upper critical magnetic field and the Ginzburg-Landau coherence length
articles.abstract_zh: 本文为 Bianconi–Perali–Valletta（BPV）理论提供实验验证，该理论预言可通过人工高 Tc 超晶格的量子材料设计形成超导穹顶。研究对象为由超导掺杂莫特绝缘层与正常金属间隔层构成的 SNSN 超晶格，其化学势可通过几何因子 L/d 调控。作者在最高 72 T 脉冲磁场下系统研究了整个超导穹顶掺杂范围内的磁输运行为，考察电阻转变、上临界场和 Ginzburg-Landau 相干长度的演化。
authors: Gaetano Campi, Andrea Alimenti, Danielle Villa, G. Alexander Smith, Fedor F. Balakirev, Luis Balicas, Andrea Perali, Sergio Caprara, Gennady Logvenov, Antonio Bianconi1
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本工作中，我们为 Bianconi Perali Valletta（BPV）理论提供了有力的实验验证；该理论预言，基于由特定纳米尺度异质结构几何构型制成的人工高 TC 超晶格（AHTS）的量子材料设计，可以产生一个超导穹顶。这些 AHTS 是周期为 d 的量子阱 SNSN 超晶格，由第一类单元——具有 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的超导掺杂莫特绝缘体层（S），其厚度为 L——与第二类单元——正常金属间隔层（N）——相互插层组成。在这些通过分子束外延（MBE）生长的超晶格中，实验上的超导穹顶是通过材料量子设计获得的，即通过量子几何因子 L/d 改变化学势；该因子调控 BCS 区域中的超导能隙与 BEC-BCS 交叉区域中的不同能隙之间配对转移的 Fano-Feshbach 形状共振。这里，我们利用最高达 72 T 的脉冲磁场，对跨越超导穹顶完整掺杂范围——从深度欠掺杂到过掺杂区域——的 AHTS 人工超晶格进行了系统的磁输运研究。通过改变 L/d 比值，我们调控有效空穴浓度 δ=0.45(1-L/d)，并绘制电阻转变、上临界磁场以及 Ginzburg-Landau 相干长度的演化图景。

articles.title: Revealing Intrinsic Anisotropy of Collective Magnetic Excitations in Twinned Crystals of a Kitaev-Heisenberg Quantum Magnet
articles.title_zh: 揭示 Kitaev-Heisenberg 量子磁体孪晶晶体中集体磁激发的本征各向异性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02531v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum magnets with competing interactions often emerge from delicate balances among microscopic parameters, making it essential to disentangle intrinsic spin dynamics from extrinsic disorder effects. Here, we introduce a multimodal optical approach combining magneto-infrared spectroscopy with domain-resolved micro-Raman spectroscopy at high magnetic fields to reconstruct the intrinsic magnetic excitation spectrum of twinned crystals of the Kitaev-Heisenberg quantum magnet Na₃Co₂SbO₆. Far-infrared spectroscopy reveals multiple field-tunable magnetic excitations, but the intrinsic response is obscured by replica features arising from twin domains. By correlating magneto-infrared and domain-resolved Raman spectra, we isolate the single-domain magnon response and uncover a pronounced twofold in-plane magnon anisotropy. This anisotropy far exceeds that expected from the measured in-plane g-factor anisotropy and is instead dominated by anisotropic bond-dependent exchange interactions. By unifying high-field, high-resolution and spatially selective optical probes, our work establishes a broadly applicable framework for revealing intrinsic spin dynamics and constraining the spin Hamiltonian in multidomain quantum magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种结合高磁场磁红外光谱与畴分辨微拉曼光谱的多模态光学方法，用于重构孪晶 Na₃Co₂SbO₆ 的本征磁激发谱。远红外谱显示多个随磁场可调的磁激发，但孪晶畴产生的复制特征会掩盖本征响应。通过关联两类光谱，作者分离出单畴磁振子响应，并发现显著的面内二重磁振子各向异性，其主要来源于各向异性、键依赖的交换相互作用。
authors: Naipeng Zhang, Nikolai Simonov, Mykhaylo Ozerov, Sumedh Rathi, Nolan Heffner, Sara Huszar, Long Chen, Haidong Zhou, Guangxin Ni, Chaebin Kim, Martin Mourigal, Stephen M. Winter, Zhigang Jiang, Dmitry Smirnov
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有竞争相互作用的量子磁体往往源自微观参数之间的精细平衡，因此有必要将本征自旋动力学与外在无序效应区分开来。在这里，我们引入一种多模态光学方法，将高磁场下的磁红外光谱与畴分辨微拉曼光谱相结合，以重构 Kitaev-Heisenberg 量子磁体 Na₃Co₂SbO₆ 的孪晶晶体中的本征磁激发谱。远红外光谱揭示了多个可随磁场调谐的磁激发，但本征响应被来自孪晶畴的复制特征所遮蔽。通过关联磁红外谱和畴分辨拉曼谱，我们分离出单畴磁振子响应，并揭示出显著的面内二重磁振子各向异性。这种各向异性远超由测得的面内 g 因子各向异性所预期的程度，而是主要由各向异性的键依赖交换相互作用主导。通过统一高磁场、高分辨率和空间选择性光学探针，我们的工作建立了一个可广泛应用的框架，用于揭示多畴量子磁体中的本征自旋动力学并约束其自旋哈密顿量。

articles.title: Magnetic Skyrmion Interacting with Optical Skyrmion
articles.title_zh: 磁斯格明子与光学斯格明子的相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02552v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic skyrmions (MSks) and optical skyrmions (OSks) embody topology in matter and in light, respectively. Here we investigate the interaction between a single MSk and an OSk beam. Three distinct nonlinear dynamical modes are identified: rotation, skipping, and trochoidal motion. By decomposing the optical driving force into gradient, orbital-angular-momentum, and spin-angular-momentum contributions, we clarify their respective roles of radial confinement, azimuthal drift, and precessional modulation. The skipping motion arises from the azimuthal asymmetry of the OSk beam and exhibits spatial selectivity originating from the magnetization-polarization coupling between the MSk and OSk. In three dimensions, the coupling acquires a propagation-dependent phase dominated by the differential Gouy phase, which yields z-asymmetric skipping trajectories. These results bridge topological particles and topological fields within a unified framework, offering helicity-selective and phase-programmable routes to optomagnonic control.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究单个磁斯格明子与光学斯格明子光束之间的相互作用，识别出旋转、跳跃和次摆线运动三种非线性动力学模式。作者将光学驱动力分解为梯度、轨道角动量和自旋角动量贡献，阐明其在径向束缚、方位漂移和进动调制中的作用。研究还指出三维传播中的差分 Gouy 相位会导致 z 方向不对称的跳跃轨迹，为光磁调控提供可按螺旋性选择和相位编程的途径。
authors: Lan Bo, Jian Chen, Xichao Zhang, Yan Zhou, Chengwei Qiu, Masahito Mochizuki
articles.abstract_zh_full: 磁斯格明子（MSks）和光学斯格明子（OSks）分别体现了物质和光中的拓扑。在这里，我们研究单个 MSk 与一束 OSk 光束之间的相互作用。我们识别出三种不同的非线性动力学模式：旋转、跳跃和次摆线运动。通过将光学驱动力分解为梯度、轨道角动量和自旋角动量贡献，我们阐明了它们分别在径向束缚、方位漂移和进动调制中的作用。跳跃运动源于 OSk 光束的方位不对称性，并表现出由 MSk 与 OSk 之间磁化-偏振耦合所产生的空间选择性。在三维中，该耦合获得一个依赖传播的相位，该相位主要由差分 Gouy 相位支配，从而产生 z 方向不对称的跳跃轨迹。这些结果在统一框架内连接了拓扑粒子与拓扑场，为光磁控制提供了螺旋性选择和相位可编程的路径。

articles.title: Optimal Decoding for Measurement-Based GHZ State Preparation: The Maximum-Utility Decoder
articles.title_zh: 基于测量的 GHZ 态制备的最优解码：最大效用解码器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00160v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The meticulous preparation of macroscopic Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states provides a foundational resource for quantum technologies such as metrology, cryptography, and fault-tolerant codes. While state-of-the-art measurement-based protocols offer efficient low-depth execution, their performance can be bottlenecked by conventional decoders, such as minimum weight perfect matching (MWPM) or even maximum-likelihood decoding (MLD), which optimize for binary logical recovery and fail to maximize the continuous long-range order characteristic of a GHZ state for two-dimensional geometries. Here we overcome this limitation by framing the decoding problem as minimum Bayesian risk inference, introducing a general paradigm that maximizes the expected utility of the decoded state. Implementing this maximum-utility approach, we construct an algorithm that achieves the highest possible per-shot decoded quantum order and thereby establish an optimal decoding strategy for measurement-based GHZ state preparation. To improve its computational efficiency, we design a scalable two-stage decoder, which first encodes the syndromes into the edge weights of MWPM and then refines the result with a convolutional neural network trained to maximize the expected utility, at a fraction of the cost of the optimal decoder. Remarkably, we find that the first stage alonen̆icodex2014which makes the matching aware of the gauge choice at no cost beyond bare MWPMn̆icodex2014already performs near-optimally up to the largest sizes we study, N=256×256, closing up to 87% of the gap between the bare-MWPM and optimal decoding thresholds. Generalizing MWPM and MLD, the maximum-utility decoder (MUD) establishes a versatile framework that can be explicitly tailored to the operational demands of specific experiments by redefining the utility function.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将基于测量的 GHZ 态制备中的解码问题表述为最小贝叶斯风险推断，并提出最大效用解码器，以直接最大化解码态的期望效用和长程量子有序。作者构建了最优算法，并进一步设计两阶段可扩展解码器，将 MWPM 与卷积神经网络结合以降低计算成本。结果显示，改进后的匹配阶段在大系统尺寸上已接近最优，并且最大效用框架可根据实验需求通过效用函数进行定制。
authors: Misha Yutushui, Theo Haas, Simon Trebst
articles.abstract_zh_full: 宏观 Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger（GHZ）态的精细制备为计量学、密码学和容错编码等量子技术提供了基础性资源。尽管最先进的基于测量的协议能够实现高效、低深度的执行，但其性能可能受到传统解码器的瓶颈限制，例如最小权完美匹配（MWPM），甚至最大似然解码（MLD）；这些解码器针对二元逻辑恢复进行优化，因而未能在二维几何中最大化 GHZ 态所特有的连续长程有序。在这里，我们通过将解码问题表述为最小贝叶斯风险推断来克服这一限制，并引入一种最大化解码态期望效用的一般范式。通过实现这种最大效用方法，我们构造了一种算法，它能够达到逐次实验中已解码量子有序的最高可能值，从而为基于测量的 GHZ 态制备建立最优解码策略。为提高其计算效率，我们设计了一种可扩展的两阶段解码器：第一阶段将综合征编码进 MWPM 的边权重，第二阶段使用为最大化期望效用而训练的卷积神经网络对结果进行细化，其成本仅为最优解码器的一小部分。值得注意的是，我们发现仅第一阶段——它使匹配在除裸 MWPM 之外无需额外成本的情况下感知规范选择——在我们研究的最大尺寸 N=256×256 以内已表现得接近最优，并弥合了裸 MWPM 与最优解码阈值之间差距的最高 87%。作为 MWPM 和 MLD 的推广，最大效用解码器（MUD）建立了一个通用框架，可通过重新定义效用函数而明确地针对特定实验的操作需求进行定制。

articles.title: Phase transitions in quantum-circuit compilation
articles.title_zh: 量子线路编译中的相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00189v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum-circuit compilation aims at finding an optimized realization of a target circuit under given constraints, e.g., the minimization of hardware-induced errors and the unitary-equivalence of the circuit. We connect the compilation process with the thermodynamics of a many-body spin system: circuit infidelity plays the role of the energy function and low-temperature states correspond to compiled circuits. In the paradigmatic case where crosstalk between parallel gates is present, we find a phase transition between a disordered phase and an antiferromagnetic brick-wall phase, compatible with the Ising universality class. At larger crosstalk, we observe a Z₃₋ₒᵣdered regime, suggesting that increasingly serial compiled circuits are associated with emergent Zₙ₋ₒᵣdered phases. When the unitary-equivalence constraint is removed, these phases disappear, showing that the equivalence between circuits underlies the emergent criticality and constitutes a source of complexity in quantum-circuit compilation and, more generally, in equivalence-constrained optimization. Finally, we observe that the Kolmogorov complexity of the circuit enhances the emergence of ordered phases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将量子线路编译与多体自旋系统的热力学联系起来，把线路失真度视为能量函数，低温态对应编译后的线路。在线路存在并行门串扰的典型情形中，作者发现从无序相到反铁磁砖墙相的相变，并观察到更强串扰下的 Z₃ 有序区域。研究表明，线路幺正等价约束是涌现临界性和编译复杂性的来源之一，而线路的 Kolmogorov 复杂性会增强有序相的出现。
authors: Andrea De Girolamo, Davide Rattacaso, Simone Notarnicola, Ilaria Siloi, Simone Montangero
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子线路编译旨在给定约束下寻找目标线路的优化实现，例如最小化硬件诱发误差以及保持线路的幺正等价性。我们将编译过程与多体自旋系统的热力学联系起来：线路失真度扮演能量函数的角色，而低温态对应于已编译线路。在存在并行门之间串扰的典型情形中，我们发现无序相与反铁磁砖墙相之间存在相变，该相变与 Ising 普适类相容。在更大的串扰下，我们观察到一个 Z₃ 有序区域，这表明越来越串行化的已编译线路与涌现的 Zₙ 有序相相关联。当移除幺正等价约束时，这些相消失，表明线路之间的等价性支撑了涌现临界性，并构成了量子线路编译以及更一般的等价约束优化中的复杂性来源。最后，我们观察到线路的 Kolmogorov 复杂性增强了有序相的涌现。

articles.title: Marked vertex search on disordered graphs with Rosenzweig-Porter phases
articles.title_zh: 具有 Rosenzweig-Porter 相的无序图上的标记顶点搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00224v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum marked vertex search algorithms are known to outperform their classical counterparts, yet their behavior in the presence of disorder remains largely unexplored. Here, we address this gap by studying marked vertex search on disordered random graphs. To introduce disorder, we implement the Rosenzweig-Porter (RP) model, a random matrix ensemble with tunable ergodic, non-ergodic extended, and localized phases, on Erdős-Rényi (ER) graphs. This produces a doubly random system where ER graph connectivity randomizes which interactions exist, while RP disorder controls their strength and `on-site' potentials, providing a two-parameter framework to study quantum dynamics on disordered networks. First, we show that the characteristic Wigner-Dyson-to-Poisson spectral crossover of the RP ensemble survives under graph constraints across the sparse-to-dense range, and we derive an analytical estimate for the finite-size localization boundary that shifts systematically with the graph edge probability p, consistent with a resonant-hybridization argument. Thereafter, using this disordered graph ensemble, we study the marked vertex search problem and find that search performance tracks the underlying quantum phase directly. Counterintuitively, the ergodic phase, despite supporting fast transport, yields lower success probability than the localized phase, which achieves high success probability at the cost of significantly longer search times. These results establish a direct and quantitative link between random matrix disorder on graphs and the performance of continuous-time quantum walk search, and suggest that disorder, rather than being merely an obstacle, can be exploited as a tunable parameter in quantum search protocols.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究无序随机图上的量子标记顶点搜索，将 Rosenzweig-Porter 随机矩阵模型引入 Erdős-Rényi 图，以构建兼具连接随机性和相互作用强度无序性的双随机系统。作者表明 RP 谱统计从 Wigner-Dyson 到 Poisson 的交叉在图约束下仍然存在，并给出随边概率变化的有限尺寸局域化边界估计。搜索性能与底层量子相直接相关：遍历相虽有快速输运但成功率较低，局域相则成功率高但搜索时间显著更长。
authors: Sabyasachi Chakraborty, Tilen Cadez, Sonjoy Majumder, Rohit Kishan Ray
articles.abstract_zh_full: 已知量子标记顶点搜索算法优于其经典对应物，然而它们在存在无序时的行为在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这里，我们通过研究无序随机图上的标记顶点搜索来填补这一空白。为引入无序，我们在 Erdős-Rényi（ER）图上实现 Rosenzweig-Porter（RP）模型；RP 模型是一个具有可调遍历相、非遍历扩展相和局域相的随机矩阵系综。这产生了一个双随机系统，其中 ER 图的连接性随机化了哪些相互作用存在，而 RP 无序控制它们的强度和“在位”势，从而提供了一个双参数框架来研究无序网络上的量子动力学。首先，我们表明，RP 系综特征性的 Wigner-Dyson 到 Poisson 谱交叉在从稀疏到稠密范围内的图约束下仍然存在，并推导出一个有限尺寸局域化边界的解析估计，该边界随图的边概率 p 系统性移动，与共振杂化论证一致。随后，利用这一无序图系综，我们研究标记顶点搜索问题，并发现搜索性能直接跟踪其底层量子相。与直觉相反，遍历相尽管支持快速输运，却给出低于局域相的成功概率；局域相能够达到高成功概率，但代价是搜索时间显著更长。这些结果在图上的随机矩阵无序与连续时间量子行走搜索性能之间建立了直接且定量的联系，并表明无序并非仅仅是障碍，而可以作为量子搜索协议中的可调参数加以利用。

articles.title: Hybrid BaTiO3/TiO2 Metasurface for Efficient Gigahertz-Speed Free-Space Electro-Optic Modulation
articles.title_zh: 用于高效吉赫兹速度自由空间电光调制的混合 BaTiO3/TiO2 超表面
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00286v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Free-space electro-optic modulators are key to emerging photonic systems, yet their performance remains limited by trade-offs between modulation efficiency, bandwidth, and device aperture. Here we report a hybrid BaTiO3 (BTO)/TiO2 metasurface for large-aperture, efficient, gigahertz-speed free-space electro-optic modulation. Combining scalable BTO film growth by radio-frequency magnetron sputtering with mature TiO2 nanofabrication, we pattern the metasurface in TiO2 on an unetched BTO layer. The resulting devices support guided-mode resonances with quality factors exceeding 1300 and an optical confinement factor of ~0.8, while the continuous BTO layer makes efficient use of the applied voltage, together maximizing the overlap between the optical and driving fields within the BTO. A device with a 0.3 mm x 0.3 mm metasurface achieves a transmittance modulation efficiency of ~0.020 per volt and a -3 dB electro-optic bandwidth of ~0.8 GHz, with an effective Pockels coefficient of ~151 pm/V for the BTO. This establishes a scalable route to high-performance free-space electro-optic modulators for LiDAR, free-space optical communication, and reconfigurable optical computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道一种混合 BaTiO3/TiO2 超表面，用于大孔径、高效率、吉赫兹速度的自由空间电光调制。器件将可扩展的 BTO 薄膜生长与成熟的 TiO2 纳米加工结合，在未蚀刻 BTO 层上图案化 TiO2 超表面，实现高品质因子导模共振和较强光场约束。0.3 mm × 0.3 mm 器件展示出约 0.020/V 的透射调制效率和约 0.8 GHz 的 -3 dB 带宽，为 LiDAR、自由空间光通信和可重构光计算提供可扩展方案。
authors: Zhongpeng Sun, Kerolos M. A. Yousef, Michael Domm, Agham Posadas, Xudong Li, Marcus Ossiander, Maryna L. Meretska, Yiwei Ju, Isabel Barth, Jason Tischler, Theodore P. Letsou, Moaz Waqar, Amirhassan Shams-Ansari, Xiaoqing Pan, Alexander A. Demkov, Federico Capasso
articles.abstract_zh_full: 自由空间电光调制器是新兴光子系统的关键，但其性能仍受到调制效率、带宽和器件孔径之间权衡的限制。在这里，我们报道一种混合 BaTiO3（BTO）/TiO2 超表面，用于大孔径、高效率、吉赫兹速度的自由空间电光调制。通过将射频磁控溅射实现的可扩展 BTO 薄膜生长与成熟的 TiO2 纳米加工相结合，我们在未蚀刻的 BTO 层上将超表面图案化于 TiO2 中。所得器件支持品质因子超过 1300 的导模共振，并具有约 0.8 的光学约束因子；同时，连续的 BTO 层能够高效利用所施加的电压，二者共同最大化了 BTO 内光场与驱动场之间的重叠。一个具有 0.3 mm × 0.3 mm 超表面的器件实现了约 0.020 每伏的透射调制效率和约 0.8 GHz 的 -3 dB 电光带宽，并表现出 BTO 约 151 pm/V 的有效 Pockels 系数。这为面向 LiDAR、自由空间光通信和可重构光计算的高性能自由空间电光调制器建立了一条可扩展路径。

articles.title: Work Statistics of Autonomous Quantum Energy Pumps
articles.title_zh: 自主量子能量泵的功统计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00638v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a terminal-resolved theory of work statistics for autonomous quantum energy pumps. By modeling the systems that supply and receive energy as explicit quantum terminals, the energy exchanged with each terminal is defined directly from its Hamiltonian change. When the terminals are modeled by ideal clocks, these full-space observables admit exact representations on the pump Hilbert space and recover the conventional phase-derivative currents of periodically and quasiperiodically driven systems. The framework resolves transported work from energy accumulated in the pump. It also incorporates arbitrary initial pump--terminal correlations and identifies when correlations can enhance directional energy transfer under uncertain driving phases. For periodic pumps, we derive finite-cycle work statistics in Floquet eigenstates, relate their fluctuations to Floquet quantum geometry, and show that the long-time terminal currents become mutually compatible. An exactly solvable two-terminal qubit exhibits noise matching, in which transport becomes sharp through cancellation of common-mode terminal fluctuations even though the individual terminal energies remain noisy. Finally, for physical terminals beyond the ideal-clock limit, we introduce a positive work-variance gap that quantifies the fluctuations missed by a pump-only description. A coherent-cavity benchmark shows systematic convergence toward the ideal-clock regime with increasing occupation while demonstrating that agreement of the mean current alone does not guarantee accurate work statistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了用于自主量子能量泵的端口分辨功统计理论，将供能和受能系统显式建模为量子端口，从其哈密顿量变化直接定义能量交换。该框架区分了输运功与泵内累积能量，并可纳入任意初始泵-端口关联。作者进一步推导周期泵有限周期功统计，揭示其涨落与 Floquet 量子几何的关系，并指出仅匹配平均电流并不足以保证功统计准确。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们发展了一种用于自主量子能量泵的端口分辨功统计理论。通过将供应和接收能量的系统建模为显式的量子端口，与每个端口交换的能量直接由其哈密顿量的变化定义。当端口被建模为理想时钟时，这些全空间可观测量在泵的希尔伯特空间上具有精确表示，并恢复周期和准周期驱动系统中传统的相位导数电流。该框架将输运的功与泵中累积的能量区分开来。它还纳入任意初始泵-端口关联，并确定在驱动相位不确定时关联何时能够增强定向能量转移。对于周期泵，我们推导出 Floquet 本征态中的有限周期功统计，将其涨落与 Floquet 量子几何联系起来，并表明长时间端口电流变得彼此相容。一个精确可解的双端口量子比特表现出噪声匹配：尽管各个端口能量仍有噪声，但由于共模端口涨落的抵消，输运变得尖锐。最后，对于超出理想时钟极限的物理端口，我们引入一个正的功方差间隙，用以量化仅用泵描述时遗漏的涨落。一个相干腔基准显示，随着占据数增加，系统会系统性地收敛到理想时钟区域，同时表明仅平均电流一致并不能保证功统计准确。

articles.title: On Identification of Heat and Work in Quantum Many-Body Systems with Local Operations and Classical Communication
articles.title_zh: 具有局域操作和经典通信的量子多体系统中热与功的识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00993v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How we identify heat and work is a fundamental question in modern quantum thermodynamics. Usually, heat and work are attributed to changes in the density matrix and the Hamiltonian, respectively, during time-evolution processes in quantum systems. Recently, it has been recognized that this identification is ambiguous. Furthermore, quantum thermodynamics involving quantum measurement is still under development. Motivated by these on-going works, we consider a quantum many-body system from which we extract energy by local operations and classical communication (LOCC) according to the quantum energy teleportation (QET) protocol. The central idea to define heat and work unambiguously is based on a sharp insight into the optimization condition of LOCC. When LOCC is optimized, the extractable energy by QET becomes a daemonic ergotropy; thus, it can be attributed as work. On the other hand, when LOCC is not optimized, we have not squeezed out all the energy with the unitary operation. It means there is uncontrollable energy left in the system. The uncontrollable energy can be attributed as heat after careful treatment of many-body interactions. The heat term consists of nonlocal correlation due to communication between remote participants, and the correlation cannot be directly observed for the participant in the subsystem. Thus, this feature is consistent with the traditional perspective of heat as an uncontrollable energy. To deeply understand the nature of heat, we derive two types of generalized Clausius inequality in our effective quantum thermodynamics, and discuss the direction of the inequality. To justify our perspective, we examine a one-dimensional Kitaev-like model and discuss the physical meaning of effective temperature in our thermodynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论量子热力学中热与功的界定问题，并以基于局域操作和经典通信的量子能量传输协议为背景提出判据。作者认为，当 LOCC 被优化时，可提取能量成为恶魔遍历功，应归为功；当 LOCC 未优化时，系统中残留的不可控能量可在谨慎处理多体相互作用后归为热。文章还推导了两类广义 Clausius 不等式，并在一维 Kitaev 类模型中讨论有效温度的物理意义。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们如何识别热和功，是现代量子热力学中的一个基本问题。通常，在量子系统的时间演化过程中，热和功分别归因于密度矩阵和哈密顿量的变化。近来，人们已经认识到这种识别具有歧义性。此外，涉及量子测量的量子热力学仍处于发展之中。受这些正在进行的工作的启发，我们考虑一个量子多体系统，根据量子能量传输（QET）协议，通过局域操作和经典通信（LOCC）从其中提取能量。明确定义热和功的核心思想基于对 LOCC 优化条件的深刻洞察。当 LOCC 被优化时，由 QET 可提取的能量成为一种恶魔遍历功；因此，它可以被归因于功。另一方面，当 LOCC 未被优化时，我们并未通过幺正操作榨取出所有能量。这意味着系统中留下了不可控的能量。在谨慎处理多体相互作用之后，这种不可控能量可以被归因于热。热项包含由于远程参与者之间通信而产生的非局域关联，而该关联不能被子系统中的参与者直接观测到。因此，这一特征与将热视为不可控能量的传统观点相一致。为深入理解热的本质，我们在有效量子热力学中推导出两类广义 Clausius 不等式，并讨论不等式的方向。为证明我们观点的合理性，我们考察了一个一维 Kitaev 类模型，并讨论了我们热力学中有效温度的物理意义。

articles.title: Water and the Many-Body Imagination
articles.title_zh: 水与多体想象
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01097v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: An electron crosses the cold Fermi sea. The sea recoils, screens, remembers. It returns the electron dressed: a quasiparticle with a mass, a lifetime, and a Green function. This was Nozières' lesson. We carry it to water. Electrons become dipoles; the Fermi sea becomes a hydrogen-bonded polar liquid. We ask the same question: can the collective modes of water live long enough and reach far enough for molecular machines to interact and synchronize?
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作以 Nozières 关于费米海中准粒子的图像为类比，将多体物理的思想延伸到水这一氢键极性液体。作者将电子类比为偶极子，将费米海类比为水的集体环境，提出水的集体模是否足够长寿、足够长程以支持分子机器相互作用和同步的问题。具体论证和结论需查阅原文。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一个电子穿过寒冷的费米海。海发生反冲、屏蔽并记忆。它将电子以被包裹的形式送回：一个具有质量、寿命和格林函数的准粒子。这是 Nozières 的教诲。我们将其带到水中。电子变成偶极子；费米海变成由氢键连接的极性液体。我们提出同样的问题：水的集体模能否存活足够长的时间、到达足够远的距离，从而使分子机器能够相互作用并同步？

articles.title: PolymerGPT: Multi-property Optimization with a Decoder-Based GPT Model for Generative Polymer Design
articles.title_zh: PolymerGPT：用于生成式聚合物设计中多性质优化的基于解码器的 GPT 模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01431v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Polymer property prediction and inverse generative design targeting desired properties are two crucial tasks in machine learning-assisted polymer design. While the former has received considerable attention, there have been limited methods developed for the latter. Existing methods focus on single-property optimization in the generative process, whereas accurate prediction of macroscopic material behavior requires simultaneous control of multiple physical properties. In this paper, we provide a transformative framework for direct optimization of a large collection of polymer properties. We propose PolymerGPT, a decoder-based GPT model that incorporates up to 37 commonly used polymer properties into the generative process via learned conditioning prefixes. It also supports a scaffold condition that specifies a desired scaffold for predicted structures. Our experimental results demonstrate that PolymerGPT achieves exceptional performance for unconditional and conditional generation while maintaining high validity, uniqueness, and novelty. Conditioning on five key properties yields generated structures whose predicted values closely match all target properties simultaneously.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 PolymerGPT，一种基于解码器的 GPT 模型，用于面向多种目标性质的生成式聚合物设计。该模型通过学习到的条件前缀将多达 37 种常用聚合物性质纳入生成过程，并支持指定目标骨架的条件生成。实验结果显示，PolymerGPT 在无条件与条件生成中均具有较高有效性、唯一性和新颖性，并能同时匹配多个关键目标性质。
authors: Charlie Pyle, Adarsh Gadari, C. Adrian Figg, Zhenquan Jia, Yaohang Li, Chunjiang Zhu
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚合物性质预测以及针对期望性质的逆向生成设计，是机器学习辅助聚合物设计中的两项关键任务。尽管前者已经受到相当多的关注，但针对后者开发的方法仍然有限。现有方法在生成过程中侧重于单一性质优化，而准确预测宏观材料行为需要同时控制多个物理性质。在本文中，我们提供了一个变革性框架，用于直接优化大量聚合物性质。我们提出 PolymerGPT，这是一种基于解码器的 GPT 模型，它通过学习得到的条件前缀，将多达 37 种常用聚合物性质纳入生成过程。它还支持一种骨架条件，用于为预测结构指定所需骨架。我们的实验结果表明，PolymerGPT 在无条件和条件生成方面取得了优异表现，同时保持了高有效性、唯一性和新颖性。以五个关键性质为条件时，生成结构的预测值能够同时紧密匹配所有目标性质。

articles.title: Surface adsorbates suppress low-frequency noise for shallow nitrogen-vacancy centers
articles.title_zh: 表面吸附物抑制浅层氮-空位中心的低频噪声
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01478v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Shallow nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond are promising nanoscale quantum sensors, yet their coherence is strongly limited by surface-induced noise. Surface adsorbates are widely believed to be a major source of decoherence. Here, we test this assumption by characterizing shallow single NV centers under ultrahigh vacuum (UHV) conditions, where the diamond surface is kept free of adsorbates, and comparing their behavior to ambient conditions. Surprisingly, we observe a ~4x reduction in the Hahn echo coherence time T2 in UHV. By combining Hahn echo measurements in the single-quantum (SQ) and double-quantum (DQ) bases, we separate contributions from different noise sources and find that both electric and magnetic noise are enhanced in UHV. In contrast, T1 measurements reveal an increased DQ T1 in UHV, indicating suppressed electric field noise in the ~100 MHz frequency regime. These results point to a modification of the surface noise spectrum upon adsorbate removal, with different frequency regimes arising from distinct microscopic mechanisms. Specifically, we find that the low frequency noise is consistent with increased surface charge in UHV that can be compensated by surface adsorbates in ambient conditions. Our findings highlight a complex and previously underappreciated role of surface adsorbates in shaping the noise environment of shallow NV centers, with important implications for nanoscale quantum sensing.
articles.abstract_zh: 浅层金刚石氮-空位（NV）中心是有前景的纳米尺度量子传感器，但其相干性受表面噪声限制。作者在超高真空与环境条件下比较单个浅层 NV 中心，发现去除吸附物后 Hahn 回波相干时间显著缩短，且低频电噪声和磁噪声增强。结果表明表面吸附物并非单纯导致退相干，而可能补偿超高真空中的表面电荷，从而抑制低频噪声。
authors: Zhiyang Yuan, David A. Fehr, Kalliope Zervas, Sorawis Sangtawesin, Lila V. H. Rodgers, Patryk Gumann, Michael E. Flatte, Nathalie P. de Leon
articles.abstract_zh_full: 金刚石中的浅层氮-空位（NV）中心是很有前景的纳米尺度量子传感器，但其相干性受到表面诱导噪声的强烈限制。表面吸附物被广泛认为是退相干的主要来源。在这里，我们通过在超高真空（UHV）条件下表征浅层单个 NV 中心来检验这一假设，在该条件下金刚石表面保持无吸附物，并将其行为与环境条件下进行比较。令人惊讶的是，我们在 UHV 中观察到 Hahn 回波相干时间 T2 约降低 4 倍。通过结合单量子（SQ）和双量子（DQ）基下的 Hahn 回波测量，我们分离了不同噪声源的贡献，并发现电噪声和磁噪声在 UHV 中均增强。相比之下，T1 测量显示 UHV 中 DQ T1 增大，表明约 100 MHz 频率范围内的电场噪声受到抑制。这些结果指向吸附物去除后表面噪声谱的改变，其中不同频率范围源自不同的微观机制。具体而言，我们发现低频噪声与 UHV 中增加的表面电荷相一致，而这些表面电荷可在环境条件下由表面吸附物补偿。我们的发现凸显了表面吸附物在塑造浅层 NV 中心噪声环境方面复杂且此前被低估的作用，并对纳米尺度量子传感具有重要影响。

articles.title: Beyond K-Theory: Geometry and Holomorphy in Hyperbolic Band Theory
articles.title_zh: 超越 K 理论：双曲能带理论中的几何与全纯性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.01596v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Topological K-theory supplies the decisive stable classification principle for gapped free-fermion phases in Euclidean crystals once symmetry and stabilization are fixed. In hyperbolic band theory, by contrast, it is less decisive for the full band problem: generalized momentum sectors vary through moduli spaces, but passing to ordinary K-classes collapses their geometric and holomorphic variation. We distinguish kinematical holomorphy, in which complex geometry organizes the sector spaces, from dynamical holomorphy, in which that geometry informs a Hamiltonian or projector, and formulate the resulting loss as an observable-factorization problem. For a compact hyperbolic surface X, we prove nonfactorization in three settings: fibrewise K⁰⁽X), occupied-state K⁰⁽B), and operator-algebraic K-theory. The affected quantities include spectra and Higgs spectral curves, the Berry holonomy and the quantum metric, the partially filled Hall response, and the Fermi surface and nodal geometries. We also identify the quantized pairings and local charges retained by topology. Up to an explicit area factor, the Kotani--Sunada bottom-band Hessian is the Hodge inner product on H¹⁽X;mathbb R). Together with the integral intersection form, it recovers the homology-marked principally polarized Jacobian and hence, by Torelli and uniformization, the underlying complex and hyperbolic surface, though not a full Teichmüller marking. We also separate finite-rank sectors from the thermodynamic bulk. Locally faithful covers reproduce polynomial traces exactly and control continuous spectral observables. In arithmetic congruence towers, analytic observables converge as O(|Gₙ|⁻η) for some η>0, and C^s observables as O((łog |Gₙ|)⁻s), while established coherent large-rank limits recover bulk density-of-states moments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论双曲能带理论中普通 K 理论分类的局限，指出其会压缩广义动量扇区的几何与全纯变化。作者区分运动学全纯性与动力学全纯性，并在多个 K 理论框架中证明可观测量不能完全因子化。研究还说明哪些拓扑量仍被保留，并分析有限秩扇区、覆盖空间与热力学体相极限中的谱可观测量收敛。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一旦对称性和稳定化被固定，拓扑 K 理论为欧几里得晶体中的有能隙自由费米子相提供决定性的稳定分类原则。相比之下，在双曲能带理论中，对于完整能带问题，它的决定性较弱：广义动量扇区在模空间中变化，但转向普通 K 类会压缩其几何和全纯变化。我们区分运动学全纯性与动力学全纯性，前者是复几何组织扇区空间，后者是该几何影响哈密顿量或投影算符，并将由此产生的损失表述为一个可观测量因子化问题。对于紧双曲曲面 X，我们在三种设定中证明非因子化：逐纤维 K⁰(X)、占据态 K⁰(B) 以及算子代数 K 理论。受影响的量包括谱和 Higgs 谱曲线、Berry 全纯和量子度量、部分填充的霍尔响应，以及费米面和节点几何。我们还识别出拓扑所保留的量子化配对和局域荷。除一个显式面积因子外，Kotani--Sunada 底带 Hessian 是 H¹(X; R) 上的 Hodge 内积。它与整数交叉形式一起恢复带同调标记的主极化 Jacobian，并因此通过 Torelli 定理和一致化恢复底层复曲面和双曲曲面，但不能恢复完整的 Teichmüller 标记。我们还将有限秩扇区与热力学体相区分开来。局部忠实覆盖精确再现多项式迹，并控制连续谱可观测量。在算术同余塔中，解析可观测量以某个 η>0 的 O(|Gₙ|⁻η) 收敛，C^s 可观测量以 O((log |Gₙ|)⁻s) 收敛，而已有的相干大秩极限则恢复体相态密度矩。

articles.title: Characterizing the nitrogen-vacancy center singlet transition and its phonon sideband for absorption-based room-temperature magnetometry
articles.title_zh: 面向基于吸收的室温磁测量的氮-空位中心单重态跃迁及其声子边带表征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02060v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Magnetometry with nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond has shown great promise in recent years. In particular, absorption-based magnetometry techniques, employing a cavity to enhance the absorption length, can improve the contrast and sensitivity compared to conventional techniques based on reading out the NV⁻ triplet fluorescence. The absorption techniques rely on magnetic-field-dependent absorption at the NV⁻ singlet zero phonon line at 1042,nm and its phonon sideband. In a cavity-enhanced spectroscopy approach, we study pump-laser- and microwave-induced cavity signal changes at room temperature over a spectral range of 680-1050,nm. Through normalization, we eliminate the cavity-enhancement effect and provide quasi-single-pass values for the absorption and optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) contrast. The highest contrast is found at 1042,nm, but multiple points of high contrast are found at the peaks of the phonon sideband. Additionally, cavity-enhanced ODMR contrasts in the range of 50-80,% are presented. We further measure the broadband singlet absorption cross section at room temperature with a novel method through microwave-induced signal changes. This method is insensitive to pump-laser-induced signal changes by other defects and quantifies the room-temperature absorption strength of the singlet transition and its entire phonon sideband. We determine the absorption cross section at 1042,nm to be σ,bⁱgstar₁₀₄₂=(0.89±0.14)ḑot 10⁻²¹,m² or σ,blacktrⁱaⁿgle₁₀₄₂=(2.9±0.5)ḑot 10⁻²¹,m². depending on the employed 532,nm NV⁻ absorption cross section.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究金刚石 NV 中心在 1042 nm 单重态零声子线及其声子边带处的吸收特性，以支持基于吸收的室温磁测量。作者利用腔增强光谱测量泵浦激光和微波诱导的信号变化，并通过归一化获得准单程吸收和 ODMR 对比度。研究给出了高对比度波长位置、腔增强 ODMR 对比度以及室温下单重态吸收截面的定量结果。
authors: Tobias Probst, Florian Schall, Sebastian Heuft, Janina J. Schindler, Lukas Lindner, Sven Mägdefessel, Rüdiger Quay, Philipp Reineck, Alexander M. Zaitsev, Takeshi Ohshima, Matthias Weidemüller, Jan Jeske
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，利用金刚石中氮-空位（NV）中心进行磁测量显示出巨大前景。特别是，基于吸收的磁测量技术通过使用腔来增强吸收长度，与基于读出 NV⁻ 三重态荧光的传统技术相比，可以提高对比度和灵敏度。这些吸收技术依赖于 NV⁻ 单重态零声子线 1042 nm 及其声子边带处随磁场变化的吸收。在一种腔增强光谱方法中，我们在室温下研究了 680–1050 nm 光谱范围内由泵浦激光和微波诱导的腔信号变化。通过归一化，我们消除了腔增强效应，并给出了吸收和光探测磁共振（ODMR）对比度的准单程数值。最高对比度出现在 1042 nm 处，但在声子边带峰值处也发现了多个高对比度点。此外，我们还给出了 50–80% 范围内的腔增强 ODMR 对比度。我们进一步通过一种利用微波诱导信号变化的新方法，在室温下测量了宽带单重态吸收截面。该方法对其他缺陷导致的泵浦激光诱导信号变化不敏感，并量化了单重态跃迁及其整个声子边带在室温下的吸收强度。根据所采用的 532 nm NV⁻ 吸收截面，我们确定 1042 nm 处的吸收截面为 σ*₁₀₄₂=(0.89±0.14)×10⁻²¹ m² 或 σ▲₁₀₄₂=(2.9±0.5)×10⁻²¹ m²。

articles.title: Quantum computer-based simulation of Stark many-body localization in a 1D Fermi-Hubbard model
articles.title_zh: 基于量子计算机的一维费米-Hubbard 模型中 Stark 多体局域化模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02245v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Many-body localization (MBL) is a dynamical phenomenon that describes the non-ergodicity of isolated quantum many-body systems. In contrast to thermalization, this phenomenon leads to a long-lived memory of initial states of local systems and slow growth of entanglement. In this work, we study Stark MBL in a 12-qubit correlated fermionic system described by the one-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model using Hamiltonian simulation on an IBM superconducting qubit quantum computer. To enable such a computation on current-day noisy hardware, we combine a series of compilation steps, including the use of the spin-resolved Jordan-Wigner transformation, employing SWAP networks, and integrating a tensor-network-based quantum circuit optimization routine on top of a standard circuit optimization pipeline. As a result, there is approximately an 88% and 87% reduction in two-qubit gate count and circuit depth, respectively. Through such simulations of the real-time dynamics using Trotterized quantum circuits, we exhibit a crossover from thermalizing dynamics of the system at a weak tilt of the field to a strongly localized behavior at large tilt with short evolution times. We also benchmark our obtained results with respect to those from exact simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在 IBM 超导量子计算机上模拟一维 Fermi-Hubbard 模型中的 Stark 多体局域化。作者结合自旋分辨 Jordan-Wigner 变换、SWAP 网络和张量网络量子线路优化，大幅降低双量子比特门数和线路深度。结果在短时实时间演化中展示了从弱倾斜场下热化动力学到强倾斜场下强局域行为的交叉，并与精确模拟进行了基准比较。
authors: Abdul Kalam, Prasenjit Deb, Akitada Sakurai, Tapan Mishra, V. S. Prasannaa, B. P. Das
articles.abstract_zh_full: 多体局域化（MBL）是一种动力学现象，描述孤立量子多体系统的非遍历性。与热化相反，该现象导致局域系统初态的长期记忆以及纠缠的缓慢增长。在本工作中，我们使用 IBM 超导量子比特量子计算机上的哈密顿量模拟，研究由一维 Fermi-Hubbard 模型描述的 12 量子比特关联费米系统中的 Stark MBL。为使这种计算能够在当前有噪声硬件上实现，我们结合了一系列编译步骤，包括使用自旋分辨 Jordan-Wigner 变换、采用 SWAP 网络，以及在标准线路优化流程之上集成基于张量网络的量子线路优化程序。结果，双量子比特门数量和线路深度分别约减少 88% 和 87%。通过使用 Trotter 化量子线路对实时间动力学进行此类模拟，我们在短演化时间内展示了系统从弱场倾斜下的热化动力学到大倾斜下强局域行为的交叉。我们还将所得结果与精确模拟结果进行了基准比较。

articles.title: Spread complexity as a probe in generalized and long-range Aubry-Andre-Harper models
articles.title_zh: 作为广义和长程 Aubry-Andre-Harper 模型探针的扩展复杂度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.02451v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We investigate the spread complexity of quantum quenches in generalized and long-range Aubry-Andre-Harper (AAH) models, encompassing regimes with and without mobility edges. In particular, in the generalized AAH models supporting energy-dependent mobility edges, we demonstrate that the long-time averaged spread complexity exhibits nonanalytic behavior when the post-quench quasiperiodic potential crosses the mobility edge associated with the energy of the initial eigenstate, thereby accurately identifying the mobility-edge transition. Such a behavior is supported by the spreading of local density of states. We further derive analytical expressions for the moments and the corresponding Lanczos coefficients for quenches between the limits of vanishing and strong quasiperiodic potentials. The Lanczos coefficients display qualitatively distinct behavior depending on the presence of mobility edges - they exhibit an initial plateau followed by a decay with the Krylov basis index, in contrast to the nearly constant behavior of the conventional AAH model without mobility edges. For LR hopping, the coefficients decay with the Krylov basis index for quenches from the localized to the extended phase, while they coincide with the AAH results for quenches in the opposite direction.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究广义与长程 Aubry-Andre-Harper 模型中量子淬火的扩展复杂度，涵盖存在和不存在迁移率边的情形。在具有能量依赖迁移率边的广义模型中，长时间平均扩展复杂度在淬火后准周期势跨越与初始本征态能量相关的迁移率边时出现非解析行为。研究还推导了若干极限淬火下矩和 Lanczos 系数的解析表达式，并比较了不同模型和相区中的特征行为。
authors: Triyas Sapui, Tanoy Kanti Konar, Subinay Dasgupta, Aditi Sen De
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究广义和长程 Aubry-Andre-Harper（AAH）模型中量子淬火的扩展复杂度，涵盖具有和不具有迁移率边的区域。特别是在支持能量依赖迁移率边的广义 AAH 模型中，我们证明，当淬火后的准周期势跨越与初始本征态能量相关的迁移率边时，长时间平均扩展复杂度表现出非解析行为，从而准确识别迁移率边转变。这种行为得到局域态密度扩展的支持。我们进一步推导了在消失和强准周期势极限之间淬火时矩及相应 Lanczos 系数的解析表达式。Lanczos 系数会根据迁移率边是否存在而表现出定性不同的行为——它们呈现初始平台，随后随 Krylov 基指标衰减；这与没有迁移率边的传统 AAH 模型中近乎恒定的行为形成对比。对于长程跃迁，在从局域相淬火到扩展相时，系数随 Krylov 基指标衰减；而在相反方向淬火时，它们与 AAH 结果一致。

articles.title: Production and stabilization of a spin mixture of ultracold dipolar Bose gases
articles.title_zh: 超冷偶极玻色气体自旋混合物的制备与稳定化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2407.08702v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Mixtures of ultracold gases with long-range interactions are expected to open new avenues in the study of quantum matter. Natural candidates for this research are spin mixtures of atomic species with large magnetic moments. However, the lifetime of such assemblies can be strongly affected by the dipolar relaxation that occurs in spin-flip collisions. Here we present experimental results for a mixture composed of the two lowest Zeeman states of ¹⁶²Dy atoms, that act as dark states with respect to a light-induced quadratic Zeeman effect. We show that, due to an interference phenomenon, the rate for such inelastic processes is dramatically reduced with respect to the Wigner threshold law. Additionally, we determine the scattering lengths characterizing the s-wave interaction between these states, providing all necessary data to predict the miscibility range of the mixture, depending on its dimensionality.
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验研究由 ¹⁶²Dy 原子最低两个 Zeeman 态组成的超冷偶极玻色气体自旋混合物。作者发现，由于干涉效应，自旋翻转碰撞中的偶极弛豫率相对于 Wigner 阈值律被显著降低。研究还测定了这些态之间 s 波相互作用的散射长度，为预测不同维度下混合物的可混溶范围提供参数。
authors: Maxime Lecomte, Alexandre Journeaux, Julie Veschambre, Jean Dalibard, Raphael Lopes
articles.abstract_zh_full: 具有长程相互作用的超冷气体混合物有望为量子物质研究开辟新的方向。此类研究的天然候选体系是具有大磁矩的原子物种的自旋混合物。然而，这类集合体的寿命可能会受到自旋翻转碰撞中发生的偶极弛豫的强烈影响。在这里，我们给出了由 ¹⁶²Dy 原子的两个最低 Zeeman 态组成的混合物的实验结果，这两个态相对于光诱导的二次 Zeeman 效应表现为暗态。我们表明，由于一种干涉现象，这类非弹性过程的速率相对于 Wigner 阈值律被显著降低。此外，我们确定了表征这些态之间 s 波相互作用的散射长度，从而提供了根据混合物维度预测其可混溶范围所需的全部数据。

articles.title: Magnetic quantum criticality: The role of the Fermi surface geometry
articles.title_zh: 磁性量子临界性：费米面几何的作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2409.04308v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate magnetic quantum phase-transitions in bulk correlated metals. To this end, we focus on the Hubbard model on different cubic lattices as a function of temperature and electronic density, determining the relevant regimes around its quantum magnetic transition, i.e. classical, quantum critical, and quantum disordered, as well as the corresponding (thermal/non-thermal) quantum critical exponents. Our numerical results, based on dynamical mean-field theory, together with supporting analytical derivations, rigorously demonstrate how and why the presence of different kinds of Kohn anomalies on the underlying Fermi surface (i) drives the quantum critical behavior above the quantum critical point and (ii) shapes the whole phase diagram around it. Our findings highlight the importance of an explicit inclusion of such Fermi surface geometrical properties into the universality class definition for magnetic quantum phase-transitions in correlated metals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究体相关联金属中的磁性量子相变，重点分析不同立方晶格 Hubbard 模型随温度和电子密度变化的行为。基于动力学平均场理论和解析推导，作者确定了量子磁性转变附近的经典、量子临界和量子无序区域及相应临界指数。结果表明，费米面上的不同 Kohn 异常会驱动量子临界点以上的临界行为，并塑造整个相图。
authors: D. R. Fus, S. Adler, M. O. Malcolms, A. Vock, K. Held, A. A. Katanin, T. Schäfer, A. Toschi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究体相关联金属中的磁性量子相变。为此，我们关注不同立方晶格上的 Hubbard 模型随温度和电子密度的变化，确定其量子磁性转变附近的相关区域，即经典区域、量子临界区域和量子无序区域，以及相应的热/非热量子临界指数。我们基于动力学平均场理论的数值结果，连同支持性的解析推导，严格证明了底层费米面上存在不同类型 Kohn 异常如何以及为何（i）驱动量子临界点以上的量子临界行为，并且（ii）塑造其附近的整个相图。我们的发现强调，在定义关联金属中磁性量子相变的普适类时，显式纳入此类费米面几何性质具有重要意义。

articles.title: Active screws: Emergent active chiral nematics of spinning self-propelled rods
articles.title_zh: 主动螺旋体：旋转自推进杆的涌现主动手性向列相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.12263v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Several types of active agents self-propel by spinning around their propulsion axis, thus behaving as active screws. Examples include cytoskeletal filaments in gliding assays, magnetically driven colloidal helices, and microorganisms such as the bacterium itMyxococcus itxanthus. Here, we develop a model for spinning self-propelled rods on a substrate, and we coarse grain it to derive the corresponding hydrodynamic equations. If the rods propel purely along their axis, they form an active nematic at high density and activity. However, spinning rods can also roll sideways as they move. We find that this transverse motion turns the system into a chiral active nematic. Thus, we identify a mechanism whereby individual chirality can give rise to collective local chiral flows. Finally, we analyze experiments on itM. itxanthus colonies to show that they exhibit chiral flows around topological defects, with a chiral activity about an order of magnitude weaker than the achiral one. Our work reveals the collective behavior of active screws, which is relevant to colonies of social bacteria and groups of unicellular parasites.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了基底上旋转自推进杆的模型，并粗粒化得到相应流体动力学方程。若杆仅沿自身轴向推进，高密度和高活性下形成主动向列相；若旋转杆运动时还能侧向滚动，则体系转变为手性主动向列相。作者还分析了黄色黏球菌群落实验，发现其拓扑缺陷周围存在手性流动，且手性活性弱于非手性活性约一个数量级。
authors: Debarghya Banerjee, Lauritz Hahn, Ricard Alert
articles.abstract_zh_full: 若干类型的主动主体通过围绕其推进轴旋转来实现自推进，因此表现为主动螺旋体。例子包括滑行实验中的细胞骨架丝、磁驱动胶体螺旋体，以及诸如细菌黄色黏球菌（Myxococcus xanthus）等微生物。在这里，我们建立了基底上旋转自推进杆的模型，并对其进行粗粒化以推导相应的流体动力学方程。如果这些杆纯粹沿其轴向推进，它们会在高密度和高活性下形成主动向列相。然而，旋转杆在运动时也可以侧向滚动。我们发现，这种横向运动将体系转变为手性主动向列相。因此，我们识别出一种机制，通过该机制个体手性能够产生集体的局域手性流。最后，我们分析了黄色黏球菌群落的实验，表明它们在拓扑缺陷周围表现出手性流动，其手性活性比非手性活性弱约一个数量级。我们的工作揭示了主动螺旋体的集体行为，这与社会性细菌群落和单细胞寄生虫群体相关。

articles.title: Emergent superconductivity and non-reciprocal transport in a van der Waals Dirac semimetal/antiferromagnet heterostructure
articles.title_zh: 范德华 Dirac 半金属/反铁磁体异质结构中的涌现超导性与非互易输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2504.20393v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate emergent superconductivity and non-reciprocal transport (magnetochiral anisotropy, superconducting diode effect) at the heterointerface of two non-superconducting van der Waals (vdW) materials, the Dirac semimetal ZrTe₂ and the antiferromagnetic iron chalcogenide FeTe, grown using molecular beam epitaxy. We show from electrical transport measurements that two-dimensional (2D) superconductivity arises at the heterointerface below a critical temperature T_c sim 10~K. In the superconducting transition region, non-reciprocal transport, characterized by the magneto-chiral anisotropy, exhibits a magnitude comparable to that observed in topological insulators, and is enhanced by a factor of three when the heterostructure is capped with a 2D vdW ferromagnet (CrTe₂₎. Below T_c, the superconducting diode effect exhibits an efficiency of 29%. With strong spin-orbit coupling in ZrTe₂, these epitaxial heterostructures provide an attractive epitaxial vdW platform for exploring unconventional superconductivity in Dirac semimetals and for developing non-reciprocal devices for superconducting electronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究由非超导范德华材料 Dirac 半金属 ZrTe₂ 与反铁磁 FeTe 构成的外延异质界面中的涌现超导和非互易输运。电输运测量表明，界面在约 10 K 以下出现二维超导性，并在超导转变区域观察到显著磁手性各向异性。加盖二维铁磁 CrTe₂ 可增强非互易效应，低于 Tc 时超导二极管效应效率达到 29%。
authors: Saurav Islam, Max Stanley, Anthony Richardella, Seungjun Lee, Kalana D. Halanayake, Sandra Santhosh, Danielle Reifsnyder Hickey, Tony Low, Nitin Samarth
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究两种非超导范德华（vdW）材料的异质界面处的涌现超导性和非互易输运（磁手性各向异性、超导二极管效应），这两种材料为 Dirac 半金属 ZrTe₂ 和反铁磁铁硫族化物 FeTe，并通过分子束外延生长。我们通过电输运测量表明，二维（2D）超导性在临界温度 T_c 约为 10 K 以下的异质界面处出现。在超导转变区域，由磁手性各向异性表征的非互易输运表现出与拓扑绝缘体中观察到的量级相当的幅度，并且当异质结构覆盖二维 vdW 铁磁体 CrTe₂ 时增强三倍。在 T_c 以下，超导二极管效应表现出 29% 的效率。凭借 ZrTe₂ 中强自旋-轨道耦合，这些外延异质结构为探索 Dirac 半金属中的非常规超导性以及开发用于超导电子学的非互易器件提供了有吸引力的外延 vdW 平台。

articles.title: Algorithms for variational Monte Carlo calculations of fermion projected entangled pair states in the swap gates formulation and the detailed balance of tensor network sequential sampling
articles.title_zh: 交换门表述中费米子投影纠缠对态的变分蒙特卡罗计算算法及张量网络序贯采样的细致平衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.20106v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In recent years, the variational Monte Carlo (VMC) calculations of projected entangled pair states (PEPS) has emerged as a competitive method for computing the ground states of many-body quantum systems. This method is particularly important for fermion systems where sign problems are abundant. We derive and explain the algorithms for the VMC calculations of fermion PEPS in the swap gates formulation. As a separate key result, we prove the detailed balance of sequential sampling of tensor networks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论投影纠缠对态（PEPS）的变分蒙特卡罗方法在费米子多体量子系统中的算法实现。作者推导并解释了交换门表述下费米子 PEPS 的 VMC 计算算法。作为另一项关键结果，论文证明了张量网络序贯采样满足细致平衡。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 近年来，投影纠缠对态（PEPS）的变分蒙特卡罗（VMC）计算已成为计算多体量子系统基态的一种有竞争力的方法。该方法对于符号问题普遍存在的费米子系统尤其重要。我们推导并解释了交换门表述中费米子 PEPS 的 VMC 计算算法。作为一个独立的关键结果，我们证明了张量网络序贯采样的细致平衡。

articles.title: Current-induced spin-orbit torque on the surface of a transition metal dichalcogenide connected to a two-dimensional ferromagnet CrI₃: Effects of twisting and gating
articles.title_zh: 连接二维铁磁体 CrI₃ 的过渡金属二硫族化物表面上的电流诱导自旋-轨道力矩：扭转与栅控效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.23655v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Motivated by recent progress in employing two key classes of two-dimensional materials-topological insulators and transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs)-as spin sources for generating spin-orbit torque (SOT), we investigate current-induced spin polarization and the resulting SOT in bilayers composed of a TMDC (WSe₂ or MoSe₂₎ and ferromagnetic chromium iodide (CrI₃₎, beyond the linear response regime. Using the steady-state Boltzmann equation, we find that intra-band transitions yield a strong field-like torque on the CrI₃ layer, while inter-band transitions give rise to a comparatively weaker damping-like torque in the WSe₂/CrI₃ system. Remarkably, the damping-like component is enhanced by up to three orders of magnitude in n-doped MoSe₂, reaching a strength comparable to the field-like torque, which itself is an order of magnitude larger than that in the WSe₂₋based bilayer. Both torque components exhibit strong asymmetry between n-type and p-type doping in WSe₂ and MoSe₂ systems. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the twist angle plays a crucial role: depending on the TMDC and chemical potential, twisting can reverse the sign of the SOT and significantly modulate its magnitude. Finally, we show that a transverse gate electric field enables substantial tunability of the SOT, by nearly one order of magnitude, and induces a sign reversal at a twist angle of 10.16ⁱ̧rc.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究 TMDC（WSe₂ 或 MoSe₂）与二维铁磁 CrI₃ 双层中的电流诱导自旋极化和自旋-轨道力矩，超越线性响应范围。Boltzmann 方程结果显示，带内跃迁产生强场状力矩，带间跃迁产生较弱阻尼状力矩，但在 n 掺杂 MoSe₂ 中阻尼状分量可增强数个数量级。扭转角和横向栅电场可显著调控力矩大小并导致符号反转。
authors: Leyla Majidi, Azadeh Faridi, Reza Asgari
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受近期利用两类关键二维材料——拓扑绝缘体和过渡金属二硫族化物（TMDC）——作为产生自旋-轨道力矩（SOT）的自旋源方面进展的推动，我们研究由 TMDC（WSe₂ 或 MoSe₂）和铁磁碘化铬（CrI₃）组成的双层中的电流诱导自旋极化及其产生的 SOT，并超越线性响应范围。利用稳态 Boltzmann 方程，我们发现带内跃迁在 CrI₃ 层上产生强场状力矩，而带间跃迁在 WSe₂/CrI₃ 体系中产生相对较弱的阻尼状力矩。值得注意的是，在 n 掺杂 MoSe₂ 中，阻尼状分量增强高达三个数量级，达到与场状力矩相当的强度，而场状力矩本身又比 WSe₂ 基双层中的相应力矩大一个数量级。在 WSe₂ 和 MoSe₂ 体系中，两种力矩分量在 n 型和 p 型掺杂之间均表现出强烈不对称性。此外，我们证明扭转角起着关键作用：取决于 TMDC 和化学势，扭转可以反转 SOT 的符号并显著调制其大小。最后，我们表明横向栅极电场能够使 SOT 产生显著可调性，幅度接近一个数量级，并在 10.16° 的扭转角处诱导符号反转。

articles.title: Asymptotically exact solution of the non-Hermitian disordered interacting Hatano-Nelson chain
articles.title_zh: 非厄米无序相互作用 Hatano-Nelson 链的渐近精确解
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.16309v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present an asymptotically exact solution of a paradigmatic non-Hermitian model: the disordered interacting fermionic Hatano-Nelson model, or equivalently, the non-Hermitian spin-1/2 XXZ model. We use a renormalization group method suited for disordered systems and show that non-Hermitian couplings are relevant perturbations to the Hermitian model, which ultimately leads to a quantum-to-classical crossover. The ground state of the model consists of a collection of strongly coupled pairs of spins of arbitrary size at random positions which, unlike the Hermitian case, do not form singlets, but a mixture of the singlet and the M=0 triplet state. As a result, the magnetic susceptibility in the x,y-directions becomes negative and diverges at a finite small temperature. Additionally, in sharp contrast to the łn(L) increase observed in disordered Hermitian chains, the entanglement entropy of a partition of size L saturates for large L, as the strongly coupled pairs become classical and stop contributing at large length scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者给出无序相互作用费米 Hatano-Nelson 模型等价非厄米自旋 1/2 XXZ 模型的渐近精确解。利用适用于无序系统的重整化群方法，研究表明非厄米耦合是厄米模型的相关微扰，并最终导致量子到经典的交叉。基态由随机位置处强耦合自旋对组成，磁化率和纠缠熵行为与无序厄米链显著不同。
authors: Valéria M. Mattiello, Victor L. Quito, Eduardo Miranda
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们给出一个典型非厄米模型的渐近精确解：无序相互作用费米 Hatano-Nelson 模型，或等价地，非厄米自旋 1/2 XXZ 模型。我们使用一种适用于无序系统的重整化群方法，并表明非厄米耦合是厄米模型的相关微扰，最终导致量子到经典的交叉。该模型的基态由随机位置处任意大小的强耦合自旋对集合组成；与厄米情形不同，这些自旋对不形成单态，而是单态与 M=0 三重态的混合。因此，x、y 方向的磁化率变为负值，并在有限的小温度处发散。此外，与无序厄米链中观察到的 ln(L) 增长形成鲜明对比，大小为 L 的分区的纠缠熵在大 L 时饱和，因为强耦合自旋对变得经典化，并在大长度尺度上停止贡献。

articles.title: Observation of mirror-odd and mirror-even spin texture in ultrathin epitaxially strained RuO2 films
articles.title_zh: 超薄外延应变 RuO₂ 薄膜中镜面对称奇性与偶性自旋织构的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.16361v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recently, rutile ruthenium dioxide (RuO₂₎ has attracted renewed interest due to expectations of prominent altermagnetic spin splitting. However, accumulating experimental evidence suggests that, in its bulk and thick-film forms, RuO₂ does not display any form of magnetic ordering. Despite this, the spin structure of RuO₂ remains largely unexplored in the ultrathin limit, where substrate-imposed epitaxial strain can be substantial. Here, we use spin-resolved angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, supported by ab initio calculations, to reveal the electronic structure of 2-nanometer-thick epitaxial RuO₂ heterostructures. We observe an unconventional spin texture characterized by the coexistence of mirror-even and mirror-odd momentum-dependent components. A comprehensive symmetry analysis rules out nonmagnetic origins of this spin texture. These findings suggest an emergent nonrelativistic spin structure enabled by epitaxial strain in the ultrathin limit, marking a distinct departure from the behavior of relaxed or bulk RuO₂. Our work opens previously unexplored perspectives for exploring symmetry-breaking mechanisms and spin textures in oxide heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用自旋分辨角分辨光电子能谱并结合第一性原理计算，研究了 2 纳米厚外延 RuO₂ 异质结构的电子结构。作者观测到同时包含镜面对称偶性和奇性动量依赖分量的非常规自旋织构，并通过对称性分析排除了非磁性起源。结果表明，超薄极限下外延应变可能诱导出不同于体相或弛豫 RuO₂ 的非相对论自旋结构。
authors: Yichen Zhang, Seung Gyo Jeong, Luca Buiarelli, Seungjun Lee, Yucheng Guo, Jiaqin Wen, Hang Li, Sreejith Nair, In Hyeok Choi, Zheng Ren, Ziqin Yue, Jounghoon Hyun, Tieqiong Zhang, Alexei Fedorov, Sung-Kwan Mo, Hojoon Lim, Adrian Hunt, Iradwikanari Waluyo, Junichiro Kono, Jan Minar, Jong Seok Lee, Tony Low, Turan Birol, Rafael M. Fernandes, Milan Radovic, Bharat Jalan, Ming Yi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 最近，金红石型二氧化钌（RuO₂）由于被预期具有显著的交替磁性自旋劈裂而重新引起关注。然而，越来越多的实验证据表明，在体相和厚膜形式中，RuO₂ 不显示任何形式的磁有序。尽管如此，在超薄极限下，RuO₂ 的自旋结构仍然很大程度上未被探索，而在这一极限中，由衬底施加的外延应变可能相当显著。在这里，我们使用自旋分辨角分辨光电子能谱，并辅以从头算计算，揭示了 2 纳米厚外延 RuO₂ 异质结构的电子结构。我们观测到一种非常规自旋织构，其特征是镜面对称偶性和镜面对称奇性的动量依赖分量共存。全面的对称性分析排除了这种自旋织构的非磁性起源。这些发现表明，在超薄极限下，外延应变可能使一种新兴的非相对论自旋结构成为可能，标志着其行为明显偏离弛豫态或体相 RuO₂。我们的工作为探索氧化物异质结构中的对称性破缺机制和自旋织构开辟了此前未被探索的视角。

articles.title: Structural, optical, and electrical properties of Cu-doped NiO films synthesized by spray pyrolysis for potential gas sensing applications
articles.title_zh: 喷雾热解法制备的 Cu 掺杂 NiO 薄膜的结构、光学与电学性质及其潜在气体传感应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.24197v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Cu-doped NiO thin films were deposited on ITO substrates via spray pyrolysis at 450 degC for 1.5 minutes. XRD confirmed a cubic NiO structure, with Cu incorporation reducing crystallite size, increasing interplanar spacing, and expanding the lattice parameter, indicating successful substitution of Cu ions. Optical analysis showed a slight bandgap reduction from 3.70 to 3.65 eV, while PL revealed lower emission intensity, suggesting enhanced defect states and suppressed carrier recombination. Raman spectroscopy exhibited redshifts in LO, 2TO, and 2LO modes and the disappearance of the TO mode, confirming lattice distortion from Cu doping. Gas sensing tests under ambient and LPG conditions demonstrated significantly improved sensitivity and voltage-dependent response for doped films. These results establish that Cu incorporation enhances charge transport and gas interaction mechanisms, making Cu-doped NiO films highly promising for efficient and reliable gas sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过喷雾热解法在 ITO 衬底上制备 Cu 掺杂 NiO 薄膜，并系统表征其结构、光学、电学和气敏性能。Cu 掺杂导致晶格畸变、带隙略微减小、缺陷态增强和载流子复合受抑。气体传感测试显示掺杂薄膜对液化石油气具有显著提升的灵敏度和电压依赖响应，表明其适用于高效可靠气体传感器。
authors: Eka Nurfani, Grace Grace, Mahardika Yoga Darmawan, Resti Marlina, Jumaeda Jatmika, Asnan Rinovian, Aditya Rianjanu
articles.abstract_zh_full: Cu 掺杂 NiO 薄膜通过喷雾热解法在 450 摄氏度下沉积于 ITO 衬底上，沉积时间为 1.5 分钟。XRD 证实了立方 NiO 结构，其中 Cu 的引入减小了晶粒尺寸，增大了晶面间距，并扩展了晶格参数，表明 Cu 离子成功实现了取代。光学分析显示带隙从 3.70 eV 略微降低至 3.65 eV，而 PL 显示发射强度降低，表明缺陷态增强并且载流子复合受到抑制。拉曼光谱显示 LO、2TO 和 2LO 模式发生红移，并且 TO 模式消失，证实 Cu 掺杂引起了晶格畸变。在环境条件和液化石油气条件下进行的气体传感测试表明，掺杂薄膜的灵敏度和电压依赖响应显著提高。这些结果表明，Cu 的引入增强了电荷传输和气体相互作用机制，使 Cu 掺杂 NiO 薄膜在高效可靠气体传感器方面具有很大前景。

articles.title: Observation of electromagnons in a monolayer multiferroic
articles.title_zh: 单层多铁材料中电磁振子的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.08253v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Van der Waals multiferroics have emerged as a promising platform to explore novel magnetoelectric phenomena. Recently, it has been shown that monolayer NiI₂ hosts robust type-II multiferroicity down to the two-dimensional limit, a giant dynamical magnetoelectric coupling at terahertz frequencies, and an electrically switchable spin polarization. These developments present the possibility of engineering ultrafast, low-energy-consumption, and electrically-tunable spintronic devices based on the collective excitations of the multiferroic order, electromagnons. However, the direct visualization of these bosonic modes in real space and within the monolayer limit remains elusive. Here, we report the atomic-scale observation of electromagnons in monolayer NiI₂ using low-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy. By tracking the thermal evolution of the multiferroic phase, we establish the energy scale and resolve coherent in-gap excitations of the symmetry-broken multiferroic state. Comparison with first-principles and spin-model calculations reveals that the low-energy modes originate from electromagnon excitations. Spatially resolved inelastic tunneling spectroscopy maps show a stripe-like modulation of the local spectral function at electromagnon energies, matching theoretical predictions. These results provide direct evidence of the internal structure of electromagnons and establish a methodology to probe these modes at the atomic scale, opening avenues for electrically tunable spintronics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究使用低温扫描隧道显微镜，在单层 NiI₂ 中实现了电磁振子的原子尺度观测。通过跟踪多铁相的热演化并结合第一性原理和自旋模型计算，作者确认低能带隙内激发源于电磁振子。空间分辨非弹性隧穿谱图显示出与理论预测一致的条纹状局域谱函数调制，为原子尺度探测多铁集体激发提供了方法。
authors: Mohammad Amini, Tiago V. C. Antão, Liwei Jing, Ziying Wang, Antti Karjasilta, Robert Drost, Shawulienu Kezilebieke, Jose L. Lado, Adolfo O. Fumega, Peter Liljeroth
articles.abstract_zh_full: 范德瓦耳斯多铁材料已成为探索新型磁电现象的一个有前景平台。最近的研究表明，单层 NiI₂ 在二维极限下仍具有稳健的 II 型多铁性、太赫兹频率下的巨动态磁电耦合以及可电切换的自旋极化。这些进展带来了基于多铁有序的集体激发——电磁振子——来设计超快、低能耗且电可调自旋电子器件的可能性。然而，在实空间中以及单层极限下直接可视化这些玻色模式仍然难以实现。在这里，我们报道了使用低温扫描隧道显微镜在单层 NiI₂ 中对电磁振子的原子尺度观测。通过追踪多铁相的热演化，我们确定了能量尺度，并分辨出对称性破缺多铁态中的相干带隙内激发。与第一性原理和自旋模型计算的比较表明，低能模式起源于电磁振子激发。空间分辨非弹性隧穿谱图显示，在电磁振子能量处局域谱函数呈条纹状调制，这与理论预测相一致。这些结果提供了电磁振子内部结构的直接证据，并建立了一种在原子尺度探测这些模式的方法，为电可调自旋电子学开辟了途径。
articles.focus_summary: 本文在单层多铁材料 NiI2 中观测到 electromagnon，并结合第一性原理与自旋模型分析其低能激发来源。结果表明，二维极限下仍存在可直接探测的磁电耦合集体激发。
articles.focus_relation: 与我们在二维范德华磁体、多铁性、自旋-晶格耦合和磁电耦合方向非常相关。该工作对理解二维多铁体系中的集体激发及其电控特性具有直接参考价值。
articles.focus_suggestion: 可进一步关注其从第一性原理到自旋模型的映射方法，以及 electromagnon 的谱学特征。若结合我们的研究，可延伸到其他二维磁体、多铁异质结或电场调控自旋激发问题。

articles.title: Néel-Vector-Orientation Induced Direction-Robust Spin Filtering in Two-Dimensional Altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 二维交替磁体中由 Néel 矢量取向诱导的方向稳健自旋过滤
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.17522v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Whether an antiferromagnet can host direction-robust spin-polarized transport without a conventional spin-selective band gap remains a central challenge in antiferromagnetic spintronics. Here we establish a gapless, direction-robust spin-filtering mechanism in a compensated two-dimensional altermagnetic Weyl semimetal that requires neither a spin-selective band gap nor a large velocity contrast between spin projections. Using Janus monolayer Ta₂TeSeO as a realistic platform, we combine symmetry analysis with first-principles calculations, full-Brillouin-zone Wannier interpolation, and semiclassical transport. Rotating the Néel vector removes a unitary-mirror constraint and shifts one Weyl-cone pair away from its parent high-symmetry line. For an in-plane Néel vector, the residual C₂zmathcal T symmetry forbids the independent σ_y mass that would open a local gap, allowing the reconstructed cones to shift in momentum while remaining gapless. Breaking unitary C₂z simultaneously lifts the energy equivalence of the remaining mirror-pinned Weyl cones. The resulting coexistence of a metallic spin-projected manifold and a low-DOS Weyl-derived manifold produces a predominantly DOS-driven conductance imbalance. At charge neutrality and 20~K, the longitudinal conductivity polarization for mathbf nparallel x remains positive for every in-plane current direction and ranges from 76.4% to 82.0%. The degenerate in-plane magnetic anisotropy facilitates reversible switching between symmetry-related spin-filtering states using strain or weak anisotropic fields. This Néel-vector-driven symmetry mechanism provides a general route to direction-robust gapless spin filtering in compensated altermagnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出了一种在补偿二维交替磁性 Weyl 半金属中实现无能隙、方向稳健自旋过滤的机制，不依赖传统自旋选择性带隙或巨大速度差异。以 Janus 单层 Ta₂TeSeO 为平台，作者结合对称性分析、第一性原理、Wannier 插值和半经典输运，说明 Néel 矢量旋转可重构 Weyl 锥并产生电导不平衡。结果显示在特定 Néel 矢量取向下，自旋过滤在所有面内电流方向上保持正极化，为补偿交替磁体中的可切换自旋过滤提供了通用路径。
authors: Xin Chen, Jin Zou, Lipeng Song, Wei Sun, Yiwen Wu, Luyao Zhu, Xu Cheng, Duo Wang, Biplab Sanyal
articles.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁体能否在没有传统自旋选择性带隙的情况下承载方向稳健的自旋极化输运，仍然是反铁磁自旋电子学中的一个核心挑战。在这里，我们在一种补偿二维交替磁性 Weyl 半金属中建立了一种无能隙、方向稳健的自旋过滤机制，该机制既不需要自旋选择性带隙，也不需要自旋投影之间存在大的速度反差。以 Janus 单层 Ta₂TeSeO 作为现实平台，我们结合对称性分析、第一性原理计算、全布里渊区 Wannier 插值和半经典输运进行研究。旋转 Néel 矢量会去除一个酉镜面对称约束，并使一对 Weyl 锥偏离其母体高对称线。对于面内 Néel 矢量，残余的 C₂zT 对称性禁止会打开局域能隙的独立 σ_y 质量项，从而允许重构后的锥在动量空间中移动，同时保持无能隙。破缺酉 C₂z 同时会解除剩余镜面钉扎 Weyl 锥的能量等价性。由此产生的金属性自旋投影流形与低态密度 Weyl 衍生流形的共存，导致主要由态密度驱动的电导不平衡。在电荷中性点和 20 K 下，对于 n 平行 x 的情形，纵向电导率极化在每一个面内电流方向上均保持为正，并处于 76.4% 至 82.0% 的范围内。简并的面内磁各向异性有助于利用应变或弱各向异性场在对称相关的自旋过滤态之间实现可逆切换。这种由 Néel 矢量驱动的对称性机制，为补偿交替磁体中方向稳健的无能隙自旋过滤提供了一条通用路径。

articles.title: Hex9: A Quasi-Authalic, Quasi-Continuous Hexagonal DGGS on the Reference Ellipsoid
articles.title_zh: Hex9：参考椭球上的准等面积、准连续六边形离散全球网格系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00022v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discrete global grid systems are conventionally designed over a prior coordinate reference system and inherit its compromises. Hex9 inverts the direction of design: we ask what requirements a hierarchical grid must satisfy to be geometrically coherent -- intrinsic orientability, flat mode transport, vertex closure, refinement commutativity -- and show that these requirements essentially determine the grid. The admissible cell primitive is the triangle; the admissible seed is the octahedral triangulation of S²; admissible refinement is uniquely aperture 9, and uniquely up to chirality, with exactly one orientation of the hexagonal dual lattice per chirality -- fixed by a machine-verified exhaustive enumeration. The surviving structure is a shifted-aperture-9 hexagonal hierarchy in which every cell carries a unique address derived from the construction alone: truncated at level L, the address is a DGGS zonal identifier in the sense of OGC Topic 21; carried to the limit, a function recovers from it a point on the reference ellipsoid to arbitrary precision. The addressing is quasi-continuous -- position is recoverable everywhere except on a measure-zero set of seams -- rather than continuous in the strict ISO 19111 sense; the same object serves as both zonal identifier and position-recovery coordinate, with no prior coordinate reference system as input. A separable geometric realisation -- an analytical octahedral base projection composed with an optimal-transport-derived area-correcting warp -- places the grid on WGS84 with quasi-uniform cell areas: at level 5, 99% of the 708,588 cells lie within 0.005% of ideal area, with residual deviation confined to the six octahedral vertices required by the topology. The combinatorial grid is projection- and ellipsoid-independent; only the warp is specific to the reference body, and is recomputable for any ellipsoid, terrestrial or planetary.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出 Hex9，一种不以既有坐标参考系统为前提、由几何一致性要求推导出的层级六边形离散全球网格系统。作者证明其可接受单元、种子剖分和细化方式几乎被内在可定向性、平坦模式传输、顶点闭合与细化交换性等条件唯一确定。该系统在 WGS84 上实现准均匀面积分布，并具有准连续寻址和位置恢复能力，可推广到不同椭球体。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 离散全球网格系统通常是在一个预先存在的坐标参考系统之上设计的，并继承其折衷。Hex9 反转了设计方向：我们询问一个层级网格必须满足哪些要求才能在几何上相干——内在可定向性、平坦模式传输、顶点闭合、细化交换性——并表明这些要求基本上决定了该网格。可接受的单元基元是三角形；可接受的种子是 S² 的八面体三角剖分；可接受的细化唯一地是孔径 9，并且在手性意义下唯一，每种手性恰有一种六边形对偶格的取向——这一点由机器验证的穷尽枚举所固定。保留下来的结构是一个移位孔径 9 的六边形层级，其中每个单元都携带一个仅由构造本身导出的唯一地址：在层级 L 截断时，该地址是 OGC Topic 21 意义下的 DGGS 分区标识符；当推进到极限时，一个函数可从中以任意精度恢复参考椭球上的一个点。该寻址是准连续的——除测度为零的一组接缝外，处处可恢复位置——而不是严格 ISO 19111 意义下的连续；同一对象同时作为分区标识符和位置恢复坐标使用，且无需以预先存在的坐标参考系统作为输入。一个可分离的几何实现——由解析八面体基投影与一个由最优传输导出的面积校正形变复合而成——将网格放置在 WGS84 上，并具有准均匀单元面积：在第 5 层级，708,588 个单元中的 99% 位于理想面积 0.005% 的范围内，残余偏差局限于拓扑所要求的六个八面体顶点。组合网格独立于投影和椭球；只有形变与参考天体相关，并且可针对任何地球或行星椭球重新计算。

articles.title: Hybrid Quantum CNN for Cross-Sensor Spaceborne Volcanic Thermal Activity Recognition Worldwide
articles.title_zh: 用于全球跨传感器星载火山热活动识别的混合量子卷积神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.00069v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As Earth Observation (EO) enters the Big Data era, the exponential volume of daily satellite imagery poses significant computational and storage challenges for classical Deep Learning (DL) models. Moreover, current approaches often struggle to generalize across heterogeneous sensors and volcanic environments while requiring large labeled datasets and substantial computational resources. These limitations are particularly critical for emerging On-Board Processing (OBP) applications, where memory, computational power, and annotated data are inherently limited. This work proposes a Hybrid Quantum AlexNet architecture for cross-sensor recognition of volcanic thermal activity at the global scale.
