articles.abstract_zh: 量子可积性是相互作用量子自旋链精确理论的基石。本文证明，在一个广泛的标准设置下，Reshetikhin 条件不仅是必要条件，而且也是充分条件，从而把可积性的隐藏代数结构还原为哈密顿量层面的守恒律。由于该条件等价于总能流守恒，它还具有实验可检验性，并可直接用于寻找可积自旋链。
authors: Mizuki Sanatani, Naoto Shiraishi, Fuga Ishii
articles.abstract_zh_full: 量子可积性是相互作用量子自旋链精确理论的基石。然而，在其标准表述中，人们通常是从满足杨-巴克斯特方程的 R 矩阵出发，而不是从哈密顿量本身出发。因此，如何在哈密顿量层面直接刻画杨-巴克斯特可解性，以及它与局域守恒律的关系，一直不甚清楚。本文证明，在一个广泛的标准设置下，Reshetikhin 条件不仅是必要的，而且也是充分的，因此把可积性的隐藏代数结构还原为哈密顿量层面的守恒律。由于 Reshetikhin 条件等价于总能流守恒，这一哈密顿量层面的判据也具有实验可达性。该结果建立了一个量子版的李乌维尔-阿诺德定理，适用于各向同性自旋链，即杨-巴克斯特可解性等价于无限层级的局域守恒量。我们的结果还显著简化了可积自旋链的搜寻过程，因为它用一个直接作用于局域哈密顿量的判据取代了对 R 矩阵的搜索。

articles.title: Magnetic properties of a quasi-two-dimensional spin-1/2 antiferromagnet Y2CuGe4O12
articles.title_zh: 准二维自旋 1/2 反铁磁体 Y2CuGe4O12 的磁性性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29676v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Competing magnetic interactions and frustration-induced quantum fluctuations in spatially anisotropic low-dimensional magnets often give rise to exotic magnetic phenomena, including field-induced phases. Here, we present crystal structure, magnetic susceptibility, specific heat, and electron spin resonance (ESR) measurements on polycrystalline Y2CuGe4O12, supported by density functional theory (DFT) calculations. In this compound, the Cu²⁺ ions form a distorted triangular lattice with competing intraplanar ferromagnetic (J₁ approx 0.138 K and J₂ approx 0.01 K) and antiferromagnetic (J₃ approx -3.22 K) exchange interactions, together with a weaker interplanar antiferromagnetic coupling (J₄ approx -1.56 K). These interactions account for the small Curie--Weiss temperature, θm̊ CW=-1.8 K. Despite the dominant antiferromagnetic interactions, no signature of long-range magnetic ordering is observed down to 0.4 K. Instead, broad maxima in both the magnetic susceptibility and magnetic specific heat reveal the development of short-range spin correlations, further supported by the critical ESR linewidth broadening characteristic of low-dimensional frustrated magnets. Application of an external magnetic field progressively suppresses the broad maximum in the magnetic specific heat, reflecting competition between the Zeeman and exchange energy scales, and drives the system into a field-polarized state above the saturation field, μ₀Hₘ̊ ₛ=2.6 T. In this regime, the magnetic specific heat exhibits an exponential temperature dependence, consistent with gapped magnon excitations. These results establish Y₂CuGe4O12 as a rare distorted triangular-lattice magnet in which further-neighbor exchange interactions dominate the magnetic behavior, providing a promising platform for exploring frustration-driven quantum phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们结合晶体结构、磁化率、比热和电子自旋共振测量，并辅以密度泛函理论计算，研究了多晶 Y2CuGe4O12 的磁性。该化合物中的 Cu2+ 离子形成畸变三角晶格，平面内存在竞争性的铁磁与反铁磁交换作用，平面间还有较弱的反铁磁耦合。尽管以反铁磁相互作用为主，0.4 K 以下并未观察到长程磁有序，而是出现短程自旋关联和典型的低维受挫磁体特征。
authors: J. Khatua, Changhyun Koo, Suyoung Kim, Eundeok Mun, Yugo Oshima, V. K. Sahu, Heung-Sik Kim, B. Koteswararao, Kwang-Yong Choi, P. Khuntia
articles.abstract_zh_full: 空间各向异性低维磁体中的竞争磁相互作用和由受挫引发的量子涨落，常常导致奇异的磁现象，包括磁场诱导相。本文结合晶体结构、磁化率、比热和电子自旋共振（ESR）测量，并辅以密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，对多晶 Y2CuGe4O12 进行了研究。在该化合物中，Cu2+ 离子形成一个畸变三角晶格，平面内存在竞争性的铁磁交换（J1 约为 0.138 K，J2 约为 0.01 K）和反铁磁交换（J3 约为 -3.22 K），同时还存在较弱的平面间反铁磁耦合（J4 约为 -1.56 K）。这些相互作用解释了较小的 Curie-Weiss 温度，θCW = -1.8 K。尽管反铁磁相互作用占主导，在降至 0.4 K 之前并未观察到长程磁有序的迹象。相反，磁化率和磁比热中的宽峰揭示了短程自旋关联的形成，而临界 ESR 线宽展宽进一步支持了低维受挫磁体的特征。外加磁场会逐步抑制磁比热中的宽峰，这反映了塞曼能与交换能标度之间的竞争，并在超过饱和场 μ0Hs = 2.6 T 后把体系驱动到场极化态。在这一状态下，磁比热表现出指数型温度依赖，与具有能隙的磁振子激发相一致。这些结果表明，Y2CuGe4O12 是一种罕见的畸变三角晶格磁体，其中远邻交换相互作用主导磁行为，为探索受挫驱动的量子现象提供了一个有前景的平台。

articles.title: Gaussian-augmented bosonic matrix-product states: theory and applications
articles.title_zh: 高斯增强的玻色矩阵乘积态：理论与应用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28753v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose and analyze the structure of a family of bosonic quantum many-body states that have the following features: (i) they include all pure Gaussian states and finite-dimensional matrix-product states as subclasses; (ii) their expectation values can be efficiently computed, allowing them to be used, among other things, for variational calculations; (iii) they admit exact parent Hamiltonians expressed as simple functions of the bosonic creation and annihilation operators.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们提出并分析了一类玻色量子多体态的结构，它同时包含纯高斯态和有限维矩阵乘积态作为子类。此类态的期望值可以高效计算，因而适用于变分计算等任务，并且它们还具有可写成玻色产生湮灭算符简单函数的精确母哈密顿量。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出并分析了一类玻色量子多体态的结构，其具有如下特征：第一，它们将所有纯高斯态和有限维矩阵乘积态都包含为子类；第二，它们的期望值可以高效计算，因此可用于变分计算等任务；第三，它们存在精确的母哈密顿量，而且这些母哈密顿量可以表示为玻色产生与湮灭算符的简单函数。

articles.title: Representations from Pretrained Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials as Coarse Coordinates for Material Generation and Evaluation
articles.title_zh: 将预训练机器学习原子间势的表示作为材料生成与评估的粗粒化坐标
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28776v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative machine learning is increasingly used for inorganic crystal structure generation. Most models and the corresponding evaluation approaches rely on simple forms of crystal structure representation. In this paper, we showcase the power of atom-averaged features from pretrained Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs), such as MACE, for such tasks. We first introduce a distance measure that assesses the output of material generative models by capturing both quality and novelty in a single distribution-based evaluation framework. In particular, we introduce the Coarse-Fine Transport Distance (CFTD) using two different featurizers, where the quality component is based on coarse MACE features. We showcase CFTD's versatility in capturing crystal-structure quality while also detecting memorization, and compare it with the recently introduced continuous SUN metrics. We further show that coarse MACE features can be used as guidance for a material generative model.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们展示了来自预训练机器学习原子间势的按原子平均特征在无机晶体结构生成中的潜力。基于此，我们提出一种距离度量，将生成模型输出的质量与新颖性统一到一个基于分布的评估框架中，并进一步证明粗粒化的 MACE 特征还可用于引导材料生成模型。该方法可有效表征晶体结构质量并识别记忆化现象。
authors: Paul Hagemann, Katharina Ueltzen, Simon Müller, Janine George, Philipp Benner
articles.abstract_zh_full: 生成式机器学习正日益用于无机晶体结构生成。大多数模型及其对应的评估方法都依赖于简单形式的晶体结构表示。本文展示了来自预训练机器学习原子间势（MLIPs），例如 MACE 的按原子平均特征，在此类任务中的强大能力。我们首先引入一种距离度量，它通过一个基于分布的评估框架，将材料生成模型的输出质量和新颖性同时纳入考量。特别地，我们利用两种不同的特征提取器提出了粗细传输距离（Coarse-Fine Transport Distance, CFTD），其中质量部分基于粗粒化的 MACE 特征。我们展示了 CFTD 在刻画晶体结构质量方面的多样性，同时还能检测记忆化现象，并将其与最近提出的连续 SUN 指标进行比较。我们还表明，粗粒化的 MACE 特征可以作为材料生成模型的引导信息。

articles.title: Transcorrelated Random-Phase Approximation
articles.title_zh: 转相关随机相位近似
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28845v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We extend the random-phase approximation (RPA) to the non-Hermitian transcorrelated (TC) Hamiltonian, which explicitly includes three-body interactions generated by a Jastrow correlation factor. We consider both the direct RPA (dRPA) and RPA with exchange (RPAx). We apply the resulting TC-dRPA and TC-RPAx methods to calculate ground-state correlation energies and vertical excitation energies for atoms (ȩHe and ȩNe) and small molecules (ȩH2O, ȩNH3, ȩCH4, and ȩH2CO). For ground-state correlation energies, the TC treatment substantially improves accuracy and accelerates basis set convergence, reducing errors by nearly an order of magnitude relative to conventional RPA calculations. By contrast, it yields only marginal improvements in vertical excitation energies. We attribute this limited effect to the ground-state optimization of the Jastrow factor, which does not adequately capture the distinct electronic character of excited states. These results establish TC-RPA as an accurate and computationally efficient approach to ground-state energetics, while highlighting the need for state-specific Jastrow optimization to achieve reliable descriptions of excited states.
articles.abstract_zh: 我们将随机相位近似扩展到非厄米的转相关哈密顿量，该哈密顿量通过 Jastrow 相关因子显式包含了三体相互作用。我们将所得方法应用于原子和小分子的基态相关能与垂直激发能计算，发现其对基态相关能的精度有显著提升，并加快了基组收敛，但对激发能的改进有限。结果表明，TC-RPA 是一种高效而准确的基态能量方法，而激发态描述则需要态相关的 Jastrow 优化。
authors: Abdallah Ammar, Enzo Monino, Anthony Scemama, Emmanuel Giner, Pierre-François Loos
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们将随机相位近似（RPA）扩展到非厄米的转相关（TC）哈密顿量上，该哈密顿量通过 Jastrow 相关因子显式包含了三体相互作用。我们考虑了直接 RPA（dRPA）以及带交换的 RPA（RPAx）。我们将所得的 TC-dRPA 和 TC-RPAx 方法应用于原子（He 和 Ne）以及小分子（H2O、NH3、CH4 和 H2CO）的基态相关能和垂直激发能计算。对于基态相关能，TC 处理显著提高了精度，并加速了基组收敛，使误差相较于常规 RPA 计算减少了近一个数量级。相比之下，它对垂直激发能的改进仅为有限。这一有限效果可归因于 Jastrow 因子是在基态优化的，无法充分捕捉激发态不同的电子特性。这些结果确立了 TC-RPA 作为一种准确且计算高效的基态能量方法，同时也指出，要可靠描述激发态，需要进行态相关的 Jastrow 优化。

articles.title: Parent Hamiltonian and intrinsic phase transition in non-Hermitian photonic systems
articles.title_zh: 非厄米光子系统中的母哈密顿量与内禀相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28964v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Non-Hermitian systems host phenomena absent in Hermitian physics, but realizing Hamiltonians with intrinsic non-Hermitian properties remains challenging. The theoretical method of non-Hermitian parent Hamiltonian (NH-PH) enables the construction of a non-Hermitian system from a pair of matrix product states (MPSs) with tailored properties. Here, we report the first experimental generation of NH-PHs. This generation starts from MPSs that represent asymmetric Affleck--Kennedy--Lieb--Tasaki (AKLT) states. The construction is validated with single photons via imaginary-time evolution of the generated NH-PH to obtain its left and right ground states. We then characterize the properties of the system by measuring four different order parameters that probe non-reciprocal correlations, chiral imbalance, and conventional antiferromagnetic correlations. Furthermore, extending the framework to a larger system with a different model, we observe an intrinsic non-Hermitian phase transition, manifested by abrupt jumps of an order parameter when the designated zero-energy modes cease to be the globally lowest-energy states. Our work provides the first experimental realization and characterization of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians with controllable and customizable properties, opening new avenues for exploring intrinsic non-Hermitian phenomena across diverse physical platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 非厄米系统能够展现厄米物理中不存在的现象，但构造具有内禀非厄米性质的哈密顿量仍然困难。本文首次实验生成了非厄米母哈密顿量，并以非对称 AKLT 态对应的矩阵乘积态为起点，通过单光子的虚时间演化验证了其左、右基态。进一步测量四个序参量后，作者观察到一个内禀非厄米相变，表现为当指定的零能模不再是全局最低能态时，序参量出现突跃。
authors: Yuntao Xiao, Yuchen Guo, Xiaojian Huang, Huixia Gao, Dengke Qu, Lei Xiao, Kunkun Wang, Shuo Yang, Peng Xue
articles.abstract_zh_full: 非厄米系统具有厄米物理中所没有的现象，但实现具有内禀非厄米性质的哈密顿量仍然具有挑战。非厄米母哈密顿量（NH-PH）的理论方法使得可以从一对具有特定性质的矩阵乘积态（MPS）构造出一个非厄米系统。本文报道了首个非厄米母哈密顿量的实验生成。该生成从表示非对称 Affleck-Kennedy-Lieb-Tasaki（AKLT）态的 MPS 出发。通过对生成出的 NH-PH 进行单光子虚时间演化，得到其左基态和右基态，从而验证了该构造。随后，我们通过测量四个不同的序参量来表征系统性质，这些序参量用于探测非互易关联、手性不平衡以及常规反铁磁关联。此外，我们将该框架推广到一个具有不同模型、更大尺度的系统，并观察到一种内禀非厄米相变，其表现为当指定的零能模不再是全局最低能态时，某个序参量发生突跃。我们的工作提供了首个具有可控且可定制性质的非厄米哈密顿量的实验实现与表征，为在多种物理平台上探索内禀非厄米现象开辟了新途径。

articles.title: Revisiting Stress Analysis in a Three-Dimensional Elastic Hollow Sphere under Uniaxial Compression via the Inverse Laplace Transform Expressions within an Elastodynamic Framework
articles.title_zh: 采用弹性动力学框架下的拉普拉斯逆变换表达式重新审视三维弹性空心球在单轴压缩下的应力分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29286v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The stress analysis of a three-dimensional elastic hollow sphere subjected to uniaxial compression is revisited, employing an elastodynamic framework. Through the application of the Laplace transform, the scalar and vector potentials of displacement are expanded, facilitating a detailed exploration of the system's mechanical behavior. The static solutions for displacement and stress distributions are derived in the long-time limit, which reveal key insights into the response of the elastic hollow sphere. Notably, on the inner surface, certain quantities exhibit a peak at the point where the angle between the compressive force and the point on the surface becomes perpendicular, indicating localized stress concentration. These findings provide a robust analytical approach for understanding and predicting the behavior of elastic hollow spheres under uniaxial loading, with implications for material science and structural engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文在弹性动力学框架下重新研究了三维弹性空心球在单轴压缩下的应力分布。通过拉普拉斯变换，位移的标量势和矢量势被展开，并在长时间极限下导出了静态位移与应力解。结果显示，内表面在受压方向与表面点连线垂直处会出现局部应力集中峰值。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文在弹性动力学框架下，重新研究了三维弹性空心球在单轴压缩下的应力分析。通过应用拉普拉斯变换，位移的标量势和矢量势被展开，从而对系统的力学行为进行了细致考察。在长时间极限下，推导出了位移和应力分布的静态解，这些解揭示了弹性空心球响应的关键特征。尤其是在内表面上，某些量在压缩力方向与表面上一点连线相互垂直的位置出现峰值，表明该处存在局部应力集中。这些发现为理解和预测单轴载荷作用下弹性空心球的行为提供了一种稳健的解析方法，并对材料科学和结构工程具有启示意义。

articles.title: Charging and Discharging a Hubbard-Holstein Quantum Battery: Specific Mechanisms and General Insights
articles.title_zh: 哈伯德–霍尔斯坦量子电池的充放电：具体机制与一般启示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29339v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A Hubbard-Holstein dimer functions as a correlation-driven quantum battery, with ergotropy robustly stored, under some conditions, even in the presence of dissipation. We find that, although optimal work extraction can in principle recover all the stored energy, it requires unrealistically fine-tuned couplings. By contrast, a physically realizable protocol based on spectral matching between the battery and the load achieves substantial, albeit suboptimal, energy extraction. Our results identify a mechanism for quantum energy storage, provide a realistic route to work extraction that is amenable to machine-learning-based theoretical exploration, and suggest that quantum batteries may not be universally deployable: the microscopic mechanism responsible for storing energy can constrain the classes of systems able to efficiently extract it.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，哈伯德–霍尔斯坦二聚体可作为由关联效应驱动的量子电池，并在一定条件下即使存在耗散也能稳健储存可提取功。作者发现，理论上的最优取功虽可回收全部储能，但需要不现实的精细调控耦合；相比之下，基于电池与负载谱匹配的可实现方案能提取相当可观但非最优的能量。研究揭示了量子储能机制及其对可高效取能系统类别的限制。
authors: Emil Östberg, Arvid Steen, Najmeh Abiri, Irene D'Amico, Claudio Verdozzi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 哈伯德–霍尔斯坦二聚体可作为一种由关联效应驱动的量子电池，在某些条件下，即使存在耗散，也能稳健地储存遍历功。我们发现，尽管理论上的最优功提取原则上可以回收全部储存能量，但它需要不现实的精细调谐耦合。相比之下，一种基于电池与负载之间谱匹配的物理可实现方案能够实现相当可观、尽管并非最优的能量提取。我们的结果识别出一种量子能量存储机制，提供了一条现实的功提取路径，该路径适合基于机器学习的理论探索，并提示量子电池可能并非普遍适用：负责储存能量的微观机制可能会限制能够高效提取该能量的系统类别。

articles.title: Revisiting the Equation-of-Motion Method: A Universal Framework for Correlated Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 重新审视运动方程方法：关联量子系统的通用框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29396v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A general implementation of the equation-of-motion (EOM) formalism for correlated many-body states is presented and applied to the description of collective excitations in atomic nuclei. While EOM approaches are traditionally formulated on top of independent-particle reference states, the present work extends the method to correlated reference states generated by modern many-body solvers. This formulation enables a consistent treatment of ground-state correlations and excited-state dynamics within a unified framework. Particular emphasis is placed on collective nuclear excitations employing chiral nuclear Hamiltonians in an ab initio context. The approach is motivated by the renewed interest in EOM techniques across several fields, including quantum chemistry and quantum computing, where they provide efficient and systematically improvable descriptions of excitation spectra. The present results demonstrate that the EOM framework offers a flexible and powerful tool for the microscopic description of nuclear spectroscopy beyond the traditional mean-field paradigm.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出了面向关联多体态的运动方程形式主义的一般实现，并将其用于描述原子核中的集体激发。该方法将传统上建立在独立粒子参考态之上的 EOM 扩展到由现代多体求解器生成的关联参考态，从而在统一框架内处理基态关联与激发态动力学。结果表明，EOM 框架可作为超越传统平均场范式的核谱学微观描述工具。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种针对关联多体态的运动方程（EOM）形式主义的一般实现，并将其应用于原子核中集体激发的描述。虽然 EOM 方法传统上是在独立粒子参考态之上建立的，但本工作将该方法扩展到由现代多体求解器生成的关联参考态。这一表述能够在统一框架内一致地处理基态关联和激发态动力学。本文特别强调在从头算背景下采用手征核哈密顿量研究集体核激发。该方法的动机来自多个领域对 EOM 技术重新产生的兴趣，包括量子化学和量子计算，在这些领域中，EOM 技术为激发谱提供了高效且可系统改进的描述。本文结果表明，EOM 框架为超越传统平均场范式的核谱学微观描述提供了一种灵活而强大的工具。

articles.title: Thermal and structural properties of iron at high pressure by molecular dynamics
articles.title_zh: 分子动力学研究高压下铁的热学与结构性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:1702.04909v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the basic thermal, mechanical and structural properties of body centred cubic iron (α-Fe) at several temperatures and positive loading by means of Molecular Dynamics simulations in conjunction with the embedded-atom method potential and its modified counterpart one. Computations of its thermal properties like average energy and density of atoms, transport sound velocities at finite temperatures and pressures are detailed studied as well. Moreover, there are suggestions to obtain hexagonal close- packed structure (ǎrepsilon-phase) of this metal under positive loading. To demonstrate that, one can increase sufficiently the pressure of simulated system at several temperature's ranges; these structural changes depend only on potential type used. The ensuring structures are studied via the pair radial distribution functions (PRDF) and precise common- neighbour analysis method (CNA) as well.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用分子动力学结合嵌入原子势及其修正形式，研究体心立方铁在不同温度和正载荷下的热学、力学与结构性质。作者详细计算了平均能量、原子密度以及有限温压下的声速等性质，并探讨了在增压条件下形成六方密堆积 ε 相的可能性。结构变化通过成对径向分布函数和共同近邻分析进行表征，且结果依赖于所采用的势函数类型。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们借助分子动力学模拟，并结合嵌入原子法势及其修正对应势，研究了体心立方铁（α-Fe）在若干温度和正载荷下的基本热学、力学和结构性质。本文还详细研究了其热学性质的计算，例如平均能量和原子密度，以及有限温度和压力下的输运声速。此外，还提出了在正载荷下获得该金属六方密堆积结构（ε 相）的建议。为展示这一点，可以在若干温度范围内充分提高模拟体系的压力；这些结构变化仅取决于所使用的势类型。所得到的结构还通过成对径向分布函数（PRDF）以及精确的共同近邻分析方法（CNA）进行了研究。

articles.title: Voltage characteristics of hydrodynamic Dirac electron nozzles with supersonic flow
articles.title_zh: 具有超声速流动的流体力学狄拉克电子喷嘴的电压特性
articles.abstract: arXiv:1905.01247v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In clean Dirac electron systems such as graphene, electron-electron interactions can dominate over other relaxation mechanisms such as phonon or impurity scattering. In this limit, collective electron dynamics can be described by hydrodynamic equations. The prerequisites for electron hydrodynamics have already been fulfilled in experiments, and signatures of hydrodynamic flow have been identified in transport measurements. Here, we derive the pressure-driven hydrodynamic flow profile across a de Laval nozzle profile for Dirac electrons in the subsonic and supersonic regimes. Based on this, we resolve the local voltage characteristics, which provide clear signatures of supersonic hydrodynamic flow. In particular, we identify two distinct features in the experimentally measurable potential profile: a pronounced asymmetry of the local voltage profile on opposite sides of the nozzle, and a sharp differential resistance signature induced by an electron shock wave on the exit side of the nozzle.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究了石墨烯等洁净狄拉克电子系统中由压力驱动的电子流体通过德拉瓦尔喷嘴时的亚声速和超声速流动轮廓。基于所得流场，作者解析了局域电压特性，并指出其可为超声速流体力学流动提供清晰实验信号。关键特征包括喷嘴两侧局域电压剖面的显著不对称性，以及喷嘴出口侧电子激波导致的尖锐微分电阻信号。
authors: Kristof Moors, Oleksiy Kashuba, Thomas L. Schmidt
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在诸如石墨烯这样的洁净狄拉克电子系统中，电子—电子相互作用可以主导声子或杂质散射等其他弛豫机制。在这一极限下，集体电子动力学可以用流体力学方程来描述。电子流体力学的先决条件已经在实验中得到满足，并且流体力学流动的特征已在输运测量中被识别出来。在这里，我们推导了狄拉克电子在亚声速和超声速区域中穿过德拉瓦尔喷嘴轮廓时由压力驱动的流体力学流动剖面。在此基础上，我们解析了局域电压特性，这些特性为超声速流体力学流动提供了清晰信号。特别地，我们识别出实验可测势剖面中的两个不同特征：喷嘴相对两侧局域电压剖面的显著不对称性，以及由喷嘴出口侧电子激波诱导的尖锐微分电阻信号。

articles.title: State-dependent recruitment of adhesion molecules enables perfect stabilization in cell-adhesion models
articles.title_zh: 状态依赖的黏附分子募集使细胞黏附模型中的完美稳定化成为可能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.11510v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Cells adapt their adhesion to mechanical load, but physical conditions under which this prevents rupture remain unclear. Inspired by focal adhesions, we study models in which force-sensitive conformational states within an adhesion cluster are coupled to the recruitment of additional molecules. We show that sufficiently strong coupling creates a distinct regime under load in which clusters grow in proportion to the applied force while the average load per bond remains below the level that destabilizes the cluster. The clusters can therefore withstand arbitrarily large stationary forces in principle. We term this behavior ``perfect stabilization''. At still stronger coupling, the same feedback causes unbounded growth already at equilibrium. For the minimal model, we derive state diagrams that characterize adhesion stability under stationary and dynamic loading. More broadly, using generic molecular-state networks, we derive conditions under which perfect stabilization and related growth instabilities arise in nonequilibrium adhesion systems with state-dependent recruitment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究受焦点黏附启发，考察了黏附簇内力敏构象状态与额外分子募集耦合的模型。作者发现，足够强的耦合可使簇在载荷下按外力比例增长，同时单个键的平均载荷保持在失稳阈值以下，从而原则上承受任意大的稳态力，这一行为被称为“完美稳定化”。研究还推导了静态和动态加载下的稳定性状态图，并给出更一般的非平衡黏附网络中相关失稳条件。
authors: Anton F. Burnet, Julia Müllner, Benedikt Sabass
articles.abstract_zh_full: 细胞会使其黏附适应机械载荷，但这种适应在何种物理条件下能够防止断裂仍不清楚。受焦点黏附启发，我们研究了一类模型，其中黏附簇内部的力敏构象状态与额外分子的募集相耦合。我们表明，足够强的耦合会在载荷下产生一个独特区域，在该区域中，簇的增长与所施加的力成正比，而每个键的平均载荷仍低于使簇失稳的水平。因此，原则上这些簇能够承受任意大的稳态力。我们将这种行为称为“完美稳定化”。在更强的耦合下，同一反馈会导致即使在平衡态下也出现无界增长。对于最小模型，我们推导了表征静态和动态加载下黏附稳定性的状态图。更广泛地，利用通用分子状态网络，我们推导了在具有状态依赖募集的非平衡黏附系统中出现完美稳定化及相关增长不稳定性的条件。

articles.title: Observation of angular momentum transfer among crystal lattice modes
articles.title_zh: 晶格模式之间角动量转移的观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2503.11626v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Transfer of energy and linear momentum between lattice vibrations via anharmonic coupling is an important concept in solid-state physics. However, it remains difficult to directly observe how angular momentum is exchanged and conserved among lattice modes, even though these processes are thought to play an important role in achieving magnetization equilibrium and in spin relaxation effects like the Einstein-de Haas effect. Here, we demonstrate and coherently control angular momentum transfer between two lattice modes using the inverse process of anharmonic decay. The observed rotational phonon-phonon Umklapp scattering enforces the conservation of quantized crystal angular momentum, as dictated by the crystal's discrete rotational symmetry. We thereby experimentally confirm the fundamental analogy between linear and angular momentum conservation in solids. Moreover, we establish axial nonlinear phononics towards ultrafast control of material properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作实验展示并相干控制了两个晶格振动模式之间的角动量转移，利用的是非谐衰变的逆过程。观测到的旋转声子–声子 Umklapp 散射体现了由晶体离散旋转对称性决定的量子化晶体角动量守恒。研究实验证实了固体中线动量守恒与角动量守恒之间的基本类比，并为超快调控材料性质的轴向非线性声子学奠定基础。
authors: Olga Minakova, Carolina Paiva, Maximilian Frenzel, Michael S. Spencer, Joanna M. Urban, Christoph Ringkamp, Martin Wolf, Gregor Mussler, Dominik M. Juraschek, Sebastian F. Maehrlein
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过非谐耦合在晶格振动之间转移能量和线动量是固体物理中的一个重要概念。然而，尽管这些过程被认为在实现磁化平衡以及爱因斯坦–德哈斯效应等自旋弛豫效应中起重要作用，但直接观察角动量如何在晶格模式之间交换和守恒仍然很困难。在这里，我们利用非谐衰变的逆过程，展示并相干控制了两个晶格模式之间的角动量转移。所观测到的旋转声子–声子 Umklapp 散射强制满足量子化晶体角动量守恒，正如晶体的离散旋转对称性所规定的那样。由此，我们在实验上确认了固体中线动量守恒与角动量守恒之间的基本类比。此外，我们建立了轴向非线性声子学，以实现对材料性质的超快控制。

articles.title: A Machine Learning Closure for Polymer Integral Equation Theory
articles.title_zh: 聚合物积分方程理论的机器学习闭合关系
articles.abstract: arXiv:2509.11030v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Polymer reference interaction site model (PRISM) theory, a descendant of Ornstein-Zernike liquid state theory, is a powerful tool to predict the structure and thermodynamics of equilibrium polymer systems, but its accuracy and applicability can be limited in some important cases. Typically, these shortcomings are traced to the analytical closure relationships used to solve the integral equations. Here, we propose a machine learning (ML)-based closure relation trained on a dataset of coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations of homopolymer melts and solutions. PRISM theory with the ML closure outperforms traditional atomic closures (e.g., Percus-Yevick) in predicting the structure of typical coarse-grained model systems. We also use the ML closure to accurately model the results of small-angle neutron scattering experiments. This ML-enhanced PRISM theory can therefore enable rapid soft materials discovery and design efforts.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的 PRISM 理论闭合关系，训练数据来自均聚物熔体与溶液的粗粒化分子动力学模拟。与传统原子闭合关系相比，机器学习闭合在预测典型粗粒化模型体系结构方面表现更优，并可准确模拟小角中子散射实验结果。该方法有望加速软材料发现与设计。
authors: Zhihao Feng, Christian T. Randolph, Tyler B. Martin, Thomas E. Gartner III
articles.abstract_zh_full: 聚合物参考相互作用位点模型（PRISM）理论源自 Ornstein-Zernike 液态理论，是预测平衡聚合物体系结构和热力学的强大工具，但在一些重要情况下，其准确性和适用性可能受到限制。通常，这些不足被归因于用于求解积分方程的解析闭合关系。在这里，我们提出一种基于机器学习（ML）的闭合关系，该关系在均聚物熔体和溶液的粗粒化分子动力学模拟数据集上训练得到。采用 ML 闭合的 PRISM 理论在预测典型粗粒化模型体系结构方面优于传统原子闭合关系（例如 Percus-Yevick 闭合）。我们还使用 ML 闭合准确模拟了小角中子散射实验结果。因此，这种 ML 增强的 PRISM 理论能够促进快速的软材料发现和设计工作。

articles.title: Strongly dipolar molecular Bose-Einstein condensates: From few- to many-body physics
articles.title_zh: 强偶极分子玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体：从少体到多体物理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.14511v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Recent advances in molecular cooling have enabled the realization of strongly dipolar Bose--Einstein condensates (BECs) of molecules, and BECs of many different molecular species may become experimentally accessible in the near future. Here, we explore the unique properties of such BECs and the new insights they may offer into dipolar quantum fluids and many-body physics. We explore which parameter regimes can realistically be achieved using currently available experimental techniques, discuss how to implement these techniques, and outline which molecular species are particularly well suited to explore exotic new states of matter. We further determine how state-of-the-art beyond mean-field theories, originally developed for weakly dipolar magnetic gases, can be pushed to their limits and beyond, and what other long-standing questions in the field of dipolar physics may realistically come within reach using molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 随着分子冷却技术进步，强偶极分子玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体已可实现，更多分子物种的凝聚体也可能很快进入实验范围。本文探讨这类凝聚体的独特性质及其对偶极量子流体和多体物理的启示，评估现有技术可实现的参数区域与合适分子物种。作者还讨论了超越平均场理论在分子体系中的适用边界，以及偶极物理中的长期问题如何借助分子系统得到研究。
authors: Andreas Schindewolf, Jens Hertkorn, Ian Stevenson, Matteo Ciardi, Phillip Gross, Dajun Wang, Tijs Karman, Goulven Quemener, Sebastian Will, Thomas Pohl, Tim Langen
articles.abstract_zh_full: 分子冷却的最新进展使强偶极分子玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚体（BEC）的实现成为可能，并且许多不同分子物种的 BEC 可能在不久的将来变得实验可及。在这里，我们探索这类 BEC 的独特性质，以及它们可能为偶极量子流体和多体物理提供的新见解。我们研究利用目前可用的实验技术能够现实达到哪些参数区域，讨论如何实施这些技术，并概述哪些分子物种特别适合探索奇异的新物质状态。我们进一步确定最先进的超越平均场理论——这些理论最初是为弱偶极磁性气体发展起来的——如何被推至其极限乃至超越其极限，以及利用分子体系，偶极物理领域中哪些其他长期存在的问题可能现实地进入可研究范围。

articles.title: Gapped topological spin-orbital liquid on the honeycomb lattice
articles.title_zh: 蜂窝晶格上的有能隙拓扑自旋–轨道液体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.06549v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We perform large-scale density matrix renormalization group simulations of the SU(4) Heisenberg model on the honeycomb lattice to address the long-standing question of its ground state in an unbiased and quantitatively controlled manner. We find reliable numerical evidence that the ground state is a gapped spin-orbital liquid, presumably with a Z₄ topological order, characterized by a finite topological entanglement entropy close to łn(4), the absence of both SU(4) and lattice symmetry breaking, and a variationally optimized ground-state energy well below the previously proposed π-flux variational state. By exploiting full SU(4) symmetry and keeping up to 12,800 SU(4) multiplets, corresponding to more than one million U(1) states, we achieve unprecedented accuracy for two-dimensional SU(4) quantum magnets. Finite-size scaling of energies and entanglement entropies supports a robust gapped phase in the two-dimensional limit, while a gapless critical state on narrow cylinders is identified as a proximate remnant of a Dirac spin-orbital liquid. Our results find the SU(4) honeycomb Heisenberg model a realization of a gapped topological spin-orbital liquid and provide convincing numerical evidence for topological order in a highly symmetric two-dimensional quantum magnet.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用大规模密度矩阵重整化群模拟，以无偏且定量受控的方式研究蜂窝晶格 SU(4) 海森堡模型的基态问题。结果提供可靠数值证据表明其基态为有能隙自旋–轨道液体，可能具有 Z₄ 拓扑序，并表现出接近 ln(4) 的有限拓扑纠缠熵、无 SU(4) 与晶格对称性破缺，以及低于此前 π 通量变分态的能量。有限尺寸标度支持二维极限下的稳健有能隙相，同时窄圆柱上的无能隙临界态被解释为邻近 Dirac 自旋–轨道液体的残留。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们对蜂窝晶格上的 SU(4) 海森堡模型进行了大规模密度矩阵重整化群模拟，以无偏且定量受控的方式解决其基态这一长期问题。我们发现可靠的数值证据表明，基态是一种有能隙自旋–轨道液体，推测具有 Z₄ 拓扑序，其特征包括接近 ln(4) 的有限拓扑纠缠熵、SU(4) 和晶格对称性破缺的缺失，以及经过变分优化的基态能量显著低于先前提出的 π 通量变分态。通过利用完整 SU(4) 对称性并保留多达 12,800 个 SU(4) 多重态（对应于超过一百万个 U(1) 态），我们在二维 SU(4) 量子磁体方面实现了前所未有的精度。能量和纠缠熵的有限尺寸标度支持二维极限中存在稳健的有能隙相，而窄圆柱上的无能隙临界态被识别为邻近 Dirac 自旋–轨道液体的残余。我们的结果表明 SU(4) 蜂窝海森堡模型实现了一种有能隙拓扑自旋–轨道液体，并为高度对称二维量子磁体中的拓扑序提供了有说服力的数值证据。

articles.title: Universal Transport Properties of Continuous Quantum Gases
articles.title_zh: 连续量子气体的普适输运性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.22009v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The Drude weight characterizes ballistic transport in quantum many-body systems. Although analytical calculations of Drude weights have been extensively studied in integrable models, their direct connections to finite-temperature macroscopic state functions remain unestablished, especially for continuous multicomponent quantum gases. In the present work, we use generalized hydrodynamics and the thermodynamic Bethe ansätz to calculate exactly the Drude weights for one-dimensional continuous integrable systems, including the Lieb-Liniger and Bose-Fermi mixture models. We derive universal exact relations between Drude weight matrix components and key thermodynamic densities (particle density, enthalpy, entropy). Analytic expressions for Drude weight are obtained across different physical regimes, i.e. strong- and weak-coupling regimes in addition to universal scaling laws near the quantum phase transitions. To bridge theory and experiment, we simulate two experimental protocols, linear potential quench and bipartitioning quench, to enable reliable measurements of the Drude weights. Using these protocols, we calculate the charge and energy Drude weight for Lieb-Liniger gas and compare with recent measurements reported in [Science 391, 290 (2026)], showing excellent agreement with particle density and enthalpy, respectively, thus offering deeper physical insights into experimental observations. Our findings directly link ballistic transport properties to thermodynamics, providing rigorous theoretical benchmarks for future ultracold atomic gas experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用广义流体力学和热力学 Bethe Ansatz 精确计算了一维连续可积系统的 Drude 权重，包括 Lieb-Liniger 模型和玻色–费米混合模型。作者推导了 Drude 权重矩阵元与粒子密度、焓、熵等热力学密度之间的普适精确关系，并给出不同物理区域及量子相变附近的解析表达和标度律。通过模拟线性势淬火和双分区淬火实验方案，研究将弹道输运与热力学直接联系起来，并与近期实验测量符合良好。
authors: Zi-yang Liu, Xiangguo Yin, Yunbo Zhang, Shizhong Zhang, Xi-Wen Guan
articles.abstract_zh_full: Drude 权重表征量子多体系统中的弹道输运。尽管 Drude 权重的解析计算已在可积模型中得到广泛研究，但它们与有限温度宏观状态函数之间的直接联系尚未建立，尤其是对于连续多组分量子气体。在本工作中，我们使用广义流体力学和热力学 Bethe Ansatz，精确计算了一维连续可积系统的 Drude 权重，包括 Lieb-Liniger 模型和玻色–费米混合模型。我们推导了 Drude 权重矩阵分量与关键热力学密度（粒子密度、焓、熵）之间的普适精确关系。在不同物理区域中，即强耦合和弱耦合区域，以及量子相变附近的普适标度律中，我们得到了 Drude 权重的解析表达式。为连接理论与实验，我们模拟了两种实验方案，即线性势淬火和双分区淬火，以实现对 Drude 权重的可靠测量。利用这些方案，我们计算了 Lieb-Liniger 气体的电荷和能量 Drude 权重，并与 [Science 391, 290 (2026)] 中报道的近期测量结果进行了比较，显示其分别与粒子密度和焓高度一致，从而为实验观测提供了更深入的物理见解。我们的发现将弹道输运性质与热力学直接联系起来，为未来超冷原子气体实验提供了严格的理论基准。

articles.title: Electrostatically-induced topological phase transitions in polyacetylene molecules
articles.title_zh: 聚乙炔分子中静电诱导的拓扑相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.03473v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the electronic properties of a linear trans-polyacetylene (tPA) molecule capacitively coupled to an external gate voltage V_g of width d. We describe this system using the Takayama-Lin-Liu-Maki model, a continuum version of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, and analyze it within the Abelian bosonization formalism, which allows us to treat both electronic and lattice degrees of freedom and to incorporate the effects of repulsive Coulomb interactions among electrons. The global ground state describing simultaneously the electronic charge-density field as well as the lattice dimerization field of a tPA molecule is shown to consist of multikink solutions of a modified sine-Gordon equation for the charge-density field, which is controlled by V_g, the width d, and the Luttinger parameter K encoding the strength of electron-electron interactions. We show that these solutions belong to distinct topological sectors labeled by an integer invariant q that simultaneously quantifies both the bound charge and the number of domain walls in the dimerization pattern induced at the gated region. Increasing V_g drives a sequence of topological phase transitions characterized by abrupt changes in q. We further examine the effect of repulsive Coulomb interactions on the resulting topological phase diagram, and, finally, we discuss the relevance of our findings for potential nanoelectronic devices based on gated tPA molecules.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了线性反式聚乙炔分子与外部门电压电容耦合时的电子性质。作者使用 Takayama-Lin-Liu-Maki 模型和阿贝尔玻色化处理电子、晶格及排斥库仑相互作用，发现全局基态由受门电压、门宽和 Luttinger 参数控制的修正 sine-Gordon 方程多 kink 解构成。不同解对应由整数 q 标记的拓扑扇区，升高门电压会驱动一系列以 q 突变为特征的拓扑相变。
authors: Tomás Suleiman, Aníbal Iucci, Alejandro Martín Lobos
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了线性反式聚乙炔（tPA）分子与宽度为 d 的外部门电压 V_g 电容耦合时的电子性质。我们使用 Takayama-Lin-Liu-Maki 模型来描述该系统，该模型是 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型的连续版本，并在阿贝尔玻色化形式主义下对其进行分析，这使我们能够同时处理电子和晶格自由度，并纳入电子之间排斥库仑相互作用的影响。我们表明，同时描述 tPA 分子的电子电荷密度场和晶格二聚化场的全局基态由电荷密度场的修正 sine-Gordon 方程的多 kink 解组成，该解受 V_g、宽度 d 以及编码电子—电子相互作用强度的 Luttinger 参数 K 控制。我们表明，这些解属于由整数不变量 q 标记的不同拓扑扇区，该不变量同时量化了束缚电荷以及在门控区域诱导的二聚化图案中畴壁的数量。增大 V_g 会驱动一系列拓扑相变，其特征是 q 的突变。我们进一步考察了排斥库仑相互作用对所得拓扑相图的影响，最后讨论了我们的发现对于基于门控 tPA 分子的潜在纳米电子器件的意义。

articles.title: Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid theory for one-dimensional attractive Fermi gases
articles.title_zh: 一维吸引费米气体的 Tomonaga–Luttinger 液体理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13958v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The one-dimensional (1D) Yang-Gaudin model-an integrable δ-function interacting Fermi gas, serves as a paradigm in quantum many-body physics, encompassing phenomena from spin-charge separation to the Luther-Emery liquid. However, a consistent description of the Luther-Emery liquid and the bosonization of Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO)-like pairing states in the 1D attractive Fermi gas remains elusive. In this work, we develop a universal Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid (TLL) theory to describe the FFLO state across both weak and strong coupling regimes. We rigorously derive the low-energy effective Hamiltonian using bosonization, revealing the emergence of a two-component Luttinger liquid: one exhibiting spin-charge coupling in the weakly attractive regime, and another featuring charge-charge separation in the strongly attractive regime. For the weakly attractive regime, we further derive the renormalization-group equations for the sine-Gordon term in the spin sector and show that this term undergoes a relevant-irrelevant phase transition driven by the magnetic field. For the strongly attractive regime, we analyze the dynamical correlation functions of the FFLO pairing state based on the derived effective Hamiltonian. Finally, we propose an experimental scheme using ultracold atoms to verify the Luther-Emery liquid behavior and the subtle phenomena of spin-charge coupling and charge-charge separation.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文发展了一种普适 Tomonaga–Luttinger 液体理论，用于描述一维吸引费米气体中 FFLO 态在弱耦合和强耦合区域的行为。作者通过玻色化严格推导低能有效哈密顿量，揭示弱吸引区的自旋–电荷耦合双组分 Luttinger 液体，以及强吸引区的电荷–电荷分离。研究还分析了自旋扇区 sine-Gordon 项的重整化群行为、强吸引区 FFLO 配对态的动力学关联函数，并提出了超冷原子实验验证方案。
authors: Hai-Ying Cui, Yu-Hao Yeh, Randall G. Hulet, Han Pu, Thierry Giamarchi, Xi-Wen Guan
articles.abstract_zh_full: 一维（1D）Yang-Gaudin 模型——一种具有 δ 函数相互作用的可积费米气体——是量子多体物理中的一个范式，涵盖了从自旋–电荷分离到 Luther-Emery 液体的各种现象。然而，对一维吸引费米气体中 Luther-Emery 液体以及 Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov（FFLO）样配对态的玻色化的一致描述仍然难以获得。在本工作中，我们发展了一种普适的 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体（TLL）理论，用于描述弱耦合和强耦合区域中的 FFLO 态。我们使用玻色化严格推导了低能有效哈密顿量，揭示了双组分 Luttinger 液体的出现：一种在弱吸引区域表现出自旋–电荷耦合，另一种在强吸引区域具有电荷–电荷分离。对于弱吸引区域，我们进一步推导了自旋扇区中 sine-Gordon 项的重整化群方程，并表明该项会经历由磁场驱动的相关—无关相变。对于强吸引区域，我们基于所推导的有效哈密顿量分析了 FFLO 配对态的动力学关联函数。最后，我们提出了一种利用超冷原子验证 Luther-Emery 液体行为以及自旋–电荷耦合和电荷–电荷分离等精细现象的实验方案。

articles.title: Josephson effects in an interaction-asymmetric junction across the BCS-BEC crossover
articles.title_zh: BCS-BEC 跨越中相互作用非对称结的约瑟夫森效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.25577v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We theoretically study the Josephson effect in ultracold Fermi gases, where the two sides of the Josephson junction are independently tuned to different regions of the Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS)-Bose-Einstein condensation (BEC) crossover. Using the nonequilibrium Green's function approach combined with the tunnel Hamiltonian formalism and a mean-field approach, we evaluate the DC and AC Josephson currents throughout the entire crossover region. We calculate the DC Josephson current as a function of interaction strength by tuning both sides of the junction synchronously from the BCS to the BEC regimes, and give the asymptotic expression of the current in the deep BCS and BEC limits. We also study the AC Josephson junction through the interaction-asymmetric junction by fixing the interaction in one reservoir and tuning that of the other one. A peak of the tunneling current is found when one side is fixed in the BCS limit and the other side is tuned into the BEC regime, which corresponds to the interaction-biased Riedel peak. Our results indicate the competition between contributions of increasing pair spectral weight and decreasing chemical potential to Josephson tunneling throughout the BCS-BEC crossover, and demonstrate the realization of the Riedel peak in strong-coupling quantum gases.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文从理论上研究了超冷费米气体中的约瑟夫森效应，其中结的两侧可独立调节至 BCS-BEC 跨越的不同区域。作者结合非平衡格林函数、隧穿哈密顿量形式和平均场方法，计算了整个跨越区的直流与交流约瑟夫森电流。结果揭示了配对谱权重增强与化学势降低对隧穿贡献的竞争，并指出强耦合量子气体中可实现相互作用偏置的 Riedel 峰。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们从理论上研究了超冷费米气体中的约瑟夫森效应，其中约瑟夫森结的两侧被独立调节到 Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer（BCS）-玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）跨越的不同区域。利用非平衡格林函数方法，并结合隧穿哈密顿量形式和平均场方法，我们评估了整个跨越区域中的直流和交流约瑟夫森电流。我们通过将结两侧从 BCS 区域同步调节到 BEC 区域，计算了直流约瑟夫森电流随相互作用强度的变化，并给出了深 BCS 和 BEC 极限下电流的渐近表达式。我们还研究了通过相互作用非对称结形成的交流约瑟夫森结，即固定一个粒子库中的相互作用并调节另一个粒子库中的相互作用。当一侧固定在 BCS 极限而另一侧被调节到 BEC 区域时，发现隧穿电流出现一个峰值，这对应于相互作用偏置的 Riedel 峰。我们的结果表明，在整个 BCS-BEC 跨越中，约瑟夫森隧穿受到不断增加的配对谱权重贡献与不断降低的化学势贡献之间的竞争影响，并展示了强耦合量子气体中 Riedel 峰的实现。

articles.title: A unified equation for saturation magnetization and spin transport in weakly disordered ferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 弱无序铁磁体中饱和磁化强度与自旋输运的统一方程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.02483v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: In this report, a unified description of the loss of saturation magnetization in the presence of a distribution of finite-size effects is provided for weakly disordered spin-1/2 ferromagnets. This description allows us to derive a unified form of the Bloch equation for these systems. We further extend this approach to obtain a unified expression for spin transport in such systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报告为弱无序自旋 1/2 铁磁体中由有限尺寸效应分布导致的饱和磁化强度损失提供了统一描述。基于这一描述，作者推导了适用于此类系统的统一 Bloch 方程形式，并进一步扩展到自旋输运表达式。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 在本报告中，针对弱无序自旋 1/2 铁磁体，在存在有限尺寸效应分布的情况下，提供了饱和磁化强度损失的统一描述。这一描述使我们能够为这些系统推导出 Bloch 方程的统一形式。我们进一步扩展这一方法，以获得此类系统中自旋输运的统一表达式。

articles.title: Thermalization Dynamics in the Two-Dimensional Hubbard Model with Neural-Network Quantum States
articles.title_zh: 利用神经网络量子态研究二维 Hubbard 模型中的热化动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.05293v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Thermalization in strongly correlated fermionic systems remains a central open problem in quantum many-body physics. In this work, we investigate the real-time dynamics and the approach to thermalization in the two-dimensional Hubbard model, a paradigmatic framework for correlated electrons, relevant to high-temperature superconductivity and ultracold quantum simulation. Focusing on the half-filled square lattice, we monitor the time evolution of the double occupancy following a quench in the on-site interaction U, and assess whether its long-time value is captured by a canonical thermal ensemble. We employ time-dependent variational Monte Carlo methods combined with transformer-based Neural-Network Quantum States to accurately describe the nonequilibrium dynamics of fermions, especially for the behavior at long times, thereby accessing regimes that were previously inaccessible to numerical simulations. Our results reveal two dynamical behaviors: for weak to intermediate interactions, the double occupancy rapidly approaches the thermal prediction, consistent with ergodic evolution; beyond a critical interaction UC, the dynamics remains distinct from the thermal expectation on the timescales investigated, revealing signatures of a prethermal plateau delaying fast relaxation. These results establish numerical simulation as a powerful tool to probe nonequilibrium quantum phenomena in correlated fermionic matter.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究强关联费米系统的实时动力学及其热化过程，聚焦半填充平方晶格二维 Hubbard 模型在相互作用 U 猝变后的双占据数演化。作者采用含 transformer 架构神经网络量子态的含时变分蒙特卡罗方法，探索以往数值模拟难以达到的长时间非平衡动力学。结果显示，弱到中等相互作用下系统迅速接近热系综预言，而超过临界相互作用后出现偏离热化的预热化平台迹象。
authors: Alessandro Sinibaldi, Luciano Loris Viteritti, Riccardo Rende, Fakher F. Assaad, Giuseppe Carleo
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强关联费米系统中的热化仍然是量子多体物理中的一个核心开放问题。在这项工作中，我们研究二维 Hubbard 模型中的实时动力学以及趋向热化的过程；该模型是关联电子的典范框架，并与高温超导和超冷量子模拟相关。我们聚焦半填充平方晶格，监测在位相互作用 U 猝变后双占据数的时间演化，并评估其长时间取值是否可由正则热系综捕捉。我们采用含时变分蒙特卡罗方法，并结合基于 transformer 的神经网络量子态，以准确描述费米子的非平衡动力学，特别是长时间行为，从而进入此前数值模拟无法达到的区域。我们的结果揭示了两种动力学行为：对于弱到中等相互作用，双占据数快速接近热化预言，这与遍历演化一致；超过临界相互作用 UC 后，在所研究的时间尺度内动力学仍不同于热期望，显示出延迟快速弛豫的预热化平台迹象。这些结果确立了数值模拟作为探测关联费米物质中非平衡量子现象的有力工具。

articles.title: First-order phase transitions in the three-dimensional Blume-Capel ferromagnet
articles.title_zh: 三维 Blume-Capel 铁磁体中的一级相变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.17691v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate first-order phase transitions in the three-dimensional Blume-Capel ferromagnet on the simple cubic lattice by combining multicanonical simulations with two-parameter Wang-Landau sampling. The generalized-ensemble approach enables a detailed characterization of the coexistence region over a broad range of temperatures and crystal-field couplings, extending from the vicinity of the tricritical point deep into the first-order regime. We analyze the finite-size scaling behavior of thermodynamic observables, with particular emphasis on the energy probability density function, free-energy barriers, and interfacial properties. The evolution of the double-peaked energy distributions reveals a gradual crossover from weak to strong first-order behavior as the temperature is lowered. From the scaling of the free-energy barrier we determine the interface tension along the coexistence line and characterize its approach to the tricritical region through its vanishing behavior. In parallel, a field-mixing analysis based on the joint density of states obtained from two-parameter Wang-Landau simulations is employed to locate first-order transition points and probe tricritical behavior. While this approach has been highly successful in two-dimensional realizations of the Blume-Capel model, we find that in three dimensions its practical implementation becomes increasingly sensitive in the vicinity of the tricritical region, where the shallow structure of the relevant scaling variable distribution limits the ability to resolve coexistence conditions for the system sizes currently accessible. These results delineate the range of applicability of the method in three dimensions and provide a consistent picture of the first-order regime of the model.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合多正则模拟与双参数 Wang-Landau 采样，研究简单立方晶格上三维 Blume-Capel 铁磁体的一级相变。广义系综方法使作者能够在从三临界点附近到深一级相变区的宽范围内刻画共存区域，并分析能量概率密度、自由能势垒和界面性质的有限尺寸标度。研究还评估了场混合分析在三维中的适用范围，指出其在三临界附近受有限系统尺寸和浅分布结构限制而变得敏感。
authors: D. Mataragkas, A. Vasilopoulos, Z. D. Vatansever, Y. Kim, D. -H. Kim, N. G Fytas
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过结合多正则模拟与双参数 Wang-Landau 采样，研究简单立方晶格上三维 Blume-Capel 铁磁体中的一级相变。广义系综方法能够在宽广的温度和晶场耦合范围内对共存区域进行详细表征，该范围从三临界点附近一直延伸到深入一级相变区域。我们分析热力学观测量的有限尺寸标度行为，特别强调能量概率密度函数、自由能势垒和界面性质。双峰能量分布的演化揭示，随着温度降低，系统从弱一级行为逐渐交叉到强一级行为。通过自由能势垒的标度，我们确定了共存线上的界面张力，并通过其消失行为刻画其接近三临界区域的方式。与此同时，基于由双参数 Wang-Landau 模拟获得的联合态密度，采用场混合分析来定位一级相变点并探测三临界行为。尽管这种方法在二维 Blume-Capel 模型实现中非常成功，但我们发现，在三维中，其实际实施在三临界区域附近变得越来越敏感；在那里，相关标度变量分布的浅结构限制了在当前可及系统尺寸下解析共存条件的能力。这些结果划定了该方法在三维中的适用范围，并为该模型的一级相变区域提供了一幅一致图像。

articles.title: Intrinsic Magnetic Excitations and Heavy-Fermion Formation in the Frustrated Mn Pyrochlore System YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓXₓ (X = In and Al) Revealed by Nuclear Magnetic Resonance and Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance Measurements
articles.title_zh: 核磁共振与核四极共振揭示受挫 Mn 烧绿石体系 YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓXₓ（X = In 和 Al）中的本征磁激发与重费米子形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25242v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We performed nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) and nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR) measurements to investigate the microscopic electronic states of the d-electron heavy-fermion candidates mathrmYMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓInₓ and mathrmYMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓAlₓ. In these compounds, magnetic fluctuations of the Mn pyrochlore lattice are expected to play an important role in heavy-fermion formation; however, excess Mn atoms complicate the interpretation of the physical properties. Our spectral analysis reveals that In substitution exhibits much higher site selectivity and introduces significantly less disorder in local structure than Al substitution. The temperature dependence of the nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate divided by temperature 1/T₁T measured by ⁵⁵Mn-NQR shows a clear enhancement at low temperatures, indicating the development of low-energy excitations associated with heavy-fermion formation. However, its absolute magnitude is approximately 20 times smaller than that in the related compound YMn₂, which hosts stronger antiferromagnetic correlations, indicating that the magnetic interactions are substantially weakened by the enlarged Mn-Mn distance. These results demonstrate that the heavy-fermion state in this system arises from the Mn pyrochlore network and is more closely associated with frustration-induced magnetic excitations with low energy than with conventional antiferromagnetic quantum-critical fluctuations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文通过 NMR 和 NQR 测量研究 d 电子重费米子候选材料 YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓInₓ 与 YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓAlₓ 的微观电子态。谱分析表明 In 取代比 Al 取代具有更高位点选择性并引入更少局域结构无序。55Mn-NQR 的 1/T1T 在低温增强，说明与重费米子形成相关的低能激发发展，但其幅度远小于 YMn₂，表明该体系重费米子态更接近由受挫诱导的低能磁激发而非传统反铁磁量子临界涨落驱动。
authors: Shunsaku Kitagawa, Kenji Ishida, Yoshihiko Okamoto, Zenji Hiroi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们进行了核磁共振（NMR）和核四极共振（NQR）测量，以研究 d 电子重费米子候选材料 YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓInₓ 和 YMn₂₊δZn₂₀₋ₓAlₓ 的微观电子态。在这些化合物中，Mn 烧绿石晶格的磁涨落预计在重费米子形成中发挥重要作用；然而，过量 Mn 原子使物理性质的解释变得复杂。我们的谱分析表明，与 Al 取代相比，In 取代表现出高得多的位点选择性，并在局域结构中引入显著更少的无序。由 55Mn-NQR 测得的核自旋-晶格弛豫率除以温度 1/T₁T 的温度依赖性在低温下显示出明显增强，表明与重费米子形成相关的低能激发正在发展。然而，其绝对大小约比相关化合物 YMn₂ 小 20 倍，后者具有更强的反铁磁关联，这表明由于 Mn-Mn 距离增大，磁相互作用被显著削弱。这些结果表明，该体系中的重费米子态起源于 Mn 烧绿石网络，并且与受挫诱导的低能磁激发的关联比与传统反铁磁量子临界涨落的关联更为密切。

articles.title: Coexisting Regular and Chaotic Dynamics in the Dysprosium Feshbach Spectrum
articles.title_zh: 镝 Feshbach 谱中规则动力学与混沌动力学的共存
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28233v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Strongly dipolar gases, such as dysprosium, erbium and thulium, exhibit dense Feshbach spectra whose level statistics have been associated with quantum chaos arising from couplings among many molecular channels. Here, we combine a precise calibration of the Feshbach spectrum of ¹⁶²Dy with spectroscopic measurements of the differential magnetic moments of bound states associated with more than 80 resonances between 0 and 30 G. These magnetic moments provide an eigenstate-sensitive probe of the molecular states underlying the resonance spectrum. We find that the level statistics are not uniform: resonances associated with states near the center of the magnetic-moment distribution display enhanced level repulsion, whereas those near the lower edge remain close to Poisson statistics. Our results reveal hidden structure within the chaotic dysprosium Feshbach spectrum and identify molecular-state composition as a key ingredient in the emergence of quantum chaos in strongly dipolar scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究强偶极气体 162Dy 在 0 至 30 G 范围内的 Feshbach 谱，并通过 80 多个共振相关束缚态的差分磁矩谱测量探测其分子态。结果显示能级统计并不均一：磁矩分布中心附近态对应的共振表现出增强的能级排斥，而低边缘附近的共振仍接近 Poisson 统计。该研究揭示了混沌镝 Feshbach 谱中的隐藏结构，并指出分子态组成是强偶极散射中量子混沌涌现的关键因素。
authors: Julie Veschambre, Alexandre Journeaux, Maxime Lecomte, Alice Belmon, Ethan Uzan, Inès de Verdelhan, Patricia Christina Marques Castilho, Jakub Zakrzewski, Jean Dalibard, Raphael Lopes
articles.abstract_zh_full: 强偶极气体，如镝、铒和铥，表现出稠密的 Feshbach 谱，其能级统计已被认为与由许多分子通道之间的耦合所产生的量子混沌相关。在这里，我们将 162Dy 的 Feshbach 谱的精确校准与 0 到 30 G 之间 80 多个共振相关束缚态的差分磁矩谱测量相结合。这些磁矩为共振谱背后的分子态提供了一种对本征态敏感的探针。我们发现，能级统计并不均一：与磁矩分布中心附近的态相关的共振显示出增强的能级排斥，而靠近低边缘的共振仍接近 Poisson 统计。我们的结果揭示了混沌镝 Feshbach 谱中的隐藏结构，并将分子态组成确定为强偶极散射中量子混沌涌现的关键要素。

articles.title: Digital Quantum Simulation of Flat-Band and All-Bands-Flat Dynamics for Tunable Quantum Transport
articles.title_zh: 用于可调量子输运的平带与全平带动力学数字量子模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2508.08734v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Flat-band systems offer a uniquely powerful tool for quantum control in dynamics due to their characteristic feature of having a dispersionless energy band. Simulating such highly sensitive systems on current digital quantum computers is a challenging task, due to the intrinsic limitations of the noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices. Here we present high-fidelity digital quantum simulations of flat-band (FB) and all-bands-flat (ABF) lattices, using an advanced tensor network based variational optimization approach to compress the circuit depth. With the compressed quantum circuits, we first explore single-particle dynamics and observe two distinct behaviours: strong localization in ABF lattices and delocalization in FB lattices. By integrating FB and ABF lattices into a one-dimensional hybrid structure, we achieve controllable quantum transport, where the ABF lattice acts as a quantum switch. Extending to two-particle dynamics, we show that transport remains controllable by tuning the hopping amplitude alone, even in the presence of interactions. These results establish flat-band engineered systems as a promising pathway for scalable control of quantum transport in emerging quantum technologies, with potential applications in qubit isolation, particle trapping, and state transfer.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用基于张量网络的变分优化方法压缩量子线路深度，在数字量子计算机上高保真模拟平带和平带全带晶格。单粒子动力学显示，全平带晶格中强局域化，而平带晶格中出现离域化；将二者构成一维混合结构后，可实现由全平带晶格充当量子开关的可控量子输运。进一步的双粒子结果表明，即使存在相互作用，也可仅通过调节跃迁振幅控制输运。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 平带系统由于具有无色散能带这一特征，为动力学中的量子控制提供了一种独特而强大的工具。由于噪声中等规模量子（NISQ）设备的内在限制，在当前数字量子计算机上模拟这种高度敏感的系统是一项具有挑战性的任务。在这里，我们提出了平带（FB）和全带平坦（ABF）晶格的高保真数字量子模拟，使用一种先进的基于张量网络的变分优化方法来压缩线路深度。借助压缩后的量子线路，我们首先探索单粒子动力学，并观察到两种不同的行为：ABF 晶格中的强局域化和 FB 晶格中的离域化。通过将 FB 和 ABF 晶格整合到一维混合结构中，我们实现了可控量子输运，其中 ABF 晶格充当量子开关。扩展到双粒子动力学，我们表明即使存在相互作用，也仍可仅通过调节跃迁振幅来控制输运。这些结果确立了平带工程系统作为新兴量子技术中可扩展控制量子输运的有前景途径，并可能应用于量子比特隔离、粒子俘获和态转移。

articles.title: Fisher Information, Training and Bias in Fourier Regression Models
articles.title_zh: Fourier 回归模型中的 Fisher 信息、训练与偏置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.06945v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Motivated by the growing interest in quantum machine learning, in particular quantum neural networks (QNNs), we study how recently introduced evaluation metrics based on the Fisher information matrix (FIM) are effective for predicting their training and prediction performance. We exploit the equivalence between a broad class of QNNs and Fourier models, and study the interplay between the empheffective dimension and the emphbias of a model towards a given task, investigating how these affect the model's training and performance. We show that for a model that is completely agnostic, or unbiased, towards the function to be learned, a higher effective dimension likely results in a better trainability and performance. On the other hand, for models that are biased towards the function to be learned a lower effective dimension is likely beneficial during training. To obtain these results, we derive an analytical expression of the FIM for Fourier models and identify the features controlling a model's effective dimension. This allows us to construct models with tunable effective dimension and bias, and to compare their training. We furthermore introduce a tensor network representation of the considered Fourier models, which could be a tool of independent interest for the analysis of QNN models. Overall, these findings provide an explicit example of the interplay between geometrical properties, model-task alignment and training, which are relevant for the broader machine learning community.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文受量子机器学习尤其是量子神经网络研究的启发，考察基于 Fisher 信息矩阵的评估指标能否预测训练和预测性能。作者利用一大类量子神经网络与 Fourier 模型的等价性，分析有效维数和模型对任务的偏置之间的相互作用。研究表明，无偏模型通常受益于更高有效维数，而与目标函数对齐的偏置模型则可能在较低有效维数下更易训练，并引入了相关 Fourier 模型的张量网络表示。
authors: Lorenzo Pastori, Veronika Eyring, Mierk Schwabe
articles.abstract_zh_full: 受量子机器学习，特别是量子神经网络（QNN）日益增长的兴趣所激励，我们研究了最近引入的基于 Fisher 信息矩阵（FIM）的评估指标在预测其训练和预测性能方面的有效性。我们利用一大类 QNN 与 Fourier 模型之间的等价性，研究模型的有效维数与其对于给定任务的偏置之间的相互作用，并考察这些因素如何影响模型的训练和性能。我们表明，对于一个对要学习的函数完全无知或无偏的模型，更高的有效维数很可能带来更好的可训练性和性能。另一方面，对于偏向于要学习函数的模型，较低的有效维数在训练过程中很可能是有益的。为获得这些结果，我们推导了 Fourier 模型的 FIM 的解析表达式，并识别出控制模型有效维数的特征。这使我们能够构造具有可调有效维数和偏置的模型，并比较它们的训练。我们还引入了所考虑 Fourier 模型的一种张量网络表示，这可能成为分析 QNN 模型的一个具有独立意义的工具。总体而言，这些发现提供了几何性质、模型-任务对齐和训练之间相互作用的一个明确例子，这对更广泛的机器学习共同体具有相关意义。

articles.title: Attention in Krylov Space: Transformer-Based Extrapolation of Lanczos Coefficients
articles.title_zh: Krylov 空间中的注意力：基于 Transformer 的 Lanczos 系数外推
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.07937v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The Universal Operator Growth Hypothesis formulates time evolution of operators through Lanczos coefficients. In practice, however, numerical instability and memory cost limit the number of coefficients that can be exactly computed. In response to these challenges, the standard approach relies on fitting early coefficients to asymptotic forms, but such procedures can miss subleading, history-dependent structures in the coefficients that subsequently affect reconstructed observables. In this work, we treat the Lanczos coefficients as a causal time sequence and introduce a transformer-based model to autoregressively predict future Lanczos coefficients from short prefixes. For classical and quantum chaotic systems, our model outperforms asymptotic fits in both coefficient extrapolation and physical observable reconstruction, and achieves an order-of-magnitude reduction in error. The model also accurately extrapolates coefficients in integrable regimes, where no universal asymptotic fit exists. Remarkably, our model transfers across system sizes: it can be trained on smaller systems and then be used to extrapolate coefficients on a larger system emphwithout retraining. By probing the learned attention patterns and performing targeted attention ablations, we identify portions of the coefficient history that are most influential for accurate forecasts. Our results demonstrate that modern sequence models can serve as practical surrogates for probing operator dynamics deep in Krylov space, where brute-force Lanczos iteration can be computationally prohibitive.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将 Lanczos 系数视为因果时间序列，并提出基于 transformer 的模型从短前缀自回归预测后续系数，以克服精确计算中的数值不稳定和内存成本限制。对于经典和量子混沌系统，该模型在系数外推和物理观测量重构上优于渐近拟合，误差降低一个数量级，并能处理缺乏通用渐近形式的可积区域。模型还可跨系统尺寸迁移，并通过注意力分析识别对预测最重要的系数历史片段。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 普适算符增长假说通过 Lanczos 系数来表述算符的时间演化。然而在实践中，数值不稳定性和内存成本限制了能够被精确计算的系数数量。为应对这些挑战，标准方法依赖于将早期系数拟合到渐近形式，但这种程序可能遗漏系数中次主导的、依赖历史的结构，而这些结构随后会影响重构的观测量。在这项工作中，我们将 Lanczos 系数视为因果时间序列，并引入一种基于 transformer 的模型，从短前缀自回归地预测未来的 Lanczos 系数。对于经典和量子混沌系统，我们的模型在系数外推和物理观测量重构方面均优于渐近拟合，并实现了误差降低一个数量级。该模型还能够在可积区域中准确外推系数，而在那里不存在普适的渐近拟合。值得注意的是，我们的模型可以跨系统尺寸迁移：它可以在较小系统上训练，然后无需重新训练即可用于在较大系统上外推系数。通过探查学习到的注意力模式并进行有针对性的注意力消融，我们识别出系数历史中对准确预测最有影响的部分。我们的结果表明，现代序列模型可以作为实用替代工具，用于探测 Krylov 空间深处的算符动力学，在那里蛮力 Lanczos 迭代在计算上可能过于昂贵。

articles.title: Spontaneous Emission, Work Potential and Relaxation-Limited Processes in Setting Limits on Solar Energy Conversion Efficiency
articles.title_zh: 自发辐射、做功能力与弛豫受限过程对太阳能转换效率极限的设定
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.14982v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Understanding the thermodynamics of radiation and the quantum-mechanical interactions between light and matter is important both for theoretical purposes and for technological advances, such as determining the limits of key processes like light-to-usable-energy conversion efficiencies. In this report, we discuss the physics of these two aspects, considering spontaneous emission as a pathway, and highlight the limitations of such descriptions in assessing energy-harvesting efficiency. In view of these limitations, we adopt a simplified approach to evaluate the exergy and work potential of radiation, providing a framework for assessing various aspects of light-to-usable-energy conversion efficiency. Our approach allows a theoretical estimate of the thermodynamic maximum limit for light-to-usable-energy conversion, which is approximately 76%. We validate these exergy and work potential estimates by modeling and accurately reproducing the Shockley-Queisser limit (~ 33.3%), which imposes a practical constraint on solar-to-usable-energy conversion efficiency. Beyond exergy considerations, our model incorporates processes such as spontaneous emission, nonradiative thermal losses, and photon upconversion, allowing us to evaluate their roles. The model further suggests that, under certain conditions, the maximum conversion efficiency can reach approximately 48%, for example with multijunction solar cells or via photon upconversion. These findings further suggest that the true thermodynamic limit for light-to-usable-energy conversion may be much higher (approximately 76%). However, accurately estimating this limit requires a more complete understanding of the thermodynamics of light, light-matter interactions, and the connection between them.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报告讨论辐射热力学以及光与物质量子相互作用在评估光能到可用能转换效率极限中的作用，并指出仅从自发辐射通道描述的局限。作者采用简化方法估算辐射的火用和做功能力，得到约 76% 的热力学最大转换极限，并通过再现约 33.3% 的 Shockley-Queisser 极限验证模型。模型还纳入自发辐射、非辐射热损失和光子上转换，提示多结电池或上转换条件下效率可达约 48%，但真正热力学极限仍需更完整理论。
articles.abstract_zh_full: 理解辐射热力学以及光与物质之间的量子力学相互作用，对于理论目的和技术进步都很重要，例如确定从光到可用能量转换效率等关键过程的极限。在本报告中，我们讨论这两个方面的物理，考虑自发辐射作为一种途径，并强调这类描述在评估能量收集效率时的局限性。鉴于这些局限性，我们采用一种简化方法来评估辐射的火用和做功能力，为评估光到可用能量转换效率的各个方面提供框架。我们的方法允许对光到可用能量转换的热力学最大极限作出理论估计，该极限约为 76%。我们通过建模并准确再现 Shockley-Queisser 极限（约 33.3%）来验证这些火用和做功能力估计，该极限对太阳能到可用能量转换效率施加了实际约束。除火用考虑之外，我们的模型还纳入自发辐射、非辐射热损失和光子上转换等过程，使我们能够评估它们的作用。该模型进一步表明，在某些条件下，最大转换效率可达到约 48%，例如使用多结太阳能电池或通过光子上转换。这些发现进一步提示，光到可用能量转换的真实热力学极限可能高得多（约 76%）。然而，准确估计这一极限需要对光的热力学、光-物质相互作用以及二者之间的联系有更完整的理解。

articles.title: Inverse generalised spin models of answers to questionnaires
articles.title_zh: 问卷答案的逆广义自旋模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29739v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Network psychometrics conceptualises psychological constructs as emergent properties of systems of interacting items. Energy-based probabilistic models have gained popularity as models of these interactions, but their psychometric application has so far been limited to binary responses, bilinear interactions, and approximated inference methods. To fill these gaps, we here infer and analyse three generalized-spin models of ordinal questionnaire data: the Ising, Blume-Capel (BC), and Blume-Emery-Griffiths (BEG) models. These are maximum-entropy models that accommodate ordinal responses on Likert-type scales with an arbitrary number of options, allowing for single-site anisotropy (BC, BEG) and bi-quadratic item interactions (BEG). We prove the concavity of the maximum likelihood estimation of their parameters, as well as the gauge invariance of the Ising and BC models. We introduce a stochastic gradient ascent algorithm for maximum likelihood inference, and apply this procedure to eleven psychometric and sociological questionnaire datasets. Evaluating the predictive ability of the inferred models reveals that the BEG model systematically outperforms Factor Analysis and the other spin models in capturing the distributions of factors and distances of subject answers to the mean, across all datasets. By leveraging a competitive interplay between the quadratic and bi-quadratic energy terms, the BEG model uniquely captures individual average-extremist response styles, alongside standard latent factor positioning. Moreover, only the spin models can account for the non-concavity and multi-modality of factor histograms in the most polarizing questionnaires. Finally, the analysis reveals other highly non-linear traits of ordinal data---such as the fat-tailed distribution of Mahalanobis distances to the mean---that escape satisfactory description by both factor and spin models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将网络心理测量中的问卷有序数据建模为广义自旋最大熵模型，推断并分析 Ising、Blume-Capel 和 Blume-Emery-Griffiths 模型。作者证明了相关极大似然估计的凹性及部分模型的规范不变性，并提出随机梯度上升算法应用于 11 个心理测量和社会学问卷数据集。结果表明 BEG 模型在捕捉因子分布和回答偏离均值的距离方面系统优于因子分析和其他自旋模型，同时能描述平均-极端回答风格与极化问卷中的多峰性。
authors: Arianna Armanetti, Luca Cecchetti, Paolo Sarti, Diego Garlaschelli, Miguel Ibáñez-Berganza
articles.abstract_zh_full: 网络心理测量学将心理构念概念化为相互作用项目系统的涌现性质。基于能量的概率模型作为这些相互作用的模型已受到欢迎，但迄今为止，它们在心理测量中的应用仍局限于二元回答、双线性相互作用和近似推断方法。为弥补这些不足，我们在这里推断并分析三种有序问卷数据的广义自旋模型：Ising、Blume-Capel（BC）和 Blume-Emery-Griffiths（BEG）模型。这些是最大熵模型，可容纳具有任意选项数量的 Likert 型量表上的有序回答，并允许单点各向异性（BC、BEG）和双二次项目相互作用（BEG）。我们证明了其参数极大似然估计的凹性，以及 Ising 和 BC 模型的规范不变性。我们引入一种用于极大似然推断的随机梯度上升算法，并将该程序应用于 11 个心理测量和社会学问卷数据集。对所推断模型的预测能力进行评估表明，在所有数据集中，BEG 模型在捕捉因子分布以及被试答案到均值的距离分布方面，系统地优于因子分析和其他自旋模型。通过利用二次能量项与双二次能量项之间的竞争性相互作用，BEG 模型独特地捕捉到个体的平均-极端回答风格，同时也捕捉到标准的潜在因子定位。此外，只有自旋模型能够解释最具极化性的问卷中因子直方图的非凹性和多峰性。最后，分析揭示了有序数据的其他高度非线性特征——例如到均值的 Mahalanobis 距离的厚尾分布——这些特征无论是因子模型还是自旋模型都无法令人满意地描述。

articles.title: The bulk spectral gap is semi-decidable: a convergent family of certified upper bounds
articles.title_zh: 体谱隙是半可判定的：一族收敛的认证上界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.03836v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Determining spectral gaps in the thermodynamic limit is a central challenge in quantum many-body physics. Existing rigorous methods are largely limited to special settings, while variational numerical approaches typically provide estimates rather than certified bounds. Here we introduce a complete family of certified upper bounds on the bulk spectral gap of quantum many-body systems. These upper bounds are obtained by solving a series of semidefinite programs and they become arbitrarily tight at the cost of more computational resources. This shows that the bulk spectral gap is semi-decidable, in contrast to undecidability results for alternative notions of spectral gap based on sequences of finite systems with prescribed boundary conditions. As a proof of principle, we apply our algorithm to the spin-frac12 kagome lattice Heisenberg antiferromagnet and obtain, to our knowledge, the first nontrivial certified upper bounds on its bulk spectral gap.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一族完整的量子多体系统体谱隙认证上界，可通过求解一系列半定规划获得，并随计算资源增加而任意收紧。该结果表明体谱隙是半可判定的，与基于具有指定边界条件的有限系统序列的其他谱隙概念的不可判定性结果形成对比。作为原理验证，作者将算法应用于自旋 1/2 kagome 晶格 Heisenberg 反铁磁体，并获得其体谱隙的非平凡认证上界。
authors: Xiangling Xu, Matthias Schötz, Jie Wang, Victor Magron, Igor Klep, Omar Fawzi, Marc-Olivier Renou
articles.abstract_zh_full: 确定热力学极限中的谱隙是量子多体物理中的一个核心挑战。现有严格方法大多局限于特殊设定，而变分数值方法通常提供的是估计而非认证界。在这里，我们引入一族完整的量子多体系统体谱隙认证上界。这些上界通过求解一系列半定规划获得，并且以更多计算资源为代价可以变得任意紧。这表明体谱隙是半可判定的，这与基于具有指定边界条件的有限系统序列的其他谱隙概念的不可判定性结果形成对比。作为原理验证，我们将算法应用于自旋 1/2 kagome 晶格 Heisenberg 反铁磁体，并据我们所知，获得了其体谱隙的首个非平凡认证上界。

articles.title: An agent-based model of the formation and evolution of common ground
articles.title_zh: 共同知识形成与演化的基于主体模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28915v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The existence of a communal common ground is vital for collective action and coordination in a population, but the micro-level cognitive and social processes that lead to the formation and evolution of common ground at the macro-level are undertheorised and have not been rigorously explored. In this work, we adopt a formal approach and develop an agent-based model that describes repeated grounding attempts between agents interacting on a network, with an explicit distinction between a sender agent and a receiver agent during an interaction involving sharing information. Several key novel features enable us to capture a range of different interaction contexts: we allow for the interaction to result in either acceptance or rejection, the receiver's response may be lost to the sender, and the sender can interpret this lack of response as either acceptance or rejection (or even something in between). A campaign of Monte Carlo simulations reveals how different interaction contexts, as well as the available information for sharing, result in different emergent phenomena, such as a global communal common ground, fragmentation into multiple clusters of differing common ground, and even the total loss of any shared common ground. This work highlights the potential for using mathematical models to study micro-macro links in cultural dynamics, including identifying ways to facilitate interactions to foster the emergence of a global communal common ground.
articles.abstract_zh: 共同体层面的共同知识对于群体中的集体行动与协调至关重要，但其由微观认知和社会过程形成并演化为宏观现象的机制仍缺乏充分理论化和严格探索。本文提出一个网络上主体之间重复“奠基”互动的基于主体模型，区分发送者与接收者，并纳入接受、拒绝、反馈丢失及其解释等情境。蒙特卡洛模拟显示，不同互动情境和可共享信息会导致全局共同知识、多个共同知识簇的碎片化，甚至共享共同知识完全丧失等涌现现象。
authors: Mengbin Ye, Wooseok Jung, Tony J. Mathew, Lorenzo Zino, Yoshihisa Kashima
articles.abstract_zh_full: 共同体共同知识的存在对于群体中的集体行动和协调至关重要，但导致宏观层面共同知识形成与演化的微观层面认知和社会过程仍缺乏充分理论化，也尚未得到严格探索。在本研究中，我们采用形式化方法，发展了一个基于主体的模型，用以描述在网络上互动的主体之间反复进行的奠基尝试，并在涉及信息共享的互动中明确区分发送者主体和接收者主体。若干关键的新特征使我们能够刻画一系列不同的互动情境：我们允许互动结果为接受或拒绝，接收者的回应可能无法传达到发送者，而发送者可以将这种无回应解释为接受或拒绝（甚至介于二者之间的某种情况）。一系列蒙特卡洛模拟揭示了不同互动情境以及可用于共享的信息如何导致不同的涌现现象，例如全局性的共同体共同知识、分裂为多个具有不同共同知识的簇，甚至任何共享共同知识的完全丧失。本研究凸显了使用数学模型研究文化动态中微观—宏观联系的潜力，包括识别促进互动以培育全局性共同体共同知识涌现的方法。

articles.title: Pulse Shaping Increases Efficiency in Pulsed Plasma Accelerators
articles.title_zh: 脉冲整形提高脉冲等离子体加速器效率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.28976v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The performance of a gas-fed pulsed electromagnetic thruster is governed by the ability to deposit electrical energy while propellant is available for acceleration. Current pulsed-power systems require tradeoffs between high-current discharges that produce high exhaust velocities and longer pulses that overlap the energy deposition with more of the gas injection. This limited control restricts the specific impulse and mass utilization of these thrusters. This work introduces programmable pulse shaping as a method to increase control over energy deposition and expand the accessible operating space. We use solid-state integrated power modules to vary the discharge delay, pulse width, peak current, and the shape of the current waveform as propellant is injected. Experiments varying pulse widths from 30 to 500 μs and peak currents from 3 kA to 16 kA show that short, high-current pulses produce higher exhaust velocities and greater impulse bits than longer, lower-current pulses at comparable discharge energy. The switches also enable multiple discharges of arbitrary positioning and duration during a single gas injection. This micro-burst operation is shown to increase specific impulse in air by 278% from 840 to 3177 s through improved propellant utilization. This same pulse shaping ability is found to increase thrust efficiency from 0.2% in single-shot operation to 3.3% in micro-burst operation while operating with air.
articles.abstract_zh: 气体供给式脉冲电磁推进器的性能取决于在推进剂可被加速期间沉积电能的能力，而传统脉冲功率系统在高电流短脉冲和较长能量沉积窗口之间存在权衡。本文提出可编程脉冲整形，通过固态集成功率模块调控放电延迟、脉宽、峰值电流和电流波形。实验表明，在相近放电能量下短高电流脉冲优于长低电流脉冲，多次微爆发放电显著提高了空气工质下的比冲和推力效率。
authors: Patrick W. Schools, Mammadbaghir Baghirzade, Ryan Heiser, Adrian Woodley, Laxminarayan L. Raja, Thomas C. Underwood
articles.abstract_zh_full: 气体供给式脉冲电磁推进器的性能受制于在推进剂可用于加速时沉积电能的能力。当前的脉冲功率系统需要在产生高排气速度的高电流放电与能使能量沉积同更多气体注入过程重叠的较长脉冲之间进行权衡。这种有限的控制能力限制了这些推进器的比冲和质量利用率。本工作提出可编程脉冲整形，作为一种增强能量沉积控制并扩展可达运行空间的方法。我们使用固态集成功率模块，在推进剂注入过程中改变放电延迟、脉冲宽度、峰值电流以及电流波形形状。将脉冲宽度从30到500 μs、峰值电流从3 kA到16 kA进行变化的实验表明，在可比的放电能量下，短的高电流脉冲比更长的低电流脉冲产生更高的排气速度和更大的冲量位。该开关还能够在单次气体注入期间实现任意位置和持续时间的多次放电。结果显示，这种微爆发运行通过改进推进剂利用率，使空气中的比冲从840 s提高到3177 s，增加了278%。同样的脉冲整形能力还被发现可在使用空气工质时，将推力效率从单次放电运行中的0.2%提高到微爆发运行中的3.3%。

articles.title: Strontium {}¹S₀!i̊ghtarrow!{}¹P₁ transition frequency measurements assisted by a photonic grating chip
articles.title_zh: 借助光子光栅芯片的锶 ¹S₀→¹P₁ 跃迁频率测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29056v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We measure the absolute frequency of the {}¹S₀!i̊ghtarrow!{}¹P₁ transition in strontium using two methods: fluorescence spectroscopy of a thermal atomic beam source from a compact low-power oven and velocity measurements of a slow atomic beam from a two-dimensional grating magneto-optical trap (2D gMOT). The measurements for both methods are performed in the same ultra-high vacuum chamber containing a diffraction grating chip which is placed below the strontium atoms that are being interrogated. The first method uses a probe laser beam incident on the grating chip such that the grating acts as an end mirror, with the first-order diffracted beam providing a retro-reflected probe beam. The counter-propagating laser beams traverse an atomic beam emitted from an oven, enabling spatially resolved fluorescence spectroscopy through CCD imaging and hyperfine-constrained multi-isotope fitting. The second method relies on a large profile cooling laser beam normally incident onto the grating chip which laser cools strontium atoms for a slow atomic beam source. The velocity of the atoms exiting the 2D gMOT is measured as a function of the laser detuning and intensity from which the resonance frequency can be estimated. The two methods are consistent within their quoted uncertainties. Using three datasets based on retro-beam spectroscopy measurements, and one dataset using slow atom beam velocity measurements, we determine the {}¹S₀!i̊ghtarrow!{}¹P₁ transition frequency to be 650.503,815(5)~THz. Our result provides a re-evaluation of this 461 nm transition demonstrated on a compact laser cooling apparatus based on a diffraction grating platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文采用两种方法测量锶原子 ¹S₀→¹P₁ 跃迁的绝对频率：紧凑低功耗炉产生的热原子束荧光光谱，以及二维光栅磁光阱慢原子束的速度测量。两种测量均在含衍射光栅芯片的同一超高真空腔内完成，结果在给定不确定度内一致。结合三组反射束光谱数据和一组慢原子束速度数据，作者确定该跃迁频率为650.503,815(5) THz。
authors: Jaewhan Lee, Hyun Gyung Lee, Won-Kyu Lee, Huidong Kim, Dohyeon Kwon, Sang-Bum Lee, Meungho Seo, Taeg Yong Kwon, Sangwon Seo, Hyun-Gue Hong, Seji Kang, Sang Eon Park, Young-Ho Park, Jongcheol Park, Yeeun Na, Il-Suk Kang, Sangsik Kim, Jae Hoon Lee
articles.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用两种方法测量锶中 ¹S₀→¹P₁ 跃迁的绝对频率：一种是来自紧凑低功耗炉的热原子束源的荧光光谱，另一种是来自二维光栅磁光阱（2D gMOT）的慢原子束速度测量。两种方法的测量都在同一个超高真空腔中进行，该腔包含一个放置在被探测锶原子下方的衍射光栅芯片。第一种方法使用入射到光栅芯片上的探测激光束，使光栅充当端镜，并由一级衍射光束提供反向反射的探测光束。反向传播的激光束穿过由炉发射出的原子束，从而通过CCD成像和受超精细结构约束的多同位素拟合实现空间分辨荧光光谱。第二种方法依赖于一个大光斑冷却激光束垂直入射到光栅芯片上，该激光束对锶原子进行激光冷却，以形成慢原子束源。测量从2D gMOT射出的原子的速度作为激光失谐和强度的函数，并由此估计共振频率。两种方法在其所给出的不确定度范围内一致。利用基于反向光束光谱测量的三组数据以及一组使用慢原子束速度测量的数据，我们确定 ¹S₀→¹P₁ 跃迁频率为650.503,815(5) THz。我们的结果对这一461 nm跃迁进行了重新评估，并在基于衍射光栅平台的紧凑激光冷却装置上加以展示。

articles.title: Learning transferable event representations for charmed baryon physics at BESIII
articles.title_zh: 面向BESIII粲重子物理的可迁移事件表征学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep learning has become an essential tool in high-energy physics, where the ability to learn transferable event representations can significantly improve model generalization across related physics processes. In this work, we present a Particle Transformer-based framework for learning such representations for charmed baryon physics in the BESIII experiment. The framework is implemented through large-scale pre-training on Monte Carlo simulation samples and subsequent fine-tuning for downstream analyses. Using the production and decays of the charmed baryon Łambda_c⁺ as a benchmark, we develop pre-trained models for both event classification and momentum-direction regression. The classification model learns discriminative event representations for the dominant physics categories, rejecting 97.0% of background events at a signal efficiency of 90.0%. Across 12 benchmark Łambda_c⁺ decay channels, fine-tuning from the pre-trained model achieves performance comparable or better than training from scratch, with particularly clear improvements in low-statistics regimes. For the regression task, the pre-trained model improves the momentum-direction prediction across the same benchmark channels. Further improvement is obtained after fine-tuning in the representative semileptonic decay Łambda_c⁺ → p K⁻ e⁺ νₑ. This strategy provides a scalable solution for a wide range of physics cases at BESIII and can be extended to other high energy experiments.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于Particle Transformer的框架，用于在BESIII实验的粲重子物理中学习可迁移事件表征。该方法通过大规模蒙特卡洛样本预训练并在下游分析中微调，以Λc⁺的产生与衰变为基准开展分类和动量方向回归。结果显示，预训练模型在背景抑制、低统计量通道性能提升以及动量方向预测方面具有优势，并可推广到BESIII及其他高能物理实验的多类应用。
authors: Kaixuan Huang, Yangu Li, Junpeng Zhao, Peilian Li, Peirong Li, Xiaorui Lyu, Yunxuan Song, Shengsen Sun, Yangheng Zheng
articles.abstract_zh_full: 深度学习已成为高能物理中的重要工具，其中学习可迁移事件表征的能力能够显著提高模型在相关物理过程之间的泛化能力。在本工作中，我们提出一个基于Particle Transformer的框架，用于在BESIII实验的粲重子物理中学习这类表征。该框架通过在蒙特卡洛模拟样本上进行大规模预训练，并随后针对下游分析进行微调来实现。以粲重子 Λc⁺ 的产生和衰变为基准，我们开发了用于事件分类和动量方向回归的预训练模型。分类模型学习了针对主要物理类别的判别性事件表征，在90.0%的信号效率下拒绝了97.0%的背景事件。在12个基准 Λc⁺ 衰变道中，从预训练模型进行微调所达到的性能与从头训练相当或更好，尤其在低统计量情形下改进特别明显。对于回归任务，预训练模型在同一组基准通道上改进了动量方向预测。在代表性的半轻子衰变 Λc⁺ → p K⁻ e⁺ νₑ 中进行微调后，进一步获得了性能提升。该策略为BESIII上的广泛物理案例提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，并可推广到其他高能实验。

articles.title: Dynamical control of light-matter interaction through coherent multipolar scattering in broken symmetry metasurfaces
articles.title_zh: 通过破缺对称性超表面中的相干多极散射动态控制光—物质相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Achieving control over spontaneous emission by tailoring light-matter interactions is a key objective in quantum nanophotonics. Metasurfaces composed of high-refractive-index resonators like silicon (Si) provide a low-loss platform that supports a variety of strong electric and magnetic multipolar resonances, offering new opportunities to tailor the local density of optical states (LDOS). This work employs phase-resolved multipolar analysis to investigate spontaneous-emission control in symmetry-broken dielectric metasurfaces composed of Si cuboid and disk resonators. Controlled in-plane geometrical asymmetry enables hybridization between magnetic dipole (MD) and magnetic quadrupole (MQ) modes, whose coherent interaction modifies the local density of optical states (LDOS). Symmetry-broken dielectric metasurfaces are closely related to quasi-bound states in the continuum (quasi-BICs) and Fano-resonant systems, where geometrical perturbations promote coupling between weakly radiative and bright resonances. From this perspective, the observed MD-MQ hybridized states may be understood as a near-field and multipolar manifestation of symmetry-broken quasi-BIC physics. The resulting coherent magnetic multipolar interaction produces strong near-field localization and substantial spontaneous-emission enhancement for embedded emitters. For Erbium ions in broken-symmetry Si metasurfaces operating near 1.54 um, the analysis reveals pronounced enhancement associated with resonant magnetic multipolar coupling. These results establish magnetic multipolar interference as a physically transparent mechanism for emission control in low-loss dielectric metasurfaces and provide useful design guidelines for integrated quantum photonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究破缺对称性的硅介质超表面中通过磁多极共振相干耦合来控制自发辐射的机制。作者采用相位分辨多极分析，表明面内几何不对称可促使磁偶极与磁四极模式杂化，从而改变局域光学态密度并增强嵌入发射体的辐射。该机制与准连续谱束缚态和Fano共振物理相关，为低损耗集成量子光子器件提供了设计思路。
authors: Mohammed Ashahar Ahamad, Faraz Ahmed Inam
articles.abstract_zh_full: 通过调控光—物质相互作用来实现对自发辐射的控制，是量子纳米光子学中的一个关键目标。由硅（Si）等高折射率谐振器组成的超表面提供了一种低损耗平台，支持多种强电多极和磁多极共振，为调控局域光学态密度（LDOS）提供了新的机会。本工作采用相位分辨多极分析，研究由Si长方体和圆盘谐振器组成的破缺对称性介质超表面中的自发辐射控制。受控的面内几何不对称性使磁偶极（MD）和磁四极（MQ）模式之间发生杂化，其相干相互作用改变了局域光学态密度（LDOS）。破缺对称性的介质超表面与连续谱中的准束缚态（quasi-BIC）和Fano共振系统密切相关，在这些系统中，几何扰动促进弱辐射共振与明亮共振之间的耦合。从这一角度看，所观察到的MD-MQ杂化态可理解为破缺对称性准BIC物理在近场和多极层面的表现。由此产生的相干磁多极相互作用为嵌入式发射体带来了强近场局域化和显著的自发辐射增强。对于工作在约1.54 μm附近的破缺对称性Si超表面中的铒离子，分析揭示了与共振磁多极耦合相关的显著增强。这些结果确立了磁多极干涉作为低损耗介质超表面中辐射控制的一种物理上透明的机制，并为集成量子光子器件提供了有用的设计指南。

articles.title: Intestinal peristalsis and wrinkling: A novel paradigm
articles.title_zh: 肠道蠕动与起皱：一种新范式
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29204v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A new computational framework for modeling the intestinal wall as a multi-layered fiber-reinforced continuum is presented. The framework reproduces for the first time physiological motility and overcoming large-displacements limitations (self-contact and volume locking) occurring in classical hyperelastic formulations of soft tissues. We introduce: i) layer-specific functions, segregating active circumferential and longitudinal muscle fibers while maintaining homogeneous passive reinforcement, and ii) a quasi-incompressible volumetric contribution, to handle large peristaltic contractions. Cell electrophysiology is further extended to reproduce both slow waves and spike bursting activities thus mimicking for the first time a localized neural excitation in a three-dimensional geometry of small intestine segment. We introduce a spatio-temporal modulation of contractility to accurately capture activation driven by both slow waves and spike bursts. The overall coupled nonlinear electromechanical boundary valued problem is modeled following the active strain approach. A robust augmented-Lagrangian contact algorithm is also embedded to avoid self-penetration and geometrical instabilities under large displacements. The 8-variables nonlinear governing equations are then discretized using in house P1-P2-P4 finite elements codes implemented within the GetFEM library. Numerical experiments demonstrate the ability of the proposed framework to reproduce physiological peristalsis, i.e., wall contraction greater than 80%, thus allowing full occlusion matching in vivo endoscopic images, and naturally generating wrinkling patterns consistent with experimental observations. We show that an active electromechanics anisotropic heterogeneous modeling strategy is critical for a numerically stable and physiologically accurate representation of gastrointestinal motility.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种将肠壁建模为多层纤维增强连续体的新计算框架，首次再现生理性动力并克服经典软组织超弹性公式中的大位移限制。模型引入分层肌纤维功能、准不可压体积项、扩展细胞电生理和时空调制收缩性，并结合主动应变方法与接触算法。数值实验表明，该框架可稳定再现超过80%的肠壁收缩、完全闭合以及与实验一致的起皱模式。
authors: René Thierry Djoumessi, Christopher Miller, Nipuni D. Nagahawatte, Marco Paggi, Leo K. Cheng, Alessio Gizzi
articles.abstract_zh_full: 本文提出了一种新的计算框架，用于将肠壁建模为多层纤维增强连续体。该框架首次再现了生理性动力，并克服了软组织经典超弹性公式中出现的大位移限制（自接触和体积锁定）。我们引入了：i）层特异性函数，在保持均匀被动增强的同时，将主动环向和纵向肌纤维分离；以及 ii）准不可压的体积贡献，以处理大幅度蠕动收缩。细胞电生理模型进一步扩展，以同时再现慢波和尖峰爆发活动，从而首次在小肠节段的三维几何中模拟局部神经兴奋。我们引入了收缩性的时空调制，以准确捕捉由慢波和尖峰爆发共同驱动的激活。整体耦合非线性电机械边值问题按照主动应变方法进行建模。还嵌入了一种稳健的增广拉格朗日接触算法，以避免大位移下的自穿透和几何不稳定性。随后，使用在GetFEM库中实现的自研P1-P2-P4有限元代码，对8变量非线性控制方程进行离散。数值实验展示了所提出框架再现生理性蠕动的能力，即肠壁收缩超过80%，从而实现与体内内窥镜图像相匹配的完全闭合，并自然产生与实验观察一致的起皱模式。我们表明，主动电机械各向异性异质建模策略对于胃肠动力的数值稳定且生理准确的表示至关重要。

articles.title: Integrated tunable magnonic devices for beyond 6 GHz signal processing
articles.title_zh: 面向6 GHz以上信号处理的集成可调谐磁振子器件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.29257v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the search for novel technology platforms supporting the transition towards ''beyond 6G'' telecommunications, magnonics is emerging as a viable route, primarily due to its intrinsic compatibility with the UWB-FR3 bands and its easy tunability. In this paper, we present a proof-of-concept device based on a CoFeB magnonic waveguide, fully integrated on silicon, which demonstrates all the key features of our integration approach, based on co-integrated hard magnetic micromagnets, magnonic conduits, reconfigurable soft magnetic elements and MEMS. The bias field enabling operation up to about 12 GHz is provided by SmCo micromagnets embedded in the silicon substrate. Real-time tunability is implemented in two ways.
